eng: I'm starting to think the US government sent a fake one to us, because that woman looks too old and motherly to be Hillary!
swa: Naanza kufikiri kuwa serikali ya Marekani ilimtumia Clinton wa uongo, kwa sababu yule mwanamke anaonekana mzee sana na jimama kuwa Clinton wa kweli.

eng: Not everybody was cheering the visit of Hillary Clinton in Indonesia.
swa: Siyo kila mmoja aliyeshangilia ziara ya Hillary Clinton nchini Indonesia.

eng: Picture from Jakarta Today
swa: Picha kutoka kwa Jakarta Today.

eng: Andreas Harsono wanted Clinton to raise the issues of religious freedom, impunity, and military reform during her visit:
swa: Andreas Harsono alitaka Clinton aongelee masuala ya uhuru wa kidini, usawa katika sheria na mageuzi ya kijeshi wakati wa ziara yake:

eng: (Clinton) should be careful not to say that Muslims in Indonesia are “moderate,” as most diplomatic visitors like to say. 	(Clinton) awe muangalifu na asiseme kuwa Waislamu wa Indonesia wana "siasa za wastani" kama wanavyosema wanadiplomasia wageni.
For members of persecuted religious groups in Indonesia, it is a useless and inaccurate cliche.
swa: Kwa wanachama wa makundi ya kidini yanayokandamizwa nchini Indonesia, tamko hilo halina maana na ni kauli mbiu potofu.

eng: Concern over rising religious intolerance is not the only human rights issue Clinton should raise with President Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono. 	Mashaka ya ongezeko la kutokuvumiliana kidini sio suala pekee ambalo Clinton angeliongelea na Rais Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono.
Freedom of expression is also a huge problem on islands where ethnic minorities show their resistance toward the Indonesian state.
swa: Uhuru wa kujieleza pia ni tatizo kubwa katika visiwa vidogo ambako makabila madogo yanaonyesha upinzani kwa dola ya Indonesia.

eng: But in Indonesia, even peaceful acts like a flag raising can land you in jail for a long time "Clinton may be tempted to gloss over issues like religious freedom, impunity, and military reform, in favor of closer Indonesian-US ties.
swa: Katika Indonesia, hata vitendo vya amani kama vile kupandisha bendera vinaweza kukupeleka jela kwa muda mrefu. Clinton anaweza kushawishika kupamba masuala kama uhuru wa kidini, usawa katika sheria na mageuzi ya kijeshi ili kuboresha uhusiano wa Marekani na Indonesia.

eng: But if she does, she’ll miss a golden opportunity to transform the lives of many people in Indonesia who need pressure on the government to recognize their rights."
swa: Na kama akifanya hivyo, atapoteza fursa ya kubadilisha maisha ya watu wengi nchini Indonesia ambao wanataka serikali ishinikizwe kutambua haki zao.

eng: Via Twitter, below are some reactions to the Clinton visit:
swa: Kupitia huduma ya Twita yafuatayo ni maoni yanayohusu ziara ya Clinton:

eng: waxinglyrical: someone asked who is Hillary Clinton??
swa: waxinglyrical: kuna mtu ameuliza hillary Clinton ni nani?

eng: mirageinblue: saw hillary clinton at the lobby. awesome oplet: Obama Fans Club stages protest against Hillary Clinton in Jakarta, saying they're just not that into her since presidential race
swa: Safi sana oplet: Klabu ya mashabiki wa Obama wanafanya maandamano kumopinga Hillary Clinton mjini Jakarta, wanasema hawampendi tangu wakati wa kugombea nafasi ya kugombea urais.

eng: Picture from Flickr page of US Department of State
swa: Picha kutoka ukurasa wa Flickr wa Idara ya Mambo ya Nje ya Marekani

eng: An interactive map of endangered languages, showing 2,500 out of 6,000 tongues at risk, has been released by the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO).
swa: Ramani shirikishi ya lugha zinazopotea, inayoonyesha lugha 2,500 kati ya 6,000 ambazo ziko hatarini, imezinduliwa na Shirika la Elimu, Sayansi na Utamaduni la Umoja wa Mataifa (UNESCO).

eng: The international organization asks users to contribute comments to a project that has many bloggers worried about preserving cultures.
swa: Shirika hilo la kimataifa linawaomba watumiaji wachangie kwa kutuma maoni kwenye mradi huo ambao unawatia mashaka wanablogu wengi wenye nia ya kuhifadhi tamaduni.

eng: Iglesia Descalza, a librarian, blogs:
swa: Mkutubu, Iglesia Descalza anablogu:

eng: As someone who loves languages, I am chagrined to read the news coming out of UNESCO's presentation of the updated Atlas of the World’s Languages in Danger of Disappearing.
swa: Nikiwa mmojawapo wa watu wanaopenda lugha, ninasikitishwa ninaposoma habari zinazotoka wakati wa kutolewa kwa Kitabu kipya cha ramani ya lugha zilizo Hatarini kutoweka Duniani cha UNESCO.

eng: According to the Atlas, unveiled on the eve of International Mother Language Day (21 February), nearly 200 languages have fewer than 10 speakers and 178 others have between 10 and 50 speakers.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa kitabu hicho cha ramani, kilichozinduliwa kwenye mkesha wa Siku ya Kimataifa ya Lugha (21 Februari), karibu ya lugha 200 zina wazungumzaji pungufu ya 10 na lugha nyingine 178 zina wazungumzaji kati ya 10 na 50.

eng: The data shows that out of the 6,000 languages currently in existence, over 200 have died out over the last three generations, 538 are critically endangered, 502 severely endangered, 632 definitely endangered and 607 unsafe.
swa: Takwimu zinaonyesha kuwa kati ya lugha 6,000 zilizopo sasa, zaidi ya 200 zimetoweka katika vizazi vitatu vilivyopita, 38 ziko hatarini kabisa, 502 ziko hatarini sana, 632 ziko hatarini bila ya shaka na 607 haziko salama.

eng: As the last remaining speakers of a language pass away, the language itself dies.
swa: Wazungumzaji wa mwisho wa lugha wanapofariki, na lugha pia hufariki.

eng: The language of Manx in the Isle of Man died out in 1974 when Ned Maddrell, the last speaker, passed away while Eyak, in Alaska, United States, met its demise last year with the death of Marie Smith Jones.
swa: Lugha ya Ki-Manx katika kisiwa cha Man ilitoweka mwaka 1974 wakati Ned Maddrell, mzungumzaji pekee wa lugha hiyo alipofariki wakati lugha ya Ki-eyak huko Alaska Marekani, ilikumbana na maangamizi mwaka jana kilipotokea kifo cha Marie Smith Jones.

eng: We need to prize bio-diversity, cultural and racial diversity, and linguistic diversity because we lose too much by becoming homogenized into one big, white, English-speaking society.
swa: Inatubidi tuuenzi uwingi wa kibaiolojia, uwingi wa tamaduni na rangi za watu, pamoja na uwingi wa lugha kwa sababu tunapoteza mambo mengi mno kadiri tunavyozidi kumezwa na jamii moja kubwa nyeupe, inayoongea Kiingereza.

eng: While disappearing languages are mostly those of indigenous peoples faced with globalization and state-nationalism, Daniel Moving Out, a blog by a Portugal native now in the UK, says not all “unofficial” languages are dying out:
swa: Huku lugha zinazopotea nyingi zake ni zile za watu watu wa makabila wanaokumbwa na utandawazi na utaifa wa dola, Daniel Moving Out, blogu ya mwanablogu wa kireno anayeishi uingereza kwa sasa, inasema siyo lugha zote "zisizo rasmi" ambazo zinakufa.

eng: The Galician sounds like a cross between Spanish and Portuguese, somewhat like a dialect originated from the second and enriched with vocabulary and accent of the first.
swa: Lugha ya Ki-Galisia inasikika kama vile ni mchanganyiko wa Kihispania na Kireno, kana kwamba ni lugha iliyotokana na Kireno na kuboreshwa na misamiati na lafudhi za Kihispania.

eng: The language is originated from the Galician-Portuguese of medieval times, and it was spoken at all the County of Portucale.
swa: Lugha hiyo asili yake ni Ki-Galisia na Kireno cha zama za kale, na ilikuwa ikizungumzwa katika jimbo lote la Portucale

eng: This week, the Unesco atlas of world languages was released, regarding Galician as a strong language among those that are not the main languages of any country.
swa: Wiki hii, kitabu cha ramani za lugha cha UNESCO kilitolewa, na kudai kwamba Ki-Galisia ni moja ya lugha zenye nguvu ambazo si lugha kuu katika nchi yoyote.

eng: It receives protection from the Castilian (common Spanish) from being geographically close to Portugal.
swa: Inalindwa na Ki-Kastilia (Kihispania cha kawaida) kutokana na kuwa karibu na Ureno kijiografia.

eng: The blog, nonetheless, summarizes some of the worst data:
swa: Blogu hiyo inaandika muhtasari wa takwimu mbaya zaidi:

eng: 199 languages have less than a dozen of native speakers.
swa: Lugha 199 zina wazungumzaji wa asili pungufu ya kumi na wawili.

eng: In Indonesia, the 4 remaining speakers of Lengilu talk within ; the Karaim in Ukraine is kept by only 6 people.
swa: Katika Indonesia, wazungumzaji 4 waliobakia wa Ki-lengilu wanaongea miongoni mwao ; Ki-Karaim nchini Ukraine kinatunzwa na watu 6 tu.

eng: Over than 200 different languages have disappeared in the last 3 generations.
swa: Zaidi ya lugha 200 nyingine zimetoweka katika vizazi 3 vilivyopita.

eng: The Manx, from the Isle of Man, here in the UK died with the last native speaker in 1974.
swa: Ki-Manx, kutoka Kisiwa cha Man, hapa uingereza kilitokomea na mzungumzaji wake pekee mwaka 1974.

eng: But not everyone is concerned with disappearing languages.
swa: Lakini si kila mmoja anayejali kupotea kwa lugha.

eng: Commenting on TED blog, user Magnus Lindkvist says:
swa: Akitoa maoni kwenye blogu ya TED blog, Magnus Lindkvist anasema:

eng: Why do we insist on romanticizing ancient languages that arguably noone wants to speak anymore?
swa: kwa nini tunaendelea kuzikumbatia lugha za kale ambazo hakuna anyetaka kuziongea tena?

eng: What about the hundreds of new programming languages that have sprung up in the past decades?
swa: Vipi kuhusu mamia ya lugha mpya za 'Ki-programu' (agh. kwenye tarakilishi) ambazo zimechepuka katika miongo iliyopita?

eng: Or the infinite variations of English that people are adopting and "remixing" to make their own around the world?
swa: Au aina mbalimbali za Kiingereza ambazo watu wanazipokea na "kuzichanganya tena" na kuzifanya zao wenyewew duniani kote?

eng: These are real languages and show a lot more vitality than Manx and Tirahi.
swa: Hizi ni lugha za kweli na zinaonyesha uwezo zaidi ya Ki-Manx na Ki-Tirahi.

eng: Abdullah Waheed, a native speaker of Dhivehi – an "official" language yet one with not many speakers in Maldives – explains in one example why language preservation matters:
swa: Abdullah Waheed, mzungumzaji asilia wa Ki-Dhivehi - lugha "rasmi" ambayo haina wazungumzaji wengi visiwani Maldives - anafafanua katika mfano mmoja ni kwa nini uhifadhi wa lugha ni muhimu:

eng: Dhivehi language is absolutely vital to the identity of Maldivians as a people and Maldives as a country, because it is the only feature we all share and which few others have.
swa: Lugha ya Ki-Dhivehi ni ya muhimu sana kwa utambuzi wa watu wa Maldive kama watu na pia kama nchi, kwa sababu hilo ndilo jambo pekee tunaloshiriki wote na ambalo ni wengine wachache tu wanalo.

eng: It is a strategic factor in our advances towards sustainable development and the harmonious coordination of our affairs.
swa: Ni moja mkakati wa muhumi tunapoelekea kwenye maendeleo endelevu na uratibu muwafaka wa mambo yetu.

eng: Far from being a field reserved for writers, Dhivehi lies at the heart of all social, economic and cultural life.
swa: Mbali ya kuwa ni kitengo kilichotengwa kwa ajili ya waandishi peke yake, Ki-Dhiveli kipo katikati ya ya maisha yote ya kijamii, kiuchumi na kitamaduni.

eng: Dhivehi does matter to all of us.
swa: Ki-Dhiveli kinatuhusu sote.

eng: It matters when we want to promote cultural diversity, and fight illiteracy, and it matters for quality education, including teaching in the first years of schooling.
swa: Kinatuhusu pale tunapotaka kutangaza uwingi wa tamaduni, na kupigana na ujinga, na kinahusu kiwango cha elimu, pamoja na ufundishaji katika miaka ya mwanzo ya elimu.

eng: It matters in the fight for greater social inclusion, for creativity, economic development and safeguarding indigenous knowledge.
swa: Kinahusu katika mapambano kwa ajili ya ujumuishaji wa jamii , kwa ajili ya ubunifu, maendeleo ya kiuchumi na kulinda ufahamu wa watu wa makabila.

eng: After weeks of largely peaceful protests in the French overseas departments of Guadeloupe and Martinique, things took a violent turn on Monday, as police and demonstrators clashed in Guadeloupe's largest city, Pointe-à-Pitre.
swa: Baada ya wiki za maandamano ya amani katika Idara za Ng'ambo za Ufaransa za Guadeloupe na Martinique, mambo yaligeuka na kuwa ghasia siku ya jumatatu, polisi na waandamanaji walipambana katika jiji kubwa la Guadeloupe, Pointe-a-Pitre.

eng: Workers are protesting skyrocketing unemployment and the rising costs of basic necessities, many of which are imported from France.
swa: Wafanyakazi wanapinga ukosefu wa ajira unaoongezeka pamoja na kupanda kwa bei za bidhaa muhimu, ambazo nyingi zake huagizwa kutoka Ufaransa.

eng: On the citizen media website, Agoravox, Illiouchine, a métropolitain , describes the scene in Guadeloupe this weekend and the calm that followed Monday night's violence, an unfortunate turn of events
swa: Katika tovuti ya uandishi wa kiraia, Agoravox, Illiouchine, metropolitanin , anaelezea hali ilivyokuwa katika Guadeloupe mwishoni mwa juma na utulivu uliofuatia baada ya ghasia za usiku wa Jumatatu.

eng: Last weekend, the Haitian blogosphere was buzzing about the exclusion of political parties from the April 2009 Senatorial elections by the Conseil Electoral Provisoire or Temporary Electoral Council - and on Friday January 6th, the CEP published a list of the candidates for the next democratic parliamentary elections in Haiti.
swa: Mwishoni mwa juma lililopita, ulimwengu wa wanablogu wa Kihaiti ulikuwa umejaa habari za kutengwa kwa vyama vya siasa na Tume ya muda mfupi ya uchaguzi kwenye uchaguzi wa maseneta utakaofanyika mwezi Aprili 2009 , na siku ya tarehe 6 Januari, tume hiyo, CEP, ilichapisha orodha ya wagombea ubunge watakaokwaana kwenye uchaguzi ujao wa bunge nchini Haiti.

eng: Vario Sérant presents in Alterpresse a list of the rejected candidates:
swa: Kwenye blogu ya Alterpresse , Vario Serant ameweka orodha ya wagombea walioachwa:

eng: Danny Boyle's Slumdog Millionaire, a British social film based on a novel set out in India made a clean sweep at the The 81st Academy Awards Ceremony.
swa: Filamu ya Danny Boyle, Slumdog Millionaire, iliyotokana na kitabu chenye maudhui ya India imefanya vyema katika sherehe za 81 za tuzo ya Academy.

eng: Its British and Indian crews bagged 8 awards including the best picture award.
swa: Wahusika wake kutoka Uingereza na India walitia kapuni zawadi 8 ikiwemo ile ya Picha Bora.

eng: It was truly India's day as 'Smile Pinky', another short documentary based in India also won an Oscar.
swa: Kwa hakika ilikuwa ni siku ya India, kwa kuwa filamu nyingine fupi 'Smile Pinky' pia ilishinda tuzo ya Oscar.

eng: A section of the 'Slumdog Millionaire' casts in Hollywood- photo by Flickr User KaushiK™, used under a creative commons license
swa: Sehemu ya waigizaji wa filamu ya Slumdog Millionaire wakiwa Hollywood - picha kwa hisani ya mtumiaji wa Twita KaushiK™,kwa idhini ya hati miliki za umma.

eng: People from all over the world watched the awards ceremony.
swa: Watu duniani kote waliangalia sherehe za kutoa tuzo.

eng: Some were live blogging the event like Sepia Mutiny.
swa: Wengine walikuwa wakiblogu moja kwa moja, kama vile Sepia Mutiny.

eng: There were hundred of Twitter messages appearing in a minute during the live transmission where voices like Raajesh said:
swa: Kulikuwa na mamia ya jumbe za Twita zinazoandikwa kila dakika wakati wa matangazo ambapo kama sauti ya Raajesh ilivyosema:

eng: Prerna at No Borders and Binaries said:
swa: Prerna wa No Borders and Binaries aliandika:

eng: A horde of Indian invaders and their British allies on tourist visas took home the coveted and prized Oscars as the world watched.
swa: Majeshi ya wavamizi wa Kihindi pamoja na maswahiba wao wenye viza za kitalii wamenyakua tuzo inayotamaniwa na kuthaminiwa ya Oscar huku dunia ikiangalia.

eng: One in particular, A R Rahman, dazzled and charmed everyone with his musical genius while also speaking sentences in Tamil.
swa: A R Rahman aliwashangaza na kuwachangamsha wote kwa kipaji chake cha muziki wakati akiongea pia sentensi za lugha ya Kitamil.

eng: This is America, English-only!!
swa: Hii ni Marekani, Kiingereza-kitupu!!

eng: And of course there were many who did not like Indians invading the Oscars:
swa: Kadhalika kulikuwa na wale ambao hawakupenda Wahindi kuvamia sherehe za Oscar:

eng: But many Indian bloggers were tepid in acknowledging the feat of 'Slumdog Millionaire'.
swa: Lakini wanablogu wengi wa Kihindi waliupokea ushindi wa Slumdog Millionaire kwa furaha ya wastani.

eng: We highlighted the mixed reactions of many Indians about this movie in an earlier post in Global Voices.
swa: Tumewakilisha mchanganyiko wa maoni ya Wahindi wengi kuhusu filamu hii katika makala ya mwanzo ya Global voices.

eng: Many slum-dwellers in Mumbai, where the movie was shot, have protested because they were called slumdog in that movie.
swa: Wakazi wengi wanaoishi kwenye vitongoji visivyo na mpangilio mjini Mumbai ambko filamu hii ilichukuliwa, wameipinga kwa sababu wamepachikwa jina la mbwa koko wa mitaani au 'slumdog' katika filamu hiyo:

eng: Meera Sinha writes:
swa: Mwanablogu, Meera Sinha anaandika:

eng: Despite feeling that Slumdog Millionaire shouldn’t be viewed as a defining film about Indian poverty, it’s been exciting to see India in the limelight after the movie’s 8 Oscar wins.
swa: Pamoja na hisia kwamba filamu ya Slumdog Millionaire haitakiwi kuchukuliwa kama filamu kielelezo ya umasikini wa Wahindi, imekuwa ni jambo la kusisimua kuiona India ikiwa katika mwangaza baada ya filamu hiyo kunyakua tuzo 8 za Oscar.

eng: I’m tempted to write more, but I’ll give into the celebratory moment and avoid going into any further detail about my issues with the film.
swa: Ninashawishika kuandika zaidi, lakini ni budi niingie kwenye chereko na kuepuka kuandika zaidi kero zangu zinazoihusu filamu hiyo.

eng: Great Bong at Random Thoughts Of A Demented Mind was not too impressed either:
swa: Bloga Great Bong wa Random Thoughts Of A Demented Mind kadhalika hakuvutiwa:

eng: For one, Slumdog Millionaire very deliberately and very effectively strikes many of the chords that Academy judges have been known to have a soft spot for.
swa: Sababu moja, filamu ya Slumdog Millionaire kwa makusudi na kwa ufanisi mkubwa inagusa hisia ambazo waamuzi wa tuzo hiyo wanajulikana kuwa nazo.

eng: In order to ace an exam, you do not necessarily have to be the best —even an average person can excel if he/she can understand the “system” and do exactly what is expected.
swa: Ili kufaulu mtihani, sio lazima uwe mahiri zaidi - hata mtu wa wastani anaweza kufanya vizuri kama unaufahamu "mfumo" na akifanya yale ambayo yanatarajiwa.

eng: Slumdog Millionaire does that admirably.
swa: Filamu ya Slumdog Millionaire imefanya vizuri sana kwenye jambo hili.

eng: Hitesh Bagai wonders in a twitter message:
swa: Hitesh Bagai anajiuliza katika ujumbe wa Twita:

eng: Lekhni at The imagined Universe tries to find "Why do Indians hate Slumdog Millionaire?"
swa: Lekhni wa The Imagined Universe anajaribu kupata sababu ya kwa nini Wahindi wanaichukia filamu ya Slumdog Millionaire:

eng: I wonder if our main objection to the movie is because it depicts a part of India we’d rather not focus on.
swa: Najiuliza ikiwa pingamizi letu kuu kwa filamu hii ni kwa sababu inaonyesha sehemu ya India ambayo hatupendi kuitazama.

eng: We’d like to celebrate our economic growth and our resurgent middle class.
swa: Tungependa kushangilia mafanikio yetu ya uchumi na ongezeko la watu wa tabaka la kati.

eng: We’d like to point to our new malls and glass-fronted buildings.
swa: Tungependa kuonyesha maduka makubwa ya kisasa na majengo ya vioo.

eng: The movie does not show much of the prosperity of middle class India.
swa: Filamu hii haionyeshi utajiri wa watu wa India wa tabaka la kati.

eng: It shows the other India that not many of us know very well, or would like to think about - the poor India that has remained poor despite all the recent economic growth.
swa: Inaonyesha India nyingine ambayo wengi wetu tunaifahamu fika, au tusiyopenda kuifikiria - India ya masikini iliyobakia masikini pamoja na maendeleo ya kiuchumi ya hivi karibuni.

eng: Shripriya Mahesh at Tatvam (Inner Truth) loved the movie and writes:
swa: Shripriya Mahesh wa Tatvam (Ukweli wa ndani) ameipenda hiyo filamu na anaandika:

eng: Why on earth should any filmmaker be burdened with representing a city or a country?
swa: Ni kwa nini mtengeneza filamu yeyote ajitwike mzigo wa kuuwakilisha mji au nchi?

eng: He’s not making a documentary.
swa: Hatengenezi filamu ya matukio ya kweli.

eng: There’s a story to be told.
swa: Kuna hadithi ya kusimulia.

eng: It involves a sliver of a view of a city.
swa: Inahusisha picha ndogo ya mtazamo wa mji.

eng: From the point of view of one fictitious life.
swa: Kutokea kwenye mtazamo wa maisha ya mhusika.

eng: The filmmaker’s job is to tell that story to the best of his/her ability.
swa: Kazi ya mtengeneza filamu ni kusimulia hadithi hiyo kwa uwezo wake wote.

eng: And that’s exactly what Danny Boyle did.
swa: Na hivyo ndivyo Danny Boyle alivyofanya.

eng: And I for one, loved the result.
swa: Na mimi, nimeyapenda matokeo.

eng: Prerna highlights India's capabilities and concluds with:
swa: Prerna anongelea uwezo wa India na anahitimisha:

eng: Sure, it took a British director to make a movie on an ‘Indian subject’ to get Oscars for Indian technicians who have been doing superior work for decades (i.e. Gulzar, A R Rahman, Pookutty).
swa: Ndio, imembidi Mkurungenzi wa filamu kutoka Uingereza kutengeneza filamu yenye 'maudhui ya India' ili kuwapatia tuzo ya Oscar mafundi wa Kihindi ambao wamekuwa wakifanya kazi nzuri kwa miongo mingi (yaani akina Gulzar, A R Rahman, Pookutty).

eng: Slumdog Millionaire is nowhere near the A-list of Bollywood movies given it’s simple tried-and-tested theme of love over money.
swa: Slumdog Millionaire haiwezi kuzikaribia filamu za orodha-A za Bollywood ukichukulia uzoefu wake katika maudhui ya mapenzi yanayoshinda fedha.

eng: And this isn’t A R Rahman or Gulzaar’s best work.
swa: Na hii sio moja ya kazi bora zaidi za Rahman au Gulzaar.

eng: At the same time, it is heartening to see these musical greats finally getting international recognition for what is ultimately an Indian movie.
swa: Wakti huo huo, ni jambo zuri kuwaona hawa mahiri wa muziki, hatimaye wanapata kutambuliwa ulimwenguni kutokana na filamu ambayo ni ya Kihindi.

eng: However, THAT should not be a marker for success.
swa: Hata hivyo, HIYO isiwe ndio kielelezo cha mafanikio.

eng: AR Rahman doesn’t need Hollywood; Hollywood needs him.
swa: AR Rahman haihitaji Hollywood; Holywood inamuhitaji yeye.

eng: Congratulations nonetheless, to Slumdog Millionaire and to every Indian that considers this their movie.
swa: Hongera kwa Slumdog millionaire na kwa Muhindi yeyote anayeipokea filamu hii kama filamu ya Kihindi.

eng: I feel guilty writing about divorce and polygamy on Valentine’s Day.
swa: Najihisi nina hatia ninapoandika kuhusu talaka na ndoa za mitala wakati wa siku ya wapendanao ya Valentino.

eng: But these two unmentionable topics are also realities of love and relationships.
swa: Lakini mada hizi zisizotamkika ni ukweli wa mapenzi na mahusiano.

eng: In Indonesia, more women are divorcing their husbands because of polygamy.
swa: Katika Indonesia, wanawake wengi wanawataliki waume zao kwa sababu ya mitala.

eng: Records show that in 2006 there were nearly 1000 cases of divorce because of husbands marrying another woman.
swa: Takwimu zinaonyesha kuwa mwaka 2006 kulikuwa na karibu ya kesi 1000 za talaka zilizotokana na mume kuoa mke mwingine.

eng: Polygamous marriages are also increasing - the Legal Aid Foundation of the Indonesian Women's Association for Justice received 87 reports of polygamy in 2008, up from 16 in 2007.
swa: Ndoa za mitala pia zinaongezeka - Asasi ya Msaada wa Sheria ya Jumuiya ya Haki za Wanawake wa Indonesia ilipokea taarifa 87 za mitala mwaka 2008, ongezeko kutoka taarifa 16 katika mwaka 2007.

eng: More women in polygamous marriages are becoming more assertive about their rights.
swa: Wanawake zaidi walio katika ndoa za mitala wanaanza kusisitizia haki zao.

eng: Abdul Khalik writing for The Jakarta Post quotes the views of scholars about this issue:
swa: Abdul Khalik anayeandika kwenye The Jarkata Post ananukuu mitazamo ya wanazuoni kuhusu suala hili:

eng: Director General for Islamic guidance at the Ministry for Religious Affairs Nasaruddin Umar: "There has been a significant increase in divorce because women have been rejecting polygamy in recent years.”
swa: Mkurugenzi Mkuu wa miongozo ya Kiislamu katika Wizara ya Mambo ya Dini, Nasaruddin Umar: "Kumekuwepo na ongezeko kubwa la talaka kwa sababu wanawake wameanza kupinga ndoa za mitala katika miaka ya karibuni."

eng: Muslim scholar Siti Musdah Mulia: “The data shows women are now daring to fight for their rights and reject male domination.
swa: Mwanazuoni wa Kiislamu Siti Musdah Mulia: "Takwimu zinaonyesha kuwa wanawake hivi sasa wanathubutu kupigania haki zao na kupinga utawala wa wanaume.

eng: They are now saying, 'What is the point in continuing a marriage when I am miserable'"
swa: Hivi sasa wanasema, 'ina maana gani kuendelea na ndoa wakati ninasononeka'"

eng: Divorce in general has risen in Indonesia in the past decade.
swa: Kwa ujumla talaka zimeongezeka katika Indonesia kwenye mwongo mmoja uliopita.

eng: A news report early this month confirmed this trend; and couples are also separating because of political differences:
swa: Habari moja mwanzoni mwa mwezi huu ilithibitisha mwelekeo huu; na kadhalika wanandoa wanatengana kutokana na tofauti za kisiasa:

eng: The divorce rate jumped from an average of 20,000 a year to more than 200,000 a year over the decade Believe it or not, some couples decide to divorce because the husband and wife have different takes on political issues.
swa: Wastani wa talaka ulipanda kutoka 20,000 kwa mwaka kufikia zaidi ya 200,000 kwa mwaka katika kipindi cha miaka kumi. Amini usiamini, wanandoa wengine huamua kutengana kwa sababu mume na mke wana mwelekeo tofauti kuhusu masuala ya siasa.

eng: This has never happened before,” said Umar.
swa: Hili halikuwahi kutokea hapo awali," alisema Umar.

eng: In 2005, 105 couples cited political differences as the cause of their split but this figure jumped to 502 couples in 2006.
swa: Mwaka 2005, wanandoa 105 walitaja tofauti za kisiasa kama sababu ya kuachana lakini idadi hii iliongezeka kufikia wanandoa 502 mwaka 2006.

eng: Figures for 2007 and 2008 were yet to be calculated.
swa: Takwimu za mwaka 2007 na 2008 hazijajumlishwa bado.

eng: The official said 90 per cent of marriages between people of different religions ended in divorce
swa: Ofisa huyo alisema asilimia 90 ya ndoa kati watu wa dini tofauti huisha kwa talaka.

eng: Indonesia Matters cites a 2007 study about the causes of divorce:
swa: Indonesian Matters inanukuu ripoti ya mwaka 2007 kuhusu sababu za talaka:

eng: The main causes of divorce, says a report by the National Child Protection Commission (Komnas PA), are economic pressures (23%), followed by domestic squabbling (19%), incompatibilty (19%), interference by relatives (14%), violence (12%), adultery (8%), and sexual problems (3.6%).
swa: Ripoti ya Tume ya Taifa ya Kulinda Watoto (Komnas PA) inasema kuwa sababu kubwa za talaka ni mashinikizo ya kiuchumi (asilimia 23), ikifuatiwa na ugomvi katika unyumba (asilimia 19), kutopatana (asilimia 19) kuingiliwa na ndugu (asilimia 14), vurugu (asilimia 12), uzinzi (asilimia 8) na matatizo ya kingono (asilimia 3.6).

eng: However these figures are based on only 109 cases
swa: Takwimu hizi, hata hivyo, zimekusanywa kutoka katika kesi 109 tu

eng: A 2008 article cites the causes of divorce:
swa: Makala moja ya mwaka 2008 inanukuu sababu za talaka kama ifuatavyo:

eng: incompatibility (because of adultery) - 54000 cases
swa: kutopatana ( kutokana na uzinzi) - kesi 54000

eng: disharmony - 46000
swa: Kutoelewana - 46000

eng: economic hardship - 24000
swa: Hali ngumu ya uchumi - 24000

eng: interference by relatives - 9000
swa: Kuingiliwa na ndugu - 9000

eng: family crisis - 4700
swa: Matatizo ya kifamilia - 4700

eng: forced marriage - 1700
swa: Ndoa za kulazimishwa - 1700

eng: domestic violence - 900
swa: Ugomvi wa ndani ya nyumba - 900

eng: polygamy - 879
swa: Mitala - 879

eng: biological defect (like infertility) - 580
swa: Matatizo ya kibaiolojia (kama vile ugumba) - 580

eng: underage marriage - 284
swa: Ndoa kabla ya umri wa ndoa - 284

eng: imprisonment - 150
swa: Kufungwa jela - 150

eng: political differences – 157
swa: Tofauti za kisiasa - 157

eng: It is difficult to be a divorcee in Indonesia.
swa: Ni vigumu kuwa mtalikiwa katika Indonesia.

eng: My Busy Brain explains:
swa: Bloga My Busy Brain anafafanua:

eng: Some people, in Indonesia that is (I don’t know about other countries), divorce is not a choice.
swa: Watu wengine katika Indonesia (sijui nchi nyingine), talaka si chaguo.

eng: Even if the marriage is not healthy, even if it is abusive, one choose to be still married because either cannot imagine living by themselves, too tired and just accept that this is fate , or economically dependant (usually woman).
swa: Hata kama ndoa haina afya, hata kama ndoa yenyewe ni ya mateso, mtu huamua kuendelea na ndoa kwa sababu pengine hawezi kufikiria kuishi peke yake, amechoka sana na anakubali kuwa hiyo ndiyo hatima yake, au ni mtegemezi (hususan kwa wanawake).

eng: This morning I was bombed by an email that I received from my friend from highschool, that he is not doing well and lost 7 kgs the last 3 months because he is going through divorce.
swa: Asubuhi hii nilipigwa na barua pepe niliyopokea kutoka kwa rafiki yangu tuliyekuwa naye shule ya sekondari, kwamba haendelei vizuri na amepoteza kilo 7 katika miezi 3 iliyopita kwa sababu yumo katika mchakato wa talaka.

eng: Oh my God.
swa: Mungu wangu.

eng: Not another one.
swa: Siyo nyingine tena.

eng: Even though I myself is a divorcee, I don’t really like hearing people getting divorce because I know how painful it is
swa: Japokuwa mimi mwenyewe ni mtaliki, sipendi kusikia watu wanapewa talaka kwa kuwa nafahamu ni jinsi gani inavyouma

eng: Parvita writes more about the stigma associated with divorced women in Indonesia:
swa: Parvita naandika zaidi kuhusu unyanyapaa unaoambatana na wanawake waliotalikiwa nchini Indonesia:

eng: I have no problem being divorced, it was the right thing to do at the time and I never regret it.
swa: Sina tatizo kwamba nimetalikiwa, lilikuwa ni jambo sawa kufanya wakati ule na sijuti asilani.

eng: When people ask me where my husband is, I tell them I’m divorced.
swa: Watu wanaponiuliza mumeo yuko wapi, nawaambia kuwa tumetalikiana.

eng: Usually, they are the one that feel uncomfortable.
swa: Kwa kawaida ni wao ndio hujisikia vibaya.

eng: The sad thing that I would like to address here is, that after 3 years, the person I hoped and wished to be able to accept me for what I am, still cannot accept it and look at me as I am incomplete.
swa: Jambo la huzuni ninalotaka kusema hapa, ni kuwa baada ya miaka 3, mtu ambaye nilitarajia na kutumaini kuwa angenipokea kama nilivyo, hajaweza kuikubali hali na ananiangalia kama vile sijatimia.

eng: I am sure there are lots of women here in my country that experience that, especially from the older generation or the conservatives.
swa: Nina hakika kuwa kuna wanawake wengi katika nchi yangu ambao wanafikwa na hali hii, hasa wale wa kizazi cha zamani au wale wahafidhina.

eng: Despite of their bravery to live alone, they just stick with an unhappy marriage because afraid of what other people think, or simply because they are not independent, financially or mentally.
swa: Pamoja na ujasiri wao wa kuishi pekee, wanang'ang'ania ndoa zisizo na furaha kwa sababu wanahofia watu wengine watafikiriaje, au kwa sababu tu hawako huru, kifedha au kiakili.

eng: In Indonesia, women are considered successful not from what they have achieved, but from their husbands, how many kids they can deliver and how fat their kids are and where their kids go to school.
swa: Katika Indonesia wanawake wanaangaliwa mafanikio yao si kwa yale waliyoyafanya, bali kutokana na waume zao, ni watoto wangapi wanaweza kuzaa na watoto wao wana siha kiasi gani, na watoto wanasoma shule zipi.

eng: nin's journey was inspired by the post written by Umm Faroug about being a radical Muslim feminist:
swa: Bloga nin's journey alitiwa moyo na makala iliyoandikwa na Umm Faroug kuhusu namna ya kuwa mwanamke wa Kiislamu mwenye siasa kali:

eng: As a radical Muslim feminist I know my rights as a wife, which are to be fed, sheltered, clothed, and cared for in a way befitting to me.
swa: Nikiwa kama mwanamke wa Kiislamu mwenye siasa kali ninatambua haki zangu kama mke, ambazo ni kulishwa, kutunzwa katika makazi, kuvishwa na kuenziwa kwa hali inayonipasa.

eng: I have the right to a marriage contract which safeguards me in case of a divorce.
swa: Nina haki ya kuwa na mkataba wa ndoa unaonihakikishia haki zangu kama itatokea talaka.

eng: On a lighter note, Indosingleparent Community posts pictures of divorce cakes.
swa: Katika hali ya mzaha, Indosingleparent Community anatuma picha ya keki za talaka.

eng: Indonesian restaurateur Puspo Wardoyo offers "polygamy juice", a mixture of four tropical fruits, and "polygamy vegetables", a four-vegetable combo, in his restaurants.
swa: Mfanyabiashara ya migahawa wa Kiindonesia Puspo Wardoyo anatoa 'maji ya matunda ya ndoa za mitala', mchanganyiko wa matunda manne, na mboga za mitala, mseto wa mboga nne, kwenye migahawa yake.

eng: Thumbnail image used is from the Flickr page of Daquella Manera
swa: Picha ya kielelezo kwa hisani ya ukurasa wa Flickr wa Daquella Manera

eng: Jamaican blogger, Girl with a Purpose notes that while she does think the ban will be effective in reducing the lewd music that is heard "for probably 50% of the time...via radio and television", a large part of the responsibility lies with the adults of our society, especially parents, who need to censor themselves and realize that:
swa: Bloga wa Kijamaika, Girl With a Purpose anaandika kwamba anafikiri amri hii ya kuzuia iliyowekwa itafanikiwa kuzuia miziki michafu itakayosikilizwa “pengine kwa asilimia 50 ya muda… kupitia redio na televisheni”, wajibu mkubwa bado ni wa watu wazima katika jamii yetu, hasa wazazi, ambao inawabidi wajichunge wao wenyewe na wajue kwamba:

eng: To expose their young children to lewd and explicit music, thus making them prematurely ready and aware of sex and violent acts, is wrong.
swa: Ni makosa, kuwaachia watoto wao wasikilize miziki iliyojaa ngono na uchafu, kunawakuza watoto kabla ya wakati wao na kuwafundisha vitendo vya ngono na unyama.

eng: Another trend in these discussions is the issue of other musical genres besides dancehall (i.e. soca and calypso, hip hop, rap etc.), especially as Jamaica enters its Carnival season - a time when imported soca music takes centre stage across the island.
swa: Mwelekeo mwingine katika majadiliano haya yanahusu mitindo mingine ya muziki ukiachilkia mbali muziki wa dancehall (yaani, soca na calypso, hip hop, miziki ya kufoka n.k.), hasa kutokana na kwamba Jamaika ndiyo inaingia kwenye msimu wa Kanivali – kipindi ambacho miziki ya soca inachukua jukwaa la kati visiwani kote.

eng: Amidst cries of hypocrisy by several Jamaican artistes who feel that dancehall is being unfairly singled out, MadBull, a Jamaican blogger in Cayman, writes that he fully supports the ban and thinks it should be extended to any genre of music being considered for public airplay.
swa: Katikati ya vilio vya unafiki kutoka kwa wasanii wengi wa Kijamaika ambao wanahisi kwamba mtindo wa Dancehall pekee ndio unasakamwa, Bloga wa Kijamaika, MadBull aliyeko huko Cayman, anaandika kwamba anaunga mkono amri hiyo na anafikiri kuwa amri hiyo ienezwe na kuzuia mtindo wowote wa muziki unaotarajiwa kurushwa hewani.

eng: He exclaims on his blog:
swa: Anashangaa katika blogu yake:

eng: What about soca and hip hop and so on?
swa: Vipi kuhusu soca, hip hop na mingineyo?

eng: I don’t care what the genre is!
swa: Sijali ni mtindo upi!

eng: If the lyrics dutty, drop dem too!
swa: Kama mashairi ni machafu, nayo pia iangushwe!

eng: That's what I think!
swa: Hivyo ndivyo ninavyofikiri!

eng: Outspoken Jamaican blogger, Agostinho, published on his blog a letter he submitted to the editors of various local media in which he discusses the need for dancehall to revamp its image.
swa: Bloga wa Kijamaika mwenye siasa kali, Agostinho, alichapisha katika blogu yake barua aliyoiwasilisha kwa wahariri mbalimbali wa vyombo vya habari nchini humo ambamo alijadili haja ya muziki wa dancehall kubadili sura yake.

eng: While he acknowledges the place of dancehall music in Jamaican society and its importance as the centre of popular culture, he feels that dancehall has a responsibility to the society from which it springs to reform its image...
swa: Ilhali anaikubali nafasi ya muziki wa dancehall katika jamii ya Kijamaika na umuhimu wake katika utamaduni maarufu, anahisi kwamba muziki wa dancehall unawajibika kwa jamii iliyoikuza na unapaswa kubadili sura yake…

eng: not just in the interests of practicality given its increased powers of importance in the society, but also as a means of demonstrating its inherent versatility/creativity.
swa: Siyo tu kwa maslahi ya ukweli uliopo kwamba (muziki huo) umejiongezea nguvu na umuhimu katika jamii, bali pia kama njia ya kuonyesha ubunifu wake.

eng: The latter, as we are aware, goes beyond a focus on only themes of sex and violence.
swa: Kama tunavyofahamu, (ubunifu) unaweza kwenda zaidi ya mada za ngono na unyama.

eng: Excuses regarding a chronic lack of education on the part of many of its producers and artistes are an insult to the diversity of intelligence and depth of talent within the industry/culture.
swa: Visingizio vinavyohusu ukosefu wa elimu kati ya wengi wa watengenezaji pamoja na wasanii wa muziki huo ni kutusi akili na kina cha ubunifu uliopo kwenye utamaduni/muziki.

eng: These must yield to the more urgent demands of true national development, cultural pride and meaningful progress.
swa: Yote haya lazima yahusishwe na mahitaji yetu muhimu ya maendeleo ya taifa, kujivunia utamaduni na maendeleo ya kweli.

eng: Stunner's Afflictions also explains his thoughts on the ban.
swa: Mwanablogu Stunner’s Afflictions pia anafafanua mawazo yake kuhusu amri hiyo.

eng: He fully supports the move by the Broadcasting Commission, noting that it was long overdue:
swa: Anaunga mkono hatua hiyo ya Tume ya Utangazaji, anasema kuwa amri hiyo ilikuwa inahitajika tungu kitambo:

eng: It is their job to police what is good for public broadcast as prescribed by Television and Sound Broadcasting Regulations.
swa: Ni kazi yao kuangalia lipi ni jema kurushwa hewani kama inavyoelezwa katika Taratibu za Televisheni na Sauti.

eng: So why did they have to wait on public outcry and pressure for them to take a step to ban such material?
swa: Hivyo kwa nini walingojea mpaka umma ulipopiga kelele na kutia shinikizo ili wachukue hatua za kuzuia mambo kama hayo?

eng: What have they been doing and what are they doing, for my hard earned taxpayer dollars?
swa: Walikuwa wakifanya nini na wanafanya nini, na pesa zangu za kodi nilizozipata kwa shida?

eng: The Broadcasting Commission need to pull up their socks and this incident really shows them up.
swa: Tume ya utangazaji inabidi inabidi iongeze bidii na tukio hili linawadhihirishia.

eng: His followup post on Valentine's Day sought to remind readers of a crucial point:
swa: Makala yake iliyofuatia katika siku ya Wapendanao ya Valentino ilitaka kuwakumbusha wasomaji jambo moja muhimu:

eng: Not all of our Dancehall/Reggae music is less than desirable.
swa: Siyo miziki yetu yote ya dancehall/Reggae isiyovutia.

eng: There are still very good songs being played on our airwaves.
swa: Bado kuna miziki mizuri sana inayorushwa hewani.

eng: Since this public ban on explicit music, support has begun for more positive products to come out of the Jamaican entertainment industry.
swa: Tangu kutolewa amri ya kuzuia miziki yenye matusi, pameanza wimbi la kuunga mkono utengenezwaji wa bidhaa chanya kutoka kwa watengeneza burudani wa Kijamaika.

eng: YardFlex, tagging itself as the Ultimate Jamaican Entertainment Magazine, reported recently on Tychicus, a self-described healer and prophet who staged a one-man protest last year against "daggering", and who has since come out with some clean dances that he says are inspired by the Almighty.
swa: Yard Flex, jarida lililojipachika cheo cha Gazeti kuu la burudani Jamaika, liliripoti kuhusu Tychicus, mtu anayejiita nabii na mponyaji ambaye alifanya maandamano ya mtu mmoja kupinga nyimbo zote zinazosifu uchezaji wa muziki unaofanana na kitendo cha kufanya ngono kwa kasi au “daggering”, (tychicus) amebuni mitindo safi ya kucheza ambayo anadai imetoka kwa Muumba.

eng: This discussion is ongoing as the ban is only 10 days old and the full implementation and its effects are yet to be seen.
swa: Mjadala huu bado unaendelea kwani amri ya kuzuia ina siku 10 tu, na utekelezaji pamoja na madhara yake bado hayajaonekana.

eng: Jamaican bloggers have all come out in full support of the ban, and see this as a time for Jamaican artistes to step up and prove their creativity to the world.
swa: Wanablogu wa Jamaika wanaunga mkono amri hiyo, na wanaona kuwa huu ni wakati wa wasanii wa Jamaika kuongeza bidii na kuudhihirishia ulimwengu ubunifu wao.

eng: As the number of Internet users has been growing rapidly in Southeast Asia in recent years, online censorship has proliferated, from China to Cambodia, as if it runs through the Mekong river.
swa: Kadiri idadi ya watumiaji wa intaneti invyokua kwa haraka katika Kusini Mashariki ya Asia kwenye miaka ya hivi karibuni, na ndivyo kuchujwa kwa kwa habari kunavyozidi, kuanzia Uchina mpaka Kampuchea, kana kwamba kunafuata mkondo wa Mto Mekong.

eng: Not only the "Great Firewall of China" that is known to many people, democratic country like Thailand also blocks a large number of Web sites; in Vietnam, its Ministry of Information and Communication has recently released a circular to regulate and enforce blogging rules in the country in late 2008.
swa: Siyo tu "ukuta mkuu wa moto wa Uchina" unaojulikana na watu wengi, nchi ya kidemokrasia kama vile Thailand pia inazuia idadi kubwa ya tovuti; nchini Vietnam, wizara yake ya Habari na Mawasiliano hivi karibuni ilitoa tamko la kusimamia na kutekeleza taratibu za kublogu nchini humo tangu mwishoni mwa mwaka 2008.

eng: With rules and regulations in place, these governments have developed and deployed their own censorship machine to control how citizens publish and access online contents.
swa: Utaratibu na utekelezaji vikiwa vimeshika nafasi, serikali hizo zimeendeleza na kusimika mashine za kuchuja ili kudhibiti jinsi raia wanavyoandika na kuyapata yaliyomo mtandaoni.

eng: Although Cambodia has the lowest Internet penetration rate (70,000 users as of 2007), artists, however, are more recognized not through offline exhibitions, but their presence on the world wide web.
swa: Pamoja na nchi ya Kampuchea kuwa na uenezi mdogo zaidi wa intaneti (watumiaji 70,000 hadi kufikia mwaka 2007), wasanii wanatambulika zaidi kwa uwepo wao kwenye mtandao wa intaneti.

eng: This increasing use of blog to reach out larger audiences attracts more than attention and support.
swa: Ongezeko hili la matumizi ya blogu ili kufikia kadamnasi kubwa kunavutia zaidi ya kujionyesha na kuungwa mkono.

eng: A former freelance editorial cartoonist for Far Eastern Economic Review from 1997-1999, Bun Heang Ung presently lives in Australia.
swa: Aliyekuwa mchoraji huru wa picha za vikaragosi wa Jarida la Uchumi la Mashariki ya Mbali tokea mwaka 1997 - 1999, Bun Heang Ung anaishi Australia hivi sasa.

eng: Observing his home country Cambodia from the other side, the 57-year-old cartoonist launched Sacrava Toons blog in 2004, nearly a decade after he published 'The Murderous Revolution : Life and Death in Pol Pot's Kampuchea,' his first book of black and white line illustrations that tells his very own experiences of the Khmer Rouge regime.
swa: Akiiangalia nchi yake kutokea upande mwingine, mchoraji huyo mwenye umri wa miaka 57 alizindua blogu ya Sacrava Toons mnamo mwaka 2004, mwongo mmoja baada ya kuchapisha "Mapinduzi ya Mauaji ; Uhai na Kifo katika Kampuchea ya Pol Pot" kitabu chake cha kwanza cha michoro ya rangi nyeusi na nyeupe ambacho kinaelezea uzoefu wake binafsi wakati wa utawala wa Khmer Rouge.

eng: In voicing his opinions, the talented cartoonist publish his drawings of all things that matter to him on the Web.
swa: Katika kuupaza ujumbe wake, mchoraji huyu mwenye kipaji huchapa michoro yake ya vitu vinavyomgusa katika mtandao wa intaneti.

eng: In one of his recent posts, he used 'I have a dream' as a backdrop for his illustration of Barack Obama, the 44th President of the United States.
swa: Katika moja ya jumbe zake za hivi karibuni, alitumia "nina ndoto" kama picha ya nyuma ya mchoro wake wa Barack Obama, rais wa 44 wa Marekani.

eng: Barack Obama, illustrated by Bun Heang Ung
swa: Barack Obama kama alivyochorwa na Bun Heang Ung

eng: Recently, according to Wikileaks, the political cartoonist's blog is being blocked in Thailand, where its Ministry of Information and Communication Technology is in charge of banning Internet sites that violates its Kingdom's lèse majesté.
swa: Hivi karibuni, kwa mujibu wa Wikileaks, blogu ya mchoraji huyu wa vikaragosi vya kisiasa imezuiwa nchini Thailand, ambako Wizara yake ya Habari na Mawasiliano inashika hatamu za kufunga tovuti ambazo zinamtukana mfalme.

eng: Cambodian blogger Thom Vanak, at Blog By Khmer, made his point on the issue:
swa: Bloga wa Kampuchea Thom Vanak, anayeblogu kwenye Blog By Khmer, anafikisha ujumbe kuhusu suala hili:

eng: Regarding Lèse majesté, although I think it's archaic and outdated law in this day and age, but nevertheless, it's still Thai's law.
swa: Kuhusu sheria inayokataza kumtusi mfalme, japokuwa nafikiri kuwa ni sheria ya kizamani sana na imepitwa na wakati katika wakti huu, hata hivyo, bado ni sheria ya Ki-Thai.

eng: If I ever set my foot on Thai soil I would respect their laws.
swa: Kama nitatia mguu kwenye nchi ya Wa-Thai lazima niheshimu sheria zao.

eng: The same if I'm to visit any other country, I would respect the local laws of that country.
swa: Sawa tu na vile nitakapotembelea nchi nyingine yoyote, nitaheshimu sheria za nchi hiyo.

eng: While the prominent cartoonist's blog appears on censorship list (as of 20 Dec 2008) by Thailand, the Cambodian Ministry of Women's Affairs, in December last year, threatened to block a Web site that contains artistic illustrations of bare-breasted Apsara dancers and a Khmer Rouge soldier.
swa: Wakati blogu ya mchoraji mashuhuri wa vikaragosi inaonekana kwenye orodha ya kuzuiwa (kama ilivyokuwa tarehe 20 desemba 2008) ya Thailand, Wizara ya Masuala ya Wanawake ya Kampuchea, mwezi wa Desemba mwaka jana, ilitishia kuzuia tovuti yenye michoro ya wacheza ngoma ya Apsara walio vifua wazi pamoja na mwanajeshi wa Khmer Rouge.

eng: The attempt to shut down reahu.net (or at least to filter it by Internet Service Providers in the Cambodian capital) was echoed by a human rights activist, who was quoted as saying that "the Web site should be shut down because it appealed too much to young Cambodians."
swa: Jaribio la kuifunga reahu.net (au kuichuja kwa kutumia watoaji huduma za mawasiliano aktika jiji la Kampuchea) vilishika mwangwi wa wananaharakati wa haki za binadamu, ambaye alinukuliwa akisema kwamba "Tovuti hiyo lazima ifungwe kwani inamvuto mkubwa kwa vijana wadogo wa Kikampuchea."

eng: Reahu.net is currently not accessible by Internet visitors in Cambodia, while there is no issue with access in the U.S. The error message appears:
swa: Reahu.net hivi sasa haipatikani kwa watumiaji wa intaneti walioko nchini Kampuchea, ingawa hakuna vizingiti kama hivyo nchini Marekani, ujumbe wa makosa hutokea:

eng: Screenshot of reahu.net site being filtered by Cambodia's Internet Service Providers
swa: Picha ya tovuti ya reahu.net inavyochujwa na watoa huduma za intaneti nchini Kampuchea.

eng: Cambodia's most prominent anonymous blog author at 'Cambodia: Details are Sketchy' wrote about the controversial issue:
swa: Mwanablugu mashuhuri asiye na jina wa Kampuchea kwenye ‘Cambodia: Details are Sketchy' ameandika kuhusu suala hili tata:

eng: If anyone should understand the value of free speech, the deputy director of communication and advocacy at Licadho seems a likely candidate. 	Kama kuna yeyote anayetakiwa kuelewa thamani ya uhuru wa kujieleza, Naibu Mkurugenzi wa Mawasiliano na Utetezi kule Licadho ndiye anayepaswa kuwa.
It is disheartening that Vann Sophath supports censoring Reahu’s illustrations"
swa: Inavunja moyo kwamba Vann Sophath anaunga mkono kuchujwa kwa michoro ya Reahu"

eng: Artist Reahu posted a note on his site, recently becoming popular after gaining media attentions in the past few months, in response to his critics:
swa: Msanii Reahu alituma ujumbe kwenye tovuti yake, ambayo imeongezeka umashuhuri hivi karibuni baada ya kuangaliwa na vyombo vya habari katika miezi michache iliyopita, ili kuwajibu wanaompinga:

eng: Judging from the complaints, I wonder how we as Khmer will be able to make it in the 21st Century.
swa: Kutokana na malalamiko niliyoyaona, ninajiuliza ni jinsi gani sisi kama Wa-Khmer tunaweza kuishi katika karne ya 21.

eng: Please be open-minded, you must be able to see beyond the four walls surrounding your hut.
swa: Tafadhalini kuweni na akili huru, ni lazima muweze kuona zaidi ya kuta nne zinazowazunguka.

eng: Carnival is a tradition, a part of every West Indian soul and the French Caribbean is no exception.
swa: Kanivali ni utamaduni, sehemu ya uhai wa kila Muhindi wa Magharibi na bila kuwaacha wale wa Karibeani ya Kifaransa.

eng: Here is a review of blogs from Martinique, French Guiana, Haiti and Guadeloupe, which highlights the features of Carnival there.
swa: Ufuatao ni muhtasari wa blogu kutoka Martiniki, Gayana ya Kifaransa, Haiti na Guadalupe, ambao unaelezea mambo yanavyokuwa kwenye Kanivali.

eng: In brevesdeguyane, we learn about the kick-off of Carnival in French Guiana and discover pictures illustrating the French Guianese tradition of the “Touloulous“.
swa: Katika blogu ya brevesdeguyane, tunajifunza jinsi Kanivali inavyozinduliwa huko Gayana ya Kifaransa na tunazivumbua picha za vielelezo vya utamaduni wa Kiguyana ya Kifaransa wa “Touloulous”.

eng: The term originally refers to small colorful earth crabs, which swiftly run and hide under the ground whenever they feel threatened.
swa: Neno hilo kwa asili yake lina maana ya kaa wadogo wenye rangi ya kuvutia, ambao hukimbia upesi na kujificha chini ya ardhi pindi wanapohisi kutishwa.

eng: So what is the connection with those wonderfully disguised women?
swa: Je kuna uhusiano upi baina yao na wanawake wa kuvutia waliojibadilisha?

eng: Lilie Belle in MaGuyane decribes Carnival in French Guiana and provides an answer to the question :
swa: Lilie Belle katika blogu ya MaGuyane anaielezea Kanivali inavyokuwa katika Gayana ya Kifaransa na anatoa jibu la swali hilo :

eng: See our special coverage page on Madagascar's Power Struggle.
swa: Angalia ukurasa wa habari maalum kuhusu Mapambano ya kugombea nguvu za kiasiasa Madagaska.

eng: At least 25 people were shot dead today in Madagascar's capital Antananarivo during a march to the presidential palace called by the city's mayor Andry Rajoelina after he declared himself the leader of a new transitional government at a political rally.
swa: Watu wapatao 25 walipigwa risasi na kuuwawa leo katika mji mkuu wa Madagaska, Antananarivo, wakati wa maandamano ya kuelekea ikulu ya nchi hiyo yaliyoitishwa na meya wa jiji Andry Rajoelina baada ya kujitangaza kama kiongozi wa serikali mpya ya mpito katika mkutano wa hadhara wa kisiasa.

eng: In the past weeks, a power struggle between the mayor and the president Marc Ravalomanana has led to both violence and looting.
swa: Katika majuma yaliyopita, ugombeaji wa nguvu za kisiasa kati ya Meya na Rais Marc Ravolamanana kumesababisha ghasia na uporaji.

eng: The political gathering took place in downtown Antananarivo around noon local time.
swa: Mkutano huo wa kisiasa ulifanyika katikati ya Mji wa Antananarivo majira ya mchana, saa za Madagaska.

eng: Rajoelina announced the creation of a new transitional government, with himself as its leader, in spite of the fact that the current government is still in place.
swa: Rajoelina alitangaza kuundwa kwa serikali ya mpito, na yeye mwenyewe akiwa kiongozi wa serikali, bila kujali ukweli kwamba serikali iliyopo sasa bado inashikilia nafasi hiyo.

eng: He asked his supporters to march to the presidential Palace in Ambohitsorohitra.
swa: Aliwataka watu wanaomuunga mkono waandamane kuelekea ikulu iliyopo Ambohitsorohitra.

eng: When the massive crowd arrived at the palace, a delegation entered the palace at 14:46 local time.
swa: Wakati umati mkubwa ulipowasili ikulu, wajumbe waliingia kwenye kasri majira ya saa 8:46.

eng: This is when shots were fired.
swa: Ni wakati huu ambapo risasi zilirushwa.

eng: The local twittersphere and other bloggers reported:
swa: Watumaiaji wa twita waliokuwapo na wanablogu wengine waliripoti:

eng: Preliminary reports indicate that dozens of bodies are laying on the streets.
swa: Habari za mwanzo zinaashiria kuwa dazeni za miili ilikuwa imenguka mitaani.

eng: Among the casualties, is said to be a cameraman from the RTA TV station (official confirmation still pending).
swa: Mooja wa majeruhi, inasemekana ni mpiga mpiga wa idhaa ya televisheni ya RTA (uthibitisho rasmi bado unasubiriwa).

eng: As of 15:40 local time, shots were still being fired.
swa: Hadi majira ya saa 9:40 alasiri, risasi bado zilikuwa zinapigwa.

eng: Rajoelina asked the armed EMMONAT forces, a military entity accepted by both parties and created during the crisis, to intervene and protect the crowds.
swa: Rajoelina, alilitaka jeshi la EMMONAT, linaloungwa mkono na pande zote ambalo liliundwa wakati wa mgogoro huu, kuingilia kati na kuulinda umma.

eng: News releases (Reuters, Al Jazeera) report up to 25 deaths as images are currently streaming on national TV.
swa: Habari rasmi (kwa mujibu wa Reuters, Al Jazeera) zinaeleza kuwa vifo vinafikia 25 kwa kadiri ya picha zinavyozidi kumiminika kwenye Televisheni ya taifa.

eng: BBC and AFP only reported 5 casualties so far.
swa: BBC na AFP viliripoti vifo 5 tu.

eng: Live online reports can also be found in French here.
swa: Habari kama zinavyotokea (katika wakati halisi) mtandaoni zinapatikana kwa lugha ya Kifaransa hapa.

eng: This is a live search of Twitter for "#madagascar", which is the tag people have been using throughout the past weeks of political tension and occasional violence.
swa: Kuna kurasa za kutafiti za twita “#madagascar”, ambalo ndio neno-kiini ambalo watu wamekuwa wakilitumia wakati wote katika majuma yaliyopita ambayo yalijaa fukuto la kisiasa na ghasia za hapa na pale.

eng: The week gone has been a politically hot one for many Malawians as they have seen their presidential and parliamentary candidates present their nominations papers to the Malawi Electoral Commission ahead of the May 19 polls.
swa: Juma lililopita lilikuwa lenye moto wa kisiasa kwa Wamalawi wengi kwani wameshuhudia wagombea wa viti vya urais na ubunge wakiwasilisha maombi yao kwenye Tume ya Uchaguzi kuelekea Uchaguzi utakaofanyika terehe 19 Mei.

eng: By the end of the exercise, about 8 presidential and over 500 parliamentary candidates presented their nomination papers to compete for the 193 seats in parliament.
swa: Hadi kufikia mwisho wa zoezi hilo wagombea wapatao 10 waliwasilisha maombi yao ya kugombea urais na mamia wengine kwa ajili ya kugombea viti 193 vya bunge.

eng: Journalist Kondwani Munthali earlier on shared his views on the political developments which are expected to lead to the most contested at both presidential and parliamentary levels.
swa: Mapema, mwanahabari, Kondwani Munthali alieleza maoni yake kuhusu maendeleo ya kisiasa ambayo yanategemewa kwenye ushindani wa ngazi ya urais na kadhalika kwenye ngazi za ubunge.

eng: He writes Viva My Country's Democracy:
swa: Anaandika kwenye Viva My Country's Democracy:

eng: Yes, I said DPP has no structures to manage itself through primaries, I am glad two Ministers recalled my discussions with them and called me.
swa: Ndiyo, nilisema kuwa chama cha DPP hakina muundo wa kujiendesha kwenye hatua za mwanzo za uchaguzi. Nafarijika kuwa mawaziri wawili wamekumbuka majadiliano niliyofanya nao na wamenipigia simu.

eng: For UDF how they can managed the situation of Muluzi will be entirely to them.
swa: Kwa chama cha UDF, jinsi watakavyodhibiti hali inayomuhusu Muluzi hilo ni juu yao.

eng: For MCP it seems they have changed indeed, the guys look serious enough to upset tables.
swa: Kwa MCP inaonekana wamebadilika kwa hakika, wanaonekana wako makini sana kuweza kupindua meza.

eng: For today thats where it ends
swa: Kwa leo hapa ndio inapoishia

eng: Another blogger under Ndagha agrees with Munthali that Malawi's politics this year is getting hotter.
swa: Mwanablohu mwingine anayeblogu kwenye Ndagha anakubaliana na Munthali kwamba siasa za Malawi mwaka huu zimeshika moto.

eng: He hope that its players have a genuine heart for the Malawians and not necessarily to serve their own interests.
swa: Anategemea kwamba washiriki wana moyo wa dhati kwa ajili uya Wamalawi na si kwa ajili ya kuhudumia maslahi yao.

eng: He says that for him this year offers hope.
swa: Anasema kwamba mwaka huu unatia moyo.

eng: How and why?:
swa: Kwa nini?:

eng: For me, the parliamentary race will the most exciting as it will showcase lots of new entrants-most of whom in my view can make important contributions to the country's development.
swa: Kwangu, mbio za uchaguzi wa wabunge zitakuwa za kusisimua kwani zitaonyesha wagombeea wapya wengi ambao kwa mtazamo wangu wanaweza kutoa mchango muhimu kwa maendeleo ya nchi.

eng: I wish we had popular new faces on the presidential race.
swa: Natamani tungekuwa na sura mpya maarufu kwenye uchaguzi wa rais.

eng: Another journalist Mzati Nkolokosa terms this political time in Malawi as a Season of Rumors.
swa: Mwanahabari mwingine, Mzati Nkolokosa anakiita kipindi hiki cha siasa nchini Malawi kama kipindi cha uzushi.

eng: He writes a long post focusing on Brown Mpinganjira who has dumped the party he helped to form and paired himself with John Tembo of the Malawi Congress Party as a running mate.
swa: Anaandika makala ndefu inayomuhusu Brown Mpinganjira ambaye amekitosa chama ambacho alisaidia kukijenga na amejiunga na John Tembo wa Chama cha Malawi Congress kama mgombea mwenza.

eng: It is right to call this period a season of rumours.
swa: Ni sahihi kukiita kipindi hiki kama kipindi cha uzushi.

eng: But Brown Mpinganjira must go on to accept that crucial political truths in Malawi start as rumours.
swa: Lakini Brown Mpinganjira ni lazima akubali kwamba ukweli wa kisiasa katika Malawi huanza kama uzushi.

eng: Brown Mpinganjira, the cleverest politician in Malawi according to Jack Mapanje, is good at communication.
swa: Brown Mpinganjira, mwanasiasa mwerevu zaidi nchini Malawi kwa mujibu wa Jack Mapanje, ni mzuri katika mawasiliano.

eng: He knows words that are loaded with meaning, he speaks poetry, and he can confuse people, even journalists, who don’t follow him critically.
swa: Anayafahamu maneno yaliyojaa maana, anaongea kishairi, anaweza kuwachanganya wananchi, hata wanahabari, ambao hawamfuatilii kwa makini.

eng: Most Malawi's public offices are not fully computerised.
swa: Idara nyingi za umma nchini Malawi zinatumuia tarakilishi.

eng: While there are some efforts to improve this, it remains a challenge to most government departments and agencies.
swa: Wakati kuna juhudi za kuboresha (muundo), bado ni changamoto kubwa kwa idara na asasi nyingi.

eng: One of the offices that serves lots of Malawians is the office of the Administrator General where among others, clients are helped with services regarding their deceased estate.
swa: Moja ya ofisi ambazo zinahudumia Wamalawi wengi ni Ofisi ya Serikali ambako pamoja na mambo mengine wateja husaidiwa kwa huduma zinazohusu masuala ya mirathi.

eng: Having attended a short course on data entry, journalist Pauline Kalumikiza writes on the importance of such offices going digital:
swa: Baada ya kufanya kozi fupi ya uingizaji takwimu, Mwanahabari, Pauline Kalumikiza anaandika juu ya umuhimu wa ofisi kama hizi kutumia teknolojia ya dijitali.

eng: The reason is that, it takes so long for them to help the benefiaries due to their manual storage.
swa: Sababu ni kuwa, inawachukua muda mrefu mrefu kuwahudumia warithi kutokana na uhifadhi kwa kutumia mikono.

eng: I think it is laborious and time consuming, because they handle multiple of files so them to take out one, it takes ages.
swa: Nafikiri ni mtindio unaochukua muda mrefu, kwa sababu wanashughulikia mafaili mengi ili kulitoa moja, inachukua muda.

eng: Most of the times, they will tell you that ‘Sorry come next month, give us time to look for it’. Now Imagine a person is coming from Nsanje to the AG’s office in Blantyre; he comes again as per the arrangement and is told that he should wait for another week, very frustrating isn’t it?
swa: Mara nyingi, watakuambia, ‘Samahani, njoo mwezi ujao, tupe muda wa kulitafuta faili lako’ hebu fikiria mtu anakuja kutoka Nsanje kuja kwa Mwanasheria Mkuu mjini Blantyre; anakuja tena kama alivyoahidiwa na anaambiwa asubiri tena kwa wiki moja nyingine, inaghafirisha, au sivyo?

eng: Yes technology has its own disadvantages but I think, the AG’s office would save time and energy by going digital.
swa: Naam, teknolojia ina faida zake lakini nafikiri, Ofisi ya Mwanasheria Mkuu ingeweza kuokoa muda na nishati kwa kutumia teknolojia ya dijitali.

eng: We cannot be talking of making ICT accessible to everyone, if our important offices that hold crucial information are still using manual storage system.
swa: Hatuwezi kuendelea kuongelea teknolojia ya mawasiliano ya kidijitali kuweza kumfikia kila mmoja, kama ofisi zinazohifadhi habari muhimu bado zinatumia mbinu za uhifadhi za mikono.

eng: Zisinthe!
swa: Zisinthe!

eng: (Let things change!)
swa: (Yaache Mambo yabadilike!)

eng: Martinique blogger le blog de , in another post on the ongoing workers' movement in Martinique and Guadeloupe, takes issue with Christophe Barbier, opinion editor of the French news magazine, L'Express.
swa: Bloga wa Kimartinique le blo de , katika makala yake nyingine inayohusu harakati za wafanyakazi wa Martinique na Guadeloupe anapambana na Christophe Barbier, mhariri wa maoni katika gazeti la Kifaransa, L'Express.

eng: In a recent interview on the radio show C dans l'air, Barbier responded to an SMS from a listener who asked, "Why don't we just grant the overseas departments their independence?"
swa: Katika mahojiano ya redio ya C dans l'air hivi karibuni, Barbier alijibu ujumbe wa simu ya mkononi kutoka kwa msikilizaji aliyeuliza, "kwa nini tusizipe Idara za Ng'ambo uhuru wao?"

eng: Barbier replied:
swa: Yesu wangu!

eng: Many people across the Middle East have decided to boycott Israeli and American products in response to the Israeli war on Gaza.
swa: Watu wengi Mashariki ya Kati wamesusia bidhaa za Israeli na Marekani kama jibu la mashambulizi ya Israeli huko Gaza.

eng: The Angry Arab News Service wrote:
swa: Bloga anayejiita Shirika la Habari la Kiarabu Lenye Hasira anaandika:

eng: Among all the American brands, Starbucks was the main target of the boycotting campaigns.
swa: Miongoni mwa maduka yote yenye chapa ya Marekani, Starbucks ndio iliyokuwa inalengwa zaidi na kampeni hizo za kususia.

eng: Zeinobia, from Egypt, wrote about this saying:
swa: Bloga Zeinobia wa Misri, anaandika:

eng: Starbucks, the famous Starbucks branch was closed in Beirut for a day because of the protests.
swa: Starbucks, tawi maarufu la Starbucks mjini Beirut lilifungwa kwa siku moja kufuatia maandamano ya kulipinga.

eng: There are calls and actual respond to it across the Arab world to boycott the American products especially 84268245 those products associated with Israel in a way or another.
swa: Kuna wito umetolewa na kuitikiwa katika ulimwengu wa Waarabu kususia bidhaa za Marekani hasa 84268245 bidhaa ambazo zinazohusishwa na Israeli kwa njia moja au nyingine.

eng: She then continued:
swa: Halafu anaendelea:

eng: Of course the Arabic public is convinced that Starbucks in America gives annual donation to the IDF due to the fact that founder and the owner of Starbucks is a Jew, to be honest this is not enough to draw a conclusion that the chain donates to the IDF but news like that one makes the Arab public thinks twice.
swa: Umma wa Waarabu unaamini kwamba Starbucks ya Marekani hulipatia Jeshi la Israeli, IDF mchango wa mwaka kutokana na ukweli kwamba mwanzilishi wa Starbucks ni Myahudi, na nikitaka kuwa mkweli, ukweli huo hautoshi kufikia hitimisho kwamba kampuni hiyo hutoa michango kwa jeshi la Israeli, lakini habari kama hizi zinaufanya umma wa Waarabu kufikiri mara mbili.

eng: Starbucks-IDF rumors are bit old rumours even before it opens its branches in Egypt ,it was fought in the Arab world.
swa: Uvumi wa Starbucks-Jeshi la Israeli ni uvumi wa siku nyingi hata kabla ya kufungua tawi lake nchini Misri, kampuni hiyo ilipingwa na ulimwengu wa Waarabu.

eng: I remember one day I received any email about the logo of Starbucks and its history , saying that it is the Hebrew Princess that saved the Jews in Babylonian ancient time where in reality it is another whole thing.
swa: Nakumbuka siku moja nilipokea barua pepe inayohusu nembo ya Starbucks na historia yake, ikisema kwamba nembo hiyo ni alama ya binti mfalme wa Kiebrania aliyewakomboa Wayahudi waliokuwa Babeli wakati wa zamani ilhali hilo ni jambo jingine kabisa.

eng: The boycotting campaigns were not limited to the Arab world only, and American-Palestinian group blog KABOBfest reported here how people in Malaysia are also participating in the campaigns:
swa: Kampeni hizo za kususia hazipo tu huko Uarabuni, kundi la wanablogu wa Kimarekani na Kipalestina KABOBfest linaripoti jinsi watu huko Malaysia wanavyoshiriki katika kampeni hizo:

eng: Over 2,000 Muslim-owned restaurants in Malaysia have taken Coca-Cola off the menu in an effort to support global boycotts against Israel.
swa: Zaidi ya migahawa 2,000 inayomilikiwa na Waislamu nchini Malaysia imeondoa Coca-Cola kwenye orodha za vyakula katika jitihada za kuunga mkono migomo dhidi ya Israeli.

eng: Local organizations are encouraging employees of Coca-Cola, as well as Starbucks and other companies, to quit their jobs.
swa: Mashirika ya kizawa yanawashawishi wafanyakazi wa Coca-Cola, kadhalika na wale wa Starbucks na makampuni mengine, waziachee ajira zao.

eng: From Jordan, Khobbeizeh also wrote about boycotting Starbucks:
swa: Kutokea Jordan, Khobbeizeh pia anaandika kuhusu ususiaji wa Starbucks:

eng: Howard Schultz is an active Zionist, extremely sectarian for the Israeli army.
swa: Howard Schultz ni Mzayonisti mwenye siasa kali zinzounga mkono jeshi la Israeli.

eng: He is supporting them with hundred of millions yearly from Starbucks' income, and he's one of the major sponsors of their weaponry.
swa: Anawaunga mkono na mamia ya mamilioni kila mwaka kutoka katika kipato cha Starbucks, ni mmoja wa wadhamini wakubwa wa silaha.

eng: For sure, the Israeli products were boycotted by many people as well, and here is what Body on the Line wrote in her blog:
swa: Kwa hakika, bidhaa za Israeli zimegomewa na watu wengi, haya ndiyo alioandika bloga Body on the Line katika blogu yake:

eng: Farmers say much of their produce is being held in warehouses due to canceled orders, and fear a sharp decrease in fruit exports to countries such as Jordan, Britain, and the Scandinavian countries.
swa: Wakulima wanasema kwamba mazao yao mengi yamezuiliwa kwenye maghala kutokana na kusitishwa kwa ununuzi, na kuna hofu ya kupungua kwa uuzwaji wa matunda kuelekea nchi kama vile Jordan, Uingereza na nchi za Skandinavia.

eng: Ilan Eshel, director of the Organization of Fruit Growers in Israel, said Scandinavian countries have also been canceling orders.
swa: Ilan Eshel, mkurugenzi wa shirika la wakulima wa matunda nchini Israeli, alisema kuwa nchi za Kiskandinavia pia zimekuwa zikisitisha uagizaji.

eng: The American blogger, who lives in Palestine, then wrote about how academics in the United Kingdom are reacting to the Israeli attack on Gaza:
swa: Bloga wa Kimarekani anayeishi Palestina, anaandika yale wasomi wa Uingereza wanayosema kuhusu mashambulizi ya Israeli huko Gaza:

eng: British academics have written an open letter, published in the Guardian, calling for boycott, divestment, and sanctions:
swa: Wasomi wa Uingereza wameandika barua ya wazi, iliyochapwa kwenye gazeti la Guardian, inayoitisha ususiaji, kuondoa vitega uchumi, na migomo:

eng: We must do what we can to stop Israel from winning its war. 	Ni lazima tufanye tunaloweza ili kuizua Israeli kushinda vita hivi.
Israel must accept that its security depends on justice and peaceful coexistence with its neighbors, and not upon the criminal use of force."
swa: Israeli ni lazima ikubali kuwa usalama wake unategemea haki na kuishi salama pamoja na majirani zake, na siyo kwa kutegemea matumizi maovu ya nguvu.

eng: We believe Israel should immediately and unconditionally end its assault on Gaza, end the occupation of the West Bank, and abandon all claims to possess or control territory beyond its 1967 borders. 	Tunaamini israeli lazima isitishe mara moja bila masharti mashambulizi yake huko gaza, isitishe ukaliaji wa mabavu kwenye Ukingo wa Magharibi, waache madai ya kumiliki au kuendesha himaya inayovuka mipaka yake ya 1967.
We call on the British government and the British people to take all feasible steps to oblige Israel to comply with these demands, starting with a programme of boycott, divestment and sanctions."
swa: Tuanitaka serikali ya Uingereza na watu wa Uingereza kuchukua hatua zote zinazowezekana za kuitaka Israeli ikubaliane na madai haya, kwa kuanza na programuya ususiaji, kuondoa vitega uchumi, na vikwazo."

eng: In London students also took action in solidarity with Gaza at the prestigious London school of economics: More than 40 students were continuing their sit-in at the London School of Economics today in protest at the conflict in Gaza.
swa: Mjini London wanafunzi pia walichukua hatua ya mshikamano na Gaza katika chuo cha Uchumi cha London: Zaidi ya wanafunzi 40 waliendela na kampeni yao ya kukaa chini katika Chuo Cha Uchumi cha London leo hii ili kupinga machafuko huko Gaza.

eng: There are also organizations and sites that are dedicated to spreading word about the campaigns like this, this, and this one.
swa: Pia kuna asasi na tovuti ambazo zinalenga tu kusambaza habari juu ya kampeni kama hii, hii na hii.

eng: But on the other hand some others, like Crossroads Arabia were not that much into the boycotting:
swa: Lakini kwa upande mwingine, wengine, kama vile bloga Crossroads Arabia hawakutilia mkazo sana kwenye kususia bidhaa:

eng: Saudi Gazette reports that a boycott of American products in support of the people of Gaza is beginning to take hold in Saudi Arabia.
swa: Gazeti la Saudi liliripoti kwamba kususia bidhaa za Marekani ili kuwaunga mkono watu wa Gaza kumeanza kumea nchini Saudi Arabia.

eng: As with earlier, similar boycotts, this one is likely to a) assuage Saudi feelings of impotence and b) hurt the Saudi franchisees and their employees, without actually doing much damage to the US economy, contrary to what a professor from King Abdulaziz University states.
swa: Kama ilivyowahi kutokea awali, ususiaji huu unaweza a) kupunguza hisia za kutokuwa na nguvu na b) kuumiza wamiliki wa Kiarabu pamoja na wafanyakazi wao, bila ya kuathiri uchumi wa Marekani, kinyume na vile anavyodai profesa wa Chuo Kikuu cha Abdulaziz.

eng: It’s clear that the idea of a boycott has strong popular support, though.
swa: Hata hivyo, ni wazi kwamba dhana ya kususa inaungwa mkono na wengi.

eng: Also Jewlicious wrote a post in reply to Khobbeizeh:
swa: Kadhalika, bloga Jewlicious ameandika makala kumjibu Khobbeizeh:

eng: Now, I’m no big fan of Starbucks, or of Coffee for that matter, but the notion that Starbucks supports the IDF to the tune of “hundred of millions yearly” is patently ludicrous.
swa: Mimi si mshabiki wa Starbucks, au kahawa, lakini suala la Starbucks kuunga mkono Jeshi la Israeli kwa kiasi cha "mamia ya mamilioni kila mwaka" ni jambo ambalo ni vigumu kuaminika.

eng: Khobbeizeh my friend, your ample Photoshop skills aside, you are an idiot.
swa: Rafiki yangu Khobbeizeh, tukiweka pembeni ufundi wako wa kutumia Photoshop, wewe ni mbumbumbu.

eng: A French tourist was killed and around 20 people were injured when a bomb exploded outside the Al Hussein Mosque in Cairo's popular tourist area Khan Al Khalili earlier today.
swa: Mtalii wa Kifaransa ameuwawa na watu wapatao 20 wamejeruhiwa wakati bomu lilipolipuka nje ya msikiti wa Al Hussein uliopo katika eneo la utalii la Khan Al Khalili mjini Kairo mapema leo.

eng: And as the world was coming to grips with what was happening on the ground, Egypt's bloggers were quick at work, exchanging updates, information, analysis and concerns.
swa: Na wakati dunia ilipokuwa inaanza kufahamu ni kipi kilichokuwa kinatokea, wanablogu wa Misri waliingia kazini haraka, wakipashana habari za yanayotukia, taarifa, uchambuzi na hofu zao.

eng: It all started when Zenobia posted a message on Twitter reporting that "There is some kind of explosion in Cafe at Al Azhar."
swa: Yote yalianza wakati Zenobia alipotundika ujumbe katika ukurasa wa Twita akiripoti kuwa “Kumetokea mlipuko wa aina fulani kwenye mgahawa uliopo Al Azhar.”

eng: Minutes later Arabawy followed up with another confirming message which read: "Explosion in el-Mashhad el-Husseini Street, Cairo."
swa: Dakika chache baadaye Arabawy alifuatia na ujumbe mwingine uliothibitisha: “Mlipuko katika mtaa wa el-mashhad el-Husseini mjini Kairo.”

eng: Moftasa was the first to guess a link between the bombings and a new controversial anti-terrorism law, which will be discussed within days in the Egyptian parliament.
swa: Moftasa ndiye alikuwa wa kwanza kuuhisi uhusiano wa milipuko na sheria mpya ya kuzuia-ugaidi, ambayo itajadiliwa katika siku chache zijazo kwenye bunge la Misri.

eng: The draft law was met by wide objections.
swa: Rasimu ya sheria hiyo imekumbana na vipingamizi vikubwa.

eng: Nothing was confirmed yet, and rumors were circulating; however, Zeinobia was trying to gather updates from different sources Newspapers and TV channels in a quick but comprehensive roundup.
swa: Hakuna lililothibitishwa mpaka sasa, na uvumi unaenea; hata hivyo, Zeinobia alijaribu kukusanya habari kama zinavyotokea kutoka vyanzo tofauti vya magazeti na idhaa za televisheni katika muhtasari.

eng: The Arabist, who was near the area and heard both explosions himself, wrote:
swa: Mwanablogu Arabist, ambaye alikuwa Karibu na eneo na kuusikia mlipuko huo yeye mwenyewe, aliandika:

eng: Am hearing reports of a bomb going off in the medieval part of Cairo near Khan al-Khalili, a major tourist destination.
swa: Nimesikia taarifa za mabomu yanayolipuka katika mji mkongwe wa Kairo Karibu na Khan al-Khalili, sehemu maarufu kwa watalii.

eng: Will update as more news is available.
swa: Nitawapasha kadri habari zitakapopatikana.

eng: Update: Al Jazeera reporting 11 deaths, three Egyptians, three Germans, one French, 16 wounded, one french dead these and others remain to be confirmed.
swa: Habari mpya: Al Jazeera inaripoti vifo 11, Wamisri watatu, Wajerumani watatu, Mfaransa mmoja, 16 wamejeruhiwa, Mfaransa mmoja amefariki, haya na mengineyo bado hayajathibitishwa.

eng: Update 2: Already activists are saying this is conveniently close to next month when the Emergency Law is to be discussed in parliament… Update 3: Four dead (German and French), 12 wounded, various nationalities.
swa: Habari mpya 2: Tayari wanaharakati wanasema kuwa tukio hili limetukia Karibu sana na mwezi ujao ambapo Sheria ya Dharura itajadiliwa Bungeni… Habari mpya 3: Wanne wamefariki (Wajerumani na Wafaransa) 12 wamejeruhiwa, wa mataifa mbalimbali.

eng: moftasa then posts a link to a photograph from the blast area on Twitter.
swa: Halafu moftasa alibandika kiungo cha picha kutoka kwenye eneo la mlipuko kwenye Twita.

eng: And while Msfour, and American expat living in Cairo, was the first to ask bloggers on Twitter to use the tag #cairobomb, Arabawy was the first to ask bloggers to use a unified delicious tag: El-HusseinExplosion to pool all links under the same URL.
swa: Wakati Msfour, mfanyakazi wa Kimarekani anayeishi Kairo, alikuwa wa kwanza kuwataka wanablogu wanaotumia Twita kutumia kielelezo cha #cairobomb, Arabawy ndiye alikuwa wa kwanza kuwataka wanablogu watumie kielelezo jumuishi cha delicious: El-HusseinExplosion ili kukusanya viunganishi vyote chini ya anwani pepe moja.

eng: Yassary Masry , Carl, Msfour, Maree, Rob, SandMonkey and Grey wool Knickers were among the first to blog about the incident, whether to comfort their friends and families or to discuss if they think there is a connection between the bombings and the anti-terrorism law or not.
swa: Wanablogu Yassary Masry , Carl, Msfour, Maree, Rob, SandMonkey pamoja na Grey wool Knickers walikuwa ni miongoni mwa wanablogu wa kwanza kuandika kuhusu tukio hilo, ama kuwafariji marafiki na familia au kujadili uhusiano wa milipuko ya mabomu na sheria ya kuzuia ugaidi.

eng: Grey wool Knickers wrote a short note connecting the last events happening in Egypt, trying to relate them to the recent bombings:
swa: Grey wool Knickers aliandika ujumbe mfupi unaohusianisha matukio ya mwisho yaliyotokea Misri, akijaribu kuyaunganisha na milipuko ya hivi karibuni:

eng: As several people have noted, this comes at a very suspicious time, considering that the extension of the State of Emergency (in place since the 1967 Arab-Israeli War, with a brief break during Sadat’s presidency) was just about to be considered once again.
swa: Kama watu kadhaa wanavyoona, matukio haya yametokea katika wakati wa kushuku, tukizingatia kwamba Sheria ya Dharura (iliyokuwepo tangu mwaka 1967 wakati wa vita vya Waarabu-na-Waisraeli, vilivyositishwea kwa muda wakati wa utawala wa Rais Sadat) ilitaka kuanzishwa tena.

eng: Mubarak’s government has been promising for years to come forth with an anti-terrorism law to replace martial law, which would at least give citizens some protection under Egypt’s constitution.
swa: Serikali ya Rais Mubarak imekuwa ikiahidi kwa miaka mingi kuanzisha sheria ya kuzuia ugaidi ambayo ingechukua nafasi ya sheria za kijeshi, ambayo ingewapa raia angalau kinga kidogo kwenye katiba ya Misri.

eng: The regime is currently able to invoke the Emergency Law to do whatever it wants, which is what readers here will recognize in the abuction of Philip Rizk and Diaa Gad, among many others.
swa: Utawala wa sasa unao uwezo wa kurejesha Sheria ya Dharura na kutenda inavyotaka, kama wasomaji watakavyogundua katika kutekwa kwa Philip Rizk na Diaa Gad, kati yaw engine wengi.

eng: With the changes afoot in US and Israeli administrations—along with increasingly vocal, powerful and interconnected resistance groups, domestically and across the border in Gaza—it seems the aging Mubarak regime is getting nervous and finds little option to maintain its grip on power but to resort to a strategy of tension.
