swa: Huku kukiwa na matarajio ya mabadiliko katika serikali za Marekani na Israeli – pamoja na makundi ya upinzani yenye sauti na yaliyo mitandao ya ndani na ile inayovuka mipaka na kuingia Gaza – inaonekana kuwa utawala unaozeeka wa Mubarak unaanza kuingiwa na kihoro na kujikuta una machaguo machache ya kuendeleza mshiko wake madarakani isipokuwa kwa kutumia mikakati ya kuongeza hali ya vuguvugu.

eng: I think the recent release of celebrated political prisoner Ayman Nour should be considered as evidence of the panic roiling the upper echelons of this dictatorship.
swa: Nafikiri kuachiwa kwa mfungwa wa kisiasa Ayman Nour hivi karibuni kunaweza kuwa ni ushahidi wa mchechetu unaozikumba ngazi za juu za utawala huu wa kiimla.

eng: For developing news on this event, check this delicious feed.
swa: Ili kupata habari kama zinavyotukia, angalia ukurasa huu wa delicious.

eng: Until the writing of this post it has been confirmed that a 21-year-old French girl was killed, and around 20 people of different nationalities were injured.
swa: Mpaka wakati makala hii ilipokuwa ikiandikwa imethibitishwa kwamba msichana wa Kifaransa mwenye umri wa miaka 21 ameuwawa, na watu wengine wapatao 20 wa mataifa mbalimbali wamejeruhiwa.

eng: However, it still seems to be pretty early to jump into conclusions about who is responsible for the blast.
swa: Hata hivyo, bado ni mapema mno kurukia hitimisho la ni nani aliyehusika na milipuko.

eng: Pictures can be found on Ahmed AbdelFatah's blog and readers can follow Egyptian bloggers on Twitter here.
swa: Picha zinaweza kupatikana katika blogu ya AbdelFatah na wasomaji wanaweza kuwafuatilia wanablogu wa Misri kwenye twita hapa.

eng: It is a common story across Latin America, where emigrants set off to find greener pastures in neighboring or distant countries.
swa: Ni jambo la kawaida katika Marekani ya Latini kwa wahamiaji kuondoka na kwenda kwenye malisho ya kijani zaidi kwenye nchi jirani au nchi za mbali.

eng: It is no different for Paraguayans, who leave behind friends and family for other opportunities, whether in other South American countries or across the ocean in Europe.
swa: Hakuna tofauti kwa Waparaguai, ambao huwaacha marafiki zao na familia ili kufuata fursa nyingine ama katika nchi za Marekani ya Kusini au ng'ambo nyingine ya bahari kwenye bara la Ulaya.

eng: Some of these stories are now being told using citizen media.
swa: Baadhi ya simulizi hizo zinasimuliwa hivi sasa kwa kutumia uandishi wa kiraia.

eng: A blog called Somos Paraguayos (We Are Paraguayans) invites immigrants across the globe to submit their firsthand stories about their experiences and the response from other Paraguayans in the comments sections add to the conversation.
swa: Blogu inayoitwa Somos Paraguayos (sisi ni Waparaguai) inawakaribisha wahamiaji duniani kote kuwasilisha simulizi za uzoefu wao na kujibiwa na Waparaguai wengine katika safu za maoni.

eng: Many of the stories are filled with heartache about trying to adapt to a new land, and other stories are ones of success.
swa: Simulizi nyingi zimejaa machungu ya moyoni yanayohusu jitihada za kuzoea nchi mpya, na simulizi nyingine ni za mafanikio.

eng: The common theme among many of these stories is a search for better economic opportunities.
swa: Simulizi nyingi zina maudhui ya kutafuta fursa bora za kiuchumi.

eng: Gabriela writes about her 30 years in Argentina having left Paraguay behind in order to help her parents earn money.
swa: Gabriela anaandika kuhusu miaka yake 30 katika nchi ya Ajentina tangu alipoondoka Paraguai ili aweze kuwasaidia wazazi wake kutafuta pesa.

eng: However, leaving behind her country was not an easy task :
swa: Hata hivyo, kuiacha nchi yake halikuwa jambo rahisi :

eng: After a long absence, a number of fascinating Sudanese bloggers, return to the blogosphere to rant, share their thoughts on recent events and vent.
swa: Baada ya kimya kirefu, wanablogu wa Kisudani, wamerejea kwenye ulimwengu wa blogu kuongea, na kushirikiana mawazo kuhusu matukio ya hivi karibuni.

eng: They're included in this roundup along with the usual suspects.
swa: Mawazo hayo yanajumuishwa katika muhtasari huu pamoja na yale ya wanablogu tuliowazoea.

eng: After a frustrated rant about Khartoum International Airport's unhygienic condition, Sudanese Optimist mourned the passing of the respected and well-known Sudanese novelist, Al-Tayeb Saleh.
swa: Baada ya malalamiko kuhusu hali mbaya ya usalama wa afya kwenye Uwanja wa Ndege wa Khartoum, Msudani mwenye matumaini anaomboleza kifo cha mwandishi mashuhuri wa riwaya, Al- Tayeb Saleh.

eng: Sudan has lost a dear citizen, who has contributed tremendously to Sudanese and Arabic literature.
swa: Sudani imempoteza raia mpendwa, ambaye alichangia vikubwa kwenye fasihi ya Kisudani na ya Kiarabu.

eng: His most acclaimed work is the 1966 novel “Season of Migration to the North.”
swa: Kazi yake iliyopata sifa zaidi ni ile ya riwaya ya mwaka 1966 “Msimu wa Kuhamia Kaskazini.”

eng: The novel was, at one point, banned in Sudan for its inclusion of sexual imagery, yet it was declared “the most important Arabic novel of the 20th century” by the Syrian-based Arab Literary Academy in Damascus.
swa: Riwaya hiyo, kwa kipindi fulani, ilizuiliwa nchini Sudani kwa vile ilijumuisha lugha ya picha za ngono, hata hivyo imetambuliwa kama “Riwaya ya muhimu zaidi ya Kiarabu kwenye karne ya 20” na Chuo cha Fasihi cha Kiarabu kilichoko mjini Damascus, Siria.

eng: Earlier this year, The General Union for Sudanese Writers, requested Al Tayeb Saleh to be preliminarily nominated to win the 2009 Literature Noble Prize.
swa: Mapema mwaka huu, Muungano wa Waandishi wa Sudani, waliomba Al Tayeb Saleh atunukiwe Nishani ya Fasihi ya Nobeli kwa mwaka 2009.

eng: Ras Babi Babiker mourned Saleh's passing too by reminding us about the great novel that made him a major name in the world of modern Arabic literature.
swa: Ras Babi Babiker, kadhalika anaomboleza kifo cha Saleh kwa kutukumbusha ile riwaya iliyolikuza jina lake katika ulimwengu wa kisasa wa fasihi ya Kiarabu.

eng: Season of Migration to the North (Arabic: موسم الهجرة إلى الشمال Mawsim al-Hiǧra ilā ash-Shamāl ) is a classic post-colonial Sudanese novel by the late novelist Al-Tayyib Salih.
swa: Msimu wa Kuhamia Kaskazini (Kwa Kiarabu: Mawsim al-Higra ila ash-Shamal) ni rawaya ya hali ya juu sana kuandikwa katika kipindi cha baada-ya-ukoloni na mwandishi Al-Tayyib Salih.

eng: Originally published in Arabic in 1966, it has since been translated into English and French.
swa: Ilichapishwa kwanza kwa Kiarabu mnamo mwaka 1966, na imetafsiriwa katika Kiingereza na Kifaransa.

eng: The novel charts individuation of the (un-named) narrator, who has returned to his native village in the Sudan having spent seven years in England furthering his education.
swa: Riwaya hiyo inamfuatilia msimulizi (ambaye hakutajwa jina) katika safari yake ya kurejea kijijini alikozaliwa nchini Sudan baada ya kuishi Uingereza kwa miaka saba akitafuta elimu zaidi.

eng: On his arrival home, he encounters a new villager ("Mustafa Sa'eed") who exhibits none of the adulation for his achievements that most others do, and displays an antagonistically aloof nature.
swa: Alipowasili nyumbani, alikutana na mwanakijiji mpya (“Mustafa Sa’eed”) ambaye hababaishwi na mafanikio aliyoyapata (mhusika), na anaonyesha maya kwa kutojihusisha naye.

eng: The villager betrays his past one drunken evening by wistfully reciting poetry in fluent English, leaving the narrator resolute to discover the stranger's identity.
swa: Mwanakijiji huyo alifichua maisha yake ya nyuma usiku mmoja baada ya kulewa kwa kuimba mashairi katika Kiingereza sanifu, na kumuacha msimulizi wetu akishangaa baada ya kuugundua ukweli kuhusu mwanakijiji yule.

eng: As it turns out Mustafa was also a precocious student educated in the west but simultaneously harbors a violently hateful and complex relationship with his western identity and acquaintances.
swa: Iliondokea kuwa Mustafa pia alikuwa ni msomi aliyesoma katika nchi za Magharibi lakini alikuwa amejawa na chuki na uhusiano wa ajabu na marafiki zake wa kutoka nchi za Magharibi.

eng: The story of Mustafa's troubled past in Europe and in particular his love affair with a British woman, forms the center of the novel.
swa: Hadithi ya maisha magumu ya Mustafa akiwa Ulaya na hasa uhusiano wake wa kimapenzi na mwanamke wa Kiingereza, ndiyo unachukua nafasi ya kati katika riwaya hiyo.

eng: Meanwhile, as Drima mourned along with his fellow bloggers the death of his country's great novelist, he also blogged an in-depth analysis on the possible consequences of an ICC arrest warrant charging his country's president with crimes against humanity and genocide.
swa: Wakati huo huo, Mwanablogu Drima pia aliomboleza kifo cha mwandishi huyo mashuhuri na wanablogu wenzake, kwa kuandika uchambuzi wa kina wa matokeo ya agizo la kumkamata rais wa nchi yake iliyotokana na tuhuma za mauaji ya kimbari na makosa dhidi ya wanaadamu iliyotolewa na Mahakama ya Kimataifa ya Jinai (ICC).

eng: the ICC can’t do much on its own in terms of enforcing the arrest warrant (if it issues it at all) and the UN is a fangless paper tiger, but…
swa: ICC peke yake haiwezi kufanya lolote kutekeleza agizo hilo la kukamatwa (kama italitoa) na Umoja wa Mataifa ni chui asiye na meno, lakini…

eng: … given that we now have Susan Rice as the US Ambassador to the UN, Hillary as Secretary of State (she has her own blog now by the way), and a Blue Donkey administration in charge of running things, US policies towards Sudan will gradually become starkly different than they were just a few months ago when Bush was still in power.
swa: … vile hivi sasa tunaye Susan Rice kama balozi wa Marekani katika Umoja wa Mataifa, Hillary Clinton kama Katibu wa Mambo ya Nje (anayo blogu yake pia) na serikali ya punda wa kibuluu, sera ya Marekani kwa Sudani itaanza kuwa tofauti na ile iliyokuwepo miezi michache iliyopita wakati Bush alipokuwa madarakani.

eng: An ICC arrest warrant issued within this new context will now have more weight, and hence its potential issuance will probably be more useful as a tool for pressuring Omar al-Bashir to act in favor of peace in Darfur and implementing the CPA.
swa: Agizo la kukamatwa linayotolewa na ICC katika mazingira mapya litakuwa na uzito, hivyo kutolewa kwake kutakuwa na manufaa kama zana ya kumshinikiza Omar Al-Bashir kutengeneza mazingira yatakayoleta amani katika Darfur na kutekeleza mkataba wa Amani Sudani ya Kusini, CPA.

eng: Mimz, who returned to the blogosphere after a long absence, also recently mentioned the ICC arrest warrant and her adventures with Facebook.
swa: Mimz, ambaye amerejea katika ulimwengu wa blogu baada ya muda mrefu, hivi karibuni pia alizungumzia agizo hilo la ICC na mikasa yake binafsi katika Facebook.

eng: “Dang!” doesn’t even begin to describe it.
swa: “Dang! Kabla sijaanza kueleza.

eng: It’s been almost a year and a half since I was last here.
swa: Ni Karibu ya mwaka na nusu tangu nilipokuwa hapa kwa mara mwisho.

eng: And a lot of things went down during that time.
swa: Na mambo mengi yametukia katika wakati huo.

eng: Here are just a few highlights:
swa: Haya ni machache:

eng: I joined facebook.
swa: Nilijiunga na Facebook

eng: There’s a global economic crisis going on and it’s on the rise.
swa: Kuna matatizo ya kiuchumu ulimwenguni yanayoendelea, na yanazidi kukua.

eng: Obama was elected president of the United States.
swa: Obama alichaguliwa kuwa rais wa Marekani

eng: Israeli troops attacked Ghaza killing and injuring hundreds.
swa: Majeshi ya Israeli yaliivamia Gaza na kuua na kujeruhi mamia ya watu.

eng: The International Criminal Court issued an arrest warrant for Omer El-Bashir on charges of war crimes.
swa: Mahakama ya Jinai ya Kimataifa imetoa agizo la kumkamata Omer El-Bashir kwa tuhuma za makosa katika vita.

eng: I graduated.
swa: Nilifanya mahafali

eng: Sami El-Haj was released from Guantanamo Bay. (I obviously have a lot of editing to do).
swa: Sami El-Haj aliachiwa huru kutoka Guantanamo Bay. (bila ya shaka nina kazi kubwa ya kuhariri)

eng: Gillian Gibbons was arrested for a “teddy bear blasphemy case” in Khartoum.
swa: Gillian Gibbons alikamatwa kawa “makosa ya kukufuru ya Teddy Bear” mjini Khartoum

eng: The rebels reached Khartoum and attacked everyone.
swa: Waasi walifika Khartoum na kuwashambulia watu wote.

eng: I quit facebook. Did I mention that I finally graduated?
swa: Nilijitoa kwenye Facebook Hivi nilishasema kwamba nilipata shahada?

eng: Hipster, a Sudanese blogger living in the UAE, is now also back actively blogging again.
swa: Hipster, mwanablogu wa Kisudani anayeishi UAE, pia amerejea na anablogu tena.

eng: She shares with us a little "Che Guevara" experience she had while driving to work.
swa: Anasimulia mkasa wake wa Ki-Che Guevara uliomkuta alipokuwa anaendesha kuelekea kazini.

eng: Aggravated at the abrupt interruption, I glared at the monstrous vehicle, only to be completely amazed and amused at the sight of the colors and words adorning the spare tire case.
swa: Nilisita kutokana na maudhi ya ghafla, nikaliangalia lile gari baya, na kustaajabu kuona rangi na maneno yaliyopamba mfuko wa gurudumu la kipuri.

eng: Che Guevara’s renowned & symbolic raggedy face picture was sandwiched between words in bold letters namely “T.N.T” and “ Al Maafia”.
swa: Sura ngumu inayojulikana ya Che Guevara ikiwa imebanwa katika maneno makubwa yanayosomeka “T.N.T” na “Al Maafia”.

eng: I couldn’t help but look down at my paperback copy of “The Young Che: Memories of Che Guevara”, lying on the passenger’s seat, triggering me to ponder and wonder upon the mockery this revolutionary has become.
swa: Sikuweza kujizuia kuangalia nakala yangu ya Kitabu “Che Kijana: Kumbukumbu za Che Guevara”, kilichokuwa kimejiegesha kwenye kiti cha abiria, na kunifanya niwaze na kujiuliza ni jinsi gani mwanamapinduzi huyu amegeuka kuwa mzaha wa namna hii.

eng: With my humble knowledge, I ask: What do “T.N.T” and “Mafia” have anything to do with the Soldier of the Americas?
swa: Katika ufahamu wangu wa wastani, nauliza: Maneno “T.N.T” na “Maafia” yana uhusiano gani na mwanajeshi huyu wa bara la Marekani?

eng: And if you've ever wondered whether blogging is a form of therapy, you're not alone.
swa: Na kama umeshawahi kujiuliza kama kublogu ni namna fulani ya matibabu ya akili, hauko peke yako.

eng: Path2Hope shares those thoughts too.
swa: Path2Hope anashiriki katika wazo hilo pia:

eng: And then it happened, the dam that was blocking my ability from putting down thoughts onto paper broke and everything wanted to come pouring out instantly.
swa: Na ikatokea, lile bwawa lililokuwa linazuia uwezo wa kuandika mawazo yangu kwenye karatasi likapasuka na kila kitu kikataka kumwagika mara moja.

eng: So much to write about, so many experiences to relate and then you sit infront of the laptop and wonder - who the heck cares?
swa: Mambo mengi ya kuandika, matukio mengi ya kuhusisha na unapoketi na tarakilishi yako ya mapajani na kujiuliza – ni nani anayejali?

eng: Everyone has their own battle that they are tackling - and well I suppose blogging really is a form of therapy and an excuse to self indulge.
swa: Kila mtu ana mapambano yake – na nadhani kublogu ni aina ya matibabu na kisingizio cha ubinafsi.

eng: As for JohnAckec, he reminded us today of the increasingly sad situation with education in Sudan.
swa: Na kwa John Ackec, leo anatukumbusha juu ya hali ya kusikitisha ya elimu nchini Sudan.

eng: With more than 30 universities in Sudan and with talk of declining academic standards and rising level of unemployment amongst university graduates in our country, one is led to believe that university education has lost its glitter and is now next to worthless.
swa: Kukiwa na vyuo vikuu zaidi ya 30 nchini Sudan na kukiwa na maongezi ya kushuka kwa kiwango cha elimu na ongezeko la ukosefu wa ajira kati ya wale waliohitimu chuo kikuu, tunashawishika kuamini kuwa Vyuo Vikuu vimepoteza thamani yake na sasa vinakaribia kutokuwa na thamani yoyote.

eng: Nothing could be further from the truth.
swa: Hakuna lililo mbali na ukweli.

eng: On a happier note, Precious, wished everyone a Happy Valentine's Day.
swa: Katika furaha, Precious anawatakia kila mmoja siku njema ya wapendanao ya Matakatifu Valentino.

eng: Although I no longer beleive in romance and that passionate love I used to dream of, and although I no longer trust a man's fake "I love you"s, but you might still have a little hope.
swa: Japokuwa siamini tena katika mahaba na mapenzi mazito niliyokuwa nikiyatamani, na japokuwa siamini uongo wa wanaume wanaposema “nakupenda” wewe bado unaweza kuwa na matumaini kidogo.

eng: So anyway, I deeply and sincerely wish you a very Happy Valentines day, whether you are Single, dating, engaged or married.
swa: Haidhuru, Kwa dhati na taadhima nakutakia sikukuu yenye furaha ya Mtakatifu Valentino, ikiwa uko peke yako, una mpenzi, umechumbiwa au umefunga ndoa.

eng: Enjoy the day and dont let anyone not even him/her, ruin it for you!
swa: Furahia siku hiyo, na usimruhusu yeyote pamoja na yeye, akuharibie siku yako!

eng: According to a poll carried out last month, Ukraine's president Victor Yushchenko "would have won less than 2.9% of the vote if the presidential elections were held in late December 2008 or early January 2009."
swa: Kwa mujibu wa kura ya maoni iliyofanyika mwezi uliopita, Rais wa Ukraine Victor Yushchenko “angeshinda chini ya asilimia 2.9 ya kura kama uchaguzi wa rais ungefanywa mwishoni mwa mwezi desemba 2008 au mwanzoni mwa mwezi wa Januari 2009.”

eng: Among reasons for such low approval ratings is "the relentless infighting" between the president and PM Yulia Tymoshenko.
swa: Kati ya sababu za matokeo hafifu ya kura ya maoni ni "migogoro ya ndani isiyoisha" kati ya rais na Mwaziri mkuu Yulia Tymoshenko.

eng: On Feb. 5, Tymoshenko's cabinet survived a no-confidence vote in parliament: the motion won 203 votes in the 450-seat assembly; a minimum of 226 votes is required for a motion to pass.
swa: Tarehe 5 Februari, baraza la mawaziri la Tymoshenko lilinusurika kuondolewa baada ya kura ya kutokowa na imani katika bunge: waliopendekeza kura hiyo walishinda kwa kura 203 katika bunge la viti 450; kura 226 zinahitajika ili muswada upite.

eng: LEvko of Foreign Notes wrote this about the implications of the vote for the president and his political allies:

swa: Manaibu wajumbe 10 tu ndio waliounga mkono muswada wa kutokuwa na imani uliofadhiliwa na katika serikali inayoongozwa na Tymoshenko katika bunge la Ukraine leo hii.

eng: Amongst the 10 were presidential secretariat head Viktor Baloha's 'Yedyniy Tsentr' group, and Yushchenko's brother Petro.
swa: Miongoni mwa wajumbe hao 10 lilikuwepo kundi la ‘Yedyniy Tsentr' linaloongozwa na mkuu wa sekretarieti ya rais Viktor Baloha pamoja na kaka yake Yuschenko, Petro.

eng: The numbers are very bad news for the president.
swa: Idadi hiyo ni habari mbaya kwa rais.

eng: The pro-presidential NUNS entered the current parliament with 72 deputies in Autumn 2007.
swa: Wajumbe wanaomuunga mkono rais waliingia bungeni wakiwa na manaibu 72 wakati wa majira ya kipupwe 2007.

eng: With an ever-receding power base, the chances of a second presidential term for Yushchenko are almost nil.
swa: Wakiwa wanazidi kupungukiwa na msingi wa nguvu, nafasi ya Yuschenko kushika awamu ya pili ya urais inakaribia na kutokuwepo.

eng: Rising Voices and Global Voices are holding a live online chat for bloggers and activists on Friday March 6, 2009 (5 pm Nairobi time) on how to use blogging to improve awareness and information about HIV/AIDS.
swa: Mradi wa Rising Voices na Global Voices wanaandaa gumzo la moja kwa moja mtandaoni kwa wanablogu na wanaharakati siku ya Ijumaa mwezi wa tatu mwaka huu(saa 11 jioni kwa saa za Nairobi) mada kuu ikiwa jinsi ya kublogu na kuongeza uelewa na habari kuhusu virusi vya ukimwi na Ukimwi.

eng: Everyone is welcome.
swa: Kila mmoja anakaribishwa

eng: Local Times: New York 09:00 | Buenos Aires 12:00 | London 14:00 | Johannesburg, Beirut 16:00 | Nairobi, Moscow 17:00 | New Delhi 19:30 | Hong Kong 22:00 | Tokyo 23:00
swa: Muda:New York 3 asubuhi | Buenos Aires 6mchana | London 8mchana | Johannesburg,Beirut 10jioni | Nairobi, Moscow 11 jioni | New Delhi 1:30 usiku | Hong Kong 4usiku | Tokyo 5 usiku

eng: Chatroom: http://www.worknets.org/chat/ Login instructions: Click on the link above and login using your name.
swa: Chumba cha gumzo:http://www.worknets.org/chat/

eng: Then select the room you want to join by clicking enter. Once in the room, select a font color on the left side of the screen, and join the chat.
swa: Jinsi ya kujiunga:Bonyeza kingo hapo juu tumia jina lako.Kisha chagua chumba utakacho kujiunga kwa kubonyeza ingia.Baada ya kuingia chagua ukubwa wa maandishi upande wa kushoto wa kiwambo cha tarakishi yako, jiunge katika gumzo

eng: The March 6th chat will build on topics brought up in last week's successful online discussion.
swa: Gumzo la tarehe 6 mwezi wa 3 litajenga mada iliyoletwa katika majadiliano yaliofanikiwa wiki iliyopita.

eng: The February 27th chat addressed issues such as why blogging can be important for people affected by HIV/AIDS and the vital roles of mentoring and advocacy, but it mainly focused on the Blogging Positively Guide, a guide being created by Global Voices to provide valuable advice on how to blog about HIV/AIDS issues.
swa: Gumzo la tarehe 27 mwezi wa pili lilitoa tamko kama vile umuhimu wa kublogu kwa watu walioathirika na virusi vya ukimwi na jukumu katika upelekaji na ushawishi wa maarifa,lakini kikubwa lililenga kwenye muongozo wa kublogu vyema ,muongozo ulitengenezwa na Global Voices kutoa ushauri tunu jinsi ya kublogu kuhusu masuala ya Virusi vya Ukimwi na Ukimwi.

eng: The Guide is a work-in-progress, so we are looking for help to create it and/or to give feedback.
swa: Muongozo huo bado ni kazi inayooendelea, kwa hiyo tunatafuta msaada kutengeneza na kutoa matokeo.

eng: Those interested in or already blogging about the pandemic are encouraged to participate in this week's chat, particularly those living with and/or affected by HIV/AIDS.
swa: Kwa wale waliokuwa na nia au waliokwisha blogu kuhusu maafa wanahimizwa kushiriki katika gumzo wiki hii, hasa wale wanaoishi au walioathirika na virusi vya ukimwi.

eng: Friday's chat will focus on issues such as forming working groups for the Blogging Positively Guide and discussing what chapters and topics to include in it.
swa: Gumzo la Ijumaa litalenga masuala kama vile uanzishwaji makundi maalum ya kazi au vitengo kwa ajili ya mchakato wa kutengeneza muongozo wa kublogu vyema kadhalika gumzo hilo litajadili kuhusu aya na na mada zipi zijumuishwe kwenye muongozo.

eng: If there are other topics that you would like to discuss during the chat, please add comments below. Hope you can join us on March 6!
swa: Pia kuna mada nyingine ambazo utataka kujadili wakati wa gumzo,tafadhali weka maoni chini.Natumaini mtashirikiana nasi tarehe 6 mwezi wa tatu

eng: Pope Benedict XVI is visiting Cameroon from 17 to 20 March 2009.
swa: Papa Benedikti wa XVI anazuru Kameruni kuanzia tarehe 17 mpaka tarehe 20 Machi 2009.

eng: This has led the government to take some radical clean-up measures as described by Griet,Thorsten, Jara and Lisa blog:
swa: Ziara hii imepelekea serikali kuchukua hatua kali za usafi kama anavyoelezwa katika blogu ya Griet,Thorsten, Jara and Lisa:

eng: 1 All small shops, houses, vendor's stalls that don't look nice enough are being destroyed with a large caterpillar.
swa: 1. Maduka yote madogo, nyumba, vibanda vya wachuuzi ambavyo havina sura nzuri vianbomolewa na makatapila makubwa.

eng: The truck comes by, looks at your stall/house/whatever and if the driver doesn't like, he just destroys it with all its content.
swa: Malori hayo ya katapila yanafika, na kutazama kibanda/nyumba/au chochote ambacho dereva haridhishwi nacho, halafu anabomoa pamoja na vyote vilivyomo.

eng: It all started about a week ago in the city centre.
swa: Hii ilianza kama wiki moja iliyopita katikati ya mji.

eng: Suddenly the streets did not house streetvendors anymore, all the local shops at the post office disappeared etc.
swa: Ghafla jiji halikuwa na wachuuzi wa mitaani tena, maduka yote yaliyoko posta yalitoweka n.k.

eng: Now it's been extended all the way to the airport.
swa: Hivi sasa (operesheni hiyo) imeenea mpaka uwanja wa ndege.

eng: 2 The road to the airport has brand new streetlights.
swa: Barabara inayoelekea uwanja wa ndege ina taa mpya za barabarani.

eng: But then ONLY the way from the airport to the town centre.
swa: Lakini ni katika njia hiyo TU kutokea uwanja wa ndege mpaka katikati ya jiji.

eng: 3 Tuesday (for sure, other days to be confirmed) the road between airport and town centre will be blocked.
swa: 3. Jumanne (kwa hakika, na siku nyingine zitathibitishwa) baranbara kati ya uwanja wa ndege na katikati ya jiji zitafungwa.

eng: Note: the pope arrives in the evening, but the road needs to be blocked from EARLY MORNING.
swa: Angalia: Papa atawasili wakati wa jioni, lakini barabara zitafungwa kuanzia ALFAJIRI.

eng: Hence nobody can get to/from work, school etc.
swa: Hivyo hakuna atakayeweza kwenda au kurudi kutoka kazini, shule n.k.

eng: This post also links to another blog by an expertriate family Sander Elke en Milan that has has photos of the destruction to roadside shops in the streets of Yaounde.
swa: Makala hii kadhalika inaunganisha blogu nyingine ya familia ya mfanyakazi kutoka nje Sander Elke en Milan ambayo ina picha ya uharibifu wa maduka yaliyoko kandokando ya barabara kwenye mitaa ya Yaounde.

eng: This demolition has sparked a debate on the blogs of two expatriates in Cameroon.
swa: Bomoabomoa hii imezua mjadala katika blogu za wafanyakazi wawili kutoka nje walioko Kameruni.

eng: Συγκακοπαθησον a blog maintained by a missionary in Cameroon posted on the changes to the outlook of Yaounde as a aresult of the Pope's coming.
swa: Blogu ya Συγκακοπαθησον inayoandikwa na mmisionari aliyeko Kameruni ilichapisha mabadiliko yatakayotokana na ujio wa Papa jijini Yaounde.

eng: So what’s my take on the whole thing?
swa: Je nina mtazamo upi kuhusu suala hili?

eng: It’s nice that the city is getting a face-lift - it sure makes things look a lot nicer, and the big street lights make driving at night or trying to get a taxi along the main route so much easier and safer - but it’s sad that this clean-up has to mean the destruction of people’s way of life.
swa: Ni jambo zuri kwamba jiji linapata sura mpya - (safisha-safisha) inalifanya jiji lionekane zuri zaidi, na mataa ya barabarani yamerahisisha kuendesha magari usiku kadhalika kupata usafiri wa teksi kuwa rahisi na salama - lakini ni masikitiko kwamba safisha-safisha hii inamaanisha uharibifu wa namna ya watu wanavyoishi.

eng: Unfortunately, these people were simply ignorant of the “rules,” some willfully so, and are now facing the consequences.
swa: Kwa bahati mbaya, hawa watu hawazifahamu "taratibu", wengine kwa kupenda, na hivi sasa wanakumbana na matokeo.

eng: The sad part is that it seems the government was content to just let things be (possibly for as long as 10 years or longer) until something big came up, like the Pope’s arrival.
swa: Jambo la kusikitisha ni kuwa serikali ilikuwa imeridhika na kuachia mambo yaendelee kuwa yalivyo (pengine kwa miaka 10 au zaidi) mpaka jambo kubwa lilipotokea, kama vile ujio wa Papa.

eng: If they had taken these structures down as soon as they went up, there wouldn’t be this kind of destruction of people’s livelihood now.
swa: Kama wangebomoa majengo yale pale tu yalipotojitokeza, pasingekuwa na uharibifu wa njia za kuishi za watu.

eng: Then again, I guess the law is still the law even when it’s not enforced.
swa: Lakini hata hivyo, nadhani sheria ni sheria hata kama haitekelezwi.

eng: This point of view wasn't really shared by British-born VSO volunteer blogging at Our Man in Cameroon.
swa: Mtazamo huu haujapokelewa vizuri na mfanyakazi wa kujitolea wa VSO aliyezaliwa Uingereza ambaye anablogu katika blogu ya Our Man in Cameroon.

eng: His reaction in a post entitled Impossible Missionary was simple:
swa: Majibu yake katika makala iliyoitwa Impossible Missionary yalikuwa ni mepesi:

eng: Street stalls are a way of life here.
swa: Vibanda vya biashara vya mitaani ni njia ya maisha hapa.

eng: They are everywhere.
swa: Vipo kila sehemu.

eng: It’s easy just to say they are illegal but they can be pretty solid structures.
swa: Ni rahisi kusema kuwa vipo kinyume ya sheria lakini vinaweza kuwa ni majengo madhubuti.

eng: What’s more, if they are illegal I’d imagine that they have only been allowed to remain because someone, somewhere is taking a regular few thousands Francs in bribes.
swa: La zaidi, kama vipo kinyume cha sheria nadhani vimeruhusiwa kuwepo kwa sababu kuna mtu, mahali fulani ambaye kila mara anachukua faranga elfu kadhaa kama rushwa.

eng: People here struggle.
swa: Watu wanahangaika hapa.

eng: You can bet these structures don’t turn over much and in a country where enterprise and entrepreneurship is so minimal…well what a way to reward it.I ask you, if you are in general agreement with what I have written and also find the missionary’s take as ignorant as I do, to leave a comment.
swa: Unaweza kusema kuwa majengo haya hayazalishi sana katika nchi kama hii ambapo juhudi na ujasiriamali viko chini mno… naam, ni njia iliyoje ya kuwatuza. Ninakuomba, kama unakubaliana na niliyoyaandika na kama uafikiri kuwa mtazamo wa mmisionari ni wa kijinga, tafadhali acha maoni.

eng: Not below but instead on the missionaries own blog.
swa: Siyo hapa chini, bali katika blogu ya mmisionari.

eng: However, readers still commented on this story on the Our Man in Cameroon blog.
swa: Hata hivyo, wasomaji waliendelea kuandika maoni kuhusu habari hii kwenye blogu ya Our Man in Cameroon.

eng: The reactions got to a point that, Karis, the wife of the missionary stepped-up in defence of her husband:
swa: Maoni yalifikia kiwango ambapo Karis, mke wa mmisionari aliingilia kati ili kumtetea mume wake:

eng: I never knew my husband could cause such a stir.
swa: Sikujua kwamba mume wangu anaweza kusababisha mtafaruku wa namna hii.

eng: I think sometimes we think that only people that know us read our blogs and those people know how to take what we write instead of tearing it apart line by line without knowing us at all.
swa: Nadhani kuwa wakati mwingine huwa tunafikiri kuwa ni watu wanaotufahamu pekee ambao husoma blogu zetu na watu hao hufahamu jinsi ya kuchukulia yale tunayoyaandika badala ya kuyachambua mstari kwa mstari pasina kutufahamu hata chembe.

eng: Trav, thanks for putting in a good word.
swa: Trav, nakushukuru kwa maoni yako mazuri.

eng: Dad A, thanks for the humor.
swa: Dad A, nashukuru kwa utani wako.

eng: You always put a smile on my face.
swa: Kila mara huwa unanijaza tabasamu usoni kwangu.

eng: I just wish all of you that commented here and on his blog knew my husband — you wouldn’t be so harsh as you pull apart sentences.
swa: Ninatamani kuwa nyie wote mliotoa maoni hapa na kwenye blogu ya mume wangu mngekuwa mnamfahamu mume wangu - msingekuwa wakali namna hii wakati mkichambua sentensi zake.

eng: He and I have had many conversations about how horrible it is that people’s livelihood is taken away from them and all for a few days visit from the Pope.
swa: Mimi na yeye tumekuwa na mazungumzo mengi kuhusu ni jinsi gani njia za maisha za watu zimepokonywa na yote hayo kwa sababu tu ya ziara ya Papa kwa siku chache.

eng: When we were in town on Monday and saw stuff being thrown into trucks, it made me sick to my stomach.
swa: Tulipokuwa mjini jumatatu na kuona vitu vinavyotupwa kwenye magari ya mizigo, nilichefuka mpaka tumboni.

eng: More than once, we said, “But how are people going to eat tonight? and the next day and the next day?”
swa: Zaidi ya mara moja tulijisemea, "je watu hawa watakula wapi usiku wa leo? Na siku inayofuata na inayofuata?"

eng: It goes even beyond that in…
swa: Tuliendelea zaidi ya hapo kwenye…

eng: And then today, I saw him helping people move their sewing machines, their tables, their bags of stuff farther down on our road as the government came through with the bulldozer.
swa: Na hivi leo, nilimuona akiwasaidia watu kuhamisha cherehani, meza na mapakacha ya makabrasha yao kuyapeleka mbali zaidi hapa barabarani kwetu wakati serikali ilipokuwa inakuja na magari ya kubomoa.

eng: No, that was not emphasized enough in this post to show all of our conversations and actions, but wow… that doesn’t mean that my husband doesn’t feel for the people here!
swa: Hapana, hilo halikusisitizwa katika makala hii ili kuonyesha mazungumzo na vitendo vyetu, lakini wow… hilo halimaanishi kuwa mume wangu hana hisia na watu wa hapa!

eng: Maybe I can convince him to write another post, but I’m not sure because it may be best just to leave this rather than getting things torn apart again.
swa: Pengine ninaweza kumshawishi aandike makala nyingine, lakini sina hakika kwa sababu inaweza ikawa ni bora tu kuacha mambo kama yalivyo badala ya kufanya yachambuliwe tena.

eng: I’d better just stop.
swa: Naona bora nikome.

eng: A wife sticking up for her wonderful husband isn’t much of a mind changer.
swa: Mke kumuunga mkono mume wake hakutabadilisha akili za watu.

eng: The exchanges did not end at that.
swa: Majibizano hayo hayakuishia hapo.

eng: This Papal visit has quite some twists to it on the blogoshpere!
swa: Ziara hii ya Papa ina makeke mengi kwenye ulimwengu wa blogu!

eng: The visit of the head of the Roman Catholic Church to Cameroon this March 2009 has ignited some Cameroonian bloggers to point the search lights on the political effects (if any) of a Papal visit to country like this.
swa: Ziara ya kiongozi wa Kanisa La Katoliki nchini Kameruni mwezi huu wa Machi 2009 imepelekea baadhi ya wanablogu wa Kikameruni kuelekeza tochi zao kwenye matokeo ya kisiasa (kama yapo) yatakayotokana na ziara hiyo ya Papa nchini humo.

eng: Neba Fuh blogging at Voice of the Oppressed is one of them:
swa: Neba Fuh anayeblogu kwenye Voice of The Oppressed ni mmoja wa wanablogu hao:

eng: Two times before, Late Pope John Paul II visited The Cameroons and the effect on the already impoverished populace was nothing more than a religious euphoria at the expense of their personal financial contributions and the public treasury.
swa: Mara mbili, Hayati Papa Yohane Paulo wa Pili alizuru Kameruni na matokeo ya ziara hizo kwa umma wa watu ambao ni masikini hayakuwa zaidi ya furaha ya kidini iliyowagharimu michango binafsi pamoja na ile ya hazina ya serikali.

eng: The unanswered questions of the Biya's repressive acts were still unanswered.
swa: Maswali yasiyo na majibu kuhusu vitendo vya ukandamizaji vya (rais) Biya yalibaki bila ya majibu.

eng: Aloysius Agendia, a journalist and ex-seminarian in a post entitled Pope Benedict XVI visit to AFRICA : Going beyond spiritual rhetoric seems to suggest that the Church should denounce acts by states and politicains that harm the people's interest instead of being clothed in diplomatic robes:
swa: Aloysius Agendia, mwanahabari ambaye pia ni mseminari wa zamani katika makala aliyoipa kichwa cha Ziara ya Papa Benedikti wa XVI AFRIKA: zaidi ya kauli za kiroho inaonekana kwamba angependa Kanisa lipinge vitendo vya dola na vya wanasiasa ambavyo vinaharibu maslahi ya umma badala ya kuvivika majoho ya kidiplomasia:

eng: We understand the Church and the Vatican as a state, and as a religious body, though with political connotations, sometimes has to be diplomatic in its approach.
swa: Tunalielewa Kanisa na Vatikani kama dola, kadhalika kama chombo cha dini, japokuwa lina maana pia ya kisiasa, na wakati mwingine linapaswa kuwa na diplomasia katika mtazamo wake.

eng: In my opinion, true religion must not be indifferent to injustices, oppression, exploitation, colonialism in all its forms and other vices.
swa: Kwa maoni yangu, dini ya kweli haipaswi kufumbia macho maovu, ukandamizaji, unyonyaji, ukoloni katika mifumo yake yote pamoja na maovu mengine.

eng: The Catholic Church has done much and is still doing a lot but a lot more still has to be done.However, diplomacy though good in its own ways, must not be of too common usage in the Church because, a spade must be called a spade.
swa: Kanisa Katoliki limefanya mengi na linaendelea kufanya lakini mengi zaidi bado yanapaswa kufanywa. Hata hivyo, diplomasia hata kama ni nzuri katika namna yake, haitakiwi kutumika sana katika Kanisa kwa sababu, beleshi ni lazima liitwe beleshi.

eng: In trying to always use "subtle" means to explain burning issues, the message is either lost or the meaning/importance, seriously minimized.
swa: Katika kujaribu kutumia mbinu "laini" ili kufafanua masuala mazito, ujumbe huweza kupotea au maana/na umuhimu, unaweza kuchujwa sana.

eng: Church leaders must not choose to dine only with those in power, the rich, and the powerful.
swa: Viongozi wa kanisa hawapaswi kuchagua kufanya karamu na wale walio madarakani, matajiri na wenye nguvu.

eng: They must not necessarily be with the opposition, but, they should stand beside the weak, the oppressed, the sick etc.
swa: Siyo lazima wawe na pamoja na wapinzani, lakini, inawabidi wasimame pamoja na wanyonge, wanaokandamizwa, wagonjwa n.k

eng: He is clear about what he expects from the Pope:
swa: Anajua wazi ni nini anachotegemea kutoka kwa Papa:

eng: As a spiritual leader who represents hope, he must not only tell us to just keep waiting and hoping.
swa: Kama kiongozi wa kiroho anayewakilisha matumaini, hatakiwi kutuambia tuendelee kungoja na kutumaini.

eng: We expect him to be courageous enough to tell those thwarting the hope of Cameroonians and Africans to at least, have some feelings for human beings and or their fellow citizens.
swa: Tunatumaini kuwa atakuwa na ujasiri wa kutosha kuwaaambia wale wanaokinza matumaini ya Wakameruni na Waafrika wawe angalau na hisia kwa wanaadamu wenzao au wananchi wenzao.

eng: On the other hand, Voice of the Oppressed wonders if the clergy particularly in Cameroon has the moral high ground to demand change from those who govern the country when they themselves are not shinning examples:
swa: Kwenye upande mwingine, Voice of the Oppressed anajiuliza kama wazee wa kanisa hasa wale wa Kameruni wana maadili ya kutaka mabadiliko kutoka kwa wale wanaotawala nchi wakati wao wenyewe sio mifano angavu:

eng: What lessons can an already morally impoverished society learn from a bishop or priest who fathers children haphazardly in his community?
swa: Ni somo gani ambalo jamii iliyopotoka kimaadili inaweza kujifunza kutoka kwa askofu au padri ambaye anazaa watoto kiholela katika jamii yake?

eng: What lessons can that society learn from a priest who has numerous 'girlfriends' in his community, under the excuse that he is only as human as everybody else?
swa: Ni somo gani ambalo jamii inaweza kujifunza kutoka kwa padri mwenye wapenzi wa kike kadhaa kwenye jamii, kwa kisingizio kuwa ati "ni mwanaadamu" kama wanaadamu wengine?

eng: Or sponsored a girlfriend's trip abroad, away from his community, so she can bear him kids, and when he takes his vacation or study leave, he's welcome abroad by 'his wife' and 'children'?
swa: Au anayedhamini safari ya rafiki huyo wa kike nje ya nchi, mbali na jamii, ili aweze kumzalia watoto, na pale anapochukua likizo au likizo ya masomo, anakaribishwa huko nje ya nchi na "mke" pamoja na "wanawe"?

eng: Or a Principal of a school,who is a priest, who embezzles school money through fake bills and accounting?
swa: Au mkuu wa shule ambaye ni padri, ambaye anafuja fedha za shule kwa kutumia hundi na mahesabu ya kughushi?

eng: Or priests that have become predators to vulnerable children put at their disposal?
swa: Au padri ambaye amegeuka kuwa mwindaji wa watoto wasio na kinga ambao wamewekwa chini ya usimazi wake?

eng: To Aloysius Agendia should Pope Benedict XVI of the perceived waywardness of Catholic prelates in Cameroon:
swa: Kwa Aloysius Agendia Papa Benedikti wa XVI anapaswa aongelee mwenendo wa hovyo wa viongozi wa Kikatoliki nchini Kameruni:

eng: As the Holy Father visits Cameroon and Africa , he should note this.
swa: Wakati Baba Mtakatifu anapozuru Kameruni na Afrika, ni lazima akumbuke hili.

eng: First and foremost, the Catholic Church and most of its (shepherds) in Cameroon in particular, need serious "redressing" or "overhauling”.
swa: Kwanza kabisa, Kanisa Katoliki na wengi wa (wachungaji) wake katika Kameruni wanahitaji "kurekebishwa" au "kukarabatiwa".

eng: The numerous stories about promiscuity, extravagance and gallivanting attitudes of some of our priests including some bishops, some even go as far as bearing children, others fornicating with their students, peoples’ wives, parishioners etc must be addressed...
swa: Habari nyingi zinazohusu uzinzi, ufujaji na tabia za utongozaji kwa baadhi ya mapadri wetu wakiwamo maaskofu, ambao wengine wanafika mbali hata kuzaa watoto, wengine wanafanya ngono na wanafunzi wao, wake za watu, wanaparokia n.k, ni lazima viongelewe...

eng: This blogger belives if these issues of corruption within the Roman Catholic Church in Cameroon are not handled by the Pope then the visit would have no meaning to him:
swa: Mwanablogu huyu anaamini kuwa kama masuala ya upotofu ndani ya Kanisa la Kikatoliki la Roma nchini Kameruni hatashughulikiwa na Papa, ziara hiyo haitakuwa na maana yoyote kwake:

eng: Mortgaging the Church and its assets for “loans”, as if to sell Jesus Christ again for FCFA 950.000. 000 as Judas did for 30 pieces of silver.
swa: Kuliweka rehani Kanisa na mali zake kwa ajili ya kuchukua "mikopo", kama vile kumuuza Yesu Kristu tena kwa Faranga 950.000.000 kama vile Yuda alivyofanya kwa vipande 30 vya fedha.

eng: Tis follows using a famous Cathedral in Cameroon as a security for a loan taken by one of its bishop.
swa: Hii inatokana na kanisa linalojulikana sana nchini Kameruni kuwekwa kama dhamana kwa ajili ya mkopo aliochukua mmoja wa maaskofu wake.

eng: The serious and terrifying cases of embezzlement among others, merit papal attention.
swa: Kuna kesi za kutisha za ufujaji ambazo zinabidi kutupiwa macho na Papa.

eng: These are issues which if the Pope fails to address even in private with his priests, then his mission to Cameroon, I must admit, must have fallen far belowexpectations, and why not, a non-starter.
swa: Haya ni masuala ambayo ikiwa Papa atashindwa kuyashughulikia hata katika faragha na mapadri wake, basi ziara yake nchini Kameruni, ni lazima nikubali, kwamba itakuwa imeanguka chini ya matarajio.

eng: Will the Pope dare?
swa: Je Papa atathubutu?

eng: That may be the next point of interest of the Cameroonian blogosphere.
swa: Hilo litakuwa ndio suala linafuatia kwenye ulimwengu wa blogu wa Kameruni.

eng: Note: Part 1 of this post is found here.
swa: Tafadhali Angalia: Sehemu ya kwanza ya makala hii inapatikana hapa.

eng: There is a final push by political parties contesting the upcoming elections in South Africa.
swa: Vyama vya siasa nchini Afrika ya kusini vimo katika hatua za mwisho za kampeni ya uchaguzi ujao.

eng: In particular, the ruling party the ANC (African National Congress) held a debate via twitter today.
swa: Chama tawala cha ANC (African National Congress) kilifanya mjadala kwa kutumia huduma ya twita.

eng: Interestingly, the political parties have begun to make use of Social Media and social networks to get their message across.
swa: Vyama vya siasa vimeanza kutumia mitandao ya kijamii kwenye intaneti ili kufikisha ujumbe.

eng: The most prominent party making use of these techniques has been the DA (Democratic Alliance) whose campaign seems to have been inspired by President Obama's election campaign last year.
swa: Chama kikubwa ambacho kimekuwa kikitumia huduma hizo ni chama cha DA (Democtratic Alliance) ambacho kampeni yake imetiwa moyo na kampeni ya mwaka jana ya Obama.

eng: The DA have been managing a presence on social networks and several twitter accounts such as that of the mayor of Cape town and head of the DA, Helen Zille.
swa: Chama cha DA kinaendesha kampeni ya kujitangaza kwenye mitandao ya kijamii pamoja na akaunti kadhaa za twita kama ile ya meya wa mji wa Cape Town na mkuu wa chama cha DA, Helen Zille.

eng: However, today the ANC announced on a newly created twitter account "ANC_DEBATE" that they would be hosting a live debate with questions fielded by Jessie Duarte, an anti apartheid activist and current spokesperson for the ANC.
swa: Tarehe 17-04-2009 chama cha ANC kilitangaza akaunti yake mpya ya twita "ANC_DEBATE " ambayo itakuwa ikiendesha mijadala ya moja kwa moja huku Jessie Duarte, mwanaharakati wa kupinga ubaguzi wa rangi na msemaji wa sasa wa chama cha ANC akijibu maswali.

eng: After the announcement there was some debate on the usefulness of this.
swa: Baada ya kutangazwa kulizuka majadiliano kuhusu umuhimu (wa akaunti hiyo).

eng: A South African twitter user @woganmay even created a special page on twittersa, to aggregate all the comments.
swa: Mtumiaji wa huduma ya twita wa Kiafrika ya Kusini @ woganmay alitengeneza kurasa maalum kwenye tovuti ya twittersa ili kukusanya maoni.

eng: Some reactions to the debate however were negative and the ANC took criticism.
swa: Maoni kadhaa katika mjadala huo yalikuwa hasi na chama cha ANC kililaumiwa.

eng: For example, Jason felt that all of this was too late.
swa: Kwa mfano, Jason alihisi kuwa jitihada hizi zimechelewa na muda umekwisha.

eng: while Naeem felt that the amount of South African voters that are on twitter constitute a very small minority.
swa: Wakati Naeem alihisi kwamba idadi ya Waafrika kusini wanaotumia huduma ya twita ni ndogo sana.

eng: The ANC_Debate account saw a flood of questions directed towards it, and some of the responses are summarized below.
swa: Tovuti ya ANC_Debate ilifikiwa na mafuriko ya maswali na ufuatao ni muhtasari wa baadhi ya majibu.

eng: @Saulkza: Let's talk economy: What are you going to do to stop a local recession?
swa: @Saulkza: tuongelee uchumi: Mtafanya nini kuzuia kudhoofika kwa uchumi?

eng: What about unemployment?
swa: Vipi kuhusu ukosefu wa ajira?

eng: @ANC_debate: A massive public investment in infrastructure will stimulate economic activity, increased public works, support to key sectors.
swa: @ANC_debate: Uwekezaji kabambe kwenye miundombinu utachangamsha shughuli za kiuchumi, huduma za jamii ni uti wa mgongo wa sekta muhimu.

eng: @nikzaz: what will you do about crime in south africa?
swa: @nikzaz: mtafanya nini kuhusu uhalifu nchini Afrika ya Kusini?

eng: @ANC_debate: Overhaul criminal justice system - better coordination, modernise systems, more resources.
swa: @ANC_debate: tutakarabati mfumo wa sheria za uhalifu - uratibu bora, tutatengeneza miundo ya kisasa na tutaongeza rasilimali.

eng: Organise communities and deal with causes.
swa: Tutaiandaa jamii na kukabili vyanzo (vya uhalifu).

eng: @shaynekrige: What in your opinion was the ANC's biggest mistake over the last 15 years? @ANC_debate: Not so much a mistake, but not enough effort put into involving people in govt and in decisions about their lives.
swa: @shaynekrige:Kwa maoni yako ni kosa gani kubwa ambalo ANC imelifanya katika miaka 15 iliyopita? @ANC_debate: Siyo kosa kubwa, bali kutotilia mkazo iapasavyo kwenye kushirikisha wananchi serikalini na katika maamuzi yanayowahusu.

eng: This comment interesting, as it begs the question: Are we going to see an overhaul of the current ANC, a new way of including people in government decisions?
swa: Oni hili, linazua swali: Je tutauona ukarabati katika ANC ya leo, njia mpya za kuushirikisha umma kwenye maamuzi ya serikali?

eng: Maybe government 2.0?
swa: Labda serikali ya kidijitali 2.0?

eng: They also responded to comments and fears of censorship of the press
swa: Pia walijibu maswali yanayohusu hofu za uchujwaji wa habari

eng: @jasdonwar: What do you have to say against allegations that South Africa's media will be curtailed by the government after the election? @ANC_debate: That's a scare tactic.
swa: @jasdonwar: je unalo lolote la kusema dhidi ya madai kwamba vyombo vya habari vya Afrika ya Kusini vitapunguzwa baada ya uchaguzi? @ANC_debate: hiyo ni mbinu ya kujazana hofu.

eng: ANC fought for media freedom and there's nothing to suggest we would undermine it.
swa: Chama cha ANC kilipigania uhuru wa vyombo vya habari na hakuna lolote linaloashiria kuwa tutapuuza (msimamo huo)

eng: On the issue of censorship of satirical cartoonists
swa: Kuhusu swala la kuchuja michoro ya kuchekesha (vikatuni) vyenye mandhari ya kebehi

eng: @JeremyTNel: Do you believe that cartoonists are too irreverent?
swa: @JeremyTNel: Je unaamini kuwa michoro ya kuchekesha ina utovu wa heshima?

eng: Would the ANC like to regulate satire? @ANC_debate: Cartoonists are supposed to be irreverent.
swa: Je chama cha ANC kingependa kudhibiti michoro hiyo? @ANC_debate: Wachoraji wa vikatuni wanapaswa kuwa si waoga.

eng: Satire is important.
swa: Sanaa ya michoro ya kuchekesha (vikatuni) yenye mandhari ya kusanifu ni sanaa muhimu.

eng: But they should adhere to same code of ethics as any other journalist.
swa: Lakini wanapaswa kufuata maadili kama wana habari wengine.

eng: On questions of power and sustainability
swa: Kuhusu masuala ya (nishati) endelevu

eng: @flintza: Again. How do you plan to meet SA power needs while limiting our carbon footprint.
swa: @flintza: Je mnakidhi vipi mahitaji ya nishati ya Afrika ya kusini huku mkiwa mnadhibiti nyayo za gesi ya ukaa.

eng: Focus seems to be coal (short sighted) @ANC_debate: SA needs to move away from coal but likely to remain major source of energy for foreseeable future.
swa: Inavyoonekana mnamakinikia makaa ya mawe (hamna uwezo wa kuona mbali) @ANC_debate: Afrika ya kusini inapaswa kusogea mbali na nishati ya makaa ya mawe lakini bado ni moja ya vyanzo vikuu vya nishati katika upeo ulipo mbele yetu.

eng: Increasing investment in nuclear, solar and wind power.
swa: Nishati hiyo inaongeza uwezo wa kuwekeza kwenye nishati nyuklia, jua na upepo.

eng: On questions of Jacob Zuma the presidential candidate being in the dock for corruption charges
swa: Kuhusu suala la mgombea kiti cha urais Jacob Zuma kuwa kizimbani kwa tuhuma za rushwa

eng: @ANC_debate: All are equal before the law and have a right to be presumed innocent.
swa: @ANC_debate: kila mtu ana haki sawa mbele ya sheria na ana haki ya kudhaniwa kuwa hajakosa.

eng: On AIDS prevention strategy
swa: Kuhusu mikakati ya kuzuia UKIMWI

eng: @ANC_Debate: Focus on prevention, encourage condom use and responsible behaviour.
swa: @ANC_Debate: Tunatilia maanani kuzuia maambukizi, kuhamasisha matumizi ya kondomu na tabia njema.

eng: Expand ART to cover all who need it.
swa: Usambazaji wa dawa za ART ili ziwafikie wote wanaozihitaji.

eng: Strengthen p/ships across society
swa: Tutaimarisha ushirikiano na jamii yote

eng: @irenebarnard: How will you keep the public informed about the status of your full HIV “aggressive prevention campaign”? @ANC_debate: People need to be involved in implementation through local health facilities, NGOs, govt izimbizo in addition to traditional media.
swa: @irenebarnard: je ni kwa jinsi gani mtawapasha habari wananchi kuhusu maendeleo ya "kampeni yenu ngangari ya kuzuia Virusi Vya Ukimwi" @ANC_debate: Watu wanatakiwa kushirikishwa katika utekelezaji kwa kupitia zahanati, mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali, taarifa za serikali na vyombo vya habari.

eng: For further coverage of the debate, visit Capetownalive which also has a summary of some of the questions.
swa: Ili kusoma zaidi juu ya mjadala huu, tembelea tovuti ya Capetownalive ambayo ina muhtasari wa baadhi ya maswali.

eng: Some users reported that they had been blocked or ignored however Jessie responded that no users had been blocked, they did however acknowledge that not all questions were answered.
swa: Baadhi ya watumiaji wameripoti kuwa walizuiwa kushiriki au pengine walidharauliwa na Jessie aliwajibu kuwa hakuna mtumiaji ambaye alizuiwa, hata hivyo walikiri kuwa si maswali yote ambayo yalijibiwa.

eng: I responded on my blog, that even though this debate is coming at a very late stage and only engages with users on twitter, it is however a major step in the right direction for the ANC as it gives people direct access to the party.
swa: Niliandika katika blogu yangu kuwa japokuwa mjadala huu umekuja katika ngwe za mwisho na unashirikisha watumiaji wa huduma ya twita pekee, hii ni hatua kubwa yenye mwelekeo mzuri kwa chama cha ANC kwani kinawapa wananchi fursa ya kujadiliana nao moja kwa moja.

eng: If something similar could be rolled out nationwide allowing people with just a mobile phone to post questions and receive responses from party candidates this could prove very useful in engaging all South Africans.
swa: Kama mpango huu utasambazwa nchini kote na kuruhusu watu wenye simu za mkononi kutuma maswali yao na kupokea majibu kutoka kwa wagombea, hatua hiyo itakuwa yenye manufaa sana katika kuwashirikisha Waafrika ya Kusini wote.

eng: This year, the Iranian new year started with a surprising message from the US President Barak Obama, directed to the Iranian people and, for the first time, to the Islamic Republic leaders, in which he called for a new start between the two countries.
swa: Mwaka huu, sherehe za mwaka mpya wa Ki-Irani zilianza na ujumbe usiotarajiwa kutoka kwa rais wa Marekani Barak Obama, uliolekezwa kwa watu wa Irani na kwa mara ya kwanza, kwa viongozi wa Jamhuri ya Kiislamu, ujumbe huo ulitoa rai ya kuanza upya kati ya nchi hizo mbili.

eng: Several bloggers have reacted to this message, and some see a new era beyond the 30 years of hassles and haggles between the two States.
swa: Wanablogu kadhaa wametoa maoni kuhusu ujumbe huo, na wengine wanaanza kuziona zama mpya baada ya zaidi ya miaka 30 ya misukosuko kati ya mataifa haya mawili.

eng: Mohammad Ali Abtahi, former Iranian vice president, considers Obama's message very important and says:
swa: Mohammad Ali Abtahi, makamu wa rais wa zamani, anadhani ujumbe wa Obama ni wa muhimu sana na anaandika:

eng: using the title of Islamic republic of Iran, also congratulation to the Iran's nation and leaders.
swa: Kwa jina la jamhuri ya Kiislamu ya Irani, pia nawapongeza taifa la Irani na viongozi wake.

eng: Undoubtedly it is a historical opportunity.
swa: Bila ya shaka hii ni fursa ya kihistoria.

eng: We can not ignore the importance of USA for Iran's current situation.
swa: Hatuwezi kudharau umuhimu wa Marekani katika hali ya sasa ya Irani.

eng: Undoubtedly we can not ignore trace of US leaders in all of Iran's dossiers also at least in economical aspect by embargos which have imposed to Iran's nation.
swa: Bila ya shaka hatuwezi kupuuza nyayo za Marekani katika kila majalada ya wasifu wa Irani hasa yale ya kiuchumi hata kama ni kwa uchache, kutokana na vikwazo vilivyowekwa dhidi ya taifa la Irani.

eng: Sending message for congratulation can be the most important political, economical and historical opportunity, today and after changing American government.
swa: Kutuma ujumbe wa pongezi kunaweza kuwa ni fursa muhimu kisiasa, kiuchumi na kihistoria, leo hii na hata baada ya kubadilishwa serikali ya Marekani.

eng: Also ignoring that can make a situation for us more dangerous than Bush's term because Obama can mobilize political leaders and public opinion against Iran.
swa: Kadhalika kupuuza kunaweza kuifanya hali izidi kuwa ya hatari zaidi ya ilivyokuwa wakati wa utawala wa Bush kwa sababu Obama anaweza kukusanya viongozi wa kisiasa na maoni ya wananchi dhidi ya Irani.

eng: Blogger and journalist Masih Alinejad writes about why Iranian National TV did not broadcast Obama’s message.
swa: Mwanablogu ambaye pia ni mwanahabari Masih Alinejad anaandika kuhusu sababu zilizoifanya Idhaa ya Taifa ya Televisheni kutotangaza ujumbe wa Obama.

eng: She adds:
swa: Anaongeza:

eng: if Obama had talked as Bush and considered Iran a threat, Iranian National TV would broadcast several times.
swa: kama Obama angeongea kama Bush na kuitathmini Irani kama tishio, Idhaa ya Televisheni ya Taifa ingetangaza mara kadhaa.

eng: The blogger reminds that Bush’s famous speech when he called Iran a member of axis of evil was broadcasted several times in National TV.
swa: Mwanablogu huyu anatukumbusha ile hotuba ya mashuhuri ya Bush ambayo aliita Irani mwanachama wa kundi la waovu ilitangazwa mara kadhaa kwenye televisheni ya taifa.

eng: Zandegieh Sagi calls Obama’s message very positive and something that the Iranian people deserve.
swa: Zandgieh Sagi ameuita ujumbe wa Obama kama ujumbe chanya na jambo ambalo linawastahili watu wa Irani.

eng: The blogger says that the first thing the Iranian government can do is to use appropriate political language.
swa: Mwanablogu huyu anasema kuwa jambo la kwanza ambalo serikali ya Irani inaweza kulifanya ni kutumia lugha inayofaa kisiasa.

eng: In View from Iran, we read:
swa: Katika blogu ya In View from Iran tunasoma:

eng: There are a lot of measures that the US government can take to build trust.
swa: Kuna hatua nyingi ambazo serikali ya Marekani inaweza kuzichukua ili kujenga imani.

eng: Not all of those have to do with the Iranian government’s willingness to start dialogue with the US.
swa: Siyo zote ambazo zitategemea nia ya serikali ya Irani ya kuanzisha mazungumzo na Marekani.

eng: I see Obama’s New Year message as positive, but we need more than that.
swa: Nauona ujumbe wa Obama wa mwaka mpya kama ujumbe chanya, lakini tunahitaji zaidi ya hilo.

eng: Mmoeeni writes that while the Iranian TV did not broadcast the news about Obama's message, the Iranian president was able to insult the American leaders in the USA.
swa: Mmoeeni anaandika kwamba wakati televisheni ya Irani haikutangaza habari zinazohusu ujumbe wa Obama, rais wa Irani aliweza kuwatukana viongozi wa Marekani huko Marekani.

eng: The blogger adds, with a pinch of irony, that Ahmadinejad then says there is absolute freedom in Iran.
swa: Mwanablogu huyo anaongeza, kwa kejeli, kwamba Ahmedinejad atasema kwamba kuna uhuru wa kweli nchini Irani.

eng: New Year Holidays
swa: Sherehe za Mwaka Mpya

eng: Iranians celebrated Norouz (Nowruz) on the first day of spring as the traditional Iranian new year holidays.
swa: Wairani walisherehekea Norouz (Nowruz) kunako siku ya kwanza ya msimu wa kuchipuka mimea.

eng: On this occasion, some Iranians throw flowers on the tomb of Cyrus the Great, the founder of the first Persian Empire in Pasargad (photo above).
swa: Katika dhifa hii, baadhi ya Wairani huweka maua kwenye kaburi la Cyrus Mkuu, mwanzilishi wa ufalme wa kwanza wa Persia katika Pasargad (pichani juu).

eng: The Save Pasargad website says that the Islamic Republic authorities did not provide any comfort for visitors in this historic place, but in recent years more people have come to celebrate the new year in Pasargad.
swa: Kwenye tovuti ya Okoa Pasargad imeandikwa kwamba utawala wa jamhuri ya Kiislamu hausaidii wageni wanaozuru sehemu hii ya kihistoria, lakini katika miaka ya hivi karibuni watu wengi wamekuwa wakizuru ili kuusherekea mwaka mpya huko Pasargad.

eng: The Congolese blogosphere had harsh criticism for Congolese president Joseph Kabila's recent interview in The New York Times.
swa: Ulimwengu wa wanablogu wa Kikongo ulijaa shutuma kali dhidi ya mahojiano ya hivi karibuni ya rais wa Kongo, Joseph Kabila kwenye gazeti la New York Times.

eng: In it, Kabila talks about Rwanda, AFRICOM, Chinese investment, and his passion for motorcycles.
swa: Katika mahojiano hayo, Kabila anaongelea kuhusu Rwanda, AFRICOM, uwekezaji wa China, na upenzi wake wa pikipiki.

eng: He also talked about how good help is hard to find; many bloggers have blasted him for it.
swa: Pia aliongelea ugumu wa kupata misaada mizuri; na wanablogu wengi wamemchabanga kwa hilo.

eng: Kabila blames corruption on Mobutu's legacy and the ineptitude of his own officials, rather than taking responsibility for his government's problems:
swa: Kabila anailaumu rushwa na kuutupa mpira kwenye utawala wa Mobutu na udhaifu wa maofisa wake yeye mwenyewe, badala ya kukubali wajibu wa matatizo ya serikali yake.

eng: Q: Do you have the right people to help you?
swa: Swali: Je una watu wazuri wa kukusaidia?

eng: A: (Long pause) Mobutu led this country for over 37 years.
swa: Jibu: (baada ya kimya kirefu) Mobutu aliiongoza nchi hii kwa zaidi ya miaka 37.

eng: He created a political class and he created a mentality and we haven't done away with that.
swa: Aliunda tabaka la wanasiasa pamoja na fikra na hatujaweza kuzing'oa.

eng: The old ways are bad - corruption, misrule, mismanagement and all that.
swa: Taratibu za zamani ni mbaya - rushwa, utawala wa hovyo hovyo, utawala mbovu na mambo kama hayo.

eng: Our biggest mistake is that we have not found enough time to train and form our own cadres.
swa: Kosa letu kubwa ni kuwa hatujapata muda wa kutosha kufundisha na kutengeneza makada wetu wenyewe.

eng: You don't need a thousand people to transform a country.
swa: Hauhitaji watu elfu moja kuibadilisha nchi.

eng: No, you need 3,4, 10, 15 people with the necessary convictions, determined and resolute.
swa: Hapana, unahitaji watu 3, 4, 10, 15 ambao wana imani, wana nia, na wenye azma.

eng: Do I have those 15 people?
swa: Je ninao hao watu 15?

eng: Probably 5, 6, 7, not yet 15.
swa: Pengine 5, 6, 7, lakini bado hatuna 15.

eng: On Forum Réalisance Musengeshi Katata writes that Joseph Kabila he has injured every Congolese who had read the interview:
swa: Kwenye mtandao wa Forum Realisance Musengeshi Katata anaandika kuwa Joseph Kabila amejeruhi kila Mkongo aliyesoma mahojiano yale:

eng: “What are Rwanda's interests in the Congo?
swa:
Je ni maslahi gani Rwanda iliyonayo nchini Kongo?
I like to believe that they are the same.	Ningependa kuamini kuwa ni maslahi sawa.
But if there is a hidden agenda, and Rwanda's interest is more or less controlling the mining concessions and all that, illegally, and if they have a hand in each and everything that goes on in North and South Kivu, then we're still a long way from trust. 	Lakini kama kuna ajenda ya siri, na maslahi ya Rwanda ni kutaka kudhibiti uchimbaji wa madini na mambo kama hayo kinyume cha sheria, na kama wana mkono kwenye kwenye kila jambo linaloendelea Kivu ya kaskazini na Kusini, basi bado tupo mbali sana na kuaminiana.
Let's give them the benefit of the doubt, once again, probably for the last time” 	Hebu tuwape faida ya kutofahamu, kwa mara nyingine tena, pengine kwa mara ya mwisho.

eng: The Mushaki Pager wonders what made Kabila take such a strong stance:
swa: Ninashangaa kwamba Kabila alitamka wazi kuwa hakuna hati ya kukamkamata Nkunda.

eng: Salman Khan (center), a Bollywood super star, campaigns in support of Congress party candidate Milind Deora at a rally in Mumbai Photo by Al Jazeera English and used under a creative commons license.
swa: Salman Khan (katikati), muigizaji filamu maarufu wa Bollywood, akipiga kampeni ya kumuunga mkono mgombea wa Chama cha Congress Milind Deora katika mkutano wa hadhara mjini Mumbai Picha na Al Jazeera English na imetumika chini ya Hati Miliki Huria.

eng: In India movie stars and filmmakers wield enormous influence and that point was drawn dramatically by Danny Boyle in the movie Slumdog Millionaire (hint: it is the toilet scene).
swa: Waigizaji na watengenezaji filamu maarufu nchini India wana ushawishi mkubwa, na ukweli huo ulidhihirishwa na Danny Boyle katika filamu ya Slumdog Millionaire (dokezo: kwenye igizo la chooni).

eng: Interestingly, the entertainment industry's (especially Bollywood or the Hindi film industry based in Mumbai) involvement in Indian politics was pretty marginal with a few a actors and some film makers participating in the election campaign process. But, there was an exception.
swa: Kujihusisha kwa nyanja ya burudani (hasa Bollywood au Nyanja ya filamu za Kihindi yenye makao mjini Mumbai) katika siasa nchini India kulikuwa ni kwa kiwango kidogo (siku za nyuma) wakati waigizaji wachache na watengenezaji filamu walipokuwa wakijishirikisha kwenye kampeni za uchaguzi.

eng: The Southern state of Tamil Nadu, which is the first state in the world to effectively harness and use the film medium for political purposes right from the 1940s.
swa: Isipokuwa kwenye jimbo la kusini la Tamil Nadu ambalo ni jimbo la kwanza duniani kutumia nyenzo ya filamu kwa sababu za kisiasa kuanzia wakati wa miaka ya 1940.

eng: During the late 1960s this nexus between politicians and the Tamil film industry reaped handsome dividends for Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) and led to the formation of the first non-Congress government in the state.
swa: Mwishoni mwa miaka ya 1960 makutano haya kati ya wanasiasa na nyanja ya filamu za Kitamil Nadu kuliivunia riba nzuri Dravida Munnetra Khazagam (DMK) na kulipelekea kuundwa kwa serikali ya kwanza isiyokuwa ya chama cha Congress jimboni humo.

eng: Since then various offshoots of DMK party have alternately been in power in Tamil Nadu.
swa: Tangu wakati huo vyama kadhaa vilivyotokana na chama cha DMK vimekuwa vikichukua madaraka jimboni Tamil Nadu.

eng: By the 1980s there was a steady trickle of entertainers into the political arena.
swa: Wakati wa miaka ya 1980 kulikuwa na mtiririko imara wa watoa burudani walioingia kwenye jukwaa la siasa.

eng: In some cases they successfully contested and formed governments (like NTR and his Telugu Desam Party in Andhra Pradesh) or were voted/nominated to the Indian Parliament.
swa: Wakati mwingine walifanikiwa kugombea na kuunda serikali (kama vile NTR na chama chake cha Telugu Desam kwenye jimbo la Andhra Pradesh) au walichaguliwa kuingia kwenye bunge la India.

eng: Fast forward to 2009 and the involvement of entertainers from Bollywood (or the Hindi film industry) based in Mumbai and the Tamil and Telugu film industry have registered a significant spike in the election campaign.
swa: Ilipofikia mwaka 2009 ushiriki wa watoa burudani wa Bollywood (au filamu za Kihindi) wenye makao mjini Mumbai pamoja na wale wa Kitamil na Kitelugu waliongezeka zaidi kwenye kampeni za uchaguzi.

eng: Telugu actor Chiranjeevi launched a new political party in Andhra Pradesh, while Bollywood actor Sanjay Dutt failed to get nominated because of his criminal record in the 1993 Mumbai blast.
swa: Muigizaji filamu wa Kitelugu Chirajeevi alizindua chama kipya cha siasa jimboni Andhra Pradesh, wakati mcheza filamu wa Bollywood Sanjay Dutt alishindwa kuteuliwa kwa sababu ya rekodi yake ya makosa ya jinai wakati wa milipuko ya mabomu ya mwaka 1993 mjini Mumbai.

eng: In Tamil Nadu former actress and Chief Minister Jayalalitha is in the running after being defeated in the previous elections.
swa: Jimboni Tamil Nadu aliyekuwa mcheza filamu na waziri mkuu, Jayalalitha, bado yumo mbioni baada ya kushindwa katika uchaguzi uliopita.

eng: But, it is the involvement of Bollywood folks that has captured peoples' imagination.
swa: Lakini, ni ushiriki wa watu wa Bollywood ambao umeziteka fikra za watu.

eng: Bollywood actor cum blogger Amitabh Bachchan offers a glimpse of his thoughts on the upcoming Indian elections.
swa: Muigizaji filamu wa Bollywood ambaye pia ni mwanablogu Amitabh Bachchan anatoa mwanga wa mawazo yake kuhusu uchaguzi ujao wa India.

eng: He writes:
swa: Anaandika:

eng:
The elections are upon us. 	“Uchaguzi umewadia.
Elections in the largest and most thriving democracy in the world.	Uchaguzi katika demokrasi kubwa zaidi duniani.
TV has nothing else to offer but the electoral scenario unfolding upon us.	Televisheni hazina kingine cha kutangaza bali hii picha ya uchaguzi inayojifungua mbele yetu.
Exit polls and analysis and who will win from where and who said what to whom and why.	Kura za maoni na uchambuzi, kadhalika ni nani atakayeshinda kutokea wapi na ni nani aliyesema hivi kwa nani na kwa sababu gani.
Even the media questionnaires that come across to us are full of queries on politics.	Hata maswali ya vyombo vya habari yanayoletwa kwetu yamejaa udadisi unaohusu siasa.
Friends have become foes, foes have become friends. Games and manipulations all parties play to come to power. 	Marafiki wamekuwa maadui, maadui wamekuwa marafiki. vyama vyote vinacheza michezo na kutumiana ili kuingia madarakani.
To win for the next 5 years and remain in governance.	Ili kushinda katika miaka 5 ijayo na kubaki serikalini.
To them politics is an aphrodisiac, an elixir, that compels them to perform.
swa: Kwao siasa ni sawa na dawa ya kuongeza nguvu za kufanya mapenzi, dawa ambayo inawasukuma kuongeza juhudi.”

eng: Bachchan's wife Jaya Bachchan has been active politically for a few years now.
swa: Mke wa Bachchan, Jaya Bachchan ni mshiriki hai kwenye siasa kwa miaka michache sasa.

eng: What could be the driving force that has prompted so many Bollywood actors to step out of their comfort zone and do their bit for this Indian election campaign?
swa: Ni nini kinachowasukuma waigizaji wengi wa Bollywood kutoka kwenye Nyanja walizozoea na kutoa michango yao kwenye kampeni za uchaguzi huu wa India?

eng: Gaurav Shukla of India Election 2009 might have unearthed the answer to that question.
swa: Gaurav Shukla wa Uchaguzi wa India 2009 pengine amevumbua jibu la swali hilo.

eng: He writes:
swa: Anaandika:

eng: Celebrities who used to keep politics at an arms length have surprisingly chosen to rally around the need to vote this time. 	Watu maarufu ambao walizoea kuiweka siasa mbali wameamua kushabikia umuhimu wa kupiga kura.

Industry experts suggest that the Mumbai terror attacks in November last year may be the reason for this change...Amitabh Bachchan, Aamir Khan, John Abraham, Kamal Haasan, Rakeysh Omprakash Mehra, Anurag Kashyap, Shriya Sharan, Shruti Haasan and Sushmita Sen are among those who have joined the chorus."
swa: Wataalamu wa mambo wanadhani kwamba mashambulkio ya kigaidi mijini Mumbai ya mwezi Novemba mwaka jana yanaweza yakawa ndio sababu ya mabadiliko haya… Amitabh Bachchan, Aamir Khan, John Abraham, Kamal Haasan, Rakeysh Omprakash Mehra, Anurag Kashyap, Shriya Sharan, Shruti Haasan pamoja na Sushmita Senni ni kati ya wale waliojiunga na pambio."

eng: Bollywood actor Aamir Khan helped launch a voter awareness campaign for Association of Democratic reforms with the tagline: "Sachche ko chune, Achche ko chune” — meaning “vote for the honest, vote for good people.”
swa: Muigizaji filamu wa Bollywood Aamir Khan amesaidia uzinduzi wa kampeni ya kuelimisha wapiga kura kwa ajili ya Asasi ya Mageuzi ya Kidemokrasia kwa kutumia kauli mbiu: “Sachche ko chune, Achche ko chune” — inayomaanisha “Pigia kura watu wakweli, pigia kura watu wazuri.”

eng: Besides being the face and voice of the voter awareness campaign, Khan went one step further and helped produce the videos and audio pieces.
swa: Pamoja na kuwa sura na sauti ya kampeni ya kuelimisha wapiga kura, Khan alichukua hatua nyingine zaidi aliposaidia kutengeneza filamu za video pamoja na matangazo ya redio.

eng: AamirKhanblog writes:
swa: AamirKhanblog anaandika:

eng:
The ads have been made by the actor’s production company, Aamir Khan Productions, free of cost. 	“Matangazo yametengenezwa na kampuni ya muigizaji, Aamir Khan Productions, bila malipo.
An ‘A’ list Bollywood ensemble has put together this campaign.	Orodha ‘A’ ya kundi la Bollywood limetayarisha kampeni hii.
The creative head is Prasoon Joshi of McCann Erickson, Rakyesh Mehra is the director, Avinash Gowarikar the still photographer, and Shashi Sinha of Lodestar Media the media planner for the campaign. 	Mkuu wa ubunifu ni Prasoon Joshi wa McCann Erickson, Mkurugenzi ni Rakyesh Mehra, mpiga picha ni Avinash Gowarikar na mkuu wa mipango ya habari katika kampeni hii ni Shashi Sinha wa Lodestar Media.
Everybody is working for the campaign gratis.	Kila mtu anafanya kazi bila malipo kwa ajili ya kampeni.
The ad campaign is being aired in Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Bengali, Assamese and Oriya so that it can reach out to the masses.
swa: Kampeni hiyo inarushwa hewani katika lugha za Kihindi, Kimarathi, Gujarati, Kitamil, Kitelugu, Kikannada, Malayalam, Kibengali, Kiassam pamoja na Kioriya ili kwamba iufikie umma.”

eng: Aamir Khan, who is also a blogger reminds Indian voters to make an informed choice when they cast their post.
swa: Aamir Khan, ambaye pia ni mwanablogu anawakumbusha wapiga kura wa India kuwa wapige kura baada ya kufanya uchambuzi.

eng: He wrote in his blog post:
swa: Aliandika katika makala yake ya blogu:

eng: To all Indians, remember to vote, and make an informed choice.
swa: Kwa Wahindi wote, kumbukeni kupiga kura, na mfanye uamuzi baada ya uchambuzi.

eng: Meaning, check out all the candidates from your area before you decide who to vote for.
swa: Inamaanisha, chunguza wagombea wote kutoka katika eneo lako kabla ya kuamua ni nani wa kumpigia kura.

eng: Khan is vacationing in Montana, but according to media reports will fly back to Mumbai and cast his vote on April 30th, the day the commercial and entertainment capital of India goes to the polls.
swa: Khan yuko likizoni mjini Montana, lakini kwa mujibu wa vyombo vya habari atarejea Mumbai na kupiga kura tarehe 30 Aprili, siku ambayo jiji kuu la biashara na burudani nchini India litapiga kura.

eng: Besides Khan, a whole slew of Bollywood actors and filmmakers have volunteered their time for various election mobilization and awarness programs.
swa: Zaidi ya khan, kundi lote la wacheza filamu na watengeneza filamu wa Bollywood wamejitolea muda wao kwenye programu mbalimbali za kuhamasisha na kuelimisha umma.

eng: Perhaps, the most significant one is the involvement of the entertainment industry in the non-profit organization called Jaagore (that translates to "Wake up").
swa: Pengine, ushiriki muhimu zaidi wa nyanja hii ya burudani ni ule wa kwenye asasi-isiyo-ya-kibiashara inayoitwa Jaagore ( yaani "Amka").

eng: The NGO has created powerful short video clips like this one where Bollywood actress Sonam Kapoor points out that average age an Indian is 23 years old, while the average age of a a cabinet minister in the Federal Governmnet is 62 years old.
swa: Asasi hiyo imetengeneza filamu za video fupi-fupi zenye nguvu kama ile ambayo mcheza filamu wa kike wa Bollywood Sonam Kapoor anpodokeza kwamba wastani wa mpiga kura nchini india ni miaka 23, wakati ambapo wastani wa umri wa mawaziri katika Bunge la nchi ni miaka 62.

eng: Or, watch this video clip by Bollywood film director Rakeysh Omprakash, where he points out that in the state of Rajasthan a politician won the elections by one vote.
swa: Au, angalia video hii iliyotengenezwa na mkurugenzi wa filamu mmoja wa Bollywood, Rakeysh Omprakash, ambamo anadokeza kuwa katika jimbo la Rajasthan kuna mwanasiasa aliyewahi kushinda uchaguzi kwa kura moja.

eng: This post is part of the Global Voices special coverage on Indian Elections 2009
swa: Makala hii ni sehemu ya makala zinazohusu uchaguzi wa India 2009.

eng: Paraguayan President Fernando Lugo recently admitted that he is the father of Viviana Carillo's son, who was conceived when Lugo was still a Roman Catholic bishop.
swa: Hivi karibuni rais wa Paraguai Fernando Lugo alikiri kuwa yeye ni baba mzazi wa mtoto wa Viviana Carillo, mtoto ambaye alitungwa wakati Lugo akiwa bado ni askofu wa Kanisa Katoliki la Roma.

eng: He also acknowledged a long-time secret relationship with Carillo.
swa: Pia alikiri uhusiano wa muda mrefu na Carillo.

eng: Now this news is causing quite a stir amongst politicians, the media, and bloggers who write about the disappointment in their current leader, but also how there are much more serious problems to worry about and the comparison to other acts committed by politicians.
swa: Habari hii inazua utata hivi sasa baina ya wanasiasa, vyombo vya habari, na wanablogu ambao wanaandika kusikitishwa kwao na kiongozi huyo, na ukweli kwamba kuna matatizo mengine makubwa yanayopaswa kuangaliwa ikilinganishwa na vitendo vinavyofanywa na wanasiasa.

eng: Photo by Fernando Lugo APC Flickr Account.
swa: Picha kwa hisani ya akaunti ya APC Flickr ya Fernando Lugo.

eng: Used under Creative Commons license. http://www.flickr.com/photos/fernandolugoapc/3444612710/
swa: Chini ya Hati Miliki Huria.

eng: Carlos Rodríguez of Rescatar makes a comparison with what happened years ago in the United States, when then-President Bill Clinton had an inappropriate and extra-marital relationship with Monica Lewinski.
swa: Carlos Rodríguez wa Rescatar analinganisha (mkasa huu) na yale yaliyotokea miaka iliyopita nchini Marekani, wakati aliyekuwa rais wakati huo - rais Bill Clinton alipokuwa na mahusiano yasiyofaa, nje ya ndoa na Monica Lewinski.

eng: There are some who say that it was a personal and private relationship that did not affect the country's interests or did not have any consequences in the lives of the American citizens.
swa: Kuna wale wanaosema kuwa mahusiano hayo yalikuwa ni ya faragha na ya kibinafsi na kwamba hayakuathiri maslahi ya nchi aidha hayakuwa na athari yoyote kwa maisha ya wananchi wa Wamarekani.

eng: Now that Lugo has come forward and will accept responsibility, he writes that the issue is closed for the Paraguayan people .
swa: Na sasa Lugo amejitokeza na amekubali wajibu, anaandika kwamba suala hilo limefikia tamati kwa wananchi wa Paraguai .

eng: He adds that there are more serious acts committed by other politicians that should receive more ire from the Paraguayan citizens, and that the press should return to focusing on the "national agenda."
swa: Anaongeza kwamba kuna vitendo nyeti ambavyo vinatendwa na wanasiasa wengine ambavyo vinapaswa kusakamwa na wananchi wa Paraguai, na kwamba vyombo vya habari virejee na kumakinikia yaliyomo kwenye "ajenda ya taifa"

eng: However, since Paraguay is a predominantly Catholic country, many are disappointed in the fact that Lugo violated the clerical vows of celibacy, but to some self-described atheists like Liam of Políticamente Incorrecto , that is a non-issue.
swa: Hata hivyo, kwa kuwa Paraguai ni nchi ya Kikatoliki (Wnanchi wake wengi ni Wakatoliki) , wengi wamesikitishwa na ukweli kwamba Lugo alikiuka ahadi ya kanisa ya kujitenga na ngono, lakini kwa baadhi ya wanojiita wasiokuwa na dini kama vile Liam wa Políticamente Incorrecto , hilo si suala.

eng: He also examines the reaction by many different sectors to this piece of news both nationally and internationally:
swa: Pia anaangalia maoni ya sekta tofauti kuhusiana na habari hii ndani ya nchi na pia kimataifa:

eng: Today marks the end of a week of national mourning in Rwanda to mark 15 years since the genocide which killed 800,000 people.
swa: Hivi karibuni zilifanyika sherehe za kitaifa nchini Rwanda kuadhimisha kumbukumbu ya kutimiza miaka 15 tangu mauaji ya Kimbari. Mauaji hayo yaliangamiza maisha ya watu wapatao 800,000.

eng: On the 7th of April ceremonies were held in the capital Kigali, and in Nyanza, where more than 5,000 people were slaughtered.
swa: Mnamo tarehe 7 Aprili, maadhimisho yalifanyika katika mji mkuu wa Kigali, na pia katika mji wa Nyanza, ambapo watu wapatao 5000 waliuawa kinyama.

eng: At a stadium in Kigali, thousands of candles spelt out the word "hope" in three languages.
swa: Katika Uwanja wa Mpira wa Kigali, maelfu ya mishumaa iliwashwa na kupangiliwa katika namna ambayo iliunda neno "Matumaini" katika lugha tatu.

eng: Rwandan blogger Negrita's Chronicles asked her readers to join the nation-wide candlelight vigil for the victims through her blog:
swa: Mwanablogu Mrwanda, Negrita's Chronicles, alitoa mwito kwa wasomaji wake kushiriki katika mkesha wa kitaifa wa kuwasha mishumaa ili kuwakumbuka wahanga wa mauaji. Alifanya hivyo kupitia blogu yake:

eng: It has been 15 years since the Genocide forever changed my home and my people.
swa: Ni miaka 15 sasa tangu Mauaji ya Kimbari yalipopabadilish nyumbani kwangu na watu wangu milele.
