eng: Dadis Camara, a Guinean military officer who seized power last December in a coup, was shot yesterday by one of his aides and has been evacuated to Morocco.
swa: Dadis Camara, ofisa wa jeshi wa Guinea aliyetwaa madaraka mwezi Disemba mwaka jana katika mapinduzi ya kijeshi, alipigwa risasi na mmoja wa wasaidizi wake jana na amesafirishwa kwenda Morocco.

eng: According to several news sources, Captain Dadis Camara, leader of the military junta which seized power in Guinea in December 2008, was shot and wounded by one of his aides yesterday in Conakry.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa vyanzo kadhaa vya habari, Kapteni Dadis Camara, kiongozi wa kikundi cha jeshi kilitwaa madaraka nchini Guinea mwezi Disemba 2008, alipigwa risasi na kujeruhiwa na mmoja wa wasaidizi wake jana mjini Conakry.

eng: The leader of the de facto government of Guinea, shunned by the international community since the September 28th killing and rape of opposition protesters by soldiers, was flown to Morocco, where he arrived at around 3 P.M. GMT.
swa: Kiongozi wa serikali isiyo rasmi wa Guinea, aliyetengwa na jumuiya ya kimataifa tangu kuuwawa na kubakwa kwa waandamanaji wa upinzani kulikofanywa na maaskari tarehe 28 Septemba, alisafirishwa kwa ndege kwanda nchini Morocco, ambako aliwasili katika majira ya saa 9 Alasiri GMT.

eng: Major Kélétigui Camara, General Secretary of the Presidency, said in a phone interview with the guineenews.org website that two people, whose names he did not know, were killed.
swa: Meja Kélétigui Camara, Katibu Mkuu wa ofisi ya Rais, alisema katika mahojiano ya simu na tovuti ya guineanews.org kuwa watu wawili amboo hafahamu majina yao, waliuwawa.

eng: Two other junta members were also evacuated to Morocco.
swa: Wanachama wengine wa kundi hilo la mapinduzi ya kijeshi pia walisafirishwa kwenda Morocco.

eng: On the spot in Conakry, the situation seems to be quiet, according to several sources as well as phone calls made by this author to newspapers and the government.
swa: Kwenye eneo husika mjini Conakry, hali inaonekana kuwa ya ukimya, kwa mujibu wa vyanzo mbalimbali pamoja simu zilizopigwa kwa magazeti na serikali na mwandishi huyu.

eng: However, no one has a clue about the seriousness of the junta leader's wounds.
swa: Hata hivyo, hakuna anayefahamu ukubwa wa majeraha ya kiongozi huyo wa mapinduzi ya kijeshi.

eng: Someone from an international organization told me Captain Camara might be wounded in the head or neck.
swa: Mtu mmoja kutoka katika shirika la kimataifa aliniambia kuwa Camara anaweza kuwa alijeruhiwa kichwani au shingoni.

eng: Some preliminary reactions to the news on the RFI website showed a range of opinion.
swa: Maoni ya mwanzo kufuatia habari hii kwenye tovuti ya RFI yameonyesha mitazamo mbalimbali.

eng: One anonymous reader writes:
swa: Msomaji mmoja aliyeandika bila kutaja jina aliandika:

eng: Earlier today, Prita Mulyasari, a housewife who was prosecuted for writing a complaint email regarding a bad hospital service, was found guilty for defaming a private hospital by the Tangerang High Court.
swa: Mapema leo, Prita Mulyasari, mama wa nyumbani aliyeshtakiwa kwa kuandika barua pepe ya kulalamikia huduma mbaya iliyotolewa na hospitali, alipatikana na hatia ya kuchafua jina la hospitali hiyo ya binafsi na Mahakama Kuu ya Tangerang.

eng: The court ordered her to pay a fine of Rp. 204 M (US$ 21,680) to OMNI Internasional Alam Sutera hospital.
swa: Mahakama hiyo ilimwamuru kulipa faini ya Rupia milioni 204 (sawasawa na dola za Marekani 21,680) kwa hospitali hiyo inayojulikana kwa jina la OMNI International Alam Sutera.

eng: Salary of a factory worker in Jakarta is roughly US$ 106 per month.
swa: Mshahara wa mfanyakazi wa kiwandani katika jiji la Jakarta ni kiasi cha dola za Marekani 106 kwa mwezi.

eng: Indonesian net users are buzzing to collect the sum in form of coins because they are outraged by the court decision and they hope the coins will overwhelm the hospital, said one activist to local newspaper Kompas.
swa: Watumiaji wa mtandao nchini Indonesia wanafanya harakati kukusanya kiasi hicho katika muundo wa sarafu kwa sababu wamekasirishwa sana na uamuzi wa mahakama na wanatumaini kwamba sarafu zitaielemea hospitali hiyo, alieleza mwanaharakati mmoja kupitia gazeti moja linalochapishwa nchini humo linalojulikana kama Kompas.

eng: When justice is spared, we collect coins, says tagline of Koin Keadilan, coins for justice, a new website dedicated to collect coin donation to pay Prita's fine.
swa: “Pale haki inapokiukwa, tunakusanya sarafu”, anasema kauli mbiu ya Koin Keadilan, Sarafu kwa ajili ya Haki, ambayo ni tovuti mpya iliyojikita katika kukusanya sarafu hizo ili kulipa faini aliyotozwa Prita.

eng: Image on www.koinkeadilan.com
swa: Picha iliyoko kwenye www.koinkeadilan.com

eng: An online declaration on the site says:
swa: Tangazo la mtandaoni lililowekwa kwenye tovuti linasema:

eng: Treespotter: Dear All, drop a coin for Prita - drop a coin for common sense.
swa: Treespotter: Wapendwa Wote, tafadhali tumbukiza sarafu kwa ajili ya Prita - tumbukiza sarafu kwa ajili ya hekima ya kiwango cha kawaida.

eng: Or lots of coins.
swa: Unaweza kutumbukiza sarafu nyingi vilevile.

eng: She needs 2,5 tons of it. http://koinkeadilan.com/
swa: Anahitaji kiasi cha tani 2.5 cha sarafu hizo. http://koinkeadilan.com/

eng: el15abeth: Social media does not expire..we know Prita is innocent.
swa: el15abeth: Vyombo vya habari vya kiraia havina ukomo ... tunajua kwamba Prita hana hatia.

eng: The verdict will only give Omni hospital a bad rep. #freeprita
swa: Hukumu hiyo itazidi kutoa sura mbaya ya hospitali hiyo.

eng: Thousands of protesters defied the Islamic regime today by protesting during Student Day, chanting slogans against Ali Khamenei, the leader of the Islamic Republic, and protesting the government's foreign policy.
swa: Maelfu ya waandamanaji hawakuujali utawala wa Kiislamu leo kwa kuandamana wakati wa siku ya mwanafunzi, wakiimba kaulimbiu dhidi ya Ali Khamenei, kiongozi wa Jamuhuri ya Kiislamu, na wakipinga sera ya mambo ya nje ya serikali.

eng: They also burned photos of Iranian leaders.
swa: Vilevile walichoma picha za watawala wa Kiirani.

eng: According to several news websites, security forces clashed with students and arrested some of them.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa tovuti kadhaa za habari, vikosi vya ulinzi vilipambana na wanafunzi na kuwatia nguvuni baadhi yao.

eng: As usual, Iranian citizens covered today's event and let the world learn about it.
swa: Kama kawaida, wananchi wa Kiirani walizungumzia tukio hili la leo wakitaka dunia ijifunze kuhusu tukio hilo.

eng: What has happened to oil money
swa: “Nini kimetokea kwenye fedha za mafuta”

eng: At the University of Tehran, protesters chanted "Death to the dictator" and "What has happened to the oil money?
swa: Kwenye Chuo Kikuu cha Tehran, waandamanaji waliimba kwa sauti “Kuanguka kwa dikteta” na “Nini kimetokea kwenye fedha za mafuta?

eng: It is in the pocket of Basijis (Islamic militias)."
swa: Zimeingia kwenye mifuko ya Basijis (Wanajeshi wa Kiislamu).”

eng: Military force support support
swa: “Vikosi vya Kijeshi ungeni mkono”

eng: At Amir Kabir University, also in Tehran, the students chanted slogans such as: "Down with the dictator", "Military force support, support," and "Do not be afraid".
swa: Katika chuo kikuu cha Amir Kabir University, pia kikiwa Tehran, wanafunzi walipiga kelele kama: “Apigwe chini dikteta,” “Majeshi ungeni mkono,” na “Msiogope”.

eng: Down with Khamenei in the streets of Tehran Remember the Martyrs
swa: Chini na Khamenei katika mitaa ya Tehran Kumbukeni Mashahidi

eng: Elmo Sanat University in Tehran marched with Kianoush Asa's photo, a student who was murdered by security forces in the summer of 2009.
swa: Chuo Kikuu cha Elmo Sanat mjini Tehran waliandamana wakiwa na picha ya Kianoush Asa, mwanafunzi aliyeuawa na vikosi vya ulinzi majira ya kiangazi mwaka 2009.

eng: Protesters demonstrated in several other cities such as Mashad.
swa: Waandamanaji waliandamana katika miji mingineyo kama Mashad

eng: ... and Kerman where they chanted "Sweeper brother take Mahmoud "
swa: ...na Kerman ambapo walipiga kelele “beki mlinda mlango mchukue Mahmoud ”

eng: Environmentalists and writers from Palestine, Jordan and Israel will meet in Madaba, Jordan this month for a 2-day workshop: “Blogging for the Environment” on December 20-21, writes Israeli Green Prophet, at Mideast Youth.
swa: Wanamazingira na Waandishi kutoka Palestina, Jordan na Israel watakutana huko Madaba, Jordan mwezi huu kwa ajili ya warsha ya siku 2: Kublogu kwa Ajili ya Mazingira" tarehe 20-21 Desemba," anaandika Muisrael Green Prophet, kwenye Mideast Youth.

eng: Uln tried to sort out what had happened in Copenhagen and questioned why the developed countries did not sign among themselves a deal for reducing emission.
swa: Uln alijaribu kuchambua ni nini kilichotokea Copenhagen na kuhoji kwa nini nchi zinazoendelea hazikusaini baina yao wenyewe makubaliano ya kupunguza utokaji wa gesi ya ukaa.

eng: Inside-Out China translated a local report telling an insider story on Wen Jiabao's schedule in Copenhagen.
swa: Inside-Out China ametafsiri taarifa inayosimulia habari kutoka kwa walio ndani kuhusu mienendo ya Wen Jiabao kule Copenhagen.

eng: In what some geologists have described as rare occurrences, Malawi's northern district of Karonga has in the past three weeks experienced a total of 30 earthquakes resulting in at least 5 deaths, over 200 people injured and over 3,000 made homeless.
swa: Katika kile ambacho baadhi ya wataalamu wa miamba wamekieleza kama matukio ya nadra, Wilaya ya Kaskazini ya Karonga nchini Malawi imeshuhudia jumla ya matetemeko ya ardhi 30 katika wiki tatu zilizopita ambayo yamesababisha vifo 5, zaidi ya watu 200 kujeruhiwa na zaidi ya watu 3,000 kupoteza makazi.

eng: Fresh reports say another earthquake hit Karonga Sunday 27th December and more are expected.
swa: Habari mpya zinasema kuwa tetemeko jingine liliikumba Karonga Jumapili tarehe 27 Disemba na mengine yanatarajiwa.

eng: Since Malawi's president Bingu wa Mutharika declared Karonga as a national disaster area, appeals for help to the victims have been pouring to help the people in the uranium mining district.
swa: Tangu rais wa Malawi Bingu wa Mutharika aliposema rasmi kuwa Karonga ni sehemu ya janga la kitaifa, rai za kuwasaidia waliathirika zimekuwa zikimiminika ili kuwasaidia watu katika wilaya hii ya migodi ya madini ya uranium.

eng: Bloggers have also been quick to share their reactions.
swa: Wanablogu kadhalika wamekuwa wepesi katika kushirikiana maoni.

eng: A question that lingers on the minds of many Malawians is the cause of the earthquakes.
swa: Swali ambalo linaendelea katika fikra za Wamalawi wengi ni sababu za matetemeko hayo ya radhi.

eng: In a well-detailed post titled The missing Pieces of the Karonga Earthquake Puzzle, Muza Gondwe attempts to raise and answer the question:
swa: Katika makala ya kina iliyopewa kichwa cha Vipande Vinavyokosekana Katika Kitendawili cha Matetemeko ya Ardhi Huko Karonga, Muza Gondwe anajaribu kuliweka na kulijibu swali:

eng: The first quake struck on the evening of Sunday 6thgovernment and Red Cross are providing assistance to the victims of the earthquake but equally the government should also provide answers as to what happened?
swa: Tetemeko la kwanza lilitokea jioni ya Jumapili tarehe 6 serikali na Msalaba Mwekundu wanatoa misaada kwa walioathirika na tetemeko la ardhi lakini sawa na hivyo serikali inapaswa kutoa majibu juu ya nini kilichotokea?

eng: Do people understand what causes earthquakes: do they deem it an act of God, punishment from angry ancestors, or a sign of the end of days?
swa: Je watu wanaelewa nini kinachosababisha matetemeko ya ardhi: je wanadhani kuwa ni tendo la Mungu, adhamu ya mizimu yenye hasira, au ishara ya siku za mwisho?

eng: December, then a larger quake the next morning, followed by a series of aftershocks in the Karonga District of Northern Malawi.
swa: Disemba, halafu tetemeko kubwa zaidi asubuhi ya siku iliyofuata, lililofuatiwa na mitetemo katika Wilaya ya Kaskazini ya Karonganchini Malawi.

eng: The ground was shaking as far as Mzuzu 150km away with the biggest quake measuring 5.9 on the Richter scale.
swa: Ardhi ilikuwa inatetemeka hata kufikia Mzuzu, mbali kwa Kilometa 150 huku tetemeko kubwa zaidi ya yote lililokuwa na kipimo cha 5.9 katika kipimo cha Rikta.

eng: My parents who live in Rumphi between Mzuzu and Karonga, ran out of the house during each tremor wondering whether this was final days.
swa: Wazazi wangu wanaoishi Rumphi katikati ya Mzuzu na Karonga, walikimbilia nje ya nyuma wakati wa kila tetemeko wakijiuliza kama hizi ndio siku za mwisho.

eng: Twelve tremors were felt across three days.
swa: Mitetemo kumi na miwili ilihisiwa katika tatu.

eng: Homes and buildings have been damaged, one fatality when a child died after a wall fell on him.
swa: Makazi na majengo yameharibiwa, na kifo kimoja ambapo mtoto alifariki baada ya ukuta kumuangukia.

eng: While Muza tries to provide the geological perspective, Ndagha shares his frustrations with the non-response of Malawi's political parties which he claims could have poured into Karonga if it were campaign time.
swa: Wakati Muza anajaribu kutoa mtazamo wa sayansi ya miamba, Ndagha anaeleza kughafirika kwake na kutojihusisha kwa vyama vya kisiasa vya Malawi ambavyo anadai vingemiminika Karonga kama ungekuwa wakati wa kampeni.

eng: Is it that the parties do not have the money to give out to the victims or the area is not campaign friendly?
swa: Je vyama vya siasa havina fedha za kuwapa walioathirika au eneo hili si muafaka kwa kampeni?

eng: I remember that earlier in the campaign period for 2009 elections, politicians competed against each other by out-giving money to Ndirande market fire “victims” in Blantyre.
swa: Nakumbuka kuwa mapema katika kipindi cha kampeni za uchaguzi wa 2009, wanasiasa walishindana kwa kugawa pesa kwa ‘walioathirika’ katika ajali ya moto kwenye soko la Nyirande kule Blantyre.

eng: You may wish to note that no one was reported dead or even injured yet the victims got over 5 million Kwacha in total.
swa: Unaweza kusajili kuwa hakuna aliyeripotiwa kufa au hata kujeruhiwa nab ado walioathirika walipata jumla ya Kwacha Milioni 5.linganisha hilo na Karonga ambapo ni Kwacha milioni 2.5 tu zilizotolewa na Dk.

eng: Compare that with Karonga when only 2.5 million Kwacha was given by Dr Bingu wa Mutharika!
swa: Bingu wa Mutharika!

eng: Come on parties, be responsible and demonstrate that you are who you claim.
swa: Nyie vyama vya siasa, kuweni wawajibikaji na onyesheni kuwa mko vile ambavyo mnadai kuwa.

eng: This is when your electorate reallyneeds you.
swa: Hapa ndipo majimbo yenu yanawahitajini sana.

eng: Meanwhile the Ministry of Natural Resources, Energy and Environment has dispelled rumors that the Karonga earthquakes have been caused by the mining works at Kayerekera which is 35 km away from the district heaquarters.
swa: Wakati huo huo Wizara ya Maliasili, Nishati na Mazingira imepinga uvumi kuwa matetemeko ya Ardhi huko karonga yamesababishwa na kazi za migodi huko Kayekereka ambayo ipo Kilomita 35 kutoka makao makuu ya wilaya.

eng: The ministry says that the uranium mine is an open pit and has no underground activities hence has no connection to the earthquakes.
swa: Wizara imesema kuwa mgodi wa uranium ni mgodi shimo lililo wazi na halina kazi za chini ya ardhi kwa hiyo hauna uhusiano na matetemeko ya ardhi.

eng: Just before the earthquakes in northern Malawi, Malawi was experiencing four major economic challenges surrounding fuel, forex, power and water.
swa: Kabla tu ya matetemeko huko kaskazini ya Malawi, Malawi ilikuwa ikikabiliwa na changamoto kubwa nne kiuchumi katika maeneo ya mafuta, fedha za nje, umeme na maji.

eng: These left blogger Austin Madinga wonder if Malawi leadership was learning anything from the happenings:
swa: Changamoto hizi zimemfanya mwanablogu Austin Madinga kujiuliza ikiwa uongozi wa Malawi unajifunza chochote kutoka kwa na matukio haya:

eng: We have water shortages in Blantyre, power and fuel shortages country wide and a general lack of foreign exchange.
swa: Tuna uhaba wa maji jijini Blantyre, upungufu wa umeme na mafuta nchi nzima na ukosefu wa jumla wa fedha za nje.

eng: Left unchecked these can have debilitating effects on our economic growth.
swa: Vikiachwa bila kuangaliwa hivi vitu vina uwezo wa kuwa na madhara ya kudhoofisha kukua kwa uchumi wetu.

eng: Various players have promised to resolve or ease the current pressures but when?
swa: Wadau mbalimbali wameahidi kutatua au kupunguza shinikizo lililopo lakini lini?

eng: The question I keep asking myself is will Malawians will come out of all these events any smarter?
swa: Swali ambalo ninaendelea kujiuliza ni kuwa je Wamalawi wataweza kutoka katika matukio haya wakiwa na werevu zaidi?

eng: On fuel crisis, journalist Richard Chirombo tried to put the situation into historical perspective by pointing out that Malawi cargo was stuck in Mozambique due to a decline in the use of the Beira port.
swa: Kuhusu tatizo la mafuta, mwanahabari Richard Chirombo alijaribu kuliweka tatizo katika muktadha wa kihistoria na kuonyesha kuwa shehena ya Malawi ilikwama huko Msumbiji kutokana na kupungua kwa matumizi ya bandari ya Beira.

eng: MALAWI has for the past ten years registered a sharp decline in the use of Beira Port in Mozambique, according to traffic statistics sourced from the port’s authority.
swa: Katika miaka kumi iliyopita Malawi imesajili kupungua sana kwa matumizi ya bandari ya Beira nchini Msumbiji, kwa mujibu wa takwimu za usafiri silizopatikana kutoka kwa mamlaka ya bandari hiyo.

eng: A report from Cornelder de Mozambique, the company that won a 25 year-long concession from the Government of Mozambique in 1998 to run the port, points to a sharp decline in the use of the port by Malawian exporters and importers.
swa: Taarifa kutoka kwa Cornelder de Mozambique, kampuni ambayo ilipata zabuni kutoka kwa serikali ya Msumbiji mwaka 1998 ya kuendesha bandari hiyo, zinaonyesha kupungua kwa kasi kubwa katika matumizi ya waagizaji na wasafirishaji kwenda nje wa Malawi kwenye bandari hiyo.

eng: It says, for instance, that, while the country’s imports and exports traffic amounted to 570 million metric tonnes in 1998- and went on to reach a 1, 3 million metric tonnes peak in traffic in 2002- Malawi has failed to beat its own record peak of 2006.
swa: Taarifa hiyo inasema, kwa mfano, kuwa, wakati usafirisahji wa bidhaa zinazoingizwa kutoka nje na zile zinazosafirishwa kwenda zilifikia tani za metriki milioni 570 katika mwaka 1998 – na ziliendelea kufikia kilele cha tani za metriki milioni 1,3 kufikia mwaka 2000- Malawi imeshindwa kufifikia rekodi yake ya kilele cha 2006.

eng: The fuel importers and governments of Malawi and Mozambique blamed each other for the fuel crisis that hit Malawi for a consecutive four weeks plus in November and December.
swa: Waagizaji wa mafuta na serikali za Msumbiji na Malawi wanalaumiana kuhusu tatizo la mafuta lililoikumba Malawi kwa zaidi ya wiki nne mfululizo katika mwezi Novemba na Disemba.

eng: A veteran journalist-blogger is being sued for libel by a politician who is known for espousing press freedom in Malaysia.
swa: Mwanahabari-mwanablogu mkongwe anashtakiwa katika kesi ya kudhalilisha na mwanasiasa anayejulikana kwa kutetea uhuru wa habari nchini Malaysia.

eng: Zaid Ibrahim, former Minister in the Prime Minister's Department, was offended by a blog article written by A Kadir Jasin last October.
swa: Zaid Ibrahim, Waziri wa zamani katika Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu, aliguswa vibaya na makala iliyoandikwa na A Kadir Jasin mwezi Oktoba uliopita.

eng: Aside from suing the blogger, Zaid wants the writer to apologize.
swa: Mbali na kumshtaki mwanablogu huyo, Zaid anamtaka mwandishi aombe msamaha.

eng: What is peculiar in this case is that Zaid is known for supporting Malaysian bloggers who have been sued by powerful individuals and corporations.
swa: Kitu cha pekee katika shauri hili ni kwamba Zaid anajulikana kwa kuwaunga mkono wanablogu wa Kimalaysia ambao wameshtakiwa na watu wenye nguvu na mashirika.

eng: Zaid himself is also a blogger.
swa: Zaid mwenyewe naye pia ni mwanablogu.

eng: In fact, he made a rebuttal to the “offensive” article written by Jasin in his own blog.
swa: Na kwa kweli, alipiinga makala “inayoshambulia vibaya” iliyoandikwa na Jasin katika blogu yake mwenyewe.

eng: Rocky's Bru is surprised that Zaid is now part of an elite group of individuals who are suing bloggers
swa: Rocky's Bru anashangaa kwamba hivi sasa Zaid ni sehemu ya kundi la watu wenye nafasi ya juu ambao wanawashtaki wanablogu.

eng: I can't explain how Zaid Ibrahim, whom I once described as "maverick", has gone down this way.
swa: Siwezi kuelezea jinsi gani Zaid Ibrahim ambaye wakati fulani alielezewa kama “mtu mwenye maamuzi machachari”, amekwenda chini katika njia hii.

eng: Now Zaid has joined the queue of influential and wealthy individuals who are suing bloggers.
swa: Sasa Zaid amejiunga na msululu wa watu wenye ushawishi na matajiri ambao wanawashtaki wanablogu.

eng: With his latest action, I no longer want to describe Zaid as a "maverick".
swa: Kwa kitendo chake hiki kipya zaidi ya vyote, sitaki tena kumuelezea Zaid kama “mtu mwenye maamuzi machachari”.

eng: A maverick is unique, someone who dares go against the flow, a person you respect - even grudgingly - for his principles.
swa: Mtu mwenye maamuzi machachari ni mtu wa aina ya pekee, mtu ambaye anathubutu kwenda kinyume cha mkondo, mtu unayemheshimu – hata kwa manung’uniko – kutokana na kanuni au misimamo yake.

eng: Mat Cendana is worried that the case may lead to more defamation suits in Malaysia
swa: Mat Cendana anahofia kuwa kesi hii inaweza kusababisha kesi nyingine zaidi za udhalilishaji nchini Malaysia.

eng: In my opinion, this post, while certainly not flattering to Zaid, isn’t of “saman class” – heck, if this is ruled as defamation, then we’ll see at least 10 such cases being filed at the courts daily!
swa: Kwa maoni yangu, makala hii, huku kwa hakika haimpambi Zaid, haipo kwenye “hadhi ya saman”, kama hii itaamuliwa kama shauri la madai, basi tutashuhudia kesi kama 10 hivi zitakazoandikishwa mahakamani kila siku!

eng: Jebat is questioning the basis for filing the suit:
swa: Jebat anahoji msingi wa kusajili shauri hili:

eng: What is so wrong about the article which made him issue a writ of summon to Kadir Jasin?
swa: Ni kipi kina ubaya katika makala ambacho kimemfanya atoe tamko la kumuita mahakani Kadir Jasin?

eng: Is there any element of defamation in it?
swa: Je kuna chembe yoyote ya udhalilishaji ndani yake?

eng: Didn’t Zaid write a few allegatory statements concerning Kadir Jasin in his own rebuttal as well?
swa: Je Zaid kadhalika hakuandika matamko ya madai yanayomhusu Kadir Jasin katika makala yake ya kujibu?

eng: So, what is the contentious issue?
swa: Kwa hiyo, suala tat ani lipi?

eng: All of Pakatan Rakyat supporters are supporting Zaid Ibrahim anyway.
swa: Mashabiki wote wa Pakatan Rakyat wanamuunga mkono Zaid Ibrahim.

eng: Who cares if one negative article was published in blogosphere?
swa: Ni nani anayejali ikiwa makala moja hasi ilichapishwa katika ulimwengu wa blogu?

eng: You mean to say, people cannot write whatever they want?
swa: Unataka kusema, watu hawawezi kuandika chochote wanachotaka?

eng: Since when?
swa: Tangu lini?

eng: When he and all the opposition bloggers write tremendous amount of unfair accusations and uncouth articles defaming everyone else, it is fine.
swa: Wakati yeye na wanablogu wote wa upinzani wanapoandika idadi kubwa ya madai yasiyo na haki na makala zisizo na ustaarabu zinazowapaka matope wengine wote, ni sawa.

eng: But when one is confronted with a ghost from the past, he became rattled and couldn’t sleep peacefully.
swa: Lakini mtu anapokabiliwa na mzimu wa kale, anakereka na kushindwa kulala vizuri.

eng: The irony is, he would like to be seen as liberal and the fighter of press freedom and freedom of speech.
swa: Jambo la kinyume ni kuwa, anapenda kuonekana kama mtu mwenye mawazo huru na mpiganiaji wa uhuru wa habari na wa kujieleza.

eng: Nevertheless, it is his right to sue people as much as it was Kadir Jasin’s right to write that article.
swa: Hata hivyo, ni hali yake kuwashtaki watu kama vile ilivyo haki ya Kadir Jasin kuandika makala ile.

eng: Unlike some people who ran away like a coward, I am sure Kadir Jasin will commence all the necessary legal actions to defend his article based on any evidence that he can produce.
swa: Sio kama walivyo watu wengine ambao hukimbia kama waoga, nina hakika Kadir Jasin atachukua hatua zote zinazotakiwa za sheria ili kuitetea makala yake katika msingi wa ushahidi atakaoweza kuutoa.

eng: At bigdogdotcom, the writer is disappointed that Zaid is using the case to gain political and media mileage
swa: Katika bigdogdotcom, mwandishi anasikitishwa na kwamba Zaid anatumia kesi hii kupata faida kwenye siasa na kwenye vyombo vya habari

eng: What Zaid is trying to achieve is unclear.
swa: Kitu anachokitaka Zaid hakipo wazi.

eng: Obviously, since joining PKR, Zaid how has been infected with the acute ‘Suit Syndrome’ that only Former-Abuse-of-Power Anwar “Mat King Leather” Ibrahim suffer.
swa: Wazi, tangu ajiunge na PKR, Zaidi sasa ameambukizwa vikali “Ugonjwa wa Suti” ambao mtu mwingine pekee ni Aliyekuwa-Mtumiaji-Vibaya-wa-Madaraka Anwar “”Mfalme wa Zulia La Ngozi” Ibrahim anayesumbuliwa nao.

eng: Now Zaid has been infected with the Acute Lackofattentionitis dissease.
swa: Sasa Zaid ameambukizwa vikali ugonjwa wa kukosakutiliwamaanani.

eng: How far can Zaid go with this is also unclear.
swa: Ni umbali gani ambao Zaid anaweza kwenda pia ni jambo ambalo halipo wazi.

eng: Obviously, he needed the media and legal circus to make himself ‘relevant’ to stay on visible
swa: Wazi, alihitaji sarakasi ya vyombo vya habari na sheria ili kujipa “umuhimu” ili aweze kuonekana.

eng: Maoist night protest.
swa: Maandamano ya usiku ya ki-Mao.

eng: Image by Flickr user izahorsky.
swa: Picha na mtumiaji wa Flickr izahirsky.

eng: Used under a creative commons license
swa: Imetumika chini ya haki miliki huru.

eng: Nepal's fragile peace process is faltering amidst increasing clashes between the Maoists and the government.
swa: Mchakato nyeti wa kuleta amani nchini Nepal unasitasita katikati ya mapambano yanayozidi kuongezeka kati ya watu wa kundi la ki-Mao na serikali.

eng: Unhappy with President Ram Baran Yadav's decision to reinstate sacked Army Chief Rookmangud Katwal (Katwal was sacked by then Maoist led government), the former rebels launched massive protest across the nation.
swa: Wakiwa hawajafurahia uamuzi wa Rais Ram Baran Yadav wa kumrejesha madarakani Kiongozi wa jeshi aliyefukuzwa kazi Rookmangud Katwal (Katwali alifukuzwa kazi na serikali iliyoongozwa na kundi la ki-Mao), wapiganaji hao wa zamani wa upinzani walizindua maandamano makubwa nchini kote.

eng: Their main demand being "re-establishment of people's supreme authority", where they seek to curtail the President's authority as he is not an elected official.
swa: Ombi lao kubwa ni “kusimikwa tena kwa mamlaka ya watu”, ambapo wanataka kupunguza mamlaka ya rais kwani rais si ofisa nayechaguliwa.

eng: They have just announced third round of protest activities, after the first two round failed to produce any results.
swa: Ndiyo kwanza wametangaza duru la tatu la vitendo vya kupinga, baada ya duru mbili za kwanza kushindwa kutoa matokeo yoyote.

eng: Nepali language blog Mysansar has a brief outline of the protest programs Maoists are planning to launch. "Maoists who have been protesting on the streets and in the parliament demanding the President correct his decision have announced programs which have brought relief and some confusion.
swa: Blogu ya lugha ya Kinepali Mynsasar ina maelezo mafupi ya programu za kupinga ambazo kundi la ki-Mao limepanga kuzizindua.

eng: United Nations has expressed concerns, writes blogger Mohan Nepali at GroundReport, over the way government and the Maoists seem to ignore the promises made when signing the peace agreement in 2006. "UN Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR) today strongly urged Nepali political forces, including those in government, to make sure that human rights of all people are protected.
swa: “Ofisi ya balozi wa haki za binadamu wa Umoja wa Mataifa (OHCHR) leo hii alizitaka nguvu za kisiasa nchini Nepal, zikijumuishwa zile zilizo serikalini, kuhakikisha kuwa haki za binadamu wote zinalindwa.

eng: It has called on both Nepal government and Maoist protesters not to resort to any violence since it may jeopardize the very peace process going on since 2006.
swa: Imewataka wote, Serikali ya Nepal na wapinzani wa ki-Mao kutofanya ghasia zozote kwani kufanya hivyo kunaweza kuharibu mchakato wa amani mabo umekuwa ukiendelea tangu mwaka 2006.

eng: The OHCHR expressed its concern on the likelihood of violence in the name of Maoist protests and subsequent government actions"
swa: OHCHR imeelezea wasiwasi wake juu ya uwezekano wa ghasia katika jina la waandamanaji wa ki-Mao na vitendo vya serikali vitakavyofuatia”

eng: Prime Minister Madhav Kumar Nepal is under a lot of pressure to resolve the conflict with the Maoists but so far he has been unable to placate the former guerrillas.
swa: Waziri Mkuu Madhav Kumar Nepal yuomo kwenye shinikizo kubwa la kutatua mgogoro na watu wa kundi la ki-Mao lakini mpaka sasa hajaweza kuwaridhisha hao wanamgambo wa zamani wa upinzani.

eng: Maila Baje at Nepali Netbook says that Mr. Nepal's latest attempt to end the stand-off with the Maoist has failed to make any waves:
swa: Maila Baje katika Nepali Netbook anasema kuwa jaribio la hivi karibuni la Bw. Nepal la kuataka kumaliza kugota kwa mahusiano na watu wa kundi la ki-Mao limeshindwa kutengeneza mawimbi yoyote.

eng:
Prime Minister Madhav Kumar Nepal warned the other day that the constituent assembly could be dissolved. But the parliament that the elected body doubles as wouldn’t be, he was quick to clarify. 	“Waziri Mkuu Madhav Kumar Nepal alionya siku ile kuwa baraza la wawakilishi linaweza kuvunjwa, lakini bunge ambalo ni kivuli cha chombo kilichochaguliwa haliwezi, alikuwa mwepesi kubainisha.
If the prime conciliator was expected to attempt a middle way out of our deepening deadlock, he did not disappoint. 	Kama mpatanishi mkuu alitegemewa kujaribu kupita njia ya kati katika kugota huku kwa mahusiano ambako kunazidi kuongezeka kina, basi hakutuvunja moyo.
Especially since he passed the buck to President Ram Baran Yadav.
swa: Hasa kwa kuwa alimtupia mpira Rais Ram Baran Yadav.”

eng: Krishna Hari Pushkar, who works for Nepal's Ministry of Home Affairs, puts part of the blame for the faltering peace process on "foreign actors":
swa: Krishna Hari Pushkar, amabye anafanya kazi katika Wizara ya Mambo ya Ndani ya Nepal, anaziweka baadhi ya lawama za mchakato wa amani unaoweweseka kwa “watendaji wa kigeni”:

eng:
It is seen that all internal and external peace actors are visibly performing against the ethics of peace process and bouncing beyond the edge of comprehensive peace accord. 	“Inaonekana kuwa watendaji wa ndani na wa nje wanaonekana wazi jinsi wanavyopinga maadili ya mchakato wa amani na jinsi wanavyodunda mbali na ukingo wa mkataba wa amani.
So, how can Nepal's peace process go normally in such situation towards its expected end? 	Hivyo, ni kwa jinsi gani mkataba wa amani wa Nepal utaenda sawa katika hali kama hiyo na kelekea hitmisho linalotarajiwa?
Forlornly, it is hapless to describe that no any single direct and indirect actors found sincere and practically committed towards the success of ongoing peace process of Nepal. 	Kwa masikitiko, ni jambo la kusikitisha kueleza kuwa hakuna mtendaji hata mmoja wa moja kwa moja au wa vinginevyo walio na dhati na waliojitoa kwa vitendo kuhakikisha mafanikio ya mchakato wa amani nchini Nepal.
If the situation continues, it won't be surprising when the moist battalions decide to return jungle or government imposes special op against ethno-political combatants. 	Kama hali hii itaendelea, haitashangaza pale vikosi vya ki-Mao vitakapoamua kurejea msituni au serikali itakapoweka chaguo maalum dhidi ya wapiganaji wa kikabila.
It is unfortunate that some vested politicians' declares that re-insurgency or re-warfare is held in search of peace, however it has proved blunder to impel for “breach peace for peace”. 	Ni jambo la kusikitisha kuwa baadhi ya wanasiasa wenye maslahi wanasema kuwa mapambano mengine yanafanywa katika kutafuta amani, hata hivyo imethibitika kuwa ni uamzi wa kijinga kulazimisha “vunja amani ili kuleta amani”
So far the protest rallies have been peaceful, in some places colorful and musical. 	Mpaka sasa maandamano ya upinzani yamekuwa ya amani, katika sehemu nyingjne yaliyojaa rangi na muziki.
Here is a short video of once such protest rally.	Hii ni video fupi ya moja ya maandamano hayo ya upinzani.
Now that the Maoists have decided to launch second round of protests and are threatening to go on strike for an indefinite period if their demands are not fulfilled, it seems that the drama will continue for a while. 	Na kwa kuwa sasa watu wa kundi la ki-Mao wameamua kuzindua duru la pili la maandamano na wanatishia kuingia kwenye mgomo kwa kipindi kisicho na ukomo kama madai yao hayatakidhiwa, inaonekana kuwa mchezo huu wa kuigiza utaendelea kwa muda.
	
As the world's nations gather today in Copenhagen for the United Nations Convention on Climate Change, Madagascar, having already lost 90% of its original forest, faces continued threats from black market logging. 	Wakati mataifa ya dunia yanakutana leo huko Copenhagen kwa ajili ya Mkutano wa Umoja wa Mataifa wa mabadiliko ya tabianchi, Madagascar, ambayo imekwishapoteza 90% ya misitu yake ya asili, inakabiliwa na tishio la biashara ya magendo ya magogo.
An illegal traffic of rosewood, a topic of conversation in the Malagasy mediasphere for a few months, has now been thoroughly exposed by an undercover team of investigators. 	Biashara haramu ya mbao ngumu zinazojulikana kama rosewood (miti iliyo katika kundi la mikwaju au mpingo), ni mada ya mazungumzo katika ulimwengu wa habari wa ki-malagasy kwa miezi michache sasa, na hivi sasa imewekwa wazi na timu ya wapelelezi kanzu.
The details of this very profitable traffic have been made public and shared by many citizen bloggers and scientific publications.	Maelezo ya kina ya biashara hii yenye faida yametolewa kwa ajili ya umma na yamepokewa na kushirikishwa na wanablogu wengi na majarida ya kisayansi.
The latest report produced by Global Witness and Environmental Investigation Agency (EIA) states that about $460,000 USD worth of trade is cut down each day, with enforcement efforts hampered by the continued absence of a government of national unity. 	Taarifa ya karibuni zaidi imeandikwa na Global Witness panoja na Asasi ya Uchunguzi wa mazingira (EIA) inasema kwamba takriban magogo yenye thamani ya dola za Kimarekani 460, 000 hukatwa kila siku, huku juhudi za kudhibiti zikikwamishwa na kutokuwepo kwa serikali ya umoja.
The full report is available here (and in French here).	Taarifa kamili inapatikana hapa (na kwa lugha ya Kifaransa hapa).
names of perpetrators and the volume of the illegal traffic.	Rosewood kupitia Achille52, at http://reflexiums.wordpress.com Taarifa hiyo ina majina ya wahalifu na ukubwa wa biashara hiyo haramu
Malagasy blogger Achille quotes from the report (fr):	Mwanablogu wa ki-Malagasy Achille ananukuu kutoka kwenye taarifa hiyo (fr):
After a coup in March, the new and weakened government of Andry Rajoelina issued sweeping decrees allowing the harvest and export of wood from protected forests and World Heritage Sites. 	Baada ya mapinduzi ya kijeshi ya mwezi Machi, serikali mpya dhaifu ya Andry rajoelina ilitoa amri za haraka zinazoruhusu uvunaji na usafirishaji nje wa magogo kutoka kwenye misitu inayohifadhiwa na maeneo ya Hifadhi za Historia Duniani.
The Obama administration has condemned the de facto government, and the Wildlife Conservation Society, the World Wildlife Fund (WWF), and Conservation International have denounced the wholesale exploitation of some of the world's most diverse forests and decimation of the local population's resources and livelihoods 	Serikali ya Obama imeshutumu serikali hiyo isiyo rasmi, na Jumuiya ya Hifadhi za Wanyamapori, Mfuko wa Wanyamapori Duniani pamoja na Shirika la Conservation International yameshutumu vikali uvunaji wa jumla wa baadhi ya misitu yenye mimea mingi tofauti na kuteketezwa kwa nyenzo za maisha za watu wa eneo hilo
The rosewood scandal have now had a serious impact in the political process of Madagascar.	Suala hili la ufisadi wa rosewood hivi sasa unaathiri mchakato wa kisiasa nchini Madagascar.
Former president Albert Zafy threatened to disclose names in the current Rajoelina government if a solution to unblock the deadlock over the government of national union is not found soon.	Rais wa zamani Albert Zafy ametishia kuyaweka wazi majina ya watu walio kwenye serikali ya sasa ya Rajoelina kama ufumbuzi wa kutatua mgogoro juu serikali ya pamoja ya taifa hautapatikana mapema.
The necessity to reach a government of national union is also pressed on by the conditionality of foreign investments by the United States ( AGOA and MCC) and the European Union (fr) (NB: 70% of the Malagasy government budget come from foreign aid).	Ulazima wa kufikia serikali ya umoja wa kitaifa pia unashinikizwa na masharti ya wawekezaji wan je yaliyotolewa na Marekani (AGOA na MCC) kadhalika na Umoja wa Nchi za Ulaya (fr) (70% ya bajeti ya wa-Malagasy inatokana na misaada kutoka nje).
Interestingly, this decree allowed for the legal investigation of Gibson guitars. 	Jambo jingine, amri hii iliruhusu uchunguzi wa kisheria wa watengeneza magitaa, Gibsons Guitars.
Their headquarters were raided by the US Fish and Wildlife Service because the guitars were made from rosewood from the illegal traffic in Madagascar.	Makao yao makuu yalivamiwa na Shirika la Samaki na Wanyamapori la Marekani kwa kuwa magitaa yao yanatengenezwa kwa mbao za rosewood zinazotokana na biashara haramu huko Madagascar.
Judging from reactions of Twitter users around the world, the fact that Gibson guitars were implicated provoked more reactions that the potential loss of the ring-tail lemur habitat. 	Kwa kuangalia maoni ya watumiaji wa twita, kwamba Gibson guitars walihisishwa ni ukweli ambao ulisababisha maoni mengi zaidi kuliko kupotea kwa makazi pekee ya nyani mwenye mkia wa miaraba (ambaye anapatikana huko Madagascar pekee).
The issue of deforestation in Madagascar is unfortunately not limited to rosewood trafficking.	Suala la kupotea kwa misitu huko Madagascar kwa bahati mbaya haliishii kwenye biashara ya magogo ya rosewood.
Slash and burn agriculture has caused much of the anthropogenic deforestation of the region.	Kilimo cha kukata na kuchoma kimesababisha zaidi upoteaji wa misitu kunakotokana na vitendo vya binadamu.
The NGO Vakanala has produced a remarkable 3D real time visualization of the numbers of bush fires affecting Madagascar:	Asasi isiyo ya kiserikali Vakanala imetengeneza onyesho la pande 3 la moto katika misitu inayoiathiri Madagascar:
image via http://vakanala.orgRosewood via Achille52, at http://reflexiums.wordpress.com 	Picha kupitia http://vakanala.org
Similarily, the Malagasy NGO Mistinjo has also focused its effort on capacity building of local communities that work towards forest restoration and carbon sequestration in Andasibe. 	Vivyo hivyo, Asasi Isiyo ya Kiserikali, Mistinjo inaelekeza juhudi zake kwenye kujenga uwezo wa jamii za sehemu hiyo ambazo zinafanya kazi ya kupanda tena misitu na kuokoa gisi ya ukaa katika Andasibe.
Local bloggers have been raising awareness over the loss of the national rain forest for a long time ago now.	Wanablogu wa sehemu hiyo wamekuwa wakielimisha umma juu ya kupotea kwa misitu ya mvua ya taifa kwa muda mrefu sasa.
But they do more than just raising awareness, Patrick, a blogger from Tamatave, has been steadily replanting trees in the Toamasina region and involved many other associations in this process: 	Lakini wanafanya zaidi ya ya kuelimisha umma, Patrick, mwanablogu kutoka Tamatave, amekuwa akipanda miti katika eneo la Toasmasina na amehusisha jumuiya nyingi katika mchakato huu:
	
Many Egyptian bloggers and activists have been detained by State Security on various occasions and for various reasons - real or fake - Wa7da Masreya interviewed several bloggers and posted a detailed post on torture techniques and psychological tricks those bloggers have been subjected to in State Security headquarters in the district of Nasr City. In her post, Wa7da Masreya wrote describing the headquarters: 	Wanablogu na wanaharakati wengi wa Kimisri wamekuwa wakikamatwa na Usalama wa Taifa katika nyakati tafauti kwa sababu mbalimbali –za kweli au za bandia –Wa7da Masreya aliwahoji wanablogu mbalimbali na kuweka makala ya kina kuhusu mbinu za utesaji na hila za kisaikolojia ambazo wanablogu wale wamekuwa wakikumbana nazo kwenye makao makuu ya Usalama wa Taifa katika wilaya ya Jiji la Nasr.
e) In the same vulnerable position above, he would lay down on a wired wet blanket. 	Kwenye makala yake, Wa7da Masreya aliandika akielezea makao makuu hayo:
	
This past weekend, Moroccans celebrated Eid Al-Adha, or the Festival of the Sacrifice, often referred to in Morocco as Eid Al-Kabir, or the big festival," as opposed to Eid al-Fitr, known colloquially as Eid al-Sghir, or "the little festival."
swa: Wikiendi hii iliyopita, Wamoroko walisherehekea Eid Al-Adha, au Sherehe ya kutoa kafara, ambayo mara nyingine inajulikana nchini Moroko kama Eid Al-Kabir, au “sherehe kubwa,“ tofauti na Eid al-Fitr, inayojulikana kwa lugha ya mtaani kama Eid al-Sghir, au “Sherehe ndogo.”

eng: While the holiday shares the same meaning and traditions across the Muslim world, the celebrations are often uniquely local.
swa: Wakati siku kuu zina maana inayofanana na utamaduni uleule katika nchi zote za kiislamu, maadhimisho yenyewe mara nyingi huwa ni ya aina ya tofauti kwa kila sehemu.

eng: Bloggers in rural Morocco (referred to locally as the bled) are sharing their stories about this year's Eid.
swa: Wanablogu walioko sehemu za vijijini nchini Moroko (ambazo hujulikana kama bled) wanasimulia simulizi zao kuhusu Eid ya mwaka huu.

eng: As Internet access is sparse and often prohibitively expensive outside of cities, many of the people blogging from rural areas are Peace Corps Volunteers (PCVs) and are therefore positioned to give an outsiders' perspective...from the inside.
swa: Kwa kuwa upatikanaji wa intaneti upo sehemu chache n amara nyingi ni wa aghali mno nje miji mikubwa, wengi wanaoblugu kutokea sehemu za mashamba ni Wafanyakazi wa Amani wa Kujitolea (PCVs) na kwa hiyo wako katika nafasi ya kuweza kutoa mitazamo kama wageni kutoka nje… walioko ndani.

eng: Erin, a PCV who blogs at Reflections and Experiences in Al Maghreb Al Aqsa, explains her host family's Eid traditions, saying:
swa: Erin, mfanyakazi wa kujitolea anayeblogu katika Reflections and Experiences in Al Maghreb Al Aqsa, anaelezea tamaduni za Eid za familia yake ya kufikia, anasema:

eng: Saturday morning, my host family slaughtered a sheep and 2 goats for the Eid celebration.
swa: Jumamosi asubuhi, familia yangu ya kufikia ilichinja kondoo mmoja na mbuzi wawili kwa jili ya sherehe za Idi.

eng: This is done in honor of Abraham, who was willing to sacrifice his son for God, before God told him to sacrifice a sheep instead.
swa: Hii inafanyika kwa kumkumbuka Abraham, ambaye alikuwa tayari kumtoa mwanae wa pekee kafara kwa Mungu, kabla Mungu hajamwambia kumtoa kondoo badala yake.

eng: Although Muslim families all over the world practice this tradition, people celebrate in very different ways.
swa: Ingawa familia za Kiislamu duniani kote zinafanya kitendo hiki, watu husherekea kwa namna tofauti.

eng: Some families give all the meat to those in need, while some (like my host family) eat every last organ, and have enough meat to last them for 2 or more months.
swa: Familia nyingine hutoa nyama yote kwa wale wenye uhitaji, wakati wengine (kama famialia yangu ya kufikia) hula mpaka kiungo cha mwisho, na hubaki na nyama itakayowatosha kwa miezi miwili au zaidi.

eng: Joy in Morocco, who is also a PCV, writes of something she's grateful for in Morocco, also sharing a picture of a woman
swa: Joy in Morocco, ambaye pia ni mfanyakazi wa kujitolea wa Peace Corps, anaandika juu ya kitu anachokishukuru nchini Morocco, na vilevile kaweka picha ya mwanamke kutoka kijijini kwake anayepika wakati wa Eid:

eng: Joy in Morocco posted this photo on her blog from her village cooking on Eid:
swa: Joy in Morocco aliweka picha hii kwenye blogu yake

eng: Moroccan's close connection with food.
swa: Ukaribu wa Wamoroko na masuala ya chakula.

eng: Sheep meat doesn't arrive in frozen packages.
swa: Nyama ya kondoo huwa haiji kwa mapakacha yaliyogandishwa.

eng: They slaughter it.
swa: Wanachinja.

eng: They prepare all the meat- start to grill.
swa: Wanaandaa nyama yote na kuanza kuibanika.

eng: Similarly is their relationship with fruit and vegetables, particularly in my region.
swa: Vivyo hivyo ni kuhusu uhusiano wao na matunda na mboga mboga, hasa katika mkoa wangu.

eng: Everything comes from their backyard, literally.
swa: Kila kitu huja kutoka kwenye mashamba yao, kwa jinsi ilivyo.

eng: PCV oclynn in morocco was less of a fan of the holiday.
swa: Mfanyakazi wa kujitolea wa Peace Corps anayeblogu kwenye oclynn in morocco hakuwa shabiki wa siku kuu.

eng: The blogger explains:
swa: Mwanablogu huyo anaeleza:

eng: Smoke off the grills rising from all the rooftop decks as the heads and hooves of the sheep are first to go on the fire.
swa: Moshi unaotokea kwenye vichanja vya kubanikia ukipanda kutoka kwenye mapaa ya varanda za nyumba wakati vichwa na makongoro ya miguu ya kondoo yakienda kwanza kwenye moto.

eng: Listening to the thrashing of my neighbor’s sheep on our roof as it is dying (and why does it seem to be taking so long?).
swa: Nikisikiliza kelele za kondoo wa jirani yangu kupitia paa letu wakati akifa (na kwa nini inaonekana kuchukua muda mrefu?).

eng: Sheep were slaughtered on rooftops, the lot next door and on the sidewalk in front of homes.
swa: Kondoo walichinjiwa kwenye paa, mlango wa pili na upenuni mbele ya nyumba.

eng: Everywhere.
swa: Kila mahali.

eng: Blood running down the gutter.
swa: Damu ikitiririkia kwenye mifereji ya maji.

eng: It must be L’eid Kbir.
swa: Ni lazima iwe L’eid Kbir.

eng: Not my favorite holiday, but the holiest of them all in the Muslim world.
swa: Siyo siku kuu niipendayo, lakini ni takatifu kuliko zote kwenye dunia ya Kiislamu.

eng: Blowing up the lungs of the Eid sheep
swa: Kupulizia mapafu ya kondoo wa Idi.

eng: Yet another PCV whose blog is called From the Cold Land with the Hot Sun shares an interesting experience from the holiday, complete with photo:
swa: Bado mfanyakazi mwingine wa kujitolea wa Peace Corps ambaye blogu yake inaitwa From the Cold Land with the Hot Sun anatupa uzoefu wake unaofurahisha kutokana na siku kuu, kwa kutumia picha:

eng: Though I'd like to divert the focus away from the gruesome and entertaining aspects of the celebration in favor of the more wholesome and boring ones, I did witness a jaw-dropping moment during the disemboweling of the animal that I cannot resist writing about here.
swa: Ingawa ningependa kubadilisha uelekeo kutoka kwenye upande unaokerehesha na kuburudisha wa sherehe kwa ajili ya upande ule unaofaa kimaadili na unaochosha, nilishuhudia wasaa wa kuangusha taya wakati wa kumchuna mnyama tendo ambalo siwezi kujizuia kuliandika hapa.

eng: Upon removing the lungs from the inverted and dangling sheep's chest cavity, the friendly man spattered in blood held them up by the still-attached esophagus for all to see.
swa: Wakati wa kuondoa mapafu kutoka kwenye kifua cha kondoo aliyening’inizwa kichwa chini miguu juu, jamaa mtaratibu aliyekuwa amechafuka damu akiwa ameyashikilia kwa sehemu ya koromeo iliyokuwa imebaki kiasi cha kuonekana na wote.

eng: He then blew forcefully into the esophageal opening, causing the lungs to inflate fully- pink, glistening, and strange in the morning sun.
swa: Halafu akapuliza kwa nguvu kupitia tundu la koromeo hilo, akisababisha mapafu yajae upepo –yenye rangi nyekundu isiyokoza, yaking’aa, na ya ajabu kwa jua la asubuhi.

eng: It was so cool.
swa: Ilikuwa poa sana.

eng: Cynthia, the blogger behind The Couscous Chronicles, is another PCV writing about the holiday.
swa: Cynthia, mwanablogu wa The Couscous Chronicles, ni mfanyakazi mwingine wa Peace Corps anayeandika kuhusu siku kuu.

eng: She explains why it's best to have "family" in Morocco:
swa: Anaeleza kwa nini inakuwa vizuri sana kuwa na ‘familia’ nchini Moroko:

eng: This year was worlds better than last year simply because I chose to celebrate it with my neighbors (who have really become my family here) and their entire extended family, which is a hilarious and wonderful group of people.
swa: Mwaka huu ulikuwa ulimwengu mzuri zaidi kuliko mwaka jana kwa sababu tu nilichagua kusherekea na majirani zangu (ambao kwa kweli wamekuwa familia yangu hapa) na familia yao kubwa, ambayo ni ya watu wenye bashasha na wa ajabu sana.

eng: Last year I felt like I just got shuffled around from house to house, drinking tea and eating meat and feeling awkward the whole time, but this year I felt like part of the celebration.
swa: Mwaka uliopita nilijisikia kama vile napelekwa kutoka nyumba hadi nyumba, nikinywa chai na kula nyama na nikisikia vibaya muda wote, lakini mwaka huu nilijisikia kama sehemu ya sherehe.

eng: Feeling like a real part of a family makes holidays a lot more fun.
swa: Kujisikia kama sehemu kabisa ya familia kunafanya sherehe ziwe jambo la kusisismua sana.

eng: Last but not least, Reading Morocco shares a slideshow of photos from a Berber village in Southern Morocco, attributed to Leila Alaoui:
swa: Mwisho lakini sio kwa umuhimu, Reading Morocco anatupa mfulululizo wa onyesho la picha kutoka kwenye kijiji chake Kusini mwa Moroko, zikihusishwa na Leila Alaoui:

eng: Eid Al Adha from aida alami on Vimeo.
swa: Eid Al Adha from aida alami on Vimeo.

eng: A solidarity banner from the freebashir.org site
swa: Tovuti ya freebashir.org imetundika bango hili la kuwaunga mkono Mwanablogu na Mwenye mgahawa wa Intaneti

eng: On Monday, December 14th, Blogger Bashir Hazzam and Internet cafe owner Abdullah Boukhou were sentenced to four months and one year, respectively plus a fine of MAD 500 (USD 63) each, in a Goulmim court.
swa: Mnamo tarehe 14 Desemba, siku ya Jumatatu, mwanablogu Bashir Hazzam na mmiliki wa mgahawa wa Intaneti Abdullah Boukhou walihukumiwa kifungo cha miezi minne jela kwa huyo wa kwanza na mwaka mmoja kwa huyo wa pili pamoja na kulipa faini ya MAD 500 (sawa na dola za Marekani 63) kila mmoja katika mahakama ya Goulmim.

eng: Hazzam was sentenced for “spreading false information harmful to the kingdom's image on human rights,” while Boukhou's sentence was for similar reasons and likely included a charge for providing a space for spreading those information.
swa: Hazzam alifungwa kwa kosa la kile kinachoitwa “Kueneza habari za uongo zinazochafua sura ya ufalme kuhusu masuala ya haki za binadamu,” wakati kwa Boukhou pia ilikuwa kwa sababu hizohizo na pengine ilihusisha pia kutoa nafasi ya kusambaza taarifa hizo.

eng: Three other students have been sentenced to six months and given a fine of MAD 5000 (USD 632) along with Bashir and Abdullah for an un-authorized sit-in in the city of Taghjijt.
swa: Wanafunzi wengine watatu wamehukumiwa kwenda jela miezi sita na kulipa faini ya MAD 5000 (sawa na dola za Marekani 632) pamoja na Bashir na Abdullah kwa kuendesha mgomo haramu katika jiji la Taghjijt.

eng: Bashir Hazzam has been accused of “spreading false information harmful to the kingdom's image on human rights” after being arrested on December 8th, reported the Committee to Protect Bloggers, stating:
swa: Bashir Hazzam ametuhumiwa kwa “Kueneza habari za uongo zinazochafua sura ya ufalme kuhusu masuala ya haki za binadamu,” baada ya kutiwa mbaroni mnamo tarehe 8 Desemba, iliripoti Kamati ya Kulinda Wanablogu, ikisema:

eng: Moroccan blogger Bashir Hazem was arrested on December 8, 2009 following a protest in Tarjijt, during which students clashed with security forces, after posting a press release about the clash on his blog. He has been interrogated about his blogging, specifically his most recent post, which contained the signatures of a committee of arrested students.
swa: Mwanblogu wa Ki-Morocco, Bashir Hazem, alitiwa mbaroni mnamo tarehe 8 Desemba, 2009 kufuatia mgomo uliofanyika katika jiji la Tarjijt, ambapo wanafunzi walipambana vikali na vyombo vya usalama, na baada ya yeye kuwa amechapisha taarifa kwa vyombo vya habari kuhusu mapambano hayo katika blogu yake, na taarifa hiyo ilikuwa na saini za wanafunzi wanakamati waliotiwa mbaroni.

eng: ANHRI, The Arabic Network for Human Rights Information, denounced the arrest of the blogger Bashir Hazzam.
swa: ANHRI, ambao ni Mtandao wa Kiarabu kuhusu Taarifa za Haki za Binadamu, ulilaani vikali kukamatwa huko kwa mwanablogu Bashir Hazzam.

eng: Reporters without Borders (RSF) denounced and questioned why the sentence was given at a time when the Moroccan government is putting in place a program to promote internet access, information society and digital economy:
swa: Waandishi wa Habari Wasio na Mipaka (RSF) nao walilaani na kuhoji kwa nini hukumu ilitoka katika kipindi ambapo serikali ya Morocco inaanzisha programu ya kuhamasisha utumiaji wa Intaneti, ujenzi wa jamii iliyohabarika na uchumi wa dijitali:

eng: There are 20 languages spoken in Mozambique, according to the government website, apart from the official Portuguese.
swa: Kuna lugha 20 zinazozungumzwa nchini Msumbiji, kwa mujibu wa tovuti ya serikali, zaidi ya lugha ya serikali ya Kireno.

eng: Carlos Serra wonders if there are more, according to two renowned linguists: "One told me that there were between 20 and 26; the other told me that there were 17 written and some yet to be spelled out".
swa: Carlos Serra anajiuliza kama kuna lugha nyingine zaidi, kwa mujibu wa wataalamu wa lugha mashuhuri:"Kuna mtu aliniambia kuwa zipo kati ya 20 na 26; mwingine akaniambia zipo 17 zilizoandikwa na nyingine bado hazijaweza kuandikwa".

eng: Not many know her as Mwanaisha Abdalla but Nyota Ndogo (Kiswahili for Small Star), is a household name in East Africa.
swa: Si wengi wanamfahamu kama Mwanaisha Abdalla bali kama Nyota Ndogo, ni jina linalojulikana kwenye kila nyumba katika Afrika Mashariki.

eng: An artwork of her Nyota Ndogo's Cover Album - MpenziShe has been collecting fans of her eclectic East African sound for over 4 years now.
swa: Kazi ya sanaa ya kasha la Albamu ya Nyota Ndogo iitwayo – Mpenzi Amekuwa akijikusanyia mashabiki wa muziki wa mahadhi ya Afrika Mashariki kwa zaidi ya miaka mine sasa.

eng: Her blog on the other hand has been running for 3 years.
swa: Blogu yake kwa upande mwingine imekuwa ikifanya kazi kwa miaka mitatu.

eng: There is no doubt that the blog has contributed the growth of her online fan base.
swa: Hakuna shaka kwamba blogu yake imechangia kukua kwa umarufu wake wa mtandaoni.

eng: Born in 1981 in the Kenyan Coastal province of Mombasa, Nyota Ndogo has come from a very humble background.
swa: Akiwa amezaliwa mwaka 1981 kwenye Jimbo la pwani la Mombasa, Nyota Ndogo ametokea kwenye historia ya kinyenyekevu.

eng: She dropped out of school at a young age and for quite some time, worked as a house help until she was discovered by Andrew Burchell as a talented singer.
swa: Aliacha shule akiwa na umri mdogo na baada ya muda, akafanya kazi kama mfanyakazi wa ndani mpaka alipogunduliwa na Andrew Burchell kama mtu mwenye kipaji cha kuimba.

eng: Now she has 3 cd's released under her name, CHEREKO, NATOKA MBALI NA WEWE and MPENZI.
swa: Sasa ana CD tatu zilizotoka kwa jina lake, CHEREKO, NATOKA MBALI NA WEWE na MPENZI.

eng: She has also featured on 3 international compilations WORLD 2003, THE ROUGH GUIDE TO KENYA and OFF THE BEATEN TRACK.
swa: Ameshirikishwa vilevile katika makusanyo matatu ya kimataifa kama WORLD 2003, THE ROUGH GUIDE TO KENYA na OFF THE BEATEN TRACK.

eng: She is also holder of two Kenya Kisima Music Awards: Best Taraab Singer 2003 and Best Female Singer 2005.
swa: Pia anashikilia mbili ya Tuzo za muziki za Kisima za Kenya: Mwimbaji bora wa Taraab 2003 na Mwimbaji bora wa kike 2005.

eng: Her songs which are mostly in Kiswahili with a few in English are sang in the Taarab genre heard mostly in the East African Coast as well as in Kapuka and Genge, music genres heard mainly within the Kenyan mainland.
swa: Nyimbo zake ambazo nyingi ni za Kiswahili zenye maneno machache ya Kiingereza zinaimbwa kwa mahadhi ya Taarab yanayosikika zaidi kwenye ukanda wa mwambao wa Afrika Mashariki na pia Kapuka na Genge, mahadhi ya muziki unaosikika zaidi maeneo ya bara ya Kenya.

eng: So how does one with such a background learn to harness the internet to her advantage as a growing Kenyan based Artist?
swa: Je ni namna gani mtu mwenye historia kama hiyo anaweza kujifunza kuutumia mtandano wa intaneti kwa faida yake kama Msanii wa Kenya anayechipukia?

eng: This is the question that comes to mind when you visit her blog.
swa: Hili ni swali linalokujia kichwani unapotembelea blogu yake.

eng: In it, she shares everything about herself as an artist from a personal perspective as opposed to the edited media stories and information that one will find in the entertainment section of a newspaper or magazine.
swa: Humo, anasema kila kitu kinachomhusu yeye kama msanii kwa kutumia mtazamo binafsi ukilinganisha na habari na taarifa za vyombo vya habari zinazohaririwa ambapo mtu anaweza kuzipata kwenye sehemu ya burudani wkenye magazeti na majarida.

eng: From music videos of her songs to lyrics to photos of her performing with fellow artists and fans, one can feel a more intimate connection with Nyota Ndogo through her blog.
swa: Kutoka kwenye video za nyimbo zake mpaka kwenye mashairi ya nyimbo zake mpaka kwenye picha zake zinazomwonyesha akitumbuiza na wasanii wenzake na mashabiki wake, mtu anaweza kujisikia kuunganishwa na kuwekwa karibu zaidi na Nyota Ndogo kwa kupitia blogu yake.

eng: Blogging has not been an easy experience for her as she confessed in her blog post on 27th July, 2006 at 1.43pm
swa: Kublogu hakujawa uzoefu rahisi kwake kama alivyokiri kwenye makala yake ya blogu ya tarefhe 27 Julai, 2006 saa 7.43 mchana.

eng: wow I’d nearly given up with the blog as it was proving difficult to get a new post up .it turned out to be me using an incompatible browser.
swa: Almanusura niachane na blogu yake kwa sababu ilikuwa inaniwia vigumu kupata mtundiko mpya. Kumbe ilikuwa ni mimi niliyekuwa natumia kivinjari kisichopatana.

eng: So am back with good old internet explorer.
swa: Kwa hiyo nimerejea na kivinjari cha zamani Internet explorer.

eng: If this works expect some pix up soon so much has happend.x
swa: Kama hii itafanya kazi tegemea picha kadhaa hivi karibuni sababu mengi yametokea.x

eng: Looking at her current blog posts, one can indeed see that Nyota has known quite well how to use the blogging tool.
swa: Kwa kuangalia kwenye posti za hivi karibuni kwenye blogu yake, kwa hakika mtu anaweza kuona kuwa Nyota amefahamu vizuri sana kutumia vyenzo za kublogu.

eng: This unfortunately cannot be said of many other East African Artists as I could not find any other artist blog.
swa: Hili kwa bahati mbaya sana haliwezi kusemwa kwa Wasanii wengi wengine wa Afrika Mashariki kwa sababu sikuweza kupata blogu yoyote ya msanii mwingine.

eng: It seems, one need not be learned to know how to blog, it is after all, a tool.
swa: Inaonekana, mtu hahitaji kuwa msomi kujua namna ya kublogu, baada ya yote, ni nyenzo tu.

eng: Namibia's presidential and national assembly elections took place on 27–28 November 2009.
swa: Uchaguzi wa rais na bunge la taifa la Namibia ulifanyika tarehe 27 na 28 Novemba 2009.

eng: Fourteen political parties participated in the elections.
swa: Vyama vya kisiasa kumi na vinne vilishiriki uchaguzi.

eng: The ruling party, the South West Africa People's Organisation (SWAPO) is expected to win.
swa: Chama tawala, SWAPO kinatarajiwa kushinda uchaguzi.

eng: Rally for Democracy and Progress (RDP) is SWAPO's main challenger.
swa: Chama cha upinzani (RDP) ni mpinzani mkubwa wa Chama cha SWAPO.

eng: Political parties and non-governmental organisations used a number of social media tools to campaign, monitor and report on Namibia Elections 2009.
swa: Vyama vya siasa na mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali yalitumia nyenzo kadhaa za habari za kijamii kupiga kampeni, kufuatilia na kuripoti Uchaguzi wa Namibia 2009.

eng: The National Society for Human Rights (NSHR) used Ushahidi to monitor the elections.
swa: Asasi ya Taifa ya Haki za Binadamu (NSHR) walitumia nyenzo ya Ushahidi kufuatilia uchaguzi.

eng: Ushahidi, which means testimony in Kiswahili, was a tool created in the aftermath of disputed Kenya's elections in 2007.
swa: Ushahidi ni nyenzo ambayo ilitengenezwa baada ya Uchaguzi uliokosa maelewano wa Kenya mwaka 2007.

eng: Ushahidi collected eyewitness reports of violence placed them on a map.
swa: Ushahidi ilikusanya taarifa za ushuhuda wa kuona za mapigano na kuziweka kwenye ramani.

eng: NSHR used Ushahidi to collect reports about fraud, undue influence, intimidation, violence, etc.
swa: NSHR walitumia Ushahidi kukusanya taarifa kuhusu udanganyifu, ushawishi usio haki, vitisho, matumizi ya nguvu na kadhalika.

eng: Reports were sent in three ways: SMS, email and filling a form on the website.
swa: Taarifa zilitumwa kwa njia tatu: Ujumbe mfupi wa simu (SMS), barua pepe na kujaza fomu kwenye tovuti.

eng: Pre-election violence reported on Ushahidi:
swa: Matumizi ya nguvu kabla ya uchaguzi yaliripotiwa kwenye Ushahidi:

eng: Last Friday evening between 20hoo and 21hoo in Eveline Street in the Goreangab suburb of Windhoek, fighting started between a group of 15 Swapo party and 7 RDP supporters after the former singing 'We are Nujoma's soldiers' removed a RDP poster from a municipal light pole.
swa: Jioni ya Ijumaa iliyopita kati ya saa 2 na saa 3 usiku kwenye Mtaa wa Eveline huko Goreangab sehemu ya Windhoek, mapigano yalianza kati ya wanachama 15 wa SWAPO na wanachama 7 wa RDP baada ya wale wa chama tawala huku wakimba “Sisi ni Askari wa Nujoma ” walipobandua bango la chama cha RDP kwenye nguzo ya umeme ya Manispaa.

eng: Members of the Wanaheda Police precinct rapidly intervened and no further incident occured that evening.
swa: Wanachama wa Polisi wa Wanaheda waliwahi haraka kuingilia na hakuna tukio jingine lilitokea jioni hiyo.

eng: The African Elections Project uses new media to monitor and report on elections in African countries.
swa: Mradi wa Chaguzi za Afrika hutumia nyenzo mpya za habari kufuatilia na kuripoti chaguzi katika nchi za Kiafrika.

eng: The project set up a Namibia page, a blog and Twitter page to keep track of elections news and results.
swa: Mradi ulianzisha ukurasa wa Namibia, blogu na ukurasa wa Twita ili kuweka kumbukumbu ya habari za uchaguzi na matokeo.

swa: Hii ni siku ya 3 ya zoezi la uhakiki. Tume ya Uchaguzi imepokea asilimia 40 na asilimia 30 yamehakikishwa #namibiaelection2009
