eng: Claims of irregularities:
swa: Madai ya kasoro:

eng: The RDP and several other opposition parties held a press conference on Saturday afternoon alleging a string of irregularities including indelible ink that didn't work, ballot papers that did not have the official stamp, and the ever-changing voters register (of which there is a new version with yet another figure for the number of registered voters).
swa: Chama cha RDP na vyama vingine vya upinzani viliitisha mkutano na waandishi wa habari mchana wa Jumamosi vikidai uwepo wa mlolongo wa kasoro zikijumuisha wino usifutika ambao haukufanya kazi, karatasi za kupigia kura ambazo hazikuwa na muhuri rasmi, na daftari la wapiga kura linalobadilika kila wakati (ambalo lina toleo jipya lenye tarakimu tofauti ya idadi ya wapigakura walioandikishwa).

eng: The Institute for Public Policy Research (IPPR) also used social networks such as Facebook to allow people from all over the world to express their views and opinions about Namibian elections.
swa: Taasisi ya Utafiti wa Sera za Umma (IPPR) vilevile ilitumia mitandao ya kijamii kama Facebook kuwaruhusu watu kutoka duniani kote kueleza maoni na mawaoz yao kuhusu uchaguzi wa Namibia.

eng: Social media has not become popular in Namibia as in other African countries such as South Africa, Kenya, Malawi, Nigeria and Tanzania.
swa: Vyombo vya habari vya kijamii havijawa maarufu nchini Namibia kama ilivyo kwenye nchi nyingine za Kiafrika kama Afrika Kusini, Kenya, Malawi, Naijeria na Tanzania.

eng: We will keep our eyes on Namibia to see the future of social media in the country.
swa: Tutayakazia macho yetu Namibia kuoana mustakabali wa vyombo vya habari vya kijamii katika nchi hiyo.

eng: Leading up to the Climate Change Conference in Copenhagen (COP15) in December 2009, here is a sample of online tools to monitor climate change.
swa: Kuelekea kwenye Mkutano wa Mabadiliko ya TabiaNchi utakaofanyika Copenhagen (COP15) mwezi Desemba 2009, hizi ni baadhi ya nyenzo za mtandoni za kufuatilia mabadiliko ya Tabia Nchi.

eng: Using these tools, ordinary people can learn more about the effects, and help push decision makers to deal with solutions.
swa: Kwa kutumia vyenzo hizi, watu wa kawaida wanaweza kujifunza zaidi kuhusu athari, na kusaidia kuwashinikiza wanaofanya maamuzi kushughulikia utatuzi.

eng: In the field
swa: Katika Viwanja Husika

eng: Tracking climate change impacts generally starts in the field.
swa: Kufuatilia athari za mabadiliko ya tabia nchi kwa ujumla huanzia kwenye viwanja husika.

eng: James Balog, a photographer, has been to Alaska, USA, to record time-lapse ice cap melting.
swa: James Balog, mpigapicha, amekuwa Alaska, Marekani, kurekodi muda unaotumiwa na barafu kuyeyuka.

eng: You can see the stunning results of his photography in this video:
swa: Unaweza kutazama matokeo mazuri ya upigaji picha wake katika video hii hapa:

eng: If you don't have expensive cameras and spare-time to journey to Alaska, another approach would be to read the experiences of people on the frontline.
swa: Kama huna kamera ghali na muda wa ziada kusafiri mapaka Alaska, namna nyingine unayoweza kuitumia ni kusoma uzoefu wa watu walio mstari wa mbele.

eng: On the Frontline of the Climate Change is a project cataloging first-hand stories on the impacts of climate change, in indigenous communities, on small islands, and other vulnerable communities.
swa: Mstari wa mbele kwenye Mabadiliko ya Tabia Nchi ni mradi unaokusanya habari mama kuhusu athari za tabia nchi, katika jamii za wazawa, kwenye visiwa vidogo, na jamii nyingine zenye hatari ya kuathirika.

eng: The forums contains numerous recent contributions by email, mostly from South Asia and Africa.
swa: Majukwaa hayo yana idadi kubwa ya michango ya hivi karibuni kwa njia ya barua pepe, nyingi zikitokea Asia kusini na Afrika.

eng: One contributor and consultant for African development, George Katunguka, writes from Uganda:
swa: Mchangiaji mmoja na Mshauri wa maendeleo ya Afrika, George Katunguka anaandika kutoka Uganda:

eng: The impact of climate change has not received much prominence in my country Uganda but such changes and its effects are painfully being felt.
swa: Athari za mabadiliko ya tabia nchi hazijapewa kipaumbele kinachostahili katika nchi yangu Uganda lakini mabadiliko hayo na athari zake zinahisiwa kwa uchungu.

eng: In 2025, Uganda is likely to experience water stress according to recent report on water resources.
swa: Mwaka 2025, Uganda inaweza kukabiliwa na ukosefu wa maji kwa mujibu wa taarifa za hivi karibuni kuhusu vyanzo vya maji.

eng: People are dying of starvation and hunger like the recent case in Teso Region, Eastern Uganda; there are changes in water ecosystems like the dwindling levels of Lake Victoria; unpredictable seasons, loss of soil fertility and loss of agricultural output and hence increased household poverty and its implications.
swa: Watu wanakufa kwa kukosa chakula na njaa kama ilivyokuwa hivi karibuni katika mkoa wa Teso, Mashariki ya Uganda; kuna mabadiliko katika mfumo wa wa maji kama kupungua kwa kina cha maji cha Ziwa Victoria ; majira yasiyotabirika, kupungua kwa rutuba ya udongo na kupotea kwa uzalishaji wa kilimo na hivyo kuongezeka kwa umasikini wa familia na madhara yake.

eng: What are we doing to avert this looming catastrophe?
swa: Tunafanya nini kubadilisha janga hili linaliotutishia?

eng: From outer space to Google Earth
swa: Kutoka anga la mbali mpaka Google Earth

eng: Observation from the field can be double-checked from high ground.
swa: Uchunguzi kutoka kwenye konde unaweza kuangaliwa mara mbili kutoka kwenye uwanda wa juu.

eng: Space is the lookout from which to observe and analyze earth as a whole.
swa: Anga za mbali ni mahali ambapo kutokea hapo tunaweza kuichunguza na kuiainisha dunia kwa ujumla.

eng: It's difficult to get a seat on a spaceship, but fortunately, it's easy to find online satellite images from above.
swa: Ni vigumu kupata kiti katika vyombo vinavyovinjari anga za mbali, lakini kwa bahati, ni rahisi kupata picha za setilaiti zinazopigwa kutoka juu angani.

eng: Satellite pictures of Aral Sea, Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan 1973/2004
swa: Picha za setilaiti za Bahari ya Aral, Kazakhstan na Uzbekistan 1973/2004

eng: Besides space agencies and companies offering their services to NGOs, scientists and common people, the United Nations Environment Programme created an online atlas indexing the changes occurring in different parts of the world through decades.
swa: Pamoja na mashirika na makapuni ya anga za juu kutoa huduma zao kwa asasi zisizokuwa za kiserikali, wanasayansi na watu wa kawaida, Mpango wa Mazingira wa Umoja wa Mataifa umetengeneza kitabu cha ramani cha mtandaoni kitakachokuwa na faharasa ya mabadiliko yanayotokea kwenye maeneno mbalimbali ulimwenguni kwa miongo mingi.

eng: All the satellite pictures can be viewed on Google Earth's virtual globe, as their official blog reports:
swa: Picha zote za setilaiti zinaweza kuangaliwa kwenye tufe yakini ya Google Earth, kama blogu yao rasmi inavyotaarifu:

eng: In collaboration with the Danish government and others, we are launching a series of Google Earth layers and tours to allow you to explore the potential impacts of climate change on our planet and the solutions for managing it.
swa: Kwa ushirikiano na serikali ya Denmark na nyingine, tunazindua mfululizo wa tabaka na ziara ili kukusaidia kuvinjari athari zinazoweza kuipata sayari yetu na ufumbuzi wa namna ya kuzidhibiti athari hizo.

eng: Many more resources can be found on blogs and websites of international organisations.
swa: Rasilimali nyingine zaidi zinaweza kupatikana kwenye blogu na tovuti za mashirika ya kimataifa.

eng: Readers, feel free to add your own sources in the comment section.
swa: Wasomaji, jisikieni huru kuongeza rasilimali zenu kwenye sehemu ya maoni.

eng: Science for decision makers
swa: Sayansi kwa wanaofanya maamuzi

eng: Observation is a core issue for decision makers.
swa: Uchunguzi ni suala mtambuka kwa wafanya maamuzi.

eng: Governments initiate surveys to understand the phenomenon and how to mitigate the impacts.
swa: Serikali zinaanzisha tafiti ili kuelewa hali hii na jinsi ya kupunguza athari.

eng: The European Commission and European Space Agency initiated a space program in 1998, called the Global Monitoring Environmental Security (GMES), to sketch real-time changes from multi-source data.
swa: Tume ya Ulaya na Shirika la Anga za Mbali la Ulaya zilianzisha mpango mwaka 1998 ulioitwa Uchunguzi wa Ulinzi na Mazingira wa Dunia (GMES), ili kuchora michoro inayoonesha mabadiliko halisi yanayotokea kwa kutumia takwimu zinazotoka mahali mbalimbali.

eng: The project is due to report back in 2014, with an annexed security segment.
swa: Mradi unatarijiwa kutoa taarifa mwaka 2014, pamoja sehemu ya usalama.

eng: Developing countries impacted most directly by climate change, have taken a similar steps like the recent satellites launch by India to study climate change.
swa: Nchi zinzoendelea zilizoathiriwa moja kwa moja na mabadiliko ya tabia nchi, zimechukua hatua zinazofanana na hizo kama vile kuzinduliwa hivi karibuni kwa setilaiti ya India ili kujifunza mabadiliko ya tabia nchi.

eng: Such information can help countries plan for new environmental and economic policies.
swa: Taarifa kama hizo zinaweza kuzisaidia nchi kupanga sera mpya za mazingira na uchumi.

eng: In South Africa, a new economy-oriented tool has been created for exactly this purpose.
swa: Nchini Afrika Kusini, nyenzo mpya yenye mwelekeo wa kiuchumi imetengenezwa kwa kusudi hili hili.

eng: AllAfrica reports :
swa: AllAfrica inataarifu:

eng: Now, an analytical tool based on a study, Mapping South African Farming Sector Vulnerability to Climate Change and Variability, has been developed to help policy-planners identify the communities most vulnerable to climate change and help them prepare for radically different farming conditions.
swa: Sasa, nyenzo ainisho iliyotokana na utafiti, inayochora ramani ya uathirikaji wa sekta ya kilimo Afrika Kusini uliotokana na mabadiliko na kugeuka geuka kwa tabia nchi, imeundwa kuwasaidia watengeneza sera kutambua jamii ambazo zimo katika hatari ya kuathirika zaidi na mabadiliko ya tabia nchi na kuzisaidia kujiandaa kwa namna tofauti za ukulima.

eng: On the 31 December, the Gaza Freedom March is taking place to mark a year passing since Operation Cast Lead, the Israeli attack on Gaza.
swa: Tarehe 31 Desemba, Maandamano ya Uhuru Gaza yatafanyika kuadhimisha mwaka tangu Operesheni Tandaza Chuma, au Shaumbulio la Israeli mjini Gaza.

eng: The International Coalition to End the Illegal Siege of Gaza is mobilising an international contingent to march alongside the people of Gaza, in a non-violent show of solidarity and with the hope of ending the Gaza blockade.
swa: Muungano wa Kimataifa wa Kukomesha Vikwazo Haramu Vinavyoizingira Gaza unaandaa kikundi cha kimataifa kitakachoandamana bega kwa bega na watu wa Gaza, katika onyesho la amani la mshikamano ambalo lina matumaini ya kumaliza vikwazo huko Gaza.

eng: Many of the participants have already arrived in Cairo in preparation.
swa: Wengi wa waandamanaji wameshawasili mjini Cairo kwa ajili ya maandalizi.

eng: The Freedom March has the participation of many noteworthy people, including author Alice Walker, Syrian actor and director Duraid Lahham, Roger Waters of Pink Floyd, and French rap group MAP, amongst others.
swa: Maandamano ya Uhuru yanashirikisha watu wengi wenye uzito, pamoja na Alice Walker, muigizaji wa ki-Syria na mkurugenzi Duraid Lahlan, Roger Waters wa Pink Floyd, na kundi la muziki wa kufoka la Kifaransa MAP, kati yaw engine wengi.

eng: Amongst the participants is 84-year old Holocaust survivor Hedy Epstien.
swa: Mmoja wa washiriki ni muhanga wa Mauaji ya Wayahudi yaliyofanywa na ma-NAZI (Holocaust) Hedy Epstein.

eng: Hedy Epstein has been actively raising awareness about the march.
swa: Hedy Epstein amekuwa akielimisha na kuoneza utambuzi kuhusu maandamano hayo.

eng: On 01 Dec 2009, along with J’Ann Allen, the wife of a retired military officer and Sandra Mansour, a Palestinian refugee, she issued a public invitation to political activist, Nobel Laureate and Holocaust survivor Elie Wiesel to go to Gaza with them. Wiesel was urged to “Break Your Silence and Come With Us”, during a speech at St.Louis University:
swa: Mnamo Desemba 1, 2009, pamoja na J’Ann Allen, mke wa ofisa wa jeshi mstaafu na Sandra Mansour, mkimbizi wa Kipalestina, alitangaza hadharani mwalikowa kwenda Gaza kwa mwanaharakati wa siasa, Mshindi wa Tuzo ya Nobeli na muhanga wa mauaji ya halaiki ya Wayahudi Elie Wiesel.

eng: Hedy Epsteins participation in the March has been met with much appreciaton:
swa: Ushiriki wa Hedy Epstein katika maandamano umepokelewa kwa furaha:

eng: Desertpeace applauds her participation:
swa: Desertpeace anashangilia ushiriki wake:

eng: Seeing a survivor of those horrors struggle against today’s evils is truly an inspiration.
swa: Kumuona aliyenusurika katika matukio ya kutisha akipambana dhidi ya maovu ya leo kwa kweli ni jambo la kutia moyo.

eng: I am speaking of Hedy Epstein, who as I write this, is on her way to Gaza to take part in the Gaza Freedom March.
swa: Ninamuongelea Hedy Epstein, ambaye wakati ninaandika, yumo njiani kuelekea Gaza kushiriki katika Maandamano ya Uhuru Gaza.

eng: This is what the Holocaust should have ‘produced’ as an ‘industry’, an industry that does not allow a repetition of the past….
swa: Hiki ndicho mauaji ya Wayahudi yangetengeneza kama nyanja, nyanja ambayo hairuhu kurudiwa tena kwa yaliyopita….

eng: NEVER AGAIN!
swa: ISITOKEE TENA KAMWE!

eng: The organisation of the march has not, however, been without its hurdles, and organisers the International Coalition to End the Illegal Siege of Gaza, have not been beyond criticism.
swa: Maandalizi ya maandamano hayo hata hivyo, hayajatukia bila vikwazo, na waandalizi Muungano wa Kimataifa wa Kukomesha Vikwazo Haramu Vinavyoizingira Gaza, hawako mbali na kukosolewa.

eng: Norman Finkelstein, author of The Holocaust Industry and 'dreamer' of the march, was initially an active member of the coalition, but has since resigned.
swa: Norman Finkelstein, mwandishi wa The Holocaust Industry na ‘aliyeyaota’ maandamano mwanzoni alikuwa mwanachama hai wa wa muungano huo, lakini amejiuzulu.

eng: His frustration came from a much-debated change in the statement of the coalition.
swa: Kukarahika kwake kulitokana na tamko lililojadiliwa sana la muungano huo.

eng: The original statement of the coalition was to march to break the siege in accordance with the principle of non-violence and anchored in international law.
swa: Tamko la asili lilikuwa kuandamana ili kuvunja vikwazo vinavyoizingira Gaza kwa mujibu wa kanuni za amani zilizojikita katika sheria za kimataifa.

eng: The statement was later amended to include the ‘political context,’ which Finkelstein deemed divisive as it brought in potentially contentious issues unnecessary to the original appeal.
swa: Tamko hilo lilibadilishwa ili kujumuisha ‘muktadha wa siasa,’ ambao Finkelstein aliuona kuwa unaleta utengano kwani ulileta masuala tata yasiyo ya lazima kwa dhana ya asili ya maandamano.

eng: While he does not specify the exact amendments with which he objects, he comments in his address Why I resigned from the Gaza Freedom March coalition:
swa: Wakati hayaweki wazi mabadiliko ambayo anayapinga, anatoa maoni katika makala Kwa nini nilijiuzilu kutoka kwenye Muungano wa Maandamano ya Uhuru Gaza:

eng: It should perhaps be stressed that the point of dispute was not whether one personally supported a particular Palestinian right or strategy to end the occupation.
swa: Pengine inapaswa isisitizwe kuwa sehemu tuliyotengana haikuwa iwapo mtu binafsi aliunga mkono haki fulani ya Wapalestina au mkakati wa kukomesha kukaliwa kwa mabavu.

eng: It was whether inclusion in the coalition’s statement of a particular right or strategy was necessary if it was both unrelated to the immediate objective of breaking the siege and dimmed the prospect of a truly mass demonstration.
swa: Sehemu hiyo ilikuwa iwapo kulikuwa na ulazima wa kujumuishwa kwa haki fulani au mkakati hata kama havihusiani na lengo lililopo la kuvunja vikwazo na kupunguza matarajio ya maandamano ya kweli ya umma.

eng: His high-profile departure was accompanied by the withdrawal of a number of other active members.
swa: Kuondoka kwa mtu huyu mwenye sifa kubwa kulifuatiwa na kujitoa idadi ya wanachama hai wengine.

eng: Max at Jewbonics noted his departure from the movement with regret.
swa: Max kwenye Jewbonics alieleza kujitoa kwake kwenye wimbi hilo kwa masikitiko.

eng: As an organiser of the march he responded to fears that others would leave the movement, reporting:
swa: Kama muandalizi wa maandamano alitoa maoni kuhusu hofu kwamba wengine wangeliacha wimbi hilo, alitaarifu:

eng: I think it is safe to say that number lost will be dwarfed by the number gained, if what I've seen in-person and on-line has been any indication
swa: Nafikiri ni salama kusema kuwa idadi iliyopotea itaonekana ndogo kwa idadi itakayoonezeka, ikiwa nilichikiona binafsi na kwenye mtandao kinaashiria chochote

eng: Despite concerns over the numbers endorsing the march, this is indeed a mass demonstration, and is the first time that Palestinians will be coming together in such large numbers along with international support: there are an estimated 1,300 international participants participating, who will meet in Cairo and march alongside a predicated 50,000 local residents once they have crossed into Gaza through Rafah.
swa: Bila kujali wasiwasi juu ya idadi inayokubaliana na maandamano, haya kwa kweli ni maandamano ya halaiki, na itakuwa mara ya kwanza kwa Wapalestina kukusanyika pamoja kwa idadi kubwa pamoja na waunga mkono wa kimataifa: kuna takriban washiriki 1,300 wa kimataifa watakaoshiriki, ambao watakutana mjini Cairo na kuandamana bega kwa bega na wakazi wanaokadiriwa kufikia 50,000 pindi watakapoingia gaza kupitia Rafah.

eng: At the Electronic Intifada, Rami Almeghari reports that:
swa: Kwenye Electronic Intifada, Rami Almeghari anataarifu kuwa:

eng: In recent months, people in Gaza believe the international community began to direct its attention elsewhere, neglecting the siege of Gaza.
swa: Katika miezi ya karibuni, watu wa Gaza wanaamini kuwa jumuiya ya kimataifa imeanza kuelekeza macho yake sehemu nyingine, na kutotilia maanani vikwazo vinavyoizingira Gaza.

eng: Few international media outlets pay attention to the situation here.
swa: Vyombo vichache vya habari vya kimataifa vinatilia maanani hali ilivyo hapa.

eng: The march hopes to change this.
swa: Maandamano haya yanatarajia kubadili hali hiyo.

eng: Mustafa al-Kayali, coordinator of the steering committee for the Gaza Freedom March, reports:
swa: Mustafa al-Kayali, mratibu wa kamati ya maandalizi ya maandamano ya Uhuru Gaza, anataarifu:

eng: We call on the internationals who come here not to consider their visits as tourism.
swa: Tunawataka watu wa mataifa wanaokuja hapa kutochukulia ziara yao kama utalii.

eng: Rather, they should convey a real message from the ground to their peoples, organizations or governments...
swa: Badala yake, wafikishe ujumbe wa kweli kutoka hapa kwa watu wao, mashirika au serikali…

eng: Most of local youth with whom I talked over the Gaza Freedom March expressed excitement and enthusiasm for participation.
swa: Wengi wa vijana niliiongea nao juu ya Maandamano ya Uhuru Gaza walielezea msisimko na hamu ya kushiriki.

eng: They are keen to send a message to the outside world that the Palestinian people are there and that humans should be united for the sake of freedom.
swa: Wana hamu ya kutuma ujumbe kwa dunia ya nje kuwa wat wa Palestina wapo na kwamba binadamu wanapaswa waungane kwa ajili ya uhuru.

eng: More information about the Gaza Freedom March, its participants, mission, and on-going preparation, can be found here.
swa: Habari zaidi kuhusu Maandamano ya Uhuru Gaza, washiriki, madhumuni, na matayarisho yanayoendelea vinaweza kupatikana hapa.

eng: Sudanese Drima is the pseudonym for Global Voices' Malaysia-based Sudanese author.
swa: Sudanese Drima ni jina la bandia la mwandishi wa Kisudani wa Global Voices anayeishi nchini Malaysia.

eng: His deeply sarcastic blog The Sudanese Thinker has been featured by the BBC, USA Today, and Reuters.
swa: Blogu yake yenye kejeli The Sudanese Thinker imeandikwa na BBC, USA Today na Reuters.

eng: In this ten-minute interview we discuss how social media is affecting Islam, the Darfur conflict, and issues of Afro-Arab identity in South East Asia.
swa: Katika mahojiano haya ya dakika kumi tunajadili jinsi uanahabari wa kijamii unavyoathiri Uislamu, mgogoro wa dafur, na masuala ya nafsi ya Uafrika-Uarabu katika Asia ya Kusini Mashariki.

eng: Subscribe: iTunes | Android | RSS
swa: Podikasti: sikiliza katika dirisha jingine | Pakua

eng: Today, readers of leading Polish blogs might have been surprised to see a new welcome screen on one of their favourite websites: it announced that, beginning Dec.
swa: Wasomaji wa blogu zinayoongoza za lugha ya Kipolish ni lazima wameshangazwa kuona kivinjari skrini mpya ya ukaribisho kwenye moja ya tovuti zinazopendwa: Imetangaza kwamba, kuanzia Disemba 14, 2009, blogu hiyo haitapatikana bila ya malipo.

eng: 14, 2009, access to this blog was no longer free of charge.
swa: Utambulisho mpya umewapa wasomaji machaguo matatu:

eng: The new intro gave readers three options: 5 PLN + VAT for 7-day access (approx.
swa: 5 PLN + VAT kwa siku 7 (takriban EURO 1.25)

eng: 1.25 EUR) 9 PLN + VAT for full-month access (approx.
swa: 9 PLN + VAT kwa mwezi mzima (takriban EURO 2.1)

eng: 2.1 EUR) leave the website
swa: Ondoka kwenye tovuti

eng: The whole thing, which is one big surprise for Polish users, is almost solved after readers make up their minds and make their decision known by clicking on either of the three buttons.
swa: Jambo hili, ambalo ni limewashangaza watumiaji wa Kipolish, linaweza kutatuliwa baada ya wasomaji kuamua na kuonyesha uamuzi wao kwa kutobonyeza chochote kati ya vifungo au machaguo hayo matatu.

eng: A second screen appears then, thanking readers for... taking part in a special survey, and promising to post the results shortly.
swa: Skrini ya pili itajitokeza, na kuwashukuru wasomaji kwa… kuwa sehemu ya utafiti maalum, na kuahidi kutuma matokeo baada ya muda mfupi.

eng: Rumour is that interactive agency Autentika is behind this.
swa: Kuna uvumi kuwa kampuni ya Autentika iko nyuma ya kisa hiki.

eng: But many people decided to leave the website before making any click, which led to negative comments on Polish microblogging websites such as Blip.
swa: Hata hivyo watu wengi waliamua kuondoka kwenye tovuti kabla ya kubonyeza chochote, jambo ambalo limepelekea maoni hasi kwenye tovuti za blogu fupi fupi za Kipolish kama vile Blip.

eng: Despite the probable commercial aspect behind all of this, it's the first time when one institution managed to unite for action so many important and well-read bloggers (we have counted six of them).
swa: Pamoja na kipengele cha kibiashara nyuma ya jambo hili, nim ara ya kwanza kwa taasisi moja kuweza kuwaunganisha kwa ajili ya kutenda wanablogu wengi muhimu na wenye kusomwa sana (tumewahesabu sita miongoni mwao).

eng: Global Voices will monitor this interesting commercial/advertising case and publish the results of the survey, too, as soon as they appear.
swa: Global Voices itafuatilia kisa cha tangazo hili la biashara la namna yake na kuchapisha matokeo ya utafiti mara yatakapotolewa.

eng: The youth and adult groups also had a music workshop, here is a snippet of it:
swa: Makundi ya watu wazima na vijana pia yalikuwa na warsha za muziki, hiki ni kipande chake:

eng: In Singapore, raping your wife is not treated as rape.
swa: Nchini Singapore, kumbaka mke wako hakuchukuliwi kama tendo la kubaka.

eng: But it should be.
swa: Lakini inabidi lichukuliwe hivyo.

eng: This is the main message of the ‘No To Rape' campaign published in the Facebook page of the group.
swa: Huo ndio ujumbe mkuu wa kampeni ya “Kataa Ubakaji” ulichapishwa katika ukurasa wa Facebook wa kundi la wapiga kampeni.

eng: The organizers aim to abolish the marital rape immunity law in Singapore.
swa: Waandaalizi wana nia ya kukomesha sheria inayokinga ubakaji ndani ya ndoa nchini Singapore.

eng: The ‘No To Rape’ campaign advocates one simple idea: sexual violence by any person, against any person, is criminal violence.
swa: Kampeni ya “Kataa Ubakaji” inatetea dhana moja rahisi: uvamizi au vurugu za ngono zinazofanywa na mtu yeyote, dhidi ya mtu yeyote, ni kosa la jinai.

eng: Consequently, non-consensual sexual penetration, regardless of whether the victim and perpetrator are married to each other, should be treated as rape
swa: Kwa hiyo, uingiliaji kingono, bila kujali kama aliyetendwa au aliyetenda wameoana, kitendo hicho ni budi kichukuliwe kama ubakaji.

eng: The group has already gathered more than 3,000 signatures for the petition which will be delivered to the Prime Minister
swa: Kundi hilo limekwishakusanya zaidi ya saini 3000 kwa ajili ya kampeni ambazo zitawasilishwa kwa Waziri Mkuu.

eng: We would like to thank everyone who has given his or her support to the No To Rape petition to abolish marital rape immunity in Singapore.
swa: Tunapenda kuwashukuru kila mmoja aliyeunga mkono kampeni ya “Kataa Ubakaji” ili kukomesha kinga kwa tendo la ubakaji ndani ya ndoa nchini Singapore.

eng: Twenty minutes ago, our petition has officially come to a close with over 3,600 signatures.
swa: Dakika ishirini zilizopita, kampeni yetu imefikia kikomo ikiwa na zaidi ya saini 3,600.

eng: Over the next few days, we will be putting together the data collected before presenting it to our Prime Minister, Mr Lee Hsien Loong, by email and in hard copy.
swa: Katika siku chache zijazo, tutakuwa tunaziweka pamoja takwimu tulizokusanya kabla ya kuziwasilisha kwa Waziri Mkuu wetu, Bw. Lee Hsien Loong, kwa njia ya barua pepe na katika nakala ya kawaida.

eng: Barnyard Chorus observes that “Rape culture in Singapore is a phenomenon that has really caught us by surprise and disturbed us when it finally reared its unabashedly ugly, misogynistic andabhorrent head.”
swa: Barnyard Chorus anaona kuwa utamaduni wa ubakaji nchini Singapore ni jambo ambalo limetukamata kwa mshangao na kutusumbua wakati hatimaye lilipotokeza kichwa chake kisicho na haya, kinachochefua na chenye chuki dhidi ya wanawake.”

eng: Syinc is supportive of the ‘No to Rape’ campaign
swa: Syinc anaunga mkono kampeni ya “Kataa Ubakaji”.

eng: Let's just look at one facet of how maddeningly awful this is.
swa: Hebu na tuangalie uso mmoja wa jinsi jambo hili lilivyo baya.

eng: When a strange man rapes a stranger, it's highly unlikely that they'll ever have to face each otehr again.
swa: Wakati mtu asiyejulikana anapom’baka mtu mwingine asiyemjua, kuna uwezekano mkubwa kuwa hawataweza kuonana tena ana kwa ana.

eng: When a husband rapes a wife, they'll be seeing each other everyday.
swa: Pale mume anapom’baka mke wake, wataendelea wanaonana kila siku.

eng: In fact, the abuse is more than likely to keep going on.
swa: Kwa kweli, tendo hilo baya linawezekana sana kuendelea kutendwa.

eng: Perhaps, everyday.
swa: Pengine kila siku.

eng: When someone who promised to love and protect you through thick and thin commits such a horrific act - this leaves indelible scars deep within a person's psyche.
swa: Pale mtu aliyeahidi kukupenda na kukulinda katika hali ngumu na nyepesi anapofanya tendo baya namna hii – huacha makovu yasiyofutika ndani ya mawazo ya mtu.

eng: The Temasek Review explains why the cause involves everyone
swa: Jarida la The Temasek Review linafafanua kwa nini kampeni hii inamhusu kila mmoja.

eng: This campaign brings together women and men, the young and the old, people from different races, believers in various faiths and those of no faith at all.
swa: Kampeni hii imewaleta pamoja wanawake na wanaume, vijana na wazee, watu wa rangi tofauti, waumini wa imani mbalimbali na wale wasio na imani yoyote.

eng: Whatever your background, all of us have a shared interest in this.
swa: Bila kujali asili yako, sisi wote tuna maslahi katika hili.

eng: Everyone deserves the protection of the law from violence, no matter who commits it.
swa: Kila mmoja anastahili kinga ya sheria dhidi ya vurugu, bila kujali ni nani anyefanya vurugu hiyo.

eng: Rape is a beating, a form of abuse, that just happens to be carried out using a sexual organ instead of a fist.
swa: Ubakaji ni kupiga, namna ya uonevu, ambao unafanyika kwa kupitia kiungo cha ngono badala ya ngumi.

eng: The ‘No To Rape’ campaign has produced several ads urging Singaporeans to support the petition drive
swa: Kampeni ya “Kataa Ubakaji” imetengeneza matangazo kadhaa yanayowataka watu wa Singapore kuunga mkono zoezi la kutia saini

eng: Bu some netizens are not supportive of the campaign.
swa: Lakini raia wengine wa mtandaoni hawaiungi mkono kampeni hiyo.

eng: Toolang comments at The Online Citizen blog
swa: Toolang anatoa maoni kwenye blogu ya Raia wa kwenye Mtandao

eng: The poor response shows that if every couple supports the campaign to make marital rape into law, the Police would be kept very busy throughout the year and have no time to keep Singapore safe and secure from crimes and terrorism except to investigate what thousands of couple do every night on bed, to assess whether excessive force was used on the partner.
swa: Mwitiko dhaifu unaonyesha kuwa kama kila wanandoa wataiunga mkono kampeni na kufanya ubakaji ndani ya ndoa kuwa sheria, polisi watatingwa sana mwaka mzima na hawatakuwa na muda wa kuilinda Singapore salama dhidi ya jinai na ugaidi ila kuchunguza yale wanayofanya maelfu ya wanandoa kila usiku katika vitanda, kutathmini kama nguvu za ziada zilitumika dhidi ya mwanandoa mwenza.

eng: If excessive force was indeed used and tantamount to marital rape, the Police may take months to investigate.
swa: Na ikiwa nguvu za ziada zilitumika na kumaanisha ubakaji ndani ya ndoa, itawachukua polisi miezi kadhaa kuchunguza.

eng: In the meantime, the couple reconciles and settles another round of pleasure on bed to resolve the dispute and do not want to pursue further.
swa: Wakati huo huo, wanandoa hao wataafikiana na kuanza duru nyingine ya starehe kitandani ili kusuluhisha mgogoro na hawatataka kuendelea na kesi.

eng: All the Police efforts go down the drain.
swa: Juhudi zote za polishi zitapotea bure.

eng: I would suggest the researchers go down to the High and Family Courts and understand the family and domestic problems thoroughly first before embarking on this campaign.
swa: Ninawashauri watafiti waende mahakama kuu na mahakama ya familia na wafahamu fika matatizo ya familia na unyumba kwanza kabla ya kuanza kampeni hii.

eng: Btan believes the organizers failed to gather enough signatures because it lacks genuine public support
swa: Btan anaamini kuwa waandaaji walishindwa kukusanya saini za kutosha kwa sababu kampeni hiyo haiungwi mkono kwa dhati na umma

eng: Petitioners are still in denial.
swa: Waandaji wa kampeni ya kukusanya saini bado wamo kwenye hali ya kubisha.

eng: The lack of signature is not because of lack of publicity or drive but because most people know this petition is silly and nonsensical.
swa: Uksefu wa saini hautokani na kukosekana kwa utangazaji au msukumo bali kwa sababu watu wengi wanafahamu kuwa kampeni hii ni ujinga na haina maana.

eng: The petitioners insult the people, especially women, by assuming they cannot take care of themselves when they have the full weight of the law behind them.
swa: Wapiga kampeni ya kukusanya saini wanawatusi watu, hasa wanawake, kwa kuwa na dhana kwamba hawawezi kujiangalia wenyewe wakati wana uzito wote wa sheria nyuma yao.

eng: It is better they direct their energies to more worthy cause, like establishing a genuine two-party system in Singapore where our citizens are not whipped like slaves and foreigners entering en mass diluting our national spirit.
swa: Ni vyema wakielekeza nguvu zao kwenye masuala yanye uzito, kama vile kuanzisha mfumo wa vyama viwili vya kweli nchini Singapore ambapo wananchi hawatachapwa kama watumwa na ambapo wageni wanaingia kwa makundi makubwa na kupotosha moyo wa taifa.

eng: The house is burning and they are worrying about a bad hair day?
swa: Nyumba inaungua na wao wanahofia siku unayotoka bila kuchana nywele?

eng: Get your priorities right.
swa: Wekeni vipaumbele vyenu sawa.

eng: The ‘No To Rape” campaign also has a Twitter account.
swa: Kampeni ya “Kataa Ubakaji” pia ina akaunti ya Twita.

eng: Samak Sundaravej — former Bangkok Governor, cooking show host, and Thailand's 25th Prime Minister passed away last November 24.
swa: Samak Sundaravej — Gavana wa Zamani wa Bangkok, mwendeshaji wa kipindi cha mapishi, na Waziri Mkuu wa 25 wa Thailand amefariki dunia tarehe 24 Novemba.

eng: Samak was a controversial political figure who was legally removed from the top post last year when the Court ruled that he violated the law for hosting a cooking TV show while holding a public position.
swa: Samak alikuwa mwanasiasa aliyewachanganya wengi ambaye aliondolewa madarakani kisheria kutoka nafasi ya juu kabisa wakati Mahakama ilipoamua kuwa alivunja sheria ya kuendesha kipindi cha runinga cha mapishi wakati akiwa anashikilia nafasi ya umma.

eng: Bangkok Pundit highlights the obituaries published by major newspapers.
swa: Bangkok Pundit anapitia wasifu wake uliochapishwa na magazeti makubwa.

eng: Thaizer describes Samak as a keen chef who popularized Thai food:
swa: Thaizer anamwelezea Samak kama mpishi makini aliyekifanya chakula cha wa-Thai kuwa maarufu:

eng: A keen chef, Samak’s passion for Thai food made him a regular at the fresh food markets of Bangkok and his gruff, no-nonsense approach made him a popular host of a cookery show on Thai television.
swa: mpishi makini, shauku ya Samak kwa chakula cha kiThai ilimfanya awe maarufu kwenye masoko ya kuuza vyakula vya vibichi mjini Bangkok na ukali wake, na namna yake ya kuchukulia mambo isiyo na porojo ilimfanya awe mwongoza kipindi maarufu wa kipindi cha mapishi katika luninga za Thailand.

eng: Ironically, it was the television show which would eventually see him ousted from the position of prime minister.
swa: Katika namna ya kinyume, kilikuwa ni kipindi ambacho hatimaye kilimng’oa kwenye nafasi yake ya Uwaziri mkuu.

eng: Samak is fondly remembered as a true culinary enthusiast
swa: Samak anakumbukwa sana kama mhamasishaji wa mapishi wa kweli

eng: After his election victory the first thing he did was invite reporters from all over Thailand to his home to sample his homemade noodles.
swa: Baada ya ushindi wake kwenye uchaguzi jambo la kwanza alilolifanya lilikuwa ni kuwaalika waandishi wa habari nyumbani kwake kuonja tambi alizozitengeneza nyumbani.

eng: Samak is a true culinary enthusiast, and we think he'll be a great contributor to the reputation and enjoyment of delicious Thai food all over the world.
swa: Samak ni mhamasishaji wa kweli wa vyakula, na tunadhani atakuwa mchangiaji mkubwa kwa dunia nzima kwa uzoefu wake na kupenda kwake chakula cha Ki-Thai.

eng: A youtube video clip shows Samak’s well-attended funeral bathing rite:
swa: Sehemu ndogo ya video ya youtube inaonyesha mazishi ya Samak yaliyohudhuriwa na idadi kubwa ya watu:

eng: Bangkok twitterers react to the news of Samak’s death
swa: Wanatwita wa Bangakok wana maoni kadhaa juu ya habari za kifo cha Samak:

eng: zaz_zy: RIP Khun Samak the cooking world will miss u.
swa: zaz_zy: Pumzika kwa amani Khun Samak ulimwengu wa mapishi utakukosa.

eng: Truth Be Told ... That is absolutely right.
swa: Ukweli na usemwe…hiyo ni kweli tupu.

eng: TAN_Network: Red shirt supporters to protest against presence of Democrat MP's at Samak's funeral
swa: TAN_Network: waunga mkono wa mashati mekundu kuandamana kupinga kuwepo kwa Mbunge wa chama cha Democrat kwenye mazishi ya Samak

eng: Tongteng: @suthichai Although I aint like Khun Samak, I would say that I'm quite perplexed seeing many negative comments 'bout him online today.
swa: Tongteng: @suthichai Ingawa siko kama Khun Samak, ningesema kwamba ninashangazwa kuona maoni hasi mengi mtandaoni leo.

eng: RIP.
swa: Pumzika kwa amani.

eng: praditpi: Samak Sundaravej, 25th prime minister of Thailand, passed away today.
swa: praditpi: Samak Sundaravej, waziri mkuu wa 25 wa Thailand, amefariki leo.

eng: With all his goodness, I wish him rest in peace
swa: Pamoja na wema wake, namtakia mapumziko mema ya amani

eng: anirutpichedpan: Death of K Samak proves many people forget the good notion of 4giveness in its entirety!Only hate remains!Forget about conciliation,I say
swa: anirutpichedpan: Kifo cha K Samak kimethibitisha kuwa watu wengi husahau dhana njema ya kusameheana katika ukamilifu wake! Chuki tu hubaki!

eng: wisekwai: RIP Samak.
swa: Sahau kuhusu upatanishi, nasema

eng: Thai politics has lost a bit of color.
swa: wisekwai: Upumzike pema peponi Samak.

eng: ChadapornLin: it's sad upon Samak's death that I try to think of good things to remember him by out of courtesy but I just can't
swa: ChadapornLin: ni huzuni kwa kifo cha Samak kwamba najaribu kufikiri mambo mema ya kumkumbuka nayo kwa hisani lakini siwezi

eng: During a royally-sponsored funeral rite, the anti-government Red Shirts (most of them were Samak supporters) outside the temple booed government officials who attended the ritual.
swa: Wakati wa mazishi hayo yaliyodhaminiwa na familia ya Kifalme, wapinzani wa serikali wa Mashati ya Mekundu (wengi walikuwa wafuasi wa Samak) nje ya hekalu waliwazomea maafisa wa serikali waliohudhuria desturi hiyo.

eng: Samak had many critics.
swa: Samak alikuwa na wakosoaji wengi.

eng: After his death, some bloggers have chosen to highlight his negative legacy.
swa: Baada ya kifo chake, baadhi ya wanablogu wamechagua kutoa mabaya yake aliyoyaacha.

eng: Harrison George points out the anti-democratic record of Samak
swa: Harrison George anaitaja historia ya Samak katika kuipinga demokrasia

eng: Samak has established the right of all Thai political leaders to spend a career justifying murder, jailing opponents, shutting down the media and foul-mouthing anyone with the temerity to question them, and still be described, as his successor as PM Somchai described him, as ‘devoting his life to democracy’.
swa: Samak alianzisha haki ya watawala wote wa kisiasa wa Thailand kutumia nafasi zao za kikazi kuhalalisha mauaji, kuwatia nguvuni wapinzani wao, kuvifungia vyombo vya habari na kumchafua yeyote mwenye ujasiri wa kuwahoji, na bado akaelezewa, kama mrithi wake Mbunge Somchai aliyemwelezea kama “aliyeyatoa maisha yake kwa demokrasia”

eng: Bangkok Dazed describes Samak as a “creepy political character”
swa: Bangkok Dazed anamwelezea Samak kama “mwansiasa anayezusha hisia za msisimko unaoupata wadudu wakikutambaa”

eng: He may have been colorful but he was also a nasty character who embodied the worst traits of Thai politics.
swa: Anaweza kuwa alikuwa na rangi lakini alikuwa mhusika anayechefua aliyevaa sifa mbaya za siasa za Thailand.

eng: I only wish he would take a few hundred other current politicians to the grave with him.
swa: Ninatamani angewachukua wanasiasa wa sasa wengine mamia kadhaa ateremke nao kaburini.

eng: Political Prisoners in Thailand writes that Samak is a political dinosaur:
swa: Political Prisoners in Thailand anaandika kwamba Samak ni kiumbe aliyetoweka kwenye siasa:

eng: Samak was one of Thailand’s old guard who was able to stay on the scene and politically relevant because many basic features of Thai politics remained unchanged.
swa: Samak alikuwa mmoja wa walinzi wa kale wa Thailand ambaye aliweza kukaa jukwaani na kubaki na heshima yake kisiasa kwa sababu sura nyingi za msingi za siasa za Thailand zimebaki zilivyokuwa.

eng: In other words, because the political environment changed relatively slowly, the political dinosaurs have been able to adapt and even thrive
swa: Kwa maneno mengine, kwa sababu mazingira ya kisiasa yalibadilika kwa taratibu, kiumbe wa kisiasa wa kale ameweza kuendana nayo na hata kufanikiwa.

eng: Tunisian student Mohamed Soudani, 24, disappeared on October 22, 2009, in Tunisia after giving interviews to Radio Monte Carlo International and Radio France International.
swa: Mwanafunzi raia wa Tunisia, Mohamed Soudani, 24, alitoweka mnamo tarehe 22 Oktoba 2009 nchini humo baada ya kufanya mahojiano na Redio Monte Carlo International na Redio France International.

eng: Soudani was missing for 18 days until Tunisia’s police contacted his family inform them that he is detained in the Murnaguiya prison about 15km away from the capital Tunis.
swa: Soudani alikuwa ametoweka kwa muda wa siku 18 mpaka pale Polisi wa Tunisia walipowasiliana na familia yake kuwataarifu kwamba kijana huyo alikuwa ametupwa katika gereza la Murnaguiya, kiasi cha kilometa 15 kutoka katika mji mkuu wa Tunis.

eng: According to sources, the police also informed Soudani’s family that he was put on trial and convicted for “disorderly conduct” during his detention without legal counsel and was sentenced to four months in prison.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa vyanzo mbalimbali, polisi pia waliiarifu familia ya Soudani kwamba alikamatwa na kupelekwa mahakamani na kupatikana na hatia ya kosa la “kuwa na mwenendo mbaya” wakati wa kuwa kwake kizuini pasipo msaada wa mwanasheria na hivyo kuhukumiwa kifungo cha miezi minne gerezani.

eng: They also learned that he had since appealed his sentence.
swa: Familia yake pia walikuja kufahamu baadaye kwamba kijana huyo alikuwa amekata rufaa dhidi ya hukumu hiyo.

eng: During his court appearance on December 6, Soudani denied the charges filed against him and stated that he was tortured aggressively during his extrajudicial detention.
swa: Alipopelekwa mahakamani mnamo tarehe 6 Desemba, Soudani alikana mashtaka yaliyotolewa dhidi yake na kueleza kwamba aliteswa vibaya sana wakati alipokuwa ametupwa kizuizini kinyume cha sheria.

eng: His lawyers asked for a recess to study the case and his release on bail.
swa: Wanasheria wake waliomba muda wa kuipitia upya kesi yake na kutaka aachiwe kwa dhamana.

eng: The release request was denied while his trial was adjourned to December 14, 2009.
swa: Ombi hilo la kuachiwa kwa dhamana lilikataliwa na kesi kuahirishwa mpaka 14 Desemba 2009.

eng: Soudani was interviewed about his past activities as a student leader in the General Union of the Students of Tunisia.
swa: Soudani alihojiwa kuhusu shughuli zake wakati alipokuwa kiongozi wa wanafunzi katika Umoja Unaowaunganisha Wanafunzi wa Tunisia.

eng: He was involved last year in a 56-day hunger strike with another four students demanding their right to go back to school.
swa: Mwaka jana alishiriki katika mgomo wa kula uliodumu kwa muda wa siku 56 akiwa na wanafunzi wengine wanne wakidai haki ya kurejeshwa shuleni.

eng: They have also blogged about their hunger strike experience day by day on a blog which had been censored in Tunisia.
swa: Vijana hao pia wameandika makala mbalimbali kwenye blogu kuhusu mgomo wao wa kula wakieleza uzoefu wao wa siku hadi siku, na blogu hiyo imekuwa ikithibitiwa sana nchini Tunisia.

eng: A Facebook group and a blog have been created to support Mohamed Soudani in the hardships he is experiencing.
swa: Ukurasa wa Facebook na blogu vimezinduliwa ili kumuunga mkono Mohamed Soudani katika kipindi hiki kigumu anachokipitia.

eng: Nasser Weddady contributed to this post.
swa: Nasser Weddady amesaidia kuandika makala hii.

eng: Uganda's proposed Anti-Homosexuality Bill 2009 still awaits a final decision by the country's Parliament, but the country's Daily Monitor newspaper reported Wednesday that President Yoweri Museveni has "assured the US State Department of his willingness to block the Bill":
swa: Muswada Unaopinga Ushoga wa 2009 uliopendekezwa nchini Uganda bado unasubiri uamuzi wa mwisho utakaotolewa na bunge la nchi hiyo, lakini gazeti la Daily Monitor lilitaarifu Jumatano kuwa Rais Yoweri Museveni "ameihakikishia Idara ya Mambo ya Nje ya Marekani nia yake ya kuukwamisha muswada huo":

eng: President Museveni has reportedly assured American authorities that he will veto Ndorwa West MP David Bahati’s proposed anti-gay law, a position that breaks with his recent stance and the statements of officials in his government.
swa: Imetaarifiwa kuwa Rais Museveni amehakikishia mamlaka ya Marekani kuwa atapiga turufu muswada uliopendekezwa na mbuge wa Ndorwa David Bahati dhidi ya ushoga, msimamo ambao unavunja msimamo wake wa hivi karibuni na matamko ya maofisa walio katika serikali yake.

eng: Activists gathered outside the Ugandan Mission to the United Nations in New York City in November to protest the bill. Photo courtesy of riekhavoc on Flickr.
swa: Wanaharakati waliokusanyika nje ya ubalozi wa Uganda katika umoja wa Mataifa mjini New york mwezi Novemba ili kuupinga muswada.Picha kwa hisani ya riekhavoc riekhavoc kwenye Flickr

eng: Blogger Gay Uganda points out the contradictions in the Ugandan government's messages to the West and to Ugandans themselves:
swa: Mwanablogu Gay Uganda anaonyesha utata katika matamko ya serikali ya Uganda kwa nchi za Magharibi na kwa Waganda wenyewe:

eng: Government’s anti-gay stand stays, says minister
swa: Msimamo wa serikali dhidi ya ushoga bado unasimama, anasema waziri

eng: In a statement issued yesterday, Foreign Affairs Minister Sam Kutesa said the government does not support the promotion of homosexuality “just like we cannot promote prostitution.”
swa: Katika tamko lililotolewa jana, Waziri wa mambo ya Nje Sam Kutesa alisema serikali haiungi mkono utetezi wa ushoga “sawa tu na vile tusivyoweza kutetea biashara ya ngono.”

eng: AfroGay speculates that the Ugandan government believed it could get away with the bill because world leaders have other things on their minds:
swa: Mwanablogu AfroGay anadhani kuwa serikali ya Uganda iliamini kuwa ingeweza kupitisha muswada huo kwa kuwa viongozi wa dunia wana mambo mengine katika akili zao:

eng: As in 1999 when Museveni himself ordered that gays be arrested and jailed in what was clearly an ill-thought-out throwaway , MU7 thought that the Bahati bill would be a side issue in these times when Obama is engrossed with the Taliban, Gordon Brown is a lame duck and there is no one else taking Africa that seriously apart from the barracuda-like Chinese.
swa: Kama ilivyokuwa mwaka 1999 ambapo Museveni mwenyewe aliamuru kuwa mashoga wote wakamatwe na kufungwa jela katika kile ambacho ni wazi kilikuwa ni jambo lililowazwa hovyo , MU7 alifikiri kuwa muswada wa Bahati ungekuwa ni suala la pembeni katika nyakati hizi ambamo Obama amezama kwa Taliban, Gordon Brown ni bata mjinga na hakuna mwingine yeyote anayeitilia maananni Afrika zaidi Mchina anayefanana na samaki mla nyama.

eng: But the truth is that Obama and Europe are happy to take Uganda on because it is an easy target compared to, say, China.
swa: Lakini ukweli ni kwamba Obama na Ulaya watafurahi kuikabili Uganda kwa sababu ni shabaha rahisi ukilinganisha na, tuseme, China.

eng: Hillary Clinton said it the other day that you don't handle China the way you do a third world country and that was her way of indicating indirectly where exactly she puts Uganda in the pecking order.
swa: Hillary Clinton alisema siku ile kuwa hukabiliani na China kwa njia ambayo unakabiliana na nchi ya dunia tat una hiyo ilikuwa ndiyo njia yake ya kuashiria kwa mzunguko mahali ambapo aniweka Uganda katika orodha ya ukubwa (wa mataifa).

eng: In another post, AfroGay discusses what might be happening behind the scenes:
swa: Katika posti nyingine, AfroGay anajadili kile ambacho kinaweza kikawa kinatokea nyuma ya pazia:

eng: So, even if they are now being deliberately vague about it, the government has a view about the bill.
swa: Kwa hiyo, hata kama kwa makusudi hawawi wawazi hivi sasa, serikali ina mtazamo fulani juu ya muswada huu.

eng: And their view is that it is terrible for their international standing and funding.
swa: Na mtazamo wao nim baya kwa nafasi yao kimataifa na kiufadhili.

eng: The convulsions are not over yet.
swa: Mitetemo bado haijakwisha.

eng: Bahati has been emboldened by the attention he has received, and he is clearly reveling in his fifteen minutes of fame.
swa: Bahati amepanda kichwa kutokana na jinsi watu wengi walivyomtupia macho, na ni wazi kuwa bado anasherehekea dakika zake kumi na tano za umaarufu.

eng: So, he will likely not acquiesce easily.
swa: Hivyo basi, ianaelekea hatakubali kirahisi.

eng: But twist his arm the government is going to.
swa: Lakini serikali itampinda mkono wake.

eng: Look out for a new clinic in Bahati’s constituency, promises of this and that to the people of Ndorwa and he might even be promised direct funding of his campaign for reelection.
swa: Tazamia zahanati mpya kwenye jimbo la Bahati, na ahadi za hiki na kile kwa watu wa Ndorwa na naweza hata kuahidiwa ufadhili wa moja kwa moja kwa ajili ya kampeni yake ya kuchaguliwa tena.

eng: What Museveni wants in Uganda, Museveni gets and I predict that the bill will be a shadow of its former self by the time it reaches the floor of Parliament – if it ever gets there.
swa: Anachokitaka Museveni nchini Uganda, Museveni hukipata na ninatabiri kuwa muswada huu utakuwa kivuli cha nafsi yake ya zamani wakati utakapofika Bungeni – kama utafika.

eng: Russian authorities continue to investigate the crash of the train "Nevsky Express" that happened between Moscow and St. Petersburg on Friday night.
swa: Mamlaka nchini Urusi yanaendelea kuchunguza ajali ya treni la "Nevsky Express" ambayo ilitokea kati ya Moscow na St Petersburg usiku wa Ijumaa.

eng: According to officials, the tragedy that took lives of at least 25 passengers was a terrorist attack.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa maofisa, dhahama hiyo iliyochukua maisha ya angalau abiria 25 ilikuwa ni shambulio la kigaidi.

eng: The crash raised a number of questions.
swa: Ajali hiyo imezua maswali mengi.

eng: Many people ask what happened during the first hours after the crash and why it took so long to start reporting on it.
swa: Watu wengi wanauliza ni nini kilichotokea katika masaa ya mwanzo baada ya ajali na ni kwa nini ilichukua muda mrefu kuanza kutoa taarifa za ajali hiyo.

eng: Since the tragedy happened far from any major populated area, it took several hours for reporters to arrive on the spot.
swa: Kwa kuwa dhahama hiyo ilitokea mbali na maeneo yenye makazi ya watu, ilichukua muda mrefu kwa wanahabari kuwasili kwenye eneo la ajali.

eng: Only then the first photographs and videos started to appear everywhere.
swa: Na ndipo picha za kwanza na video zilipoanza kuonekana kila mahali.

eng: But what happened to social media platforms that actively reported on the plane crash in Perm in September 2008?
swa: Je nini kilichoyatokea majukwaa ya uanahabari wa kijamii ambayo yalitaarifu vilivyo kuhusu ajali ya ndege mjini Perm mwezi Septemba 2008.

eng: The only passenger who immediately reported about the crash of "Nevsky Express" was a Twitter user Lazy Frog.
swa: Abira pekee ambaye alitoa taarifa mara moja kuhusu ajali ya “Nevsky Express” alikuwa mtumiaji wa Twita Lazy Frog.

eng: She tweeted 12 times about the crash before she arrived home.
swa: Aliandika mara 12 kuhusu ajali hiyo kabla ya kuwasili nyumbani.

eng: Here is what she wrote:
swa: Haya ndio aliyoandika:

eng: I am alive.
swa: Nipo hai.

eng: But I should tell about it later.
swa: Lakini nitaeleza kuhusu (ajali) baadaye.

eng: If someone tells anything in news, please write me.
swa: Kama mtu ataeleza chochote kwenye habari, tafadhali niandikie.

eng: They don't tell us anything here.
swa: Hawatuambii kila kitu hapa.

eng: Later, many passengers from first cars - only last cars were derailed - said they were clueless for the whole hour after the crash.
swa: Baadaye, abiria wengi kutoka mabehewa ya kwanza – ni mabehewa ya mwisho ambayo yaliteguliwa kutoka kwenye reli –walisema kuwa kwa saa zima baada ya ajali hawakufahamu chochote.

eng: Lazy Frog posted few additional updates:
swa: Lazy frog alituma habari mpya za nyongeza:

eng: We boarded another train.
swa: Tumepanda treni jingine.

eng: I did whatever I could to help.
swa: Nilifanya kila nilichoweza.

eng: We are now at SAPSAN (new train that evacuated passengers to St. Petersburg - G.A.).
swa: Hivi sasa tupo SAPSAN (treni mpya ambyo iliwachukua abiria kwenda St. Petersburg – G.A).

eng: I wish it would go slower.
swa: Natamani ingekuwa inakwenda polepole.

eng: They announced now that specially trained people would meet us at the train station.
swa: Wametangaza sasa hivi kuwa watu walitayarishwa rasmi wangetulaki kwenye kituo cha treni.

eng: The day after the tragedy, Lazy Frog summarized her experience:
swa: Siku iliyofuata baada ya dhahama, Lazy Frog aliandika muhtasari wa uzoefu wake:

eng: I felt the first emotions about what happened when we got closer to Piter (St. Petersburg - G.A.).
swa: Nilizihisi hisia za kwanza kuhusu kilichotokea wakati tulipofika karibu na Piter (St. Petersburg G.A).

eng: I wasn't worried at the place of the crash.
swa: Sikuwa na wasiwasi nilipokuwa katika eneo la ajali.

eng: I was a little concerned about my shoes - it was so muddy around and sharp stones.
swa: Nilikuwa na hofu kidogo na viatu vyangu – kulikuwa na tope kila mahali na mawe yenye ncha.

eng: Saturday revealed more first-hand information when passengers started blogging about their experiences.
swa: Jumamosi habari nyingi zilijitokeza wakati abiria walipoanza kublogu kuhusu yaliyowakuta.

eng: The most popular blog post related to the topic was written by LJ user paltus_mk who was in one of the last cars heavily damaged by an explosion.
swa: Makala ya blogu maarufu zaidi inayohusiana na mada hii iliandikwa na mtumiaji wa LJ paltus_mk ambaye alikuwemo ndani ya mabehewa ya mwisho yaliharibiwa vibaya na mlipuko.

eng: He wrote :
swa: Aliandika :

eng: All that happens within 10 seconds when you understand what is about to occur.
swa: Yote yanatokea ndani ya sekunde 10 wakati unapofahamu ni nini kitakachotokea.

eng: I had enough time to prepare my body.
swa: Nilikuwa na muda wa kutosha kuutayarisha mwili wangu.

eng: But nothing can help against the Newton's laws when dozens of tons of metal suddenly stop at high speed - just luck ... ...therefore I was just lucky.
swa: Lakini hakuna linaloweza kusaidia dhidi ya kanuni za Newton wakati dazeni za tani za vyuma zinaposimama mara moja wakati zikiwa katika mwendo wa kasi – ni bahati tu… kwa hiyo nilikuwa na bahati tu.

eng: My brother was lucky, too, despite the fact that his wounds were more serious than mine.
swa: Kaka yangu alikuwa na bahati, pia, ukiachilia mbali ukweli kuwa majeraha yake yalikuwa yanatisha kuliko yangu.

eng: Everything from something that went wrong till the full stop took about 30 seconds.
swa: Kila kitu ambacho kilikwenda mrama hadi kusimama kabisa kulichukua kama sekunde 30 hivi.

eng: It was dark and silent.
swa: Ilikuwa giza na kimya.

eng: Then wounded people started to cry.
swa: Watu walioumia walianza kulia.

eng: I was on the floor, smashed by other bodies.
swa: Nilikuwa sakafuni, nimekandamizwa na miili mingine.

eng: I moved the bodies.
swa: Niliisogeza ile miili.

eng: I saw that I was covered with blood but it wasn't mine.
swa: Niliona kuwa nimelowana na damu lakini damu ile haikuwa yangu.

eng: I saw that I am ok and my hand\legs work.
swa: Niliona kuwa ni mzima na miguu yangu na mikono vuinafanya kazi.

eng: I had a bleeding wound in my head.
swa: Kichwani nilikuwa na jeraha linalovuja damu.

eng: I had to get up and waited for some time before men with less serious injuries cleaned the way out.
swa: Ilinibidi ninyanyuke na kusubiri kwa muda kiasi kabla ya watu wenye majeraha mado waliposafisha njia ya kutoka.

eng: Suffering was all around.
swa: Mateso yalikuwepo kila mahali.

eng: We were sitting at the end of the train car and all the bags flied toward us.
swa: Tulikuwa tumeketi mwishoni mwa behewa na mikoba yote ilipaa ikituelekea.

eng: A lot of wounded people around.
swa: Watu wengi waliojeruhiwa.

eng: Durng the first minutes after the crash, the car was just a buch of bodies, chairs and parts of the train that were equally distributed around.
swa: Katika dakika chahce baada ya ajali, behewa lilikuwa ni kama fungu la miili, viti na sehemu za treni ambazo zilikuwa zimesambaa sawia kila mahali.

eng: Paltus_mk tells the story of evacuation from the first minutes after the crash with many details but, at the same time, avoids description that may disturb readers.
swa: Paltus_mk anasimulia habari za uokoaji zenye maelezo ya kina kuanzia dakika za mwanzo baada ya ajali, lakini wakati huo huo anaepuka ufafanuzi ambao ungeweza kuwastua wasomaji.

eng: He writes that passengers started providing the first aid to each other heroically and without panic.
swa: Anaandika kuwa abiria walianza kupeana huduma ya kwanza kwa ushujaa bila kuogopa.

eng: He says it was impossible to count how many people died.
swa: Anasema haikuwezekana kuhesabu ni wagtu wangapi waliofariki.

eng: The rescuers arrived only an hour and a half after the crash.
swa: Waokoaji waliwasili saa moja na nusu baada ya ajali.

eng: Paltus_mk and his brother were finally evacuated to a local hospital and he later arrived to St. Petersburg.
swa: Paltus_mk na kaka yake hatimaye waliokolewa na kupelekwa kwenye hospitali jirani na baadaye aliwasili mjini St. Petersburg.

eng: Another survival story was published by a blogger pancakyes on another Russian blogging service Ya.ru . Her train car was not damaged by the explosion.
swa: Hadithi nyingine ya kunusurika ilichapishwa na mwanablogu pancakyes katika huduma nyingine ya kublogu ya Kirusi Ya.Ru. behewa lake halikuharibiwa na mlipuko.

eng: She published her first post at 22:11 - a half an hour after the crash - right from the place of the tragedy.
swa: Alichapisha makala yake ya kwanza saa 4:11 za usiku – nusu saa baada ya ajali – pale pale kwenye eneo la ajali.

eng: She wrote that the train stopped because of some accident, few cars were derailed and she would come home later than expected.
swa: Aliandika kuwa treni ilisimama kutokana na ajali ya namna fulani, mabehewa machache yaliteguliwa na kwamba angewasili nyumbani kwa uchelevu kuliko ilivyotarajiwa.

eng: Almost an hour later, she added that there were victims in the last two cars.
swa: Karibu saa zima baadaye, aliongeza kuwa kulikuwa na waathirika katika mabehewa mawili ya mwisho.

eng: On Saturday, pancakyes published the whole story of the crash as she witnessed it:
swa: Jumamosi, pancakyes alichapisha habari nzima kuhusu ajali kama alivyoshudia mwenyewe:

eng: We felt few shakes that were getting stronger and stronger.
swa: Tulihisi mitetemo michache ambayo ilikuwa ikiongezeka nguvu.

eng: Things started to fall down from the table.
swa: Vitu vilianza kuanguka kutoka mezani.

eng: It was not clear what happened.
swa: Haikuwa wazi ni nini kilichotokea.

eng: No announcements.
swa: Hapakuwa na matangazo.

eng: First, we were thinking that it wasn't serious.
swa: Kwanza tulidhani kuwa halikuwa jambo lenye uzito.

eng: Maybe someone stopped the train by accident.
swa: Pengine kuna mtu aliyesimamisha treni kwa makosa.

eng: But conductors with pale faces started running around collecting mattresses, tablecloths and water.
swa: Lakini makondakta wenye sura zenye hofu walianza kukimbia kila mahali wakikusanya magodoro, vitambaa vya mezani na maji.

eng: They asked us not to leave our seats unless we are doctors.
swa: Walitutaka tusiondoke kwenye viti vyetu isipokuwa kama ni madaktari.

eng: We heard some bad things from their radios.
swa: Tulisikia mambo mabaya kutoka kwenye redio zao.

eng: Some rumors started to go around.
swa: Uvumi ulianza kusambaa.

eng: We didn't believe that two cars were disconnected and they were so far.
swa: Hatukuamini kuwa mabehewa mawili yalikuwa yametengana na yalikuwa mbali sana.

eng: Later, we fund out that it was true.
swa: Baadaye tuligundua kuwa ilikuwa kweli.

eng: We went out and wanted to help. Went up untill the third car.
swa: Tulitoka nje na tulitaka kusaidia.

eng: We didn't want to be just gawkers and make a crowd without any opportunity to help.
swa: Tulikwenda mpaka behewa la tatu. hatukutaka kuwa waduwazi ambao wanaongeza wingi wa watu bila fursa yoyote ya kusaidia.

eng: We also didn't want to see what people who came from there told us.
swa: Pia hatukutaka kuona yale ambayo watu waliotoka huko walikwishatueleza.

eng: Immediately after the crash, social media platforms became the first place where Russian journalist were looking for information.
swa: Mara baada ya ajali, majukwaa ya uanahabari wa kijamii yalikuwa sehemu ya kwanza ambayo wanahabari wa Kirusi walikuwa wakitafuta habari.

eng: A reporter from a Russian news agency RIA-Novosty left a comment on the pancakyes' blog and asked her to call him immediately.
swa: Mwandishi kutoka Shirika la Habari la RIA-Novosty aliacha maoni kwenye blogu ya pancakyes na kumtaka mwanablogu huyo ampigie simu mara moja.

eng: Tatyana Landa (LJ user Elada) wrote on her blog about a friend who was on the train but survived.
swa: Tatyana Landa (mtumiaji wa LJ mwenye jina la Elada) aliandika kwenye blogu yake kuhusu rafiki aliyenusurika ambaye alikuwemo kwenye treni.

eng: Two reporters immediately left comments asking her to contact them.
swa: Mara moja wanahabari wawili waliacha maoni ya kumtaka awasiliane nao.

eng: Tatyana later published an angry post where she told that a journalist from "Komsomolskaya pravda" (Russian tabloid newspaper) was trying to call her several times during that night.
swa: Baadaye Tatyana alichapisha makala ya hasira ambamo alisema kuwa mwanahabari kutoka “Komsomolskaya pravda” (gazeti la udaku la Kirusi) alikuwa akijaribu kumpata kwa simu mara kadhaa usiku huo.

eng: The post turned to a place were people started to discuss if journalists can use bloggers as sources of information about the train crash.
swa: Makala hiyo iligeukia mahali ambapo watu walianza kujadili kama wanahabari wanaweza kuwatumia wanablogu kama chanzo cha taarifa zinazohusu hii ajali ya treni.

eng: Reporters also tried to contact a blogger who wrote that she had decided not to take the "Nevsky Express" at the last minute.
swa: Wanahabari pia walijaribu kuwasiliana na mwanablogu ambaye aliandika kuwa aliamua kutopanda treni la “Nevsky Express” katika dakika ya mwisho.

eng: Some bloggers expressed their frustration with the fact that so few people from the train used social media to report about what was happening. And, apparently, there are several explanations why social media didn't play major role in the coverage of the "Nevsky express" tragedy.
swa: Baadhi ya wanablogu walieza kughafirika kwao na ukweli kuwa ni watu wachache mno kutoka kwenye treni walitumia vyombo vya habari vya kijamii kutoa taarifa za kile kilichokuwa kinatokea., Na, inavyoonekana, kuna fafanuzi kadhaa zinazoelea ni kwa nini uanahabari wa kijamii haukuchukua nafasi kubwa katika upashaji wa habari za ajali ya “Nevsky express”.

eng: Twitter, the most convenient platform for live blogging, is relatively unpopular in Russia.
swa: Twita, jukwaa zuri la kublogu moja kwa moja, si maarufu nchini Urusi.

eng: According to twitRU , there are only 2,700 Twitter users who write in Russian language.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa twitRU , kuna watumiaji wa Twita 2,700 tu ambao wanaandika kwa lugha ya Kirusi.

eng: At the same time, popular Russian blogging platforms as Livejournal.com or ya.ru could have been used for live reporting but, as discussed above, there is only a couple of examples of this use.
swa: Wakati huo huo, majukwaa maarufu ya kublogu nchini Urusi kama vile Livejournal.com au ya.ru yangeweza kutumika ili kublogu moja kwa moja lakini, kama ilivyojadiliwa hapo juu, kuna mifano michache tu ya matumizi hayo.

eng: The second explanation is related to the role of mobile devices and connectivity.
swa: Ufafanuzi wa pili unahusiana na nafasi ya zana za mkononi na uunganishaji.

eng: The number of portable devices in the country is growing.
swa: Zana za mkononi zinaongezeka nchini.

eng: More and more Russians can use Internet and various Web-applications on the go.
swa: Warusi zaidi na zaidi wanaweza kutumia mtandao wa intaneti na zana nyingine za mtandaoni.

eng: This trend is especially strong in the area of Moscow and St. Petersburg.
swa: Tabia hii ina nguvu katika maeneo ya Moscow na St. Petersburg.

eng: But the crash happened far from any metropolitan area where, as witnesses reported, the cell phone coverage was limited.
swa: Lakini ajali ilitokea mbali na maeneo ya mjini ambako, kama mashihidi walivyotaarifu, uwezo wa kupatikana kwa mawasiliano ya simu za mkononi ulikuwa mdogo.

eng: A blogger pancakyes recollects the connectivity problem:
swa: Mwanablogu pancakyes anasimulia tatizo la mawasiliano:

eng: The phone connection was very bad.
swa: Mawasilian ya simu yalikuwa mabaya sana.

eng: Everyone probably tried to make a call at the same time and the net was overloaded.
swa: Inawezekana kuwa kila mtu alijaribu kupiga simu kwa wakati mmoja na mtandao ulielemewa.

eng: I started to get SMSs only when I was on the second train (the one that took passengers to Saint-Petersburg - G.A.).
swa: Nilianza kupata jumba za maandishi pale tu nilipokuwa kwenye treni la pili (treni ambalo liliwachukua abiria kwenda Saint- Petersburg G.A.).

eng: I could use the Internet occasionally, but it was very difficult.
swa: Ningeliweza kutumia mtandao wa intaneti, lakini ilikuwa ni vigumu mno.

eng: In contrast, the plane crash in Perm last year provided many opportunities for citizen reporting:
swa: Hii ni tofauti, ajali ya ndege kule Perm mwaka jana ambayo ilitoa fursa nyingi kwa uanahabari wa kiraia:

eng: The plane crashed within the city borders where many people could see what happened right from their windows.
swa: Ndege ilianguka ndani ya mipaka ya mji ambako watu wengi waliweza kuona ni nini kilichokuwa kinatokea kutokea madirishani.

eng: The "Nevsky express" crash, as noted earlier, happened the rural area. 2.
swa: Ajali ya “Nevsky express”, kama ilivyoelezwa awali, ilitokea sehemu za vijijini.

eng: The social media coverage in Perm was based on the accounts of those who witnessed the crash but were not part of it (unfortunately, there were no survivors on the plane).
swa: 2.Habari zilizoandikwa kwa uanahabari wa kijamii kule Perm zilitokana na maelezo ya walioishuhudia ajali ambao hawakuwamo katika ajali (kwa bahati mbaya, hapakuwa na walionusurika kutoka katika ile ndege).

eng: All the witnesses of the "Nevsky Express" incident were passengers on the train.
swa: Mashahidi wote wa tukio la “Nevsky Express” walikuwa ni abiria katika treni.

eng: Most people posted their updates on the plane crash in Perm using their home computers.
swa: Watu wengi walituma habari mpya juu ya ajali ya ndege kule Perm kwa kutumia tarakilishi za nyumbani.

eng: The "Nevsky Express" survivors had to rely on their mobile devices.
swa: Walionusurika kwenye “Nevsky Express” walitegemea zana za mikononi.

eng: These differences explain why social media reporting was prevalent in the case of the plane crash and almost absent in the situation with "Nevsky Express."
swa: Tofauti hizi zinabainisha kwa nini vyombo vya habari vya kiraia vilikuwa mbele katika ajali ya ndege na vilikaribia kutokuwepo kwenye tukio la “Nevsky Express.”

eng: It is also possible to claim that Russia has not yet developed the tradition of social media reporting.
swa: Pia inawezekana kudai kuwa urusi bado haijaendeleza utamaduni wa utoaji taarifa kupitia uanahabari wa kiraia.

eng: That is why only two passengers were motivated enough to go online and assume the role of citizen reporters.
swa: Na ndiyo sababu abiria wawili tu walikuwa na msukumo wakutosha kwenda kwenye mtandao na kujipa kazi ya uanahabari wa kijamii.

eng: It may also explain the hostility of passengers and bloggers toward journalists who were looking for information on the crash in social media.
swa: Na pia inaweza kufafanua upinzani wa abiria na wanablogu kwa wanahabari ambao walikuwa wanatafuta taarifa za ajali kwenye vyombo vya habari vya kijamii.

eng: It looks like the Russian blogosphere is still far from being a major source for breaking news.
swa: Inaonekana kana kwamba ulimwengu wa blogu wa Kirusi bado uko mbali na kuwa chanzo kikuuu cha kutangaza habari mpya.

eng: It still remains as a place for distribution of information and broad discussions about what has happened.
swa: Bado unabaki kuwa sehemu ya usambazaji wa habari na mijadala mipana inayohusu nini kilichotokea.

eng: Russian photojournalist Oleg Klimov has recently spent two hours waiting for a train at the train station in Syzran, a city in Russia's Samara region.

eng: The OneMinutesJr project gives young people between 12 and 20 years of age from many corners of the globe the opportunity to express themselves, speak out and learn audiovisual skills to communicate across borders, languages and distances through 60 second videos.
swa: Mradi wa OneMinutesJr unawapa vijana wa umri wa kati ya miaka 12 na 20 kutoka kona mbalimbali za dunia fursa ya kujieleza, kusema na kujifunza ujuzi wa kutengeneza kazi za sauti-na-kuoangalia ili kuwasiliana zaidi ya mipaka yao, lugha zao na umbali zaidi kwa kutumia video ya sekunde 60.

eng: The OneMinutesJr project results from the joint effort of the European Cultural Foundation, the One Minutes Jr. Foundation and Unicef, as well as other partner organizations.
swa: Mradi wa OneMinuteJr umetokana na jitihada za pamoja za Mfuko wa Utamaduni wa Ulaya, Mfuko wa One Minutes Jr na Unicef, vile vile na mashirika mwenza mengineyo.

eng: These short videos portray the concerns, ideas and dreams of youngsters from many different backgrounds, and give us a window into their daily lives.

swa: Je, uchumi wa Zimbabwe unapiga kona kuelekea sehemu nzuri? anauliza mwanablogu wa Ghana, Abi.

eng: Miquel discusses Google's AdWords in Africa: "While it would be an excellent method for African bloggers to get a bit of money to cover their internet expenses, Google doesn't offer payment options for any country in Sub-Saharan Africa."
swa: Miquel anajadili matangazo ya Google AdWords katika Afrika: "Wakati ingelikuwa ni njia nzuri sana kwa wanablogu wa Kiafrika kupata pesa kidogo ili kulipia gharama za intaneti, Google haitoi chaguo la malipo kwa nchi yoyote ya Afrika Kusini mwa Jangwa la Sahara."

eng: Get live feed of the African Cup of Nations taking place in Angola: "For those who wish to watch African Cup of Nations 2010 online, there will be some sports online streaming sites which will provide live feed of the soccer games for free."
swa: Pata habari za Kombe la Mataifa ya Afrika yanayofanyika nchini Angola moja kwa moja: "Kwa wale ambao wangependa kuangalia Kombe la Mataifa ya Afrika 2010 kwenye mtandao, kutakuwa na tovuti za michezo zinazotoa mtiririko wa mapambano ya mpira moja kwa moja mtandaoni, bure."

eng: The murder of an Indian man in Melbourne has reignited the debate about racism in Australia and the safety of overseas students.
swa: Mauaji ya mtu mwenye asili ya India mjini Melbourne yamewasha tena mjadala kuhusu ubaguzi wa rangi nchini Australia na usalama wa wanafunzi kutoka ng’ambo.

eng: It has also severely strained relations between Australia and India:
swa: Kadhalika yameathiri uhusiano kati ya Australia na India:

eng: INDIAN diplomats are expected to meet their Australian counterparts for crisis talks in Canberra today following the murder of an Indian migrant in Melbourne.
swa: Wanadiplomasia wa Kihindi wanatarajiwa kukutana na wenzao wa Australia kwa ajili ya mazungumzo ya kutatua tatizo hili huko Canberra leo kufuatia kifo cha muhamiaji wa Kihindi mjini Melbourne.

eng: The murder of 21-year-old accounting graduate Nitin Garg in a Yarraville park on Saturday night was yesterday condemned by politicians in India and Australia.
swa: Mauaji ya kijana wa miaka 21 Nitin Garg, ambaye pia ana shahada ya Uhasibu katika bustani za Yarraville Jumamosi usiku yalishutumiwa vikali na wanasiasa nchini India na Australia.

eng: Diplomatic crisis erupts after Indian student's murder
swa: Matatizo ya kidiplomasia yazuka baada ya mauaji ya mwanafunzi wa Kihindi

eng: Australian bloggers’ responses show a very diverse range of views.
swa: Maoni ya wanablogu wa Australia yanaonyesha utofauti katika mitazamo.

eng: Gerard Henderson, Executive director of The Sydney Institute, speculates on the geopolitical undertones in an opinion piece for the Sydney Morning Herald :
swa: Gerard Henderson, Mkurugenzi Mtendaji wa The Sydney Institute, anabashiri matokeo ya chini-chini katika mahusiano ya kisiasa katika kanda hii kwenye makala ya maoni ya gazeti la Sydney Morning Herald :

eng: The tragedy happened to coincide with a distinct cooling in the relationship between the two nations over the past couple of years.
swa: Tukio hili la kusikitisha limetokea wakati kuna kupooza katika uhusiano kati ya mataifa haya mawili katika miaka michache iliyopita.

eng: During a visit to India in late 2008 I was surprised to hear strong criticism of Kevin Rudd at the highest levels of the New Delhi administration.
swa: Wakati wa ziara nchini India mwishoni mwa 2008 nilishangaa kusikia kukosolewa vikali kwa Kevin Rudd katika ngazi za juu za serikali ya New Delhi.

eng: India's prime gripe turned on the refusal of the Rudd Government's to sell uranium to India, which overturned the intention of John Howard and his senior ministers.
swa: Lalamiko kuu la India lilizungukia katika uamuzi wa serikali ya Rudd kukataa kuiuzia india madini ya Uranium, uamuzi ambao uliipindua nia ya John Howard pamoja na mawaziri wake.

eng: Student assaults teach some harsh lessons about racism
swa: Kupigwa kwa wanafunzi kwafundisha masomo makali kuhusu ubaguzi wa rangi

eng: Loon Pond, aka Dorothy Parker, takes Henderson to task:
swa: Loon Pond, anayejulikana pia kama Dorothy Parker, anamchachafya Henderson:

eng: Is it just me, or is it just grubbiness of an arcane kind to link the assault and murder of Indians in Australia to Australia's current policies in relation to the sale of uranium to India?
swa: Je ni mimi, au ni uchafuzi wa aina ya ajabu kuunganisha kupigwa na kuuwawa kwa Wahindi nchini Australia na sera za sasa kuhusiana na uuzaji wa madini ya Uranium kwa India?

eng: That's the convoluted tap dance performed by Gerard Henderson in Student assaults teach some harsh lessons about racism.
swa: Hiyo ni aina ya dansi ngumu ya kugongagonga kama inavyochezwa na Gerard Henderson katika makala ya Kupigwa kwa wanafunzi kwafundisha masomo makali kuhusu ubaguzi wa rangi.

eng: Gerard Henderson, India, uranium, street crime, and a particularly grubby column
swa: Gerard Henderson, India, uranium, uhalifu wa mitaani, na makala chafu

eng: Peter Maher blogs for Melbourne radio station 3AW. He is concerned that there is a culture of denial, whether or not the killing was racially motivated:
swa: Peter Maher anablogu kwa ajili ya redio stesheni ya Melbourne 3AW, anahofia kuwa kuna utamaduni wa kujidanganya au kupinga, ikiwa mauaji hayo yalisababishwa na ubaguzi wa rangi au la:

eng: How anyone can say it is not race related when they do not know the circumstances of the murder as I said earlier is difficult to comprehend.
swa: Kwa namna gani mtu yeyote anaweza kusema kuwa (mauaji haya) hayana uhusiano na ubaguzi wa rangi wakati hawayajui mazingira ya mauaji hayo na kama nilivyosema awali ni vigumu kuelewa.

eng: What I do know though is that this abusive, violent, murderous behaviour towards Indians in this country is far too prevalent to suggest that we do not have a problem with racism in this country.
swa: Jambo ninalofahamu hata hivyo ni kuwa tabia hii ya utesi, ya ghasia, na ya kiuaji kwa Wahindi katika nchi hii imekuwa ya kawaida mno kusema kuwa hatuna tatizo na ubaguzi wa rangi katika nchi hii.

eng: … We are so quick to brush these racist tendencies under the carpet and provide the world with this image of us as being non-discriminatory and all-inviting.
swa: … Tu wepesi sana kusukumiza tabia hizi za kibaguzi chini ya zulia na kuupa ulimwengu picha inayotuonyesha kama watu wasio na ubaguzi na wakarimu.

eng: I think it is time we took a real good look at ourselves and do something about the racism that exists in this country.
swa: Nafikiri muda umefika kwa sisi kujiangalia vyema katika nafsi zetu na kufanya kitu kuhusu ubaguzi wa rangi ambao upo katika nchi hii.

eng: Wake up Australia!
swa: Australia Amkeni!

eng: We are racist
swa: Sisi ni wabaguzi

eng: Dave, blogging as True Blue Aussie, has little doubt about the nature of any racism:
swa: Dave, anayeblogu kama True Blue Aussie, hana mashaka juu ya asili ya ubaguzi wowote wa rangi:

eng: Of course everyone in Melbourne is aware, that Footscray, which used to be an Australian suburb, is now full of Islamic Sudanese, Middle Eastern Arabs and Somalians.
swa: Naam kila mmoja katika Melbourne anafahamu, kuwa Footscray, ambacho kilikuwa ni kitongoji cha Australia, hivi sasa kimejaa Wasudani Waislamu, Waarabu wa Mashariki ya Kati na Wasomali.

eng: There is hardly an Australian to be seen in Footscray.
swa: Hakuna Waaustralia wanaoonekana Footscray.

eng: So, welcome to the divisive multicultural, ethnically diverse, immigration hell hole where immigrants (in this case likely be be muslims) attack other immigrants and Australians are blamed.
swa: Kwa hiyo, karibu katika shimo la kuzimu la tamaduni mbalimbali kuishi pamoja, utofauti wa makabila na uhamiaji ambapo wahamiaji (katika shauri hili inawezekana kabisa wakawa Waislamu) wanawashambulia wahamiaji wengine na Waaustralia ndio wanaolaumiwa.

eng: Dave Racist immigrants will be blamed for the fatal stabbing of an Indian man
swa: Dave Wahamiaji wabaguzi watalaumiwa kwa ajili ya Muhindi kuchomwa.

eng: A Facebook group, 1,000,000 True Aussies Against Racism, has a very different view of what it means to be an “Australian”.
swa: Kundi la Facebook, Waaustralia wa Kweli 1,000,000 Wanaopinga Ubaguzi wa Rangi, lina mtazamo tofauti kabisa juu ya maana ya kuwa “Mu-australia”

eng: Their aim is to: Stop the vocal minority who are using Facebook and talk back radio to make this wonderful country look like REDNECK nirvana.
swa: Kusitisha wale wachache wenye sauti kubwa ambao wanatumia Facebook na vipindi vya kupiga simu redioni kuifanya nchi hii nzuri kuonekana kama vile ahera ya WABAGUZI (wanaojulikana kama rednecks)

eng: Andrew Bartlett, former Democrats Senator and current Greens candidate for the next Federal election, wants more action from both State and Federal leaders.
swa: Andrew Bartlett, seneta wa zamani wa Chama Cha Democrats na mgombea wa Chama cha Greens katika uchaguzi ujao wa taifa, anataka vitendo zaidi kutoka kwa wote, viongozi wa majimbo na wale wa kitaifa.

eng: Writing for Asian Correspondent he argues:
swa: Akiandika kwa ajili ya Asian Correspondent anadai:

eng: While every crime should be treated on its merits, and we should not automatically assume this latest crime was racially motivated, the history of past attacks, and arguably the slowness of Australian authorities to take the issue sufficiently seriously, means that just a single serious incident such as this has the Hindustan Times reporting that, "Indian government officials 'will be forced' to issue a (travel) advisory in the form of a warning to those who want to work and study Down Under, if the (Australian) authorities there did not take stern action this time."
