swa: Wakati kila kosa linatakiwa kutendewa kutokana na ubora wa vigezo, na kwamba hatutakiwi kudhani kuwa kosa hili jipya zaidi la jinai lilisababishwa na ubaguzi wa rangi, historia ya mashambulizi mengine ya huko nyuma, na mwendo wa pole wa mamlaka za Australia katika kulichukulia suala hili kwa umakini unaofaa, vinamaanisha kuwa tukio moja tu lenye uzito kama hili kimelifanya gazeti la Hindustan Times kuripoti kuwa, maofisa wa serikali ya India ‘watalazimika’ kutoa maonyo (ya safari) katika mtindo wa kuwaonya wale ambao wanataka kufanya kazi au kusoma nchini Australia, ikiwa mamlaka ya Australia hayatachukua hatua kali wakati huu.

eng: It is the responsibility of government and community leaders to take effective steps to assure people that (a) the issue is being treated with maximum seriousness, and (b) everything reasonable is done to ensure peoples' safety.
swa: Ni wajibu wa serikali na viongozi wa jamii kuchukua hatua zenye ufanisi ili kuwahakikishia watu kuwa (a) suala hili linashughulikiwa kwa uzito wa hali juu, na (b) kila jambo linalowezekana linafanywa ili kuhakikisha usalama wa watu.

eng: When there is a plausible prospect that people are being targeted because of their race, it is essential that all is done to reduce the risks to them.
swa: Ikiwa kuna mashaka kuwa watu wanalengwa kutokana na rangi yao, ni muhimu kila kitu kifanywe ili kupunguza hatari kwa watu hao.

eng: Tragic murder puts spotlight back on safety of Indians in Australia
swa: Mauaji ya kusikitisha yarudisha mwangaza juu ya usalama wa Wahindi nchini Australia

eng: Meanwhile the safety of athletes and visitors at the 2010 Commonwealth Games in Delhi in October is an ongoing issue that could erupt at any time.
swa: Wakati huo huo usalama wa wanamichezo na wageni kwenye Michezo ya Jumuiya ya Madola mwezi Oktoba 2010 ni suala linaloendelea ambalo linaweza kulipuka wakati wowote.

eng: The Australian Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade has a High Degree of Caution as its current travel advice for India.
swa: Idara ya Mambo ya Nje na Biashara ya Australia ina Kiwango cha Juu cha Tahadhari katika ushauri wa safari kwenda India.

eng: Tit for tat coming up perhaps?
swa: Nipe nikupe pengine?

eng: UPDATE 6 January 2010
swa: HABARI MPYA JANUARI 6, 2010

eng: The Times of India reports that an advisory warning has been the result:
swa: Gazeti la The Times of India linaripoti kuwa onyo lile lilitokana na:

eng: Succumbing to popular outrage over continuing attacks on Indian students in Australia, the government on Tuesday issued an advisory warning students heading to Australia for studies and those already there.
swa: Baada ya kusalimu amri kutokana na hasira za walio wengi juu ya mashambulizi yanayoendelea dhidi ya wanafunzi wa Kihindi nchini Australia, siku ya Jumanne serikali ilitoa onyo la kuwaasa wanafunzi wanaoelekea Australia kwa masomo na kwa wale ambao wako huko tayari.

eng: The foreign ministry cautioned students that incidents of violence had started affecting the larger Indian community in Australia.
swa: Wizara ya Mambo ya Nje iliwatahadharisha wanafunzi kuwa vitendo vya vurugu vimeanza kuiathiri jamii kubwa zaidi ya Wahindi nchini Australia.

eng: The advisory came three days after accounting graduate Nitin Garg was knifed to death, the first fatality in the attacks.
swa: Wasia huo umekuja siku tatu baada ya mhitimu wa shahada ya uhasibu Nitin Garg kuchomwa kisu mpaka kufa, kifo cha kwanza katika mashambulizi hayo.

eng: It also came on a day when Indian and Australian officials met in Canberra to search for better ways to deal with the continuing violence even as the partially burnt body of another Indian was found.
swa: Pia wasia huo ulikuja katika siku ambayo maofisa wa Australia na India walipokutana huko Canberra ili kutafuta njia nzuri zaidi za kukabiliana na vitendo viovu - wakati huo huo ambapo mwili uliongua kiasi wa Mhindi mwingine ulipopatikana.

eng: Advisory asks students to be careful in Australia
swa: Onyo linawataka wanafunzi wawe waangalifu wanapokuwa Australia.

eng: As a result of the catastrophic 7.0 earthquake that hit the island country this evening (January 12), "Haiti" is currently a trending topic on Twitter.
swa: Kutokana na janga la tetemeko la ardhi lenye ukubwa wa 7.0 ambalo limeikumba Haiti jioni ya leo (Januari 12), “Haiti” ni mada kuu hivi sasa kwenye huduma ya Twita.

eng: Among the mass of retweets of mainstream media reports and tweets sending prayers and good wishes to the Caribbean island nation, have been eyewitness reports from musician and hotelier Richard Morse, who tweets as @RAMHaiti.
swa: Miongoni mwa lundo la jumbe zinazotumwa tena na tena za taarifa za habari kutoka za vyombo vya habari vikubwa na jumbe nyingine za twita zinazotuma sala au dua pamoja na salamu za heri kwa taifa hili la Karibea, pia kumekuwepo taarifa za mashahidi waliopo kwenye tukio kama vile mwanamuziki na mwendesha hoteli Richard Morse, ambaye anatwiti kwa jina la @RAMHaiti.

eng: Morse posted his initial tweet around 6:00pm Haiti time, reporting that:
swa: Morse alituma ujumbe huu wa kwanza wa twita kwenye majira ya saa 12 jioni kwa saa za Haiti, akiripoti kuwa:

eng: were ok at the oloffson ..internet is on !! no phones ! hope all are okay..alot of big building in PAP are down !
swa: Tuko salama hapa oloffson .. intaneti inapatikana!! Hakuna simu! Natumaini wote wako salama… majengo mengi makubwa hapa PAP yameporomoka!

eng: A series of tweets sent an hour later reported:
swa: Mfululizo wa jumbe za twita zilizotumwa saa moja baadaye ziliripoti:

eng: Just about all the lights are out in Port au Prince.. people still screaming but the noise is dying as darkness sets.
swa: Karibu kila taa imezimwa katrika mji wa Port au Prince… watu bado wanapiga mayowe lakini sauti zao zinafifia kadiri giza linavyotanda.

eng: lot's of rumors about which buildings were toppled..The Castel Haiti behind the Oloffson is a pile of rubble..it was 8 stories high
swa: kuna uvumi kuhusu majengo gani yaliyoanguka… jingo la Castel Haiti nyuma ya oloffson ni biwi la kifusi… lilikuwa jingo la ghorofa 8 kwenda juu

eng: Our guests are sitting out in the driveway.. no serious damage here at the Oloffson but many large buildings nearby have collapsed
swa: Wageni wetu wamekaa nje kwenye barabara ya gari… hakuna uharibifu mkubwa hapa Oloffson lakini majengo mengi makubwa yaliyo jirani yameanguka

eng: I'm told that parts of the Palace have collapsed..the UNIBANK here on Rue Capois has collapsed people are bringing people by on stretchers
swa: Nimeambiwa kuwa sehemu za kasri (ikulu) zimeanguka… UNIBANK hapa mtaa wa Capois imeporomoka watu wanawaleta watu kwa machela

eng: Port au Prince is dark except for a few fires
swa: Port au Prince iko kwenye giza isipokuwa kwa mioto michache

eng: A huge hospital that was being built across from the Oloffson has collapsed cars are starting to circulate..I see lights in the distance towards the wharf
swa: Hospitali kubwa iliyokuwa inajengwa mkabala na Oloffson imeporomoka magari yanaanza kuzunguka.. Ninaziona taa kwa mbali kuelekea dagoni

eng: Later, Morse re-tweeted @isabelleMORSE, who reported " much destruction on Grand Rue (Ave Dessalines) Daniel Morel's ok.
swa: Baadaye, Morse alituma tena ujumbe wa twita @isabelleMORSE, ambaye aliripoti “uharibifu mkubwa kwenye mtaa wa Grand (Ave Dessalines) Daniel Morel’s iko sawa, stesheni ya polisi, Downtown teleco, kanisa la Mtakatifu Anne yote yameangamia”.

eng: Police Sta, Cathedral, Downtown teleco, Church St Anne all destroyed".
swa: Mara baada ya saa 1 jioni kwa saa za Haiti, Morse aliandika kwamba:

eng: Just after 7:30pm Haiti time, Morse wrote that:
swa: Simu zinaanza kufanya kazi.

eng: Phones are starting to work..got a call from some one who's house fell in, child is hurt but ok. .A few people showing up @ Oloffson..roads are blocked by falling walls..much destruction on Grand Rue.
swa: Nimepokea simu kutoka kwa mtu ambaye nyumba yake iliporomoka, mtoto kaumia lakini salama. .Watu wachache wanaanza kujitokeza @Oloffson.. barabara hazipitiki kutokana na kuta zilizoanguka..maangamizi makubwa katika mtaa wa Grand.

eng: I hear hospital General has collapsed people are needing medical supplies..food, housing; I don't know water situation;
swa: Nasikia hospitali kuu imeporomoka watu wanahitaji madawa na vifaa vya matibabu, chakula, malazi; sijui kuhusu hali ya maji

eng: Then, around 7:45pm:
swa: Kisha, kwenye majira ya saa 1:45 jioni:

eng: another aftershock..people are screaming and freaking out down towards the stadium..much singing and praying in large numbers
swa: tetemeko jingine dogo.. watu wanapiga mayowe na kukimbia kuelekea uwanjani.. wanaimba na kusali sana katika makundi makubwa

eng: And at around 8:40pm Haiti time:
swa: Na kwenye majira ya saa 2:40 usiku kwa saa za Haiti:

eng: another aftershock..a little longer..much screaming downtown..this is going to be a long night
swa: tetemeko jingine dogo.. limechukua muda mrefu zaidi.. mayowe mengi mjini.. huu utakuwa usiku mrefu

eng: Also proliferating on Twitter are citizen photos of the destruction such as the ones below, reportedly sent to Twitter user @marvinady by journalist Carel Pedre of Haiti's Radio One.
swa: Pia zinazotawala katika Twita ni picha za maangamizi na uharibifu zilizopigwa na raia kama hizi hapa chini, inadaiwa kuwa zilitumwa kwa mtumiaji wa Twita @marvinady na mwanahabari Carel Padre wa Radio One Haiti.

eng: @LisandroSuero has also posted photos of the destruction, including the one below: Global Voices' Special Coverage Page on the earthquake in Haiti is here.
swa: @LisandroSuero pia ametuma picha za maangamizi, pamoja nah ii hapa chini:

eng: For many, the news that Bolivian President Evo Morales would name ex-Miss Bolivia Jessica Jordan, 25, as the Movement Towards Socialism (MAS) party candidate for governor of the Department of Bení seemed like a late Day of the Innocents (Bolivia's version of April Fools Day) joke.
swa: Kwa wengi, taarifa ya kuwa rais wa Bolivia Evo Morales angemtaja aliyekuwa mshindi wa urembo nchini Bolivia Jessica Jordan, 25 kuwa mgombea ugavana kwa tiketi ya Chama Cha Ujamaa (MAS) ilichukuliwa kama masihara ya Siku ya Wasio na Hatia ( ambayo ni sawa na Siku ya Wajinga Duniani nchini Bolivia).

eng: However, when the announcement became official in a live televised press conference, the reaction became immediate on Twitter, as well as the reaction to those reactions. After the dust settled, bloggers also began to provide their thoughts about the matter.
swa: Hata hivyo tangazo hilo liliporasimishwa katika mkutano na wanahabari uliotangazwa moja kwa moja kwenye televisheni, watu waliitikia mara moja kwenye twita, kadhalika yakaandikwa maoni kuhusu maoni yaliyotolewa.

eng: Photo of Jessica Jordan by Hugo Miranda and used with permission.
swa: Picha ya Jessica Jordan iliyopigwa na Hugo Miranda na kutumika kwa ruksa maalum

eng: Initial opinions on Twitter were ones of disbelief that a former beauty queen would be nominated to participate in the elections in such a high-ranking position.
swa: Maoni ya awali kwenye Twita yalikuwa ni ya kutoamini kwamba aliyekuwa mshindi wa urembo angependekezwa kushiriki uchaguzi katika ngazi ya juu namna hii.

eng: Diego Arrázola (@darrazola) wrote:
swa: Diego Arrazola (@darrazola) aliandika:

eng: Akmal Shaikh, a British citizen convicted of smuggling heroine into China, was executed on Tuesday although his families along with the British government had pleaded for reprieve, claiming that he is mentally ill.
swa: Akmal Shaikh, raia wa Uingereza aliyeshtakiwa kwa kuingiza mihadarati kinyume cha sheria nchini China, aliuwawa siku ya Jumanne japokuwa familia yake pamoja na serikali ya Uingereza waliomba adhabu ipunguzwe, wakidai kuwa alikuwa ni mgonjwa wa akili.

eng: The supreme court of China however dismissed the request of a mental assessment because the documents provided by the British embassy cannot prove that Akmal is mentally disordered.
swa: Mahakama Kuu ya China hata hivyo ilikataa ombi la kuangalia hali ya akili ya Akmal kwa sababu hati zilizotolewa na Ubalozi wa Uingereza hazikuweza kuhakikisha kuwa Akmal ana matatizo ya akili.

eng: After the inject of Akmal by lethal injection, the British government and some right organizations reacted fiercely.
swa: Baada ya Akmal kudungwa sindano ya sumu, serikali ya Uingereza na baadhi ya mashirika ya kupigania haki yalijibu vikali.

eng: British Prime Minister Gordon Brown condemned the execution and said he was ""particularly concerned that no mental health assessment was undertaken."
swa: Waziri Mkuu wa Uingereza Gordon Brown alishutumu mauaji hayo na kusema kuwa “anaguswa hasa na ukweli kuwa hakuna tathmini yoyote ya akili iliyofanywa.”

eng: Facing the critique, China expressed strong discontent.
swa: Ikikabilia na kukosolewa, China ilieleza vikali kutoridhika.

eng: The spokesman of foreign ministry said the accusation is groundless and warned that the intervention might damage the bilateral relations between the two countries.
swa: Msemaji wa wizara ya mambo ya nje alisema kuwa shutuma hizo hazina msingi na kuonya kuwa kuingiliwa kunaweza kuharibu mahusiano baina ya nchi hizo mbili.

eng: In China, drug trafficking is considered as a felony.
swa: Katika China, upitishaji wa madawa ya kulevya unachukuliwa kama kosa la jinai.

eng: Carrying or selling heroine of more than 50 grams will get death penalty according to the Chinese law, and over 4000 grams were found on Akmal.
swa: Adhabu ya kifo itatolewa kwa kubeba au kuuza mihadarati ya zaidi ya uzito wa gramu 50 kwa mujibu wa sheria za China, na alikutwa na zaidi ya gramu 4000.

eng: To many Chinese netizens, the incident reminded them of the 2 Opium Wars fought in 19 century that British troop invaded China because Chinese officials burned up the opium sold by British.
swa: Kwa raia wengi wa wavuti wa Kichina, tukio hili limewakumbusha Vita ya Pili ya Mihadarati iliyopiganwa katika karne ya 19 ambapo majeshi ya Uningereza yaliivamia China kwa sababu maofisa wa Kichina walichoma moto mihadarati iliyozwa kwa Uingereza.

eng: China lost the war and suffered from the "100 years of humiliation" since then.
swa: China ilishindwa vita na kuteseka kutokana na “miaka 100 ya aibu” tangu hapo.

eng: On 163.com, a major portal website in China, over 3000 people supported a comment left after the news piece, which writes:
swa: Katika 163.com, huduma ya tovuti kubwa nchini China, zaidi ya watu 3000 waliunga mkono maoni yaliyoachwa hapo baada kipande cha habari, kilichoandikwa:

eng: Following Google's announcement today that (don't snicker) if the Chinese government won't let the company's China operations stop censoring search results Google China will be shut down, netizens trekked to Google's Beijing office to lay flowers.
swa: Kufuatia tangazo la Google leo kuwa ikiwa serikali ya China haitaruhusu tawi lake la China kusitisha uzuiaji wa matokeo ya kutafuta tawi la Google nchini China litafungwa, wanamtandao walitembea mpaka kwenye ofisi za Google mjini Beijing ili kuweka maua.

eng: UPDATE: more photos here, formal flowering of Google China offices scheduled for later today.
swa: HABARI MPYA: picha zaidi hapa, uwekaji rasmi wa maua (ya rambirambi) kwenye ofisi za google umepangwa kufanyika baadaye leo.

eng: Bodyguards and Assassins is an action movie released during Christmas in China, Hong Kong and Taiwan.
swa: Bodyguards and Assassins (Walinzi na Wauaji) ni filamu ya kuchangamsha iliyotolewa wakati wa Krismasi huko China, Hong Kong na Taiwan.

eng: As a patriotic film, it was originally set to release in October for celebrating the 60th year anniversary of PRC but deferred until the end of 2009.
swa: Ikiwa ni filamu ya kizalendo, awali ilipangwa kutolewa mwezi Oktoba ili kusherehekea maadhimisho ya miaka 60 ya Jamhuri ya Watu wa China lakini ikacheleshwa mpaka mwisho wa mwaka 2009.

eng: In contrast with the Founding of a Republic! which spotlights on national heroes, the movie features on a number of grassroots characters, who know nothing about revolution but choose to sacrifice their lives for their country.
swa: Tofauti na filamu ya Founding of a Republic! (Mwanzo wa Jamhuri ) ambayo inaonyesha mashujaa wa taifa, filamu hiyo inaonyesha waigizaji kadhaa kutoka chini, ambao hawafahamu kitu chochote kuhusu mapinduzi lakini wanajitolea maisha kwa ajili ya nchi yao.

eng: The story offers a diverse readings and interpretations on the Chinese history and politics.
swa: Simulizi hii inatoa masomo yenye utofauti na tafsiri kuhusu Historia ya China na siasa.

eng: The comment made by Sun Yat-sen, the father of the Republic of China, in the movie has been quoted widely on the Internet, it said:
swa: Maoni yaliyotolewa Na Sun Yat-sen, Baba WA Taifa la China katika filamu hiyo, inasemekana kuwa yamenukuliwa sana kwenye wavuti:

eng: What’s going on with Google?
swa: Ni nini kinachoendelea Google?

eng: Millions of Chinese netizens are wondering.
swa: Mamilioni ya wanamtandao wa China wanajiuliza.

eng: On Google China’s Blackboard, a Chinese-language blog run by Google.cn, a post titled ‘clear the air of rumors’ stated:
swa: Katika blogu ya lugha ya Kichina inayoendeshwa na Google.cn, Ubao wa Google nchini China, (Google China’s Blackboard), kuna makala yenye kichwa ‘safisha upepo wa uvumi’ inasema:

eng: My Camera by Marcin Wichary
swa: Kamera yangu na Marcin Wichary

eng: Through citizen videos, different Colombian organizations share their unique perspectives on crime, violence and armed conflict, where it's hard to tell apart the good guys from the bad.
swa: Kwa kupitia upigaji video wa kiraia, asasi tofauti nchini Colombia zinatoa mitazamo yao kuhusu uhalifu, unyama na migogoro inayohusisha matumizi ya silaha, ambayo ni vigumu kuwatofautisha watu wazuri kutoka kwa wabaya.

eng: Do you know of any other communities and organizations who are using video to tell stories not covered by mass media or to share different perspectives on the stories making the news?
swa: Je unafazifahamu jamii zozote na asasi ambazo zinatumia video kusimulia habari ambazo hazitangazwi na vyombo vya habari au kuelezea mitazamo tofauti katika habari zinazotangazwa sana?

eng: Please share them with us through the comments or write me a note!
swa: Tafadhali tushirikishe kwa kuandika katika kisanduku cha maoni au kwa kuniandikia barua fupi!

eng: http://www.flickr.com/photos/mwichary/ / CC BY 2.0
swa: http://www.flickr.com/photos/mwichary/ / CC BY 2.0

eng: According to Mohammed Hagos, democracy project in Eritrea has to start with the removal of the current regime: "The hurdle preventing the Eritrean people from having their say is the Issayas regime.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa Mohammed Hagos, mradi wa demokrasi katika Eritrea unapaswa uanze kwa kuuondoa madarakani utawala uliopo sasa: "Kikwazo kinachowazuia watu wa Eritrea kujieleza ni utawala wa Issayas.

eng: The path to democracy thus starts with removing the Issayas regime as quickly as possible..."
swa: Njia ya kuelekea demokrasia kwa hiyo inaanza na kuuondoa utawala wa Issayas haraka iwezekanavyo..."

eng: Berhanu Nega, one of the men sentenced to death by an Ethiopian court says he is not suprised by death penalty.
swa: Berhanu Nega, mmoja kati ya watu waliohukumiwa kifo na mahakama ya Ethiopia anasema hashangazwi na adhabu ya kifo.

eng: Perhaps the most buzzing topic in the Georgian social media scene was not politics, elections, sport, crisis, earthquakes or catastrophe.
swa: Pengine mada iliyotawala katika vyombo vya uanahabari wa kijamii vya Georgia haikuwa siasa, uchaguzi, matatizo, matetemeko ya ardhi au majanga.

eng: Instead, one of the most discussed topics was actually about a new television show, Ghame Shorenastan.
swa: Badala yake, mada iliyojadiliwa sana ilikuwa inahusu kipindi kipya cha televisheni, Ghame Shorenastan.

eng: Shown on Imedi TV, the title translates as Night with Shorena and covers topics about sex.
swa: Kinachoonyeshwa kwenye Imedi TV, jina la kipindi hicho linatafsirika kama Usiku pamoja na Shorena na kinaongelea mada zinazohusu tendo la ngono.

eng: As the first to do so, and with former Georgian Playboy Playmate Shorena Begashvili, the show received a lot of feedback online, both positive and negative.
swa: Kwa kuwa ni wa kwanza kufanya hivyo, na msichana wa zamani wa Ki-Georgia wa Playboy, Shorena Begashvili, kipindi hicho kilipokea marejeo mengi katika wavuti, yote yale yaliyo hasi nay ale yaliyokuwa chanya.

eng: NightGravity was certainly delighted.
swa: Mwanablogu NightGravity bila ya shaka alivutiwa.

eng: There was not a main topic, and it looked like a MTV program.
swa: Hakikuwa na mada kuu, na kilionekana kama programu ya MTV.

eng: During 45 minutes there was 20 minutes of advertisements and 20 minutes of MTV song videos :D last 5 minutes were "hello, goodbye, sex is not bad, sex is good" :D
swa: Katika dakika 45 kulikuwa na dakika 20 za matangazo na dakika 20 za video za nyimbo za MTV:D dakika 5 za mwisho zilikuwa “Haloo, kwa heri, ngono si kitu kibaya, tendo la ngono ni zuri” :D

eng: Lishtota even conducted an online poll asking "When will "night with Shorena" be cancelled?"
swa: Lishtota aliitisha kura ya kwenye mtandao akiuliza “Ni lini kipindi cha “Usiku pamoja na Shorena” kitafutwa?”

eng: Another blogger, Giorgi Benashvili was surprised that people did not react strongly against the show, especially as the authors and producers expected a scandal. "Today, in the year 2009, teaching sex via television is not relevant anymore - this is the conclusion which is reached because of the silence with which the programme was greeted and which was not expected by its authors or me.
swa: “Leo hii, katika mwaka wa 2009, kufundisha matendo ya ngono kupitia televisheni hakuna umuhimu tena – hili ni hitimisho ambalo limefikiwa kutokana na ukimya ambao ulikikaribisha kipindi na ambao haukutarajiwa nami au na waandishi wake.

eng: If the show was made in 2001, I can imagine the effect it would have, as opposed to that we have now."
swa: Kama kipindi hicho kingetengenezwa mwaka 2001, ninaweza kufikiria athari zake, tofauti na zile tulizoziona hivi sasa.”

eng: In fact, the lack of adverse reactions lead many to suppose that society, or at least that part of it online, was ready for such a show.
swa: Kwa kweli, kukosekana kwa maoni mabaya kunapelekea wengi kuamini kuwa jamii, au kwa uchache ile iliyo kwenye mtandao, ilikuwa tayari kwa ajili ya kipindi kama kile.

eng: Many posts on blogs and forums even complain that the show was not informative enough, as one comment complains.
swa: Makala nyingi kwenye blogu na majukwaa zinalalamika kuwa kipindi kile hakikuwa kinaelimisha vilvyo, kama ambavyo moja ya maoni linavyolalamika.

eng: Réseau Citadelle announces the launch of the Media Operations Center, an initiative from Reporters without Borders and Quebecor, aimed at facilitating the field work of local and foreign journalists in Haiti as well as establishing collaboration between the media and NGOs.
swa: Réseau Citadelle anatangaza kuzinduliwa kwa Kituo Cha Habari, mradi unaotoka kwa Wanahabari Wasio Na Mipaka pamoja na Quebecor, wenye lengo la kuwezesha kazi za wanahabari wa ndani na wa nje ambao wako nchini Haiti, na pia kuunda ubia kati ya Asasi Zisizo za Kiserikali na Vyombo vya Habari.

eng: So far the casualty reports from Haiti's earthquake have focused on the terrifying statistics, but very few names had been attached to those numbers.
swa: Mpaka sasa taarifa za majeruhi wanaotokana na tetemeko la ardhi lililoikumba Haiti zimejikita kwenye takwimu za kutisha, lakini ni majina machache tu ndiyo yameambatanishwa kwenye namba hizo.

eng: Unfortunately, today, popular Dominican blogger Guillermo Peña confirmed he lost his father, Guillermo Peña Sr., in the disaster.
swa: Kwa bahati mbaya, leo hii (14.01.10), mwanablogu maarufu wa kutoka Dominika, Guillermo Peña, alithibitisha kwamba amefiwa na baba yake aliyeitwa Guillermo Peña Sr. kutokana na janga hilo.

eng: The elder Peña was working in Port au Prince as an engineer with the Santo Domingo construction firm Mera, Muñoz & Fondeur.
swa: Baba mtu Peña alikuwa akifanya kazi katika mji wa Port au Prince kama mhandisi katika kampuni ya ujenzi ya Santo Domingo Mera, Muñoz & Fondeur.

eng: A coworker of Mr. Pena's also died.
swa: Mfanyakazi mwenzake na Mzee Pena pia alifariki.

eng: A third was injured but has been successfully evacuated to Plaza de la Salud hospital in Santo Domingo and is receiving treatment.
swa: Mfanyakazi mwingine wa tatu waliyekuwa naye amejeruhiwa vibaya lakini amekwishaokolewa na kupelekwa katika hospitali ya Plaza de Salud huko Santo Domingo kwa ajili ya matibabu.

eng: Many Dominican and Spanish-language bloggers have already expressed their condolences to Guillermo Peña, Jr., who is posting his thoughts via Twitter.
swa: Tayari wanablogu wengi wa Ki-Dominika na wale wanaozungumza Kihispania wamekwishatoa salamu zao za rambirambi kwa Guillermo Peña, Jr. ambaye naye anatuma fikra zake kupitia Twita.

eng: The DR is feeling the quake’s aftermath in other ways.
swa: Jamhuri ya Dominika inaonja adha ya baada ya tetemeko la ardhi kwa njia nyinginezo.

eng: Dominican blogger Jose Sille’ claims, also via Twitter, that CESFRONT, the Dominican border patrol, is beginning to encounter Haitians desperate to flee the country.
swa: Mwanablogu wa Ki-Dominika, Jose Sille, anaeleza, pia kupitia Twita, kwamba CESFRONT, kitengo cha kulinda mpaka wa Dominika, kimeanza kukabiliana na mmiminiko wa raia wa Haiti wanaojaribu kuikimbia nchi yao.

eng: EV:....She is fine.
swa: EV:….Mama yangu hajambo.

eng: She has no news about the rest of the family though...given that no transport is functioning everybody is on foot, so its really difficult to communicate.
swa: Hata hivyo hana taarifa za wanafamilia wengine...hasa ukizingatia kwamba hakuna mfumo wa usafiri unaofanya kazi, kila mmoja anatembea kwa miguu, kwa hiyo kuna taabu kweli ya kuwasiliana.

eng: Interviewer: And your mother, whereabouts on the island was she at the time?
swa: Mwandishi: Na mama yako alikuwa upande upi wa kisiwa hicho wakati wa tukio?

eng: EV: She was in Port-au Prince itself, the epicentre of the quake.
swa: EV: Alikuwa palepale jijini Port-au Prince, palepale kwenye kitovu cha tetemeko hilo.

eng: Interviewer: She told you what happened on the telephone?
swa: Mwandishi: Je, alikueleza yale yaliyotokea kwenye simu?

eng: EV: She told me what happened to her, we can't tell what it was like everywhere.
swa: EV: Alinieleza yale yaliyomkuta yeye, hatuwezi kujua sehemu nyingine mambo yalikuwaje.

eng: She was in a restaurant at the time the earthquake started, so there was a lot of panic.
swa: Yeye alikuwa kwenye mgahawa wakati tetemeko la ardhi lilipotokea, kwa hiyo kulikuwa na kuhamaki kwingi.

eng: Some people died in the restaurant itself, as it caved in.
swa: Baadhi ya watu walifia kwenye mgahawa huo baada ya kuporomokea ndani.

eng: She managed to get out.
swa: Yeye aliwahi kukimbilia nje.

eng: Since then...well, since then, people are in the streets...well, those who had not had injuries that were too serious in any case.
swa: Tangia hapo ... kwa kusema kweli, tangia hapo, watu wapo mitaani...wale walioshindwa walikuwa na majeraha mabaya sana kwa vyovyote vile.

eng: Interviewer: Are you worried?
swa: Mwandishi: Vipi, una hofu kuhusu usalama huko nyumbani?

eng: EV: For my mother- well, she is ok, everything is fine.
swa: EV: Kwa upande wa mama - kusema ukweli, yeye yuko salama, kila kitu ni shwari sasa.

eng: For the rest of the family... we just don't know at the moment, we haven't heard anything...we are waiting for news.
swa: Kwa wanafamilia wengine...kwa sasa hivi hatujui kitu, hatujasikia chochote...tunasubiri kupata habari.

eng: There have been victims, and many injured...
swa: Kumekuwa na wahanga, wengi wamejeruhiwa...

eng: Interviewer: And psychologically is your mother ok?
swa: Mwandishi: Kwa upande wa kisaikolojia, hali ya mama yako ikoje?

eng: EV: My goodness!
swa: EV: Mungu wangu!

eng: She has seen a lot in her life, but she is ok, she is alright.
swa: Kwa umri wake ameona mambo mengi, lakini yeye hajambo, hana tatizo.

eng: On the ground in Port au Prince, others are still collecting themselves.
swa: Huko jijini Port au Prince, wengine bado wanajaribu kujikusanya.

eng: Survivor Jean Francois Labadie posted his recollections of the disaster a few hours after midnight this morning:
swa: Bw Jean Francois Labadie, mmoja wa walionusurika alituma taarifa alizokusanya kuhusu janga hilo muda mfupi baada ya usiku wa manane leo hii alfajiri:

eng: 13/01/2010 00:25 First earthquake, umpteenth tremor
swa: 13/01/2010 00:25 Tetemeko la kwanza, mtikisiko wa kumi na nne

eng: 12:30 PM : We really need to wish it would be the last one... Seriously, never live twice...
swa: Saa 6:30 mchana : Kwa kweli tungetamani sana kama lingekuwa la mwisho ...Ama kwa hakika, huwezi kuishi mara mbili...

eng: Towards 4:45 PM, with our driver, we enter the parking lot of Karibean, Pétion-ville's big mart.
swa: Kuelekea saa 10:45 mchana, tukiwa na dereva wetu, tunaenda kuegesha gari katika eneo la Karibeani, Soko kubwa la Pétion-ville.

eng: As usual, the way in is slowed by the usual Delmas traffic.
swa: Kama kawaida, kasi inapunguzwa na msongamano wa kawaida wa Delmas.

eng: While driving up the entry, our Patrol began to dance.
swa: Tulipokuwa tunaliingiza gari mahali pa maegesho, gari letu linaanza kucheza.

eng: I was imagining three or four boys standing on the bumper wanting to swing the car.
swa: Niliona kama wavulana watatu au wanne wakiwa kwenye sehemu ya mbele ya gari wakilitingisha kwa nguvu.

eng: In front of us, the parking lot ground rocked like the waves at Wahoo Bay.
swa: Kwa mbele yetu, eneo la maegesho lilianza kucheza na kufanya mawimbi makubwa kama katika eneo la bahari la Wahoo.

eng: The Karibean building started to dance and in 3 seconds' time completely tumbled down.
swa: Jengo la Karibeani lilianza kucheza na katika muda wa sekunde tatu tu likaporomoka lote.

eng: A white cloud swept across the parking lot and you could see zombies whitened by dust appearing, in complete panic.
swa: Wingu jeupe liligubika eneo lote la maegesho na mtu ungeweza kuona mazimwi meupe yakiibuka kutoka kwenye vumbi, kila mmoja akiwa katika mhamaniko mkubwa.

eng: Once the dust has settled again - although the phrase is premature - the heap of concrete from the 4-storied building seems to leave no survivor.
swa: Mara vumbi limetulia tena - ingawa awamu hiyo bado ni mapema - yaelekea lundo la zege kutoka kwenye jengo la ghorofa 4 halikuacha mtu akiwa hai.

eng: Madness has taken over the passers-by trying to seek refuge in the Patrol while the security guards - including one seriously wounded - shut the gate behind us.
swa: Watu wameingiwa na ukichaa, wanajaribu kukimbilia sehemu ya Patroo huku walinzi - akiwemo mmoja aliyejeruhiwa vibaya - wakijaribu kufunga lango lililo nyuma yetu.

eng: The driver, having understood quicker than me what was the matter, is putting all his efforts into praying.
swa: Dereva ambaye alielewa mapema zaidi yangu kuhusu kilichokuwa kikitokea, anajitahidi kuomba dua kwa nguvu zake zote.

eng: He yells his incantations, his arms to the sky.
swa: Anapaaza sauti za kuomba kwake huku mikono ameinyanyua juu kuelekea mawinguni.

eng: Far from piercing my eardrums, he calms me down.
swa: Licha ya kunipigia kelele kali kwenye ngoma za masikio yangu, ananisaidia kupata utulivu.

eng: He is giving sense to this madness going on under our eyes.
swa: Anafanya mkanganyiko huu wa ajabu unaotokea mbele ya macho yetu uanze kueleweka.

eng: After five minutes of torpor, the few motorists able to drive back home force the guards to open the 15 ft high fence.
swa: Baada ya kitu kama dakika tano hivi za vurugu, waendesha magari wachache wanaweza kuendesha magari yao ili kurudi nyumbani baada ya kuwaamuru walinzi kufungua lango lenye urefu wa futi 15.

eng: The sight of Delmas looks distressing, astounding.
swa: Mwonekano wa eneo la Delmas ni wa kusikitisha, unaogofya.

eng: We will be driving for an hour between collapsed buildings, people running, weeping and yelling their faith in Jesus and calling him with arm signs, heads whitened by dust eying in disbelief, injured people, corpses or bits of them...Jean-Claude goes on energetically singing his faith during the whole trip.
swa: Tuliendelea kuendesha kwa muda wa saa moja tukipita katika majengo yaliyoporomoka, watu wakikimbia hovyo, wengine wakilia na kuliitia jina la Yesu, wengine wakimwita kwa ishara za mikono, vichwa vikiwa vimejaa vumbi jeupe, wakitazama huku na huko pasipo kuamini yaliyotokea, majeruhi, maiti au vipande vya miili ya watu...

eng: My atheism is being lulled by my colleague's religious enthusiasm.
swa: Jean-clause anaendelea kwa nguvu zake zote kuonyesha imani yake katika kipindi chote cha safari hiyo.

eng: The scenes unfold as in a movie seen a thousand times.
swa: Kutoamini kwangu Mungu kunafunikwa na imani ya mwenzangu iliyo motomoto.

eng: I even manage to keep down my anxiety not being able to get back to Jehanne by noticing that the one-storied buildings held out the tremors.
swa: Matukio yalitokea kama vile ni sinema ambayo mtu ameitazama hata mara elfu moja.

eng: I'll hug her before she understands how big the disaster is, as things were better in her part of town.
swa: Ninafaulu hata kuimiliki hali yangu ya kuwa na wasiwasi hasa baada ya kushindwa kufika kwa Jehanne baada ya kuona kwamba jengo fulani la ghorofa moja lilionesha mitikisiko.

eng: We get ready for our first night fearing the tremors which filled our evening.
swa: Nitamkumbatia kabla hajaelewa juu ya ukubwa wa janga, maana hali ilikuwa tofauti katika mji anakoishi.

eng: Our landlord-architect has our complete trust.
swa: Tunamwaminia kabisa fundi sanifu mwenye nyumba wetu.

eng: Till later.
swa: Mpaka baadaye.

eng: As of this afternoon, the first aid flights are reported to have landed at Haiti’s main airport. Global Voices' Special Coverage Page on the earthquake in Haiti is here.
swa: Mpaka kufika mchana huu ndege zenye kuleta misaada zimeripotiwa kuwa tayari zimekiwishafika katika uwanja mkubwa wa ndege wa Haiti.

eng: Rocio Diaz reported from Santo Domingo.
swa: Rocio Diaz aliripoti kutoka Santo Domingo.

eng: French translations by Suzanne Lehn and Katharine Ganly.
swa: Tafsiri za Kifaransa zimefanywa na Suzanne Lehn na Katharine Ganly.

eng: The first blog posts written in French about the earthquake in Haiti have come from outside the country, announcing terrible news of the Presidential Palace , a hospital and other buildings collapsing and also of the threat of a tsunami.
swa: Posti ya kwanza ya blogu iliyoandikwa kwa lugha ya Kifaransa kuhusu tetemeko la ardhi huko Haiti imetokea nje ya nchi hiyo, ikitangaza habari mbaya za kuanguka kwa Kasri ya Rais, hospitali na majengo mengine na pia tishio la tsunami.

eng: According to MetropoleHaiti, The USA have already proposed humanitarian assistance.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa MetropoleHaiti, Marekani tayari imekwishapendekeza misaada ya kibinadamu.

eng: Here are some maps that humanitarian aid responders are using to communicate the evolving situation in Haiti’s earthquake zone.
swa: Hizi hapa ni baadhi ya ramani ambazo wapokeaji misaada ya kibanadamu wanazitumia kuwasilisha hali inayobadilika kila wakati katika maeneo ya tetemeko la ardhi nchini Haiti.

eng: The Ushahidi Network has created a very detailed interactive map overlaying information on threats, people needing assistance, medical care, food and other aid availability by type.
swa: Mtandao wa Ushahidi umetengeneza ramani shirikishi inayotanda juu ya taarifa za vitisho, watu wanaohitaji misaada, huduma za matibabu, chakula pamoja na misaada mingine.

eng: The map is being updated as information is received via the Ushahidi network, Twitter and Web form.
swa: Ramani hiyo inaendelea kuwekwa habari mpya kadri habari zinavyopokewa kwa kupitia mtandao wa ushahidi, Twita na fomu zilizo kwenye wavuti.

eng: Ushahidi's Erik Hersman, in an email message, said the system was processing mostly web and Twitter communication in the first days after the quake, because cell networks were down in much of southern Haiti.
swa: Erk Hersman wa Ushahidi, alisema katika barua pepe kuwa mfumo wa usghahidi ulikuwa unashughulikia zaidi mawasiliano ya Twita na ya kwenye wavuti katika siku za kwanza za tetemeko, kwani mitandao ya simu za mkononi ilikuwa haipatikani katika sehemu kubwa ya kusini mwa Haiti.

eng: That's changing and cell service, which is more widely distributed, "is bringing in a lot more reports."
swa: Hali hiyo inabadilika na huduma ya simu za viganjani, ambayo imeenea katika sehemu nyingi zaidi, “inaleta taarifa nyingi zaidi.”

eng: Crisis Commons, a network of technology professionals that creates tools for humanitarian relief response, has announced that it has undertaken a similar project to map relief efforts and to generate a crisis-specific baseline map of Haiti’s capital, Port-au-Prince, for relief agencies to use as planning reference.
swa: Crisis Commons, mtandao wa wataalamu wa teknolojia ambo hutengeneza zana kwa ajili ya misaada ya dharura, imetangaza kuwa inaendesha mradi unaofanana ambao unaweka kwenye ramani jitihada zote za usambazaji misaada na kutengeneza ramani maalum ya janga inayoonyesha mahitaji ya mji mkuu wa Haiti, Port au Prince, ili kuyawezesha mashirika ya misaada kuitumia ramani hiyo kama nyenzo ya kufanyia mipango.

eng: The project has just begun.
swa: Mradi huo ndio kwanza umeanza.

eng: In New York City, the New York Public Library has a series of maps online showing camps where survivors are finding shelter.
swa: Mjini New York, Maktaba ya Mji wa New York una mfululizo wa ramani kwenye wavuti unaoonyesha kambi ambazo walionusurika wanahamia.

eng: A second set identifies damaged areas and buildings.
swa: Jozi ya pili inatambulisha maeneo na majengo yaliyoharibika.

eng: They are being edited and updated.
swa: Ramani hizo zinahaririwa na kuwekewa habari mpya.

eng: Most other imagery is not interactive, but arguably gives a broader overview of the situation.
swa: Taswira nyingine nyingi siyo shirikishi, lakini pengine zinatoa mtazamo mpana kuhusu hali ilivyo.

eng: This image from the Center for Satellite Based Crisis Information measures distances from the quake’s epicenter to where people lived in southern Haiti pre-quake.
swa: Taswira hii kutoka katika Kituo cha Setilaiti cha Habari Zinazohusu Majanga inapima umbali kutoka kwenye kitovu cha tetemeko hadi kwenye maeneo waliyokuwa wakii shi watu kablka ya tetemeko huko kusini mwa Haiti.

eng: It’s color-coded to reflect population density.
swa: Ramani hiyo inatofautishwa kwa rangi ili kuonyesha uwingi was watu katika maeneo hayo.

eng: According to the map, the Hatian state of Leogane, though it has not been identified by name in many news reports, was the quake’s epicenter, and contains several heavily-populated areas.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa ramani, na japokuwa halijatambulishwa rasmi kwa jina kwenye taarifa nyingi za habari , Jimbo la Leogane huko Haiti ndilo lilikuwa kitovu cha tetemeko, na lina sehemu kadhaa zinazokaliwa na watu wengi.

eng: Carrefour, a large suburb of Port-au-Prince, is on Leogane state's border.
swa: Carrefour, kitongoji kikubwa cha jiji la port au Prince, kipo kwenye mpaka na jimbo la Leogane.

eng: The city of Jacmel, on the coast, is also in Leogane and badly damaged.
swa: Mji wa Jacmel, kwenye mwambao, pia umo ndani ya jimbo la Leogane na umeharibiwa vibaya.

eng: As of late yesterday, broken roads and bridges were still cutting off the area, which is closer to the epicenter than Port au Prince is, from receiving aid.
swa: Mpaka kufikia jana, barabara na madaraja yaliyobomoka viliendelea kulitenga eneo hilo na shughuli za kupokea misaada, jiji ambalo lipo karibu zaidi na kitovu cha tetemeko kuliko lilipo jiji la Port au Prince.

eng: The US Geological Survey has put information into a very easy to read chart of cities by population, color-coded by the quake’s intensity.
swa: Utafiti wa miamba wa Marekani umeweka taarifa za miji kulingana na uwingi wa watu katika jedwali linalosomeka kirahisi kwa kutumia rangi zinazoonyesha ukubwa wa tetemeko.

eng: The result is a very fast way to understand just how many people were living in the places hit hardest by the disaster.
swa: Matokeo yake ni urahisi wa kuelewa ni idadi gani ya watu waliokuwa wakiishi katika maeneo yaliyoathiriwa zaidi na janga hili.

eng: USGS has also posted a map of the earthquake reports it has received by phone.
swa: USGS (Utafiti wa miamba wa Marekani) pia umeweka ramani ya taarifa za tetemeko ambazo imezipokea kwa njia ya simu.

eng: It shows perceptions from people phoning the USGS to tell them what they saw.
swa: Inaonyesha mitazamo ya watu waliopiga simu kwenye kituo hicho cha utafiti kueleza yale waliyoyaona.

eng: The NYTimes has created a three-dimensional map that is extremely useful for understanding where Port-au-Prince lies in relation to Haiti’s geology.
swa: Gazeti la NYTimes limetengeneza ramani ya pande tatu yenye ufanisi mkubwa katika kuelewa ni wapi mji wa Port au Prince ulipo kiuhusiano na miamba ya Haiti.

eng: It shows the city in a coastal plan at the foot of a range of mountains that complicate aid delivery.
swa: Inaonyesha mji huo katika pwani chini ya milima ambayo inakwaza usambazaji wa misaada.

eng: The Times' map also explains very clearly the location of several neighborhoods where medical aid and food distribution has begun, and shelter has become haltingly available.
swa: Ramani hiyo ya gazeti la Times pia inafafanua wazi kabisa maeneo ya vitongoji kadhaa ambapo usambazaji wa chakula na madawa umeanza, na ambapo makazi ya muda yameanza kutolewa.

eng: Direct satellite imagery is available here.
swa: Taswira za moja kwa moja za setilaiti zinapatikana hapa.

eng: Orbital images taken as recently as yesterday are being compared to images of Port-au-Prince and the environs before the quake, like this one.
swa: Taswira za mhimili zilizochukuliwa jana zinalinganishwa na taswira za jiji la Port au Prince na mazingira yake kabla ya tetemeko, kama vile hii hapa.

eng: The satellite view can determine damage and needs in areas that still do not have reliable communication.
swa: Muonekano wa picha za setilaiti unaweza kuthibitisha uharibifu na mahitaji katika maeneo ambayo bado hayana mawasiliano ya uhakika.

eng: In theory, night imagery should be able to tell us something similar about electricity, the availability of light, and perhaps fuel.
swa: Kwa nadharia, taswira za usiku zinaweza kutuambia mambo yanayofanana kuhusiana na upatikanaji wa umeme, taa, nap engine mafuta.

eng: But if those images are in use, they haven’t been made public yet.
swa: Hata hivyo, ikiwa taswira hizo zimeshaanza kutumika, mpka hivi sasa bado hazijawekwa hadharani.

eng: For more on the earthquake in Haiti, visit our Special Coverage page.
swa: Kwa habari za zaidi juu ya tetemeko la ardhi la Haiti, tembelea ukurasa wetu maalum kuhusu tetemeko hilo la ardhi.

eng: The thumbnail image used in this post, Day 15 - Small World, is by kylebaker, used under a Creative Commons license.
swa: Picha iliyotumika katika makala hii, Day 15 - Small World, imepigwa na kylebaker, na imetumika kwa idhini ya creative Commons.

eng: Visit kylebaker's flickr photostream.
swa: Tembelea mkondo wa picha wa kylebaker.

eng: As the horror of the earthquake in Haiti reverberates around the world, a number of intrepid locals, foreign reporters, and aid workers are tweeting from on the ground.
swa: Wakati habari za tetemeko la ardhi huko Haiti zikitoa mwangwi duniani kote, wakazi majasiri, wanahabari wan je, na wafanyakazi wa misaada wanaandika jumbe za twita kutokea katika eneo lililoathirika.

eng: Some are working to gather aid and funds, while others are simply trying to show the world what's happening in Haiti.
swa: Baadhi yao wanafanya kazi ya kukusanya misaada na fedha, wakati wengine wanajaribu tu kuionyesha dunia mambo yanavyooendelea nchini Haiti.

eng: Still others are reporting on incidents in specific locations, in the hopes of assuaging the concerns of loved ones abroad (as of yet, very little information on those injured and dead has been released online).
swa: Kadhalika wengine wanaripoti juu ya matukio katika maeneo fulani fulani, huku wakiwa na matumaini ya kuwaondoa hofu ndugu na wapenzi walio nje ya nchi (mpaka hivi sasa, ni taarifa chache mno zilizokwishatolewa kwenye wavuti kuhusu waliofariki na waliojeruhiwa).

eng: Earlier today, many people on the ground were tweeting about the chaos in Haiti at present. @fredodupoux said:
swa: Mapema leo, watu wengi walioko kwenye eneo la tukio walikuwa wakiandika jumbe za twita juu ya vurugu na ukosefu wa mipango inayoeleweka kunakoendelea hivi sasa. @fredodupoux anasema:

eng: fredodupoux is based in Haiti
swa: fredodupoux yupo nchini Haiti

eng: @bhatiap noted the lack of police presence:
swa: @bhatiap aliandika kuhusu kukosekana kwa uwepo wa polisi

eng: bhatiap noted the lack of police presence
swa: @bhatiap aliandika kuhusu kukosekana kwa uwepo wa polisi

eng: Boston-based @PIH_org (Partners in Health) is actively looking for doctors, specifically orthopedic surgeons, to send to Haiti:
swa: @PIH_org (Wabia katika Afya) ambao wako huko Boston wanajitahidi kuwatafuta madaktari, hasa madaktari wa mifupa, ili kuwapeleka Haiti.

eng: A Boston-based organization is seeking volunteer doctors
swa: Shirika lililoko huko Boston linatafuta madaktari

eng: Some Twitter users are reporting on specific buildings, streets, and other practical information for those looking for families or attempting to move throughout the country. @yatalley notes that the road from the capital, Port-au-Prince, to the town of Jacmel is impassable:
swa: Baadhi ya watumiaji wa Twita wanaripoti juu ya majengo, mitaa au taarifa nyingine za muhimu kwa wale wanaotafuta familia zao au wale wanaojaribu kusafiri ndani ya nchi hiyo. @yatalley anaandika kuwa barabara inayotoka mji mkuu, Port au Prince, kuelekea mji wa Jacmel haipitiki.

eng: Yael Talleyrand reports from Jacmel, Haiti
swa: Yael Talleyrand anaripoti kutokea Jacmel, Haiti

eng: @RAMHaiti noted the widespread destruction of places of worship.
swa: @RAMHaiti amebaini uharibifu nkubwa kwenye sehemu za kuabudu.

eng: Reporting on a specific Port au Prince church, he said:
swa: Anaripoti kuhusu kanisa moja la mjini Port au Prince, anasema:

eng: Richard Morse is tweeting from Port au Prince
swa: Richard Morse anaandika jumbe za twita kutokea Port au Prince

eng: @fredodupoux ventured into the district of Delmas outside of Port au Prince, an area which received the brunt of the damage.
swa: @fredodupoux aliweza kwenda kwenye wilaya ya Delmas nje kidogo ya mji wa Port au Prince, eneo ambalo lilipokea athari kwa kishindo.

eng: Frederic Dupoux noted massive destruction in Delmas, Haiti
swa: Frederic Dupoux alieleza uharibifu mkubwa uliotokea huko Delmas, Haiti

eng: As tweets keep pouring in, there are a number of ways to keep track. @georgiap has created a list of Twitter users on the ground in Haiti.
swa: Kadiri ambavyo jumbe za twita zinavyozidi kutiririka, kuna njia nyingi za kuweza kufuatilia. @georgiap ametengeneza orodha ya watumiaji wa Twita walioko sehemu ya tukio nchini Haiti.

eng: I have a separate list which also contains aid organizations and reporters on the ground.
swa: Ninayo orodha nyingine ambayo pia ina majina ya mashirika ya misaada na wanahabari walioko kwenye eneo la tukio.

eng: And keep checking GV's Haiti Special Coverage Page.
swa: Pia endelea kuangalia Ukurasa Maalum wa Haiti kwenye GV.

eng: Those of us outside of Haiti can only imagine the stark reality of daily life in the earthquake's aftermath - but amidst attempts to find loved ones, efforts to administer to the wounded and the overwhelming task of getting relief to those who most need it - bloggers in and around Port-au-Prince are finding the time to communicate with the outside world, which is desperate for news from those closest to the disaster.
swa: Sisi tulio nje ya Haiti tunaweza tu kujenga picha kichwani kuhusu hali halisi ya maisha ya kila siku yalivyo huko baada ya tetemeko baya la ardhi - lakini katikati ya juhudi za kuwatafuta wapendwa ndugu, juhudi za kuwahudumia waliojeruhiwa na jukumu zito na gumu la kuwafikishia msaada wa kiutu wale wanaouhitaji zaidi - wanablogu walio huko Port-au-Prince na maeneo ya jirani wanawasiliana na ulimwengu wa nje, ambao nao unahangaika kutaka kupata taarifa kutoka kwa wale waliokuwa katika eneo lenyewe kabisa la janga.

eng: The Livesay Weblog has been really committed to updating its posts, with Troy, the head of the family, tweeting regularly and posting images to his flickr photostream.
swa: Blogu-tovuti ya The Livesay imejitolea kwa moyo mmoja kutoa taarifa mpya za kila wakati kupitia makala zake, wakati ambapo Troy, mkuu wa kaya, akiandika kupitia Twita kila baada ya kitambo kifupi pamoja na kutuma picha kupitia kwenye mkondo wa picha wa flickr.

eng: Troy, an American doing missionary work in Haiti, does not hide his admiration for the tenacity of the Haitian people:
swa: Bwana Troy ambaye ni Mwamerika anayefanya kazi ya umisionari huko Haiti wala hafichi jinsi anavyohusudu umadhubuti wa watu wa Haiti:

eng: The amount of the current suffering caused by the earthquake cannot possibly be known right now ... the numbers cannot be estimated.
swa: Kiwango cha masumbuko ya sasa kilichosababishwa na tetemeko la ardhi si rahisi kufahamika hivi sasa...ni vigumu kukadiria idadi.

eng: But, if the way they deal with day to day hardship is any indication - the people of Haiti will rise.
swa: Lakini, kama jinsi wanavyopambana na harakati za maisha za kipindi hiki za siku hadi siku ni kiashirio kwa namna yoyote - basi watu wa Haiti wataibuka upya.

eng: His wife, Tara, also offers handy information:
swa: Mkewe anayeitwa Tara naye kwa upande wake anatupatia taarifa za maana:

eng: Diesel is going to go fast and will be needed for any sort of communication.
swa: Mafuta ya diseli yatatumika sana na yatahitajika sana kwa aina yoyote ile ya mawasiliano.

eng: Coming down if you are not willing to risk and get in and clean out horrific wounds would just tax an already taxed place.
swa: Kama unakuja huku hauko tayari kujiweka katika hatari na kujichanganya katika kusafisha vidonda vya kutisha basi kutazidisha tu machungu kwa watu ambao tayari wana uchungu mkali.

eng: Medical professionals should contact organizations with the ability to coordinate efforts and try to get here.
swa: Wenye taaluma ya utabibu hawana budi kwasiliana na asasi zenye uwezo wa kuratibu juhudi mbalimbali za uokoaji ili waweze kuja hapa.

eng: It won't help to have more non-medical people to feed and house.
swa: Haitasaidia sana kwa watu wasio na taaluma ya utabibu kuja tu na kuongeza idadi ya watu wa kulisha na kuwapa mahali pa kulala.

eng: Hope that does not sound harsh - but it is truth.
swa: Naamini maneno haya hayatachukuliwa kuwa na maana mbaya - lakini huo ndiyo ukweli.

eng: Heart wrenching testimonies and photographs were also coming from how can they hear:
swa: Ushuhuda na picha za kutisha pia ni vitu ambavyo vimekuwa vikimiminika kutoka kwenye tovuti ya wanawezaje kusikia (how can they hear):

eng: On my way out, I saw our dresser moving, the kitchen cabinets shake and spit out all sorts of cans, and the house moving as if it was made out of jello.
swa: Nilipokuwa nataka kutoka ndani, mara niliona meza ya kujipodolea ikitikisika, makabati ya jikoni yakitetemeka huku vitu vilivyo ndani vikidondoka chini, wakati huohuo nyumba ilikuwa ikichezacheza utadhani imetengenezwa kwa kitu laini mfano wa mafuta ya mgando.

eng: I had never seen anything like that.
swa: Sijawahi kamwe kushuhudia kitu cha aina hiyo.

eng: But I only realized it was an earthquake when I finally got outside and saw people running in all directions.
swa: Nilikuja kutahamaki kwamba ni tetemeko la ardhi baada ya kuwa nimekwisha toka nje na kuona watu wakikimbia ovyo huku na huko.

eng: Some crying.
swa: Wengine wao walikuwa wakipiga mayowe.

eng: Some rushing.
swa: Wengine wakikimbia mbio tu.

eng: Others wailing.
swa: Wengine wakiomboleza.

eng: Wailing as if life was pulled from within them.
swa: Yaani walikuwa walikuwa wakilia kwa kuomboleza kana kwamba kulikuwa na mtu anayewakamua uhai wao.

eng: The blog also offers information on how best to help in the midst of an untenable situation, which, judging by the blog's most recent post, is worsening:
swa: Blogu hiyo pia imekuwa ikitoa taarifa za njia bora za kutoa msaada katika hali inayochanganya sana, ambayo, kwa kutumia mtazamo wa makala mpya zaidi kwenye blogu hiyo, hali inazidi kuwa mbaya:

eng: Things are starting to get a little scary.
swa: Hali ya mambo hapa inazidi kuwa ya kutisha.

eng: We realize that the destruction in Jacmel is more than we first thought.
swa: Tunaona kwamba kiwango cha uharibifu katika eneo la Jacmel ni zaidi kuliko tulivyokadiria mwanzoni.

eng: I just found out that there are still hundreds of people here in Jacmel trapped under the rubble.
swa: Ndiyo kwanza nimegundua kwamba bado kuna mamia ya watu katika eneo hili la Jacmel ambao bado wamekwama kwenye vifusi.

eng: You can smell the dead people in the downtown area where much damage occurred.
swa: Unaweza kusikia harufu mbaya za maiti waliokufa katika eneo la katikati ya mji ambapo kulikuwa na uharibifu mkubwa zaidi.

eng: The other question is the issue of water.
swa: Suala lingine ni lile la maji.

eng: Will it run out soon?
swa: Je, yatakatika hivi karibuni?

eng: Will we be able to have access anywhere to clean safe water?
swa: Je, wapi pengine tutapata maji safi na salama?

eng: I don’t know.
swa: Sijui.

eng: Pwoje Espwa - Hope in Haiti also blogs about their experiences:
swa: Kwa upande wao Pwoje Espwa - Matumaini katika Haiti nao wanablogu kueleza yale wanayoshuhudia.

eng: The local general hospital is already filled with people who were hurt in the capitol.
swa: Hospitali kuu hapa tayari yote imejaa watu waliojeruhiwa huko katika jiji.

eng: There are doctors and nurses but nothing else.
swa: Kuna madaktari na manesi na si kingine.

eng: No medicine, no sheets, no bandages, no food for them.
swa: Hakuna dawa, mashuka, bendeji, na hakuna chakula cha kuwalisha.

eng: Some are languishing on the floor.
swa: Wengine wao wanaendelea kuangamia huku wamejilaza kwenye sakafu.

eng: Keep them and us in your prayers.
swa: Tafadhali mtuombee sisi na wao.

eng: The blog's most recent update talks about the fact that "EdH (Electricite d'Haiti) will start rolling out rations of electricity as the fuel supply is dwindling":
swa: Chapisho la karibuni kabisa kwenye blogu hiyo linazungumzia ukweli kwamba kampuni ya umeme ya “EdH (Electricite d'Haiti) hivi karibuni itaanzisha mgao wa umeme kwa kuwa kiwango cha mafuta kinazidi kupungua”:

eng: The plan is to provide electricity at night for security and a few hours during the day.
swa: Mpango uliopo ni kuwasha umeme nyakati za usiku wa ajili ya masuala ya usalama na kwa saa chache nyakati za mchana.

eng: Only one gas station is open at this time and folks are predicting super high prices.
swa: Ni kituo kimoja tu cha mafuta ndiyo kilicho wazi kwa wakati huu na baadhi ya watu wanabashiri kwamba huenda bei itapanda sana.

eng: Met a man on the street this morning who comes from Jacmel which was hit hard by the earthquake.
swa: Nilikutana na mtu mtaani leo asubuhi na yeye alikuwa ametokea eneo la Jacmel ambalo lilipigwa vibaya na tetemeko.

eng: He was talking to himself in Kreyole, French, Spanish with a sprinkling of English.
swa: Alikuwa akiongea peke yake kwa lugha za Kreyle, Kifaransa na Kihispania huku akitumbukiza Kiingereza.

eng: He spoke to me but I could not make out what he was saying.
swa: Aliniongelesha, lakini sikuambulia kitu katika aliyosema.

eng: He abruptly turned away and walked into the darkness.
swa: Mara ghafla aligeuka na kutokomea kwenye giza.

eng: Witnessing the massive destruction and loss of life can make anyone lose it.
swa: Mtu anaposhuhudia uharibifu mkubwa kupita kiasi na upotevu mkubwa wa maisha kunaweza kumchanganya vibaya mtu yeyote.

eng: Blesh Family in Haiti Weblog also posts information:
swa: katika blogu-tovuti ya Haiti, Familia ya Blesh nayo inatuma taarifa mbalimbali:

eng: The situation is quite bad.
swa: Hali ni ya kutisha.

eng: Most of the major markets for food are crumbled.
swa: Masoko mengi yanayotegemewa kwa chakula yameporomoka.

eng: The banking system is down.
swa: Mfumo wa mabenki haufanyi kazi sawasawa.

eng: There is only partial internet and cell phone service.
swa: Kuna huduma kiduchu sana za Intaneti na simu za mkononi.

eng: To make it clear from someone on the ground here…I have not kept up with the news and who is doing what but I’ll tell you that Haiti is a mess.
swa: Ili kukuelewesha upate picha ya hali ilivyo hapa...sijaweza kwenda sambamba na habari za nani anafanya nini lakini ninachoweza kukueleza ni kwamba Haiti iko katika hali mbaya.

eng: The infrastructure is in shambles.
swa: Miundombinu yote imeharibika.

eng: Still, partial Internet access in the context of such widespread devastation is nothing short of a small miracle - and Multilink Haiti, one of the country's Internet Service Providers, has taken the initiative and started tweeting, providing much-needed information and re-tweeting pleas to help find missing loved ones.
swa: Hata hivyo, kuwepo kwa huduma ya intaneti, japo kwa kiasi kidogo, katika mazingira magumu kama haya tuliyomo, bado ni kama muujiza fulani hivi mdogo - na kampuni ya Mulitilink ya hapa Haiti inayotoa huduma za intaneti (ISP) imechukua jukumu na kuanza kutuma Twita hivyo inatoa taarifa zinazohitajika sana na kurusha upya twita zinazoomba taarifa za watu waliopotezana.

eng: One of the most dedicated users of Twitter is hotelier Richard Morse, whose coverage of the situation has been stellar.
swa: Mmoja wa watu wanaotumia sana Twita ni mfanyakazi wa Hoteli, Richard Morse, ambaye taarifa zake za tukio zima zimekuwa makini sana.

eng: Changing Perspectives, while located in neighbouring DR, posts a report from a missionary located near Jeremie in Haiti:
swa: Kwa upande mwingine, Changing Perspectives, ambaye anaandika makala kutoka nchi jira ya Dominika, anatuma ripoti kutokea katika misheni moja iliyo eneo la karibu na Jeremie huko Haiti:

eng: Our phones are still out and not working and there is no way for people to get to Port to check on their families even if they wanted to.
swa: Bado simu zetu hazifanyi kazi na hakuna jinsi ambayo mtu anaweza kuitumia ili kwenda jijini Port kuona kama ndugu zao wako salama au la, yaani hiyo ni hata kama watu wangetaka kwendahuko.

eng: We have no boats coming to Jeremie and we hear that the road to Cayes across the mountains is ruined in several places and no vehicles can pass.
swa: Hakuna boti zinazokuja huku Jeremie na tumesikia kwamba barabara inayokwenda Cayes kupitia milimani imeharibika kiasi cha magari kutoweza kupita.

eng: This means that families can not get to Port to find out where their families are.
swa: Jambo hili lina maana kwamba watu hawawezi kwenda jijin Port ili kutafuta taarifa za ndugu zao.

eng: This is very, very hard on everyone.
swa: Jambo hili ni gumu sana, tena sana kwa kila mtu hapa.

eng: In a later post, she gives news about an apparently under-utilised hospital in the north of the island:
swa: Katika makala nyingine aliyotuma baadaye, aliandika kwamba kwa namna ya kushangaza kidogo kuna hospitali ambayo haitumiki sana katika maeneo ya kaskazini ya kisiwa:

eng: Hopital Sacre Coeur (Sacred Heart Hospital) is full-service hospital, fully staffed, volunteer teams both on site and standing by, ready to go.
swa: Hospitali ya Moyo Mtakatifu (Sacred Heart Hospital) ni hospitali kamili ikiwa na kila kitu kuanzia wafanyakazi, timu za wanaojitolea wa aina zote yaani walio kazini na wale walio tayari kuingia kazini wakati wowote.

eng: We have operating rooms and beds.
swa: Tuna vyumba vya upasuaji na vitanda.

eng: We have discharged other patients whose condition is less serious.
swa: Tumewaruhusu wagonjwa waliokuwa wamepata nafuu.

eng: We have cleared a soccer field for helicopter landing.
swa: Tumeondoa kila kitu kutoka kwenye uwanja wa mpira ili kuruhusu helikopta kutua hapo.

eng: Real Hope For Haiti Rescue Center, meanwhile, is also trying to help with medical aid and writes:
swa: Kituo cha Matumaini ya Kweli na Uokoaji cha Haiti (Real Hope For Haiti Rescue Center), nacho kwa upande wake, kinajaribu kutoa msaada wa dawa na kinaandika:

eng: I do not pretend to understand the suffering that is happening right now in this country.
swa: Sijifanyi kuelewa mateso yanayotokea hivi sasa katika nchi hii.

eng: I know we all feel like we had had enough over the years.
swa: Najua tunahisi kwamba tayari tumepitia mengi katika miaka iliyopita.

eng: The staff has come in to work.
swa: Wafanyakazi wamekuja kufanya kazi.

eng: They are praying for their loves ones in town.
swa: Wanawaombea wale wanaowapenda sana hapa jijini.

eng: They are hoping for news and believing that they will soon here from them.
swa: Wanaweka matumaini kwamba watapata habari wakiamini kwamba ndugu zao hao watawasiliana nao.

eng: Mothers and father are weeping for their lost children.
swa: Akina mama na akina baba wanawalilia watoto wao.

eng: Children are crying for their lost parents.
swa: Watoto nao wanawalilia wazazi wao waliofariki.

eng: The reality is even when the outside world begins , what can be done?
swa: Hali halisi inakuwa ngumu zaidi pale ulimwengu wa nje unapoanza kuwasili, je, nini kifanyike?

eng: Still, the outside world wants to know.
swa: Na bado ulimwengu wa nje unataka kupata habari.

eng: For more information on the earthquake in Haiti, please go to our Special Coverage Page.
swa: Kwa taarifa zaidi kuhusu tetemeko la ardhi lililoipiga nchi ya Haiti, tafadhali tembelea Ukurasa wetu Maalumu wa Taarifa.

eng: A video interview of Kyo Kageura, head of the project Minna no Honyaku (みんなの翻訳, Translation for all) , a new translation platform that helps NGOs and NPOs to spread their messages thanks to volunteer translators.
swa: Mahojiano ya video ya Kyo Kageura, mkuu wa mradi wa Minna no Honyaku (みんなの翻訳, Tafsiri kwa Wote) , jukwaa jipya la tafsiri ambalo linazisaidia Asasi Zisizo za Kiserikali na zile Zisizo za Kibiashara kueneza ujumbe wao, shukrani kwa wafasiri wa kujitolea.

eng: Global Voices Japan asked him about the challenge of Minna no Honyaku , the difficulties and the new frontiers of volunteer translation.
swa: Global Voices Japan ilimuuliza kuhusu changamoto za Minna no Honyaku , matatizo na nyanja mpya ya kutafsiri kwa kujitolea.

eng: The project Minna no Honyaku or Translation for all is the brainchild of Language Translation Group of the National Institute of Information and Communication Technology and Library and Information Science Laboratory of the University of Tokyo, in cooperation with publishing company Sanseido.
swa: Mradi wa Minna no Honyaku au Tafsiri kwa Wote ni matokeo ya wazo la Kundi la Kutafsiri la Maktaba na Chuo Cha Taifa cha Habari na Teknolojia ya Mawasiliano pamoja na Maabara ya Sayansi ya Habari ya Chuo Kikuu cha Tokyo, kwa kushirikiana na shirika la Uchapishaji la Sanseido.

eng: Thought as a part of the Shiitake Project, the realization of a platform to stimulate the growth of online translation has a precise purpose:
swa: Ulibuniwa kama sehemu ya Mradi wa Shiitake, na kukamilika kwa jukwaa la kutia nguvu ukuaji wa tafsiri katika wavuti una dhamira maalum:

eng: This system will ultimately enable individual translators to form a network, without any additional or conscious effort, in which translators working on similar or related domains can collectively accumulate translation data and share information relevant to their translations.
swa: Mfumo huu hatimaye utawawezesha wafasiri binafsi kujenga mtandao, bila ya jitihada nyingine za ziada, ambapo wafasiri wanaofanya kazi katika sehemu moja au sehemu zinazofanana wanaweza kukusanya kwa pamoja takwimu za tafsiri na kushirikiana habari zenye umuhimu kwa kazi zao.

eng: This, we believe, will enhance the activity of translators and encourage potential translators to join in.
swa: Hili, tunaamini, litaboresha shughuli za wafasiri na kuwapa moyo wale wanaotaka kuwa wafasiri kujiunga.

eng: As such, the Shiitake project is ultimately a social project.
swa: Kwa hiyo, mradi wa Shiitake ni mradi wa kijamii.

eng: Lastly, with the aim to make translation an easy process also to inexperienced translators, Professor Kageura's team created Minna no Honyaku, convinced that:
swa: Na mwisho, huku kukiwa na lengo la kurahisisha kutafsiri hata kwa wafasiri wasio na uzoefu, timu ya Profesa Kageura iliunda Minna no Honyaku, kwa kushawishika kuwa:

eng: The translation of news and reports by volunteers plays a vital role in this alternative information flow.
swa: Tafsiri za habari na taarifa za wale wanaojitolea zinatoa huduma muhimu sana katika huu mtiririko mbadala wa habari.

eng: Bumni writes about the decision to make Kiswahili an optional subject in Kenya: "The subject will no longer be a compulsory paper in the Standard Eight national examinations..."
swa: Bunmi anaandika kuhusu uamuzi wa kulifanya somo la Kiswahili kuwa la kuchagua nchini Kenya: "Somo hili halitakuwa tena na mtihani wa lazima katika mtihani wa taifa wa darasa la nane..."

eng: As people around the world get closer through modern technology, and cultural and racial barriers give way to mutual understanding and respect; and interracial marriages are becoming more common.
swa: Kadiri watu katika sehemu mbalimbali za dunia wanavyozidi kuwa karibu kwa sababu ya teknolojia ya kisasa, na njinsi vikwazo vya kiutamaduni na tofauti ya asili vinavyozidi kuondolewa na kuacha nafasi kwa kuelewana na kuheshimiana; basi ndoa za watu wenye asili tofauti nazo zinazidi kuwa jambo la kawaida.

eng: A number of mixed race and religion families are sharing their experiences in the blogosphere.
swa: Idadi kadhaa ya familia za watu waliocahanganyika kiasili na wa dini tofauti wanasimulia kuhusu uzoefu wao kupitia ulimwengu wa blogu.

eng: To look at a culture and country through the eyes of an outsider is a learning experience.
swa: Kuuchunguza utamaduni na nchi kupitia macho ya mtu mgeni kunatoa fursa ya kujifunza mengi.

eng: At InterracialMarriage, the blogger-an Australian male is married to a Chinese woman who happens to be an atheist.
swa: Katika blogu ya ndoa za watu wa asili tofauti, mwanaume wa Ki-Australia ambaye pia ni mwanablogu amemwoa mwanamke mwenye asili ya U-China ambaye pia si mwamini Mungu.

eng: Writing about the way they celebrated Christmas as family with their son, he finds himself in a fix trying to make sense of his wife's atheist views and belief in traditional Chinese rituals.
swa: Aliandika kuhusu jinsi walivyosherehekea sikukuu ya Noeli kama familia pamoja na mtoto wao, hapo anaeleza jinsi mara nyingine inavyomwia vigumu kujaribu kuelewa maoni ya mkewe kama mtu asiyeamini katika Mungu huku akishikilia matambiko fulani ya kiutamaduni ya Kichina.

eng:
Ms B may not believe in God because of a lack of proof, but this does not stop her believing in Luck, or in Feng Shui, or in Numerology, or in any other number of cultish beliefs that seem to have widespread basis within the Chinese community. 	“Inawezekana kwamba Bibie B haamini katika Mungu kwa sababu hakuna ushahidi wa kuthibitisha kuwepo kwake, lakini imani yake hii haimzuii kuamini katika Bahati, au imani ya Feng Shui, au katika Elimu-Namba, au katika vijiimani vyovyote vidogovidogo vingi ambavyo vinaelekea kwamba vimeenea sana miongoni mwa wanajamii wa Kichina.
I sometimes notice Ms B performing strange rituals at home to ward off Bad Luck, and she has even cost us a lot of money in re-positioning our front and back doors, in order to capture Good Luck in our home through good Feng Shui. 	Mara nyingine huwa ninamshuhudia Bibie B akifanya matambiko ya ajabu nyumbani yakiwa na lengo la kuondoa Bahati Mbaya, na hata ameshawahi kutugharimu kiasi kikubwa cha fedha ili kuijenga upya milango ya mbele na nyuma ya nyumba yetu ili kuweza kunasa Bahati Nzuri katika nyumba yetu kupitia miungu wazuri wa Feng Shui.
Now I too see no basis in these beliefs, but I tolerate them for Ms B's sake. I guess this is what she too does for me with my religion.
swa: Mimi pia sioni kama kweli imani zake hizi zina maana yoyote, lakini ninazivumilia ili nisimwudhi Bibie B. Nafikiri naye ananichukulia hivyohivyo kutokana na imani yangu ya dini."

eng: When it comes to a foreign culture reading between lines does not come easily, it seems; even when you marry someone from that culture.
swa: Linapokuja suala la utamaduni wa kigeni, kujaribu kuelewa mafumbo si jambo jepesi, jinsi inavyoelekea; hiyo ni hata uwe umeoana na mtu anayetoka kwenye utamaduni huo.

eng: But what do you do when you try to embrace your significant other's cultural practices and end up standing out among colleagues?
swa: Lakini, je, unafanyaje pale unapojaribu kukumbatia taratibu za kiutamaduni za mwenzako na kuishia kuonekana tofauti miongoni wa wenzako?

eng: At GoriGirl the blogger, a white woman married to an Indian Bengali man, shares her experience of "wearing sindoor as a white woman".
swa: Katika GoriGirl kuna mwanablogu, mwanamke mzungu aliyeolewa na Mhindi wa kutoka Bengali, yeye pia anatushirikisha uzoefu wake wa “kujipaka sindoor (doa la kwenye paji la uso) wakati yeye ni mwanamke wa kizungu”.

eng: Hindu married women wear Sindoor (vermilion power) on their forehead and this practice is common in many parts of India and Nepal.
swa: Wanawake wa Ki-Hindu walioolewa hujipaka sindoor (aina fulani ya chokaa ya rangi) kwenye mapaji ya nyuso zao na ni jambo la kawaida katika maeneo mengi katika nchi za India na Nepali.

eng: But how about the practice in Washington DC?
swa: Lakini je, utaratibu huo utakubalika katika jiji la Washington DC?

eng:
No, my problem with wearing sindoor is that most days I’m headed into work where there are a fair number of Indian people. 	“Hapana, tatizo langu linalotokana na kujipaka sindoor ni kwamba katika siku nyingi ninakwenda kazini ambapo kuna idadi ya kutosha ya wanawake wa Ki-Hindi.
And none of them wear traditional Indian clothing, except for the occasional short kurta – certainly there isn’t any sindoor-wearing going on among the married ladies! 	Hakuna hata mmoja wao anayevalia mavazi ya asili ya Ki-Hindi, labda kwa kiasi kidogo vazi lile fupi la kurta - na kwa hakika karibu hakuna mwanamke aliyeolewa anayejipaka sindoor miongoni mwao!
One older Bengali coworker even expressed amazement that I followed the “old-fashioned” tradition of wearing a loha – a gold-plated iron bangle that serves as a wedding ring among Bengali women – on my left wrist daily. ............On the third hand (yes, yes, I know), the last time I wore sindoor to the office, my boss wanted to know if I needed a band-aid for the cut on my head. 	Mwanamke mmoja mtu mzima mfanyakazi mwenzangu mwenye asili ya Bengali hata alinishangaa kwa kuwa nilikuwa nafuata utamaduni uliopitwa na wakati" wa kuvalia bangili ya loha - bangili iliyopakwa dhahabu ambayo hutumika kama pete wakati wa harusi miongoni mwa wanawake wa Ki-Bengali - katika mkono wangu wa kushoto kila siku. …………Katika hatua nyingine (ndiyo, ndiyo, najua) mara ya mwisho nilipojipaka sindoor na kwenda ofisini, bosi wangu alitaka kujua kama nilihitaji kupewa bandeji ili nijifunge kidonda nilichokuwa nacho kichwani kwangu.
Yeah. Yeah, I know.
swa: Ndiyo, ni kweli kabisa, wala si utani, najua.

eng: Does anyone else have problems with this?"
swa: Hivi, kuna mtu mwingine anayepata shida na hali hii?"

eng: Standing out was also in mind of TheGoriWifeLife blogger, who is an American married to a Pakistani man.
swa: Kuonekana u tofauti lilikuwa pia jambo lililokuwa kwenye akili ya mwanablogu wa TheGoriWifeLife, yeye ni Mwamerika aliyeolewa na mwanamme wa Kipakistani.

eng: She writes about what she is wearing while visiting Pakistan:
swa: Anaandika kuhusu namna anavyovaa pale anapokwenda nchini Pakistani:

eng:
This time, I brought two pairs of jeans and a few shirts because I thought that at least around the house I wanted to be comfortable, since that is my daily uniform back home. 	“Safari hii, nilibeba jozi mbili za nguo aina ya jeans na mashati kadhaa kwa sababu niliwaza kuwa ninapokuwa nyumbani basi napenda nijihisi kutobughudhiwa, maana hayo pia ndiyo mavazi yangu ya kila siku nyumbani kwetu.
But somehow I've ended up wearing jeans paired with a Pakistani shirt and dupatta when we go out probably as many times as I've worn shalwar kameez.	Lakini mara kadhaa niliishia kuvaa suruali ya jeans na juu shati la Kipakistani na dupatta hasa tunapotoka, huenda mara nyingi tu kadiri ambavyo nimewahi kuvaa nguo aina ya shalwar kameez.
We've even gone on several walks around the neighborhood and it feels totally normal and at ease.	Hata tumefanya matembezi katika maeneo ya jirani mara kadhaa na linaonekana kuwa jambo la kawaida na wala halisumbui.
Somehow things seem different this time.
swa: Lakini kwa sababu moja au nyingine safari hii hali imekuwa tofauti.”

eng: Difficulty of understanding and being accepted in a different culture is something interracial couples face regularly.
swa: Ugumu wa kuelewa na kukubalika katika utamaduni tofauti ni jambo ambalo wanandoa wenye asili tofauti hukutana nalo kila mara.

eng: Sometimes they also face questions about the basis of their relationship, and when marriage and immigration status get mixed up it is not comfortable.
swa: Mara nyingine hujikuta pia wakikabiliana na maswali kuhusu msingi wa uhusiano wao, na pale inapotokea ndoa na masuala ya uhamiaji yakagongana, basi huwa ni karaha tupu.

eng: At IndiaTies, blogger Heather Lurdkee, an American married to an Indian questions people who see interracial marriage as a status symbol or a way to get permanent residency status.
swa: Katika IndiaTies, mwanablogu Heather Lurdkee, Mwamerika aliyeolewa na Mhindi anawahoji watu wanaozitazama ndoa za watu wa asili tofauti kama alama ya hadhi au njia ya kupata sifa ya ukaazi wa kudumu.

eng: For my husband, being married to me (a white girl) isn't much of a status symbol - he didn't go out looking specifically for an American or a white girl. 	Kwa upande wa mume wangu, ile kunioa mimi (mwanamke wa kizungu) siyo njia ya kupanda hadhi - hakuamua kutafuta mwanamke wa Ki-Amerika au mzungu kwa ajili ya lengo hilo.
He didn't "need me" in order to get somewhere in life.
swa: Siyo kwamba "alinihitaji mimi" ili kufika mahali fulani katika maisha yake.

eng: We just happened to be at the right place at the right time and things worked out.
swa: Ilitokea tu kwamba tulikuwa mahali sahihi kwa muda sahihi na mambo yakajipa nasi tupo pamoja.

eng: However, some of my husband's Indian friends have expressed their desire to find a white girl to my husband.
swa: Hata hivyo, baadhi ya marafiki wa Ki-Hindi wa mume wangu wamemweleza nia zao za kutafuta wanawake wa kizungu.

eng: One friend (from India - who recently came to the States) actually said to my husband, "Wow, you've got it made, I have to find a white girl like you..." And he was serious! "
swa: Mmoja wao (ambaye ametoka India kuja Marekani hivi karibuni) alimwambia mume wangu "Du, rafiki yangu wewe umepatia, na mimi ngoja nitafute mwanamke wa kizungu kama wewe…” Na siyo kwamba alikuwa anatania! “

eng: The trial and tribulations of interracial couples show a mirror to how far we-as a civilization have come in accepting and respecting differences.
swa: Majaribu na mahangaiko ya watu waliooana huku wakiwa ni wa asili tofauti yaonyesha, kama kioo, ni kwa kiasi gani sisi - kama watu tuliostaarabika - tumefikia katika kupokea na kuheshimu tafauti zetu.

eng: These blogs are part of that mirror and are also a tool in cultural and social understanding. Thumbnail image by United Nations Photo. Used under a creative commons license
swa: Blogu hizi ni sehemu tu ya kioo hicho na pia ni zana ya kusaidia kuelewa tamaduni na jamii nyingine.

eng: Matthew Cassel reports the suicide of Theresa Seda, a Filipino domestic worker in Beirut.
swa: Matthew Cassel anaripoti tukio la kujia la Theresa Seda, mfanyakazi wa ndani wa Kifilipino jijini Beirut.

eng: Read the chilling details of how such suicides- which have been increasing in numbers- are going ignored at Justimage.
swa: Soma habari za kina za kutisha za jinsi vifo vya namna hiyo vinavyoongezeka kwa idadi - vinaendelea kutotiliwa maanani kwenye Justimage.

eng: Condolences poured in on Twitter after an Ethiopian Airlines jet plunged into the Mediterranean minutes after its take off from Beirut, Lebanon.
swa: Rambirambi zilimiminika kwenye Twita baada ya ndege ya Shirika la Ndege la Ethiopia kuanguka kwenye (bahari ya) Mediterani dakika chache baaday ya kupaa ikitokea Beirut, Lebanoni.

eng: All 90 people on board are presumed dead after the plane caught fire during a lightning storm and crashed into the sea.
swa: Watu wote 90 waliokuwemo wanahofiwa kuwa wamekufa baada ya ndege hiyo kushika moto katika kimbunga cha radi na kuangukia baharini.

eng: @tsepeaces retweets an eye witness as saying:
swa: @tsepeaces anatuma tena ujumbe wa twita wa mtu aliyeshuhudia tukio na kusema:

eng: RT @patrickgaley: Eyewitness Naame "We saw an explosion in the sky like the sun, it was there for seconds then vanished into darkness"#ET409
swa: RT @patrickgaley: Shahidi Naame “Tuliona mlipuko kama jua angani, ulikuwa pale kwa sekunde chache halafu ukatokomea kwenye giza” #ET409

eng: He also tweets:
swa: Pia anaandika ujumbe huu wa twita:

eng: The plane was a ball of flame for a second - these are haunting words :-/ #ET409 May they all Rest in Peace!
swa: Ndege ile ilikuwa kama mpira wa moto kwa sekunde chache – hayo ni maneno yanayojirudia :-/ #ET409 Na Wapumzike Kwa Amani!

eng: Daily Star reporter and Huffington Post blogger Patrick Galey quotes a Lebanese man who lost 10 friends on board the flight:
swa: Mwanahabari wa gazeti la Daily Star na mwanablogu wa Huffington Post Patrick Galey anamnukuu mwanaume mmoja wa Lebanoni ambaye amepoteza marafiki 10 waliokuwemo kwenye ndege hiyo:

eng: Fouad Shihab, 10 friends on board: "I was meant to be on that plane and look what happened.
swa: Fouad Shihab, marafiki 10 kwenye ndege: Nilitakiwa niwepo kwenye ndege ile na angalia kilichotokea.

eng: All my friends are dead."
swa: Marafiki zangu wote wamekufa.”

eng: In an earlier tweet, he writes:
swa: Katika ujumbe wa awali wa twita, anaandika:

eng: Just returned from Rafiq Hariri airport, scenes there are terrible.
swa: Ndiyo kwanza nimerudi kutoka uwanja wa ndege wa Rafiq Hariri, yanayoonekana huko yanatisha.

eng: No information, spoke with people who have lost entire family
swa: Hakuna taarifa, nimeongea na watu waliopoteza familia nzima

eng: Hichame Assi (@hiconomics) writes:
swa: Hichame Assi (@hiconomics) anaandika:

eng: Very sad to hear about #ET409... I hope it's as painless as possible to all family and friends.
swa: Ni masikitiko makubwa kusikia kuhusu #ET409… Natumaini (msiba) utakuwa bila ya uchungu kwa kadri inavyowezekana kwa ndugu na marafiki wote.

eng: Allah Yer7am (May God have mercy on them)
swa: Allah Yer7am (Mungu uwahurumie)

eng: Georges Azzi, who has been following the coverage on television, wasn't impressed and tweeted:
swa: Georges Azzi, ambaye amekuwa akifuatilia habari hii kwenye televisheni, hakuvutiwa na akaandika:

eng: Lebanon: too many TV Stations= too much airtime #et409 #coverage switching into sensational and fictional mode #fail
swa: Lebanoni: idhaa nyingi za televisheni = muda mrefu hewani #habari za #et409 zinaelekea kwenye udaku na hadithi za kubuni #fail

eng: Samer, who tweets @meetsamer, also expressed outrage at Lebanese media saying:
