swa: Kuelekea mwishoni mwa mwaka 2009, raia wa Hungaria na wale wa Slovakia walianzisha kampeni ya mtandaoni ambayo ilikuja kupata sura yake maridhawa mwezi Januari 2010.

eng: A Facebook group called Hungarians and Slovaks (HUN, SLO, ENG) already exists "For the good relations between Hungarians and Slovaks!", and now they're also supporting a new group called Štastný nový rok, Slovensko! / Boldog Új Évet Magyarország!
swa: Kikundi cha Facebook kinachojulikana kama Wa-Hungaria na Wa-Slovakia (HUN, SLO,ENG) tayari kimeanzishwa "Kwa lengo la kuweka uhusiano mzuri kati ya Wa-Hungaria na Wa-Slovakia!", na sasa wanaunga mkono kundi jipya linalojulikana kama Štastný nový rok, Slovensko! / Boldog Új Évet Magyarország!

eng: (SLO, HUN, "Happy New Year, Slovakia!/Happy New Year, Hungary!).
swa: (SLO, HUN, “Heri ya Mwaka Mpya, Slovakia!/Heri ya Mwaka Mpya, Hungaria!).

eng: The description of the group — which has its status updates in Slovak and Hungarian — says (HUN, SLO):
swa: Maelezo ya kundi hilo - ambalo kila mara linaingiza mambo mapya kwenye ukurasa wake kwa lugha za KiSlovak na KiHungaria - yanaeleza (HUN, SLO):

eng: Who wants to live in continuous tension with his neighbour?
swa: Je, ni nani anayependa kuishi katika mvutano usiokoma na jirani yake?

eng: What's the reason for always looking for the other's faults, and how is it disturbing if someone's always observing our faults?!
swa: Hivi ni sababu gani hasa ya kufanya mtu utafute makosa ya mwenzako, na ni kwa jinsi gani inavyoudhi kama kuna mtu anayejaribu kutafuta makosa yetu saa zote?!

eng: The opposition is seemingly becoming more and more serious, and to ease the tension deriving from it we're initiating communication aiming the society, because our conviction is that the tension is mostly generated by actual politics.
swa: Hali ya upinzani inazidi kuwa tete, na ili kupunguza mvutano unaotokana na hali hiyo, tunaanzisha mawasiliano yanayolenga jamii, kwa sababu tunaamini kwamba mvutano huo zaidi unachagizwa na siasa tu.

eng: We submit that in the judgement of each other, the two countries' civil society can be influenced positively by the courtesy of a bilateral campaign.
swa: Tunakiri kwamba katika kupitishiana hukumu, vyama vya kiraia katika nchi hizi mbili vinaweza kuambukizwa kwa njia iliyo ya chanya kwa msaada wa kampeni zinazohusisha pande mbili.

eng: The main goal of this campaign is to spread a simple New Year's message in both countries through all channels of communication, and involve NGOs and ordinary citizens in saying Happy New Year to each other.
swa: Lengo kuu la kampeni hii ni kusambaza ujumbe rahisi wa Mwaka Mpya katika nchi zote mbili kupitia njia zote za mawasiliano na kuhusisha pia Asasi Zisizo za Serikali (AZISE) na raia wa kawaida katika kutakiana Heri ya Mwaka Mpya.

eng: For this two websites were started for Hungarian and Slovakian supporters: boldogujevetmagyarorszag.sk is the Hungarian site ending with .sk, the Slovak country code, and stastnynovyrokslovensko.hu is for Slovak-speaking people signed with the Hungarian country code.
swa: Kwa ajili ya lengo hili zilianzishwa tovuti mbili kwa ajili ya waungaji mkono Wa-Hungaria na Wa-Slovakia: boldogujevetmagyarorszag.sk ambayo ni tovuti ya Ki-Hungaria inayoishia na .sk, ambayo ni kodi ya nchi ya Slovakia, na stastnynovyrokslovensko.hu ambayo ni kwa ajili ya watu wanaozungumza Ki-Slovak huku ikiwekewa kodi ya nchi ya Hungaria.

eng: Also, two videos have recorded for each country:
swa: Vilevile, kuna video mbili zilizorekodiwa kwa ajili ya kila nchi:

eng: So far, ReTRo is the only blogger who has commented on the start-up in Hungary by writing a short story (HUN) about neighbours hating each other, but whose relationship starts getting better by a snow bank shoveled away by chance from the hated neighbour's house.
swa: Mpaka sasa, ReTRo ndiye mwanablogu pekee aliyekwishatoa maoni ya kuanzia katika lugha ya Ki-Hungaria kwa kuandika hadithi fupi (HUN) kuhusu majirani waliochukiana, lakini ambao uhusiano wao baadaye ulianza kuwa mzuri kwa sababu kuna theluji iliyoondoshwa kwa nasibu tu kutoka katika baraza la nyumba ya jirani mmojawapo anayechukiwa.

eng: Maybe he wasn't awake yet, or the snow just covered his dislike, or simply he overlooked it, but he didn't notice that he had shoveled the snow not in front of the neighbour's gate, but away from it.
swa: Huenda alikuwa hajaamka bado, au labda ile theluji ilifunika tu ile chuki yake, au labda aliipuuzia,lakini hakugundua kwamba siyo kuwa alikuwa amesukumizia theluji mbele ya lango la jirani yake, bali aliiondoa kabisa kutoka hapo.

eng: He shrugged it away by thinking this would be the good act for the week.
swa: Aliamua kujiambia kwamba basi hilo lilikuwa ni tendo moja jema katika wiki hiyo.

eng: He explained this to Sanyi, when she simply said he was stupid to work in the place of the hated neighbour.
swa: Alieleza jambo hili kwa Sanyi, mkewe, ambaye alimkemea na kumwambia kwamba alikuwa mpumbavu kwa kufanya kazi katika sehemu ya jirani waliyemchukia.

eng: In the evening when they got home, the snow was freshly swept away from their gate.
swa: Walipofika nyumbani jioni ile, walikuta ndiyo kwanza theluji imeondolewa kutoka kwenye lango la kuingilia nyumbani kwao.

eng: The neighbour has thanked him.
swa: Kumbe ilikuwa ni shukrani kutoka kwa jirani yao.

eng: It went like this for three days.
swa: Hali iliendelea hivyo kwa muda wa siku tatu.

eng: They met on Saturday first.
swa: Kwanza walikutana siku ya Jumamosi.

eng: With snow shovels in their hands.
swa: Kila mmoja akiwa na sepeto ya kusombea theluji.

eng: They greeted each other.
swa: Walisalimiana.

eng: They started to chat...
swa: Walianza kuzungumza...

eng: By Monday the snow melted.
swa: Ilipofika Jumatatu theluji ilikuwa imekwishayeyuka.

eng: Something ended up...
swa: Kuna kitu kilikuwa kimefika mwisho...

eng: ...or has just begun.
swa: ... au ndiyo kilikuwa kimeanza.

eng: Oh, yes and there's a start-up just launched by the name „Boldog Új Évet Magyarország! - Štastný Nový rok, Slovensko!”.
swa: Ndiyo, kuna jambo limezinduliwa nalo linaitwa „Boldog Új Évet Magyarország! - Štastný Nový rok, Slovensko!”.

eng: We could start with snow shoveling...
swa: Kumbe tunaweza kuanza na kuzoleana theluji...au siyo?

eng: Sri Lanka's incumbent president Mahinda Rajapakshe's aggressive re-election campaign includes purchasing banner ads on leading global media sites.
swa: Kampeni kabambe ya Rais wa Sri Lanka aliye madarakani, Mahinda Rajapakshe inajumuisha manunuzi ya nafasi za matangazo katika tovuti mashuhuri za vyombo vya habari duniani.

eng: Groundviews questions what is the point of paying global media for local elections.
swa: Groundviews anahoji sababu ya kuvilipa vyombo vya habari vya kimataifa kwa ajili ya uchaguzi wa ndani ya nchi.

eng: Writing in Arabic, Sudanese blogger Ayman Hajj discusses his country's politics and why many Sudanese people are losing faith in unity.
swa: Akiandika kwa Kiarabu, mwanablogu wa Kisudani Ayman Hajj anajadili siasa za nchi yake na kwa nini watu wengi wa Sudani wanapoteza imani katika umoja.

eng: The actions of the Sudanese government and the southern Sudan Popular Movement, says the blogger, are being seen as a farce: لماذا يظل الشعور متزايدا بأن الحكومة السودانية وشريكها في الحكم الحركة الشعبية لايقومان بشئ غير اداء مسرحية باهتة الملامح امام اعين الشعب السوداني. Why is the feeling increase that the Sudanese government and its partner in governance, the Popular Movement, are not doing anything other than performing a play which is dull, in front of the eyes of the Sudanese people?
swa: Vitendo vya serikali ya Sudan na vile vya Chama Maarufu cha Sudani ya Kusini anasema mwanablogu huyu, vinaonekana kama vile mchezo wa kuigiza:

eng: “We're sick of Ministry of Culture in Thailand”
swa: “Tumechoshwa na Wizara ya Utamaduni ya Thailand”

eng: This Facebook fan page was created by netizens who are criticizing the methods and policies of Thailand’s Ministry of Culture.
swa: Ukurasa huu wa Facebook ulianzishwa na raia wa mtandaoni wanaokosoa njia na sera za Wizara ya Utamaduni ya Thailand.

eng: The Ministry has been strict in its promotion and monitoring of authentic Thai culture in old and new media sites.
swa: Wizara hiyo imekuwa ikidhibiti sana uhamasishaji na usimamizi wa utamaduni wa asili wa Ki-Thai katika tovuti za vyombo vya habari vya kizamani na hata vile vya kisasa.

eng: As of this writing, the page has 2,857 fans.
swa: Mpaka kufikia hivi punde (11.01.2010), ukurasa huo tayari umetembelewa na mashabiki wapatao 2,857.

eng: The Facebook page was also a response to the exaggerated reaction of ministry officials to the discussion thread started by one of its staff workers on popular web portal Pantip.
swa: Ukurasa huo wa Facebook pia ulikuwa ni kama jibu kutokana na mwitikio uliotiwa chumvi uliofanywa na wafanyakazi wa wizara hiyo kuhusu mtiririko mmoja wa mijadala ulioanzishwa na mfanyakazi mmojawapo wa wizara hiyo katika tovuti moja maarufu iitwayo Pantip.

eng: The intention of the staff was to solicit feedback from the people about the performance of the ministry.
swa: Lengo la mfanyakazi huyo lilikuwa kupata maoni kutoka kwa watu kuhusu utendaji wa wizara hiyo.

eng: The web forum generated an interesting discussion, including constructive criticism about the work of the ministry.
swa: Jukwaa hilo la mtandaoni liliamsha majadiliano ya kusisimua, ambapo kulikuwa na ukosoaji wa kujenga kuhusu utendaji wa wizara hiyo.

eng: But ministry officials didn’t like the negative comments.
swa: Lakini watendaji wa Wizara hawakupendezwa na maoni yaliyokuwa hasi.

eng: It forced its own employee to reveal his identity and to issue a public apology.
swa: Kwa hiyo, wizara hiyo ilimwamuru mfanyakazi wake huyo kujitambulisha yeye ni nani na kutoa tamko hadharani la kuomba radhi.

eng: Sampan Ruksa, the staff of the ministry who initiated the online thread, wrote an apology letter for his actions.
swa: Mfanyakazi huyo aliyeanzisha mtiririko huo wa mtandaoni na aliyejitambulisha kama Sampan Ruksa aliandika barua ya kuomba msamaha kwa kitendo chake.

eng: He began by pointing out that he didn’t mean to cause disrespect to the ministry by starting a web discussion on Pantip since it is a popular and credible website
swa: Alianza kwa kusema kwamba halikuwa kusudio lake kujenga hisia za kutoiheshimu wizara hiyo kwa kuanzisha kwake majadiliano hayo ya mtandaoni katika Pantip, hasa ukizingatia kwamba tovuti hiyo ni maarufu na yenye kuheshimika.

eng: Pantip is a top tier, high quality Thai web board.
swa: Pantip ni tovuti yenye ubora wa hali ya juu na yenye kusimamiwa na bodi inayotambulika.

eng: The respondents on the web board are members of the site who must submit their national ID card number or show their IP address.
swa: Wale walio kwenye bodi hiyo ni wanachama ambao hawana budi kupeleka vitambulisho vyao vya kitaifa na kuonyesha anwani za kompyuta zao.

eng: Discussion on this web board is more polite than on other web boards.
swa: Majadiliano katika tovuti hii ni ya kiungwana zaidi kuliko katika tovuti nyingine yoyote.

eng: Sampan apologized to his superiors and colleagues in the ministry
swa: Sampan aliwaomba radhi wakubwa wake na wenzake katika wizara.

eng: I, Mr. Samphan Ruksa, started discussion threads at the beginning of last month on the web boards of Pantip.com, Larn Dham Sewana, and MThai.
swa: Mimi, Bw. Samphan Ruksa, nilianzisha mtiririko wa majadiliano mwanzoni mwa mwezi uliopita katika tovuti ya bodi ya Pantip.com, Larn Dham Sewana, na MThai.

eng: I contacted the Larn Dham Sewana administrator at the beginning of last month to request the thread be deleted.
swa: Niliwasiliana na msimamizi wa Dham Sewana mwanzoni mwa mwezi uliopita ili kuomba kwamba mtiririko huo uondolewe kwenye tovuti.

eng: I believe that my actions have had no benefit to the Cultural Monitoring Office, and worse, have caused discouragement and unease to the staff members who work therein.
swa: Naamini kwamba vitendo vyangu hivi havikuwa na manufaa yoyote kwa Ofisi Inayosimamia Utamaduni, na mbaya zaidi, nimesababisha kuvunjika moyo na kukosa raha kwa wafanyakazi wa kitengo hicho.

eng: I hereby accept that my actions were due to my ignorance, inexperience, foolishness, and an incomplete understanding of their work process.
swa: Ninakubali kwamba vitendo vyangu hivi vilikuwa kwa sababu ya kutojua, kukosa uzoefu, ujinga, na kukosa uelewa kabisa wa kazi zinazofanywa na wenzangu.

eng: In addition, I acted without consulting my superiors, acted beyond my duties, without judgment, and inappropriately, by allowing the outside public to criticize the Office's work too intrusively, to the point of criticizing specific individuals.
swa: Kwa kuongezea, nilifanya yote hayo pasipo kuwashirikisha wakubwa zangu, nilifanya kazi isiyo yangu, bila kupima vizuri, na pasipo usahihi, hasa kwa kuruhusu watu walio nje ya ofisi hii kukosoa kazi za ofisi kwa kina kiasi hata cha kukosoa watendaji binafsi.

eng: Thus, I, as the one who caused the damage, hereby take responsibility, admitting that my actions were unwitting.
swa: Kwa hiyo, ambaye ndiye niliyesababisha uharibifu huu nakubali kuwajibika nikikiri kwamba vitendo vyangu havikuwa makini.

eng: I apologize to each staff member of the Cultural Monitoring Office.
swa: Ninamwomba msamaha kila mfanyakazi katika Ofisi ya Wizara Ya Utamaduni.

eng: I realize that the policies and the work of each staff member benefit our society and nation.
swa: Natambua wazi kwamba kuna sera inayoelekeza kuwa kila mfanyakazi afanye kazi ili kuinufaisha jamii na taifa letu.

eng: They are determined and diligent, enduring difficulties and fatigue, and are very dedicated to their work.
swa: Wafanyakazi hao ni watu wanyoofu na wavumilifu kwa usumbufu na mambo mengi magumu, na wamejitoa kabisa katika kulitumikia taifa.

eng: I am sorely grieved.
swa: Nimehuzunishwa sana na yote haya.

eng: Kong Rithdee, in his Bangkok Post blog, lambasted the reactions of the ministry officials
swa: Kwa upande wake, Kong Rithdee, katika makala aliyochapisha kwenye blogu inayoitwa Bangkok Post, alishambulia vikali vitendo vya watendaji wa Wizara hiyo.

eng: Poor ministry.
swa: Maskini Wizara hii.

eng: They still don't get it that the most important culture is the culture of constructive criticism and free expression.
swa: Bado hawajui kwamba utamaduni wa muhimu zaidi ni ule ulio wa kufanya ukosoaji wa kujenga na kuruhusu fikra huru.

eng: Commenting on the Facebook page, Natnaree Uriyapongson gives this advice
swa: Akitoa maoni yake kuhusu ukurasa wa Facebook, Natnaree Uriyapongson anatoa ushauri huu:

eng: The Ministry of Culture should do something about the many prostitutes swarming our country instead of turning a blind eye and using it to "help and promote" our economy!!
swa: Wizara ya Utamaduni haina budi kufanya kitu kuhusu tatizo la ongezeko la makahaba wanaozidi kuigubika nchi yetu badala ya kulifumbia macho na kulitumia "eti kuhamasisha" uchumi wetu!!

eng: In Thailand, citizens can call a hotline to complain about images, shows, and events which do not represent Thai culture.
swa: Nchini Thailand, raia wanaweza kupiga simu ya moja kwa moja na kulalamikia picha, maonyesho, na matukio yasiyowakilisha vema utamaduni wa Ki-Thai.

eng: Thai Film Journal reports:
swa: Jarida la Filamu la Thailand linaripoti:

eng: Call 1765.
swa: Piga simu namba 1765.

eng: Thailand’s “culture police force” is composed of 1.3 million volunteers from 4,825 networks across the country who monitor TV shows, websites, and media events that offend and harm Thai culture.
swa: Kikosi cha polisi cha utamaduni cha Thailand kina jumla ya watu milioni 1.3 wanaojitolea na ambao wanatoka katika mitandao ipatayo 4,825 kutoka kote nchini humo. Hawa wana kazi kubwa ya kufuatilia maonyesho ya Televisheni, tovuti, na matukio ya vyombo vya habari ambayo yana nafasi ya kusababisha uharibifu au upotoshaji wa utamaduni wa Ki-Thai.

eng: Togo's national football team has been formally disqualified from the African Cup of Nations following Friday's deadly attack on the team's convoy in Cabinda, a region of Angola long troubled by separatist violence.
swa: Timu ya Taifa ya Togo sasa imeondolewa rasmi kutoka kwenye mashindano ya Kombe la Mataifa ya Afrika kufuatia shambulizi lililoelekezwa kwa msafara wa timu hiyo Ijumaa iliyopita katika eneo la Kabinda lililo nchini Angola na ambalo liko kwenye ukanda wa mapigano baina ya vikosi vya serikali na vile vya waasi wanaotaka kujitenga.

eng: Members of the Togolese national football team before a warm-up match in Biberach/Riss a few days before the World Cup (Source: Wikipedia)
swa: Wachezaji wa timu ya Taifa ya Togo kabla ya mashindano ya utangulizi huku Biberach/Riss siku chache kabla ya Mashindano ya Kombe la Dunia (Chanzo: Wikipedia)

eng: The team's assistant coach and media officer were killed and goalkeeper Kodjovi "Dodji" Obilale, seriously injured.
swa: Kocha msaidizi na ofisa wa habari wa timu waliuwawa na mlinda mlango, Kodjovi "Dodji" Obilale, alijeruhiwa vibaya sana.

eng: Obilale is reported to be in stable condition after undergoing surgery in South Africa, although he is still breathing with the assistance of a respirator.
swa: Hata hivyo, imeripotiwa kwamba hali ya Obilale sasa imetengemaa baada ya kufanyiwa upasuaji nchini Afrika ya Kusini, ingawa bado anaendelea kupumua kwa kutumia mashine maalumu ya kusaidia upumuaji.

eng: FLEC, the rebel group which has claimed responsibility for the attack, indicated in a statement that the police envoy, and not the Togolese players, were the target.
swa: Kundi la waasi linalojulikana kwa jina la FLEC na ambalo limedai kuhusika na shambulizi hilo lilieleza kwenye taarifa yake kwamba wao walikuwa wamelenga kushambulia msafara wa polisi na si timu ya wachezaji ya Togo.

eng: The Angolan government, for its part, has called the attack an "isolated incident" and has guaranteed the security of the other teams.
swa: Kwa upande wake, serikali ya Angola, imeelezea kwamba shambulizi hilo limetokea "kwa bahati mbaya" na kwamba inazihakikishia timu nyingine usalama.

eng: Matches continue as scheduled in Cabinda province.
swa: Hivi sasa mechi zinaendelea kama zilivyopangwa huko kwenye jimbo la Kabinda.

eng: Although according to news reports, many players had indicated they wanted to keep playing, the Togolese government recalled the team on Saturday.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa taarifa mbalimbali, wachezaji walionyesha nia ya kutaka kuendelea na mashindano, lakini serikali ya Togo iliamua kuirudisha nyumbani timu hiyo siku ya Jumamosi.

eng: Togo, which was to play Ghana today, was officially disqualified when the team failed to appear.
swa: Togo ambayo ilikuwa icheze dhidi ya Ghana mapema leo, imeondolewa rasmi kwenye mashindano baada ya kushindwa kutokea uwanjani.

eng: Since the attack, many Togolese have been asking difficult questions about what was a preventable tragedy: Why was the team traveling by bus and not by air?
swa: Tangu kutokea kwa shambulizi hilo, wananchi wengi wa Togo wamekuwa wakiuliza maswali magumu kuhusu msiba huo ambao pengine ungeweza kuepukika: Kwa nini timu hiyo ilisafiri kwa basi na si kwa ndege?

eng: Did the Angolan government choose to stage a matches in Cabinda just to prove the rebellion was over?
swa: Je, nini hasa ilikuwa nia ya serikali ya Angola kuchagua kuendesha mashindano hayo katika jimbo la Kabinda, je, ilikuwa kwa nia ya kuonyesha kwamba imewashinda waasi?

eng: Is football worth all the tragedy that seems to follow it?
swa: Je, hivi, mchezo wa soka una manufaa makubwa ya kusababisha mtu ujiweke kwenye hatari ya msiba kama huo?

eng: Should the Cup be canceled?
swa: Je, mashindano hayo yafutiliwe mbali?

eng: Play on?
swa: Je, mashindano yaendelee?

eng: Directly following the attack, there was a big debate online as to whether Togo should withdraw.
swa: Mara baada ya shambulizi hilo, kulizuka mjadala mkubwa wa mtandaoni kuhusu kama timu ya Togo ijitoe au la.

eng: Rêve d'Afrique, the blog of Togolese writer Gerry Taama, argued the game should go on:
swa: Rêve d'Afrique, ambayo ni blogu ya raia wa Togo na mwandishi Gerry Taama alijenga hoja zake kwamba mchezo uendelee:

eng: At 3:34 a.m. local time, an earthquake with a magnitude of 8.8 struck off the coast of the Maule region in Chile.
swa: Saa 9:34 usiku kwa saa za Chile, tetemeko la ardhi lenye ukubwa wa 8.8 liliukumba mwambao wa eneo la Maule nchini Chile.

eng: The earthquake was felt in the capital city of Santiago located 325km from the epicenter.
swa: Tetemeko hilo liliutetemesha mji mkuu wa Santiago uliopo Kilomita 325 kutoka katika kiini cha tetemeko hilo.

eng: Extensive damage has been reported throughout the country, and the number of casualties continues to go up.
swa: Uharibifu mkubwa umeripotiwa nchin nzima, na idadi ya waliofariki inazidi kwenda juu.

eng: Throughout the day, aftershocks have also been felt in the region.
swa: Kwa siku nzima, matetemeko madogo madogo yaliyofuatia yalilitetemesha eneo hilo.

eng: A blog Terremoto Chile (Earthquake Chile) was quickly created by Francisco soon after the earthquake hit.
swa: Blogu ya Terremoto Chile (Tetemeko la ardhi Chile) iliundwa haraka na Fransisco mara baada yua tetemeko kutokea.

eng: In addition to posting recommendations on what citizens should do following the earthquake , he has been collecting and linking to various Twitpic pictures.
swa: Na zaidi ya kuchapisha mapendekezo kuhusi nini raia wanachotakiwa kufanya kufuatia tetemeko la ardhi , amekuwa akikusanya na kupanga picha mbalimbali za Twitpic.

eng: Photo of damage to Nuestra Señora de la Divina Providencia Church in Santiago.
swa: Picha ya uharibifu uliolikuta Kanisa la Nuestra Señora de la Divina Providencia mjini Santiago.

eng: Taken by Julio Costa Zambelli and used under a Creative Commons license.
swa: Iliyopigwa na Julio Costa Zambelli na kutmika kwa leseni ya Creative Commons.

eng: Near the epicenter, Robinson Esparza of the citizen newspaper El aMaule , part of the Diarios Ciudadanos network has been updating a post with the latest regional and national news .
swa: Karibu na kiini cha tetemeko, Robinson Esparza wa gazeti la kiraia la El aMaule , ambalo ni sehemu ya mtandao wa Diarios Ciudadanos amekuwa akiweka habari mpya kadri zinavyotokea kutoka katika habari mpya za kanda na taifa .

eng: Many comments have been worrying about family members in areas outside the capital, and this lack of communication has continued to be an issue for relatives trying to contact family and friends in places where electricity and phone lines have been affected.
swa: Maoni mengi yamekuwa ni ya hofu juu ya wanafamilia walio kwenye maeneo ya nje ya mji mkuu, na ukosefu wa mawasiliano umeendelea kuwa suala gumu kwa ndugu wanaojaribu kuwasiliana na familia pamoja na marafiki katika sehemu ambazo nyaya za umeme na simu zimeathirika.

eng: Ign.
swa: Ign.

eng: Rodríguez de R. (@micronauta) writes about this frustration:
swa: Rodríguez de R. (@micronauta) anaandika kuhusu usumbufu huu:

eng: Just days after American Secretary of State Hillary Clinton's speech on Internet freedom, open source source code repository SourceForge.net blocked access to IP addresses originating in Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Sudan and Syria.
swa: Siku chache baada ya hotuba ya Waziri wa Mambo ya Nje wa Marekani, Hillary Clinton juu ya uhuru wa mtandaoni, mtandao huria wa alama za tarakilishi wa SourceForge.net umefungia upatikanaji wa anuani mahsusi za kompyuta za nchini Cuba, Iran, Korea Kaskazini, Sudani na Syria.

eng: SourceForge justifies the move saying they are only following American law.
swa: SourceForge wanahalalisha hatua hiyo kwa kusema wanafuata tu sheria ya Kimarekani.

eng: Which is more or less the same argument Chinese government spokespeople make when questioned about their country's Internet censorship.
swa: Ambayo ni kama hoja inayotolewa na wasemaji wa serikali ya Uchina wanapoulizwa juu ya zuio la mtandao la nchi hiyo.

eng: SourceForge has been blocked by China before.
swa: SourceForge imewahi kufungiwa na China kabla.

eng: Hearing word of this new Great Firewall of America left some Chinese coders wondering if they might now start getting blocked from the other end and what can be done about it.
swa: Kwa kusika neno la ukuta huu mkubwa wa moto wa Marekani uliowaacha wataalamu wa alama hizo wa Kichina wakishangaa ikiwa wanaweza kuanza kufungiwa kutoka kwenye nchi nyingine na kile kinachoweza kufanywa kuhusu suala hilo.

eng: Photo from William Lone's Moonlight Blog.
swa: Picha kutoka Blogu ya Moonlight ya william Lone

eng: At CNBeta on the day the news broke, ugmbbc wrote:
swa: Kwenye CNBeta katika siku ya habari hiyo, ugmbbc aliandika:

swa: Picha imepigwa na thombo2 na fick wameitumia kwa mujibu wa lesini ya CC

eng: The Costa Rican Presidential elections are this Sunday and through videos, many Costa Ricans are expressing their concerns regarding the candidates and the future of their country through parody and humor.
swa: Uchaguzi wa Rais wa Costa Rica unafanyika Jumapili hii na kwa kupitia video, wananchi wengi wa Costa Rica wanatoa hisia zao kuhusu wagombea na mustakabali wa nchi yao kupitia vichekesho na utani.

eng: First, we have an online video uploaded by El Basureo , where they propose an innovative solution to the age old problem of not knowing whom to vote for.
swa: Kwanza, tuna video ya mtandaoni iliyopandishwa na El Basureo, ambamo wanapendekeza utatuzi wa maana kwa tatizo kongwe la muda mrefu la kutokujua nani wa kumpigia kura.

eng: In this Costa Rican election, out of the 6 candidates running for office, four of them are in the lead: National Liberation's Laura Chinchilla, Libertarian Otto Guevara, Socialdemocrat Otton Solis and Social Christian Luis Fishman.
swa: Katika uchaguzi huu wa Costa Rica, kati ya wagombea 6 wanaokilimbia ikulu, wanne wao wako mbele: Laura Chinchilla wa Chama cha NL, Otto Guevara wa chama Liberty, Otton Solis wa chama cha Socialdemocrat na Luis Fishman wa Social Christian.

eng: El Basureo proposes a new machine which will mix and match characteristics of the candidates, and the names that come off those mixes are a wink and nod to the Costarican political situation.
swa: El Basero amapendekeza mashine mpya ambayo itachanganya na kuoanisha sifa za wagombea, na majina yatakayotoka baada ya mchanganyiko huo yatakuwa sawia kwa hali ya kisiasa ya Costa Rica.

eng: Ethiopia-based bloggers rushed to defend the safety record of the country's national airline on Monday after one of its planes crashed near Beirut, with all 90 people on board feared dead.
swa: Wanablogu waishio Ethiopia wameharakia kuitetea rekodi ya usalama wa safari za ndege za nchi hiyo siku ya Jumatatu baada ya ndege moja kuanguka karibu na Beirut, ikihofiwa kupoteza maisha ya watu wote 90 waliokuwepo.

eng: Owen Abroad said he was "very upset" by the news in the post Ethiopian Airlines, adding:
swa: Owen Abroad alisema “alikasirishwa sana” na habari katika posti ya Shirika la Ndege la Ethiopia, akiongeza:

eng: Ethiopian Airlines has an outstanding safety record.
swa: Shirika la Ndege la Ethiopia lina rekodi ya nhali juu ya usalama.

eng: The staff are professional, courteous and efficient.
swa: Wafanyakazi wake ni wataalamu, wenye ari na wafanisi.

eng: I will be flying from the UK to Addis on Friday on Ethiopian Airlines and, despite today’s tragedy, I am looking forward to it.
swa: Nitasafiri kwa ndege kutoka Uingereza kwenda Addis siku ya Ijumaa kwa Shirika la Ndege la Ethiopia na, pamoja na balaa la leo, bado ninatarajia (safari).

eng: A commenter on the blog agreed, writing:
swa: Mtoa maoni kwenye blogu hiyo alikubaliana naye, akiandika:

eng: I’ve flown with them a number of times, and never had a bad experience.
swa: Nimesafiri nazo (ndege za Ethiopian Airlines) mara kadhaa, na sijawahi kukutana na uzoefu mbaya.

eng: They’re also much better with changing dates than most other airline companies.
swa: Pia wana utaratibu mzuri wa kubadikili tarehe kuliko mashirika mengine ya ndege.

eng: Two annoyances about the news coverage in the UK
swa: Kero mbili juu ya namna tukio hilo lilivyoripotiwa na vyombo vya habari nchini Uingereza

eng: When the crash was first announced on the news, we were told that there were 2 Brits on board, one Canadian citizen, and one French citizen.
swa: Wakati ajali hiyo ilipotangazwa kwa mara ya kwanza katika vyombo vya habari, tuliambiwa kwamba kulikuwa na Waingereza wawili, raia wa Canada mmoja na raia wa Ufaransa mmoja.

eng: Apparently people of other nationalities are less relevant / interesting.
swa: Kiuwazi kabisa watu wa mataifa mengine si wa muhimu wala kuvutia hisia.

eng: The second:- The airline safety expert was repeatedly questioned about the safety record of African airlines, and had to answer a number of questions about the quality of Ethiopian Airlines’ fleet (in particular the age of the planes).
swa: Pili:- Mtaalamu wa safari za anga aliulizwa mara kadhaa kuhusu rekodi ya usalama wa Mashirika ya Ndege ya Afrika, na ilibidi ajibu maswali kadhaa kuhusu kiwango bora cha safari za anga za Shirika la Ndege la Ethiopia (hasa hasa umri wa ndege zenyewe).

eng: I certainly don’t remember similar questions being asked after the Air France crash last summer.
swa: Sikumbuki maswali kama hayo kuulizwa bada ya kuanguka kwa ndege ya Shirika la Ndege la Ufaransa, Air France kiangazi kilichopita.

eng: Reuters' Addis-based correspondent Barry Malone wrote a post on the company's Africa News Blog titled Ethiopian plane crash should not sully success story:
swa: Mwandishi wa habari wa Reuters aliyeko Addis Barry Malone aliandika posti kwenye blogu ya shirika hilo iitwayo Africa News Blog yenye kichwa cha habari Kuanguka kwa ndege ya Kiethiopia kusipake matope habari za mafanikio:

eng: When news of the Ethiopian Airlines plane crash broke this morning my heart sank at the thought of covering yet another negative story about Ethiopia.
swa: Habari za kuanguka kwa ndege ya Shirika la Ndege la Ethiopia zilipotapakaa asubuhi ya leo moyo wangu ulisinyaa kwa mawazo ya kuelezea habari nyingine mbaya kuhusu Ethiopia.

eng: It’s particularly galling for Ethiopians that the airline is one of the few international success stories for a country known mostly for famine and war.
swa: Kwa hakika inakera sana kwa Waethiopia kwamba shirika la ndege ni moja ya mafanikio adimu ya kimataifa ya nchi hii inayofahamika kwa njaa na vita.

eng: When the news emerged I also immediately knew how hard the company’s staff would take it.
swa: Habari zilipojitokeza nilifahamu mara moja namna gani wafanyakazi wa shirika hilo wangezichukulia.

eng: I’ve been to the sprawling campus that serves as headquarters to Africa’s arguably flagship airline many times.
swa: Nimewahi kuwepo kwenye maeneo yanayofanya kazi kama makao makuu ya shirika la ndege linaloongoza Afrika mara kadhaa.

eng: The last time was just last week to interview CEO Girma Wake and I left with a gift of Ethiopian coffee and the impression that I’d rarely seen people so passionate or proud about their work and what it does for their country.
swa: Mara ya mwisho ilikuwa juma lililopita nilipoongea na Mkurugenzi Mtendaji Girma Wake na nikaondoka na zawadi ya kahawa ya Ethiopia na picha niliyoipata ambayo ni nadra sana kuona watu wenye upendo na kujivunia kazi yao na kile inachokitenda kwa ajili ya nchi yao.

eng: Nazret.com provided running updates on the crash as the story developed through the day.
swa: Nazret.com inatoa habari za hivi karibuni kuhusu ajali hiyo kadri habari hii ilivyoendelea hadi leo.

eng: In 2008, during the presidential elections, candidates promised Ghanaians a review of the nation’s constitution.
swa: Mwaka 2008, wakati wa Uchaguzi wa rais, wagombea waliwaahidi Waghana kuwa wangeitazama tena katiba ya nchi hiyo.

eng: What made this pledge more appealing was the contenders’ - President John Atta Mills included - intention to involve Ghanaians in the review process.
swa: Jambo lililoifanya ahadi hii kuonekana kama ni ya kweli lilikuwa ni nia ya wagombea – pamoja na Rais John Atta Mills – ya kuwashirikisha Waghana katika mchakato huo wa kuitathmini katiba.

eng: The president seems to have fulfilled that promise, and new proposals now fuel interesting debates.
swa: Inaonekana kuwa rais ametimiza ahadi hiyo, na sasa mapendekezo mapya yanachochea mijadala ya kuvutia.

eng: In an article posted by Ghana Pundit entitled, “Don’t Extend President’s Tenure, ” Prof. Kofi Quashigah, Dean of the law faculty at the University of Ghana, remarked:
swa: Katika makala iliyotumwa na Ghana Pundit yenye kichwa kinachosema, “Msiongeze Muda Wa Rais Madarakani,” Prof. Kofi Quashigah, Mkuu wa Kitivo cha Sheria cha Chuo Kikuu Cha Ghana, anasema:

eng: A two four year system is long enough to afford a determined individual as president to impact on the democratic institutions.
swa: Mfumo wa mihula miwili ya miaka minne minne ni mrefu wa kutosha kumwezesha mtu mwenye nia kama akiwa rais kuacha msukumo wake katika vyombo vya demokrasi.

eng: A two five year period will be the beginning of creation of tin gods.
swa: Mfumo wa mihula miwili ya miaka mitano mitano utakuwa ni mwanzo wa kutengeneza miungu wa bati.

eng: It is the strengthening of the institutions of governance that should engage our attention so that the individual does not become the dominant feature…the four year period appears just sufficient so as to avoid the individual staying on too long and becoming complacent.
swa: Ni uimarishaji wa taasisi za utawala ambao unapaswa kuzikamata fikra zetu ili kwamba watu binafsi wasiweze kuwa wa muhimu zaidi… kipindi cha miaka minne kinaonekana kuwa kinatosha tu ili kuepusha mtu kukaa kwa muda mrefu na kuanza kuridhika.

eng: This comment is a response to one of various constitutional amendment proposals under consideration by Ghana’s Constitutional Review Committee: extending the president’s current four-year term to five.
swa: Maoni haya yanatokana na moja ya mapendekezo ya marekebisho ya katiba yanayotazamwa na Kamati ya Kuipitia Katiba ya Ghana: kuongeza muhula wa sasa wa urais kutoka miaka minne kwenda miaka mitano.

eng: Quashigah adds:
swa: Quashigah anaongeza:

eng: The status quo should be maintained to avoid creating an aura of indispensability around individuals who become President.
swa: Mfumo unapaswa kudumishwa ili kuepuka kuundwa kwa hali ya kutegemewa katika watu ambao wanakuwa marais.

eng: And how is President Atta Mills doing with his promise to involve the people in the review process?
swa: Na je Rais Atta Mills anaendeleaje na ahadi yake ya kuwahusisha watu katika mchakato wa huu kuitazama katiba?

eng: Have Ghanaians even welcomed the idea?
swa: Je Waghana wamelipokeaje wazo hilo?

eng: Ghana Pundit reports in a February 11 post :
swa: Ghana Pundit anaripoti katika makala yake ya Februari 11:

eng: A legal practitioner has suggested that the review of the constitution should ensure that power resides in the hands of the people through well-structured local institutions and organs and a perfected district assembly system.
swa: Kuna mwanasheria aliyependekeza kwamba maopitio ya katiba ni lazima yahakikishe kwamba madaraka yanabaki katika mikono ya wananchi kwa kupitia taasisi na vyombo vyenye miundo mizuri na mfumo mzuri kabisa wa mabunge ya majimbo.

eng: The legal practitioner, Nana Addo-Aikens, continues:
swa: Mwanasheria, Nana Addo-Aikens, anaendelea:

eng: The constitutional amendments, which Ghana needs today, should therefore not be the surface-scratching or cosmetic or window-dressing type but must be the type of constitution, which will be all-embracing and sweeping enough in order not to waste a rare opportunity for change.
swa: Marekebisho ya katiba, ambayo Ghana inayahitaji leo, hayapaswi kuwa ya juu ya uso au ya urembo au ya fahari ya macho bali yanatakiwa kuwa katika namna ya katiba, ambayo itakumbatia yote na itakayofikia kila nyanja ili kwamba yasipoteze fursa hii ya nadra ya mabadiliko.

eng: He then adds:
swa: Kisha anaongeza:

eng: Functional checks and balances as well as workable forms of separation of powers were other issues that needed serious consideration by the commission.
swa: Mfumo wa vizingiti na mizani unaofanya kazi sawa pamoja na miundo fanisi ya utanganishaji wa madaraka ni masuala kadhaa ambayo yanahitaji kutazamwa kwa makini na tume hii.

eng: In a piece about the constitutional amendment on Inter Press Services (IPS) News website , Osabutey Anny quotes legal practitioner and executive secretary of the Commission, Dr. Raymond Atuguba, as saying:
swa: Katika makala kuhusu marekebisho ya katiba katika tovuti ya shirika la Habari la IPS, Osabutey Anny anamnukuu mwanasheria na katibu mtendaji wa tume hiyo, Dkt. Raymond Atuguba,, akisema:

eng: Every single petition before the commission will be carefully examined.
swa: Kila pendekezo litakalowekwa mbele ya tume litachunguzwa vizuri.

eng: The issues raised are very valid.
swa: Mapendekezo yaliyotolewa ni ya maana.

eng: Anny reports:
swa: Anny anaripoti:

eng: The petitions received to date vary and include calls for a review of the powers of the executive.
swa: Mapendekezo yaliyopokewa mpaka hivi sasa ni mengi na yanajumuisha tathmini ya nguvu za serikali.

eng: According to Anny, Atuguba remarked that,
swa: Kwa mujibu wa Anny, Atuguba alidai kuwa,

eng: The number of petitions received by the commission shows the extent to which the public was looking forward to the review.
swa: Idadi ya mapendekezo yaliyopokelewa na tume yanaonyesha upeo ambao umma unasuburi matokeo

eng: It is apparent from reports that Ghanaians are more eager to engage in the burgeoning democratic process of the nation since its constitution commenced in 1993.
swa: Kutokana na ripoti ni wazi kuwa Waghana wapo tayari kujihusisha katika mchakato unaokua wa demokrasi wa taifa hili tangu katiba yake ilipoanza mwaka 1993.

eng: Anny commends the African nation in his piece:
swa: Anny analisifia taifa hili la Afrika katika makala yake:

eng: The country has made much progress since then.
swa: Nchi hii imepiga hatua kubwa tangu wakati huo.

eng: Ghana was ranked the seventh-best country on the continent for good governance according to the 2009 Ibrahim Index of African Governance.
swa: Ghana ilikuwa ni nchi bora ya saba katika bara katika utawala bora kwa mujibu wa orodha ya Ibrahim ya Utawala wa Afrika 2009.

eng: The index measured, among other things, the delivery of public goods and services by government.
swa: Orodha hiyo ilipima, pamoja na mambo mengine, utoaji vifaa na huduma za jamii unaofanywa na serikali.

eng: Ashanti Regional Minister, Kofi Opoku-Manu, has recently taken great heat for remarks he made during a speech to supporters of the ruling party, National Democratic Congress (NDC) on January 6th.
swa: Mkuu wa Mkoa wa Ashanti, Kofi Opoku-Manu, hivi karibuni alionja joto ya jiwe kutokana na matamshi aliyoyatoa kwenye hotuba yake kwa mashabiki wa chama tawala, Nationa Democratic Congress (NDC) tarehe 6 Januari.

eng: According to Ghana’s Ato-Kwamena Dadzie, Opoku-Manu “urged party supporters to resort to violence to resolve their differences.”
swa: Kwa mujibu wa Ato-Kwemena Dadzie, Opoku-Manu “aliwasihi mashabiki wa chama kutumia ghasia kusuluhisha tofauti zao.”

eng: Dadzie reports in his article, “Opoku-Manu Must Go” with a direct quote from the Regional Minister:
swa: Dadzie anataarifu kwenye makala yake “Opoku-Manu Lazima Ang’oke” kwa nukuu ya moja kwa moja kutoka kwa Mkuu huyu wa Mkoa:

eng: If you can slap him, do so.
swa: Kama unaweza kumpiga kofi, fanya hivyo.

eng: Dadzie states:
swa: Dadzie anaeleza:

eng: Comments like these are reckless and irresponsible.
swa: Maoni kama haya hayana maana na ni ya kipuuzi.

eng: You don’t expect a man in Mr. Opoku-Manu’s position to utter them.
swa: Huwezi kutegemea mtu aliye kwenye nafasi ya Bw. Opoku-Manu kuropoka maneno hayo.

eng: But he did.
swa: Lakini ndivyo alivyofanya.

eng: Two days later, he had no recollection of what he had said until a recording was played back to him.
swa: Siku mbili baadaye, hakuwa na kumbukumbu ya kile alichosema mpaka rekodi ya sauti ilipochezwa mbele yake.

eng: That was when he came to his senses, acknowledged his momentous folly and offered an apology, which only came after some big wigs within the government instructed to clear the mess he has created.
swa: Hapo ndipo aliporudi kwenye fahamu zake, akakubali ujinga wake na kuomba radhi, hatua ambayo ilikuja baada ya baadhi ya watu wenye nguvu kubwa ndani ya serikali kumwelekeza asafishe uchafu alioutengeneza.

eng: Below is Opoku-Manu’s apology as quoted by Dadzie:
swa: Hili hapa chini ni tamko la kuomba radhi kama lilivyonukuliwana Dadzie:

eng: I’ll be the last person to advocate for warfare of any type and having listened to this myself, I must say I really feel sorry.
swa: Nitakuwa mtu wa mwisho kupendelea vita ya namna yoyote na baada ya kusikiliza (sauti hii) mwenyewe, ni lazima niseme najisikia kusikitika sana.

eng: Dadzie interjects with this comment:
swa: Dadzie anakatiza na maoni yafuatayo:

eng: But he didn’t stop there.
swa: Lakini hakuishia hapo.

eng: He offered a veiled defense.
swa: Alitoa hoja za kujitetea kwa njia ya mzunguko.

eng: He claims he was speaking in a “charged environment”, implying that he wasn’t using his head.
swa: Anasema alikuwa anazungumza katika “mazingira ya hasira”, hiyo ikimaanisha kwamba hakuwa anatumia kichwa chake.

eng: He was speaking by heart.
swa: Alikuwa akizungumza kwa moyo.

eng: You could say he was farting with his mouth.
swa: Ungeweza kusema alikuwa akitoa mashuzi kwa mdomo wake.

eng: For opening his mouth too wide to spew such dangerous nonsense, Mr. Opoku-Manu has shown himself to be an irresponsible man who doesn’t deserve to occupy the position he does.
swa: Kwa kule kuufungua mdomo wake kwa upana na kutapika upuuzi wa hatari kama huo, Bw. Opoku-Manu amejionyesha mwenyewe kuwa mtu asiyewajibika ambaye hastahili kukalia nafasi aliyonayo.

eng: He must be sacked.
swa: Ni lazima afukuzwe kazi.

eng: And if there is anyone who deserves a hefty slap it is him.
swa: Na kama kuna mtu anayestahili kuzabwa kibao ni yeye.

eng: That half-hearted apology he offered only after he had been instructed to do so is not enough.
swa: Kuomba radhi kwa moyo ulio nusu nusu alikokufanya baada ya kuelekezwa kufanya hivyo hakutoshi.

eng: He must go.
swa: Ni lazima atoke.

eng: Responses to Opoku-Manu’s comment seem to be mostly in the negative.
swa: Mwitikio wa wasomaji kwa maoni ya Opoku-Manu yanaonekana kuwa hasi zaidi.

eng: David S. left this comment on Dadzie’s blog post:
swa: David S. aliacha maoni kwenye posti ya blogu ya Dadzie:

eng: At a time when Ghana's democracy is in its infancy, the last thing we need is someone encouraging political violence.
swa: Katika wakati ambao demokrasia ya Ghana ipo katika uchanga wake, kitu cha mwisho tunachohitaji ni mtu kushabikia ghasia za siasa.

eng: Nobody wants this country to become like Zimbabwe or Iran.
swa: Hakuna anayetaka nchi hii iwe kama Zimbabwe au Iran.

eng: He should be made to resign for encouraging people to damage our democracy with political violence.
swa: Ni lazima alazimishwe kujiuzulu kwa kuwataka watu kuharibu demokrasia yetu kwa vurugu za kisiasa.

eng: He is an enemy of democracy.
swa: Ni adui wa demokrasia.

eng: Banske said this about the same post:
swa: Banske alisema haya kuhusu posti hiyo hiyo.

eng: I wonder why people are asking for sacking-sacking doesn't solve the problem.
swa: Ninashangaa kwa nini watu wanataka afukuzwe kazi –kufukuzwa hakutatui tatizo.

eng: If Ohene Ntow made this statement, what would have happened?
swa: Kama Ohene Ntow angetoa tamko hilo, pangetokea nini?

eng: If Wereko-Brobby, Jake etc made the statement....What would the BNI/National security do?
swa: Kama Wereko-Brobby, Jake nk wangetoa matamshi kama hayo…BNI/Usalama wa taifa wangefanya nini?

eng: And people pretend Mills is humane.
swa: Na watu wanajidanganya kwamba Mills ana ubinadamu.

eng: Sacking him wouldn't stop the order he gave and similar ones given by the Rawlingses, Vanderpuyes, Anyidohos etc.
swa: Kumng’oa (Opoku-Manu) hakungesimamisha amri aliyoitoa na ile inayofanana na yake iliyotolewa na wafuasi wa Rawling, Vanderpuyes, Anyidoho nk.

eng: Sack him as RM and bring him to the presidency?
swa: Kumng’oa (Opoku) kama Mkuu wa Mkoa na kumleta kwenye Uraisi?

eng: This man was the RCC chief director under NPP and that was not enough for him.
swa: Mtu huyu alikuwa Mkurugenzi Mkuu wa RCC chini ya NPP na hiyo haikumtosha.

eng: If you are born an idiot, you can be 1000years and will still be an idiot that is what OM has confirmed.
swa: Kama umezaliwa mjinga, unaweza kuwa na miaka 1000 na utaendelea kuwa mjinga na hicho ndicho OM amekithibitisha.

eng: Is only the fool we sees political appointment as a permanent job.
swa: Ni mjinga tu anayeona nafasi ya kuteuliwa kisiasa kama kazi ya kudumu.

eng: Idiocy can be seeing political appointment as a matter of life and death.
swa: Upuuzi unaweza kutafsiriwa kama kuona uteuzi wa kisiasa kama suala la kufa na kupona.

eng: By the way Mills is dumb, timid, and powerless and so has not heard/seen anything.
swa: Pamoja na hayo Mills ni mjinga, mpole na asiye na nguvu na kwa hiyo hajasikia wala kuona chochote.

eng: Nana Poku wrote in his article at Modern Ghana, “Opoku-Manu Must go, Apology or Not”:
swa: Nana Poku aliandika kwenye makala yake katika Modern Ghana, ”Opoku-Manu lazima aondoke, awe kaomba msamaha au la”:

eng: The more important point is this: how can he assure his political opponents of fairness?
swa: Mantiki ya muhimu zaidi ni hii: anawezaje kuwahakikishia haki wapinzani wake wa kisiasa?

eng: How can they trust him to be an honest broker should any matter of political violence come before him as the Chair of REGSEC?
swa: Wanawezaje kumwamini kuwa mwamuzi mwaminifu ikitokea suala lolote la machafuko ya kisiasa likaletwa kwake kama Mwenyekiti wa REGSEC?

eng: How does he ensure the safety and security of the very people he wants beaten up?
swa: Anahakikisha vipi usalama na ulinzi wa watu hao hao anaotaka wapigwe?

eng: I believe he's lost the integrity required for a position as Regional Minister.
swa: Ninaamini amepoteza heshima inayotakiwa kwa nafasi ya Mkuu wa Mkoa.

eng: He must resign or be made to.
swa: Ni lazima ajiuzulu au alazimishwe kufanya hivyo.

eng: We were all witnesses to the many cases of intimidation and harassment of political opponents during and after the 2008 elections.
swa: Wote tumekuwa mashahidi wa matukio mengi ya kutishwa na kubughudhiwa kwa wanasiasa wa upinzani wakati na baada ya uchaguzi wa mwaka 2008.

eng: The last thing we need in this country is for officials, who should know better, to be purveyors of violence and intimidation, themselves.
swa: Jambo la mwisho tunalolihitaji katika nchi hii ni maafisa, ambao kimsingi wangepaswa kujua zaidi, wawe wachuuzi ghasia na vitisho,

eng: A press release by the Alliance for the Advancement of Democracy (AAD), an interest group for the progression of Ghana’s democracy, posted by MyJoyOnline stated:
swa: Tamko kwa vyombo vya habari lililotolewa na Chama cha Kukuza Demokrasia (AAD), kikundi chenye kutafuta ukuzaji wa Demokrasia ya Ghana, lililotundikwa na MyJoyOnline linasema:

eng: The Alliance for the Advancement of Democracy (AAD) wishes to condemn the Ashanti Regional Minister- Hon. Opoku-Manu for his malicious and distasteful comments made over the weekend; which have the propensity to destabilize the peace and security of this nation.
swa: AAD ingependa kumlaani Mkuu wa Mkoa wa Ashanti Mhe. Opoku-Manu kwa maoni yake yenye kinyaa na ya hovyo aliyoyatoa mwishoni mwa juma; yenye mwelekeo wa kuvuruga amani na usalama wa taifa hili.

eng: The Alliance for the Advancement of Democracy (AAD) also views the call by the New Patriotic Party on Hon. Opoku Manu to resign and the subsequent invitation by the appropriate Security agency on the subject matter as most unfortunate and highly hypocritical.
swa: AAD vile vile inauona wito wa Chama cha NPP kujiuzulu na kukaribishwa na wakala wa Ulinzi kwenye suala hilohilo kama wa kusikitisha na wa kinafiki.

eng: AAD believes that, he who seeks equity must come with clean hands and that the New Patriotic Party's blatant disregard and failure to condemn violent acts of the former Central Regional Minister- Hon. Edumadzie, and the similar comments of Hon. Maxwell Kofi Jumah, Hon. Mike Ocquaye, Dr. Nyaho.
swa: AAD inaamini kwamba, yule atafutaye usawa lazima aje na mikono iliyosafi na kwamba udhaifu wa chama cha NPP wa kushindwa kulaani vitendo vya vurugu vya Mkuu wa Mkoa wa Kati –Mhe. Edumadzie, na maoni kama hayo hayo ya Mhe.

eng: Tamakloe, etc. as morally reprehensible and ultimately negates any good intent to uphold the rule of law and to consolidate peace and security in Ghana.
swa: Nyaho, Tamakloe , nk kama yanayomomonyoa maadili na mwishowe kuharibu nia njema yoyote ya kusimika utawala wa sheria na kuimarisha amani na usalama nchini Ghana.

eng: AAD believes that the apology of the Ashanti Regional Minister is an indication of gross remorse and must be accepted in good faith but we however insist that his averments militates against his status as the Regional Minister and the Chairman of the Regional Security Council.
swa: AAD inaamini kwamba kuomba radhi kwa Mkuu wa Mkoa wa Ashanti ni dalili za ukuaji wa dhana ya kuwajibika na lazima ikubaliwe kwa imani njema lakini hata hivyo tunasisitiza kwamba matamshi yake hayo yameidhalilisha hadhi yake kama Mkuu wa Mkoa na Mwenyekiti wa Baraza la Usalama la Mkoa.

eng: We therefore hold the strong view that he must honorably resign or the President must find it necessary to remove him from office.
swa: Kwa hiyo tuna maoni yenye msisitizo kwamba ni lazima ajiuzulu kwa heshima au Rais lazima atambue ni muhimu kumng’oa kutoka kwenye ofisi yake.

eng: During the 2008 General elections, the President was touted as a man of peace ('asomdwehene') and must therefore be committed in working with public officials and appointees who reflect his character and principles.
swa: Wakati wa Uchaguzi Mkuu wa mwaka 2008, Rais alitangazwa kuwa mtu wa amani (“asomdwehene”) na lazima kwa hiyo ajitoe mhanga katika kufanya kazi na maafisa wa umma na wateule wao wanaoakisi tabia na kanuni zake.

eng: Sonia left this comment in response to the AAD press release:
swa: Sonia aliacha maoni kujibu taarifa ya AAD kwa vyombo vya habari:

eng: I have monitored the activities of AAD and have come to the conclusion that their sense of objectivity and insight in national issues must be commended by all well meaning Ghanaians.
swa: Nimefuatlia harakati za AAD na nimehitimisha kwamba mwelekeo wao wa msimamo na uelewa katika masuala ya kitaifa lazima yaungwe mkono na Waghana wote wenye nia njema.

eng: I wish AFAG and all pressure groups learn from the brains behind AAD.
swa: Ninatamani AFAG na makundi yote ya kushinikiza wajifunze kutoka kwenye vichwa makini nyuma ya AAD.

eng: I believe in the point that he who seeks equity must come with clean hands.
swa: Ninaamini katika mantiki kwamba yeye atafutaye usawa lazima aje kwa mikono safi.

eng: The NPP must be bold to condemn their own else they will never be taken seriously.
swa: Na NPP lazima iwe imara kujilaani wao wenyewe vinginevyo hawatachukuliwa kama watu makini.

eng: A month after a seven-point earthquake destroyed much of southern Haiti, the fate of children, and particularly orphans, has become the main story in many corners.
swa: Mwezi mmoja baada ya tetemeko la ardhi lenye ukubwa wa poiti saba kuangamiza sehemu kubwa ya Haiti ya kusini, mustakabali wa watoto, na hasa hasa yatima, umekuwa ni habari kubwa katika kona mbalimbali.

eng: But Haitian voices on the topic have been few.
swa: Lakini sauti za Wahaiti kwenye mada husika zimekuwa chache.

eng: In this long video report posted at Telegraph21, recorded in the days immediately following the quake, managers of two Haitian orphanages speak to the issue in two drastically different ways.
swa: Katika taarifa hii ndefu ya video iliyowekwa kwenye Telegraph21, iliyorekodiwa siku chache baada ya tetememeko, mameneja wa vituo viwili vya watoto yatima nchini Haiti wanazungumzia suala hili katika njia mbili zilizotofauti sana.

eng: At minute 2:30, the manager of an orphanage in an unnamed location in Haiti expresses frustration at the sudden interest in Haitian children, where before there was less concern.
swa: Katika dakika ya 2:30, meneja wa kituo cha yatima katika sehemu isiyotajwa nchini Haiti anaonyesha kuchanganyikiwa kwake kuhusiana na maslahi ya ghafla ya watoto wa Kihaiti, ambapo kabla hayakuangaliwa sana.

eng: Inquiries from foreign families seeking to adopt have become daily.
swa: Maombi kutoka kwenye familia za ughaibuni kuwaasili watoto yamekuwa ya kila siku.

eng: I don't even reply, she says.
swa: “Hata sijibu,” anasema.

eng: Everybody listen, I don't want to receive post-catastrophe requests.
swa: “Kila mmoja asikie, sitaki kupokea maombi ya baada ya janga.”

eng: A counterpart identified as Ledice, however, who cares for sixty children in a different facility, calls for relocating kids faster, and cites a lack of government services to approve adoptions, even those underway before the disaster.
swa: Mshirika mwenza aliyetambulika kama Ledice, hata hivyo, anayewalea watoto sitini katika vituo tofauti, anatoa wito wa kuwahamisha watoto haraka sana, na anaonyesha kutokuwepo kwa huduma za serikali kupitisha maombi ya kuwaasili watoto, hata yale yaliyokuwa yanatazamwa kabla ya janga.

eng: Now it's a humanitarian cause, she says.
swa: “Sasa ni shauri la kibinadamu,” anasema.

eng:
Let's take the kids. 	“Tuwachukue watoto.
We'll see the papers later.
swa: Tutaona makaratasi baadae.”

eng: Much of the recent focus on kids, both mainstream and not, comes from the widely-publicized case of an American church group arrested last week while trying to bring thirty-three kids from Haiti to the Dominican Republic.
swa: Mingi ya mitazamo ya hivi karibuni kwa watoto, ile iliyo rasmi na ile isiyo, inatoka kwenye suala lililotangazwa sana la kikundi cha kanisa cha Kimarekani kukamatwa juma lililopita wakati wakijaribu kuwapeleka watoto thelathini kutoka Haiti kwenda Jamuhuri ya Dominika.

eng: But a broader debate is also underway.
swa: Lakini mjadala mpana zaidi unaendela pia.

eng: Conducive, a group blog that frequently debates international adoption, notes that previous rushes to adopt children out of crisis went awry:
swa: Conducive, blogu ya kikundi ambayo mara nyingi hujadili uasili wa kimataifa wa watoto, inaona kwamba uharaka wa kuasili watoto baada janga ulikwenda mrama:

eng: Removing children during times of disaster is not new.
swa: Kuwahamisha watoto wakati wa majanga si jambo jipya.

eng: We saw this with Operation Babylift after the Vietnam War, where the American government hurriedly removed almost 3,000 children from their homeland during the Fall of Saigon in 1975.
swa: Tuliliona hilo katika operesheni Inuamtoto baada ya Vita ya Vietnam, ambapo serikali ya Marekani kwa haraka sana iliwaondoa watoto 3,000 kutoka nchini mwao wakati wa kuanguka kwa Saigon mwaka 1975.

eng: Lawsuits between birth parents and adopted parents tied up U.S. courts for years.
swa: Kesi za kisheria kati ya wazazi wa kibaolojia na wazazi wa kuasili zilizikabili mahakama za Marekani kwa miaka mingi.

eng: Birth parents claimed they never consented to the adoption, and adoptive parents claimed the adoption was legitimate.
swa: Wazazi wa kibaolojia waliadai hawakuwahi kukubaliana na uasiliwaji wa watoto wao, na wazazi wa kuasili walidai kwamba uasiliwaji huo ulikuwa wa halali.

eng: Critical adoption theorists are seeing parallels with the current rushed adoption of Haitian children.
swa: Wanadharia wanaopinga uasiliwaji wa watoto wanaona mengi yanayofanana na uasiliwaji huu wa haraka haraka kwa watoto wa Haiti.

eng: In a post titled Orphans, Orphans, Orphans!, ResistRacism is more specific:
swa: Katika posti yenye kichwa cha habari Yatima, Yatima, Yatima!, mwanablogu ResistRacism yu mahususi zaidi:

eng: How many prospective adoptive parents have been trained in cross cultural and transracial adoption issues?
swa: Wazazi watarajiwa wangapi wameshapata mafunzo kuhusiana na masuala ya kuasili watoto wa tamaduni na rangi tofauti?

eng: (The same parent referenced above wonders about black hair care.
swa: (Mzazi huyo huyo aliyezungumziwa hapo juu anajiuliza kuhusu namna ya kutunza nywele za mtu mweusi.

eng: Now that she’s receiving the child.
swa: Hivi sasa anapopokea mtoto.

eng: Do you think she thought about other issues of race and culture?)
swa: Unafikiri alitafakari masuala mengine kuhusu rangi na utamaduni?)

eng: (Don’t even get me started about trauma issues.
swa: (Wala usinifanye nianze kuhusu majeraha ya kisaikolojia.

eng: That’s too big to even cover.
swa: Hilo ni kubwa sana kulizungumzia.

eng: But I’m of the opinion that the average individual isn’t equipped to handle extensive trauma in a child.)
swa: Lakini nina mawazo kuwa mtu wa kawaida hajaandaliwa kukabili athari kubwa za kisaikolojia kwa mtoto.)

eng: Why aren’t agencies soliciting prospective parents of Haitian descent?
swa: Kwa nini mashirika hayo yasiwahamasishe wazazi watarajiwa wenye asili ya Haiti?

eng: Folks with experience treating trauma?
swa: Watu wenye uzoefu na namna ya kushughulikia majeraha ya kisaikolojia?

eng: The same post suggests a more creative solution.
swa: Posti hiyo hiyo inapendekeza utatuzi wa kibunifu zaidi.

eng: Here’s a radical thought: If some of those “orphans” were relinquished for adoption because their parents could not keep them, how about we airlift entire families from Haiti to the U.S.?
swa: Hapa kuna wazo fikirishi: Kama baadhi ya ‘yatima’ walitolewa kwa uasiliwaji kwa sababu wazazi wao hawawezi kuwatunza, vipi kuhusu kusafirisha familia nzima kutoka Haiti kwenda Marekani?

eng: If you’re seriously talking about the welfare of the child, isn’t it best for the family to remain together?
swa: Kama unazungumzia kwa kumaanisha kuhusu ustawi wa motto, je si vyema zaidi kwa familia nzima kuwa pamoja?

eng: But that wouldn’t serve the needs of those other families.
swa: Lakini hiyo haitafaa kwa matakwa ya familia hizo nyingine.

eng: You know, those good families who wish to save the orphans.
swa: Unajua, familia zile zinazotaka kuwasaidia yatima.

eng: Renewed attention to Haiti's Restavec (sometimes Restavek) system has also become an issue.
swa: Mkazo mpya kwa mfumo ya Kihaiti wa Restavek imekuwa suala la mjadala.

eng: In a post from before the quake, Repeating Islands says the system, "through which parents unable to support their children send them to live with more affluent relatives or strangers for whom they receive food, shelter and education in return for work" has become tantamount to slavery.
swa: Katika posti iliyotoka kabla ya tetemeko, mwanablogu wa Repeating Islands anasema mfumo, “ambao kupitia kwa huo wazazi wanaoshindwa kuwatunza watoto wao huwapeleka kusihi na ndugu wenye ahueni au wageni ambako hupata chakula na, malazi na elimu kama malipo kwa kazi wanayofanya” umekuwa kama aina ya utumwa.

eng: She quotes a United Nations investigator who visited Haiti last year to investigate the Restivek issue, saying
swa: Anamnukuu mchunguzi wa Umoja wa Mataifa ambae alitembelea Haiti mwakauliopita kuchunguza suala hilo la Restivek, akisema

eng: ...Although placement with children with other family members has long been a practice in Haiti, nowadays 'paid recruiters scour the country looking for children to traffic both within and outside Haiti.
swa: …Ingawa kuwaweka watoto pamoja na wanafamilia nyingine ni mazoea ya siku nyingi nchini Haiti, siku hizi ‘waandikishaji wanaolipwa huzunguka nchi wakitafuta watoto kwa ajili ya kuwasafirisha ndani na nje ya nchi ya Haiti.

eng: This practice is a severe violation of the most fundamental rights of the child.'
swa: Kitendohiki ni ukiukwaji mkubwa wa haki za msingi za mtoto.'

eng: Most international agencies involved in crisis childcare have, in the past two weeks, stated opposition to rapid adoptions in Haiti.
swa: Mashirika mengi ya Kimataifa yanayojihusisha na kuwatunza watoto walio kwenye mazingira magumu, katika majuma mawili yaliyopita, yametoa tamko la kupinga uasiliwaji huu wa haraka nchini Haiti.

eng: The International Committee of the Red Cross, in a statement presented as an interview with one of its child protection officers, said it believed efforts to connect children with family members in Haiti should receive priority, and adoption a last resort.
swa: Kamati ya Kimataifa ya shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu, katika tamko lililoweka kama mahojiano na mmoja wa maofisa wake wa matunzo ya mtoto, ilisema kwamba inaamini kwamba jitihada za kuwaunganisha watoto na familia zao nchini Haiti ni lazima zipewe kipaumbele, na kuasili watoto iwe ni hatua ya mwisho kabisa.

eng: ...In situations where a child is evacuated, there are clear procedures to follow: the child should be accompanied by a relative or someone who knows them, if possible; the details of the child must be registered and their family must know where the child is taken to and by whom.
swa: ...Katika hali ambayo mtoto anahamishwa, zipo hatua za kufuata: mtoto lazim afuatane na ndugu yake au mtu anayemfahamu, ikiwezekana; taarifa za kina za mtoto lazima ziandikishwe na familia zao lazima zijue wapi mtoto amepelekwa na nani.

eng: Unfortunately some children were evacuated in haste without all their details being recorded.
swa: Kwa bahati mbaya watoto wengine walichukuliwa kwa haraka bila taarifa zote za kina kuandikwa.

eng: Aid groups including Save the Children, World Vision and the Red Cross Disaster Fund (which is separate from the International Committee), issued a joint statement also opposing evacuations and adoptions.
swa: Makundi ya kutoa msaada pamoja na Save the Children, World Visison na Mfuko wa Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu wa majanga (ambalo ni tofauti na Kamati ya Kimataifa), yalitoa tamko la pamoja kupinga kuchukuliwa kwa watoto pamoja na kuwaasili.

eng: So did UNICEF.
swa: UNICEF nayo ilifanya hivyo.

eng: So what's the controversy?
swa: Kwa hiyo mkanganyiko ni upi?

eng: The case of the children stopped at the border involved a Protestant church adoption group, some of which have advocated international adoption as a means of spreading their own religious views.
swa: Suala la watoto kuzuiliwa mpakani likihusisha kukindi cha kuasili cha Kanisa la Protestanti, baadhi yao wakiwa wametumia uasili wa kimataifa kama namna ya kusambaza maoni yao ya kidini.

eng: Other evangelist Christian blogs are more careful.
swa: Blogu nyingine za wakristo wa Kiinjili zimekuwa makini zaidi.

eng: Christianity Today, "A Magazine of Evangelical Conviction" opposed quick international adoptions:
swa: Ukristo Leo, “Gazeti la Vuguvugu la Kiinjili” lilipinga uasili huo wa haraka wa kimataifa:

eng: In the initial months after an incident like this, we don't want to move children away from the area where family members are searching for them.
swa: Katika hatua za miezi ya mwanzo baada ya tukio kama hili, hatutaki kuwasafirisha waotot mbali na maeneo yao ambako wanafamilia wao wanawatafuta.

eng: After the Southeast Asian tsunami in 2004, there were many small kids virtually unidentifiable, and yet a very high percentage of those children, thanks to DNA testing and other methods, were eventually returned to family members.
swa: Baada ya tukio la tsunami la Asia ya kusini mashariki mwaka 2004, kulikuwa na watoto wengi wadogo wasiotambulika, na bado asilimia kubwa ya watoto hao, shukrani kwa vipimo vya Vinasaba (DNA) na njia nyingine, walirudishwa kwenye familia zao.

eng: With phone lines being restored in Haiti, money sent from families abroad "by wire" is again arriving, and helping reconstruction even where international aid has not arrived.
swa: Huku simu zikiwa zinaanza kufanya kazi tena nchini Haiti, pesa zinazotumwa na ndugu walio nje ya nchi “kwa waya” zinaanza kuwasili tena, na kusaidia ujenzi hata kule ambako mashirika ya kimataifa bado hayajafika.

eng: Remittances from family members living abroad represented at least thirty percent of Haiti's Gross National Product before the January 12 earthquake.
swa: Pesa zinazotumwa na wanafamilia wanaoishi nje ya nchi, kwa uchache, zilikuwa kama asilimia thelathini ya Mapato ya Taifa ya Haiti kabla ya tetemeko la ardhi la Januari 12.

eng: The two largest Haitian communities outside Haiti are those in the Dominican Republic and the United States.
swa: Jamii kubwa mbili za kiHaiti zilizo nje ya nchi hiyo ni zile za katika Jamhuri ya Dominika na Marekani.

eng: Between 400 thousand and 600 thousand Haitian citizens call each of the neighboring nations home.
swa: Kati ya Wahaiti laki 4 na laki 6 wanaishi katika mataifa hayo jirani.

eng: Another 80-100 thousand live in other Caribbean nations or in France.
swa: Wengine 80 elfu – laki 1 wanaishi katika mataifa mengine ya Karibea au Ufaransa.

eng: This chart from the Inter-American Development bank, based on a 2006 study, claims that Haitians living in the United States sent nearly $1.9 billion home annually.
swa: Jedwali hili kutoka Benki ya Maendeleo ya Mataifa ya Marekani, ambalo linatoka kwenye utafiti wa mwaka 2006, linadai kuwa Wahaiti wanaoishi Marekani walituma Karibu ya dola bilioni 1.9 za Kimarekani kiola mwaka kwenda nyumbani.

eng: The collapse of telephone service and, in some cases the buildings that housed banks and remittance offices, had temporarily cut off that money.
swa: Kuanguka kwa mfumo wa huduma za simu, na katika kesi nyingine majengo yalikuwa na ofisi za benki au huduma za kutuma pesa, kulikata njia ya pesa.

eng: But this week long lines were visible outside money transfer offices, such as this CAM office in Carrefour, southeast of Port au Prince, photographed by GV's Georgia Poppelwell.
swa: Lakini wiki hii foleni ndefu zilionekana nje ya ofisi za kutuma na kupokea pesa, kama vile katika ofisi hii ya CAM katika Carrefour, kusini-mashariki ya Port au Prince, kama ilivyopigwa picha na Georgia Poppelwell.

eng: Though the capital has received the bulk of media attention, it's not necessarily where the money sent by family members abroad will arrive.
swa: Japokuwa mji mkuu uliangaliwa zaidi na vyombo vya habari, pesa zinazotumwa na wanafamilia si lazima ziwasili hapo.

eng: The International Association of Money Transfer Networks, an industry association which represents companies that carry electronic money transfers, says that about half the funds wired to Haiti from the US, the largest source of remittances, is sent to rural areas.
swa: Jumuiya ya Kimataifa ya Mitandao ya Kutuma na Kupokea Pesa, jumuiya ambayo inawakilisha makampuni yayosafirisha pesa kwa njia ya umeme (au waya) inasema kuwa Karibu ya nusu ya fedha zilizotumwa kwenda Haiti kutokea Marekani, ambayo ni chanzo kikubwa cha pesa zinazotumwa, zilitumwa kwenda vijijini.

eng: That's significant because those areas are also seeing an increase in population, as people displaced by the quake go to live with family and friends in hometowns and less-damaged areas.
swa: Hilo ni jambo muhimu kwani maeneo hayo yamekuwa na ongezeko la watu, kwani watu waliopoteza makazi kutokana na tetemeko la ardhi wanakwenda kuishi na familia pamoja na marafiki katika miji waliyotoka na sehemu ambazo hazikuharibika sana.

eng: Dilip Ratha, a World Bank economist, argues at the bank's blog that remittances could hold a more important role with the emergency extension of "temporary protected" immigration status ("TPS) to as many as 200 thousand Haitians living in the US.
swa: Dilip Ratha, Mchumi wa Benki ya Dunia, anadai kwenye blogu ya benki hiyo kuwa pesa zinazotumwa zinaweza kufanya kazi muhimu pamoja na ile hadhi ya uhamiaji ya dharura iliyoongezwa ya “kinga ya muda” (TPS) kwa Wahaiti laki 2 wanaoishi nchini Marekani .

eng: If the TPS resulted in a 20 percent increase in the average remittance per migrant, we would expect an additional $360 million remittance flows to Haiti in 2010!
swa: Ikiwa TPS imepelekea ongezeko la asilimia 20 kwa wastani wa pesa zinazotumwa na kila mhamiaji, tunaweza kutarajia ongezeko la dola 360 za pesa zinazotumwa kwenda Haiti katika 2010.

eng: What is more, if the TPS were to be extended once beyond the currently stipulated 18 months – the extension is almost certain to happen, judging by the history of extensions of the TPS for El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua, Somalia and Sudan – additional fund flows to Haiti would exceed a billion dollar over three years.
swa: Na zaidi ya hilo, kama hadhi ya TPS itaongezwa muda wa zaidi ya miezi 18 ambayo imewekwa sasa – kuna uwezekano mkubwa wa kuongezwa muda wa (TPS) tukiangalia historia ya kuongezwa muda wa TPS kwa ajili ya El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua, Somalia na Sudani – ziada katika fedha zinazotumwa nchini Haiti itavuka dola bilioni katika miaka mitatu.

eng: That would be a billion dollar of financial help coupled with goodwill and advice, tailored to the needs of the recipient.
swa: Huo utakuwa msaada wa fedha wa dola bilioni moja ambao umeambatana na imani pamoja na ushauri, kadri ya mahitaji ya mpokeaji.

eng: Financial help in the form of remittances from family members abroad is always the first to arrive in times of distress.
swa: Misaada ya fedha yaani zile zinazotumwa na ndugu walio nje ya nchi huwa ni ya kwanza kuwasili wakati wa shida.

eng: Remittances to Haiti this year will surge, as they have done whenever and wherever there has been a crisis or natural disaster
swa: Pesa zinazotumwa na ndugu na marafiki kwenda Haiti zitaongezeka mwaka huu, kama ambavyo imewahi kutokea kila wakati na kila sehemu zilizopatwa na majanga.

eng: Image courtesy http://twitpic.com/photos/abhi_bol
swa: Picha kwa hisani ya http://twitpic.com/photos/abhi_bol

eng: At around 7:30 pm on Saturday (February 13, 2010) a bomb blast at a restaurant popular with tourists in India's western city of Pune killed 9 people and left 57 people injured.
swa: Mnamo majira ya saa 1:30 jioni (Februari 13, 2010) mlipuko wa bomu uliua watu 9 na kuwajeruhi wengine 57 katika mgahawa maarufu kwa watalii uliopo katika mji wa Magharibi wa Pune, India.

eng: The bomb was in a backpack and it exploded when an waiter tried to inspect the left luggage.
swa: Bomu hilo lilikuwa katika mkoba wa mgongoni na lililipuka wakati mhudumu alipojaribu kukagua mzigo huo.

eng: Shashi Bellamkonda at My Digital Thoughts reports:
swa: Shashi Bellamkonda anaripoti katika My Digital Thoughts:

eng: A few hours ago (Feb 13th 2010) a bomb went off popular cafe ‘German Bakery” in Pune India.
swa: Masaa machache yaliyopita (tarehe 13 Februari, 2010) bomu lililipuka katika mgahawa wa ‘Tanuri la Ujerumani’ mjini Pune, India.

eng: At the time of posting this the press were reporting that 8 people had died and about 40 injured in this blast which left the bodies charred beyond recognition.
swa: Wakati wa kutuma makala hii vyombo vya habari vilikuwa vinaripoti kuwa watu 8 wamefariki na wengine 40 wamejeruhiwa katika mlipuko huo ambao uliiacha miili ikiwa imekatwakatwa na haitambuliki.

eng: The bakery is a popular spot with foreign tourists.
swa: Tanuri hilo la mikate ni maarufu kwa watalii kutoka nje.

eng: Shashi has also these observations:
swa: Kadhalika Shashi alibaini haya yafuatayo:

eng: The blast area is near the Osho Ashram frequented by tourists another similarity to the Mumbai 2008 blasts.
swa: • Eneo la mlipuko lipo karibu na eneo la utawa la Osho linalitembelewa sana na watalii, jambo ambalo linafanana na mlipuko wa Mumbai.

eng: Pragmatic Euphony warns:
swa: Pragmatic Euphony anaonya:

eng: The jehadis have struck again on the Indian mainland; this time in Pune, albeit more than a year after the horrendous terror attacks on Mumbai in November 2008.
swa: Wana-jihadi wameshambulia tena ndani ya bara Hindi; hivi sasa huko Pune, japokuwa ni zaidi ya mwaka mmoja baada ya mashambulizi mabaya ya kigaidi mjini Mumbai ya mwezi Novemba 2008.

eng: The initial response, while going with the most plausible and popular assumption that the blast was the handiwork of Pakistan based jehadi groups, is one of indignation.
swa: Hisia za awali, wakati tukifuata dhana maarufu inayowezekana ya kwamba mlipuko huo ulikuwa ni kazi ya makundi ya jihadi yenye makazi nchini Pakistani, ni hisia za hasira.

eng: Perhaps understandably so as tempers are bound to run high.
swa: Pengine inaweza kueleweka kwa nini jazba zinaweza kupanda sana.

eng: And this emotion is likely to be further amplified as the Indian mainstream media hyperventilates and virtually runs amok with its over the top coverage of the incident.
swa: Nahisia hizi zinaweza kuongezeka zaidi kwa vile vyombo vikuu vya habari vya India vinahaha na kukimbia kila mahali na matangazo yake yaliyokithiri ya tukio hilo.

eng: People are already finding links to Pakistan.
swa: Watu tayari wameshaanza kugundua uhusiano (wa tukio hilo) na Pakistani.

eng: Offstumped informs that the Pune blast followed a Laskar-e-Taiba threat.
swa: Offstumped anataarifu kuwa mlipuko wa Pune ulifuatia vitisho vya Laskar-e-Taiba.

eng: A top leader of the Lashkar-e-Taiba named Pune as a target city at a permitted public rally in Pakistan.
swa: Kiongozi wa juu wa Lashkar-e-Taiba aliitaja Pune kama mji unaolengwa katika maandamano ya umma yaliyoruhusiwa huko Pakistani.

eng: A two-day event which began yesterday; is being organized by the Danquah Institute (DI), a policy think tank, research and analysis centre, to create a national platform for stakeholders to lead the discussion on the possibility of facilitating the adoption of biometric voter registration, and subsequently the e-voting system in Ghana.
swa: Tukio la siku mbili lililoanza jana; linaratibiwa na Taasisi ya Danquah (DI), kituo cha kutafakari sera, utafiti na uchambuzi, kutengeneza jukwaa la kitaifa kwa washikadau kuongoza majadiliano kuhusu uwezekano wa uanzishwaji wa kuandikisha wapiga kura kwa njia za vipimo vya kibaiolojia na hatimaye mfumo wa upigaji kura kwa njia ya mtandao nchini Ghana.

eng: The Danquah Institute has hailed the successful conclusion of electronic voting in the world's largest democracy and called on Ghana's Electoral Commission to consider the numerous benefits of electronic voting as demonstrated in this latest poll.
swa: Taasisi ya Danquah kimesifu mafanikio makubwa ya matumizi ya mtandao kwa upigaji kura katika nchi ya demokrasi kubwa zaidi duniani na kutoa wito kwa Tume ya Uchaguzi ya Ghana kuangalia faida nyingi za kupiga kura kwa njia ya mtandao kama iliovyooneshwa kwenye uchaguzi wa hivi karibuni.

eng: According to Honorable Haruna Iddrisu, Minister of Communication,

eng: even though the implementation of both the biometric voter registration which is been handled by the National Identification Authority and e-Voting were practicable in the long term, they could not be introduced anytime soon”.

All political parties have endorsed biometric registration, which is prelude to e-voting and what we are doing here today will help to shape our electoral process in the future, but we do not have the requisite infrastructure for a speedy implementation of the all important projects in the short term”. 	“Vyama vyote vya siasa vimesisitiza uandikishaji kwa njia za vipimo vya kibaiolojia, ambao ni mwanzo wa upigaji kura wa mtandoni na tunachofanya hapa leo kitatusaidia kurekebisha mchakato wa uchaguzi katika siku zijazo, lakini hatuna miundo mbinu inayohitajika kwa utekelezaji wa kasi wa miradi yote muhimu katika kipindi kifupi”.
Therefore, government should still research more into its implementation by 2016 and not 2012. 	Kwa hiyo, serikali ni lazima iendelee kutafiti zaidi kwenye utekelezaji wake ifikapo mwaka 2016 na sio mwaka 2012.

eng: Dr Afari-Gyan said even developed countries such as Britain, Canada and Australia had not subscribed to e-voting and wondered why Nigeria and Kenya wanted to go e-voting.
