eng: Lauren, an American who formerly lived in Kampala, remembers taking friends to visit the tombs:
swa: Lauren, Mmarekani ambaye aliwahi kuishi Kampala, anakumbuka jinsi aliwapeleka wageni kutembelea makaburi hayo:

eng: The Kasubi Tombs are more than important cultural and historic structures to me.
swa: Makaburi ya Kasubi kwangu ni zaidi ya majengo muhimu ya utamaduni na historia.

eng: When we lived in Uganda, they were my neighbors.
swa: Wakati tulipokuwa tunaishi Uganda, yalikuwa jirani zangu.

eng: Our apartment was at the bottom of Kasubi Hill, and we passed the Tombs every day to and from downtown Kampala.
swa: Nyumba yetu ilikuwa chini ya bonde la kasubi, tuliyapita Makaburi hayo kila siku tukienda na kurudi kutoka Kampala mjini.

eng: We took numerous visitors to see the tombs to learn more about the Buganda tribe, its history and culture.
swa: Tuliwapek\leka wageni wengi kuyaangalia Makaburi hayo na kujifunza zaidi juu ya kabila la Buganda, historian a utamaduni wake.

eng: I always loved passing the guards of the Tombs; dressed in the traditional saffron-colored robe and leaning against the big tree out front, they waited patiently to greet the next set of visitors.
swa: Siku zote nilipenda kupita mbele ya walinzi wa makaburi; waliovalia mavazi ya kitamaduni ya rangi ya chungwa iliyokoza na kuegemea mti mkubwa ulikuwa mbele, walisubiri bila kuchoka ili kusalimu wageni wanaofuatia.

eng: The Kasubi Tombs in October 2008.
swa: Makaburi ya Kasubi Oktoba 2008.

eng: Photo courtesy of Lauren.
swa: Picha kwa hisani ya Lauren

eng: Santiago After the Earthquake by pviojo CC-By
swa: Santiago baada ya tetemeko la ardhi na pviojo CC-By

eng: As the day comes to a close, more videos crop up of the devastating 8.8 magnitude earthquake that hit Chile at 3:30 am.
swa: Wakati siku inakaribia kuisha, video zaidi za tetemeko la ardhi lenye ukubwa wa 8.8 ambalo liliikumba Chile majira ya saa 9.30 usiku zinajitokeza.

eng: The earthquake, which not only affected the mainland through the ground movements, also generated tsunami waves that set out an alarm throughout the Pacific as different nations prepared for the waves to hit their shores.
swa: Tetemeko hilo, ambalo halikuathiri maeneo ya bara pekee kwa njia ya kusogea sogea kwa ardhi, kadhalika lilisababisha mawimbi ya tsunami mabyo yalizua tahadhari katika eneo zima la Pasifiki huku mataifa mbalimbali yakijiandaa kwa mawimbi hayo pindi yatakapofika kwenye fukwe zao.

eng: Some videos were made during the earthquake itself, as this amateur video found on YouTube.
swa: Kuna video zilizotengenezwa wakati wa tetemeko lenyewe, kama vile video hii ya ridhaa iliyokutwa kwenye YouTube.

eng: It starts with a shot of a computer in a room, and as the earth moves the rumble of the earth can be heard, then the lights go out and we are left in the dark, hearing only the voices of a woman and a man we assume to be the one holding the camera trying to calm her down.
swa: Inaanza kwa picha ya kompyuta kwenye chumba, na wakati ardhi ilivyokuwa ikisogea mingurumo ya ardhi inaweza kusikika, halafu taa zilizimikana tunaachwa kwenye giza, na kusikia sauti pekee ya mwanamke na mwanaume ambaye tunadhani ndio aliyekuwa amebeba kamera akijaribu kumtuliza.

eng: As daylight came, more people went out to the streets and recorded the damage they observed: Netprox drove through the highway, and had to squeeze under a fallen bridge to get through.
swa: Wakati mwanga wa asubuhi ulipotoka, watu zaidi walielekea mitaani na kurekodi madhara waliyoyaona:

eng: Rafael Vial also went out to the streets and recorded a collapsed bridge in Llaillay, Chile, which he streamed through his mobile phone on Qik.
swa: Rafael Vial pia alikwenda mitaani na kurekodi daraja lililoanguka huko Llaillay, Chile, amblo alilionyesha kwa kupitia simu yake ya mkononi katika Qik.

eng: At the exact moment of this post's publication, over 1,735,000 people had already signed a petition supporting the Ficha Limpa (No Criminal Record) bill, which seeks to prevent politicians who have committed serious crimes, such as misuse of public funds, corruption, murder and drug trafficking, from running in elections.
swa: Wakati ambapo makala haya yanakwenda mitamboni, karibu watu 1,735,000 walikwishatia saini kuunga mkono muswada wa sheria inayojulikana kama Ficha Limpa (yaani Mtu Safi au Mtu Asiye na Rekodi ya Uhalifu), na sheria hiyo inakusudia kuwazuia wanasiasa ambao wametenda makosa makubwa ya jinai kama vile matumizi mabaya ya fedha za umma, ufisadi, mauaji na kujihusisha na biashara ya dawa za kulevya ili kwamba wasipate fursa ya kugombea nafasi yoyote ya kuchaguliwa.

eng: It may be hard for the international reader to understand why a law is needed to regulate something like this, but in Brazil, there are a good number of politicians in office with a criminal record.
swa: Pengine itakuwa vigumu kwa mtu wa kutoka taifa lingine kuelewa kwa nini ni muhimu kuwekea sheria jambo la namna hii, hasa kwa kuzingatia kwamba kuna idadi kubwa tu ya wanasiasa wenye rekodi za uhalifu na walio madarakani.

eng: For example, the Congressional Deputy Paulo Maluf, whose name recently made it to the wanted list of Interpol, for conspiracy and appropriation of public funds.
swa: Kwa mfano, Makamu wa Kongresi, Paulo Maluf, ambaye hivi karibuni jina lake limetokea katika orodha ya watu wanaotafutwa na Polisi wa Kimataifa (Interpol), kwa ajili ya kula njama na kutumia vibaya fedha za umma.

eng: (Malufar is a neologism invented by Brazilians, a verb meaning "to steal public money".)
swa: (Malufar ni neno lililobuniwa na raia wa Brazili kumaanisha kitendo cha "kuiba fedha za umma".)

eng: The goal of the campaign, which included Avaaz.org in recent weeks, was to gather 2 million signatures before today Wednesday April 7, the day the project is to be decided on in the Chamber of Deputies.
swa: Lengo la kampeni hiyo, ambayo katika majuma ya karibuni ilijumuisha Avaaz.org, ilikuwa kupata sahihi zipatazo milioni 2 kabla ya tarehe 7 Aprili, yaani katika siku ambapo mradi huo hauna budi kutolewa uamuzi katika Chemba cha Wasaidizi.

eng: If approved in the Chamber, the bill goes to the Senate.
swa: Kama jambo hili litapitishwa katika Chemba hiyo basi muswada utapelekwa katika Seneti.

eng: With the tagline "A vote has no price, it has consequences", the Ficha Limpa campaign was launched in April 2008 by the Movimento de Combate à Corrupção Eleitoral with the goal to improve the profile of candidates running for office in the country:
swa: Huku ikiwa na kauli mbiu inayosema "Kura haina bei, ila inaweza kuleta mabadiliko", Kampeni ya Ficha Limpa ilizinduliwa mwezi Aprili mwaka 2008 na Movimento de Combate à Corrupção Eleitoral kwa lengo la kupata wagombea nafasi za kuchaguliwa wengi walio na rekodi safi:

eng: Calling for “national unity” in Concepcion’s main square on March 27, exactly a month after the devastating earthquake that hit Chile, President Sebastián Piñera announced “Plan Manos a la Obra” (Plan "Let's Get to Work") , an initiative of the Chilean government to reconstruct the country’s infrastructure and housing.
swa: Akihimiza "Umoja wa kitaifa" katika viwanja vya wazi vya Concepcion mnamo tarehe 27 Machi, mwezi mmoja kamili baada ya nchi kupigwa na tetemeko baya kabisa, Rais Sebastián Piñera alitangaza Mpango uliobatizwa jina la "Hebu Turejee kwenye Kazi" (“Manos a la Obra”) , ambalo ni vuguvugu lililoanzishwa na Serikali ya Chile ili kujenga mpya miundombinu ya nchi pamoja na majengo.

eng: Two days later, on March 29, Piñera also announced a plan to provide a subsidy of US$2,543 each to assist 195,950 families.
swa: Siku mbili baadaye, tarehe 29 Machi, Piñera pia alitangaza mpango wa kutoa ruzuku ya dola za Marekani 2,543 ili kuzisaidia familia zipatazo 195,950.

eng: In Concepcion, he explained that the necessary measures to reconstruct bridges, roads, ports, and airports were already underway.
swa: Huko Concepcion, Rais alieleza kwamba hatua za muhimu zilikuwa zimekwishaanza kuchukuliwa ili kujenga upaya madaraja, barabara, bandari na viwanja vya ndege.

eng: He also announced that emergency health posts will correct the deficiencies of the health care system starting in April, and that emergency ferries and bridges in the Bio-Bio River will allow for the transport of heavy loads of materials and supplies to San Pedro de la Paz and Talcahuano.
swa: Pia alitangaza kwamba vituo vya dharura vya afya vitasaidia kazi za mfumo mzima wa afya kuanzia mwezi Aprili, na kwamba feri na madaraja ya dharura kuvuka Mto Bio-Bio utasaidia katika usafirishaji wa mizigo mizito na vifaa kwenda San Pedro de la Paz na Talcahuano.

eng: Finally, the President highlighted a special fund that will distribute $8 billion Chilean pesos (US $15,107,160) through vouchers given to more than 200.000 families to provide them with construction materials.
swa: Hatimaye, Rais alieleza kwamba kutakuwa na mfuko maalumu ambao utagawanya jumla ya peso bilioni 8 (sawa na dola za Marekani milioni 15,107,160) kwa kupitia vocha maalumu zitakazogawanywa kwa familia zipatazo 200,000 ili ziweze kununua vifaa vya ujenzi.

eng: Julio Segovia, a reader of the La Nación newspaper article that informed about this announcement, criticized the special fund for housing:
swa: Julio Segovia, ambaye ni msomaji wa makala iliyochapishwa na gazeti la La Nación na ambayo ndiyo ilibeba tangazo hilo la mfuko huo maalumu, alikosoa mfuko huo maalumu wa nyuma akisema:

eng: Colombian Presidential candidate Antanas Mockus, of the Green Party , sealed an alliance with the Medellín's ex-Mayor, Sergio Fajardo, who will be his Vice-Presidential running mate for the May 30, 2010 elections.
swa: Mgombea urais wa Kolombia Antanas Mockus, wa Chama cha Kijani , ametia muhuri ushirika na aliyekuwa Meya wa Medellín, Sergio Fajardo, ambaye atakuwa mgombea mwenza wake wa nafasi ya Makamu wa Rais kwenye Uchaguzi wa Tarehe 30 Mei mwaka 2010.

eng: Both men were mayors of Colombian's two largest cities, Bogotá and Medellín, respectively.
swa: Wote wamewahi kuwa mameya wa majiji makubwa ya Kolombia, Bogotá na Medellín.

eng: Many Colombians believe that they led transparent administrations during their time as Mayors.
swa: Wakolombia wengi wanaamini kuwa walikuwa na utawala wa uwazi wakati wa enzi zao kama mameya.

eng: This alliance has been met with approval by many Colombians, as demonstrated in opinion polls.
swa: Muungano huu umekubalika na Wakolombia wengi, kama ilivyonekana kwenye kura za maoni.

eng: However, the virtual world in blogs is also not alien from this.
swa: Hata hivyo, ulimwengu wa kublogu nao hauko mbali katika hilo.

eng: Here are some reflections on how this alliance is seen online.
swa: Hapa ni baadi ya maoni yanayoakisi ni kwa jinsi gani muungano huu unaonekana mtandaoni.

eng: Photo of Antanas Mockus by Gó Me Z and used unde a Creative Commons license.
swa: Picha ya Antanas Mockus na Gó Me Z na imetumika kwa kibali cha Creative Commons.

eng: To begin, Álvaro Ramírez in the digital magazine EquinoXio writes about the importance of working as a team:
swa: Kwa kuanza, Álvaro Ramírez katika gazeti la kidijitali EquinoXio anaandika kuhusu umuhimu wa kufanya kazi kama timu:

eng: The Laguna del Tigre National Park - a critical reservoir of wetlands and tropical dry forest habitats - is currently threatened by human encroachment, out-of-control fires, and oil exploitation.
swa: Hifadhi ya Taifa ya Laguna del Tigre – hifadhi muhimu ya nchi nyevu na nchi misitu ya kavu ya kitropiki – kwa sasa inatishiwa sana na uvamizi wa binadamu, mlipuko ya moto isiyoweza kudhibitiwa, na uchimbaji wa mafuta.

eng: While the 25-year contract expired, the company Perenco Guatemala LTD is seeking its renewal, but environmentalists and activists are opposing to it strongly, organizing campaigns on Facebook and other websites.
swa: Wakati mkataba wa miaka 25 umekwisha, kampuni ya Perenco Guatemala LTD inaomba tena mkataba huo, lakini wanamazingira na wanaharakati wanapinga vikali, wakiandaa kampeni hizo kwenye Facebook na tovuti nyingine.

eng: On behalf of Guatemala, the The International Commission of Jurists (ICJ) for Guatemala with the representation of the Environmental and Social Legal Action Center (CALAS for its initials in Spanish), filed an Environmental Submission before the Secretariat for Environmental Matters stating that the country is failing in the implementation of its protected areas and not respecting the laws with the extension of the 2-85 contract for oil operations in the Laguna del Tigre National Park in the Mayan Biosphere Reserve.
swa: Kwa niaba ya Guatemala, Kamati ya Kimataifa ya Wanasheria (ICJ) kwa ajili ya Guatemala ikiwa na wawakilishi kutoka Kituo cha Msaada wa Sheria za Mazingira na Jamii (CALAS kifupisho chake kwa Kihispania), wamewasilisha maoni yao juu ya mazingira mbele ya Sekretarieti ya Mambo ya Mazingira wakieleza kuwa nchi inashindwa kutekeleza mpango wa kulinda maeneo na haiheshimu sheria kwa kurefusha mkataba wa uchimbaji mafuta 2-85 huko Hifadhi ya Haifa ya Laguna del Tigre kwenye hifadhi ya viumbe hai ya Maya.

eng: Photo by MikeMurga and used under a CC license.
swa: Picha na MikeMurga kwa kibali cha CC.

eng: In other words, many are concerned about the destruction of the homes of many living creatures, as explained by the blog Guatemalan Birdwatching :
swa: Kwa maneno mengine, wengi wanaguswa na uharibifu huo wa makazi ya viumbe hai wengi, kama ilivyoelezwa na blogu ya Guatemalan Birdwatching :

eng: Guatemala has like 19 ecosystems, 300 microclimates, more than 37 volcanoes, rivers, lakes and beaches that are united in our ethnic diversity forming a destination of mystical magic and adventure.
swa: Guatemala ina maeneo19 ya uoto asilia, 300 yenye hali ya hewa tofauti, zaidi ya maeneo ya volkeno 37, mito, maziwa na fukwe ambavyo vinaungana na utofauti wetu wa makabila na kuifanya nchi hii kuwa ya ajabu na ya kupendeza.

eng: Biological diversity has enabled Guatemala to stand among the 25 countries with the most variety of natural resources in the world.
swa: Uwepo wa viumbe hai wengi tofauti umeiwezesha Guatemala kusimama kati ya nchi 25 zenye aina nyingi zaidi za hifadhi asilia duniani.

eng: Millions of species living in its varied ecosystems, more than 700 species of birds, mammals like the jaguar, tapir and a variety of reptiles and insects.
swa: Mamilioni ya aina mabalimbali ya viumbe wakiishi katika mazingira mbalimbali, zaidi ya aina 700 za ndege, mamalia kama Jaguar, tapir na aina nyingi za reptilia na wadudu.

eng: Savia, a school for learning how to respect and protect the planet created a video, where the story of the Laguna del Tigre is told and why they feel it is important to protect it (with English subtitles).
swa: Savia, shule ya kufunza kuheshimu na kuilinda sayari hii imetengeneza video, ambayo inatoa hadithi ya Laguna del Tigre na kueleza kwanini ni muhimu kulilinda eneo hilo (yenye vidokevya vya maandishi ya kiingereza).

eng: It is still uncertain whether he will extend the contract to the oil company, which may go against the will of members of his own Cabinet, as is the case with Luis Ferraté, the Minister of the Environment who is not in favor of extending the contract.
swa: Bado haijajulikana iwapo ataamua kurefusha mkataba wa kampuni ya kuchimba mafuta, kitu ambacho kitakuwa kinyume cha matakwa ya baraza lake la mawaziri, hasa kwa waziri wa mazingira Luis Ferraté, ambaye anapinga kabisa urefushwaji wa mkataba huo.

eng: The park is considered a Scarlet Macaw Sanctuary for birdwatchers, and is one of the reasons why Guatemalan birding School blog expresses its concerns.
swa: Hifadhi hii hulichukuliwa kama eneo la pekee la ndege wa aina ya macaw wekundu na waangalia ndege (wapenzi wa ndege) na ndiyo maana blogu ya shule ya kufundisha utunzaji ndege Guatemala inaeleza mashaka yake.

eng: It is estimated that there are only 300 Scarlet Macaw families left in the Mayan Biosphere.
swa: Ina kadiriwa kuwa kuna jamii 300 tu za macaw wekundu waliobaki katika mazingira ya kibaiolojia ya Maya.

eng: Dayamn shares the sad story of Poc Duck, now extinct:
swa: Dayamn anatushirikisha simulizi ya huzuni ya Poc Duck, ambao wamepotea sasa:

eng: Maybe it is a name most of the people in the world haven’t and will never get to hear.
swa: Inawezekana kuwa hili ni jina ambalo watu wengi hawajalisikia na hawataweza kilisikia.

eng: This beautiful kind of duck became extinct a long time before a lot of us were even born.
swa: Hii aina nzuri ya bata ilitoweka muda mrefu kabla wengi wetu hatujazaliwa.

eng: It inhabited one of the biggest lakes in Guatemala. n 1966, the Ecologist Anne LaBastille started a campaign to save the duck from extinction but her efforts were in vain.
swa: Bata hao waliishi kwenye bwawa kubwa zaidi ya yote nchini. Mwaka 1966, mwanaikologia Anne LaBastille alianzisha kampeni ya kuokoa bata hao wasitoweke lakini juhudi zake zilipotea bure.

eng: Her natural reserve wasn’t enough to counteract the damage we did to their environment and finally in the year 2004 after a study made by the UICN with the sponsorship of BirdLife International, the bird was officially considered extinct.
swa: Hifadhi alioianzisha haikuwa na uwezo wa kukabiliana na uharibifu tulioufanya katika mazingira na mwishowe mwaka 2004 baada ya uchunguzi uliofanywa na UICN kwa udhamini wa Shirika la Kimataifa la BirdLife, ndege hao walitangzwa rasmi kuwa wametoweka.

eng: For the lake in Atitlan, the place where Poc duck disappeared the story is different.
swa: Na ziwa la Atitlan, mahali ambapo Poc duck walitoweka hadithi ni tofauti .

eng: Alan Mills points out that the lake did not collapsed overnight but it was the result of the irresponsible hippie-chic tourism development that took place there, and all the empty beer bottles and rubbish left behind by wild parties, neither improving the living conditions of the extremely poor people from the villages around, which did not increase the environmental friendly tourism.
swa: Alan Mills anasema ziwa halikuharibiwa usiku mmoja, bali ni matokeo ya maendeleo ya hovyo ya utalii yaliyofanyika hapo, na chupa nyingi tupu za bia na uchafu ulioachwa na tafrija za usiku, ambazo hazikubadilisha umasikini uliotopea wa wanavijiji waliozunguka, na wala haukuongeza utalii mzuri kwa mazingira.

eng: For Guatemala Solidarity Network, the Lake is crying, too:
swa: Kwa Mtandao wa Mshikamano wa Guatemala, ziwa hilo linalia pia:

eng: The writer, Aldous Huxley, famously wrote wrote of Lake Atitlán,"Lake Como, it seems to me, touches on the limit of permissibly picturesque, but Atitlán is Como with additional embellishments of several immense volcanoes.
swa: Mwandishi, Aldous Huxley, aliandika kwa umaarufu juu ya Ziwa Atitlán, ”ziwa Como, kwangu mimi naliona kama, linagusa upeo unaoruhusiwa katika uzuri wa mandhari, lakini Atitlán ni Como (eneo zuri la milima na maziwa asili yaliyotokana na volkeno) yenye vikorombwezo kadhaa vya volkeno.

eng: It really is too much of a good thing." While, I’ve never been to Lake Como I have been to Lake Atitlán and it is stunning.
swa: Hii sasa ni zaidi ya kitu kizuri. ”Japo sijawahi kufika kwenye ziwa Como lakini nimefika ziwa Atitlán na ni zuri na la kuvutia mno.

eng: However, there is a fear that the lake is dying and will become marshland through man-made interventions.
swa: Hata hivyo, kuna hofu kuwa ziwa hilo linakufa na litageuka kuwa ziwa la tope kwa sababu ya shughuli za kibinadamu.

eng: These interventions include, for example, farming, tourism, and the lack and/or breakdown of public services to manage human waste.
swa: Shughuli hizo zinajumuisha, kwa mfano, kilimo, utalii, na kukosekana huduma za kijamii kudhibiti taka.

eng: While there are opinions saying that there is nothing left at the Laguna del Tigre National Park, archaeologists working in the region with communities clarified that a substantial amount of forest canopy remains intact within the enclave zone.
swa: Wakati yapo maoni yanayosema kuwa hakuna kilichobaki kwenye Hifadhi ya Taifa ya Laguna del Tigre, wanaikiologia wanaofanya kazi katika eneo hilo na jamii za hapo waliweka wazi kuwa kuna paa za misitu ambayo bado zipo salama katika eneo lisilokaliwa.

eng: The governor of Petén regrets that they did not act before to protect our jungle.
swa: Gavana wa Petén anajutia kuwa hakuchukua hatua mapema ili kulinda pori letu.

eng: However, it is not only about preserving the environment.
swa: Hata hivyo, si katika kuhifadhi mazingira tu.

eng: One of Laguna del Tigre's greatest treasures is a 2,500-year-old city of the ancient Maya world, called Waka´(500 BC) or El Peru.
swa: Moja ya vitu vya thamani vya Laguna del Tigre's ni mji wa zamani wenye umri wa miaka 2,500 wa Maya ulioitwa Waka´(miaka 500 kabla ya Kristo) au El Peru.

eng: It host among other treasures, the tomb of a Mayan Queen.
swa: Unahifadhi pamoja na vitu vingine vya tahamana kaburi la Malkia wa Maya

eng: ¿Que te pasa Guatemala? reported that CALAS filled a claim against the Ministry of Energy, who is in favor of extending the oil exploration contract in the middle of the rain forest.
swa: ¿Que te pasa Guatemala? anataarifu kuwa CALAS wameilalamikia Wizara ya Nishati, ambayo inapendekeza kurefusha mkataba wa uchimbaji mafuta katikati ya msitu wa mvua.

eng: The blogger Tokoloshte suggests visiting Laguna Lachua to be "industrialized" by the government (they will create a highway across the reservoir).
swa: Mwanablogu Tokoloshte anapendekeza kutembelea Laguna Lachua ambayo “itageuzwa kuwa ya viwanda ” na serikali (watajenga barabara kibwa katikati ya hifadhi).

eng: Manuel Boloma a young Maya Q’eqchi’ Social Anthropologist from the North (near the reservoir) strongly rejects the President's attitude and the apathetic role of people, doing nothing to rescue our future.
swa: Manuel Boloma kijana wa Maya Q’eqchi’ mwanasayansi wa jamii kutoka Kaskazini (karibu na hufadhi) anapinga kwa nguvu msimamo wa Rais na tabia ya kupuuzia ya watu, ya kutokufanya kitu chochote ili kuilinda kesho.

eng: He saids that it is not an economy-environmental issue but rather the government distorted priorities, a suicide for Guatemala future.
swa: Alisema kuwa hili sio jambo la kiuchumi au la kimazingira bali Serikali ilipotosha vipaumbele, ni kifo cha kujiua kwa Guatemala ya kesho.

eng: He asks Guatemalans to open their eyes and see how they are destroying a valuable tomorrow.
swa: Anawataka Waguatemala kufunga macho ili kujionea wenyewe jinsi wanavyoharibu thamani ya maisha yao ya baadae.

eng: The Shoaib Malik and Sania mirza wedding controversy has been an awakening for people on the both sides of the India, Pakistan border.
swa: Utata wa harusi ya Shoaib Malik na Sania Mirza imewaamsha watu wa pande zote mbili za mpaka wa India na Pakistani.

eng: With the media blitz, it seems people of both the countries are witnessing a desi version of "papparazzi" as TV channels, print media and other agencies have hounded, gleaned and extracted any bit of information possible about this impending wedding.
swa: Huku kukiwa na mlipuko katika vyombo vya habari, inaonekana kuwa watu wan chi zote mbili wanashuhudia toleo la kiHindi la “papparazzi” kwani idhaa za Televisheni, magazeti na asasi nyingine vimewaandama, vimekusanya na kutoa kila chembe ya habari inayowezekana kuhusu harusi hii inayotarajiwa.

eng: Past skeletons have crept up on Shoaib in the form of his "ex wife" Ayesha Siddiqui, whom he had to officially divorce to end the controversy.
swa: Mafuvu na mifupa vimemnyemelea Shoaib kwa kupitia “mke wake wa zamani” Ayesha Siddiqui, ambaye ilimbidi amtaliki rasmi ili kuumaliza utata.

eng: The allegations and the judicial case on him in India have now been taken back by the Siddiqui family for an alleged Rs. 150 million in alimony.
swa: Madai na kesi inayomkabili nchini India hivi sasa vimeondolewa na familia ya Siddiqui baada ya malipo ya kiasi cha Rupia milioni 150 kama fedha za kumkimu aliyetalikiwa.

eng: The twists and turns of the story have been pure mayhem for media and obviously the bloggers are not far behind.
swa: Mapindo na mizunguko ya habari hii vimekuwa kama vurumai kwa vyombo vya habari na wazi wanablogu hawako nyuma sana.

eng: The blogsphere in India and Pakistan have literally lit up with views and debates, some think its a sign of peace to come while others cite this marriage as a source for future acrimony.
swa: Ulimwengu wa blogu nchini India na Pakistani umewaka kwa mitazamo na midahalo, wengine wanafikiri kuwa hii ni ishara ya Amani inayokuja wakati wengine wanasema kuwa ndoa hii ni chanzo cha ugomvi wa baadaye.

eng: Syed Zaki Ahmed at Pak spectator thinks that the marriage and the noise is good for businesses:
swa: Syed Zaki Ahmed wa Pak Spectator anafikiri kuwa ndoa hii na kelele zote ni nzuri kwa biashara:

eng: Now in this situation how could businessmen lag behind.
swa: Sasa katika hali kama hii wafanyabiashara wangebaki vipi nyuma.

eng: Businessmen in Pakistan have joined the party as they are getting orders for hundreds of thousands of T-shirts featuring Shoaib and Sania ahead of their wedding that is expected to take place next week on 15 April.
swa: Wafanyabiashara nchini Pakistani wamejiunga na hafla kwani wanapata maagizo ya mamia ya maelfu ya fulana zenye picha ya Shoaib na Sania kuelekea harusi yao ambayo inatarajiwa kufungwa wiki ijayo siku ya tarehe 15 Aprili.

eng: They call me muslim blog comments on the rationale behind the decision Sania Mirza took to marry Shoaib Malik:
swa: Blogu ya Wananiita Muislamu inatoa maoni kuhusu sababu zilizopelekea uamuzi wa Sania Mirza kuolewa na Shoaib Malik:

eng: What can Indian Muslims learn from Sania’s very personal decision?
swa: Je ni kipi ambacho Waislamu wa India watajifunza kutokana na uamuzi binafsi mno wa Sania?

eng: It is this: never be apologetic about Pakistan.
swa: Ni hiki: Usiijutie Pakistani.

eng: Do not be needlessly cynical about that country out of fear of being dubbed a traitor.
swa: Usiwe shuku zisizo na sababu kuhusu nchi hiyo kutokana na hofu ya kuitwa msaliti.

eng: You are not.
swa: Wewe sio msaliti.

eng: The Hindu right wing parties, from Bajrang Dal to Shiv Sena, did make a meal of Sania’s decision.
swa: Vyama vya kiHindu vyenye siasa za kulia, kuanzia Bajrang Dal mpaka Shiv Sena, waliufanya chakula uamuzi huo wa Sania.

eng: Yet, the bouncy tennis sensation took the plunge.
swa: Na bado, mcheza tennis huyu anayevutia amejitosa.

eng: Why?
swa: Kwa nini?

eng: Simply because, deep in her heart, love for a Pakistani and being Indian need not necessarily be a conflicting experience.
swa: Kwa sababu rahisi, ndani sana ya moyo wake, mapenzi yake kwa mPakistani na kuwa Mhindi havipaswi kwa lazima viwe vitu vinavyopingana.

eng: However, Capricious thinks the marriage is going to fail:
swa: Hata hivyo, Capricious anafikiri kuwa ndoa hiyo itaanguka:

eng: * Sania Mirza got all the fame, popularity, wealth and iconic status in a very young age.
swa: * Sania Mirza amepata umaarufu wote, kujulikana, utajiri na nafasi ya kuwa kama nembo wakati akiwa na umri mdogo sana.

eng: She became a darling of India, pampered and loved by all Indians and projected by Indian and world media.
swa: Amekuwa ni kipenzi cha India, amekwezwa na kupendwa na Wahindi wote na kutangazwa na vyombo vya habari vya india na ulimwengu wote.

eng: She is a independent girl.
swa: Ni msichana huru.

eng: Unlike majority of Muslim girls of the subcontinent, she doesn’t need a husband for the bread and butter. The sense of providing livelihoods to the family is some thing on which man’s character, attitude and his authority develops.
swa: Tofauti na wasichana wengi wa Kiislamu katika Bara Hindi, hahitaji mume kwa ajili ya mkate na siagi (maisha). hali ya kutaka kuwapatia maisha familia ni jambo ambalo hukua na nafsi ya mwanamme yeyote, mtazamo pamoja na mamlaka yake.

eng: It gives the typical Pakistani Muslim mediocre mindset.
swa: Inampa mPakistani Muislamu hasa fikra za hali ya chini.

eng: This mindset always demands some thing extra and undue favor from the wives.
swa: Mtizamo na fikra hizo siku zote hutaka jambo la ziada na upendeleo usio wa lazima kutoka kwa wake.

eng: Which will be absent in the marriage.
swa: Vitu ambavyo vitakosekana katika ndoa hii.

eng: The luxury of being “husband” could not be availed by Shoaib Malik.
swa: Starehe ya kuwa “mume” Malik Shoaib hawezi kuipata.

eng: Whilst every day brings new news like the Pakistani PM sending a special gift for the couple, the diatribe continues elsewhere.
swa: Wakati kila siku inaleta habari kama Waziri Mkuu wa Pakistani atuma zawadi maalum kwa wanandoa, ukosoaji unaendelea sehemu nyingine.

eng: Sunni Ulema Board, a group of religious scholars, reportedly issued a 'fatwa' (religious edict) against Sania and Shoaib for mingling freely and living together before the marriage is solemnized.
swa: Baraza la Ulema la waSunni, kundi la wanazuo wa dini, imeripotiwa kuwa walitoa ‘fatwa’ (amri ya kidini) dhidi ya Sania na Shoaib kutokana na kutembea kwa uhuru na kwa kuishi pamoja kabla ya ndoa hiyo kupitishwa rasmi.

eng: There has even been a term coined on twitter for this union with the hashtag #shoania
swa: Kuna hata usemi ulianzishwa kwenye twita kwa ajili ya muungano huu lenye alama ya #shoania

eng: We have seen rumor mongering reports that the actual nikah (marriage registry) took place on the 9th of April.
swa: Tumeshuhudia ripoti za uvumi kwamba nikah yenyewe (uandikishaji ndoa) ulifanyika siku ya tarehe 9 Aprili.

eng: But nothing is over until Sania and Shoaib say it's over.
swa: Lakini hakuna litakalokwisha mpaka hapo Sania na Shoaib watakaposema yamekwisha.

eng: It seems the media is feeding the mania and millions of people in both the country remain engrossed with all these.
swa: Inaonekana kuwa vyombo vya habari vinachochea shauku hii na mamilioni ya watu katika nchi hizo mbili wanaendelea kuzama ndani ya mambo yote haya.

eng: Obviously this will continue till the 15th of April, as two very emotional nations watch a movie like story transforming itself in real life.
swa: Ni wazi mambo haya uyataendelea mpaka tarehe 15 ya Aprili, huku nchi mbili zenye hisia kali zikiangalia mchezo wa filamu unavyojikunjua wenyewe katika maisha ya kweli.

eng: Last month, Sony Arianto Kurniawan or Sony AK from Mega Kuningan, Jakarta in Indonesia was threatened with a trademark infringement lawsuit by Japan’s Sony Corporation if he does not close his personal website whose domain name is www.sony-ak.com.
swa: Mwezi uliopita, Sony Arianto Kurniawan au Sony AK kutoka Mega Kuningan, Jakarta nchini Indonesia alitishiwa kushitakiwa kwa kukiuka sheria za matumiza ya nembo na shirika la Sony la Japan kama hatafunga tovuti yake binafsi yenye jina www.sony-ak.com.

eng: Thankfully, Sony the person was supported by the online community and Sony the corporation finally realized the folly of pursuing the case.
swa: Tushukuru kuwa, Sony mtu alikuwa akisaidiwa na jumuiya ya mtandaoni na shirika la Sony hatimaye liliona kuwa ni ujinga kufungua kesi.

eng: Sony Corp. has since then dropped the charge and has already apologized to the blogger.
swa: Shirika la Sony likaamua kuondoa mashtaka na limeshaomba msamaha kwa mwanablogu huyo.

eng: The personal website of Sony AK was established in 2003 and it was awarded the best website in educational category for 2003, 2004 and 2006 by PC Magazine Indonesia.
swa: Tovuti hiyo binafsi ya Sony AK ilianzishwa mwaka 2003 na imekwisha zawadiwa kama tovuti bora zaidi ya kuelimisha kwa mwaka 2003, 2004 na 2006 na Gazeti la PC la Indonesia.

eng: Multibrand reminds Sony Corp. that the website of Sony AK provides only free information to the public and does not sell anything
swa: Multibrand ililijuza shirika la Sony kwamba tovuti ya Sony AK hutoa bure taarifa kwa jamii na haiuzi kitu chochote.

eng: In my humble opinion, Sony Corp. have been over confident in making the said demand, because protection given by trademark registration is limited to certain types/kinds of products covered by said trademark.
swa: Kwa maoni yangu binafsi, Shirika la Sony lilitoa madai hayo kwa kujiamini mno, kwa sababu kinga inayotolewa wakati wa usajili wa nembo huwa inahusu aina fulani tu ya bidhaa iliyo chini ya nembo husika.

eng: In this case, Sony Corp. is a manufacturer of electronics products, whereas the website: www.sony-ak.com is only a personal website of its owner that provides free information.
swa: Katika hili, Shirika la Sony ni mzalishaji bidhaa za elektroniki, wakati tovuti ya: www.sony-ak.com ni tovuti binafsi tu ya aina yake inayotoa maarifa bure kabisa.

eng: talking points affirms the popularity of Sony AK’s website in the past six years
swa: talking points imesaidia kuongeza umaarufu wa tovuti hii ya Sony AK kwa miaka sita iliyopita.

eng: This suit has upset many Indonesian onliners, especially those who have been blogging and are into IT for several years.
swa: Mashtaka hayo yamewaudhi waIndonesia mtandaoni hasa wale ambao wakuwa wakiblogu na waliokuwa katika tekinoloia ya habari kwa miaka kadhaa.

eng: Sony AK’s site has been known for being the knowledge sharing center for IT enthusiasts in Indonesia, and has been up for approximately 6 years.
swa: Tovuti ya Sony AK imekuwa ikijulikana kuwa ni kituo cha kushirikishana elimu kwa wadau wa teknologia ya habari nchini Indonesia na imekuwa ikifanya hivyo kwa takribani miaka 6.

eng: Website of Sony AK
swa: Tovuti ya Sony AK

eng: Whispurr's Blog points out that there are many Indonesians named Sony
swa: Blogu ya Whispurr inasema kuwa kuna waIndonesia wengi wanaoitwa Sony

eng: And mind you again, there are thousands of people here in Indonesia with the name Sony.
swa: Na kwa taarifa yako, kuna maelfu ya watu hapa Indonesia wanaoitwa Sony.

eng: I have some friends with the name Sony, one of Indonesian Badminton star is SONY DWI KUNCORO, one of the most famous actor in Indonesia is SONY TULUNG.
swa: Ninao marafiki wanaoitwa Sony, mchezaji nyota wa Badminton wa indonesia ni SONY DWI KUNCORO, na mwingine ni mwigizaji maarufu wa Indonesia SONY TULUNG.

eng: Well then SONY CORPORATION, why don’t you sue those guys and thousands of Mothers who named their child with SONY.
swa: Sasa kwanini SHIRIKA LA SONY lisiwashitaki hao na maelfu ya akina mama wanaowaita watoto wao SONY.

eng: finally woken wonders whteher Apple Inc. would sue actress Gwyneth Paltrow for naming her daughter Apple
swa: Na finally woken anajiuliza je kampuni Apple itamshitaki mwanadada mwigizaji Gwyneth Paltrow kwa kumwita bintie Apple

eng: Maybe Apple Inc. should sue Gwyneth Paltrow for naming her daughter Apple as she might have a blog called apple too in the future… Seriously this is beyond ridiculous.
swa: Nadhani kampuni ya Apple imshitaki Gwyneth Paltrow kwa kumpa bintie jina Apple na kwa kuwa binti huyo anaweza baadae kufungua Blogu nakuuita Apple pia… Hakika hii ni zaidi ya ujinga.

eng: Colson describes the issue as a battle between David and Goliath
swa: Colson anaelezea hili kama pambano kati ya Daudi and Goliati

eng: The sympathy naturally is with David (AK) in his fight against Goliath (Corp).
swa: Wakumhurumia zaidi hapa ni Daudi (AK) katika vita yake dhidi ya Goliati (shirika).

eng: Actually it is bizarre if an innocent citizen uses a name which remotely is the same as the one of a multinational, in a strictly personal context, is being sued for that reason only. Yet I'm afraid Goliath has a point here - because the legal system is to a large extent the product of the interests of the Goliaths.
swa: Kumshitaki raia mwema kwasababu tu anatumia jina ambalo kwa umbali ni sawa tu na lile litumikalo na kampuni kubwa ya kimataifa, kwa kweli ni kituko Nafikiri bado Goliath yuko sahihi hapa – kwasababu mfumo wa sheria kwa kiasi kikubwa upo kwa matakwa ya Goliati.

eng: And because the legal power Goliath is able to organizie is n-th time as huge as the limited funds a David has at his disposal.
swa: Na kwa sababu ya nguvu ya kisheria Goliati ana uwezo wa kupanga matokeo mara nyingi zaidi kuliko Daudi kutokana na uwezo mkubwa wa kifedha alionao.

eng: Before the withdrawal of the case, bloggers were planning to launch a boycott campaign against Sony Corp. Yari NK is happy with the decision of the firm to drop the case It is wise for Sony Corp. to drop the claim since it does not make sense in almost any way that one has to stop using his own name for his personal non-commercial site.
swa: Kabla ya kuondolewa kwa kesi mahakamani , wana blogu walikuwa wanapanga kuanzisha mgomo wa kutonunua bidhaa za shirika la Sony.

eng: By dropping the claim, Sony wouldn't hit the negative consequences in public opinion that, at worst, could lead to boycotting its products by the Indonesian public that backed Sony AK becuase they know that Sony AK had nothing but good intentions when he initially set up his blog or site and he is not eating into Sony Corp's profits....
swa: Yari NK anafurahia uamuzi wa shirika hilo wa kuifuta kesi. Ni busara kwa shirika la Sony kufuta shutma, kwa sababu haina maana kwa namna yeyote ile kumtaka mtu kuacha kutumia jina la blogu yake binafsi isiyokuwa ya kibiashara Kwa kitendo chake cha kufuta kesi, Sony haitakumbwa na athari hasi ambazo zingetokana na muonekano wake kwa jamii ya waindonesia, ambao ungeweza kufikia kwenye mgomo wa kutonunua bidhaa zakekwa wale wanoipenda blogu ya Sony AK kwasababu wanajua kuwa Sony AK alikuwa na malengo mazuri tu alipoanzisha blogu yake na si kwa lengo la kuliingilia shirika la Sony...

eng: Eleven Iranian bloggers and media professionals representing different parts of the political spectrum have answered a questionnaire about the changing dynamics of Iranian citizen media since the election.
swa: Wanablog wa Irani kumi na moja na wandishi wa habari wanaowakilisha sehemu tofauti za misimamo ya kisiasa wamejibu dodoso kuhusu mabadiliko uanahabari wa kiraia nchini Irani tangu Uchaguzi.

eng: Before the June 2009 presidential election the most dynamic pillars of citizen media in Iran were YouTube and blogs.
swa: Kabla ya uchaguzi wa rais wa Juni 2009 misingi ya mabadiliko ya vyombo vya habari vya kiraia nchini Iran ilikuwa ni YouTube na blogu.

eng: The election and the crisis that followed introduced Facebook and Twitter as two new primary channels of online citizen expression.
swa: Uchaguzi na mtafaruku uliofuataia ulizitambulisha Facebook na Twita kama njia nyingine mpya za raia kujieleza mtandaoni.

eng: For a short time during the election, the Iranian government blocked access to Facebook, YouTube, Twitter and several other websites.
swa: Kwa muda mfupi wakati wa uchaguzi, Serikali ya Irani ilizuia upatikanaji wa Facebook, YouTube, Twita na tovuti nyingine kadhaa.

eng: Some, including one leading Islamist blogger , called it a miscalculated strategy that helped the Iranian opposition dominate in the virtual realm.
swa: Baadhi, akiwemo mwanablogu anayeongoza wa mlengo wa Kiislam , iliita hali hii kama mkakati ambao haukupimwa vizuri ambao ulisaidia wapinzani nchini Iran kutawala eneo yakini.

eng: Despite the regime's attempts to filter social media websites, they became a powerful communication platform for the Green Movement.
swa: Licha ya majaribio ya utawala kuchuja tovuti za kijamii, ziliendelea kuwa njia yenye nguvu ya mawasiliano ya Harakati za Kijani.

eng: So did the Iranian presidential election change the dynamics of citizen media tools and channels?
swa: Je Uchaguzi warais nchini Irani ulibadilisha matumizi ya zana za uanahabari wa kiraia na njia zake?

eng: Are Facebook and Twitter the dominant players?
swa: Je Facebook na Twita ndio wadau wakubwa?

eng: Are blogs gradually become a second hand channel for sharing ideas?
swa: Je blogu zinazidi kwa taratibu kuwa njia ya pili ya kushirikiana mawazo?

eng: What are the channels political activists use the most?
swa: Je ni vyombo vipi vinavyotumika zaidi na wanaharakati wa kisiasa?

eng: I asked one leading Islamist blogger; three Green bloggers; one leading environmentalist blogger; five media people; and one active blogger, to participate in a short multiple-choice survey.
swa: Niliwataka mwanablogu mmoja anayeongoza wa mlengo wa Kiislam; wanablogu watatu wa mlengo wa kijani; mwanablogu mmoja wa mazingira; wanahabari watano; mwanablogu hai mmoja kushiriki katika kupitia maswali ya kuchagua.

eng: A group of eleven netizens could never represent the entire Iranian blogosphere, but it is a small step to gain insight.
swa: Kundi la raia wa matandaoni kumi na mmoja wasingeweza kuwakilisha ulimwengu mzima wa blogu wa Irani, lakini ni hatua ndogo kelekea kuelewa jambo zima.

eng: 1-Which are the sites you visit frequently since the presidential election?
swa: 1-Je ni tovuti zipi ulizozitembelea zaidi tangu uchaguzi?

eng: Facebook was the favorite with six points, Twtter is at the bottom with one point.
swa: Facebook ndiyo ilipendwa sana na kupata pointi sita, Twita ipo chini na ina pointi moja.

eng: Blogs got two points and FriendFeed and YouTube three each.
swa: Blogu zilipata pointi mbili na FriendFeed na YouTube tatu kila moja.

eng: 2-In your opinion which sites do political and civil society activists use?
swa: 2-Je, kwa mtazamo wako ni tovuti zipi ambazo wanasiasa na wanaharakati wakijamii huzitumia zaidi?

eng: Blogs are still king with six points, Facebook gets three points, you Tube two points, FriendFeed one, Twitter got zero, and None gets one point.
swa: Blog zinaendelea kuwa mfalme kwa kuwa na alama sita, Facebook alama tatu, you Tube alama mbili, FriendFeed alama moja, Twita ilipata sifuri, na hakuna ilipata alama moja.

eng: Six of our netizens believe the importance of the blogs after the presidential election did not diminish, two think blogs became more important, and three believe their importance was diminished.
swa: Sita kati ya raia wetu wa mtandaoni wanaamini kuwa umuhimu wa blogu haukupungua baada ya Uchaguzi, wawili wanafikiri kuwa blogu zilidi kuwa na umuhimu, na watatu wanaamini kuwa umuhimu wake ulipungua.

eng: Of the latter group, two think that blogs became less important because of Facebook's growing popularity, and one thinks the reason is that bloggers became less active.
swa: Katika kundi lililofuata, wawili wanafikiri kwamba blogu zimepungua umaarufu kutokana na kukua kwa umaarufu wa Facebook, na mmoja anadhani kuwa Wanablogu wamepunguza kujishulisha.

eng: 3-What is/are the site/s you prefer to discuss your favorite topics:
swa: 3-ni tovuti zipi unazozipendelea kufanyia miadala yako muhimu?:

eng: Blogs are mentioned 4 times, Facebook, 6 times, FriendFeed 3 times and Twitter one time.
swa: Blog zimetajwa mara 4, Facebook, mara 6, FriendFeed mara 3 na Twitter mara moja.

eng: In sum, reading this survey shows that after presidential election Iranian netizens have gone more visual and that Facebook has become a place to be for many of them including political leaders.
swa: Kwa ujumla , ukisoma haya mapitio inaonesha kuwa baada ya Uchaguzi wa rais, raia wa mtandaoni nchini Iran wamekuwa zaidi na kwamba Facebook imekuwa uwanja wa wengi wao wakiwemo viongozi wa kisiasa.

eng: The survey also shows that the so-called 'twitter revolution' (at least for our 11 participants) may have been more a phenomenon of western media than one of lasting consequence in the Iranian virtual world.
swa: Utafiti pia unaonesha kuwa kile kiitwacho ‘mapinduzi ya twita' ( angalau washiriki wote 11) labda ilikuwa na upashanaji habari wa kimagharibi zaidi na usingeleta athari halisi nchini Iran.

eng: Blogs still remain a valuable place but are losing the ground to the newcomers.
swa: Blog zinaendelea kuwa ni sehemu muhimu lakini zinapoteza eneo kwa washiriki wapya.

eng: Probably there is one certainty that after presidential election, nothing remained the same in Iranian community, the virtual as well as physical one.
swa: Pengine Jambo moja ni hakika kuwa baada ya Uchaguzi wa rais Nchini Iran mambo hayako vile yalivyokuwa kwenye jumuiya ya waIrani, kwa mtazamo na uhalisia.

eng: On April 6th, Kyrgyzstan a mountainous country in Central Asia, was hit by mass protests which eventually led to the overthrow of the government.
swa: Mnamo tarehe 6 Aprili, nchi ya milima milima ya Kirigistani huko Asia ya Kati ilikumbwa na maandamano makubwa ya kupinga utawala ambayo yaliishia kuing'oa serikali.

eng: Regional administrators were seized by protesters, and the army and police switched sides to the opposition, leaving President Kurmanbek Bakiev with almost no support.
swa: Wakuu wa mikoa walikamatwa na waandamanaji, huku jeshi na polisi wakiamua kuunga mkono upande wa upinzani na kumwacha Rais Kurmanbek Bakiev akiwa karibu hana uungaji mkono kabisa.

eng: The riots have not been bloodless - the recent unrest has so far left almost 74 people dead and more than 500 wounded - unlike a previous peaceful "Tulip revolution" in 2005.
swa: Siyo kwamba maandamano hayo yalikosa umwagaji damu - la hasha - mpaka sasa tukio hilo la maandamano makubwa la hivi karibuni limeacha takribani watu 74 wakiwa wamekufa na zaidi ya 500 wakiwa majeruhi - hii ni tofauti na mapinduzi yaliyopita yaliyopachikwa jina la "Tulip Revolution" ya mwaka 2005.

eng: The two uprisings are not dissimilar.
swa: Mapinduzi haya mawili hayafanani.

eng: Only five years ago, it was Bakiev who came to the Ala-Too square in the center of Kyrgyz capital demanding the resignation of former president Askar Akayev.
swa: Miaka mitano tu iliyopita, ilikuwa Bakiev aliyekwenda katika viwanja vya wazi vya Ala-Too katikati ya mji mkuu wa Kirigzi akidai kujiuzulu kwa aliyekuwa Rais wakati huo, Askar Akayev.

eng: Now, it is Bakiev himself who has had to flee the capital amidst roaring crowds led by opposition leader Roza Otunbaeva.
swa: Safari hii ni Bakiev mwenyewe aliyepaswa kutimua mbio katika jiji hilo katikati ya umati mkubwa ulioongozwa na kiongozi wa upinzani Roza Otunbaeva.

eng: Kyrgyzstan cultural-political divisions, map source: Wikimedia
swa: Migawanyiko ya kiutadamaduni na kisiasa katika Kirigistani.

eng: The roots of the present revolution are various: South vs. North clash (Bakiev is from the South, the rebels are from the North), corruption and suppressive government (in recent years Kyrgyz people witnessed all forms of oppression from closings of the newspapers to independent journalists' murders , Russia's Great Game interest, Ortega-y-Gasset'ian "revolt of the masses", etc.
swa: Vyanzo vya mapinduzi ya sasa vipo kadhaa: mapambano kati ya Kusini na Kaskazini (Bakiev anatoka Kusini, wapinzani wanatoka Kaskazini), ufisadi na serikali inayogandamiza watu (katika miaka ya karibuni raia wa Kirigistani wameshuhudia kila aina ya ugandamizaji kutoka ule wa kufungiwa magazeti hadi kuuwawa kwa waandishi wa habari wasioegemea upande wowote ), Mchezo mkubwa wenye maslahi kwa Urusi, Ortega-y-Gasset'ian "mapinduzi ya watu" n.k.).

eng: Whatever the real reasons of the Kyrgyz revolution of 2010 are, it is important to note that it was overwhelmingly immediate, furious, bloody and... well-documented.
swa: Pasipo kujali sababu za mapinduzi hayo ni zipi, mapinduzi ya watu wa Kirigistani ya 2010 kwa kuyachukulia kwa uzito wake yamekuja ghafla, yakiwa na nguvu ya ajabu, ya kumwaga damu na ... yamehifadhiwa vema.

eng: The role of the new media changed slightly this time compared to other dramatic events (like the protests in Moldova or Iran).
swa: Dhima ya vyombo vipya vya habari safari hii ilibadilika kidogo kulinganisha na matukio yenye kushangaza (kama maandamano ya kupinga utawala ya Moldova au Irani).

eng: Blogs and Twitter didn't serve as serious means of public mobilization since the Internet penetration rate is relatively small in Kyrgyzstan ( just 15 percent in 2009).
swa: Blogu na Twita hazikutumika kama nyenzo kuu za kuhamasisha umma hasa kwa kuzingatia kwamba intaneti bado ni changa katika nchi ya Kirigistani (imefikia asilimia 15 tu mpaka mwaka 2009).

eng: However, new media were agile enough to cover all the main events giving detailed footage of initial protests in Talas, rampage in Bishkek and looting that followed.
swa: Hata hivyo, vyombo hivyo vipya vya habari vilikuwa na nguvu ya kutosha kuchukua matukio yote muhimu na kutoa picha za video zilizo kamilifu tangu yalipoanza pale Talas, mlipuko wa watu kule Bishkek na matukio ya unyang'aji yaliyofuatia vurugu hizo.

eng: At the same time, new media were efficiently used by the opposition attracting the attention of international community and shifting public opinion to the side of the protesters.
swa: Wakati huo huo vyombo vipya vya habari vilitumika kwa ufanisi mkubwa na upande wa upinzani uliokuwa unajaribu kuvuta macho ya jumuiya ya kimataifa na kugeuza mwelekeo wa maoni ya umma kwa upande wa waandamanaji.

eng: The opposition leader Roza Otunbaeva (@otunbaeva), for instance, registered her account as soon as she became the head of the provisional government.
swa: Kiongozi wa upinzani, Roza Otunbaeva (@otunbaeva), kwa mfano, alifungua akaunti yake ya Twita mara tu bibie huyo aliposhika wadhifa wa kiongozi wa mpito wa serikali.

eng: On the other day, son of president Bakiev, Maxim opened a LiveJournal account to express the pro-government point of view.
swa: Siku nyingine, mtoto wa Rais Bakiev, Maxim alifungua LiveJournal ili kupata sehemu ya kusemea maoni yanayoiunga mkono serikali.

eng: Bloggers who both knew the region and were outside the country to see the big picture and collected the photographs, videos and Twitter confessions.
swa: Wanablogu ambao kwanza wanaijua nchi na pili walikuwa nje ya nchi ili kuweza kuona vizuri zaidi matukio ya ndani ambapo walikusanya picha, video na taarifa zilizotumwa kwa Twita.

eng: Two most informed bloggers in this situation were people outside the country: US-based Yelena Skochilo (a.k.a. LJ user morrire) and Kazakhstan-based Vyacheslav Firsov (a.k.a. lord_fame).
swa: Wanablogu wawili waliokuwa na taarifa za karibu kabisa walikuwa nje ya nchi: Yelena Skochilo anayeishi Marekani (akifahamika pia kama LJ user morrire) na Vyacheslav Firsov anayeishi Kazakistani (akifahamika pia kama lord_fame).

eng: They managed to assemble the most complete collections of photos, videos and timelines.
swa: Hawa wawili walifaulu kukusanya kikamilifu kabisa picha, video na hata nyakati.

eng: Another "winners" in the coverage are the local blog-portals namba.kz, kloop.kg, issyk-kulpress.kg (as well as traditional news sites like internews.kg, neweurasia.net and 24.kg), forum diesel.elcat.kg and a wordless webcam showing Ala-Too square (its screenshots were captured and transmitted by many bloggers).
swa: Washindi wengine katika uchukuaji taarifa za matukio hayo ni blogu za ndani ya nchi kama vile namba.kz, kloop.kg, issyk-kulpress.kg (vilevile tovuti za habari za kawaida ama vile internews.kg, neweurasia.net na 24.kg), jukwaa la diesel.elcat.kg na kamera ya mtandaoni isiyotoa maneno (webcam) ikionyesha viwanja vya wazi vya Ala-Too (picha zake zilinaswa na kutumwa na wanablogu wengi).

eng: Twitter hashtags #freekg (the major hashtag of the event), #bishkek, #kyrgyzstan and #talas, although filled with re-tweets and various provocations, made it possible for English-speaking audience to follow the events as well.
swa: Hashi za Twita #freekg (ambayo ndiyo hashi kuu ya tukio zima) #bishkek, #kyrgyzstan na #talas, ingawa imejaa Twita zilizotumwa upya na uchokozi mwingi, vyote viliwezesha wafuatiliaji wanaozungumza lugha ya Kiingereza kufuatilia yale yaliyokuwa yakiendelea.

eng: Despite nation-wide problems with the Internet on April 6 and 7 (the government forces blocked several popular websites "Azattyk" (RFERL), 24.kg, ferghana.ru, LJ user sabinareingold reported), the Kyrgyz revolution came out to be very well-documented.
swa: Licha ya matatizo ya nchi nzima ya Intaneti mnamo tarehe 6 na 7 Aprili (vikosi vya serikali vilizuia tovuti maarufu kama vile "Azattyk" (REFERL), 24.kg, ferghana.ru, LJ user sabinareingold alivyotaarifu), mapinduzi ya Kirigistani yametokea kuwa yenye kuwekwa katika kumbukumbu zaidi kulinganisha na mengine.

eng: Registan.net, comparing the events with Andijan massacre, wrote:
swa: Registan.net ikilinganisha matukio ya mauaji ya Andijani, aliandika:

eng: The information coming out of Kyrgyzstan is not always reliable.
swa: Taarifa zinazotoka Kirigistani huwa si za kutegemewa sana.

eng: It is often biased, short-sighted, confusing and contradictory.
swa: Mara nyingi ni za kuelemea upande mmoja, zenye mtazamo finyu, zinazochanganya na zinazojipinga.

eng: But it is giving us a view of Kyrgyzstan that demands our attention — not only now, but in the months and years to come, when we look back on these events and try to piece together what happened
swa: Lakini bado zinatupa picha ya Kirigistani inayohitaji tuitazame vema - siyo sasa tu, lakini katika miezi na miaka inayokuja, huku tukizama nyuma katika matukio ya sasa hivi na kuunganisha vipande vipande ili kupata picha kamili ya ya kile hasa kilichotokea.

eng: Since the information was so vast, so there was a systematized list of events and materials gathered and published by the bloggers.
swa: Kwa kuwa kumekuwa na taarifa nyingi mno, kwa hiyo iliandaliwa orodha iliyopangiliwa vema ya matukio na mambo yaliyokusanywa na kuchapishwa na wanablogu.

eng: April 6th, Talas
swa: Tarehe 6 Aprili, Talas

eng: The revolution began on April 6 in Talas , north-western Kyrgyzstan, where the local people stormed the local administration.
swa: Mapinduzi yalianza tarehe 6 Aprili huko Talas, kaskazini-magharibi mwa Kirigistani, ambapo wenyeji wa huko walivamia jengo la utawala la eneo hilo.

eng: The same happened in Naryn a couple of hours earlier.
swa: Jambo hilo pia lilitokea Naryn saa mbili kabla ya hili.

eng: On the next day, almost all regional capitals except Bishkek in the North of Kyrgyzstan were controlled by the opposition.
swa: Siku iliyofuata, karibu makao makuu ya mikoa yote isipokuwa Bishkek huko Kaskazini mwa Kirigistani yalikuwa yakishikiliwa na upande wa upinzani.

eng: Photos of Talas City administration storming, Talasmost.kg Photos of Talas city administration after the storm, NewEurasia.net
swa: Picha za baada ya uvamizi wa Jengo la Utawala la Jiji la Talas, NewEurasia.net

eng: April 7th, Bishkek rampage
swa: Tarehe 7 Aprili, Vurugu za Bishkek

eng: The most important events happened on April 7 in Bishkek.
swa: Matukio muhimu zaidi yalitokea tarehe 7 Aprili huko Bishkek.

eng: The opposition meeting turned to an open conflict.
swa: Mkutano wa upande wa upinzani uligeuka kuwa mgogoro wa wazi.

eng: When protesters (who somehow acquired arms) started to storm the Presidential palace after defeating police forces, the presidential guards started firing at them in an attempt to stop the attackers.
swa: Mara baada ya waandamanaji (ambao kwa namna moja au nyingine walijipatia silaha) walipoanza kuvamia makazi ya Rais baada ya kuvishinda vikosi vya polisi, walinzi wa Rais walianza kuwatupia risasi ili kujaribu kuwadhibiti.

eng: Witnesses said several snipers killed at least 20 people (others were killed by grenades and open fire).
swa: Mashuhuda walisema kwamba vitendo hivyo vilisababisha walau kuuwawa kwa watu 20 (wengine waliuwawa kwa mabomu ya kutupa kwa mkono na risasi za moto).

eng: Pictures of clashes with police, 24.kg Complete set of videos of Bishkek rampage, namba.kz Looting of Bakiev's house, sabinareingold Set of pictures of clashes with police, lord_fame Pictures of the explosions at the Ala-Too square, abstract2001 Set of pictures from the Ala-Too square, abstract2001
swa: Picha za mapambano dhid ya polisi, 24.kg Seti kamili ya video kuonyesha vurugu za huko Bishkek, namba.kz Unyang'anji katika nyumba ya Bakiev, sabinareingold Seti ya picha za mapambano dhidi ya polisi, lord_fame Picha za milipuko katika viwanja vya wazi vya Ala-Too, , abstract2001 Seti ya picha kutoka viwanja vya Ala-Too, , abstract2001

eng: Video of the storm:
swa: Picha za video za uvamizi:

eng: Another video:
swa: Picha nyingine ya video:

eng: The police was unable to stop the protesters and left the building.
swa: Polisi walishindwa kuwadhibiti waandamanaji na hivyo walikimbia kuliacha jengo.

eng: President Bakiev left for the unknown location on his plane.
swa: Rais Bakiev alikimbilia kusikojulikana kwa kutumia ndegeyake.

eng: On April 8, there was information that he landed in Osh (south of the country), and moved to his native village near Jalalabad.
swa: Mnamo tarehe 8 Aprili, kulikuwa na taarifa kwamba alikuwa amekimbilia huko Osh (Kusini mwa nchi), na kwenda katika kijiji alikozaliwa karibu na Jalalabad.

eng: He refused to abdicate.
swa: Alikataa kuachia madaraka.

eng: The Osh region is among those that aren't controlled by the opposition so far.
swa: Mkoa wa Osh ni moja kati ya mikoa ambayo bado haiko chini ya upande wa upinzani mpaka sasa.

eng: It is still unclear what will happen to Bakiev.
swa: Bado haijulikani Bakiev atapatwa na nini.

eng: April 8, Revolution aftermath
swa: Tarehe 8 Aprili, baada ya Mapinduzi

eng: After the opposition forces won Bishkek, they confronted another serious danger: the looters.
swa: Baada ya vikosi vya upinzani kuwa na udhibiti kamili wa Bishkek, walikabiliana na hatari nyingine kubwa zaidi, yaani, unyang'anyi.

eng: Various bloggers reported omni-presence of looters (sometimes armed).
swa: Wanablogu kadhaa walitoa taarifa za kuwepo kwa wanyang'anyi wengi sana (mara nyingine wakiwa wamebeba silaha).

eng: In the evening, the looters were stopped by newly established police and volunteer brigades with white bandage on their hands.
swa: Ilipofika jioni, wanyang'anyi walizuiliwa kuendelea na vitendo vyao na jeshi jipya la polisi na walinzi wa kujitolea ambao walikuwa wamejifunga beji nyeupe mkononi.

eng: The last messages from the blogs said that the situation in Bishkek stabilized.
swa: Ujumbe wa mwisho kutoka kwenye blogu ulisema kwamba hali huko Bishkek ilikuwa tayari imetengemaa.

eng: Pictures of the people next to presidential palace, Jamila Kulova Flickr set with photos of Bishkek streets, Yelena Skochilo Broken windows of the shops in Bishkek, Vyacheslav Firsov Pictures of Bishkek, Valery Georgiadi
swa: Picha ya watu karibu na makazi ya Rais,, Jamila Kulova Set za Flickr zenye picha za mitaa ya Bishkek, Yelena Skochilo Madirisha ya maduka yaliyovunjwa huko Bishkek , Vyacheslav Firsov Picha za Bishkek, Valery Georgiadi

eng: In early March, observers watched as around 20 long-time Christian orphanage workers were expelled from the country they called home.
swa: Mapema mwezi Machi mwaka huu, watazamaji walishuhudia jumla ya wafanyakazi wa muda mrefu katika kituo cha Kikristo cha kulelea watoto yatima wapatao 20 wakifukuzwa kutoka katika nchi ambayo wanaiona kama nyumbani.

eng: The incident, and others which followed it, have brought to light the debate surrounding Christianity in the Kingdom.
swa: Tukio hilo pamoja na mengine kadhaa yaliyofuatia yamezusha mjadala kuhusiana na imani ya Kikristu katika ufalme huo.

eng: While the official Moroccan line is that 98.7-99 per cent of the population is Muslim (the remainder being approximately 1% Christian and 0.2% Jewish), that statistic includes ethnic Europeans residing in Morocco.
swa: Takwimu rasmi za kiserikali nchini Moroko zinaeleza kwamba asilimia kati ya 98.7 - 99 za jumla ya watu nchini humo ni Waislamu (waliobaki ni kama asilimia 1 ambayo ni Wakristo na asilimia 0.2 ambao ni Wayahudi), takwimu hizo zinajumuisha pia Wazungu wanaoishi Moroko.

eng: Proselytizing is illegal, as is conversion away from Islam.
swa: Kuinjilisha ni kosa kama ilivyo kwa mtu kuacha Uislamu na kuingia katika dini nyingine.

eng: Still, foreign Christians are allowed to practice freely, and a number of churches, mostly from the era of French colonization, remain.
swa: Hata hivyo, wageni wanaruhusiwa kuishi imani yao kwa uhuru, na kuna makanisa kadhaa bado, yaliyo mengi ni yale yaliyojengwa enzi za ukoloni wa Wafaransa.

eng: In contrast, the country's tiny Jewish population is almost entirely native, and is also allowed free practice of their faith.
swa: Kwa kulinganisha na kundi hilo lililopita, Wayahudi wa nchi hiyo ni wale walio wenyeji kabisa wa hapo, hawa nao wanaruhusiwa kuishi imani yao kwa uhuru.

eng: Despite guarantees of freedom, it would appear that the government is taking a stronger approach of late to proselytism, both real and perceived.
swa: Pamoja na kutoa uhuru huo, inaonekana kwamba siku za karibuni serikali inachukua hatua kali dhidi ya uinjilishaji, uwe ule wa waziwazi au unaodhaniwa kufanyika.

eng: The Moroccan Dispatches shares a recent incident in which an Egyptian Catholic priest was expelled from the country:
swa: The Moroccan Dispatches inatukumbusha tukio moja la hivi karibuni la kule Misri ambapo Padre mmoja Mkatoliki alifukuzwa kutoka katika nchi hiyo:

eng: Evangelicals have operated for years in Morocco, with their main purpose being the conversion of Muslims.
swa: Wainjilisti wamekuwa wakifanya kazi kwa miaka mingi nchini Moroko na lengo lao kubwa limekuwa ni kuwaongoa Waislamu.

eng: Catholics have operated for longer, but purposefully have not engaged in proselytizing.
swa: Wakatoliki wamekuwepo kwa muda mrefu zaidi, lakini kwa makusudi kabisa hawakutaka kujihusisha na uinjilishaji wa moja kwa moja.

eng: So it came as a surprise that a Catholic priest was also detained and then exported during last week's crackdown.
swa: Kwa hiyo lilikuwa tukio la kushangaza kwamba Padre Mkatoliki alikamatwa na kisha kufukuziwa mbali na tukio la hivi karibuni la ushughulikiaji wanaoinjilisha.

eng: The blogger shares a message he received from a Catholic priest working in Morocco:
swa: Mwanablogu anatutumia ujumbe aliopokea kutoka kwa padri wa Kikatoliki anayefanya kazi Moroko:

eng: On Sunday the 7th of March, five minutes before mass began; the police in the city of Larache entered our friary and arrested one of our confrères, Rami Zaki, a young Egyptian friar still in initial formation who was spending a year with us.
swa: Mnamo Jumapili tarehe 7 mwezi Machi, dakika tano kabla ya kuanza misa; askari polisi wa jiji la Larache waliingia kwenye nyumba yetu ya watawa na kumkamata mmoja wa watawa, Rami Zaki, ambaye ni raia wa Misri na ambaye bado yuko katika hatua zake za awali za malezi na aliyekuwa anaishi na sisi kwa mwaka mmoja.

eng: He was ordered to go with the police, had no possibility to collect anything, and was given no explanation for his arrest... ...When Rami was put on the plane, his passport was taken from him and given to the pilot who later surrendered it with Rami to the police in Cairo.
swa: Aliamriwa kuondoka na polisi wale, wala hakupewa fursa ya kuchukua chochote, wala hakuelezwa kwa nini alikuwa akikamatwa ... …Pale Rami alipopakiwa kwenye ndege, alinyang'anywa pasi yake ya kusafiria ambayo ilikabidhiwa kwa rubani ambaye naye aliikabidhi pamoja na Rami kwa polisi kule jiji la Kairo.

eng: He was detained by the police in Cairo for another seven hours for interrogation before he was permitted to telephone his community of friars.
swa: Alishikiliwa na polisi wa Kairo kwa muda wa saa saba kabla hajaruhusiwa kupiga simu kwenye nyumba ya watawa wenzake.

eng: From Sunday, the morning of his arrest, to Tuesday afternoon, when he was released – a total of more than 50 hours – Rami was deprived by the police in Morocco and Egypt of any of his human rights.
swa: Tangu Jumapili asubuhi alipokamatwa mpaka mchana wa Jumanne alipoachiwa - jumla ya saa 50 - Rami alinyimwa haki zake za kimsingi kama binadamu na askari polisi wa Moroko na wale wa Misri.

eng: In another post, the blogger demonstrates that the public has joined in the crackdowns, citing a recent incident in which a cross was removed from its site of many years:
swa: Katika makala nyingine, mwanablogu anaeleza kwamba umma nao umejiunga katika msako huo, akitoa mfano wa tukio la hivi karibuni ambapo msalaba uling'olewa kutoka katika eneo ambapo umekuwa kwa miaka mingi sana:

eng: Where a cross once hung in Meknés
swa: Hapa ndipo ambapo msalaba ulikuwepo huko Meknés

eng: This is the place where a cross used to hang in Meknes' medina.
swa: Hapa ndipo ambapo msalamu ulikuwepo huko Meknes' medina.

eng: The Catholics who teach Moroccans languages and career skills in this building do not engage in proselytism but have caught up in the anti-Christian sentiment following the recent expulsions of Christians.
swa: Wakatoliki wanaofundisha raia wa Moroko lugha na stadi nyingine za kazi katika jengo hili hawashughuliki na uinjilishaji lakini nao wamenaswa na chuki hizi dhidi ya Ukristo kufuatia kufukuzwa kwa Wakristo kadhaa hivi karibuni.

eng: Last week, the cross was knocked down and beaten into pieces.
swa: Wiki iliyopita, msalaba uling'olewa na kuvunjwavunjwa vipande vidogovidogo.

eng: On a positive note, Moroccans who have benefited from their services have volunteered to reconstruct the cross.
swa: Katika hatua inayoonekana kuwa ya pekee, raia wa Moroko ambao wamekuwa wakinufaika na kazi za watawa hawa, wamejitolea kuujenga upya msalaba huo.

eng: In a more recent post, the same blogger assesses a TelQuel article on the situation, and says of it:
swa: Kwenye makala yake ya hivi karibuni, mwanablogu huyo anatathmini makala ya TelQuel kuhusiana na matukio hayo, na anaeleza hivi:

eng: In the main article, it points out that most Moroccans convert to Christianity more as a result of Arabic media and not from foreign missionaries.
swa: Katika makala kuu, inaonyesha kwamba raia wengi wa Moroko huongokea Ukristo zaidi kwa sababu ya vyombo vya habari vya Kiarabu kuliko shughuli za wamisionari wageni.

eng: This jives with my experience: a number of Moroccans I know have had long conversations with Christian missionaries about religion and none have converted.
swa: Jambo hili linaendana na yale ambayo nimewahi kuyashuhudia: raia wengi wa Moroko wamewahi kufanya mazungumzo kuhusu duni na wamisionari Wakristo lakini hakuna walioongoka.

eng: Some defended Islam while smoking hashish just to piss off the Christians, it that gives you an idea of how many Moroccans understand their Islamic identity.
swa: Wapo walioutetea Uislamu huku wakivuta bangi ili mradi tu wawaponde Wakristo, uzoefu huu unaokupa picha kuhusu namna gani raia wa Moroko wanavyoelewa Uislamu wao.

eng: This observation about foreign missionaries, of course, undermines the rationale behind the recent expulsions of many foreigners.
swa: Mtazamo huu kuhusu wamisionari wageni, bila shaka, unaondolewa mbali msingi wa hoja za matukio ya hivi karibuni ya kuwafukuza wageni wengi.

eng: To conclude, the blogger notes the recent media crackdowns and laments:
swa: Ili kuhitimsha, mwanablogu anaeleza kuhusu namna vyombo vya habari vilivyoathiriwa na usakaji huo na anaomboleza:

eng: Other media critical of the government have been shut down recently.
swa: Baadhi ya vyombo vya habari vinavyoikosoa serikali vimefungiwa.

eng: And the same could happen to Tel Quel.
swa: Jambo kama hilo linaweza kutokea kwa Tel Quel pia.

eng: But as long as they are still around, there will be at least some debate and critical thinking about current events.
swa: Lakini, kadiri vitakavyoendelea kuwepo ndiyo kadiri hiyohiyo ambapo kutakuwa na mijadala ya kutafakarisha kuhusu matukio ya hivi karibuni.

eng: The blog translation project High Peaks Pure Earth has recently focused on "music with a message" by translating the lyrics of Tibetan songs from music videos that have been uploaded onto the internet.
swa: Mradi wa kutafsiri Blogu uitwao High Peaks Pure Earth hivi karibuni umetupia jicho “muziki wenye ujumbe” kwa kutafsiri mashairi ya nyimbo za Tibet kutoka video za Muziki zilizowekwa kwenye mtandao.

eng: On March 10 this year, the blog presented a hip hop video titled "New Generation" by the popular group known as "Yudrug" in Tibetan ("Green Dragon" in English).
swa: Tarehe 10 Machi mwaka huu , blogu hiyo iliweka video ya hip hop inayoitwa “New Generation” (“Kizazi kipya” kwa Kiswahili) wa kundi maarufu liitwalo “Yudrug” kwa ki-Tibet (Mnyama wa kubuni aina ya “Dragon wa kijani” kwa Kiswahili).

eng: Yudrug had first released the video on their blog the previous month.
swa: Yudrug waliiachia video yao katika blogu yao mwezi uliopita.

eng: According to High Peaks Pure Earth:
swa: Kwa mujibu wa High Peaks Pure Earth:

eng: This bold new style of musical expression heard in "New Generation" has been quite controversial in Tibetan cyberspace, with Tibetan bloggers praising Yudrug for their outspoken lyrics, but some also criticising Yudrug for adopting a style that is seen as “too western”.
swa: Aina hii mpya ya kujieleza kimuziki inayosikika katika “New Generation” imeleta mtafaruku katika mtandao wa wazi wa Tibet huku wanablogu wa Tibet wakiwasifu Yudrug kwa ujasiri wa mashairi yao lakini baadhi yao pia waliwakosoa Yudrug kwa kutumia mtindo ambao ni “wa Kimagharibi mno”.

eng: Whatever your musical taste may be, the song is undeniably powerful and energetic with a rousing chorus:
swa: Bila kujali kionjo chako cha muziki, huwezi kukana kuwa wimbo huu una msukumo na nguvu ukiwa na kiitikio:

eng: The new generation has a resource called youth
swa: Kizazi kipya kina utajiri uitwao ujana

eng: The new generation has a pride called confidence
swa: Kizazi kipya kinajivunia kitu kiitwacho kujiamini

eng: The new generation has an appearance called playfulness
swa: Kizazi kipya kinamuonekano uitwao Burudani

eng: The new generation has a temptation called freedom
swa: Kizazi kipya kina majaribu yaitwayo uhuru

eng: Indeed Yudrug's "New Generation" is a demonstration of an upsurge in online activity by and about Tibetan identity, as described by an earlier blogpost in High Peaks Pure Earth.
swa: Ni kweli kuwa “New Generation” wa Yudrug ni dhihirisho la muibuko wa wanaharakati wa mtandaoni juu ya U-Tibet, kama ilivyoelezwa mapema katika makala ya blogu ya High Peaks Pure Earth.

eng: The music is full of pride and confidence.
swa: Muziki huo umejaa majivuno na kujiamini.

swa: Ukiachana na Yudrug, High Peaks Pure Earth imemtambulisha pia mwimbaji chipukizi wa Tibet, Tashi Dhondup, kwa wasomaji wake.

eng: Tashi Dhondup is from the Amdo area of Tibet and is currently serving 15 months of re-education through labour for "crimes" related to his music.
swa: Tashi Dhondup anatokea katika eneo la Amdo katika tibet na kwa sasa anatumikia miezi 15 ya elimu rejea kwa kufanya kazi kutokana na “makosa” yanayohusiana na muziki wake.

eng: His 2008 CD "Torture Without Trace" sold out in thousands in Tibet.
swa: CD yake ya mwaka 2008 “Torture Without Trace” (mateso bila vielelezo) iliuzwa kwa maelfu ndani ya Tibet.
