eng: In his customary funny style, Sead Dzigal provided a list of similarities between Facebook and the Communist Party of Yugoslavia (CPY):
swa: Kwa desturi yake ya ucheshi, Sead Dzigal ametoa orodha ya Ufanano baina ya Facebook na Chama cha Kikomunisti cha Yugoslavia (CPY):

eng: Facebook - social networking
swa: Facebook – ni mtandao wa wanajamii

eng: CPY - socialist networking If you are not a Facebook member - you are a nobody
swa: CPY – ni mtandao wa wajamaa Kama sio mwanachama wa Facebook – Huna maana kwao

eng: If you are not a CPY member - you are a nobody Everybody on Facebook are your friends, even though you don't know half of them.
swa: Kama si mwanachama wa CPY – Huna maana kwao Kila mtu kwenye Facebook ni rafiki yako, japo kuwa huwajui nusu yao.

eng: In the CPY everybody are your comrades,* even though you don't know half of them.
swa: Kila mwana CPY ni swahiba wako,* japo huwajui zaidi ya nusu yao.

eng: On Facebook you support various actions and causes without lifting a finger.
swa: Katika Facebook unashabikia matukio mbalimbali bila hata kuinua kidole chako.

eng: In CPY you are a member of a zillion committees, boards, assemblies, without lifting a finger.
swa: Katika CPY we ni mjumbe wa kamati na makusanyiko lukuki bila hata ya kunyanyua kidole chako.

eng: On Facebook you've got FarmVille,
swa: Kwenye Facebook kuna mchezo wa mashamba,

eng: in CPY you've got zadrugas and land reform. On Facebook you've got "Like,"
swa: katika CPY kuna zadrugas na sera mpya ya ardhi. kwenye Facebook utajipatia “Like,” (naipenda)

eng: in CPY you've got "Long live comrade...!!!" Facebook - often invading your privacy,
swa: kwenye CPY unajipatia “Long live comrade…!!!” (maisha marefu swahiba) Facebook – mara nyingi huingilia faragha yako,

eng: CPY - often invading your privacy.
swa: CPY - mara nyingi huingilia faragha yako.

eng: .aNTI reacted through a comment , using a phrase often attributed to Vaclav Havel:
swa: .aNTI alichangia kwa kutoa maoni , akitumia usema uliotumiwa mara nyingi na raisi wa kwanza wa jamhuri ya Czech Vaclav Havel:

eng: This post is filled with cliches and anti-communist propaganda.
swa: Makala hii imejaa maoni yaliyozoeleka na ni propaganda za wapinga ukomunisti.

eng: The only thing worse than the communists are the anti-communists.
swa: Kitu pekee kibaya katika hili ni kwamba wakomunisti wenyewe ni wapinga ukomunisti.

eng: Recenzent agreed, and trying to prove wrong the current anti-communist prejudices about how things changed, he noted :
swa: Recenzent anakubali na anajaribu kuonesha jinsi wapinga ukomunisti wa sasa walivyo na mtazamo usio sahihi kwajinsi mabadiliko yanayojitokeza, anakumbusha :

eng: The media used to be run by the political party.
swa: Vyombo vya habari vilikuwa vikimilikiwa na vyama vya siasa.

eng: Today they can be pro-government or anti-government, but are still run by political parties.
swa: Siku hizi vinaweza kuwa kwa niaba ya Serikali au vipinga Serikali, lakini bado vinamailikiwa na vyama vya siasa.

eng: You can get a job much easier if you are a political party member. Regardless if it was CPY, SDSM or VMRO-DPMNE.
swa: Utapata kazi kirahisi zaidi ilimradi tu ni mwanachama wa chama cha siasa , haialishi chama hicho ni CPY, SDSM or VMRO-DPMNE.

eng: He also noted that passive "support" for various actions remains a staple of current political parties too, as well is fighting dissenters using conspiracy theories.
swa: Pia amejuza kuwa huu msimamo usio wazi wa vyama vya siasa katika mambo mbalambali umebaki kuwa ni msingi wa vyama hivyo sasa. Vyama pia hupigana na waandishi kwa nadharia za kihasidi.

eng: * The words friend and comrade are synonyms in most South Slavic languages, such as Macedonian, Serbian, Croatian, Bosnian...
swa: * maneno swahiba na rafiki yamekuwa na maana sawa katika lugha za kislavik, kama Kimasedonia, Kiserbia, Kikroashia, Kiboznia…..

eng: Online voting has begun for the Best of the Blogs Awards from Deutsche Welle, one of the most prestigious international blog competitions with nominated blogs in eleven different languages.
swa: Upigaji kura mtandaoni umeanza kwa ajili ya Tuzo ya Blogu Bora Zaidi inayotolewa na Deutsche Welle (shirika la habari la Ujerumani), moja kati ya mashindano ya blogu yenye hadhi kubwa kimataifa na blogu zilizotajwa kushiriki ni za lugha kumi na moja tofauti.

eng: You can vote for your favorites until April 14, 2010.
swa: Unaweza kuipigia kura blogu uipendayo hadi April 14, 2010.

eng: The jury will meet in the middle of April to decide on the winners, and the results will be announced on April 15 during the re:publica conference in Berlin, Germany.
swa: Jopo la majaji litakutana katikati ya mwezi Aprili ili kuamua washindi, na matokeo yatatangazwa Tarehe 15 April wakati wa kongamano la re:publica jijini Berlin, Ujerumani.

eng: The winners will receive their awards at a ceremony during the Deutsche Welle Global Media Forum in June 2010 in Bonn.
swa: Washindi watapokea tuzo zao kwenye sherehe za Kusanyiko la Wadau wa Habari Ulimwenguni la Shirika la Habari la Ujerumani litakalofanyika mwezi Juni 2010 huko mjini Bonn.

eng: Among the Nominees
swa: Miongoni mwa Waliopendekezwa

eng: In the "Best Weblog" category, the competition is fierce between well-known blogs from around the web.
swa: Katika kigezo cha “ Blogu bora zaidi”, mashindano ni makali baina ya blogu maarufu kutoka katika mtandao.

eng: Jordanian blogger Osama Romoh currently has over 60% of the votes.
swa: Mwanablogu wa Jordan Osama Romoh hadi sasa ana zaidi ya asilimia 60 ya kura kura zote zilizopigwa.

eng: He blogs about social issues in his country with ironic humor.
swa: Anablogu masuala ya kijamii ya nchi yake kwa mzaha na kejeli.

eng: In this same category, AJI - Ação de Jovens Indígenas from Brazil is designed to accommodate young indigenous bloggers of the Dourados Reservation and help them write about problems in their reservation as well as to address national issues, like the status of native populations generally in Brazil.
swa: Kwa kigezo hichohicho, AJI - Ação de Jovens Indígenas ya Brazil imebuniwa ili kuwapa nafasi wanablogu vijana wazawa wa eneo lililotengwa la Dourado na kuwasaidia waweze kuandika kuhusu matatizo ya eneo hilo maalum na vile vile kuchambua mambo ya kitaifa, kama vile nafasi ya wazawa nchini Brazil kwa ujumla.

eng: Another contender of this category is Han Han, a prolific novelist and race car driver from China who happens to be China's most read blogger and a contender for Time Magazine's Top 100 list.
swa: Mshindani mwingine katika kigezo hiki ni Han Han, mwandishi wa riwaya mwenye ufanisi mkubwa ambaye pia ni dereva wa magari ya mashindano wa huko China ambaye ametokea kuwa mwanablogu aliyesomwa sana nchini China na mshiriki katika shindano la 100 bora wa gazeti la Time.

eng: Global Voices and The BOBs
swa: Global Voices na Tuzo ya Blogu Bora Zaidi

eng: Global Voices itself won a BOBs award in 2005, but many of the current and former contributors to this website are featured in this year's BOBs for their activities outside Global Voices.
swa: Global Voices ilishinda tuzo hiyo mwaka 2005, lakini wengi wa waandishi wa zamani na sasa wa Global Voices wanashiriki katika shindano hili mwaka huu kupitia shughuli zao nje ya Global Voices.

eng: Among the "Best Blog" nominees is Ushahidi, a blog that accompanies a web application that helps map disaster situations via mobile phones and social networking.
swa: Miongoni mwa blogu zilizotajwa kushindania tuzo hiyo ni Ushahidi, blogu ambayo kwa kutumia tovuti inasaidia kutoa taarifa za maafa kupitia simu za mikononi na mtandao wa kijamii.

eng: Global Voices' former authors Juliana Rotich, Ory Okollah helped develop this project, that was initially created to map reports of violence in Kenya after the post-election fallout at the beginning of 2008.
swa: Waandishi wa zamani wa Global Voices Juliana Rotich, Ory Okolloh walisaidia katika kuandaa mradi huu, ambao awali uliundwa ili kuorodhesha taarifa za mgogoro wa baada ya uchaguzi nchini Kenya mwanzoni mwa mwaka 2008.

eng: Recently, Ushahidi maps were deployed in Haiti after the earthquake that devastated the country, as well as after the Chile Earthquake.
swa: Hivi karibuni, ramani za Ushahidi zilitumika nchini Haiti baada ya tetemeko la ardhi kuikumba nchi hiyo, vilevile baada ya tetemeko nchini Chile.

eng: HerdictWeb, a project of the Berkman Center for Internet & Society at Harvard University (where Global Voices was founded) is a nominee in the 'Reporters Without Borders Award" category.
swa: HerdictWeb, ni mradi wa kituo cha Berkman cha Intaneti na Jamii cha chuo kikuu cha Havard (ilipoanzishwa Global Voices) ni mtajwa katika kigezo cha ‘Tuzo ya Wanahabari Wasio na Mipaka”.

eng: Herdict Web seeks to gain insight into what users around the world are experiencing in terms of web accessibility and censorship.
swa: Tovuti ya Herdict inatafuta kujua kinachowapata watumiaji wa mtandao ulimwenguni hasa wanavyoweza au kushindwa kuzifikia tovuti.

eng: Another Global Voices author, Jorge Gobbi has been blogging travel tips in Spanish on Blog de Viajes since 2003.
swa: Mwandishi mwingine wa Global Voices, Jorge Gobbi amekuwa akiblogu kuhusu vidokezo vya safari kwa kiHispania katika Blog de Viajes tangu 2003.

eng: The blog has already won the Best Spanish Travel Blog Award by travel guide publisher Lonely Planet.
swa: Blogu hiyo imeshawahi kushinda tuzo blogu bora ya safari ya kiHispania na mwandishi wa mwongozo wa safari Lonely Planet.

eng: Check other blogs in this category here.
swa: Tazama blogu nyingine zilizotajwa katika kigezo hiki hapa.

eng: Canadian blogger nominee threatened with death
swa: Mwanablogu mKanada anayetishiwa kifo

eng: Michelle Blanc, a Canadian transsexual women who blogs in French about her life transformation is among the nominees in the French weblog category.
swa: Michelle Blanc, mwanamke mKanada aliyebadili jinsia ambaye anablogu kwa Kifaransa kuhusu mabadiliko ya maisha yake ni miongoni mwa walipendekezwa katika kigezo cha blogu za Kifaransa.

eng: Michelle recently discovered several disturbing threats on her life posted on YouTube and other websites.
swa: Michelle aligundua hivi karibuni vitisho kadhaa vinavyosumbua dhidi maisha yake vilivyotumwa kwenye YouTube na tovuti nyingine.

eng: Alongside Michelle's blog, Femme 2.0 ou le parcour transsexuel in the French category, there are many others, such as La Vigie du Web, Chez Gangoueus, Chroniques de la loose, Entendu à Paris and more.
swa: Sambamba na blogu ya Michelle iitwayo, Femme 2.0 ou le parcour transsexuel katika kigezo cha Kifaransa, kuna nyingine nyingi kama vile La Vigie du Web, Chez Gangoueus, Chroniques de la loose, Entendu à Paris na zaidi.

eng: Don't forget to vote for all your favorites!
swa: Usisahau kuzipigia kura zile unazozipenda!

eng: Also see: Arab World: Pulling all the Stops for the BoBs
swa: Pia tazama: Arab World: Pulling all the Stops for the BoBs

eng: Today's announcement that the Polish presidential couple killed in the tragic aircraft accident over Smolensk last Saturday would be buried on Sunday at 2PM in Krakow's Wawel Castle raised a lot of controversy.
swa: Tangazo la leo kuwa rais wa Poland na mke wake, waliofariki katika ajali mbaya ya ndege huko Smolensk Jumamosi iliyopita, watazikwa siku ya Jumapili saa 8 mchana katika Kasri la Wawel huko Krakow limezua utata mkubwa.

eng: Lech Kaczyński's family was given a choice of three burial locations: the Wawel Castle in Krakow, as well as St. John's Cathedral and the Powązki Military Cemetery in Warsaw.
swa: Familia ya Lech Kaczyński ilipewa machaguo matatu ya sehemu za kuzika: Kasri la Wawel mjini Krakow, vile vile Kanisa la Mt. Yohana na Makaburi ya Kijeshi ya Powazki mjini Warsaw.

eng: Stanisław Dziwisz, the Cardinal Archbishop of Krakow, announced today that they had decided in favor of Wawel, and this announcement later sparked a series of public protests.
swa: Stanisław Dziwisz, Askofu Kadinali wa Krakow, alitangaza leo kuwa wameamua na kuichagua Wawel, baadaye tangazo hilo lilichochea mfululizo wa upinzani wa umma.

eng: Some 400 protesters gathered in front of the Metropolitan Curia of Krakow tonight to voice their concerns: the authorities' failure to consult with the nation; the fact that Wawel is a resting place of kings, military leaders, representatives of the Polish literature and other historical personalities considered heroes of the nation; the fact that none of the spouses of the heroes resting there had been buried along with them.
swa: Kadri ya waandamanaji 400 walikusanyika mbele ya Jengo la Kanisa Kuu (Jengo la jiji) la Krakow ili kueleza kero yao: uongozi kushindwa kujadiliana na taifa; ukweli kwamba Wawel ni makaburi ya wafalme, viongozi wa kijeshi, wawakilishi wa fasihi ya kiPoland na watu wengine mashuhuri katika historia ambao wanachukuliwa kama mashujaa wa taifa; ukweli ni kwamba hakuna hata mke mmoja wa mashujaa hao aliyezikwa hapo pamoja nao.

eng: The protest was organized through several Facebook groups, such as this one (currently 2,143 fans), this (23,369 fans) and this (11,782 members).
swa: Upinzani huo uliandaliwa na vikundi vya Facebook, kama vile hiki hapa (mpaka sasa kina mashabiki 2,143), hiki (mashabiki 23,369) na hiki (wanachama 11,782).

eng: Nearly 1,400 people have signed this online petition related to the protest as well.
swa: Karibu watu 1,400 wamesaini katika waraka huu wa mtandaoni ambao kadhalika unahusiana na upinzani huo.

eng: The scale of the protest on Facebook did not go unnoticed in the Polish mainstream media .
swa: Ukubwa wa upinzani huo kwenye Facebook haukupita bila kutupiwa macho na vyombo vikuu vya habari .

eng: To understand the sentiments of the protesters, let's look at some of their posts on Facebook.
swa: Ili kuelewa hisia za waandamanaji, hebu tuangalie baadhi ya mitundiko yao kwenye Facebook.

eng: Maciej Sadkowski expresses the dominant opinion of one of the groups opposing the decision :
swa: Maciej Sadkowski anaelezea maoni yanayotawala katika moja ya vikundi vinavyopinga uamuzi huo :

eng: Not only that suddenly the person everyone laughed at suddenly becomes a national hero, now this...paranoia...maybe we should bury , and others in Wawel, too? they died as well...
swa: Sio tu kwamba kwa ghafla mtu ambaye kila mmoja alimcheka anageuka kuwa shujaa wa taifa, na sasa… shuku … pengine tuwazike , na wengine huko Wawel, pia? Nao pia walifariki …

eng: Paula Rettinger believes that the president's place is in Warsaw:
swa: Paula Rettinger anaamini kwamba sehemu ya kuzikwa rais ni Warsaw:

eng: I protest against the burial of in Wawel.
swa: Ninapinga kuzikwa kwa huko Wawel.

eng: Brother of my grandfather died in Katyń.
swa: Kaka yake babu yangu alifariki Katyn.

eng: As well as my mother's uncle.
swa: Kadhalika mjomba wake mama yangu.

eng: The topic is close to my heart.
swa: Mada hii ipo karibu na moyo wangu.

eng: The only reason to call Kaczyński a hero is his accidental death.
swa: Sababu pekee ya kumuita Kaczyński shujaa ni kifo chake katika ajali.

eng: It's an irresponsible, foolish decision taken under the pressure of a constant propaganda flow of condolences to the deceased couple.
swa: Ni kutowajibika, na uamuzi wa kijinga uliochukuliwa chini ya shinikizo la mtiririko wa propaganda za salamu za rambirambi kwa wanandoa hao waliofariki.

eng: The Warsaw Cathedral is a necropolis for presidents, and it is where the president should rest.
swa: Kanisa kuu la Warsaw ndio mahali wanapozikwa marais, na ndipo hapo ambapo rais apumzishwe.

eng: Izabela Wójcik refers to the image of Poland abroad:
swa: Izabela Wójcik anakumbusha jinsi Poland inavyoonekana nchi za nje:

eng: I also oppose it, as all my friends I've talked to.
swa: Na mimi pia ninapinga (uamuzi huo), kadhalika marafiki zangu nilioongea nao.

eng: But it is not only our internal matter because now the entire world will see how after a short period of unity the Polish nation divides and argues again.
swa: Lakini hili si suala la ndani kwa sababu sasa dunia nzima itaona ni jinsi gani baada ya kipindi kifupi cha umoja taifa la waPoland linatengana na kubishana tena.

eng: Try to look at this image: the cortege with guests from all around the world and a demonstration in the back of it.
swa: Jaribu kuangalia taswira hii: gwaride la heshima lenye wageni kutoka duniani kote na maandamano ya upinzani nyuma yake.

eng: How will it look like to the world?
swa: Itaonekana vipi duniani?

eng: Why multiply conflicts with decisions of this type?
swa: Kwa nini tuzidishe migogoro kwa maamuzi ya namna hii?

eng: Eh...
swa: Eh…

eng: Piotr Tomula points out the past sentiments of the Kaczyński family towards Krakow:
swa: Piotr Tomula anaonyesha hisia za zamani za familia ya Kaczyński kuhusu Krakow:

eng: He did not receive the honorable citizenship of Krakow, so now his brother pushes him in through the back door for even more, this is exactly how the duckies , NO HONOR, only VANITY...
swa: Hakupokea uraia wa heshima wa Krakow, na sasa hivi kaka yake anamsukuma kwa kupitia mlango wa nyuma ili apate zaidi, na hivi ndivyo bata hawa , HAKUNA HESHIMA, ni UBATILI tu…

eng: Kuba Bielecki speaks with irony:
swa: Kuba Bielecki anaongea kwa kejeli:

eng: If my family decides where we should be buried, I will tell my brother that I want it to be Wawel, but hand in hand with Sobieski, well actually Mickiewicz would satisfy me, too.
swa: Kama familia yangu itaamuani wapi nitakapozikwa, nitamwambia kaka yangu kuwa nataka mahali hapo pawe Wawel, lakini mkono kwa mkono na Sobieski, na hata Mickiewicz panaweza kuniridhisha pia.

eng: Agata Kol is one of the few voices supporting the decision, though:
swa: Agata Kol ni moja ya sauti chache zinazounga mkono uamuzi huo:

eng: Kaczyński was a head of state, just as kings from the Piast or Jagello dynasties.
swa: Kaczyński alikuwa mkuu wa taifa, kama vile walivyokuwa wafalme kutoka katika familia za Piast au Jagello.

eng: He was also chosen democratically.
swa: Kadhalika alichaguliwa kidemokrasia.

eng: Gazeta.pl posts a survey on the topic, asking the public for their opinions.
swa: Gazeta.pl imeweka tafiti juu ya mada hiyo, ikiutaka umma kutoa maoni yao.

eng: Here are the current results (as of 11PM):
swa: Haya ndio matokeo ya sasa (mpaka ilipofika saa 5 usiku):

eng: What do you think of the plans to bury Kaczyński in Wawel?
swa: Je Unafikiria nini kuhusu mipango ya kumzika Kaczyński huko Wawel?

eng: 63% Should be buried in Warsaw
swa: 63% Azikwe Warsaw

eng: 26% Brilliant, is is exactly his place 11% It does not matter, his family should decide
swa: 26% Vizuri sana, hii ndiyo sehemu yake hasa 11% haina shaka, familia yake ndio iamue

eng: Piotr Kowalczyk's tweet sums up the general direction of the discussions:
swa: Ujumbe wa twita wa Piotr Kowalczyk anatoa muhtasari wa muelekeo wa mjadala huu:

eng: Wawel will not unite the Poles, but divide them.
swa: Wawel haitawaunganisha watu wa Poland, bali itawatenganisha.

eng: On the night of the 3rd of April 2010, the leader of the Afrikaans Weerstandsbeweging (AWB), an Afrikaner resistance movement, Eugene Terre'Blanche, was murdered.
swa: Usiku wa Tarehe 3, Aprili 2010, kiongozi wa kundi la watetezi wa waafrika kusini wenye asili ya udachi (Afrikaans Weerstandsbeweging (AWB), an Afrikaner resistance movement), Eugene Terre'Blanche, aliuawa .

eng: This has happened in the time when issues of race relations are hotly debated following the singing of 'kill the boer', an old apartheid activist song, by the ANC Youth leader, Julius Malema.
swa: Hii imetokea wakati kukiwa na mjadala mkubwa unaohusiana na ubaguzi wa rangi kufuatia wimbo wa ‘kill the boer' (uwa mkaburu), wimbo wa zamani wa kupinga ubaguzi wa rangi wa rangi ulioimbwa na kiongozi wa vijana wa ANC, Julius Malema.

eng: Let's see what digital citizens in South Africa are saying about his death and the future of race relations in the county.
swa: Hebu na tuone jinsi raia wa Afrika ya kusini wanavyosema mtandaoni kuhusu kifo cha kiongozi huyo na mustakabali wa baadae kuhusiana na rangi ya ngozi nchini humo.

eng: From the Old has been following the entire fiasco so far and here's what he's posted on the South African Scouts Association: "Statement by the Verkenners Beweging van Suid-Afrika about the murder of Eugene Terreblanche"
swa: From the Old amefuatilia vizuri mpango huo wa aibu wa mauaji na hapa ni yale aliyoyatuma kwa Chama cha Skauti cha Afrika ya Kusini: “Maelezo ya Verkenners Beweging van Suid-Afrika kuhusu mauaji ya Eugene Terreblanche”

eng: PLEASE NOTE THIS IS A ROUGH TRANSLATION FROM AFRIKAANS TO ENGLISH, PROPER VERSION WILL BE UPDATED IN A FEW MINUTES.
swa: TAFADHALI TAMBUA KUWA TAFSIRI YA KWANZA KUTOKA LUGHA YA KIAFRIKAANS KWENDA KIINGEREZA ILIKUWA YA JUU JUU, TOLEO RASMI LITAWEKWA BAADA YA DAKIKA CHACHE.

eng: The Scouts Movement of South Africa has learned with sadness of the brutal murder of the elderly Eugene Terre'Blanche.
swa: Chama cha Maskauti wa Afrika Kusini wamepokea kwa uchungu mauaji ya kikatili ya mzee wetu Eugene Terre'Blanche.

eng: Mr. Terre'Blanche devoted his life in bondage to his people whom he loved had. It is sad that his life was lost, for his bondage.
swa: Mr. Terre'Blanche aliyatoa maisha yake kuwatumikia watu wake ambao aliwapenda sana.Ni huzuni kuwa maisha yake yamepotea, kwa utumishi wake.

eng: It is instructive to note that the murders are less than a month after Mal-emma the first time the commission had sung "shoot the farmer."
swa: Ni muhimu kutambua kuwa mauaji yametokea wiki chache tu baada ya Mal-emma kwa mara ya kwanza ilipoimba “shoot the farmer” (uwa wakulima).

eng: This follows two days of court order against Malema and can rightly be asked whether this court order an influence on the killing of our uncle Eugene.
swa: Hii imetokea siku mbili tu baada ya kutolewa amri ya mahakama ikimpinga Malema na ni haki pia kuuliza iwapo hii amri ya mahakama ilihamasisha mauaji ya mjomba wetu Eugene.

eng: Whether there is a connection between the death of the communist Hani Paassaterdag in 1993 and the murder of Uncle Eugene Paassaterdag in 2010 for the Scouts Movement irrelevant.
swa: Iwapo kuna uhusiano baina ya kifo cha mkomunisti Hani Paassaterdag cha mwaka 1993 na mauaji ya Mjomba Eugene Paassaterdag mwaka 2010 (hiyo sababu) haijalishi kwa Chama cha Maskauti.

eng: The fact is, a vulnerable elderly farmer in his bedroom on barbaric way with sticks and PanGas beaten to death and the regime of the day, the climate created for this genocide being committed against our people are.
swa: Ukweli ni kwamba, mkulima mzee asiye na kinga akiwa kitandani kwake kwa namna ya kikatili kabisa kwa fimbo na panga alipigwa hadi kifo na utawala wa leo, mazingira yaliyoandaliwa kwa ajili ya mauaji haya yametekelezwa makusudi ili kuwaangamiza ndugu zetu.

eng: The link between Julius Malema's provocative statements and the Murder of Eugnene Terre'blanche is a consistent theme when looking at the list of blog posts on the subject.
swa: Uhusiano baina ya matamko ya kichokozi ya Julius Malema na mauaji ya Eugnene Terre'blanche ni majadala wa kudumu hasa ukiangalia makala husika katika Blogu.

eng: DBS on MyDigitalLife calls the event a big opportunity:
swa: DBS kwenye MyDigitalLife analiita tukio hili kama fursa kubwa:

eng: The murder of Eugene Terreblanche is a big opportunity for South Africans.
swa: Mauaji ya Eugene Terreblanche ni fursa kubwa kwa Waafrika Kusini.

eng: This is a great opportunity to take a big breath and show the world that we are able to be sensible, think before opening mouths and talk to each other before doing anything physically rash.
swa: Huu ni wakati mzuri wa kuanza upya na kuuonyesha ulimwengu kuwa tuna uwezo wa kuwa watu wenye akili timamu, wenye kufikiri kabla kufungua midomo na kuongea sisi kwa sisi kabla ya kufanya kitu chochote chenye madhara kwa binaadamu.

eng: The hatred stirred up by different leaders in the past months is not good for the country.
swa: Chuki iliyochochewa na viongozi mbalimbali miezi iliyopita si nzuri kwa taifa.

eng: Let us use this man's death as a turning point to reconcile ourselves to the different views of the people in the country rather than lying the blame with someone singing a song.
swa: Hebu na tutumie kifo hiki cha mtu wetu kama wakati wa kubadili mwelekeo ili kujipatanisha na mitazamo tofauti ya watu wa nchi yetu badala la kuishia kumtupia lawama mtu aliyeimba wimbo.

eng: Can we do that?
swa: Je tunaweza kufanya hivyo?

eng: Yes we can!
swa: Ndio tunaweza!

eng: Will we?
swa: Je tutafanya?

eng: Well sadly I suspect not.
swa: Sawa lakini kwa bahati mbaya nadhani hatutafanya.

eng: Obviously having a bone to pick with the AWB.
swa: Ni dhahiri kuwa kuna jambo la kugombana na AWB.

eng: KickMugabeOut hopes the former AWB Leader suffers eternal torment.
swa: KickMugabeOut anatumai kuwa aliyekuwa kiongozi wa AWB anapata mateso ya milele.

eng: He does cover the story with some very interesting pictures and comments.
swa: Anaandika habari zikiambatana na picha za kuvutia pamoja na maoni.

eng: One of the pictures shows a guy wearing a T-shirt with the old Apartheid flag as well as an Israeli flag on a fence.
swa: Picha moja inamuonyesha jamaa akiwa kavalia fulana na bendera ya zamani ya kibaguzi huku akiwa na bendera ya Israeli kwenye ugo.

eng: South Africa's president, Jacob Zuma, has made a statement on the murder of Eugene Terre'Blanche.
swa: Rais wa Afrika ya kusini, Jacob Zuma, ametoa tamko juu mauaji ya Eugene Terre'Blanche.

eng: One is covered here by the Times Live Blog.
swa: Imeandikwa hapa na blogu ya Live Times.

eng: And another perspective on Jacob Zuma's statement by From The Old:
swa: Na habari nyingine kuhusu tamko la Jacob Zuma zimeandikwa na From The Old:

eng: Today Jacob Zuma will speak to South Africa at 2pm.
swa: Leo Jacob Zuma atazungumza na Afrika Kusini saa 8 mchana.

eng: He will most likely tell South Africans to forget about the event and that we should move on, however many claim this is not possible and that the boers are under attack.
swa: Anategemewa kuwaambia Waafrika Kusini kusahau tukio hilo na kwamba tuendelea mbele, hata hivyo wengi wanasema hilo haliwezekani kwani makaburu wako chini ya mashambulizi.

eng: Jacob Zuma also said today that "South Africans not to allow agent provocateurs to take advantage of this situation by inciting or fuelling racial hatred”.
swa: Pia, Jacob Zuma amesema leo kuwa “Waafrika kusini wasiruhusu wachochezi kutumia tukio hili na kuchochea au kutia mafuta chuki za misingi ya rangi".

eng: However he seems to forget that in the past few weeks white South Africans have been constantly attacked by Julius Malema that cant seem to stop the racial hatred and blaming of white people.
swa: Lakini ni kama amesahau kuwa wiki chache zilizopita watu weupe wa Afrika Kusini wamekuwa wakishambuliwa na Julius Malema na hilo halionyeshi kuwa linaweza kukomesha chuki za misingi ya rangi na kuwashutumu watu weupe.

eng: From The Old also covers another statement, this time by the AWB, claiming the murder was political:
swa: From The Old pia anaandika juu ya kauli nyingine, hii ya sasa ni ya AWB, na kudai kuwa mauaji yalikuwa ya kisiasa:

eng: The AWB came forward and said in a press conference that the murder was in fact political and that they will retaliate against Julius Malema whom they believe is the cause of the murder.
swa: AWB ilijitokeza katika mkutano na waandishi wa habari na kusema kuwa mauaji kwa hakika yalikuwa ni ya kisiasa na kwamba watamlipizia Julius Malema ambaye wanaamini kuwa ndio sababu ya mauaji.

eng: Julius Malema in the last few weeks incited hatred against white Afrikaners and Boers by insisting on singing the "kill the boer" song.
swa: Julius Malema wiki chache zilizopita alichochea chuki dhidi ya watu weupe wa Afrika ya Kusini na Makaburu kwa kuimba wimbo unaoitwa “uwa kaburu.”

eng: As tensions grow in South Africa just as the World Cup is heading this way.
swa: Wakati hali ya wasiwasi ikikua Afrika Kusini kombe la dunia nalo liko njiani kuelekea huku.

eng: In under two months South Africa will hold the biggest sport event Africa has seen while polarization and racial tensions are peaking.
swa: Ndani ya chini ya miezi miwili ijayo Afrika kusini itakuwa mwenyeji wa mashindano makubwa ya kimichezo kuliko yote ambayo Afrika imewahi kuandaa wakati hali ya kibaguzi ikiendelea kukua.

eng: Continuing on this line, Common Dialogue asks, "Is Terre Blanche’s blood on Malema’s hands?":
swa: Ikiendelea katika mistari hiyo hiyo, Common Dialogue inahoji, "Je damu Terre Blanchie ipo mikononi mwa Malema?”:

eng: Eugene Terre Blanche died a violent death allegedly at the hands of his farm hands.
swa: Eugene Terre Blanche amekufa kifo kibaya na inadaiwa kuwa aliuawa na mikono ya vibarua wa shambani kwake.

eng: Is this as a result of Malema singing “kill the boer”?
swa: Je haya ni matokeo ya Malema kuimba “uwa kaburu”?

eng: Terre Blanche was allegedly hacked and bludgeoned to death on his farm near Ventersdorp, in the North West province, allegedly by farmworkers during an argument over R600.
swa: Inadaiwa kuwaTerre Blanche alikatwa katwa na kubondwa hadi kufa katika shamba lake karibu na Ventersdorp, katika jimbo la Kaskazini Magharibi, bila shaka na wafanyakazi wake kutokana na mabishano juu ya randi 600.

eng: Emotions are inflamed with some rightwingers even threatening to avenge the killing.
swa: Hisia zinazaidi kukua na baadhi ya wale wenye mrengo wa kulia wakiahidi hata kulipiza kisasi.

eng: The question is just how “miraculous” was South Africa’s transition from apartheid to democracy?
swa: Swali ni kwamba "miujiza" ya mpito wa Afrika Kusini kutoka sera za kibaguzi Kufikia demokrasia ilikuwaje?

eng: And just how dangerous are the racial utterances by people like Malema and other politicians who are fond of racial political posturing?
swa: Na ni kwa hatari kiasi gani matamko yenye hisia za ubaguzi wa rangi yanayotolewa na watu kama Malema na wanasiasa wengine ambao wanaopenda siasa za kibaguzi?

eng: From The Old, covering many aspects of the case on his blog, says this yet again from the AWB's perspective agreeing with a perspective revealed on Facebook:
swa: From The Old, ameandika maelezo mengi juu ya kesi hii kwenye blogu yake, amelizungumzia tena hili katika mtazamo wa AWB anakubaliana na mtazamo ulioonyeshwa kwenye Facebook:

eng: The BWB sympathizes with the family of Eugene Terreblanche and wants to point to the fact that this deed was politically motivated by Melama as revealed on Facebook
swa: “AWB ipo pamoja na familia ya Eugene Terreblanche na inataka kusisitiza kuwa tukio hilo lilichochewa na Malema na lilikuwa la kisiasa kama ilivyowekwa dhahiri katika Facebook”

eng: White farmers all over South Africa are still under attack, now one of the biggest known boers have been murdered on his own farm because of a wage dispute allegedly.
swa: Wakulima Weupe pote Afrika Kusini bado wapo chini ya mashambulizi, sasa mmoja wa makaburu anayefahamika sana ameuawa katika shamba lake mwenyewe kutokana na ugomvi wa malipo ya mshahara kama inavyodaiwa.

eng: Many find it hard to believe that a normal pay dispute could lead to the death of Eugene Terreblanche the leader and founder of the AWB.
swa: Wengi wanapata shida kuamini ugomvi wa kawaida wa malipo unaweza kuwa sabau ya kifo cha Eugene Terreblanche kiongozi na mwanzilishi wa AWB.

eng: Eugene Terreblanche is said to not sleep at his farm at all and the fact that it came out that he was "sleeping" also brings up more doubts about the reality of what happened.
swa: Eugene Terreblanche inasemekana kuwa huwa halali kabisa shambani kwake na ukweli kuwa amegundulika kuwa alikuwa "amelala" pia unatia shaka ya juu ya nini hasa kilichotokea.

eng: Whether or not this is politically motivated is another story, a white farmer employing black people on his farm gets murdered.
swa: Kama hili tukio ni la kisiasa au la ni hadithi nyingine, mkulima mzungu aliyeajiri watu weusi ameuawa .

eng: The first thing that comes to mind is the song the ANC is so desperate wants to get unbanned.
swa: Kitu cha kwanza kinachoingia akilini ni wimbo ambao ANC inafanya juu chini usipigwe marufuku.

eng: The same song Julius Malema was gagged not to sing but continues to sing in Zimbabwe despite court orders.
swa: Wimbo huo huo ambao Julius Malema alizuiwa kuuimba na bado anaendelea kuuimba nchini Zimbabwe bila kujali amri ya mahakama.

eng: Tony Lankester puts up his opinion in "What Would Malema Do?":
swa: Tony Lankester anatoa maoni yake katika “Je malema atafanya nini?”:

eng: So Eugene Terreblanche has been murdered.
swa: Kwa hiyo Eugene Terreblanche ameuawa.

eng: And although it is probably unrelated, the fact that it happened while the country debates the appropriateness of struggle songs like “kill the boer” is going to put the whole debate in stark relief.
swa: Japo inaweza kuwa haina uhusiano, ukweli kwamba imetokea wakati nchi ikihangaika na mdahalo wa uhalali wa wimbo wa “uwa kaburu” utauweka mdahalo huo katiaka hali ngumu zaidi.

eng: And while it is unlikely that a tubeless rendition of the song inspired anyone to put a bullet into a sleeping Mr Terreblanche, it will be interesting to see what Julius Malema does next.
swa: Na wakati ni vigumu kuwezekana kuwa uimbaji usio na msingi wa wimbo huo ungeweza kumhamasisha mtu yeyote kumpiga risasi Mr Terreblanche usingizini, kila mmoja anatamani kujua Malema atachukua hatua gani?

eng: Will he back down and stop singing it?
swa: Je atashuka chini na kuacha kuimba?

eng: Will he publicly condemn the murder and say that actually doing it is not what he meant?
swa: Je atayashutumu hadharani mauaji hayo na kusema kuwa hicho sicho alichomaanisha?

eng: Or will he stick to the principle he’s been holding forth and sing it at the next opportunity?
swa: Au atabaki na msimamo wake alioushikilia na kuuimba wimbo huo kila apatapo fursa?

eng: FliMflaMfLiK argues that instead of focusing on "kill the boer" the song, and we should focus on this facts: "Terreblanche = White Earth":
swa: FliMflaMfLiK anasema kuwa badala ya kushadidia wimbo wa “uwa kaburu” na badala yake tutilie mkazo katika ukweli huu: “Terreblanche = Dunia Nyeupe”:

eng: Everyone seems to be focussing on "the song" but nobody is looking at "the facts".
swa: Kila mtu amekazania “wimbo” lakini hakuna anayeangalia “ukweli”.

eng: Getting knickers in a twist is what people do best and what they should be doing is sitting back and looking at the logical:
swa: (Kufunga funga nguo za ndani) Kufanya mambo yawe magumu ndio kile ambacho watu wanaweza kukifanya vizuri zaidi, lakini kile wanachotakiwa kufanya ni kukaa chini na kuiangalia mantiki:

eng: They were 16 and 21 respectively - very young.
swa: Walikuwa na umri wa miaka 16 na 21 kila mmoja – vijana sana.

eng: They did not run, they waited for the cops.
swa: Hawakukimbia, waliwasubiri polisi.

eng: They were angry about not getting their monthly salary of R300.00 each (shocking).
swa: Walikasirishwa na kitendo cha kutokulipwa mshahara wao wa mwezi wa R300.00 kila mmoja (inatisha).

eng: Apparently Eugine treated them very badly in the past (this I can well believe).
swa: Inasemekana kuwa Eugine aliwatenda vibaya sana siku za nyuma (hili ninaweza kuamini).

eng: He had threatened to kill them before.
swa: Alishawahi kuwatishia kuwauwa hapo kabla.

eng: Given the above, could these young lads have thought (in their minds), that they were acting in self defense?
swa: Kwa hayo hapo juu, je hawa vijana hawa wangliweza kufikiri (katika akili zao) kuwa walifanya hivyo ili kujikinga wenyewe?

eng: Just because Eugine was famous, it's an issue?
swa: Kwa sababu tu Eugine alikuwa anafahamika , hili limekuwa suala kubwa?

eng: These young men may not have known anything about any song in their parts.
swa: Hawa vijana wanaweza kuwa hawakujua uwepo wa wimbo wowote kwa upande wao.

eng: We don't know.
swa: Hatujui.

eng: Perhaps it's wise to wait and see what other facts present themselves?
swa: Labda ni busara kukaa na kusubiri Ukweli mwingine utakavyojitokeza wenyewe?

eng: And finally, in a satirical twist, Azad Essa uses the Terreblanche event to pick apart issues and stereotypes in the South African Muslim Community in his post on Thought Leader "Was Terror’Blanche a Muslim?"
swa: Na mwisho, katika mpindisho wa kejeli, Azad Essa anatumia tukio la Terreblanche kubainisha mambo na imani maarufu juu ya watu katika Jumuiya ya Waislamu wa Afrika Kusini katika makala yake kwenye safu za Thought Leader "Kiongozi wa Fikra" “Je gaidi'Blanche alikuwa Muislamu?"

eng: Overall, one of South Africa's leading figures of the "Afrikaner Resistance" movement has been put to rest in violent circumstances.
swa: Kwa ujumla wake ni kwamba, Mmoja kati ya viongozi wa watetezi wa Wazungu wa Afrika Kusini ameuawa kikatili.

eng: Tunisian bloggers used to avoid expressing themselves in English (the third language in the country), writing in Arabic (sometimes in Tunisian dialect) or French instead.
swa: Wanablogu wa Tunisia walizoea kuepuka kutumia Kiingereza (lugha ya tatu nchini mwao), na badala yake waliandika kwa Kiarabu (na wakati mwingine kwa lahaja za Tunisia) au Kifaransa.

eng: This has, in some way, limited their foreign audience and hindered the access to their thoughts and opinions to non-Arabic and non-French speakers.
swa: Hii, kwa namna fulani, imezuia hadhira ya nje na kukinza ufikiwaji wa mawazo na maoni na hadhira isiyozungumza Kiarabu au Kifaransa.

eng: But lately some bloggers are using English in their posts.
swa: Lakini hivi karibuni baadhi ya wanablogu wanatumia Kiingereza katika makala zao.

eng: Here's a look at some of the blogs in English.
swa: Hapa kuna pitio la baadhi ya blogu za Kiingereza.

eng: In his post entitled:AlJazeera.net inaccessible in Tunisia , Amin Zayani exposes the controversial censorship of AlJazeera.net: Tunisians can watch Al Jazeera freely whereas the website is censored.
swa: Katika makala yenye kichwa: Kutopatikana kwa AlJazeera.net nchini Tunisia, Amin Zayani ameeleza wazi utata wa kuzuiwa kwa AlJazeera.net: Watunisia wanaweza kutazama Al Jazeera bure kabisa ilihali tovuti yake ikichungwa.

eng: He writes:
swa: Anaandika:

eng: You switch on your TV and satellite receiver in Tunisia and you can watch Aljazeera, Aljazeera English, Aljazeera Children, Aljazeera Documentary, Aljazeera Live, Aljazeera Sport all day.
swa: Ukiwasha luninga yako na kipokea satelaiti nchini Tunisia unaweza kutazama Aljazeera, Aljazeera idhaa ya Kiingereza, Aljazeera kwa Watoto, Aljazeera idhaa ya filamu za Kuelimisha, Aljazeera Live, Aljazeera Michezo siku nzima.

eng: But you type the web address in your browser and you can not access it.
swa: Lakini ukiandika anwani ya tovuti yake kwenye mtandao huwezi kuipata.

eng: Strange, isn't it?
swa: Ajabu, Au sio?

eng: Under the title: Tilikum The Killer Whale, Foetus.me jotted down a small story about freedom:
swa: Ikiwa na kichwa: Tilikum The Killer Whale (Tilikum nyangumi muuaji), Foetus.me Anaandika kwa hadithi fupi inayohusu Uhuru:

eng: Remind ‘em who you are.
swa: Wakumbushe we ni nani.

eng: Remind ‘em how free and wild you really are.
swa: Wakumbushe ulivyo huru na silika ya mwituni.

eng: These people forgot you’re the apex predator of the oceans.
swa: Hao watu wamekusahau mwindaji mkuu wa baharini.

eng: Don’t bear with them, they dreamed of power, wicked as they see it, food related and cruel.
swa: Usiwaachie, waliota ndoto za kutawala, wawaza utawala dhalimu kama walivyo wao, wakiuhusisha na chakula na ukatili.

eng: Tell them that true power is to respect others freedom and build up on that.
swa: Waambie utawala wa kweli ni kuheshimu uhuru wa watu wengine na ujenge katika hilo.

eng: Show them that they are responsible and accountable.
swa: Waonyeshe kuwa wana wajibu.

eng: Nature will prevail my friend.
swa: Uasilia utadumu rafiki yangu.

eng: Amor blogging his world wrote a post about China's new rules concerning the media coverage of the conflict with Google:
swa: Amor akiblog katika ulimwengu wake aliandika kuhusuiana na kanuni mpya za China kwa vyombo vya habari vinayotangaza kuhusu mgogoro wake na Google:

eng: A new set of rules and instructions from the Chinese government itself suppresses China media outlets from reporting almost anything about Google’s recent pull out from China.
swa: Kanuni mpya na maagizo kutoka kwa serikali ya China yenyewe zinazozuia vyombo vya habari vya China kutokutangaza kitu chochote kuhusiana na tukio la hivi karibuni la Google kujiondoa nchin China.

eng: The instructions, nabbed by China Digital Times, outline a series of rather disturbing edicts to media outlets that are covering the Google story.
swa: Maagizo hayo, yaliyodakwa na China Digital Times, yanaorodhesha mfululizo wa amri ambazo zinaghasi kiasi kwa vyombo vya habari vinavyotangaza habari za Google.

eng: While this is nothing new, the Chinese government’s broad and suppressive mandates are still striking.
swa: Wakati hili si jipya hata kidogo, serikali ya China inaendelea kutenda kwa mabavu na mamlaka yake kandamizi.

eng: Sam' s World gives us his take on the First Arab Internet Conference, held in Beirut recently.
swa: Sam' s World anatupa mtazamo wake wa Kongamano la Kwanza la Kimtandao la Kiarabu, lilofanyika Beirut hivi karibuni.

eng: For the first time, the Arab web industry has its conference bringing together leaders from across the MENA, Europe and Silicon Valley to discuss cutting-edge trends and emerging opportunities.
swa: Kwa mara ya kwa kwanza, Wanamtandao wa Kiarabu wamefanya kongamano lililowajumuisha viongozi kutoka eneo lote la Mashariki ya Kati na Afrika ya Kaskazini, Ulaya na Bonde la Silicon ili kujadili maendeleo ya teknolojia ya mtandao na fursa zinazoambatana nayo.

eng: How to settle up your e-business or manage/promote your e-commerce?
swa: Namna gani unaweza kuanzisha biashara ya kwenye mtandao au kumudu/ kuitangaza biashara yako ya kwenye mtandao?

eng: Sula7fet, an English language student and a newcomer to the Tunisian blogosphere shared with us extracts from a book he read :
swa: Sula7fet, Mwanafunzi wa lugha ya Kiingereza na mgeni katika uwanja wa wanablogu wa Tunisia anatushirikisha kitabu anachokisoma kwa nukuu:

eng: The Paranoid Style in American Politics by Richard Hoftasadter , when reading the title I first thought that the issue s discussed in the book will be mainly addressed to the American reader , I remember taht i took a moment , hesitated for a while , and then asked how much ?
swa: The Paranoid Style in American Politics na Richard Hoftasadter , niliposoma jina la kitabu nilifikiri kuwa mambo yaliyoandikwa yamelenga hasa wasomaji wa Marekani, nakumbuka kuwa ilinichukua muda kidogo, Nilisita kidogo, na ndipo nikauliza bei gani?

eng: Hopefully, this new linguistic orientation towards the use of the English language, will give the Tunisian blogosphere a new fresh breath and will introduce it to readers from all over the world.
swa: Natumai, huu mwelekeo mpya wa matumizi ya lugha kuelekea kutumia lugha ya Kiingerza, utawapa wanablogu wa Tunisia pumzi mpya na kuwatambulisha kwa wasomaji wapya ulimwenguni kote.

eng: Moscow's Monday morning routine was broken today by two subway suicide bombings , which took the lives of at least 38 and wounded at least 70 people (many victims were students, aged below 40).
swa: Utaratibu wa Jumatatu asubuhi mjini Moscow ulivunjwa leo na milipuko miwili ya mabomu ya kujiua , ambayo yaliua watu wapatao 38 na kujeruhi kwa uchache watu 70 (wengi wa walioathirika walikuwa ni wanafunzi wenye umri wa chini ya miaka 40).

eng: The suicide explosions were carried out by two women allegedly affiliated with the North Caucasus rebels .
swa: Milipuko hiyo ya mabomu ya kujiua ilifanywa na wanawake wawili wanaodaiwa kuwa na uhusiano na Waasi wa Caucasus Kaskazini .

eng: Bloggers were among the first to spread the word about the tragic event, becoming the only stable media while major news websites stopped responding due to high traffic and TV channels were too slow to prepare any material on time.
swa: Wanablogu walikuwa ni miongozni mwa watu wa kwanza kusambaza habari kuhusu tukio hilo baya, na hivyo kuwa chombo cha habari imara wakati tovuti nyingi za vyombo vikubwa vya habari viliposhindwa kutoa huduma kutokana na msululu mkubwa (wa watumiaji wa mtandao) na idhaa za televisheni zilikuwa taratibu mno katika kutayarisha maudhui katika wakati unaotakiwa.

eng: As Twitter user Krassnova noticed , Twitter hashtag #metro29 had 40 tweets per second while TV channels managed to prepare just 4 stories.
swa: Kama vile mtumiaji wa Twita Krassnova alivyoona , alama ya twita ya #metro29 ilikuwa na jumbe 40 kwa sekunde wakati idhaa za televisheni ziliweza kuandaa habari 4 tu.

eng: In less than a couple of hours a website metro29.ru has been installed to cover the events.
swa: Chini ya masaa mawili tovuti ya metro29.ru iliundwa ili kupasha habari kuhusu tukio hilo.

swa: Kuanguka kwa muda mfupi kwa mawasiliano na usafiri kulifuata.

eng: As terrified Muscovites started to check if their friends or relatives were alive, cellphone network in the centre of Moscow went down.
swa: Wakati Wakazi waliokuwa na hofu wa jiji la Moscow walipoanza kuangalia kama ndugu na marafiki wapo hai, mtandao wa simu za mikononi katikati ya jiji la Moscow ulikatika.

eng: LJ user offnet complained that one of the reasons for the cell phone network blackout was a bureaucratic routine that required mounting an extra re-translator cell stations even in extreme situations.
swa: Mtumiaji wa LJ offnet alilalamika kwamba moja ya sababu za kukatika kwa mtandao wa simu za mkononi ilikuwa ni utaratibu wa kimangimeza ambo ulihitaji usimikaji wa kituo kingine cha ziada cha kurushia matangazo hata katika wakati wa wa hali mbaya zaidi.

eng: Habrahabr user rubyrabbit made a complete log of the major news website blackouts.
swa: Mtumiaji wa Habrahabr, rubyrabbit alitengeneza orodha nzima ya tovuti za habari zilizozimika.

eng: Muscovites getting to their workplaces, photo by Nikolay Danilov (nl)
swa: Wakazi wa Moscow wakielekea kazini, picha na Nikolay Danilov (nl)

eng: TV channels were not only slow but have also been accused for the lack of adequate attitude in their coverage of the event.
swa: Idhaa za televisheni hazikuwa tu na kasi ndogo bali poia zimeshutumiwa kwa kukosa mtazamo unaofaa katika upashaji wao habari kuhusu tukio hili.

eng: The World Cup will kick off in about three weeks and bloggers across the Levant have already been busy using their keyboards and camera shutters trying to capture the hysteria that engulfs the world once every four years.
swa: Kombe la Dunia litaanza katika kama wiki tatu hivi na wanablogu katika mashariki ya kati tayari wameshaanza kutumia vibodi na kamera zao kujaribu kunasa shauku inayoizingira dunia mara moja kila miaka minne.

eng: Syrian and Lebanese national teams have never qualified to the World Cup finals, yet that does not stop people from being hardcore fans and showing their admiration to their favorite teams in any way possible.
swa: Timu za Taifa za Syria na Lebanoni hazijawahi kufuzu kuingia katika fainali za kombe la Dunia, hata hivyo hilo haliwazuii watu kutokuwa mashabiki wakali na kuonyesha upenzi wao kwa timu wanazozipenda katika kila njia inayowezekana.

eng: While Lebanese blogger Rami from the +961 blog was content with certain aspects of the football fever, he was not impressed by some of what his compatriots are doing.
swa: Wakati mwanablogu wa KiLebanoni Rami wablogu ya +961 aliridhika na mambo fulani ya homa hii ya mpira wa miguu, hajavutiwa na baadhi ya yale wananchi wenzake wanayoyafanya.

eng: people are getting those mini flags for their cars and balconies, it might seem silly but it’s cool as long as it makes people deviate a bit from the political discussions.
swa: Watu wanakusanya vijibendera kwa ajili ya magari na viambaza vyao, inaweza kuonekana kama vile ni ujinga lakini ni jambo poa kwani litawafanya watu wepukane na mijadala ya siasa.

eng: Still, it really is pathetic when you get a flag that is more than 1 meter in width or length!
swa: Bado, ni jambo la kusikitisha pale unaponunua bendera ambayo ni zaidi ya mita 1 kwa upana au urefu!

eng: I’m pretty sure you could have put that spent money for a better use!
swa: Nina uhakika ungeweza kutumia pesa hizo kwa matumizi mazuri zaidi!

eng: Photo courtesy of +961 blog
swa: Picha kwa hisani ya blogu ya +961

eng: From Syria, Nasdaq on the other hand was occupied with analyzing the different reasons people get behind a certain team, highlighting religion as a factor:
swa: Kutoka Syria, Nasdaq Nasdaq kwa upande mwingine alikuwa amezama katika kuchambua sababu tofauti za watu kuwa nyuma ya timu fulani, anapendekeza dini kuwa mojawapo ya sababu :

eng: You're a girl, so it's only normal that you're cheering for Italy.
swa: Wewe ni msichana kwa hiyo ni jambo la kawaida kwamba unaishangilia Italia.

eng: When my nana (grandmother) was young, she also cheered for the Italian team and they were even more handsome than they are now according to her.
swa: Wakati nyanya yangu alipokuwa kijana, naye pia aliishabikia timu ya Italia na walikuwa ni vijana wanaovutia zaidi kuliko hawa wa sasa kwa mujibu wa bibi.

eng: And Independence '05 blog , from Lebanon, publishes more photos of the "flag industry" that flourishes due to World Cup:
swa: Na blogu ya Independence '05 , kutoka Lebanoni, inachapisha picha zaidi za “kiwanda cha bendera” ambacho kinashamiri kutokana na kombe la dunia:

eng: Flags for sale in Beirut - Courtesy of Independence '05
swa: Bendera zinauzwa mjini Beirut - kwa hisani ya Independence '05

eng: Courtesy of Independence '05
swa: Kwa hisani ya Independence '05

eng: And like the others, she dwells a little on the reasons of the somewhat excessive expressions of excitement for world cup, but reaches the same conclusion:
swa: Na kama walivyo wengine, anasisitizia kidogo juu ya sababu za kujieleza kulikopita kiasi kwa shauku ya kombe la dunia, lakini anafikia hitimisho sawa sawa na lile:
