swa: Matokeo?

eng: It's FUN FUN FUN.
swa: Ni FURAHA, FURAHA, FURAHA.

eng: Mozambique relies on money from other governments that give aid directly to its State Budget, making possible essential services like health and education.
swa: Msumbiji inategemea fedha kutoka serikali nyingine ambazo zinatoa msaada moja kwa moja kwenye bajeti yake ya Taifa, kuwezesha huduma muhimu kama afya na elimu.

eng: The relationship between the "donor" countries, and the Mozambican government, which has remained in the hands of the strong ruling party, has had its ups and downs over the years.
swa: Uhusiano kati ya nchi ‘wafadhili’, na serikali ya Msumbiji, ambayo bado inaendelea kuwa chini ya mikono ya chama tawala chenye nguvu, umekuwa unayumba yumba kwa miaka kadhaa.

eng: And the donor countries are diverse, from Europe, North America and Asia, and they have rarely acted with a unified voice.
swa: Na nchi wafidhili zinatofautiana, kuanzia Ulaya, Marekani Kaskazini na Asia, na kwa nadra sana hutenda kwa kauli moja.

eng: Since the late 1990s, most donor countries have repeatedly demanded proof of improvement in "governance" - in what relates to corruption, improvements in accountability and the rule of law.
swa: Tangu mwishoni mwa miaka ya 1990, nchi wafadhili nyingi kila mara zimekuwa zikidai ushahidi wa kuboreshwa kwa “utawala” – katika kile ambacho kinahusiana na ufisadi, uboreshwaji katika uwajibikaji na utawala wa sheria.

eng: These demands were made concrete in written agreements between donor countries and Mozambique.
swa: Madai haya yaliwekwa bayana katika mikataba kati ya nchi wafadhili na Msumbiji.

eng: The murders of two high profile figures investigating corruption in 2000 and 2001 continue unresolved in the eyes of donor countries.
swa: Mauaji ya watu wawili mashuhuri waliokuwa wakipeleleza ufisadi mwaka 2000 na 2001 yanaendelea kutotatuliwa katika macho ya nchi wafadhili.

eng: The recent trial of managers of Mozambican Airports, a state enterprise, for embezzlement of millions of dollars of state monies reminded that corruption continues to occur at a high level.
swa: Kesi za hivi karibuni za mameneja wa viwanja vya ndege vya Msumbiji, kufujwa kwa mamilioni ya dola ya fedha za taifa vilikumbusha kuwa ufisadi unaendelea kutokea katika ngazi za juu.

eng: Photo from Flickr user Sida - Swedish International Development Cooperation
swa: Picha kutoka kwa mtumiaji wa Flickr Sida - Shirika la Maendeleo na Ushirikiano wa Kimataifa la Sweden

eng: Yet, it is safe to say that, until Sweden decided that it would reduce its support to the Mozambican budget last year, most of the tension between donor countries and the receiving government remained behind closed doors.
swa: Hata hivyo, ni sawa kusema kuwa, mpaka Sweden ilipoamua kwamba itapunguza msaada wake kwenye bajeti ya msumbiji mwaka jana, misuguano kati ya nchi wafadhili na na serikali inayopokea viliendelea kubaki ndani ya milango iliyofungwa.

eng: Additionally, last year's presidential election also elevated public tensions, as donors challenged the administration of elections.
swa: Na kwa nyongeza, uchaguzi wa rais wa mwaka jana pia ulipandisha misuguano hiyo hadharani, kwani wafadhili walihoji jinsi uchaguzi ulivyoendeshwa.

eng: Joseph Hanlon, long-time Mozambique analyst, journalist and Professor at Open University, offers up a full section on his website documenting the "donor strike" of 2010.
swa: Joseph Hanlon, mchambuzi wa muda mrefu wa masuala ya Msumbiji, mwanahabari na Profesa katika Chuo Kikuu cha Wazi, ametoa sehemu nzima katika tovuti yake kuorodhesha “mgomo wa wafadhili” wa 2010.

eng: He summarizes
swa: Ameatoa muhtasari Unaoeleza kuwa wafadhili wa bajeti

eng: Budget support donors (G19) sent two letters to government in December 2009, demanding rapid moves on electoral law reforms, corruption, conflict of interest, and the overlap between the Frelimo party and the state.
swa: (G19) walituma barua mbili kwa serikali mnamo Disemba 2009, wakidai hatua za haraka kurekebisha sheria za uchaguzi, rushwa, migongano ya kimaslahi, na kuingiliana kati ya chama cha Frelimo na serikali.

eng: Budget support was suspended.
swa: Msaada wa bajeti ulisitishwa.

eng: On 5 February 2010 Aiuba Cuereneia, Minister for Planning and Development and the main government negotiator with the donors, sent a reply to the G19, setting out the government position and making few concessions.
swa: Mnamo tarehe 5 Februari 2010 Aiuba Cuereneia, Waziri wa Mipango na Maendeleo na mjumbe wa serikali anayeshauriana na wafadhili, alituma majibu kwa G19, iliyoeleza msimamo wa serikali na kutoa masharti nafuu.

eng: Negotiations in early March led to an agreement announced 24 March and a resumption of the flow of money.
swa: Mapatano ya mwanzoni mwa mwezi Machi yalipelekea makubaliano yaliyotangazwa tarehe 24 Machi na kuanza tena kwa mtiririko wa fedha.

eng: Edígio Vaz kicked off a debate in the Mozambican blogosphere in March on the recent breakdown of communication between donor nations and his government
swa: Edigio Vaz alianzisha mjadala katika ulimwengu wa blogu za Msumbiji mwezi Machi juu ya kuvunjika kwa mawasiliano hivi karibuni kati ya mataifa wafadhili na serikali yake

eng: A short video interview about the tournament organized by the Refugee VI soccer team is to raise awareness about the issue of xenophobia in South Africa.
swa: mahojiano mafupi ya video kuhusu mashindano yaliyoandaliwa na timu ya mpira wa miguu ya Refugee VI soccer ynakusudia kuelimisha umma juu ya suala la ubaguzi dhidi ya wageni nchini Afrika Kusini.

eng: Nelson Mandela Source:www.ambassadors.netMany people know that Nelson Mandela spent 27 years of his life in a prison on Robben Island in South Africa.
swa: Nelson Mandela Chanzo:www.ambassadors.netWatu wengi wanafahamu kwamba Nelson Mandela katika maisha yake alitumikia kifungo cha miaka 27 jela kule katika Kisiwa cha Robben nchini Afrika ya Kusini.

eng: What most people don’t know is that Madiba (as he is affectionately known in South Africa) spent 67 years in the fight against racism and poverty.
swa: Kitu ambacho watu wengi hawajui ni kwamba Madiba (kama ambavyo wengi wanapenda kumwita huko Afrika ya Kusini) alitumia miaka 67 ya maisha yake katika kupiga vita ubaguzi wa rangi na umaskini.

eng: South Africa’s former President will turn 92 on Sunday, 18 July 2010.
swa: Jumapili hii Julai 18 2010, Rais huyu wa Zamani atatimiza miaka 92.

eng: For the past 16 years, South Africans have been celebrating Madiba’s birthday with fervor and enthusiasm.
swa: Kwa miaka 16 iliyopita, raia wa Afrika ya Kusini wamekuwa wakisherehekea siku kuu hii ya kuzaliwa Madiba kwa shauku na hamasa motomoto.

eng: In 2002, however, Nelson Mandela himself used this day to launch his global HIV/AIDS awareness and prevention campaign, 46664.
swa: Mnamo mwaka 2002, Nelson Mandela mwenyewe alitumia siku hii kuzindua kampeni yake ya ulimwengu mzima kuhamasisha welewa na kupiga vita tatizo la VVU/UKIMWI, kameni hiyo inajulikana kama 46664.

eng: In 2009, the success of the 46664 campaigns and celebrations evolved to what is now known as “Mandela Day”, a day in which people around the world dedicate 67 minutes to making the world a better place for all.
swa: Mnamo mwaka 2009, mafanikio ya kampeni na sherehe hizo za 46664 zilipiga hatua ya juu zaidi na kuwa kile kinachofahamika kama “Mandela Day”,yaani "Siku ya Mandela", ambayo ni siku wanayotumia watu kila mahali duniani kutoa dakika 67 kwa ajili ya kupafanya duniani kuwa mahali bora zaidi pa kuishi.

eng: The organisers explained:
swa: Waandaaji walieleza hivi:

eng: It was decided that there could be nothing more fitting than to celebrate Madiba’s birthday each year with a day dedicated to his life’s work and that of his charitable organisations and to ensure his legacy continues forever.
swa: Uamuzi ulifikiwa kwamba kusingekuwa na namna nyingine iliyo bora zaidi ya kusherehekea siku ya kuzaliwa Madiba kila mwaka zaidi ya kuwa na siku ambayo itatengwa maalumu kumkumbuka kwa kazi aliyofanya maishani mwake na kwa shughuli za asasi yake ya hisani na kuhakikisha kwamba urithi aliotuachia unaendelea daima.

eng: 2009’s Mandela Day was a roaring success in South Africa.
swa: Siku ya Mandela ya mwaka 2009 ilikuwa yenye mafanikio makubwa sana nchini Afrika ya Kusini.

eng: So much so that 2010 will be the first Nelson Mandela International Day as Joburg reports:
swa: Ilikuwa yenye mafanikio kiasi hicho kwamba tarehe hii katika mwaka 2010 itakuwa ndiyo ya kwanza katika Siku ya Nelson Mandela ya Kimataifa kama Joburg anavyoripoti:

eng: It will be the first Nelson Mandela International Day, as the United Nations passed a resolution on the day in November 2009, declaring 18 July an international day set aside for humanitarian activities.
swa: Itakuwa ndiyo Siku Kimataifa ya Nelson Mandela ya kwanza tangu Umoja wa Mataifa ulipopitisha azimio mwezi Novemba mwaka 2009, likiitangaza tarehe 18 Julai kwamba ni siku inayotengwa kwa ajili ya shughuli za kuimarisha utu.

eng: It is the first time the organisation has dedicated an international day to an individual, recognising him as a symbol of hope for those who are oppressed and marginalised.
swa: Ni mara ya kwanza kabisa ambapo taasisi hiyo kubwa duniani imetangaza siku ya kimataifa kwa jina la mtu binafsi, likimtambua mtu huyo kama alama ya matumaini hasa kwa wale wanaokangamizwa na kutengwa.

eng: Although the day will be celebrated worldwide, Madrid, in Spain has been chosen as the host of the first official Nelson Mandela International Day celebration concert, at which BB King is billed to perform.
swa: Ingawa siku hiyo itasherehekewa kote ulimwenguni, Madrid, mji mkuu wa Hispania, umechaguliwa kuwa wenyeji wa tamasha kubwa la kusherehekea Siku ya Kimataifa ya kwanza ya Nelson Mandela, na BB King anatarajiwa kutumbuiza.

eng: New Yorkers will also host its own celebration concert.
swa: Wakazi wa New York nao wataendesha tamasha lao kubwa la kusherehekea.

eng: Staying with New York, an installation celebrating the life and legacy of Nelson Mandela was put on display in Grand Central Terminal in New York in honour of Mandela Day 46664.
swa: Tukibaki hapo New York, kazi ya kutundika ya sanaa inayosherehekea maisha na urithi wa Nelson Mandela iliwekwa hadharani katika Kituo Kikuu cha jiji la New York kwa heshim ya Mandela Day 46664.

eng: The installation features six illuminated 3-D action words: act, listen, lead, unite, learn and speak.
swa: Tangazo hilo linaonyesha maneno sita yanayotoa mwanga mzuri wa rangi wa pande 3: tenda, sikiliza, ongoza, unganisha, jifunze na sema.

eng: The front of each word shows key messages that reveal Nelson Mandela’s values and inspire visitors to act.
swa: Mbele ya kila neno kuna ujumbe unaoonyesha aliyothamini Nelson Mandela, ujumbe unaowahamasisha wasafiri wanaopita hapo kutenda.

eng: The Nelson Mandela Foundation reports:
swa: Taasisi ya Nelson Mandela inaripoti:

eng: In Italy, the Firenze City Council, in conjunction with the Mandela Forum, have arranged for a video about Mr Mandela, the movie Invictus and Mandela Day, to be aired at the Mandela Forum as well as at an open air cinema in Florence.
swa: Nchini Italia, Halmashauri ya Jiji la Firenze, kwa kushirikiana na Jukwaa la Mandela, wameandaa onyesho la picha za video kuhusu Mandela, sinema na Siku ya Mandela, vyote hivyo vitarushwa katika Jukwaa la Mandela na vilevile katika eneo la wazi la kuonyeshea sinema la Florence.

eng: The Firenze City Council has committed to supporting Mandela Day and encourages all citizens of Florence to get involved in the global movement for good by signing a resolution in support of Mandela Day.
swa: Halmashauri ya Jiji la Firenze imejitolea kusaidia Siku ya Mandela na kuhamasisha raia wa Florence kujihusisha katika vuguvugu hili la ulimwengu kwa ajili ya kutenda wema kwa kutia sahihi katika makubaliano yanayounga mkono kuwepo kwa Siku ya Mandela.

eng: Mandela’s call to action was also heard by Cuba:
swa: Wito wa Mandela wa kutenda pia umesikika kule Cuba:

eng: The Foreign Relations Commission of the Cuban parliament agreed today in an extraordinary meeting to commemorate every July 18 as the International Day of Nelson Mandela.
swa: Tume ya Uhusiano wa Kimataifa ya Bunge la Cuba leo, katika kikao cha dharura, imepitisha uamuzi wa kusherehekea Julai 18 kama Siku ya Kimataifa ya Nelson Mandela.

eng: South Africans have also heeded the call to spend 67 minutes of their day to improve lives in the country.
swa: Raia wa Afrika ya kUsini nao wameitikia wito wa kutumia dakika 67 za siku yao ili kukuza ubora wa maisha nchini humo.

eng: Activities have been set up around the country whereby people may volunteer their time.
swa: Shughuli mbalimbali zimeandaliwa nchini kote ambapo watu watajitolea muda wao.

eng: PastorMosaSono asks:
swa: PastorMosaSono anauliza:

eng: Who's joining us at Chris Hani Bara tomorrow @08h30 for the 67min Mandela Day clean up campaign?
swa: Je, nani atajiunga na sisi pale Chris Hani Bara kesho saa @02h30 asubuhi kwa muda wa dakika 67 katika Siku ya Mandela katika kampeni ya kufanya usafi?

eng: MuffinMegain asserts: Good afternoon Everyone!
swa: MuffinMegain anaeleza kwa msisitizo:

eng: Who's joining us at Chris Hani Bara tomorrow @08h30 for the 67min Mandela Day clean up campaign? #TeamPsSono
swa: Tutakuwa tukisherehekea Siku ya Mandela siku ya Jumapili pale kwenye Zoo ya Lake na tutakuwa tukisaidia kufanya usafi katika jumuiya yetu!

eng: A blogger at Hope Blog says that we should not consider Mandela Day a holiday:
swa: Mwanablogu katika Hope Blog anasema kwamba tuamue kuifanya siku ya Mandela kuwa Siku ya Mapumziko:

eng: Each of us can make a small difference and our collective efforts can truly change the world.
swa: Kila mmoja wetu anaweza kuleta tofauti chanya, hata kama ni kidogo, na tukiweka zote hizo pamoja tunaweza kweli kuleta mabadiliko ulimwengui.

eng: Nelson Mandela Day is not a holiday – it is a day for all of us to all come together through action.
swa: Siku ya Nelson Mandela siyo siku ya mapumziko - ni siku ambayo sisi sote hatuna budi kuungana na kutenda.

eng: Help us to share Nelson Mandela’s vision of a better future for all, take action this weekend, and tell us about it on our Facebook Page.
swa: Tusaidiane katika kueneza ndoto ya Nelson Mandela ya baadaye iliyo bora kwa wote, shiriki katika shughuli fulani mwisho wa juma hili, na utueleze kuhusu shughuli hiyo kupitia ukurasa wa Facebook.

eng: Need some inspiration?
swa: Je, unataka kutiwa matumaini?

eng: Our staff will be sharing their individual volunteer efforts for Nelson Mandela on Facebook as well, and here are 67 ideas on how to change the world.
swa: Wafanyakazi wetu watakuwa wakijitolea juhudi zao kwa ajili ya Nelson Mandela hata kupitia ukurasa wa Facebook, na hapa kuna fikra 67 za namna ya kuubadili ulimwengu.

eng: This is how farm workers in Stellenbosch, South Africa, will honor Mandela Day:
swa: Hivi ndivyo wafanyakazi wa mashambani huko Stellenbosch, Afrika ya kusini, watakavyoienzi Siku ya Mandela:

eng: Farm workers in have urged volunteers to spend 67 minutes with them on Sunday, in celebration of International Mandela Day.
swa: Wafanyakazi wa mashambani wametoa wito kwa watu wa kujitolea kufanya nao kazi kwa dakika 67 siku ya Jumapili katika kusherehekea Siku ya Kimataifa ya Nelson Mandela.

eng: The group "Women on Farms" has set aside a piece of land for unemployed female workers, giving them a chance to put food on the table.
swa: Kundi la "Wanawake walio Mashambani" limetenga kipande cha ardhi kwa ajili ya wanawake wafanyakazi wasio na ajira, wakiwapa fursa ya kupata chakula kidogo cha kuweka mezani.

eng: The initiative aims to alleviate gender discrimination within the agricultural sector.
swa: Kusudi la vuguvugu hilo ni kupunguza ubaguzi wa kijinsia katika sekta ya kilimo.

eng: Tanzanian blogger, Simba Deo, emphasises the value of self-sacrifice:
swa: Mwanablogu wa nchini Tanzania, Simba Deo, anasisitiza thamani ya kujitoa sadaka:

eng: It in giving that we receive
swa: Ni katika kutoa ndiyo tunapokea

eng: In loving that we are loved
swa: Katika kupenda ndiyo tunapendwa

eng: In sacrificing that others do sacrifice for us
swa: Katika kujitoa sadaka ndiyo na wengine wanajitoa sadaka kwa ajili yetu

eng: Self sacrificing for others is key to improving peace, sustaining development, sustaining freedom and justice.
swa: Kujitoa sadaka kwa ajili ya wengine ni ufunguo wa kuendeleza amani, kuendeleza maendeleo, kuendeleza uhuru na haki.

eng: The opposite would be seeking for personal glory.
swa: Kinyume cha kufanya hivyo ni kujitafutia utukufu binafsi.

eng: Whatever we do, we should do it because we believe in it and that it is for humanity and not for personal glory.
swa: Kwa chochote tunachofanya, tukifanye kwa sababu tunaamini katika kitu hicho, na kwamba ni kwa ajili binadamu wenzetu na wala si kwa ajili ya kujitafutia utukufu binafsi.

eng: Dorin and the Bush Warriors Clan want us to honor Mandela by protecting wildlife and the environment:
swa: Dorin na the Bush Warriors Clan wanatutaka kumuenzi Mandela kwa kulinda wanyama pori na misiti na mazingira:

eng: The amazing things Nelson Mandela has done reaches far beyond humans, as he has done many things for wildlife and the environment as well.
swa: Mambo makubwa aliyofanya Nelson Mandela yanapita welewa wa binadamu wengi, maana amefanya mambo mengi kwa ajili ya viumbe pori na mazingira vilevile.

eng: Much like his dreams for human rights, Nelson Mandela has also dreamed of African wilderness being unified in peace across many countries.
swa: Kama ilivyokuwa kwa ndoto zake kuhusu haki za binadamu, Nelson Mandela pia alikuwa na ndoto kuhusu maisha ya viumbe kwenye mapori ya Afrika ili viumbe hao waunganishwe kwa amani katika nchi nyingi.

eng: He once told National Geographic journalist, Peter Godwin, “I dream of an Africa which is in peace with itself…I dream of the realization of the unity of Africa, whereby its leaders combine in their efforts to solve the problems of this continent.
swa: Aliwahi kumwambia mwandishi wa habari wa National Geographic, Peter Godwin, "Nina ndoto ya Afrika iliyo katika amani yenyewe kwa yenyewe ... ninaota ndoto ya kuwezekana kwa muungano wa Afrika, ambapo viongozi wake wataunganisha juhudi zao ili kutatua matatizo yanayolikabili bara hili.

eng: I dream of our vast deserts, of our forests, of all our great wildernesses.
swa: Ninaota juu ya majangwa makubwa, juu ya misitu yetu, ya maisha yote yanayoendelea kwenye nyika na mapori yetu.

eng: We must never forget that it is our duty to protect this environment.
swa: Tusisahau kamwe kwamba ni wajibu wetu kulinda mazingira haya.

eng: Transfrontier parks are a way we can do just that.”
swa: Ni kupitia mbuga za wanyama zinazovuka mipaka ya nchi kwamba tunaweza kufanikisha jambo hilo.

eng: We recently brought you the story about his plan to save southern Africa’s elephants with the implementation of Elephant Corridors.
swa: Hivi karibuni tuliwaletea habari ya mpango wake wa kuokoa tembo wa Afrika ya Kusini kwa kuanzisha Kumbi (penu/njia) za Tembo.

eng: It is through his involvement with his organization, the Peace Parks Foundation, along with Sir Richard Branson, Mike Humphries, and Virgin Unite that this dream will become a reality.
swa: Ni kupitia ushiriki wake katika asasi yake ya the Peace Parks Foundation (Taasisi ya Mbuga za Wanyama za Amani), pamja na ile ya Sir Richard Branson, Mike Humphries, na Virgin Unite kwamba ndoto hiyo itatimia na kuwa kweli.

eng: There is also “Bikers for Mandela Day” – a group of 21 motorbike riders (and Morgan Freeman) who are on a six-day road trip around Cape Town in spread the word about Mandela Day.
swa: Pia kuna “Bikers for Mandela Day” (Waendesha Pikipiki kwa Ajili ya Siku ya Mandela) – kundi la waendesha pikipiki 21 (pamoja na Morgan Freema) ambao wapo katika safari ya siku sita kuizunguka Cape Town ili kusambaza ujumbe wa Siku ya Mandela.

eng: And if you’re still not convinced, have a look at this passionate plea by The Elders
swa: Na kama bado hujashawishika, hebu tazama wito huu mtamu wa kutoka The Elders

eng: Madiba said on his last ever international visit in London, June 2008:
swa: Madiba alisema katika safari yake ya mwisho kabisa ya kimataifa kule Landani, Uingereza, mwezi Juni 2008:

eng: It is time for the next generations to continue our struggle against social injustice and for the rights of humanity.
swa: Sasa ni wakati wa vizazi vya sasa na vijavyo kuendeleza mapambano yetu dhidi ya utovu wa haki na kwa ajili ya haki za binadamu wote.

eng: It is in your hands.
swa: Mapambano hayo sasa yapo mikononi mwenu.

eng: Market in Luanda by Flickr user BRamirez37, CC
swa: Picha ya soko mjini Luanda na mtumiaji wa Flickr BRamirez37, CC

eng: The Roque Santeiro Market, a name that comes from the famous Brazilian soap opera that was a hit among the soap-opera crazed Angolans, is known for being the biggest open-air market in Africa, for transacting thousands of dollars a day, and for being the main stage for the sale of every imaginable product.
swa: Soko la Roque Santeiro, jina ambalo linatokana na maigizo maarufu ya filamu ya Brazil ambao ulipata umashuhuri miongoni mwa wapenzi wa maigizo ya filamu wa Angola, linajulikana kwa kuwa soko kubwa zaidi ya yote barani Afrika, na kwa kufanya biashara ya maelfu ya dola kwa siku, na kwa kuwa ulingo mkuu wa mauzo ya kila bidhaa inayofikirika.

eng: Fortunately or unfortunately, the market’s days are numbered.
swa: Kwa bahati nzuri au mbaya, siku za zoko hilo zinahesabika.

eng: The Luandan government plans to move the market from the Sambizanga to Panguila, located nearly 30 kilometers to the north of Luanda.
swa: Serikali ya Luanda inapanga kulihamisha soko hilo kutoka Sambizanga kwenda panguila, Karibu kilomata 30 kaskazini mwa Luanda.

eng: The date has yet to be decided.
swa: Tarehe bado haijaamriwa.

eng: The Roque Santeiro Market was established in its current venue in the 1980’s, at a time when the country was still beaten down by war and provisions were scarce.
swa: Soko la Roque Santeiro, liliwekwa kwenye eneo lake la sasa mnamo miaka ya 1980, wakati ambao nchi ilikuwa bado imeharibiwa na vita na mahitaji yalipokuwa adimu.

eng: Initially designed like the Boa Vista Market, the commercial area was perhaps the only location where it was possible to find a little bit of everything – albeit through hidden means, including guns and arms trafficking and both adult and child sexual services.
swa: Mwanzoni lilianzishwa kama vile soko la Boa Vista, eneo la biashara lilikuwa pengine ndio sehemu pekee ambayo palikuwa na uwezekano wa kupata bidhaa zozote – japokuwa kwa njia za vificho, pamoja na bunduki na biashara ya silaha na pia huduma za ngono za watu wazima pamoja na watoto.

eng: Currently, the Roque Santeiro Market is means of survival for many Angolan families.
swa: Hivi sasa soko la Roque Santeiro ni njia ya kujikimu ya familia nyingi za WaAngola.

eng: At the same time, the market is also a haven for criminals who have given the commercial area its bad name.
swa: Wakati huo huo, soko hilo pia ni hifadhi ya wahalifu ambao wanalipa eneo hilo la biashara jina baya.

eng: In an old article, taken from the blog entitled Angola Drops, the Brazilian blogger describes the market:
swa: Katika makala ya zamani kwenye blogu, iliyopewa jina la Angola Drops, mwanablogu wa kiBrazili analilezea soko hilo:

eng: The recent assassination of a woman by the alleged father of her baby, and a promising young Brazilian goalkeeper, has been on the media spotlight, shocking the country for the level of violence involved in the crime.
swa: Mauaji ya hivi karibuni ya mwanamke yaliyofanywa na aliyedaiwa kuwa baba wa mwanae, na kijana golikipa mtarajiwa wa Brazil, yamekuwa kwenye vyombo vya habari, na kuishtua nchi nzima kwa kiasi cah ukatili uliofanywa kwenye ualifu huo.

eng: At the same time, Instituto Sangari , a non profit for social awareness on scientific culture based in São Paulo, published its 2010 Map of Violence in Brazil stating that 10 women are assassinated everyday in the country.
swa: Wakati huohuo, Instituto Sangari , taasisi isiyo ya kibiashara ya kuelimisha jamii juu utamaduni wa kisayansi iliyopo São Paulo, ilichapisha Ramani ya Ukatili Nchini Brazil ya mwaka 2010 ikieleza kuwa wanawake kumi wanauawa kila siku nchini humo.

eng: Inevitably, the blogsphere put the two together and condemnation of such crimes became a hot topic beyond the sensationalist broadcasting of mainstream media, which has been limited to the footballer's crime.
swa: Bila shaka, uwanja wa blogu wameweka haya mawili pamoja na ulaani wa vitendo hivyo vya kihalifu umeondokea kuwa mada kuu zaidi ya yale yanayotangazwa katika vyombo vikuu vya habari, ambavyo vimejikita katika habari za uhalifu wa mchezaji huyo wa mpira wa miguu.

eng: According to Nilcéa Freire, minister of women policies, violence against women is in fact largely ignored by the media :
swa: Kwa mujibu wa Nilcéa Freire, Waziri wa sera za wanawake, ukatili dhidi ya wanawake kwa hakika unpuuzwa sana na vyombo vya habari :

eng: Célestin Lingo shows the link betwee the press and the democratization process in Cameroon.
swa: Célestin Lingo anaonyesha uhusiano kati ya vyombo vya habari na mchakato wa demokrasi nchini Cameroon.

eng: A plagiarism scandal broke out in March in Chinese academic circles when Nanjing University literature professor Wang Binbin charged that Wang Hui's dissertation on Lu Xun -Resistance to despair - contains a number of passages lifted from other books without citation.
swa: Kuna kashfa ya wizi wa kitaaluma iliyoibuka mwezi Machi katika duru za kitaaluma za Kichina pale Profesa wa Fasihi wa Chuo Kikuu cha Nanjing, Wang Binbin, alipotuhumu kwamba kazi ya uzamizi ya Wang Hui kuhusu Lu Xun - Kugomea Kukata Tamaa - ina aya kadhaa ambavyo vimenukuliwa moja kwa moja kutoka katika vitabu vingine pasipo kukiri kunukuu huko.

eng: (More background information from Granite Studio and ChinaGeeks)
swa: (Taarifa zaidi za historia ya jambo hilo zinapatikana Granite Studio na ChinaGeeks)

eng: Wang Hui is honored as the spokesperson of the Chinese "New Left" intellectual circle and in spite of the scandal, in May he was nominated by Tsinghua University and successfully received a scholarship award from the highest government authority, the State Council.
swa: Wang Hui anaheshimika kama msemaji mkuu wa "Mrengo Mpya wa Kushoto" wa duru za wasomi wa Kichina na pamoja na kuwa na kashfa hiyo, mwezi Mei alipendekezwa na Chuo Kikuu cha Tsinghua na hatimaye alifaulu kupata tuzo ya udhamini kutoka kwenye mamlaka ya juu kabisa ya serikali, Baraza la Dola.

eng: While Wang Hui kept silent and expected the matter to be “clarified within the academic community”, many scholars and public intellectuals have commented on the issue via local media outlets.
swa: Wakati ambapo Wang Hui mwenyewe aliamua kubaki kimya akitarajia kwamba suala hilo "lingefafanuliwa na kumalizwa ndani ya jamii ya wanataaluma", wasomi wengi walio vyuoni na wasomi wengine walio uraiani wametoa maoni yao kuhusu jambo hilo kupitia vyombo vya habari vya ndani.

eng: Some defended Wang Hui; some pointed out that the dilemma is one of non-standard citation rather than of intentional plagiarism; some have suggested a thorough investigation be led by an independent academic committee.
swa: Wapo waliomtetea Wangu Hui; wapo waliosema kwamba kitendawili hicho kinatokana na kutokutaja vitabu vya rejea kwa kufuata utaratibu wa kawaida zaidi kuliko kufanya wizi wa kitaaluma kwa makusudi; wapo ambao wamependekeza ufanyike uchunguzi wa kina ukiongozwa na kamati huru ya wanataaluma.

eng: The whole debate has mainly taken place within the local academic circle and online public sphere until very recently (July 7) when a local media outlet (ifeng.com) disclosed a joint letter signed by "an international community of scholars, translators, editors, historians and cultural critics" in support of Wang Hui.
swa: Mdahalo huo mzima umefanywa zaidi miongoni mwa wasomi wa ndani ya nchi na kwenye mtandao wa intaneti mpaka hivi karibuni kabisa (Julai 7) pale chombo cha habari kimoja cha nchini humo (ifeng.com) kilipochapisha barua iliyotiwa saini kwa pamoja na "jumuiya ya kimataifa ya wasomi, wafasiri, wahariri, wanahistoria na wakosoaji wa utamaduni" wakimwunga mkono kwa juhudi zote Wang Hui.

eng: Backup from international academic community
swa: Uungwaji mkono kutoka katika jumuiya ya wanazuoni wa kimataifa

eng: The open letter, signed by many prominent western scholars such as Tani Barlow, Arif Dirlik, Gayatri C. Spivak and Frederic Jameson, frames the plagiarism charge as an "attack from the popular media in China" and defends Wang Hui's academic integrity:
swa: Barua hiyo ya wazi, iliyotiwa saini na wanazuoni wenye majina mkubwa wa kimagharibi kama vile Tani Barlow, Arif Dirlik, Gayatri C. Spivak na Frederic Jameson,imezichukulia shutuma hizo za wizi wa kitaaluma kama "mashambulizi kutoka katika vyombo vya habari vya Uchina vinavyojitafutia umaarufu" na inatetea umadhubuti wa kitaaluma wa Wang Hui:

eng: The charges have been contested and discredited in the careful analyses given by Zhong Biao, Shu Wei, Wei Xing and others.
swa: Shutuma hizo zimepata pingamizi na hata kuonekana kuwa hazina maana kufuatia uchambuzi yakinifu uliofanywa na Zhong Biao, Shu Wei, Wei Xing na wengineo.

eng: Among the signatories to this letter are also translators and they are without doubt closest to the work of Wang Hui.
swa: Miongoni mwa waliotia sahihi zao kwenye barua hii ni pamoja na wafasiri, ambao bila shaka wapo karibu sana na kazi za Wang Hui.

eng: Each translator has checked and double checked all the footnotes in the vast bibliographies of Professor Wang's publications over the last thirty years.
swa: Kila mfasiri amekagua tena na tena rejea zote katika machapisho makubwa yote ya wasifu za watu miongoni mwa zile alizoandika Profesa Wang Hui katika miaka thelathini iliyopita.

eng: None has found any indication of plagiarism no matter how loosely this word is defined.
swa: Hakuna mfasiri aliyeona hata dalili kidogo ya wizi wa kitaaluma hata kwa kujaribu kuchukua maana ya mbali kabisa ya neno hilo.

eng: Second, among us are many Asia specialists in Chinese studies and we attest to Professor Wang's scholarly integrity and his importance in international Asian studies.
swa: Jambo la pili, miongoni mwetu wapo wataalamu wa masuala ya Asia katika Masomo Juu ya Uchina na tunathibitisha kwamba umadhubuti wa kitaaluma wa Profesa Wang unasimama kidete na vivyo hivyo umuhimu wake katika masomo ya kimataifa kuhusu Asia.

eng: Interestingly, the two accounts of Zhong Biao and Wei Xing, quoted in the letter, were set up for the purpose of this debate but quoted as if the two individuals were well-known public intellectuals.
swa: Jambo la kushangaza zaidi, ushuhuda wa Zhong Biao na Wei Xing, kama ulivyonukuliwa kwenye barua hiyo, uliandaliwa maalumu kwa ajili ya mdahalo huu lakini umenukuliwa kama kwamba watu hao wawili ni wasomi wanaofahamika vema sana na umma.

eng: In addition, their “careful analyses” have yet to clear Wang Hui of his technical mistakes.
swa: Zaidi ya hilo, "uchunguzi wao huo yakinifu" bado haujamsafisha Wang Hui kuhusu makosa yake hayo ya kiufundi.

eng: In Zhong Biao's article, he explains the background of Wang Hui's book and criticizes Wang Binbin's unreasonable charge:
swa: Katika makala ya Zhong Biao, anaelezea historia ya kitabu cha Wangu Hui na anakosoa shutuma zisizo na maana alizotoa Wang Binbin:

eng: The state broadcaster CCTV revealed in June 28 that China is expected to receive 8 trillion yuan ($1.18 trillion) in financial revenue by the end of 2010.
swa: Shirika la utangazaji la taifa CCTV liliweka wazi mnamo tarehe 28 Juni kuwa China inatarajia kupata yuani trilioni 8 (sawa na dola trilioni 1.18) katika mapato ya fedha kufikia mwisho wa 2010.

eng: Such figure will turn China into the second-largest country in terms of revenue income after the United States.
swa: Mapato hayo kitaifanya China kuwa nchi ya pili kwa ukubwa wa mapato ya fedha baada ya Marekani.

eng: It seems that China has realized its dream of being a strong country, however, netizens have been rather skeptical about the news because of the uneven distribution of wealth.
swa: Inaoneka kuwa China imefanikisha ndoto yake ya kuwa taifa imara, hata hivyo, raia wa kwenye mtandao wamekuwa na mashaka kuhusu taarifa hiyo kwa sababu ya mgawanyo wa utajiri usio sawa.

eng: Great Leap Forward in financial revenue
swa: “Hatua Kuu Mbele” katika mapato ya fedha

eng: Online current affair commentator, Hou Jinliang, says that such kind of "Great Leap Forward" is unbearable.
swa: Mtaalamu wa mambo katika wavuti, Hou Jinliang, anasema kuwa “Hatua Kuu Mbele” ya namna hiyo haistahimiliki.

swa: Picha kwa kupitia Wikipedia

eng: I was a bit sad when I saw the bold headline at Modern Ghana website yesterday; “Rawlings Homeless”.
swa: Nilisikitishwa kidogo jana pale nilipoona kichwa kikubwa cha habari katika tovuti ya Modern Ghana “Rawlings Hana pa Kuishi”.

eng: Jerry Rawlings is the former president of Ghana.
swa: Jerry Rawlings ni rais wa zamani wa Ghana.

eng: I became totally shocked after reading just part of the story. In February, 2010 an intense fire described as "rapid and fast" razed to ashes the residence of former President Jerry Rawlings with nothing to salvage from the debris.
swa: Nilishtushwa sana baada ya kusoma kipande kidogo tu cha habari hiyo.Mwezi Februari, 2010 moto mkali ulioelezwa kama ‘wa ghafla na haraka” uliteketeza makazi ya Rais wa zamani Jerry Rawlings na haukubakisha kitu chochote kilichoweza kuokolewa kutoka kwenye mabaki ya moto huo.

eng: The fire was said to have started at about 0420GMT during a heavy rain characterized by intermittent power cuts.
swa: Moto huo ulielezwa kuwa ulianza mnamo majira ya 10 na dakika 20 Saa za GMT wakati wa mvua kubwa iliyombatana na kukatikakatika kwa umeme.

eng: While no life was lost, the disaster left behind “the depressing spectacle" of the ruins of a house which firemen had tried in vain to salvage in three hours.
swa: Wakati hakuna maisha yaliyopotea, janga hilo liliacha “sura ya kusikitisha” ya mabaki ya nyumba ambayo wazima moto walijaribu bila mafanikio kuyaokoa kwa masaa matatu.

eng: The fire burnt nearly every valuable item and by the time the fire service personnel were done putting out the inferno; everything was down to ashes except the concrete walls and pillars.
swa: Moto huo uliunguza Karibu kila kitu chenye thamani na wakati wazima moto walipomaliza kuuzima moto huo; kila kitu kilikuwa ni majivu isipokuwa kuta za zege na nguzo.

eng: According to the Modern Ghana website Ghana's former president and his wife are homeless and urgently looking for an accomodation to rent in Accra.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa tovuti ya Modern Ghana kiongozi huyo wa zamani wa Ghana pamoja na mkewe hawana makazi na wanatafuta kwa haraka sehemu ya kupanga mjini Accra.

eng: It is also reported that the former president had to travel from a “small village house” at Tefle in the Volta Region to Ghana’s capital; Accra for meetings when the needs arise whiles his wife is currently putting up with her mother at the Nyaniba Estate residency; a situation which is affecting their marriage.
swa: Kadhalika inaripotiwa kwamba rais huyo wa zamani alipaswa kusafiri kutoka katika “nyumba ndogo ya vijijini” Tefle katika mkoa wa Volta mpaka kwenye mji mkuu wa Ghana, Accra kwa ajili ya mikutano pale anapohitajika wakati mkewe kwa wakati huu anaishi na mama yake katika kitongoji cha Janiba; hali ambayo inaathiri ndoa yao.

eng: According to the former first lady, Nana Konadu; when their Ridge residence got burnt on February 14, 2010; government promised to find an alternative residential facility for them but 5 months later, that promise from government is far from being fulfilled.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa mke wa rais huyo wa zamani, Nana Konadu; wakati makazi yao ya huko Ridge yalipoungua tarehe 14, februari; serikali iliahidi kutafuta makazi mbadala kwa ajili yao lakini miezi 5 baadaye, ahadi hiyo ya serikali iko mbali na kutimizwa.

eng: She also complained that the Ridge residence might have been saved from the fire if the house had a constant flow of water because when the fire fighters arrived, they had little water in their tanks and thought they could get some more water from the house.
swa: Pia alilalamika kuwa makazi ya Ridge yangeweza kuokolewa kama nyumba ingekuwa na upatikanaji wa maji wa uhakika kwani wakati wazima moto walipowasili, walikuwa na maji kidogo tu kwenye mitungi yao na walifikiri kuwa wangeliweza kupata maji zaidi pale nyumbani.

eng: Let's look at the opinions of Ghanaian bloggers and their readers on this issue.
swa: Hebu tuangalie maoni ya wanablogu wa Ghana na wasomaji wao kuhusu suala hili.

eng: Obed Nanayaw Sarpong does not understand why the former first family wants a new house from government:
swa: Obed Nanayaw Sarpong haelewi kwa nini familia hiyo ya kwanza ya zamani inadai nyumba kutoka kwa serikali:

eng: Earlier last week, the former first lady, Nana Konadu Agyemang Rawlings granted an interview to Joy fm in Accra in which she spoke widely about how her family life has been affected after they lost the ridge residence.
swa: Mapema wiki iliyopita, mke wa rais wa zamani, Nana Konadu Agyemang Rawlings alikuwa na mahojiano na Joy FM mjini Accra ambayo kwayo aliongelea kwa upana kuhusu jinsi ambavyo maisha yake ya kifamilia yalivyoathirika baada ya kupoteza makazi yao ya Ridge.

eng: I couldn't help laughing.
swa: Sikuweza kujizuia kucheka.

eng: I hated that my almost 5-month old prophecy that the former first family would demand a new residence from government, and the people of this country, was coming to pass.
swa: Nilichukia kwamba utabiri wangu wa takriban miezi 5 kuwa familia ya rais wa zamani ingedai nyumba mpya kutoka kwa serikali, na watu wan chi hii, ungetimia.

eng: The rest, we all live to see.
swa: Mengine yote, tutayaona.

eng: As a country, we should wipe off the letters in the constitution that give those 3 or more houses plus cars etc to people who have served this country.
swa: Kama nchi, inatubidi tufute vipengele kwenye katiba ambavyo vinatoa nyumba 3 au zaidi pamoja na magari n.k. kwa watu ambao walilitumikia taifa hili.

eng: My opinion is that if they love this country well enough like I do, they would allow those monies to be used in ensuring the people of this country get good and safe drinking water, a place to 'ease' themselves (if they get to eat at all), schools etc.
swa: Maoni yang uni kuwa ikiwa wanaipenda nchi vya kutosha kama ninavyoipenda mimi, wangeruhusu fedha hizo zitumike katika kuhakikisha watu wan chi hii wanapata maji safi na salama ya kunywa, sehemu za ‘kujisaidia’ (ikiwa wote wanakula vizuri), shulke n.k.

eng: Things they couldn't provide while they had access to the resources to do so!
swa: Vitu ambavyo hawakuweza kuvitoa wakati walipokuwa na rasilimali za kufanya hivyo!

eng: Mike reacts to Obed’s post saying:
swa: Mike anaijibu makala ya Obed kwa kusema:

eng: So they lost their Ridge residence?
swa: Wamepoteza makazi yao ya Ridge?

eng: Why not live at their Adjiringanor house?
swa: Kwa nini wasiishi katika nyumba yao ya Adjiringanor?

eng: What about the one off the Volta River near the Sogakope Bridge?
swa: Vipi kuhusu ile iliyo Karibu na mto Volta pale Karibu na daraja la Sogakope?

eng: They don't own those anymore?This is why I'm excited about Ghanaians blogging.
swa: Hawazimiliki tena nyumba hizo? Hii ndiyo sababu ya kusisimka kwa waGhana kublogu.

eng: Those that are full of crap will be noted.
swa: Wale waliojaa upuuzi wataonwa.

eng: If Rawlings had a blog in 1978, 1979, we would have evidence of what drove him to power and what he stood for.
swa: Kama rawlings angelikuwa na blogu mwaka 1978, 1979, tungelikuwa na ushahidi wa kile kilichomsukuma madarakani na kile alichokisimamia.

eng: The hypocrisy in some ranks has hurt the country and apparently is still crippling us.
swa: Unafiki katika ngazi fulani umeiumiza nchi hii na bila ya shaka unaendelea kutukwaza.

eng: Obed Nanayaw Sarpong responds to Mike's comment:
swa: Obed Nanayaw Sarpong anajibu maoni ya Mike:

eng: @Mike, they say the house is not completed-there is a 10m high wall around that residence.
swa: @Mike,wanasema kuwa nyumba haijamalizika kujengwa – kuna ukuta wenye urefu wa mita 10 unaozunguka nyumba hiyo.

eng: The wife says Mr. Rawlings lives at the Tefle residence and it's a challenge for them.
swa: Mke wae anasema kuwa Bw. Rawlings anaishi kwnye nyumba ya Tefle n ani tatizo kwao.

eng: I get disappointed when these men and women shamelessly want to feed on us
swa: Ninasikitishwa sana wakati hawa watu bila aibu wanapotaka kutunyonya.

eng: Ghana’s Most Irreverent; Ato Kwamena Dadzie says, "Get a mortgage, Mr. Rawlings":
swa: Mwandishi mwenye kejeli wa Ghana: Ato Kwamena Dadzie “Chukua mkopo wa nyumba, Bw. Rawlings”:

eng: Almost everything Mrs. Rawlings said in that interview seemed calculated to deceive Ghanaians into thinking that her family was in a very dire situation and to force the hand of government to do her bidding, knowing very well that she had rejected government offers of alternative accommodation.
swa: Karibu kila kitu alichosema Bi. Rawlings katika mahojiano yale kilionekana kulenga kuwarubuni Waghana wafikirie kuwa familia yake imo kwenye hali mbaya na kulazimisha mkono wa serikali kupandisha dau lake, huku akijua fika kuwa amekataa serikali kila dau la makazi mbadala lilitolewa na serikali.

eng: I foolishly fell for her trickery.
swa: Nilianguka kijinga kwenye hila zake.

eng: I sat on radio and said government had no excuse for its failure to provide the Rawlings’s with alternative accommodation – five months after something (or someone) set their house on fire.
swa: Niliketi kando ya redio na kusema serikali haikuwa na kisingizio kwa kushindwa kwake kutoa makazi mbadala kwa familia ya Rawlings – miezi mitano baada ya kitu (au mtu) kuiunguza nyumba yao.

eng: I wasn’t alone.
swa: Sikuwa peke yangu.

eng: Others were also incensed and government had no choice than to come out to quickly rebut her claim that nothing had been done yet to provide her family with a home."
swa: Wengine pia walikasirishwa na serikali haikuwa na jingine la kufanya isipokuwa kujitokeza haraka na kukana madai yake kuwa hakuna lolote lililofanywa ili kuipatia familia yake nyumba”

eng: With that, one question was foremost on many Ghanaian minds.
swa: Pamoja na hilo, swali moja lilikuwa mbele zaidi ya akili za Waghana.

eng: “Ah, Rawlings paa,” one man asked.
swa: “Ah, Rawlings,” mtu mmoja aliuliza.

eng: “After 19 years in power as a dictator, is he saying that he hasn’t built a house for himself?”
swa: “Baada ya miaka 19 madarakani kama mtawala wa kiimla, je anasema kuwa hajajijengea nyumba?”

eng: Ato advises Rawlings to go to Ghana Home Loans to get a mortgage:
swa: Ato anamshauri Rawlings aende kwenye Shirika la Mikopo ya Nyumba la Ghana ili akachukue mkopo::

eng: That’s just about as far as we should go.
swa: Hapo ndio pengine inabidi tufike.

eng: It’s a good salary Rawlings gets.
swa: Ni mshahara mzuri tu anaoupata rawlings.

eng: In Gaza, blogger Kalam was thinking of someone he wished were on the ship: هي هلا التي لم تكمل سنتها الأولى في الحياة بعد، ولكنها تحمل بالوراثة كل مشاعر الفلسطيني المغترب، فهي ابنة للاجئ لم من يرى من أرضه شبرا واحدا طوال حياته، ولأم تعيش مشتتة الفؤاد بين الوطن والغربة بين الأهل والزوج بين الأم والبيت بين الأخوة والأبناء، فعقلها وجزء مهم من قلبها هناك وأهلها وبقية قلبها وذكرياتها هنا.

eng: She is the daughter of a refugee who has seen not a single inch of his land his whole life, and of a mother who lives with her heart split between her homeland and a foreign country, between her family and her marriage, between her mother and her home, between her siblings and her children.

eng: Her mind and an important part of her heart are there, and her family and the rest of her heart and her memories are here.

eng: Praise God and ask him to allow her to come to Gaza… She is unable to come because of the difficulty of getting residence in Libya, which means she cannot be sure of returning there where her father who is a displaced person – he does not have an identity number – and the rest of her family are.

eng: Hala is waiting full of hope, a hope larger than the Libyan ship coming to us here, which I have wished so much she were on so I could embrace her; when they reach I will see in every one of them a piece of Hala's image, and I will ask them why they did not bring Hala with them.

eng: Regulating internet content today is viewed as an anti-democratic practice but Southeast Asian governments seem able to justify it by invoking the need to save the young from the scourge of indecent sexual behavior.
swa: Kuratibu vilivyopo kwenye mtandao siku hizi inaonekana kama ni kitendo kinachopinga demokrasia lakini serikali za Kusini Mashariki mwa Asia zinaonekana kuweza kuhalalisha vitendo hivyo kwa kudai kuwa vinatokana na haja ya kuwaepusha vijana na majanga ya tabia za ngono za hovyo hovyo.

eng: Indonesia’s plan to filter web of “bad” content through its Multimedia Content Screening team was shelved last February after it was opposed by the public.
swa: Mpango wa Indonesia wa kuuchuja mtandao wa intaneti na mambo yote “mabaya” kwa kutumia timu maalumu ya kuchuja media-anuai uliwekwa pembeni mwezi wa pili mwaka huu baada ya kupingwa vikali na wananchi.

eng: Today, the proposal is being revived in the wake of a celebrity sex tape scandal which continues to shock both the young and old in the world’s most populous Muslim-majority nation.
swa: Leo, pendekezo hilo limeamshwa upya kutokana na kuwepo kwa mkanda wa kutia aibu wa ngono wa mtu maarufu ambao unaendelea kuwastua wote watoto na watu wazima katika nchi yenye idadi kubwa zaidi ya Waislamu duniani.

eng: After enacting an anti-pornography law two years ago, Indonesia now wants to enforce an internet blacklist in response to the demand of conservative voices to protect the morals of the young.
swa: Baada ya kurasimisha sheria ya kupinga picha za ngono miaka miwili iliyopita, Indonesia sasa inataka kuanzisha orodha ya visivyotakiwa mtandaoni kama namna ya kuitikia haja ya makundi ya kihafidhina ya kulinda maadili ya vijana.

eng: A similar celebrity sex scandal hounded the Philippines last year which paved the way for the passage of an anti-voyeurism law.
swa: Mkasa wa kutia aibu wa ngono wa watu wanaojulikana sanawa namna hiyo uliibabatiza sana nchi ya Ufilipinomwaka jana ambao ulifagia njia ya kuanzishwa kwa sheria inayozuia kuangalia mambo ya nguoni.

eng: The internet was also blamed for the instant dissemination of the sex tapes which prodded lawmakers to craft a cybercrime bill.
swa: Mtandao wa intaneti pia ulilaumiwa kwa kusambaza papo kwa papo kanda za hizo za ngono na hivyo watunga sheria kuamua kupitisha mswaada wa makaosa ya kimtandao.

eng: In Cambodia, the government is proposing to establish a state-run exchange point to control all local internet service providers which is intended to strengthen internet security against pornography, theft and other cybercrimes.
swa: Huko Kambodia, serikali inapendekeza kuanzishwa kwa kituo cha taifa cha usambazaji ili kudhibiti watoa huduma za intaneti, kituo hicho kina nia ya kuimarisha usalama wa kwenye mtandao dhidi ya picha za ngono, wizi pamoja na uhalifu mwingine wa kwenye mtandao.

eng: The draft regulation is not yet final but it is expected that the government will seriously pursue this measure especially after it recently became almost helpless in stopping the cell phone and internet uploading of an illegally taped video of nude ladies bathing in a monastery.
swa: Rasimu ya sheria hiyo bado haijakamilika lakini inategemewa kuwa serikali itafuatilia hatua hii kwa makini hasa baada ya kukaribia kushindwa kuzuia upakiaji holela kwenye simu za viganjani na kwenye intaneti wa wa picha za uchi za wanawake waliokuwa wakioga hekaluni zilizopigwa kinyume cha sheria .

eng: Southeast Asian governments do no always need sex scandals to censor the web since they can always cite other reasons, like national security, to filter and monitor internet content.
swa: Kusini mashariki mwa Asia serikali hazihitaji kutokee shutuma za ngono ndipo ianze kuchunga mtandao kwani huweza kutumia sababu nyingine yeyote, kama usalama wa taifa, kuchuja na kufuatilia vilivyopo kwenye mtandao.

eng: For example, Thailand became the first country in the world to shut down 100,000 websites for containing “dangerous” material.
swa: Kwa mfano, Thailand ilikuwa ya kwanza kufungatovuti 100,000 fkutokana na kuwa na mambo “hatari”.

eng: It punishes bloggers, writers and website administrators for violating the lese majeste law.
swa: Huwaadhibu wanablogu,waandishi na waratibu wa tovuti kwa kukiuka sheria inayoulinda ufalme dhidi ya aibu.

eng: Vietnam was accused by Google and McAfee of launching cyber attacks against some websites, specifically websites that advocate opposition to bauxite mining, a controversial issue in the country.
swa: Vietnam ilishutumiwa na Google na McAfee kwa kufanya mashambulizi ya mtandaoni dhidi ya baadhi ya tovuti, hasa tovuti zinazoandika kuhusu uchimbaji wa madini yanayotengeneza bati, ambao ni mjadala tata nchini humo.

eng: But politically-driven internet regulation often encounters strong opposition from internet users and it always elicits condemnation around the world, especially from media groups and human rights organizations.
swa: Lakini uratibu wa mtandao unaosukumwa na siasa mara nyingi huwa unakumabana na upinzani mkubwa sana kutoka kwa watumiaji wa mtandao na mara nyingi huamsha lawama nyigi sana kote ulimwenguni, hasa kutoka kwa vyombo vya habari na mashirika ya haki za binadamu.

eng: Governments can always ignore the noisy critics but they will also lose credibility.
swa: Serikali zinaweza kuwapuuzia wakosoaji wenye kelele nyingi lakini pia zinaweza kupoteza umaarufu.

eng: Governments with democratic trappings cannot afford to censor the online media for an extended period.
swa: Serikali zenye vifungu vya demokrasia haziwezi kumudu kuwa na ujanja wa kuratibu vinavyokuwepo kwenye mtandao kwa muda mrefu.

eng: But regulating the web to stop pornography and other immoral acts somehow generates only a whisper of protest.
swa: Lakini kuratibu mtandao ili kuzuia picha za ngono na vitendo vingine visivyo na maadili huamsha lawama chache sana na za chini chini.

eng: It has become the safest ruse to block “harmful” websites.
swa: Imekuwa ni ujanja salama kuzuia tovuti “haribifu”.

eng: Myanmar’s internet regulation policy has been identified as one of the draconian measures imposed by the ruling junta but its decision to ban two weekly journals for posting photos of female models in short pants didn’t draw the normal level of opposition from democracy groups.
swa: Myanmar’s Sera ya uratibu wa mtandao ya Myanmar iliyosimikwa na utawala wa kijeshi imetambuliwa kuwa ndio iliyo katili kuliko zote ulimwenguni kwa uamuzi wake wa kuyapiga marufuku majarida mawili ya kila wiki kwa kuchapisha picha za wanawake wanamitindo wakiwa nusu uchi japo hawakupata kukosolewa sana na wanaopenda demokrasia.

eng: The aggressive drive to eliminate sex and sexual imageries in the online domain may be a symptom of the rising tide of conservatism in many Southeast Asian nations.
swa: Hatua kali za kutaka kuondoa ngono na picha za ngono mtandaoni inaweza kuwa ni dalili ya kuibuka upya kwa uhafidhina katika nchi nyingi za Kusini Mashariki mwa Asia.

eng: The morality card is being played to produce desirable attitudes, sentiments and behavior among the population even if this strategy disrespects the diverse cultures in the region.
swa: Karata ya maadili inachezwa ili kurudisha hali inayokubalika, hisia na tabia halali kati ya watu hata kama njia itumikayo haitaheshimu tofauti za mila na desturi kati ya watu wa kanda hiyo.

eng: When Indonesia passed the anti-porn law, the Bali governor protested since the law is contrary to the local tradition where making historic nude statues and erotic dances are sometimes still popular.
swa: Wakati Indonesia ilipopitisha sheria ya kupinga picha za ngono, Gavana wa Bali aliipinga kwa vile sheria ilikuwa ile ilikuwa kinyume na tamaduni za za eneo hilo ambako kuweka sanamu za uchi zenye kuamsha hisia bado zina nafasi na zinakubalika.

eng: When Cambodia blocked websites showing pornography or sexy images, it included reahu.net for containing artistic illustrations of ancient bare-breasted Apsara dancers and a Khmer Rouge soldier.
swa: Wakati Kambodia ilipozizuia tovuti zinazoonesha picha za ngono, iliijumuishareahu.net kwa kuwa na vielelezo vya kisanii vyawachezaji wa zama wa Apsara walio matiti wazi pamoja na askari wa Khmer Rouge.

eng: Another problem is the vague definition of what constitutes images and actions that are pornographic, indecent, immoral, and obscene.
swa: Tatizo jingine ni maelezo yasiyoeleweka ya lipi hasa linaloweza kuitwa ni la ki ngono, lisilo la kistaarabu, lisilo la kimaadili, na la nguoni.

eng: Filipino activists are worried that the cybercrime bill would now make it unlawful to publish or upload materials that contradict the official state interpretation of what is decent, moral, and proper.
swa: Wanaharakati wa Kifilipino wana mashaka kuwa muswaada wa uhalifu wa mtandaoni sasa unaweza kufanya kuwa kinyume cha sheria kuchapisha au kupakia maudhui yaliyo kinyume cha tafsiri ya serikali ya vitu vyenye heshima, maadili na sawa.

eng: Governments have mastered the tools and techniques of censorship in the traditional media.
swa: Serikali zimefuzu nyenzo na mbinu za kuchuja habari kwenye vyombo vya habari vya kitamaduni.

eng: They are now testing the limits of online regulation.
swa: Hivi sasa wanaijaribu mipaka ya udhibiti wa kwenye mtandao.

eng: Indonesia’s plan to enforce an internet blacklist should be monitored because of its impact in the region.
swa: Mpango wa Indonesia wa kusimika orodha marufuku ya kwenye intaneti unapaswa ufuatiliwe kutokana na athari zake kwenye eneo hilo.

eng: Indonesia has more than 40 million internet users and it is acknowledged as the Twitter capital of Asia.
swa: Indonesia ina watumiaji wa intaneti zaidi ya milioni 40 na imetambuliwa kama makao makuu yaTwitter katika Asia.

eng: If Indonesia succeeds in filtering web content, other countries in the region are expected to follow this model.
swa: Kama Indonesia itafanikiwa katiaka kuchuja yaliyopo mtandaoni, nchi nyingine katika eneo hili zinatarajiwa kufuata mfano huo.

eng: Web censorship does not only cut access to information; it also weakens the power of internet users to form online solidarities.
swa: Kuuchunga mtandao hakuishii tu kuzuia upatikanaji wa taarifa, bali pia hudhoofisha mshikamano wa watumiaji wa intaneti katika mtandao.

eng: To really protect the young and innocent, the best solution is to give them, their parents, and the community in general, the proper education and relevant information about the potential and risks of surfing the web.
swa: Ili kuwakinga vijana wasio na hatia, njia rahisi ni kuwapa elimu muafaka wazazi na hao vijana na jamii kwa ujumla kuhusiana na faida na hasara za kuuvinjari mtandao.

eng: On December 18, 2008, millions of Thai mobile phone subscribers got this text message from the newly installed Prime Minister Abhisit Vejjajiva:
swa: Mnamo Disemba 18, 2008, mamilioni ya wateja wa simu za viganjani wa Thailand walipokea ujumbe huu kutoka kwa Waziri Mkuu mpya Abhisit Vejjajiva:

eng:
I, Abhisit Vejjajiva, the Prime Minister, realized that you fellow citizens are suffering, and are under stress. 	“Mimi, Abhisit Vejjajiva, Waziri Mkuu, nimeona kwamba ninyi raia wenzangu mnateseka, na mko kwenye shinikizo kubwa.
Therefore, I'll concentrate in exerting all my knowledge and ability to help the country. 	Kwa hiyo, nitajipanga kuelekeza maarifa na uwezo wangu wote ili kuisaidia nchi.
But I can't succeed if Thai people are not together in harmony.	Lakini siwezi kufaulu kama watu wa Thai hawana mshikamano.
So I beg you all a chance.
swa: Kwa hiyo, nawaomba nyote mnipe fursa."

eng: sms from the PMAccording to Democrat Party officer, the text messaging was an idea of Abhisit himself, and was coordinated by Korn Chatikavanij, the country's Finance Minister.
swa: UjumbeKwa mujibu wa ofisa wa Chama cha Demokrasia, wazo la kutumia ujumbe mfupi wa maneno lilikuwa ni la Abhisit mwenyewe, na lilisimamiwa na Korn Chatikavanij, ambaye ni Waaziri wa Fedha.

eng: Korn allegedly called Thailand's three major mobile phone operators, AIS, DTAC, and True, for a cooperation to send out the message to their subscribers.
swa: Inatuhumiwa kwamba Korn aliitisha mkutano na makampuni makubwa matatu ya simu za mkononi ya AIS, DTAC, na True, na kuyataka yatoe ushirikiano katika kutuma ujumbe huo mfupi wa maneno kwa wateja wao.

eng: The meeting for cooperation was held in December 16, one day before Abhisit Vejjajiva got officially appointed to be the Prime Minister.
swa: Mkutano huo wa ushirikiano ulifanyika tarehe 16 Disemba, siku moja kabla Abhisit Vejjajiva hajateuliwa rasmi kuwa Waziri Mkuu.

eng: And the reason for requesting for 5-digits postcode is to evaluate the demographic of those who replied.
swa: Na sababu iliyotolewa ya kuomba tarakimu 5 ni ili kutathmini idadi ya watu ambao wangejibu ujumbe huo.

eng: The subscribers will then be listed in a database.
swa: Baadaye wateja hao wangeorodheshwa na kuingizwa kwenye mfumo wa hifadhidata.

eng: Sending a text message to a person without the person's consent is considered a violation of a consumer's privacy rights, said consumer rights advocate Saree Ongsomwang.
swa: Kutuma ujumbe mfupi wa maneno kwa mtu pasipo kupata ridhaa yake ni jambo linalotazamwa kama ukiukwaji wa haki za faragha za wateja, alieleza mtetezi wa haki za walaji Saree Ongsomwang.

eng: She said Abhisit should opt to keep contacts with the people via television and other public communication outlets in order to avoid infringing on the consumer's rights.
swa: Yeye alisema kwamba Abhisit hana budi kuendeleza mawasiliano yake na hadhira kupitia televisisheni na njia nyingine za mawasiliano ya ummaili kuepuka kutovunja haki za walaji.

eng: Saree, who is also part of the committee of the Telecommunication Consumer Protection Institute, added that under Thai telecommunication law, mobile phone operators are not allowed to release the list of subscribers without their consent.
swa: Saree, ambaye ni mmoja wa wajumbe wa kamati ya Taasisi ya Utetezi wa Walaji katika Mawasiliano ya Simu, aliongeza kwamba sheria inayosimamia mawasiliano ya simu nchini Thailand, kampuni zinazotoa huduma ya simu za mkononi haziruhusiwa kuweka hadharani orodha ya wateja wao pasipo kwanza kupata ridhaa yao.

eng: When the three mobile operators sent the controversial text message to their subscribers, free of charge, in behalf of the Prime Minister or the Democrat Party, it brought some legal and political complications.
swa: Pale makampuni hayo matatu yalipotuma ujumbe huo wenye utata kwa wateja wao, pasipo kutoza malipo, kwa niaba ya Waziri Mkuu au Chama Cha Demokrasia, jambo hilo lilileta migogoro ya kisheria na kisiasa.

eng: Under the 1999 Anti-Corruption Law (amended 2007), state officers, including cabinet members, cannot receive any gift or benefit that is worth more than 3,000 Baht.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Kupiga Vita Ufisadi ya mwaka 1999 (iliyorekebishwa mwaka 2007), watumishi wa umma, ikiwa ni pamoja na mawaziri, , hawaruhusiwi kupokea zawadi au takrima inayoziti Bhat 3,000.

eng: It is estimated that the sending of the Prime Minister's text message cost more than 10 million Baht.
swa: Inakadiriwa kwamba utumaji wa ujumbe huo wa Waziri Mkuu unagharimu zaidi ya Baht milioni 10.

eng: Abhisit could be charged in the courts, as argued by Pheu Thai Party spokesman Prompong Nopparit, urging the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) to investigate the case.
swa: Kwa maana hiyo, Abhisit anaweza kupelekwa mahakamani kujibu mashitaka ya kuvunja sheria hiyo, ndivyo alivyojenga hoja msemaji wa Chama cha Pheu Thai, Prompong Nopparit, ambapo aliihimiza Tume ya Kudhibiti Rushwa ya Taifa (NACC) kuanzisha uchunguzi wa kesi hiyo.

eng: If Abhisit and Korn are found guilty, they will be impeached and suspended from holding any political position in accordance with the Constitution.
swa: Endapo Abhisit na Korn watapatikana na hatia, watavuliwa madaraka yao na kupigiwa marufuku kushika nafasi yoyote ya kisiasa kwa mujibu wa Katiba ya nchi.

eng: Comments in the Internet were quite mixed at that time.
swa: Maoni yaliyotumwa kwenye mtandao wa intaneti yalikuwa tofautitofauti kwa wakati ule.

eng: In general, many agreed that this may be a violation of privacy and personal data, and the Prime Minister doing too much PR on media.
swa: Kwa ujumla, wengi walikubaliana kwamba ukiukwaji wa haki za faradha za walajio pamoja na siri za taarifa binafsi, pamoja na Waziri Mkuu kufanya mambo mengi ili kujijengea sifa binafsi kupitia vyombo vya habari.

eng: But at the same time they feel that if it's a good intention, it should be ok, and he should have a chance to work for the country.
swa: Lakini wakati huohuo wengi wanafikiri pia kwamba nia yake ilikuwa njema, kwa hiyo hakuna shida, na kwamba apewe nafasi ili kuitumikia nchi.

swa: Kwa hiyo, wanaweza kujua ni kutoka wilaya zipi, majimbo gani, ambapo majibu yanarejeshwa na kwa hiyo wanaweza kutathmini hali ya mambo.

swa: Binafsi, nafikiri ni jambo jema na ninataka kuona mshikamano kila mahali nchini Thailand.”

swa: Lakini hebu tumpe nafasi, ajithibitishe kwamba yeye anastahili kwa kazi zake.

swa: Pengine ni bora hivyo kuliko sisi huku kubaki tunapambana.”
