swa: Kitabu cha Alan Shadrake “Once a Jolly Hangman” ni simulizi inayokosesha raha.

eng: The book might have made those in power uncomfortable enough to arrest Mr Shadrake on the rarely used draconian charge of criminal defamation.
swa: Kitabu hiki kinaweza kuwa kiliwakosesha raha baadhi ya watawala kiasi cha kuwalazimu kumkamata Mr Shadrake kwa kutumia sheria mabayo inatumika kwa nadra sana ya jinai ya kuharibu sifa.

eng: A Singaporean blog, Chemical Generation Singapore, wrote:
swa: Blogu ya kiSingapore, Chemical Generation Singapore, iliandika:

eng: With the arrest of Shadrake, the whole issue is less about the death penalty, and more about where we draw the line on supposed foreign intervention.
swa: Kwa kumatwa kwa Shadrake, suala zima limekuwa siyo la kuhusu adhabu ya kifo, na badala yake limehusu zaidi juu ya wapi msaada kutoka nje ya nchi unapokoma kuingilia kati.

eng: Cracking down on local politicians getting foreign money and logistics is fine with me.
swa: Kuwadhibiti wanasiasa wa ndani wanaopokea pesa toka nje ya nchi hilo sina tatizo nalo.

eng: But turning the screws on a foreigner in his book launch, although the foreigner is like a taunting Oliver Fricker and asking for it, is a bit too much in my book.
swa: Lakini hili la kumdhibiti mgeni wakati wa uzinduzi wa kitabu chake ni sawa na uchokozi wa kitoo kabisa kwa Oliver Fricker, pengine umezidi kipimo katika kitabu changu.

eng: Unless there is more than meets the eye here
swa: Labda tu kama kuna zaidi ya yale tunayoyaona

eng: Political Activist, Chee Siok Chin accused the Government of having 'dirty secrets':
swa: Mwanaharakati wa kisiasa, Chee Siok Chin ameishutumu serikali kuu ya nchi hiyo kwa kuwa na ‘siri chafu ':

eng: Now, which authoritarian regime would want to have it’s “dirty little secrets” blown opened in a book?
swa: Sasa, ni utawala gani wa kiimla utakaotaka siri zake zianikwe hadharani na kijitabu?

eng: The same goes for Dr. Lim Hock Siew’s speech that was put up by Martyn See on Youtube.
swa: Vile vile hata kwa hotuba Dr. Lim Hock Siew iliyowekwa na Martyn See kwenye Youtube.

eng: Of course Martyn had to comply with the MDA who required him to take it down.
swa: Bila shaka Martyn ilimbidi kukubaliana na matakwa ya MDA ambayo iliamtaka kuiondoa hotuba hiyo.

eng: After all, Dr. Lim spoke about his unlawful 19-year detention without trial by the ISD.
swa: Hata baada ya yote, Dr. Lim alizungumzia kuhusu kitendo cha ukiukwaji wa sheria kilichofanywa na ISD cha kumuweka kizuizini kwa miaka 19.

eng: Again, which oppressive regime would want to have the truth told about how it entrenches its power blown open in a video clip that can be accessed by all?
swa: Tena, ni serikari gani kandamizi ambayo itataka ukweli usemwe juu ya jinsi ilivyo kiasi cha kuzuia urushwaji wa video ambayo mtu yoyote anaweza kuipata?

eng: A bee pollinates a flower in Baguio, Philippines - copyright Jay Suasin on Flickr (used with permission)This school year, the Philippine government is implementing a United Nations-backed sex education program in public schools for children and teenagers.
swa: Nyuki akichavusha ua huko Baguio, Philippines - haki miliki Jay Suasin kwenye Flickr (Imetumika kwa ruhusa)Mwaka huu wa masomo serikali ya Philippines inatekeleza mpango wa elimu ya uzazi kwenye shule za umma unaofadhiliwa na Umoja wa Mataifa kwa ajili ya watoto na vijana.

eng: The sex education program is being piloted in selected schools around the country and will include topics such as reproductive health, HIV/AIDS prevention, and family planning.
swa: Elimu hiyo imefanyiwa majaribio katika shule teule nchini kote na itakuwa na mada kama afya ya uzazi, kujikinga na VVU/UKIMWI na Uzazi wa mpango.

eng: The Catholic Church has expressed strong opposition to the program.
swa: Kanisa Katoliki limepinga vikali mpango huo.

eng: Bloggers comment on the issue.
swa: Na wanablogu wametoa maoni juu ya suala hilo.

eng: Tom Martin asks if sex education should be done "in the classroom or behind a tree?"
swa: Tom Martin anauliza kama elimu ya ngono inafaa kufundishwa "darasani au nyuma ya mti?"

eng: No parent is going to have absolute control over the places their children are going to learn about sex and it seems to me that a wise parent would at least want his or her children to be exposed to proper sex education by trained teachers in a controlled school setting rather than learning about sex from a peer behind a tree.
swa: Hakuna mzazi atakayeweza kuwa na udhibiti mahsusi juu ya pahali ambapo mwanae atajifunza kuhusu ngono na jinsi ninavyoona mimi mzazi mwenye busara atapenda mwanae apate elimu hiyo kutoka kwenye shule na kutoka kwa mwalimu aliyefuzu vizuri kuliko kujifunza kuhusu hilo toka kwa watoto wenzie nyuma ta mti.

eng: The Pinoy Catholic echoes the official stand of the local clergy and adamantly suggests that sex education should be left to the parents.
swa: The Pinoy Catholic anatoa msimamo unaofanana na ule wa viongozi wa kanisa na kwa nguvu zote anapendekeza kuwa elimu ya ngono ibaki kuwa jukumu la wazazi.

eng: A Filipina Mom Blogger points out that not all parents may know how to discuss sex with their children:
swa: A Filipina Mom Blogger anahadharisha kuwa si wazazi wote wanaojua namna ya kuzungumza na watoto wao juu ya masuala ya ngono:

eng:
We can’t assume parents know how to discuss sex openly. 	“Hatuwezi kuchukulia kuwa wazazi wote wanajua namna ya kujadili ngono kwa uwazi.
Some might be uneducated to understand the anatomy of reproduction and thus fail to grasp natural birth control methods.
swa: Baadhi yao wanaweza kuwa hawana elimu hivyo kushindwa kuelewa muundo na mfumo wa uzazi, na hivyo kushindwa kuelewa juu ya njia asilia za uzazi wa mpango.”

eng: The Catacomb recommends that sex education should be given to the parents instead. Why not leave these children alone for now..
swa: The Catacomb anapendekeza kuwa elimu hii ifundishwe kwa wazazi badala ya watoto.

eng: Or maybe government should try to impose a law of proper parenting, where in parents are given some constant trainings or symposiums that will equip them with proper knowledge in giving their children the right guidance as they grow up.
swa: Kwanini tusiwaache hawa watoto kwanza… Au labda serikali ijaribu kuweka sheria ya kudhibiti malezi, ambayo kwayo ndani yake wazazi wapewe mafunzo endelevu au warsha ambazo zitawawezesha kwa kuwapa elimu inayofaa katika kuwapa watoto wao muongozo mzuri wakati wanakua.

eng: This will prevent not only the exposure of children to the sensitivity of sex but it will also give the parents a better chance to bond with their kids, spending quality time, giving the necessary attention, love and care...
swa: Hii itazuia watoto kuwa kwenye nafasi ya kuamsha hisia zao za ngono bali pia itawapa wazazi nafasi ya kuwa karibu na watot wao, kuwa nao kwa muda mwingi, kuwaangalia kwa Karibu kama inavyotakikana, na kukuza upendo…

eng: The x-piles believes that those against the sex education program should go after the mass media instead.
swa: The x-piles anaamini kuwa wale wanaopinga elimu hiyo wanatakiwa kuvishambulia vyombo vya habari kwanza.

eng: The church could have overlooked the real culprit for the alleged generation of sexual perverts – the mass media.
swa: Kanisa linaweza kuwa limekosea kwa kutoangalia ni nini hasa nini chanzo cha kile kinachodaiwa kuwa kizazi cha waliopotoka ki-ngono – vyombo vya habari.

eng: Violence and sex are prevalent on many T.V. shows and movies and these are all absorbed by the youth and children as well.
swa: Uhalifu na ngono vinaoneshwa wazi kabisa kwenye michezo ya luninga na filamu na hivi vyote vinafonzwa na vijana na watoto pia.

eng: All of these have the capacity to change the moral perception of the youth’s developing minds, bringing them to confusion on what is right or wrong.
swa: Hivi vyote vina uwezo wa kubadili akili inayokua ya vijana, na kuwafikisha kwenye kuchanganyikiwa juu ya lipi ni sahihi na lipi si sahihi.

eng: Meanwhile, Quod Dixit Dixit questions the government's motives for implementing the program.
swa: Wakati huohuo, Quod Dixit Dixit anahoji kinachoisukuma serikali katika kutekeleza mpango huo.

eng: It is not clear to me whether the government’s move sprung from its idea that overpopulation is one of the root causes of grinding poverty in the Philippines and hence, it must be put into a lower gear. (N.B.: I always assume perhaps with precision that the main roots of poverty in the country are graft and corruption and the unabated abuse and destruction of the environment and natural resources.)
swa: Haipo wazi kwangu iwapo hatua hii ya serikali inapata imetokana na fikra yake kuwa chanzo cha umasikini ni idadi kubwa sana ya watu nchini Ufilipino na hivyo ni lazima kasi ya kuzaliana ipunguzwe (N.B.: Siku zote huwa naamini kuwa msingi mkuu wa umasikini ni ubadhilifu na rushwa pia uharibifu wa mazingira usiodhibitiwa.)

eng: The women's group Gabriela see the program as a step in the right direction.
swa: Kundi la wanawake Gabriela linauona mpango huo kama hatua yenye muelekeo sahihi..

eng: The Department of Education (DepEd)’s Memorandum No. 26, allowing the use of teaching modules on sex education, could be a positive step, granting that DepEd will conduct an intensive process of consultation with different stakeholders before full implementation.
swa: 26 ya Idara ya Elimu (DepEd), iliyoruhusu vitini vya kufundishia elimu ya ngono, ingeliweza kuwa hatua chanya, iwapo kitengo hicho kinge endesha mchakato wa kushauriana na wadau mbalimbali kabla ya kuanza kutekeleza mpango huo.

eng: This will ensure that the program is not implemented mechanically, and all arguments are heard.
swa: Hilo lingehakikisha kwamba mpango huo hautatekelezwa bila kujali, na kwamba misimamo yote imewekwa maanani.

eng: In our part, GABRIELA, Gabriela Women’s Party and SALINLAHI are willing to become part of the consultation process and share our extensive experience in gender and sexuality education with children and parents.
swa: Kwa upande wetu, GABRIELA, Chama Cha wanawake Gabriela na SALINLAHI vipo tayari kuwa sehemu ya mchakato wa kushauriana na kutoa ushauri kwa kutumia uzoefu na ujuzi wetu katika elimu ya jinsia na masuala ya kujamiiana kwa wazazi na watoto.

eng: Ducky Paredes, however, believes that the program is as good as dead with the appointment of Brother Armin Luistro FSC to the post of Secretary of Education by the new Aquino administration.
swa: Ducky Paredes, hata hivyo anaamini kuwa, mpango huu umeshafika mwisho kutokana na kuteuliwa kwa Buruda Armin Luistro FSC kuwa Waziri wa Elimu katika utawala mpya wa Aquino.

eng: Is this the end of the UN-funded program for sex education for lour public schools?
swa: Je huu ndio mwisho wa ruzuku ya UN kwenye mradi huu?

eng: Probably.
swa: Inawezekana.

eng: One cannot see how a Christian brother can support sex education for elementary and high school students considering that many in the Catholic Church believe that exposing students to learning about sex and sexuality will surely lead to unwanted pregnancies.
swa: Hatuwezi kutarajia mtawa wa Kikristu akaruhusu ufundishwaji wa elimu ya ngono kwa watoto wadogo na wanafunzi wa sekondari ukichukulia kuwa wengi katika Kanisa Katoliki wanaamini kuwa masomo ya kuhusiana na ngono na uzazi yataleta mamba zisizotarajiwa kwa wanafunzi.

eng: That African Girl is a blog with a series of posts written by Africans around the world about their childhood.
swa: That African Girl ni blogu yenye mfululizo wa makala zilizoandikwa na Waafrika duniani kote kuhusu maisha yao ya utotoni.

eng: It is a blog about growing up in an African family and learning to live in two worlds.
swa: Ni blogu juu ya kukulia katika familia ya kiAfrika na kujifunza kuishi katika dunia (au tamaduni) mbili.

eng: The bloggers sharing their memories have lived both in Africa and the West.
swa: Wanablogu wanaoelezea kumbukumbu hizo wamewahi kuishi kote, Barani afrika na katika nchi za Magharibi.

eng: The blog was started by Makafui Fiavi and Adey Teshome.
swa: Blogu hiyo ilianzishwa na Makafui Fiavi pamoja na Adey Teshome.

eng: Makafui was born in Togo and grew up in the United States and Adey is young Ethiopian-American.
swa: Makafui alizaliwa nchini Togo na alikulia nchini Marekani na Adei ni kijana mwenye asili ya Ethiopia-na-Marekani.

eng: This is Makafui's introduction:
swa: Huu ndio utangulizi wa Makafui:

eng: During the college years, many people take the time to better understand themselves and their place in the world.
swa: Wakati wa miaka ya uanafunzi chuoni, watu wengi hujipa muda wa kuzielewa nafsi zao zaidi pamoja na nafasi yao ulimwenguni.

eng: Most people do it by trying out different identities, or exploring different social circles and ideologies.
swa: Watu wengi hufanya hivyo kwa kujaribu namna tofauti za kujitambua, au kwa kuvinjari makundi tofauti ya kijamii na kiitikadi.

eng: For me, the 4 years brought an exploration of my various sub-identities and a strong desire to learn how to live between 2 worlds.
swa: Kwangu, miaka ile 4 ilinipa fursa ya kuvinjari utambuzi wa nafsi zangu tofauti na hamu kubwa ya kutaka kujifunza jinsi ya kuishi kati ya tamaduni 2.

eng: Born and raised in Togo and growing up in the United States has given me the desire to explore and understand various cultures, to listen to stories and to learn about what brings people together.
swa: Kuzaliwa na kukulia nchini Togo na kuendelea kukua nchini Marekani kumenipa hamu ya kuchunguza na kuelewa tamaduni mbalimbali, kusikiliza simulizi na kujifunza kuhusu mambo yanayowakutanisha watu.

eng: That African Girl (TAG) is the culmination of ideas, conversations and a desire to continue learning and sharing.
swa: Msichana Yule wa kiAfrika (TAG) ni matokeo ya dhana, mazungumzo na hamu ya kuendelea kujifunza na kushirikiana masomo yaliyoyojitokeza.

eng: Here’s where I share about things, people, places, stories, dreams and passions that inspire me.
swa: Hapa ndio sehemu ninayoelezea kuhusu vitu, watu, mahali, simulizi, ndoto pamoja nay ale yanayonivutia moyoni na ambayo yananipa ari.

eng: Adey Teshome considers the blog as "a place for the cultural hybrid, multi-interest, eclectic children such as ourselves to air our thoughts":
swa: Adey Teshome anaichukulia blogu kama “sehemu ya watu wa tamaduni mchanganyiko, wenye kuvutiwa na masuala anuai, (sehemu) ya watoto wa kipekee kama sisi kupaza mawazo yetu”:

eng: When I first agreed to contribute to this blog, I was super-inspired by Mak’s idea–a place for the cultural hybrid, multi-interest, eclectic children such as ourselves to air our thoughts.
swa: Mwanzoni nilipokubali kuandika katika blogu hii, nilihamasishwa sana na wazo la Mak - sehemu ya watu wa tamaduni mchanganyiko, wenye kuvutiwa na masuala anuai, (sehemu) ya watoto wa kipekee kama sisi kupaza mawazo yetu.

eng: And as I like to say, this is why we’re friends.
swa: Na kama ninavyopenda kusema, hii ndiyo sababu sisi ni maraki.

eng: She has such an eye for self-expression and such cool views to share.
swa: Ana jicho zuri la kujieleza na mitizamo mizuri ya kueleza.

eng: And I loved the thought of being part of that.
swa: Na nililipenda wazo la kuwa sehemu ya mchakato huo.

eng: So that’s who I’ll try to be for this blog– a young Ethiopian-American, recent (well, in the works) college grad, trying to figure out my place and get my grounding in life, who can put in her two cents every now and then.
swa: Na hivyo ndivyo ninavyojaribu kuwa katika blogu hii – kijana mwenye asili ya kiEthiopia na Kimarekani, mhitimu (aam, anayetarajia) kuhitimu mafunzo ya chuo, anmbaye anajaribu kuijua nafasi yake katika na kupata msingi katika maisha, ambaye anaweza kuchangia senti mbili za mawazo kila inapowezekana.

eng: Liz A. is a contributor from Uganda/Kenya living in the United States. These are her childhood memories:
swa: Liz A. ni mchangiaji kutoka Uganda/Kenya ambaye anaishi nchini Marekani.Na hizi ndizo kumbukumbu zake za utotoni:

eng: 1) Being beaten as punishment.
swa: 1)Kuchapwa kama adhabu.

eng: I always found it interesting when my White or Asian friends would talk about being told to sit in a corner, or were sent to their room as a form of punishment.
swa: Mara zote niliona kama jambo la kuvutuia pale marafiki zangu wa Kizungu au Kiasia walipokuwa wanaongelea adhabu ya kuketi kwenye kona, au walipoamriwa kwenda chambani kama adhabu.

eng: For us, we were beaten.
swa: Kwetu, tulikuwa tunapigwa.

eng: My mum would usually get very thin branches that had fallen off the trees in our compound and my dad would get the thick ones, sometimes we would be sent to get them ourselves, and we would be given a few lashes on the calves of our legs.
swa: Mama kwa kawaida alikuwa akiokota fimbo nyembamba zilivyoanguka kutoka kwenye miti iliyokuwa ndani ya boma letu na baba alikuwa akiokota zile kubwa, wakati mwingine tulitumwa kwenda kuzileta sisi wenyewe, na tulikuwa tunachapwa kwenye sehemu ya viazi nyuma ya ugoko.

eng: In America, it seems that such a thing can result in social services being called in to review the situation or children here feel some sort of resentment towards their parents for it.
swa: Nchini Marekani, inaonekana kuwa jambo kama hilo linaweza kusababisha taasisi za huduma za jamii kuitwa ili kutathmini hali, au watoto hapa huweza kuhisi namna fulani ya kuwachukia wazazi wao kutokana na adhabu kama hizo.

eng: But I have
swa: Lakini mimi

eng: School children being told to chant candidates’ names by their teachers.
swa: Watoto wa shule wanaambiwa na waalimu wao waimbe majina ya wagombea uchaguzi.

eng: Civil servants getting sacked for not campaigning for their political bosses.
swa: Watumishi wa serikali wanafukuzwa kazi kwa kutowapigia kampeni viongozi wao wa kisiasa.

eng: Zinc roofing being traded for votes.
swa: Mabati ya kuezekea yananunua kura.

eng: The public wholesaling of voters’ personal data to campaigners.
swa: Taarifa binafsi za wapiga kura zinauzwa wazi wazi kwa wapiga kampeni.

eng: Death threats to those who denounce electoral crimes.
swa: Vitisho vya kuuwawa vinatumwa kwa wale wanaopinga vitendo vichafu vya uchaguzi.

eng: Welcome to the unpleasant side of Brazilian electioneering.
swa: Karibu kwenye upande usiovutia wa kampeni za uchaguzi nchini Brazil.

eng: These are just some of the reports coming from Eleitor 2010, a "crowdsourcing" project aiming to facilitate citizen reports of abuses of the electoral process in Brazil.
swa: Hizo ni baadhi tu ya taarifa zinazotoka katika mradi wa Eleitor 2010, mradi wa “vyanzo vya habari vya kiraia” ambao una lengo la kuratibu taarifa za raia zinazoripoti ukiukwaji wa mchakato wa uchaguzi nchini Brazil.

eng: In the largest democracy in Latin America - with over 120 million voters - this year, voters go to the polls they will be choosing the successor of one of the country's most popular Presidents in history (Luiz Inácio "Lula" da Silva) but also voting on governors, a large portion of Congress.
swa: Katika demokrasia kubwa zaidi huko kusini mwa bara la Amerika – katika nchi yenye wapiga kura zaidi ya milioni 120 – mwaka huu, wapiga kura watakwenda kwenye uchaguzi kumchagua kiongozi atakeyemrithi mmoja wa marais maarufu zaidi katika historia (Luiz Inácio “Lula” da Silva) na pia watawapigia kura magavana, ambao wanajaza sehemu kubwa ya bunge la Kongresi.

eng: Eleitor2010 website
swa: Tovuti ya Eleitor2010

eng: Every country has its own unique political culture and oddities.
swa: Kila nchi ina utamaduni wake wa kipekee wa kisiasa pamoja na kawaida zake.

eng: Even the most minimal democracy has its own rules around electioneering, the mechanics of the vote, and ensuring that the state regulates the electoral process.
swa: Hata demokrasia ndogo (ya ki-ishara) huwa taratibu zake katika mchakato wa uchaguzi, namna upigaji kura unavyoendeshwa, na uhakikishaji kuwa serikali inaratibu mchakato wa uchaguzi.

eng: Brazil was one of the first democracies of its size to use electronic voting machines.
swa: Brazil ilikuwa ni moja kati ya nchi za kidemokrasia za kwanza kutumia mashine za umeme za kupigia kura.

eng: It also has compulsory voting.
swa: Kadhalika upigaji kura ni sharti la lazima kwa kila mwananchi.

eng: But other aspects of its electoral process are unique, including attempts to strictly regulate of online campaigning, vote buying and what are called "showmícios" (concert-rallies).
swa: Lakini pande nyingine za mchakato wa uchaguzi ni za kipekee, pamoja na jitihada za kudhibiti kampeni za kwenye mtandao wa intaneti, ununuaji kura na kile kinachoitwa “showmícios” (au matamasha ya kampeni).

eng: Brazil has very clear and comprehensive laws regulating elections but the problem is enforcing these laws.
swa: Brazil ina sheria zilizo wazi na timilifu ambazo zinadhibiti uchaguzi klakini tatizo lipo kwenye utekelezaji wa sheria hizo.

eng: There is a real culture of politicians subverting the law, maintaining a privileged position as patrons of voters in Brazil.
swa: Kuna utamaduni hai wa wanasiasa wa kupindisha sharia, huku wakidumisha nafasi zao za upendeleo kama wafadhili wa wapiga kura nchini Brazil.

eng: This stems from a distant colonial past and continued persistent inequality, where entrenched elite interests have maintained themselves.
swa: Jambo hili linatokea katika historia ya ukoloni huko nyuma pamoja na ukosefu wa usawa usiokwisha, ambao kwao maslahi ya viongozi yanaendelea kujidumisha

eng: The idea behind Eleitor 2010, which is a purely volunteer, non-partisan project run by a virtual team with zero funding, is to engage the voter beyond the day of the election.
swa: Wazo lililo nyuma ya mradi wa Eleitor 2010, ambao ni mradi wa kujitolea, usiofungamana na chama chochote na uanoendeshwa na timu ya kwenye mtandao isiyo na ufadhili wowote wa kifedha, ni kuwashirikisha wapiga kura zaidi ya siku siku ya uchaguzi.

eng: According to Paula Góes and Diego Casaes, its creators - who met via Twitter and now collaborate on Global Voices Online, the project is to promote critical and active citizenship, that challenges some of the arcane and undemocratic practices mentioned above.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa waanzilishi, Paula Goes na Diego Casaes – ambo walikutana kwenye Twita na ambao hivi sasa wanashirikiana kwenye mradi wa Global Voices Online, mradi huo una nia ya kukuza uraia hai na wenye jicho la uchunguzi, uraia ambao unachabanga baadhi ya mazoea yasiyo ya kidemokrasia na yasiyoeleweka kama ilivyoelezwa hapo juu.

eng: Eleitor 2010 runs on the open source software Ushahidi, a web-based platform which received much attention for its utility in mapping incidents after the Haiti earthquake, driven by SMS reports from the ground.
swa: Mradi wa Eleitor 2010 unatumia programu huria ya Ushahidi, jukwaa la kwenye mtandao ambalo liliangaliwa kwa karibu na watu wengi kutokana na ufanisi wake katika upangaji wa taarifa katika ramani baada ya tetemeko la ardhi huko nchini Haiti, ambao ulifanikishwa na jumbe fupi za simu za mkononi (SMS) kutokea katika maeneo ya tukio.

eng: Ushahidi has yet to reach its full potential as an election monitoring platform, say Góes and Casaes.
swa: Mpaka sasa jukwaa la Ushahidi bado halijafikia upeo wake kama jukwaa la ufuatiliaji uchaguzi, wanasema Goes na Casaes.

eng: With an estimated 25% of the country online every day, and one of the highest mobile subscriber rates in Latin America, they hope Brazil could be the place where it comes of age this year.
swa: Huku takriban 25% ya nchi inatumia mtandao kila siku, na moja ya nchi zenye watumiaji wa simu za mkononi wengi zaidi katika Amerika ya Latini, wanatumaini kwamba Brazil itakuwa ndiyo sehemu ambapo (ushahidi) itafikia upeo wake mwaka huu.

eng: Four weeks away from the election, Eleitor 2010 already has 230+ reports, from every state in the country, and from the most remote areas.
swa: Majuma manne kabla ya uchaguzi, Eletoir 2010 tayari ina taarifa 239+, kutoka kila jimbo nchini humo, na kutoka katika maeneo pweke ya mbali.

eng: However, it is an uphill battle to get the message out about the platform, in a country where broadcast and print media are still strong, held in the hands of a privileged elite bent on defending its interests.
swa: Hata hivyo, ni mapambano magumu kueneza ujumbe kuhusu jukwaa hili, katika nchi ambayo vyombo vya utangazaji na magazeti bado vina nguvu sana, na bado vimo mikononi mwa vigogo wachache ambao wana nia ya ketetea maslahi yao.

eng: Despite this, the communications team at Eleitor 2010 has generated some media attention, and networking with other online transparency initiatives has been crucial.
swa: Pamoja na hayo, timu ya mawasiliano ya eleitor 2010 imeweza kuvivutia vyombo vya habari, na ushirikiano na miradi mingine ya uwazi kwenye mtandao umekuwa ni wa muhimu.

eng: Google recently featured Eleitor 2010 on its page dedicated to the Brazilian elections.
swa: Hivi karibuni Google iliuchapisha mradi wa Eleitor 2010 katika ukurasa wake unaoandika habari za uchaguzi wa Brazil.

eng: Góes and Casaes hope that with their awareness campaign - on social networks including Orkut with over 40 million users, partnerships with networks of internet cafés, NGOs, and social movements - Eleitor 2010 will break through and change the way thousands of voters engage in the electoral process.
swa: Goes na Casaes wanatumaini kuwa kutokana na kapeni yao ya kuelimisha umma – kwenye mitandao ya kijamii ikiwemo Orkut yenye watumiaji zaidi ya milioni 40, ubia na mtandao wa wenye migahawa ya intaneti, Asasi zisizo za kiserikali, na vyama vya wananchi – mradi wa Eleitor 2010 utafanikiwa na kubadilisha namna ambavyo maelfu ya wapiga kura hujihusisha na mchakato wa uchaguzi.

eng: Through the plaftorm, some entertaining anecdotes have already come to light, well in advance of the October 3 vote.
swa: Kwa kupitia jukwaa hilo, simulizi kadhaa za kuburudisha zimeshaanza kujitokeza, muda mrefu kabla ya uchaguzi wa Oktoba 3.

eng: Voters caught one man in a small town in the interior selling off Twitter accounts with 40,000+ followers for the sickeningly low price of US$125. This is illegal under Brazilian electoral law.
swa: Wapiga kura walimkamata mtu mmoja kwenye mji fulani mdogo akiuza akaunti za Twita zenye wafuasi zaidi ya 40,000 Kitendo hiki ni kinyume cha sheria ya uchaguzi nchini brazil.

eng: When confronted, the man in question gave more incriminating evidence and then threatened to sue Eleitor 2010.
swa: Alipokabiliwa, mtu huyo alitoa ushahidi uanomtia hatiani zaidi, na kasha yake alitishia kuishtaki Eleitor 2010.

eng: The evidence, including screenshots and transcript of a chat with him, were delivered to the Electoral Courts.
swa: Ushahidi huo, zikiwemo picha za kiperuzi na maandishi ya maongezi, vilipelekwa kwa mahakama ya uchaguzi.

eng: Another comic report from São Paulo, where teachers at a school illegally encouraged children to chant for two candidates, one for mayor and one for President, and it backfired with children instinctively chanting "Lula!"
swa: Taarifa nyingine ya kuchekesha inatoka Sao Paulo, ambako waalimu katika shule moja, kinyume cha sheria waliwahamasisha watoto waimbe kwa ajili ya wagombea wawili, mmoja kwa ajili ya kiti cha Umeya na mwingine kwa ajili ya kiti cha Urais, lakini kitendo hicho kiliwaridia bila mafanikio pale ambapo watoto walipoanza kuimba “Lula!”

eng: Lula!
swa: “Lula!”

eng: The video circulated widely, and has had over 70,000 views.
swa: Video hiyo ilisambaa sana na imeshaangaliwa mara zaidi ya 70,000.

eng: Another video that raised eyebrows was one by blogger Ricardo Gama of a VW bus owned by the City Hall being used for a campaign in Rio de Janeiro.
swa: Video nyingine ambayo iliwashangaza watu ilikuwa ni ile ya mwanablogu Ricardo Gama wa basi la VW linalomilikiwa na Ukumbi wa jiji lilipotumiwa kwa ajili ya kampeni mjini Rio De Janeiro.

eng: The blogger shouts “Are you carrying electoral propaganda in the car of the City Hall?
swa: Mwanablogu huyo alipiga kele akisema “je mnabeba propaganda za kampeni ndani ya gari la ukumbi wa Jiji?

eng: This is an electoral crime!
swa: Hili ni kosa katika uchaguzi!

eng: I filmed it.
swa: Nimepiga filamu.

eng: I am going to denounce you.”
swa: Nitawashitaki.”

eng: From the north of Brazil, in the state of Maranhão, word reached Eleitor 2010 that a network of evangelical churches was offering to “trade” 3,000 votes for “support” after the election.
swa: Kutokea kaskazini mwa Brazil, katika jimbo la Maranhao, Eleitor 2010 ilipata habari kuwa mtandao wa makanisa ya kiinjilisti ulikuwa unataka “kuuza” kura 3000 kwa ajili ya kusaidiwa baada ya uchaguzi.

eng: In the state of São Paulo, one Bishop implored the faithful not to support President Lula’s chosen successor, Dilma Roussef.
swa: Katika jimbo la Sao Paulo, Askofu mmoja aliwasihi waumini wasimuunge mkono mrithi aliyeteuliwa na Rais Lula, Dilma Roussef.

eng: These examples indicate how this platform and online, participatory tools will be of use in years to come. No matter whether it goes “viral” and becomes a household name, Eleitor 2010 and other transparency initiatives have already become game-changers this election year.
swa: Mifano hii inaonyesha jinsi gani jukwaa hili pamoja na zana shirikishi za kwenye mtandao zitakavyoweza kutumiwa katika miaka ijayo.Bila kujali kama (zana hii) itasambaa haraka “kama virusi” na kujulikana sana, Eleitor 2010 pamoja na zana nyingine za uwazi vimeshakuwa nguvu ya mabadiliko katika mwaka huu wa uchaguzi.

eng: Early on Thursday September 23, Colombians woke up with the news: the day before, 30 airplanes and 27 helicopters of the Colombian Air Force raided a camp where Víctor Julio Suárez, better known as Jorge Briceño or Mono Jojoy, one of the top leaders of the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC), was hiding with dozens of guerrillas near La Macarena, Meta.
swa: Mapema siku ya Alhamisi tarehe 23 Septemba watu wa Colombia waliamka na taarifa ya habari hii: Siku iliyopita, ndege 30 na helikopta 27 za jeshi la Anga la Colombia zilivamia kambi ambamo Víctor Julio Suárez, ambaye anajulikana zaidi kama Jorge Briceño or Mono Jojoy, mmoja wa viongozi wa juu wa Majeshi ya Ukombozi wa Colombia (FARC), alikuwa amejificha pamoja na dazeni za wapiganaji gorila karibu na La Macarena, Meta.

eng: Suárez, 57, was killed in the so-called "Operation Sodom", as president Juan Manuel Santos confirmed from New York, where he is attending the United Nations General Assembly.
swa: Suarez, mwenye umri wa miaka 57, aliuwawa katika kile kilichoitwa “Operesheni Sodoma”, kama ambavyo Rais Juan Manuel Santos alivyothibisha kutokea mjini New york, ambako alikuwa akihudhuria mkutano wa Baraza la umoja wa mataifa.

eng: Five members of the State security forces were injured and a female police dog was killed .
swa: Askari watano wa majeshi ya Usalama walijeruhiwa na mbwa wa kike wa polisi aliuwawa .

eng: Other top guerrilla members might have been caught in the 300 square-meter camp —which reportedly included an underground bunker— and the Colombian Armed Forces (mostly members of the Colombian Army and the Colombian National Police which landed after the combats ended) are identifying them as this post is being written.
swa: Viongozi wengine wa juu wa wapiganaji hao gorila inawezekana kuwa walikamatwa ndani ya kambi hiyo yenye ukubwa wa mita za mraba 30 – ambayo inataarifiwa kuwa ilikuwa na mahandaki ya kuishi chini ya ardhi – na majeshi ya ulinzi ya Colombia (ambayo yalijumuisha zaidi wanajeshi wa jeshi la Colombia pamoja na Jeshi la Polisi la Taifa ambalo lilitua baada ya mapigano kumalizika) yanawafanyia utambulizi wakati makala hii ikiwa inaandikwa.

eng: On Thursday afternoon unofficial sources claimed that FARC leader Henry Castellanos, Romaña, had also been killed in the operation
swa: Mnamo majira ya mchana siku ya Alhamisi vyanzo visivyo rasmi vilidai kuwa kiongozi wa FARC Henry Castellanos, Romaña, naye pia aliuwawa katika operesheni hiyo.

eng: Mono Jojoy, who was tipped off by an informant, was considered the leader of the hard-line military wing of the FARC and was the commander of its Eastern Bloc.
swa: Mono Jojoy, ambaye alitoswa na mdukizi, alikuwa akichukuliwa kama kiongozi wa upande wenye siasa kali katika jeshi la FARC na alikuwa kamanda wa Kanda wa Mashariki.

eng: Regarded as "one of the most blood-thirsty" guerrillas , he had 62 arrest warrants against him, had been sentenced 5 times, and the United States had asked for his extradition for drug-trafficking related charges, offering a reward for his capture.
swa: Aliaminika kama “mmoja wa wapiganaji gorila mwenye uchu wa damu" ,kulikuwa na hati 62 za kuamrisha kukamatwa kwake, aliwahi kuhukumiwa mara 5, na Marekani ilikwishaomba kukamatwa na kusafirishwa kwa mtu huyo kwenda Marekani kujibu tuhuma zinazohusiana na usafirishaji madawa ya kulevya, na iliahidi kutoa zawadi kwa kukamatwa kwake.

eng: A controversy arose when El Tiempo, the daily newspaper with the highest circulation in the country (and partially owned by President Juan Manuel Santos' family), posted a series of tweets regarding the news:
swa: Utata uliibuka pale ambapo El Tiempo, gazeti la kila siku lenye wasomaji wengi zaidi nchini humo (ambalo linamilikiwa kwa kiasi na familia ya Rais Juan Manuel Santos' ), lilipotuma mfululizo wa twita kuhusu habari hii:

eng: @eltiempocom
swa: @eltiempocom

eng: Rajesh Jain at Emergic criticizes the ban on all bulk SMS and MMS in India to prevent mass mobilization of people before and after the Ayodhya verdict.
swa: Rajesh Jain kwenye Emergic analaumu kupigwa marufuku utumaji wa jumla wa ujumbe wa simu za mkononi pamoja na ujumbe wa media-anuai ili kuzuia uhamasishaji umma kabla na baada ya hukumu ya Ayodhya.

eng: A reliable source has told Global Voices that Tehran's prosecutor is seeking the death penalty for jailed Iranian blogger Hossein Derakhshan (also known as "Hoder").
swa: Chanzo cha kuaminika kimeifahamisha Global Voices kwamba mwendesha mashtaka huko Tehran analenga kuhakikisha kwamba mwanablogu aliyefungwa Hossein Derakhshan (anayefahamika pia kama "Hoder") anapewa adhabu ya kifo.

eng: The presiding judge, named Salavati, has not yet ruled in the case.
swa: Jaji anayesimamia kesi hiyo, anayeitwa Salavati, bado hajatoa uamuzi katika kesi hiyo.

eng: Derakhshan has been accused of “collaborating with enemy states, creating propaganda against the Islamic regime, insulting religious sanctity, and creating propaganda for anti-revolutionary groups.”
swa: Derakshan anashitakiwa kwa "kushirikiana na dola adui, kupiga propaganda dhidi ya utawala wa Kiislamu, kudhihaki utakatifu wa kidini, na kuandaa propaganda kwa ajili ya vikundi vinavyopinga mapinduzi."

eng: He was arrested 22 months ago, and his trial began in June 2010.
swa: Alikamatwa miezi 22 iliyopita, na kesi yake ilianza kusikilizwa mwezi Juni mwaka huu wa 2010.

eng: The reasons for Hoder’s initial arrest upon his return to Iran from Canada in 2008 remain unclear, but many speculated that his two (highly publicised) trips to Israel were the primary reason.
swa: The Sababu zilizosababisha kukamatwa kwa Hoder mara ya kwanza mara tu aliporejea nchini Irani akitokea Kanada mwaka 2008 bado hazifahamiki, lakini wengi walihisi kwamba safari mbili (zilizotangazwa sana kupitia vyombo vya habari) alizofanya kwenda Israeli huenda zikawa ndiyo sababu.

eng: Derakhshan holds a Canadian passport, but Iran does not recognize dual citizenship and visiting Israel is frowned upon by the government.
swa: Derakhshan ana pasi ya Kanada, lakini Irani bado haitambui uraia wa nchi mbili, na kutembelea Israeli ni jambo ambalo linaichukiza sana na serikali ya nchi hiyo.

eng: Confusing in this case, is that Hoder gained worldwide notoriety as a leading Iranian blogger and free speech activist (even blogging for Global Voices in 2004 and 2005).
swa: Jambo linalochanganya zaidi ni kwamba Hoder alipata umaarufu duniani kote kama mwanablogu anayeongoza huko Irani na mwanaharakati wa uhuru wa kujieleza (aliwahi hata kublogu kwa ajili ya Global Voices kati ya mwaka 2004 na 2005).

eng: Later he changed tacks and wrote favorably of President Mahmoud Ahmedinajhad's policies regarding the United States, nuclear weapons, Israel, and even intolerance for public dissent from human rights activists.
swa: Baadaye alibadili mbinu na kuandika habari zinazosifu sera za Rais Mahmoud Ahmedinejad hususan kwa msimamo wake dhidi ya serikali ya Marekani, silaha za nyuklia, Israeli, na hata kutovumilia upinzani wa umma unaofanywa na wanaharakati wa haki za binadamu.

eng: In April of 2009, Iranian president, President Ahmadinejad, issued a letter calling for Hossein Derakhshan’s case to be processed in a timely and legal fashion.
swa: Mwezi Aprili mwaka 2009, Rais wa Irani, Ahmedinejad, aliandika barua akitaka kesi ya Hossein Derakshan ishughulikiwe haraka na kwa kuzingatia sheria.

eng: The Canadian government has not been publicly vocal on Derakhshan's case.
swa: Serikali ya Kanada bado haijatoa msimamo wake hadharani kuhusu kesi ya Derakhshan.

eng: A Free Hoder blog was created by online free speech activists shortly after his arrest in 2008.
swa: Mara baada ya kukamatwa kwake mwaka 2008, wanaharakati wa uhuru wa kujieleza wa mtandaoni walianzisha blogu ya Kudai Hoder Aachiewe Huru.

eng: On Twitter, Sanam Dolatshahi tweeted the news of a possible death penalty, and a site in Persian called Kamtarin has also mentioned it, noting that despite previous rumors that Derakhshan was being held for "spying" in Israel this is apparently not one of the accusations for which the prosecutor seeks his death.
swa: Kupitia Twita, Sanam Dolatshahi alituma twitakuhusu habari za uwezekano wa kuwepo na adhabu ya kifo, vilevile kuna tovuti moja ya Uajemi inayojulikana kama Kamtarin ambayo nayo imetaja uwezekano huo, ikizingatiwa kwamba licha ya minong'ono iliyokuwepo hapo kabla kwamba Derakshan alikamatwa kwa "ujasusi" nchini Israeli , lakini ni wazi kwamba hii si moja kati ya makosa ambayo kwayo mwendesha mashtaka anataka itolewe adhabu ya kifo.

eng: In a blog created by Derakhshan's family, Edalat Baraye Hossein Derakhshan (meaning justice for Hossein Derakhshan) there are still no reports or updates on this topic.
swa: Katika blogu iliyoanzishwa na familia ya Derakshan, Edalat Baraye Hossein Derakhshan(ikiwa na maana ya Haki kwa ajili ya Hossein Derakshan) bado hakuna taarifa mpya zinazohusiana na taarifa hii.

eng: The last post on the family blog is dated August 15, and says that Hossein's trial ended weeks ago :
swa: Makala ya mwisho kuchapishwa kwenye blogu hiyo ni ile ya tarehe 15 Agosti, na ambayo ilieleza kwamba kesi ya Hossein ilimalizika wiki kadha za nyuma :

eng: We are waiting for the verdict.
swa: Bado tunasubiri hukumu.

eng: He had not got even one week vacation out of prison to come home...
swa: Hajapata hata likizo ya wiki moja kutoka gerezani kuja nyumbani ...

eng: It is the second Ramadan that he is not at home...
swa: Hii ni Ramadhani ya pili ambayo hajakuwa nyumbani ...

eng: He told us the quality of food since last Ramadan became better in prison...
swa: Alitueleza kwamba ubora wa chakula kule gerezani umeongezeka kidogo tangu Ramadhani iliyopita ...

eng: His mother is very worried...
swa: Mama yake ana wasiwasi sana ...

eng: It is said this month God answers the prayers easier...
swa: Inasemekana kwamba katika mwezi huu Mungu hujibu dua kwa urahisi zaidi ...

eng: Please do not forget our Hossein.
swa: Tafadhali msimsahau Hossein wetu.

eng: Iranian Blogger Z8tun summed up the situation about two years ago:
swa: Mwanablogu wa Irani anayejulikana kama Z8tun alihitimisha hali halisi ya mambo yapata miaka miwili iliyopita:

eng: “Other Iranians have been caught visiting Israel, but were released after a few hours of interrogation.
swa: “Raia wengine wa Irani wamewahi kukamatwa kwa kuingia nchini Israeli, lakini waliachiwa saa chache baada ya mahojiano.

eng: Some speculate that Derakhshan, who in recent years became a supporter of President Ahmadinejad’s government, was arrested because he insulted some religious leaders in the country.
swa: Wapo wanaodhani kwamba Derakshan, ambaye katika miaka ya karibuni alitokea kuwa mwungaji mkono wa serikali ya Rais Ahmedinejad, alikamatwa kwa sababu aliwakashifu viongozi wa kidini nchini humu.

eng: He has himself argued in Western media, despite multiple testimonies of jailed bloggers, that nobody goes to jail in Iran because of the content of their blog.”
swa: Yeye mwenyewe ameeleza kupitia vyombo vya habari vya nchi za Magharibi, licha ya kuwepo kwa ushahidi mwingi wa wanablogu waliotupwa gerezani, kwamba hakuna anayekwenda jela nchini Irani kwa sababu ya yale wanayochapisha kwenye blogu zao."

eng: The Islamic Republic has cracked down on the blogosphere in recent years, and there are several other bloggers sentenced to prison in Iran including human rights activist Shiva Nazar Ahari.
swa: Katika miaka ya karibuni, Jamhuri hii ya Kiislamu imetumia nguvu kuvunjilia mbali ulimwengu wa blogu, na wapo wanablogu kadha kwenye magereza ya Irani akiwemo mwanaharakati wa haki za binadamu Shiva Nazar Ahari.

eng: On 18 March 2009, Omid Reza Mir Sayafi became the first blogger to die in suspicious circumstances in an Iranian prison.
swa: Mnamo tarehe 18 Machi mwaka 2009, Omid Reza Mir Sayafi alikuwa mwanablogu wa kwanza kuuwawa katika mazingira ya kutatanisha katika gereza nchini Irani.

eng: YardFlex.com is following the Buju Banton drug possession case which goes to trial in the U.S. on Monday.
swa: YardFlex.com anaifuatilia kesi ya umiliki wa madawa ya kulevya inayomkabili Buju Banton na ambayo itaendeshwa siku ya Jumatatu huko Marekani.

eng: In light of news that two co-defendants have turned state witnesses, the blog says: "The next couple of days will be crucial as Buju and his lawyers hunker down and prepare to tell previously untold stories."
swa: Kutokana na taarifa zinazosema kwamba washtakiwa wenzake wawili wameamua kuwa mashahidi wa serikali (upande wa mashtaka) blogu hiyo inasema: "Siku mbili zinazofuata zitakuwa ni za muhimu sana kwani Buju na wanasheria wake wanajipinda na kutayarisha kueleza habari ambazo hazikuelezwa hapo awali."

eng: Caribbean bloggers are mourning the loss of one of the region's soca music pioneers - Alphonsus Cassell, better known as "Arrow" - whose mega-hit, Hot, Hot, Hot is largely credited with taking soca to a global audience.
swa: Wanablogu wa Karibeani wanaomboleza kifo cha mmoja wa waasisi wa muziki wa soca katika kanda hiyo - Alphonsus Cassell, anayejulikana zaidi kama “Arrow” - na ambaye kibao chake kikali, Hot, Hot, Hot kinapewa sifa ya kuutambulisha mtindo wa soca kwa kadamnasi ya dunia.

eng: News reports confirm that the singer had been ailing from cancer for some time; bloggers' tributes have been both touching and personal.
swa: Taarifa za habari zinathibitisha kuwa muimbaji huyo alikuwa akisumbuliwa na ugonjwa wa saratani kwa muda; rambirambi za wanablogu zimekuwa na mguso pia zinaelezea masikitiko binafsi.

eng: One Tribe, Many Voices recognises that his music was a soundtrack to the lives of many Caribbean people, even posting a link for readers to take a listen:
swa: Mwanablogu One Tribe, Many Voices anatambua kuwa muziki wa mwanamuziki huyo ulikuwa ni muziki uliosindikiza maisha ya watu wengi wa Karibeani , na ametuma kiungo kwa wasomaji ili waweze kusikiliza:

eng: For many people who are not familiar with Calypso, Arrow may not be a recognizable name but for those of us who have danced and partied from Brooklyn to Port of Spain that is not the case.
swa: Kwa wengi ambao hawaujui muziki wa Calypso, jina la Arrow linaweza kuwa halijulikani lakini kwa wale miongoni mwetu ambao wameucheza na kushereheka kuanzia Brooklyn mpaka Port of Spain si hivyo.

eng: Arrow brought a distinct flavor to Kaiso, it was the flavor of Montserrat.
swa: Arrow alileta vionjo vya aina yake kwa Kaiso (jina jingine la Calypso), vilikuwa ni vionjo vya kisiwa cha Montserrat.

eng: Arrow put Montserrat and himself on the musical map in 1982 with his gigantic hit: 'Hot, Hot, Hot'.
swa: Arrow alijiweka yeye pamoja Montserrat katika ramani ya muziki mnamo mwaka 1982 kwa kibao chake kikali: ‘Hot, Hot, Hot'.

eng: I can recall being drenched in sweat in Trinidad Carnival as Arrow sang 'Bills', 'Soca Rhumba' and 'Rub Up'.
swa: Ninakumbuka jinsi nilivyolowana jasho wakati wa tamasha la Carnival nchini Trinidad wakati Arrow alipoimba ‘Bills’, ‘Soca Rhumba’ na ‘Rub Up’.

eng: His was a different take on soca, it had the feel of merengue and it seemed to crossover into a more Pan-Caribbean vibe.
swa: Upigaji wake wa muziki wa soca ulikuwa tofauti kidogo, ulikuwa na hisia za merengue na ulikuwa na mahadhi yanayovuka mipaka na kuijumuisha Karibeani yote.

eng: The beat was hard and it reminded me of the French Caribbean and the Spanish Caribbean all at once.
swa: Mrindimo wake ulikuwa mzito na ulinikumbusha Karibeani iliyotawaliwa na Wafaransa pamoja na ile iliyotawaliwa na Wahispania.

eng: The horns were very prominent, in your face.
swa: Matarumbeta yalitawala sana, yalishambulia bila kukwepeka.

eng: The Caribbean Camera lists Arrow's musical achievements, but also offers a peek into another side of the man:
swa: Blogu ya The Caribbean Camera inaorodhesha mafanikio ya Arrow katika muziki, lakini pia inachungulia upande mwingine wa mtu huyu:

eng: The title track became his first pan-Caribbean hit and the biggest selling soca hit of all time.
swa: Jina la wimbo wa santuri hiyo ukawa ndio kibao chake kikali cha kwanza cha ki-Karibeani na kibao cha soca kilichouzwa zaidi ya vyote.

eng: Arrow also established himself as a businessman in Montserrat, owning the Arrow`s Manshop store in Plymouth.
swa: Kadhalika Arrow alijiimarisha kama mfanyabiashara huko Montserrat, alimiliki duka la Arrow’s Manshop pale Plymouth.

eng: When it was destroyed by the Soufriere Hills volcanic eruption, he relocated to Salem.
swa: Wakati duka hilo lilipoharibiwa na mlipuko wa volkeno ya vilima vya Soufriere, akahamia Salem.

eng: He organized a fundraising calypso festival on the island in 1996, in response to the devastation caused by the volcano.
swa: Aliandaa tamasha la calypso la Harambee kisiwani humo mnamo mwaka 1996, ili kukabili uharibifu uliasababishwa na volkeno.

eng: Arrow continued to be much in demand in the Caribbean and most recently performed at the Cricket World Cup 2007 opening ceremonies with Shaggy, Byron Lee and Kevin Lyttle.
swa: Arrow aliendelea kuwa mwanamuziki anayetafutwa sana huko Karibeani na hivi karibuni kabisa alitumbuiza katika ufunguzi wa Kombe la Dunia la mchezo wa Kriketi la mwaka 2007 pamoja na Shaggy, Byron Lee na Kevin Lyttle.

eng: Finally, from St. Vincent and the grenadines, Abeni says:
swa: Na mwisho, kutoka visiwa vya St. Vincent na grenadines, Abeni anasema:

eng: Born on the tiny island of Montserrat Alphonsus 'Arrow' Cassell's talent was anything but tiny.
swa: Alizaliwa katika kisiwa kidogo cha Montserrat, na kipaji cha Alphonsus ‘Arrow' Cassell hakikuwa kidogo.

eng: He gave us hits such as 'Pirates', 'Long Time' and the monster hit 'Hot, Hot, Hot'.
swa: Alitupatia vibao kama vile ‘Pirates’, ‘Long Time’ pamoja na kibao cha kutisha ‘Hot Hot Hot’.

eng: It was to enjoy more success following Buster Poindexter's remake in 1987.
swa: Ambacho kilifanikiwa zaidi kufuatia utengenezwaji wake mpya uliofanywa na Poindexter mwaka 1987.

eng: Years later, St Vincent's Kevin Lyttle was to enjoy unprecedented success with his hit 'Turn me on'. So, it is I think fair to say that Arrow paved the way for other soca artistes to realize that soca could be marketed to non traditional markets.
swa: Miaka kadhaa baadaye, Kevin Lyttle anayetokea huko St Vincents naye alifurahia mafanikio ambayo hayakutarajiwa na kibao chake cha ‘Turn me on’. kwa hiyo, nadhani ni sawa nikisema kwamba Arrow alipalilia njia kwa wasanii wengine wa soca ambao waligundua kuwa muziki wa soca unaweza kuuzika katika masoko mengine yasiyo ya kitamaduni.

eng: I think it was on the weekend I read that he was airlifted to Antigua for medical attention.
swa: Nadhani nilisoma mwishoni mwa juma kwamba alisafirishwa kwa ndege kwenda Antigua kwa ajili ya matibabu.

eng: Today (September 15th) I learnt he had succumbed to brain cancer.
swa: Leo (Tarehe 15 Septemba) nimefahamu kuwa alishindwa na saratani ya ubongo.

eng: My condolences go out to his family and the people of Montserrat who are mourning his loss.
swa: Rambirambi zangu ziwafikie familia yake na watu wa Montserrat ambao wanaomboleza kifo chake.

eng: If it's any consolation he will always be 'hot, hot, hot'.
swa: Na ikiwa italeta ahueni, nasema ataendelea kuwa ‘hot, hot, hot’.

eng: The thumbnail image used in this post, Cane Arrows 2, is by TarikB, used under an Attribution-NonCommercial 2.0 Generic Creative Commons License.
swa: Picha ndogo iliyotumika katika makala hii, Cane Arrows 2, imepigwa na TarikB na imetumika kwa leseni ya an Attribution-NonCommercial 2.0 Generic Creative Commons License.

eng: Visit TarikB's flickr photostream.
swa: Tembelea ukurasa wa picha wa TarikB..

eng: Yesterday rumors spread in Mozambique about a general strike via word of mouth, SMS, and even Twitter.
swa: Kuna uvumi ulioenezwa jana nchini Msumbiji kwa njia ya mdomo, ujumbe mfupi wa maneno wa simu na hata kupitia Twita kuhusu mgomo.

eng: The motive: the "unjust" cost of living - rises in the price of bread, water and electricity.
swa: Msukumo ukiwa: gharama za maisha zisizo za "haki" - kuongezeka kwa bei ya mkate, maji na umeme.

eng: Readers may recall that an increase the price of minibuses sparked riots and protest in February 2008.
swa: Wasomaji watakumbuka kwamba ongezeko la nauli za vyombo vya usafiri wa umma lililofanywa mwezi Februari 2008 lilisababisha kuwepo kwa machafuko na maandamano.

eng: So the city went to sleep on edge.
swa: Kwa hiyo, jiji lilijikuta katika hali ya wasiwasi mkubwa.

eng: While the mainstream media is just starting to report this, this morning bloggers and twitters have already been reporting on events.
swa: Wakati vyombo vya habari vikuu nchini humo vilipoanza kuripoti kuhusu yanayoendelea, leo asubuhi wanablogu na wanatwita tayari wameanza kuripoti juu ya matukio mbalimbali.

eng: Eduardo Castro of Elefante News writes
swa: Eduardopp Castro wa Elefante News anaandika

eng: Rioting in township areas.
swa: Vurugu katika maeneo ya vitongoji.

eng: Rubber bullets fired.
swa: Risasi za mpira zinapigwa.

eng: Burning tyres on the roads, and a smoke haze rising up over Maputo from the fires.
swa: Watu wanachoma matairi yaliyotumika katikati ya barabara, na moshi unaonekana ukipaa katika anga la Maputo kutokana na moto huo.

eng: Update - 12:15 pm Maputo time:
swa: Taaria ya hivi punde, saa 6:15 mchana kwa saa za Maputo:
