swa: “Mtangazaji habari wa zamani wa televisheni ya Misri na mwanaharakati Bothaina Kamel alitangaza kwenye ukurasa wake wa twita usiku wa Ijumaa saa za Cairo kwamba ana mipango ya kugombea urais kwenye duru inayofuata ya uchaguzi, na kumfanya awe mwanamke wa kwanza kutangaza nia ya kutaka kuingia kwenye ofisi kuu nchini Misri, Manar Ammar

eng: This is how Manar Ammar reported the news of Bothaina Kamel running for the Egyptian presidential elections.
swa: Hivi ndivyo Manar Ammar alivyoripoti habari za Bothaina Kamel kugombea kwenye uchaguzi wa Urais wa Misri.

eng: Kamel (@basboussa1) has received mixed reactions from Twitter users.
swa: Kamel (@basboussa1) amepokea miitikio mchanganyiko kutoka kwa watumiaji wa twita.

eng: Twitter user @FaresADL could not believe it, so he wrote to Kamel wondering if the news had been confirmed or was just a rumour: @FaresADL: @basboussa1 are you really running for presidency?
swa: Mtumiaji wa Twita @FaresADLhakuweza kuamini habari hiyo, kwa hiyo akamwandikia Kamel akishangaa kama habari hizo zilikuwa zimethibitishwa ama zilikuwa ni uvumi tu: @FaresADL: @basboussa1 ni kweli kabisa unagombea uraisi?

eng: Fatma Emam, who is a feminist wrote about the news: @fatmaemam: Bothina Kamel the first and only women candidate for presidency in #Egypt , follow her on @basboussa1 , in solidarity#womenrights #jan25
swa: Fatma Eman, ambaye ni mtetezi wa usawa wa mwanamke aliandika kuhusu habari hizo: @fatmaemam: Bothina Kamel mgombea mwanamke wa kwanza na wa pekee nchini #Egypt , mfuatilie hapa @basboussa1 , katika mshikamano #womenrights #jan25

eng: Photo taken from the Facebook account of Bothaina Kamel; participating in a demonstration during the World Day Against Corruption.
swa: Picha iliyochukuliwa kwenye ukurasa wa facebook wa Bothaina Kamel; akishiriki maandamano wakati wa maadhimisho ya Siku ya Vita Dhidi ya Rushwa duniani

eng: Lara (@FarawlaLawra) found it good news, whether she is convinced to vote for her or not: @FarawlaLawra: @basboussa1 I am so proud and glad u r running- its a step forward to opening up the society to equal rights.(even if i might not vote 4 u)
swa: Lara (@FarawlaLawra) aliiona habari hiyo kuwa nzuri, bila kujali ikiwa ameshawishika kumpigia kura ama la: @FarawlaLawra: @basboussa1 ninajisikia fahari na furaha unagombea –ni hatua moja mbele kuifungua jamii kuelekea kwenye haki sawa (hata kama ninaweza nisikupigie kura wewe)

eng: Mahmoud Salem, aka @Sandmonkey, also wrote in support: @Sandmonkey: @basboussa1 ana ma3aky ya rayessah 3ala fekra. so far u have my vote.
swa: Mahmoud Salem, anayefahamika pia kama @Sandmonkey, pia aliandika kumuunga mkono: @Sandmonkey: @basboussa1 ana ma3aky ya rayessah 3ala fekra. mpaka hapo kura yangu umepata

eng: Some people commented on the above video against her running for presidency.
swa: Watu kadhaa walitoa maoni juu ya video hiyo hapo juu kupingana na nia yake ya kugombea Urais.

eng: MyHamosa: I'm against us being ruled by a woman Algeriangirls123: I don't think she will even have the minimum votes required to enter the elections!
swa: MyHamosa: Sikubaliani sisi kutawaliwa na mwanamke Algeriangirls123: Sidhani kama hata ataambulia kura za chini kabisa zinazotakiwa ili kuingia kwenye uchaguzi!

eng: Radwa El-Shami questioned the reason behind the huge number of candidates running for presidency in Egypt: The number is increasing and I am seriously starting to question the intentions and motives of every person willing to ascend the throne of Egypt.
swa: Radwa El-Shami alihoji sababu zilizo nyuma ya idadi kubwa ya wagombea wanaoutaka Urais nchini Misri: Idadi inaongezeka na nimeanza kujiuliza kwa makini dhamira na nia za kila mtu anayetaka kupanda kwenye kiti cha enzi cha Misri.

eng: It is looking more like I can't serve the country unless I am at the top of the hierarchy, unless I am the president.
swa: Inaonekana zaidi kana kwamba siwezi kuitumikia nchi yangu bila kushika nafsi za juu za utawala, bila ya kuwa rais.

eng: I admit that I am also questioning who is hankering for power and prestige
swa: Ninakiri kwamba ninahoji pia wale wenye uchu wa madaraka na sifa binafsi.

eng: Radwa then continued: I don’t know if I am the only one who pessimistically perceives the situation as farcical, and this is the reason am writing.
swa: Halafu Radwa aliendelea: Sijui kama mimi ni mtu pekee ninayeikatia tamaa hali hii na kuiona kama kituko, na hii ndiyo sababu ninaandika.

eng: I am voicing my concerns because I need a reassurance.
swa: Ninapazia sauti kuguswa kwangu kwa sababu ninahitaji uhakikisho.

eng: I am asking for a well-informed, insightful opinion; I am looking for someone to talk sense.
swa: Ninaomba maoni yenye weledi na ujuzi; Ninatafuta mtu atakayeongea kwa mantiki.

eng: Just a few months ago, many Egyptians might have wished to see the country's then-President Mubarak in jail, yet almost certainly none of them imagined this wish might come true one day.
swa: Miezi michache tu iliyopita, raia wengi wa Misri walitamani sana kumwona aliyekuwa rais wa nchi hiyo, Rais Mubarak, akitupwa jela, hata hivyo, pengine ni wachache miongoni mwao waliofikiri kwa uhakika kabisa kwamba siku moja jambo hili lingetimia.

eng: However, on Wednesday April 13, 2011, Egyptians woke up to the news of Mubarak's detention first thing in the morning.
swa: Hata hivyo, mnamo Jumatano ya tarehe 13 Aprili, 2011, raia wa Misri waliamka na mapema asubuhi ya siku hiyohiyo kukutana na habari zinazohusu Mubaraka kutupwa kizuizini.

eng: Here is how the moment was documented in the Egyptian social media scene.
swa: Hapa chini tunawaletea jinsi habari hizi zilivyopokelewa katika ulimwengu wa uandishi wa habari wa Kijmii miongoni mwa Wamisri.

eng: Celebrating a dictator's detention
swa: Kusherehekea kutiwa nguvuni kwa dikteta

eng: The Egyptian writer Ibrahim Farghali compared the moment to that of the first man in space: ...
swa: Mwandishi wa Misri, Ibrahim Farghali, alilinganisha wakati huo na wakati ule kulipokuwa na habari za mtu wa kwanza kufika katika anga za juu: ...

eng: نتمنى أن نرى مصر قريبا تحتفل بإنجازات شبيهة بمنجزات دول العالم المتقدم
swa: نتمنى أن نرى مصر قريبا تحتفل بإنجازات شبيهة بمنجزات دول العالم المتقدم

eng: Yesterday, Russia celebrated the anniversary of the first time a human being went into outer space, Yuri Gagarin.
swa: والثورة لا تزال في الشارع Jana, Urusi ilisherehekea kumbukumbu za binadamu wa kwanza kwenda katika anga za juu, Yuri Gagarin.

eng: And today Egypt celebrates its former president Hosni Mubarak's journey to prison.
swa: Na leo, Misri inasherehekea tukio la aliyekuwa rais, Hosni Mubarak, kuanza safari ya kwenda gerezani.

eng: We hope that one day Egypt celebrates similar achievements like those of the first world, and we hope then that the revolutionary spirit continues to exist in the streets.
swa: Tuna matumaini kwamba siku moja Misri isherehekee mafanikio kama hayo ya ulimwengu uliondelea, na tunatumaini kwamba hata wakati huo ule moyo wa mapinduzi utaendelea kuwepo mitaani.

eng: Zeinobia also wrote a new blog post about the moment, simply titled, "A Historical Moment".
swa: Zeinobia naye aliandika makala mpya ya blogu kuhusiana na wasaa huo, aliupa jina rahisi tu, "A Historical Moment" yaani "Wakati wa Kihistoria".

eng: She then elaborated how the president's sons were also detained: Former ousted president Mohamed Hosni Mubarak and his son Alaa and Gamal El-Din are detained for 15 days in jail.
swa: Kisha alieleza jinsi watoto wa rais huyo wa zamani nao walivyokamatwa na kutiwa kizuizini: Rais aliyetimuliwa madarakani Mohamed Hosni Mubarak na watoto wake Alaa na Gamal El-din wametiwa nguvuni na watakuwa gerezani kwa siku 15.

eng: Zeinobia then continued to explain that Mubarak is facing charges of murdering protesters and stealing public money; however, till now Mubarak is staying in a hospital for health reasons.
swa: Kisha Zeinobia aliendelea kueleza kwamba Mubarak anakabiliwa na mashtaka ya kuua waandamanaji na kuiba fedha za umma; hata hivyo, hadi wakati huu Mubarak bado yupo hospitalini kwa sababu ya matatizo ya kiafya.

eng: Alaa and Gamal Mubarak are facing the same charges as their father.
swa: Alaa na Gamal Mubarak wanakabiliwa na mashtaka kama hayo ya baba yao.

eng: Reactions of the people
swa: Jinsi watu waliyopokea

eng: Brazilian cartoonist Carlos Latuff documented the moment by his own way, with a series of cartoon drawings.
swa: Mchora katuni wa Brazil Carlos Latuff aliweka kumbukumbu ya wasaa huo kwa namna yake,alichora mifululizo ya series katuni .

eng: Mubarak Before and After Jan25 Revolution, illustration by Carlos Latuff
swa: Michoro ya kumwonyesha Mubarak Kabla na Baada ya Mapinduzi ya Januari 25, imechorwa na Carlos Latuff

eng: The majority of Egyptian status updates on Twitter over the past couple of days have also been about Mubarak's detention as well. @engmtm: I wish I could interrogate #Mubarak myself :D @Eslam_Foad: Thanks to the guy who writes Mubarak's speeches, without you the revolution wouldn't have succeeded.
swa: Nyingi ya Twita za hivi punde zilizotumwa katika siku mbili zilizopita nazo zilihusu kukamatwa kwa Mubarak na kutiwa kizuizini. @engmtm: Natamani ningeweza kumhoji #Mubarak mimi mwenyewe :D @Eslam_Foad: Asante kwa mtu anayeandika hotuba za Mubarak, bila wewe pengine mapinduzi yasingalipata mafanikio kama haya.

eng: In the past weeks, Torah Prison became not only host for Mubarak's sons, but it has also been hosting many of the pillars of Mubarak's regime.
swa: Katika majuma machache yaliyopita, Gereza la Torah liligeuka siyo tu kuwa makazi ya watoto wa Mubarak, lakini pia limekuwa makazi ya nguzo (watu) wengi tu waliokuwa katika utawala wa Mubarak.

eng: People on Twitter did not miss the chance to mock this fact: @MAkhnoukh: Breaking News: Torah Jail is now called Torah Republic and it's citizens demand their independence.
swa: Kupitia Twita, watu hawakuiachia fursa ya kufanyia mzaha jambo hili: @MAkhnoukh: Habari za hivi punde: Gereza la Torah hivi sasa linaitwa Jamhuri ya Torah na raia wake wanadai uhuru.

eng: It's got it's own president, government, and they do not need people there. @Aessameldin: Gamal Mubarak will star in Prison Break's new season, and his wife Khadija will join Desperate House Wives crew.
swa: Lina rais wake, serikali yake na kwa hakika hawataki kuwa na watawaliwa pale. @Aessameldin: Gamal Mubarak atakuwa nyota katika (filamu ya) Kujaribu Kutoroka Gerezani, na mkewe Khadija atajiunga na timu ya wapiga picha wa (filamu ya) Wake Wasio na Matumaini.

eng: Various fake Twitter accounts of Mubarak, his family (Suzanne Mubarak, Alaa Mubarak, Gamal Mubarak and his wife Khadija), and his regime (Fathi Sorour, Safwat El-Sharif and Ahmed Nazif) have also been created to make fun of them.
swa: Akaunti za uongo kadhaa za Twita za Mubarak, familia yake (Suzanne Mubarak, Alaa Mubarak, Gamal Mubarak na mkewe Khadija), na za watu katika utawala wake (Fathi Sorour, Safwat El-Sharif na Ahmed Nazif) zimetengenezwa ili kuwakebehi.

eng: Car carrying banners in celebration of the detention of Mubarak, posted on Yfrog.
swa: Picha ya gari likiwa limebandikwa matangazo ya kusherehekea kutiwa kizuizini kwa Mubarak, na kutumwa katika posted on Yfrog.

eng: Finally, despite all this, and despite the list of Mubarak's anti-achievements written by Ahmed Hayman, some people still sympathise with the former president: @MontuEssam: I swear to God I'm now sad to be an Egyptian, because of what I'm seeing now.
swa: Hatimaye, pamoja na yote haya, na licha ya orodha ya upingaji wa mafanikio ya Mubarak kama ilivyoandikwa na Ahmed Hayman, bado kuna wanaomwonea huruma rais huyo wa zamani: @MontuEssam: Ninaapa kwa Mungu, hivi sasa ninajisikia mwenye huzuni kwa kuwa raia wa Misri, hasa kwa sababu ya yale ninayoyashuhudia sasa.

eng: How come the Egyptian people carries all this amount of hatred and will to take revenge!
swa: Inakuwaje kwamba watu wa Misri wamebeba chuki nyingi kiasi hiki, na wanataka kulipiza kisasi!

eng: What's going?
swa: Kuna nini?

eng: Are we really that bad?
swa: Je, sisi kweli ni wabaya kiasi hicho?

eng: A 6.8 magnitude earthquake hit the northern Shan State in Myanmar on Thursday, and according to a state-run TV report, the death toll has increased to 74 people, and the number of injured has climbed past 100 people.
swa: Tetemeko la ardhi la ukubwa wa 6.8 lililopiga Jimbo la Kaskazini la Shan nchini Myanmar Alhamis iliyopita, kwa mujibu wa taarifa ya habari iliyorushwa na Televisheni ya Taifa idadi ya vifo imeongezeka na imefikia 74, , na wale waliojeruhiwa idadi yao imefikia watu 100.

eng: According to an updated report from Weekly Eleven, several aftershocks have been recorded in areas near the eastern Shan State spreading fear among the residents.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa taarifa za hivi karibuni kutoka Weekly Eleven, kumekuwepo na matetemeko mengine madogomadogo yaliyofuatia na kuripotiwa mashariki mwa jimbo la Shan na kusababisha hofu miongoni wa wakazi wa maeneo hayo.

eng: One resident in Oak Kyin village said on March 26, around 12pm:
swa: Mkazi mmoja wa kijiji cha Oak Kyin alisema siku ya tarehe 26 Machi saa 6 mchana:

eng: There was another earthquake last night and one this morning also.
swa: Usiku uliopita kulikuwa na tetemeko lingine na hata asubuhi ya leo pia.

eng: I don't dare to stay in my house anymore.
swa: Sithubutu kuendelea kukaa ndani ya nyumba yangu tena.

eng: The shaking is felt more because my house is ground-based.
swa: Tunasikia mtetemo zaidi kwenye nyumba yangu kwa sababu yenyewe ndiyo iko chini na imekwenda chini ardhini.

eng: Nothing can be predicted because it is a nature event.
swa: Ni vigumu kutabiri nini kitatokea, maana hili ni tukio la kimaumbile la dunia.

eng: I will let fate decide.
swa: Nitaacha majaliwa yaamue hatma.

eng: Residents also said that because of the earthquake, the death toll in Tarchileik, Tarle, Nar Yaung village, Mine Lin village, and Mine Koe village is estimated to be more than a hundred, with Mine Lin village having the most number of casualties.
swa: Vilevile, wakaazi walisema kwamba kwa sababu ya tetemeko hilo la ardhi, idadi ya vifo katika vijiji vya Tarchileik, Tarle, Nar Yaung, Mine Lin, Viand Mine Koe vinakadiriwa kuwa zaidi ya mia moja, huku kijiji cha Mine Lin kikiwa kina idadi kuwa zaidi ya waathirika wa tetemeko hilo.

eng: Earthquake damage in Myanmar.
swa: Uharibifu uliosababishwa na tetemeko la ardhi nchini.

eng: Photo from blog of akm-kunta
swa: Picha kutoka kwenye blogu ya akm-kunta

eng: In the same report by Weekly Eleven, an aid worker described the situation in Tarle:
swa: Katika taarifa hiyohiyo ya Weekly Eleven, mfanyakazi wa kutoa misaada alieleza hali ilivyokuwa kule Tarle:

eng: Wounded people have been sent to Tarchileik Hospital and Mine Phyat Hospital.
swa: Majeruhi wamepelekwa katika Hospitali ya Tarchileik na ile ya Mine Phyat.

eng: Aid groups from Tarchileik and Kyaing Tong have based their camps in Tarle.
swa: Vikundi vya watoa misaada kutoka Tarchileik na Kyaing Tong wamepiga kambi kule Tarle.

eng: I can say that the situation has calmed down a little.
swa: Naweza kusema kwamba hivi sasa hali imetulia kidogo.

eng: Reconstructions have begun.
swa: Kazi ya kujenga upya imeanza.

eng: Rehabilitation camps have been opened in Tarle and Nar Yaung village.
swa: Kambi za ukarabati zimefunguliwa katika vijiji vya Tarle na Nar Yaung.

eng: An aid worker who went to Tarle, one of the worst-hit areas, was interviewed by The Irrawaddy:
swa: Mfanyakazi mmoja wa kutoa misaada alikwenda Tarle, eneo lililoathiriwa vibaya zaidi na tetemeko la ardhi alihojiwa na The Irrawaddy:

eng: I arrived in Tarle around 10am.
swa: Niliwasili Tarle majira ya saa 4 asubuhi.

eng: Most of the 3-storey buildings on the side of the road only has 2 stories now. Many 2-storey buildings have also collapsed.
swa: Majengo mengi yaliyokuwa ya ghorofa 3 pembezoni mwa barabara hivi sasa yamebaki kuwa ya ghorofa 2 tu, mengi yameanguka.

eng: Monasteries were also included in those collapsed buildings.
swa: Jumba la Utawa (Monasteri )pia ni kati ya majengo yaliyoanguka.

eng: Some of these buildings are more than 20 years old, so it made things worse.
swa: Baadhi ya majengo haya yana zaidi ya umri wa miaka 20, kwa hiyo hali inakuwa mbaya zaidi.

eng: Not only residents of Tarle, but also the residents in Tarchileik had to sleep on tarpaulins.
swa: Sio wakazi wa Tarle tu waliolazimika kulala kwenye mahema bali hata wale wa Tarchileik.

eng: When I arrived in Tarle, I saw that some people were clearing the things at their house by themselves.
swa: Nilipowasili Tarle, niliona baadhi ya watu wakiondoa vitu wao wenyewe kutoka kwenye nyumba zao.

eng: Some were crying in front of relative's houses.
swa: Wapo waliokuwa wakilia mbele ya nyumba za ndugu zao.

eng: I also saw some crying because they lost their relatives.
swa: Kadhalika niliwaona waliokuwa wakilia kwa ajili ya kuwapoteza ndugu zao.

eng: I couldn't ask them anything.
swa: Sikuweza kuwauliza chochote.

eng: I should say some were lucky to be alive.
swa: Naweza kusema tu kwamba baadhi yao walikuwa na bahati kubaki hai.

eng: The government hasn't done anything yet.
swa: Serikali bado haijafanya kitu.

eng: Some were sent to hospitals.
swa: Wapo waliotumwa kwenda kwenye mahospitali.

eng: But I didn't go to the hospital so I don't know what's happening there.
swa: Lakini mimi sikwenda hospitalini, kwa hiyo sijui nini kinaendelea kule.

eng: As far as I see, I see that there are about 60 deaths in Tachileik.
swa: Ukiniuliza makadirio yangu, naweza kusema watu kiasi cha 60 walipoteza maisha kule Tachileik.

eng: There were about 20-30 deaths there (in Tarle).
swa: Kulikuwa na kati ya watu 20 - 30 waliopoteza maisha kule (Tarle).

eng: Death toll would be above that.
swa: Naamini waliokufa ni wengi zaidi.

eng: I donated some materials, instant noodles and water.
swa: Nilichangia vifaa kadhaa, maji na tambi za kupika haraka.

eng: I gave all of them to residential officials.
swa: Nilivitoa vyote hivyo kwa maafisa wa makazi.

eng: I don't know what they will do with these things.
swa: Sijui watavitumiaje vitu hivyo.

eng: They have opened temporary shelters.
swa: Wameanzisha sehemu za kujihifadhi za muda.

eng: Those who have relatives go and live at their house.
swa: Wale walio na ndugu wamekwenda kuishi nao kwenye nyumba zao.

eng: Now, the highway has been closed temporarily.
swa: Kwa sasa, barabara kuu imefungwa kwa muda.

eng: They said that it will be going under maintenance.
swa: Walisema kwamba lengo lilikuwa ni kuifanyia matengenezo.

eng: Another aid worker from Tarchileik said:
swa: Mfanyakazi mwingine wa kutoa misaada kutoka Tarchileik alisema:

eng: The earthquake happened on March 24, 8:25pm.
swa: Tetemeko la ardhi lililotokea mnamo tarehe 24 Machi, saa 2.25 usiku.

eng: Some hours after, officials from Tarchileik came and asked me to volunteer so I went with them.
swa: Saa kadhaa baadae, maofisa kutoka Tarchileik, walinijia na kutaka niende kujitolea kufanya nao kazi.

eng: I arrived in Tarle at midnight.
swa: Niliwasili kule Tarle usiku wa manane.

eng: On the road to Tarle, there is one big bridge.
swa: Kwenye barabara kuelekea Tarle, kuna daraja moja kubwa.

eng: When we reached that place, our car cannot go forward anymore.
swa: Tulipofika pale, gari letu lisingeweza kuendelea mbele.

eng: So we had to cross the bridge on foot and continue on to Tarle.
swa: Kwa hiyo, ilitulazimu kuvuka daraja kwa miguu na kuendelea kutembea kwa miguu hadi Tarle.

eng: The road at the edge of the bridge had moved down about 5 feet.
swa: Sehemu ya barabara pale kwenye daraja ilikuwa imeporomoka kwa takribani futi 5.

eng: There was a great deal of destruction.
swa: Kulikuwa na uharibifu mkubwa.

eng: With some houses, only the roof was visible and the whole house has went down into the ground.
swa: Kwa baadhi ya nyumba mtu uliweza kuona paa tu, nyumba nzima ilikuwa imetitia ardhini.

eng: What I had to do there was to send wounded people to Tarchileik hospital.
swa: Nilichofanya pale ilikuwa ni kuwasafirisha majeruhi kwenda hospitali ya Tarchileik.

eng: There is a hospital at Tarle, but that hospital had also collapsed.
swa: Kuna hospitali kule Tarle, lakini nayo iikuwa imeharibiwa vibaya.

eng: So at first, we had to place the patients at the empty yard in front of the hospital and give them treatment.
swa: Kwa hiyo, mwanzoni ilitulazimu kuwalaza wagonjwa kwenye uwanja mtupu ulio mbele ya jengo la hospitali na kuwapa matibabu pale.

eng: Afterwards, they were carried by stretchers to the car at the other side of the bridge.
swa: Baadaye, walibebwa kwenye machela hadi kwenye magari upande mwingine wa daraja.

eng: The walk there takes about 15 minutes.
swa: Umbali wa kutembea hapo ulichukua takribani dakika 15.

eng: When we get to the other side of the bridge, we can't immediately send the patients to the hospital.
swa: Baada ya kufika upande wa pili wa daraja, hatukuweza kuanza safari ya kwenda hospitali mara.

eng: Because we didn't have many available stretchers, we had to take that stretcher back to the hospital and carry another patient.
swa: Kwani hatukuwa na machela nyingi za kutosha, ilitulazimu kurudisha machela kule hospitali ili tubebe wagonjwa wengine.

eng: There wasn't enough cars so we couldn't send one patient to Tarchileik hospital with one car.
swa: Pia hakukuwa na magari ya kutosha, kwa hiyo isingewezekana kumsafirisha mgonjwa mmoja peke yake kwenye gari.

eng: Therefore, the patient who was sent first to the car had to wait for other patients to arrive.
swa: Kwa hiyo, mgonjwa aliyepelekwa wa kwanza hadi kwenye gari, ilimlazimu kuendelea kusubiri ili wagonjwa wengine waletwe.

eng: Another thing is we had to wait for many levels of officials' approval for clearance in order for the car to leave to the hospital.
swa: Jambo lingine ni kuwa ilitulazimu kusubiri vibali kutoka ngazi mbalimbali kabla hatujaruhusiwa kuondoka na gari kwenda hospitali.

eng: That wastes a lot of valuable time.
swa: Jambo hilo linapoteza kiasi kikubwa tu cha muda.

eng: In the car I had to drive, one patient died when we were about to reach Tarchileik Hospital.
swa: Katika gari niliyiopaswa kuendesha, mgonjwa mmoja alifariki tulipokaribia kufika hospitali ya Tarchileik.

eng: There were people who had survived the earthquake, but died when they shouldn't have because they were not treated in time for their sustained injuries.
swa: Wapo walionusurika katika janga la tetemeko la ardhi, lakini walikufa huku kwa kweli wangeweza kabisa kuokolewa kwa sababu hawakupata matibabu katika muda mwafaka ili kumudu kuvumilia majeraha yao.

eng: It really makes me sad.
swa: Kwa kweli jambo hili linanihuzunisha sana.

eng: U Win Swe, president of Myanmar Geological Society, said to Weekly Eleven:
swa: U Win Swe, ambaye ni rais wa Chama cha Jiolojia cha Myanmar, aliliambia Weekly Eleven:

eng: In the past, strong earthquakes have occured in areas around Shan State.

eng: This post is part of our special coverage Nigeria Elections 2011.
swa: Makala hii ni sehemu ya habari maalum za Uchaguzi wa Naijeria 2011.

eng: Nigerians voted yesterday (16 April, 2011) in the third presidential election since the nation transitioned to civilian rule in 1999.
swa: Wanaijeria walipiga kura jana katika uchaguzi wa tatu wa rais tangu taifa hilo lilipoingia kwenye utawala wa kiraia mwaka 1999.

eng: Thus far, the election has widely been declared a success, with only sporadic reports of violence and voting irregularities.
swa: Mpaka sasa, uchaguzi huo umeelezwa na wengi kuwa ulikuwa wa mafanikio, huku kukiwa na taarifa za ghasia za hapa na pale na hitilafu za upigaji kura.

eng: News sources reported a large turnout, orderly queues, and voters waiting until polls closed to make sure their votes were counted.
swa: Vyanzo vya habari vimeripoti kuwa watu wengi walijitokeza, foleni zenye kufuata utaratibu, na wapiga kura kusubiri hadi uchaguzi utakapomalizika ili kuhakikisha kwamba kura zao zimehesabiwa.

eng: As Africa's largest nation and a major international oil supplier, Nigeria stands in the spotlight during election season.
swa: Kama nchi yenye watu wengi zaidi Afrika na muuzaji wa mafuta mkubwa kimataifa, Naijeria inamulikwa kwa ukaribu wakati wa uchaguzi.

eng: Previous elections in 2003 and 2007 were marred by fraud and violence; as a result, high hopes have been placed on this year's polls.
swa: Chaguzi zilizopita mwaka 2003 na 2007 zilitiwa dosari na uchakachuaji pamoja na ghasia; na matokeo yake, matumaini makubwa yamewekwa kwenye uchaguzi wa mwaka huu.

eng: Incumbent Goodluck Johnathan, the former vice-president who assumed office after his predecessor's death last year, is perceived as the frontrunner; his closest competition is expected from Mohammadu Buhari, who briefly governed the country during the 1980s.
swa: Rais aliye madarakani Goodluck Johnathan, makamu wa rais wa zamani ambaye alichukua madaraka baada ya kifo cha aliyemtangulia mwaka jana, anachukuliwa kama mgombea anayeongoza; mshindani wake wa karibu anategemewa kuwa Mohammadu Buhari, ambaye kwa muda mfupi aliongoza nchi hiyo mnamo miaka ya 1980.

eng: Other challengers are former anti-corruption chief Nuhu Ribadu and Kano State governor Ibrahim Shekarau, as well as 16 candidates from smaller parties.
swa: Washindani wengine ni aliyekuwa mkuu wa kitengo cha kuzuia rushwa Nuhu Ribadu na Gavana wa Jimbo la Kano Ibrahim Shekarau, kadhalika wagombea wengine 16 kutoka katika vyama vidogo vidogo.

eng: Official results are expected Monday.
swa: Matokeo rasmi yanatarajiwa siku ya Jumatatu.

eng: For more coverage, check out GV's special page on the Nigerian Election.
swa: Kwa habari zaidi, angaliaukurasa maalum wa GV kuhusu Uchaguzi wa Naijeria.

eng: Report from the polls
swa: Taarifa kutoka kwenye Uchaguzi

eng: At Bella Naija, Chiedu Ifeozo wrote how he changed his mind about voting in Nigeria.
swa: Bella Naija, Chiedu Ifeozo aliandika alivyobadili mawazo yake kuhusu upigaji kura nchini Naijeria.

eng: He said that although he had voted in “every election that was held while I lived in England,” at home in Nigeria he just “didn't see the point,” because of the prevalent assumption that 'Nigerian votes do not count' and 'the winners have already been decided.'
swa: Alisema kwamba japokuwa amepiga kura katika "kila uchaguzi uliofanyika wakati alipokuwa akiishi Uingereza," alikuwa "haoni sababu" ya kufanya hivyo nyumbani Naijeria kwa sababu ya dhana iliyoenea kwamba 'kura za Wanaijeria hazina maana' na kwamba 'washindi tayari wamekwisha amuliwa.'

eng: But, like many young Nigerians, Ifeozo changed his mind and headed to the polls this election season:
swa: Lakini, kama Wanaijeria wengi vijana, Ifeozo alibadili mawazo yake na kwenda kwenda kupiga kura katika msimu huu wa uchaguzi.

eng: Regardless of the cynicism, there has been renewed vigor among the people of my generation regarding the 2011 elections.
swa: Bila kujali mashaka yaliyopo, kumekuwa na mwamko mpya kati ya watu wa kizazi changu juu ya uchaguzi wa 2011.

eng: Various youth coalition groups have gone all out to show that it isn’t only ‘cool’ to vote but have gone as far as giving insight into exactly who was running for the various offices by performing online polls, organizing a debate, and even developing web and mobile applications for easy monitoring of the elections through citizen reports.
swa: Vikundi mbalimbali vya vijana vimejitokeza ili kuonyesha kwamba kupiga kura siyo tu 'ni jambo la kisasa' bali pia vimeendelea na kuonyesha kwa ukaribu ni akina nani wanaogombea ofisi mbalimbali kwa kuendesha chaguzi za kwenye mtandao, kwa kuandaa midahalo, na hata kutengeneza programu-tumizi za intaneti na simu za viganjani kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji rahisi wa uchaguzi kwa kutumia ripoti za kiraia.

eng: Through these processes, the candidates became more than just names and faces on campaign posters.
swa: Kwa kupitia michakato hiyo, wagombea wamekuwa zaidi ya majina na picha kwenye mabango ya kampeni.

eng: They became the possible agents of change my country needed.
swa: (Vikundi hivyo vya vijana) vimekuwa madalali wa mabadiliko ambayo nchi yangu inayahitaji.

eng: He then gave a blow-by-blow account of his experience on voting day:
swa: Na baada ya hapo alitoa uzoefu wake mmoja baada ya mwingine katika siku hiyo ya kupiga kura:

eng: 1.04pm: When it was my turn, my heart was beating a little fast, I can’t lie.
swa: Saa 7.04 mchana: Ilipofika zamu yangu, moyo wangu ulikuwa unadunda kwa kasi kidogo, siwezi kudanganya.

eng: We had been educated on how to correctly complete the process for our votes to count, and I didn’t want to make a mistake, certainly not at the last moment.
swa: Tulielimishwa jinsi ya kushiriki kwenye mchakato ili kwamba kura zetu zihasibiwe, na sikutaka kufanya makosa, bila ya shaka kwenye bhatua za mwisho.

eng: I handed the official my registration card, and he passed it to another official while he searched for my name on the list.
swa: Nilimkabidhi ofisa kadi yangu ya usajili, naye akamkabidhi ofisa mwingine wakati akilitafuta jina langu kwenye orodha.

eng: When he found it, he put some ink on my right thumb and ushered me to the female NYSC personnel from earlier, who tore out two separate ballot sheets folded them and stamped some information on the back.
swa: Alipolipata, aliweka wino kwenye kidole gumba changu cha kulia na kunielekeza kwa ofisa wa awali wa kike wa NYSC, ambaye alichomoa kadi mbili tofauti za kupigia kura akazikunja na kupiga muhuri kwenye taarifa fulani nyuma ya kadi hizo.

eng: She then wrote some details as well before handing it over to me and then directed me to the polling booth, a white folded stand with visors on both sides to prevent anyone from seeing me make my choice.
swa: Kisha aliandika mambo kadhaa kabla ya kunikabidhi tena na kunielekeza kwenye chumba cha kupigia kura, kichumba cheupe kilichosimikwa chenye ubao kila upande ili kuzuia mtu yeyote asinione wakati nafanya chaguo langu.

eng: I made towards the ballot boxes, one for the senate and the other for the House of Representatives, put my ballot sheets through the slot and I was done.
swa: Nilielekea kwenye masunduku ya kura, moja kwa ajili ya bunge la seneti, na jingine kwa ajili ya baraza la wawakilishi, nikachomeka karatasi zangu kwenye upenyo na nikawa nimemaliza.

eng: I had voted for the first time, and honestly the first thing that crossed my mind was, “that wasn’t so bad now was it”.
swa: Nilipiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza, na kwa kweli jambo la kwanza kupita mawazoni mwangu lilikuwa, "halikuwa jambo baya, au siyo".

eng: 5.15pm: I saw the result of my polling unit on the internet.
swa: Saa 11.15 jioni: Niliona matokeo ya kituo changu cha kupigia kura kwenye intaneti.

eng: My lips stretched into a smile….. “this is is the beginning of a new day for my country.”
swa: Midomo ikatanuka na kuwa tabasamu... "huu ni mwanzo wa siku mpya kwa nchi yangu."

swa: Mfanyakazi wa kituo cha kupigia kura Naijeria.

swa: Picha kwa hisani ya @feathersproject

eng: In a post titled “A different kind of war,” Salisu Suleiman wrote about how the election season interrupts the business of daily life:
swa: Katika makala yenye kichwa“Vita ya aina nyingine,” Salisu Suleiman aliandika kuhusu jinsi gani msimu wa uchaguzi ulivyoingilia mtiririko wa maisha ya kila siku:

eng: All schools were closed down.
swa: Shule zote zilifungwa.

eng: No form of teaching or learning took place for the duration.
swa: Hapakuwa na aina yoyote ya ufundishaji au kujifunza iliofanyika wakati wote.

eng: When it was discovered that the private school the president’s children attend did not close down along with others, public outcry forced it to close down also.
swa: Na ilipogundulika kuwa shule binafsi ambayo watoto wa rais wanasoma haikufungwa, kilio cha umma kiliilazimu ifungwe pia.

eng: After the initial two weeks, an extension was sought and granted.
swa: Baada ya wiki mbili za mwanzo, ziada iliombwa na ikatolewa.

eng: So for an entire month, all primary and secondary schools in the whole country were shut.
swa: Mpaka sasa ni mwezi mzima, shule zote za msingi na sekondari nchini zimefungwa.

eng: Even in tertiary institutions, not much activity took place.
swa: Hata katika taasisi za elimu ya juu, hakuna matukio yaliyoendelea.

eng: In that one month period, every Nigerian aged 18 and above was practically drafted to put down their names and fingerprints at various centres.
swa: Katika kipindi hicho cha mwezi mmoja, kila Mnaijeria mwenye umri wa miaka 18 na zaidi aliandikishwa ili aweke jina lake na lalama zake za vidole kwenye vituo mbalimbali.

eng: Government said it was a civic duty.
swa: Serikali ilisema kuwa hilo ni jukumu la kiraia.

eng: Preachers harangued citizens on the need to perform this divinely inspired responsibility.
swa: Wahubiri waliwahubiria vikali raia juu ya umuhimu wa kutekeleza jukumu hili lililowekwa wakshi wa kiungu.

eng: Parties tried every trick known and unknown to get people to these centres.
swa: Vyama vilitumia kila ujanja unaojulikana na usiojulikana ili kuwafikisha watu vituoni.

eng: Civil society groups made sure they were not left out and they shouted loudly on the need for citizens to participate in the noble exercise.
swa: Vikundi vya jumuiya za kiraia vilihakikisha kwamba havikuachwa nyuma na vilipaza sauti juu ya umuhimu wa wananchi kushiriki katika zoezi hili.

eng: Public holidays were declared in several states to ensure that the details of all eligible citizens were captured.
swa: Sikukuu za kitaifa ziliamriwa katika majimbo kadhaa ili kuhakikisha kwamba taarifa za kila mwananchi ambaye ana uwezo wa kupiga kura zinaorodheshwa.

eng: Sophisticated digital equipment, worth over USD 500 million, were imported.
swa: Vifaa vya kisasa vya kidijitali, vyenye thamani ya zaidi ya dola za Kimarekani Milioni 500 viliagizwa.

eng: At the end of one month of frantic activity, including a week’s extension, over 73 million gallant Nigerians had voluntarily participated in the noble cause.
swa: Na mwisho wa mwezi wa matukio ya haraka haraka, pamoja na kuahirishwa kwa wiki moja, zaidi ya Wanaijeria milioni 73 walishiriki kwa hiari katika zoezi hili adili.

eng: Imnakoya expressed a cautious optimism shared by many in the blogosphere:
swa: Imnakoya alieleza matumaini yenye tahadhari ambayo wengi kwenye ulimewengu wa blogu wameyaonyesha:

eng: People came out to vote, voted, and even waited for the votes to be counted, without being intimidated by gun-trotting hoodlums, as was the case 2007.
swa: Watu walikuja kupiga kura, na wakasubiri kura zihesabiwe, bila ya kubugudhiwa na wahuni wenye bunduki, kama ilivyokuwa mwaka 2007.

eng: This appears to be the case across most South-western region of the country.
swa: Hivi ndivyo inavyoonekana kuwa katika majimbo mengi ya Kusini-magharibi mwa nchi.

eng: This is a significant shift from the last election.
swa: Haya ni mabadiliko makubwa (ikilinganishwa) na uchaguzi uliopita.

eng: Writing at NigeriansTalk, Kunle Durojaiye agreed:
swa: Akiandika kwenyeNigeriansTalk, Kunle Durojaiye anakubali:

eng: One cannot deny that there is a sense of a wind of change.
swa: Mtu hawezi kupinga kuwa kuna hali ya wimbi la mabadiliko.

eng: People voted, and waited behind to witness the counting and collation of votes; media stations ran a live coverage of the elections while it lasted, and very importantly, young people influenced the exercise with the flood of information available via twitter, facebook and blackberry messaging.
swa: Watu walipiga kura, na kusubiri ili washuhudie kuhesabiwa na kupangwa kwa kura; vituo vya habari vilirusha matangazo ya moja kwa moja ya uchaguzi wakati unaendelea, na muhimu zaidi, vijana walielekeza zoezi zima kwa mafuriko ya taarifa zilizopatikana kwa njia ya twita, facebook na ujumbe wa blackberry.

eng: Without mincing words, change is inevitable, but one just wonders if the stage is truly set. Read election day diary by Global Voices author, Nwachukwu Egbunike, which describes his day at the Polling Unit in Agbowo, Ibadan, Oyo State.
swa: Bila ya kumung'unya maneno, mabadiliko ni lazima, lakini kila mtu anajiuliza ikiwa uwanja upo tayari kikweli.

eng: More money was promised to Saudis today, following an address by King Abdulla to the nation.
swa: Fedha zaidi zimeahidiwa kutolewa kwa wananchi wa Saudia, ahadi ambayo Mfalme Abdulla ameitoa kupitia hotuba yake kwa taifa leo.

eng: In a short address, the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques thanked clerics, writers and the Ministry of Interior for their efforts in defending the kingdom.
swa: Katika hotuba hiyo iliyokuwa fupi, Mlinzi wa Misikiti Miwili Mitukufu aliwashukuru viongozi wa dini, waandishi na Wizara ya Mambo ya Ndani kwa juhudi walizofanya kutetea ufalme.

eng: Following that, a series of royal decrees were read by an announcer,outlining how billions of dollars would be spent to provide better housing, jobs and health care to Saudis.
swa: Baada ya hapo, matamko kadhaa yalisomwa na mtangazaji, hasa akieleza jinsi mabilioni ya dola yatakavyotumika katika kujenga nyumba bora, kazi na afya kwa raia wote wa Saudia.

eng: An anti-corruption committee would also be formed; Saudi workers would benefit from a minimum wage; and military and police officers would get the promotions they deserve.
swa: Vilevile kuna mpango wa kuunda kamati ya kudhibiti rushwa; wafanyakazi wa Saudia watanufaika na kima cha chini cha mshahara; wakati ambapo wanajeshi na askari polisi watapandishwa vyeo kama wanavyostahili.

eng: The speech drew a lot of attention from netizens, before, during and after it was read.
swa: Hotuba hii imevuta hisia za raia wa mtandaoni, kabla, wakati na baada ya kusomwa kwake.

eng: On Twitter, the hashtag #sakingspeech became a worldwide trending topic.
swa: Katika Twita alama #sakingspeech ilikuwa mada inayoenea kwa kasi ulimwenguni kote.

eng: The speech comes following calls, and small protests, for reforms in the Kingdom, where clergymen earlier urged Saudis not to ride the protest wave engulfing the region as such protests in Saudi Arabia were against religion.
swa: Hotuba hiyo ilikuja baada ya miito, maandamano madogo kudai mageuzi katika falme hiyo, ambapo viongozi wa dini hapo wali waliwaasa WaSaudia kutodandia wimbi la maandamano ya upinzani linaloikumba kanda hiyo kwani maandamanio ya namna hiyo ndani ya Saudi Arabia ni kinyume na dini.

eng: Coincidently, one of the royal decrees issued today was the setting up of a new religious body to handle fatwas (religious edicts).
swa: Kwa nasibu, moja ya amri za kifalme zilizotolewa leo ilikuwa ni kuundwa kwa chombo kipya cha kidinikitachoshughulikia fatwa (amri za kidini).

eng: On Friday 25th March, several Kenyan bloggers held a meeting in the Kenyan capital Nairobi, under the newly formed BAKE ( Bloggers Association KEnya).
swa: Mnamo tarehe 25 Machi, wanablogu kadhaa wa Kenya walifanya mkutano katika mji mkuu wa nchi hiyo, Nairobi, mkutano uliitishwa na BAKE ( Bloggers Association KEnya).

eng: The meeting was the 4th in an initiative by some of Kenyas veteran bloggers.
swa: Huo ulikuwa mkutano wa 4 uliotokana na msukumo wa wanablogu wakongwe wa Kenya.

eng: There have been numerous complaints, accusations and in some instances, outright battle of words simmering between the blogger community and the mainstream media with cases of plagiarism, copyright infringement and a general lack of appreciation by the mainstream media on the impact that blogging has had in generation and delivery of news and information content in Kenya.
swa: Kumekuwepo na malalamiko mengi, shutuma na hata katika nyakati nyingine, vita vikali vya maneno kurindima kati ya upande wa wanablogu dhidi ya ule wa vyombo vikuu vya habari hasa kuhusiana na matukio ya kugushi habari,kitendo ambacho kinakiuka suala la hakimiliki na kutokiri chanzovitendo vinavyofanywa na vyombo vikuu vya habari na hasa katika taathira ya kublogu katika uzalishaji habari na utangazwaji wake kwa umma na makala mbalimbali nchini Kenya.

eng: This standoff has been aptly covered in a recent blogpost by Jacque Ndinda titled, WriteThinking: Plagiarism-masters of copy paste.
swa: Mtafaruku huu umeandikwa kiyakinifu zaidi na makala ya kwenye blogu ya Jacque Ndinda aliyoipa kichwa cha habari chaWriteThinking: Plagiarism-masters of copy paste. (yaani Uandishi wa Fikra: 'Wataalamu wa kugushi kwa mtindo wa kunakili na kubandika).

eng: Kenyan Bloggers at a previous Barcamp.
swa: Wanablogu wa Kenya katika mkutano uliopita wa Barcamp.

eng: Photo source: Njeri Wangari Her main bone of contention is in how the mainstream media owners are downplaying this as the culprits when exposed through numerous emails to the editor do not receive any disciplinary action.
swa: Chanzo cha picha na: Njeri Wangari Msingi mkuu wa hoja yake ni jinsi wamiliki wa vyombo vikuu vya habari wanavyodharau suala hili kama wakosefu hasa pale wanapoanikwa hadharani kupitia baruapepe, wakati huohuo hakuna hatua za kinidhamu zinazochukuliwa dhidi ya wahariri.

eng: More often than note, a simple “we are sorry”, is offered to the blogger with no discussion on compensation or acknowledgment.
swa: Mara nyingi huishia tu kusema “samahani”, kwa mwanablogu bila kuwepo majadiliano kuhusu fidia au kukiri kwa maandishi.

eng: This, among other issues, as well as opportunities for bloggers were some of the items in the agenda at the Friday meeting.
swa: Jambo hili, miongoni mwa masuala mbalimbali, na vilevile fursa kwa wanablogu yalikuwa baadhi ya mambo yaliyojadiliwa katika mkutano wa Ijumaa hiyo.

eng: The turnout was quite impressive with more than 20 bloggers in attendance.
swa: Mahudhurio yalikuwa ya kutia moyo ambapo zaidi ya wanablogu 20 walishiriki.

eng: Most were attending for the first time as the original members had been caught up in other matters.
swa: Wengi wao walikuwa wanashiriki kwa mara ya kwanza, hasa kwa vile wanablogu waliowahi kushiriki hapo kabla walikuwa na mambo mengine ya kushughulikia.

eng: A blog post by Kachwanya, one of Kenya’s most prolific bloggers, laid out the full agenda as well as the aim and objectives of the association.
swa: Makala ya kwenye blogu iliyoandikwa na Kachwanya, ambaye ni mmoja wa wanablogu wanaoblogu sana nchini Kenya, alianika ajenda nzima na vilevile shabaha na malengo ya umoja huo.

eng: Our aims will be primarily
swa: Shabaha zetu kimsingi ni:

eng: 1.Create and promote high quality online local contents and innovations
swa: 1.Kubuni na kuhamasisha utoaji habari kupitia mtandao zinazohusu nchi yetu zenye ubora na ubunifu wa hali ya juu

eng: 2.Create viable online Marketing channel for the Kenyan companies
swa: 2.Kubuni mkondo wa utafutaji masoko kupitia mtandao unaowezekana kwa ajili ya makampuni ya Kenya

eng: Have fun online
swa: Kufurahia kupitia mtandao

eng: One of the things that received a lot of emphasis was the need to build a community where bloggers supported each other and worked closer together to achieve a common objective which is to provide relevant and useful local content online.
swa: Moja ya mambo yaliyotiliwa mkazo sana lilikuwa kuhusu kujenga jamii ambapo wanablogu watasaidiana na kufanya kazi pamoja ili kufikia lengo moja ambalo ni kutoa habari za nchi zilizo mwafaka na zenye kufaa kupitia mtandao.

eng: During the discussion on revenue generation which most bloggers didn’t view as an incentive to their blogging quest, most admitted that despite signing up with international online advertising companies, there was very little to show for it with most eventually withdrawing from the service.
swa: Katika mjadala uliohusu upatikanaji mapato, kitu ambacho wanablogu wengi, hawakukichukulia kama kichocheo kikubwa katika kiu yao ya kublogu, wengi walikiri kwamba ingawa walikuwa wamejisajili katika makampuni ya kimataifa ya masoko ya mtandaoni, hakukuwa na kitu kikubwa kilichopatikana jambo lililowafanya wengi kujitoa katika huduma.

eng: Thus the association will among other things, come up with a more realistic and relevant ad platform that will involve local advertisers.
swa: Kwa hiyo, taasisi itabuni, miongoni mwa mambo mengine, jukwaa linalozingatia hali halisi na lililo mwafaka litakalojishughulisha na watangazani kutoka nchini Kenya.

eng: This, it was noted, would be more effective and would earn bloggers that extra penny which though not sought desperately, would afford bloggers some stipend.
swa: Ilifikiriwa kwamba jambo hili huenda litasaida kufanya wanablogu wajipatie kipato cha ziada pamoja na kwamba sicho kitu wanachokisaka kwa udi na uvumba, lakini bado itawapatia wanablogu kifuta jasho.

eng: Wanjiku, one of Kenya’s veteran bloggers, announced that she had registered the domains www.bake.co.ke and www.bake.com for use by the BAKE community.
swa: Wanjiku, ambaye ni mmoja kati ya wanablogu wakongwe nchini Kenya, alitangaza kwamba ameandikisha anwani za mtandaoni www.bake.co.ke na www.bake.com kwa ajili ya matumizi ya jumuiya ya BAKE .

eng: Some of the activities that BAKE is organizing are:-
swa: Baadhi ya shughuli zinazoandaliwa na BAKE ni pamoja na:

eng: Activities
swa: Shughuli za

eng: • Bloggers expo after every three months.
swa: • Maonyesho ya wanablogu kila baada ya miezi mitatu.

eng: • Bloggers meet up or happy hour every month.
swa: • Wanablogu kukutana mara moja kila mwezi kwa saa moja kujifurahisha.

eng: • Blog competition on topical topics with huge rewards at the end for the winners
swa: • Mashindano ya blogu kuhusu mada iliyo moto ambapo washindi watapatiwa zawadi kubwa.

eng: • Blog Awards at the end of the year
swa: • Kuwepo kwa Zawadi kwa blogu kila mwisho wa mwaka.

eng: Bloggers in attendance were informed that Collins Mbalo who runs the blog ‘A Nairobian’s Perspective’ and a fellow Global Voices author, would offer his advice on legal matters like plagiarism and copyright infringement among others.
swa: Wanablogu walioshiriki walitaarifiwa kwamba Collins Mbalo ambaye huendesha blogu inayoitwa ‘A Nairobian’s Perspective’ na ambaye ni mwandishi wa Global Voices, atatoa ushauri wake kuhusu masuala ya kisheria hasa kuhusiana na kugushi na ukiukwaji wa hakimiliki, miongoni mwa mambo mengine mengi.

eng: Many agreed that this is a great initiative and that it was about time that Kenyans bloggers started speaking in one voice.
swa: Wengi walikubaliana kwamba jambo hilo lilikuwa vuguvugu la maana na kwamba wakati ulikuwa umefika ili wanablogu wa Kenya wawe na sauti moja.

eng: We thus look forward to see a lot of good things coming forth in the days to come.
swa: Kwa hiyo tuna matumaini kwamba mambo mengi mazuri yapo njiani yanakuja katika siku za usoni.

eng: There was already some rumors that a large corporation is in negotiations with BAKE for the sponsorship of the first Bloggers Expo.
swa: Tayari kulikuwa na mnong'ono kwamba kampuni moja kubwa ilikuwa kwenye majadiliano na BAKE ili kudhamini Expo ya kwanza ya Wanablogu.

eng: Let us hope that this will spur growth in not just blogging but also in the relevance of the content.
swa: Tuombe kwamba jambo hili liamshe ari si ya kublogu peke yake lakini hasa katika kufanya mambo yaendane vema na utoaji wa makala zilizo mwafaka.

eng: This post is part of our special coverage The Death of Osama Bin Laden.
swa: Makala hii ni sehemu ya habari zetu maalum kuhusu Kifo cha Osama Bin Laden.

swa: Picha ya Khulood Al-Khamis kutoka kwenye akaunti yake ya Twita

eng: So what does it take to make a woman fall in love with someone like Al-Qaeda leader Osama Bin Laden?
swa: Ni kitu gani kinachoweza kumfanya mwanamke aanguke katika penzi na mtu kama kiongozi wa Al-Qaeda Osama Bin Laden?

eng: Apparently, a long beard, admits Kuwaiti female columnist Khulood Al-Khamis, who stunned readers with a love letter she wrote for the terror mastermind, who was killed by the US, in Abbottabad, Pakistan, this week.
swa: Inavyoonekana, ni ndefu ndefu, anasema mwandishi wa makala kutoka Kuwait Khulood Al-Khamis, ambaye aliwastua wasomaji kwa barua yake ya mapenzi aliyoandika kwa kiongozi wa ugaidi, ambaye aliuwawa na Marekani, huko Abbottabad, Pakistan, wiki iliyopita.

eng: In her letter, in her column in the Kuwaiti Arabic daily Al-Qabas, Al-Khamis described Bin Laden as the man of her dreams, describing how she would have loved going with him to his cave, washing his beard and becoming one of his wives.
swa: Katika barua yake, kwenye makala yake ya gazeti la kila siku la Kiarabu Al-Qabas, Al-Khamis alimuelezea Bin Laden kama mwanume wa ndoto zake, aliezea jinsi mabvyo angependa kwenda naye ndani ya pango lake, na kuosha ndefu zake na kuwa mmoja wa wake zake.

eng: She ended her article promising to wait or him in heaven to continue her Scheherazade tales.
swa: Alimalizia makala yake yake kwa kuahidi kumngojea ahera ili kuendelea na simulizi zake hizi za Scheherazade.

eng: Around 400 Nepali youth showed up at Maitighar Mandala on May 8, 2011 to demand a new constitution.
swa: Takriban vijana 400 wa Nepali walijitokeza sehemu ya Maitighar Mandala tarehe 8 Mei, 2011 na kudai katiba mpya.

eng: Faheem Haider at Pakistan Foreign Policy Blog questions what the Pakistani Military and Intelligence Service knew about the top terror Osama Bin Laden, who was intercepted and killed in Abbottabad, near the Pakistan capital.
swa: Faheem Haider katika blogu ya Sera ya Nchi za Nje ya Pakistani anahoji kile ambacho Jeshi na Usalama wa Taifa (shirika la kijasusi) la Pakistani vilikuwa vinafahamu kuhusu gaidi mkuu Osama Bin Laden, ambaye aliingiliwa na kuuwawa huko Abbottabad, karibu na mji mkuu wa Pakistani.

eng: A Unesco report cites the "heavily regulated" mainstream media in Singapore while recognizing blogs and other new media sites as offering "alternative discourse on important socio-political issues like domestic politics, rights of gays and senior citizens."
swa: Repoti ya Unesco inaonesha 'udhibiti wa hali juu' wa vyombo vikuu vya habari nchini Singapore huku ikizitambua blogu na tovuti za vyombo vyauanahabari mpya kuwa vinatoa "mazungumzo makini mbadala juu ya masuala muhimu ya kisiasa na jamii kama vile siasa za ndani ya nchi, haki za mashoga na wazee."

eng: As uprisings continue across the Arab World, several incidences of angry young people have sprung up on Senegalese websites.
swa: Wakati vuguvugu la mapinduzi likiendelea Uarabuni matukio kadhaa ya vijana wenye hasirayamezuka katika tovuti za Senegal.

eng: Since early March, this activism has left the web behind and a group calling itself "Y'en a marre" (Enough is Enough) has now become the main symbol of the protests.
swa: Tangu mwanzoni mwa mwezi wa tatu, uanaharakati huo umeachana na ulimwengu wa mtandao na kundi linalojiita "Y'en a marre" (Imetosha Sasa Basi) sasa limegeuka na kuwa alama ya vuguvugu la upinzani.

eng: Founded in January 2011, Enough is Enough arose from frustration built up during power cuts that brought Senegal to a standstill.
swa: Kundi la Imetosha Sasa Basi lilioundwa mwezi Januari 2011, liliibuka kutokana na kukata tamaa kulikojengeka baada yamgawo wa umeme ambao uliisababisha nchi ya Senegal ikwame.

eng: The group hails from the Dakar suburbs and is led by several local rappers, including Fou Malad, Thiat (from the group Keur Gui) and Matador.
swa: Kundi hilo (la harakati) linatokea katika vitongoji vya Dakar na linaongozwa na wanamuziki wa ughanii wa kufoka, wakiwemo Fou Malad, Thiat (wa kikundi cha Keur Gui) pamoja na Matador.

eng: An article on Afrik.com explains the story behind the movement .
swa: Makala kwenye Afrik.com inaelezea habari za vuguvugu hilo .

eng: The group does not hold anything back on its Facebook page:
swa: Kundi hilo halifichi kitu chochote kwenye ukurasa wake wa Facebook:

eng: The time has passed for moaning in your living room or futile complaining about power cuts.
swa: Muda wa kulalamika mabarazani kwenu au kulalamika kusikozaa matunda juu ya kukatika kwa umeme umeshapita.

eng: We refuse to accept the systematic rationing imposed in our homes to supply electricity.
swa: Tunakataa kukubali mgawo wa kimfumo wa umeme unaolazimishwa kwenye nyumba zetu.

eng: We're sick and tired of it.
swa: Tumechoka mno.

eng: ENOUGH IS ENOUGH.
swa: IMETOSHA SASA BASI.

eng: ﻿﻿The group has now transformed its discontent at power cuts into a mobilisation movement for young people.
swa: Kundi hilo hivi sasa limegeuza manung’uniko yake juu ya mgawo wa umeme kuwa vuguvugu la kuwahamasisha vijana.

eng: It attacks mass unemployment, police brutality and corruption.
swa: Linashambulia ukosekanaji mkubwa wa ajira, unyama wa polisi na ufisadi.

eng: But above all, it tries to make people take part.
swa: Lakini zaidi ya yote linawataka watu wajitokeze kushiriki.

eng: On 19 March, Enough is Enough held a protest in Dakar's Place de l'Obélisque (Obelisk Square), using its website to summon young Dakarois there.
swa: Mnamo tarehe 19 Machi, kundi la Imetosha Sasa Basi lilifanya maandamano kwenye Place de l'Obélisque (Viwanja vya Obelisk) jijini Dakar, na lilitumia tovuti yake kuwaalika vijana wa Dakar.

eng: The organisers certainly knew how to get their message across: black t-shirts with "y'en a marre" in white letters were distributed around the crowd.
swa: Waandaaji bila ya shaka walijua jinsi ya kufikisha ujumbe wao: fulana nyeusi zenye maandishi meupe “y'en a marre” ziligawanywa kwenye umati.

eng: There were also rhythmic, rap-style slogans, and both youth speak and the local Wolof language were heard.
swa: Pia palikuwa na kauli mbiu zenye vina katika mtindo wa ughanii wa kufoka, na pia misemo ya vijana pamoja na lugha ya Wolof pia vilisikika.

eng: To keep its momentum, the group has given itself a new objective: mobilise young people and give them a voice in anticipation of the 2012 presidential election. The organisers have redefined their message and come up with a new slogan: "ma carte d'electeur, mon vote" ("my polling card, my vote").
swa: Ili kudumisha mwamko huo, kundi hilo limejipa lengo jipya: kuhamasisha vijana na kuwapa sauti katika uchaguzi mkuu ujao wa 2012.Waandaji pia wameboresha ujumbe wao na kuja na kauli mbiu mpya: “ma carte d'electeur, mon vote” (”kadi yangu ya uchaguzi, kura yangu”).

eng: On 15 April they launched a national campaign called Daas Fanaanal (a Wolof verb meaning "to protect oneself"), which aims to encourage young people to vote without pledging allegiance to any particular party.
swa: Siku ya tarehe 15 Aprili walizindua kampeni ya taifa waliyoiita Daas Fanaanal (neno la ki-Wolof linalomaanisha “kujilinda”), kampeni ambayo ina shabaha ya kuwapa moyo vijana wapige kura bila ya kutoa kiapo au kujihusisha na chama chochote.

eng: Many young Senegalese have shown their support for the campaign on Facebook and Twitter, such as this post by Mamadou Dieye:
swa: Vijana wa Senegal wameonesha kuunga mkono kampeni hiyo kwenye Facebook na Twita, kama inavyoeleza makala hii ya Mamadou Dieye:

eng: Enough is also enough because the majority of the 1.4 million young people of voting age will not register on the electoral roll.
swa: Imetosha pia inatosha kwa sababu sehemu kubwa ya vijana wapatao milioni 1.4 wenye umri wa kupiga kura hawatajiandikisha kwenye daftari ya wapiga kura.

eng: They're always quick to complain but never do anything about it.
swa: (Vijana) hulalamika kwa haraka lakini huwa hawafanyi lolote kuhusu malalamiko yao.

eng: Y'en a marre will only succeed in the challenge it has set itself if it helps to wreck the Interior Minister's plan to leave all young people who don't support the Government off the electoral roll!
swa: Imetosha Sasa Basi itafanikiwa kwenye changamoto iliyojiwekea ikiwa tu itasaidia kuharibu mpango wa Waziri wa mambo ya Ndani wa kuwaacha nje ya orodha ya wapiga kura vijana wote wasioiunga mkono serikali.

eng: Enough is Enough does not hesitate to slam President Abdoulaye Wade's government, and the government is not sitting idly by.
swa: Imetosha Sasa Basi haisiti kuichachafya serikali ya Rais Abdoulaye Wade, na serikali haijaketi ubwete.

eng: The group claims to have been put under a lot of pressure, and says it has received threats from the authorities.
swa: Kundi hilo linadai kuwa limewekewa shinikizo kubwa sana, na linasema kuwa limepokea vitisho kutoka vyombo vya mamlaka.

eng: One press conference was cancelled when the landlord of Janeer, the bar in which it was supposed to take place, was pressurised by police.
swa: Mkutano mmoja na waandishi wa habari ulisitishwa baada ya mmiliki wa Janeer, mgahawa ambamo mkutano huo ulikuwa ufanyike, kushinikizwa na polisi.

eng: The police also seized loudspeakers seized at a rally on 19 March, 2011, in the city of Rufisque, close to Dakar, despite the fact that the group had been granted official permission to hold the event.
swa: Polisi pia walikamata vipaza sauti katika mkutano wa hadhara wa tarehe 19 Machi, 2011, kwenye mji wa Rifisque, karibu na Dakar, bila kujali ukweli wa kwamba kundi hilo lilipewa kibali rasmi cha kufanya tukio lile.

eng: Thiat, one of the leaders of the group, explains that it is first and foremost a movement of citizens, not an anti-Wade movement:
swa: Thiat, mmoja wa viongozi wa kundi hilo, anaeleza kuwa kwanza na kabla ya yote kundi hilo ni kundi la wananchi, na si kundi la kumpinga Wade:

eng: We are on the side of neither the President nor the opposition, we are on the side of the people and we are creating a movement which guards and upholds the respect of democracy and the institutions of Senegal.
swa: Hatupo upande wa Rais wala ule wa upinzani, tupo upande wa wananchi na tunatengeneza kundi la harakati ambalo linalinda na kudumisha heshima ya demokrasi na taasisi za Senegal.

eng: If the "enough is enough" movement is closer to the opposition right now, its founders have said that's because we're taking on the concerns of the citizens.
swa: Ikiwa kundi la “imetosha Sasa Basi” lipo karibu na upinzani hivi sasa, waanzilishi wake wamesema kuwa hilo linasababishwa na kuwa tumechukua kero za raia.

eng: The group wants change.
swa: Kundi hilo linataka mabadiliko.

eng: Period.
swa: Mwisho.

eng: Its growing popularity has made it April's catch of the month .
swa: Umaarufu wake unaoongezeka umekuwa kana kwamba mavuo ya mwezi Aprili .

eng: The group instantly responded :
swa: Kundi hilo lilijibu mara moja:

eng: Y'en a marre is not a fish.
swa: Imetosha Sasa Basi sio samaki.

eng: Small fish in a big pond, or mini revolution?
swa: Samaki mdogo kwenye bwawa kubwa, au mapinduzi madogo?

eng: The real extent of its impact on the 2012 presidential campaign will be known soon.
swa: Upeo wa athari zake katika kampeni ya uchaguzi wa rais wa 2012 utajulikana mara.

eng: The fact remains, only the rappers of the Dakar suburbs are speaking out.
swa: Ukweli unabaki kuwa, ni waghanii wafokaji wa vitongoji vya Dakar pekee ambao wanajitokeza kusema.

eng: During Senegal's last presidential election campaign in 2007, the only passing mention of youth issues arose from the "Concrete Generation" movement.
swa: Wakati wa uchaguzi wa rais uliopita wa mwaka 2007, masuala ya vijana yalitajwa kidogo tu kutokana na kundi la harakati la “Kizazi cha Zege”.

eng: Its figurehead was Karim Wade, the then 39 year-old son of President Wade.
swa: Kiongozi wake alikuwa Karim Wade, ambaye alikuwa ni kijana wa umri wa miaka 39 ambaye pia ni mwana wa Rais Wade.

eng: To say that young people are missing from Senegalese politics is an understatement.
swa: Kusema kwamba vijana hawamo katika siasa za Senegal ni kupunguza makali ya ukweli.

eng: Enough is Enough is not a call for the overthrow of the government, and it talks the line of democracy and non-violence.
swa: Imetosha Sasa Basi Imetosha Sasa Basi sio wito wa kuiangusha serikali, na unaongelea msimamo wa demokrasi na amani.

eng: Its revolution will affect every ballot box in Senegal.
swa: Mapinduzi yake yataathiri kila sanduku la kura nchini Senegal.

eng: These events confirm that the Senegalese people believe in the power of their ballot papers, but above all that the next presidential election campaign has long since begun, and this time, Senegal's youth will not settle for a role as mere spectators.
swa: Matukio haya yanathibitisha kuwa watu wa Senegal wanaamini katika nguvu ya karatasi za kura, lakini zaidi ya yote kwamba kampeni ya uchaguzi ujao wa rais imeshaanza, na wakati huu, vijana wa Senegal hawatakubali nafasi ya kuwa watazamaji tu.

eng: Singapore’s ruling party, People’s Action Party (PAP), released its election manifesto on April 17, 2011, which was immediately criticized by many bloggers for being “too vague.”
swa: Chama kinachotawala Singapore, People’s Action Party (PAP), kilitoa ilani yake ya uchaguzi tarehe 17 aprili, 2011, ambayo mara moja ilikosolewa na wanablogu wengi kwa “kutokuwa wazi”.

eng: PAP has been in power for five decades already.
swa: PAP kimekuwa madarakani kwa miongo mitano.

eng: The country's General Election will take place on May 7.
swa: Uchaguzi mkuu nchini humo umefanyika tarehe 7 Mei.

eng: The PAP manifesto promises a better future for all Singaporeans
swa: Ilani ya Uchaguzi ya PAP inaahidi mustakabali bora kwa kila mwananchi wa Singapore

eng: You can count on the PAP to do the best for Singaporeans from all walks of life, and to keep us united through good times and bad.
swa: Hauwezi kuitegemea PAP kuwatendea vyema zaidi Wasingapori wa kila kada ya maisha, na kuendelea kutuunganisha katika wakati mzuri na mbaya.

eng: Together, we will make Singapore a vibrant and inclusive society, with opportunities for a better life for each and every citizen.
swa: Kwa pamoja, tutaifanya Singapore kuwa jamii ya kusisimua na shirikishi, yenye nafasi za maisha bora kwa kila raia.

eng: We will be a city for the young and old.
swa: Tutakuwa jiji la wazee na vijana

eng: To achieve this vision, we seek your mandate to:
swa: Ili kutekeleza visheni hii, tunaomba ridhaa yenu ili:

eng: • Create opportunities for higher incomes for all
swa: • Tutengeneze fursa za kujipatia kipato cha juu kwa wote

eng: • Improve the lives of lower-income Singaporeans
swa: • Tuboreshe maisha ya Wasingapori wenye kipato cha chini

eng: • Bring out the best in every child
swa: • Tuwezeshe kila mtoto kufanya vyema zaidi

eng: • Develop a vibrant city and an endearing home
swa: • Kujenga mji wa kusisimua na kaya zinazovutia

eng: • Help our seniors stay active, healthy and engaged
swa: • Tuwasaidie wazee wawe na maisha yaliyochangamka, yenye afya na yenye kujishirikisha

eng: * Involve all Singaporeans in shaping our future
swa: • Kuwashirikisha wasingapori wote katika kutengeneza mustakabali wao

eng: The manifesto mentioned about the commitment of PAP to respect diverse views in society.
swa: Ilani hiyo iligusia juu ya ahadi ya PAP kuheshimu maoni tofauti katika jamii.

eng: But Mr. Brown complained that commenting is disallowed on the PAP video site.
swa: Brown alilalamika kuwa maoni hayakubaliwi kwenye tovuti ya video hiyo ya PAP.

eng: Lucky Tan is not impressed with the manifesto and warns that the proposed solutions have been done before:
swa: Lucky Tan naye hajashawishikana ilani hiyo na anaonya kwamba ufumbuzi uliopendekezwa umeshawahi kufanyika huko nyuma:

eng: In fact, where solutions are cited in the manifesto, they are what the PAP has been doing in the past decades e.g. retraining of low income workers from one low income job to another etc.
swa: Kwa kweli, ufumbuzi unaelezwa katika ilani, ndiyo yale ambayo PAP imekuwa ikiyafanya kwa miongo mingi iliyopita, kwa mfano, kuwapa mafunzo wafanyakazi wa kipato cha chini kutoka kazi moja ya kipato cha chini kwenda nyingine n.k.

eng: When the same solutions are used, we will only get the same results - widening income gap, rising cost of living and a deteriorating quality of life.
swa: Pale ambapo ufumbuzi huo huo unatumika, tutapata matokeo yale yale – kupanuka kwa pengo la vipato, ongezeko la gharama za maisha na kuanguka kwa kiwango cha maisha.

eng: Through the Wordle site, alvinology compares the PAP manifesto with the manifesto issued earlier by the opposition Workers’ Party’s (WP).
swa: Kupitia tovuti ya Wordle, alvinology analinganisha ilani ya PAP na ilani iliyotolewa awali na chama cha upinzani cha Wafanyakazi (Workers’ Party au WP).

eng: The PAP document consists of 25 pages compared to the 63 pages in the WP manifesto.
swa: Ilani ya PAP ina kurasa 25 ikilinganishwa na kurasa 63 katika ilani ya WP.

eng: Bloggers also noticed that the WP manifesto has detailed recommendations in 15 different policy areas.
swa: Wanablogu pia waling’amua kuwa ilani ya WP ina mapendekezo ya kina katika maeneo 15 ya sera.

eng: Yawning Bread criticizes the leadership brand of PAP:
swa: Yawning Bread anakosoa chapa ya uongozi wa PAP:

eng: It’s getting very tired.
swa: Inaanza kuchoka.

eng: And what the PAP does not realise is that this constant harping about the risk of failure has actually damaged Singapore.
swa: Na kile ambacho PAP haijakigundua ni kuwa huu upigaji kinanda kuhusu hatari ya kushindwa kwa hakika kumeiathiri vibaya Singapore.

eng: Far from making us a confident, innovative society willing to try new things and benefitting from experimentation, it has made us risk-averse and slightly paranoid.
swa: Mbali na kutufanya tuwe jamii yenye kujiamini, yenye ubunifu ambayo iko tayari kujaribu mambo mapya na kunufaika na majaribio hayo, imetufanya tuwe waoga wa kujaribu na wenye mashaka kiasi.

eng: It’s hardly any wonder stress levels in Singapore are so high
swa: Si ajabu kuwa kiwango cha mashininikizo nchini Singapore ni kikubwa

eng: Blogging for Myself accuses PAP of being ‘clueless’ to the current realities in the world:
swa: Blogging for Myself anakishutumu PAP kwa'kutokuwa na ufahamu' kuhusu hali ilivyo sasa duniani:

eng: In one word, the PAP is CLUELESS.
swa: Katika neno moja, PAP HAIFAHAMU LOLOTE.

eng: I am not expecting some grand theory that is good enough to help illuminate mankind into the future, but they do not have a sufficient grasp of the driving forces today beyond being bewildered by it all and can only say this: The future is highly uncertain.
swa: Sitegemei nadharia kuu fulani ambayo ni nzuri kiasi cha kuweza kumpa mwanadamu mwanga wa utabiri wa huko mbeleni, lakini hawa hawana mashiko ya mambo yanavyojiendesha hii leo zaidi ya kushikwa butwaa na ninaweza kusema hivi: mustakabali hauna uhakika.

eng: The PAP has been short changing themselves because they are apt to choose people they trust rather than the ablest.
swa: PAP imekuwa ikijidhulumu chenji kwani imekuwa ikiwachagua watu inaowaamini kuliko wale ambao wana uwezo.

eng: You know the dynamics of human relationships, it is impossible to have a large company of people that you can develop deep trust.
swa: Unajua mahusiano ya watu, haiwezekani kuwa na kundi kubwa la watu ambalo unaweza kujenga kuaminiana kweli ndani yake.

eng: Molly Meek publishes an annotated document of the PAP manifesto.
swa: Molly Meek anachapa nyaraka yenye maelezo ya ilani ya PAP.

eng: She also described the manifesto as a defense of the status quo:
swa: Pia anaeleza kuwa ilani hiyo ina nia ya kulinda hali (ya uongozi) kama ilivyo:

eng: The PAP Manifesto is ultimately about maintaining the status quo, making it cosmetically and statistically better but substantially worse.
swa: Lengo kuu la Ilani ya PAP ni kuendeleza hali kama ilivyo, na kuifanya kuwa bora kwa urembo na kwa takwimu lakini kubaki mbaya katika ukweli halisi.

eng: Expect minor tweaks but do not expect them to translate to any palpable benefit for Singaporeans; do not expect anything near a paradigm shift in thinking.
swa: Tegemeeni marekebisho madogo lakini msiwategemee kuitafsiri kwa manufaa yoyote dhahiri kwa Wasingapori; msitegemee lolote linalokaribiana na mabadiliko ya kimuundo katika kufikiri.

eng: (And no, of course there’s no groupthink in the PAP.)
swa: (Na hapana, hakuna mawazo ya kijumla katika PAP.)

eng: Nigel Tan is disappointed that the manifesto contains only vague promises:
swa: Nigel Tan amesikitishwa na kwamba ilani hiyo imesheheni ahadi ambazo haziko bayana:

eng: The document seems to contain a series of vague promises, with neither details of specific policies nor information on how the various stated aims were going to be implemented.
swa: Nyaraka yenyewe inaoneka kuwa imesheheni mfululizo wa ahadi sizisokuwa bayana, bila ya maelezo ya kinaganaga ya sera husika wala maelezo yanayofafanua kwa jinsi gani sera hizo zitatekelezwa.

eng: As elections get nearer, netizens are encouraged to post photos of the elections in the GE2011 Media website.
swa: Kadri uchaguzi unavyokaribia, raia wa kwenye mtandao wanaombwa watume picha picha za uchaguzi kwenye tovuti ya GE2011 Media.

eng: This post is part of our special coverage Uganda: Walk to Work Protests. Ugandan police have responded to the past month's ongoing Walk to Work protests by spraying protesters with tear gas and live bullets.
swa: Polisi wa Uganda wameikabili kampeni inayoendelea kwa mwezi mmoja sasa ya Kutembea Kwenda Kazini kwa kuwanyunyuzia waandamanaji mabomu ya machozi na risasi sa moto.

eng: During a demonstration on Tuesday, they took a different tack, firing water cannons filled with pink liquid at demonstrators who were attempting to walk to Constitution Square in the center of Kampala.
swa: Wakati wa maandamano siku ya Jumanne, walitumia mbinu mpya, ya kuwashambula waandamanaji waliokuwa wakijaribu kuandamana kuelekea viwanja vya katiba katikati ya jiji la Kampala kwa maji yaliyochanganywa na maji ya rangi ya waridi.

eng: Uganda's New Vision Newspaper tweeted a photo of opposition leaders covered in the paint. yfrog Photo user flashdancer11 shared the photo below:
swa: Gazeti la New Vision la Uganda lilituma picha ya viongozi wa upinzani waliokuwa wamemwagiwa rangi hiyo kwa njia ya Twita. Mtumiaji wa yfrog flashdancer11 alituma picha hii:

eng: Some bloggers pointed out the irony of the government spraying protesters pink — a color often associated with the gay and lesbian community — given the anti-homosexuality bill currently making its way through Uganda's Parliament.
swa: Baadhi ya wanablogu walinyooshea kidole kejeli ya serikali ya kuwanyunyuzia waandamanaji rangi ya waridi – rangi ambayo mara nyingi huhusishwa na jamii ya mashoga na wasagaji – ikizingatiwa kuwa muswada unaopinga ushoga hivi sasa unapitiwa ndani ya bunge la Uganda.

eng: Blogger Afrogay writes:
swa: Mwanablogu Afrogay anaandika:

eng: ...might this also be a subliminal response to the leader of the opposition, Kizza Besigye, for pledging four months ago to decriminalize homosexuality if elected?
swa: … je hili nalo ni jibu la fumbo kwa kiongozi wa upinzani, Kizza Besigye, ambaye miezi minne iliyopita aliahidi kuhalalisha ushoga ikiwa atachaguliwa?

eng: To which AfroGay would say to the head of the military guys drenching opposition in pink: thanks guys but the pink color is really just a metaphor.
swa: (Swali ambalo) Afrogay atamjibu kiongozi wa askari wanaowalowesha wapinzani kwa rangi ya waridi: ahsanteni jamaa lakini rangi ya waridi ni sitiari tu.

eng: There is no need to take it too literally.
swa: Hakuna haja ya kuichukulia kama hivyo.

eng: The hashtag #pinkstuff is also popular topic in the Ugandan Twittersphere:
swa: Alama ya #pinkstuff pia ni mada maarufu katika ulimwengu wa Twita wa Uganda:

eng: @Rosejackson3: So illegal to #walk2work in UG w/o permit. If you drive, windows smashed & tear gas to face.
swa: @Rosejackson3: kwa hiyo ni kinyume cha sheria kutembea kwenda kazini #walk2work nchini U/G bila ya kibali.

eng: If you fly, blocked.
swa: Ikiwa utapsafiri kwa anga, utazuiwa.

eng: If you stand-#pinkstuff
swa: Kama ukisimama tu, rangi ya waridi -#pinkstuff

eng: @ishtank: On the other hand, think of the stories we'll tell our great-grandchildren. "Kaaka, where were you the day #pinkStuff #trended on #Twitter?"
swa: @ishtank: Kwa upande mwingine, fikiria hadithi tutakazowasimulia wajukuu wetu. “kaaka, ulikuwa wapi siku rangi ya waridi #pinkStuff #ilipotawala kwenye #Twita?"

eng: While many found the "pink stuff" humorous, others are still upset at the government's treatment of protesters.
swa: Huku wengi waliona kisa hicho cha “rangi ya waridi” kinachekesha, wengine bado wamekasirishwa na namna ambayo serikali imewatendea waandamanaji.

eng: Blogger KellyUganda writes:
swa: Mwanablogu KellyUganda anaandika:

eng: Why does this seem incredibly Hitler/Nazi-esque to me?
swa: Kwa nini naiona hali hii kana kwamba ni ya ki-Hitler/ki-Nazi?

eng: As if people don't have the right to demonstrate!
swa: Ni kana kwamba watu hawana haki ya kuandamana kupinga jambo?

eng: I don't know how Museveni can even pretend to be running a democracy.
swa: Sijui ni kwa jinsi gani Museveni anaweza kujidai kuwa naendesha demokrasi.

eng: No doubt these people are being sprayed pink so that police can harrass and interrogate them and abuse them in the effort to crush their spirit of civic duty and freedom of expression!
swa: Bila ya shaka watu hawa wananyunyuziwa rangi ya waridi ili polisi waweze kuwanyanyapaa na kuwahoji na kuwaonea wakati wanajaribu kuvunja moyo wao wa jukumu la kiraia na uhuru wa kujieleza!

eng: In a post titled "Turning Pink," another blogger, Rhino, laments the government's actions:
swa: Katika makala yenye kichwa “Kugeuka kuwa Waridi,” mwanablogu mwingine, Rhino, analalamikia vitendo vya serikali:

eng: I'm starting to dislike my government very much, it shows so much fear, infantile logic and an alarming willingness to resort to violence.
swa: Ninaanza kuichukia sana serikali yangu, inaonesha hofu kubwa sana, mantiki ya kitoto na utashi unaostusha wa kutumia nguvu.

eng: That is not what I want from it.
swa: Hivyo sivyo ninavyotaka kutoka kwake.

eng: I want it to be just, to inspire me to be a better person and to help me create a better place for my kin and I to live in.
swa: Ninaitaka iwe ya haki, na kunitia moyo ili niwe mtu bora zaidi na kunisaidia niweze kujenga mahali pazuri pa kuishi kwa ndugu zangu.

eng: I don't want it to threaten me with death should I choose to differ in opinion and practice, if that is the society it wishes to create, then I would rather not be party to it. This post is part of our special coverage Uganda: Walk to Work Protests.
swa: Siitaki initishie kifo ikiwa nitatofautiana nayo kimawazo na kiutendaji, ikiwa hiyo ndio jamii inayotaka kuiunda, basi sitaki niwe sehemu yake.

eng: This post is part of our special coverage Uganda: Walk to Work Protests. Uganda opposition leader Dr.Kiiza Besigye was re-arrested in the capital Kampala for participating in the Walk to Work Campaign one night after he was granted bail.
swa: Kiongozi wa upinzani nchini Uganda Dk.Kiiza Besigye alikamatwa tena katika mji mkuu wa Kampala kutokana na kushiriki kwake katika Kampeni yaKutembea Kwenda Kazini usiku mmoja baada ya kuachiwa huru kwa dhamana.

eng: Besigye had been granted bail on the condition that he would not engage in the campaign that has put the Ugandan regime in the headlines for three weeks now.
swa: Besigye alipewa dhamana kwa sharti kuwa asijihusishe na kampeni ambayo imeuweka utawala wa Uganda kwenye vichwa vya habari kwa majuma matatu sasa.

eng: The protests led by the opposition are aimed at high fuel prices which have led to high food prices and President Museveni is defiant that he will not intervene to reduce prices.
swa: Maandamano hayo yaliyoongozwa na upinzani yanalenga kwenye bei kubwa za mafuta ambazo zimepelekea kuwa na bei kubwa za vyakula na Rais Museveni ametia kiburi kwamba hataingilia kati ili kupunguza bei hizo.

eng: The protests have so far left five people dead and dozens injured with bullets.
swa: Maandamano hayo ya upinzani mpaka sasa yamesababisha vifo vya watu watano na na dazeni wengine kujeruhiwa kwa risasi.

eng: Today was the fourth time Besigye was arrested, this time with more show of force by the military and police.
swa: Leo Besigye alikamatwa kwa mara ya nne, na mara hii kulikuwa na utumiaji nguvu zaidi kulikofanywa na wanajeshi pamoja na polisi.

eng: Besigye’s car windows were smashed with gun butts and teargas and pepper spray were sprayed in the car before her was thrown on a police truck.
swa: Dirisha la gari la Besigye lilivunjwa kwa vitako vya bunduki na bomu la machozi pamoja na upupu wa pilipili vilipeperushwa kwenye gari kabla ya Besigye kutupwa kwenye gari la polisi.

eng: President Musveni's main challenger was later taken to Kasangati Magistrates Court where he was released on a non-cash court bond of Ushs. 5 million (aprox. US $2,100).
swa: Baadaye mshindani mkuu huyo wa Rais Museveni alipelekwa kwenye mahakama ya Hakimu Mkazi ya Kasangati ambako aliachiwa kwa dhamana isiyo ya fedha taslimu ya Shilingi za Uganda milioni 5 (Takriban Dola za Kimarekani $2,100).

eng: Protests broke out again today against the violent arrest of Besigye, and more than 100 people have been injured by police.
swa: Matukio ya upinzani yalizuka tena leo dhidi ya kukamatwa kikatili kwa Besigye, na zaidi ya watu 100 wamejeruhiwa na polisi.

eng: Unconfirmed reports indicate that 3 people may have died.
swa: Taarifa zisizothibitishwa zinaashiria kuwa pengine watu watatu wamefariki.

eng: Ugandans online have been reporting diligently on the Walk to Work campaign.
swa: Waganda walio kwenye mtandao wanaripoti kwa uangalifu mkubwa kuhusu Kampeni ya Kutembea Kwenda Kazini.

eng: Twitter and Facebook users were enraged by the manner in which Besigye was arrested.
swa: Watumiaji wa Twita na Facebook walikasirishwa na namna ambayo Besigye alikamatwa.

eng: On Facebook
swa: On Facebook

eng: Facebook users expressed worry about the increasing police brutality.
swa: Watumiaji wa Facebook walielezea wasiwasi wao kuhusu unyama unaoongezeka wa polisi.

swa: Don Wanyama alisema:

eng: Seen the pictures of Besigye's arrest.
swa: Je umeona picha za kukamatwa kwa Besigye?

eng: I have never seen this kind of mistreatment.
swa: Sijawahi kuona aina hii ya uonevu.

eng: Break a guy's car and spray him with over 5 cans of teargas??
swa: Unavunja gari ya mtu halafu unampulizia zaidi ya makopo matano ya mabomu ya machozi??

eng: It is worse than the rape and treason and all other things slapped on him.
swa: No mbaya zaidi ya kubaka na uhaini pamoja na mambo mengine yote aliyokwisha chapwa nayo.

eng: It is troubling.
swa: Inasumbua.

eng: For how long will Besigye take the pain for people who seem comfortable in their misery, who are cowed?
swa: Mpaka lini Besigye ataendelea kubeba maumivu ya watu ambao wanaonekana kuwa wameridhika na dhiki yao, ambao wamefyata?
