eng: Somalia has not had a central government controlling the entire country since the fall of Muhammad Siad Barre in 1991.
swa: Somalia haijawahi kuwa na serikali kuu inayotawala nchi nzima tangu kuanguka kwa Muhammad Siad Barre mwaka 1991.

eng: The Transitional Federal Government (TFG) is the internationally recognized government of the Republic of Somalia.
swa: Serikali ya shirikisho ya mpito (TFG) ndiyo serikali ya Jamhuri ya Somalia inayotambulika kimataifa.

eng: After political discussions in Ethiopian, leaders of various Somali parties agreed to political steps to end the transitional period and elect a new president.
swa: Baada ya majadiliano ya kisiasa nchini Ethiopia, viongozi wa vyama mbalimbali vya siasa vya Somalia walikubaliana kuchukua hatua za kisiasa ili kumaliza kipindi cha mpito na kumchagua Raisi mpya.

eng: One of the steps outlined in a detailed timetable is the drafting of a new constitution.
swa: Miongoni mwa hatua zilizobainishwa katika ratiba changanuzi ni kuandaa muswada wa katiba mpya.

eng: Technical Revision Committee for the new constitution participated in a 4-day working session in Nairobi:
swa: Kamati ya Ufundi ya Mapitio ya katiba mpya ilishiriki katika kikao cha siku nne mfululizo katika jiji la Nairobi:

eng: Military portrait of Major General Mohamed Siad Barre, Somalia's longest-serving President.
swa: Picha ya Kijeshi ya Meja Jenerali Mohamed Siad Barre, Rais wa Somalia aliyetawala kwa muda mrefu kuliko wengine.

eng: Source: U.S. Library of Congress (Public Domain)
swa: Chanzo: maktaba ya Congress (Kwa matumizi ya umma)

eng: A four-day working session with the Signatories’ Technical Revision Committee has been concluded in Nairobi.
swa: Kikao cha siku 4 mfululizo kilichojumuisha waweka saini wa makubaliano, kimekwishahitimishwa mjini Nairobi.

eng: The working session is a follow up to the recent Addis Signatories’ meeting were most of the constitutional issues were agreed and some of the provisions – prepared by the Independent Federal Constitution Commission – have been amended after congenial political negotiations between the signatories of the Roadmap to end the transition, which was adopted in Mogadishu last September.
swa: Kazi hii ni ya ufuatiliaji wa yaliyotekelezwa katika kikao cha waweka saini cha hivi karibuni kilichofanyikia mjini Addis Ababa ambapo mambo mengi ya kikatiba yalikubaliwa na baadhi ya mapendekezo -yaliyoandaliwa na Tume Huru ya Katiba ya Serikali ya Shirikisho- yamerekebishwa baada ya makubaliano ya kisiasa ya amani baina ya waweka saini wa mpango huo wa amani wa kumaliza kipindi cha mpito, yaliyofanyika Mogadishu mwezi wa 9 mwaka jana.

eng: The technical Revision Committee’s mandate as per Addis Ababa’s Communiqué is to complete the constitutional process.
swa: Mamlaka ya kiufundi ya Kamati ya Mapitio, kwa mujibu wa tamko rasmi la Addis Ababa ni kukamilisha mchakato wa katiba.

eng: The Minister of Constitutional Affairs who convened the meeting explained to the participants and the media that “that road towards ending of the transition is getting closer and closer by the day, and we need to collectively work towards delivering a constitution that Somalia deserves and which serves its people.
swa: Waziri wa Mambo ya Katiba ambaye ndiye aliyeitisha mkutano aliwaeleza washiriki pamoja na vyombo vya habari kuwa “hatua ya kuelekea mwisho wa kipindi cha mpito zinaendelea kuwapo kukaribia sana siku hadi siku, na tunapaswa kufanya kazi kwa pamoja ili kuipatia Somalia katiba inayoistahili na itakayowatumikia watu wa Somalia

eng: Members of the Technical Revision Committee in Nairobi.
swa: Washiriki wa kamati ya ufundi ya mapitio wakiwa mjini Nairobi.

eng: Photo courtesy of http://horn.so/
swa: Picha kwa idhini ya: http://horn.so/

eng: Mahad Abdalle Awad, Deputy-Minister Ministry of Planning International Cooperation in Somalia, is optimistic that the country will soon have a new constitution:
swa: Mahad Abdalle Awad, Naibu Waziri wa Mipango na Ushirikiano wa Kimataifa wa Somalia ana matumaini makubwa kwamba nchi hiyo katika muda mfupi ujao itapata katiba mpya:

eng: Fearmongers use scare tactics to influence public opinion to impede change and progress by disseminating false information about the draft constitution and the planned Constituent Assembly meeting.
swa: Waoga wanatumia mbinu za vitisho ili kushawishi maoni ya wengi yawe ni ya kuzuia mabadiliko na mchakato huu kwa kusambaza taarifa ambazo si sahihi kuhusu uundwaji wa katiba na kikao cha bunge la katiba kilivyopangwa.

eng: Naysayers, natural skeptics and cynical people among us, habitually express negativity about the accomplishment of others and are pessimistic about change.
swa: Wale wasiotaka kuamini, na wenyewe wasiwasi kwa asili baina yetu, wamekuwa na tabia ya kuonesha mashaka na mafaninikio ya wengine na ambao si warahisi kupokea mabadiliko.

eng: Dale Carnegie’s famous quote fittingly describes the nature of Naysayers when he wrote “Any fool can criticize, condemn and complain, and most fools do.”
swa: Nukuu maarufu ya Dale Carnegie inafafanua kwa usahihi kasumba ya wote wenye tabia za kupinga pale alipoandika “mjinga yeyote anaweza kukosoa, kushutumu na kulalamika, na wajinga wengi ndivyo wafanyavyo.”

eng: These Naysayers often spread blatant lies to oppose anything other people do.
swa: Walalamikaji mara nyingi wanasambaza uongo kupinga kila kitu ambacho wengine wanakifanya.

eng: In the case of the Constituent Assembly, they assert that the constitution can only be approved by popular referendum, disregarding discernible historical fact that the Somali Republic itself was founded by the 1960 Constitution, approved by Constituent Assembly of only 110 delegates, and a process that took only 29 days, whereby public referendum was held 21st of July 1961, after more than one year.
swa: Kuhusu suala hili la Bunge la Katiba, wanasema kuwa katiba inaweza kuidhinishwa kwa kukubaliwa na wengi kupitia kura ya maoni tu bila kujali ukweli wa kihistoria ulio wazi kuwa Jamhuri ya Somalia yenyewe ilipatikana kwa katiba ya mwaka 1960, iliyoidhinishwa na bunge la katiba lililokuwa na wajumbe 110 tu, tena kwa mchakato uliochukua siku 29, ambapo mchakato wa kupata maoni ya wananchi ulifanyika tarehe 21 Julai, 1961, zaidi ya mwaka mmoja baadae..

eng: However, Mohamed Ali Hassan, Chairman of the Somali-American Peace Council and Manuela Melandri, PhD candidate at University College London, note that most Somalis look at the draft constitution with deep skepticism:
swa: Hata hivyo, Mohamed Ali Hassan, Mwenyekiti wa Baraza la Amani la Somalia-Marekani na Manuela Melandri, mwanafunzi anayesomea shahada ya uzamivu katika Chuo Kikuu cha London, waliweka bayana kuwa wasomali wengi wanauangalia muswada wa katiba kwa mashaka makubwa:

eng: The optimism of the international community is not shared by Somalis themselves, who instead look with deep skepticism at a document that they perceive as externally-imposed, faulty and fundamentally undemocratic.
swa: Matumaini makubwa kwa jamii ya kimataifa hayaeleweki kwa wa-Somali wenyewe, ambao badala yake wanaiangalia rasimu hiyo kwa mashaka makubwa wakiiona kama iliyoandaliwa na wageni, yenye makosa na kimsingi isiyo ya kidemokrasia.

eng: To understand this dynamic, one should start by questioning the facts.
swa: Kuielewa hali hii, lazima mtu aanze kwa kuhoji masuala ya msingi.

eng: What is wrong with the new Somali Constitution and why has the adoption of this document been met with resistance by educated Somalis, religious figures, secularists, former Somali Prime Ministers, women, scholars and by Somali Diaspora organizations?
swa: Kitu gani hakiendi sawa katika mchakato wa katiba mpya ya Somalia na kwa nini ukamilishaji wa katiba hii umekuwa ukikabiliwa na upinzani mkali kutoka kwa wasomali walioelimika, watu maarufu wa dini, wale wasio katika mrengo wowote wa dini, Mawaziri Wakuu waliotangulia wa Somalia, wanawake, wasomi na hata jumuiya za wa-Somali waishio nje ya nchi?

eng: First, there are issues concerning the content of the Constitution and the substance of its provisions.
swa: Kwanza, kuna mambo yanayohusiana na maudhui ya Katiba na utekelezekaji wa mapendekezo yake.

eng: Above all, the question of federalism remains deeply divisive.
swa: Lililo kubwa kabisa, ni swali la hali ya kuwa shirikisho ambalo linabaki kuwa jambo linaloleta mpasuko mkubwa kabisa.

eng: Views can be found both in support of and against Somalia adopting a federal structure.
swa: Maoni yanaweza kuwa ya kuunga mkono na ya kupinga mpango wa Somalia kuwa na muundo wa shirikisho.

eng: Somali President Sharif Sheikh in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, during the 12th African Union Summit Feb.
swa: Rais wa Somalia, Sharif Sheikh akiwa Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, wakati wa mkutano wa 12 wa nchi huru za Afrika uliofanyaka Feb.

eng: Source: U.S. federal government (Public Domain But one Somali argue that the new constitution can be improved in the future.
swa: Chanzo: Serekali ya shirikisho ya Marekani (Kwa matumizi ya Umma) Lakini m-Somali mmoja alikuwa na hoja kuwa katiba mpya inaweza kuboreshwa mbeleni.

eng: Somalis do not have time to wait for a a perfect constitution:
swa: Wa-Somali hawana muda wa kuisubiri kupata Katiba isiyo na makosa yoyote:

eng: Whether we like it or not, when we see images of the Somali people around the world and we compare our own situation (at least, those in the Diaspora that live in peace), do we feel that those brothers and sisters need a constitution that works for them now since they are dealing with horrible situations?
swa: Tupende tusipende, tunapoona taswira ya watu wa Somalia ulimwenguni kote, na tukifananisha na hali yetu (angalau, wenzetu waishio nje ya nchi kwa amani), je ni kweli tunahisi kuwa hao kaka na dada zetu wanahitaji katiba inayoweza kuwasaidia hivi sasa kwa kuwa wanahanganika kujinasua na hali mbovu?

eng: Think about this: maxay ku gaaraan mustaqbalka?
swa: Lifikirie hili: maxay ku gaaraan mustaqbalka?

eng: You have to know that I did not write those news articles mentioned above, Iam not part of the group that put together of the new constitution and I am not here to justify whether the new constitution is good, bad or ugly.
swa: Unapaswa kufahamu kuwa, sikuandika makala hizo za habari zilizotajwa hapo juu, mimi sio miongoni mwa kundi linalojadili katiba mpya na sipo hapa kwa nia ya kuhalalisha ikiwa katiba mpya ni nzuri, mbaya au ni mbovu.

eng: All I want to remind you is that: those that are in need may not have time to wait a new perfect and pretty constitution; they need one that works for them for the time being. More importantly, I am not here to oppose anyone’s idea – I am just expressing my own views as anyone else.
swa: Ninachotaka kuwakumbusha ni kuwa: wale walio kakika uhitaji wanaweza wasiwe na muda wa kusubiri katiba mpya isiyo na makosa na yenye mvuto; wanahitaji katiba itakayoweza kuwasaidia kupita katika mazingira waliyonayo hivi sasa; Tena lililo muhimu zaidi, siko hapa kupinga wazo la yeyote yule -ninatoa maoni yangu tu kama ambavyo na mwingine yeyote angeweza kufanya.

eng: However, the best solution that I see, at least in my opinion, let us commence discussing how to improve the new constitutions in the future.
swa: Pamoja na hayo, suluhisho bora zaidi ninaloliona, angalau kwa maoni yangu, hebu tuanze kujadili jinsi ya kuiboresha katiba mpya kwa ajili ya wakati ujao.

eng: Mohamud Uluso considers the draft constitution "a hurried job, with the latest version available only in Somali language while various outdated or fake versions are circulating on the web":
swa: Mohamud Uluso anauchukulia rasmu ya katiba kama “kazi inayoharakishwa, toleo la hivi karibuni zaidi likipatikana katika lugha ya kisomali pekee wakati rasimu nyingine za zamani au zile batili zikiwa zinazagaa katika mtandao wa intaneti":

eng: It appears that the UN-wise roadmap for Somalia is nothing but part of a plan of perfidy to keep Somalia and the Somalis in turmoil.
swa: Inaonekana kuwa mpango wa amani wa Umoja wa Mataifa unaoonekana kuwa ni wa busara kwa Somalia si chochote bali ni sehemu ya mkakati wa ulaghai ili kuiweka Somalia na wa-Somali katika matatizo.

eng: Instead of liberating the true Somalis, who need and want to continue living in and developing their own country and their communities inside Somalia, the planned constitution appears as the manifestation of the shackles of foreign as well as internal oppression of the indigenous Somali people in perpetuity.
swa: Badala ya kuwakomboa wasomali halisi, wanaohitaji na wanaoendelea kuishi nchini mwao na kuendelea kuiendeleza nchi yao wenyewe na jamii zao ndani ya Somalia, rasimu hii ya katiba inaonekana kuwa ilani ya kuwakumbatia wageni na pia kuwakandamiza milele wazawa wa Somalia.

eng: According to insiders FGM is now permitted by the newly proposed Somali constitution, which will be presented for adoption to selected "traditional leaders".
swa: Kwa mujibu wa chanzo cha habari kilichopo ndani ya serikali ya mpito ya shirikisho (FGM) kwa sasa imeruhusiwa na katiba mpya ya Somalia iliyopendekezwa, ambayo itawasilishwa kwa utekelezaji kwa baadhi ya “viongozi wa jadi” waliochanguliwa.

eng: A typical scheme how the UN and their stooges want to get it their way - or the way their master wants it.
swa: Ni utaratibu wa aina yake ambao umoja wa mataifa na washirika wake wanataka mambo yawe kwa kadiri ya wanavyotaka, au kwa kadiri ya wakubwa wao wanavyotaka iwe..

eng: Abduallhi Jamaa analyses various arguments about the draft constitution appearing online, vernacular radios and in village meetings and cafes:
swa: Abduallhi Jamaa anachanganua hoja mbalimbali kuhusu mswada huu wa katiba unaoonekana mtandaoni, katika redio zinazotangaza kwa lugha za ki-Somali na katika mikutano vijiji na hata migahawani:

eng: Analysts say the proposed law is seemingly a milestone, but one that may fracture Somalia further into autonomous and semi-autonomous regions as well as ministates.
swa: Wachambuzi wanasema kuwa mswada wa sheria uliopendekezwa unaonekana kama hatua muhimu sana, lakini ambayo inaweza kuigawa zaidi Somalia katika maeneo mawili yanayojitegemea au yenye aina fulani ya kujitegemea, na hata kufikia kuwa na majimbo madogo madogo.

eng: “There is absolute confusion.
swa: “Kuna mkanganyiko wa wazi kabisa.

eng: There wasn’t any civic education to put across the letter and spirit of the proposed laws and this means that most people are not comfortable with the contents, many more have not heard about the whole process,” he told Somalia Report.
swa: Hakukuwa na elimu yoyote ya uraia ya kufafanua suala la muswada wa katiba pamoja na dhima ya sheria zilizopendekezwa na hii inamaanisha kuwa watu wengi hawana uhakika na yaliyomo (katika mswada wa katiba), wengi zaidi hawajawahi hata kuusikia mchakato wenyewe” yeye [Hassan Sheikh, kiongozi wa Chama cha Amani na Maendeleo, PPD) alilieleza shirika la Habari ya Somalia.

eng: Amongst the contentious issues include the proposed model of government, the controversial issue of natural resources and the religious influence.
swa: Miongoni mwa mambo yanayojadiliwa ni pendekezo la mfumo wa serikali, mkanganyiko wa masualaa ya mali asili na ushawishi wa kidini.

eng: Some players argue that the language of the draft is not understandable, an issue that can lead to various kinds of misinterpretation.
swa: Baadhi ya wadau wanasema kuwa lugha iliyotumika katika mswada haieleweki, jambo linaloweza kuleta tafsiri tofauti na ile iliyokusudiwa.

eng: It is related to an absence of public representation.
swa: Suala hapa linahusiana na kukosekana kwa uwakilishi wa walio wengi.

eng: I do not wish to be part of a constituent assembly that does not represent Somalia’s vision and mission," said traditional elder Mohamed Hersi.
swa: Sitamani kuwa sehemu ya bunge la katiba ambalo haliwakilishi dira na malengo ya Somalia”, alisema kiongozi wa jadi, Mohamed Hersi..

eng: Google Ideas developed a pilot project with the Somali service, Africa Division of Voice of America (VOA) to help Somalis register their opinions with just a few clicks.
swa: Mradi wa 'Google Ideas' ulitengeneza mpango wa majaribio kwa kushirikiana na idhaa ya Somalia, Idaara ya Afrika ya Sauti ya Marekani (VOA) kuwasaidia wa-Somali kuandikisha maoni yao kwa njia rahisi kwa kubofya mara kadhaa tu.

eng: The poll shows, among other things, that Somalis want a Somalia based on the civil and criminal codes of Sharia, a strong central government and are divided over the inclusion of women in government.
swa: Pamoja na mambo mengine, takwimu za maoni zinaonyesha kwamba, wa-Somali wanahitaji Somalia itakayozingatia misingi ya “Sharia” za kiislamu kwa makosa ya madai na jinai, serikali kuu iliyo imara na (wa-Somali) wamegawanyika juu ya hatua za kuwajumuisha wanawake katika muundo wa serikali.

eng: Yesterday’s protests saw the arrest of many protesters from the streets by police and National Intelligence Security Service (NISS) agents.
swa: Maandamano ya jana yalisababisha polisi wakishirikiana na maafisa wa Usalama wa Taifa kuwakamata waandamanaji wengi katika mitaa kadhaa.

eng: Among them is prominent Sudanese Twitter personality and activist Usamah Mohammed Ali (@simsimt).
swa: Miongoni mwao alikuwa mtumiaji wa twita na mwanaharakati ambaye ni raia wa Sudani Usamah Mohammed Ali. (@simsimt).

eng: In his last tweet, Usamah was advocating free content to help spread the word about the events happening on the streets in the capital Khartoum:
swa: Katika twiti yake ya mwisho, Usamah alikuwa akifanya utetezi wa maudhui huru kusaidia kusambaza habari za matukio yanayoendelea katika mitaa ya jiji la Khartoum:

eng: Btw, I'm just being technical.
swa: Kiukweli, ni kwamba ninajaribu kufanya ujanja.

eng: You can use my tweets without even mentioning me.
swa: Unaweza kutumia twiti zangu bila hata kunitaja.

eng: Free content advocate here!
swa: Utetezi wa maudhui huru!

eng: Usamah’s last couple of tweets included information about his whereabouts and the situation on the ground.
swa: Twiti chache za mwisho za Usamah zilikuwa pia na taarifa kuhusu mahali alipo na hali ilivyo katika eneo alipo.

eng: He was in Burri area next to Nile Street :
swa: Alikuwa kwenye eneo la Burri karibu tu na Mtaa wa Nile:

eng: #FreeUsamah @simsimt is not released yet!
swa: @simsimt hajaachiwa bado!

eng: And I don't know where is he!!
swa: Na sijui aliko!

eng: According to Asaad, Usamah was taken to NISS headquarters in Khartoum North while he himself was taken to a police station in Khartoum.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa Asaad, Usamah alipelekwa kwenye jengo la makao makuu ya Idara ya usalama wa Taifa yaliyopo Khartoum Kaskazini wakati yeye mwenyewe alipelekwa kwenye kituo cha polisi mjini Khartoum.

eng: Usamah’s friends were tweeting their concern for his safety and demanding his immediate release.
swa: Rafiki za Usamah walitwiti kuonyesha mashaka na usalama wa Usamah wakitaka aachiwe huru mara moja.

eng: Ayman Elkhidir showed his concern for Usamah,
swa: Ayman Elkhidir alionyesha hofu yake kwa usalama wa Usamah,

eng: Good night.
swa: Habari za usiku.

eng: Hopefully tomorrow will bring better news from ‪#Sudan, with inshallah @Simsimt, Ahmed Hussein, and all the others free.
swa: Bila shaka kesho tutapata habari nzuri kutoka ‪#Sudani, na Mungu akijalia @Simsimt, Ahmed Hussein, na wote wengine watakuwa huru.

eng: Several other Sudanese Twitter users have been arrested and released, such as Omer Mahgoub (@OmarMahgoub), who was released today.
swa: Wa-Sudani wengine kadhaa wanaotumia mtandao wa twita wamekamatwa na kuachiwa, kama Omer Mahgoub (@OmarMahgoub), ambaye aliachiwa leo.

eng: He was held in the same building as Usamah, but says he has not seen him.
swa: Alikuwa ameshikiliwa kwenye jengo hilo hilo aliko Usamah, ingawa anasema hakumwona.

eng: Usamah has been in the custody of the notorious NISS for over 24 hours, and his twitter friends are campaigning for him using #FreeUsamah.
swa: Usamah amekuwa kwenye kizuizi cha Idara katili ya Usalama wa Taifa kwa zaidi ya masaa 24, na marafiki wake wa twita wanafanya kampeni ya kuachiwa kwake kwa kutumia alama habari ya #FreeUsamah.

eng: In the wake of the ongoing protests taking place in Khartoum and other states calling on the fall of the regime, numerous other peaceful protesters have been kidnapped by the NISS and many of them were tortured.
swa: Tangu kuibuka kwa maandamano haya yanayoendelea jijini Khartoum na katika majimbo yote kushinikiza kuanguka kwa utawala wa nchi hiyo, waandamanaji wengine wengi waliokuwa wakiandamana kwa amani wamekuwa wakitekwa na Idara ya Usalama wa Taifa hilo na wengi wao wanateswa.

eng: The decades of war and terrorism have placed Afghanistan among the world's most dangerous countries.
swa: Miongo ya vita na ugaidi vimeiweka Afghanistan katika kundi la nchi hatari zaidi kuishi duniani.

eng: Despite the progress made by the country since the ousting of the Taliban in 2001, most media writing about Afghanistan focus stubbornly on negative issues such as bomb blasts, suicide attacks, and casualties.
swa: Pamoja na hatua za mafanikio zilizofikiwa na nchi hiyo tangu kuondolewa kwa wa-Taliban mwaka 2001, vyombo vingi vya habari vinavyoandika habari za Afghanistan kwa ujeuri tu vimejikita katika masuala hasi kama vile milipuko ya mabomu, mashambulizi ya kujitoa muhanga na kujeruhiwa kwa watu.

eng: Reports in such media feature terrifying pictures that lead most people to never want to visit the war-torn but very beautiful country.
swa: Ripoti katika vyombo hivyo zinaonyesha picha za kuogofya ambazo husababisha watu wengi kughairi kabisa mpango wa kuitembelea nchi hiyo iliyoathirika vibaya na mapigano lakini kwa asili ikiwa ni nchi nzuri sana.

eng: This is why the work of Antony Loveless, a freelance British journalist and photographer, makes so much difference.
swa: Hii ndiyo sababu kazi ya Antony Loveless, mwanablogu Antony Loveless, mwandishi huru wa habari na mpiga picha wa Ki-Ingereza, inaleta tofauti kubwa.

eng: Since March 2012, Loveless has been posting photos from his trips to Afghanistan on Twitter, using the hashtag he invented, #TheAfghanistanYouNeverSee.
swa: Tangu mwezi Machi 2012, Loveless amekuwa akiweka picha anazopiga katika safari zake nchini Afghanistan kupitia mtandao wa twita, kwa kutumia alama ishara aliyoitengeneza yeye, #TheAfghanistanYouNeverSee.

eng: Speaking to Global Voices about the hashtag, Loveless said:
swa: Akioongea na mwandishi wa Global Voices kuhusu alama ishara hiyo ya twita, Loveless alisema:

eng: I have a portfolio of over 2,000 images shot on three trips to Afghanistan in recent years and to keep track of them, I conceived of the rather unwieldy hashtag .
swa: Nina jalada lenye picha zaidi ya 2,000 zilizopigwa katika safari zangu tatu nilizofanya nchini Afghaniistan katika miaka ya hivi karibuni na ili kuweka kumbukumbu hizo, niliamua kutengeneza alama ishara ya .

eng: The Girl in the Lake.
swa: Msichana katika Ziwa.

eng: Taking a dip to stay cool under the unforgiving midday sun.
swa: Akiogelea kujipooza mwili baada ya jua kali la mchana.

eng: Image by Antony Loveless, used with permission.
swa: Picha ya Antony Loveless, imetumiwa kwa ruhusa.

eng: Afghanistan's 'green zone', a stretch of fertile, cultivated ground along the Helmand River Valley.
swa: Eneo Kijani’'s 'nchini Afghastan', pana lenye rutuba, lililolimwa pembezoni mwa Bonde la Mto Helmand.

eng: Image by Antony Loveless, used with permission.
swa: Picha ya Antony Loveless, imetumiwa kwa ruhusa.

eng: The stunning beauty of Kajaki Lake in southern Afghanistan, seen from a Royal Air Force Chinook.
swa: Uzuri usiomithilika wa Ziwa Kajaki kusini mwa Afghanistani, kama unavyoonekana ukiwa juu kwa ndege ya Royal Air Force Chinnok.

eng: Image by Antony Loveless, used with permission.
swa: Picha ya Antony Loveless, imetumiwa kwa ruhusa.

eng: Loveless' hashtag was picked up by the Royal Air Force (RAF) Sergeant Alex Ford, who spent six months in 2011 in Afghanistan's Hilmand Province.
swa: Alama ishara hiyo ya Loveless ilitumiwa pia na Sajenti Alex Ford, wa Royal Air Force (RAF), aliishi kwenye jimbo la Hilmand nchini Afghanistan kwa muda wa miezi sita mwaka 2011.

eng: Sharing his views about the hashtag, Ford writes in Warfare Magazine:
swa: Akielezea maoni yake kuhusu alama ishara hiyo ya twita, Ford anaandikakwenye Jarida la Warfare:

eng: We have been involved in Afghanistan for almost 11 years now, and it has become commonplace to see images of the war back here.
swa: Tumekuwa tukijihusisha na masuala ya Afghanistan kwa takribani miaka 11 sasa, na imekuwa kawaida kuona picha za vita kutoka hapa.

eng: But generally those images tend to be more about the negative side of the conflict there.
swa: Lakini picha hizo kwa ujumla huwa zinaonyesha upande hasi wa mgogoro nchini humo.

eng: Pictures of flag-draped coffins driving through Wootton Bassett or out of Brize Norton... a picture of a soldier smiling, but the caption underneath giving the date he died.
swa: Picha za majeneza yaliyofunikwa bendera yakiingizwa Wootton Bassett au kutoka brize Norton…picha za mwanajeshi anayetabasamu, lakini maelezo chini yake yakitoa tarehe alipofariki dunia.

eng: Sadly, the majority of the British population that supports the lads and lasses on the ground have no real insight into the story of the war out there; the story that is Afghanistan.
swa: Inasikitisha sana, wengi wa wa-Ingereza wanaounga mkono wanawake na akina dada walio kwenye eneo la tukio hawana taarifa halisi za habari za vita inayoendelea kule; habari ambayo inatokana na Afghanistan yenyewe.

eng: Local children ready to chat to Paras leaving the Helicopter Landing Site.
swa: Watoto wa nchi hiyo wakiwa tayari kuzungumza na Paras anayeondoka eneo hilo la kutua kwa Helkopta.

eng: Image by Alex Ford, used with permission.
swa: Picha ya Picha ya Alex Ford, imetumiwa kwa ruhusa.

eng: Afghan kids with UNICEF-donated books and pens in a classroom.
swa: Watoto wa ki-Afghanistan wakionyesha vitabu na kalamu walizopewa na UNICEF darasani kwake.

eng: Image by Alex Ford, used with permission.
swa: Picha ya Picha ya Alex Ford, imetumiwa kwa ruhusa.

eng: The hashtag has become a popular photo tag for those who travel to Afghanistan to share the images that people outside of the country rarely see in conventional media.
swa: Alama ishara hiyo imekuwa maarufu kwa wale wanaosafiri kwenda Afghanistan kubadilishana picha ambazo watu nje ya nchi hiyo huziona mara chache katika vyombo vya habari.

eng: An Afghan child seems ready to be on camera.
swa: Mtoto wa ki-Afghan akionekana tayari kutumia kamera.

eng: Image by Steve Blake, used with permission.
swa: Picha ya Steve Blake, imetumiwa kwa ruhusa.

eng: Lately, Iqbal Ahmad Oruzgani, a photographer from Afghanistan has also begun posting photos under the hashtag to show Afghanistan from a different perspective.
swa: Hivi karibuni,Iqbal Ahmad Oruzgani, mpiga picha kutoka Afghanistan ameanza pia kuweka picha kwenye alama ishara hiyo hiyo ya mtandao wa twita kwa mtazamo tofauti.

eng: Collective wedding organized for tens of couples in Daikundi, central Afghanistan.
swa: Harusi za pamoja zilizoandaliwa kwa ajili ya kufungisha ndoa za makumi ya maarusi huko Daikundi, katikati ya Afghanistan.

eng: Collective weddings have becoming very popular in the country because they help lessen the cost of wedding for each individual family.
swa: Harusi za pamoja zimekuwa maarufu nchini humo kwa sababu hupunguza gharama za harusi kwa kila familia ya maarusi.

eng: Image by Iqbal Ahmad Oruzgani, used with permission.
swa: Picha ya Iqbal Ahmad Oruzgani, imetumiwa kwa ruhusa.

eng: Young Afghan girls reading a school book in front of a closed shop.
swa: Wasichana wa ki-Afghan wakisoma kitabu cha shule mbele ya duka lililofungwa.

eng: Image by Iqbal Ahmad Oruzgani, used with permission.
swa: Picha ya Iqbal Ahmad Oruzgani, imetumiwa kwa ruhusa.

eng: Image by Iqbal Ahmad Oruzgani, used with permission.
swa: Picha ya Iqbal Ahmad Oruzgani, imetumiwa kwa ruhusa.

eng: Every photo shared under this hashtag is retweeted by hundreds of Twitter users, giving the photographers a very wide audience.
swa: Kila picha iliyowekwa katika alama ishara hiyo ya twita hutwitiwa tena (retweeted) na mamia ya watumiaji wa twita, kuwawezesha wapiga picha hao kupata hadhira kubwa zaidi.

eng: Speaking to Global Voices, Antony Loveless says:
swa: Akizungumza na Global Voices, Antony Loveless anasema:

eng: Countless tweeters have said it’s the best use of a hashtag on twitter, ever, and I am currently in talks to produce a book based on the hashtag after countless people expressed an interest in buying one.
swa: Watumiaji wasiohesabika wa twita wanasema hayo ni matumizi mazuri zaidi ya alama ishara za twita, kuliko ilivyopata kutokea, na hivi sasa niko kwenye mazungumzo kuchapisha kitabu kinachotokea na alama habari ya twita baada ya watu wengi mno kuonyesha nia ya kukinunua ikiwa kitachapishwa.

eng: Nodding disease is a mentally and physically disabling disease that affects children between 1 and 10 years.
swa: Ugojwa unaofanana na Kifafa unaosababisha akili na mwili kwa ujumla kushindwa kufanya kazi vizuri, unaathiri watoto walio na umri kati ya mwaka 1 hadi miaka 10.

eng: It is currently restricted to small regions in South Sudan, Tanzania and northern Uganda.
swa: Hadi sasa ugojwa huu umeonekana zaidi katika baadhi ya maeneo ya nchi za Sudani ya Kusini,Tanzania na upande wa Kaskazini mwa Uganda.

eng: The disease is incurable at the moment and its cause is not known.
swa: Ugonjwa huu hadi sasa haujapata tiba na haijafahamika unasababishwa na nini.

eng: Recently, some old people have also shown signs of the disease.
swa: Siku za hivi karibuni, dalili za ugojwa huu zimeonekana pia kwa baadhi ya watu wazima.

eng: The areas affected by the disease are mainly in the northern region of the country.
swa: Maeneo yaliyoathiriwa na ugonjwa huu zaidi, ni yale ya upande wa kaskazini mwa Uganda.

eng: The disease denies the children a chance to be productive as they cannot do anything for themselves, be it holding a knife to make a meal for the girls, and holding a hoe to plant a single seed for the boys.
swa: Ugonjwa huu unawafanya watoto kushindwa kufanya shughuli yoyote ya uzalishaji; wasichana hawawezi hata kushika kisu ili kuandaa chakula, na kwa wavulana, hawawezi hata kushika jembe na kuotesha walau mbegu moja ya mmea.

eng: An 18 year old man may look like a 3 year old boy and has to be carried around and held to get some heat in the body.
swa: Mwanaume wa miaka 18 anaweza kuonekana kama ni mvulana wa miaka 3, na anapaswa kubebwa na kusaidiwa kutoka nje ya nyumba ili angalau aweze kuota jua.

eng: The first symptoms of this disease is the continuous nodding of the head, failure to eat and drink.
swa: Dalili za kwanza za ugonjwa huu ni kutikisa tikisa kichwa na kushindwa kula na kunywa.

eng: Later on the child becomes stunted physically and mentally.
swa: Na baadae mtoto anaharibikiwa akili na mwili kushindwa kufanya kazi.

eng: A Ugandan journalist, Florence Naluyimba, has taken the first initiative to investigate and bring the issue to light.
swa: Mwanahabari wa Uganda, Florence Naluyimba, ameshachukua hatua za awali kuchunguza na kuliweka bayana jambo hili.

eng: She says although the government is trying to provide medicine to help the victims in 3 health centers, they have to travel long distances on foot or on bicycles to reach the health centers.
swa: Anasema kuwa, pamoja na kuwa serekali inajaribu kutoa dawa katika vituo vitatu vya afya ili kuwasaidia waathirika, watu wanalazimika kusafiri umbali mrefu kwa miguu au kwa baiskeli ili kuvifikia vituo hivi.

eng: The sick ones cannot take themselves to the hospitals and have to be carried on the back or put on bicycles for over 30km.
swa: Wagonjwa hawawezi kwenda hospitali peke yao, hivyo wanapaswa kubebwa mgongoni au kubebwa kwa baiskeli na kusafiri umbali wa zaidi ya kilometa 30.

eng: The disease usually leads to seizures and at times this makes them fall into fire, sharp objects or in ponds/rivers, leading to death or severe injuries.
swa: Ugonjwa huu mara nyingi unapelekea mtu kukakamaa na wakati mwingine hali hii huwapelekea hata kuangukia kwenye moto, kuangukia vitu vyenye ncha kali au kwenye mabwawa/ kwenye mito hali inayoweza kusababisha kifo au kupata majeraha makubwa.

eng: Many children have lost body parts such as fingers in these accidents.
swa: Watoto wengi wameshapoteza viungo vya mwili kama vile vidole katika ajali hizi.

eng: It so happens that the victims can be too weak to even cry.
swa: Wakati mwingine wagojwa wanaweza kuwa wadhaifu sana kiasi cha kushindwa hata kulia.

eng: The Center for Disease Control plans to carry out aerial spraying targeting black flies, which are suspected to be the major cause of this illness.
swa: Kituo cha kukabiliana na ugojwa huu kimepanga kupulizia dawa kutoka angani ili kuangamiza inzi weusi wanaosadikiwa kuwa ndio chanzo kikubwa cha ugojwa huu.

eng: It is not clear whether this will help or not.
swa: Bado haifahamika sana kama njia hii itaweza kusaidia au la.

eng: Ugandan villagers complain that samples were taken to USA since 2010, but they have never received any reliable information about the cure and cause since that time.
swa: Wanavijiji nchini Uganda wanalalamika kuwa vipimo vilipelekwa nchini Marekani tangu mwaka 2010 lakini hadi sasa bado hawajapata taarifa za kuridhisha kuhusiana na kinga pamoja na visababishi vya ugojwa huu.

eng: Below are some pictures and YouTube videos about the disease.
swa: Zifuatazo ni baadhi ya picha na video kutoka kwenye mtandao wa YouTube kuhusiana na ugojwa huu.

eng: Nodding disease in its initial stages.
swa: Ugojwa wa kuanguka katika hatua zake za awali.

eng: Photo courtesy of ugandaradionetwork.com
A child with injuries in the face after he fell on fire during seizures Photo courtesy 256news.com
swa: Picha kwa idhini ya ugandaradionetwork.com Mtoto mwenye majeraha usoni baada ya kuanguka kwenye moto wakati alipokakamaa

eng: Medical care is supposed to be free in Uganda.
swa: Huduma za afya zinapaswa kutolewa bure nchini Uganda.

eng: However, there has been a consistent shortage of medicine and health workers in the national health centres.
swa: Hata hivyo, kumekuwa na upungufu wa nuda nrefu wa dawa na wahudumu wa afya katika vituo vya afya vya taifa.

eng: A video produced by Results for Development, an international non-profit organisation whose mission is to unlock solutions to tough development challenges, was released online recently to encourage Ugandans to break their silence and take control of their health rights.
swa: Video iliyoandaliwa na Results for Development (Matokeo kwa Maendeleo), shirika la kimataifa lisilo la kibiashara ambalo lina malengo ya kutafuta suluhisho la matatizo sugu yanayokwamisha maendeleo, iliwekwa kwenye mtandao wa intaneti siku za hivi karibuni ili kuwahamasisha watu wa Uganda kuvunja ukimya wao na kupigania haki ya afya zao.

eng: Introducing the video, Oscar Abello writes:
swa: Akitambulisha video hii, Oscar Abello anaandika kuwa:

eng: Uganda has made great strides in the past few years building up the "hardware" of its public distribution system for medicines – central warehouses and staffed distribution points – but the "software" isn’t quite right.
swa: Uganda imeshapiga hatua kubwa katika miaka kadhaa iliyopita kwa kujenga majengo kwa ajili ya mifumo ya kusambaza dawa kwa jamii- vituo vya kuhifadhia na kusambazia dawa- lakini huduma za afya bado si za kuridhisha.

eng: Many health centers run out of medicines in the 2-3 months between deliveries, meanwhile central warehouses are chock-full of supplies.
swa: Vituo vingi vya afya vinaendeshwa bila ya kuwa na dawa kati ya miezi 2 hadi 3 tokea dawa zipelekwe, wakati katika majengo ya serikali ya kuhifadhia dawa kuna hifadhi kubwa.

eng: Medicine supply chain problems aren’t news to Uganda’s poor, many of them in remote rural villages, but few channels exist to bring that information to the public officials who are in position to do something about it.
swa: Matizo ya mfumo wa usambazaji wa dawa sio jambo jipya kwa watu masikini nchini Uganda, wengi wao wakiwa vijijini, lakini kuna namna chache sana za kutoa taarifa hizo kwa wataalamu wa afya walio katika nafasi ya kufanya jambo kuhusiana na changamoto hizo.

eng: In the video, Dennis Kibira, the medicines advisor at HEPS Uganda, a health consumer organization that helps increase access to essential medicine in Uganda says:
swa: Katika video hii, Denis Kibira, mshauri wa afya wa HEPS Uganda, shirika la wanufaika wa afya linalosaidia kuongeza upatikanaji wa dawa muhimu nchini Uganda anasema:

eng: I want to see a country where people do not have to die because they have failed to receive the care that they deserve.
swa: nataka kuona nchi ambayo watu hawafi kwa kuwa wameshindwa kupata huduma wanayostahili.

eng: In 2006, three ministers lost their posts after it was reported that they were involved in embezzlement of funds from the health sector.
swa: Mwaka 2006, mawaziri watatu walipoteza nyadhifa zao baada ya kuripotiwa kuwa walihusishwa na ufujaji wa fedha katika idara ya afya.

eng: Their cases are still pending in court.
swa: Mashitaka yao bado yanasikilizwa mahakamani.

eng: Patients on the floor of Mulago Hospital, the National Referral Hospital.
swa: Wagonjwa wakiwa wamekaa chini katika hospitali ya rufaa ya Taifa ya Mulaago.

eng: Photo courtesy of williamkituuka.blogspot.com
swa: Picha kwa hisani ya williamkituuka.blogspot.com

eng: Rosette Mutambi, the founder and executive director of HEPS Uganda says in the video that health care is supposed to be free in Uganda, but it is not the case at the moment.
swa: Rosette Mutambi, mwanzilishi na mkurugenzi wa HEPS Uganda, katika video hii anasema kuwa huduma ya afya nchini Uganda inapaswa kuwa bure, lakini hali haiko hivyo kwa sasa.

eng: She adds that the health centres are operating over-capacity and that health workers are over-worked.
swa: Anaongeza kuwa, vituo vya afya vinafanya kazi kupita uwezo wake ikiwa na maana kuwa hata wafanyakazi wa sekta ya afya nao wanafanya kazi kupita uwezo wao.

eng: Uganda also has experiences power outages or load-shedding, which affects health centres that have no standby generators since some medicine needs refrigeration.
swa: Pia, Uganda ina tatizo sugu la kukatika kwa umeme ambalo linaathiri sana vituo vya afya ambavyo havina majenereta ya kutoa nishati hiyo pindi umeme unapokatika hasa kwa kuwa kuna dawa zinazohitaji kuhifadhiwa katika majokofu.

eng: According to Moses Kamabare, the general manager of National Medical Stores, the organisation responsible for the storage and delivery of medicine to health centres, they makes one delivery every two months to all districts.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa Moses Kamabare, msimamizi mkuu wa Bohari ya Dawa ya Taifa, shirika linalohusika na kuhifadhi na kusambaza dawa katika vituo vya afya, huwa wanasambaza dawa mara moja katika wilaya zote kila baada ya miezi miwili.

eng: But a health worker on the ground says that the heath centers actually receive medicine once every three months.
swa: Lakini mfanyakazi wa kituo kimoja cha afya anasema kuwa vituo vya afya kwa kweli huwa vinapokea dawa mara moja kila baada ya miezi mitatu.

eng: Medical Stores iin Uganda are always full, but there are no drugs in the health centers.
swa: Bohari za dawa za Uganda mara zote huwa zimejaa, lakini katika vituo vya afya hakuna dawa.

eng: Some people have to walk more than 10km to these health centers only to find that medicine is not there.
swa: Baadhi ya watu wanalazimika kutembea zaidi ya kilometa 10 kufuata vituo hivi vya afya ili kujipatia huduma za dawa na kuambulia patupu.

eng: This experience is heartbreaking for many people and discourages them from coming back to the centres and seeking medical care.
swa: Hali hii inawakatisha watu tamaa na kuwafedhehesha kiasi cha kuamua kutorudi tena katika vituo hivi kwa ajili ya matibabu.

eng: A lot needs to be done to improve health care in Uganda: faster, more frequent service delivery, an increase in funding, more health centers, higher salaries for health workers, and procurement of equipment for centres.
swa: Kuna mambo mengi yanayopaswa kutimizwa ili kuimaridha huduma za afya nchini Uganda, ambayo ni: usambazaji wa dawa wa haraka na wa mara kwa mara, sekta ya afya kutengewa fedha za zaidi, vituo vingi zaidi vya afya, mishahara ya kutosha ya wafanyakazi katika sekta ya afya, pamoja na upatikanaji wa vitendea kazi vya kutosha katika vituo vya afya.

eng: There is also a challenge of shortage of doctors, some of whom allegedly steal medicine for their private clinics.
swa: Pia kuna changamoto ya upungufu wa madaktari, baadhi yao wakituhumiwa kuiba dawa kinyemela kwa ajili ya kliniki zao binafsi.

eng: But the big question still stands, will this video encourage Ugandans to finally break the silence?
swa: Lakini swali kubwa la kujiuliza ni kuwa; Je, video hii hatimaye itawahamasisha watu wa Uganda kuvunja ukimya?

eng: On July 1, Mexicans went to the polls to elect their next President.
swa: Mnamo tarehe 1 Julai, Wa-Mexico walipiga kura kumchagua rais wao mpya.

eng: From before the elections, the sentiment among most netizens was that it would be a close race between Enrique Peña Nieto (EPN) from the Institutional Revolutionary Party and Andrés Manuel López Obrador (AMLO) from the Party of the Democratic Revolution, although supporters of Josefina Vázquez Mota (from the current ruling party) did not lose hope.
swa: Kabla ya kuanza kupiga, hisia za watumiaji wa mtandao zilionyesha kwamba uchaguzi huo utakuwa na ushindani wa karibu kati ya Enrique Peña Nieto (kwa kifupi, EPN) wa chama cha mageuzi ya kitaasisi na Andrés Manuel López Obrador (kwa kifupi AMLO) wa chama cha mageuzi ya kidemokrasia, ingawa wafuasi wa Josefina Vázquez Mota (kutoka chama kinachotawala sasa) hakupoteza matumaini ya kushinda.

eng: As soon as the polls opened, netizens began to share their thoughts and experiences.

swa: Diário de Classe , ukurasa wa Facebook uliofunguliwa na Isadora Faber, aliye na miaka 13 na anayetokea Santa Catarina, Brazil, tayari umeonyesha kupendwa zaidi ya mara 176,000.

eng: Aiming to "show the truth about public schools", Isadora shares photos that show the repairs needed in her own school and reports on other general problems.
swa: Huku lengo lake likiwa ni "kuonyesha ukweli kuhusu shule za umma", Isadora anaweka picha zinazoonyesha maeneo yanayohitaji kufanyiwa ukarabati katika shule yake pamoja na kutoa taarifa kuhusu matatizo mengine mengi ya jumla.

eng: The 16th Summit of the Non-Aligned Movement started amid heavy security presence in Tehran, August 26, 2012.
swa: Mkutano wa 16 wa Umoja wa Nchi Zisizofungamana na Upande Wowote ulianza mnamo tarehe 26 Agosti, 2012 jijini Tehran huku kukiwa na ulinzi mkali.

eng: The 120-nation strong Non-Aligned Movement (NAM), a holdover from the Cold War's pull between East and West, is also seen by Iran and others as an alternative forum for current world discussions.
swa: Umoja huo madhubuti (NAM) unaoundwa na nchi ni mabaki ya mvutano uliokuwepo enzi za Vita Baridi kati ya Mashariki na Magharibi, na umoja huu unachukuliwa na Iran pamoja na mataifa mengine kama jukwaa mbadala kwa ajili ya kuendesha mijadala kuhusu masuala mbalimbali yanaoukabili ulimwengu hivi sasa.

eng: Iran says it has planned talks on a peace plan to end Syria's civil war, but no rebel factions will attend because of Tehran's close bonds with Bashar Assad's regime.
swa: Iran inasema kwamba imepanga mazungumzo kuhusu mpango wa amani wa kukomesha vita vya wenyewe kwa wenyewe vya nchini Syria, hata hivyo hakuna uwakilishi kutoka upande wa waasi utakaokuwepo kwenye mazungumzo hayo kwa sababu ya uhusiano wa karibu kati ya Tehran na utawala wa Bashar Assad, Rais wa Syria.

eng: Tehran's 'non-declared curfew'
swa: Marufuku ya kutotembea usiku isiyotangazwa' ya serikali ya Tehran

eng: The Summit is being held from 26-31 August in Tehran.
swa: Mkutano unafanyika kuanzia tarehe 26 hadi 31 Agosti jijini Tehran.

eng: The Iranian State has shut down Iran's capital for five days and has mobilized 110,000 policemen to "guarantee NAM security."
swa: Dola la Irani imelifunga jiji lake kuu kwa siku tano na imewatayarisha askari polisi wapatao 110,000 ili "kuhakikishia usalama Mkutano wa NAM."

eng: Logo for the XVI Summit of the Non-Aligned Movement.
swa: Nembo ya Mkutano wa XVI wa Umoja wa Nchi Zisizofungamana na Upande Wowote.

eng: Source: IRNA.
swa: Chanzo: IRNA.

eng: Public Domain.
swa: Haki Huru za Umma.

swa: kwa mujibu wa taarifa mbalimbali, kuna vizuizi kadhaa vya kiusalama jijini Tehran pamoja na kuwepo kwa ulinzi mkali kabisa.

eng: It is like a non-declared curfew.
swa: Ni kama vile kuna marufuku ya kutembea usiku lakini isiyotangazwa rasmi.

eng: Security forces also check inside a lot of cars on their way for holidays on Chalous Road...Protesters in 2009 humiliated security forces and now they want to prove their authority and their importance.
swa: Vikosi vya usalama pia vinakagua ndani ya magari mengi yanayopeleka watu mapumzikoni Katika Barabara ya Chalous ...waandamanaji mwaka 2009 walividhalilisha vikosi vya usalama na kwa hiyo hivi sasa vikosi hiyo vinatka kudhirisha mamlaka na umuhimu wao.

eng: Blogger Sayeh Azadi published a couple of photos from security forces and writes if 'EU and USA had listed Basijs on the terrorist list, this regime's beasts would not dare to intimidate people.'
swa: Mwanablogu Sayeh Azadi alichapisha picha mbili kuhusu vikosi vya usalama na anaandika kuuliza kama 'Umoja wa Ulaya na Marekani ziliwaorodhesha Basijs katika orodha ya magaidi, washenzi hawa wa utawala huu hawatathubutu kuwatishia watu.'

eng: Protesting against the regime?
swa: Maandamano ya kupinga utawala?

eng: Security is not the only topic Iranian bloggers talk about, some see the NAM summit as an opportunity to protest against the regime.
swa: Suala la usalama siyo peke yake ambalo wanablogu wa Iran hujadili, kuna wanaoona kwamba kufanyika hapa kwa Mkutano wa NAM kunatoa fursa kwa watu kuandamana ili kupingia serikali iliyo madarakani.

eng: Sabzarman writes the presence of thousands of reporters and foreign guests is a rare opportunity for the Green Movement to make its voice heard in the world.
swa: Sabzarman anaandika uwepo wa maelfu ya wanahabari na wageni wa kimataifa ni fursa adimu kwa ajili ya Vuguvugu la Kijani kufanya sauti yake isikike ulimwengunni.

eng: Among other things the blogger invites Iranians to write slogans in English with green spray on posters and walls close to the place where the summit is being held.
swa: Miongoni mwa mambo mengine, mwanablogu huyo anawaalika raia wa Iran kuandika miito mbalimbali katika lugha ya Kiingereza na kuweka rangi ya kijani kwenye mabango na kuta zilizo karibu na mahali Mkutano huo unapofanyika.

eng: A group of students and political activists launched a Facebook campaign inviting Ban-Ki Moon, the United Nations General Secretary who is attending the NAM Summit, to visit detained opposition leaders, Mir Hossein Mousavi and Mehdi Karroubi.
swa: Kikudi cha wanafunzi na wanaharakati wa kisiasa walizindua kampeni ya Facebook wakimwalima Ban-Ki Moon, Katibu Mkuu wa Umoja wa Mataifa ambaye pia anashiriki kwenye Mkutano huu wa NAM, ili awatembelee viongozi wa upinzani waliotiwa nguvuni, Mir Hossein Mousavi na Mehdi Karroubi.

eng: They published this open latter on the page:
swa: Walichapisha barua hii ya wazi baadaye page:

eng: Mr. Secretary General,
swa: Katibu Mkuu,

eng: I am an Iranian citizen, and as a concerned Iranian I would like to invite you to visit Mr.Mir Hussein Mousavi during your stay in Tehran for the 16th Non-aligned Movement (NAM) summit.
swa: Mimi ni raia wa Iran, na kama mwana Iran mwenye uchungu na nchi hii, ningependa kukukaribisha kumtembelea Bw Mir Hussein Mousavi katika kipindi utakachokuwa hapa Tehran kwa ajili ya Mkutano wa 16 wa Umoja wa Nchi Zisizofungamana na Upande wowote (NAM).

eng: Mr Mousavi, the opposition leader, was recently hospitalized due to heart complications after 15 months of house arrest...The democratic aspirations and the just demands of the Iranian people deserve the support of the international community, including the United Nations and the Secretary General.
swa: Bw Mousavi, ambaye ni kiongozi wa upinzani, hivi karibuni alilazwa hospitalini baada ya kupata matatizo ya moyo kufuatia miezi 15 ya kifungo cha nyumbani ...Matamanio ya kidemokrasi na madai ya haki ya watu wa Iran yanastahili kuungwa mkono na jumuiya ya kimataifa, ikiwemo Umoja wa Mataifa na Katibu wake Mkuu.

eng: Your position as the international authority entrusted with the responsibility for the protection and promotion of universal human rights accords you a special role.
swa: Kwa nafasi yako kama mamlaka ya kimataifa iliyoaminiwa na wajibu wa kulinda na kuhamasisha mikataba ya ulimwengu ya haki za binadamu zinakupa dhima ya pekee.

eng: We wish you success in discharging of this historical mission.
swa: Tunakutakia mafanikio katika kutekeleza kazi hii maalumu ya kihistoria.

eng: Azadi Esteghlal Edalat calls Iranians to become united with one voice and turn the NAM summit into a nightmare for the regime.
swa: Azadi Esteghlal Edalat anatoa wito kwa raia wa Iran ili waungane na kuwa kitu kimoja na kuugeuza Mkutano wa NAM kuwa wa kuutetemesha utawala wa nchi hiyo.

swa: Mkutano wa NAM umetupatia nafasi ya pekee kabisa maalumu ya kuandamana dhidi ya maovu ya utawala na kuunga mkono Vuguvugu la Kijani.

eng: Let's inform people via social media and all other means.
swa: Tuwafahamishe watu kupitia zana za vyombo vya habari vya kiraia na njia nyingine.

eng: Zambia has had many expatriate national football team coaches.
swa: Zambia imewahi kuwa na makocha wengi wa kigeni wa timu yake ya taifa.

eng: The most well known of them is Croatian Ante Buselic, who took the country to the African Cup of Nations finals in 1974, but Frenchman, Herve Renard, who led the team in scooping the Africa Cup of Nations in 2012 has swept all previous coaches off the perch.
swa: Pengine aliyekuwa maarufu zaidi kati yao ni raia wa Kroatia Ante Buselic, ambaye aliifikisha nchi katika fainali za Kombe la Washindi barani Afrika za mwaka 1974, lakini Mfaransa, Herve Renard, aliyeiwezesha timu kushinda Kombe la Washindi barani Afrika la 2012 amefutilia mbali umaarufu wa watangulizi wake wengine wote.

eng: In recognition of his success, the Zambian government recently accorded him permanent residence.
swa: Ili kutambua mafanikio yake hayo, Serikali ya Zambia hivi karibuni ilimtunuku ukaazi wa kudumu.

eng: If he wants to become a permanent resident, the Zambian Government is willing to do that for him and that is why we have decided to give him a resident permit as a way of our appreciation for his contribution to football development in the country.
swa: Kama anataka kuwa mkazi wa kudumu, Serikali ya Zambia iko tayari kumpa fursa hiyo, na ndiyo sababu tumeamua kumtunuku kwa ukaazi wa kudumu kama njia ya kuonyesha tunathamani mchango wake katika maendeleo ya soka ya nchi hii.

eng: Herve Renard showing off a scarf in Zambian flag colours.
swa: Herve Renard akionyesha skafu yenye rangi za bendera ya Taifa la Zambia.

eng: Photo used with permission from UKZambians website.
swa: Picha imetumiwa kwa kibali kutoka tovuti ya UKZambians.

eng: On one citizen media website the issue of granting permanent residency to a coach who once deserted Zambia for neighbouring Angola, has assumed political overtones.
swa: Katika moja ya tovuti za uandishi wa kiraia suala la kumtunuku ukazi wa kudumu kocha ambaye wakati fulani aliitosa Zambia na kwenda zake Angola, kunaonekana kuwa na mrengo wa kisiasa zaidi.

eng: Dual citizenship is controversial because most Zambians abroad want it included in the new constitution being drawn up, but Renard's status has effectively short-circuited the procedure.
swa: Suala la uraia wa nchi mbili bado lina mzozo kwa sababu Wazambia wengi wanaoishi nje ya nchi wanataka suala hilo liingizwe kwenye katiba mpya inayoandaliwa hivi sasa, lakini hali ya Renard ya sasa kuhusu uraia wake ni kama vile imetia dosari mchakato huo.

eng: Global Voices This post is part of our special coverage Europe in Crisis.
swa: Mgogoro wa Umoja wa Ulaya: Kitabu cha Kwanza cha Global Voices cha Kieletroni

eng: EU in Crisis is the first production of our new Global Voices Books project and includes the best material from social conversation, participation and mobilization boosted by citizens going through the tough times of austerity in the old continent and beyond.
swa: Umoja wa Ulaya katika Mgogoro (EU in Crisis) ni chapisho letu la kwanza katika Mradi wa Vitabu wa Global Voices na ambao unahusisha makala bora zaidi kuhusu mazungumzo ya kijamii, ushiriki na uhamasishaji unaopewa nguvu na raia wanaopitia nyakati ngumu za kubana matumizi katika bara la kale zaidi na kwingineko.

eng: We hand-picked and assembled the best posts, from our special coverage on Europe in Crisis launched in Spring 2011, and written by our team of dedicated international citizen-reporters.
swa: Tulichakua kwa makini kabisa makala zilizokuwa bora zaidi kutoka katika mfululizo wetu wa kuhusu Mgogoro wa Kiuchumi wa Ulaya ambapo mfululizo huo ulianza Majira ya Machipuo ya 2011, na kuandikwa na vikundi vya waandishi wetu wa kimataifa wanaofanya kazi kwa bidii kama waandishi wa kiraia.

eng: The e-book is released under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 License and is available for downloading in three different formats:
swa: Kitabu hicho cha kielektroni kimetolewa kwa utaratibu wa Leseni ya Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 na kinapatikana kwa kukipakua kutoka mtandaoni katika mitindo mitatu tofauti:

eng: - PDF (3,2 MB)
swa: - PDF (3,2 MB)

eng: - ePub (3,2 MB)
swa: - ePub (3,2 MB)

swa: - Ukubwa wa Mfukoni (2,8 MB)

eng: EU in Crisis ebook Cover
swa: Kitabu hiki cha kieletroniki kina jumla ya makala 13 katika lugha ya Kiingereza (matoleo katika lugha nyingine yanaandaliwa).

eng: Along with an original introduction which gives broader context on the issue, this e-book includes 13 posts in English (other language editions are currently underway) which cover Greece, Spain, Portugal, Italy and other European countries, affected by the banking and Euro crisis, through the lens of participatory online media.
swa: Makala hizo zimeandikwa kuhusu Ugiriki, Hispania, Ureno, Italia na nchi nyingine za Ulaya, hasa zilizoathiriwa na mgogoro wa kibenki na sarafu ya euro, na mgogoro huo unatazamwa kupitia darubini ya ushiriki wa vyombo vya habari vya kiraia vya mtandaoni.

eng: This e-book is intended as a flexible tool for further dissemination and discussion about these on-going issues.
swa: Kitabu hiki cha kielektroniki kinakusudiwa kuwa zana mojawapo inayoweza kutumiwa kulingana na mazingira na kusambaza zaidi na kuibua mijadala kuhusu masuala haya ya migogoro ya kiuchumi yanayoendelea.

eng: Up until July 2012, our dedicated team of about 80 volunteers produced over 80 posts in English, many them translated in various languages.
swa: Hadi kufikia mwezi Julai 2012, timu ya watu wetu wanaojitolea wapatao 80 waliandika zaidi ya makala 80 katika lugha ya Kiingereza, makala hizo pia zilitafsiriwa katika lugha nyingi mbalimbali.

eng: Global Voices Books aims at "sharing citizen media for the future", as our subtitle reads, based on GV's huge archive and its on-going multi-language production.
swa: Mradi wa Vitabu wa Global Voices unalenga "kushirikisha vyombo vya habari vya kiraia kwa ajili ya siku za baadaye", kama ambavyo kichwa chetu kidogo kinavyosomeka, kwa kutumia hifadhi kubwa ya GV na uzalishaji wake unaoendelea katika lugha nyingi mbalimbali.

eng: We will put out electronic publications according to topics, regions, issues, languages, media, etc. and in a variety of formats, thus providing broader exposure to the best material produced over the years by our community.
swa: Tutakuwa tukitoa matoleo ya vitabu vyetu hivi vya kielektroni kwa kufuata mada, kanda, masuala, lugha, vyombo vya habari n.k. na kwa mitindo mbalimbali, na kwa hiyo kutoa picha pana zaidi na kusambaza zaidi makala zilizo bora zilizoandikwa katika vipindi tofautitofauti kupitia jumuiya yetu.

eng: Please spread the word, check out the Global Voices Books website and get involved! This post is part of our special coverage Europe in Crisis.
swa: Tafadhali eneza taarifa hii, tembelea tovuti ya Mradi wa Vitabu wa Global Voices na jihusishe!

eng: Two Northern youth groups on Wednesday criticized the Senate President, David Mark over his recent comments urging northern leaders to check the activities of the dreaded Boko Haram sect, Connected Africa reports.
swa: Makundi mawili ya vijana Kaskazini mwa Nigeria Jumatano yalimkosoa Rais wa Seneti, David Mark, kutokana na matamshi aliyotoa siku za karibuni akiwataka viongozi wa mikoa ya kaskazini kudhibiti shughuli za kundi linaloogopwa sana la Boko Haram, Connected Africa anaripoti.

eng: Al Joresh is an outspoken critic of Saudi interior ministry's arbitrary detentions.
swa: Al Joresh ni mkosoaji mkubwa dhidi ya wizara ya Mambo ya Ndani ya Saudi kwa kuwekwa watu kiholela kizuizini.

eng: Moreover, she is the wife of a prisoner who has been detained for eight years without a trial.
swa: Aidha, yeye ni mke wa mfungwa ambaye amekuwa kizuizini kwa miaka nane bila ya kufunguliwa mashtaka.

eng: She was planning to give away 500 gifts that contain a letter to raise awareness about the issue of arbitrary detention in Saudi Arabia.
swa: Alikusudia kutoa zawadi zipatazo 500 pamoja na barua ya kukuza uelewa wa watu kuhusu suala la kukamatwa kwa watu kiholela nchini Saudi Arabia.

eng: At 5:11 AM (Saudi time), Al Joresh tweeted : Greetings, the police arrested me and my children.
swa: Saa 5:11 alfajiri (saa za Saudia), Al Joresh alituma twiti: Hamjambo? Polisi wamenitia mbaroni mimi na watoto wangu.

eng: Photo posted by Reema Al Joresh on Twitter as she tweeted: We have been arrested A hashtag was immediately started by Saudi Twitter users, who expressed their frustration.
swa: Picha imewekwa na Reema Al Joresh wakati akituma twiti: Sisi tumekamatwa Alama ashiria ilianzishwa mara moja na watumiaji twita wa Saudi walioonyesha hisia zao za kuchukizwa na vitendo vya aina hiyo.

eng: Abdulaziz al-Shihri tweeted: "Secret police do not have either pre-Islam generosity, nor post-Islam ethics.
swa: Abdulaziz al-Shihri alitwiti: "Askari kanzu hawana si tu ukarimu uliokuwepo kabla ya Uislamu, bali hata maadili ya baada ya kuwepo Uislamu.

eng: Oh God, let us rest - like the Egyptians - by not having them."
swa: Ee Mungu, hebu tupumzishe - kama Wamisri -kwa kuwaondolea mbali hawa "

eng: Mohammad al-Ogaimi added: She was followed by 800 people, now they are 2100.
swa: Mohammad al-Ogaimi aliongezea: Alikuwa na wafuasi 800 wa Twita, sasa anao 2100.

eng: With your oppression, their voice will go even further.
swa: Pamoja na ukandamizaji wenyu, sauti zao zitakwenda mbali zaidi.

eng: The comment refers to the number of followers Al Joresh had on Twitter.
swa: Maoni hayo yanahusu idadi ya wafuasi alikuwa nao Al Joresh kwenye Twita.

eng: At the time of writing this post, they have multiplied to around 3,500 and growing.
swa: Wakati wa kuandika posti hii, walikuwa wameongeza na kufikia karibu 3500 huku wakiendelea kuongezeka.

eng: Screen shot showing Al Joresh's followers on Twitter When Reema was released, she wrote a series of tweets explaining what had happened: At 4:30am, I headed to the Eid mosque with my gifts.
swa: Wakati Reema alipoachiliwa, aliandika mfululizo wa twiti kueleza yaliyotokea: Saa 10:30 alfajiri, mimi nilielekea kwenye msikiti wa Eid na zawadi zangu.

eng: About 100 meters away from my house, a car tried to stop us and they pointed machine guns at us.
swa: Mita 100 kutoka kwenye nyumba yangu, gari lilijaribu kutuzuia na wakatuelekezea bunduki.

eng: My daughter Sara said to them: "You have stolen my father and now you are coming to steal us?".
swa: Binti yangu Sara akawaambia: "Mmemuiba baba yangu na sasa mmekuja kutuiba sisi?".

eng: They tried to silence my daughter Marya, who was crying.
swa: Walijaribu kumnyamazisha binti yangu Marya, ambaye alikuwa analia.

eng: They got my son Mo'ath and the driver out of the car then a policeman tried to take my phone, but Mo'ath told him to keep his hands off me they took the gifts and a policeman came in the front seat and told the driver to go to the General Intelligence office in Buraidah.
swa: Walimtoa mwanangu Mo'ath na dereva nje ya gari kisha polisi alijaribu kuchukua simu yangu, lakini Mo'ath alimwambia asiniguse hata chembe walichukua zawadi na polisi alikuja katika kiti cha mbele na alimwamuru dereva kuelekea katika ofisi ya Mkuu wa Upelelezi huko Buraidah.

eng: For an hour, they questioned me and tried to look for explosives within those boxes They told me to write down my confession.
swa: Kwa saa moja, walinihoji na kujaribu kutafuta mabomu ndani ya yale masanduku Walinitaka niandike kukiri kwangu makosa.

eng: In the blog Crónicas, Santos García Zapata explains the context around the Presidential decision to start peace talks with guerrilla groups.
swa: Katika blogu ya Crónicas, Santos García Zapata anaeleza muktadha kuhusu uamuzi wa Rais wa kuanzisha mazungumzo ya amani na makundi ya waasi.

eng: The Congress' Peace Commission has declared that President Santos "is not alone" in his determination to reach peace.
swa: Kongresi ya 'Kamisheni ya Amani' imetangaza kwamba Rais Santos "hayupo peke yake" katika dhamira yake ya kupatikana kwa amani.

eng: This post is part of our special coverage #SudanRevolts.
swa: Makala hii ni sehemu ya habari zetu maalumu kuhusu Sudani Yaendesha Mapinduzi.

eng: The Sudanese National Intelligence and Security Service (NISS) launched a heavy-handed campaign in mid-June 2012, arresting thousands of protesters, activists, political party members and leaders and even law-abiding citizens from protest sites, universities, public places and in many cases people’s homes, following anti-regime protests.
swa: Shirika la Ujasusi na Usalama wa Taifa la Sudani (NISS) lilijimwaga mitaani na kuendesha kampeni kubwa ya kamatakamata, ambapo liliwakamata maelfu ya waandamanaji, wanaharakati, wanachama wa vyama vya upinzani vya kisiasa na viongozi na hata raia wanaoitii sheria waliokutwa maeneo ya maandamano, vyuo vikuu, maeneo ya umma na hata kwenye nyumba za watu, kufuatia maandamano ya kupinga utawala ulio madarakani yaliyoanza katikati ya mwezi Juni.

eng: However, once the protests calmed down over two months, the NISS began releasing detainees; August 17 marked the largest number of detainees released.
swa: Hata hivyo, baada ya kutulia kwa maandamano hayo zaidi ya miezi miwili tangu yaanze #SudanRevolts, Shirika la Ujasusi limeanza kuwaachia mahabusu.

eng: Among those released is Twitter activist Usamah Mohamed Ali who was arrested from the scene of a protest in Khartoum on June 22.
swa: Miongoni mwa walioachiwa ni pamoja na mwanaharakati anayetumia Twita Usamah Mohamed Ali ambaye alikamatwa katika eneo la tukio la maandamano jijini Khartoum mnamo tarehe 22, 2012.

eng: Usamah Mohamed Ali is a Sudanese Twitter activist who was arrested at a protest.
swa: Usamah Mohamed Ali ni mwanaharakati wa nchini Sudani anayetumia Twita na ambaye alikamatwa wakati wa maandamano.

eng: He has tweeted his prison experience following his release.
swa: Anatuma twiti kuhusu aliyoyaona gerezani baada ya kuachiwa kwake

eng: A month into Usamah’s arrest, Mimz wrote a blog post highlighting his detention.
swa: Mwezi mmoja tangu kukamatwa kwa Usamah, Mimz aliandika makala kwenye bloguakizungumzia kutiwa kwake mahabusu.

eng: A day after his release, he tweeted a mere two words but confirmed to his followers that he had been released:
swa: Siku moja baada ya kuachiwa kwake, alituma twiti ya maneno mawili tu; lakini aliwathibitishia wafuasi wake kwamba alikuwa ameachiwa huru:

eng: @simsimt: I'm so grateful for all who campaigned for me!
swa: @simsimt: Ninawashukuru sana wote walionitia moyo!

eng: A week later, Usamah wrote a series of short tweets narrating the conditions of his arrest.
swa: Wiki moja baadaye, Usamah aliandika mfululizo wa twiti fupifupi akielezea hali iliyokuwepo wakati wa kukamatwa kwake.

eng: He started off:
swa: Alianza kwa kusema:

eng: @simsimt: Without further detail for now, I was arrested by an #NISS agent in plainclothes who approached me while I was tweeting. #SudanRevolts
swa: @simsimt: Bila kutoa undani sana wa mambo kwa sasa, nilikamatwa na jasusi aliyekuwa kwenye mavazi ya kiraia wa #NISS ambaye alinifuata wakati nikiandika twiti. #SudanRevolts

eng: @simsimt: I remember very clearly that I was writing about the huge attempts made by #NISS to prevent any documentation of the protest. #SudanRevolts
swa: @simsimt: Nakumbuka wazi kabisa kwamba nilikuwa nikiandika kuhusu juhudi kubwa zilizofanywa na #NISS kuzuia ingizwaji kwenye rekodi wa aina yoyote wa maandamano hayo. #SudanRevolts

eng: Usamah explained that he refused to give away the password to his phone, provoking the anger of the NISS officers:
swa: Usamah alieleza kwamba alikataa kutoa nywila (neno la siri) la simu yake, jambo lililowakasirisha maofisa wa Shirika la Ujasusi la NISS:

eng: @simsimt: Locking my phone, which I've password-protected, later became the catalyst for much abuse, torture & interrogation I'd endured #SudanRevolts
swa: @simsimt: Kufunga simu yangu, ambayo inatumia nywila, baadaye ilikuja kuwa kichocheo cha kutendewa vibaya sana, kuteswa n.k.; mahojiano ambayo nimeyastahimili #SudanRevolts

eng: Stating:
swa: akieleza:

eng: @simsimt: When taken to an #NISS pickup truck that was stationed by the protest area, I was ordered several times to unlock my phone. #SudanRevolts
swa: @simsimt: Nilipopelekwa kwenye gari (pick up) la #NISS lililokuwa limeegeshwa katika eneo la maandamano, niliamriwa mara kadhaa kufungua simu yangu. #SudanRevolts

eng: @simsimt: I fiercely refused.
swa: @simsimt: Nilikataa katakata.

eng: When they finally gave up on me, I was taken alone on a pickup, blindfolded, to #NISS premises in Bahri. #SudanRevolts
swa: Baadaye waliamua kuachana nami, lakini baadaye walinipakia peke yangu kwenye gari lao hilo, huku wakiwa wamenifunga macho, hadi kwenye ofisi za #NISS huko Bahri. #SudanRevolts

eng: He then notes the emotional and physical torture he sustained while in detention:
swa: Kisha anaeleza kuhusu mateso ya kihisia na kimwili aliyoyapitia wakati akiwa kizuizini:

eng: @simsimt: At #NISS building, I endured almost 4 or 5 hours of verbal abuse, severe beating up and all kind of threats to unlock my phone #SudanRevolts
swa: @simsimt: Katika jengo la #NISS, nilistahimili karibu saa 4 au 5 za kutukanwa, kupigwa na vitisho vya kila aina ili tu nifungue simu yangu #SudanRevolts

eng: @simsimt: I was threatened w/ sexual assault/abuse numerous times during that day.
swa: @simsimt: Nilitishiwa kufanyiwa vitendo vya ngono, mara nyingi tu katika siku hiyo.

eng: At one point, even by a top-rank #NISS officer. #SudanRevolts
swa: Wakati fulani hadi na ofisa wa ngazi za juu wa #NISS. #SudanRevolts

eng: Noting that:
swa: Alieleza kwamba:

eng: @simsimt: I endured severe beating up on my head w/ a rock, 'cause my phone while in their possession, received a call from the U.S. #SudanRevolts
swa: @simsimt: Nilistahimili vipigo vikali kichwani kwangu kwa jiwe, kwa sababu simu yangu waliyokuwa wanaishikilia ilipigiwa simu kutoka Marekani. #SudanRevolts

eng: @simsimt: The torturer who had gone pretty mad was hysterically shouting "You're an agent, AGENT, AGENT!" while beating me up! #SudanRevolts
swa: @simsimt: Mtesaji aliyekuwa sasa kama aliyechanganyikiwa alikuwa akitukana na kupaza sauti akisema "Wewe ni jasusi, JASUSI, JASUSI!" huku akinipa kipigo! #SudanRevolts

eng: Explaining that NISS officers forcefully deprived him of sleep:
swa: Alieleza kwamba maofisa wa NISS walihakikisha kwamba hapati hata lepe la usingizi:

eng: @simsimt: When again, they finally gave up on me, I was ordered by an officer, in front of me, to be deprived from sleeping. #SudanRevolts
swa: @simsimt: Hadi hapo walipoamua kuachana na mimi, niliamrishwa na ofisa aliyekuwa mbele yangu, kunyimwa usingizi. #SudanRevolts

eng: Usamah concluded saying:
swa: Usamah alihitimisha kwa kusema:

eng: @simsimt: I hold #NISS accountable for everything I've endured.
swa: @simsimt: Ninaituhumu #NISS kwa kila jambo baya nililotendewa.

eng: I remember the faces of my torturers and abusive officers. #SudanRevolts
swa: Ninazikumbuka vizuri sura za watesi wangu na walionitembea vibaya. #SudanRevolts

eng: This post is part of our special coverage #SudanRevolts.
swa: Makala hii ni sehemu ya habari zetu maalumu kuhusu Sudani Yaendesha Mapinduzi.

eng: Monday's official confirmation of Ethiopia’s Prime Minster Meles Zenawi's death, sparked reactions among social media users in Tanzania, especially after tweets started appearing from what some thought was Zenawi's official Twitter account.
swa: Taarifa rasmi iliyotoka Jumatatu ya Wiki iliyopita kuhusu kifo cha Waziri Mkuu wa Ethiopia Meles Zenawi, ziliibua mishtuko miongoni mwa watumiaji wa zana za habari za kiraia nchini Tanzania, hasa baada ya twiti kuanza kutumwa kutokea anuani ya Twita iliyoaminika kuwa rasmi ya Zenawi mwenyewe.

eng: In all started when Zitto Zuberi Kabwe, a Member of Parliament from Tanzania, sent this tweet:
swa: Mjadala ulianza pale Zitto Zuberi Kabwe, ambaye ni Mbunge nchini Tanzania, alipotwiti ujumbe huu:

eng: @zittokabwe: My condolences to the people of #Ethiopia following the death of Prime Minister #MelesZenawi Hope for a democratic developmental Abbysinia
swa: @zittokabwe: Natuma salamu zangu za rambirambi kwa wananchi wa #Ethiopiakufuatia kifo cha Waziri Mkuu #MelesZenawi.Ni matumaini yangu kwamba kutakuwa na muendelezo wa kidemokrasi huko Abbysinia.

eng: Susan Mashibe ‏replied:
swa: Susan Mashibe alijibu:

eng: @iMashibe: @zittokabwe is this really true this time?
swa: @iMashibe: @zittokabwe Je, ni kweli kwamba jambo hili limetokea kwelikweli safari hii?

eng: Cc @SwahiliStreet
swa: Cc @SwahiliStreet

eng: And Swahili Street concluded:
swa: And Swahili Street alihitimisha:

eng: @iMashibe announced on ETV.
swa: @iMashibe Imetangazwa kupitia ETV.

eng: It's official @zittokabwe
swa: Ni taarifa rasmi @zittokabwe

eng: Chambi Chachage tweeted a blog post titled ‘Meles Zenawi's Farewell to Young African Leaders' from the United Nations Economic Commission for Africa (UNECA) on 16 November 2006, which was retweeted by others.
swa: Chambi Chachage alitwiti makala ya blogu yenye kichwa cha habari ‘Salamu za Meles Zenawi za Kuwaaga Viongozi Vijana wa Afrika' kutoka Kamisheni ya Uchumi wa Afrika ya Umoja wa Mataifa (UNECA) tarehe 16 Novemba 2006, ambayo pia ilitumwa kama twiti na watumiaji wengine.

eng: And then suddenly @PMMelesZenawi intervened, apparently 'tweeting after death' to Tanzania's Member of Parliament Zitto Kabwe:
swa: Na kisha ghafla @PMMelesZenawi aliingilia kati, ikiwa ni bayana kabisa kwamba 'alituma jumbe za twiti baada ya kifo chake' akimlenga Mbunge wa Tanzania Zitto Kabwe:

eng: @PMMelesZenawi: @zittokabwe please be better than I was.
swa: @PMMelesZenawi: @zittokabwe Uwe kiongozi bora kuliko nilivyokuwa mimi.

eng: Not fun up here I am preparing 2 pay for some of this http://www.ethiopianreview.net/index/?p=42267
swa: Huku juu hakuna utani, ninajiandaa kulipa kwa ajili ya makosa yangu http://www.ethiopianreview.net/index/?p=42267

eng: Meles Zenawi ‏@PMMelesZenawi - tweeting after death.
swa: Meles Zenawi ‏@PMMelesZenawi - akitwiti baada ya kifo chake.

eng: Source: Twitter Screen Shot
swa: Chanzo Twitter Screen Shot

eng: This tweet to Zitto Kabwe, who has more than 29,000 followers, caused a stir, setting off speculation- was ‏@PMMelesZenawi hacked by opponents?
swa: Twiti hii kwa Zitto Kabwe, ambaye ana zaidi ya wafuasi 29,000, ilisambabisha mizozo, ikifanya watu waanze kudadidi ikiwa anwani ya ‏@PMMelesZenawi ilikuwa imeibwa na wapinzani wake?

eng: @zittokabwe: @hmgeleka this account seems not to be genuine of recent @pmmeleszenawi
swa: @zittokabwe: @hmgeleka anwani hii haionekani kuwa ya kweli hasa kwa sababu ya ujumbe huu @pmmeleszenawi

eng: Zitto Zuberi Kabwe concluded, and continued:
swa: Zitto Zuberi Kabwe naye alihitimisha, na kisha aliendelea kusema:

eng: @zittokabwe: @AnnieTANZANIA tweets by @PMMelesZenawi not genuine.
swa: @zittokabwe: @AnnieTANZANIA alitwiti kwa @PMMelesZenawi si akaunti halali.

eng: Ignore them.
swa: Zipuuzeni jumbe zinazotumwa nayo.

eng: Account hacked by his opponents
swa: Akaunti imeibwa na wapinzani wake

eng: Omar Ilyas backed it:
swa: Omar Ilyas naye aliiunga mkono:

eng: @omarilyas: This account is fake from the begining @PMMelesZenawi - a parody type like that one of @Julius_S_Malema @zittokabwe
swa: @omarilyas: Akaunti hii daima imekuwa si iliyo ya kweli toka mwanzo @PMMelesZenawi - ni aina ya watu wenye majivuno kupita kiasi kama yule jamaa anayeitwa @Julius_S_Malema @zittokabwe

eng: However, the debate on Meles Zenawi’s legacy continued ranging from both admiration for Meles ability to ‘get the job done’ to the widespread awareness that Meles was not a democrat:
swa: Hata hivyo, mjadala kuhusu yale atakayokumbukwa nayo Meles Zenawi unaendelea kuunguruma kutoka wale wanaomhusudu Meles kwa uwezo wake 'kufikia malengo katika kazi yake' hadi kwenye uvumi kwamba Meles hakuwa mwanademokrasia:

eng: @Htunga: @zittokabwe Who is Meles seriously?I see Ethiopians starving n dying in lorries..I remember the shooting in 2010 too.
swa: @Htunga: @zittokabwe Hivi, huyu Meles ni nani hasa? Ninawaona Waethiopia wakikabiliwa na njaa na kufa kwenye malori ... Nakumbuka pia kuuwawa kwa watu kwa kupigwa risasi mwaka 2010.

eng: @zittokabwe: @Htunga were Tanzanians not starving and dying during Nyerere?
swa: @zittokabwe: @Htunga Je, Watanzania hawakuwa wakikabili njaa na kufa wakati wa Nyerere?

eng: But we celebrate him because of his principles.
swa: Lakini tunamkumbuka na kumhusudu kwa sababu alikuwa mtu wa kanuni.

eng: Meles the same’
swa: Ni hivyo hivyo hata kwa Meles’

eng: @zittokabwe: @PMMelesZenawi regardless of his mistakes, #MelesZenawi remains a role model to me.
swa: @zittokabwe: @PMMelesZenawi Pamoja na makosa yake, #MelesZenawi anabaki kuwa mfano bora kwangu wa kuigwa.

eng: You have freedom to bring back #TheDerg or Isaias
swa: Mnao uhuru wa kumrejesha #TheDerg au Isaias

eng: The fake (supposedly hacked) @PMMelesZenawi Twitter account, which managed to set off the debate mentioned above, also raises the question of why many public figures and politicians in Africa haven’t had their Twitter accounts verified.
swa: Anwani ile bandia ya Twita (inayohisiwa kuwa iliibwa) @PMMelesZenawi iliyosababisha kuibuka kwa mjadala huo hapo juu, vilevile inaibua swali kwamba kwa nini viongozi wengi wa umma na wanasiasa barani Afrika hawataki kuthibitisha anwani zao za Twita.

eng: Reportedly, in many cases Twitter takes too long, or simply never respond to requests for verifying accounts.
swa: Kwa taarifa zilizopo, mara nyingi Twita huchukua muda mrefu sana, au pengine haijishughulishi kabisa kujibu maombi ya kuthibitisha anwani fulani fulani.

eng: Twitter is extremely popular in Tanzania as a tool for exchanging views and debate and also as a platform for breaking news.
swa: Twita ni maarufu sana nchini Tanzania kama chombo cha kubadilishana maoni na kuendesha mjadala na pia jukwaa la kutoa habari za papo kwa papo, au hivi punde.

eng: Twitter, however, can easily be abused as in @PMMelesZenawi case, and can also cause confusion and suspicion with regard to authenticity and reliability of sources.
swa: Twita, hata hivyo, inaweza kutumiwa vibaya kama ilivyokuwa kwa hii ya @PMMelesZenawi na pia inaweza kuleta vurugu na hisia mbaya kuhusu usahihi na kuaminika kwa chanzo cha taarifa fulanin.

eng: Other fake, hacked or parody African Twitter profiles at present are:@Hailemdesalegne, @Julius_S_Malema, @kabwezitto, @alfredmutua and @MwaiKibaki
swa: Anwani nyingine za Twita zilizo bandia, zilizoibwa au korofi za Waafrika kwa sasa ni: @Hailemdesalegne, @Julius_S_Malema, @kabwezitto, @alfredmutua na @MwaiKibaki

eng: Meles Zenawi was President of Ethiopia from 1991 to 1995 and later became the Prime Minister of Ethiopia in 1995 following the general elections that year.
swa: Meles Zenawi alikuwa Rais wa Ethiopia kutoka mwaka 1991 hadi 1995 na baadaye alikuwa Waziri Mkuu wa nchi hiyo kutoka mwaka 1995 baada ya kufanyika Uchaguzi Mkuu mwaka ule.

eng: Submit your story for The Golden Baobab Award: "The Golden Boabab Award was established in 2008 to encouraged writers in Africa who specialize in books for children and young adults."
swa: Wasilisha kisa chako upate fursa kushinda Tuzo ya Mbuyu wa Dhahabu: "Tuzo ya Mbuyu wa Dhahabu ilianzishwa mwaka 2008 kuwahamasisha waandishi wa ki-Afarika waliojikita katika vitabu vya watoto na vijana."

eng: Winners: Dorothee Danedjo from Cameroon with Ndesanjo Macha of Global Voices.
swa: Washindi: Dorothee Danedjo kutoka Kameruni akiwa na Ndesanjo Macha wa Global Voices.

eng: Photo by Ettione Ferreira (used with permission)
swa: Picha ya Ettione Ferreira (imetumiwa kwa ruhusa)

eng: Global Voices Sub-Saharan Africa coverage won the Telekom Highway Africa Award for "Best African ICT Blog".
swa: Timu ya Global Voices inayoandika habari za Nchi za Afrika zilizo Kusini mwa Jangwa la Sahara imeshinda Tuzo ya Telekom Highway Africa katika kundi la "Blogu bora ya TEHAMA ya Kiafrika".

eng: Regional editor Ndesanjo Macha accepted the award (and trophy!) in South Africa on September 11, 2012 on behalf of the team.
swa: Mhariri wa Eneo hilo Ndesanjo Macha alikuwepo Afrika Kusini kuipokea tuzo hiyo (na kikombe cha ushindi!) tarehe 11 Sepetemba, 2012 kwa niaba ya timu nzima.

eng: Blogger and multi-media journalist Dorothy Dandejo from Cameroon was the runner up in the same category.
swa: Mwanablogu na mwandishi wa habari Dorothy Dandejo kutoka Kameruni alikuwa mshindani wa karibu aliyeibuka mshindi wa pili katika kundi hilo hilo.

eng: The Union Women and Child Development Ministry in India is considering a draft bill which, if passed by parliament, would make it legally compulsory for husbands to pay out a portion of their monthly income to their homemaker wives, for doing household chores.
swa: Wizara ya Umoja wa maendeleo ya wanawake na Watoto nchini India inaufikiria mswada ambao kama utapitishwa na bunge utahalalisha ulazima wa waume kumega sehemu ya mishahara yao na kuwalipa wake wasio na ajira kama ujira kwa kazi za nyumbani wanazozifanya.

eng: As per the Ministry's proposal, a model is being framed which will allow for valuation of the work done by homemakers in economic terms and then recognition of this contribution to the economy by compensating homemakers for their labour.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa pendekezo hilo la wizara, mswada huo unaandaliwa kiasi kwamba utaruhusu kupima kiwango cha kazi iliyofanywa na akina mama wa nyumbani kwa mtizamo wa makubaliano ya kiuchumi na kutambua mchango huu katika uchumi kwa kuwafidia akina mama hawa wa nyumbani kulingana na kazi wanazozifanya.

eng: The proposed law is expected to refer to homemakers as "home engineers".
swa: Kwa mujibu wa sheria hiyo, wafanyakazi wa ndani wanachukuliwa kama " wahandisi wa kazi za nyumbani ".

eng: Minister Krishna Tirath has said that this amount, which could be anywhere between 10-20% of the husband's monthly salary, should not be looked upon as salary for housework; rather it could be referred to as an honorarium or something similar.
swa: Waziri Krishna Tirath alisema kuwa, kiasi hiki ambacho kinakadiriwa kati ya asilimia 10-20% ya mshahara wa mwezi wa mume, haipaswi kuchukuliwa kama mshahara kwa ajili ya kazi za nyumbani, bali unapaswa kuchukuliwa kama jambo la kuonesha heshima au jambo linalofanana na hilo.
