swa: http://youtu.be/S6IskZCANfI

eng: A resounding theme in Malaysia’s 13th General Election on May 5, 2013 has been the prospect of change, or 'ubah' (change in Malay).
swa: Maudhui makuu katika Uchaguzi Mkuu wa 123 nchini Malaysia uliofanyika Mei 5, 2013 yamekuwa ni matarajio ya mabadiliko, au 'ubah' (mabadiliko ya Malay).

eng: A popular slogan being bandied about is ‘ini kalilah, ubah’ which translates as ‘this time around, change comes’.
swa: Kauli mbiu maarufu kubandikwa kuhusu ni 'ini kalilah, ubah' ambayo hutafsiriwa kama 'wakati huu, mabadiliko yanakuja'.

eng: Having said that, it is unclear how the election will play out, and Channel News Asia has reported that the ruling Barisan Nasional (BN) coalition might still win, but with a smaller margin.
swa: Kwa kusema hayo, haijawa wazi bado jinsi uchaguzi utakavyo kuwa, na Kituo cha Habari cha Asia kimetangaza kwamba Muungano wa chama tawala Barisan Nasional (BN) bado una nafasi kubwa ya kushinda, lakini kwa tofauti ndogo ya kura.

eng: BN has ruled Malaysia for the past half-century.
swa: Chama cha BN kimetawala Malaysia kwa kipindi cha nusu karne.

eng: Shufei made a case for a change in government:
swa: Shufei alijenga hoja ya ulazima wa mabadiliko ya serikali:

eng: I'm not one for politics.
swa: Mimi sio mtu yw siasa kivile.

eng: I detest it actually, it makes me more emotional than almost anything else.
swa: Naichukia kusema kweli, na hunifanya kuwa na hisia za hasira zaidi ya kitu kingine chochote.

eng: I'm so easily roused by anger when I read about prejudices, dirty tricks, unjustified behaviour, corruption.
swa: Huwa nasisimka kwa urahisi na kupandwa na hasira ninaposoma kuhusiana na mambo ya upendeleo, chuki, mbinu chafu, tabia zisizokubalika, rushwa.

eng: Everything that is humanely destructive but equally bracketed into the flawed mortality of individuals I'm entrusting my country with.
swa: Chochote chenye uharibifu kwa utu wa mwanadamu lakini hichohicho ndicho kinachotumika kuua watu ninaoamini ndio wamebeba mustakabali wa nchi yangu.

eng: But don't you think we should have a choice?
swa: Lakini je, huoni kuwa tulistahili kuwa na hiari ya kuamua tukitakacho?

eng: A two-party system so we have the ability to choose if the government is corrupt?
swa: Mfumo wa vyama viwili ili tuwe na uwezo wa kuchagua tukipendacho kama serikali inakuwa imetopea kwenye vitendo vya ufisadi?

eng: Isn't that what democracy is all about?
swa: Je hiyo si ndiyo maana ya demokrasia?

eng: Not being shushed or silenced because 'they have done so much things for us'.
swa: Si kunyamazishwa kwa sababu 'wao wamefanya mambo mengi kwa ajili yetu'.

eng: Yes, they have done things for us, but they're our government.
swa: Ndiyo, wamefanya mambo kwa ajili yetu, lakini wao ni serikali yetu.

eng: It's, I'm sorry to be blunt, their job.
swa: Ni, samahani kwa kuwa mkweli, ni kazi yao

eng: Glam also urged their readers to vote for a change in government, using several videos.
swa: Glam pia alitoa wito kwa wasomaji wao kupiga kura kwa ajili ya mabadiliko katika serikali, kwa kutumia video kadhaa.

eng: Anil Netto also posted a video of voters in Penang calling for change in the country.
swa: Anil Netto pia aliweka video ya wapiga kura huko Penang wakitoa wito kwa mabadiliko katika nchi.

eng: The people have made up their minds.
swa: Watu wamekwisha amua.

eng: This wasn’t about the people calling for tunnels, new highways and more high-rise luxury condos; it was the about the people calling for an end to corruption in the country and for political change at the federal level.
swa: Hii haikuwa juu ya watu kutoa wito kwa kujengwa barabara milimani, barabara kuu mijini na nyumba za kifahari; ilikuwa ni juu ya watu kutoa wito wa kumalizwa vitendo vya kifisadi katika nchi na kwa ajili ya mabadiliko ya kisiasa katika ngazi ya nchi.

eng: Thomas described Prime Minister Najib Razak as the 'Trojan Horse' of Malaysian politics:
swa: Thomas alimwelezea Waziri Mkuu Najib Razak kama 'Mbabe' katika siasa za Malaysia:

eng: Throughout the country, on the numerous BN’s billboards, printed materials and TV commercials and news, it is Najib’s sweet and gentle smiling face that you see.
swa: Nchini kote, kwenye mabango mengi ya chama cha BN, machapisho na matangazo ya runinga na habari, kile unachoona ni sura yenye tabasamu zuri lenye upole la Najib.

eng: Never before in the history of general elections in our country has so much been hinged on the persona of a man instead of on the ideals or vision of the party for the country.
swa: Haijawahi kutokea katika historia ya uchaguzi mkuu katika nchi yetu kutokea uchaguzi kutawaliwa na tashasha za mtu fulani badala ya tafakuri au maono ya chama kwa ajili ya nchi.

eng: But Najib Razak is a trojan horse, constructed by professional public relations firm like APCO with the help of a very compliant broadcast and printing mass media industry.
swa: Lakini Najib Razak ni 'mbabe', ambaye haiba yake imejengwa asasi zenye utaalamu mkubwa wa mahusiano ya umma kama APCO kwa msaada wa matangazo mengi pamoja na machapisho kibao kwenye vyombo vya habari.

eng: He has had an extreme makeover which transformed him from an ultra Malay rights politician to one that espouse the inclusive and tolerant values of 1Malaysia.
swa: Yeye alikuwa na uhawilishaji uliokithiri ambao ulimbadilisha kutoka mwanasiasa wa ki-Malay hadi kuwa mtu anayetangazwa kuwa mtu wa umoja na mtunzaji wa tunu za Malayasia.

eng: Malaysia has been swamped with campaign materials such as banners, flags, posters and billboards.
swa: Malaysia imefurikwa na viwezeshaji vya kampeni kama vile mabango, bendera, vipeperushi na mabango makubwa mitaani.

eng: Photo by Hon Keong Soo, Copyright @Demotix (5/2/2013)
swa: Picha kwa hisani ya Hon Keong Soo, haki miliki @Demotix (5/2/2013)

eng: This is the first time that postal voting is allowed in the Malaysian elections.
swa: Hii ni mara ya kwanza kuruhusiwa kwa upigaji kura kupitia posta katika uchaguzi wa Malaysia.

eng: Chelliah, a Malaysian living in the UK, wrote about their excitement at the possibility of a change in government:
swa: Chelliah, M-Malaysia aishiye nchini Uingereza, aliandika kuhusu furaha yao katika uwezekano wa mabadiliko katika serikali:

eng: As I write this post the sun is rising in Malaysia on a new day and I will be going to bed soon because it is the end of the day in the UK.
swa: Ninapoandika taarifa hii jua linatokea nchini Malaysia siku mpya na mimi ntakuwa na kwenda kulala mapema kwa sababu ni siku ndio inaishia hivyo hapa nchini Uingereza.

eng: There is something ironic about that.
swa: Kuna kitu cha kushangaza kuhusu hilo.

eng: I left Malaysia 32 years ago and although I now live thousands of miles away I am excited at the prospect of 'Ubah' ('change' in the Malay language)becoming a reality on 0505.
swa: Mimi nilitoka Malaysia miaka 32 iliyopita na ingawa mimi sasa naishi maelfu ya maili nina msisimko katika matarajio ya 'Ubah' ('mabadiliko' katika lugha ya Malay) kuwa ukweli mnamo 0505.

eng: The election or GE13 as it has become known, I suspect, will be a political milestone for the manifestation of Malaysian unity all over the world.
swa: Uchaguzi au GE13 kama unavyojulikana sasa, ninahisi, itakuwa ni hatua ya kisiasa kwa ajili ya udhihirisho wa umoja wa wa-Malaysia duniani kote.

eng: I don't think I am alone in hoping for Ubah while living in a foreign land.
swa: Sidhani niko peke yangu katika matumaini kwa Ubah wakati huu ninapoishi katika nchi ya kigeni.

eng: You may wonder why this is important for someone who does not experience daily life under a regime that many Malaysians experience as being corrupt and authoritarian.
swa: Unaweza kushangaa kwa nini suala hili ni muhimu kwa mtu ambaye hana uzoefu wa maisha ya kila siku chini ya utawala ambao Wa- Malaysia wengi kwa tajiriba yao wanauona kuwa umejaa ufisadi na wenye udikteta.

eng: I may not live there now but I did live the daily life of state-led grind for many years.
swa: Siishi huko sasa lakini mimi niliishi maisha hayo yakiwa ni sehemu ya maisha ya kila siku kwa miaka mingi.

eng: In Melbourne, JOM Magazine, a magazine that caters to the Malaysian community, made a video about the postal voting day, which was held a week before May 5.
swa: Katika jijini Melbourne, jarida la JOM, linalohudumia jumuiya ya Malaysia, ilitengeneza video juu ya siku ya kupiga kura kwa njia ya posta, uliofanyika wiki moja kabla ya Mei 5.

eng: There is also a video of Malaysian voters in London:
swa: Pia kuna video ya wapiga kura Malaysia katika jiji la London:

eng: With social media so widely used, it is not a surprise that this election has been dubbed the social media election.
swa: Pamoja na vyombo vya habari vya kijamii kutumika sana, siyo jambo la kushangaza kwamba uchaguzi huu umekuwa ukijulikana kama Uchaguzi wa vyombo vya habari vya kijamii

eng: Elias Munshya, a Zambian lawyer and paster, explains why parastatals have failed in Zambia since independence:
swa: Elias Munshya, mwanasheria na mchungaji wa Zambia, anaeleza kwa nini mashirika ya umma yamedumaa nchini Zambia tangu uhuru:

eng: Parastatals have never made a profit since 1964.
swa: Mashirika ya umma hayajawahi kutengeneza faida tangu mwaka 1964.

eng: Parastatals have been run not on a business model but on a political model.
swa: Yamekuwa yakiendeshwa kiholela bila utaalamu wa kibiashara bali kisiasa.

eng: Parastatals have not had professionals running the boards but they have been staffed with relatives, nephews, nieces and great-grandsons of the politicians
swa: Mashirika haya hayajawahi kuwa na wataalamu wanaoendesha bodi husika bali yamejaa wafanyakazi kwa misingi ya mahusiano ya undugu, ubinamu, upwa na ujukuu na wanasiasa

eng: Lebanese blogger Habib Battah narrates how he was held against his consent, forced to delete photographs of ruins from his phone camera and repeatedly assaulted in this post on the Beirut Report.
swa: Mwanablogu wa ki-Lebanoni Habib Battah anaeleza namna alivyoshikiliwa bila hiari, akilazimishwa kufuta picha katika kamera ya simu yake na kudhalilishwa mfululizo katika posti hii inayohusiana na ripoti ya Beirut.

eng: When he reported the case to his local police station, the officers in charge said it was his word against theirs.
swa: Aliporipoti suala hilo katika kituo cha polisi mahali alipokuwa, mafisa wanaohusika walimkana na kumgeuzia kibao yeye.

eng: He adds:
swa: Anaongeza:

eng: They were right.
swa: Walikuwa sahihi.

eng: If the men on site were willing to beat me up to please their boss, they would certainly lie for him.
swa: Kama watu walikuwa eneo la tukio walikuwa tayari kunipa kichapo ili kumridhisha bosi wao, watu hao lazima wangeweza kudanganya kumridhisha.

eng: And I was sealed in, no one from the street could witness how they had repeatedly assaulted me.
swa: Na nilivyopigwa, hakuna mtu mtaani angekuwa tayari kutoa ushahidi namna walivyoninyanyasa namna ile.

eng: I left the police station feeling that Lebanese citizens have no protection under the law.
swa: Niliondoka polisi nikijisikia kuwa raia wa ki-Lebanoni hawalindwi na sheria.

eng: The wealthy developers can smash us like ants, if ever we dare to upset them.
swa: Matajiri wanaweza kutukanyaga kama sisimizi, kama tutajaribu kuwakasirisha.

eng: Global Voices reviews the May 1, 2013 Labor Day protests in Cambodia, Philippines, Indonesia, and Singapore.
swa: Global Voices inayapitia kwa haraka maandamano ya Siku ya Wafanyakazi Mei Mosi kwenye nchi za Cambodia, Filipino, Indonesia na Singapore.

eng: The rallies, which were organized to echo the various demands of workers and advocacy groups, were relatively peaceful across the region.
swa: Mikutano, ambayo iliandaliwa kudai haki za wafanyakazi na makundi mengine ya utetezi, yalifanyika kwa amani katika bara lote la Asia ya Kusini Mshariki.

eng: In Cambodia, more than 6,000 garment workers were joined by students, NGOs, and urban poor residents in Phnom Penh City who marched from the Freedom Park to the National Assembly calling for living wages and improved working conditions.
swa: Nchini Cambodia, zaidi ya wafanyakazi 6,000 wa kiwanda cha nguo waliungwa mkono na wanafunzi, Mashirika yasiyo ya Kiserikali, na wakazi masikini wa mijini katika Jiji la Phnom Penh ambao wote kwa pamoja waliandamana kutokea Viwanja vya Freedom Park kuelekea kwenye Bunge la nchi hiyo kutoa wito wa kuboreshewa maslahi yao pamoja na mazingira bora zaidi ya kazi.

eng: Garment workers march in Phnom Penh, Cambodia.
swa: Wafanyakazi wakiandamana jijini Phnom Penh, Cambodia.

eng: Photo from Licadho
swa: Picha na Licadho

eng: Photo from Licadho
swa: Picha na Licadho

eng: In Indonesia, thousands of workers marched in front of the Presidential Palace in Jakarta to commemorate Labor Day.
swa: Nchini Indonesia, maelfu ya wafanyakazi waliandamana mbele ya Ikulu ya nchi hiyo jijini Jarkata kuadhimisha Siku ya Wafanyakazi.

eng: Among their demands were the “fulfillment of the minimum wage, health insurance and safety for workers, as well as refusing outsourcing.”
swa: Baadhi ya madai yao, yalikuwa "kuongezwa kwa kima cha chini cha mshahara, bima ya afya na usalama kwa wafanyakazi, pamoja na kukataa misaada ya nje.”

eng: Thousands of workers march in Jakarta.
swa: Maelfu ya wafanyakazi wakiandamana jijini Jarkata.

eng: Photo by Ibnu Mardhani, Copyright @Demotix (5/1/2013)
swa: Picha na Ibnu Mardhani, Kwa idhini ya @Demotix (5/1/2013)

eng: Workers march in Jakarta during Labor Day.
swa: Wafanyakazi wakiandamana jijini Jarkata siku ya Mei Mosi.

eng: Photo by Ibnu Mardhani, Copyright @Demotix (5/1/2013)
swa: Picha na Ibnu Mardhani, Kwa idhini ya @Demotix (5/1/2013)

eng: In the Philippines, labor group Kilusang Mayo Uno is disappointed with the labor policies of the government:
swa: Nchini Ufilipino, kikundi cha wafanyakazi kiitwacho Kilusang Mayo Uno kilikatishwa tamaa na sera za kazi zinazotekelezwa na serikali:

eng: We mark the 127th International Workers’ Day and its 110th celebration in the Philippines with a nationwide protest condemning the rabidly anti-worker and pro-capitalist regime of Pres. Noynoy Aquino.
swa: TUnaadhimisha mwaka wa 127 wa Siku ya Wafanyakazi Kimataifa na mwaka 110 wa maadhimisho hayo nchini Ufilipino kwa maandamano ya kitaifa kupinga utawala usiojali maslahi ya mfanayakazi na unaoshabikia ubepari wa Rais Noynoy Aquino.

eng: Aquino has again rejected workers’ calls for a significant wage hike, the junking of contractual employment and a stop to trade-union repression.
swa: Aquino ameyakataa madai ya wafanyakazi ya kupandisha mishahara yao, kuachana na mfumo wa ajira za mkataba na kusimamishwa kwa ukandamizaji unaofanywa na vyama vya wafanyakazi.

eng: He has bragged about non-wage benefits and his government’s efforts at creating jobs.
swa: Amejitetea kwa kutengeneza mfumo wa kuwanufaisha wafanyakazi pamoja na juhudi za serikali kuzalisha ajira.

eng: Filipino workers march near the presidential palace demanding higher wages and rollback of prices.
swa: Wanafanyakazi wa ki-Filipino wakiandamana karibu na Ikulu ya Rais wakidai kupandishiwa mshahara na kudhibiti mfumuko wa bei.

eng: Photo from Facebook of Tine Sabillo
swa: Picha kutoka kwenye ukurasa wa Facebook wa Tine Sabillo

eng: Photo from Facebook of Tine Sabillo
swa: Picha kutoka kwenye ukurasa wa Facebook wa Tine Sabillo

eng: In Singapore.
swa: Nchini Singapore.

eng: Gilbert Goh of transitioning,org wrote about the historic Labor Day protest in Singapore:
swa: Gilbert Goh wa tovuti ya transitioning,org aliandika kuhusu maandamano hayo ya kihistoria ya wafanyakazi nchini Singapore:

eng: We realised that we are also creating another piece of history in Singapore here as so far no one has managed to organise a labour day event from the ground up – ever and we are proud to be able to do so for the first time!
swa: Tumejua kuwa nasi pia tunatengeneza sehemu nyingine ya historia nchini Singapore kwa kuwa haikuwa kutokea mtu akahamasisha tukio la siku ya wafanyakazi kutokea chini kabisa -haijawahi kutokea na tunajisikia fahari kufanya hivyo kwa mara ya kwanza!

eng: We may even contemplate doing an annual labour day protest from now on – like what many other countries have done for decades.
swa: Kwa sasa tunaweza hata kupanga kufanya maandamano ya wafanyakazi wakati wa Mei Mosi kuanzia sasa -kama inavyofanyika katika nchi nyinginezo kwa miongo sasa.

eng: Thousands of Singaporeans assembled in Hong Lim Park on Labor Day.
swa: Maelfu ya wa-Singapore wakiwa wamekusanyika katika Viwanja vya Hong Lim Mei Mosi.

eng: Photo from Facebook of Lawrence Chong
swa: Picha kutoka ukurasa wa Facebook wa Lawrence Chongg

eng: Singaporeans participate in historic Labor Day protest to air their views on the government's population policy paper.
swa: Wa- Singapore wakishiriki katika Maandamano ya kihistoria ya Wafanyakazi kufikisha kilio chao kwa serikali kuhusu andiko lake la sera ya idadi ya watu.

eng: Photo from Facebook of Lawrence Chong
swa: Picha kutoka ukurasa wa Facebook wa Lawrence Chongg

eng: The Team Tanzania is a TV drama series about:
swa: The Team Tanzania (Timu Tanzania) ni mfululizo wa Tamthilia ya Runinga yenye kuzungumzia:

eng: Ms. Wito, a dynamic civics teacher, who turns the world of 3 teenagers upside down when she challenges them with controversial questions like “Who are you”? The three 16-year olds, who have known each other all their lives.
swa: Wito, mwalimu mahiri wa somo la uraia, anaigeuza kabisa mitazamo ya vijana makinda watatu anapowauliza maswali mazito mfano "Wewe ni nani"? vijana wale wenye umri wa miaka 16, waliofahamiana vyema tangu wakikua.

eng: On the edge of adulthood, they are searching for their own identities while facing family and cultural pressures.
swa: Katika kuingia katika umri wa utu uzima, vijana hao wanatafuta kujitambua huku wakikabiliwa na misongo mingi ya kifamilia na kiutamaduni.

eng: Dar Sketches is part of the Street Level project in Dar Es Salaam, Tanzania initiated by artist and illustrator Sarah Markes:
swa: Dar Sketches (Michoro ya Dar) ni sehemu ya mradi unaoanzia ngazi ya Mtaa jijini Dar Es Salaam, Tanzania ulioanzishwa na msanii na mchoraji Sarah Markes:

eng: It is a celebration of the cultural and architectural heritage of Dar es Salaam as well as an effort to raise awareness of the threats to this heritage posed by rapid and unplanned urban development.
swa: Ni katika kuenzi urithi wa kitamaduni na wa sanaa ya ubunifu wa majengo kwa jiji la Dar Es Salaam sambamba na juhudi za kukuza uelewa kwa wananchi juu ua tishio la urithi huu linalotokana na kasi kubwa ya kupanuka holela kwa jiji hilo.

eng: Screenshot from press conference video
swa: Picha ya video ya mkutano na vyombo vya habari

eng: Medical professionals in Mozambique have announced they will strike.
swa: Madaktari nchini Msumbiji wametangaza rasmi kuwa wanaingia kwenye mgomo.

eng: They consider that they were "humiliated, insulted and disdained" in their last meeting with government.
swa: Wanadhani "walikandamizwa, kutukanwa na kunyanyaswa" katika mkutano wao wa mwisho na serikali.

eng: This current strike follows a strike earlier this year by doctors.
swa: Mgomo huu wa sasa unafuatia mgomo wa madaktari uliofanyika mapema mwaka huu.

eng: The video announcement is available with subtitles in English, and a number of languages.
swa: Tangazo kwa njia ya video linapatikana likiwa na tafsiri kwa maandishi ya kiingereza, na katika lugha kadhaa.

eng: The same day that the death toll of a nine-story factory collapse in Savar in the outskirts of Bangladesh's capital city of Dhaka rose to 1,055, now the deadliest building collapse since the 9/11 terrorist attacks, a female worker named Reshma Begum was found alive after being trapped in the rubble for 17 days.
swa: Siku ifananayo na ile iliyogharimu maisha ya watu mara baada ya kuporomoka kwa jengo la ghorofa tisa huko Savar pembezoni mwa mji mkuu wa Banglasesh, Dhaka idadi ya vifo imeongezeka hadi 1,055, hadi sasa hili ndilo jingo lililowahi kuporomoka na kuua idadi kubwa zaidi ya watu tangu lilipotokea shambulizi la kigaidi mnamo tarehe 9/11, mfanyakazi mmoja mwanamke ajulikanaye kwa jina la Reshma Begum amekutwa akiwa hai baada ya kuzuiwa na vifusi vya jengo hilo kwa siku 17.

eng: Begum worked on the building's second floor as a sewing operator.
swa: Begum alikuwa akifanya kazi ya ushonaji katika ghorofa ya pili ya jengo hilo.

eng: As the building collapsed, the 24-year-old was trapped in a mosque inside the basement and survived 416 hours there by breathing through a pipe and scavenging for biscuits in the rucksacks of dead colleagues.
swa: Jingo lilipoporomoka, mwanamke huyo wa miaka 24 alizuiwa ndani ya msikiti uliokuwa sakafu ya ardhi na aliweza kustahimili kwa masaa 416 kwenye vifusi kwa kupumua kupitia kwenye bomba pamoja na kutafuta biskuti kwenyee vibegi vido vya mgongoni vya wenzake waliokuwa wameshapoteza maisha.

eng: In the first few days after the structure caved in on April 24,2013, 2,428 people were rescued from the collapsed building.
swa: Katika siku chache za kwanza mara baada ya jingo hilo kuporomoka mnamo Aprili 24, 2013, watu 2,428 wameshaokolewa kutoka katika vifusi vya jengo hilo.

eng: Hope that others survivors will be found among the rubble is fading fast.
swa: Tumaini la kuwapata watu wengine wakiwa hai katika vifusi vya jengo hilo linazidi kufifia.

eng: Bangladeshi rescuers retrieve garment worker Reshma from the rubble of a collapsed building in Savar after 17 days. Image by Rehman Asad.
swa: Waokoaji wa Bangladeshi wakimuokoa mfanyakazi wa kiwanda cha kutengenezea nguo ajulikaye kwa jina la Reshma kutoka kwenye vifusi vya jengo lililoporomoka baada ya kufunikwa kwa vifusi vya jengo hilo kwa siku 17. picha na Rehman Asad.

eng: Copyright Demotix (10/5/2013).
swa: Copyright Demotix (10/5/2013).

eng: Begum told a news agency: I survived mainly by drinking water.
swa: Begum aliwaambia mawakala wa habari :

eng: I was trapped immediately after the building collapse.
swa: kwa kiasi kikubwa niliweza kuishi kwa kunywa maji.

eng: I quickly went to the prayer room for refuge.
swa: Nilibanwa mara tu baada ya jengo kuporomoka.

eng: The rescuers dropped water inside in different times.
swa: Haraka nilielekea kwenye chumba kwa ajili ya maombi kama mkimbizi.

eng: I managed to collect two bottles and survived on them all these days.
swa: Niliweza kupata chupa mbili za maji ambazo ndizo zilizonifanya nikawa hai kwa siku zote hizi.

eng: Begum's miraculous survival has caused a stir among many.
swa: Kuepuka kifo huku kwa miujiza kwa Begum kuliibua hisia kali miongoni mwa wtu wengi.

eng: Hearing the good news, blogger Ashraf Shishir (@ashrafshishir) wrote:
swa: Baada ya kusikia habari hizi nzuri, mwanablogu Ashraf Shishir (@ashrafshishir) aliandika:

eng: @shahanasiddiqui: Holding back tears as I read through Reshma's miraculous save!
swa: @shahanasiddiqui: Niliacha kutoa machozi yangu mara baada ya kusikia kuokoka kimiujiza kwa Reshma!

eng: Times of joy, times of pride #Bangladesh #savar.
swa: Ni wakati wa furaha, ni muda wa kujisikia fahari.

eng: Army and rescuers look through the pocket point in the rubble of Rana Plaza where they found Reshma located alive under the rubble.
swa: Wanajeshi na waokoaji wakiangalia sehemu Rishma alipokuwa amezuiwa na kifusi cha jengo la Rana Plaza, mahali walipompata akiwa hai.

eng: Image by Firoz Ahmed.
swa: Picha na Firoz Ahmed.

eng: Copyright Demotix (10/5/2013)
swa: Copyright Demotix (10/5/2013)

eng: Baroness Sayeeda Hussain Warsi (@SayeedaWarsi), senior minister of state for foreign and commonwealth affairs of UK, responded after hearing the news of Reshma's rescue:
swa: Baroness Sayeeda Hussain Warsi (@SayeedaWarsi), waziri mwandamizi wa Uingerezera anayehusika na mambo ya nje na ushirikiano wa makoloni ya Uingereza alitoa maoni yake mara baada ya kusikia habari za kuokolewa kwa Reshma:

eng: @SayeedaWarsi: Extraordinary & uplifting scenes of a young women rescued 17 days after #Savar building collapse.
swa: @SayeedaWarsi: ni zaidi ya ajabu; tukiio la kutia moyo kwa mwanamke mdogo kuokolewa baada ya siku 17 kupita tokea jengo la Savar kuporomoka.

eng: A ray of hope in the midst of tragedy.
swa: Mwale wa matumaini katikati ya janga.

eng: Asif Touhid, a marketing professional, wrote on Facebook: Reshma ...
swa: Asif Touhid, mtaalamu wa mauzo, aliandika katika Facebook:

eng: Journalist Kamrul Hasan (@_Kamrul_Hasan_) thanked all the rescuers who worked hard to pull out Begum alive: @Kamrul_Hasan: Even this is possible!
swa: @Kamrul_Hasan: kumbe hili linawezekana!

eng: Congratulations Reshma, please stay alive and well.
swa: Hongera sana reshma, uishi maisha marefu na mazuri.

eng: Many thanks to the Bangladesh army rescue team for their efforts.
swa: Shukrani za pekee kwa jopo la waokoaji wa kijeshi kwa juhudi walizoweka.

eng: The role of the media was questioned as they converged on the rescued Begum and tried to interview her. Journalist Tanvir Ahmed urged his colleagues on Facebook:
swa: Jukumu la vyombo vya habari lilihojiwa pale walipohamia kwa Begum na kujaribu kumhoji.

eng: Relatives of missing or dead garment workers remain optimistic even 17 days after the incident.
swa: Mwandishi wa habari Tanvir Ahmed aliwahoji waandishi wenzake katika ukurasa wa Facebook:

eng: The readymade garments industry is the largest export earners of Bangladesh, so in the eyes of many the building collapse is a negative portrayal of Bangladesh's image.
swa: Bangladesh iliweza kuishi kwenye kifusi kwa siku 17.

eng: Bangladesh survived under rubble for 17 days.
swa: Dada Rishma- umenusurika na kifo.

eng: Sister Reshma - you have come back from the dead hole. You have shown that Bangladesh even survives under rubble.
swa: Umeonesha kuwa hata Bangladesh inaweza kuishi kwenye vifusi.

eng: Zafar Sobhan, editor of the Dhaka Tribune, concluded in an interview with Australian website News.com.au: Reshma represents the best of Bangladesh, the nation's resilience in the face of unbelievable hardship, its courage, its strength, its determination to never give up whatever the odds.
swa: Zafar Sobhan, mhariri wa Jukwaa la Dhaka, alitoa mjumuisho katika mahojiano na mtandao wa habari wa News.com.au:

eng: Omar Qatifaan, a 14-year-old media activist, was killed 21 May, 2013 while covering clashes between the Syrian Army and the rebel Free Army in the southern Daraa al-Ballad area of Syria near the border with Jordan.
swa: Omar Qatifaan, Mwanaharakati wa Habari mwenye umri wa miaka 14, aliuawa Mei 21, 2013 wakati alipokuwa anaripoti mapigano kati ya Jeshi la Syria na waasi wanaopinga serikali ya nchi hiyo kusini mwa al-Ballad eneo la Syria karibu na mpaka na Jordan.

eng: Youth media project Syrian Documents reported on his death, and Syrian news blog YALLA SOURIYA called him the "Spirit of Syria".
swa: Nyaraka kuhusu Syria zilizotolewa na Mradi wa vyombo vya habari vya vijana ziliripoti kuhusu kifo chake, na blogu ya habari nchini humo YALLA SOURIYA ilimwita kijana huyo kuwa "Roho wa Syria".

eng: The conflict in Syria, as well as other Arab Spring uprisings, has seen a rise in citizen journalists reporting from the ground on the ongoing war between the country's pro- and anti-government forces.
swa: Mgogoro wa Syria, kama vile Mapinduzi mengine yaliyozikumba nchi za Kiarabu, zimesababisha kuongezeka kwa waandishi wa habari za kiraia wanaoripoti kutoka katika kwenye uwanja wa vita kuhusu mgogoro unaoendelea kati ya majeshi yanayounga mkono serikali na yale ya waasi.

eng: Many have been detained, tortured, and even killed while trying to bring the story of the revolution to the world.
swa: Wengi wamekuwa kizuizini, kuteswa, na hata kuuawa wakiwa katika jitihada za kuutangazia ulimwengu habari za mapinduzi.

eng: Children have also paid a terrible price during the conflict, with thousands killed during the violence so far.
swa: Watoto pia wameumia kupindukia wakati wa vita, na maelfu wakiuawa wakati wa ghasia hadi wakati huu.

eng: Media activist Omar Qatifaan was 14-years-old when he was killed while covering a battle in Daraa, Syria.
swa: Mwanaharakati wa Vyombo vya Habari Omar Qatifan alikuwa na umri wa miaka 14 alipouawa akiwa anaripoti habari za vita huko Daraa, Syria.

eng: This post is part of our Special Coverage Pakistan Votes 2013. Popular cricketer-turned-politician Imran Khan, whose hopeful campaign promise of a "New Pakistan" has drawn large crowds of young people and urban voters to his rallies ahead of the country's general elections, fractured three vertebrae and a rib after falling off a 15-feet high forklift just before a scheduled speech.
swa: Aliyekuwa mchezaji maarufu wa kriketi na kisha kuamua kuwa mwanasiasa Imran Khan, ambaye kampeni yake yenye tumaini kubwa la kupata “Pakistani Mpya” imeshavuta makundi makubwa ya vijana pamoja na wapiga kura wa mijini kwenye mikutano yake katika harakati za kuelekea kwenye uchaguzi mkuu , alivunjika vifupa vitatu vya uti wa mgongo pamoja na mbavu baada ya kuanguka kutoka kwenye winchi iliyokuwa katika kimo cha futi 15 mda mfupi kabla ya kuhutubia.

eng: Khan, who was at a rally in the city of Lahore, was immediately rushed to the Shaukat Khanum Memorial Hospital.
swa: Khan, aliyekuwa katika mkutano katika jiji la Lahore, alikimbizwa haraka kwenye Hospitali ya Kumbukumbu ya Shaukat Khanum.

eng: Within a few hours of being hospitalized, he regained consciousness and managed to make a powerful political speech to the journalists at his bedside.
swa: Ndani ya masaa machache ya kulazwa hospitalini, alipata tena fahamu na kuweza kutoa hotuba ya kisiasa yenye mashiko kwa waandishi wa habari waliokuwa pembeni mwa kitanda chake.

eng: With the country's hotly contested elections on May 11, 2013 only days away, Khan's dramatic fall comes during the final campaign push.
swa: Kwa kuzingatia uchaguzi huu ulio na ushindani mkubwa unaotarajiwa kufanyika Mei 11, 2013, siku chache zijazo, kuanguka ghafla kwa Khan kunatokea wakati wa harakati za mwisho za kampeni.

eng: He is leading Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI), a newcomer that could be a strong contender for the people's representation in the upcoming elections.
swa: Yeye ndiye anayekiongoza chama cha Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI), mwanasiasa mgeni ambaye anaweza kuwa mgombea shupavu atakayewawakilisha watu kwenye chaguzi za hivi karibuni.

eng: But phenomenally, the incident shows signs of bridging the bitter political divides across the country, with political rivals, critics, and opponents putting aside their differences to wish Khan good health.
swa: Lakini, jambo kubwa kabisa ni kuwa, tukio hili linaonesha ishara ya kuwepo kwa hali ya umoja pamoja na kuwepo kwa mpasuko hatari wa kisiasa uliotapakaa nchini kote kwani washindani, wakosoaji na wapinzani wanaweka tofauti zao kando na kumtakia Khan siha njema.

eng: Imran Khan falling off the lifter.Image courtesy PTI UK official Facebook page
swa: Picha kwa hisani ya PTI Ukurasa Maalum wa Facebook wa Uingereza

eng: The news instantly replaced all other headlines on TV channels and social media were soon abuzz with it.
swa: Habari hii kwa haraka kabisa ilibadilisha vichwa vya habari vingine kwenye vituo vya televisheni na pia mitandao mingi ya kijamii ghafla ilihanikizwa na habari hii.

eng: People from all sorts of political affiliations, from his staunch rivals, Nawaz Sharif and Shahbaz Sharif, to international celebrities such as Brian Lara, spoke up to wish Imran Khan a speedy recovery.
swa: Watu mbalimbali kuanzia washirika wake wa kisiasa, washindani wake wakubwa Nawaz Sharif na Shahbaz Sharif hadi watu maarufu duniani kama vile Brian Lara walimwombea Imran Khan kupona haraka.

eng: @BrianLara: Imran Khan injured @ rally fell off stage... Out of danger Thank God!!
swa: @BrianLara: Imran Khan aliumia wakati wa mkutano kwa kuanguka kutoka jukwaani... balaa limemuepuka, Asante mungu!

eng: Get well soon great man.
swa: Upone kwa haraka ndugu uliye muhimu.

eng: Continue striving in what u believe in.
swa: Endelea kukipigania kile unachokiamini.

eng: Just visited Imran Khan in the hospital and conveyed best wishes of Mian Nawaz Sharif... He is Alhumdulillah fine and recovering mashaaAllah... Prayers for him and his family!!!
swa: Si muda mrefu nimetoka hospitalini kumjulia hali Imran Khan na kufikisha salamu za kumtakia siha njema kutoka kwa Mian Nawaz Sharif...Alhumdulillah yeye hajambo na anaendelea vizuri mashaaAllah... tunamwombea yeye na familia yake!!!

eng: @MaryamNSharif: Got the sad news while campaigning.
swa: @MaryamNSharif: Alipata bahati mbaya wakati kampeni zikiendelea.

eng: Our prayers and wishes for Imran Khan Sahib's early & complete recovery.
swa: Tunamuombea na kumtakia kila lenye kheri Imran Khan Sahib apone haraka; awe na siha njema kabisa.

eng: Hundreds of people gathered outside the Shaukat Khanum Hospital where Imran Khan was being treated.
swa: mamia ya watu wakiwa wamekusanyika nje ya Hospitali ya Shaukat Khanum, hospitali aliyokuwa anapatiwa matibabu Imran Khan.

swa: @TahirulQadri: huruma ya moyo wangu ni kwa mwenyekiti wa PTI, ndugu Imran Khan kwa kujeruhiwa.

eng: I pray for his better health.
swa: Ninamuombea awe na siha njema.

swa: @SenRehmanMalik: Ninamuombea Imran Khan apone haraka.

swa: Mwenyezi Mungu amjalie Baraka za kupona haraka.

eng: In Punjab, Khan's party is locked in a bitter political tussle with Pakistan Muslim League (PML-N). Despite this, PML-N head, Nawaz Sharif, expressed his grief over the incident and decided to stall his party's election campaign for a day, as a show of solidarity with Khan.
swa: Huko Punjab, chama cha Khan kinakabiliana na hali ngumu ya ushindani wa kisiasa dhidi ya chama cha Pakistan Muslim League (PML-N). pamoja na hali hii, kiongozi wa PML-N, Nawaz Sharif, alionesha kuguswa kwake na tukio hili na hivyo kuamua kusitisha kampeni za chama chake kwa siku moja kama namna ya kuonesha hali ya umoja kati yake na Khan.

eng: Many have gone on to claim that Khan has united a divided nation with his fall.
swa: Wengi wameeendelea kusema kuwa, kwa kuanguka kwake, Khan ameliunganisha tena taifa.

eng: The incident, Hammad Siddiqui (@hammads) wrote, also hints that Pakistani politicians have matured:
swa: Hammad Siddiqui (@hammads) aliandika na pia kudokeza kuwa, wanasiasa wa Pakistan wameerevuka kisiasa:

eng: @hammads: Altaf Bhai was the first one to cancel his address and prayed for Imran Khan - Followed by NS this shows political maturity #GetwellSoonIK
swa: @hammads: Altaf Bhai ndiye aliyekuwa wa kwanza kusitisha hotuba yake na kumuombea Imran Khan – akifuatiwa na NS, hii inaonesha kupevuka kisiasa # UpatenafuuharakaIK

eng: The incident has also triggered mass support and sympathy for Khan's political party, with many speculating that it may turn the tables in the party's favor.
swa: Tukio hili pia limechochea idadi kubwa ya watu kukihurumia na kukiunga mkono chama cha siasa cha Khan, huku wengi wakitabiri kuwa, hali hii inaweza kuwa kuwa msaada mkubwa kwa chama cha Khan.

eng: Hassan Belal Zaidi (@mightyobvious_), a media consultant, penned a post titled "Fall to Grace" for Pak Votes. In his post, Zaidi wrote:
swa: Hassan Belal Zaidi (@mightyobvious_), mshauri wa vyombo vya habari," Anguka Kutoa baraka" za Kura za watu wa Pakistan . katika makala hii, Zaidi aliandika:

eng: The truth is, Imran might just end up winning this one.
swa: Ukweli ni kuwa, Imran anaweza kuibuka mshindi katika chaguzi hizi.

eng: I can smell a victory for the Cricket Bat a mile away.
swa: Ninaweza kunusa harufu ya ushindi maili chache hivi kwa mcheza kriketi huyu.

eng: It may not be a massive win, it may not be a rout, but for a first time party, it will definitely be a victory.
swa: Unaweza usiwe ushindi wa kishindo, inawezekana usiwe ushindi wa moja kwa moja, lakini kwa chama kipya, bila mashaka yoyote, utakuwa ni ushindi mkubwa.

eng: I just hope that this (excuse the pun) knock on the head will be the wake-up call many in our country need.
swa: Ninatumai kuwa, kugongwa huku kichwani, utakuwa ni wito wa kuamshwa ambao watu wengi katika nchi yetu wanauhitaji.

eng: I do not support the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaaf, nor will I be voting for them.
swa: Siungi mkono chama cha Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaaf, na wala sitawapigia kura yangu.

eng: But I do wish their party and their leader the best of luck.
swa: Lakini nakitakia chama chao na kiongozi wao mafanikio mema.

eng: While many have criticized Imran Khan for having rightist leanings, the unfortunate fall has yet again highlighted the fact that Khan has politically stirred the nation, especially the youth.
swa: Wakati, watu wengi walimkosoa Imran Khan kuwa ameegemea siasa za mrengo wa kulia, kuanguka kwa bahati mbaya, kumeonesha tena uthibitisho kuwa taifa limeamshwa tena kisiasa na hususani kwa vijana.

eng: And when all is said and done, such mobilization is a very welcome change in a budding democracy.
swa: Na yote yakishasemwa na yakaisha, muhamasisho wa aina hii ni mabadiliko yanayohitajika sana kwenye demokrasia inayokua.

eng: Rafael Correa took power as President of the Republic of Ecuador to govern until 2017.
swa: Rafael Correa amekabidhiwa madaraka kuwa Rais wa Jamhuri ya Ekuado kwa kipindi kingine mpaka mwaka 2017.

eng: Correa took on his third term at the National Assembly before the heads of state of different Latin American and European countries, international delegations, assembly members, ministers, family members, and members of the governing party Alianza PAIS.
swa: Correa aliianza awamu yake ya tatu katika Bunge akishuhudiwa na wakuu wa nchi kadhaa za Marekani ya Kusini na Ulaya, wawakilishi wa kimataifa, wabunge, mawaziri, wanafamilia wake na wanachama wa chama tawala cha Alianza PAIS.

eng: Correa and his Vice President Jorge Glas were sworn in before the President of the National Assembly, Gabriela Rivadeneira, on the morning of May 24, 2013.
swa: Correa na Makamu wake Jorge Glas waliapishwa na Rais wa Bunge, Gabriela Rivadeneira, asubuhi ya Mei 24, 2013.

eng: In his inauguration speech President Rafael Correa promised to continue the social programs which his high levels of popularity have been based on.
swa: Katika hotuba yake ya kuapishwa Rais Rafael Correa aliahidi kuendelea na mipango ya kijamii ambayo ndiyo iliyochangia umaarufu wake mkubwa.

swa: President Correa ana mahusiano ya karibu sana na vyombo vya habari nchini humo.

swa: Katika hotuba yake alisema "vyombo vya habari katika Bara la Amerika ya Kusini, ukiacha mifano michache kama ilivyo kawaida, ni vibovu, vibovu sana" na akadai kuwa mhanga wa "kufa kwa vyomvo vya habari".

eng: Nevertheless, as social communicator Edison Pérez (@edyelrojo) mentions, Correa added: “We defend the freedom of expression of all Ecuadorians and not only of certain groups”.
swa: Hata hivyo, kama mtaalamu wa mawasiliano ya umma Edison Pérez (@edyelrojo) alivyosema, Correa aliongeza: “Tutautetea uhuru wa kujieleza wa wananchi wote wa Ekuado na sio makundi fulani fulani pekee”.

eng: Five Yemenis convicted of murder and robbery were executed in Saudi Arabia and their bodies displayed in public in the southwestern town of Jizan.
swa: Watu Watano wa Yemeni waliokuwa wametiwa hatiani kwa mauaji na ujambazi walinyongwa kwa kukatwa vichwa vyao nchini Saudia Arabia na miili yao kutundikwa hadharani katika mji wa Jizan ulio kusini magharibi mwa nchi hiyo.

eng: The beheadings of the men, who were reportedly members of a gang, bring Saudi Arabia's total number of executions this year to 47.
swa: Kunyongwa kwa watu hao, waliosemekana kuwa sehemu ya genge la majambazi, limefanya idadi ya watu walionyongwa nchini humu mwaka huu kufikia 47.

eng: Murder, armed robbery, drug trafficking, rape, and apostasy are capital offenses under the kingdom's Muslim Sharia law.
swa: Mauaji, ujambazi wa kutumia silaha, usafirishaji wa madawa ya kulevya, ubakaji, na kufuru za kidini ni makosa yanayoongoza chini ya sharia ya dini inayotumika katika nchi hiyo ya Kiislamu.

eng: Yemen also has the death penalty and ranks sixth in the world when it comes number of executions, according to Amnesty International.
swa: Nchi ya Yemen pia inayo hukumu ya kifo na inashikilia nafasi ya sita duniani kwa idadi ya hukumu hizo, kwa mujibu wa shirika la kutetea haki za binadamu la Amnesty International.

eng: Saudi Arabia ranks fourth, behind China, Iran, and Iraq.
swa: Saudi Arabia iko kwenye nafasi ya nne, nyuma ya China, Iran na Iraq.

eng: The United States ranks fifth.
swa: Marekani ni ya tano.

eng: Photos of the five corpses hanging from a rope high in the air tied to two cranes circulated on Twitter and Facebook on May 21, 2013 to the outrage of many users, including many Yemenis who were disturbed and enraged by the images of their executed countrymen.
swa: Picha za miili ya watu watano ikining'inia kwenye kamba juu ikiwa imefungwa kwenye winchi zilisambazwa kwenye mitandao ya twitter na facebook tarehe 21, 2013 zikiwasikitisha watumiaji wengi, ikiwa ni pamoja na raia wa Yemeni walioogopeshwa na kukerwa na picha za miili ya raia wenzao.

Mamlaka za Saudi Arabia mara kwa mara zimekiuka viwango vya kimataifa vinavyoongoza mashitaka ya haki na kuhakikisha usalama wa watuhumiwa, ambao mara nyingi wananyimwa haki ya kuwakilishwa na wanasheria wala haki ya kujulishwa mwenendo wa mashitaka yanayowakabili.

eng: Benjamin Roger for Jeune Afrique reports that 18 soldiers, one civilian and four terrorists were killed early morning in an suicide car bombing in Agadez, Niger on May 23.
swa: Benjamin Roger wa Jeune Afrique anaripoti kuwa wanajeshi 18, raia mmoja na magaidi wanne waliuawa mapema subuhi ya leo katika shambulio la mabomu ya kujitoa Muhanga kwenye gari mjini Agadez, Niger tarehe 23 Mei.

eng: He adds that military school students are currently being held hostages by another attacker following the bombing.
swa: Anaongeza kuwa wanafunzi wa chuo cha kijeshi wametekwa na gaidi mwingine kufuatia mabomu hayo.

eng: Simultaneously, another car exploded in an uranium mine exploited by the Areva Group in Arlit, Niger.
swa: Wakati huo huo, gari jingine lilipuka kwenye mgodi wa madini ya Uraniam unaomilikiwana Kampuni ya Areva Group mjini Arlit, Niger.

eng: The militant group MOJWA has claimed responsibility for both terror attacks.
swa: Kikundi cha kijeshi cha MOJWA kimedai kuhusika na mashambulio hayo mawili.
