eng: Those were the reasons given by the human rights activist, Benilde Nhalivilo, to give up candidacy for a seat on the National Elections Commission of Mozambique, a body responsible for overseeing elections in the country.
swa: Hizo zilikuwa baadhi ya sababu zilizotolewa na mwanaharakati wa haki za binadamu, Benilde Nhalivilo, wakati akijitoa rasmi kugombea nafasi kwenye Tume ya Taifa ya Uchaguzi ya Msumbiji, chombo kinachohusika na kuandaa na kusimamia chaguzi nchini humo.

eng: Information on the A Verdade newspaper.
swa: Taarifa zaidi zinapatikana kwenye gazeti la A Verdade .

eng: Mkhuseli "Khusta" Jack is from South Africa and Oscar Olivera is from Bolivia; they come from different continents but they share one common story: they both challenged injustice and won.
swa: Mkhuseli "Khusta" Jack anatoka Afrika ya Kusini na Oscar Olivera anatoka Bolivia; wote wawili wametoka katika mabara tofauti lakini wanayo historia inayofanana: wote wawili walipambana na dhuluma na wakashinda.

eng: In 1985, Khusta helped end racial apartheid by organizing a consumer boycott in Port Elizabeth, South Africa.
swa: Mwaka 1985, Khusta alisaidia kuukomesha ubaguzi wa rangi kwa kuandaa na mgomo wa kununua bidhaa za makaburu mjini Port Elizabeth, Afrika Kusini.

eng: Fifteen years later, in 2000, Olivera played a key role in a resistance movement that stopped the privatization of water in Cochabamba, Bolivia.
swa: Miaka kumi na mitano baadae, mwaka 2000, Olivera alihusika kwa kiasi kikubwa katika vuguvugu la upinzani lililomaliza jaribio la ubinafsishaji wa maji mjini Cochabamba, Bolivia.

eng: These two struggles, years and continents apart, are a testimony of the power of strategic organizing and non-violent civil resistance.
swa: Jitihada hizi mbili, zilizotokea kwa tofauti kubwa ya miaka na katika mabara tofauti, ni ushahidi wa nguvu ya maandalizi ya kimkakati na upinzani wa kiraia usiotegemea matumizi ya vurugu.

eng: This year, Khusta and Olivera met in Mexico at the School of Authentic Journalism.
swa: Mwaka huu, Khusta na Olivera walikutana nchini Mexico katika Shule ya Uandishi wa Weledi.

eng: A group of scholars and professors from the school produced a video with their stories, which was recently released by Narco News TV.
swa: Kundi la wanazuoni na maprofesa kutoka katika shule hiyo waliandaa video yenye masimulizi ya watu hawa, ambayo ilizinduliwa hivi karibuni na kituo cha televisheni kiitwacho Narco News TV.

eng: Lawyer and human rights advocate Rumbidzai Dube, who helped produce the video, adds more detail about the two struggles:
swa: Mwanasheria na mtetezi wa haki za binadamu Rumbidzai Dube, aliyesaidia kuandaa video hiyo, anaongeza taarifa zaidi kuhusu jitihada hizo mbili za watu wawili:

eng: Young and energetic, Khusta led an economic boycott of downtown white-owned businesses in Port Elizabeth to leverage black people’s demands for better treatment -humane treatment by the apartheid government of South Africa.
swa: Akiwa kijana na mwenye nguvu, Khusta aliandaa mgomo wa kiuchumi dhidi ya biashara zinazomilikiwa na makaburu kushinikiza madai ya watu weusi ya kuheshimiwa -kuheshimiwa utu wao na serikali ya makuburu wa Afrika Kusini.

eng: In the dizzying heights of Cochabamba, Bolivia, in 2000, Oscar Olivera together with others waged a popular resistance that came to be known as the Cochabamba Water Wars- a struggle against the privatisation of Bolivia’s water; including its rain water.
swa: Katika milima Cochabamba, Bolivia, mwaka 2000, Oscar Olivera akishirikiana na wengine walianzisha vuguvugu maarufu la upinzani lililokuja kufahamika kama Vita ya Maji Cochabamba -Mapambano dhidi ya hatua ya Bolvia kubinafsisha maji; ikiwa ni pamoja na maji ya mvua.

eng: She concludes:
swa: Anahitimisha:

eng: Both men mobilised, they rallied their people to take a stand, they stood their ground.
swa: Watu hawa wawili walihamasisha, waliwakusanya watu wao kuwa na msimamo, walisimamia walichokiamini.

eng: They took a risk; their activities were daring, after all they were dealing with life and death matters.
swa: Walihatarisha maisha yao; Mapambano yao yalikuwa ni uthubutu, ukizingatia ukweli kuwa walikuwa wanashughulika na masuala ya kufa na kupona.

eng: But what choice did they have?
swa: Lakini je walikuwa na uchaguzi gani mwingine?

eng: Was a life without water a choice?
swa: Je, maisha bila maji ndilo lingekuwa chaguo lao?

eng: Was a life without freedom, dignity and justice a choice?
swa: Je, maisha bila uhuru, heshima na haki lingekuwa chaguo?

eng: And so they sacrificed; not only their time and energy but their lives; and they both won.
swa: Na ni kwa sababu hiyo walijitolea maisha yao, si tu muda wao na nguvu zao bali maisha yao; na wote wawili wakashinda.

eng: Journalist Arzu Geybulla also met Khusta and Olivera.
swa: Mwandishi wa Habari Arzu Geybulla pia alikutana na Khusta na Olivera.

eng: She writes in her blog that both men are "inspirational just like their story."
swa: Anaandika katika blogu yake kwamba watu hawa "wanatia hamasa kama ilivyo hadithi ya mafanikio yao."

eng: Mexican blog Hazme el Chingado Favor posted a short commentary encouraging their readers to share the video:
swa: Blogu ya ki-Mexico Hazme el Chingado Favor ilitundika uchambuzi mfupi kuwahamasisha wasomaji wake kuisambaza video hiyo:

eng: This video is not a comedy like the others we've done, but we believe in its message so much that we are motivated to share it with the world and would like to ask for your support in spreading it.
swa: Video hii si ucheshi kama wengine walivyodhani, bali tunaamini sana katika ujumbe wake kiasi kwamba tunahamasishwa kuisambaza duniani kote na tungependa kuomba mtuunge mkono katika kuisambaza.

eng: The theme of the video is self-explanatory.
swa: Maudhui ya video hii yanajieleza yenyewe.

eng: In early April, three MPs from the opposition political force “Svoboda” registered a bill that would ban abortions in Ukraine.
swa: Mapema mwezi Aprili, wabunge watatu toka katika kambi ya Upinzani iitwayo “Svoboda” waliandikisha mswada utakaozuia utoaji mimba nchini Ukraine.

eng: The only exceptions foreseen in the proposal included cases when the pregnancy threatened a woman’s life, when a fetus had grave pathologies, and when the pregnancy was proven to have resulted from rape.
swa: Mambo pekee ambayo hayakujumuishwa kabisa katika mswada huu ni pamoja na mazingira ambayo mimba inahatarisha maisha ya mama mjamzito, ugonjwa uliothibitishwa kuwa mtoto hatapona na ujauzito uliothibitika kuwa ulitokana na kubakwa.

eng: This initiative comes only a year since the Ukrainian lawmakers’ last attempt to ban abortions.
swa: Hatua hii inakuja mwaka mmoja tu tangu Bunge la Ukraine lilipojaribu na kushindwa kuzuia utoaji mimba.

eng: In the explanatory note to the bill, the authors of the proposal justified the need for such restrictions with the following arguments :
swa: Katika taarifa ya kufafanua mswada huo, watunzi wa mswada huo walitetea ulazima wa kupitishwa sheria hiyo kwa hoja zifuatazo :

eng: Despite the declining tendency, the level of abortions in Ukraine remains among the highest in Europe and amounts to 21.1 abortions per 1,000 women of childbearing age; 45.8 abortions per 100 pregnancies or 84 abortions per 100 births.
swa: Pamoja na kupungua kwa tabia hii, kiwango cha utoaji mimba nchini Ukraine bado kinaendelea kuwa kikubwa kabisa miongoni mwa nchi za Ulaya kwani mimba zilizotolewa zilifikia 21.1 kwa kila wanawake 1000 waliofikia umri wa kuweza kuzaa, mimba zilizotolewa ni 45.8 kati ya mimba 100 au mimba zilizotolewa 84 kati ya watoto 100 waliozaliwa.

eng: It must be noted, that the following fact was not taken into consideration: according to a series of scientific medical researches, a child that is being aborted experiences the same level of suffering as a grown up person who is being tortured to death.
swa: Ifahamike kwamba uhalisia ufuatao haukutiliwa maanani: kwa mujibu wa tafiti mbalimbali za kitabibu, mimba inapotolewa, mtoto huwa anapata maumivu sawasawa na ya mtoto aliyezaliwa kawaida na akakuzwa halafu akateswa hadi kufa.

eng: Moreover, abortions have negative consequences on the psychological and physical health of all those involved.
swa: Zaidi, utoaji mimba una madhara ya afya ya kisaikolojia na kimwili kwa wote waliohusika.

eng: In most of Ukraine, the number of deaths is nearly three times the number of births.
swa: Kwa maeneo mengi ya Ukraine, idadi ya vifo vya watu ni karibu mara tatu ya idadi ya watu wanaozaliwa.

eng: During the last 20 years, the population of Ukraine has decreased by 5 million people (from 52 to 47 million).
swa: Kwa kipindi cha miaka 20 iliyopita, sensa ya watu nchini Ukraine ilionyesha kupungua kwa watu milioni tano (kutoka watu milioni 52 hadi milioni 47).

eng: If such demographic dynamics persist, in a few years immigrants, mostly from Asia, would constitute the majority of the Ukrainian people.
swa: Kama kutakuwa na mabadiliko ya kitakwimu ya aina hii, kwa miaka michache ijayo, wahamiaji, hususani kutoka bara la Asia, wataongezeka kwa kiwango kikubwa kabisa katika nchi ya Ukraine.

eng: One of the major reasons behind such discontenting demographic tendencies is the legality of abortions.
swa: Moja ya sababu kuu ya uwepo wa hali hii ya takwimu isiyoridhisha ni kuhalalishwa kwa vitendo vya utoaji mimba.

eng: The lawmakers also stressed the negative attitude toward abortions shared by all Christian churches of Ukraine.
swa: Wabunge hao pia walitilia mkazo mtazamo hasi dhidi ya utoaji mimba unaofanana kwa makanisa yote ya Kikristo nchini Ukraine

eng: The proposal has proven quite controversial and sparked active discussions both online and offline.
swa: Mswada huu umeleta mkanganyiko mkubwa kiasi cha kuibua mijadala mikali katika mitandao ya intaneti na uraiani.

eng: Many commentators immediately focused on the issue of proving the occurrence of rape in court.
swa: Watoa maoni wengi, kwa haraka walijadili suala la kuthibitisha mahakamani kuwa mwanamke kabakwa au la.

eng: Reporters of a major Ukrainian TV channel, TSN, noted that only 10 percent of rape charges become court cases and asked Olexandr Sych, one of the bill’s authors, what a woman should do if she became pregnant but failed to prove the fact of rape.
swa: Wanahabari wa kituo kikuu cha televisheni cha Ukraine, TSN, walitanabaisha kuwa, asilimia 10 tu ya makosa ya ubakaji yanafunguliwa mashitaka mahakamani na walimuuliza ndugu Olexandr Sych ambaye ni miongoni mwa waandishi wa mswada huu kuwa, mwanamke angefanyeje kama alipata ujauzito lakini akashindwa kuthibitisha kuwa alibakwa?

eng: The MP replied :
swa: Mbunge huyo alijibu :

eng: I do not work in the law enforcement and do not know what a woman can or cannot prove… But first of all, should lead such a lifestyle as to not be exposed to the risk of rape.
swa: Sifanyi kazi katika vyombo vya kusimamia sheria na sifahamu kile anachoweza au asichoweza kukithibitisha… lakini kabla ya yote, mwanamke ni lazima ajiepushe na aina ya maisha itakayompelekea kubakwa.

eng: In particular, drinking alcohol beverages in a questionable company.
swa: Kiuhalisia, mwanamke hapaswi kunywa pombe iliyotengenezwa na makampuni yasiyoeleweka.

eng: This excerpt was widely circulated online and discussed on Facebook by regular users, journalists and activists.
swa: Maelezo haya yalisambazwa mtandaoni kwa kiwango kikubwa na kujadiliwa na watumiaji wakuu wa mtandao katika mtandao wa facebook, wakiwemo Wanahabari na wanaharakati.

eng: User Serhiy Masliuchenko wrote :
swa: Mtumiaji wa Facebook Serhiy Masliuchenko aliandika :

eng: This law is yet another attempt of the state and the bureaucrats to interfere with an individual’s life… when lack brains to do something about the economy, science, education, ecology, invent laws like this one
swa: Sheria hii ni jaribio jingine tena la serikali na ni ukiritimba wa kuingilia maisha ya mtu….. wanapokosa maarifa ya kufanya jambo fulani linalohusu uchumi, sayansi, elimu, elimu ya uhusiamo wa viumbe, ndipo wanapoanzisha sheria kama hizi.

eng: User Vasyl Martyuk disagreed :
swa: Mtumiaji wa Facebook Vasyl Martyuk alikuwa na mawazo tofauti :

eng: I do not consider “Svoboda” to be a cure-for-all, but I support this bill!
swa: Sichukulii Upinzani kuwa kinga kwa wote, lakini ninauunga mkono mswada huu.

eng: Ukraine as one of the leaders in the number of abortions – this is terrible!
swa: Nchi ya Ukraine ikiwa ni miongoni mwa nchi zilizo na idadi kubwa ya matukio ya utoaji mimba- hali inasikitisha!

eng: Facebook user Andrey Anthony wrote :
swa: Mtumiaji wa facebook, Andrey Anthony aliandika :

eng: Before proposing such laws should restore the order in the country.
swa: Kabla ya kupendekeza sheria kama hizi, ni lazima kwanza uhakikishe nchi ipo katika hali ya utulivu.

eng: How can you propose such initiatives in a state where there aren’t even any roads, no rule of law, and endless corruption around?
swa: Inawezekanaje kupendekeza hatua kama hiyo katika nchi ambayo haina barabara yoyote, hakuna utawala wa sheria, na rushwa isiyo na kikomo?

eng: User Elena Bondarenko wrote :
swa: Mtumiaji mwingine wa facebook, Elena Bondarenko aliandika :

eng: another opportunity for gynecologists to underground abortions!!!
swa: Hii ni nafasi nyingine kwa wataalamu wa magonjwa ya uzazi kwa wanawake kuneemeka kupitia utoaji mimba wa kificho.

eng: Are there too few newborns found in dumpsters? Too few in ?
swa: Je, ni idadi ndogo sana ya watoto wachanga wanaokutwa majalalani?

eng: IDIOTS!!
swa: WAPUMBAVU!!

eng: Create social and economic conditions for parenthood, not restrictions!!!
swa: Andaa mazingira mazuri ya kijamii na kiuchumi kwa ajili ya malezi na siyo kukataza!!!

eng: User Marianna Goncharova commented :
swa: Mtumiaji wa Facebook Marianna Goncharova alitoa maoni yake :

eng: This is one of those cases where gender-sensitive approach is needed.
swa: Hili ni miongoni mwa matukio ambayo umakini wa usawa wa kijinsia lazima uzingatiwe.

eng: Why is this issue being raised by men?
swa: Kwa nini jambo hili linaibuliwa na kushadadiwa na wanaume?

eng: User Vitaliy Diachenko mocked the proposal :
swa: Mtumiaji mwingine, Vitaliy Diachenko aliudhihaki mswada huu:

eng: Svoboda should adopt another law where their members are prohibited from having sex, unless they obtain a written document certifying that the sole intention behind this sexual act is .
swa: Kambi ya Upinzani yapaswa kupitisha sheria nyingine ya kuwazuia wanachama wake kufanya mapenzi, hadi hapo watakapopewa hati ya maandishi ya kuthibitisha kuwa nia ya dhati ya tendo la kujamiana ni kwa ajili ya kuzaa watoto tu.

eng: User Yevgeniy Ikhelzon wondered why so little public reaction followed the introduction of the bill:
swa: Yevgeniy Ikhelzon alishangazwa na mwitikio mdogo wa watu kufuatilia mswada huu:

eng: paradox, people who resent Muslims making women wear headscarves, calmly accept deputies attempting to ban abortions .
swa: Watu ambao ziku za hivi karibuni walisababisha wanawake wa kiislam kuanza kuvaa hijabu, kwa upole kabisa wanapokea hatua ya wabunge ya kutaka kupiga marufuku utoaji mimba..

eng: Journalist Iryna Slavinska criticized the proposal :
swa: Mwandishi wa habari, Iryna Slavinska aliukosoa mswada huu :

eng: to fight the high numbers of unwanted pregnancies, sex education should be introduced in schools and there must be places where condoms and oral contraceptives are disseminated free of charge, instead of putting a ban on abortions.
swa: Kukabiliana na idadi kubwa ya mimba zisizo tarajiwa na elimu ya maswala ya uzazi haina budi kuanzishwa mashuleni na ni lazima kuwe na maeneo maalum ambayo kondomu pamoja na dawa za uzazi wa mpango zitakuwa zinatolewa bila malipo badala ya kukataza utoaji wa mimba.

eng: Many users addressed the moral and ethical aspects of abortions.
swa: Watumiaji wengi wa mtandao walizungumzia utoaji wa mimba wakihusisha na kanuni na taratibu za kimaadili.

eng: In particular, such a discussion took place on the Facebook page of a physician and activist Evgeny Komarovsky.
swa: Kulikuwepo na mjadala wa aina hii katika ukurasa wa facebook wa Mwanafizikia na Mwanaharakati ajulikanaye kwa jin la Evgeny Komarovsky.

eng: User Yulia Zheleznova wrote :
swa: Mtumiaji wa mtandao wa Facebook, Yulia Zheleznova aliandika :

eng: Those commenting here, unfortunately, have not convinced me otherwise, but only strengthened my previously held convictions.
swa: Hao wanaotoa maoni yao hapa, kwa bahati mbaya, hawajaweza kubadilisha mtizamo wangu, bali wameendelea kuimarisha msimamo wangu niliokuwa nao toka awali.

eng: Regrettably, in our modern society there are so many women who do not consider not only the morals aspects of abortions, but even the elementary of their own health.
swa: Kwa kukiri, kwa kizazi cha sasa, wapo wanawake wengi ambao sio tu kuwa hawazingatii mambo ya kimaadili, bali pia hawazingatii mambo muhimu ya msingi kuhusiana na afya zao.

eng: There are no arguments to justify murder.
swa: Hakuna maelezo yoyote ya kuthibitisha mauaji.

eng: Full stop.
swa: Hakuna la zaidi.

eng: Adding to the same discussion, user Olga Shandra wrote :
swa: Akiongezea katika mjadala huo huo, Olga Shandra aliandika :

eng: I think abortion is a choice of every individual woman, her moral and ethical principles, and definitely not the MPs, psychologists, public moralizers and so on.
swa: Ninafikiri kuwa, kutoa mimba ni chaguo la kila mwanamke kwa kuzingatia kanuni na taratibu zake za kimaadili, na kwa hakika kabisa, siyo swala la wabunge, wanasaikolojia, walimu wa maadili na wengineo.

eng: User Enela Adonieva wrote :
swa: Mtumiaji wa mtandao, Enela Adonieva aliandika :

eng: I am against abortions.
swa: Ninapinga kabisa utoaji wa mimba.

eng: But a woman should have a choice. And it is not to be made by politicians.
swa: Lakini mwanamke lazima awe na maamuzi ambayo hayataingiliwa na wanasiasa.

eng: Currently, abortions in Ukraine are legal until the 12th week of pregnancy (the 22nd week in emergency cases).
swa: Kwa hivi sasa, utoaji mimba nchini Ukraine unaruhusiwa kwa mimba iliyo na hadi juma la 12 (na hata juma la 22 katika mazingira ya dharura).

eng: Ukraine is one of the leading countries in Europe in the annual number of abortions, although there is a clear downward tendency.
swa: Nchi hii ni miongoni mwa nchi za ulaya zinazoongoza kwa kuwa na idadi kubwa ya utoaji mimba kwa mwaka, pamoja na kuwa kuna dalili dhahiri za kupungua kwa matukio ya utoaji mimba.

eng: “Abortion tourism” from the neighboring countries where the laws are more restrictive, such as Poland, has also been documented.
swa: Pamekuwepo na aina mpya ya utalii unaoitwa "utalii wa kutoa mimba" kutoka katika nchi jirani ambapo sheria za kuzuia utoaji mimba zimekuwa kali zaidi sana, kama vile Poland, na zimeandikwa.

eng: Photo of the clashes, uploaded by Abo Bakr Ahmado on his Facebook
swa: Picha ya mapigano, iliyowekwa na Abo Bakr Ahmado kwenye ukurasa wake wa Facebook

eng: On the morning of Tuesday, May 28, 2013, thousands of workers, who are paid their wages for their work on a day to day basis, started a major protest in Zouérat, the capital of Tiris Zemmour state in north of Mauritania, demanding proper contracts and rights as well as ending the monopoly of businessmen over the Arab Mining Company (ARMICO).
swa: Siku ya Jumanne asubuhi, Mei 28, 2013, maelfu ya vibarua, wanaolipwa ujira wao kwa kufanya kazi kwa siku, walianzisha maandamano makubwa huko Zouérat, mji mkuu wa jimbo la Tiris Zemmour kasikazini mwa Mauritania, wakidai mikataba inayoeleweka na haki zao nyinginezo ikiwa ni pamoja na kumalizwa kwa ukiritimba wa wafanyabiashara kwenye makampuni ya machimbo ya madini katika nchi za Kiarabu (ARMICO).

eng: The workers headed to the administrative headquarters of the state before anti-riot units suppressed the protest. The workers retaliated by occupying the state building, the premises of one of the contractor companies, as well as the state radio buildings.
swa: Wafanyakazii hao waliandamana kuelekea kwenye makao makuu ya utawala wa jimbo hilo, majengo ya mmoja wapo wa makampuni ya wakandarasi, pamoja na majengo ya kituo cha redio ya taifa.

eng: The army intervened to control the situation and stop the workers protests.
swa: Jeshi liliingilia kati kudhibiti hali hiyo na kuyatawanya maandamano hayo.

eng: Activist Magdy Ahmed tweeted about the escape of the governor of Tiris Zemmour after the workers protests :
swa: Mwanaharakati Magdy Ahmed alitwiti kuhusu kutoroka kwa gavana wa Tiris Zemmour baada ya wafanyakazi kuandamana :

eng: @mejdmr: The governor, Ould Bahia, the deputy governor and the police ran away after witnessing the one-day workers anger when they occupied that governorate and state radio headquarters.
swa: @mejdmr: Gavana, Ould Bahia, naibu gavana na polisi walikimbia baada ya kushuhudia hasira ya wafanyakazi hao kwa siku moja walipovamia ofisi ya gavana na kituo cha redio ya taifa.

eng: Update: Here is the full list of the 49 candidates for the presidential elections.
swa: Habari Mpya: Hapa ni orodha kamili ya wagombea 49 wanaowania nafasi ya Urais katika uchauzi ujao.

eng: It does not include the current president of the transition.
swa: Orodha hiyo haina jina la rais wa sasa wa mpito.

eng: As the deadline to submit candidacies for the Malagasy presidential elections ends today (28/04), a few surprising candidates have allegedly come forth.
swa: Siku ya mwisho ya kurudisha fomu kwa ajili ya kugombea Urais katika uchaguzi ujao ilikuwa tarehe 28 Aprili, na inavyoonekana ni wagombea wachache sana wasiotarajiwa wamejitokea kuwania kiti hicho.

eng: While the earlier candidates were relatively new to the general public, a few prominent political players from the past are expected to contest: former president Didier Ratsiraka, current president of the transition Andry Rajoelina and the spouse of former president Ravalomanana, Lalao Ravalomanana.
swa: Wakati wagombea wa awali walikuwa wapya kabisa wasiofahamika sana, wanasiasa wachache machachari wanaofahamika wanatarajiwa kugombea akiwemo rais wa zamani Didier Ratsiraka, rais wa sasa wa mpito Andry Rajoelina na mke wa rais wa zamani Ravalomanana, anayeitwa Lalao Ravalomanana.

eng: One of the purest and most sacred holidays in Bulgaria!
swa: Mojawapo ya likizo safi na takatifu zaidi nchini Bulgaria!

eng: It's a celebration that makes us proud to have given something to the world!
swa: Ni sherehe itupayo fahari ya kuwa tumetoa kitu chochote duniani!

eng: It's a holiday which is not related to any rebels, battles or violence, although it fills us with patriotism and joy.
swa: Ni likizo isiyohusiana na waasi wowote, vita, wala vurugu, ingawa hutujaza uzalendo na furaha.

eng: When you walk on the streets, foreign signs and directions, they far exceed our domestic ones.
swa: Unapotembea katika mitaa, mabango ya ugenini na maelekezo, yanazidi haya tuliyonayo kwetu kwa mbali sana

eng: Noting with sadness about the ever-increasing use of the Latin script in Bulgaria, blogger Stranniche writes about The Day of the Bulgarian Education, Culture and Alphabet, a national holiday commemorating Saints Cyril and Methodius, to whom the creation of the oldest known Slavic alphabet - the Glagolitic alphabet - is attributed.
swa: Akibainisha kwa huzuni juu ya kuongezeka kwa matumizi ya miandiko ya Kilatini nchini Bulgaria, mwanablogu Stranniche anaandika kuhusu Siku ya Utamaduni, Elimu na Alfabeti za Kibulgeria, maadhimisho ya kitaifa kukumbuka Watakatifu Cyril na Methodius, ambao wanakumbukwa kwa kuunda alfabeti kongwe za Kislavoni ziitwazo -alfabeti za Glagoliti.

eng: On this day, too, the third International Bulgarian Studies Congress began, bringing nearly 500 scholars from 34 countries to the University of Sofia.
swa: Katika siku hii, pia, Kongamano la kimataifa la Tatu la Kibulgeria lilianza, likikusanya wasomi karibu 500 kutoka nchi 34 kwenye Chuo Kikuu cha Sofia.

eng: An article published at mongabay.com exposes the destructive environment impact of mining in remote Indonesian towns.Some scholars fear that "parts of Indonesia now have the highest levels of mercury contamination on earth."
swa: Makala iliyochapishwa katika mtandao wa mongabay.com imefichua athari za uharibifu wa kimazingira ziazotokana na shughuli za uchimbaji madini katika maeneo ya vijiji nchini Indonesia. Baadhi ya wanazuoni wanahofia kwamba maeneo mengi nchini Indonesia yana kiwango cha juu kabisa cha zebaki duniani.

eng: Security considerations are being cited as reasons behind new regulations which could put an end to the use of popular services such as Skype, WhatsApp, Viber and Tango in Bahrain.
swa: Sababu za Kiusalama zinatajwa kuwa kigezo kilichosababisha kanuni mpya zinazoweza kuhitimisha matumizi ya huduma maarufu za Skype, WhatsApp, Viber na Tango nchini Bahrain.

eng: Newspapers quoted Minister of State for Communication Fawaz bin Mohammed Al Khalifa as saying new regulations were being introduced for Voice Over Internet Protocol (VoIP) applications, which have become popular across the Gulf region, with millions of users exchanging news, views, photographs, and trivial jokes daily, as well as making free calls and connecting with friends and family.
swa: Magazeti yalimnukuu Waziri wa Nchi anayeshughulikia Mawasiliano Fawaz bin Mohammed Al Khalifa akisema sheria mpya zilikuwa zinaanza kutumika kudhibiti zama tumizi za sauti mtandaoni (Voice Over Internet Protocol), ambazo zimekuwa maarufu sana katika eneo la Ghuba ya Uarabuni, zikitumiwa na mamilioni ya watu wanaobadilishana habari, maoni, picha na ucheshi kila siku ikiwa ni pamoja na kupiga simu na kukutana na marafiki na familia.

eng: Al Khalifa is quoted as saying:
swa: Al Khalifa ananukuliwa akisema:

eng: The measures are meant to guarantee there is no clash with traditions and customs in addition to security considerations.
swa: Hatua hizi zinakusudiwa kuhakikisha kuwa hakuna mwingiliano usiofaa wa mila na desturi ikiwa ni pamoja na tahadhari za kiusalama.

eng: They are part of the efforts exerted by the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) to ensure the existence of regulations that preserve the rights of operators and that there is no abuse of communication applications.”
swa: Ni sehemu ya jitihada zilizochukuliwa na Baraza la Ushirikiano wa Ghuba ya Uarabuni (GCC) kuhakikisha uwepo wa sheria zinazolinda haki za watoaji huduma na kwamba hakuna matumizi mabaya ya zana hizi za mawasiliano.”

eng: He said the move was to protect the country's communication sector, adding that a study showed that "100,000 people in Bahrain had used VoIP applications in four days."
swa: Alisema hatua hiyo inakusudiwa kulinda sekta ya mawasiliano nchini humo, akiongeza kuwa utafiti umeonyesha kuwa "watu laki moja nchini Bahrain wametumia zana hizo za mawasiliano ya sauti katika kipindi cha siku nne."

eng: Bahrain seems to be taking the cue from Saudi Arabia, which has already banned the use of Viber in the Kingdom.
swa: Bahrain inaonekana kuiiga Saudi Arabia, ambayo tayari imepiga marufuku matumizi ya huduma ya Viber katika nchi hiyo ya kifalme.

eng: Saudi Arabia blocked the instant messaging application on June 5, 2013, after it threatened to block encrypted communication software, unless it was allowed to spy on users.
swa: Saudi Arabia imezuia huduma ya kutuma ujumbe wa moja kwa moja tangu tarehe 5 Juni, 2013, baada ya kutishia kuzuia zana za kimawasiliano, ikiwa isingeruhusiwa kuwapeleleza watumiaji wa huduma hiyo.

eng: Other services the Saudi authorities are threatening to block include Skype and mobile messaging service WhatsApp.
swa: Huduma nyingine ambazo serikali ya Saudi Arabia inatishia kuzizuia ni pamoja na Skype na hduma ya kutumiana ujumbe wa simu za mkono iitwayo WhatsApp.

eng: According to @Comms_BH, a verified Twitter account, which describes itself as the official account of the Ministry of State for Communications:
swa: Kwa mujibu wa @Comms_BH, akaunti ya mtandao wa twita iliyohakikiwa, inayojieleza kuwa ni ya Wizara ya Ndani inayoshughulikia Mawasiliano:

eng: @CommsBH: Minister: MoSC is conducting a research study for the purpose of setting up controls over the usage of (VoIP) technology. #Bahrain
swa: @CommsBH: Waziri: Wizara inafanya utafiti kwa lengo la kutengeneza udhibiti wa matumizi ya teknolojia ya mawasiliano ya sauti. #Bahrain

eng: @CommsBH: The procedures comes in order to prevent any breaching of observable moral values and traditions as well as for security considerations.
swa: @CommsBH: Hatua hizo zinakuja kwa ajili ya kuzuia uvunjaji wa tunu za maadili na utamaduni pamoja na sababu za usalama.

eng: @CommsBH: Legislations and regulations aim to ensure the protection of data and boost the security of international calls and telecom networks.
swa: @CommsBH: Sheria na kanuni zinakusudiwa kuhakikisha usalama wa takwimu za kimtandao na kuimarisha usalama wa simu za kimataifa na mitandao ya simu.

eng: Online, netizens expressed dismay at the news.
swa: Mtandaoni, watumiaji wa mtandao walionyesha mshangao wao kwa habari hizo.

eng: Ahmedroid asks:
swa: Ahmedroid nauliza:

eng: @albosta: Shall we kiss free VOiP goodbye #bahrain #skype #asterisk #previousTweet #viber
swa: @albosta: Je, tujiandae kuaga huduma za mawasiliano ya sauti kama #bahrain #skype #asterisk #Twiti iliyopita #viber

eng: And Rasha Yousif adds:
swa: Na Rasha Yousif anaongeza:

eng: @RshRsho: If @Comms_BH blocks viber, tango or Skype I’m burning tires #Bahrain
swa: @RshRsho: Kama @Comms_BH (Wizara) inazuia huduma za viber, tango au Skype ninachoma matairi #Bahrain

eng: Burning tyres and blocking roads is a popular sign of protest in restive Bahrain, which has been witnessing almost daily protests since February 14, 2011.
swa: Kuchoma matairi na kuweka vizuizi barabarani ni ishara maarufu za kupinga kitu nchini Bahrain, nchini ambayo imekuwa ikishuhudia maandamano karibu kila siku tangu Februari 14, 2011.

eng: On March 12, the World Day Against Cyber-Censorship, Reporters Without Borders named Bahrain as one of five state Enemies of the Internet - "spy states that conduct systematic online surveillance that results in serious human rights violations."
swa: Mnamo Machi 12, Siku ya Dunia Kupinga Upelelezi wa Mtandaoni, shirika la Waandishi Wasio na Mipaka (Reporters Without Borders) liliitaja Bahrain kama moja ya nchi tano Maadui wa mtandao wa intaneti -"nchi zinazoingilia mawasiliano ya watu mtandaoni na kusababisha kuvunjwa kwa haki za binadamu."

eng: The other four are Syria, China, Iran and Vietnam.
swa: Nchi nyingine nne ni Syria, China, Iran na Vietnam.

eng: Lavish Budget but poor plan?
swa: Bajeti ya kifahari lakini mpango duni?

eng: An ordinary citizen posts comments and analysis on the recent Bangladesh budget for the financial year 2013-2014.
swa: Raia wa kawaida anatoa maoni na kuichambua bajeti ya hivi karibuni ya Bangladesh kwa mwaka wa fedha 2013-2014.

eng: Xinhua News reported that 124 Chinese allegedly involved in illegal gold mining were arrested and detained in Ghana.
swa: Shirika la Habari la Xinhua limeripoti kwamba raia 124 wa Kichina waliodaiwa kushiriki katika uchimbaji wa madini haramu ya dhahabu walikamatwa na kuwekwa kizuizini nchini Ghana.

eng: Nationalists demanded the Chinese government to protect and avenge its citizens.
swa: Serikali ya China imetakiwa kulinda na kuwatetea raia wake.

eng: On the other hand, more reflective comments criticized the discrimination against African people in Chinese gold mining business in Ghana.
swa: Kwa upande mwingine, maoni yaliyotokana na tukio hilo yaliukosoa unyanyasaji unaofanywa dhidi ya watu wa Afrika katika biashara ya madini ya dhahabu inayosimamiwa na China nchini Ghana.

eng: Offbeat China has the details.
swa: Mtandao wa China offbeat unayo maelezo ya kina.

eng: Leila Hall blogs about the first-ever gay parade in Lesotho:
swa: Leila Hall anablogu kuhusu gwaride la kwanza la mashoga kuwahi fanyika nchini Lesotho:

eng: The event has been organised by MATRIX Support Group – a Lesotho-based NGO working to advocate for the rights of lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and intersex (LGBTI) individuals in the country.
swa: Tukio hilo limeandaliwa na Kikundi cha Kutoa msaada cha MATRIX- Shirika lisilo la kiserikali la Lesotho- linatetea haki za watu kama wasagaji, mashoga, wenye hisia za mapenzi kwa jinsia zote mbili, Wanaogeuza jinsia nchini humo.

eng: The organisation, which only received legal recognition in 2010, is – like this year’s parade – the first of its kind in Lesotho.
swa: Shirika hilo, ambalo lilitambuliwa kisheria mwaka 2010, kama lilivyo gwaride la mwaka huu ni shirika la kwanza la aina yake nchini Lesotho.

eng: Patrick Rajoelina argues that by law, if the president of the transition Andry Rajoelina still wants to run for the upcoming presidential elections in Madagascar, he can no longer be president, according to the road map signed by all Malagasy political parties in 2011.
swa: Patrick Rajoelina anahoji kisheria, ikiwa rais wa mpito Andry Rajoelina bado anataka kugombea katika uchaguzi ujao wa raia nchini Madagaska, basi hatakuwa na sifa tena za kuwa rais, kwa mujibu wa makubaliano yaliyotiwa saini na vyama vyote vya nchi hiyo mwaka 2011.

eng: The current prime minister Beriziky stated on 30/05 that Andry Rajoelina is no longer eligible to seat at the government meetings because he should have already resigned from his position.
swa: Waziri Mkuu wa sasa Beriziky alitoa tamko tarehe 30 Mei kwamba Andry Rajoelina hana sifa tena ya kuendelea kushiriki vikao vya serikali kwa sababu alipaswa tayari awe ameshajiuzulu nafasi yake.

eng: Several netizens tweeted about the second presidential debate and made laugh of candidates.
swa: Raia wa mtandaoni kadhaa walitwiti kuhusu mjadala wa pili wa rais na waliwakejeli wagombea.

eng: Potkin Azarmehr tweeted "Pres Candidates may be asked to play musical chairs next."
swa: Potkin Azarmehr alitwiti "Wagombea urais wanaweza kuombwa kucheza muziki."

eng: A protest organized by three groups affiliated with the Israeli social justice movement (#j14) was held in Jerusalem on Saturday night (June 8).
swa: Maandamano yaliyoandaliwa na vikundi vitatu vinavyohusiana na Vuguvugu la Israel la haki ya kijamii (#j14) yalifanyika jijini Yerusalemu mnamo Jumamosi usiku (Juni 8).

eng: The protesters demanded a reversal of the decision to export most of Israel's natural gas reserves with only 12.5% of the value of the gas going to the State in taxes.
swa: Waandamanaji walidai kubatilishwa kwa uamuzi wa kuuza zaidi kiasi kikubwa cha hifadhi ya gesi wakati ni asilimia 12.5 tu ya mapato hayo yatakwenda serikalini kama kodi.

eng: The protesters also voiced objections against the budget of the new government, which is expected to significantly raise taxes on Israel's lower and middle-class, while at the same time cutting government services on which those classes rely.
swa: Waandamanaji pia walionyesha upinzani wao dhidi ya bajeti ya serikali mpya, ambayo inatarajiwa kwa kiasi kikubwa kuongeza kodi kwa wa-Israeli wa tabaka la chini na la kati, na wakati huo huo ikikata huduma za serikali ambazo matabaka hayo hutegemea.

eng: The protest, despite being peaceful and rather small (a few hundreds of protesters) was met with an unusually high level of random police brutality.
swa: Maandamano hayo, licha ya kuwa na amani na kuwa na madogo (yakiwa na mamia kadhaa tu ya waandamanaji) yalikumbana na kiwango cha juu kabisa cha ukatili wa polisi usio wa kawaida.

eng: Leftist activist Ben Marmara tweeted a series of updates throughout the protest:
swa: Mwanaharakati wa mrengo wa kushoto Ben Marmara alitwiti mfululizo wakati wote wa maandamano:

eng: Policemen are beating up women, they should be jailed.
swa: Polisi wanawapiga wanawake, wanapaswa kufungwa jela.Kuna idadi ya wafungwa wa kike na wa kiume mjini Yerusalemu.

eng: There are a number of female and male detainees in Jerusalem. #j14 Police keep arresting people and piling them into police vans.
swa: Polisi wanaendelea kuwakamata watu na kuwajaza katika magari yao yapolisi.

eng: Just like the protest in Ramat Gan , once again, the police broke the law and forcefully prevented a protest.
swa: Kama yalivyokuwa maandamano ya Ramat Gan , kwa mara nyingine tena, polisi walivunja sheria na kutumia nguvu kuzuia maandamano.

eng: Then they arrested protesters.
swa: Kisha wakawatia mbaroni waandamanaji.

eng: Jerusalem-based #j14 activist, Yishai Oltchik, posted this update on Facebook:
swa: Mwanaharakati wa #j14 anayeishi Yerusalemu, Yishai Oltchik, alibandika andiko hili kwenye mtandao wa Facebook:

eng: So today I can mark the first time when a cop kicked me.
swa: Kwa hiyo leo naweza kuweka kumbukumbuku kwa mara ya kwanza kwa askari kunipiga mateke.

eng: Attacked me, I mean.
swa: Alinishambulia, Namaanisha.

eng: Why?
swa: Kwa nini?

eng: Simply because I stood with a sign calling the Knesset to hold hearings regarding the export of natural gas....
swa: Kwa sababu tu mimi nilisimama na bango la kutoa wito kwa Knesset kusikiliza zaidi maoni ya watu kuhusu kuuzwa kwa gesi asilia nje ya nchi...

eng: I did not talk to the cop... did not look at him directly.
swa: Mimi sikuzungumza na askari ... na sikumwangalia moja kwa moja.

eng: I did not even film him, which is legal but usually ends in assault .
swa: Sikuweza hata kumpiga picha ya video, kitu ambacho hata hivyo si kosa kisheria lakini kwa kawaida huishia kwa kushambuliwa .

eng: I just stood there and then he arrived, forcefully pushed the girl who held the sign with me (throwing her on her back), and on the way, kicked me....
swa: Mimi nilisimama tu pale na kisha yeye akaja, akamsukuma kwa nguvu msichana aliyeshika bango na mimi (akamsukuma aangukie mgongo), na akifanya hayo, alinipiga mateke na mimi ....

eng: I went to a nearby police officer and told him that the cop kicked me for no reason; he just smiled and kept walking.
swa: Nilikwenda kwa afisa wa polisi aliyekuwa karibu na kumwambia kwamba askari amenipiga teke bila sababu; polisi akatabasamu tu akiendelea kutembea.

eng: The thing that makes me so angry is knowing that this is not something out of the ordinary.
swa: Kitu ambacho kinanifanya kuwa na hasira ni kujua kwamba hili silo jambo lisilo la kawaida.

eng: I saw at least 10 other people being pushed and kicked by policemen, and one or two violent arrests.
swa: Nilioona si chini ya watu wengine 10 wakisukumwa na kupigwa mateke na polisi, na mmoja au wawili wakikamatwa vurugu.

eng: Tel Aviv-based #j14 activist Orly Bar-Lev posted this image on Facebook and wrote:
swa: Mwanaharakati wa Tel Aviv wa #j14 Orly Bar-Law alibandika picha hii kwenye mtandao wa Facebook na akaandika:

eng: Right to left: "Bibi - stop the economic terrorism!Orly in the center: "Export of gas = suicide for the state" and "No to the cut in child stipends"
swa: Kulia hadi kushoto: "Bibi - Zuia ugaidi wa kiuchumi!Orly katikati: "Uuzaji wa gesi nje = kujiua kwa serikali" na "Tunapinga kukatwa kwa mafao ya mtoto"

eng: Hundreds of law-abiding and peaceful concerned citizens who came to protest against the austerity measures, the economic situation and the export of gas were met with violent and completely disproportional police treatment.
swa: Mamia ya raia wanaouguswa na hatua za kubana matumizi zinazopangwa kuchukuliwa na serikali wenye kutii sheria bila vurugu, walioamua kupinga mpango huo pamoja na hali mbaya ya kiuchumi na hatua za kuuza gesi nje walikumbana na hatua mbaya za vurugu zisizolingana zilizofanywa na polisi.

eng: Policemen on horses???
swa: Polisi kupanda farasi??

eng: Beating up women???
swa: Wakiwapiga wanawake??

eng: A protester who was run over by a cop on a motorcycle???
swa: Mwandamanaji ambaye alikanyagwa na kupitiwa juu yake na askari anayeendesha pikipiki??

eng: What is wrong with you?
swa: Mna shida gani nyie watu?

eng: Who gave the order to stop this protest violently and repress the right to protest?
swa: Ni nani aliyewapa amri ya kuzuia haya maandamano kwa ukatili na kukandamiza haki ya kuandamana?

eng: Who gave the order to stop a democratic rally from reaching the home of the Prime Minister?
swa: Ni nani mbaye alitoa amri ili kuzuia mkutano wa hadhara wa kidemokrasia kutofikia nyumba ya Waziri Mkuu?

eng: Who is responsible for this madness?
swa: Ni nani aanayehusika na ukichaa huu?

eng: Andrea Radu re-posted Orly's update and added:
swa: Andrea Radu alipandika tena andiko la Orly na kuongeza:

eng: In the only democracy in the Middle east, peaceful protesters get run over, beaten and arrested because they attempted to exercise their democratic right to protest.
swa: Katika nchi pekee ya kidemokrasia katika eneo la Mashariki ya Kati, waandamanaji wa amani wanakanyagwa, wanapigwa na kukamatwa kwa sababu walijaribu kutumia haki yao ya kidemokrasia ya kuandamana.

eng: Policemen riding horses surround #j14 protesters near the Prime Minister's residency in JerusalemPhoto: #j14 activist Gali Fialkow
swa: Polisi wanaoendesha farasi wakiwazingira waandamanaji wa #j14 karibu na makaazi ya Waziri Mkuu jijini YerusalemuPicha: Mwanaharakati wa #j14 Gali Fialkow

eng: The protest and police brutality did not receive a great deal of coverage and Israeli media and activists complained about biased reporting.
swa: Maandamano na ukatili wa polisi hayakugonga vichwa vya habari za vyombo vya habari vya Israel na wanaharakati walilalamikia habari kutangazwa kiupendeleo.

eng: Naminag who was at the protest tweeted:
swa: Naminag ambaye alikuwa katika maandamano alitwiti:

eng: Ynet says that policemen used "reasonable force".
swa: Ynet anasema kwamba polisi wa walimumia "nguvu sawia".

eng: Really?
swa: Kweli?

eng: Because I saw a protester being pushed down a flight of stairs and rolling down, a policemen who ran over a protester with his motorcycle and a policemen wearing a helmet who headbutted a protester.
swa: Sababu niliona mwandamanaji akisukumwa chini ya ngazi kadhaa na kubingirita chini, polisi aliyemkanyaga mwandamanaji kwa pikipiki yake na polisi ambaye alikuwa amevaa kofia aliyempiga kichwa mwandamanaji.

eng: And all of this before we even marched 100 meters.
swa: Na yote haya yalifanyika kabla hata ya kutembea mita 100.

eng: The National Gallery of Jamaica Blog is excited about an upcoming exhibition of children's art, which will highlight "the children’s unique responses to questions about their curiosities and the diverse urges of their developing imaginations."
swa: Blogu ya Maonyesho ya Sanaa ya Taifa Nchini Jamaika inayo msisimko kuhusu maonyesho yajayo ya sanaa ya watoto, ambayo yataonyesha "mwitikio wa pekee wa watoto kwa maswali kuhusu udadisi wao na msukumo wa aina tofauti wa ubunifu unaokua."

eng: Is Italy ready for an African-born government minister?, Donata Columbro asks:
swa: Je, Italia iko tayari kwa Waziri wa Serikalki aliyezaliwa Afrika?, Donata Columbro anauliza:

eng: Two months after the recent elections, Italy has a new government.
swa: Miezi miwili baada ya uchaguzi wa hivi karibuni, Italia ina serikali mpya.

eng: And Cécile Kyenge, 48 years old, an eye surgeon and Congo-born Italian citizen, is the new Minister for Integration in the cabinet of Prime Minister Enrico Letta.
swa: Na Cécile Kyenge, mwenye umri wa miaka 48, daktari wa upasuaji macho na raia wa Italia aliyezaliwa Kongo, ni Waziri mpya wa Ushirikiano katika baraza la mawaziri la Waziri Mkuu Enrico Letta.

eng: iMoney.my creates an infographic about bankruptcies in Malaysia.
swa: iMoney.my wametengeneza mchoro unaoelezea takwimu za kufilisika nchini Malaysia.

eng: Almost 20,000 bankruptcy cases were recorded in 2012 or about 53 Malaysians who went bankrupt everyday.
swa: Wastani wa matukio 20,000 ya kufilisika yamerekodiwa mwaka 2012 hiyo na maana kwamba wa-Malaysia 53 wanafilisika kila siku.

eng: Who's next for Liquidation? - a poster at today's journalist protest in Skopje, referring to the official code name of the operation ("Liquidation"), in which journalist Tomislav Kezarovski was captured along with others on May 28.
swa: Nani anayefuata kufilisiwa? - bango katika maandamano ya leo ya wandishi wa habari mjini Skopje, akimaanisha jina la kificho kwa mpango unaoendelea ("Kufilisi"), ambapo mwandishi wa habari Kezarovski Tomislav alikamatwa pamoja na watu wengine mnamo Mei 28.

eng: Photo by Biserka Velkovska/@bvelkovska, used with permission.
swa: Picha kwa hisani ya Biserka Velkovska/@bvelkovska, imetumiwa kwa ruhusa.

eng: Macedonian journalists gathered in front of the Criminal Court in the capital Skopje today to protest against the arrest of their colleague, Tomislav Kezarovski, according to this note posted in the Macedonian Facebook group titled "Journalists and citizens in defense of the right to freedom of information."
swa: Waandishi wa habari wa Kimasedonia walikusanyika mbele ya Mahakama ya Makosa ya Jinai hivi leo katika mji mkuu Skopje kupinga kukamatwa kwa mwenzao, Tomislav Kezarovski, kwa mujibu wa maandishi haya yaliyoandikwa katika ukurasa wa kundi la Kimasedonia kwenye mtandao wa Facebook yaliyopewa kichwa cha habari cha "Waandishi wa habari na wananchi katika kutetea haki ya uhuru wa habari."

eng: It appears that the official reason for Kezarovski's 30-day detention is a story he wrote five years ago for a publication that no longer exists.
swa: Inaonekana kwamba sababu rasmi ya kutiwa kizuizini kwa Kezarovski kwa siku 30 ni habari aliyoiandika miaka mitano iliyopita kwa ajili ya jarida ambalo halipo tena.

eng: On the other hand, he has been investigating the death of Nikola Mladenov, publisher and editor of an independent media outlet, for the past two months.
swa: Kwa upande mwingine, amekuwa akichunguza kifo cha Nikola Mladenov, mchapishaji na mhariri wa kampuni huru ya habari, kwa miezi miwili iliyopita.

eng: Although the official cause of Mladenov's death is a "classic traffic accident," much remains unclear in the case.
swa: Ingawa sababu rasmi ya kifo cha Mladenov ni "ajali ya barabarani," mengi hayajulikani katika tukio hilo.

eng: Kezarovski wrote an article about Mladenov's last hours, based on the evidence found by the Nova Makedonija daily's team, revealing that after the police left the heavily-guarded crime scene, much evidence was left there, including paid toll bills and parts of the vehicle.
swa: Kezarovski aliandika makala kuhusu masaa ya mwisho mwisho ya Mladenov, akitumia ushahidi uliogunduliwa na waandishi wa gazeti la kila siku liitwalo Nova Makedonija, kubainisha kuwa baada ya polisi kuondoka katika eneo hilo la tukio lililokuwa linalindwa isivyo kawaida, ushahidi mwingi uliachwa huko, ikiwa ni pamoja na risiti ya kulipa ushuru wa maegesho na sehemu za gari hilo.

eng: Small groups of Saudi women held simultaneous "Sit-ins for Freedom" across Saudi cities on June 10, 2013, which were called for by anonymous advocacy group @almonaseron to call for release of their imprisoned relatives.
swa: Makundi madogo ya wanawake wa Saudi Arabia, kwa wakati mmoja waliitisha “maandamano ya kudai uhuru” katika maeneo mbalimbali ya majiji ya Saudi Arabia mnamo Juni 10, 2013. Maandamano hayo yaliratibiwa na kikundi kisichofahamika cha mawakili @almonaseron , lengo likiwa ni kushinikiza kuachiwa huru kwa ndugu zao waliofungwa gerezani.

eng: As a result, over 140 protesters, men and women, were arrested by Saudi forces during the previous two days.
swa: Matokeo yake ni kuwa, kwa kipindi cha siku mbili zilizopita, zaidi ya waandamanaji 140, wanawake kwa wanaume walitiwa nguvuni na maofisa wa polisi wa Saudi Arabia.

eng: At 4.55pm, local time, @almonaseron announced the beginning of the sit-in and tweeted :
swa: Majira ya saa10:55 jioni, @almonaseron alitangaza kuanza kwa maandamano, na alitwiti :

eng: @almonaseron: The Sit-in for Freedom just started: women from different areas simultaneously.
swa: @almonaseron: mikutano kwa ajili ya kudai uhuru imeanza hivi punde: wanawake katika maeneo mbalimbali wanakutana kwa wakati mmoja.

eng: Detainees' relatives should join them right now.
swa: Ndugu wa watu wanaoshikiliwa, hawana budi kuungana nao haraka iwezekanavyo.

eng: In Riyadh, a group of women, several of whom were relatives of Suliman al-Roushodi, head of the Saudi Civil and Political Rights Association, gathered in front of the government-funded National Society for Human Rights, where they had protested back in February.
swa: Huko Riyadh, kikundi cha wanawake, baadhi yao wakiwa ni miongoni mwa ndugu wa Suliman al-Roushodi, ambaye ni kiongozi wa Jumuia ya Haki za Kisiasa na Kiraia ya Saudi Arabia, walikusanyika mbele ya jengo la Utaifa na Haki za Binadamu lenye ufadhili wa serikali, mahalipofanyia maandamano mapema mwezi Februari .

eng: One of the protesters was his daughter, Bahia al-Roushodi, who was given a suspended four-month prison sentence after that earlier sit-in.
swa: Miongoni mwa waandamanaji hao, alikuwapo mtoto wa Bahia al-Roushodi, ambaye alihukumiwa kifungo cha miezi minne mara baada ya maandamano hayo.

eng: They were quickly surrounded by over 30 police cars , and their driver was arrested and they were prohibited from leaving.
swa: Haukupita muda, walizingirwa na zaidi ya magari 30 ya polisi , na na kisha dereva wao kutiwa nguvuni na wote walizuiwa kuondoka.

eng: One of Riyadh's main roads, King Fahad Road, was closed by police during rush hour to crackdown on the sit-in.
swa: Moja ya barabara kuu za jiji la Riyadh, Barabara ya Mfalme Fahad, ilifungwa na polisi wakati wa pilika pilika nyingi ili kuweza kukabiliana na mikutano ya waandamanaji.

eng: At 6.20pm, one of the protesters, al-Roushodi's wife, tweeted:
swa: Mnamo saa 12:20 jioni, mmoja wa waandamanaji, ambaye ni mke wa, al-Roushodi, alitwiti:

eng: @omamar1: They arrested us, and they arrested my brother.
swa: @omamar1: walitutia nguvuni, na pia walimtia nguvuni kaka yangu.

eng: Relatives of the arrested women protesters gathered in front of the prison where they were reportedly held.
swa: ndugu wa waandamanaji wanawake waliokamatwa wakiwa wamekusanyika mbele ya gereza lililotaarifiwa kuwa ndiko walikokuwa wameshikiliwa.

eng: Photograph shared by @fatma_mesned on Twitter
swa: Picha imewekwa na @fatma_mesned katika ukurasa wa Twita

eng: At 11.44pm, relatives of the arrested women protesters gathered in front of the prison where they were reportedly held. al-Roushodi's granddaughter, Fatima al-Mesned tweeted:
swa: Mnamo saa 5:44 usiku, ndugu wa waandamanaji wanawake waliokamatwa wakiwa wamekusanyika mbele ya gereza lililotaarifiwa kuwa ndiko walikokuwa wameshikiliwa, mjukuu wa kike wa al-Roushodi, Fatima al-Mesned alitwiti:

eng: @fatma_mesned: For those who want to demand the protesters: We are now in front of al-Malez prison, the female section.
swa: @fatma_mesned: kwa wale wanaoshinikiza kuachiwa huru kwa waandamanaji: kwa sasa tupo mbele ya gereza la al-Malez, upande wa wanawake.

eng: Support those who supported our prisoners.
swa: Waunge mkono wale waliowaunga mkono wenzetu waliofungwa jela.

eng: @almonaseron: Women were just forced to ride the buses.
swa: @almonaseron: wanawake walilazimishwa kuendesha mabasi ya polisi.

eng: The following day, June 11, at 5pm, a group of men and women gathered to protest the previous day's arrests.
swa: Siku iliyofuata, Juni 11, saa 11 jioni, kundi lililokuwa na wanaume na wanawake lilikusanyika kupinga kukamatwa kwa waandamanaji kulikotokea siku iliyotangulia.

eng: Within minutes, they were surrounded by emergency forces , beaten and arrested.
swa: Ndani ya dakika kadhaa, walizingirwa na maafisa usalama wa dharura , beaten na kisha kukamatwa.

eng: Other small gathers were held in Mecca, Aljouf and Hial.
swa: Mikusanyiko mingine midogo ilifanyika huko Mecca, Aljouf na Hial.

eng: Tite Yokossi unpacks a poll by the Zinsou Foundation that asked the citizens of Benin what are their main concerns today .
swa: Tite Yokossi anafunua matokeo ya kura ya maoni iliyoendeshwa na Mfuko wa Zinsou ambao uliwauliza wananchi wa Benin ni yapi ndiyo matatizo yao makuu leo .

eng: The first concern listed was the low purchasing power of public servants.
swa: Tatizo la kwanza lililoorodheshwa lilikuwa uwezo mdogo wa kufanya manunuzi miongoni mwa watumishi wa umma.

eng: The other main concerns are access to education, access to clean water, health care and electricity, civil protection and aid for farmers.
swa: Mengineyo ni uwezekano wa kupata fursa ya elimu, huduma ya maji safi, huduma za afya na umeme, ulinzi wa raia na misaada kwa wakulima.

eng: Cairo..The city of a thousand pillars?
swa: Cairo..Jiji la nguzo elfu?

eng: Photograph from CairoObserver Facebook page.
swa: Picha kutoka kwenye ukurasa wa Facebook wa CairoObserver.

eng: The red lines show buildings which obscure the minerats of mosques which is a signature of the Cairo horizon being lost to new development
swa: Mistari myekundu ikionyesha majengo ambayo huziba minara ya misikiti ambayo ni alama muhimu ya jiji la Cairo inayopotea kwa ujenzi mpya unaondelea.

eng: Cairobserver calls people in Egypt through Facebook and Twitter to demonstrate in front of governorate buildings, who are responsible for managing the city, across Egypt to call for an end to destroying and deforming historical cities.
swa: Cairoobserver atoa wito kwa wakaazi wa Misri kupitia mtandao wa Facebook na Twita kufanya maandamano mbele ya majengo ya serikali, yanayohusika na mipango miji, kote nchini Misri kudai kusitishwa kwa kuharibiwa na kupotezwa kwa sura halisi ya kihistoria katika miji.

eng: The city of a thousand minarets is now the city of a thousand pillars!
swa: Jiji lenye minara elfu sasa ni jiji lenye nguzo elfu!

eng: The historical city that was listed as a world heritage site in the 70s is now facing demolition and changing all its characteristics and officials are dealing with it as if it is an out of control informal city
swa: Mji wa kihistoria ambao uliorodheshwa kama urithi wa dunia katika miaka ya 70 sasa unakabiliwa na uharibifu na kubadilika kila sifa yake na viongozi wanaishughulikia hali hii kama jiji lisilo rasmi lisilodhibitika tena

eng: Join us on Wednesday 19 June, 2013, at 5pm (Cairo local time) in Abdin sq. in front of Cairo governorate
swa: Jiunge nasi Jumatano Juni 19, 2013, saa 05:00 ( Masaa ya Cairo) katika Maandamano mbele ya ofisi la Gavana wa Cairo

eng: The sentencing of 43 Egyptian and foreign employees in non-governmental organisations to jail terms of up to five years, has sparked anger on social media networks - and on the ground.
swa: Kuhukumiwa kwa wafanyakazi 43 wa Misri na kigeni katika mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali na kifungo jela cha hadi miaka mitano, kumeibua hasira kwenye mitandao ya kijamii - na sehemu nyinginezo.

eng: The move is seen as a warning for human rights organisations, and those promoting democracy.
swa: Hatua hiyo inaonekana kama onyo kwa mashirika yanayotetea haki za binadamu, na yale yanayokuza demokrasia.

eng: Egyptian blogger Zeinobia explains:
swa: Mwanablogu wa Misri Zeinobia anaelezea:

eng: It is just sad because NGOs played an extremely important role in Egypt when it comes to development and foreign funding played a role in this.
swa: Inasikitisha mno kwa sababu mashirika haya yamekuwa na nafasi muhimu sana nchini Misri linakuja suala la maendeleo na misaada ya wafadhili ilichangia sana katika hili.

eng: What is even more sadder is how the Egyptian NGOs workers and employees are being punished in this way.
swa: Cha kusikitisha zaidi ni jinsi wafanyakazi wa mashirika haya wanavyoadhibiwa namna hii.

eng: Those Egyptian women and men may not find a job in Egypt easily when they are officially convicted in a political case like this.
swa: Wanawake na wanaume hao wa ki-Misri, hawataweza kupata kazi kirahisi nchini Misri wanapokuwa na hatia katika kesi ya kisiasa kama hii.

eng: Of course the world is not stupid , it understands what happened and is happening.
swa: Bila shaka ulimwengu hauna ujinga, unaelewa nini kilichotokea na kinachoendelea.

eng: It happened before with TV channels like Orbit, Dream TV and Al Jazeera Mubshar Misr.
swa: Imeshawahi kutokea awali kwa vituo vya televisheni kama Orbit, Dream TV na Al Jazeera Mubshar Misr.

eng: Of course it is worth to mention that the Muslim brotherhood is walking on the same path like Mubarak regime and SCAF.
swa: Kwa kweli ni sahihi kusema chama cha Muslim Brotherhood kinafuata nyayo za serikali ya Mubarak na SCAF.

eng: This is another setback to human rights in Egypt and actually it will not encourage people to come to the country or invest in it.
swa: Hiki ni kikwazo kingine kwa haki za binadamu nchini Misri na kwa kweli hakitahamasisha watu kuja nchini au kuwekeza.

eng: I believe this verdict will also be a setback in the relation between the United States and the Muslim brotherhood as well EU and the Muslim brotherhood.
swa: Naamini uamuzi huu utakuwa kikwazo katika uhusiano kati ya Marekani na chama cha Muslim Brotherhood na pia kati ya Umoja wa Ulaya na Muslim Brotherhood.

eng: On Twitter, netizens reacted with shock.
swa: Kwenye mtandao wa Twita, raia wa mtandaoni walipokea habari hizi kwa mshtuko.

eng: Sally Sami tweets:
swa: Sally Sami alitwiti:

eng: @Salamander: In utter shock of the #NGOtrial verdict!!
swa: @Salamander: Kwa mshtuko mkubwa juu ya uamuzi #kesiyaNGO!!

eng: No one should be imprisoned simply for working for an NGO ... #NGO #ngocrackdown
swa: Hakuna mtu anastahili kufungwa kwa kufanya kazi na NGO ...

eng: Lina El Wardani comments:
swa: Lina El Wardani alitoa maoni:

eng: @linawardani: Shocked & terrified by the #NGOtrial verdict 11 sentenced to 1 year suspended 5 to two years and 27 5 years in absentia, 4 NGOs closed
swa: @linawardani: Nimestushwa una kuogopeshwa sana na uamuzi wa #kesiyaNGO watu 11 kuhukumiwa mwaka 1, wengine watano miaka miwili, 27 miaka 5, na kama vile haitoshi mashirika manne yakifungwa

eng: Bel Trew notes:
swa: Bel Trew alitoa maelezo:

eng: @Beltrew: #NGO trial was spear-headed by a Mubarak-era minister under #SCAF rule, individuals were on trial NOT organisations for being unregistered
swa: @Beltrew: #Kesi za mashirika haya zilioongozwa na waziri wa enzi za utawala wa Mubarak chini ya utawala #SCAF, ni watu walikuwa wanashitakiwa na sio mashirika kwa kile kinachoitwa kutosajiliwa

eng: And Mona Eltahawy adds:
swa: And Mona Eltahawy anaongezea:

eng: @monaeltahawy: "Justice" in #Egypt: jail time for defendants in politically motivated #ngotrial, acquittals for regime figures/police who killed protesters
swa: @monaeltahawy: "Haki" nchini #Misri: kifungo jela kwa washitakiwa katika mashitaka ya mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali yaliyosukumwa na mambo ya siasa, wakati vigogo wa utawala huo pamoja na polisi wakionekana hawana hatia kwa kuwaua waandamanaji

eng: Ghada Shahbender laments :
swa: Ghada Shahbender analalamika:

eng: @ghadasha: The real tragedy is that 99 per cent of Egyptians will accept the ruling to jail the NGO employees and will be happy for curtailing "foreign interference", which is being promoted
swa: @ghadasha: Janga halisi ni kwamba asilimia 99 ya Wamisri watakubali uamuzi kuwafunga jela wafanyakazi wa mashirika hayo na kuwa na furaha kwa kuzuia nchi hiyo "kuingiliwa na mataifa ya nje", jambo ambalo ndilo linachukuliwa kuwa sababu kwa sasa.

eng: @ghadasha:... by the Mubarak regime, the Supreme Council of the Armed Forces and the Muslim Brotherhood - who all get international aid and beg the international community.
swa: @ghadasha:... utawala wa Mubarak, Baraza Kuu la kijeshi na Muslim Brotherhood - ambao wote hupata misaada ya wafadhili na huomba omba kwa jumuiya ya kimataifa.

eng: They have promoted the idea of "foreign interference" and then abused it to crackdown
swa: Wao ndio wanatangaza dhana ya "kuingiliwa na wageni" na kuitumia vibaya kukandamizaji

eng: One of the defendants, Robert Becker, who was sentenced to two years and was the only foreign defendant to remain in Egypt during the trial, said he was forced into "exile" after the verdict was announced.
swa: Mmoja wa watuhumiwa, Robert Becker, ambaye alihukumiwa miaka miwili na alikuwa mshatika wa pekee wa kigeni kubaki nchini Misri wakati wa kesi, alisema alilazimishwa kwenda "uhamishoni" baada ya uamuzi kutangazwa.

eng: He tweeted:
swa: Alitwiti:

eng: @rbecker51: Safely out of #Egypt.
swa: @rbecker51: Niko salama nje ya #Misri.

eng: On my lawyers advice, I have unwillingly and angrily gone into exile until appeals get sorted out. #NGOtrial
swa: Kwa ushauri wa wanasheria wangu, nimelazimika kuikimbia nchi bila kutaka na kwa kweli nikiwa na hasira mpaka rufaa itakapotatuliwa.

eng: In two previous tweets, he explains:
swa: Katika twiti mbili za awali, anaelezea:

eng: @rbecker51: Thank you everyone for the kind words.
swa: @rbecker51: Asanteni nyote kwa maneno mazuri.

eng: Reviewing my legal/appeals options with lawyers #NGOtrial
swa: Naipitia kuona uwezekano wa kisheria/rufaa kwa msaada wa wanasheria wangu

eng: @rbecker51: #pt Maintaining my innocence on charges of starting NGO six years before I actually arrived in Egypt & waiting for appeal strategy #NGOtrial
swa: @rbecker51: Ninasisitiza sina hatia kwenye mashitaka haya ya kuanzisha NGO miaka sita kabla ya mimi kuwasili nchini Misri na kwa sasa ninasubiri mipango ya rufaa yangu

eng: Sally Sami concludes :
swa: Sally Sami anahitimisha :

eng: @Salamander: We really are entering black days .. when people are sentenced to jail just for working in NGOs
swa: @Salamander: Kweli tunaingia kwenye siku za giza.. wakati ambao watu wanafungwa jela kwa ajili tu ya kufanya kazi katika mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali

eng: For more reactions, check out the hashtags #ngocrackdown and #ngotrial.
swa: Kwa miitikio zaidi, angalia alama habari #ngocrackdown na #ngotrial.

eng: According to news reports and their own Twitter accounts, the defendants will appeal the sentence.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa taarifa za habari na akaunti zao wenyewe za mtandao wa Twita, washitakiwa watakata rufaa kupinga hukumu hiyo.

eng: Initiated in 2011, the Singapore Memory Project aims "to collect, preserve and provide access" to Singapore's history.
swa: Ukiwa umeanzishwa mwaka wa 2011, Mradi wa Kumbukumbu za Singapore unalenga "kukusanya, kuhifadhi na kuhakikishia upatikanaji" wa historia ya Singapore.

eng: Further, "it aims to build a national collection of content including print, audio and video to preserve them in digital form, and make them available for discovery and research."
swa: Zaidi ya hayo, "ina lengo la kutengeneza mkusanyiko wa maudhui ya taifa ikiwa ni pamoja na maandiko, kanda za sauti na video kwa ajili ya kuzihifadhi katika mfumo wa kidijitali, na kuzifanya zipatikane kwa ajili ya ugunduzi na utafiti."

eng: The project hopes to collect 5 million personal memories by 2015.
swa: Mradi huu unatarajia kukusanya kumbukumbu wa watu binafsi zipatazo milioni 5 ifikapo mwaka 2015.

eng: A young man was killed after he was hit by a car in Ribeirao Preto and dozens were hurt in confrontations with the police in Brasilia, Rio de Janeiro, and Salvador as more than a million people took to the streets of large and small cities throughout Brazil in the biggest protests seen in the country in two decades.
swa: Kijana mdogo aliuawa kwa kugongwa na gari huko Ribeirao Preto na dazeni ya watu kujeruhiwa wakati waandamanaji walipokabiliana na polisi hukoBrasilia, Rio de Janeiro na Salvador pale zaidi ya watu milioni moja walipojitokeza katika mitaa mbalimbali ya miji mikubwa na midogo nchini kote Brazil katika maandamano makubwa ambayo hayakuwahi kushuhudiwa kwa miongo miwili.

eng: The national force had also been deployed to Belo Horizonte and Fortaleza, the other cities hosting games in FIFA's Confederations Cup, and helped counter the protests on June 20, 2013.
swa: Maafisa wa polisi walisambazwa katika miji ya Belo Horizonte na Fortaleza, miji itayokuwa mwenyeji wa michuano ya Kombe la shirikisho la FIFA, ambayo yalisaidia kukabiliana na maandamano ya tarehe 20, Juni 2013.

eng: Despite the focus on violence, the majority of the demonstrations were peaceful.
swa: Pamoja na hali ya machafuko, maandamano mengi yalikuwa ya amani.

eng: In this second week of national protests, which began over a rise in bus fare prices, the demonstrations happened in more than 100 places despite the reduction of bus fare in many cities, including major capitals such as Rio de Janeiro and Sao Paulo, showing that “it was not just about 20 cents”.
swa: Katika wiki hii ya pili ya maandamano ya kitaifa, ambayo yalikuja kufuatia kuongezwa kwa nauli za usafiri wa umma, maandamano yalifanyika kwenye zaidi ya maeneo 100 pamoja na kupunguzwa kwa nauli katika miji mingi ikiwa ni pamoja na miji mikuu kama vile Rio de Janeiro na Sao Paulo, kuonesha kuwa “halikuwa tu suala la senti 20”.

eng: Demonstration in Rio de Janeiro.
swa: Maandamano huko Rio de Janeiro.

eng: Photo by Tomás Pinheiro (CC BY-SA 2.0)
swa: Picha na Tomás Pinheiro (CC BY-SA 2.0)

eng: A country at war?
swa: Nchi ipo vitani?

eng: Contrary to what the mainstream media has been broadcasting, some of the protesters were trying to mobilize others to go to Congress; There are two bridges/entries and one of them had a higher concentration of vandals.
swa: Tofauti na kile kilichokwisha tangazwa na vyombo vya habari vya kawaida, baadhi ya waandamanaji walijaribu kuwashawishi waandamanaji wengine ili wakusanyike pamoja; Kuna mageti mawili, na moja ya mageti hayo kulikuwa na kiasi kikubwa cha uharibifu wa mali.

eng: It turns out that we were all surprised with tear bombs and rubber bullets; One protester close was shot directly in his thigh, and had a bullet lodged until he was taken away by the fire brigate.
swa: Punde tulishangaa kuona mabomu ya machozi yakitupwa pamoja na risasi za mpira zikifyatuliwa; muandamanaji mmoja aliyekuwa karibu yangu alifyatuliwa kwenye paja lake kiasi cha risasi kubakia pajani hadi pale alipochukuliwa na askari wa kikosi cha zima moto.

eng: In Salvador, protesters faced much violence in a march that began peaceful.
swa: Huko Salvador, waandamanaji walikabiliana na machafuko katika matembezi yaliyoanza kwa amani.

eng: The demonstration turned sour when the crowd advanced towards the local stadium, where Uruguay was playing against Nigeria for the Confederations Cup.
swa: Maandamano yalibadilika na kuwa machungu pale umati mkubwa wa watu ulipokuwa unalekea Uwanja Mkuu wa Taifa, uwanja ambao timu ya taifa ya Uruguay ilipokuwa inacheza na timu ya taifa ya Nigeria katika kombe la Shirikisho la FIFA.

eng: An official local government car with plate number OKU 8877 was taped firing gun shots – according to the author of the video, Felipe Amorim , it was not rubber bullet.
swa: Gari la afisa wa polisi wa serikali ya mtaa lililokuwa na namba OKU 8877, milio ya bunduki ilirekodiwa kutoka kwenye gari hilo– kwa mujibu wa mpakiaji wa video, Felipe Amorim , haikuwa risasi ya mpira.

eng: The video has thousands of shares and comments, among which witness Berlindo Ribeiro Reis, who confirmed:
swa: Video hii inaonesha kusambazwa zaidi ya mara elfu pamoja na maelfu ya maoni, miongoni mwa maoni hayo ni ya shuhuda Berlindo Ribeiro Reis, ambaye aliweka bayana kuwa:

eng: I was there and saw it all.
swa: Nilikuwepo pale na nilishuhudia kila kitu.

eng: The police came down beating up and throwing grenades in everyone, they didn't want to know whether it was children, pregnant woman
swa: Polisi walifika na kuanza kuwapiga watu na kuwarushia watu makombora, hawakutaka kuelewa kama kulikuwa na watoto wala wanawake wajawazito

eng: In Rio de Janeiro, conflicts between police and protesters were also registered by citizen reporters.
swa: Huko Rio de Janeiro, ugomvi kati ya polisi na waandamanaji ulitolewa taarifa na wanahabari ambao ni raia.

eng: Some netizens claimed that real weapons were used against people throughout the city.
swa: Baadhi ya watumiaji wa mtandao wa intaneti walisema kuwa, silaha halisi zilitumika dhidi ya watu katika meneo mbalimbali ya jiji.

eng: Chico Freitas reported on Facebook:
swa: Chico Freitas kupitia mtandao wa Facebook aliripoti:

eng: Today, Rio was at war.
swa: Leo Rio ilikuwa vitani.

eng: One million protesters took to the streets.
swa: Waandamanaji milioni moja walijitokeza mitaani.

eng: The police attacked without sympathy, before we were even able to do any other thing besides protesting, there was no vandalism.
swa: Polisi walishambulia bila ya huruma, kabla hata ya kufanya jambo jingine lolote mbali na kuandamana, hakukuwa na uharibifu wa mali.

eng: They surrounded us at the city center.
swa: Walituzingira tukiwa katikati ya jiji.

eng: They used lethal and non-lethal weapons, they closed the metro stations and oppressed those who were trying to catch the ferry.
swa: Walitumia silaha zenye uwezo wa kuua na zile mabazo si rahisi kuua, walifunga vituo vya treni za chini ya ardhi na kuwazuia kidhalilishaji wale waliokuwa wanataka kukiwahi kivuko.

eng: They threw bombs at us, from the city hall to the Sambadrome, they trapped us at Avenida Presidente Vargas, we were able to go to Praça Tiradentes and there we saw on the TV in a bar, the riot troops were going there.
swa: Waliturushia mabomu, kutoka kwenye ukumbi wa jiji hadi kwenye Sambadrome, walituzuilia kwenye Avenida Presidente Vargas, tuliweza kufika Praça Tiradentes na tukiwa pale, tuliwaona wanajeshi wa kutuliza ghasia kupitia televisheni iliyokuwepo hapo kwenye Baa wakielekea huko.

eng: We run towards Lapa and learned they were throwing tear gas even at the children who were playing there, so we went via Avenida Chile to Cinelandia.
swa: Tulikimbia kuelekea Lapa na tulitambua kuwa walikuwa wakiwarushia mabomu ya machozi hata watoto wadogo waliokuwa wanacheza pale, kwa hiyo tulienda kwa kupitia Avenida Chile kwenda Cinelandia.

eng: There, people were gathering again in front of Municipal Theater.
swa: Mahali pale, walikusanyika tena mbele ya Uwanja wa Manispaa.

eng: Until the Riot Police’s vehicles got closer and threw bombs. I got lost from my friends.
swa: Magari ya polisi yalipokaria pale watu walipokusanyika, walianza kurusha mabomu, na hapo nilipotezana na marafiki zangu.

eng: We all run to Flamengo’s area.
swa: Sote tulikimbilia eneo la Flamengo.

eng: There, I saw a bus to Niteroi and embarked on it.
swa: Nikiwa pale, niliona gari la kuelekea Niteroi na hivyo na niliingia ndani ya gari hilo.

eng: From the bus, I saw they were throwing teargas there as well.
swa: Nikiwa ndani ya basi, niliona wakiendelea kurusha mabomu ya kutoa machozi.

eng: The police will never allow anyone to go anywhere, wherever people go, they will follow with oppression.
swa: Polisi wasingeweza kuruhusu mtu yeyote kwenda popote. Popote watu wanapotaka kwenda, polisi wangewafuata na kuwaghasi.

eng: Today, the police was more violent than ever.
swa: Leo polisi walikuwa wakatili zaidi kuliko wakati mwingine wowote.

eng: They were truculent, atrocious, they brought fear and terror.
swa: Walikuwa watu wa kutaka shari, wakatili kupita kiasi, walisababisha hali ya woga na hofu kuu.

eng: The police, that is paid to protect the people. #protestorj #ogiganteacordou #revoltadovinagre #thegiantwokeup #vemprarua #changebrazil #rio #brasil#brazil
swa: Hwa ndio polisi wanaolipwa mishahara kwa lengo la kuwalinda raia. #protestorj #ogiganteacordou #revoltadovinagre #thegiantwokeup #vemprarua #changebrazil #rio #brasil#brazil

eng: Abdulkareem al-Khadar, a founding member of the Kingdom's defiant leading human rights organisation, the Saudi Civil and Political Rights Association (ACPRA), was sentenced to eight years in prison for inciting public opinion and establishing an unlicensed human rights organization among other charges, five years of which to be suspended and applied only if the activist participates in any illegal assembly or association after his release.
swa: Abdulkareem al-Khadar, mwanafamilia ya kifalme mwanzilishi wa shirika la haki za binadamu, Chama cha ki-Saudi cha Haki za Kiraia na Kisiasa (ACPRA), alihukumiwa kifungo cha miaka nane jela kwa kosa la uchochezi na kuanzisha shirika la haki za binadamu lisilo na leseni pamoja na mashtaka mengine, katika hukumu hiyo miaka mitano itaahirishwa na kutumika tu ikiwa mwanaharakati huyo atashiriki au kuhusishwa na mkutano wowote kinyume cha sheria baada ya kuachiliwa kwake.

eng: Today's session was held in the Saudi Arabian city of Buraydah and it was attended by tens of ACPRA supporters, but the judge allowed no women, saying that "men are good enough."
swa: Shauri la leo lilifanyika katika mji wa Saudi Arabia, Buraydah na kuhudhuriwa na mamia ya wafuasi wa ACPRA, lakini hakimu hakuruhusu wanawake, akisema kuwa "wanaume wanatosha."

eng: The first hearing session in Dr. al-Khadar's trial was on February 20th, when he asked the judge to withdraw from the case because of a previous personal conflict that they had had, but the judge refused.
swa: Shauri la kwanza kusikilizwa katika kesi ya Dk al-Khadar lilifanyika mnamo Februari 20, alipomwomba hakimu kujitoa kwenye shauri hilo kwa sababu ya mgongano wa zamani wa kimaslahi aliwahi kuwanao, lakini hakimu aligoma.

eng: The same judge, Ibrahim al-Husni, previously sentenced peaceful protesters to be flogged.
swa: Hakimu huyo huyo, Ibrahim al-Husni, awali aliwahukumu waandamanaji wa amani kuchapwa viboko.

eng: Dr. al-Khadar (in the middle) before the beginning of a previous session.
swa: Dr. al-Khadar (katikati) kabla ya kuanza kwa shauri (kesi) ya awali.

eng: Image uploaded by @acprahr
swa: Picha imepakiwa mtandaoni na @acprahr

eng: Back in March, two other prominent human rights activists and co-founders of ACPRA were found guilty and sentenced to 10 and 11 years in jail for “breaking allegiance to the ruler and his successor” and “trying to impede the country’s developments”.
swa: Hapo awali mwezi Machi, wanaharakati wengine wawili mashuhuri wa haki za binadamu na waanzilishi wa ACPRA walikutwa na hatia na kuhukumiwa kifungo cha mpaka miaka 10 na 11 jela kwa "kuvunja kiapo cha utii kwa kiongozi na mrithi wake" na "kujaribu kuzorotesha maendeleo ya nchi".

eng: After today's session, al-Khadar's lawyer and ACPRA member Abdualziz al-Shubaily was held by police forces after a secret police member had accused him of "inappropriate behavior."
swa: Baada ya shauri la leo, mwanasheria wa al-Khadar na mwanachama wa ACPRA Abdualziz al-Shubaily walishikiliwa na vikosi vya polisi baada ya wapelelezi wa polisi kumtuhumu kwa "tabia zisizofaa."

eng: He was shortly released:
swa: Aliachiliwa muda mfupi baadae:

eng: @a_abdulaziz300: I was just released from the Southern Police Station after a secret police member had accused me of inappropriate behavior toward him.
swa: @a_abdulaziz300: Niliachiliwa kutoka Kituo cha Polisi cha Kusini baada ya mpelelezi wa polisi kunituhumu kwa kumwonyesha tabia zisizokubalika

eng: Following the session, Saudi Twitter users started a hashtag: (#أنا_عضو_حسم) (I am an ACPRA member), where they wrote their names to declare their full support of ACPRA's positions and demands of political reforms.
swa: Kufuatia shauri hilo, watumiaji wa mtandao wa Twita nchini Saudi walianzisha alama habari: (# أنا _ عضو _ حسم) (Mimi ni mwanachama wa ACPRA), ambapo waliandika majina yao kama hatua ya kutangaza kuunga mkono msimamo na madai ya ACPRA kuhusiana na mabadiliko ya kisiasa.

eng: The fourth protest of the Free Fare Movement, which took place this Thursday, June 13, in São Paulo was met with police repression in the form of pepper spray, rubber bullets and tear gas.
swa: Maandamano ya nne ya Harakati za Kudai Usafiri wa Bure , yaliyotokea Alhamisi ya tarehe 13 Juni huko São Paulo lilikabiliwa na upinzani kutoka kwa polisi waliokuwa wakinyunyiza maji ya pilipili, risasi za plastiki na mabomu ya machozi.

eng: According to the latest news, at least 235 people were arrested during the protests.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa habari za hivi karibuni, takribani watu 235 walikamatwa wakati wa maandamano hayo.

eng: Nearly five thousand protesters gathered in front of the Municipal Theater as part of continued protests against the bus fare increase from 3.00 BRL (1.40 USD) to 3.20 BRL (1.50 USD).
swa: Takribani waandamanaji elfu tano walikusanyika mbele ya uwanja wa Halmashauri ya Jiji kama sehemu ya maandamano yanayoendelea ya kupinga ongezeko la nauli kutoka 3.00 BRL (dola za Marekani 1.40) hadi 3.20 BRL (dola za Marekani 1.50).

eng: Protests have been ongoing since June 6 in response to the increase that was put into effect four days earlier.
swa: Maandamano yamekuwa yakiendelea tangu Juni 6 kufuatia nauli mpya zilizoanza kutumika siku nne zilizopita.

eng: The case has already gained international attention.
swa: Jambo hili tayari limeenea na yanafuatiliwa kimataifa

eng: The movement has been using a Facebook page to organize, and demonstrations have followed in other Brazilian state capitals that are also protesting fare increases for public transportation.
swa: Harakati hizi zimekuwa zikitumia ukurasa wa Facebook kuhamasisha kiasi kwamba, maandamano mengine yalifuata katika majiji mengine ya Brazil ambayo pia yanapinga ongezeko la nauli kwa usafiri wa umma.

eng: Journalists and other opinion leaders have been discussing the fare increase in the national media, while citizens have been expressing their opinions through the internet.
swa: Waandishi wa habari pamoja na viongozi wa kisiasa wamekuwa wakijadiliana kwenye vyombo vya habari vya nchini humo kuhusiana na uongezekaji wa nauli, wakati kwa upande mwingine, raia wao wamekuwa wakitoa maoni yao kupitia mtandao wa intaneti.

eng: The protesters, who suffered police brutality during the protests, were referred to as “vandals”, by Governor Geraldo Alckmin and criticized by Mayor Fernando Haddad (currently in Paris).
swa: Waandamanaji ambao wamekuwa wakikabiliana na ukatili kutoka kwa polisi wakati wa maandamano, Gavana Geraldo Alckmin aliwaita “wahuni” na Meya Fernando Haddad (ambaye kwa sasa yupo jijini Paris) alikosa vitendo vyao.

eng: Nonetheless, both the state and city governments confirmed they will maintain fare increase.
swa: Hata hivyo, serikali kuu pamoja na mamlaka za majiji walionesha msimamo wao kwa kusisitiza kutokubadili ongezeko hilo la nauli.

eng: The ethnic violence in Myanmar seems to be spreading in nearby countries.
swa: Vurugu za kikabila nchini Mynmar inaonekana kusambaa hata katika nchi za jirani.

eng: Some Myanmar Buddhist migrants in Malaysia have been attacked in recent weeks which many people believe are related to the ongoing ethnic and religious tension in Myanmar.
swa: Baadhi ya wahamiaji wa Mynmar wa jamii ya budha wanaoishi nchini Malasia wiki chache zilizopita walishambuliwa tukio ambalo wengi wanaamini kuwa tukio hilo linahusiana na mvutano wa kimakabila na kidini unaoendelea nchini Mynmar.

eng: According to Eleven Media, 6 died and 12 were hospitalized with injuries during the violent attacks against Myanmar nationals in Malaysia from May 30 to June 8.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa Eleven Media, watu 6 walifariki na wengine 12 walikimbizwa hospitalini kutoka na majeraha waliyoyapata wakati wa mashambulizi makali yaliyotokea kati ya Mei 30 na Juni 8 dhidi ya raia wa Mynamar wanaoishi nchini Malasia.

eng: Myanmar's Embassy in Malaysia initially dismissed the news which angered many Burmese netizens.
swa: Ubalozi wa Myanmar nchini Malasia mapema ilitoa habari ambazo ziliwaghadhabisha sana watumiaji wengi wa mtandao wenye utaifa wa Mynmar.

eng: Ye Htut, Myanmar's Deputy Minister of Ministry of Information clarified the report:
swa: Ye Htut, ambaye ni naibu wa Waziri katika Wizara ya Mawasiliano alifafanua taarifa hiyo:

eng: (We) read the news on the Internet about the clashes near a Myanmar monastery at KamPung and Selayang and that some Myanmar nationals died.
swa: (Sisi) tulisoma habari hiyo katika mtandao wa intaneti kuhusiana na vurugu karibu na nyumba ya watawa huko KamPung pamoja na Selayang na kwamba baadhi ya watu wa Mynmar walipoteza maisha.
