eng: I am sure that the White House is already aware that even if this whole amount was provided in a single year, and it is more likely that it will be provided over a 3 to 5 year timeframe, it will not be able to dent the $23 billion YEARLY deficit in energy investment on the continent.
swa: Nina uhakika kwamba Ikulu ya Marekani inaelewa kwamba hata kama kiasi hiki chote kitatolewa katika kipindi cha mwaka mmoja, na kuna uwezekano kwamba kitatolewa kwa kipindi cha miaka 3 mpaka 5, hakitaweza kutosheleza mahitaji ya kiasi cha dola bilioni 23 zinazohitajika kwa mwaka kuwekeza katika nishati ya umeme barani kote.

eng: Daniel McLaughling reacted to his post arguing that abolishing national monopolies on electrical utilities is the only solution capable of producing results:
swa: Daniel McLaughling alijibu makala hiyo akihoji kwamba kumaliza ukiritimba katika huduma ya umeme ndilo haswa suluhisho linaloweza kuleta matokeo yanayoeleweka:

eng: If people are serious about solving Africa’s electricity problem, they should be promoting the only solution capable of producing real results: abolish national monopolies on electric utilities.
swa: Kama hawa jamaa wanamaanisha kwa dhati kutatua tatizo la umeme barani Afrika, ni lazima wapiganie suluhisho pekee linaloweza kuleta matokeo halisi: kuachana na ukiritimba wa huduma ya umeme.

eng: It amazes me that, with all of the talk about increasing electricity production, nobody wants to admit into the discussion the possibility that government monopolies and corruption are the problem, and that billions more in money transferred to governments will only entrench the corruption further, with little benefit for the people.
swa: Inanishangaza kwamba, pamoja na mazungumzo yote kuhusu kuongeza uzalishaji wa umeme, hakuna anayetaka kukiri kuona kuwa inawezekana kabisa kuwa ukiritimba wa serikali na vitendo vya ufisadi ni tatizo, na kwamba mabilioni yanayokwenda serikalini yanakuza ufisadi tu, yakisaidia walengwa kwa kiasi kidogo sana.

eng: Open up the markets to competition and profits and you will see large-scale investments and significantly improved access.
swa: Fungueni masoko kwa ushindani na biashara za faida na mtaona uwekezaji mkubwa na matokeo yake huduma hiyo itaongezeka kuwafikia watu wengi zaidi.

eng: Joel B. Pollak was of the view that "Power Africa" will likely not produce as much energy as promised:
swa: Joel B. Pollak alikuwa na maoni kuwa Mradi wa "Nishati kwa Afrika" hautazalisha umeme mwingi kama inavyoahidiwa:

eng: Power Africa will likely not produce as much energy as promised, while lining the pockets of politically-connected individuals in both the U.S. and Africa.
swa: Mradi wa "Umeme kwa Afrika" hautazalisha umeme kwa kiasi kingi kama inavyoahidiwa, labda sana utatunisha tu mifuko ya watu wenye uhusiano na wanasiasa wa pande zote mbili, Marekani na Afrika.

eng: Meanwhile, China, which does not mind if Africans are driving cars and living in large houses with air conditioning, will continue to invest in Africa in ways that generate actual economic growth, relegating the U.S. to the sidelines in Africa's economic future.
swa: Wakati huo huo, China, ambayo haionekani kujali kama Waafrika wanaendesha magari na kuishi katika nyumba bora zenye viyoyozi, itaendelea kuwekeza barani Afrika kwa namna ambayo itakuza kweli uchumi wa Afrika, ikiishinda Marekani katika mipango yenye mustakabali bora wa kiuchumi barani Afrika.

eng: Siddhartha Mitter noted that "all infrastructure investment should be considered a good thing unless proven otherwise—especially in Africa":
swa: Siddhartha Mitter alibaini kwamba "uwekezaji katika miundo mbinu ni jambo linalopaswa kuwa jema isipokuwa ikithibitika vinginevyo - hasa Afrika":

eng: At present, continent-wide installed capacity and power generation are roughly equivalent to those of Germany or Canada.
swa: Kwa sasa, uwezo na uzalishaji wa nishati barani kote ni karibu sawa na ule wa Ujerumani na Kanada.

eng: Remove South Africa and Egypt, and you are left with about 63 GW supplying 260 billion kWh, scarcely more than Australia or Iran.
swa: Ukiondoa Afrika Kusini na Misri, unabakiwa na GW 63 zinazotoa kWh bilioni 260, zaidi kidogo ya Australia au Irani.

eng: In this context, if the first phase of Power Africa succeeds in its stated goal of adding 10 GW of generation capacity and connecting 20 million new residential and commercial customers, it will represent a major expansion—albeit not near the doubling of access that, according to the White House fact sheet on Power Africa, is the program’s ultimate aim.
swa: Katika mukhtadha huu, kama awamu ya kwanza ya mradi huu wa "Umeme kwa Afrika" itafanikiwa kufikia malengo yake ya kuongeza GW 10 za uwezo wa uzalishaj na kuwaunganisha wateja milioni 20 wa nyumbani na wa kibishara, itakuwa ni ukuaji mkubwa ambao hata hivyo haitakuwa mara dufu ambalo, kwa mjibu wa mkakati wa Ikulu ya Marekani kwa mradi huo, ndilo lengo kuu la mradi.

eng: Indeed, the same fact sheet soberly estimates that it would cost $300bn to secure universal access to power on the continent by 2030.
swa: Kwa hakika, mkakati huo huo unakadiria kwamba inagharimu dola za Marekani bilioni 300 kufikia kiwango cha kila mtu kupata huduma ya umeme barani kote ifikapo mwaka 2030.

eng: Despite the excitement shown by citizens of the three countries, Shadow Government showed that there was a low point to the trip:
swa: Pamoja na shamra shamra nyingi zilizoonyeshwa na raia wa nchi hizo tatu, blogu ya Shadow Government ilionyesha ziara hiyo haikuwa na faida yoyote kubwa:

eng: But there has been a low point to the trip: namely, his comments in South Africa during the press conference with President Jacob Zuma.
swa: Lakini pamekuwa na udhaifu katika ziara hiyo: kwa mfano, matamshi yake (Obama) akiwa Afrika Kusini wakati wa mkutano na wanahabari akiwa na Rais Jacob Zuma.

eng: The president made what I consider ill-thought-out comments, probably meant to be humorous, regarding the press.
swa: Rais huyo alitoa maoni ambayo ninayachukulia kuwa maoni yasiyofikiriwa ipasavyo, labda yalitegemewa kuishia kuwa kichekesho, kuhusu vyombo vya habari.

eng: He referred to the American press corps as "my press," and he chided them for asking too many questions.
swa: Aliwaita wanahabari wa Marekani kama "waandishi wangu," na kuwazuia kuuliza maswali mengi.

eng: Normally, perhaps, this wouldn't be a big deal.
swa: Kwa kawaida, huenda, hili lisingekuwa jambo kubwa.

eng: But in that he was visiting three African countries whose press is judged by Freedom House to be "partially free," I think it is not just bad form but harmful for his administration's support for democracy.
swa: Lakini kwa sababu alikuwa anatembelea nchi tatu za Afrika ambapo vyombo vya habari vinaonekana "kutokuwa huru," ninadhani si tu matamshi yale ni namna mbaya bali ni hatari kwa serikali yake inayojinadi kupigania demokrasia.

eng: Of course I would not expect the president to use his trip as an occasion to criticize his hosts directly.
swa: Ni kweli sitarajii rais aitumie ziara yake kama fursa ya kuwakosoa wenyeji wake moja kwa moja.

eng: But I would expect that while he, himself, is under scrutiny for his administration's treatment of the press (the AP phone records and Fox News's James Rosen), he would not make light of such matters.
swa: Lakini ningetarajia kwamba wakati huu ambapo yeye, mwenyewe, anatazamwa kwa jicho la wasiwasi namna anavyowachukulia wanahabari (masuala ya kupeleleza simu na yale ya James Rosen wa Fox News), asingeweza kulipuuza hilo.

eng: Kumekucha called Obama "snubbish Obama" for not visiting Kenya, the land of his father:
swa: Kumekucha alimwita Obama "Obama mkatili" kwa sababu ya kutokuzuru Kenya, nchi aliyozaliwa baba yake:

eng: Now that Obama has finally landed in Dar es Salaam dancing to Bongo 'Ohangla' Flava , we can finally bid him bye from without and mend our punctued national pride.
swa: Wakati huu Obama anapotua Dar es Salaam na kucheza Bongo 'Ohangla' Flava , tunaweza kujihesabu kuwa tumeshamkosa na kubaki tukimwona kama fahari yetu ya taifa iliyokosa maana.

eng: What a snubbish man to have him camp at next door neighbour with no regard to the hurt he is causing his own people who adore him so much.
swa: Mtu mwenye dharau namna gani kumwona anakesha mlango wa pili kwa jirani bila kujali maumivu anayowasababishia watu wake mwenyewe wanaomheshimu kupindukia.

eng: SHAME.
swa: AIBU.

eng: Forget all the bitterness spewed that we do not need Obama's visit.
swa: Sahau uchungu wote uliosikika kwa watu wakisema hatuhitaji kutembelewa na Obama.

eng: True, the economic side of such a visit would be realisedmuch later but boy, isn't Nairobi missing the buzz!
swa: Ni kweli, matokeo ya kiuchumi kwa ziara hiyo yangeonekana baada ya muda, lakini je, ni kweli Nairobi haikosi kitu!

eng: Obama's ICC-laced whip smacks of utmost contempt after Kibaki declared a holiday in his honour after winning the elections in 2008.
swa: Obama kusingizia kesi za ICC ni kutuumiza kulikozidi kipimo hasa baada ya Kibaki kutangaza mapumziko ya kufurahia ushindi wake katika uchaguzi mwaka 2008.

eng: What is more, the Tanzanians could afford to shame him with a street name for recognition.
swa: Zaidi, Watanzania wangeweza kumwaibisha kwa kumpa jina la mtaa kumtambua.

eng: Looking at Obama's overall contribution to Africa's development, Tolu considered Obama "positively neglectful" when comparing him to the Bush administration.
swa: Akichambua mchango wa jumla wa Obama katika maendeleo ya Afrika, Tolu alimwona Obama kama mtu "apuuziaye mambo kwa namna chanya" anapomfananisha na mtangulizi wake Bush.

eng: He explained:
swa: Alieleza:

eng: The Bush government left footprints across the continent beyond the aid arena.
swa: Serikali ya Bush imeaacha nyayo barani kote zaidi ya kutoa misaada.

eng: It played a role in the signing of the peace agreement that brought an end to decades of civil war in Sudan, showed a lot of interest in bringing an end to the wars in the Congo region, and helped bring about an end to the civil war in Liberia, helping ensure Charles Taylor’s resignation, and eventual arrest and prosecution.
swa: Serikali yake ilikuwa na nafasi muhimu katika kusainiwa kwa makubaliano ya amani yaliyomaliza miongo kadhaa ya vita vya wenyewe kwa wenyewe nchini Sudani, ilionyesha kutaka kumaliza vita katika eneo la Kongo, na ilisaidia kumaliza vita vya wenyewe kwa wenyewe nchini Liberia, ikisaidia kuhakikisha Charles Taylor anaachia madaraka, na kisha akikamatwa na kushitakiwa.

eng: (Taylor has of course since wondered aloud why Bush is himself not facing prosecution for his own “crimes”).
swa: (Taylor mwenyewe amekuwa akishangaa kwa nini Bush mwenyewe hashitakiwi kwa "uhalifu" wake).

eng: Against this background of US, Obama comes across as positively neglectful.
swa: Katika historia hii ya Marekani, Obama anaonekana kama anayepuuzia mambo kwa mtazamo chanya.

eng: His only activity of note has been to ramp up US military activity in Africa, adding drone bases and deploying significant numbers of troops.
swa: Kimoja tu alichokifanya na kikaonekana ni kuongezeka kwa vikosi vyake vya kijeshi barani Afrika, akiongeza vituo vya kijeshi, kuingiza vikosi vingi vya kijeshi kulinda amani.

eng: When he was first elected there were celebrations across the continent, and perhaps unrealistic expectations that he would champion African interests on the world stage.
swa: Alipochaguliwa kwa mara ya kwanza kulikuwa na shangwe barani kote, na huenda kwa matarajio yasiyo halisi kwamba angepigania maslahi ya Afrika katika uso wa kimataifa.

eng: Indeed on his first visit to Ghana, he declared that he had “the blood of Africa within me”.
swa: Na kwa kweli katika ziara yake ya kwanza nchini Ghana, alitangaza kuwa alikuwa na "damu ya AFrika ndani yake".

eng: Since then his absence has been keenly felt, sparking accusations that he has betrayed his roots.
swa: Tangu wakati huo umbali wake na bara hili umekuwa bayana mno, ukisababisha shutma kwamba ameisaliti asili yake.

eng: But is this fair?
swa: Lakini hii ni haki?

eng: Does Obama have a special responsibility to the continent, because of his ancestry?
swa: Je, Obama ana jukumu maalumu kwa bara hili, kwa sababu ya asili yake?

eng: Perhaps not.
swa: Huenda sivyo.

eng: Perhaps the emphasis on Obama as a black president is missing the point.
swa: Labda msisitizo kwa Obama kama rais mwenye asili ya Afrika unakosa mantiki.

eng: Because it’s not just for reasons of solidarity that the US president should attend to Africa.
swa: Kwa kuwa si kwa sababu za ushirikiano kwamba Rais wa Marekani anapaswa kulisikiliza bara la Afrika.

eng: There are more selfish reasons, both , economic and political, as well.
swa: Kuna sababu zaidi za kibinafsi, za kiuchumi na kisiasa vile vile.

eng: Being a feminist South African, Jennifer Thorpe noted that the environment she lives in affects women’s lives most tangibly.
swa: Akiwa mtetezi wa haki za wanawake wa ki-Afrika Kusini, Jennifer Thorpe alibaini kwamba mazingira anayoiishi yanaathiri sana maisha ya wanawake kwa kiasi kikubwa.

eng: She therefore looks at Obama's environmental protection track record:
swa: Kwa hiyo anaitazama "rekodi" ya Obama kwa utunzaji wa mazingira:

eng: We know the US has a poor track record environmentally — a perfect example of how legislation protecting the environment is not nearly as good as not polluting it in the first place.
swa: Tunajua Marekani ina "rekodi" mbaya kimazingira -mfano sahihi wa namna sheria zinazolinda mazingira hazina uzuri wowote kama zinavyoyaharibu mazingira hayo.

eng: Recently Obama has changed his tune, saying he’d stop dangerous and environmentally disastrous projects like the Keystone pipeline if they showed the environmental impact would be negative.
swa: Hivi karibuni Obama alibadili mtazamo wake, akisema angesitisha miradi yenye hatari kubwa kwa mazingira kama bomba la Keystone kama zingeonyesha athari mbaya za kimazingira.

eng: In South Africa, the Constitution provides the right for all of us to live in an environment that is not bad for our health.
swa: Nchini Afrika Kusini, katiba inatoa haki kwa watu wote kuishi katika mazingira yasiyo na athari za kiafya.

eng: Yet we see so often that environmental impact assessments just make sure that companies meet the bare minimum rather than actively going out of their way to protect the land and environment that belongs to all of us.
swa: Lakini bado tunaona mara nyingi tathmini za athari za mazingira zinahakikisha kuwa makampuni yanafikia angalau kiwango cha chini kabisa cha utunzaji wa mazingira na sio kuhakikisha kuwa yanatunza mazingira na ardhi tunayoimiliki sote.

eng: I hope that when President Obama evaluates the impact of Keystone on the environment, he does so in broad strokes, not in a narrowly defined minimum norms and standards type of way.
swa: Ninatarajia kwamba Rais Obama anapotathimini madhara ya Keystone kwa mazingira, anafanya hivyo kwa mtazamo mpana, na sio kwa mtazamo mwembamba wa viwango na mazoea.

eng: I think the question should be simple — will the innately valuable biodiversity, beauty, and sanctity of the land be improved by Keystone?
swa: Ninadhani swali lapaswa kuwa rahisi -je uoto wa asili, uzuri, na ardhi itaboreshwa na mradi wa Keystone?

eng: As someone who grew up in Hawaai, I know he knows the answer to this question in his heart.
swa: Kama mtu aliyekulia Hawaai, najua anajua jibu la swali hili moyoni mwake.

eng: On Twitter, BBC's Andrew Harding (@BBCAndrewH) observed:
swa: Kwenye mtandao wa twita, Andrew Harding wa BBC (@BBCAndrewH) aliona haya:

eng: @BBCAndrewH: #obama - Africa cannot just be a source of raw materials for somebody else.
swa: @BBCAndrewH: #obama - Afrika haiwezi kuwa chanzo cha bidhaa ghafi kwa mtu mwingine.

eng: Mr. Mabotja (@MelosoDrop_Line) responded to @BBCAndrewH's tweet by saying:
swa: Mr. Mabotja (@MelosoDrop_Line) alijibu twiti ya @BBCAndrewH kwa kusema:

eng: @MelosoDrop_Line: @BBCAndrewH #Obama never indicated that Africa is a raw materials shop... His indicating the shift away from that mentality
swa: @MelosoDrop_Line: @BBCAndrewH #Obama hajawahi kuonyesha kwamba Afrika ni duka la bidhaa ghafi...ameonyesha mabadiliko ya mtazamo wa jinsi hii

eng: Dayo Olopade (@madayo) wrote:
swa: Dayo Olopade (@madayo) aliandika:

eng: @madayo: The #ObamaInAfrica trip is as notable for what he's doing as for what he's not.
swa: @madayo: Zaiara ya #ObamabaraniAfrika inaonekana kwa kile inachokifanya na kile isichokifanya.

eng: Rule of law fixation leaves out the most relevant countries.
swa: Utawala wa sheria unaziacha mbali nchi nyingi ambazo zingestahili.

eng: Haru Mutasa (@harumutasa) pointed out what some Africans are asking:
swa: Haru Mutasa (@harumutasa) anaonyesha kile ambacho baadhi ya Waafrika wanauliza:

eng: @harumutasa: #obamainafrica.
swa: @harumutasa: #obamabaraniafrika.

eng: Some Africans are asking, "what has the US president done for Africa that's different from previous US leaders?"
swa: Baadhi ya Waafrika wanauliza, "kipi kilichofanywa na rais huyu wa Marekani kwa ajili ya Afrika ambacho ni tofauti na marais wengine waliopita?"

eng: Ashley Koen (@a_koen) was concerned about innocent civilians who were rounded up to "clean up the city" - it is a commons practice in most African countries when a foreign head of state, especially from Europe and USA visits, for street vendors to be removed:
swa: Ashley Koen (@a_koen) alikuwa na wasiwasi na wananchi wasiona hatia waliofukuzwa katika jitihada za "kusafisha mji" -ni shughuli ya kawaida katika nchi nyingi za Afrika wakati mkuu wa nchi ya kigeni, hasa kutoka Ulaya na Marekani anapokuja, kwa wazururaji wa mitaani kuondolewa:

eng: @a_koen: Will all those displaced businesses and innocent civilians who were thrown in jail to clean up the city get their lives back? #ObamainAfrica
swa: @a_koen: Je, biashara zilizoondolewa na wananchi wasio na hatia waliotupwa jela kwa kisingizio cha kusafisha mji wataendelea na maisha yao? #ObamabaraniAfrika

eng: Brazil and Turkey are thousands of kilometers away from each other, but they have something in common: both countries went out to the streets to protest for their rights as citizens and are now struggling against the excessive violence and oppression from the police.
swa: Nchi za Brazil na Uturuki zimetengwa na umbali wa maelfu ya kilomita, lakini zina kitu fulani cha kufanana: nchi zote mbili ziliingia mitaani kudai haki zao kama raia na sasa wanahangaika kujinasua na matumizi ya nguvu na unyanyasaji wa kupindukia unaofanywa na polisi.

eng: V for Vinegar is a website created to track protests and promote petitions about relevant causes in each country: in Brazil, for the demilitarization of the Police , and for the immediate end to the violence in Turkey .
swa: V rVinegar ni tovuti iliyotengenezwa kufuatilia maandamano na kukuza uungwaji mkono wa matukio hayo katika nchi husika: nchini Brazil, kupinga uwepo wa polisi , na kusitishwa mara moja kwa vurugu nchini Uturuki

eng: Cambodian netizens are actively using Facebook to discuss, debate, and share updates about the July 28 National Assembly elections.
swa: Watumiaji wa mtandao wa intaneti nchini Kambodia wanatumia mtandao wa Facebook kwa kiwango kikubwa katika kujadili, kuendesha midahalo na kushirikishana mambo mapya yanayohusu chaguzi za kitaifa zinazotarajiwa kufanyika tarehe 28 Julai, 2013.

eng: Meanwhile, political parties are also maximizing the popular social networking site to reach out to younger voters.
swa: Wakati huohuo, vyama vya siasa pia vinatumia mtandao huu ulio maarufu zaidi katika kuwashawishi vijana wadogo wanaotarajiwa kupiga kura.

eng: Moses Ngeth, an activist and human rights advocate, admitted his mistake about his earlier assertion that Cambodian Facebook users are only concerned with entertainment issues:
swa: Moses Ngeth, ambaye ni mwanaharakati na wakili wa masuala ya haki za binadamu, alikiri kosa lake kufuatia tamko lake la hivi karibu kuwa, watumiaji wa Facebook nchini Kambodia wautumia mtandao huu kwa minajili ya burudani tu:

eng: Several months ago I made an interview with media saying that young people (are only) using Facebook for entertainment and their own interest.
swa: Miezi kadhaa iliyopita nilifanya mahojiano na vyombo vya habari na kusema kuwa, vijana wnatumia Facebook kwa ajili ya burudani tu na mambo yao binafsi.

eng: Since (the start of the) national election campaign, young people on Facebook have proven me wrong; and YES, I admit that I made a wrong comment.
swa: Tangu kuanza kwa kampeni za uchaguzi mkuu, vijana wanaotumia mtandao wa Facebook walithibitisha kuwa mawazo yangu hayakuwa sahihi; na ni kweli ninakiri kuwa, tamko langu halikuwa sahihi.

eng: I have seen the increasing number of young people who are using this social platform for change.
swa: Nimeona idadi endelevu ya vijana wanaotumia Facebook kwa ajili ya kutafuta mabadiliko.

eng: To all brave young people who are publicly standing up for their rights to choose their own leader, accept my apology
swa: Kwa wale vijana wote makini ambao wamesimama kidete na kwa uwazi katika kutumia haki yao ya kumchagua kiongozi wao, ninawaomba msamaha

eng: Princess Norodom Arunrasmey, daughter of late king Norodom Sihanouk and head of the royalist party, cheers her supporters gathered at the Freedom Park in Phnom Penh.
swa: Malkia Norodom Arunrasmey, ambaye ni mtoto wa hayati Mfalme Norodom Sihanouk na kiongozi wa chama cha Kifalme akiwapungia mkono wafuasi wake waliokusanyika katika Bustani ya Uhuru (Freedom Park) huko Phnom Penh.

eng: Photo by Thomas Cristofoletti, Copyright @Demotix (7/3/2013)
swa: Picha naThomas Cristofoletti, Copyright @Demotix (7/3/2013)

eng: Rachna Im, a journalist for RFI in Khmer language and a young female blogger, agreed with Moses in a Facebook message reply sent to this author:
swa: Rachna Im, ambaye ni mwandishi wa habari wa RFI katika lugha ya Khmer na ambaye ni mwanablogu chipukizi mwanamke alikubaliana na Moses katika ujumbe alioujibu na kwa kuutuma kwa mwandishi wa makala hii:

eng: Facebook has been used in a brand new way.
swa: Mtandao wa Facebook umekuwa ukitumiwa kwa namna mpya na ya kipekee kabisa.

eng: Users, especially youth, have been recently using the social media as a platform of expressing their political views As I noticed, this is a good way to use this social media - to have one's voice heard and to also show a better situation in freedom of expression in Cambodia, not much, but at least a bit better.
swa: Watumiaji na hususani vijana, siku za hivi karibuni wamekuwa wakitumia mitandao ya kijamii kama nmna ya kutolea maoni yao yanayohusu siasa. Kama nilivyobaini, hii ni namna nzuri ya kutumia mitandao ya kijamii-katika kuhakikisha mawazo ya mtu yanasikika na pia inaonesha hali nzuri ya uhuru wa kujieleza nchini Kambodia, siyo sana, lakini kwa kiasi fulani, hali inaridhisha..

eng: However, Rachna reminded Cambodian netizens participating in political debates to respect diverse views:
swa: Hata vivyo, Rachna aliwakumbushas watumiaji wa mtandao wa intaneti wanaoshiriki kwenye midahalo ya kisiasa kuheshimu hali ya mgongano wa mawazo:

eng: They normally end up cursing others for having opposite ideas They believe they have freedom to support a party - but they don't respect others' freedom to support a different party.
swa: Mara nyingi huwa wanaishia kuwatukana wengine pale kunapotokea mgongano wa kimawazo. Wanaamini kuwa wana uhuru wa kukiunga mkono chama fulani-lakini hawaheshimu haki ya watu wengine ya kukiunga mkono chama kingine.

eng: I sometimes find myself hard to believe things posted on Facebook since I understand that that thing is probably posted by only the finger, not the brain.
swa: Wakati mwingine huwa ninashangazwa sana na baadhhi ya mambo yanayowekwa kwenye Facebook, kwani huwa ninajiuliza kitu hicho kimewekwa tu bila hata ya kutumia akili.

eng: Still, Rachna applauded young people for bravely expressing their thoughts and hoped that it would improve society especially the freedom of expression situation in Cambodia.
swa: Zaidi, Rachna aliwapongeza vijana kwa basara zao katika kutoa maoni yao na kuamini kuwa utaratibu huu utaiimarisha jamii na haswa haswa katika suala la uhuru wa kujieleza nchini Kambodia.

eng: Chantra Be, a social networking manager of the Open Institute and a prominent organizer of BarCamp events in Cambodia who is known to dislike talking about politics, has recently initiated a political discussion.
swa: Chantra Be, msimamizi wa mfumo mtandao wa kijamii wa Asasi Huru na mtaalamu wa kuratibu matukio ya BarCamp huko Cambodia na ambaye anajulikana kwa kutokupenda kuzungumzia masuala ya siasa, siku za hivi karibuni alianzisha mjadala wa kisiasa.

eng: In an interview with this author, Chantra explained his sudden interest in politics:
swa: Katika maojiano na mwandishi wa makala hii, Chantra alielezea ni kwa nini kwa ghafla alihamasika kwenye mambo ya siasa:

eng: Personally I don't like politics, and I do not belong to any party.
swa: Binafsi sipendi siasa, na mimi siyo mwanachama wa chama chochote.

eng: I like to be in the middle.
swa: Ninapenda kuwa vuguvugu.

eng: I am a citizen who has the right to vote and share my thoughts.
swa: Mimi ni raia niliye na haki ya kupiga kura na kutoa maoni yangu.

eng: I have read many things on Facebook that touch my heart about Cambodia's situation
swa: Nimesoma mambo mengi kuhusiana na hali ya sasa ya Kambodia katika mtandao wa Facebook yaliyonigusa.

eng: Recently, Chantra questioned the role of 164 advisers of the ruling government and whether or not they have correctly advised the government on certain aspects such as health, education, judiciary, investment and the utilization of natural resource.
swa: Hivi karibuni, Chantra alihoji jukumu la washauri 164 wa chama kilicho madarakani kama wameshaishauri kwa makini serikali katika mambo fulani kama vile ya afya, elimu, mahakama, uwekezaji na mali asili.

eng: Sovichet Tep, a high school student and one of the country's youngest bloggers, also noticed the growing importance of social media in the country:
swa: Sovichet Tep, ambaye ni mwanafunzi wa shule ya upili na miongoni mwa wanablogu wadogo kabisa nchini Cambodia, pia, aligundua hali ya kuongezeka kwa umuhimu wa uanahabari wa kijamii nchini mwake:

eng: Information sharing has become viral not only during the start of the elections To my memory, this trend started since the mid or late 2011 when Facebook users began sharing information that are not accessible via the traditional media such as TV or radio. Although Sovichet is still young and could not yet vote, he believes that information sharing through the Internet can help him make an informed decision in the next election: Although I am too young to vote (But I can already vote in the next election), social media has clearly educated me about the current situation so that I could be well prepared to choose a party that I think and hope would prove to be good for our society.
swa: Pamoja na kuwa mimi bado ni mdogo kiasi cha kushindwa kupiga kura (lakini nimeshakuwa na maamuzi sahihi ya kupiga kura kwenye uchaguzi unaofuata), mitandao ya kijamii kwa hakika imenifundisha mengi kuhusiana na hali ya kisiasa iliyopo hivi sasa na hivyo kuweza kujiandaa kuchagua chama ambacho ninafikiri na kuamini kuwa kitakuwa na manufaa kwa jamii yetu.

eng: Protests in Antananarivo, Madagascar on July 22, 2013.
swa: Maandamano jijini Antananarivo, Madagaska tarehe 22 Julai, 2013.

eng: Images via MaTV
swa: Picha kupitia MaTV

eng: Vola R of Ma-Laza reports that 7 were hurt following police repression of protests demanding elections in Antananarivo, Madagascar.
swa: Blogu ya Vola R ya Ma-Laza inaandika kwamba watu 7 walijeruhiwa kufuatia matumizi ya nguvu yaliyofanywa na polisi dhidi ya waandamanaji waliokuwa wanadai kufanyika kwa uchaguzi mjini Antananarivo, Madagaska.

eng: The party leading the protest states that the current administration has no intention of organizing elections this year and is just hanging on to their position of power.
swa: Chama kinachoongoza maandamano kinasema kwamba utawala uliopo hauna dhamira ya kuitisha uchaguzi mwaka huu na kwamba serikali imeng'ang'ania madarakani.

eng: The leader of the party was allegedly arrested following the protests.
swa: Kiongozi wa chama hiko alidaiwa kukamatwa kufuatia maandamano hayo.

eng: Following three days of continuous protests, it seems the Heshan municipal government in Jiangmen city has abandoned its plans to construct a massive nuclear fuel complex.
swa: Kufuatia siku tatu mfululizo za maandamano, inaonekana serikali ya Manispaa ya Heshan jijini Jiangmen imetupilia mbali mkakati wake wa ujenzi wa mradi mkubwa wa mtambo wa nguvu ya Nuklia.

eng: Some believe that this victory - confirmed in a written document released on July 14, 2013 - is only temporary.
swa: Baadhi ya watu wanaamini kuwa ushindi huu ulithibitishwa kwa taarifa ya maandishi iliyotolewa mapema Julai 14, 2013 – kuwa ni ya dharura tu.

eng: They worry the project may simply prop up somewhere else, near the highly populated Pear River Delta in Southern China.
swa: Watu wana wasiwasi kuwa mradi huu unaweza kuibukia sehemu nyingine yoyote, karibu na eneo lililo na idadi kubwa ya watu la Delta ya mto Pearl, Kusini mwa China.

eng: The Heshan government made several concessions after hundreds of local residents took to the street on July 12 enraged by the high-risk project.
swa: Serikali ya Heshan iliridhia mambo kadhaa kufuatia mamia ya raia wa jiji la Heshan kuandamana Julai 12, 2013 wakipinga kujengwa kwa mradi huo ambao wanaamini utaweka maisha yao hatarini.

eng: At first, the government tried to negotiate to extend their consultation period to 20 days.
swa: Katika hatua ya awali, serikali ilijaribu kufikia muafaka kwa kukubali kuongeza siku za kutoa maoni ambapo iliongeza hadi kufikia siku 20.

eng: But this move failed to pacify local residents and at a press conference on July 13 they announced, "with respect to public opinion, the project would not be approved" , even though the city government had already signed the initial agreement with China National Nuclear Corp (CNNC).
swa: Lakini, hatua hii haikuweza kuwaridhisha raia, ambapo, tarehe 13 Julai katika mkutano na vyombo vya habari, serikali ilitangaza kuwa,"kwa kuheshimu maoni ya wananchi, mradi huu hautaidhinishwa" , pamoja na kuwa utawala wa jiji ulikuwa tayari umeshaingia kandarasi ya awali na Shirika la Taifa la Nyuklia la China (CNNC).

eng: Protesters took to the street to oppose construction of the proposed nuclear fuel plant on July 12, 2013.
swa: Waandamanaji walijitokeza kwenye mitaa mbalimbali katika kupinga ujenzi wa mtambo wa Nyuklia mnamo tarehe 12 Julai, 2013.

eng: Image from Zhu Kunling's weibo.
swa: Picha kutoka Zhu Kunling weibo.

eng: But some people are not satisfied with the government's claim.
swa: Hata hivyo, baadhi ya watu hawajaridhishwa na madai ya serikali.

eng: In the past, Chinese local governments have adopted delay-tactics like this to pacify people's anger.
swa: Kwa uzoefu, serikali za mitaa za China zimerithi mbinu ya kuchelewesha mambo kama namna ya kutuliza hasira za wananchi.

eng: For example, in Dalian, the city government suspended the PX factory after thousands took to the streets in 2011 in the "Not-In-My-Back-Yard" campaign, but the factory was restored back to normal operations after a few months .
swa: Kwa mfano, huko Dailan, serikali ya jiji ilisitisha shughuli katika kiwanda cha PX mara baada ya maelfu ya watu kuandamana mwaka 2011 katika kampeni ya "Not-In-My-Back-Yard", lakini kiwanda hicho baada ya miezi kadhaa kupita, kiliendelea na shughuli zake kama kawaida .

eng: Little bee (@小蜜蜂-V) and "Little Eaffen" (@Eaffen细细)'s comments on Sina Weibo:
swa: Maoni ya "Little bee" (@小蜜蜂-V) na "Little Eaffen" (@Eaffen细细) kwenye mtandao wa Sina Weibo:

eng: Little bee: Having seen the press conference, (the spokesperson) did not mention ‘cancel’, only said ‘as long as there is no agreement in the society, the project will not be approved and built.
swa: Little bee: Katika mkutano na waandishi wa habari, msemaji wa serikali hakutaja “kusitisha”, alichosema ni ‘kwa kuwa hakujafikiwa muafaka kati ya serikali na wananchi, mradi autaidhinishwa wala ujenzi kuanza.

eng: (Have we) misunderstood?
swa: Hivi hatukuelewa?

eng: Little Eaffen: Is it true?
swa: Little Eaffen: Ni kweli?

eng: What does it mean by ‘not approve’? We only accept ‘not to build the plant forever’!
swa: Ina maana gani inaposemwa ‘bado haijakubaliwa’? tunachokubaliana nacho ni ‘kutokujenga mtambo huo kabisa’!

eng: Some netizens spelled out that the halt is just a ‘delay tactic’ :
swa: Baadhi ya watumiaji wa mtandao walisema kuwa kusitishwa kwa ujenzi wa mtambo huo ni‘ mbinu ya kuchelewesha ’ :

eng: Zhang Erfei flyfan: Wonder if which inland city will be unlucky.
swa: Zhang Erfei flyfan: Ninajaribu kuwaza ni jiji lipi hilo ambalo halitakuwa na bahati.

eng: Damn like motorcycle: Will (the government) announce that the Heshan nuclear processing plant is cancelled, and with research from professionals, the project will be relocated to Xinhui (another Guangdong city)?
swa: Ninawafananisha na pikipiki: Serikali ya Heshan itatangaza kuwa hatua za ujenzi wa mtambo huo zimesitishwa, na kwa kutumia taarifa ya tafiti kutoka kwa wataalamu kuwa mradi huo utahamishwa na kupelekwa Xinhui (ambao ni jiji jingine la Guangdong)?

eng: The government document on the cancellation of the nuclear plant project .With anger and distrust, hundreds of local residents continued to rally on the third day on July 14 demanding a written official document on the cancellation of the project.
swa: Kwa jazba na hali ya kukosa imani, mamia ya wakazi wa jiji la Jiangmen waliendelea kuandamana na kuingia siku ya tatu ya maandamano tarehe 14 Julai wakitaka kupewa hati maalum ya serikali inayoonesha kusitishwa kwa mradi huu.

eng: The city's two vice mayors arrived at the protest spot, Donghu Square to reassure the public of their decision.
swa: Wasaidizi meya wawili waliwasili mahali maandamano yalipoanzia, uwanja wa Donghu kuwahakikishia kuwa maoni yao yatazingatiwa.

eng: Still people could not accept their verbal promise and they marched to the municipal government building, where the secretary of municipal Party committee showed them a written notice of the project's cancellation.
swa: Hata hivyo, watu hawakuweza kukubali maneno yao matupu na badala yake, walitembea kuelekea kwenye jengo la serikali ya manispaa ambapo katibu wa kamati ya manispaa aliwaonesha hati ya kusitishwa kwa mradi huo.

eng: They cheered and claimed victory.
swa: Walishangilia na kusema kuwa wamefanikiwa.

eng: However, the written document has not cleared all skepticism as the contract signed between Heshan government and CNNC involves 37 billion RMB (6 billion USD) investment.
swa: Hata hivyo, hati hiyo haijaondoa hali ya mashaka iliyokuwepo kwani kandarasi iliyopitishwa kati ya serikali ya Heshan na CNNC inahusisha uwekezaji wa RMB bilioni 37 (dola za kimarekani bilioni 6).

eng: So far, the CNNC has not announced any change in its plan.
swa: Hadi sasa, CNNC hakijatangaza mabadiliko yoyote kwenye mikakati yake.

eng: Some are worried that the project will eventually find a home in the Pearl River Delta.
swa: Wengine wanahofu kuwa, hatimaye mradi huu utahamishiwa eneo la Delta ya mto Pearl.

eng: For example, "ocean_Joe" said:
swa: For example, "ocean_Joe" alisema:

eng: Ocean_Joe: We have to think carefully.
swa: Ocean_Joe: Tunapaswa kuwaza kwa makini.

eng: Why did the government introduce the project?
swa: Kwa nini serikali iliamua kuuleta mradi huu?

eng: Why wasn't it introduced after public consultation?
swa: Kwa nini haukutambulishwa mara baada ya kupata maoni ya wananchi?

eng: Why did (the government) intend to make a decision that affects our lives and our offsprings' lives, in only 13 days?
swa: Kwa nini serikali ilidhamiria kufanya maamuzi yatakayoathiri maisha yetu na ya watoto wetu ndani ya siku 13 tuu?

eng: The dispute has been settled, but who will know the project might start again in the future?
swa: Mgogoro sasa umetulizwa, lakini ni nani anayejua ni lini na wapi mradi huu utaanzishwa tena katika siku zijazo?

eng: Please do not test the baseline of the people of Jiangmen and Pearl River Delta.
swa: Tafadhali msijaribu kupima misimamo ya watu wa Jiangmen nay a wale wa Delta ya mto Pearl.

eng: My home belongs to the Delta.
swa: Nyumbani kwangu ni huko kwenye Delta.

eng: A mother and her two teenage daughters were shot to death after five masked men broke into their house in the small town of Chilas in Gilgit, Pakistan in what was reported to be an honor killing.
swa: Mama na watoto wake wawili wa kike wameuawa kwa kufyatuliwa risasi mara baada ya watu watano waliokuwa wameficha nyuso zao kuvamia nyumba yao iliyopo katika mji mdogo wa Chilas huko Gilgit, Pakistan, tukio lililo taarifiwa kuwa ni mauaji ya kulinda heshima ya familia.

eng: The girls, ages 15 and 16, were reportedly targeted on June 24, 2013 killing over a mobile video of them enjoying rain in their garden, which had been circulating locally and was taken as an affront to the family's honor.
swa: Wasichana hao wenye umri wa miaka 15 and 16, iliripotiwa kuwa waliuawa mnamo tarehe 24 Juni, 2013 kufuatia kusambaa kwa video iliyorekodiwa kwa simu ikiwaonesha wakiifurahia mvua katika bustani yao, hali iliyochukuliwa kuwa ni kosa na hivyo kuvunja heshima ya familia.

eng: Authorities allege that the killer was the girls' stepbrother Khutore who was enraged at watching this video and enlisted the help of four of his friends to restore, in his view, his family's honor.
swa: Serikali ilidai kuwa, muuaji alikuwa ni binamu wa wasichana hao ajulikanaye kwa jina la stepbrother Khutore ambaye alionekana kukerwa na video ile na hivyo kuwaomba rafiki zake wanne, kwa maoni yake, arudishe heshima ya familia yake.

eng: The friends have since been captured and confessed to their crimes, but Khutore is still at large.
swa: Marafiki zake walishakamatwa na kukiri makosa yao lakini Khutore hajataka kukiri kosa hilo la mauaji.

eng: According to the Human Rights Commission of Pakistan's annual report, honor killings remain "the most consistent and abhorrent form of violence against women in Pakistan." In 2012, 913 women were killed in the name of their family's honor, including 99 children, the report says.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa taarifa ya kila mwaka ya Tume ya Haki za binadamu ya Pakistan, mauaji ya ya kulinda heshima yanabaki kuwa ni “namna ya ukatili dhidi ya wanawake nchini Pakistan unayoendelea kushamiri na unaochukiza kabisa " Mwaka 2012, wanawake 913 waliuawa kwa kulinda heshima ya familia zao, ikiwa ni pamoja na kuuawa kwa watoto 99, taarifa hiyo inaeleza.

eng: Shafiqul Hassan Siddiqui dissected the reasons behind honor killing in Pakistan on Dunya blogs:
swa: Shafiqul Hassan Siddiqui alifafanua kwa kina sababu zinazopelekea kufanyika kwa mauaji ya heshima nchini Pakistan kwenye blogu ya Dunya:

eng: It is an outcome of vengeance.
swa: Ni matokeo ya kulipiza kisasi.

eng: 95% focused on women.
swa: Asilimia 95% ya visasi hivi huelekezwa kwa wanawake.

eng: One of the family members (mostly a man), with the consent of other family members, kills and sentences the woman on few basis.
swa: Mmoja wa ndugu wa familia (kwa kiasi kikubwa mwanaume), na kwa idhini ya watu wa familia nyingine, mwanamke anahukumiwa na kuuawa kwa sababu zisizo na msingi.

eng: For the whole family this becomes a moment of pride when they sacrifice their own blood because due to her they earned dishonor.
swa: Kwa familia yote, wakati huu unakuwa ni wa kujivunia pale wanapomtoa sadaka mtu wa familia yao kwa kuwa, mwanamke huyo aliwaondolea heshima.

eng: There are many reasons that are considered as the main and basic causes behind the honor killing.
swa: Kuna sababu nyingi za msingi zinazozingatiwa katika kutekeleza mauaji haya ya heshima.

eng: Reacting to the recent killing, New York Times Pakistan Bureau Chief Declan Walsh (@declanwalsh) tweeted:

eng: @declanwalsh: utter madness - two girls and mother killed in northern Pakistan over video showing them enjoying the rain. http://beta.dawn.com/news/1020576
swa: @declanwalsh: Ukichaa kabisa- wasichana wawili na mama yao wameuawa kaskazini mwa Pakistan kufuatia kuonekana kwao wakifurahi kwa kucheza kwenye mvua. http://beta.dawn.com/news/1020576

swa: @Lubnagigyani: Ni tukio ovu kabisa la aina yake.

eng: Honourable humans do not KILL under any circumstances-egoistic machoism being the last
swa: Honourable humans do not KILL under any circumstances-egoistic machoism being the last

eng: @zeesh2: honor killing is a misnomer - misdirected emotions- if they really have honor they need to kill themselves not others
swa: @zeesh2: Mauaji ya heshima ni dhana inayotumiwa vibaya- hisia zinatumiwa vibaya- kama kweli wana heshima, wajiue wao wenyewe kuliko kuua wengine

swa: Gedrosia (@gedrosian), mtumiaji wa Twita kutoka katika jimbo la Balochistan, aliongeza kuwa, video hizo za simu zilizofichuliwa zimeshakuwa na madhara makubwa kwa wanafunzi wa kike katika maeneo yaliyo na msimamo mkali kuhusiana na dhana ya mauji ya heshima added that leaked mobile videos have had dire consequences for female students in conservative areas too:

eng: @gedrosian: there are a number of cases in Balochistan too where college/school photos were leaked. and girls were taken out of colleges Writing a few days before this most recent killing, The Future summed up the solution to ending honor killings:
swa: @gedrosian: Kuna matukio kadhaa pia huko Balochistan ambapo kuna picha kutoka vyuoni/ shuleni ziliwekwa hadharani na wasichana waliondoshwa kutoka vyuoni

eng: I feel that a revolution is required in the thinking pattern of the male members to change the existing notion of power. The prerequisite in the present scenario is not to empower one gender over the other but equilibrium between the two genders towards accomplishment of joint goals, better society and a better future for the upcoming generations by being proud of one’s own culture is needed.
swa: Akiandika siku chache kabla ya kutokea kwa mauaji haya ya hivi karibuni, The Future alitoa suluhisho la kumaliza mauaji ya kiheshima:

eng: The much anticipated face-off between Muslim Brotherhood supporters and protesters who called for the ousting of former Egyptian president Mohamed Morsi took place today .
swa: Mapambano yaliyotarajiwa kati ya wafuasi wa Muslim Brotherhood na waandamanaji waliotaka rais wa zamani wa Misri Mohamed Morsi aondoke yametokea leo .

eng: The drama unfolded live on television, and was broadcast by local and international channels.
swa: Ilikuwa kama mchezo wa kuigiza na ulionekana moja kwa moja kwenye televisheni, na ulirushwa kwa moja kwa moja na vituo vya televisheni vya ndani na vile vya kimataifa.

eng: At least 17 people were killed and more than 400 protesters injured in clashes across Egypt today, which many on social media described as "expected" and "surreal."
swa: Watu wasiopungua 17 waliuawa na zaidi ya waandamanaji 400 wakijeruhiwa katika mapigano nchini kote Misri leo, tukio ambalo mitandao mingi ya kijamii inalielezea kama "lililotarajiwa" na "linalosikitisha."

swa: Watu waliojeruhiwa wamelala chini

swa: Maspero ni jengo la televisheni na redio ya taifa ya Misri lililoko katikati ya Cairo, na liko mita kadhaa kutoka viwanja vya Tahrir, amahali ambapo waandamanaji wanaompinga Morsi wanaendelea na sherehe za kuondoka kwa Morsi.

swa: @acarvin: Video ya kusikitisha inaonyeshwa kwenye kituo cha al jazeera hivi sasa -ikiwaanesha jamaa kadhaa wakirusha mawe, kila mmoja akimwulika kwa toshi ya kijani ili kupata shabaha kwa wapinzani wao

eng: Gunshots and many injuries.
swa: Milio ya risasi inasikika na kuna majeruhi wengi.

eng: The ousting of former Egyptian president Mohamed Morsi after a year in office ushered celebrations across the country, as well as a bout of violence between pro- and anti-Morsi supporters.

eng: While Morsi supporters say that the removal of Morsi from power was a military coup, the anti-Morsi camp insists it was the will of the people, with the support of the powerful military establishment that has made the ousting possible.

eng: Many also are angry over what they call as the US meddling in Egyptian Affairs.
swa: Wengi pia wana hasira kwa kile wanachokiita hatua ya Marekani kuingilia mambo ya ndani ya Misri.

eng: They say that the "provocative statement" by US president Barak Obama ignored the masses who took the streets to reclaim their freedom and waved the aid card instead.

eng: The US statement, issued on July 3, reads:
swa: Taarifa ya Marekani, iliyotolewa Julai 3, inasema:

eng: The United States is monitoring the very fluid situation in Egypt, and we believe that ultimately the future of Egypt can only be determined by the Egyptian people.
swa: Marekani inafuatilia mwenendo wa mambo nchini Misri, na tunaamini kwamba hatimaye mustakabali wa Misri unaweza kutengenezwa na watu wa Misri wenyewe.

eng: Nevertheless, we are deeply concerned by the decision of the Egyptian Armed Forces to remove President Morsy and suspend the Egyptian constitution.
swa: Hata hivyo, tunatiwa wasiwasi na uamuzi wa Jeshi kumwondoa Rais Morsi na kusimamisha katiba ya nchi hiyo.

eng: I now call on the Egyptian military to move quickly and responsibly to return full authority back to a democratically elected civilian government as soon as possible through an inclusive and transparent process, and to avoid any arbitrary arrests of President Morsy and his supporters.
swa: Ninalitaka jeshi la Mirsi kuchukua hatua za haraka na za kiwajibikaji kurudisha mamlaka kamili kwa serikali ya kiraia iliyochaguliwa kwa njia za kidemokrasia mara moja kwa njia za wazi na za pamoja, na kukwepa kumkamata Rais Morsi na wafuasi wake.

eng: Given today’s developments, I have also directed the relevant departments and agencies to review the implications under U.S. law for our assistance to the Government of Egypt.
swa: Kwa kuangalia mwenendo wa mambo leo hii, nimezielekeza idara na mashirika yanayohusika kutathmini matokeo ya matukio haya chini ya sheria yetu ya Marekani inayoongoza misaada yetu kwa serikali kwa Misri.

eng: Families of Saudi detainees marked the Third Detainees Day to protest the arbitrary detention of their loved ones, who have been behind bars for years without access to a fair trial.
swa: Familia za watu wanaoshikiliwa gerezani nchini Saudi Arabia zaingia siku ya tatu ya kupinga kushikiliwa bila utaratibu maalum kwa wapendwa wao, ambao wamekuwa mahabusu kwa miaka kadhaa sasa bila ya kusomewa mashitaka yoyote.

eng: The day, on July 7, was called for by anonymous advocacy groups @e3teqal and @almonaseron .
swa: Siku hii ya tarehe 7 Julai, iliitishwa na makundi ya mawakili yasiyofahamika, ambayo ni @e3teqal na @almonaseron .

eng: Saudi Arabia is one of the few remaining absolute monarchies in the world and has a devastating human rights record which includes arbitrarily detaining over 30,000 people.
swa: Saudi Arabia ni moja ya nchi chache duniani ambazo bado zipo chini ya mfumo wa utawala wa kifalme na ina rekodi isiyoridhisha kuhusu haki za binadamu ikiwa ni pamoja na kushikilia gerezani zaidi ya watu 30,000 bila sababu maalum.

eng: Across the kingdom, families of detainees hung pictures and signs demanding the release of their relatives.
swa: Sehemu mbalimbali za dola hiyo, familia za watu wanaoshikiliwa wananing’iniza picha na ishara kama namna ya kushinikiza ndugu zao waachiwe huru.

eng: They made videos and distributed flyers to publicize the cause.
swa: Waliandaa video na vipeperushi vilivyojaribu kuelezea sababu ya kuandamana kwao.

eng: Unlike the first and second detainees day, this time bridges were guarded by security forces to make sure no one hangs signs on them.
swa: Tofauti na siku ya kwanza na ya pili ya kuwatetea watu walioshikiliwa gerezani, safari hii madaraja yalikuwa yakilindwa na askari ili kuzuia watu wasibandike vipeperushi katika madaraja hayo.

eng: Also, walls that had any sort of expressions demanding the release of the prisoners were painted right away.
swa: Aidha, kuta zote zilizoonekana kuwa na ishara yoyote ya kushinikiza kuachiwa kwa wafungwa, zilifutwa mara moja.

eng: The family that got the most attention was that of Abdullah Al-Ayaf.
swa: Familia iliyotiliwa mkazo zaidi ilikuwa ni ile ya ndugu Abdullah Al-Ayaf.

eng: Al-Ayaf has been in jail for six years now.
swa: Al-Ayaf amekuwa gerezani kwa miaka sita sasa.

eng: He was tried and acquitted, but he still remains in jail.
swa: Kesi yake ilisikilizwa na hakukutwa na hatia lakini bado anashikiliwa gerezani.

eng: His picture was hung outside their home in Qassim.
swa: Picha yake ilitundikwa nje ya nyumba yao huko Qassim.

eng: The house was soon surrounded by police and Mabahith (secret police) cars.
swa: Ghafla, nyumba hiyo ilizingirwa na askari pamoja na Mabahith ( magari ya polisi kanzu).

eng: A member of the Mabahith talked to Maha Al-Dhuhaian - Al-Ayaf's wife - during the day and cursed her.

eng: Later, a police officer came to talk to her demanding the photograph be taken down. She told him about the Mabahith member.

Sifikiri kama afisa wa usalama yeyote angeweza kutamka maneno yale” afisa wa polisi alimjibu.
That sign is the only reason we're here in the first place, it's better you take it down," he adds.

eng: More than 60 Vietnamese bloggers signed a unity statement urging the Vietnam government to improve its human rights record and commitment as it vies for membership in the UN Human Rights Council:

eng: The Vietnamese government also needs to review the human rights situation in their own country and the Vietnamese people also have a right to freedom of opinion and expression, including on these matters.
swa: Serikali ya Vietnam pia inahitaji kutathmini hali ya haki za binadamu katika nchi hiyo na wa-Vietinamu pia wana haki ya uhuru wa maoni na kujieleza, ikiwa ni pamoja na masuala haya.

eng: As advocates for freedom of expression in Vietnam and victims of human rights violations because of our activism, we view Vietnam's candidacy for the Human Rights Council as a platform for constructive human rights discussions in our country.
swa: Kama watetezi wa uhuru wa kujieleza nchini Vietnam na wahanga wa ukiukwaji wa haki za binadamu kwa sababu ya harakati zetu, sisi twaona mgombea Vietnam kwa Baraza la Haki za Binadamu kama jukwaa kwa ajili ya majadiliano ya kujenga haki za binadamu katika nchi yetu.

eng: Global hacktivist group Anonymous has leaked the 1990-2011 financial accounts of the governing Partido Popular (PP) to the Internet. Recently, the judge overseeing the Gürtel case, an ongoing political corruption scandal in Spain that implicates PP members, asked for access to the documents dated since 1990 on the suspicion of illegal financing.
swa: Siku za hivi karibuni, hakimu anayesimamia kesi yaGürtel, inayohusu kashfa ya rushwa ya kisiasa nchini Uhispania inayowahusisha wanachama wa Chama cha Umma (PP), aliomba tangu mwaka 1990 kupatiwa nyaraka kufuatia mashaka ya udanganyifu wa taarifa za kiuchumi.

eng: The PP refused, claiming that they were only obligated turn in documents from the last five years.
swa: Chama cha Umma kilikataa wakidai kuwa walipaswa kuziwasilisha hati hizo kwa kipindi cha miaka mitano iliyopita na si vinginevyo.

eng: On 8 July, 2013, Anonymous uploaded close to 5GB of data of the party's accounts, and at the same time made their financial data since 1990 public on portal anonyourvoice.com. The content rapidly spread via social networks, torrents, blogs and channels.
swa: Tarehe 8 Julai, 2013, mtu asiyejulikana alipakia mtandaoni hazi zenye karibu 5GB ya data za akaunti ya chama, na wakati huo huo waliweka bayana taarifa zao za kiuchumi za kuanzia mwaka 1990 katika mtandao wa anonyourvoice.com.

eng: This data, which was not public before, has now become available to the citizenry. Thousands of citizens through social networks have started to share and scrutinize the documents.
swa: Hati hizo zilianza kusambaa kwa haraka sana katika mitandao mbalimbali ya kijamii, kwenye torenti, blogu na katika idhaa mbalimbali.

eng: You can follow the examination of these documents on Twitter under the hashtag #CuentasdelPP :
swa: Mtu huyu asiyejulikana alizipa taarifa zilizovuja jina la utani:

eng: @15MayoValencia: Do you want to give us a hand with the #AuditoriaCiudadanaAlPP ?
swa: @15MayoValencia: Unapenda kutuunga mkonoDo you want to give us a hand with the #AuditoriaCiudadanaAlPP ?

eng: Download the #CuentasDelPP , analyse and share! http://fb.me/L8xmiwBh
swa: Pakua #CuentasDelPP , zifanyie uchanganuzi na kisha uwashirikishe na wengine ! http://fb.me/L8xmiwBh

eng: @LaliSandi : Never seen before: the #cuentasdelpp explode and spread over the internet in little pieces.
swa: @LaliSandi : Haikuwahi kutokea: #cuentasdelpp kuvuja kwa wingi na kusambaa katika mitandao ya intaneti katika vipande vidogo vidogo.

eng: ‏@alvarinaitis : #CuentasDelPP But seriously, Is no one going to show their face today? a statement? nobody from the @PPopular nor business sponsors?
swa: ‏@alvarinaitis : #CuentasDelPP lakini ni kweli kuwa, hakuna yeyote atakayejitokeza siku ya leo? Maelezo yoyote? Hakuna yeyote kutoka @PPopular Chama cha Umma (PP) au mfadhili wa Kibiashara?

eng: The PP, which promised to submit a transparency law before the first 100 days of government but has still not formalised the legislation, has been exposed through the broadcasting of its financial management to the watchful eyes of hundreds of anonymous people.
swa: Chama cha Umma(PP), ambacho kiliahidi kuleta sheria ya uwazi kabla ya siku 100 za uongozi ambapo hadi sasa bado hakijaidhinisha sheria hiyo, taarifa za kiuchumi za chama hiki zimesambaa kwa mamia ya wafuatiliaji wasiojulikana.

eng: Public management is being examined.
swa: Utawala wa umma bado unaendelea unachunguzwa.

eng: Several hundred residents in Jiangmen, a city near China’s southern Guangzhou, took to the street to protest against a planned uranium processing plant on July 12, 2013.
swa: Siku ya tarehe 12 Julai, 2013, mamia kadhaa ya wakazi wa Jiangmen, jiji lililo jirani na Guangzhou ya Kusini nchini China, walifurika mtaani kuandamana kupinga mpango wa kuanzisha mtambo wa kuchakata Uranium .

eng: Marchers moved through the city carrying banners and wearing masks that read “we want children, not atoms.”
swa: Waandamanaji walitembea maeneo mbalimbali ya jiji wakiwa wamebeba mabango pamoja na kuvaa mabarakoi yaliyo na maandishi yaliyoandikwa “tunataka watoto, siyo atomi”.

eng: The protesters say they're worried about radiation and possible nuclear pollution.
swa: Waanadamanaji wanasema kuwa wanahofia mionzi na uwezekano wa uchafuzi utakaosababishwa na mtambo huo wa nyuklia.

eng: According to The New York Times, Jiangmen authorities have already signed an agreement with the China National Nuclear Corporation to house the six billion US dollar project.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa gazeti la The New York Times, serikali ya Jiangmen tayari imeshaweka mkataba na Shirika la Taifa la Nyuklia la China katika kufadhili mradi huu kwa kiasi cha dola bilioni sita za kimarekani.

eng: Construction is expected to begin at the end of this year.
swa: Ujenzi unatarajiwa kuanza mwisho wa mwaka huu.

eng: The local government announced the project last week, giving the public 10 days to submit comments.
swa: Serikali ya mtaa ilitangaza mradi huu wiki iliyopita na kuwapa wananchi siku kumi za kuwasilisha maoni yao.

eng: The officials claimed that the plant is harmless, but the residents were not convinced.
swa: Pamoja na maafisa wa serikali kudai kuwa mradi huu hauna madhara, lakini wananchi bado hawajaridhika.

eng: A news conference was held after the protest, and the mayor promised to extend another 10 days for public comment.
swa: Katika mkutano na waandishi wa habari ulioitishwa baada ya maandamano, Meya wa jiji hilo aliahidi kuongeza muda wa siku 10 zaidi kwa wananchi kutoa maoni yao.

eng: Earlier this year, similar protest took place in China’s southern Kunming where residents protested against a gas refinery.
swa: Mapema mwaka huu, maandamano kama haya yalifanyika huko Kunming ya Kusini nchini China ambapo wakazi wa huko waliandamana kupinga kujengwa kwa kiwanda cha kusafishia mafuta.

eng: South China Morning Post has reported that the protest had been organized via China’s social messaging services: QQ and WeChat.
swa: Gazeti la South China Morning Post lilitaarifu kuwa, maandamano yaliratibiwa kupitia mitandao ya kijamii ya nchini China ya huduma za ujumbe ambayo ni: QQ na WeChat.

eng: On China’s most popular microblogging site Sina Weibo, information about the protests was quickly censored.
swa: Kwenye tovuti ya jukwaa la kublogu la Sina Weibo, taarifa kuhusu maandamano haya kwa haraka kabisa iliweza kuratibiwa.

eng: Some Weibo users were able to get around the censor and post pictures.
swa: Baadhi ya watumiaji wa Weibo waliweza kufuatilia taarifa hizo na na pia kuweka picha.

eng: Below are some of the pictures of the protests from Sina Weibo:
swa: Zifuatazo ni baadhi ya picha za maandamano kutoka Sina Weibo:

eng: Banner reads: We want children, not atoms. (from Sina Weibo)
swa: Bango linalosomeka: Tunataka watoto na siyo atomi. (Kutoka Sina Weibo)

eng: At least three women were killed in Mansoura when a protest in support of former Egyptian president Mohamed Morsi was attacked by "thugs" tonight.
swa: Wanawake wasiopungua watatu wameuawa kwa kushambuliwa na watu wanaosadikiwa kuwa ni majambazi huko Mansoura wakati wa maandamano ya kupinga kung’olewa madarakani kwa aliyekuwa Rais wa Misri Mohamed Morsi.

eng: Dozens of people were also reportedly injured by shotgun and knife wounds.
swa: Inmeripotiwa pia kuwa, zaidi ya makumi mawili ya watu walijeruhiwa kwa risasi na visu.

eng: Egyptian blogger Zeinobia exclaims:
swa: Mwanablogu wa Misri, Zeinobia aonesha kushitushwa na tukio hili:

eng: And @egyrevolution12 adds :
swa: Na @egyrevolution12 anaongeza :

eng: The Ikhwan protests in Mansoura start after prayers and half of it is usually women.
swa: Maandamano ya Ikhwan huko Mansoura huanza mara baada tu baada ya sala na nusu yao huwa ni wanawake.

eng: Complete families/ Attacking them cannot be excused.
swa: Wote wanaowashambulia hawawezi kuvumiliwa kamwe.

eng: Ibrahim Elgarhi is shocked at those who excuse the murder of women.
swa: Ibrahim Elgarhi anashangazwa na wote wanaowahurumia wauaji.

eng: He writes:
swa: Anaandika:

eng: Let's sell our values and keep quiet over the murder of women.
swa: Tuuze thamani yetu na kufumbia macho mauaji ya wanawake.

eng: Let's go against our conscience and say what took them (the women) there (to the protest).
swa: Hebu tupingane na dhamira zetu na tutafakari kile kilichowafanya wanawake hawa waungane na wenzao kwenye maandamano

eng: On June 30, Egyptians took to the streets to demand that president Mohamed Morsi, a Muslim Brotherhood (MB) candidate, steps down.
swa: Tarehe 30 Juni, raia wa Misri waliandamana wakishinikiza kuondoka madarakani kwa kiongozi wa Chama cha Kindugu cha Kiislam (Muslim Brotherhood0na Rais wa Misri Mohamed Morsi.

eng: On July 3, Morsi's one-year reign was cut short and an interim government now runs Egypt.
swa: Juni 3, Serikali ya Morsi iliondoshwa madarakani na kupelekea nchi hiyo hadi sasa kuongozwa kwa serikali ya mpito.

eng: Morsi's supporters have since been staging protests calling for his return to power.
swa: Tangu kuondolewa madarakani, wafuasi wa Morsi wamekuwa wakifanya maandamano kushinikiza arudishwe madarakani.

eng: Dar es Salaam, Tanzania's commercial capital, is getting back to normal after two days in which the city found itself playing host to arguably the most powerful man on earth: President Barack Obama of the United States.
swa: Dar es Salaam, ambao ni mji mkuu wa kibiashara wa Tanzania, unarejea katika hali yake ya kawaida baada ya siku mbili za kuwa mwenyeji wa mtu anayeaminika kuwa mwenye mvuto mkubwa duniani, Rais wa Marekani, Barack Obama.

eng: The city's streets were inundated with posters of the man.
swa: Mitaa ya jiji la Dar Es Salaam ilihanikizwa na picha za Rais huyu.

eng: Image of President Barack Obama on a billboard in Dar Es Salaam.
swa: Picha ya Rais Barack Obama katika bango la barabarani jijini Dar Es Salaam.

eng: Photo courtesy of Sandy Temu.
swa: Picha kwa idhini ya Sandy Temu.

eng: This instagrammer captured an image on one of the billboards and seemed quite pleased about the prospect of Obama's visit:
swa: Mtumiaji huyu wa Instagramu alinasa picha kwenye miongoni mwa mabango ya barabarani na inaonekana aliridhika sana na mategemeo yaliyopo kuhusiana na ujio wa Obama.

eng: Folks lined up the streets to welcome the first African-American president to their shores, as the image posted with the tweet below demonstrates:
swa: Wakazi wa jiji la Dar Es Salaam walijipanga pembezoni mwa barabara kwa ajili ya kumpokea katika ardhi yao Rais wa kwanza wa Amerika aliye na asili ya Afrika, kama jinsi picha hii iliyowekwa katika ukurasa wa Twita inavyoonesha:

eng: @whitehouse: "Ultimately, the goal here is for Africa to build Africa for Africans." —Obama in Tanzania: http://at.wh.gov/mz2hT , pic.twitter.com/pnBCU7bSCQ
swa: @whitehouse: "Mwishowe, lengo kubwa hapa ni kwa Waafrika kuijenga Afrika kwa ajili ya Waafrika." —Obama in Tanzania: http://at.wh.gov/mz2hT , pic.twitter.com/pnBCU7bSCQ

eng: And upon landing, Obama received an especially warm reception, as photo-blogger Issa Michuzi was able to capture in this photograph the mood at Julius Nyerere International Airport:
swa: Wakati wa kuwasili kwake, Obama alikaribishwa vizuri na kwa aina ya kipekee kabisa kama jinsi mwanablogu mpiga picha Issa Michuzi alivyoweza kunasa picha ya hali ilivyokuwa katika uwanja wa kimaifa wa ndege wa Julius Nyerere:

eng: President Obama arriving at Julius Nyerere International Airport.
swa: Rais Obama akiwasili katika Uwanja wa Ndege wa kimataifa wa Julius Nyerere.

eng: Photo courtesy of Issa Michuzi.
swa: Picha kwa hisani ya Issa Michuzi.

eng: Such images prompted one tweep to say this:
swa: Picha za aina hii zilimfanya mtu mmoja kusema hili :

eng: @bkyeyune: By the looks of the online images/photos, Obama had more fun in Tanzania than he had in South Africa.
swa: @bkyeyune: Kwa kuangalia picha mbalimbali mtandaoni, Obama alikuwa na wakati mzuri zaidi Tanzania kuliko alipokuwa Afrika Kusini.

eng: The interest in Obama's visit extended farther than the streets of Dar es Salaam.
swa: Mvuto wa ujio wa Obama haukuishia tu katika mitaa ya jiji la Dar Es Salaam.

eng: Gaure Mdee (@Profesy) tweeted this image from Stone Town, Zanzibar showing people watching his visit on local television:
swa: Gaure Mdee (@Profesy) alitwiti picha hii kutoka katika mji wa Stone Town, Zanzibar ikionesha watu wakifuatilia ziara ya Obama kupitia Televisheni moja ya Tanzania:

eng: Zanzibaris watching Obama's visit on local television station.
swa: Wazanzibari wakifuatilia ziara ya Obama kupitia kituo cha televisheni kimojawapo cha Tanzania.

eng: Photo courtesy of @Profesy.
swa: Picha kwa hisani ya @Profesy.

eng: This view seemed to be shared by blogger Elsie Eyakuze of The Mikocheni Report who, a week ago, conjured up the word 'neocolonialism' in describing the relevance of Mr. Obama's visit:
swa: Mtizamo huu ulionekana kuwekwa na mwanablogu Elsie Eyakuze wa blogu ya The Mikocheni Report ambaye, wiki moja iliyopita aliibua neno 'ukoloni mamboleo' katika kuelezea umuhimu wa ziara ya Obama:

eng: Now there's going to be a delegation of hundreds of businessmen in the Obama entourage looking to explore opportunities in Tanzania.
swa: Sasa kutakuwa na jukumu kubwa la wafanyabiashara walioambatana na Rais Obama la kutafuta fursa za kibiashara nchini Tanzania.

eng: There is something disconcerting about being considered a sweet little morsel by America on the planet...Gas, Africom, the Millenium Challenge Corporation, businessmen - what are these in the face of our current situation?
swa: Kuna hali fulani ya kutia mashaka inayotumiwa na Marekani ya kuyahadaa mataifa mengi ulimwenguni...Gesi, Africom, Mpango wa Ushirikiano wa Maendeleo wa Milenia, wafanyabiashara – Hivi ni vitu gani ukizingatia hali tuliyonayo hivi sasa?

eng: Yes, Barack Obama is coming to Tanzania.
swa: Ndio, Barack Obama anakuja Tanzania.

eng: If he could bring along plane-load of respect for civil rights and inject it directly into my government's veins I would be happier.
swa: Kama angeweza kuja na shehena ya kuheshimu haki za raia na kisha kuzidunga moja kwa moja kwenye mishipa ya viongozi wetu, ningeridhika.

eng: But I understand POTUS has a few problems of his own respecting the freedoms of Americans- like, say, freedom from state surveillance? *shrug.*
swa: Lakini, ninafahamu, Rais wa Marekani ana matatizo yake machache ya kuheshimu uhuru wa watu wa Amerika, kwa mfano, upelelezi huru wa Taifa? *dharau.*

eng: Over at Vijana.FM, there were complaints about why there was more brouhaha for this Head of State than usually afforded to other visiting Presidents:
swa: Katika Vijana.FM, kulikuwa na manung’uniko kuwa ni kwanini kulikuwa na pilikapilika nyingi katika ujio wa Obama kuliko ilivyowahi kuwa kwa wakuu wanchi wengine waliowahi kuitembelea Tanzania:

eng: I can understand the vast security preparations for him, but should we only clean up when we have a high profile guest?
swa: Ninaweza kuelewa kuhusu maandalizi ya kina ya kiulinzi kwa ajili yake, lakini ni kweli tunapaswa kufanya usafi eti kwa kuwa kiongozi huyu mashuhuri anaitembelea Tanzania?

eng: I understand that he comes to visit our country and maybe he has good things in store, but our reaction to his visit is absurd.
swa: Ninaelewa kuwa, anakuja kuitembelea nchi yetu na labda ana vitu vizuri kwa ajili yetu, lakini mtizamo wetu kuhusiana na safari yake ni wa kipuuzi kabisa.

eng: What message are we sending to our fellow African states, and most importantly, to the world?
swa: Ni ujumbe gani tunataka kuyaambia mataifa mengine ya Afrika, na la muhimu sana, kwa ulimwengu?

eng: What message are we passing along to the young generation, the leaders in the making?
swa: Ni ujumbe gani tunaourithisha kwa watoto wetu, viongozi bado wanajipanga?

eng: Elsewhere, January Makamba, who also happens to be the Deputy Minister for Science and Technology, blogging at Taifa Letu, argued that it is not Tanzania, and in extension Africa, that needs the US.
swa: Kwingineko, January Makamba, ambaye pia ni Naibu Waziri wa Sayansi na Teknolojia, akitoa maoni yake katika blogu ya Taifa Letu, alisema kuwa, siyo Tanzania, na pia Afrika yote, inayoihitaji Amerika.

eng: Rather, it was America that needed Africa more:
swa: Bali ni Marekani ndio iliyoihitaji zaidi Afrika:

eng: America’s global leadership remains robust – at least for now.
swa: Amerika bado inaendelea kuwa Taifa kubwa duniani- angalau kwa wakati huu.

eng: One way to retain and strengthen it in the face of insecure world and a deepening economic and cultural competition is to project it for the good of humanity.
swa: Namna mojawapo wa kuendelea kushikilia nafasi hii katika wakati huu ambao dunia si salama na iliyo na ushindani mkubwa wa kiuchumi na kiutamaduni ni kwa kuweka mbele utu.

eng: And this is the expectation of most Africans – that America shouldn’t befriend a country just for security or strategic concerns but because of advancement of shared values – of freedom, equality, tolerance and human progress.
swa: Na hili ndilo tegemeo la Waafika wengi- kwamba Amerika isijenge urafiki na nchi fulani kwa sababu za kiulinzi au kwa ajili ya mikakati fulani tu bali iw ni kwa ajili ya maendeleo yaliyokusudiwa kwa kila mmoja- ya uhuru, usawa, uvumilivu na pamoja na maendeleo ya watu.

eng: As Obama departed, Ahmed Salim (@asalim86) captured what the country felt yesterday evening:
swa: Jana majira ya jioni wakati Obama alipokuwa anaondoka, Ahmed Salim aliweza (@asalim86) kunasa hisia za watu:

eng: @asalim86: …and POTUS is gone, back to our regularly scheduled program in #Tanzania
swa: @asalim86: …na Rais wa Marekani ameshaondoka, turudi kwenye taratibu zetu za kawaida hapa #Tanzania

eng: And while the significance of his visit continues to be a point of contention, it seems like Mr. Obama is already entrenching his legacy into Dar es Salaam's identity:
swa: Wakati umuhimu wa ziara yake hapa Tanzania unaendelea kuwa gumzo, inaonekana kama vile Obama ameshajiwekea kumbukumbu ya kudumu katika utambulisho wa Jiji la Dar Es Salaam

eng: Guinee News reports the latest death toll - 60 - from the killings in Nzérékoré, Guinea :
swa: Tovuti ya Guinee News inaripoti idadi ya vifo kufikia 60 kutokana na mauaji ya Nzérékoré, Guinea :

eng: 52 non-identified bodies were buried in a mass grave yesterday.
swa: miili 52 ambayo haikutambulika ilizikwa kwenye kaburi la pamoja jana.

eng: The other bodies were returned to their families.
swa: Miili minngine ilirudishwa kwa wafiwa.

eng: A recent sex scandal involving two top Shanghai judges was exposed by a businessman Ni Peiguo who believes one of the judges was unfair in a ruling of a corporate suit that Ni was involved in.
swa: Kashfa ya ngono ya hivi majuzi inayowahusisha majaji wawili maarufu wa Shanghai iliwekwa hadharani na mfanyabiashara Ni Peiguo anayeamini kuwa mmoja wa majaji hakutoa hukumu ya haki katika kesi ya kampuni anayohusika nayo.

eng: He took revenge of his financial loss by following the judge for a year and exposing the sex scandal.
swa: Alichukua uamuzi wa kulipiza kisasi kufuatia hasara ya fedha kwa kumfuatilia hakimu kwa mwaka na hatimaye kufichua kashfa yake ya ngono.

eng: China Beat highlightes netizens' comments on Ni's revenge, which is a lot more effective than trying to petition the case.
swa: Mtandao wa China Beat ulisaili maoni ya raia wa mtandaoni juu ya kisasi cha Bw. Ni, ambayo ina ufanisi zaidi kuliko kujaribu kukata rufaa dhidi ya kesi.

eng: Hossein Ronaghi Malki a jailed blogger who is serving a 15-year sentence in prison started his hunger strike last week.A Facebook campaign has been launched to support him.
swa: Hossein Ronaghi Malki mwanablogu anayetumikia kifungo cha miaka 15 jela alianza mgomo wake wa kutokula kuanzia wiki iliyopita. Kwenye mtandao wa Facebook kampeni imeanzishwa yenye lengo la kummwuunga mkono.

eng: Iran's new foreign minister Mohammad Javad Zarif has a Facebook page where he answers questions.
swa: Waziri mpya wa Uhusiano wa Kimataifa wa Iran Mohammad Javad Zarif ana ukurasa wa Facebook ambapo huutumia kujibu maswali.

eng: He says "my children and I update this page."
swa: Anasema "Mimi na watoto wangu huuhuisha (kuweka habari mpya) ukurasa huu."

eng: The page has more than 10,000 likes.
swa: Ukurasa huo una zaidi ya wafuatialiaji 79,854 walioupenda (wakati wa kutafsiriwa kwa posti hii).

eng: Facebook is filtered in Iran but used by all presidential candidates.
swa: Mtandao wa Facebook hudhibitiwa nchini Iran lakini ndio uliotumiwa na wagombea wote wa urais katika uchaguzi uliopita.

eng: David Degner shares photographs from the mobbed and burned churches in Mallawi, Minya, in Upper Egypt here.
swa: David Degner aweka picha kutoka makanisa yaliyoshambuliwa na kuchomwa katika sehemu iitwayo Mallawi, Minya, Misri ya Juu hapa.

eng: He writes:
swa: Anaandika:

eng: Friday two churches in the village of Mallawi, a village in the province of Minya, were attacked and set on fire.
swa: Siku ya Ijumaa makanisa mawili katika kijiji cha Mallawi, jimbo la Minya, yalishambuliwa na kuchomwa moto.

eng: After the attack on the pro-Morsy sit in where more than 600 people died, Morsy supporters gathered after Friday prayer storming and burning two churches, and some Christian owned shops in the village of Mallawi.
swa: Baada ya mashambulizi dhidi ya wafuasi wa Morsy ambapo zaidi ya watu 600 walifariki, wafuasi wa Morsy walikusanyika baada ya swala ya Ijumaa wakavamia na kuchoma makanisa mawili, na baadhi ya maduka yanayomilikiwa na wakristo katika kijiji cha Mallawi.

eng: Groups also attacked and looted the museum of Mallawi, and banks, shops and 10 other churches in Minya.
swa: Watu walikuwa katika makundi pia walishambulia na kuiba vitu kwenye chumba cha makumbusho kijijini humo, na benki, maduka na makanisa mengine 10 jimboni humo.

eng: He shares this video, showing the Evangelical Church, in Mallawi, burning:
swa: Anaweka video hii, inayoonyesha Kanisa la Kiinjili, kijijini humo likiwaka moto:

eng: A fight broke out in a Riyadh mosque between Saudis and Egyptians after a Saudi clergyman cursed Egyptian Defence Minister General Abdel Fattah el-Sisi during today's Friday prayers sermon.
swa: Mapigano yamelipuka kweeye msikiti wa Riyadh kati ya Wa-Saudi na wa-Misri baada ya mhubiri wa ki-Saudi kumlaani Waziri wa Ulinzi wa Misri Generali Abdel Fattah el-Sisi wakati mawaidha ya swala ya leo ya Ijumaa.

eng: The fight, uploaded on to YouTube, has gone viral and the tug-of-words continues online.
swa: Mapigano hayo, yaliyowekwa kwenye mtandao wa YouTube, yamesambazwa mno na kuzua mjadala mkali kwenye mtandao wa intaneti.

eng: The 46-second video, uploaded on several accounts on YouTube, has been the talk of the Saudi blogosphere today.
swa: Video hiyo ya sekunde 46, ilipandishwa na watu mbalimbali kwenye mtandao wa YouTube, imekuwa ni mjadala wa siku miongoni mwa wanablogu wa ki-Saudi leo.

eng: One version, uploaded today by umum0707, has been watched more than 750,000 times at the time of writing this post.
swa: Katika toleo moja liliwekwa mtandaoni na umum0707, limetazamwa zaidi ya mara 750,000 wakati wa kuandikwa kwa makala hii.

eng: It shows a man in Saudi garb taking off his headgear, the agal, and hitting another man, an Egyptian, inside Al Ferdous Mosque, after the latter objected to el-Sisi being cursed.
swa: Inaonyesha mwanaume aliyevalia mavazi ya ki-Saudi akivua kilemba chake, akimpiga mwanaume mwingine, Mmisri, ndani ya Msikiti wa Al Ferdous, baada ya Mmisri huyo kupinga kulaaniwa kwa el-Sisi.

eng: A commotion follows:
swa: Ilikuwa kama ifuatavyo:

eng: el-Sisi, who is also the First Deputy Prime Minister of Egypt now, played a leading role in the ousting of former President Mohamed Morsi, a Muslim Brotherhood member.
swa: el-Sisi, ambaye pia ni Naibu Waziri Mkuu wa Kwanza wa Misri sasa, amehusika kwa kiasi kikubwa katika kumng'oa rais wa zamani Mohamed Morsi, mwanachama cha wa Udugu wa ki-Islamu.

eng: Mohamed Al Omar posts a link to the video on Twitter and quips :
swa: Mohamed Al Omar aliweka kiungo hiki cha video katika mtandao wa twita na kusema :

eng: This fight is proof of the chaos that will happen if squabbles on Twitter are taken to the street
swa: Mapigano haya ni ushahidi wa ghasia zitakazotokea kama yanayoendelea kwenye mtandao wa twita yatahamia mitaani.

eng: Ibrahim Al Rasheed said the preacher had no business butting into Egyptian affairs:
swa: Ibrahim Al Rasheed alisema mhubiri huyo hakuwa na haki ya kuzingumzia masuala ya Misri:

eng: The people of Egypt are more knowledgeable of their affairs and it is of bad taste for this preacher to employ himself as a guardian over Egyptians
swa: Watu wa Misri wanao ufahamu wa kutosha kuhusu mambo yao na haifai kwa mhubiri huyu kujiajiri kama mlezi wa wa-Misri.

eng: Others provide suggestions of how to deal with such clergymen in the future.
swa: Wengine wanatoa maoni ya namna ya kushughulikia watu kama mhubiri huyo katika siku za usoni.

eng: Yazeed Al-Mogren writes:
swa: Yazeed Al-Mogren anaandika:

eng: Next time, those praying should break the preacher's jaw so that he learns his lesson and stops including his political opinion in sermons
swa: Wakati mwingine, waumini wanapaswa kulivunja taya la muhubiri ili ajifunze na kuacha kuingiza maoni yake ya kisiasa kwenye mawaidha yake

eng: They say the clergyman has been arrested.
swa: Inasemekana mhubiri huyo amekamatwa.

eng: What about the cattle who disrupted the sanctity of the mosque and hit the Egyptians there?
swa: Je, wamefanyaje ng'ombe aliyenajisi msikiti na kuwapiga wa-Misri pale?

eng: When will they be arrested and put on trial?
swa: Watakamatwa lini na kufunguliwa mashitaka?

eng: Activist Waleed Sulais sees no reason for aggressive behaviour.
swa: Mwnaharakati Waleed Sulais haoni sababu ya hasira zisizo na sababu:

eng: No to violence.
swa: Tuseme hapana kwa matumizi ya nguvu.

eng: Political differences should be peaceful, and resorting to violence and excusing it, by any side, is unacceptable
swa: Tofauti za kisiasa zapaswa kuwa kwa amani, na kuchagua matumizi ya nguvu, kwa namna yoyote, haikubaliki

eng: He adds:
swa: Anaongeza:

eng: Cursing others is unacceptable and beating up whoever objects to that is vile.
swa: Kuwalaani wengine haikubaliki na kumpiga yeyote anayepinga hilo haifai.

eng: People have dignity.
swa: Watu wanastahili heshima.

eng: Aziz notes:
swa: Aziz anabainisha:

eng: In reaction to burning churches, a little girl in Upper Egypt sketched this picture that brought tears to my eyes: pic.twitter.com/iymw3SF49R — daliaziada (@daliaziada) August 15, 2013
swa: Kufuatia kuchomwa kwa makanisa, msichana mdogo katika Misri ya Juu alichora picha hii iliyonifanya nitiririkwe na machozi: pic.twitter.com/iymw3SF49R — daliaziada (@daliaziada) Agosti 15, 2013

eng: Egyptian women rights advocate Dalia Aziada posted this tweet after several Coptic churches were burnt across Egypt following a brutal military operation on August 14 2013, to clear Muslim Brotherhood supporters from sit-in camps in the capital Cairo, where they have been demanding ousted president Morsi's reinstatement for weeks.
swa: Mtetezi wa haki za wanawake nchini Misri Dalia Aziada aliposti twiti hii baada ya makanisa kadhaa ya wakristo kuteketezwa katika maeneo mbalimbali nchini Misri kufuatia operesheni ya kikatili iliyofanywa na jeshi Agosti 14 2013, iliyokusudia kuwatoa wafuasi wa chama cha Udugu wa Ki-islamu kutoka makao ya makambi katika mji mkuu wa Cairo, ambapo wamekuwa wakidai kurejeshwa madarakani kwa rais Morsi kwa wiki kadhaa.

eng: The clearing operation resulted in at least 638 deaths according to the Egyptian government.
swa: Operesheni hiyo ya kuwaondoa wafuasi hao ilisababisha vifo vya watu wasiopungua 638 kwa mujibu wa serikali ya Misri.

eng: A Muslim Brotherhood spokesman has said 2,000 people were killed in the “massacre.”
swa: Msemaji wa chama cha Udugu wa ki-Islamu amesema watu 2,000 waliuawa katika "mauaji hayo ya halaiki".

eng: Dozens more were killed on August 16, as Muslim Brotherhood supporters clashed with security forces in the "Day of Anger."
swa: Makumi kadhaa waliuawa mnamo Agosti 16, wakati wafuasi wa Udugu wa ki-Islamu walipokuwa wakipambana na vikosi vya usalama katika "Siku ya hasira."

eng: Read more in our Special Coverage Bloodbath in Egypt.
swa: Soma zaidi katika Habari zetu MaalumUmwagaji wa damu nchini Misri.

eng: The authorities in Uzbekistan are seeking to impose strict controls on the country's bloggers.
swa: Serikali nchini Uzbekistan inatafuta namna ya kutumia hatua kali za kudhibiti wanablogu wa nchi hiyo.

eng: Alisher Abdugofurov on Registan.net shares his opinion about why this is happening in a society where there are not many bloggers to start with.
swa: Alisher Abdugofurov kwenye Registan.net anajadili sababu ya kutokea hali hii katika jamii ambayo haina wanablogu wengi wa kuanzia zoezi hilo.

eng: Today, a group of Hong Kong activists from League of Social Democrats and Socialist Action protested outside Egypt Consulate and condemned the military over August 14 Cairo Massacre.
swa: Leo, kundi la wanaharakati wa Hong Kong kutoka Chama cha Demokrasia na Ujamaa (LSDS) waliandamana nje ya ubalozi wa Misri na kulilaani jeshi kwa mauaji ya halaiki mnamo Agosti 14 mjini Cairo.

eng: Photo from inmediahk.net.
swa: Picha kutoka kwa inmediahk.net.
