eng: President Robert Mugabe won Zimbabwe's presidential election on Saturday 31 July, 2013, beating his closest rival, the former Prime Minister in the coalition government Morgan Tsvangirai.
swa: Rais Robert Mugabe ameshinda uchaguzi wa Rais nchini Zimbabwe ulifanyika Jumamosi ya Julai 31, 2013, akimbwaga mshindani wake wa karibu, waziri mkuu wa zamani katika serikali ya umoja wa kitaifa Morgan Tsvangirai.

eng: The peaceful elections were the first since the formation of a coalition government between Mugabe's Zanu PF party and Tsvangirai's The Movement for Democratic Change (MDC).
swa: Uchaguzi huo umekuwa wa amani kwa mara ya kwanza tangu kuanzishw akwa serikali ya pamoja kati ya chama cha Zanu PF cha Mugabe na chama kikuu cha upinzani kinachoongozwa na Tsvangirai kiitwacho Movement for Democratic Change (MDC).

eng: The coalition was formed following the last disputed and bloody elections in 2008.
swa: Serikali ya pamoja ilianzishwa kufuatia uchaguzi uliopita wa mwaka 2008 ulisemekana kuvurugwa mno na kusababisha umwagaji wa damu.

eng: Mugabe, who is 89 years old and has been in power for 33 years, will continue to rule the country for the next five years.
swa: Mugabe, mwenye umri wa miaka 89 na ambaye amekuwa madarakani kwa miaka 33, ataendelea kuitawala nchi hiyo kwa miaka mingine mitano.

eng: Election observer missions from the African Union (AU) and Southern African Development Community (SADC) have endorsed Mugabe's victory amid claims of massive electoral fraud coming from the opposition.
swa: Waangalizi wa uchaguzi huo kutoka Umoja wa Afrika (AU) na Jumuiya ya Maendeleo ya Nchi za Afrika ya Kusini (SADC) wameunga mkono uchaguzi wa Mugabe pamoja na madai ya udanganyifu mkubwa yanayotolewa na upinzani.

eng: Botswana, however, is the only African country that has called for an independent audit into the election.
swa: Botswana, hata hivyo, ni nchi pekee ya Afrika iliyotoa wito wa ukaguzi huru wa uchaguzi huo.

eng: Some SADCC members have qualified their endorsements by arguing that the election was free "but not necessarily fair."
swa: Baadhi ya wnaachama wa SADC wamethibitisha kuyaunga mkono matokeo hayo kwa kudai kuwa uchaguzi ulikuwa huru "lakini si lazima uwe wa haki."

eng: President Robert Mugabe is the oldest leader in Africa.
swa: Rais Robert Mugabe ni mtawala mzee kuliko wote barani Afrika.

eng: Photo released to the public domain by the U.S. federal government.
swa: Picha imeruhusiwa kutumiwa na umma na serikali ya Marekani.

eng: The election took place despite protests from Mugabe's coalition partners and Zimbabwean citizens after he unilaterally declared 31 July, 2013 as the date the country will hold elections.
swa: Uchaguzi ulifanyika pamoja na maandamano kutoka kwa washirika wa muungano wa Mugabe na raia wa Zimbabwe baada ya *Mugabe) kujitangazia mwenyewe kuwa Julai 31, 2013 ndiyo tarehe ya uchaguzi.

eng: The Constitutional Court ordered Robert Mugabe to hold elections by 31 July following a successful application by Jealousy Mawarire, director of the Centre for Elections and Democracy in Southern Africa (CEDSA).
swa: Mahakama ya Katiba ilimwamuru Robert Mugabe kuitisha uchaguzi tarehe 31 Julai kufuatia kufanikiwa kwa maombi ya Jealousy Mawarire, mkurugenzi wa Kituo cha Uchaguzi na Demokrasia kwa eneo la Afrika ya Kusini (CEDSA).

eng: Using the hashtags #ZimElections, #ZimbabweDecides, #ZimDecides and #ZimbabweElections, Twitter users from different parts of the world react to Mugabe's victory.
swa: Kwa kutumia alama habari #ZimElections, #ZimbabweDecides, #ZimDecides na #ZimbabweElections, watumiaji wa Twita kutoka sehemu mbalimbali za dunia walitoa maoni yao kuhusiana na ushindi wa Mugabe.

eng: A Zambian based in the the UK and the founder of CrossFire Radio, Mueti Moomba (@Muweight) wondered who voted for the 89-year-old leader:
swa: Mzambia anayeishi Uingereza na mwanzilishi wa CrossFire Radio, Mueti Moomba (@Muweight) alishangaa nani alimpigia kura mtawala huyo mzee wa miaka 89:

eng: Before I sleep I call out to all #zimbabweans , who in their right mind among you voted for a man on deaths door? #zimbabwedecides my foot — mueti moomba (@Muweight) August 3, 2013
swa: Kabla sijalala ninawaomba #wazimbabwe wote, ambao kwa akili zao timamu walimpigia kura mzee anayechungulia kaburi? #zimbabwedecides my foot — mueti moomba (@Muweight) August 3, 2013

eng: Zimbabwean social entrepreneur Sir Nigel (@SirNige) has not not given up hope:
swa: Mjasiria mali wa kijamii wa Zimbabwe Sir Nigel (@SirNige) hakukata tamaa:

eng: I was once again reminded that there are things I/we can do after #ZimElections ie participate in the process starting NOW #263Chat #Twimbos — Sir Nigel (@SirNige) August 6, 2013
swa: Nilikumbushwa kwa mara nyingine tena kwmaba yapo mambo ninayo/tunayoweza kufanya baada #Uchaguzi wa Zimbabwe yaani kushiriki kwenye mchakacho kuanzia SASA #263Chat #Twimbos — Sir Nigel (@SirNige) August 6, 2013

eng: Andiva (@AndyAndiva) from Kenya blamed the opposition MDC for participating in a flawed election:
swa: Andiva (@AndyAndiva) kutoka Kenya anakilaumu chama cha upinzani cha MDC kwa kushiriki uchaguzi uliovurugwa:

eng: so why did MDC participate in the elections with knowledge it was flawed from the onset? #Zimbabwedecides — Andiva (@AndyAndiva) August 3, 2013
swa: kwa nini MDC walishiriki kwneye uchaguzi huo wakijua kuwa ulikuwa umevurugwa tangu mwanzo? #Zimbabwedecides — Andiva (@AndyAndiva) August 3, 2013

eng: South African author and brand advisor Thebe Ikafaleng (@ThebeIkafaleng) quoted Tendai Biti, the Secretary General for MDC, making fun of those arguing that the presence of two million dead people on the voters' roll did not cost the opposition:
swa: mwandishi wa Afrika Kusini na mshauri wa matangazo Thebe Ikafaleng (@ThebeIkafaleng) alimnukuu Tendai Biti, Katibu Mkuu wa MDC, aliwakejeli wale waliokuwa wakihoji uwepo wa watu milioni mbili waliokwisha kufa katika daftari la wapiga kura haukuathiri upinzani:

eng: They admit there's 2m people who are dead on the voters' roll, but 'because they're dead, they can't vote'.
swa: Wanakiri kuwa kuwa watu milioni mbili waliokufa katika daftari la wapiga kura, lakini 'kwa sababu wamekufa, hawawezi kupiga kura'.

eng: Tendai Biti. #ZimbabweDecides. — Thebe Ikalafeng (@ThebeIkalafeng) July 31, 2013
swa: Tendai Biti. #ZimbabweDecides. — Thebe Ikalafeng (@ThebeIkalafeng) July 31, 2013

eng: Zim Elections (@ZimElections) showed the seriousness of dead voters' problem:
swa: Uchaguzi wa Zimbabwe (@ZimElections) umeonyesha ukubwa wa tatizo la wapiga kura mfu:

eng: 75% of the 59 ID discovered at Polling stations in Chegutu town since last week Wednesday belong to dead people. #ZimElections — ZimElections2013 (@Zimelections13) August 6, 2013
swa: asilimia 75 ya vitambulishi vya mpiga kura vilivyogunduliwa katika vituo vya kupigia kura kwenye mji wa Chegutu tangu Jumatano ya wiki iliyopita ni vya watu waliokwisha kufa siku nyingi. #ZimElections — ZimElections2013 (@Zimelections13) August 6, 2013

eng: rakim allah (@LDaviano) commented on the same issue of “dead voters”:
swa: rakim allah (@LDaviano) alitoa maoni kwenye suala hilo hilo la "wapiga kura wafu":

eng: Might be traumatising to hv more dead people voting than the living#zim elections — rakim allah (@LDaviano) August 6, 2013
swa: Inaweza kushangaza sana kuwa na watu wengi waliokufa wakipiga kura zaidi ya wale walio hai — rakim allah (@LDaviano) August 6, 2013

eng: Al Jazeera's Azad Essa (@azadessa) questioned the African Union's assessment of the election:
swa: Azad Essa wa Al Jazeera(@azadessa) alihoji tathmini ya Umoja wa Afrika kwa uchaguzi huo:

eng: There were 9700 polling stations.
swa: Kuna vituo 9700 vya kupigia kura.

eng: The AU visited 350.
swa: AU walitembelea vituo 350.

eng: Is that an acceptable sample size to pass judgement? #zimelections — Azad Essa (@azadessa) August 3, 2013
swa: Je, hiyo ni sampuli inayokubalika kufanya uamuzi? #zimelections — Azad Essa (@azadessa) August 3, 2013

eng: Investigative journalist and film maker Stanley Kwenda (@stanleykwanda) noted that participation of police could have intimidated illiterate voters:
swa: Mwandishi wa Habari za Uchunguzi na Mtengenezaji wa filamu Stanley Kwenda (@stanleykwanda) alibainisha kuwa ushiriki wa polisi inawezekana uliwatisha wapiga kura wasio na uelewa:

eng: #Zimbabwedecides involvement of police & electoral officers in assisting illiterate voters could have intimidated voters — stanley kwenda (@stanleykwenda) August 2, 2013
swa: #Zimbabwedecides kuhusishw akwa polisi kama & maafisa wa uchaguzi katika kuwasaidia wapiga kura wasio na uelewa inawezekana kuliwatisha wapiga kura hao — stanley kwenda (@stanleykwenda) August 2, 2013

eng: South African businessman Another_craig (@@Another_craig) tweeted about reports of a 135-year-old soldier who "voted" in the election:
swa: mfanya biashara wa Afrika Kusini Another_craig (@@Another_craig) alitwiti kuhusu taarifa ya mwanajeshi mwenye miaka 135 "aliyepiga kura" katika uchaguzi huo:

eng: So apparently, a 135 year old soldier actually voted in #Zimelections last week.
swa: Kwa hiyo, inawezekana, mwanajeshi mzee wa miaka 135 kweli akapiga kura kwenye uchaguzi huo wiki iliyopita.

eng: Ah, the benefit of regular exercise. — Craig (@Another_craig) August 6, 2013
swa: Oh, ndio faida ya zoezi hili huru. — Craig (@Another_craig) August 6, 2013

eng: Replying to @Another_craig, South African entrepreneur Sello Rabele (@sellorabs) wrote that he wishes to be a soldier when he grows up:
swa: Akimjibu @Another_craig, mjasiria mali wa Afrika Kusini Sello Rabele (@sellorabs) alindaika kwamba anatamani kuwa mwanajeshi akikua:

eng: @Another_craig @chrishartZA #Zimelections I want to be a soldier when I grow up, over 130 yrs, that is — Sello Rabele (@sellorabs) August 6, 2013
swa: @Another_craig @chrishartZA #Zimelections Ninataka kuwa mwanajeshi nikikua, yaani nikifikisha miaka 130 — Sello Rabele (@sellorabs) August 6, 2013

eng: arnold chamunogwa (@chamunogwa) was not surprised that the ruling party rigged.
swa: arnold chamunogwa (@chamunogwa) hakuonyesha kushangaa kuwa chama tawala kimeiba kura.

eng: He is surprised by something else:
swa: Alishangazwa na suala jingine kabisa:

eng: Its not surprising that ZPF rigged but its surprising tht MDC is actually surprised by the extent of rigging #Zimelections #Zimbabwedecides — arnold chamunogwa (@chamunogwa) August 2, 2013
swa: Haishangazi kwamba ZPF kiliiba kura lakini inashangaza kwamba MDC ndiyo imeshangazwa na kiwango cha wizi wa kura katika uchaguzi huo #Zimbabwedecides — arnold chamunogwa (@chamunogwa) August 2, 2013

eng: Akuzike Polela (@Mulengi) from Zambia noted that Morgan Tsvangirai has one African friend:
swa: Akuzike Polela (@Mulengi) kutoka Zambia alibainisha kwamba Morgan Tsvangirai ana rafiki mmoja wa ki-Afrika:

eng: Botswana speaks different word on Zim elections.
swa: Botswana inaongea neno tofauti kuhusu uchaguzi wa Zimbabwe.

eng: Morgan has ONE African friend so far. — Akuzike Polela (@Mulengi) August 6, 2013
swa: Morgan ana rafiki MMOJA wa Kiafrika mpaka sasa. — Akuzike Polela (@Mulengi) August 6, 2013

eng: Zimbabwean Kudzai (@shuestrait) would like to see Zimbabweans living in the country decide what is good for their country:
swa: Zimbabwean Kudzai (@shuestrait) ningependa kuwaona wa-Zimbabwe wanaoishi nchini humo wakiamua kile kilicho chema kwa ajili ya nchi yao:

eng: Only Zimbos know whts gud for Zimbabweans..Resident Zimbabweans nt ppl in the diaspora & some state secretary from the US or UK..#ZimDecides — kudzai (@shuestrait) August 5, 2013
swa: Ni wa-Zimbabwe pekee wanaojua kile kilichochema kwa wa-Zimbabwe..Wakaazi wa Zimbabwe na sio watu wanaoishi nje na baadhi ya mawaziri kutoka Marekani au Uingereza..#ZimDecides — kudzai (@shuestrait) August 5, 2013

eng: Kenyan David Ogara (@david_ogara) came to a bitter conclusion about elections in Africa:
swa: Mkenya David Ogara (@david_ogara) alifanya hitimisho chungu kuhusu uchaguzi wa Afrika:

eng: So MUGABE 89 is President elect Zimbabwe.....Presidential elections are meaningless in Africa...... — David Ogara (@david_ogara) August 2, 2013
swa: Kwa hiyo MUGABE mwenye miaka 89 ni Rais mteule wa Zimbabwe.....uchaguzi wa Rais hauna maana yoyote kwa Afrika...... — David Ogara (@david_ogara) August 2, 2013

eng: Yeshey Dorji welcomes the move of the Bhutanese National Council to initiate a discussion on the electoral corruptions that were reported during the country's last General Elections the possible amendments the electoral laws require.
swa: Yeshey Dorji anaunga mkono hatua ya Baraza la Taifa Butan kuanzisha mjadala wa rushwa wakati wa uchaguzi ambazo zimeripotiwa wakati wa Uchaguzi Mkuu uliopita zinazohitaji marekebisho yanayowezekana ya sheria ya uchaguzi.

eng: Saudi Arabia marks its National Day on September 23.
swa: Saudi Arabia huadhimisha Sikukuu ya Kitaifa ya Uhuru tarehe 23, Septemba.

eng: While this is usually a day people celebrate the monarchy more than the country itself, the previous two national days were different.
swa: Wakati kwa kawaida hii huwa ni siku ya watu kusherehekea ufalme wa nchi hiyo kuliko nchi yenyewe, miaka miwili iliyopita imekuwa tofauti kidogo.

eng: Saudis, with the use of social networks and blogs, had the chance to express themselves freely - blogging their hopes for a nation which respects and embraces its people and their aspirations.
swa: Wa-Saudi, kwa kutumia mitandao ya kijamii na blogu, wamekuwa na nafasi ya kujieleza kwa uhuru -wakiblogu matumaini yao kwa taifa linaloheshimu na kuthamini watu wake na matarajio yao.

eng: Writer and Doctor, Bader Al-Ibrahim wrote:
swa: Mwandishi na Daktari, Bader Al-Ibrahim aliandika:

eng: The carnival celebration is not enough to reinforce the national sense of belonging in the absence of a popular memory, a joint identity and institutions sponsoring citizenship.
swa: Sherehe hizo za kitaifa hazitoshi kuhamasisha hisia za utaifa wakati kumbukumbu muhimu hazipo, utambulisho wa pamoja na taasisi zinazofadhili uraia hazipo.

eng: Jordanian Human Rights Defender, Fadi Al-Qadi, tweeted:
swa: Mtetezi wa Haki za Raia wa Jordan, Fadi Al-Qadi, alitwiti:

eng: Abdullah Al-Hamed and his fellows in ACPRA are spending the Saudi national day in prisons.
swa: Abdullah Al-Hamed na wafanyakazi wenzake katika shirika la ACPRA wanatumia siku ya maadhimisho ya uhuru wa Saudia wakiwa gerezani.

eng: One of their charges is "impeding development" while the ruler's charge is "impeding humanity".
swa: Mojawapo ya mashitaka ni "kukwaza maendeleo" wakati mtawala anashitakiwa kwa "kukwaza utu".

eng: Writer Abdullah Al-Malki tweeted:
swa: Mwandishi Abdullah Al-Malki alitwiti:

eng: On our national day, we remember ACPRA, Al-Hamed, Al-Qahtani, Al-Bjadi, Tawfeeq Al-Amer, Al-Mnasif and Jeddah reformists and everyone who struggled for this country to reform and prosper.
swa: Siku yetu ya Uhuru, tunakumbuka ACPRA, Al-Hamed, Al-Qahtani, Al-Bjadi, Tawfeeq Al-Amer, Al-Mnasif na Jeddah ambao ni wanaharakati wa mabadiliko pamoja na wengine wote waliopigana kwa ajili nchi hii kubadilika na kufanikiwa.

eng: Peace be upon you.
swa: Amani iwe kwenu.

eng: While Eman Al-Qaffas noted:
swa: Wakati Eman Al-Qaffas anabaini:

eng: Whoever thinks loving your country necessitates loving your government is a person who does not love the country.
swa: Yeyote anayedhani kuipenda nchi yake maana yake ni kuipenda serikali yako ni mtu asiyeipenda nchi.

eng: And Rehab Al-Hamdan added:
swa: Na Rehab Al-Hamdan anaongeza:

eng: People are more aware now.
swa: Watu wameelimika sasa.

eng: Empty words don't fool them anymore.
swa: Hawadanganyiki kwa maneno matupu tena.

eng: Many bloggers shared their thoughts on the national day from different perspectives.
swa: Wanablogu wengi walitoa maoni tofauti kuhusu siku hiyo ya uhuru.

eng: Sultan Al-Amer, writer and blogger, wrote from an Arab nationalist point of view:
swa: Sultan Al-Amer, mwandishi na mwanablogu, aliandika kwa mtazamo wa kizalendo wa Kiarabu:

eng: Our national history as Arabs is not restricted by the borders and history of Saudi Arabia.
swa: Historia ya taifa letu kama Waarabu haijafungwa na mipaka na historia ya Saudi Arabia.

eng: Our national history is that of the people living between the Gulf and the ocean not the history of regimes only.
swa: Historia ya taifa letu ni kwamba watu wanaoishi kati ya Ghuba na bahari na sio historia ya tawala mbalimbali tu.

eng: The meaning of "a country" cannot be celebrated until it is embodied by political rights and freedoms.
swa: Maana ya "nchi" haiwezi kusherehekewa mpaka iwe imefungamanishwa na haki za kisiasa na uhuru.

eng: The ruling regimes can easily build a strong legitimacy if they start defending and siding with their people's causes and responding to their hopes and aspirations.
swa: Tawala zilizomadarakani zinaweza kujenga uhalali kama zitaanza kutetea na kuungana na misimamo ya watu wake na kujibu matumaini yao na ndoto walizonazo.

eng: While another nationalist journalist and writer, Abdullah Al-Duhailan, blogged criticizing two types of people.
swa: Wakati mwandishi mwingine wa habari mzalenzo, Abdullah Al-Duhailan, aliblogu akikosoa aina mbili za watu.

eng: One is the intellectual elites who refuse to celebrate such a day until all political and civil demands are met.
swa: Moja ni tabaka la wasomi wanaokataa kusherehekea siku hiyo mpaka matakwa yote ya kisiasa na kiraia yatekelezwe.

eng: The other is the majority of the people who respond to media's propaganda and celebrate certain people instead of the country itself.
swa: Wengine ni idadi kubwa ya watu wanaoshabikia propaganda za vyombo vya habari na kujikuta wakisherehekea watu fulani badala ya nchi yenyewe.

eng: The families of detainees saw this day as a chance to raise awareness about their cause.
swa: Familia za watu waliowekwa kizuizini wanaiona siku hii kama nafasi ya kukuza uelewa kuhusu malengo yao.

eng: Anonymous advocacy groups @e3teqal and @almonaseron called for several small protests that took place mainly in Buraiydah.
swa: Vikundi vya utetezi visivyofahamika majina @e3teqal na @almonaseron kutoa mwito wa maandamano madogo yaliyofanyika zaidi mjini Buraiydah.

eng: From the women's protest in Buraiydah
swa: Kutoka kwenye maandamano ya wanawake mjini Buraiydah

eng: Tires were burnt in non-residential areas with posters next to them demanding the release of the detainees.
swa: Matairi yalichomwa katika maeneo yasiyo ya makazi huku kukiwa na mabango karibu yanayotaka watu waliokamatwa kuachiwa huru.

eng: And a meeting was held in Buraiydah where relatives of detainees met and discussed the possible ways to support the detainees.
swa: Na mkutano ulifanyika mjini Buraiydah ambapo ndugu za watu waliokamatwa walikutana na kujadili njia zinazoweza kufanyika ili kuwasaidia wafungwa hao.

eng: The family of Abdulkarim Al-Khuder, imprisoned ACPRA member, were among a few families who had their houses surrounded by police cars for hanging pictures of their detained loved ones.
swa: Familia ya Abdulkarim Al-Khuder, mwanachama wa ACPRA aliyefungwa, walikuwa miongoni mwa familia chache zilifanya nyumba zao zizingirwe na magari ya polisi kwa kosa la kutundika picha za wapendwa wao waliowekwa kizuizini.

eng: Mahdi Al-Zahir, an activist from Qatif, tweeted:
swa: Mahdi Al-Zahir, mwanaharakati kutoka Qatif, alitwiti:

eng: I would like to celebrate the national day.
swa: Ningependa kusherehekea siku ya Uhuru.

eng: But my brother is detained, my cousin is detained, my friend is detained, even my neighbor is detained.
swa: Lakini kaka yangu yuko kizuizini, mpwa wangu naye yuko kizuizini, rafiki yangu naye yuko kizuizini, hata jirani yangu naye yuko kizuizini.

eng: And The Saudi Civil and Political Rights Association (ACPRA) published a statement calling for the release of all prisoners of conscience and for a national dialogue between the government and elected representatives of the people as equals.
swa: Na Shirika la Haki za Kiraia na Kisiasa la Kisaudi (ACPRA) lilichapisha tamko lililotaka kuachiwa kwa wafungwa wote wa dhamira na pia kuwepo kwa mjadala wa kitaifa wenye usawa kati ya serikali kwa upande mmoja na wawakilishi wa wananchi waliochaguliwa kwa kura kwa upande wa pili.

eng: There are persons in this nation, like any other, who are willing to continue the peaceful struggle until their legitimate demands are met.
swa: Kuna watu katika taifa hili, kama wengineo, waliotayari kuendelea kupambana kwa amani mpaka madai yao ya haki yatakaposikilizwa na kutekelezwa.

eng: Prisons will not be enough.
swa: Magereza hayatatosha.

eng: Every time a group is imprisoned, another group will come out... Governments, and sometimes countries, change, but the people remain.
swa: Kila kundi linapowekwa kizuizini, kikundi kingine kinaingia uwanjani...Serikali, na wakati mwingine nchi, hubadilika, lakini watu wake hubaki.

eng: Honorable Joseph (Sugu) Mbilinyi resisting attempts by security officers to remove him from Parliament last week.
swa: Mheshimiwa Joseph (Sugu) Mbilinyi akipinga jaribio la kutaka kutolewa ndani ya ukumbi wa Bunge na maafisa usalama wa Bunge wiki iliyopita.

eng: Photo Courtesy of Jamii Forums.
swa: Picha kwa idhini ya jamii forums.

eng: Over the last few years, Tanzania's parliament has become fodder for fantastic theatrics.
swa: Kwa miaka ya hivi karibuni, bunge la Tanzania limekuwa na mfululizo wa matukio ya kustaajabisha na vituko mithili ya maigizo.

eng: Random eruptions of arguments followed by mass walkouts, usually by the opposition, has turned parliamentary sessions into must-watch television.
swa: Kulipuka kwa majibizano yasiyo ya mpangilio yanayofuatiwa na wabunge kutoka nje ya bunge, ambao mara nyingi huwa ni wabunge wa vyama vya upinzani, imesababisha vikao vya bunge kuwa ni miongoni mwa vipindi vya televisheni visivyochosha kuangaliwa.

eng: In April 2011, for example, Ezekiel Wenje, a member of parliament (MP) from the leading opposition party Chadema, drew the ire of the Speaker Anna Makinda with his comment that certain government positions are selected via the 'dark market'.
swa: Kwa mfano, Aprili 2011, Ezekiel Wenje, mbunge wa kwa tiketi ya chama kikuu cha upinzani, CHADEMA aliamsha hasira ya spika Anna Makinda kufuatia matamshi yake kuwa baadhi ya nyadhifa fulani za serikali zinachaguliwa kupitia “njia za udanganyifu”.

eng: Ruling party MPs from Chama Cha Mapinduzi (CCM) protested and demanded that Wenje retract his statement.
swa: Wabunge wa chama tawala, Chama cha Mapinduzi (CCM) walipinga na kumtaka Wenje kufuta kauli yake.

eng: He refused, upon which a shouting match broke out.
swa: Alikataa kufanya hivyo, hali iliyosababisha azomewe na wabunge wa Chama cha Mapinduzi.

eng: As Tanzanian blogger Subi wrote at the time, heard within this exchange was the phrase, "tufunge mlango tupigane" ("let's close the doors and fight").
swa: Kama mwanablogu wa Kitanzania, Subi alivyoandika yaliyosikika wakati wa majibizano, inasemekana Wenje alisema "tufunge mlango tupigane".

eng: In the end it never came to that, as Wenje took back his statement, and things proceeded with relative calm.
swa: Hali haikufika huko, kwani Wenje alifuta kauli yake na taratibu za bunge ziliendelea kama kawaida.

eng: But there were a few other close calls.
swa: Lakini kuliendelea kuwa na maneno ya ugomvi wa hapa na pale.

eng: In February 2013, live coverage of a session had to be suspended because things became too heated.
swa: Februari 2013, kikao cha bunge kilichokuwa kikirushwa moja kwa moja tokea bungeni ilibidi kisitishwe kuoneshwa kufuatia vurugu zilizoibuka Bungeni humo .

eng: And then there was the incident five months ago, when a Chadema MP was thrown out of the chamber for interrupting a colleague of his from CCM, during a debate on the budget.
swa: Ndipo, miezi mitano tena baadae, lilipotokea tukio la mbunge wa Chadema kutolewa nje ya ukumbi wa Bunge kwa kuingilia hotuba ya mbunge mwenzake kutoka chama tawala, CCM wakati wa mjadala wa bajeti ya serikali.

eng: Serukamba's 'f**k you' moment prompted one commenter, a voter from his constituency, identifying himself as Dr Mvano Khalidi, to apologize on Facebook for his MP's conduct:
swa: Tusi la Serukamba, “f**k you'”, lilipelekea mmoja wa wapiga kura kutoka katika jimbo la Serukamba, aliyejitambulisha kwa jina la Dr Mvano Khalidi, kutoa maoni yake kwa kuomba msamaha kupitia ukurasa wa Facebook kufuatia utovu wa nidhamu wa mbunge wake:

eng: My apologies honorable members of parliament for the insult thrown at you, we ask your forgiveness on behalf of everyone from Kigoma, for the error committed by our MP from Kigoma his tongue slipped and he did not intended to say what he said, I am a patriot for my region.
swa: Poleni sana waheshimiwa wabunge kwa kutukanwa ila tunaomba rathi kwa niaba ya wana Kigoma wote kwa kosa alilolifanya mbunge wetu kutoka kigoma ulimi ulitereza jumani hayakuwa makusudio yake kusema vile mimi kuma mzalendo wa mkoa wangu.

eng: On Thursday, 5 September, 2013, matters got even farther out of hand.
swa: Siku ya Alhamisi, Septemba 5, 2013, mambo yaliendelea kuwa mabaya zaidi.

eng: An opposition MP Joseph Mbilinyi of Chadema found himself embroiled in a physical altercation with parliamentary security officers that surprised and shocked in equal measure.
swa: Mbunge wa chama cha upinzani cha Chadema, Mheshimiwa Joseph Mbilinyi, alijikuta katika wakati mgumu pale alipokuwa akikabiliana kwa nguvu na majibizano na maafisa usalama wa bunge, tukio lililokuwa la kushangaza na la kuwaacha watu midomo wazi.

eng: Things came to a head after Freeman Mbowe, the leader of the opposition in parliament, refused to sit down after being asked to do so by Ndugai.
swa: Hali ilifikia hapo mara baada ya kiongozi wa kambi rasmi ya upinzani Freeman Mbowe, kukataa kukaa hata baada ya kutakiwa kufanya hivyo na Ndugai.

eng: From newspaper The Citizen:
swa: Kutoka katika gazeti la The Citizen:

eng: Mr Ndugai ordered that the Chadema supremo be kicked out for disregarding his orders to sit down.
swa: Bwana Ndugai alitoa amri kuwa, kiongozi wa kambi rasmi ya Upinzani atolewe katika ukumbi wa Bunge kwa kukataa kutii amri ya kukaa.

eng: Mr Mbowe was protesting the move by the Deputy Speaker to bar him from moving a motion to block continuation of the debate on the Bill for Amendment of the Constitutional Review Act 2013.
swa: Bwana Mbowe alipinga harakati za Naibu Spika za kutaka kumzuia Mbowe asiendelee na msimamo wake wa kutaka kuhamisha mjadala ili kusitisha mjadala wa Rasimu ya mapitio ya mabadiliko ya Katiba ya mwaka 2013.

eng: Chaos soon ensued on the floor as other opposition MPs rushed to form a human shield around Mr Mbowe to prevent the security men from throwing him out.
swa: Punde, machafuko yalianza mara baada ya wabunge wengine wa upinzani kwenda kumkinga kwa kumzunguka bwana Mbowe ili kuzuia maafisa wa usalama wa bunge wasimtoe Mbowe Bungeni.

eng: On the popular platform Jamii Forums, photos showing Mbilinyi resisting attempts by officers to remove him from the House floor generated considerable debate about the nature of politics in Tanzania.
swa: Katika jukwaa maarufuJamii Forums, picha zilimuonesha Mbilinyi akikataa kuondolewa katika ukumbi wa bunge na maafisa usalama, uliibua mjadala wa kina kuhusiana na aina ya siasa ya Tanzania.

eng: One commenter by the name of "Stoudemire" posed this question:
swa: Mchangiaji mmoja aliyejitambulisha kwa jina la "Stoudemire" aliuliza swali hili:

eng: With this attitude, should we give the country to young people?
swa: Namna hii kweli tuwape vijana nchi kweli?

eng: Our elders are good enough even if they doze off in Parliament!
swa: Waacheni wazee wasinzie bungeni tu inatosha!

eng: Another contributor by the name of Tata suggested that the whole incident pointed to the inability by Deputy Speaker Ndugai to control the session.
swa: Mchangiaji mwingine mwenye jina Tata alipendekeza kuwa, tukio zima limesababishwa na Naibu spika kushindwa kuongoza vyema kikao cha bunge.

eng: Tata also implied that the behaviour by MP Mbilinyi may have been because he was under the influence:
swa: Tata pia alitanabaisha kuwa, hali iliyooneshwa na Mbunge Mbilinyi naweza kuwa ilisababishwa na hamasa kutoka kwa wenzake:

eng: The Deputy Speaker makes me laugh when he suggests that it is shameful for the leader of the opposition to instruct other opposition members to leave the chamber, when in fact it is a shame for him to be unable to control the session. But this move by Honorable Sugu has left me dead with laughter.
swa: Amenifurahisha huyu Naibu Spika kwa kudai ni aibu ya kiongozi wa Upinzani kuongoza wapinzani kutoka nje wakati kimsingi hii ni aibu yake kwa kushindwa ku-manage kikao...la hii move ya mwisho ya huyu mheshimiwa Sugu imeniacha hoi kwa kicheko.

eng: It seems like he was drunk on something or may have smoked these cigarettes preferred by the youth.
swa: Inaonekana jamaa ama alikuwa amepata "chang'aa" au alikuwa amevuta haya masigara yanayopendwa na vijana.

eng: On Twitter, Sajjad Fazel (@SajjadF) argued that the incident may have undermined Chadema's credibility: What Hon. Joseph Mbilinyi has done gives a really negative image of Chadema and Tanzanians as a whole.
swa: Katika mtandao wa Twita, Sajjad Fazel (@SajjadF) alihoja kuwa, tukio hilo linaweza kuwa limeshusha hadhi ya chadema:

eng: The former Attorney General, former Minister of Infrastructure, currently beleaguered owner of a few billion 'vijisenti' . Mr. Andrew Chenge was caught on CCTV a few nights ago doing something very fishy inside Parliament.
swa: Jaji Mkuu mstaafu, waziri wa zamani wa Wizara ya Miundo Mbinu, hivi sasa akifahamika kama mmiliki wa vibilioni vichache , Bw Andrew Chenge alinaswa na kamera za bunge( CCTV) siku chache zilizopita muda wa usiku katika ukumbi wa bunge akifanya jambo lililotiliwa mashaka makubwa.

eng: Mheshimiwa was filmed entering the building after hours in the company of a Parliament staff member, and sprinkling an unknown substance on every all the MPs' seats.
swa: Mheshimiwa alinaswa na kamera hizo zilizomuonesha akiingia bungeni masaa kadhaa baada ya kusindikizwa na mfanyakazi wa bunge na kisha kuonekana akinyunyiza kitu kwenye viti vyote vya wabunge.

eng: He spent an especially long time hovering around the Speaker's chair.
swa: Alitumia muda mwingi zaidi akizunguka-zunguka katika kiti cha Spika.

eng: I am guessing it was not linen freshening spray.
swa: Ninahisi hayakuwa marashi.

eng: At the time, Chenge was under investigation by the British government's Serious Fraud Office for corruption involving the British arms manufacturer BAE.
swa: Kwa wakati huo, Chenge alikuwa akichunguzwa na taasisi ya kuchunguza makosa makubwa ya jinai nchini Uingereza (SFO) kufuatia kutuhumiwa kwa kosa la rushwa iliyohusisha kampuni ya kiingereza ya BAE.

eng: Four years later, after Tanzania's Prevention and Combating of Corruption Bureau 'failed' to discover evidence of wrongdoing, the Director of Public Prosecution dropped the charges.
swa: Miaka minne baadae, mara baada ya Tume ya Kupambana na Rushwa ya Tanzania ‘kushindwa’ kuweka bayana makosa aliyotuhumiwa nayo Mh. Chenge, Mkurugenzi wa mashitaka alifutilia mbali mashitaka hayo.

eng: That day in parliament, however, it was unclear what, exactly, Chenge was doing.
swa: Hata hivyo, haikuweza kufahamika moja kwa moja, alichokuwa anakikifanya Chenge katika ukumbi wa Bunge.

eng: But for Ms. Eyakuze it seemed that the former Attorney General had resorted to the dark arts to get himself out of trouble:
swa: Lakini, kwa mujibu wa Eyakuze, ilionekana kuwa, jaji huyo Mkuu mstaafu aliamua kutumia njia za giza katika harakati za kutaka kujinasua kwenye mashitaka yaliyokuwa yakimkabili:

eng: Your goat, Mr. Chenge, is roasted.
swa: Chenge, mbuzi wako anachomwa.

eng: Your chickens have come home and they are roosting.
swa: Vifaranga wako wameshafika nyumbani na sasa wanajikusanya kwenye kiota.

eng: You are reaping what you sowed, et cetera. What you have left in the public eye at this point is a tiny little modicum of dignity, that stuff that we so willingly accord to old men with money and pot-bellies.
swa: Unakivuna kile ulichokipanda n.k Ulichokiacha katika macho ya watu hadi wakati huu ni kiasi kidogo sana cha sehemu ya utu wako, kitu ambacho sote kwa hiari tulikubaliana na wazee wenye pesa na vitambi.

eng: I suggest you hold on to it with both hands.
swa: Nashauri uendelee kung’ang’ania tena kwa mikono yote miwili.

eng: Sneaking around ju-juing your fellow MPs isn't the way to do it.
swa: Kusaliti wenzako na kutaka kuwabiga juju wabunge wenzako sio utaratibu mzuri wa kutatua yanayokusibu.

eng: Chenge is still in parliament and currently serves as the Chairman of the powerful Parliamentary Budget Committee.
swa: Chenge bado yupo bungeni na kwa sasa ni Mwenyekiti wa kamati ya Bajeti ya Bunge.

eng: Peruvian news agency Andina informed on Saturday, September 21, 2013, that Peruvian physician Juan Jesús Ortiz is one of the fatalities from the attack in Kenya's capital city, Nairobi, which has left a death toll of 59 individuals and over 175 injured.
swa: Shirika la Habari la Andina limearifu siku ya Jumamosi, Septemba 21, 2013, kwamba daktari wa ki-Peru Juan Jesús Ortiz ni mmoja wa watu waliuawa katika shambulizi la kigaidi lililotokea katika mji mkuu wa Kenya, Nairobi, lilisababisha idadi ya vifo vya watu 59 na wengine 175 wakijeruhiwa.

eng: This is how Periodismo en Línea tweeted the news:
swa: Hivi ndivyo Periodismo en Línea alivyotwiti habari hizo:

eng: Peruvian physician among the mortal victims of terrorist attack in Kenya: Ministry of Foreign Affairs confirmed that Juan Jesús Ortiz...
swa: Daktari wa ki-Peru ni mmoja wa wahanga waliopoteza maisha katika shambulio la kigaidi lilitokea Kenya: Wizara ya Mambo ya Kigeni imethibitisha kwamba Juan Jesús Ortiz...

eng: GV Face: Retweeting Terrorists?
swa: GV Face: Magaidi Wanatwiti?

eng: Social media played a major role in the dissemination of news about the terrorist attack on Westgate Mall in Nairobi, Kenya, but unverified information spread with lightning speed, including from government, terrorists, journalists and citizens on Facebook and Twitter.
swa: Mitandao ya kijamii imefanya kazi kubwa katika kusambaza habari za shambulio la kigaidi lililofanyika kwenye jengo la Westgate, Nairobi, Kenya, lakini hata hivyo taarifa hizo zisizothibitishwa zilisambaa mithili ya mwale wa radi, iwe ni kutoka serikalini, kwa magaidi wenyewe, waandishi wa habari na hata raia wa kawaida katika mitandao ya Facebook na Twitter.

eng: What does this tell us about the quest for truth in the aftermath of this devastating attack on Kenyan citizens?
swa: Je, hili linatupa ujumbe gani kuhusu utafutaji wa habari za kweli baada ya shambulio hili la kutisha dhidi ya raia wa Kenya?

eng: Does it even matter what the media report, when anyone who wants the real story seeks out hashtags on Twitter?
swa: Je, yanayotangazwa na vyombo vikuu vya habari yana maana yoyote, kama yeyote anayetaka kupata habari halisi anatafuta alama habari kwenye mtandao wa twitter?

eng: GV's Sub-Saharan Africa authors - Omar Mohamad (@shurufu ) and Collins Mbalo (@collinsom92) answered these questions and more in our Google Hangout series GV Face on Friday, September 27, 2013.
swa: Siku ya Ijumaa, Septemba 27, 2013, timu ya Global Voices ya Kusini mwa Jangwa la Sahara - Omar Mohamad na Collins Mbalo walijibu maswali haya na mengine mengi kwenye mfululizo wa Mazungumzo yetu ya Gv Face yaliyofanyika kwa kutumia zana ya Google Hangout.

eng: How different is reporting on the Syrian crisis depending on where you are?
swa: Ni namna gani habari zinazozungumzia mgogoro wa Syria zinategemeana na mahali uliko?

eng: And what does that mean for Syrians?
swa: Na hiyo ina maana gani kwa raia wa Syria?

eng: We discussed this and more in a Google Hangout on Monday, Sep 23, 2013, at 11am EST/3pm UTC in our second edition of GV Face.
swa: Tulijadili suala hili na mengine mengi kwa kutumia zana ya majadiliano ya Google Hangout Jumatatu ya Septemba 23, 2013, saa 3 alasiri UTC katika toleo letu la pili la GV Face.

eng: Reports in the US or UK suggest that chemical weapons were used by President Assad's regime to kill more than a thousand people in Syria last month.
swa: Taarifa katika nchi za Marekani au Uingereza zinadai kuwa silaha za maangamizi zilitumiwa na utawala wa Rais Assad kuwaua watu zaidi ya elfu moja nchini Syria mwezi uliopita.

eng: Meanwhile, Russian reporters say "all is well" in Damascus.
swa: Wakati huo huo, vyombo vya habari vya Urusi vinasema, "hali ni shwari" mjini Damascus.

eng: And Iranian media reports the chemical attack was by "rebels" trying to raise the pressure for an international intervention.
swa: Vyombo vya Habari vya Iran vinadai shambulio la kemikali lilifanywa na "waasi" katika juhudi za kutaka kuongeza shinikizo la kimataifa kuingilia kati.

eng: As the US government weighs military action in Syria, Russia's President Putin appealed to the American people in the New York Times to keep their weapons out of the war-torn country.
swa: Wakati serikali ya Marekani ifikiri kuishambulia Syria kijeshi, Rais wa Urusi akiwa New York amewasihi watu wa Marekani kufutilia mbali mpango wao wa kuipiga nchi hiyo ambayo tayari imeshaharibiwa mno na vita.

eng: Videos suggesting Iranian military activity on the ground in Syria have gone viral on social media.
swa: Video zinazoonyesha dalili ya hatua za kijeshi zinazochukuliwa na Iran nchini Syria zimesambaa kwenye mitandao ya kijamii.

eng: Our Hangout participants included GV Syria author, Leila Nachawati, Founder of Syria Untold, an online storytelling project dedicated to the non-violent Syrian uprising; our RuNet Echo editor Kevin Rothrock who spoke about the Putin and Mc Cain OpEds and how they were perceived by the Russian Internet; Amira Al Hussaini, our MENA Editor, touched on citizen media and mainstream media coverage of Syria within the Middle East and North Africa; Solana Larsen, our Managing Editor spoke about the role of citizen media in mainstream portrayal of Syria, Ellery Biddle our Advocacy Editor spoke about how the calls for US intervention are being interpreted by US netizens, and Ivan Sigal our Executive Director gave his opinion on why Syrian coverage is being shaped the way it is around the world.
swa: Washiriki wa mazungumzo yetu hayo ya mtandaoni walikuwa ni pamoja na mwandishi wa Gv Syria, Leila Nachawati, Mwanzilishi wa Syria Untold, mradi wa kupashana habari mtandaoni uliojikita kwenye mapinduzi ya amani yanayofanywa na wananchi wa Syria; Mhariri wetu wa RuNet Echo Kevin Rothrock aliyezungumza kuhusu Putin na Mc Cain OpEds na namna wanavyotazamwa na mitandao ya Urusi; Amira Al Hussaini, Mhariri wetu wa Mashariki ya Kati na Afrika Kaskazini, aliyegusia habari zilizikuwa zinaandikwa na vyombo vya habari vya kiraia na vyombo vikuu vya habari ndani ya Mashariki ya Kati na Afrika Kaskazini; Solana Larsen, Mhariri Mtendaji alizungumzia kuhusu wajibu wa vyombo vya habari vya kiraia katika taswira inayojengwa na vyombo vikuu vya habari kuhusu Syria, Ellery Biddle Mhariri wa Utetezi aliyezungumza namna wito wa kuiomba Marekani kuingilia kati mgogoro huo inavyotafsiriwa na raia wa Marekani mtandaoni na Ivan Sigal Mkurugenzi Mtendaji aliyetoa maoni yake kuhusu namna habari za Syria zinavyoumbwa kuwa vile zilivyo duniani kote.

eng: For some background about international coverage of the Syrian Crisis, check out our Special Coverage page.
swa: Kupata habari za kimataifa zilizojikita kwenye Mgogoro wa Syria, unaweza kupitia ukurasa wetu maalumu.

eng: Can a person with Criminal Records become the PM of India? - asks Dr. Abdul Ruff while discussing the nomination of the right wing leader and Gujarat chief-minister Narendra Modi.
swa: Je, mtu anaweza kuwa na historia ya uhalifu na bado akawa Waziri Mkuu wa India? - anauliza Dr. Abdul Ruff wakati anajadili uteuzi wa kiongozi wa mrengo wa kulia na Waziri Mkuu wa Gujarat Narendra Modi.

eng: He is the prime ministerial candidate of the BJP and the National Democratic Alliance for the upcoming 2014 Indian general elections.
swa: Ni mgombea wa Uwaziri Mkuu wa chama cha National Democratic Alliance katika uchaguzi mkuu ujao wa India wa mwaka 2014.

eng: Iraqi security forces carried out a “massacre” of 52 unarmed Iranian dissidents early Sunday at their camp north of Baghdad,Mujahedeen-e-Khalq, the Iranian exiles said.
swa: Vikosi vya usalama vya Iraq vilifanya "mauaji" ya wapinzani wa Iran wapatao 52 ambao hata hivyo hawakuwa na silaha asubuhi ya Jumapili ndani ya kambi yao kaskazini mwa Baghdad, mujahedeen-e-Khalq, wafungwa wa Iran walisema.

eng: Netizens in Balatarin, a popular link sharing site, shared several photos, films and posts regarding this attack.
swa: Netizens in Balatarin, tovuti maarufu ya kusambaza habarii, iliweka picha kadhaa, filamu na posti kuhusiana na shambulio hilo.

eng: A photograph circulating on Facebook of two young Egyptians kissing in the street stirred both outrage and admiration.
swa: Picha inayosambazwa katika mtandao wa Facebook inayowaonyesha vijana wawili raia wa Misri wakibusiana barabarani iliibua hasira na wengine kuipenda.

eng: Shared by Ahmed ElGohary, a commentator objected to 'the lack of manhood' entailed by sharing such photo.
swa: Ilitolewa na Ahmed ElGohary, mtangazaji aliyepingwa kwa 'kukosa utu uzima' kwa sababu ya kuweka picha ya jinsi hiyo.

eng: Others praised the beauty of it and its revolutionary sense.
swa: Wengine walisifu uzuri wa picha hiyo na tafsiri yake kwa mapinduzi ya kiutamaduni.

eng: Two young lovers kiss on the street in Egypt, shared by Ahmed ElGohary http://tinyurl.com/l3rozz9
swa: Vijana wawili wakibusiana barabarani nchini Misri. Picha: Ahmed ElGohary http://tinyurl.com/l3rozz9

eng: Public display of affection is widely frowned upon in Egypt, as laws of public indecency could be used to prosecute those who publicly show affection or drink alcohol on the streets.
swa: Kuonyesha mapenzi hadharanini si jambo linalokubalika nchini Misri, na sheria ya kuzuia kukosa maadili hadharani inaweza kutumika kuwashitaki wale wanaothubutu kuonyesha mapenzi hadharani au kunywa pombe katika mitaa.

eng: Alongside the photo, ElGohary shared lyrics of Youssra El Hawary's song On The Street.
swa: Sambamba na picha, ElGohary aliweka mashairi ya wimbo wa Youssra El Hawary uitwao On The Street .

eng: El Hawary an upcoming independent singer and her songs proved a youtube success.
swa: El Hawary mwimbaji huru chipukizi na nyimbo zake zimeonyesha mafanikio kwenye mtandao wa youtube.

eng: On The Street's lyrics read:
swa: Mashairi ya On The Street yansema:

eng: Some people curse each other, kill each other on the street,
swa: Baadhi ya watu kuwalaani wengine, kuua kila mmoja kwenye mitaani,

eng: Some people sleep on the floor on the street,
swa: Watu wengine hulaaniana, huuana kwenye sakafu za mitaani,

eng: Some people sell their honor on the street,
swa: Watu wengine huuza heshima zao mitaani,

eng: But it would truly be a scandal if one day we forgot and kissed each other on the street!
swa: Lakini ingekuwa kashfa ya kweli kama siku moja tutasahau na kubusiana kwenye mitaani!

eng: Rocky Intan explains why a minimum wage hike in Indonesia will harm the country's economy:
swa: Rocky Intan aneleza kwa nini kupandishwa kwa kima cha chini cha mshahara nchini Indonesia kutaathiri uchumi wa nchi hiyo:

eng: National and local leaders should resist pressure by some union leaders for an increase in the minimum wage.
swa: Viongozi wa kitaifa na wale wa ngazi za chini lazima wapambane na shinikizo la baadhi ya viongozi wa vyama vya wafanyakzi wanaodai kupandishwa kwa kima cha chini cha mshahara.

eng: The increase has not been in line with inflation, unlike what the protesters claim.
swa: Ongezeko la kima cha chini limekuwa halihusiani na mfumuko wa bei, kinyume na madai ya waandamanaji.

eng: Moreover, the raise will result in further worker layoffs and damage our regional competitiveness in labor-intensive manufacturing.
swa: Zaidi, ongezeko hilo litasababisha matatizo zaidi ya wafanyakazi na hivyo kuathiri ushindani wetu katika uzalishaji unaotegemea nguvu kazi.

eng: Shurufu is a Tanzanian journalist based in Dar es Salaam.
swa: Shurufu ni mwandishi wa Tanzania anayeishi Dar es Salaam.

eng: Also read his post How the Nairobi Mall Attack Unfolded on Social Media.
swa: Pia waweza kusoma posti yake Namna shambulizi la Westgate jijini Nairobi lilivyobainikia kupitia Mitandao ya Kijamii.

eng: At the time of writing, the number of people killed in the brutal attack on Westgate Mall in Nairobi stood at 69, with more than 200 injured.
swa: Wakati wa kuandikwa kwa posti hii, idadi ya watu waliouawa katika shambulizi la kikatili kwenye kituo cha kibiashara jijini Nairobi ilifikia 69, wakati wengine 200 wakijeruhiwa.

eng: Armed militants burst into the mall, one of the city's most popular locations for foreigners and middle-class Kenyans, and carried out the deadliest attack the country has seen since the 1998 bombing of the U.S. embassy.
swa: Wanajeshi wenye silaha walivamia jengo hilo, moja wapo ya maeneo maarufu zaidi jijini humo linalotembelewa na raia wa kigeni na wa-Kenya wa tabaka la kati, na kufanya shambulizi la kikatili zaidi kuwahi kushuhudiwa nchini humo tangu kulipuka kwa bomu katika jengo la Ubalozi wa Marekani mwaka 1998.

eng: Among the dead include renowned Ghanaian poet Kofi Awoonor.
swa: Miongoni mwa waliouawa ni pamoja na Mshairi anayeheshimika, raia wa Ghana Kofi Awoonor.

eng: Also killed was a well-known broadcaster, Ruhila Adatia.
swa: Mwingine ni mtangazaji maarufu, Ruhila Adatia.

eng: She was reportedly pregnant.
swa: Inasemekana alikuwa mjamzito.

eng: I, too, lost friends in the Westgate attack: Ross Langdon and Elif Yavuz, a couple who were expecting their first child.
swa: Mimi, vilevile, nimepoteza marafiki katika shambulio hilo la Westgate: Ross Langdon na Elif Yavuz, wenzi waliokuwa wakimtarajia mtoto wao wa kwanza.

eng: They lived in Dar es Salaam but were in Nairobi to have their baby there because they preferred the city's medical care.
swa: Waliishi Dar es Salaam lakini walikuwa Nairobi kwa ajili ya kujifungua kwa sababu ya kuziamini zaidi huduma za afya jijini humo.

eng: Elif had completed her PhD at the Harvard University's School of Public Health.
swa: Elif alimaliza PhD yake katika Shule ya Afya ya Jamii ya Chuo Kikuu cha Harvard.

eng: She moved to Dar es Salaam to work for the Clinton Foundation.
swa: Alihamia Dar es Salaam kufanya kazi katika Mfuko wa Clinton.

eng: Here she is, meeting with President Bill Clinton during his visit to Tanzania in August:
swa: Hapa chini, akikutana na Rais Bill Clinton wakati wa ziara yake nchini Tanzania mwezi Agosti:

eng: Elif Yavuz meeting with former US President Bill Clinton during his visit to Tanzania in August 2013.
swa: Elif Yavuz akikutana na Rais wa zamani Bill Clinton wakati wa ziara yake nchini Tanzania mwezi Agosti 2012.

eng: Photo via Ms. Yavuz's Facebook page.
swa: Picha kupitia ukurasa wa Facebook wa Yavuz .

eng: Elif was smart, witty, disarmingly charming and a joy to be around.
swa: Elif alikuwa na akili, anayejua kutumia maneno vizuri, mchezi na mtu wa kufurahia kuwa nae.

eng: She would have made a terrific mother.
swa: Angekuwa mama mwema ajabu.

eng: Her boyfriend Ross had the easy going Aussie humor and zest for life typical of folks from 'down under.'
swa: Rafiki yake wa kiume Ross alikuwa na bashasha na ucheshi wa ki-Australia na mwenye furaha ya maisha kama ilivyo kawaida ya watu wakarimu na wanyenyekevu kutoka Australia.

eng: He was also an incredibly talented architect.
swa: Alikuwa mbunifu wa majengo mwenye kipaji cha ajabu.

eng: He co-founded a successful inter-continental design studio, Regional Associates.
swa: Alishiriki kuanzisha kituo cha kimataifa cha ubunifu wa majengo, kinachooitwa Regional Associates.

eng: Here he is talking about what he called Chameleon architecture at last year's TEDxKraków:
swa: Hapa anazungumzia kile alichokiita ubunifu wa Kinyonga katika mkutano wa TEDxKraków wa mwaka jana:

eng: He was looking forward to becoming a Dad.
swa: Alikuwa akitarajia kuwa Baba.

eng: But Ross and Elif are now gone.
swa: Lakini Ross na Elif wametutoka.

eng: It is difficult to explain why these two wonderful human beings and Professor Awoonor and Ms. Adatia, and Mbugua and Wahito and all the other innocent souls who perished at Westgate Mall had to die.
swa: Ni vigumu kueleza kwa nini watu hawa wema ajabu kiasi hiki pamoja na Profesa Awoonor na Bi. Adatia, wakiwa na Mbugua na Wahito na roho zote zisizo na hatia zilizopotea katika Shambulio la Westgate.

eng: In the words of the writer Teju Cole (@tejucole), may their gentle souls be ferried in peace to the new world.
swa: Katika maneno ya mwandishi Teju Cole (@tejucole), mroho zao zipumzike kwa amani katika ulimwengu mpya.

eng: Also read: How the Nairobi Mall Attack Unfolded on Social Media.
swa: Soma pia: Namna shambulizi la Westgate jijini Nairobi lilivyobainikia kupitia Mitandao ya Kijamii.

eng: Also read his post Global Voices Author Remembers Friends Slain in Nairobi Mall Attack.
swa: Unaweza kusoma posti yake Mwandishi wa Global Voices Awakumbuka Marafiki Waliouawa Kwenye Shambulio la Westgate.

eng: In a moment, everything changed.
swa: Kwa muda mfupi, kila kitu kilibadilika.

eng: On 21 September, 2013, a group of armed militants stormed an upscale mall in Nairobi, the capital city of Kenya, and opened fire, killing by the latest count 69 people and injuring hundreds more.
swa: Tarehe 21 Septemba, 2013, kikundi cha wanajeshi wenye silaha walivamia kituo cha biashara jijini Nairobi, mji mkuu wa Kenya, walimimina risasi, wakiua watu wanaosemekana kufikia 69 na kujeruhi mamia.

eng: Twitter captured the confusion of the attack in real-time as users first reported what they thought was an explosion.
swa: Mtandao twita ulikuwa na taarifa za shambulio hilo katika muda halisi tangu watumiaji walivyoripoti awali kile walichodhani ni mlipuko.

eng: Shortly after noon, news started trickling through the social network that something had gone horribly wrong at Westgate Mall, one of Nairobi's most popular locations for foreigners and middle-class Kenyans.
swa: Baada ya saa za mchana kupita, habari zilianza kuenea kupitia mitandao ya kijamii kwamba hali ilikuwa mbaya sana kwenye kituo cha kibiashara cha Westgate, eneo moja wapo maarufu kwa wageni na wa-Kenya wa tabaka la kati.

eng: Ma Bradley (@NyamburaMumbi) tweeted:
swa: Ma Bradley (@NyamburaMumbi) alitwiti:

eng: explosion at westgate.... how bad is it? — Ma Bradley (@NyamburaMumbi) September 21, 2013
swa: mlipuko kwenye maduka ya westgate.... inasikitisha namna gani?

eng: In the immediate few minutes after after the news broke, however, it was still unclear what, exactly, was going on.
swa: Ndani ya dakika chache baada ya habari kusambaa, hata hivyo, haikuwa imejulikana wazi, kwa hakika, nini hasa kilikuwa kimetokea.

eng: Naporneon Pornaparte (@aCreole) reflected this uncertainty in his tweet:
swa: Naporneon Pornaparte (@aCreole) alitafakari hali hii ya kutokuwa na uhakika wa mambo kupitia twiti yake ifuatayo:

eng: Explosion or gunfire? "@NyamburaMumbi: explosion at westgate.... how bad is it?" — Naporneon Pornaparte (@aCreole) September 21, 2013
swa: Mlipuko au ni risasi? "@NyamburaMumbi: mlipuko kwenye maduka ya westgate....inasikitisha namna gani?

eng: For some, the location of the reported incident itself was under dispute.
swa: Kwa baadhi, eneo hasa la tukio hilo lililoripotiwa, halikuwa bayana.

eng: Ramsy Ama Ramah (@ramjanja) suggested that initial reports claiming that an explosion had taken place at Westgate were mistaken:
swa: Ramsy Ama Ramah (@ramjanja) alidhani kuwa taarifa za mwanzo zinazodai kuwa mlipuko umetokea eneo la Westgate zilikosewa:

eng: yoh explosion ni mathare sio westgate RT @NyamburaMumbi: explosion at westgate.... how bad is it? — RAMSY AMA RAMAH (@ramjanja) September 21, 2013
swa: mlipuko umetokea Mathare na sio Westgate

eng: yoh the explosion is in Mathare not Westgate Soon enough, however, it became clear that something ominous was taking place at the mall.
swa: Baada ya muda mchache, hata hivyo, ilikuwa bayana kuwa kuna jambo lisilo la kawaida linaendelea kwenye kituo kicho cha kibiashara cha Westgate.

eng: Confirmation of this came after the Ministry of Interior tweeted this update:
swa: Uthibitisho wa hali hii ulikuwa baada ya Wizara ya Mambo ya Ndani kutwiti habari hii mpya:

eng: We urge Kenyans to keep away from Westgate mall in westlands until further notice cc @policeke @IGkimaiyo — InteriorCNG Ministry (@InteriorKE) September 21, 2013
swa: Tunawasihi wa-Kenya kukaa mbali na kituo cha Westgate kilichopo Westlands mpaka itakapotangazwa vinginevyo

eng: What was emerging on the Twittersphere was that armed individuals had gone inside Westgate, journalistSmriti Vidyarthi (@SmritiVidyarthi) informed her Twitter followers:
swa: Kilichokuwa kinaanza kuwa wazi katika mtandao wa twita ni kwamba watu wenye silaha walikuwa wameingia ndani ya majengo ya Westgate, mwandishi wa habari Smriti Vidyarthi (@SmritiVidyarthi) aliwajulisha wafuatiliaji wa habari zake kwenye mtandao wa twita:

eng: STAY AWAY from Westgate Mall - heavily armed individuals shooting in the mall.
swa: KAENI MBALI na Jengo la Westgate -watu wenye silaha kali wanapiga risasi hovyo ndani.

eng: Inform family and friends to avoid the area. — Smriti Vidyarthi (@SmritiVidyarthi) September 21, 2013
swa: Wafahamishe wanafamilia na marafiki zako kutokufika kwenye eneo hilo.

eng: Inspector General of Police David Kimaiyo via his twitter account (@IGkimaiyo) confirmed that a police operation was underway:
swa: Inspekta Jenerali wa Polisi David Kimaiyo kupitia ukurasa wake wa twita(@IGkimaiyo) alithibitisha kwamba operesheni ya polisi ilikuwa ikiendelea:

eng: Kindly keep off from Westgate Mall, Westland. Police has surrounded the area. — David Kimaiyo (@IGkimaiyo) September 21, 2013
swa: Tafadhali msisogelee eneo la Westgate, Westland.

eng: Despite this update from the authorities, the nature of what they were responding to remained a mystery, even to them, at least based on what they were saying publicly, as revealed by Internal Security Ministry Permanent Secretary Mutea Iringo's comments to reporters:
swa: Pamoja na habari hizi mpya kutoka kwenye vyombo vya dola, kile hasa walichokuwa wakikishughulikia kilibaki kuwa utata, hata kwao, angalau kupitia kile walichokuwa wakikisema hadharani, kama ilivyowekwa wazi na Katibu Mkuu wa Wizara ya Mambo ya Ndani Mutea Iringo kupitiakauli yake kwa waandishi:

eng: PS #Mutea:We have sent air surveillance.We confirm there are armed criminals but haven't established who they're,let @PoliceKE do their job — InteriorCNG Ministry (@InteriorKE) September 21, 2013
swa: Tumefanya upepelezi wa anga. Tumethibitisha kuwa kuna wahalifu wenye silaha lakini hatujaweza kuthibitisha ni akina nani hasa. Tuwape nafasi @PoliceKE wafanye kazi yao

eng: But other sources within the Kenyan police started to realize that what they were confronting was more than an armed robbery.
swa: Lakini vyanzo vingine ndani ya polisi ya Kenya vilianza kugundua kuwa walichokuwa wakipambana nacho ni zaidi ya ujambazi wa kutumia silaha.

eng: Here is Robert Alai (@RobertAlai), one of the first to report that something more sinister was underway:
swa: Hapa ni Robert Alai (@RobertAlai), mmoja wa watu wa mwanzo kuarifu kwamba kulikuwa na kitu cha ajabu kinaendelea:

eng: Many foreigners and locals shot in the #WestgateAttack. This is not a robbery - Police Source. — Robert A. (@RobertAlai) September 21, 2013
swa: Raia wengi wa kigeni na wenyeji wengi wameuawa kwa kupigwa risasi kwenye Shambulio la Westgate.

eng: After images like these began to circulate, it was becoming clear that an act of terror had been perpetrated in Westgate: Don't look if you don't want to #westgate pic.twitter.com/fnXZOwGdPa — Alan Boswell (@alanboswell) September 21, 2013
swa: Baada ya picha kamahizi zilipoanza kusambaa mtandaoni, ilikuwa wazi kwamba kilichokuwa kinaendelea Westgate ni kitendo cha kigaidi:

eng: Who is behind the Westgate attack?
swa: Nani yuko nyuma ya shambulizi la Westgate?

eng: At about 11 p.m. in the evening, President Uhuru Kenyatta addressed the nation and confirmed that what was happening in Westgate was, indeed, a terror attack.
swa: Ilipotimu saa 5 usiku, Rais Uhuru Kenyatta alilihutubia taifa na kuthibitisha kwamba kilichokuwa kinaendelea huko Westgate, kilikuwa, kwa hakika, ni shambulio la kigaidi.

eng: Via KTN:
swa: Kupitia kituo cha televisheni cha KTN:

eng: Mr. Kenyatta was sombre and informed his people the enormity of what Kenya was experiencing:
swa: Kenyatta alionekana mwenye uso wa huzuni nyingi naaliwafahamisha watu wake uovu wa kile ambacho Kenya ilikuwa inakumbana nacho:

eng: This morning, a group of armed terrorists forcefully entered the Westgate Mall in Nairobi’s Parklands area and unleashed senseless violence upon customers and workers.
swa: Asubuhi ya leo, kikundi cha magaidi wenye silaha waliingia kwa nguvu kwenye kituo cha kibiashara cha Westgate kwenye eneo la Parkland, jijini Nairobi na kusababisha ghasia zisizo za kiungwana kwa wateja na wafanyakazi.

eng: They have killed at least 39 innocent people and injured more than 150 others.
swa: Wameua watu wasio na hatia wapatao 39 na kujeruhi zaidi ya watu 150.

eng: With the entire nation, I stand with the families of those who have lost their lives and extend every Kenyan’s deepest condolences.
swa: Kwa niaba ya taifa lote, ninaungana na familia za wale waliopoteza maisha yao na kuwapa rambirambi za kila raia wa Kenya kwa kilichotokea.

eng: Later, it would be reported that he too had lost loved ones:
swa: Baadae, iliripotiwa kwamba naye pia alikuwa miongoni mwa waliopoteza wapendwa wao:

eng: According to reports, the president’s nephew, Mbugua and his fiancée Wahito, were shot dead during the attack and from a witness account, Mbugua had made it safely out of the building when he realised that his fiancee was still stuck in the building.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa taarifa, mpwa wa rais, Mbugua na mchumba wake Wahito, waliuawa kwa risasi wakati wa shambulio hilo na kwa maelezo ya walioshuhudia tukio hilo, Mbugua alikuwa amefanikiwa kutoka kwenye jengo hilo na baadae aligundua kuwa mchumba wake alikuwa bado yumo kwenye jengo.

eng: He rushed back to get her only to be shot dead together with his fiancee.
swa: Alirudi haraka kwenye jengo kumchukua ndipo alipopigwa risasi akiwa na mchumba wake.

eng: Despite the confirmation that the Westgate attack was an act of terrorism, it was still unclear who had perpetrated it.
swa: Pamoja na uthibitisho kuwa shambulio la Westgate lilikuwa la kigaidi, haikuwa bayana nani hasa alilipanga.

eng: In his statement to the nation, President Kenyatta did not name assign responsibility to any specific group.
swa: Katika tamko lake kwa taifa, Rais Kenyatta hakutaja kuhusika kwa kikundi chochote.

eng: But soon, a Twitter handle believed to be controlled by Al-Shabaab, a Somali Islamist group, claimed responsibility for the attack.
swa: Lakini baadae, anuani ya twita inayoaminiwa kuendeshwa na Al-Shabaab, kikundi cha Kiislam cha Kisomali, kilidai kuhsuika na shambulio hilo.

eng: The account has since been suspended, but their claim of responsibility is captured in this Storify piece by Canoe News.
swa: Anuania hiyo imesimamishwa tangu wakati huo, lakini madai yao yamewekwa kwenye habari za Storify za mtandao wa Canoe News.

eng: Robert Alai was also able to capture an image of the Al-Shabaab alleged Twitter page before it was taken down:
swa: Robert Alai aliweza kupata picha ya ukurasa huo unaodaiwa kumilikiwa na Al-Shabaab kabla haujaondolewa:

eng: And #AlShabaab now say that they will soon post the video of #WestgateAttack pic.twitter.com/Q2sRBBkSF4 — Robert A. (@RobertAlai) September 21, 2013
swa: #AlShabaab sasa wanasema kwamba wataweka video ya Shambulio la Westgate

eng: Indeed, hours later, a YouTube clip purporting to be by Al-Shabaab was posted online.
swa: Ni kweli, masaa kadhaa baadae, kipande cha video kwenye mtandao wa YouTube kinachodaiwa kuwekwa na Al-Shabaab kiliwekwa mtandaoni.

eng: In grandiose and religious tones, the message was chilling:
swa: Video hiyo iliyokuwa na maneno makali na ya kidini, ilikuwa na ujumbe ulikuwa wazi:

eng: Soon after, a group of Muslim Scholars reacted angrily to the claims by supposed members of Al-Shabab that their actions were committed in the name of Islam.
swa: Baadae, kikundi cha Wanazuoni wa Kiislamu walijibu kwa hasira madai hayo ya wanamgambo wa Al-Shabaab kwamba matendo yao yalifanywa kwa kutumia jina la Uislam.

eng: The Nigerian popular online platform, Nairaland, quoted a Sheikh Abu Eesa Niamatullah, denouncing what he called their turning of blood of civilians into cheap commodity.
swa: Jukwaa maarufu la mtandaoni la Naijeria, Nairaland, lilimnukuu Sheikh Abu Eesa Niamatullah, akipinga kile alichokiita kuifanya damu ya raia wasio na hatia kuwa bidhaa ya bure.

eng: He went on to say,
swa: Aliendelea kwa kusema,

eng: You never touched anything except that you destroyed it, you never entered a legitimate cause except that you corrupted it, you never came across the sanctity of human life except that you violated it, and you never tried to act in the name of Islam except that you polluted it.
swa: Hamjawahi kugusa chochote isipokuwa kukiharibu, hamjawahi kulitumikia kusudi halali isipokuwa kulighoshi, hamjawahi kudhamini upekee wa maisha ya mwanadamu isipokuwa kuyakatisha, hamjawahi kufanya kitu kwa jina la Uislamu isipokuwa kuuchafua.

eng: So why now, Al-Shabaab?
swa: Kwa hiyo ni kwa nini wakati huo, Al-Shabaab?

eng: The audacity of this attack has left some to suggest it may portend a new phase for the Somali Islamists.
swa: Ujasiri wa shambulizi hizi umefanya baadhi ya watu kudhani linaweza kutengeneza sura mpya kwa wa-Islamu wa Kisomali.

eng: In August of this year, analyst Abdihakim Ainte (@Abdikhakim) writing on the website Al-Monitor suggested that the defeats experienced by the group in Somalia at the hands of Ugandan and Kenyan troops has forced it to adopt a more guerrilla and assymetrical type of warfare.
swa: Mwezi Agosti mwaka huu, mchambuzi Abdihakim Ainte (@Abdikhakim) anayeandikia tovuti ya Al-Monitor alidhani kuwa kuzidiwa nguvu kwa kikundi hicho nchini Somalia na majeshi ya Uganda na Kenya kumekilazimu kubuni mbinu mpya ya kigaidi kufanya vita.

eng: To wit:
swa: Anasema:

eng: In a recent audio message, Ahmed Godane, al-Shabab’s operational brain, made it clear that he is determined to reverse the organization’s plummeting operations.
swa: Katikaujumbe wa sauti wa hivi karibuni, Ahmed Godane, kiongozi mkuu wa operesheni za al-Shabab, aliweka wazi kwamba alikuwa amekusudia kubadili mbinu za operesheni zake.

eng: That includes, as he put it, plans to install a whole new generation who can interact with fast-moving jihadist warfare.
swa: Hiyo ilikuwa ni pamoja, kama anavyosema yeye, na mipango ya kuingiza kizazi kipya kinachoweza kuendana na vita vya Jihad vinayobadilika kwa kasi.

eng: Unlike al-Shabab 1.0, the upgraded al-Shabab is likely to have new recruiters — mostly youths, under 30, who have exposure to the West and are fluent in foreign languages, to appeal to coming generations.
swa: Tofauti na al-Shabab 1.0, al-Shabab mpya inaweza kuwa na wapinganaji wapi -hasa vijana, chini ya miaka 30, ambao wanayafahamu vyema mataifa ya Magharibi na wanafahamu vyema lugha za kigeni, kuweza kusukuma mbele mapambano hayo kwa vizazi vijavyo.

eng: This seems evident in new footage released by al-Shabab featuring three young Somali-Americans who died while waging war.
swa: Hili linaonekana kuwa bayana katika video mpya iliyotolewa na al-Shabab ikiwaonyesha vijana watatu wa ki-Somali waliouawa wakati wa vita.

eng: The video “The Path to Paradise: From the Twin Cities to the Land of Migration” is part of al-Qaeda-approved propaganda messages to appeal to the next generation.
swa: Video hiyo iliyopewa jina la "Njia ya kwenda Ahera: Kutoka Majiji Pacha kwenda Nchi ya Kuhamia" ni sehemu ya ujumbe wa propaganda zinazokubalika na Al-Qeda kushawishi kizazi kipya.

eng: Meanwhile, Ken Menkhaus over at Think Progress concured that Al-Shabab is indeed weakened.
swa: Wakati huo huo, Ken Menkhaus katika tovuti ya Think Progress alikubali kwamba Al-Shabab imedhoofishwa kwa hakika.

eng: Menkhaus went on to argue that this latest gamble by the group was an attempt to reframe the terms of the conflict in Somalia:
swa: Menkhaus aliendelea kusihi kwamba karata hii ya hivi karibuni iliyochezwa na kikundi hicho ilikuwa ni jaribio la kutengeneza upya vigezo na masharti ya mgogoro unaoendelea Somalia:

eng: The Westgate attack is the latest sign of the group’s weakness.
swa: Shambulio la Westgate ni dalili ya hivi karibuni ya udhaifu wa kikundi hicho.

eng: It was a desperate, high-risk gamble by Shabaab to reverse its prospects.
swa: Ilikuwa ni karata ya kukata tamaa, isiyo na uhakika iliyochezwa na Al-Shabaab kujaribu kurudi kwenye malengo yake.

eng: If the deadly attack succeeds in prompting vigilante violence by Kenyan citizens or heavy-handed government reactions against Somali residents, Shabaab stands a chance of recasting itself as the vanguard militia protecting Somalis against external enemies.
swa: Kama shambulio hilo baya litafanikiwa kuibua vurugu baina ya raia wa Kenya au hatua nzito za serikali dhidi ya wa-Somali, basi Al-Shabaab itakuwa na nafasi ya kujitengenezea picha ya kikundi cha kijeshi kinachowalinda wa-Somali na maadui wa nje.

eng: It desperately needs to reframe the conflict in Somalia as Somalis versus the foreigners, not as Somalis who seek peace and a return to normalcy versus a toxic jihadi movement.
swa: Kikundi hicho kinahitaji kutengeneza upya sura ya mgogoro wa Somalia kama vita ya wa-Somali na wageni, na sio wa-Somali wanaotafuta amani na kurudi kwenye maisha ya kawaida didi ya harakati za kikatili za Jihad.

eng: On Twitter, Charles Onyango Obbo (@coboo3) disagreed, saying that the attack shows the metastasizing of Al-Shabaab:
swa: Kwenye mtandnao wa twita, Charles Onyango Obbo (@coboo3) hakukubaliana na hilo, akisema kwamba shambulizi hilo linaonyesha kukua kwa kikundi hicho cha Al-Shabaab:

eng: @mmnjug @QulshTM Interesting, though my analysis is that Al-Shabaab is metamorphosing into a regional terror group, not declining. — Charles Onyango-Obbo (@cobbo3) September 22, 2013
swa: @mmnjug @QulshTM Inafikirisha, ingawa nionavyo mimi ni kwaba Al-Shabaab inapanuka na kuwa kikundi cha kigaidi katika eneo hili la Afrika, na wala sio kusambaratika. — Charles Onyango-Obbo (@cobbo3) Septemba 22, 2013

eng: A version of this perspective was echoed in the analysis from the website Somalia Newsroom, which argued that the Westgate attack was inevitable blowback from Kenya's continued operations in Somalia.
swa: Namna nyingine ya mtazamo huu ilisikika katika uchambuzi wa tovuti ya Somalia Newsroom, ilisema kwamba shambulio la Westgate lilikuwa ni shambuli la kisasi lisilokwepeka kufuatia operesheni ya Kenya inayoendelea Somalia.

eng: Additionally, they pointed out, a lack of a long-term strategic plan on how to combat terrorism by Kenya may explain Al-Shabaab's continued potency:
swa: Kwa nyongeza, walibainisha kuwa, kutokuwepo kwa mpango mkakati wa muda mrefu wa namna ya kupambana na ugaidi nchini Kenya unaweza kueleza sababu ya kuendelea kwa nguvu ya Al-Shabaab:

eng: The Kenyan government may find more progress in combatting the influence of al-Shabaab and its sympathizers by building bridges between communities rather than scapegoating, offering under-served communities more resources to serve youth and families, and undertaking serious reform and accountability for security forces’ actions on civilians.
swa: Serikali ya Kenya inaweza kupata mafanikio katika kupambana na ushawishi wa Al-Shabaab na wanaowaunga mkono kwa kujenga daraja kati ya jamii na sio kutafuta mchawi, kutoa misaada kwa jamii zisizopata msaada ili kuwatumikia vijana na familia, na kuchukua hatua mpya makini na uwajibikaji kwa vitendo vinavyofanywa na vikosi vya kijeshi kwa raia wa kawaida.

eng: While Kenya’s current approach to al-Shabaab has garnered some successes, it has created tension in Somalia and left unaddressed shortcomings at home.
swa: Wakati mbinu za sasa za Kenya kuwadhibiti al-Shabaab zimekuwa na mafanikio kadhaa, hata hivyo zimesababisha hali ya tahayaruki kwa wa-Somali na zimeacha mapungufu mengi yasiyoshughulikiwa huko nyumbani.

eng: Rather than respond in blind rage to the Westgate attack, Kenya should meditate and answer soberly to the real questions that it is confronting in trying to increase stability at home and abroad.
swa: Badala ya kushuhulikia shambulizi la Westgate kwa hasira za kipofu, Kenya lazima itafakari na kujibu kwa upole maswali halisi yanayoikabili katika kujaribu kuongeza hali ya usalama nyumbani na nje ya mipaka.

eng: There is no doubt that, as time goes by, more pondering and analysis will follow to reflect on the horrific events of 21 September.
swa: Hakuna mashaka kwamba, kadri muda unavyoendelea, tafakuri na chambuzi zaidi zinafuatia katika kujaribu kutafakari matukio ya kutisha ya Septemba 21.

eng: Also read: Global Voices Author Remembers Friends Slain in Nairobi Mall Attack.
swa: Soma pia: Mwandishi wa Global Voices Akumbuka Kuuawa kwa Marafiki katika Shambulio la Westgate.

eng: Merchants from the Gamarra area, a well-known center of textile manufacturing and commercialization in Lima, burned imported Chinese clothing in the streets as a protest over the low priced Chinese garments which, according to them, make their businesses go bankrupt.
swa: Wafanyabiashara kutoka eneo la Gamarra , kituo maarufu cha viwanda vya nguo na ambako ndiko lilipo eneo la kibiashara jijini Lima, walichoma nguo zilizoingizwa kutoka China katika mitaa kupinga biashara hiyo ya nguo zinazouzwa bei ndogo ambazo, kwa mujibu wao, hufanya biashara zao kufilisika.

eng: On Twitter, Alfredo "Alial" (@Alfredo_jch) implied a better use for those burnt clothes:
swa: Kwenye mtandao wa Twita, Alfredo "Alial" (@ Alfredo_jch) alipendekeza matumizi bora kwa nguo hizo zilizoteketezwa kwa moto:

eng: In Gamarra they are burning Chinese clothes, in Puno people are freezing to death. #Perú
swa: Jijini Gamarra wanachoma moto nguo za Kichina, huko Puno watu wanaganda hadi kufa . #Perú

eng: This last weekend, the Carabaya province, located in the department of Puno, experienced the worst snow storm in a decade, affecting more than 1,200 families, leaving people missing and causing the death of animals that are the livelihood for the people in the area.
swa: Mwishoni mwa wiki iliyopita, Jimbo la Carabaya, lililoko katika mkoa wa Puno, lilishuhudia dhoruba kali ya theluji mbaya zaidi kuwahi kutoka katika kipindi cha muongo, ikiathiri familia zaidi ya 1,200 na kuwaacha watu wengi wasiojulikana walipo na kusababisha vifo vya wanyama ambao ni riziki ya watu wa eneo hilo.

eng: Portraits in Black is a work of three photographers – Marco Ambrosi, Matteo Danesin and Aldo Sodoma – the Centre for Immigration Studies in Verona, the Cities of Verona and Padua, the Padua University Sociology Department showing Africans in Italy.
swa: Picha Nyeusi ni kazi za wapiga picha watatu – Marco Ambrosi, Matteo Danesin na Aldo Sodoma – Kituo cha Stadi za Uhamiaji mjini Verona, Majiji ya Verona na Padua, Chuo Kikuu cha Padua Idara ya Sosholojia ikiwaonyesha Waafrika nchini Italia.
