swa: Soma pia: Namna Shambulizi la Westgate Lilivyodalidiliwa kwenye Mitandao ya Kijamii na Mwandishi wa Global Voices Awakumbuka Marafki Waliouawa kwenye Shambulio la Westgate.

eng: On September 21, 2013, a group of suspected al-Shabab militants stormed Westgate mall in Nairobi, the capital city of Kenya, killing at least 61 people, six security personnel and injuring hundreds of innocent men, women and children.
swa: Mnamo Septemba 21, 2013, kikundi cha watu wenye silaha wanaodhaniwa kuwa al-Shabab walivamia jengo la Westgate jijini Nairobi, mji mkuu wa Kenya, wakiua watu wasiopungua 61, wanausalama sita na kujeruhi mamia ya watu wasio na hatia wakiwamo watoto.

eng: Following the horrible attack, Ushahidi has come up with two tools for emergencies.
swa: Kufuatia shambulizi hilo la kusikitisha, Ushahidi wamekuja na zana mbili mahsusi kwa dharura .

eng: Ushahidi is a non-profit technology company that specializes in developing free and open source software for information collection, visualization and interactive mapping.
swa: Ushahidi kampuni ya teknolojia isiyoendeshwa kibiashara iliyobobea katika kutengeneza zana huru za bure kwa ajili ya kukusanya na kutazama habari pamoja na utengenezaji shirikishi wa michoro.

eng: Ushahidi, which means "testimony" in Swahili, was a website that was initially developed to map reports of violence in Kenya after the post-election fallout at the beginning of 2008.
swa: Ushahidi, neno linalotokana na maana yake halisi ya kiswhaili, ilikuwa tovuti ambayo ilitengenezwa awali kwa ajili ya kutengeneza michoro inayotokana na taarifa za ghasia zilizokuwa zinapokelewa nchini Kenya baada ya ghasia zilizofuatia uchaguzi mwanzoni mwa mwaka 2008.

eng: The Ping app is a binary, multichannel check-in tool for groups.
swa: The Ping ni zana tumizi yenye sehemu mbili, chaneli kadhaa za kuingia na kumtafuta mtu inayoweza kutumiwa na watu kadhaa kwa pamoja.

eng: The tool will help families, friends and companies to quickly check in with each other:
swa: Zana hii inatawasaidia wanafamailia, marafiki na makampuni yanayotaka kutafutana kwa haraka:

eng: There was a consistent problem in every disaster that happens, not just in Kenya, but everywhere.
swa: Kuna tatizo sugu katika kila janga linapotokea, si tu nchini Kenya, lakini mahali kokote.

eng: Small groups, families and companies need to quickly check in with each other.
swa: Vikundi vidogo, wanafamilia na makampuni yanahitaji kutafutana.

eng: They need to “ping” one another to make sure they’re okay.
swa: Wanahitaji "kupigiana alamu" kuhakikisha kuwa wako salama.

eng: It has to be something incredibly simple, that requires little thinking to use.
swa: Ili hilo liwezekane, inabidi zana hiyo iwe rahisi sana, isiyohitaji kufikiri sana.

eng: People have been doing some stuff in this space in the past, the best like “I’m Ok” are focused on smartphone users, but we have a need to make it work for even the simplest phones.
swa: Watu wamekuwa wakitumia njia zinazofanana na hili tunalolisema tangu siku za nyuma, kwa mfano watu wanaotumia simu za kisasa (smartphone) wanaweza kutumiana ujumbe wa "niko salama", lakini inabidi hilo liwezekane hata kwa simu za kawaida sana.

eng: Our goal is to have this available for anyone globally to use.
swa: Lengo letu ni kuifanya zana hii ipatikane kwa ajili ya matumizi ya kila mmoja duniani.

eng: The Ping App – a group check-in tool for emergencies.
swa: The Ping App – zana ya kutafutana kwa kikundi nyakati za dharura.

eng: Photo source: Ushahidi blog.
swa: Picha: Ushahidi blog.

eng: This is how the Ping works:
swa: Hivi ndivyo Ping inavyofanya kazi:

eng: You create a list of your people (family, organization), and each person also adds another contact who is close to them (spouse, roommate, boy/girlfriend, etc).
swa: Unatengeneza orodha ya watu wako (wanafamilia, taasisi), na kila mmoja anamworodhesha kila mmoja aliye kwenye orodha (mwenzi, mshiriki wa chumba, rafiki wa kike/kiume, nk).

eng: When a disaster happens, you send out a message for everyone to check-in.
swa: Janga linapotokea, unatuma ujumbe mfupi wa maandishi kwa kila mmoja kujua hali zao.

eng: The admin sends out a 120 character message that always has “are you ok?” appended to the end.
swa: Mtu anayedhibiti orodha hiyo hutuma ujumbe wenye herufi 120 ambao huwa na maneno "uko salama?" mwishoni.

eng: This goes out via text message and email (more channels can be added later).
swa: Ujumbe huo huenda kwa mfumo wa kawaida wa Ujumbe mfupi wa simu (SMS) na barua pepe (chaneli nyingine zitaongezwa baadae).

eng: The message goes out three times, once every 5 minutes.
swa: Ujumbe huenda mara tatu, mara moja kwa kila dakika tano.

eng: If there is a response, then that person is considered okay.
swa: Kama hapatakuwa na majibu, basi mtu huyo aliyetumiwa atachukuliwa kuwa yuko salama.

eng: If no response, then 3 messages get sent to their other contact.
swa: Ikiwa hapatakuwa na majibu, ujumbe huo hutumwa kwa wengine walio kwenye orodha.

eng: We file each response into one of 3 areas: responded (verified), not responded, not okay.
swa: Kila jibu linakuwa katika mojawapo ya maeneo matatu: alijibu (imethibitishwa), hajajibu, hayuko salama.

eng: Every message that comes back from someone in that group is saved into a big bucket of text, that the admin can add notes to if needed.
swa: Kila ujumbe unaorudi kutoka kwa mtu aliye kwneye orodha hiyo hutunzwa katika kapu kubwa la ujumbe, na mtu anayedhibiti orodha hiyo huweza kuongeza ujumbe ikihitajika.

eng: Another tool is Blood Donation Kenya, which is a crowdmap of all locations of blood drive centers.
swa: Zana nyingine ni Kujitolea Damu Kenya, ambayo ni ramani ya vituo vyote vya kupokelea damu.

eng: The map matches blood location centers with people willing to help with donation, medical instruments or medical personnel.
swa: Ramani hiyo huoanisha vituo vya kupokelea damu na watu wanaohitaji kujitolea damu, vifaa vya kitabibu au wafanyakazi wa afya.

eng: A screenshot of a crowdmap showing blood donation sites in Kenya.
swa: Ramani inayoonyesha maeneo ya kupokelea damu nchini Kenya.

eng: Image source: Ushahidi blog.
swa: Picha: Ushahidi blog.

eng: Erik Hersmann explains the logic behind the map:
swa: Erik Hersmann anaeleza mantiki ya ramani:

eng: One of the most amazing guys in Kenya in any emergency is Philip Ogola of the Kenya Red Cross.
swa: Mmoja wapo wa jamaa mahodari sana nchini Kenya katika kila wakati wa dharura ni Philip Ogola wa Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu Kenya.

eng: He’s first on scene with great updates, but there’s only so much that one person can do.
swa: Huwa wa kwanza kwenda kwenye eneo la tukio akiwa na habari za wakati husika, lakini kwa kweli haiwezekani mtu mmoja kufanya zaidi.

eng: Now, the Kenya Red Cross itself has been doing incredible work, but they have a problem with a lot of their stuff still being paper and pen (and there’s another group working on a locally hosted database system to digitize this without putting real people’s names online, run by Nivi of eLimu).
swa: Sasa, Msalaba Mwekundu Kenya wenyewe wamekuwa wakifanya kazi kubwa, lakini wana tatizo kwamba wafanyakazi wao wengi bado wanategemea sana kalamu na karatasi (na kuna kikundi cha watu wengine, wakiongozwa na Nivi wa eLimu, wanaojaribu kutengeneza mfumo wa "database" utakaokuwa wa humu humu nchini ili kufanya kazi hii iwe ya kidijitali bila kulazimika kuweka majina halisi ya watu mtandaoni).

eng: Another problem that they have is that the hospitals are running short on some types of blood, and are overwhelmed with others, as the Kenyan population comes out in full force to donate blood.
swa: Tatizo jingine wanalokumbana nalo ni kwamba hospitali zinaishiwa damu, na zinazidiwa, hata wanapokuja watu kwa ari kubwa kuja kujitolea damu.

eng: How can this be managed better, so that people aren’t turned away from some places and so that they know where to go for their type?
swa: Namna gani hili linaweza kudhibitiwa vizuri zaidi, ili watu wasikumbane na usumbufu wa kuondoka katika vituo fulani ili basi wajue wanatakiwa kwenda wapi kutoa damu ya aina yao?

eng: We set up a crowdmap deployment to map our all locations of blood drive centers, in an effort to match these areas with those willing to help at BloodDonationKenya.Crowdmap.com, either through blood donation, medical instruments or medical personnel.
swa: Tumetengeneza ramani ya kuonyesha maeneo ya kutolea damu, kama sehemu ya juhudi za kuyaoanisha maeneo haya na wale wanaojisikia kusaidia BloodDonationKenya.Crowdmap.com, ama kwa kutoa damu, vifaa vya kitabibu au watu wenye ujuzi wa mambo ya afya.

swa: Soma pia: Namna Shambulizi la Westgate Lilivyodalidiliwa kwenye Mitandao ya Kijamii na Mwandishi wa Global Voices Awakumbuka Marafki Waliouawa kwenye Shambulio la Westgate.

eng: President Park is under fire for her retreat on campaign promises of higher pension and tuition subsidies.
swa: Rais Park yuko kwenye wakati mgumu kwa r ahadi yake aliyoitoa wakati wa kampeni kuwa angepandisha ruzuku ya pensheni gharama za mafunzo.

eng: Critics say her campaign pledges adopted against her own identity as a conservative candidate, helped Park to rake in more votes in the last presidential election. @metempirics gathered relevant links and web reactions in Storify.
swa: Wakosoaji wanasema kampeni yake iliahidi kinyume na sera yake kama mgombea mhafidhina, ilimsaidia kuzoa kura katika uchaguzi uliopita. Akaunti ya mtandao wa twita wa @metempirics ilikusanya viunganishi vinavyohusika na miitikio ya mtandaoni katika kipengele cha Habari (Storify).

eng: Following a thrilling victory in the quarterfinals (see our coverage), last night the Mozambican women's basketball team won a place in the Afrobasket Finals tonight against reigning champions Angola.
swa: Kufuatia ushindi wa kishindo kwenye mashindano ya robo fainali (tazama habari zetu ), yaliyofanyika usiku wa jana timu ya mpira wa kikapu ya Msumbiji, wanawake, ilishinda nafasi ya kuingia kwenye Fainali za Mashindano ya Afrobasket usiku wa leo dhidi ya washindi watetezi Angola.

eng: With yet another comeback-style victory over Cameroon in the semifinals, they are also guaranteed a place in the World Championships, and in the nation's sporting history.
swa: Kwa staili nyingine ya kurudi kwa ushindi dhidi ya Kameruni kwenye hatua ya nusu fainali, waliweza kujihakikishia nafasi kwenye Mashindano ya Dunia, na kuandika historia mpya ya michezo nchini humo.

eng: There have long been rumors that Vladimir Putin has a romantic relationship with Uzbekistan-born former gymnast Alina Kabaeva.
swa: Kumekuwepo uvumi kwamba Vladimir Putin ana uhusiano wa kimapenzi na mcheza sarakasi wa zamani aliyezaliwa Uzbekistan Alina Kabaeva.

eng: Indeed, the speculation predates Putin's divorce, which he announced to the press in June 2013.
swa: Na kweli, uvumi huo ulikuwepo kabla ya talaka ya Putin, ambayo aliitangaza kwenye vyombo vya habari mwezi June 2013.

eng: In the last week, the gossip has flared up again, and this time the RuNet's busybodies suspect that Putin (age 60) and Kabaeva (age 30) may finally have tied the knot.
swa: Juma lililopita, tetesi ziliibuka kwa mara nyingine, na wakati huu "wapika majungu" wa RuNet wanabashiri kuwa Putin (umri miaka 60) na Kabaeva (umri miaka 30) hatimaye wanaweza kufunga pingu za maisha.

eng: It started with a mid-afternoon tweet on Saturday:
swa: Habari zilianza na twiti ya mchana wa Jumamosi:

eng: I am told that Putin and Kabaeva were married today in the Iversky Monastery.
swa: Ninaambiwa kwamba Putin na Kabaeva wameoana leo katika nyumba ya watawa ya Iversky.

eng: All of Valdai is cordoned off.
swa: Magari yote ya mji wa Valdai yako eneo hilo.

eng: This message, written by lawyer Koloy Akhilgov, grabbed over 500 retweets, and sent the Russian blogosphere scrambling for more information.
swa: Ujumbe huu, ulioandikwa na mwanasheria Koloy Akhilgov, ulitwitiwa kwa zaidi ya mara 500, na kutzifanya blogu za ki-Rusi kupigana vikumbo kupata habari zaidi.

eng: A few hours later, Akhilgov reported:
swa: Masaa mamchache baadae, Akhilgov aliripoti:

eng: Friends, I cannot vouch for the accuracy of the facts, but locals reported the FSO blocked off everything and everyone around Iversky.
swa: Rafiki zangu, siwezi kuwa na habari za uhakika, lakini watu wa sehemu hiyo walisema kila kitu na kila mmoja amezuia kufanya chochote kuzunguka Iversky.

eng: A parody Twitter account that mocks Putin’s spokesman, Dmitry Peskov, soon tweeted:
swa: Akaunti ya twita inayomkejeli msemaji wa Putin, Dmitry Peskov, haikuchelewa kutwiti:

eng: Yes, Vladimir Vladimirovich is married!
swa: Ndio, Vladimir Vladimirovich ameoa!

eng: Though not to Alina Kabaeva, but to the kingdom.
swa: Ingawa sio kwamba kamwoa Alina Kabaeva, lakini kauoa ufalme.

eng: Within hours of Akhilgov's first tweet, Dmitry Peskov went on TV Dozhd (TV Rain) and denied the rumors, reproving the blogosphere for its chatter, and accusing netizens of “Internet exercises on Saturday out of boredom.”
swa: Ndani ya masaa machache tangu twiti ya kwanza ya Akhilgov, Dmitry Peskov alienda kwenye kituo cha televisheni cha TV Dozhd (TV Rain) na kukanusha uvumi huo, akiwalaumu wanablogu kwa kuandika haraka haraka bila ushahidi, na kuwashutumu watumiaji wa mitandao kwa "Kufanya mazoezi mtandaoni siku ya Jumamosi shauri ya kukosa cha kufanya."

eng: This seemingly vague denial only heightened the buzz online.
swa: Kanusho hili lililoonekana kuwa lisiloeleweka vyema lilikuza ziadi michapo ya mtandaoni.

eng: For instance, LiveJournal user Egor Sedov argued that Peskov had only stoked the flames of the rumor and made it an even bigger story.
swa: Kwa mfano, mtumiaji wa LiveJournalEgor Sedov alihoji kwamba Peskov alikuwa amemwaga petroli kwenye moto wa tetesi hizo na kuzifanya ziwe habari kubwa zaidi.

eng: I had not heard these rumors.
swa: Sikuwa nimezisikia kabisa tetesi hizo.

eng: But now I have.
swa: Lakini sasa nimeshazisikia.

eng: Whom can I say thank?
swa: Nimeshukuru nani?

eng: Mr. Peskov, that's who!
swa: Peskov, ndiye wa kushukuru!

eng: If Peskov had said nothing, the rumors (even if they are true) would have died down by themselves.
swa: Kama asingesema kitu, tetesi hizo (hata kama zingekuwa kweli) zingefifia zenyewe na kupotea.

eng: But not now.
swa: Lakini si sasahivi.

eng: Another thing: is Kabaeva a Muslim?
swa: Kitu kingine: Je, Kabaeva si ni Muislamu?

eng: Or no?
swa: Au sio?

eng: If she is a Muslim, is a wedding possible?
swa: Kama ndivyo, hivi hapo harusi inawezekana kweli?

eng: Also commenting on the religious aspect of a potential Putin-Kabaeva union, another blogger speculated that Kabaeva has converted to Orthodoxy, in order to marry Putin.
swa: Akizungumzia upande huo buo wa dini kwa uwezekano wa ndoa kati ya Ptin na Kabaeva, mwanablogu mwingine alidodosa kwamba Kabaeva alikuwa amebadili dini, ili aolewe na Putin.

eng: Blogger Pasha Businessman urged the blogosphere to calm down and stop spreading unfounded rumors:
swa: Mwanablogu Pasha Businessman aliwasihi wanablogu kuwa watulivu na kuacha kueneza uvumi usiothibitika:

eng: I think that all of these rumors are just inventions.
swa: Ninafikiri uvumi wote huu ni wa kupikwa.

eng: Except for the rumors, nothing is confirmed by other sources.
swa: Na ukweli ni kwamba, linapokuja suala la tetesi, hakuna kinachothibitishwa na vyanzo vingine.

eng: Not one photograph, not one video, and so on.
swa: Hakuna picha hata moja, hakuna video hata moja, na kadhalika.

eng: It does not matter what the press office says.
swa: Haina maana ofisi ya habari inasemaje.

eng: Besides stuffing the tabloids and all the tabloid journalists, there are no other facts that Putin met with Kabaeva.
swa: Ukiacha habari uchwara za magazeti, na waandishi wote wa magazeti, hakuna uthibitisho mwingine kwamba Putin amewahi kukutana na Kabaeva.

eng: Lord, journalists, let’s not run ahead of the engine.
swa: Bwana, waandishi, hebu tusirukie gari kwa mbele.

eng: Get the facts, get a handle on them, verify using independent sources, and then publish.
swa: Kusanyeni taarifa, zifanyieni kazi, zithibitisheni kwa kutumia vyanzo huru, na kisha chapisheni.

eng: On her Facebook wall, journalist Natalia Gevorkyan wondered why the Kremlin has to make everything a “special operation," noting how Putin waited for wide speculation in the media to accumulate before announcing his divorce.
swa: Kwenye ukurafsa wake wa Facebook, mwandishi Natalia Gevorkyan alishangaa kwa nini Ikulu ya Kremlin inapenda kufanya kila kitu kiwe "operesheni maalumu," akibainisha namna Putin alivyosubiri uchokonozi wa magazeti ujue kila kitu kabla hajatangaza talaka yake.

eng: How many years did he not live with his wife before going to the theatre for an interview about his divorce?
swa: Ni miaka mingapi hakuishi na mke wake kabla ya kwenda kwenye ukumbi wa mahojiano kuhusioana na talaka yake?

eng: Now will he live as many years in this marriage before it is announced?
swa: Sasa ataishi miaka mingapi kenye ndoa hii kabla hajaitangaza rasmi?

eng: Maybe, however, at the Olympic games.... Somehow logical-symbolic .
swa: Labla, hata hivyo, wakati wa michezo ya Olimpik...kwa namna yoyote na mantiki ya mwonekano .

eng: The odds are that the gossip about Putin's remarriage is just that.
swa: Habari ni kwamba uvumi kuhusu ndoa nyingine ya Putin ni uvumi tu.

eng: But if Gevorkyan is right that Putin is waiting for another unexpected, well-attended setting for the dramatic reveal, we may have to wait until next year's Winter Olympics in Sochi.
swa: Lakini kama Gevorkyan yuko sahihi kwamba Putin anasubiri mazingira mengine yasiyotarajiwa, yenye halaiki ya watu wengi ndipo atoboe siri, basi tunaweza kusubiri mpaka kwenye Mashindano ya mwakani ya Olimpiki mjini Sochi.

eng: The Egyptian citizen collective Mosireen has been tirelessly documenting the #Jan25 revolution and the events that followed in images and documentaries.
swa: Mkusanyiko wa kiraia la Misri Mosireen umekuwa, bila kuchoka, ukiweka kumbukumbuza Mapinduzi ya Januari 25 na matukio yaliyofuata baadae kwa kutumia picha na dokumentari.

eng: One of their very last creations is "Prayer of Fear", a filmpoem by Mahmoud Ezzat narrated by Mosireen member Salma Said.
swa: Moja ya ubunifu wake wa mwisho mwisho ni "Maombi ya Woga", shairi la filamu iliyotengenezwa na Mahmoud Ezzat na kusimuliwa na mwanachama wa Mosireen Salma Said.

eng: Between roving and painful memories, the filmpoem stuns with its disarming sincerity and humanity.

eng: Nearly 500 forest fires were recorded in Sumatra Island last August which caused a thick haze to descend on Riau in Indonesia and even in some parts of Malaysia.
swa: Karibu matukio 500 ya moto wa msituni yalirekodiwa katika kisiwa cha Sumatra mwezi Agosti matukio ambayo yalisababisha vumbi nene kutimka angani Riau nchini Indonesia na hata katika baadhi ya maeneo ya Malaysia.

eng: The burning of forests is blamed on the operations of oil palm plantations, wood suppliers’ concessions, and pulpwood plantations.
swa: Uchomaji wa misitu ni unasemekana kusababishwa na shughuli za kilimo cha mashamba makubwa ya mafuta ya mawese, makubaliano ya uuzaji wa kuni, na mashamba ya mashapo.

eng: Several schools were closed in Riau during the return of the deadly haze last week.
swa: Shule kadhaa zilifungwa katika jimbo la Riau wakati wa vumbi hilo baya lilipoonekana tena wiki iliyopita.

eng: The haze pollution is a recurring problem in the region caused mainly by forest fires in Indonesia.
swa: Vumbi linalosababishwa na uchafuzi wa mazingira ni tatizo la mara kwa mara katika eneo hilo linalosababishwa zaidi na matukio ya moto wa msituni nchini Indonesia.

eng: Last June, the haze covered Singapore and many areas in Malaysia.
swa: Mwezi Juni, vumbi nene kiliifunika Singapore na maeneo mengi nchini Malaysia.

eng: Forest fire hotspots in Riau, Indonesia.
swa: Maeneo yanayoonesha matukio ya moto wa msituni jimboni Riau, Indonesia.

eng: Yellow areas are palm oil plantations.
swa: Maeneo yenye rangi ya manjano ni mashamba makubwa ya mawese.

eng: Image from Eyes on the Forest.
swa: Picha ya Eyes on the Forest .

eng: On Twitter, Indonesians expressed their concern about the return of the haze in Sumatra.
swa: Kwenye mtandao wa Twita, Wa-Indonesia walionyesha wasiwasi wao juu ya kurejea tena kwa vumbi hilo huko Sumatra.

eng: If Indonesia Prez dtg, pls tell Msian palm oil owners in Sumatra to burn more fires so tht SBY can see with his own eyes what Haze is. — Dr Wan Norashikin (@drshikin) August 31, 2013 SBY refers to Indonesian President Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono.
swa: Kama Rais wa Indonesia aone kwa macho yake vumbi hili linafananaje

eng: #haze #Sumatra land burning bad for 2 days in #Medan, left a layer of black dust on my motorcycle in 8 hours #health #environment #Indonesia — SumatraEEC (@SumatraEEC) August 27, 2013
swa: Ardhi inateketea vibaya kwa moto kwa siku mbili huko Medan, imeacha vumbi jeusi kwenye pikipiki yangu kwa masaa nane tu

eng: In Penang, Malaysia, the haze affected many residents.
swa: Huko Penang, vumbi hilo liliathiri wakazi wengi.

eng: Fortunately, the haze was already gone last weekend.
swa: Kwa bahati nzuri, vumbi lilikuwa tayari kimekwisha mwishoni mwa wiki iliyopita.

eng: Haze is stopping me from jogging ): — June (@SScarsorrow) August 29, 2013
swa: Vumbi hili linanizuia kufanya mazoezi ya kukimbia kimbia

eng: Finally, no more haze.
swa: Hatimaye, hakuna vumbi zaidi.

eng: Yeay.
swa: Safi.

eng: I can finally see the sunrise.
swa: Hatimaye naweza kuona mawio ya jua.

eng: Alhamdulillah.
swa: Alhamdulillah.

eng: Aaron Leaf discusses how the Liberian president, Ellen Johnson Sirleaf, is often presented by western media as an avatar of all things good.
swa: Aaron Leaf anajadili jinsi taswira ya rais wa Liberia, Ellen Johnson Sirleaf, hujengwa na vyombo vya habari kimagharibi kama alama ya mambo yote mazuri.

eng: He says that this was the narrative that made her an icon of international development and women’s empowerment.
swa: Anasema kwamba hili ndiyo simulizi lililomwezesha Sirleaf kuwa mhimili wa maendeleo ya kimataifa na uwezeshaji wa wanawake.

eng: The unexpected release of two Spanish aid workers from Doctors Without Borders, kidnapped on October 13, 2011, was announced following 21 months of captivity.
swa: Tangazo la kuachiliwa huru kusikotarajiwa kwa wafanyakazi wawili wa Hispania wa misaada waliokuwa wakifanya kazi katika Shirika la Madaktari Wasiokuwa na Mipaka, na kutekwa nyara Oktoba 13, 2011, lilitoka baada ya miezi 21 ya utumwa.

eng: Montserrat Serra (left) y Blanca Thiebaut, the two Spanish aid workers freed after 21 months of captivity in Somalia.
swa: Montserrat Serra (kushoto) y Blanca Thiebaut, wafanyakazi wawili wa Ki-Hispania wa misaada walioachiliwa huru baada ya miezi 21 ya kutekwa nyara nchini Somalia.

eng: Photo posted on Twitter by José Campos.
swa: Picha iliwekwa kwenye mtandao wa twita na José Campos.

eng: It is also unclear if their captors were common criminals or members of a faction of Al Qaeda, though most observers attribute the incident to terrorists.
swa: Haiko wazi vilevile ikiwa watekaji wao walikuwa wahalifu wa kawaida au wanachama wa kikundi cha Al Qaeda, ingawa waangalizi wengi wanalichukulia tukio hilo kama lililofanywa na magaidi.

eng: Doctors Without Borders (MSF) called a press conference following the news, but José Antonio Bastos, President of (MSF) Spain, said they could not release information on the liberation process "so as not to compromise the rest of the volunteers in Somalia nor the informants."
swa: Madaktari Wasiokuwa na Mipaka waliitisha mkutano wa waandishi wa habari baada ya habari hiyo, lakini José Antonio Bastos, Rais wa DWB Hispania, alisema hawangetoa taarifa juu ya mchakato wa ukombozi "ili kutokusababisha matatizo kwa watu wengine wanaojitolea nchini Somalia pamoja na watoa habari."

eng: It has been MSF who has partaken in the negotiations to free the volunteer workers.
swa: Shirika hilo ndilo lililokuw likifanya maelewano yaliyosababisha kuachiwa huru wafanyakazi hao.

eng: The Spanish state has not intervened.
swa: Serikali ya Uhispania haikuingilia kati suala hilo.

eng: What has not been revealed is whether ransom was paid, the amount that could have been paid, or who has taken responsibility for the supposed payment.
swa: Kisicho wazi ni kama fidia ilipwa, kiasi kilichotakiwa kulipwa, au nani aliyechukua jukumu la kulipa malipo yaliyotakiwa.

eng: Many celebrated the release of the two women, such as Beli Álvarez , who tweeted:
swa: Wengi walisheherekea kuachiliwa huru kwa wanawake hao wawili, kama vile Beli Alvarez, aliyetwiti:

eng: @Beli_Alvarez: A message of love and welcoming to the two Spanish aid workers from @MSF_espana Congratulations to this NGO for their great work in the world
swa: @Beli_Alvarez: Ujumbe wa upendo wa kuwakaribisha wafanyakazi wawili wa misaada wa ki-Hispania kutoka @MSF_espana Hongera AZISE hii kwa kazi ya kubwa inayoifanya dunia kote

eng: Nevertheless, not all were messages of congratulations.
swa: Hata hivyo, sio kila ujumbe ulikuwa ni wa pongezi.

eng: Many netizens took for granted that the Spanish state had paid the ransom for aid workers and expressed their dissatisfaction, sometimes accusing the aid workers of being reckless and seeking their own misfortune.
swa: Raia wengi wa Mtandao hawakujali kuwa serikali ya Kihispania ilikuwa imelipa fidia kwa ajili ya wafanyakazi hao na wakaonyesha kutoridhika kwao, wakati mwingine wakiwalaumu wafanyakazi hao kwa kutokuogopa hatari na kujitafutia matatizo yao wenyewe.

eng: burbman89 left this comment to the news, which appeared on 20minutos.es :
swa: burbman89 alitoa maoni hii kwenye habari hiyo, ambayo yalionekana kwenye 20minutos.es :

eng: Come on, it has cost all of us Spaniards so much money for these "good Samaritans" to go there to make them feel good about themselves.... why won't they just stay home!!!!
swa: Jamani, imetugharimu sana sisi Wahispania kiasi kikubwa cha fedha kwa ajili ya hawa "wasamaria wema" kwenda huko kuwafanya waponde raha .... kwa nini wao wasikae nyumbani!!!

eng: In the same media outlet, 1-2-3-4 blamed the volunteers for potential Al Qaeda attacks in the future:
swa: Katika chombo hicho hicho cha habari, 1-2-3-4 waliwalaumu wafanyakazi hao wa kujitolea kwa uwezekano wa mashambulizi ya Al Qaeda kwa siku za usoni:

swa: Madakatari Wasiokuwa na Mipaka nchini Uhispania wakiwa kwenye mkutano na vyombo vya habari kutangaza kuachiliwa huru kwa wafanyakazi wawili wa kujitolea.

eng: Image published on Twitter by DWB Press.
swa: Picha zimechapishwa kwenye Mtandao wa Twita na DWB Press.

eng: (...) the Islamists will buy weapons with the millions of euros that we have given them.
swa: (...) Waislam watanunua silaha kwa mamilioni ya Euro tulizo wapa.

eng: Weapons with which the Islamists will kidnap more Westerners and murder many Africans.
swa: Silaha ambazo Waislam watazitumia kuteka nyara zaidi raia wa Magharibi na kuwaua Waafrika wengi.

eng: Weapons with which they will carry out attacks.
swa: Silaha ambazo kwazo hufanyia mashambulizi.

eng: The harm caused by these "aid workers" is incalculable.
swa: Madhara yanayosababishwa na hawa "wafanyakazi wa misaada" hayahesabiki.

eng: In his column, "The state is no longer what it was" , in La Gaceta magazine, Rafael Bardají says that
swa: Katika safu yake, "hali haiko tena kama ilivyokuwa" , katika jarida la La Gaceta, Rafael Bardají anasema kwamba

eng: Are no longer neutral elements that are respected, but rather another piece in the conflicts.
swa: wamebadilika na si wale tuliowajua kuwa hawana upande wowote na waliheshimiwa, lakini badala yake wamekuwa ni sehemu ya migogoro.

eng: And that is something that affects not only their personal security, but that of the entire State (...).
swa: Na hili ni jambo ambalo huathiri si tu usalama wao binafsi, bali hata wa Nchi nzima (...).

eng: Paying them for what they do and paying for the release of their members is amoral and unsustainable.
swa: Kuwalipa kwa wanachokifanya na tena kulipa ili watoe wafanyakazi wao ni kinyume na maadili na ni kazi isiyoweza kuendelea kwa muda mrefu.

eng: In the same vein, Ricardo Peytaví shares his opinion in his column "Altruism that we all pay for" in the online newspaper El Día
swa: Katika hali hiyo hiyo, Ricardo Peytaví anatoa maoni yake katika safu yake ya Upotevu ambao sote huulipia katika gazeti la mtandaoni la El Dia

eng: The only thing that I want to know is how much this all costs me in terms of the share, given that this month I have paid over a third of my gross income in taxes. (...) any citizen of this country has become an easy piece for everything criminal that wants to make easy money.
swa: Kitu pekee ambacho nataka kujua ni kiasi gani haya yote hunigharamu mimi kwa maana ya hisa, kutokana na kwamba mwezi huu mimi nimelipa zaidi ya theluthi moja ya mapato yangu katika kodi. (...) Raia yeyote wa nchi hii amekuwa mhanga rahisi kwa kila chenye jinai ambacho kinachotaka kupata fedha kwa urahisi.

eng: Nonetheless, there have also been many netizens and bloggers who are pleased with the happy outcome of the kidnapping, and praised the work of the volunteers and the organization in a community so vulnerable like that of the refugees.
swa: Hata hivyo, kuna raia wa mtandao na wanablogu wengi pia ambao wanafurahia matokeo mazuri ya utekaji nyara, na kupongeza kazi ya wafanyakazi wa kujitolea na hata shirika lenyewe katika jamii yenye mazingira magumu kama yale ya wakimbizi.

swa: Belen de la Banda alizungumza kuhusu hili katika blogu ya 3500 millones :

eng: Blanca, Montse, and their colleagues are the moral examples that we need in these times of uncertainty and mistrust. (...) our society should look for a way to feel our embrace, to acknowledge the enormous effort and valuable work that has led them to this extreme situation.
swa: Blanca, Montse, na wenzao ni mifano ya kimaadili kwamba tunawahitaji katika nyakati hizi za kutokuwa na uhakika na kutoaminiana. (...) Jamii yetu yapaswa kutafuta njia ya kuhisi ukaribu wetu, kukubali juhudi kubwa sana na kazi muhimu ambayo imesababisha hali hii ya kupindukia.

eng: Because people like them make our country and our world better.
swa: Kwa sababu watu kama wao huifanya nchi na dunia yetu kuwa bora.

swa: Na 1358 aliacha maoni haya kwenye habari ya iliyoonekana kwenye El Pais

swa: Kuwasili kwa wafanyakazi wa kujitolea Uhispania kufuatia kuachiliwa kwao.

swa: Picha kutoka kwa tovuti ya RTVE.

swa: Ninaungana na wale ambao WANA FURAHA kwa kurudi nyumbani ya watu hawa wawili na kama MLIPAKODI INAONEKANA VYEMA SANA kwangu mimi ikiwa kuachiliwa kwao kulipaswa kulipiwa.

eng: Life, even the lives of those who we do not like, has no price and it is much better to spend money (if it has been done) on PEOPLE than on cowboys and indians games so that four SLACKERS play and believe themselves to be chonvaine on "missions" of "peace" and "reconstruction."
swa: Maisha, hata maisha ya wale ambao sisi hatuwapendi, hayana bei na ni bora zaidi kutumia fedha (kama imefanyika) kwa WATU kuliko kwa michezo ya Wahindi ili WAZEMBE wanne wacheze na kujiamini wenyewe kuwa mashujaa katika "huduma" wa "amani" na "mageuzi."

eng: Regardless of the controversy that has been created around the payment of their rescue, the good news is that Montserrat Serra and Blanca Thiebaut are with their families, safe and sound.
swa: Pamoja na utata ambao umetokana na malipo ya kuwaokoa, habari njema ni kwamba Montserrat Serra na Blanca Thiebaut wako pamoja na familia zao, salama na wazima.

eng: The DWB doctors and psychologists that have tended to them since their release have advised that they be given some time to recuperate and adapt to day to day life once again, meaning people will have to wait some time before they can talk about what they lived through these 21 months in captivity.
swa: Madaktari DWB pamoja na wanasaikolojia wamewahudumia tangu kuachiliwa kwao wameshauri kwamba wapewe muda wa kupata nafuu na kukabiliana na pilika pilika za maisha kwa mara nyingine tena, kumaanisha kwamba watu watasubiri kwa muda kabla hawajaweza kuzungumza kuhusu jinsi walivyoishi utumwani katika miezi hii 21.

eng: They have only been seen getting off the plane in the Madrid airport, extremely skinny and appearing exhausted, but smiling.
swa: Walionekana tu wakishuka kwenye ndege katika uwanja wa ndege wa Madrid, wakionekana kukonda na kuonekana kuchoka, lakini wakitabasamu.

eng: Hopefully they have a speedy recovery and return to their normal lives soon.
swa: Ni matumaini watapona haraka na kurudi kwa maisha yao ya kawaida hivi karibuni.

swa: Picha ya tamko linalomtaka waziri huyo ajiuzulu.

eng: According to Uganda's Youth Affairs Minister Ronald Kibuule, women who are dressed indecently are asking to be raped, and suspects who have raped such women should be released.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa Waziri wa Mambo ya Vijana wa Uganda Ronald Kibuule, wanawake wanaovaa mawazi yasiyositiri miili yao wanaomba kubakwa, na watuhumiwa wanaodaiwa kuwabaka wanawake waliovaa namna hiyo waachiliwe huru.

eng: He also said that in cases of rape, police should first ascertain the dress code of the victim, and if they were dressed indecently, they should also be charged with inviting the crime.
swa: Alisema vile vile kuwa katika kesi za ubakaji, polisi wawe wa kwanza kusimamia namna wanawake hao waathirika walivyovaa, na kama wamevaa hovyo, nao washitakiwe kwa kosa la kukaribisha uhalifu.

eng: Kibuule made the comments in Kajara County, Ntungamo District on Saturday September 21, 2012, while attending the launch of Kajara Youth Development Cooperative and Savings Society.
swa: Kibuule alitoa matamshi hayo akiwa kwenye halmashauri ya Kajara, wilayani Ntungamo siku ya Jumamosi Septemba 21, 2013 wakati akihudhuria ufunguzi wa Chama cha Ushirika na Akiba cha Vijana wa Kajara.

eng: The comments appeared on Uganda's newspaper Daily Monitor on September 24, 2013.
swa: Kauli hiyo ilionekana kwenye gazeti la Uganda Daily Monitor la Septemba 24, 2013.

eng: The article, however, did not explain the context in which Kibuule made the comments.
swa: Makala hiyo, hata hivyo, haikueleza mukhtadha ambao Kibuule alitoa matamshi hayo.

eng: The parliament has summoned the minister to appear before it to explain the comment he made last week.
swa: Bunge limemtaka waziri huyo ajieleze bungeni ilikuwaje akatoa matamshi hayo juma lililopita.

eng: Ugandan netizens responded in fury to the comments using the hashtag #Kibuule on Twitter.
swa: Raia wa Uganda mtandaoni walijadili matamshi hayo kwa hasira wakitumia alama habari #Kibuule kwenye mtandao wa twitter.

eng: Those calling for his resignation are using the hashtags #KibuuleMustGo and #KibuuleOut.
swa: Wale waliomtaka ajiuzulu wanatumia alama habari #KibuuleMustGo na #KibuuleOut .

swa: Kwa manano haya, Bw. Kibuule anautangaza ubakaji wa wanawake kwa kigezo la mavazi yao; anawahurumia wabakaji kwa makosa yao ya jinai waliyoyafanya kwa wanawake wanaodaiwa kuvaa vibaya na; anahakikisha waathirika wa ubakaji wanapata hofu ya kujitokeza hadharani kwa kuogopa kushitakiwa kwa kubakwa.

eng: He should lose his position immediately since he clearly does not represent the well being of his constituents.
swa: Lazima aachane na msimamo huo haraka sana kwa kuwa ni wazi alichokisema hakiwakilishi ustawi wa wapiga kura wake.

eng: The tiny West African State of The Gambia has announced via state television that it will withdraw from the Commonwealth of Nations, a fellowship of 54 countries that are mainly former colonies of the British Empire.
swa: Gambia, Nchi ndogo ya Afrika Magharibi imetangaza kupitia kituo cha runinga cha taifa kwamba imejitoa kwenye Jumuiya ya Madola, ushirikiano wa nchi zipatazo 54 zilizowahi kuwa makoloni ya Ufalme wa Uingereza.

eng: A statement released on Wednesday, 2 October 2013 stated that "the government has withdrawn its membership of the British Commonwealth and decided that the Gambia will never be a member of any neo-colonial institution and will never be a party to any institution that represents an extension of colonialism."
swa: Tamko lililotolewa Jumatano, Oktoba 2, 2013 limesema kwamba "serikali imesitisha uanachama wake wa Jumuiya ya Madola na kuamua kwamba Gambia kamwe haitakuwa mwanachama wa taasisi yoyote ya ukoloni mambo-leo na kamwe haitakuwa sehemu ya taaisis yoyote inayotanua ukoloni."

eng: No further reasons have been advanced by the government, but relations between the Gambia and the UK in 2013 have been rocky.
swa: Hakuna sababu nyingine zaidi zilizotolewa na serikali, ila ni wazi kuwa mahusiano kati ya Gambia na Uingereza mwaka 2013 yamekuwa magumu.

eng: In April, the UK Foreign Office's annual Human Rights and Democracy Report was critical of the country's human rights record under President Yahya Jammeh, highlighting violations such as unlawful detentions, illegal closures of newspapers and discrimination against minority groups.
swa: Mwezi Aprili, Ripoti ya mwaka ya Haki za Binadamu na Demokrasia ya Wizara ya Mambo ya Nje ya Uingereza ilikosoa rekodi ya haki za binadamu nchini humo chini ya Rais Yahya Jammeh, ikionyesha ukiukwaji mkubwa wa haki za binadamu ikiwa ni pamoja na ukamataji wa raia usiofuata sheria, kufungwa kwa magazeti kinyume cha sheria na unyanyasaji wa makundi madogo.

eng: The country's response to the report was sharp: "Britain has no moral authority to dictate moral standards of rectitude and democracy to any former colony in Africa”.
swa: Majibu ya nchi hiyo kwa ripoti hiyo yalikuwa makali: "Uingereza haina uhalali wa kimaadili kufundisha maadili ya haki na demokrasia kwa nchi yoyote iliwahi kuwa koloni lake barani Afrika".

eng: After the Gambia announced the decision to dump its membership of the international body headed by Queen Elizabeth II, netizens around the globe have reacted with mix feelings.
swa: Baada ya Gambia kutangaza uamuzi wa kufutilia mbali uanachama wake wa chombo hicho cha kimataifa kinachoongozwa na Queen Elizabeth II, watumiaji wa mtandao duniani kote wameitikia uamuzi huo kwa hisia tofauti.

eng: Mathew Jallow, an exiled Gambian journalist, saw the move as good for publicising President Jammeh's "stupidity".
swa: Mathew Jallow, mwandishi wa habari raia wa Gambia aliyefukuzwa nchini humo, aliichukulia hatua hiyo kuwa nzuri kuutangaza "ujinga" wa Rais Jammeh.

eng: Jammeh, who came to power in a 1994 coup, for years has earned the world's ire for his repressive rule, one that has been defined by executions, restricted freedom of the press and expression, persecution of homosexuals, and heavy-handed supression of political dissent:
swa: Jammeh, alitwaa madaraka kwa mapinduzi ya kijeshi ya mwaka 1994, kwa miaka mingi amekuwa akichukiwa na dunia kwa utawala wake wa kikandamizaji, utawala ambao umejaa mauaji, kubanwa kwa uhuru wa habari na maoni, kuuawa kwa mashoga, ukandamizaji mkubwa wa wapinzani wa kisiasa:

eng: Behind every dark cloud, there is a silver lining.
swa: Nyuma ya kila wingu zito jeusi, pana utepe mwembamba wa shaba.

eng: Yahya Jammeh's Gambia withdrawal from the Commonwealth is more negative publicity worth one year's newspaper reporting.
swa: Kujitoa kwa Gambia ya Yahya Jammeh kutoka Jumuiya ya Madola inatosha kuwa habari hasi kwa mwaka mzima wa taarifa za magazeti.

eng: Today, ever country in the world will carry this withdrawal news and every Commonwealth member state, including the US, will have every lingering doubt about our claims, confirmed.
swa: Leo, kila nchi duniani itajua habari hizi za kujitoa na kila nchi mwanachama wa Jumuiya ya Madola, ikiwa ni pamoja na Marekani, itathibitishiwa wasiwasi wowote kuhusiana na madai yetu.

eng: This is what dictators do all the time.
swa: Hili ndilo linalofanywa na madikteta siku zote.

eng: They create their own downfalls as they attempt to solidify their rules and barricade themselves within their crumbling worlds.
swa: Hujichimbia makaburi yao wenyewe katika harakati za kuimarisha tawala zao na kujididimiza ndani ya tawala zao zinazoharibikiwa.

eng: Thank you Yahya Jammeh.
swa: Asante Yahya Jammeh.

eng: All our efforts could not have publicized your stupidity better.
swa: Jitihada zetu zisingetangaza ujinga wako vizuri zaidi ya ulivyofanya mwenyewe.

eng: Commenting on his Facebook wall, Gambian journalist Sainey MK Marena analyzed the situation (post used with permission):
swa: Akitoa maoni katika ukurasa wake wa mtandao wa Facebook, mwandishi wa Gambia Sainey MK Marena alichambua hali ilivyo (bandiko lake limetumiwa kwa ruhusa):

eng: Gambia withdrawal from the Commonwealths attracts international headlines.
swa: Kujitoa kwa Gambia kutoka Jumuiya ya Madola kunavutia vichwa vya habari za kimataifa.

eng: The multi -million dollar question is why are we withdrawing our membership at a time when countries like Mozambique and others are seriously yearning to join the global body.
swa: Swali kuu ni kwa nini tunajitoa kwenye Jumuiya ya madola wakati ambapo nchi kama Msumbiji na nyinginezo zinatamani kujiunga na chombo hicho.

eng: Gambia has and continued to benefit from commonwealth in diverse areas including education/scholarship, sports and most recently the commonwealth proposed National Human Rights Commission.
swa: Gambia imekuwa na inaendela kufaidika na Jumuiya ya Mdola katika maeneo mengi ikiwa ni pamoja na elimu/ufadhili, michezo na hivi karibuni Jumuiya hiyo ilipendekeza kuundwa kwa Tume ya Taifa ya Haki za Binadamu.

eng: MY point is Gambia like any nation has right to withdraw from any association or organization but is should be based on credible and genuine reason (s).
swa: Mantiki yangu ni kwamba Gambia kama taifa lingine lolote ina haki ya kijitoa kutoka kwenye umoja au shirika lolote lakini iwe hivyo kwa sababu zenye uzito na za kweli.

eng: In 2003, Zimbabwe Under Mugabe withdraw from the Commonwealth for reasons best known to them but smallest country in the mainland African should take a different take and approached.
swa: Mwaka 2003, Zimbabwe chini ya Mugabe ilijitoa kwneye Jumuiya hiyo kwa sababu wanazozijua wao lakini nchi ndogo kuliko zote barani Afrika ingechukua hatua kwa mwelekeo tofauti.

eng: However, Sefa-Nyarko Clement seemed to disagree, writing on Facebook:
swa: Hata hivyo, Sefa-Nyarko Clement alionekana kutokukubaliana, akaandika kwenye mtandao wa Facebook:

eng: Great move, Gambia.
swa: Hatua nzuri, Gambia.

eng: Although I don't subscribe to the summary executions and despotic policies of Baba Jammeh, I support his withdrawal from the Commonwealth.
swa: Ingawa siungi mkono vitendo vya mauaji na sera mbovu za Baba Jammeh, ninaunga mkono kujitoa kwake kutoka Jumuiya ya Madola.

eng: Indeed, the Commonwealth of Nations has outlived its usefulness.
swa: Kwa hakika, Jumuiya ya Madola imepoteza umuhimu wake.

eng: On Twitter, user Abdou ‏(@abs2ray) criticised the president's behaviour:
swa: Kwenye mtandao wa twita, mtumiaji Abdou ‏(@abs2ray) alikosoa tabia ya rais:

eng: I'm not against the Gambia withdrawing from the commonwealth in principle but as usual Yaya is acting erratically once again. #Gambia — Abdou (@abs2ray) October 3, 2013
swa: Kimsingi siko kinyume na kitendo cha Gambia kujitoa kwenye Jumuiya ya Madola lakini kama kawaida Yahya haonyeshi mwelekeo kwa mara nyingine.

eng: While the discussion on the Jammeh’s latest diplomatic rumbling continues, it remains unclear what the poorly impoverished nation will gain by quitting the Commonwealth.
swa: Wakati majadiliano juu ya mahusiano duni ya Jammeh kidiplomasia yakiendelea, bado si bayana kile ambacho nchi hiyo masikini sana itakifaidi kwa kujitoa kwenye Jumuiya ya Madola.

eng: Do you care about free speech on the Internet?
swa: Je, unajali uhuru wa maoni kwenye mtandao?

eng: What about your privacy online?
swa: Vipi kuhusu faragha yako mtandaoni?

eng: What if your government created a law that could protect these rights, rather than threatening them?
swa: Vipi kama serikali yako ingetunga sheria ambayo ingeweza kulinda haki hizi, badala ya kuzitishia?

eng: Brazilian digital rights advocates have been working for years to pass the Marco Civil da Internet, a one-of-a-kind law that would protect key rights and freedoms on the Internet.
swa: Watetezi wa haki za kidijitali nchini Brazili wamekuwa wakifanya kazi kwa miaka mingi kupitisha Marco Civil da Internet, sheria ya aina yake inayolinda haki na uhuru mtandaoni.

eng: US government surveillance programs have brought new momentum to the issue, galvanizing support from civil society and even Brazil's president, Dilma Rousseff.
swa: Mipango ya kufuatilia mawasiliano ya watu ya Serikali ya Marekani imelifanya suala lipewe kasi mpya, likipata uungwaji mkono kutoka katika vyama vya kiraia na hata rais wa Brazil, Dilma Rousseff.

eng: This week on GV Face, our Advocacy Editor Ellery Biddle (@ellerybiddle) talks with leading experts on the issue, including GV author Raphael Tsavkko @Tsavkko, Carolina Rossini (@carolinarossini) and Joana Varon (@joana_varon) an original author of the bill.
swa: Wiki hii kwenye sehemu ya , Mhariri wetu wa Utetezi Ellery Biddle (@ellerybiddle) alizungumza na wataalamu waliobobea kwenye suala, mmoja wapo akiwa ni mwandishi wa GV Raphael Tsavkko @Tsavkko, Carolina Rossini (@carolinarossini) naJoana Varon (@joana_varon) mwandishi wa mwanzo wa muswada huo.

eng: For some more links and comments on this issue, check out our Google + event page.
swa: Kwa viungo zaidi na maoni katika suala hili, tazama kwenye ukurasa wetu wa matukio wa Google +.

eng: On October 26, 2013 thousands of Saudi women have vowed to defy the kingdom's ban on female driving.
swa: Mnamo Octoba 26, 2013 maelfu yaa wanawake wa ki-Saudi wameapa kuvunja amri ya Ufalme kuwazuia wanawake kuendesha magari.

eng: In this week's edition of GV Face, we meet Jeddah-based blogger and writer Tamador Alyami, who is supporting the #Women2Drive campaign.
swa: Katika toleo la GV Face wiki hii, tunakutana na mwanablogu wa Jeddah na mwandishi Tamador Alyami, anayeunga mkono kampeni ya #WanawakeWataendesha.

eng: We are also joined by Hadeel Mohammed, our Saudi Author based in Dammam and our MENA Editor Amira Al Hussaini.
swa: Tunaungana na Hadeel Mohammed, Mwandishi wetu wa Saudia anayeishi Dammam na Mhariri wetu wa Mashariki ya Kati na Afrika Kaskazini Amira Al Hussaini.

eng: We talked about the campaign, life for women in Saudi, and how activists handle naysayers like the cleric who recently said "we find that most of those who drive cars continuously deliver children with varying degrees of clinical dysfunction.”
swa: Tumezungumzia kampeni hiyo, maisha ya wanawake nchini Saudi, na jinsi wanaharakati walivyowachukulia wapinzani wa kampeni hiyo kama alivyofanya mhubiri mmoja siku za hivi karibuni aliposema, "tumegundua kuwa wale wanaoendesha magari wanajifungua watoto wenye vilema vya aina mbalimbali."

eng: GV Face is hosted by our Managing Editor Solana Larsen and Deputy Editor Sahar Habib Ghazi.
swa: GV Face inaandaliwa na Mhariri Mtendaji Solana Larsen na Mhariri Msaidizi Sahar Habib Ghazi.

eng: A coalition of concerned individuals and NGOs, Hong Kong for Elephants, rallied on October 4 in the city center calling on the Hong Kong Government to destroy its entire stockpile of 25 tonnes of confiscated ivory.
swa: Muungano wa watu binafsi na Asasi Zisizo za Serikali zinazoguswa na tatizo la ujangili wa tembo, Hong Kong kwa Tembo, uliandamana mnamo Oktoba 4 katikati ya jiji wakiitaka serikali ya Hong Kong kuteketeza hifadhi yake ya tani 25 za pembe za ndovu.

eng: The local rally is a solidarity action with the International March for Elephants organized by The David Sheldrick Wildlife Trust under the iworry campaign.
swa: Mkutano huo ni hatua ya kuunga mkono Matembezi ya Kimataifa kwa ajili ya kupigania tembo yaliyoandaliwa na Mfuko wa Wanyamapori wa David Sheldrick chini ya kampeni ya iworry.

eng: Lucy and Christine are acting as the spokesperson for the anti-ivory trade campaign in Hong Kong.
swa: Lucy na Christine wakiigiza kama wasemaji wa kampeni ya kupinga biashara ya pembe za ndovu mjini Hong Kong.

eng: Photo from Avaaz.org
swa: Picha ya Avaaz.org

eng: The local anti-Ivory action was launched with a petition by Lucy Lan Skrine aged 11 and Christina Seigrist aged 8 at Avaaz.org in mid September calling for the destruction of confiscated ivory in order to send a strong signal to Chinese consumers that buying ivory is immoral and wrong.
swa: Hatua hiyo ya kupinga biashara ya pembe za ndofu ilizinduliwa na tamko la Lucy Lan Skrine mwenye umri wa miaka 11 na Christina Seigrist mwenye miaka 8 kwenye wavuti ya Avaaz.org katikati ya mwezi Septemba likitoa mwito wa kuteketezwa kwa pembe za ndofu zilizokamatwa ili kutuma ujumbe mzito kwa wateja wa bidhaa hiyo nchini China kuwa shughuli hiyo haifai na ni kinyume cha maadili.

eng: The two school kids are studying in Hong Kong, a major port in the illegal global trade of ivory on route from Africa to mainland China.
swa: Watoto wawili wa shule wanaosoma Hong Kong, njia kuu ya biashara hiyo haramu kwa bishaa zinazotoka Afrika ili kuingizwa China.

eng: In an interview with inmediahk.net, they said that they love animals and wanted to stop the massive killing of elephants by helping to give them a voice.
swa: Katika mahojiano na mtandao wa inmediahk.net, wanasema wanapenda wanyama na kuwa wangependa kuwasaidia kusema ili kumaliza kuuawa kwa tembo.

eng: The two girls become the spokespersons for Hong Kong for Elephants.
swa: Wasichana hao wawili wamekuwa wasemaji wa Tembo nchini Hong Kong.

eng: Activists demonstrated outside the Chinese Arts and Crafts Department Store on October 4.
swa: Wanaharakati wakiandamana nje ya JUmba la Sanaa la Kichina na Ghala la Idara ya Vito Oktoba 4.

eng: Photo by Mara McCaffery shared in International March for Elephants' event page.
swa: Picha ya McCaffery imewekwa kwenye ukurasa wa matukio ya Matembezi ya Kimataifa kutetea Tembo.

eng: Despite the active crackdown of ivory smugglers by the Hong Kong Customs and Excise Department in the implementation of the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES), it has been difficult for the authorities to identify and prosecute the smugglers.
swa: Pamoja na hatua kali dhidi ya wahalifu wa pembe za ndovu zinazochukuliwa na Idara ya Uhamiaji ya Hong Kong na Idara ya Forodha katika kutekeleza Tamko la Biashara ya Kimataifa la Viumbe Waliohatarini Kutoweka (CITES), imekuwa vigumu kwa mamlaka kuwatambua na kuwashitaki waingizaji wa bidhaa hiyo.

eng: Furthermore, domestic trade of ivory accessories is allowed both in Hong Kong and in mainland China.
swa: Zaidi, biashara ya ndani ya bidhaa zinazotokana na pembe za ndovu inaruhusiwa nchini Hong Kong na hata bara China.

eng: When the illegal raw ivory is successfully smuggled to mainland China via Hong Kong, it is wholesaled to carvers and manufacturers, turned into luxurious products and circulated in the domestic market through both licensed businesses and underground black market.
swa: Wakati bidhaa haramu za pembe za ndovu zikiingizwa China kupitia Hong Kong, zinanunuliwa kwa jumla na wazalishaji wa vito pamoja na wabunifu, na kugeuzwa kuwa bidhaa za thamani na kuingizwa kwenye mzunguko katika soko la ndani kupitia biashara zenye leseni na hata kwenye soko bubu.

eng: That's why international anti-ivory trade campaigns, such as Save All Elephants, are calling for a a stop to ivory carving industry in China:
swa: Ni kwa sababu hiyo kampeni za kupinga bishara ya pembe za ndovu kimataifa, kama hiyo ya Waokoe Tembo Wote, zinatoa wito wa kumalizwa kwa biashara ya vito vinavyotokana na pembe hizo nchini China:

eng: China is the driving factor in the ivory trade, yet claims they are not responsible for poaching.
swa: China ni kichocheo cha biashara ya pembe za ndovu, lakini hata hivyo inadai haihusiki na uwindaji haramu wa tembo.

eng: It is their carving in their massive factories which produce all the items for people to buy.
swa: Ni viwanda vyake vingi vya utengenezaji wa vito vya thamani vinavyotengeneza bidhaa zote zinazonunuliwa na watu.

eng: Carving is the Bottle Neck of the trade.
swa: Utengenezaji wa bidhaa hiyo ni sababu ya bishara hiyo.

eng: China is at fault, the ivory is in their literal laps to be carved.
swa: China inategemea pembe za ndovu kuzalisha bidhaa hizo.

eng: They must be called out on it, and you, the activist, is the one to do it, the one to ask your government to demand that China stop so that elephants have their right to life.
swa: Kwa hiyo ni lazima wawajibishwe, na nyie, wanaharakati, ndio mnaopaswa kuchukua hatua, za kuitaka serikali yenu kuitaka China kumaliza viwanda hivyo ili Tembo wapate haki yao ya kuishi.

eng: This is also a long term goal for Hong Kong for Elephants.
swa: Hili ni lengo la muda mrefu la kampeni hiyo ya Hong Kong Itetee Tembo.

eng: On October 4, around 30 animal activists rallied along the Nathan Road in Tsim Sha Tsui, a most touristic area in Hong Kong.
swa: Mnamo Oktoba 4, kiasi cha wanaharakati 30 waliandamana kupitia barabara ya Nathan huko Tsim Sha Tsui, eneo maarufu kwa utalii nchini Hong Kong.

eng: Apart from raising public awareness, the coalition will submit the signatures collected from the online petition to the Hong Kong government and hasarranged a meeting with the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department to discuss their petition to destroy the stockpiles of confiscated ivory.
swa: Mbali na kukuza uelewa wa jamii, muungano huo utawsilisha saini zilizokusanywa kutokana na tamko la mtandaoni kwa serikali ya Hong Kong na umeandaa mkutano na Idara ya Kilimo, Uvuvi na Hifadhi kujadili tamko lao la kuteketezwa kwa shehena ya pembe za ndovu zilzokamatwa.

eng: As the coalition explained, destroying the stockpiles is only a start, their mission is to ban the domestic ivory trade:
swa: Kwa mujibu wa ushirikiano huo, kutekelezwa kwa shehena hiyo ni mwanzo tu, lengo lao ni kupigwa marufuku biashara ya pembe za ndovu:

eng: Christine wants consumers aware that buying of ivory products is equal to killing of elephants.
swa: Christine anataka wateja waelewe kuwa kununua bidhaa zinazotokana na pembe za ndovu ni sawa na kuua tembo.

eng: Photo from Hong Kong for Elephants.
swa: Picha ya kampeni ya Hong Kong Itetee Tembo.

eng: We also want the Chinese government to ban its domestic ivory trade, to shut down the shops selling ivory products and to close down the 37 state-owned ivory carving factories across the country.
swa: Tunaitaka serikali ya China kupiga marufuku biashara hiyo ya tembo ndani ya nchi hiyo, kuyafunga maduka yote yanayouza bidhaa za pembe za ndovu na kufunga viwanda 37 vinavyomilikiwa na serikali vinavyotengeneza bidhaa hizo nchini kote.

eng: But first we want you to sign our petition asking the Hong Kong government to crush and burn the stockpile of ivory.
swa: Lakini kwanza tunakutaka wewe kusaini tamko letu kuiomba serikali ya Hong Kong kuteketeza shehena ya pembe za ndovu.

eng: We want Hong Kong to send a message to the world that ivory isn’t welcome here and we won’t allow our city to be any part of this cruel trade.
swa: Tunaitaka Hong Kong kutuma ujumbe kwa dunia kwamba pembe a ndovu hazikaribishwi nchini humu na hatutaruhusu jiji letu kuwa sehemu ya bishara hii ya kikatili na haramu.

eng: Think about the elephants that died to create that 25 tonne pile of tusks.
swa: Hebu tafakari kuhusu tembo waliokufa ili kupata shehena ya tani 25 ya pembe za ndovu.

eng: We must do all we can to make sure they didn’t die for nothing…
swa: Ni lazima tufanye kile kinachowezekana ili kuhakikisha tembo hawafi bure...

eng: As explained by Tom Grundy, a pedestrian called the police and the woman was arrested for slapping her boyfriend who was kneeling down in front of her pleading for her forgiveness for bringing another woman home.
swa: Kama inavyoelezwa na Tom Grundy, mpita njia aliwaita polisi na mwanamke huyo aliwekwa chini ya ulinzi kwa kumpiga vibao rafiki yake wa kiume aliyekuwa amepiga magoti mbele yake akimwomba msamaha kwa kumleta mwanamke mwingine nyumbani.

eng: Kamayani at Kracktivist reports that the Happy hours discount concept, which is popular across bars, restaurants and multiplexes, is now catching up in the Indian health care sector.
swa: Kamayani wa mtandao wa Kracktivist anasema kuwa dhana ya saa nzuri kupata punguzp la bei, ambayo ni maarufu sana kwenye vilabu vya pombe, mahotelini na hata kwenye majengo ya sinema, imeingia hadi kwenye sekta ya afya nchini India.

eng: A Bangalore based private hospital has recently started offering 30-75% discounts on key services, including diagnostics, radiology, and consultancy, during off-peak hours.
swa: Hospitali binafsi iliyoko Bangalore siku za hivi karibuni imekuwa ikitoa punguzo la bei kati ya asilimia 30-75 kwa huduma muhimu, ikiwa ni pamoja na uchunguzi, kufanyiwa vipimo vya x-ray na hata ushauri, wakati wa masaa yasiyo yasiyo na shughuli nyingi.

eng: Other leading hospital chains are preparing to follow soon.
swa: Hosptali nyingine zinajiandaa kufuata mkondo huo hivi karibuni.

eng: Presidents of Iran and US: Hassan Rouhani and Barack Obama.
swa: Marais wa Iran na Marekani: Hassan Rouhani na Barack Obama.

eng: Via Iran-emrooz.net
swa: Kupitia Iran-emrooz.net

eng: Just one week after a historic phone call between Iran’s new president, Hassan Rouhani, and Barack Obama, there were still Iranians chanting the customary “Death to America” and burning US and Israeli flags after Friday prayers in Tehran on October 4, 2013.
swa: Wiki moja tu baada ya tukio la kihistoria la kupigiana simu kati ya rais mpya wa Iran, Hassan Rouhani, na Barack Obama, bado kuna minong'ono miongoni mwa wa-Irani kuhusu "Kufa kwa Marekani" na kuchoma bendera za Marekani na Israeli baada ya swala ya Ijumaa mjini Tehran Oktoba 4, 2013.

eng: Still, some Iranians hope the call was a step towards thawing relations that could someday lead to US sanctions being lifted.
swa: Bado, baadhi ya wa-Iran wanatarajia kuwa simu hiyo ilikuwa ni hatua nzuri katika kuimarisha mahusiano ambayo yangeweza kufanya vikwazo vya Marekani viongozwe.

eng: Others are unhappy about any dialogue with "the Great Satan," as the United States is most often referred to in Iran's official speeches.
swa: Wengine hawakufurahia mazungumzo hayo na "Shetani Mkuu," jina ambalo Marekani huitwa kila hotuba rasmi za Iran zinapotolewa.

eng: As an indication that this topic also on President Rouhani's mind, he has reportedly asked two polling organizations to "find out" what Iranians think about USA-Iran relations.
swa: Katika kuonyesha kuwa mada hii imo kwenye kichwa kwa Rais Rouhani, ameripotiwa kuyaomba mashirika mawili ya kura ya maoni "kutafiti" kile wa-Irani wanachofikiri kuhusu mahusiano ya Marekani na Irani.

eng: Meanwhile, netizens share their own ideas about the ongoing saga between the two countries.
swa: Wakati huo huo, watumiaji wa mtandaoni walitoa maoni yao kuhusu matukio hayo kati ya nchi hizo mbili.

eng: - "How many people want the Islamic Republic regime?"
swa: - "Watu wangapi wanahitaji utawala wa Jamhuri ya Kiislamu?"

eng: - "What do they think about social and political freedom?"
swa: - "Wanafikiri nini kuhusu uhuru wa kijamii na kisiasa?"

eng: Since 2007, Blog Action Day has called upon bloggers around the world to hit the keys: One day, one topic, thousands of voices.
swa: Tangu 2007, Siku ya Blogu imekuwa ikiwaalika wanablogu duniani kushiriki kwa mtiririko huu: Siku moja, Mada mmoja, maelfu ya sauti.

eng: The topic of this year is Human Rights - and the date is October 16.
swa: Mada ya mwaka huu ni Haki za Binadamu - na tarehe ni Oktoba 16.

eng: In joint effort, bloggers, podcasters and others will highlight the important global issue - and what better way of highlighting human rights than using one: "Everyone has the right to freedom of opinion and expression" (Human Rights Declaration, Article 19).
swa: Jitihada za pamoja, wanablogu, watangazaji wa mtandao na wengine walizungumzia masuala ya kidunia -na namna nzuri ya kuzungumzia haki za binadamu kuliko kutumia maneno yaliyozoeleka: "Yeyote ana haki ya uhuru wa maoni na kujieleza" (Tamko la Haki za Binadamu, Ibara ya 20).

eng: On Global Voices we often discuss human rights, especially in relationship to censorship, surveillance and free speech online.
swa: Kwenye mtandao wa Global Voices mara kadhaa huwa tunajadili masuala ya haki za binadamu, hasa kwenye maeneo yenye uhusiano na ufuatiliwaji wa mtandaoni, upepelezi na uhuru wa maoni mtandaoni.

eng: We look forward to dedicating a day to thinking and talking about a topic that never seems to lose relevance.
swa: Tunatarajia kuwa na siku moja kwa ajili ya kutafakari na kuzungumza kuhusiana na mada hiyo ambayo daima imekuwa na umuhimu wake.

eng: So far, 1,377 blogs from 114 countries have registered to take part in Blog Action Day 2013.

eng: Register your blog today, and join the global conversation!

eng: Award-winning photographer Geoffrey Hiller first visited Myanmar in 1987; and he was ‘haunted’ by what he saw in the country:

eng: After a frenetic trip, it wasn’t so much the monks and pagodas that haunted me, but the faces of the Burmese, painted in white, often smiling.
swa: Baada ya safari ya kuchosha, sikushangazwa na watawa, ila nyuso ya wananchi wa Burma, zilizochorwa kwa rangi nyeupe, mara nyingi zenye tabasamu.

eng: I wanted to find out more about who they really were, plagued by a corrupt government and international sanctions.
swa: Nilitaka kufahamu zaidi hawa walikuwa akina nani, walioteswa na serikali ya kifisadi na vikwazo vya kimataifa.

eng: He has since then returned to Myanmar several times and he witnessed the changes that have taken place in the country in recent years:

eng: I returned yet again in 2013.

eng: My camera focused on capturing daily life, from the cramped streets of the colonial capital of Yangon, to dusty markets in Mandalay, to Muslims in Meikhtila, and river life in Pathein.
swa: Kamera yangu ilitaka kuyanasa maisha ya kila siku, kuanzia mitaa iliyojaa watu ya mji wa kikoloni wa Yangon, hadi kwenye masoko yenye vumbi ya Mandalay, hadi Waislamu wa Meikhtila, na hata maisha ya mtoni huko and Pathein.

eng: The face of Yangon has already changed, with new building construction and imported cars.
swa: Sura ya mji wa Yangon ilishabadilika, majengo mengi mapya yakijengwa pamoja na magari mengi yanayoingizwa nchini humu.

eng: He plans to publish a book through a Kickstarter project that would include his photographs documenting life inside Myanmar from 1987 through the recent historic transition.
swa: Lengo lake lilikuwa kuchapisha kitabu kupitia Kickstarter mradi ambao ungehusisha picha zake kuweka kumbukumbu za maisha ndani ya nchi hiyo kuanzia mwaka 1987 mpaka kufikia mabadiliko ya kihiistoria ya hivi karibuni.

eng: The book, Burma in Transition, would also feature photos of Meiktila which Hiller visited before riots erupted in the town:

eng: It seems that Spain is not very happy.
swa: Inaonekana Uhispania si taifa lenye watu wenye furaha.

eng: According to a study by Carlos III University in Madrid (uc3m) , Spaniards rank 49th in happiness out of the 112 countries polled.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa utafiti ulifanywa na Chuo Kikuu cha Carlos mjini Madrid (uc3m) , Wahispania wanashika nafasi ya 49 kwa furaha katika ya nchi 112 duniani zilizohusishwa na utafiti huo.

eng: This happiness index (pdf) is based not on subjective questions, but on "revealed preferences," using migration as a standard; that is, what people do, not what they say.
swa: Hiki Kielelezo cha Furaha (pdf) hakitokani na maswali huru yaliyoulizwa, bali kimetokana na "utashi uliogunduliwa," kwa kutumia uhamaji kama kigezo; yaani, kile watu wanachokifanya, na sicho kile wanachokisema.

eng: Per Juan de Dios Tena , a statistics professor at Carlos III University: "Migration flows are closely linked to psychological issues related to happiness," that is, people tend to leave a country if it lacks the conditions for their happiness, in favor of someplace where they think they can be happy.
swa: Per Juan de Dios Tena , profesa wa takwimu katika Chuo Kikuu cha Carlos anasema: "Wimbi la Uhamiaji lina uhusiano na masuala la kisaikolojia yanayohusiana na furaha," yaani, watu huhama nchi kama wanakosa mazingira ya furaha, na hivyo kupendelea maeneo mengine wanayodhani yatawapa furaha.

eng: The researchers took into account both economic and non-economic factors of happiness, which overlap with what can be considered the determining factors of migration: absolute and relative income, demographic and social characteristics, social development, relationships with others and characteristics of the place where one lives, as well as variables like distance or a common border and language.
swa: Watafiti walizingatia sababu za kiuchumi na zile zisizo za uchumi zinazomfanya mtu kuwa na furaha, ambazo zinaingilia na na kile kinachoweza kuchukuliwa kuwa mambo yanayosababisha uhamaji: kipato kisichotosha, sura ya idadi ya watu wa mahali, maendeleo ya kijamii, mahusiano na watu wengine na sifa za mahali anakoishi mtu, pamoja na vibadilika (viriables) kama umbali au kupakana kwa nchi na lugha.

eng: Considering all these factors, and led by Hong Kong, Singapore and New Zealand, Spain is 49th out of the 112 countries in the ranking, followed by Mexico, Iran and Costa Rica, among others.
swa: Kwa kuzingatia sababu zote hizi, huku ikiongozwa na Hong Kong, Singapore na New Zealand, Uhispania imeshikilia nafasi ya 49 kati ya nchi 112 katika orodha hiyo, ikifuatiwa na Mexico, Iran na Costa Rica, kw auchache.

eng: In last place are countries like Afghanistan, South Africa and China.
swa: Zilizoshika mkia ni Afghanistan, Afrika Kusini na China.

eng: A person who created a fake Facebook account in the name of Zambia’s former first lady Maureen Mwanawasa recently appeared in court for fraud.
swa: Mtu aliyetengeneza ukurasa bandia kwa jina la mke wa rais wa zamani wa Zambia, Maureen Mwanawasa alipandishwa kizimbani hivi karibuni kujibu mashitaka ya utapeli.

eng: Mwanawasa, the wife of Zambia’s third president, the late Levy Patrick Mwanawasa, who ruled for seven years until his death in 2008, runs a non-government organisation called the Maureen Mwanawasa Community Initiative (MMCI), which helps underprivileged people in society.
swa: Mwanawasa, mke wa rais wa tatu wa Zambia, marehemu Levy Patrick Mwanawasa, aliyetawala kwa miaka saba mpaka alipopatwa na mauti mwaka 2008, anaendesha shirika lisilo la kiserikali linaloitwa Mradi wa Jamii wa Maureen Mwanawasa (MMCI), unaosaidia watu masikini katika jamii.

eng: The NGO was very active when her husband was in power and received support from a number of organisations and individuals.
swa: Shirika hilo lilikuwa imara sana enzi za utawala wa mme na lilipokea msaada kutoka katika mashirika kadhaa pamoja na watu binafsi.

eng: It has since scaled down its operations and it is only active in one or two areas, notably Kapiri Mposhi where it runs a school for underprivileged children.
swa: Tangu kifo cha mumewe shirika hilo limekuwa likipunguza shughuli zake na kubakiwa na maeneo mawili tu, Kapiri Mposhi ambapo linaendesha shule kwa ajili watoto wanaoishi katika mazingira magumu.

eng: Details about the case are scant, but Mwanawasa, a lawyer herself, appeared in court and tweeted her reasons for her attendence in response to questions from Twitter users:
swa: Taarifa za kina kuhusiana na kesi hiyo hazitolewa, lakini Mwanawasa, ambaye ni mwanasheria yeye mwenyewe, alipanda kizimbani na kutwiti sababu za kwenda mahakamani kujibu maswali ya watumiaji wa mtandao wa twita:

eng: @NizaSich someone has created a face book page in my name and she collects 250$ for false scholarships she has been arrested#Zambia — Maureen K Mwanawasa (@mwanachilembo) October 3, 2013
swa: kuna mtu ametengeneza ukurasa wa facebook kwa jina langu na anakusanya dola za marekani 250$ kwa ajili ya kutoa udhamini bandia kwa wanafunzi ametiwa kizuizini.

eng: Zambia's former First Lady Maureen Mwanawasa courtesy of her Twitter account.
swa: Mke wa Rais wa zamani wa Zambia Maureen Mwanawasa iliyokwa kwenye ukurasa wa Twita.

eng: The Zambian Watchdog reported a potential scam in January 2012, but it is not clear if it is related to the present court case.
swa: Mtandao wa Zambian Watchdog uliripoti kashfa hiyo mwezi Januari 2012, lakini haiko wazi kama inahusiana na kesi iliyopo mahakamani.

eng: Quoting whistleblower Laston Nyirenda, the website reported:
swa: Akimnukuu mkosoaji Laston Nyirenda, wavuti hiyo iliripoti:

eng: I am friends with the said person and they started sending me messages purporting to be Mrs Mwanawasa and started asking me to lend them $2000 and send it to the person named Florence Lucky who they said is based in Madrid, Spain and want me to send the money using western union.
swa: Nina urafiki na mtu huyo na walianza kunitumia jumbe wakidai kuwa Bi Mwanawasa na kuanza kuniomba niwaazime dola 2000 na kumtumia mtu aliyetajwa kuwa Florence Lucky aliyesema anaishi Madrid, Uhispania na wakanitaka niwatumie pesa hizo kwa njia ya western union.

eng: They even provided me a Zambian phone number I can call stating that it is for the former first lady if I want to confirm and when I called the number, the person who answered is based in Kitwe and it is not even Mrs Mwanawasa.
swa: Wakanipatia namba ya simu ya Zambia ili niwapigie wakisema kwamba ni ya mke wa zamani wa rais na kama ninataka kuhakiki na nilipoipiga namba hiyo, ikapokelewa na mtu aliyekuwa Kitwe na hata haikuwa ya Bi Mwanawasa.

eng: After Mwanawasa made it known on Twitter that she was in court, one user asked the former first lady how it felt to be cross-examined:
swa: Baada ya Mwanawasa kulitangaza suala hilo kupitia mtandao wa Twita kuwa yuko mahakamani, mtumiaji mmoja alimwuliza mke huyo wa rais huyo wa zamani namna alivyojisikia kutoa ushahidi:

eng: She responded:
swa: Huenda ukihojiwa?

eng: @EricKamocha naturally it felt strange but it was a good experience — Maureen K Mwanawasa (@mwanachilembo) October 3, 2013
swa: @EricKamocha kwa kawaida mtu unajisikia vibaya lakini ulikuwa ni uzoefu mzuri

eng: Mwanawasa’s tweets did not give a lot of details about the case such as the name of the culprit and where she is based.
swa: Twiti za Mwanawasa hakutoa habari za kina kuhusu kesi hizo kama jina la mtuhumiwa na wapi anakoishi.

eng: The former first lady, however, is not the first high profile Zambian who has had her profile faked.
swa: Mke huyo wa Rais wa zamani, hata hivyo, si mtu maarufu wa kwanza nchini Zambia aliyewahi kukumbwa na matukio ya kughushiwa kwa akaunti zao mitandaoni.

eng: Recently, a Facebook page in the name of the country’s Vice President Dr. Guy Scott, cropped up sending “friend requests” to people who usually comment on political issues on the social networking site.

eng: Wake up people.

eng: Dr Scott was latter quoted by the Zambia Intelligence News, saying:
swa: Dr Scott baadae alinukuliwa na mtandao wa Zambia Intelligence News, akisema:

swa: Nilifungua akaunti mwaka 2011 kwa malengo ya kampeni na sijawahi kufungua akaunti nyingine tena.

eng: I have not used it since then so everything else that is propping up now is fake.
swa: Sijawahi kuitumia tangu wakati huo kwa hiyo kila kinachoibukia leo ni bandia.

eng: The whole thing is a fraud.
swa: Yote hayo ni utapeli tu.

eng: It is basically fraudulent.
swa: Huo ni utapeli tu.

eng: Croatian supporters made far-right salutes which were used during World War II by the fascist Ustase movement, fan monitoring group Fare reported to FIFA.

eng: FIFA fined the Greek federation 30,000 Swiss francs ($32,500) following reports of far-right banners displayed when Greece beat Slovakia 1-0 in Athens on October 11.
swa: FIFA iliipiga faini shirikisho la Kigiriki 30,000 faranga ya Uswisi ($ 32,500) kufuatia taarifa ya mabango yaliyoonyeshwa wakati Ugiriki iliwashinda Slovakia 1-0 mjini Athens Oktoba 11.

swa: Washiriki kutoka sehemu mbalimbali za dunia wametengeneza filamu zinazochukua muda wa dakika 1 kwa kuzingatia mada zinazohusiana na mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa, maendeleo endelevu pamoja na bayoanuai.

swa: Kwa ujumla, misaada haiwafikii kwa muda muafaka watu hawa waliosalimika katika kimbunga Haiyan, kinachojulika kwa jina maarufu, Yolanda.

eng: As Kenya, or any other country, we should define who we are, what we stand for, what we expect of other countries we interact with, and what we will and will not accept.
swa: Kama wenyeji wa Kenya ama nchi nyingine ile, tunafaa kujiainisha, kueleza msimamo wetu, kueleza tunayotarajia kutoka kwa nchi zingine tunazoshirikiana nazo, na kutaja yale tutakayokubali na yale ambayo hatutayakubali.

eng: We should forge this identity independent of others’ expectations and preconceptions. Then, we should stand by it.
swa: Tunafaa kuunda utambulisho usiotegemea matarajio na dhana za wengine, kisha kuuegemeza.

eng: Saying who you are is not enough, you also have to show who you are by how you act.
swa: Kujitambulisha kwa maneno pekee yao hakutoshi, lazima ujitambulishe kwa vitendo vyako pia.

swa: Picha ya maonesho ya mitindo iliyopigwa wakati wa onesho la mwaka jana. wapenzi hawa wanaonekana kwa nje wanafuraha, lakini mkono wa mwanamke huyu umefungwa pamoja na mkono wa mwanaume.

swa: Mkono wa kushoto wa mwanaume, ameshika bunduki isiyo halisi.

eng: Tropical storm Maring (international name Trami) caused record high floods in Metro Manila and nearby provinces in the Philippines which left 8 people dead, 41 injured, and 4 missing.
swa: Dhoruba kubwa ya kitropiki ya Maring ilisababisha mafuriko makubwa kuwahi kutokea katika Metro Manila na mikoa ya jirani nchini Ufilipino ambayo ilisababisha vifo vya watu 8, majeruhi 41, na 4 wakiwa hawajulikani walipo.

eng: According to a government report, 125,348 families (602,442 persons) were affected by the storm.
swa: Kulingana na ripoti ya serikali, familia 125,348 zenye watu 602,442 ziliathirika na dhoruba hiyo.

eng: As of August 20 in the evening, 40,837 persons are still sheltered in 198 evacuation centers.
swa: Kufikia Agosti 20 jioni, watu 40,837 bado walikuwa wamehifadhiwa katika vituo 198 vya uokoaji.

eng: The flood made 65 major roads impassable.
swa: Mafuriko yalifanya barabara kuu 65 kutopitika.

eng: About 415 areas in 68 municipalities/cities recorded flood cases.
swa: Jumla ya maeneo 415 katika manispaa/miji 68 zilirekodi visa vya mafuriko.

eng: A total of 162 flights (59 international and 103 domestic) have been cancelled due to the storm.
swa: Idadi ya ndege 162 (59 ya kimataifa na 103 za ndani) kubatilishwa kutokana na dhoruba.

eng: Filipinos used the hashtag #maringPH and #floodPH to monitor the flood situation in Manila and nearby regions.
swa: Wafilipino walitumia alama habari #maringPH na #floodPH kufuatilia hali ya mafuriko katika Manila na mikoa ya jirani.

eng: The arrival of two cars with officers from the Rapid Intervention Force (FIR) of the Police of the Republic of Mozambique (PRM) interrupted the final rally of the campaign of opposition party MDM in Beira.
swa: Kuwasili kwa magari mawili na walinzi kutoka kwa Jeshi la Kutuliza Ghasia (FIR) na Polisi wa Jamhuri ya Msumbiji (PRM) kulileta ghasia katika mkutano wa hadhara wa mwisho wa kampeni ya chama cha upinzani cha MDM katika Beira.

eng: Photo @Verdade newspaper (CC BY 2.0)
swa: Picha @Verdade newspaper (CC BY 2.0)

eng: The final mayoral campaign rally of opposition party MDM in Beira ended with three people killed and several injured - the injured included the candidate's own son - following an attack by riot police who used tear gas grenades and shot bullets to the air.
swa: Mkutano wa hadhara wa mwisho kwa kampeni ya umeya wa chama cha upinzani cha MDM katika Beira ulimalizika kwa watu watatu kuuawa na kadhaa kujeruhiwa - waliojeruhiwa ni pamoja na mwana wa mgombea - kufuatia mashambulizi ya polisi wa kutuliza ghasia ambao walitumia mabomu ya kutoa machozi na kufyatua risasi kwa hewa.

eng: When the tumult began, incumbent mayor Daviz Simango was preparing to take the stage and call on the crowd to vote once again for the main opposition party MDM (Mozambique Democratic Movement), in power in the second largest city of Mozambique, also the capital of the province of Sofala.
swa: Wakati ghasia zinaanza, Meya anayemaliza muda wake Daviz Simango alikuwa anajianda kwenda kwenye jukwaa kutoa wito kwa umati wa watu kupigia kura kwa mara nyingine tena chama kikuu cha upinzani MDM (Mozambique Democratic Movement), ili kishike madaraka ya mji mkubwa wa pili kwa ukubwa nchini Msumbiji, pia mji mkuu wa jimbo la Sofala.

eng: Unrest in Beira set in on November 16, the second to last day of the electoral campaign for Mozambique's municipal elections.
swa: Machafuko katika mji huo wa Beira yalianza Novemba 16, na ya pili siku ya mwisho ya kampeni za uchaguzi kwa ajili ya uchaguzi wa manisipaa nchini Msumbiji.

eng: The vote will take place on November 20, 2013. @Verdade newspaper is gathering citizen reports in a special website for the elections.
swa: Uchaguzi utafanyika Novemba 20, 2013. @ Verdade gazeti linakusanya taarifa za kiraia katika tovuti maalum kwa ajili ya uchaguzi.

eng: Unrest set in and citizens tried to flee in disarray while FIR agents kept shooting.
swa: Machafuko yalipoanza na wananchi walijaribu kukimbia eneo hilo wakati kikosi cha FIR kikiendelea kufyatua risasi.
