eng: InSerbia reports and adds details to a poll carried out by Serbian daily Blic on whether the Serbian Orthodox Church, whose clergymen have recently been in the media often due to reports of visible overspending, should begin paying taxes.
swa: Nchini Serbia ripoti ya uchuguzi uliofanywa na shirika la Serbia la kila siku liitwalo Blic ikiwa Kanisa la Kisabia la Orthodox, ambao viongozi wao hivi karibuni wamekuwa katika vyombo vya habari mara nyingi kutokana na ripoti ya matumizi ya anasa yaonyesha sasa lazima kuanza kulipa kodi.

eng: The Serbian Orthodox Church and all other religious institutions are exempt from taxes in Serbia and state tax authorities have never inspected the finances of any registered religious community in the country.
swa: Kanisa la Kisabia la Orthodox taasisi zingine zote za kidini yana msamaha wa kutolipa kodi nchini Serbia na mamlaka ya serikali ya kodi hawajawahi kukagua fedha ya jamii yoyote iliyosajiliwa kidini nchini humo.

eng: These benefits, however, only apply to products and services that serve for religious activities, while the Serbian Orthodox Church is known to have a variety of the most expensive vehicles in the ownership of the Church, used by its officials and employees.
swa: Faida hizi, hata hivyo, hutumika tu kwa bidhaa na huduma zinazotumika kwa ajili ya shughuli za kidini, wakati Kanisa la Serbia la Orthodox inajulikana kuwa na aina mbalimbali za magari ya gharama kubwa katika umiliki wa Kanisa, zinazotumiwa na viongozi wake na wafanyakazi.

eng: In the public poll conducted by Blic in early November 2013, 83% of the respondents said the Serbian Orthodox Church should pay taxes.
swa: Katika uchaguzi wa umma uliofanywa na Blic mapema mwezi Novemba 2013, 83% ya washiriki walisema Kanisa la Kisabia la Orthodox wanapaswa kulipa kodi.

eng: Rough estimates, derived from the statements of church dignitaries, indicates that only from VAT on the sale of books and other goods in church stores, as well as profit tax, the Republic budget could be richer for about 10 billion dinars (6.4 million euros/8.5 million dollars).
swa: Takribani makadirio, inayotokana na kauli ya vigogo wa kanisa, inaonyesha kuwa tu kutoka kwa VAT kwenye mauzo ya vitabu na bidhaa nyingine katika maduka ya kanisa, kama vile faida ya kodi, bajeti ya Jamhuri inaweza kuwa tajiri kwa dinar zipatazo bilioni 10 (€ 6,400,000 / dola milioni 8.5).

eng: Protesters decry land rights violations in Cambodia.
swa: Waandamanaji wanalamikia kuhusu ukiukwaji wa haki za ardhi nchini Cambodia.

eng: Photo from Facebook of LicadhoMore than 500 Cambodians joined a protest march during the World Habitat Day celebration in Phnom Penh to highlight forced evictions and land disputes in the country.
swa: Picha kutoka ukurasa wa Facebook wa Licadho Zaidi ya Wa-Cambodia 500 walijiunga na maandamano wakati wa maadhimisho ya Siku ya Makazi Duniani katika Phnom Penh kuonyesha kufukuzwa kwa nguvu na migogoro ya ardhi nchini.

eng: As Global Voices reported, some netizens say they will vote for the incumbent president during November 6 elections in Tajikistan because a "full leader is better than a hungry one".
swa: Kama mtandao wa Sauti za Dunia ulivyoripoti, baadhi ya raia wa mtandaoni wanasema watampigia rais anayemaliza muda wake wakati wa uchaguzi wa Novemba 6 katika Tajikistan kwa sababu "kiongozi aliyeshiba ni bora kuliko aliye njaa".

eng: Reflecting on this, Salimi Aioubzod suggests it is "sad" that voters in the country are more concerned about how "full" or "hungry" a presidential candidate is than about the candidate's platform.
swa: Kutafakari juu ya hili, Salimi Aioubzod anadokeza ni "huzuni" kuwa wapiga kura katika nchi wasiwasi wao zaidi ni kuhusu "shibe" au "njaa" ya mgombea urais= kuliko kuhusu jukwaa la mgombea.

eng: Yet the blogger argues that if the voters wish to know how "full" a candidate is, they have the right to know that:
swa: Hata hivyo mwanablogu anasema kuwa kama wapiga kura wanataka kujua namna mgombea wao "alivyoshiba" basi wana haki ya kujua hayo:

eng: ...t would be good if the Central Commission for Elections and Referendums of Tajikistan (CCERT) demanded that all presidential candidates declare their annual income and its sources...
swa: ...itakuwa vizuri kama Tume ya Mpito ya Uchaguzi na kura ya maoni ya Tajikistan (CCERT) kuwataka wagombea wote wa urais kutangaza mapato yao ya kila mwaka na vyanzo vyake ...

eng: Making public a candidate's income and its origins, their movables and real assets, and their bank accounts will allow to see whether the candidate is "full" or "hungry"...
swa: Kutangaza kwa umma mapato ya mgombea na asili yake, mali yao halisi, na akaunti ya benki yao itaruhusu , ili kuona kama mgombea ni "kashiba" au "njaa" tupu...

eng: Representatives of the organizations that manage the technical infrastructure of the Internet meeting in Montevideo, Uruguay, have released a Declaration on the future of Internet cooperation , in which they analyze the problems currently affecting the future of the Internet.
swa: Wawakilishi wa mashirika yanayoratibu miundombinu ya kiufundi ya huduma ya intaneti waliokutana huko Montevideo; Uruguay, wametoa tamko kuhusu mustakabali wa ushirikiano katika masuala ya Intaneti , ambapo walifanya uchanganuzi kuhusiana na changamoto zinazoathiri mustakabali wa mtandao wa Intaneti.

eng: Among other things, they mention the importance of globally consistent Internet operations and warn against the fragmentation of the Internet at a national level, while expressing their concern about the global decrease in confidence of Internet users due to the recent revelations of monitoring and surveillance.
swa: Pamoja na mambo mengine, walizungumzia umuhimu wa upatikanaji wa mtandao wa intateti usio na mashaka na kuonya dhidi ya tofauti za upatikanaji wa mtandao wa intaneti zilizopo katika ngazi ya kitaifa, huku wakionesha mashaka yao dhidi ya kuongezeka kwa kukosekana kwa uhuru wa watumiaji wa mtandao ulimwenguni kufuatia matukio ya hivi karibuni ya kuchunguzwa na kufuatiliwa.

eng: This can, in some way, be considered as a response to proposals that go in that direction, such as that recently advanced by the president of Brazil, Dilma Roussef, before the UN and to the activities of the NSA.
swa: Hatua hii, kwa namna moja, inaweza kuchukuliwa kuwa ni matokeo ya mapendekezo yaliyokuwa na muelekeo wa namna hiyo, kama vile maoni yaliyoelekezwa Umoja wa Mataifa (UN) na Rais wa Brazil, Dilma Roussef na maoni juu ya utendaji kazi wa uwepo wa vikwazo vya mtandao wa intaneti(NSA).

eng: In a video released Monday, August 12, the soccer team Grêmio of Porto Alegre brought together some of the key players on its roster, white and black, to talk about racism.
swa: Katika video iliotolewa Jumatatu, Agosti 12, timu ya soka ya Grêmio of Porto Alegre ilileta pamoja baadhi ya wachezaji muhimu kwenye orodha ya majina yake, weupe na weusi, kwa majadiliano juu ya ubaguzi wa rangi.

eng: The initiative was carried out in support of a new FIFA initiative, implemented in May of this year and unanimously approved, that made punishments against racism in soccer more strict.
swa: Mpango huo ulifanyika kusaidi mpango mpya wa FIFA, uliotekelezwa Mei mwaka huu na kupitishwa bila kupingwa, uliofanya adhabu dhidi ya ubaguzi wa rangi katika soka kuwa kali zaidi.

eng: While campaigns for raising awareness and discussions against racism on the field have intensified in the past few years in Europe, the subject is rarely addressed inside soccer stadiums in Brazil.
swa: Wakati kampeni kwa ajili ya kuongeza uelewano na majadiliano dhidi ya ubaguzi wa rangi kwenye uwanja kumeongezeka katika miaka michache iliyopita katika Ulaya, swala mara chache hushughulikiwa ndani ya viwanja vya soka nchini Brazil.

eng: In the video, Zé Roberto, the tricolor team's midfielder, former player on Brazil's national team, tells how he was never a victim of racism on the field, but before becoming a successful player, he was discriminated against during an interview because of his skin color.
swa: Katika video, Ze Roberto, kiungo wa timu ya tricolor, aliyekuwa mchezaji wa timu ya taifa ya Brazil, anaelezea jinsi yeye kamwe hajawahi kuwa mwathirika wa ubaguzi wa rangi kwenye uwanja, lakini kabla ya kuwa mchezaji wa mafanikio, alibaguliwa wakati wa mahojiano kwa sababu ya ngozi yake.

eng: Defensive midfielder Matheus Biteco recalls an incident from his childhood, when a supermarket security guard tackled him, his father, and his brother Guilherme, also a player on the team.
swa: Mjihami kiungo Matheus Biteco anakumbuka tukio kutoka utoto wake, wakati mlinda usalama katika maduka makubwa walikabiliana naye, baba yake, na ndugu yake Guilherme, pia mchezaji wa timu.

eng: The team's campaign made the rounds on social networks with the hashtag #azulpretoebranco (meaning blue, black and white, in reference to the team's colors).
swa: Kampeni ya timu ilifanya raundi kwenye mitandao ya kijamii kwa alama ashiria #azulpretoebranco (kumaanisha bluu, nyeusi na nyeupe, kufuatia rangi za timu).

eng: Egyptian blogger Zeinobia shares her two cents on the reemergence of Sami Anan, the former Chief of Staff of the Egyptian Armed Forces.
swa: Mwanablogu wa Misri Zeinobia anatoa maoni yake machache kuhusu kuibuka tena kwa Sami Anan, Mnadhimu mkuu wa zamani wa Majeshi ya Misri.

eng: Is he bidding for presidency?
swa: Je, ana mpango wa kugombea urais?

eng: Global Voices Online's Victor Salama has more.
swa: Mwanahabari wa Sauti za Dunia Mtandaoni Victor Salama anasimulia zaidi.

eng: Tessa Houghton shares the findings of a study which monitored media bias in Malaysia during the 13th General Elections a few months ago:
swa: Tessa Houghton anashiriki matokeo ya utafiti ambao ulifuatilia upendeleo katika vyombo vya habari nchini Malaysia wakati wa Uchaguzi Mkuu wa 13 miezi michache iliyopita:

eng: Malaysian citizens who relied on English and Bahasa Malaysia newspapers and/or television as their media source/s during the GE13 campaign were not provided with fair and accurate information with which to construct informed voting preferences, with clear voting patterns emerging along these strata of info-communicative diversity and scarcity, and the media used more as a tool of division than of reconciliation.
swa: Wananchi wa Malaysia ambao walitegemea Kiingereza na Bahasa magazeti ya Malaysia na/au televisheni kama chanzo cha vyombo vyao vya habari wakati wa kampeni ya GE13 hawakutolewa habari ya haki na sahihi na ambayo ingesaidia kwa uamuzi wanaopendelea wa kupiga kura, na mifumo wazi ya kupiga kura kujitokeza pamoja matabaka haya ya utofauti wa habari-mawasiliano na uhaba, na vyombo vya habari kutumika kama chombo zaidi cha mgawanyiko kuliko ya maridhiano.

eng: The destruction of at least 11 mosques in the last two months in Angola is provoking reactions of outrage online.
swa: Uharibifu wa misikiti isiyopungua 11 katika miezi miwili iliyopita nchini Angola imechochea athari ya hasira kwenye mtandao.

eng: The Minister of Culture, Rosa Cruz e Silva, said that a law related to liberty of religious assembly should be revised "as a way of fighting 'vigorously' the coming up of new religious congregation whose religious assembly are contrary to our habits and customs to Angolan culture." The destruction (...) must be immediately stopped and we demand an apology from the President of Angola to muslims around the world. If not, then we would like to invite the Islam community to protest peacefully in front of the buildings of Angolan embassies around the world.
swa: Waziri wa Utamaduni, Rosa Cruz e Silva, alisema kuwa sheria inayohusiana na uhuru wa mkutano wa dini lazima iundwe upya kama njia ya kupambana kwa 'nguvu' kuanzishwa kwa mkutano mpya za kidini ambazo mikutano yao ya dini ni kinyume na tabia zetu na forodha katika utamaduni wa Angola. "

eng: Workers who cut sugarcane and other crops in the coastal lowlands of Central America are being hit by a mysterious disease:
swa: Wafanyakazi ambao hukata miwa na mazao mengine katika tambarare ya pwani ya Amerika ya Kati na wamekumbwa na ugonjwa wa ajabu:

eng: From Panama to southern Mexico, laborers are coming down with kidney failure at rates unseen virtually anywhere else in the world.
swa: Kutoka Panama hadi kusini mwa Mexico, wafanyakazi wamashikwa na na maradhi ya kushindwa kwa figo katika viwango vya ghaibu amabavyo havijaonekana mahali popote duniani.

eng: Families and villages are being devastated by the loss of nearly entire generations of men.
swa: Familia na vijiji imekumbwa na hasara ya vizazi karibu yote ya watu.

eng: Since 2000, chronic kidney disease has killed more than 24,000 people in El Salvador and Nicaragua, the two countries that are by far the worst-hit by the disease.
swa: Tangu mwaka 2000, ugonjwa sugu wa figo imeua zaidi ya watu 24,000 katika El Salvador na Nikaragua, nchi mbili ambazo zimeathirika zaidi na janga hilo.

eng: Rigorous scientific investigation has only just begun in the communities hit by the epidemic, and relatively few facts have been established, but scientists are coming up with what they believe to be a credible hypothesis.
swa: Uchunguzi zaidi wa kisayansi umeanza tu katika jamii zilozo adthiriwa na ugonjwa, na ukweli mchache kuanzishwa, lakini wanasayansi nwamezindua kile wanachokiamini kuwa wazo la kuaminika.

eng: They say the roots of the epidemic appear to lie in the grueling nature of the work performed by its victims.
swa: Wanasema kuwa chanzo cha ugonjwa kuonekana mdomoni asili kwa kazi inayofanywa na waathirika wake.

eng: Esteban Félix, a Peruvian photographer from the Associated Press, documented the effect of the epidemic in Chichigalpa, Nicaragua, one of the most affected communities.
swa: Esteban Félix, mpiga picha wa Peru kutoka Shirika la vyombo vya habari, anatoa kumbukumbu ya athari za janga katika Chichigalpa, Nicaragua, moja ya jamii kuathirika zaidi.

eng: Thanks to his work, Félix received the Gabriel García Marquez Prize for Journalism this year in the Journalistic Image category.
swa: Shukrani kwa kazi yake, Félix alipokea tuzo la uandishi wa habari la Gabriel García Marquez mwaka huu katika uandishi wa habari kitengo cha picha.

eng: In this video, edited by Alba Mora (@albamoraroca) with music by Dan Bality, Félix tells the stories behind the photos that he took during his stay at Chichigalpa.
swa: Katika video hii, iliyo haririwa na (@albamoraroca) na muziki kwa niaba ya Dan Bality, Félix anaelezea hadithi nyuma ya picha ambazo yeye alichukua wakati wa kukaa kwake katika Chichigalpa.

eng: In his own words, Félix summarizes:
swa: Kwa maneno yake mwenyewe, Félix anatoa muhtasari::

eng: Some people work to live, but here, people work to die.
swa: Baadhi ya watu kufanya kazi kwa kuishi, lakini hapa, watu kufanya kazi kufa.

eng: Bitter Sugar: A Mystery Disease from Alba Mora on Vimeo.
swa: Sukari chungu: Ugonjwa wa ajabu kutokaAlba Mora kwenyeVimeo.

eng: Steve Sharra explains why Malawians should brace for more cash-gate scandal after revelations that some powerful Malawians abused the Integrated Financial Management System internal controls to loot billions of public funds:
swa: Steve Sharra anaelezea kwa nini Wamalawi wanakabiliwa na kashfa ya zaidi za ufisadi baada habari kuwa wazi kwamba baadhi ya wa-Malawi wenye nguvu walitumia vibaya Mfumo wa Pamoja wa Ndani wa Udhibiti wa Fedha kupora mabilioni ya fedha za umma:

eng: Social inequality is creating deep rifts among Malawians, a ticking time bomb.
swa: Kutokuwepo kwa usawa wa kijamii kunajenga ufa mkubwa miongoni mwa Wamalawi, jambo ambalo ni bomu linalosubiri kulipuka.

eng: The increasing incidents of mass violence and vandalism we are witnessing across the country daily are but a tiny ripple in the sea of resentment resulting from this inequality.
swa: Kuongezeka kwa matukio ya matumizi ya nguvu na uharibifu tunaoshuhudia nchi kote kila siku ni tone dogo katika bahari ya hasira na chuki inayotokana na kukosekana kwa usawa huu.

eng: That is made more complicated by how our political parties have no established means of raising funds for their very survival, rendering the entire political arena a charade and a get-rich-quick scheme.
swa: Hali inafanywa kuwa ngumu zaidi na namna vyama vyetu vya kisiasa visivyo na njia imara za kuendesha harambee ya kuchangiwa fedha kwa ajili ya kuendesha shughuli zake, hali inayosababisha uwanja wote wa kisiasa kuwa vurugu na sehemu ya miradi kujipatia-utajiri-wa-haraka.

eng: Unless we address the fundamental causes of the deep inequality ripping Malawian society apart, we should brace ourselves for more cashgates.
swa: Tusiposhughulikia sababu za msingi za kukosekana kwa usawa inayoigawa mno jamii ya Malawi, tujiandae kwa matatizo zaidi.

eng: Resident of eastern Samar have set up temporary shelters after the storm.
swa: Wakazi wa mashariki Samar wameanzisha makazi ya muda mfupi baada ya dhoruba.

eng: Image from Plan Philippines
swa: Picha kutoka kwa Mpango wa Ufilipino

eng: Also see Haiyan Devastates the Philippines, our special coverage page. Six days have passed since super typhoon Haiyan (Yolanda) hit the central part of the Philippines but relief is not yet given to many survivors.
swa: Siku sita zimepita tangu kimbunga kikubwa kijulikanacho kwa jina la Haiyan (Yolanda) kuikumba sehemu ya kati ya Ufilipino lakini misaada ya kibinadamu bado haijafika kwa waathirika wengi.

eng: Many dead bodies are still lying in the streets, refugees are begging for food, and rescue efforts are not reaching other remote islands of typhoon-ravaged provinces in the Visayas.
swa: Miili mingi ya maiti bado imelazwa katika mitaa, wakimbizi wakiomba chakula, juhudi za kuokoa hazifikii visiwa vingine mbali ya mikoa ya Visayas.

eng: Haiyan caused a tsunami-like storm surge which killed thousands in an instant.
swa: Haiyan ilisababisha dhoruba kama tsunami kuongezeka ambayo iliwauwa maelfu papo hapo.

eng: The provinces of Leyte and Samar are among the most badly-hit areas with many villages reduced into wasteland.
swa: Mikoa ya Leyte na Samar ni miongoni mwa maeneo mengi iliyoathirika vibaya na vijiji vingi kuharibika na kubaki nyika.

eng: According to the latest official report, more than 2,000 have died but the casualties could be higher because many dead bodies have yet to be retrieved.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa ripoti rasmi za hivi karibuni, zaidi ya watu 2,000 wamefariki lakini majeruhi wanaweza kuwa zaidi kwa sababu maiti mingi bado haijapatikana.

eng: The frustration about the seemingly slow response of the government is reflected on social media:
swa: Kuna hali ya sintofahamu inayosababishwa majibu yaliyochelewa kutoka serikali lakini baadae yakajitokeza kwenye vyombo vya habari vya kijamii:

eng: Overflowing of help & support from ordinary people.
swa: Misaada mingi ya kibinadamu inatoka kwa watu wa kawaida.

swa: Katika nyakati kama hizi unaweza kushangaa, wako wapi wanasiasa, wapi serikali yetu? — anjell_27 (@anjell_27) Novemba 13, 2013

eng: 5 days after the devastation,where is our Government? @govph Your training is done Pnoy,time for you to speed things up! #shame #yolandaph — JR Pantino (@guillmo) November 13, 2013
swa: Siku 5 baada ya uharibifu, iko wapi Serikali yetu? @govph mafunzo yamekwisha, ni wakati wa kufanya mambo kwa kasi! #aibu #yolandaph — JR Pantino (@guillmo) Novemba 13, 2013

eng: sadly, 6 days after #YolandaPH struck, gov't help hardly felt by survivors.bodies still strewn all over the streets waiting to be retrieved — Marlon Ramos (@iammarlonramos) November 13, 2013
swa: cha kusikitisha, siku 6 baada ya #YolandaPH kutokea, msaada wa serikali bado haujaonekana na waathirika. Miili imetapakaa kila pahali mitaani wakisubiri kuhifadhiwa. — Marlon Ramos (@iammarlonramos) Novemba 13, 2013

eng: Global media is showcasing our government's lack of action for the Yolanda victims.
swa: Chombo cha habari cha Global kimeonyesha namna serikali yetu ilivyoshidwa kuwajibika kwa ajili ya waathirika wa Yolanda.

eng: Where did d 1Trillion presidential Budget go?
swa: Bajeti ya rais ya trilioni 1 ilikwenda wapi?

eng: Hmmm? — Nina Belgica (@ninavbelgica) November 13, 2013
swa: Hmmm? — Nina Belgica (@ninavbelgica) Novemba 13, 2013

swa: Fedha kwa ajili ya waathirika wa kimbunga zote zimakwenda wapi?

eng: If the answer is in the pocket of our government?
swa: Kama jibu ni katika mfuko wa serikali yetu?

eng: Faith lost in humanity. — Anton Recto (@IamAntonRecto) November 13, 2013
swa: Imani imepotea katika hali ya binadamu. — Anton Recto (@IamAntonRecto) Novemba 13, 2013

swa: Misaada inamiminika kutoka duniani kote lakini hakuna mfumo madhubuti wa usambazaji wa rasilimali hizi:

swa: Michango ni mingi, na bado waathirika wa kimbunga kubaki na njaa na kuhisi baridi.

eng: Hope @govph resolves delivery issues ASAP!!! #YolandaDay6 — Zen Hernandez (@zenhernandez) November 13, 2013
swa: Tunatumaini @govph itatatua masuala ya utoaji haraka iwezekanavyo!!! #YolandaDay6 — Zen Hernandez (@zenhernandez) Novemba 13, 2013

eng: Infuriating that there is no visible action for relief.
swa: Vijimambo kwamba hakuna hatua inayoonekana kwa unafuu.

eng: No big or systematic efforts for aid.
swa: Hakuna jitihada kubwa au utaratibu kwa ajili ya misaada.

eng: It's disorienting' - @sanjuncssr #YolandaPH — Tudla Productions (@tudlaprod) November 13, 2013
swa: Ni hali ya kushangaza'- @sanjuncssr #YolandaPH — Tudla Productions (@tudlaprod) Novemba 13, 2013

eng: While Tacloban is considered the ‘ground zero’ of the disaster, other islands have been devastated as well and the situation there has not been adequately reported.
swa: Wakati Tacloban ikiwa haina maafa, visiwa vingine vimeharibiwa pia na hali ya huko haijaripotiwa vya kutosha.

eng: Ayi Hernandez visited Capiz province and shares his observations:
swa: Ayi Hernandez alitembelea jimbo la Capiz na anatoa uchunguzi wake:

eng: Houses made of light materials was either flattened on the ground or was heavily damaged.
swa: Nyumba zilizotengenezwa kwa vifaa vyepesi zilikuwa bapa kwenye ardhi au kuharibiwa sana.

eng: Houses made of concrete materials survived the force but lost their rooof partially or totally.
swa: Nyumba zilitengenezwa kwa saruji zilinusurika nguvu lakini zilipoteza sehemu ya paa zao kwa au kabisa.

eng: The damages were a bit distrubing when we entered the municipality of Ivisan.
swa: Uharibifu ulikuwa wa kusikitisha kidogo wakati tunaingia manispaa ya Ivisan.

eng: Some families were setting up tents in the highway and maybe because most of the houses were made of light materials, the sight was heartbreaking.
swa: Baadhi ya familia zilikuwa zikijenga mahema katika barabara kuu na labda kwa sababu zaidi ya nyumba zilizokuwa zimejengwa kwa vifaa vyepesi, mandhari ilikuwa ya kufadhaisha.

eng: With this kind of destruction, what kept us surprised was the seemingly absence of relief operation in those municipalities.
swa: Kwa aina hii ya uharibifu, kilicho tushangaza ni kuonekana kwa kukosekana kwa operesheni ya msaada katika manispaa hizo.

eng: There is no help flowing in.
swa: Hakuna msaada uliopatikana.

eng: Below are some photos in Samar, the province which was first hit by typhoon Haiyan:
swa: Chini ni baadhi ya picha katika Samar, jimbo ambalo lilikuwa la kwanza kukumbwa na kimbunga Haiyan:

eng: Ruffy Biazon, a government official, writes what he thinks should be done soon: While the relief operations are ongoing and everyone is pitching in to lend a helping hand, there should be someone stepping back, taking a look at what has happened and study what went wrong, what should have been done and what to do to prevent the preventable, prepare for the inevitable and provide resources for the doable.
swa: Wakati shughuli za kutoa misaada zinaendelea na kila mtu ameingilia katika kutoa mkono wa msaada, mi muhimu pawepo na mtu amekaa nyuma, kuangalia nini kilichotokea na utafiti wa nini kilichokwenda mrama, kile kisichokwenda ipasavyo na nini cha kufanya ili kuzuia cha kuzuilika, kujiandaa kwa matukio yanayoweza kuepukika na kutoa rasilimali kwa yanayoweza kufanyika.

eng: This should be done at the national level and most importantly, at the local level
swa: Hii lazima kufanyika katika ngazi ya kitaifa na muhimu zaidi, katika ngazi za mitaa

eng: On 0ctober 30, 87 people trying to reach the Mediterranean sea died after being abandoned in the Sahara Desert when their drivers left them stranded to seek for help.
swa: Mnamo tarehe 30 0ctoba, watu 87 waliokuwa wakijaribu kuifikia bahari ya Mediterania walifariki mara baada ya madereva waliokuwa wakiendesha magari waliyoyatumia kusafiria kuwatelekeza wahamiaji hao katika Jangwa la Sahara.

eng: The harrowing story of one the survivors, 14-year-old Shafa, highlights the plight of many migrants trying to reach Europe and the obstacles they face.
swa: Simulizi ya kuhuzunisha kutoka kwa mmoja wa watu walionusurika aliyejulikana kwa jina la Shafa mwenye umri wa miaka 14, yaelezea taabu wanazokumbana nazo wahamiaji wengi wanaojaribu kwenda Ulaya na vikwazo wanavyokabiliana navyo.

eng: In an article entitled "dying at the gates of Europe", Philippe Rekacewicz, a french cartographer, illustrates with a series of map the story of the migrants struggle from Africa to Europe :
swa: Kwenye makala iliyopewa kichwa cha habari "Kifo katika Safari ya Kuelekea Ulaya", Philippe Rekacewicz, ambaye ni Mfaransa na msanifu wa ramani, atoa ufafanuzi unaoambatana na mfululizo wa ramani kuhusiana na harakati za wahamiaji kutoka Afrika kuelekea Ulaya.:

eng: Dying at the gates of Europe by Philippe Rekacewicz on Le Monde Diplomatique
swa: Kifo katika Safari ya Kuelekea Ulaya na Philippe Rekacewicz katika Le Monde Diplomatique

eng: World Science Forum
swa: Kongamano la Dunia la Sayansi

eng: The World Science Forum (WSF) gathers hundreds of scientists from all around the world this week in Brazil, to discuss their role in the 21st century and to emphasize the importance of scientific advice in political and economical decisions.
swa: Jukwaa la Sayansi Duniani (WSF) linajumuisha mamia ya wanasayansi kutoka duniani kote wiki hii nchini Brazil, kujadili wajibu wao katika karne ya 21 na kusisitiza umuhimu wa ushauri wa kisayansi katika maamuzi ya kisiasa na kiuchumi.

eng: Brazil has hosted several events to discuss poverty eradication and sustainable development from the perspective of different social groups, occasionally antagonistic, such as Rio +20, the People's Summit and the World Social Forum. Due to the fact that nature does not recognize national borders, scientists see both issues from a global perspective.
swa: Brazil imekuwa mwenyeji wa matukio kadhaa ya kujadili kuondoa umaskini na maendeleo endelevu kutoka katika mtazamo wa makundi mbalimbali ya kijamii, mara kwa mara maadui, kama vile Rio +20, na mkutano wa watu na Kongamano la Kijamii Duniani

eng: Leo Vultus by Murillo Martins for the campaign Run4Run4Lions.
swa: Leo Vultus kwa niaba ya Murillo Martins kwa kampeni ya Run4Run4Lions.

eng: After the collective publication #sobreontem (About Yesterday) in support of the movement that started the protests this past June in São Paulo, Brazilian artists are now coming together for a new cause.
swa: Baada ya uchapishaji wa pamoja #sobreontem (kuhusu jana) katika kusaidia harakati ambayo ilianzishamaandamano haya Juni iliyopita mjini São Paulo, wasanii wa Brazil sasa wanajiunga pamoja kwa sababu mpya.

eng: This time, their artwork is against lion-killing in Samburu, Kenya.
swa: Wakati huu, kazi yao ni dhidi ya kuuawa kwa simba katika mkoa wa Samburu, Kenya.

eng: Natives of the region are using poison and other weapons against lions that are attacking their goats.
swa: Wenyeji wa mkoa wanatumia sumu na silaha nyingine dhidi ya simba ambao huwashambulia mbuzi wao.

eng: To raise the public's awareness of this issue, in 2010 the Ewaso Lions Project organized a half-marathon with the purpose of "neutralizing conflicts between humans and wildlife by involving the local community in the conservation of the lions."
swa: Kuongeza kuelewa kwa umma kuhusu suala hili, katika mwaka 2010 Mradi wa Ewaso wa Simba uliandaa mbio za nusu-marathon kwa lengo la "kutuliza migogoro kati ya binadamu na wanyamapori kwa kushirikisha jamii katika uhifadhi wa simba."

eng: For the organizers, part of the solution to the problem is "more free goats", and that's why at the first event in 2010, the prizes for winning the race were goats.
swa: Kwa waandaaji, sehemu ya ufumbuzi wa tatizo ni "mbuzi za bure zaidi", na ni kwamba katika tukio la kwanza mwaka 2010, zawadi ya kushinda mbio walikuwa mbuzi.

eng: Now the project is preparing for the next race with the crowdfunding campaign #Run4Run4Lions, which will collect funds for 2014's half-marathon.
swa: Sasa mradi unafanya maandalizi ya mashindano ya pili na kampeni crowdfunding #Run4Run4Lions, ambayo itakusanya fedha kwa ajili ya mbio za nusu-marathon mwaka wa 2014.

eng: The Brazilian artists' original artwork (of which some pieces are already sold out) is offered as compensation for those who support the project.
swa: Michoro ya awali ya Wasanii wa Brazil (ambayo baadhi ya vipande tayari vimeuzwa) inayotolewa kama fidia kwa wale ambao wanasaidia mradi.

eng: Learn more about the campaign:
swa: Kujifunza zaidi kuhusu kampeni

eng: Guatemalan journalists Carlos Alberto Orellana Chávez was gunned down on Monday, August 19, 2013; he is the fourth journalist killed in Guatemala this year.
swa: Mwandishi wa habari wa Guatemala Carlos Alberto Orellana Chávez alipigwa risasi mnano Jumatatu Agosti 19, 2013, yeye ni mwandishi wa habari wa nne kuuawa nchini Guatemala mwaka huu.

eng: In an opinion piece published in Guatemalan newspaper Prensa Libre, UN's special rapporteur for freedom of expression Frank La Rue denounced "the recent wave of aggressions against journalists in the country," as Alejandro Martínez reports in The Knight Center's Journalism in the Americas blog:
swa: Katika makala ya maoni iliyochapishwa katika gazeti la Guatemala Prensa Libre, mwandishi maalum wa ripoti ya Umoja wa Mataifa kwa ajili ya uhuru wa kujieleza Frank La Rue alishutumu "wimbi la hivi karibuni la ushambulizi dhidi ya waandishi nchini," kama Alejandro Martinez anavyoripoti katika Uandishi wa Habari wa The Knight Centre katika blogu ya Amerika:

eng: La Rue criticized the administration of President Otto Pérez Molina for failing to stem crime in the country, siding with private interests, persecuting social leaders and not protecting journalists from judicial harassment, lawsuits, threats, physical aggressions and killings.
swa: La Rue alikosoa utawala wa Rais Otto Perez Molina kwa kushindwa kuzuia uhalifu nchini, kipendeleo kwa maslahi binafsi, kutesa viongozi wa kijamii na kutolinda waandishi wa habari kutoka unyanyasaji wa mahakama, kesi za kisheria, vitisho, ushambulizi wa kimwili na mauaji.

eng: “Today violence has turned toward the sectors of the press that hold critical positions toward those in power, because of their social function of investigating and informing, but this year's level of aggressions had not been seen in a decade," said La Rue, who described the violence as a "step backwards for democracy and (the country's) peace process."
swa: “Leo vurugu imegeuka kuelekea sekta ya vyombo vya habari ambayo inashikilia nafasi muhimu kuelekea wale walio katika madaraka, kwa sababu ya kazi yao ya kijamii ya kuchunguza na kutoa taarifa, lakini kiwango cha mwaka huu cha ushambulizi hakijaonekana katika muongo mmoja," alisema La Rue, ambaye alielezea vurugu kama "hatua ya nyuma kwa ajili ya demokrasia na (nchi) mchakato wa amani."

eng: On 14 September, Tunisian artists Hamzaoui Med Amine and Kafon released their newest song 'Houmani'. With more than 3.4 million views on YouTube so far, the song has become an anthem for Tunisian Youth.
swa: Manao tarehe 14 Septemba, wasanii wa Tunisia Hamzaoui Med Amine na Kafon walitoa wimbo wao mpya ujulikanao kama 'Houmani'. hadi sasa ukiwa na watazamaji zaidi ya milioni 3.4 katika mtandao wa Youtube, wimbo huu umekuwa kama wimbo wa Taifa miongoni mwa vijana nchini Tunisia.

eng: The video clip which only cost 250 dinars (around 150 USD) to produce, depicts residents of a disadvantaged neighborhood as they go through their daily lives.
swa: Kipande cha video kilichogharimu takribani kiasi cha dinari 250 za Tunisia, karibu kiasi cha dola 250 za Marekani, inawachora watu wa daraja la chini kabisa nchini Tunisia na namna wanavyoendesha maisha yao.

eng: In the Tunisian dialect, the adjective Houmani derives from the noun Houma, which could be translated to a 'working-class district'.
swa: Kwa lahaja ya watu wa Tunisia,msemo Houmani unatokana na neno Houma, ambalo lingeweza kutafsiriwa kama 'mtaa wa wachapakazi'.

eng: Houmani refers to someone living in a working class area.
swa: Houmani lina maana ya mtu anayeishi katika eneo la wachapa kazi. eneo la tabaka la wachapa kazi nchini Tunisia hukulikana kama Houma...

eng: A working class area in Tunisia is called Houma...And rap speaks about these districts inhabited by the poor class, which officials and famous personalities rarely talk about
swa: Na mziki huu wa kufoka unazungumzia mitaa hii ambayo huishi watu wa tabaka la chini na ambalo ni nadra sana kuongelewa na viongozi wa serikali na hata watu maarufu.

eng: An Alien listening to Houmani.
swa: Zombi akisikiliza Houmani.

eng: Caricature by ZOOart
swa: Kikaragosi kimeandaliwa na ZOOart

eng: In the song, Hamzaoui and Kafon describe how life is like for youth living in working-class neighborhoods in Tunisia.
swa: katika wimbo huo, Hamzaoui na Kafon wanaelezea hali halisi ya maisha wanayokabiliana nayo vijana wanaoishi kwenye mitaa inayojulikana kama ya wachapakazi nchini Tunisia.

eng: The song lyrics say:
swa: Mashairi katika wimbo huu ni:

eng: We are living like trash in a garbage can... is suffocating here
swa: Tunaishi kama takataka kwenye pipa la taka... ni ya kubangaiza hapa

eng: Blogger Mehdi Lamloum explains howHoumani has been successful :
swa: Mwanablogu Mehdi Lamloum anafafanua namna ambavyoHoumani ilivyokwishafanikiwa:

eng: Houmani, a simple song with a strange title and a video clip that did not cost much, has generated big debates these recent weeks.The song has quickly blended into the popular culture generating several conversations and debates...The issue of working class neighborhoods vs rich neighborhoods, though not directly tackled in the song, is very present.
swa: Houmani, wimbo wa kawaida lakini wenye jina la ajabu na kiapnde cha video ambacho hakikuchukua gharama kubwa kuandaliwa, kimezua mjadala mkubwa katika wiki za hivi karibuni. Kwa haraka, wimbo huu umeshajikita katika utamaduni uliozoeleka kiasi cha kuzua majibizano na mijadala kadhaa.... suala la tabaka la wafanyakazi dhidi ya lile la watu matajiri, pamoja na kuwa halijazungumzwa sana katika wimbo huu, ni miongoni mwa mijadala inayoendelea kwa kiasi kikubwa.

eng: A question has been raised regarding this: who has the right to listen to Houmani? Do residents of ‘rich neighborhoods’ have the right to identify themselves with the everyday life recounted by Houmani?
swa: Kuhusiana na hili, kuna swali liliulizwa: ni nani mwenye haki ya kusikiliza Houmani? watu wa 'tabaka la matajiri' wana haki ya kujilinganisha na hali halisi ya maisha inayozungumzwa kwenye Houmani?

eng: He adds:
swa: Anaongeza:

eng: Those who criticize the song from a musical perspective are totally right. But, they need to see what is beyond the piece: the work has succeeded in transcribing part of what Tunisians feel, whether they come from poor districts or not and whether they are living the everyday life described in the song or not...
swa: Wale wanaoukosoa wimbo huu kwa mtazamo wa kimuziki wapo sahihi kabisa. lakini wanatakiwa kupata tafsiri sahihi ya wimbo huu: wimbo huu umefanikiwa kuwakilisha angalao hisia za watu wa Tunisia, bila kujali kama wanatokea mitaa ya watu masikini au wanaishi maisha yanayozungumzwa katika wimbo huu au vinginevyo...

eng: Brazil: Do You Admire Mandela?
swa: Brazil: Je Unamuenzi Mandela?

eng: A banner paying homage to Nelson Mandela takes on the unanimous popularity of the South-African leader in Brazil to call those who admire his legacy to support human rights.
swa: Bango la kuonyesha heshima kwa Nelson Mandela limechukua umaarufu usiojulikana wa kiongozi wa Afrika Kusini nchini Brazil kwa kuwaita wale ambao wanaenzi urithi wake kusaidia haki za binadamu.

eng: The message was spread by the non-governmental organization Conectas Human Rights in the International Human Rights Day, 10 December 2013.
swa: Ujumbe huo ulienezwa na shirika lisilokuwa la kiserikali Conectas Human Rights katika Siku ya Haki za Binadamu, Desemba 10, 2013.

eng: Banner publicized by Conectas Human Rights on FacebookTranslation: "Do you also feel moved by his legacy?
swa: Bango lililotangazwa na Conectas Human Rights kwa mtandao wa FacebookTafsiri: "Je, wewe pia kujihisi uliongozwa na urithi wake?

eng: Thousands of people around the world suffer with daily violations of human rights.
swa: Maelfu ya watu duniani kote wanakabiliwa na ukiukwaji wa haki za binadamu kila siku.

eng: They need you to do more than to be moved.
swa: Wanakuhitaji kufanya zaidi ya kutazama tuu.

eng: Follow his example.
swa: Fuata mfano wake.

eng: Embrace the cause.
swa: Kubaliana na sababu.

eng: Support human rights.
swa: Kusaidia haki za binadamu.

eng: Here.
swa: Hapa.

eng: Now."
swa: Sasa.

swa:

Do more than being moved" is the appeal of the organization in a country where conservatism and a negative vision about human rights seems to be growing.
column3: Tenda zaidi ya kuongozwa ni mwito wa shirika katika nchi ambapo kihafidhina na maono hasi kuhusu haki za binadamu inaonekana kuongezeka.

eng: As some recent opinion polls show, 90% of Brazilians support the reduction of the age of criminal responsibility, and 61% believe that criminality is caused by people's bad character.
swa: Kama baadhi kura za maoni ya hivi karibuni zinaonyesha, 90% ya Wa-Brazil wanaunga kupunguza umri wa miaka kwa jukumu la jinai, na 61% wanaamini kwamba uhalifu unasababishwa na tabia mbaya za watu.

eng: It's not like Caribbean - or global - netizens haven't been preparing themselves for news of Nelson Mandela's death.
swa: Si kwamba Caribbean - au jumuiya ya kimataifa - raia wa mtandaoni hawakujiandaa kusikia habari za za kifo cha Nelson Mandela .

eng: The former South African president and anti-apartheid activist was, after all, 95 years old and in poor health, having been hospitalised several times this year for recurring respiratory infections.
swa: Rais huyo wa zamani wa Afrika Kusini na mwanaharakati aliyepambana na ubaguzi wa rangi, na baada ya yote, alikuwa na umri wa miaka 95 na afya ikazorota, baada ya kulazwa hospitalini mara kadhaa mwaka huu akisumbumbuliwa na maradhi ya kupumua.

eng: Still, the announcement, when it came late yesterday, dealt a hard blow.
swa: Hata hivyo, tangazo la kifo chake lilipokuja mwishoni mwa juma la jana, lilileta pigo kubwa.

eng: Regional bloggers and social media users shared their thoughts about the passing of one of the world's most enduring icons of peaceful resistance.
swa: Wanablogu wa sehemu mbalimbali na watumiaji wa vyombo vya habari vya kijamii walitoa mawazo yao kuhusu kufariki kwa moja wa magwiji wa amani duniani aliyedumu zaidi duniani.

eng: Bloggers, for the most part, seemed lost for words, preferring - at least for the moment - to share news reports or quote official statements about Mandela's passing.
swa: Wananablogu, kwa sehemu kubwa, walionekana kukosa maneno, na walionekana kupendelea - angalau kwa sasa - kusambaza taarifa za habari au kunukuu za Hayati Mandela.

eng: Guyana's Propaganda Press republished excerpts from President Jacob Zuma's address to the people of South Africa, along with a short biography of Mandela, while The Bajan Reporter posted a tribute to the late president by former Commonwealth Secretary General Sir Shridath Ramphal.
swa: Chombo cha habari cha "PropagandaGuyana" kilichapisha sehemu ya hotuba ya Rais Jacob Zuma kwa raia wa Afrika Kusini, pamoja na wasifu mfupi wa Mandela, wakati Bajan Mwandishi wa Bajan aliweka posti ya heshima kwa marehemu rais na Katibu Mkuu wa zamani wa Jumuiya ya Madola Sir Shridath Ramphal.

eng: The majority of Caribbean netizens chose to share their reactions on Facebook and Twitter.
swa: Wengi wa raia wa mtandaoni wa Caribbean waliamua kutumiana maoni yao kwenye mtandao wa Facebook na Twita.

eng: Raynier Maharaj, a member of the Trinidadian diaspora and a journalist, commented on Facebook:
swa: Raynier Maharaj, raia wa Trinidad anayeishi nje na pia mwandishi wa habari, alitoa maoni kwenye Facebook:

eng: OK, if it seems I am dwelling on Mandela's passing, it is because it means a whole lot to me.
swa: Sawa, kama inaonekana mimi nafikiri sana juu ya kufariki kwa Mandela, ni kwa sababu tukio hili lina maana kubwa kwangu.

eng: He was the epitome of dignity and grace.
swa: Alikuwa mfano wa heshima na neema.

eng: Another Trinidadian journalist, Vernon O'Reilly Ramesar, noted:
swa: Mwandishi mwingine wa Trinidad, Vernon O'Reilly Ramesar, alisema:

eng: A testament to his importance that even the US media break into programming to announce the passing of Nelson Mandela.
swa: Ushahidi wa umuhimu wake ni kwamba hata vyombo vya habari Marekani vilikatiza programu na kutangaza kufariki kwa Nelson Mandela.

eng: Facebook user Skye Hernandez was saddened to hear of his death:
swa: Mtumiaji Facebook Skye Hernandez alifadhaishwa kusikia kifo cha Mandela:

eng: I feel strangely sad at the news of Madiba's passing.
swa: Nasikitika ajabu kwa habari ya kufariki kwa Madiba.

eng: He has finally gone to his rest and that is surely a good thing.
swa: Yeye hatimaye amekwenda kupumzika na hakika ni jambo jema.

eng: But his story and South Africa's have been so inspiring, sometimes so vexing, always riveting.
swa: Lakini hadithi yake na Afrika Kusini imekuwa hamasa, wakati mwingine ya kuudhi, lakini daima yenye kuvutia.

eng: He's been with us for all of our lives.
swa: Yeye amekuwa na sisi siku zote kwa maisha yetu yote.

eng: Travel well, Nelson Mandela.
swa: Safiri vizuri, Nelson Mandela.

eng: Franz Gillezeau suggested that people:
swa: Franz Gillezeau alipendekeza kuwa watu:

eng: Mourn the man, but remember to celebrate the legend.
swa: Kumuomboleza sawa, lakini tukumbuke kumsherehekea gwiji huyu.

eng: Facebook was also filled with newly uploaded photo albums chronicling Mandela's regional visits - this one, courtesy the Jamaica Information Service, of his visit to the island in the early 1990s, and this one, by Amber Media Productions, of his 2004 visit to Trinidad and Tobago.
swa: Mtandao wa Facebook pia ulijaa albamu za picha mpya zilizowekwa kuonyesha ziara za Mandela maeneo mbalimbalih- hii moja, kwa niaba ya Huduma ya Habari ya Jamaica, ya ziara yake ya kisiwa hicho katika miaka ya 1990, na hii nyingine, kwa hisani ya Amber Media Productions, na nyingine ya ziara yake ya mwaka 2004 nchini Trinidad na Tobago.

eng: On flickr, Georgia Popplewell posted a photo of Mandela, noting:
swa: Kwenye mtandao wa flickr, Georgia Popplewell aliposti picha ya Mandela, akibainisha:

eng: I fear it will be a long time before we see another leader of his calibre again.
swa: Mimi nahofia itachukuwa muda mrefu kabla ya kuona kiongozi mwingine wa aina yake tena.

eng: Farewell, dear Madiba. #Mandela
swa: Buriani, mpendwa Madiba. #Mandela

eng: Nelson Mandela; image by caribbeanfreephoto
swa: Nelson Mandela; picha kwa hisani ya caribbeanfreephoto

eng: Not everyone agreed with this assessment, however. Over at the Cuban diaspora blog babalu, drillanwr wrote:
swa: Si kila mtu aliyekubaliana na tathmini hii, hata hivyo. katika blogu ya 'babablogu', drillanwr aliandika:

eng: History will remember his life, to be sure.
swa: Historia itakumbuka maisha yake, kwa uhakika.

eng: While I appreciate and respect Nelson Mandela's struggles and his being a political prisoner within his own country for a large part of his life, I am not unaware of his post-prison political ideology and all the friendships he held with some of the world's nastiest leaders.
swa: Wakati mimi nafahamu na kuheshimu mapambano ya Nelson Mandela na kule kuwa mfungwa wa kisiasa ndani ya nchi yake mwenyewe kwa sehemu kubwa ya maisha yake, lakini sifahamu itikadi zake za kisiasa baada ya kifungo na urafiki aliokuwa nao na baadhi ya viongozi wabovu wa dunia.

eng: In a follow-up post at the same blog, Carlos Eire suggested that:
swa: Katika posti ya majibu katika blogu hiyo, Carlos Eire alipendekeza kuwa:

eng: Mandela's sainthood falls short of universal acclaim, especially among Cubans.
swa: Utakatifu wa Mandela haiambatani na sifa zote za ulimwengu, hasa kati ya raia wa Cuba.

eng: While he dedicated himself to a noble and righteous cause – ending discrimination against black Africans in South Africa – Mandela was not at all opposed to employing violence as a means for his cause.
swa: Wakati yeye alijitolea kimaadili na kwa sababu za haki - kumaliza ubaguzi dhidi ya Waafrika weusi nchini Afrika Kusini - Mandela hakupinga kutumia vurugu kama njia ya sababu zake.

eng: Worse than that, he expressed nothing but admiration for Fidel Castro and his noxiously racist tyranny, and never stopped singing Fidel’s praises.
swa: Mbaya zaidi, alitoa pongezi kwa Fidel Castro pamoja na vita yake kwa ubaguzi wa rangi, lakini kamwe hakuacha kuimba sifa za Fidel.

eng: In striking contrast, Capitol Hill Cubans shared this perspective:
swa: Kwa upande mwingine, blogu ya Capitol Hill Cubans walitoa mtazamo huu:

eng: Nelson Mandela is no longer physically among us, but his legacy of sacrifice, perseverance and freedom will endure forever.
swa: Nelson Mandela hayuko tena kimwili kati yetu, lakini urithi wake wa kujitolea, uvumilivu na uhuru utashamiri milele.

eng: Despite first espousing violence during the early days of his activism, Mandela's life journey demonstrates the transformational power of peaceful, civil disobedience.
swa: Licha ya kutetea vurugu wakati wa siku za kwanza za harakati zake, safari ya maisha ya Mandela inaonyesha nguvu ya mageuzi ya amani, pasipo uvunjaji wa sheria.

eng: His passing is also a reminder of the sacrifice of the world's historic political prisoners, such as Cuba's Eusebio Penalver Mazorra, the longest serving political prisoner of African descent in modern history, having served 28-years.
swa: Kufariki kwake ni ukumbusho wa kujitolea kwa wafungwa wa kihistoria wa kisiasa duniani, kama vile Cuba Eusebio Penalver Mazorra, mfungwa wa kisiasa aliyefungwa kwa muda mrefu mwenye asili ya Afrika katika historia ya kisiasa, baada ya kutumikia kifungo chake kwa miaka 28.

eng: Sadly, Penalver passed in 2006, without seeing his beloved homeland free.
swa: Cha kusikitisha, Penalver alifariki mwaka wa 2006, bila kuushuhudia uhuru wa nchi yake aliyoipenda.

eng: Along with former Czech leader Vaclav Havel, Mandela is the ultimate representation of a political prisoner-turned-freely elected leader.
swa: Pamoja na kiongozi wa zamani wa Czech Vaclav Havel, Mandela ni mwakilishi wa mwisho wa mfungwa aliyefunguliwa kuchaguliwa kuwa kiongozi wa kisiasa.

eng: From Cuba to North Korea, his extraordinary life gives endless hope to the democratic aspirations of dissidents, political prisoners and activists throughout the world.
swa: Kutoka Cuba hadi Korea ya Kaskazini, maisha yake ya ajabu yanatoa matumaini na matarajio ya demokrasia ya wapinzani, wafungwa wa kisiasa na wanaharakati duniani kote.

eng: Rest in peace and freedom.
swa: Pumzika kwa amani na uhuru.

eng: Twitter users - world-wide - have been using the hashtags #mandela #death to offer their condolences.
swa: Watumiaji Twita - duniani kote - wamekuwa wakitumia alama habari #mandela #death kutoa rambirambi zao.

eng: The Caribbean blogosphere will undoubtedly have much more to say about Nelson Mandela and his legacy once the reality of his death sinks in; the GV Caribbean team will provide updates accordingly.
swa: Jumuiya ya blogu Caribbean bila shaka ina mengi ya kusema kuhusu Nelson Mandela na urithi wake pamoja hali halisi ya kifo chake kukubalika; timu ya GV Caribbean itatoa habari ipasavyo katika kipindi hiki.

swa: The image used in this post is by caribbeanfreephoto, used under an Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 2.0 Generic Creative Commons license.

swa: Tembelea mtiririko wa picha kwenye mtandao wa Flickr wa caribbeanfreephoto.

eng: Henri Dumoulin, Global Voices contributor, recalls his stay in Apatou, French Guiana, located in the heart of the Amazon Forest.
swa: Henri Dumoulin, mchangiaji wa Global Voices, anakumbuka kukaa kwake huko Apatou, French Guiana,sehemu iliyoko katika msitu wa Amazon.

eng: He explains how, as the physician of Mother and Child Health Protection programme there, he had to rely on the informal colloboration with the Suriname health system and navigate the multilingual setting of the community :
swa: Anaelezea jinsi gani, kama daktari wa mpango wa ulinzi wa Afya ya Mama na Mtoto huko, alivyokuwa akitegemea ushirikiano rasmi na mfumo wa afya wa Suriname na kutizamwa mazingira ya lugha mbalimbali ya jamii :

eng: I shall be in the “Apoema tapu gezondheid zentrum” on November 28, 29 to work again with the same team, to vaccinate all people living on both sides of the borders in this franco–Surinamese archipelago.
swa: Nitakuwa eneo la "Apoema tapu gezondheid Zentrum" mnamo Novemba 28, 29 kufanya kazi tena na timu hiyo, kuwapa chanjo watu wote wanaoishi katika pande zote za mipaka katika kisiwa cha franco-Surinamese.

eng: It appears that nobody was aware of our coming So the account of injections was lesser than expected (109 in one day).
swa: Inaonekana kwamba hakuna mtu alikuwa na ufahamu wa kuja kwetu Basi akaunti ya sindano ikawa ndogo kuliko ilivyotarajiwa (109 katika siku moja).

eng: Amalia send a radio call on Thursday morning and people came progressively A little worried about the reaction of my boss regarding my way of managing our local health problems and crossing borders ..
swa: Amalia alituma wito kwenye radio Alhamisi asubuhi na watu wakaja kuendelea na wasiwasi kidogo kuhusu majibu ya bosi wangu kuhusu njia yangu ya kusimamia matatizo ya afya mitaa yetu na kuvuka mipaka ..

eng: Offbeat China introduced a new popular TV program called “Where Are We Going, Dad?”.
swa: Mtandao wa Offbeat China umeanzisha kipindi kipya na maarufu cha televisheni kinachojulikana kwa jina la “Baba, tunaelekea wapi?”.

eng: The show arranges five celebrity dads and their young kids to fulfill various outdoor tasks in the form of competition without the presence of moms.
swa: Kipindi hicho kinawakutanisha akina baba watano maarufu pamoja na watoto wao kwa ajili ya kufanya kazi mbalimbali za nje kwa lengo la kushindana na bila ya uwepo wa wake zao.

eng: Below is one of the netizens' comment quoted by the blogger:
swa: Hapa chini, ni maoni ya raia, mtumiaji wa mtandao wa intaneti yaliyonukuliwa na mwanablogu mmoja:

eng: Where Are We Going, Dad?’ becomes a hit show not only because it’s based on a new and interesting idea, but more importantly because it echoes our society’s thirst and expectations of more care and love from dads.
swa: Baba, tunaelekea wapi?’ kimekuwa kipindi kilichojizolea umaarufu sana, siyo tu kwa kuwa kimekuwa cha kuvutia na chenye kuleta mtazamo mpya, jambo la muhimu kabisa ni kuwa kinatupa taswira ya kiu na mategemeo ya kuenedelea kupendwa na kujaliwa zaidi na baba zetu.

eng: China's Twitter-like Sina Weibo is holding a "hot mom" contest.
swa: Sina Weibo, tovuti ya Kichina inayofanana na Twitta, imeandaa mashindano ya "Akina Mama Wanaotamanisha."

eng: While most of the photos are not real mom, the images do tell you a lot about gender relation in China.
swa: Picha za washindani zinaonyesha wazi kwamba wengi wao sio akina mama halisi. Hata hivyo, hizo picha zinatuambia mengi kuhusu uhusiano wa kijinsia nchini China.

eng: More from Offbeat China.
swa: Soma mengine kwenye tovuti ya Offbeat China.

eng: Cuban blog Without Evasion says the best way in which she can pay tribute to Nelson Mandela is by "imitating him in forgiveness and reconciliation":
swa: Blogu ya Cuba Without Evasion yatanabaisha kuwa, namna pekee ya kumuenzi Nelson Mandela ni kwa "kuiga mfano wake wa kusamehe na Usuluhishi":

eng: I forgive you...for the friendship with...the vilest dictator my people has ever had...for placing your hand –redemptive for your people- on the bloodied shoulders of the one who excludes and reviles mine.
swa: Ninakusamee...kwa urafiki uliokuwepo kati yako na...dikteta aliyekuwa muovu kiasi ambacho watu wangu hawakuwahi kuushuhudia...kwa kuweka mkono wako– kwa ajili ya kuwaokoa watu wako- kwenye mabega yavujayo damu ya yule aliyenitenga na kunilaani mimi.

eng: The Maldives ranks high on the list of governments that restrict religious freedom.
swa: Maldivi ni miongoni mwa nchi za kwanza kwenye orodha ya serikali zinazozuia uhuru wa dini.

eng: Maldivian citizens have to be Muslim and cannot practice any religion other than Islam.
swa: Ni lazima raia Wamaldivi wawe Waislamu, na hawawezi kufuata dini yoyote isipokuwa Uislamu.

eng: Non-Muslim foreigners cannot vote, worship publicly, obtain citizenship, and hold public positions.
swa: Wageni wasio Waislamu hawawezi kupiga kura, kuabudu hadharani, kupata uraia, wala kutumikia umma.

eng: Journalist Hilath Rasheed notes that Maldives perhaps will not be able to establish freedom of religion in the next 50 years until the mindset changes among the new generations of Maldivians.
swa: Kwa maoni ya Mwanahabari Hilath Rasheed, huenda nchi ya Maldivi ikashindwa kuegamisha uhuru wa dini katika miaka 50 ijayo, hadi kubadilika kwa mawazo ya vizazi vipya vya Wamaldivi.

eng: Nelson Mandela was the first democratically elected president of South Africa.
swa: Nelson Mandela alikuwa rais wa kwanza wa Afrika Kusini aliyechaguliwa kidemokrasia.

eng: Photo released by South Africa The Good News under Creative Commons (CC BY 2.0).
swa: Picha imetolewa na South Africa The Good News chini ya leseni ya Creative Commons (CC BY 2.0).

eng: Nelson Mandela, the first democratically elected president of South Africa and a Noble Peace Prize laureate, died on December 5, 2013 aged 95.
swa: Nelson Mandela, rais wa kwanza wa Afrika Kusini kuchaguliwa kidemokrasia na Mshindi wa Tuzo ya Amani ya Nobel, , amefariki Desemba 5, 2013 akiwa na umri wa miaka 95.

eng: Mandela spent 27 years in jail for his struggle against South Africa's system of racial segregation known as apartheid.
swa: Mandela alitumikia kifungo kwa miaka 27 kwa sababu ya mapambano yake dhidi ya mfumo wa kibaguzi wa Afrika Kusini unaofahamika kama Ukaburu.

eng: Freed from prison in 1990, he became president four years later, and left office after serving only one term, a rare gesture in African politics.
swa: Aliachiwa huru kutoka gerezani mwaka 1990, na kuwa rais miaka minne baadae, na kuachia madaraka baada ya kutumikia kwa kipindi kimoja tu, kitendo adimu kufanywa na wenye madaraka barani Afrika.

eng: The internationally beloved statesman had an impressive way with words.
swa: Akiwa mtu anayependwa duniani kote, Mandela alkuwa na namna ya mvuto katika maneno yake.

eng: One of his most famous quotes comes from a defiant speech he made in court during his Rivonia treason trial in 1964, in which he said:
swa: Moja ya nukuu zake inatoka katika hotuba yake ya kijeuri aliyoitoa mahakamani wakati wa Kesi maarufu ya Uhaini ya Rivonia mwaka 1964, ambapo alisema:

eng: I have fought against white domination, and I have fought against black domination.
swa: Nimepigana dhidi ya mfumo wa utawala unaowapendelea makaburu, na nimepigana dhidi ya mfumo wa utawala unaowapendela weusi.

eng: I have cherished the ideal of a democratic and free society in which all persons live together in harmony and with equal opportunities.
swa: Nimekuwa na ndoto ya jamii ya kidemokrasia na huru ambayo watu wote wanaishi pamoja kwa mshikamano na fursa sawa.

eng: It is an ideal which I hope to live for and to achieve.
swa: Ni ndoto ambayo nataraji kuiishi na kuitimiza.

eng: But, if need be, it is an ideal for which I am prepared to die.
swa: Lakini, kama itahitajika, hiyo ni ndoto ambayo nimejiandaa kupoteza maisha yangu kwa ajili yake.

eng: Apart from his Rivonia trial speech, Mandela leaves behind many memorable and wise quotes made throughout his life.
swa: Ukiacha hotuba hiyo ya kesi yake ya Rivonia, Mandela anaacha nyuma yake nukuu nyingi za kukumbukwa zenye busara alizozitoa katika kipindi chake chote cha uhai wake.

eng: Despite his passing, he continues to speak to the world through Twitter users, who have reacted to news of his death by sharing his words.
swa: Pamoja na kutuacha, anaendelea kuzungumza na ulimwengu kupitia watumiaji wa twita, ambao waliitikia habari za kifo chake kwa kusambaza maneno yake.

eng: On judgement:
swa: Kuhusu Hukumu:

eng: Do not judge me by my successes, judge me by how many times I fell down and got back up again.- Nelson Mandela #RIPNelsonMandela — Kate Gonzales∞♥ (@ReeeyPJr) December 6, 2013
swa: Msinihukumu kwa mafanikio yangu, nihukumuni kwa mara ngapi nilianguka na kuinuka tena.

eng: I am not a saint, unless you think of a saint as a sinner who keeps on trying. - Nelson Mandela — Alfredo Flores (@AlfredoFlores) December 6, 2013
swa: Mimi si mtakatifu, labda ukimfikiria mtakatifu kuwa mwenye dhambi asiyeacha kujitahidi

eng: On hate:
swa: Kuhusu Chuki:

eng:
Hating clouds the mind. 	Chuki hufunga akili.
It gets in the way of strategy.	Inazuia ubunifu wowote wa mbinu.
If they can learn to hate, they can be taught to love, for love comes more naturally to the human heart than its opposite.” #NelsonMandela — John Roberts (@JohnRobertsFun) December 6, 2013
swa: Kama wanaweza kujifunza kuchukia, basi wanaweza kufundishwa kupenda, kwa sababu kwa kawaida ni asili yake upendo kuja kwa moyo wa mwanadamu kuliko kinyume chake

eng: No one is born hating... _Nelson Mandela pic.twitter.com/nzs8zxNKrw — Joseph Attieh (@AttiehJoseph) December 6, 2013
swa: Hakuna aliyezaliwa awe na chuki...Nelson Mandela

eng: On forgiveness:
swa: Kuhusu Msamaha:

eng: “Courageous people do not fear forgiving for the sake of peace.”#NelsonMandelaquotes — ♠I_am_tobi☺™ (@AsvpNast) December 5, 2013
swa: Watu wenye ujasiri hawaogopi kusamehe kwa ajili ya amani

eng: You will achieve more in this world through acts of mercy than you will through acts of retribution #NelsonMandelaQuotes — Sagittarius Queen (@Phin_Dee) July 18, 2012
swa: Utafanikiwa vingi katika dunia hii kupitia matendo ya rehema kuliko kwa matendo ya kuadhibu watu

eng: On sports:
swa: Kuhusu Michezo:

eng: On leadership:
swa: Kuhusu Uongozi:

swa: Ongoza kutokea nyuma -na wafanye wengine waamini wao ndio wako mbele.

swa: Kuhusu Ubaguzi wa Rangi:

swa: Mtu mwenye akili si yule anayejisikia kuogopa, bali yule aushindaye woga. - Nelson Mandela, katika kitabu chake cha Long Walk To Freedom, 1994

swa: Kwa sababu kuwa huru si tu kutupa minyororo, bali kuishi katika namna inayoheshimu na kukuza uhuru wa wengine.

eng: On education:
swa: Kuhusu Elimu:

eng: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world. ~Nelson Mandela RIP. — Chris (@Valandir) December 6, 2013
swa: Elimu ni silaha yenye nguvu kuliko zote unayoweza kuitumia kubadilisha dunia. -Nelson Mandela Pumzika kwa Amani

swa: Kuhusu Kufungwa:

eng: On duty:
swa: Kuhusu Wajibu:

swa: Sudan kusini ilipata uhuru Julai 9, 2011 baada ya kura ya maoni ambayo ilifanyika siku ya uhuru kutoka Sudan kupitishwa.

eng: Dar es Salaam, Tanzania — When it comes to football rivalries, few in Africa are more intense than the one between Simba Sports Club and Young Africans (known locally as Yanga).
swa: Dar es Salaam, Tanzania — Unapozungumzia upinzani wa soka, ni mara chache hapa Afrika utakutana unaoshinda ule wa kati ya simba na Yanga (known locally as Yanga).

eng: Both from the country’s commercial capital, Dar es Salaam, they are the two biggest and oldest clubs in Tanzania.
swa: Zote zinatoka kwenye mji ambao unaaminika kuwa ndiyo kitovu cha biashara, Dar es Salaam, ndizo timu mbili kubwa na kongwe nchini Tanzania.

eng: They have won the the greatest number of titles, boast the biggest fan bases, and in their squads you will find the best collection of talent in the nation.
swa: Wameshinda idadi kubwa ya vikombe, wanajivunia idadi ya mashabiki wengi, na kwenye vikosi vyao utakuta wachezaji bora wenye vipaji wanavyowakilisha taifa.

eng: When these two clubs meet, Dar es Salaam is transformed.
swa: Timu hizi mbili zinapokutana, Dar es Salaam inabadilishwa.

eng: A certain electricity courses through the city.
swa: Ni kama umeme wa aina Fulani unapita jijini.

eng: It’s subtle, but the energy shift is palpable, with Dar’s famous edginess rising a few notches.
swa: Ni hafifu, lakini nguvu yake inaonekana, na uchangamfu wa jiji la Dar ukiongezeka kwa kiasi fulani.

eng: Tanzania has long prided itself on its unassailable unity.
swa: Tanzania imekuwa ikijivunia umoja wa watu wake ambao hauwezi kuingiliwa.

eng: We are Tanzanians first, before any ethnic, religious or tribal affiliation.
swa: Sisi ni Tanzania kwanza, kabla ya rangi, dini au ukabila.

eng: But on the day of the Dar es Salaam Derby, the city cleaves into two distinct clans.
swa: Lakini siku ya watani wa jadi wanapokutana Dar es Salaam hugawanyika katika pande mbili.

eng: People don either Simba SC's famous red and white or Yanga's yellow and green.
swa: Watu huvalia mavazi maarufu yenye rangi nyekundu na nyeupe kwa wapenzi wa Simba au kijani na njano kwa wapenzi wa Yanga.

eng: Street corners sprout flagpoles carrying the teams' logos, marking a neighbourhood's affiliation.
swa: Kila kona za mitaa utaona bendera zikiwa na nembo za timu husika, ilimradi tu kuwachanganya wapizani.

eng: Cars fly banners signaling their drivers’ allegiance.
swa: Magari nayo yanabandikwa vipeperushi vya moja ya timu kuonesha ushabiki wa dreva.

eng: The flag with the majestic lion is Simba; the torch superimposed on a map of Africa is Yanga.
swa: Yenye picha kubwa ya mnyama Simba ni ya timu ya Simba na ile ya mwenge unaonekana ndani ya ramani ya Afrika ni Yanga.

eng: On match day, there is no such thing in Dar as a neutral.
swa: Na siku ya pambano lenyewe, hakuna kitu kinachoitwa kutokuwa na upande jijini Dar.

eng: I Bleed Red
swa: Ninachuruzika damu nyekundu

eng: I am a Simba fan.
swa: Mimi ni shabiki wa Simba.

eng: Always have been and always will be.
swa: Siku zote nimekuwa na nitaendelea kuwa hivyo.

eng: My connection to the club runs deep.
swa: Mahusiano yangu na Simba yapo imara.

eng: My father, Mohammed Hadi Tamimi, played for the club in the late 60s and early 70s, when it was known as Sunderland.
swa: Baba yangu, Mohammed Hadi Tamimi, aliichezea timu hii mwishoni mwa miaka ya 60 hadi mwanzoni mwa miaka ya 70 wakati huo ikiitwa Sunderland.

eng: And as a boy, I would wake up on the day of the Derby, don my Simba kit and my uncles would carry me on their shoulders to the game.
swa: Nilipokuwa kijana mdogo, nilikuwa nikiamka mapema siku ya pambano na watani wetu, nakuchukua kisanduku changu cha Simba na mjomba wangu hunibeba kwenye mabega yake na tunaelekea uwanjani.

eng: One day, everyone will be Simba SC's supporter.
swa:
“ siku moja, kila mtu atakuwa mfuasi wa simba.”
Photo by Omar Mohammed	Picha na Omar Mohammed
My memory of those afternoons is filled with heartache.	Kumbukumbu zangu kwa hizo siku imejawa na maumivu ya moyo.
I remember mostly the defeats, and the sense of despair that followed. 	Nakumbuka mechi nyingi tulizofungwa, na hali ya kukata tamaa iliyofuata.
One player in particular was a thorn in Simba's side.	Mchezaji mmoja kwenye Simba ndio alikuwa ni tatizo.
Said Sued “Scud” played for Yanga in the 90s and his specialty was scoring against Simba.	Said Sued “Scud” aliyeichezea Yanga miaka ya 90 na utaalamu wake ulikuwa ni kuifunga simba.
He was slightly overweight and didn't play that much, but when the Derby came around it was almost inevitable that he would score the winner, with a thunderous strike befitting the nickname “Scud”. 	Kwa kiasi alikuwa na uzito uliopitiliza kwa hiyo hakuwa akicheza mara mara, lakini inapotokea siku anacheza ilikuwa kama haizuiliki kwamba ataifungia timu yake, na mashambulizi hatari yaliyomfanya ajitengenezee jina la “Skadi”.
As I’ve grown older, my devotion to Simba has waned somewhat. 	Kwa kadri ninavyozidi kukua, kujitoa kwangu kwa ajili ya simba kumepungua kwa kiasi fulani.
In the last ten years I attended no more than three Dar Derbies.	Miaka kumi iliyopita nilipata kuhudhuria si zaidi ya mechi tatu za Simba na Yanga.
But recently I started monitoring my old team's progress again and last Sunday, after a long hiatus, I decided to go and watch the latest meeting between the old arch-rivals. 	Lakini siku za karibuni nimeanza kufuatilia maendeleo ya timu yangu ya kale na tena jumapili iliyopita baada ya kukosekana kwa muda mrefu, niliamua kwenda kutazama mechi hii ya watani wa jadi.
A Classic For The Ages	Ni ya kiwango tangu zamani zile
I arrived, with some friends, at the fantastic, 60,000-capacity Benjamin William Mkapa National Stadium about an hour before the 4pm kick-off. 	Niliwasili, pamoja na baadhi ya rafiki zangu, katika uwanja mkubwa wenye uwezo wa kubeba watu 60,000 -Uwanja wa Taifa wa Benjamin William Mkapa yapata saa moja kabla ya saa kumi kamili mpira kuanza.
The atmosphere was already electric, with the two sets of fans trying to out-sing each other. 	Hali ya hewa ilishakuwa ya kuchangamsha, kukiwa na vikundi viwili vya mashabiki pinzani wakiimbiana.
A pre-game match between the club's youth teams was underway.	Wakati huo mechi ya timu za vijana ya timu hizo ilikuwa inaendelea.
As I took my seat, I felt the sense of anxiety start to build. 	Nilivyochukua tu kiti changu nikaona hisia za wasiwasi zinaniingia.
Simba was coming into the game the more in-form team.	Simba ilikuwa inakuja uwanjani wakiwa na hali nzuri kimchezo.
Still unbeaten and leading the league, they had won five of their last eight games. 	Bado hawajafungwa na wanaongoza ligi, walikuwa wameshinda mechi tano kati ya nane walizocheza.
Yanga, on the other hand, had already suffered their first defeat of the season, but with four wins and three draws, they were in fourth position, only three points behind the league leaders. 	Yanga, kwa upande mwingine walishaonja machungu ya kufungwa mechi moja msimu huu, lakini kushinda mechi nne na sare tatu, walikuwa nafasi ya nne, pointi tatu nyuma ya vinara wa ligi.
Simba players in a huddle before kick-off.	Wachezaji wa Simba wakipiga dua kabla ya kuanza mechi.
Photo by Omar Mohammed	Picha na Omar Mohammed
But as the game kicked off, it was Yanga who came out of the gate in blistering form. 	Lakini wakati mechi imeanza, ilikuwa ni yanga waliotoka getini katika hali ya unyonge.
They handled the ball with pace and fluency and controlled the tempo throughout the first half.	Walikaa na mpira kwa umakini na uangalifu na kutawala kipindi chote cha kwanza.
Simba seemed unsure of themselves, with no clear idea of what their tactics should be. 	Simba kama vile hawakuwa na uhakika na wanachokifanya, bila kujua wazi mbinu wanazotakiwa kutumia.
They were lethargic, struggled to keep possession, resorting instead to long balls that inevitably led to them giving the ball away, which put them on the defensive. 	Hawakuwa na nguvu kabisa, walihangaika mno kumiliki mpira, na badala yake kutegemea pasi ndefu mchezo ambao uliyopelekea kupoteza mipira, hii ikawaweka katika hali ya kucheza kwa kujilinda.
The star of the first half was undoubtedly Yanga's number 10, Mrisho Ngasa. 	Shujaa wa kipindi cha kwanza bila shaka alikuwa namba 10 wa Yanga,
A former Simba player, he was causing his former club all sorts of problems. 	Mchezaji huyu wa zamani wa Simba, alikuwa anaisababishia timu yake ya zamani kila aina ya usumbufu.
Playing in the pocket, between the midfield and attack, his movements off the ball wreaked havoc on the heart of Simba's defence. 	Akicheza kati ya viungo na ushambuliaji, mwendo wake na mpira uliwachanganya kabisa nafasi ya ulinzi ya Simba langoni.
When he had the ball his pace simply terrorised Simba's back four.	Akiwa na mpira mwenendo wake uliwavuruga wabeki wanne wa nyuma wa Simba.
15 minutes into the game, he was rewarded for his efforts. 	Dakika ya 15 tu ya mchezo alizawadiwa kwa juhudi zake.
A ball swung in from the left, eluded Simba's defender and broke into Ngasa's path. Ngasa flicked it into the net to give Yanga a well deserved lead. 	Mpira uliorushwa kutoka kushoto ulimtoroka beki wa Simba na kutua kwenye njia ya Ngasa ambaye aliunyoosha nyavuni kuiandikia Yanga bao stahili la kuongoza.
Mrisho Ngasa, who made life difficult for Simba's defense in the first half, celebrates opening the score for Yanga in the Dar Derby. 	Mrisho Ngasa, aliyeifanya kazi ya mabeki wa Simba kuwa ngumu katika kipindi cha kwanza, akishangilia bao lake la kwanza kwa Yanga katika mpambano wa Dar.
Photo courtesy of Lenzi ya Michezo	Picha ya Lenzi ya Michezo.
Things got even better for Yanga in the 35th minute.	Mambo yaliendelea kuwa mazuri kwa Yanga katika dakika ya 35.
After Simba failed to clear a long throw into their six-yard box, Yanga’s Hamid Kiiza pounced, to give his team a 2-0 lead. 	Baada ya Simba kushindwa kuondoa mpira uliorushwa ndani ya sita ya lango la Simba na kumkuta Hamis Kiiza aliyeusukuma na kuipa timu yake uongozi wa 2-0.
And just before half-time, Yanga scored again. 	Na punde tu kabla ya mapumziko, Yanga wakafunga tena.
After an errant pass was intercepted, midfielder Didier Kavumbangu dribbled past a Simba defender before setting up Kiiza, who slotted in his second goal of the game. 	Baada ya pasi ndefu iliyounganishwa na kiungo Kavumbangu aliyemzunguka mlinzi wa Simba kabla ya kumtengenezea Kiiza, aliyeukata mpira huo na kufunga goli lake la pili kwenye mchezo huo.
3-0, Yanga. 	3-0, Yanga.
It was shaping up to be a massacre.	Yalikuwa kama mauaji.
Simba had no idea of what hit them.	Simba hawakuwa na wazo ni kitu gani kimewaangusha.
When the referee blew his whistle for half-time, the players seemed relieved. 	Mwamuzi alipopiga filimbi kuashiria ni mapumziko, wachezaji wakahisi kupumua.
Their fans were shell-shocked.	Wapenzi wao walikuwa wameduwaa.
Some decided they had seen enough and left the stadium.	Wengine waliona kwamba walichokiona kinatosha wakaamua kuondoka.
Those who did were about to miss one of the greatest comebacks in the history of the Dar Derby.	Waliofanya hivyo walikuwa wakose ujio mkubwa katika historia ya mechi ya watani wa jadi.
Soon after the start of the second half Simba made two changes.	Mapema baada ya kuanza kwa kipindi cha pili Simba wakafanya mabadiliko mawili.
Midfielders William Lucian and Said Ndemla came in for the underwhelming Haroun Chanongo and Abdulhalim Humuod.	Viungo William Lucian na Said Ndemla wakaingia kumsaidia Haroun Chanongo aliyelemewa na Abdulhalim Humuod.
The two young substitutes quickly transformed the match.	Kuingia kwa washambuliaji wawili makinda kulibadilisha kabisa mchezo.
All of a sudden Simba's midfield, out-run, out-hustled and out-played in the first half, grabbed control of the game. 	Ghafla viungo wa Simba, wakachangamka, haraka haraka tofauti na kipindi cha kipindi kwanza, wakauchukua na kuutawala mchezo.
Lucian and Ndemla, in particular, injected some pace into Simba's attacks and soon enough they had helped their team pull a goal back. 	Hasa Lucian na Ndemla, waliongezea nguvu safu ya ushamuliaji ya Simba na mapema iwezekanavyo ikawasaidia Simba kuanza kupunguza magoli.
Then, in the 54th minute, Yanga failed to deal with a speculative punt forward from Simba that found striker Bertram Mombeki in position to blast the ball into the roof of the net, giving his side some hope. 	Kisha, katika dakika ya 54, Yanga walishindwa kuizuia presha kutoka kwa washambuliaji wa Simba na kusababisha mshambuliaji wa Simba Bertram Mombeki kwenye nafasi ya kupiga mpira juu ya nyavu, hii kidogo ikaipa timu yake matumaini.
A few minutes later a corner kick swung in by Ramadhan Singano was headed powerfully into the net by the Ugandan centre-back Joseph Owino and all of a sudden it was 3-2, and we had a game on our hands. 	Dakika chache baadae,kona iliyochongwa na Ramadhan Singano iliunganishwa kwa nguvu na beki wa kati wa Uganda Joseph Owino na ghafla ikawa 3-2, sasa mpira ukawa kwenye mikono yetu.
Yanga’s fans appeared deflated and anxious while Simba's began believing that a comeback might be in store.	Wapenzi wa Yanga wakaonekana kukosa pumzi na kuishiwa nguvu wakati wale wa Simba wakiamini kwamba kurudi kwao inawezekana ikawa kweli.
The noise in the stadium was deafening, with the cries of “Let's go, Simba!” 	Kelele ndani ya uwanja zilikuwa za juu, zikisisitiza ‘Twende Simba!’’
But Yanga weren’t done yet.	Lakini Yanga walikuwa bado hawajamaliza.
Ngasa, quieter in the second half, went through clean on goal at one point, but his tame shot was parried away by Simba's goalkeeper, Abel Dhaira. 	Ngasa sasa akiwa mpole kipindi cha pili, aliliwania goli la wazi, lakini awamu hii shuti lake liliokolewa na kipa wa Simba Abel Dhaira.
Ngasa was to rue that missed chance.	Ni wazi kabisa kwamba Ngassa aliijutia nafasi hiyo.
Five minutes from the end of the match, Simba got a free-kick on the right wing, near the edge of Yanga's box. 	Dakika tano kabla ya mpira kumalizika, Simba wakapata adhabu ndogo kutokea winga ya kulia, karibu na ndani ya lango la Yanga.
The resulting cross was met beautifully by Gilbert Kaze, who headed in the equalizer, sending the red and white half of the stadium into a frenzy. 	Krosi hiyo yenye matokeo ilitengenezwa na Gilbert Kaze, aliyegonga kichwa safi na kuisawazishia simba kusababishia rangi nyeupe na nyekundu nusu ya uwanja kuzizima.
Simba’s comeback was complete.	Kurudi kwa simba kukawa kumekamilika.
Final Score in the Dar Derby.	Matokeo ya mwisho katika pambano hilo.
Photo by Omar Mohammed	Picha na Omar Mohammed
It was a stunning turnaround, the first time in the history of the Derby that a team had been able to accomplish such a feat. 	Ulikuwa ni mgeuko wa kushtua, mara ya kwanza katika historia ya timu hizi kukutana kwamba wameweza kumaliza kwa matokeo hayo.
The match ended 3-3.	Mechi iliisha kwa bao 3-3.
A few minutes later, after the referee had blown for full time, some Simba players collapsed to the ground, not quite believing what they had just pulled off. 	Dakika chache baadae, baada ya mwamuzi kupiga kipenga kuashiria pambano kuisha, baadhi ya wachezaji wa simba walianguka uwanjani, wasiamini kilichotokea.
Those who could manage to stand embraced their opponents, taking in the idea that they’d just been part of an unforgettable classic, one that will long live in the memory of their fans. 	Walioweza kusimama waliwadhihaki washindani wao, wakiwasema kwamba wamekuwa ni sehemu ya mechi hiyo kubwa isiyosahaulika na ambayo itadumu kwenye kumbukumbu za mashabiki wao.

eng: Many countries are also going through controversial legal processes that could limit freedom of the press.

swa: Matamshi ya Waziri wa Mambo ya Ndani wa Ufaransa, Manuel Valls, yalifufua uhasama uliokuwepo kati ya Ufaransa na Warumi.

swa: Valls alisema katika idhaa ya France Inter radio tarehe 24, mwezi wa Septemba:

eng: This community has a way of life that is very different from ours and their way is clearly at odds with the way of life of their neighbors.
swa: Jamii hii ina utamaduni tofauti sana na wetu, na ni wazi kwamba utamaduni wao unahitilafiana na huo wa majirani zao.

eng: The statement got plenty of reactions from the francophone community on twitter, some with a hint of sarcasm :

eng: On a subject that was already quite sensitive for Human rights in France, the Minister's statement got him a warning from the Council of Europe:
swa: Kwa vile alishughulikia suala nyeti lililogusia haki za binadamu nchini Ufaransa, Waziri alionywa na Baraza la Ulaya:

swa: Mjadala huu unaendeleza mwelekeo wa kusikitisha: matamshi ya kibaguzi na ya uchochezi dhidi ya jamii ya Warumi.

eng: It might also take a turn for the worse during the next European parliamentary and municipal elections.
swa: Huenda ukawa mbaya zaidi wakati wa uchaguzi ujao wa ubunge na wa manispaa barani Ulaya.

eng: Nelson Mandela, the first black president of South Africa who played a crucial role in that country's dismantling of apartheid, died on Thursday, December 5, 2013 at the age of 95.

eng: The beloved statesman and Nobel Peace Prize laureate, who is often referred to as Madiba, spent 27 years in prison for his political activities during the country's white minority rule before becoming president.

eng: Since the news of his death broke, Nigerians have been celebrating the life and times of the man some call Africa's greatest gift to humanity.

eng: Within the African world view, the departure of a sage is no time for mourning, but a time of reflection on and appreciation of a worthy legacy.
