eng: Salva Kiir, the president of South Sudan, the world's newest nation, said on December 16, 2013 that an attempted coup by soldiers loyal to former vice-president Riek Machar had been put down.
swa: Salva Kiir, rais wa Sudan Kusini, nchi mpya zaidi duniani, alisema kuwa Desemba 16, mwaka 2013 jaribio la mapinduzi lililoanzishwa na wanajeshi wafuasi wa makamu wa rais wa zamani, Riek Machar, limekomeshwa.

eng: Riek Machar has refuted the allegations, saying that the fighting was a result of a conflict between members of the presidential guard.
swa: Riek Machar amepinga madai hayo, akisema kwamba mapambano yalikuwa matokeo ya mgogoro kati ya wanakundi wa kikosi cha kumlinda rais.

eng: Machar was the African country's first vice-president before president Kiir fired him July 2013.
swa: Machar alikuwa makamu wa rais wa kwanza wa nchi hii ya Kiafrika kabla hajafutwa kazi na Kiir mwezi wa Julai, mwaka wa 2013.

eng: About 500 civilians are reported to have been killed since the crisis began.
swa: Inasemekana kwamba raia takribani 500 wameuawa tangu kuanza kwa machafuko hayo.

eng: Was there a coup on December 16?
swa: Je, kulikuwa na mapinduzi Desemba 16?

eng: Is the crisis in the country an ethnic conflict?
swa: Na machafuko yanayoendelea ni mgogoro wa kikabila ama la?

eng: President of South Sudan Salva Kiir Mayardit outside the Security Council chamber, at UN Headquarters in New York.
swa: Rais wa Sudan Kusini, Salva Kiir Mayardit, nje ya chumba cha Baraza la Usalama, kwenye makao makuu ya Umoja wa Mataifa, mjini New York.

eng: Photo released under the GNU Free Documentation License by Jenny Rockett.
swa: Picha imetolewa na Jenny Rockett chini ya Leseni ya Matumizi Huru ya Nyaraka ya GNU.

eng: What would be the reasons for president Kiir's attempt to blame his former vice president?
swa: Mambo yepi yangemsababisha Rais Kiir kujaribu kumlaumu makamu wake wa awali?

eng: Lesley Anne Warner, an African security analyst, explains:
swa: Lesley Anne Warner, mchambuzi Mwafrika wa masuala ya usalama, hutueleza:

eng: Political tensions had been on the rise since President Kiir sacked his entire cabinet in July, especially his VP Riek Machar, whose location at the moment, is unconfirmed.
swa: Uhasama wa kisiasa ulikuwa umezidi tangu baraza zima la mawaziri, hususan Makamu wa Rais Riek Machar, lilipofutwa kazi na Rais Kiir mwezi Julai.

eng: (I’m trying to get the #WhereIsRiek hashtag started, but sadly it hasn’t gained traction.)
swa: (Nimejaribu kuanzisha alama ashiria ya #WhereIsRiek , lakini kwa bahati mbaya haijapata hadhira.)

eng: Salva was quick to point the finger at Riek to blame him for the recent unrest, but my initial sense is that Riek has spent years trying to rehabilitate his reputation from the 1991 Nasir coup attempt and would be more likely to exhaust his options in the political sphere before resorting to armed violence.
swa: Salva hakukawia kumlaumu Riek kwa machafuko haya. Lakini, kwa maoni yangu, Riek amekuwa akijaribu kukarabati jina lake kwa muda wa miaka mingi baada ya jaribio la mapinduzi la Nasir la 1991. Yamkini angejaribu juu chini kupata suluhisho ya kisiasa kabla hajafikiria vita.

eng: The key issue to consider is who stands to gain from casting Riek in a negative light and reminding South Sudan, and the international community, of his past?
swa: La muhimu hapa ni suala moja: Ni nani atakayefaidika nchi ya Sudan Kusini na jumuiya ya kimataifa zikikumbushwa kuhusu vitendo vya kale vya Riek?

eng: The answer is, President Kiir, who needs to bolster his own image as South Sudan’s leader in light of the cabinet reshuffle, and in the run-up to elections in 2015.
swa: Jawabu ni Rais Kiir. Ndiye mwenye hamu ya kuimarisha taswira yake kama kiongozi wa Sudan Kusini baada ya kulipanga upya baraza la mawaziri na katika maandalizi ya uchaguzi wa 2015.

eng: Notice how President Kiir has donned his military apparel, which he hasn’t worn in years for the press conference he gave on yesterday’s events instead of his trademark cowboy hat.
swa: Ona jinsi Rais Kiir alivyovaa sare yake ya kijeshi (ambayo hajaivaa kwa miaka mingi) badala ya kofia yake ya kawaida ya “pama” alipohudhuria mkutano wa wanahabari aliouandaa kuzungumzia matukio ya jana

eng: Is the crisis a power struggle between two ethnic groups, the Dinka and the Nuer?
swa: Je, mgogoro huu ni ugombezi wa madaraka kati ya makabila wawili, Wadinka na Wanuer?

eng: President Kiir comes from the majority Dinka people and Machar from the Nuer.
swa: Rais Kiir ni Mdinka (kabila kubwa zaidi nchini Sudan Kusini) na Machar ni Mnuer.

eng: South Sudanese bloggger PaanLuel Wël does not think so:
swa: Mwanablogu Msudan Kusini, PaanLuel Wël ametupilia mbali maelezo hayo:

eng: Deadly shoot-outs among the presidential guards in Juba is being portrayed as a war pitting the Dinka (among whom President Kiir is from) against the Nuer, the tribe of Dr. Riek Machar, South Sudan former Vice President.
swa: Inasemekana kuwa mafyatuliano hatari ya risasi miongoni mwa walinzi wa rais ni vita kati ya Wadinka (kabila ya Rais Kiir) na Wanuer (kabila ya Dk. Riek Machar), makamu wa rais wa kale wa Sudan Kusini.

eng: Yet, the senior SPLM officials being arrested are overwhelmingly Dinkas – both from Bor and Bahr el Ghazal.
swa: Lakini idadi kubwa ya viongozi wakuu wa SPLM wanaotiwa nguvuni ni Wadinka – kutoka Bor na Bahr el Ghazal.

eng: And even Equatorians and Shilluks.
swa: Na hata watu kutoka Equatoria na Washilluk.

eng: So, what is the what?
swa: Kwa hivyo suala ni lipi?

eng: South Sudanese should sort out the mess among the Presidential Guards and must leave out these two–tribalization of the unfortunate incident and victimization of innocent political opponents.
swa: Wasudan Kusini wanapaswa kutatua matatizo kati ya walinzi wa rais na kutupilia mbali kisa cha kulaumu makabila mawili na kudhabihu wapinzani wa kisiasa wasio na hatia.

eng: Wël also imagines possible end scenarios to the crisis:
swa: Zaidi ya hayo, Wël hufikiria matukio tofauti yanayoweza kukomesha mgogoro huu:

eng: Barring the tragedy of the situation, it is amusing how the government is conducting the aftermath of the mutiny – making it appear as a resounding victory rather than the beginning of a tragedy awaiting the nation.
swa: Mbali na msiba huu, yachekesha kuona jinsi serikali inavyokabiliana na matokeo ya uasi – inajifanya kama kwamba ni ushindi mkubwa badala ya mwanzo wa msiba utakaokumba taifa.

eng: One thing is clear: there is no end to this crisis other than some kind of mediated compromise between President Kiir and Riek Machar.
swa: Jambo moja li wazi: Mgogoro huu hautatatuliwa ila kwa upatanishi wa kupangwa kati ya Rais Kiir na Riek Machar.

eng: Riek Machar will come back to Juba as the 1st Vice President of South Sudan, and possibly with a clause making him unfirable by Kiir.
swa: Riek Machar atarudi mjini Juba kama Makamu wa Rais wa kwanza nchini Sudan Kusini; yawezekana kwamba kutakuwa na kishazi kitakachozuia kufutwa kwake kazi na Kiir.

eng: If that is the case, then won’t it make more sense to initiate the dialogue and peaceful end to the crisis RIGHT NOW rather than waiting for more precious lives to be lost on both sides before the two camps settle for what it is that it is.
swa: Kama hayo ndiyo yatakayotokea, si itakuwa bora zaidi kuanzisha mazungumzo na suluhisho lenye amani MARA MOJA badala ya kungojea vifo vya watu wengine kutoka pande zote mbili kabla hawajatekeleza mapatanisho?

eng: Martin Garang thinks the crisis was either a coup or mishandling reassignments on the part of security forces:
swa: Martin Garang anadhani kwamba mgogoro ulisababishwa na mapinduzi ama kushindwa kwa vikosi vya usalama kuushughulikia mchakato wa uteuzi vyema:

eng: Civilians have so far become the underdogs caught in the crossfire, targeted for no reason or locked in their homes without food or water in Juba.
swa: Mpaka sasa, maraia wamekuwa nyasi zinazoumia fahali wawili wapiganapo; wamevamiwa bila sababu au kufungiwa kwenye nyumba zao mjini Juba bila chakula au maji.

eng: Reports have hinted that the Jonglee capital of Bor had come under heavy gunfire with several deaths reported.
swa: Taarifa zinadokeza kwamba Bor, mji mkuu wa Jonglei, umestahimili upigaji risasi mwingi, na vifo vingi vimetangazwa.

eng: Either it was a coup d'état or security forces mishandling reassignments in their quarters, The SPLM has tarnished its reputation by putting innocent lives at risk.
swa: Aidha mchafuko ulikuwa mapinduzi ama vikosi vya usalama vilishindwa kuushughulikia machakato wa uteuzi vyema kwenye makao yao. SPLM imechafua sifa yake kwa kitendo cha kutia hatarini maisha ya watu wasio na hatia.

eng: Whatever the truth in the recent government rhetoric, the rhyme and whine over state power from the leaders carry the blame for the current state of affairs in Juba.
swa: Licha ya ukweli kuhusu madai ya serikali, maneno matupu na malalamiko ya viongozi kuhusu uwezo wa nchi ndiyo yaliyosababisha hali ya mambo iliyomo mjini Juba.

eng: South Sudan has a history of rebellions which had been made excessively ethnical during the decades of war of independence.
swa: Sudan Kusini ina historia ya mapinduzi kadhaa ambayo yalihusisha ukabila kwa kadiri kubwa wakati wa miongo ya vita vya uhuru.

eng: It is a reality that can be seen in all aspects of life in the country.
swa: Ni ukweli unaoonekana wazi kwenye vipengele vyote vya maisha nchini humo.

eng: It’s therefore the responsibility of the SPLM leadership to have acquainted itself with this reality by urging leaders to refrain from using ethnic cards in their power manipulations.
swa: Kwa hivyo, ni jukumu la uongozi wa SPLM kukabiliana na ukweli huu kwa kuwahimiza waongozi kutotumia hila za ukabila katika michezo yao ya kisiasa.

eng: Writing on African Arguments, Jairo Munive, a post-doctoral researcher at the Peace, Risk and Violence Unit- Danish Institute for International Studies, points out that what happened in South Sudan is probably not a coup:
swa: Akiandika kwenye tovuti ya African Arguments, Jairo Munive (anayeshughulikia utafiti ufuatao mapokezi ya shahada ya uzamivu katika Kitengo cha Amani, Hatari na Vurugu kwenye Taasisi ya Masomo ya Kimataifa) huashiria kwamba huenda yaliyotokea nchini Sudan Kusini siyo mapinduzi:

eng: But are we witnessing a coup in South Sudan?
swa: Lakini je, tunayoshuhudia nchini Sudan Kusini ni mapinduzi?

eng: Probably not.
swa: Pengine siyo mapinduzi.

eng: First, one should forget, or at least treat with caution, the wording employed by the actors involved the crisis.
swa: Kwanza, ni lazima watu wayasahau au kuyatahadhari maneno yanayotumiwa na wahusika wa mgogoro.

eng: President Kiir has spoken of a “coup attempt” and “criminal actions” whilst Machar refers to the “manufacturing of a coup plot to launch a crackdown against the opposition…the country is to be united and cannot tolerate one man’s rule or it cannot tolerate dictatorship”.
swa: Rais Kiir ameongea juu ya “jaribio la mapinduzi” na “vitendo vya jinai,” huku Machar anazungumza juu ya “utungaji wa njama ya mapinduzi, lengo lake likiwa kuangamiza upinzani… nchi iwe na umoja; haiwezi kuhimili utawala wa mwanamume mmoja au udikteta”.

eng: It is more fruitful instead to think about the apparent collapse in cohesion of SPLA.
swa: Ni bora zaidi kufikiria utengano ambao unaonekana kuwa umekumba SPLA.

eng: The real issue at this juncture, as the head of the United Mission in South Sudan (UNMISS) Hilda Johnson expressed, is the discipline, command and control in the security forces.
swa: Kwa sasa, kwa maoni ya mkuu wa Ujumbe wa Muungano Nchini Sudan Kusini, Hilda Johnson, ya muhimu haswa ni nidhamu, ukamanda na udhibiti kwenye vikosi vya usalama.

eng: To come to terms with recent events we have to understand the SPLA – its politics, tensions and drama surrounding it.
swa: Kuyatambua matukio ya hivi karibuni, tunafaa kuelewa SPLA- siasa zake, mivutano iliyomo, na visa vyake

eng: South Sudanese politics is interwoven with low intensity warfare, inter-ethnic violence and norms of authority grounded in violence.
swa: Siasa za Kisudan Kusini zimehusishwa na vita vya ukali wa kiwango cha chini, vurugu baina ya makabila na desturi za mamlaka zilizojengwa juu ya msingi wa vurugu.

eng: This violence is designed to generate loyalty, fear and legitimacy within a region or an ethnic group vis-à-vis those in power.
swa: Vurugu hizi zinakusudiwa kuzalisha uaminifu, hofu na uhalali wa wenye uwezo kwenye mioyo ya wakaazi wa eneo fulani ama ya watu wa kabila fulani.

eng: The army in South Sudan has a tremendous importance in two ways: both as a space for politics and as a ‘welfare provider’ within the nascent state.
swa: Jeshi nchini Sudan Kusini ni muhimu kwa njia mbili: inawapa watu nafasi penye wanaweza kushughulikia siasa, na inawahudumia kwa ‘kutimiza masilahi yao’ kwenye nchi hii changa.

eng: Furthermore, the make-up of the army reflects the divided politics of the country.
swa: Zaidi ya hayo, katika jeshi mna utengano mwingi wa kisiasa kama ilivyo nchini Sudan Kusini.

eng: The political environment in South Sudan, as the events of this week testify, remains vulnerable to the mobilisation of armed force.
swa: Matukio ya wiki hii yanashuhudia kwamba mazingira ya kisiasa nchini Sudan Kusini bado yana uwezekano wa kusababisha kushirikishwa kwa wanajeshi.

eng: Internal factionalism and defections have marked the SPLA in recent years.
swa: Usaliti na mizozo ya ndani imeathiri SPLA kwa muda wa miaka kadhaa.

eng: Commanders, particularly those from other armed groups integrated into the SPLA (particularly from the SSDF), have reacted to a perceived lack of integration and authority, power and military command.
swa: Makamanda, hususan wale wa makundi mengine yenye silaha yaliyojiunga na SPLA (haswa wale kutoka SSDF), wameitikia ukosefu dhahiri wa ushirikiano na mamlaka, uwezo na ukamanda wa jeshi.

swa: Only an approximate 420 remain in Laos.

eng: The new millennium has bought with it the burden of financial gain, with mahouts (elephant owner) having to work their elephants seven days a week to earn a living.
swa: Kipindi cha milenia mpya, Tembo wamekuwa wakitumika kama sehemu ya kujipatika kipato, wamiliki wa tembo hawana budi kuwatumikisha tembo wao katika siku saba za wiki ili kujikimu kimaisha.

eng: Elephants are mainly employed in the logging industry, a very hard and dangerous job.
swa: Tembo hutumiwa zaidi kwenye shughuli za usafirishaji magoo, kazi ambayo ni ngumu na hatari sana kwa tembo.

eng: Male elephants are too tired and busy to reproduce and can even die from logging accidents.
swa: Tembo wa kike huchoka sana na kushindwa kuzaa na pia huweza kupoteza maisha katika kazi za usafirishaji wa magogo.

eng: Fortunately, there is a growing awareness about the need to protect the elephants in the country.
swa: Kwa bahati nzuri, tayari kuna ufahamu wa umuhimu wa kuwatunza Tembo katika nchi hii.

eng: One of the groups spearheading this advocacy is the Elephant Conservation Center:
swa: Miongoni mw makundi yanayopigia chapuo harakati hizi ni Kituo cha Hifadhi ya Tembo:

eng: Elephant Conservation Center differentiates itself from elephant tourist camps by being a haven for elephant reproduction, lactation, convalescence and disease diagnosis.
swa: Kituo cha Hifadhi ya Tembo Kinajitofautisha na mashirika mengine ya utalii wa Tembo kwa kuwatunza Tembo kwa kuwajengea mazingira mazuri ya kuzaliana, uangalizi makini na wa karibu, matibabu na uchunguzi wa magonjwa mbalimbali.

eng: Do NOT expect to see package tours riding these elephants all day long!
swa: Usitegemee kuona watalii wakiwatumia Tembo hawa kwa siku nzima bila kupumzishwa!

eng: It is also the first elephant hospital in Laos as well as serving as an ecotourism camp.
swa: Pia, kuna hospitali ya kwanza kabisa ya Tembo nchini Laos, ambapo pia, imekuwa ikitumika kama eneo la utalii la kutunza mali asili.

eng: It provides technical and livelihood assistance to elephant owners or mahout who depend on the elephants for their daily income.
swa: Inatoa ushauri wa kitaalamu pamoja na namna bora ya kuishi na Tembo kwa watu wanaomiliki Tembo kwa ajili ya kujipatia kipato.

eng: The center is also a sanctuary for rescued elephants.
swa: Kituo hiki pia kinatoa matunzo kwa Tembo waliojeruhiwa na kisha kuokolewa.

eng: They were able to rescue a young elephant which they named Noy.
swa: Walishafanikiwa kumuokoa Tembo mdogo waliyempa jina la Noy.

eng: After a few years, the elephant will pick his new name through a process described by head veterinarian Emmanuelle Chave:
swa: Baada ya miaka kadhaa kupita, tembo huyu atajitwalia jina jingine kupitia mchakato unaoelezewa na Afisa Mifugo afahamikaye kwa jina la Emmanuelle Chave:

eng: At three years old, elephants are trained by their future mahout, to respond different cues, in order to work with humans.
swa: Wakiwa na miaka mitatu, tembo hupata mafunzo kutoka kwa wamiliki wanaotarajia kuishi na tembo hao ya namna ya kupokea ishara mbalimbali ili kuweza kufanya kazi pamoja na binadamu.At three years old, elephants are trained by their future mahout, to respond different cues, in order to work with humans.

eng: A shaman organizes this important journey, where the elephant leaves the forest world for the human world.
swa: Mzee wa kitamaduni husimamia safari hii, ambapo Tembo huacha maisha ya porini na kujiunga na maisha ya binadamu.

eng: At the end of the training, the young elephant is offered three sugarcanes, on which are written names.
swa: Hadi mwisho wa mafunzo, tembo mdogo huzawadiwa miwa mitatu, ambayo juu yake kuna majina yaliyoandikwa.

eng: The name on the first sugarcane he picks up will be his.
swa: Jina katika mua wa kwanza atakaouchukua litakuwa lakwake.

eng: Brita visited the center and recognized its role in protecting the welfare of elephants:
swa: Brita alitembelea kituo hiki na kugundua wajibu wake wa kutunza uhai wa Tembo:

eng: The Elephant Conservation Center is probably one of the few places you can visit where it’s not about elephants adapting to people’s schedules and needs but where people adapt to the rhythm and needs of the elephants I am very picky when it comes to choosing an Elephant “place” as there are far too many all over the world which treat their elephants badly and which just means moving from one horrible life (=logging) to another (= bad treatment for tourism purposes).
swa: Kituo cha Hifadhi ya Wanyama, bila shaka, ni moja ya maeneo machache unayoweza kuyatembelea na kujionea jinsi watu wanavyobadilika kulingana na vionjo na matakwa ya Tembo na siyo Tembo kubadilika kulingana na namna watu wanavyoishi. Linapokuja suala la kuchagua niende kwenye sehemu ipi ya utalii wa Tembo, huwa ninakuwa na machaguo mengi kwani karibu maeneo yote ulimwenguni huwa na tabia ya kutokuwajali kabisa tembo, ikiwa ni sawa tu na kuhama kutoka kushuhudia maisha mbaya kabisa ya tembo (= kusafirisha magogo) kwenda kushuhudia maisha mengine ya tembo(= kutokutunzwa vizuri kunakotokana na shughuli za kitalii).

eng: jo ebisujima also visited the center and learned that putting chairs on the back of an elephant is painful for the animal:
swa: jo ebisujima pia alihunduria kituo hiki na kujifunza kuwa, kuweka kiti mgongoni mwa tembo ni maumivu makubwa kwa mnyama huyu:

eng: One of the important things that were learnt was that the chairs that are used for carry people and luggage on an elephants back (hawdah) really isn't good for them.
swa: Miongoni mwa mambo ya muhimu niliyojifunza ni kuwa, viti vilivyoko migongoni mwa tembo vinavyotumika kubebea watu na mizigo kwa hakika si sahihi kabisa kwa wanyama hao.

eng: This is due to the shape of the bones...It is more comfortable for the elephant to be ridden without any kind of saddle and sat on their neck.
swa: Hii ni kwa sababu ya namna mifupa yao ilivyojengeka. Ni nafuu sana kwa Tembo kutembea bila aina yoyote ya mzigo na wala kuwekwa juu ya shingo zao.

eng: Screenshot from the cover of a Meena comic book. Image courtesy UNICEF
swa: Picha iliyopigwa kutoka kwenye gazeti la Katuni za Meena. picha kwa idhini ya UNICEF

eng: Only two decades ago, the status of many women in some South Asian countries was low. Many girls in rural areas were not allowed to study.
swa: Ni miongo miwili tuu iliyopita,wanawake wengi wa nchi za Asia ya Kusini wamekuwa wakidhaeauliwa. wasichana wengi wa maeneo ya vijijini hawakuwa wakiruhusiwa kusoma. wasichana walizuiwa kuolewa pamoja na kufikia umri uliowaruhusu kuolewa, kwa maana hiyo hata masomo yangekuwa na faida gani?

eng: Girls were inevitably married off as soon as they grew up, so what good was studying?
swa: Majumbani, wavulana walipendelewa kwa kupewa vyakula vizuri, wasichana walikuwa wakipewa masalia ya vyakula.

eng: Boys would get the best of the households' food, the girls the leftovers. But this discriminatory mindset has changed tremendously, in part thanks to a cartoon character.
swa: Lakini, dhana hii ya ubaguzi imebadilika kwa kiasi kikubwa, kwa kiasi fulani, shukrani zimwendee mchora katuni.

eng: The fictional character Meena stars in the South Asian children's television show of the same name.
swa: Fanani wa kufirika Meena ang,ara katika televisheni ya Asia ya Kusini inayorusha kipindi cha televisheni cha watoto kwa jina hilo hilo.

eng: Promoted by UNICEF, Meena and her TV show is very popular in the region.
swa: Kwa ufadhili wa UNICEF, Meena na kipindi chake cha televisheni amekuwa maarufu sana katika eneo hilo.

eng: UNICEF developed the Meena Communication Initiative (MCI) as a mass communication project aimed at changing perceptions and behavior that hamper the survival, protection and development of girls in South Asia.
swa: UNICEF iliandaa Mkakati wa Mawasiliano wa Meena (MCI) kama mradi wa mawasiliano kwa umma uliolenga kubadilisha mitizamo ya watu inayoweka rehani uhai, ulinzi pamoja maendeleo ya wanawake wa Asia ya Kusini.

eng: Bangladesh was the first country to meet Meena when a film about her struggle to go to school aired on Bangladesh national television (BTV) in 1993.
swa: Bangladesh ilikwa nchi ya kwanza kukutana na Meena mara baada ya filamu yake ya kwanza iliyokuwa inaonesha harakati zake za kutaka kwenda shuleni iliyokuwa ikioneshwa katika Televisheni ya Taifa ya Bangladesh(BTV) mwaka 1993.

eng: The secondary characters of her stories include Meena's brother Raju and her pet parrot Mithu.
swa: Waigizaji wengine katika simulizi zake ni pamoja na kaka yake na Meena ajulikanaye kwa jina la Raju pamoja na Kasuku ampendaye ajulikanaye kwa jina la Mithu.

eng: Meet Meena.
swa: Kutana na Meena.

eng: Image from Wikimedia
swa: Picha kutoka Wikimedia

eng: According to an old report of UNICEF:
swa: Kwa mujibu wa taarifa ya zamani ya UNICEF:

eng: Since her inception 14 years ago she has shown millions of women and girls what can be achieved.
swa: Tangu alipoanza, miaka 14 iliyopita, ameshawaonesha mamilioni ya wanawake na wasichana mambo wanayoweza kuyatimiza.

eng: She has delivered messages on issues as far reaching as solving the problem of bullying through to challenging the stigma of HIV/AIDS through to girls' right to play sport.
swa: Tayari ameshatoa mafunzo kuhusiana na mambo kadhaa ikiwa ni pamoja na kutatua changamoto ya maneno ya dhihaka dhidi ya wasichana ikiwa ni pamoja na kukabiliana na changamoto ya fedheha ya ugonjwa wa Ukimwi kwa wasichanaShe has delivered messages on issues as far reaching as solving the problem of bullying through to challenging the stigma of HIV/AIDS through to girls' right to play sport.

eng: The Meena stories are highly entertaining and fun, but also reflect, at their core, the realities of girls' lives in South Asia.
swa: Simulizi za Meena zinafurahisha na kuvutia sana, lakini pia, zinaakisi sana hali halisi ya maisha ya wasichana wanaoishi Asia ya Kusini.

eng: Meena has spread messages to stop child marriage and the practice of dowry and promote healthy toilet use, sending girls to school, equality between boys and girls and the right to education for the domestic workers.
swa: Meena ameshatoa ujumbe wa kupinga ndoa za utotoni na utamaduni wa utoaji mahari, ikiwa ni pamoja na kupigia chapuo matumizi sahihi ya vyoo, kuwapeleka watoto wa kike shuleni, usawa wa kijinsia miongoni mwa watoto wa kike na wa kiume pamoja na haki ya elimu kwa wafanyakazi wa ndani.

eng: Her shows highlights the potential contributions to society that girls can make if provided an equal playing field.
swa: Vipindi vya televisheni anavyoviandaa vinaonesha mchango wa dhati wa wasichana katika jamii endapo watapewa nafasi.

eng: How can a message spread by a small cartoon girl be so empowering that it has helped change the society radically?
swa: Ni kwa namna gani ujumbe unaweza kusambaa kupitia katuni ndogo ya mtoto wa kike na kuwa na nguvu kubwa kiasi cha kuweza kudali mitazamo ya watu kwa haraka?

eng: Housewife Naznin Rahman told the Daily Prothom Alo :
swa: Mama wa nyumbani, Naznin Rahman aliliambia gazeti la Daily Prothom Alo :

eng: My mom Zohra Begum has taken dowry for her two elder sons.
swa: Mama yangu Zohra Begum alipokea mahari watoto wake wawili wa kiume.

eng: In those days, Meena was not aired.
swa: Wakati huo, Meena hakuwa akifahamika.

eng: Since she started watching Meena, she had developed a special sympathy for girls in particular.
swa: Tangu alipoanza kumfuatilia Meena, alijijengea moyo wa huruma sana kwa wasichana.

eng: When she had her younger son married, we realized how she was affected by Meena.
swa: Hata mtoto wake mdogo kabisa wa kiume alipooa, tuligundua namna alivyofunzwa na Meena.

eng: She did not take any dowry for my younger brother.
swa: Hakupokea mahari yoyote kutoka kwa bibi harusi kwa ajili ya kaka yangu mdogo .

eng: Shuvo Ankur wrote on the BDNews24.com's kids page about the positive changes Meena has provoked:
swa: Shuvo Ankur aliandika katika ukurasa wa watoto wa BDNews24.com kuhusiana na mambo chanya aliyokwisha kuyagusia:

eng: Meena achieved popularity from the start.
swa: Meena alipata umaaarufu tokea mwanzoni.

eng: The changes were visible soon after.
swa: Mabadiliko yalijidhihirisha punde baada ya kujulikana kwake.

eng: Earlier, in rural areas girl students dropped out of school and ended up working as a housemaid.
swa: Mapema, katika maeneo ya vijijini, wanafunzi wa kike waliacha masomo na kuishia kufanya kazi za majumbani.

eng: But the situation changed after Meena's show began airing.
swa: Lakini hali ilibadilika mara baada ya vipindi vya televisheni vya Meena kuanza kuoneshwa.

eng: On screen, Meena was also not allowed to go to school first.
swa: Kwenye televisheni, mwanzoni, Meena hakuruhusiwa kwenda shuleni kabisa.

eng: But she changed her lot and got permission to go to school.
swa: Lakini alibadililika sana na mwishowe alipata furasa ya kwenda shuleni.

eng: Meena's wit and intelligence allowed her to learn to count and other essential knowledge to save her father from the deception from other people. She saved their cows from a thief.
swa: Ufahamu na uwezo wa Meena kiakili vilimuwezesha kujifunza kuhesabu pamoja na kujua maarifa mengine ya muhimu kwa ajili ya kumasaidia baba yake dhidi ya watu waliokuwa wakimdanganya. aliokoa ngombe wao kutoka kwa wezi.

eng: Her intelligence became popular, and the negligence of girls in South Asian countries slowly started disappearing.
swa: Uwezo wake kiakili ulifahamika na kila mmoja, na unyanyapaa dhidi ya wasichana katika nchi za Asia ya Kusini taratibu ulianza kupotea.

eng: Sohanur Rahman wrote on Kishorebarta that there is a lot to learn from the cartoon show:
swa: Sohanur Rahman aliandika kwenye Kishorebarta kuwa, kuna mengi sana ya kujifunza kutoka kwenye kipindi hiki cha katuni:

eng: We have learnt a lot from Meena.
swa: Tumejifunza mengi kutoka kwa Meena.

eng: From the '90s till today, Meena has become a star and a special character in our society.
swa: Tokea miaka ya 90 hadi sasa, Meena amekuwa maarufu sana na fanani wa kipekee sana katika jamii yetu.

eng: Meena is also broadcast on radio.
swa: Pia, Meena anatangaza redioni.

eng: Farzana Islam Tithi, 24, who voices Meena, told The Daily Star:
swa: Farzana Islam Tithi, mwenye umri wa miaka 24, ambaye anamtangaza Meena,aliliambia gazeti la The Daily Star:

eng: Everyone loved Meena from their childhood and everyone, regardless of age, watched the cartoon eagerly.
swa: Kila mmoja alimpenda Meena tokea utotoni mwake, na kila mmoja bila kujali umri, aliangalia katuni zake kwa hamasa kubwa.

eng: I also used to watch it.
swa: Nami nilikuwa nikitazama kipindi hiki.

eng: May be Meena’s accent struck to my mind since then and I believe that feeling helped me in my voice over for Meena.
swa: Labda mtazamo wa Meena ulinikaa zana akili mwangu tangu awali na ndio maana ninaamini hisia hizi ndizo zilizonisaidia kumtangaza Meena.

eng: Twitter user Bengalithings deemed Meena a role model:

swa: Kila mwaka Oktoba 24, " Siku ya Meena" inaadhimishwa nchini Bangladesh kuhamasisha jamii kuwaandikisha watoto mashuleni kwa asilimia 100, kukwepa wanafunzi kuacha masomo na kuhakikisha ilimu bora mashuleni.

eng: According to reports , Meena has also become popular outside of the South Asian region.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa taarifa , Meena amekuwa maarufu hata katika maeneo nje ya Asia ya Kusini.

eng: Is South Korea government gearing up toward social media censorship?
swa: Je, serikali ya Korea Kusini imejiandaa kwa kufuatilia mitandao ya kijamii?

eng: The latest official remark by President Park (full transcript ) had Korean net users worried.
swa: Matamshi ya hivi karibuni ya Rais Park (full transcript ) yamewashitua wa-Korea wanaotumia mtandao.

eng: Park, addressing "those rumors spreading via social media", said "if the government let these things happen, it will bring chaos nationwide" and added "bear in mind that the authorities need to react fast and aggressively, and preemptively against those groups trying to distort the situations".
swa: Park, akiwalenga "uvumi ule unaosambaa kupitia mitandao ya kijamii", alisema "kama serikali ikiachia mambo haya yakaendelea, itakuwa ghasia nchi nzima" na kuongeza "kumbukeni mamlaka za nchi zinahitaji kuchukua hatua kwa haraka sana na kwa hisia zinazotakikana dhidi makundi yale yanayoharibu hali ya hewa".

eng: Many twitter users voiced concerns and pointed out the fact (such as @ppsskr's tweet which has been retweeted over 500 times) that the government bodies sent out over 24 million tweets to tip the scale in favor of Park in the latest presidential election.
swa: Watumiaji wengi wa mtandao wa twita walipigia kelele wasiwasi wao na kuonyesha ukweli (kama twiti ya @ppsskr ambayo ilizunguka zaidi ya mara 500) kwamba vyombo vya serikali vimelituma zaidi ya twiti milioni 24 ili kumpa nafuu Park wakati wa uchaguzi wa rais uliofanyika hivi karibuni.

swa: Ili kuondoa uhaba wa hosteli kwa ajili ya wanafunzi unaovikabili vyuo vikuu barani Ulaya, baadhi ya vyuo vikuu nchini Denmaki, Ujerumani, Ufaransa (Le Havre) na Uhispania vimejaribu kubadili makontena na kuyafanya yawe hosteli za wanafunzi.

swa: Posti hii ni sehemu ya Habari zetu maalumu kuhusu Maandamano ya Ukraine.

eng: Protests in Ukraine escalated to a deadly stand-off between hundreds of thousands of citizens and government forces in the evening of February 18.
swa: Maandamano ya Ukraine yamekua kiasi cha kufikia hatua ya mapambano kati ya mamia ya maelfu ya raia na vikosi vya serikali jioni ya Februari 18.

eng: Roads to the city were blocked by authorities, and the metro in Kyiv were stopped.
swa: Barabara zinazoelekea jijini zilikuwa zimefungwa na mamlaka za serikali, na treni za jiji la Kyiv zilisimamisha huduma zake.

eng: The main opposition TV channel reported being taken off air.
swa: Kituo kikuu cha televisheni kinachopingana na serikali kinaripotiwa kufungiwa kurusha matangazo yake.

eng: Fierce clashes between police and protesters around the main square continued through the night.
swa: Mapigano makali kati ya polisi na waandamanaji katika viwanja vikuu vya mikusanyiko ya watu jijini humo yaliendelea mpaka usiku.

eng: On February 19, the Kyiv Post reported that at least 25 people are dead and more than 1,000 are injured.
swa: Mnamo tarehe 19 Februari, maandamano ya Kyiv yaliripotiwa kupoteza maisha ya watu wasiopungua 25 na wengine zaidi ya 1,000 wakijeruhiwa.

eng: In the morning of February 18, 2014, Ukraine's opposition tried to register a bill in Parliament to bring back the old version of the country's Constitution, one that significantly limits presidential powers.
swa: Asubuhi ya Februari 18, 2014, wapinzani wa serikali walijaribu kuwasilisha muswada Bungeni ili kurudisha toleo la zamani la Katiba ya nchi hiyo, ambalo lilidhibiti mamlaka ya rais.

eng: The move was backed by the nearly three-months-old Euromaidan movement, which has been protesting daily in several cities throughout Ukraine demanding that the government of President Viktor Yanukovych step down.
swa: Hatua hiyo iliungwa mkono na harakati za Euromaidan ambazo kwa sasa zimetimiza miezi mitatu, ambazo zinaendesha maandamanokila siku kwenye majiji kadhaa kote nchini Ukraine kudai serikali ya Rais Viktor Yanukovych kuondoka madarakani.

eng: Ahead of the session, the protesters marched to the Parliament building.
swa: Hapo awali, waandamanaji waliandamana kuelekea kwenye jengo la Bunge.

eng: When the speaker of the parliament refused to register the bill, clashes broke out between the people and the police.
swa: Wakati spika wa bunge alipokataa kupokea muswada huo, mapigano yalianza kati ya raia na polisi.

eng: MPs who support President Yanukovych had left the building, while the president himself was nowhere to be found.
swa: Wabunge wanaomwunga mkono Rais Yanukovych tayari walikuwa wameshaondoka kwenye jengo la Bunge, wkaati rais mwenyewe aliingia mitini.

eng: Police and special forces then stormed Maidan Nezalezhnosti (Independance Square), the protesters' stronghold.
swa: Polisi na vikosi vya ulinzi vilivamia viwanja vya Maidan Nezalezhnosti ambavyo ni ngome ya waandamanaji.

eng: Overnight negotiations between the protesters and the government failed and protesters once again reclaimed Independence Square in Kyiv on February 19.
swa: Mazungumzo yaliyodumu kwa usiku mzima kati ya waandamanaji na serikali yalikwama na waandamanaji kwa mara nyingine waliruhusiwa kutumia viwanja vya Independence Square jijini Kyiv mnamo Februari 19.
