eng: And yes, as in real life, this is also real: During most of the day, women and men of El Salvador are happy rather than distressed by the bad news that some media outlets report and pretend to make more real than the reality this video shows.
swa: Na ndiyo, kama ilivyo kwenye maisha halisi, video hii ni halisi: wakati mwingi wa siku, wanawake na wanaume wa El Salvador wanaoneka kuwa na furaha na kwa hakika hawana msongo wa habari mbaya zinazotangazwa kwenye taarifa za vyombo vya habari na kuzinya zionekane ni halisi kuliko ukweli unaonekana kwenye video hii.

eng: One week ahead of Macedonia's presidential elections, incumbent candidate President Gjorge Ivanov provoked widespread discussion among Macedonian social media users by making a series of gaffes in his first campaign interview.
swa: Ikiwa imebaki wiki moja tu kuelekea kwenye uchaguzi wa Rais nchini Macedonia, mgombea Urais ambaye ndiye Rais wa sasa Gjorge Ivanov alisababisha mjadala makali kwenye mitandao ya kijamii baada ya mgombea huyo 'kuchemka' kwenye mjadala wake wa kwanza wa kampeni za urais..

eng: Users quickly shared information about Ivanov's blunders using the hashtag #хорхе (a satirical Macedonian transliteration of the Spanish version of the name Gjorje - Jorje), reaching large audiences both in and outside the country.
swa: Watumiaji wa mitandao ya kijamii walisambaza habari za 'kuchemka' kwa Ivanov kwa kutumia alama habari #хорхе (tafsiri ya utani ya neno la Kihispania kwa Kimacedonia Gjorje - Jorje), wakiwafikia hadhira kubwa ndani na nje ya nchi hiyo.

eng: Among other mistakes in the interview, Ivanov claimed that former French President Jacques Chirac had served as president of the US:
swa: Pamoja na makosa mengine aliyoyafanya kwenye mahojiano hayo, Ivanov alidai kuwa Rais wa zamani wa Ufaransa Jacques Chirac aliwahi kuwa rais wa Marekani:

eng: When Jacques Chirac was President of America, he took the position after being mayor of Paris, and because of that experience he coped with the immigrants issue.
swa: Wakati Jacques Chirac akiwa ni Rais wa Marekani, alichukua nafasi yake kama meya wa jiji la Paris, na kwa sababu ya uzoefu huo alielewa vizuri masuala ya wahamiaji.

eng: Macedonian news portal A1on.mk published an excerpt of the televised interview that includes this claim:
swa: Tovuti ya habari ya Macedonia iitwayo A1on.mk ilichapisha nukuu ndogo ya mahojiano hayo ya televisheni yanayoonyesha madai haya:

eng: I was even in Kazakhstan and opened an embassy there. 	Nilikuwa nchini kazakhtan na kufungua ubalozi wetu pale.
And to show you how big Kazakhstan is – just imagine how big Europe and all European countries are.
swa: Na ili kukuonyesha jinsi gani Kazakhatan ni kubwa -hebu fikiria ukubwa wa bara la Ulaya na nchi zote zinazounda bara hili.

eng: That is how large the surface of Kazakhstan is.”
swa: Huo ndio ukubwa wa ardhi ya Kazakhastan.”

eng: The president is known for refusing to take part in a public debate since starting his campaign, aside from a few interviews on state-supported media.
swa: Rais huyo anafahamika kwa kugomea midahalo ya hadharani tangu aanze kampeni, ukiacha mahojiano machache ya hapa na pale anayoyafanya na vyombo vya habari vinavyomilikiwa na serikali.

eng: A parody photomontage of President Gjorge Ivanov participating in the Macedonian version of the popular television quiz “Who Wants to Be a Millionaire”.
swa: Picha ya maigizo ya Rais Gjorge Ivanov akishiriki kwenye shindano maarufu la chemshabongo ya televisheni nchini Macedonia “Nani Anataka Kuwa Milionea”.

eng: Image author anonymous - widely distributed on social networks.
swa: Aliyetengeneza picha hii hafahamiki -inasambaa kwenye mitandao ya kijamii.

eng: At the start of the presidential campaign, one of the country's national television stations, Telma, claimed that it faced unequal access to information and unfair competition in the media market and blamed this on the government.
swa: Mwanzoni mwa kampeni za Urais, mmoja wapo ya vituo vya televisheni vya taifa, Telma kilidai kuwa kilikumbana na hali ya kutokuwa na fursa sawa ya kupata habari na ushindani usio wa haki katika soko la habari, hali ambayo kituo hicho kinasema imesababishwa na serikali.

eng: Telma stated that it had invited Ivanov to participate in a live televised interview, but that he had declined their invitation.
swa: Kituo cha Telma kilimkaribisha Rais Ivanov kushiriki kwenye mahojiano ya televisheni ya moja kwa moja, lakini akikataa.

eng: Telma responded on their prime time news programme, saying that "Ignorance is the method of the insecure":
swa: Telma ilikuwa na maoni yafuatayo:

eng: The man who wants to be the president of all citizens, and that means to us too, decided to play by the rules from the centre and ignore us, without saying whether he will accept our invitation or not!
swa: Mtu ambaye anataka kuwa rais wa wananchi wote, na hiyo ikimaanisha rais wetu pia , aliamua kutumia vibaya madaraka yake na kuamua kutupuuza, bila kutoa majibu ikiwa amekubali au amekataa!.

eng: Ivanov's rejection of Telma's invitation to participate in an interview provoked a discussion among many Macedonian users on Twitter.
swa: Kitendo cha Ivanov kugomea mwaliko wa kituo cha televisheni cha Telma kushiriki kwenye mahojiano kiliibua mjadala mwingine kwenye mitandao ya kijamii hususani watumiaji wa mtandao wa Twita nchini Macedonia.

eng: Twitter user @parg0, a social media activist from the capital Skopje, said:
swa: Mtumiaji wa Twita @parg0 kutoka Skopje alisema:

eng: #Хорхе beginning to decline invitations.
swa: #Хорхе ameanza kukataa mialiko.

eng: There's going to be an empty chair in the studio I see. http://t.co/AIzDm1P4ub Or they'd have either way.
swa: Kiti chake kitakuwa wazi kwenye studio. http://t.co/AIzDm1P4ub Au basi tayari wanacho .

eng: After this tweet, other users reported that Ivanov had rejected or ignored invitations for interviews or debates from other independent media outlets.
swa: Baada ya twiti hii, watumiaji wengine wa mtandao huo walitaarifu kuwa Ivanov alikuwa amekataa au kupuuza mialiko kwenye mahojiano au midahalo kutoka kwenye vyombo huru vya habari.

eng: The web portal Libertas noted that several hours after the beginning of the online discussion about Ivanov's clumsy television appearance, several videos containing content from the interview in question were removed from YouTube .
swa: Chombo vya habari Libertas kilibainisha kuwa masaa kadhaa baada ya kuanza kwa mjadala huo wa mtandaoni kuhusu 'kuchemka' kwa Ivanov kwenye televisheni, baadhi ya video zenye maudhui ya mahojiano hayo yanayojadiliwa zilikuwa zimeondolewa kwenye mtandao wa YouTube .

eng: After the removal of some of the videos, some Twitter users compared Ivanov with Turkish Prime Minister Recep Tayyib Erdoğan, who has also faced criticism for blocking social media sites in late March 2014
swa: Baada ya kuondolewa kwa video hizo, baadhi ya watumiaji wa twita walimfananisha Ivanov na Waziri Mkuu wa Uturuki Recep Tayyib Erdoğan.

eng: I saw yesterday that the video where Ivanov said Chirac was president of the US was removed.
swa: Niligundua jana kuwa video iliyokuwa inamwonyesha Ivanov akisema Chirac alikuwa rais wa Marekani imeondolewa.

eng: Don’t forget, #Хорхе’s heart is with Erdoğan.
swa: Msisahau, #Хорхе ana moyo unaofanana na ule wa Erdoğan.

eng: It remains unclear why the videos are no longer available.
swa: Bado haieleweki kwa nini video hizo hazipatikani tena.

eng: Some social media users have suggested that YouTube could have taken them down following user complaints, that the original posters of the videos have now removed them themselves, or that they had been forced to remove them under pressure from the authorities.
swa: Baadhi ya watumiaji wa mitandao ya kijamii wanadhani huenda YouTube imeziondoa kufuatia malalamiko ya baadhi ya watazamaji, ila kwamba walioziweka ndio wameziondoa video hizo, au kwamba zimeondolewa kwa shinikisho kutoka serikalini bado haijulikani.

eng: Ethiopians marked April Fools’ Day on Twitter with a steady stream of fake news headlines that imitated the "lies" of state-owned Ethiopian Television (ETv), the only national TV station in the African country.
swa: Waethiopia walisherehekea Siku ya Wajinga kwenye mtandao wa Twita kwa kusambaza vichwa vya habari za uongo zilizokuwa zikiiga "uongo" wa kituo cha televisheni cha taifa cha nchi hiyo (ETv), ambacho ndicho kituo pekee cha televisheni cha taifa katika nchi hiyo ya Afrika.

eng: Using the hashtag #ETvDay, netizens accused ETv of "telling lies 365 days".
swa: Kwa kutumia alama habari #ETvDay, watumiaji wa mtandao walikituhumu kituo cha ETv kwa "kudanganya kwa siku 365 za mwaka".

eng: It all started with the image below:
swa: Yote hayo yalianzia kwenye picha hii hapa chiniw:

eng: ETv made it to the UN international days list. #ETvDay in #EtvStyle.
swa: ETv imefanikiwa kuingia kwenye orodha ya kimataifa ya Umoja wa Mataifa

eng: Customizing: April Fools’ is for foreigners. “Ours” is ETv.
swa: Jomanex alibainisha kwa lugha ya ki-Amariki:

eng: Soli joked about the next general election in 2015:
swa: Uchaguzi ujao utakuwa huru, haki na wa kidemokrasia

eng: The coming 2015 national election is fair, free and democratic. #ETVday. #Ethiopia — Soli ሶሊ (@Soli_GM) April 1, 2014 The disputed 2005 Ethiopian election ended in street protests, with 193 people killed and more that 30,000 people detained by security forces.
swa: Uchaguzi wa nchi hiyo wa 2005 ulivurugwa na kuishia na maandamano mtaani , ambapo watu 193 waliuawa na zaidi ya wengine 30,000 kukamatwa na vyombo vya usalama.

eng: In 2010, the election ended in a landslide victory for the incumbent Ethiopian People's Revolutionary Democratic Front, taking 99.6 percent of parliamentary seats.
swa: Mwaka 2010, uchaguzi ulikipa ushindi wa kishindo chama kinachotawala nchi hiyo cha People's Revolutionary Democratic Front, kilichopata asilimia 99.6 ya viti bungeni.

eng: The opposition rejected the results and international observers said the election fell short of international standards.
swa: Upinzani uliyakataa matokeo hayo na waangalizi wa kimataifa walisema uchaguzi huo haukukidhi wiwango vya kimataifa.

eng: Apparently, Ethiopia will meet one of its Millennium Development Goals - a set of development goals agreed upon at the United Nations' Millennium Summit in 2000 - in record time:
swa: Ni wazi, Ethiopia itafanikiwa kufikia moja wapo ya Malengo ya Kimaendeleo ya Milenia - jumla ya malengo ya kimaendeleo yalikubalika kwenye mkutano wa Milenia wa Umoja wa Mataifa mwaka 2000 - mkutano ulikuwa wa kihistoria:

eng: Sources revealed that Ethiopia will provide a supply of clean water before the Millennium Development Goals deadline
swa: Vyanzo vinasema kuwa Ethiopia itaweza kutoa huduma maji safi ya kunywa kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufikiwa kwa malengo ya Milenia.

eng: Gulelle sub-city residents who couldn't get drinking water for the past 20 days said they were not affected because they had been given training on how to live without water.
swa: Wakazi wa mtaa wa Gulelle ambao hawakuweza kupata maji kwa siku 20 zilizopita wamesema hawajapata mafunzo ya namna ya kuishi bila maji.

eng: On the Crimea referendum, in which that region of Ukraine overwhelmingly voted to be annexed by Russia:
swa: Kuhusu kura ya maoni ya Crimea, ambapo mkoa huo wa Ukraine ulipiga kura ya kishindo ya kujitenga na Urusi:

eng: Some residents of Adama said that Russia’s annexation of Crimea won’t affect the Growth and Transformation plan of Ethiopia.
swa: Baadhi ya wakazi wa Adama wamesema kujitenga kwa Crimea na kujiunga Urusi hakutaathiri Ukuaji na mipango ya Mabadiliko ya Ethiopia.

eng: Mahlet categorized news into two types: There is news and there is ETV news. #ETvDay — Mahlet (@Mahlet_S) April 1, 2014 BefeQadu added:
swa: Mahlet aligawanya habari katika makundi mawili:

eng: There are two types of people in the world: those who watch ETv daily and those who were saved by God from having to watch it.
swa: Kuna aina mbili za watu duniani: wale wanaoitazama ETv kila siku na wale waliokolewa na Mungu kuepushwa kuitazama

eng: Using the Ethiopian Tourism Commission’s former motto, ‘13 months of sunshine’, Saleh said:
swa: Kw akutumia kauli mbiu ya zamani ya Tume ya Utalii ya Ethiopia, "Miezi 13 ya mwanga wa jua", Saleh alisema:

eng: 13 months of sunshine & 13 months of government lies on a state-owned TV station. #ETvDay = April the fool @BBCAfrica @AJStream — saleh (@2zworld) April 1, 2014
swa: Miezi 13 ya mwangaza wa jua; miezi 13 ya uongo wa serikali kwenye kituo cha televisheni kinachomilikiwa na serikali = Siku ya wajinga

eng: How many days does ETv own a year?:
swa: Hivi siku ngapi za mwaka zinamilikiwa na ETv?:

eng: In response to allegations by activists that today is #ETVday, ETV announced today is the only day of the year that it does not own. #April1 — Bon Bon (@BonayaBonso) April 1, 2014
swa: In response to allegations by activists that today is #ETVday, ETV announced today is the only day of the year that it does not own. #April1

eng: I expect mass resignation by ETV journalists today. #ETvDay #13monthsofEtvlies — Oromo Network (@Oromo_NT) April 1, 2014
swa: — Bon Bon (@BonayaBonso) April 1, 2014 Katika kujibu shutuma za wanaharakati hao siku hiyo, ETV ilitangaza kuwa hii ndio siku pekee ambayo haiimiliki.

eng: Enjoy the rest of the #ETvDay tweets here.
swa: Furahia twiti nyinginezo nyingi za #ETvDay hapa.

eng: A South Korean ferry heading to a resort island sank on April 16, 2014 with hundreds of passengers, including 325 high school students, on board.
swa: Feri ya Korea Kusini iliyokuwa inaelekea kwenye kisiwa cha mapumziko ilizama mnamo Aprili 16, 2014 na mamia ya abiria, ikiwa ni pamoja na wanafunzi 325 wa shule ya sekondari waliokuwemo.

eng: It has been two days since the accident and 28 people are confirmed dead as of April 18 and 268 people are still missing.
swa: Zimetimia siku mbili tangu ajali hiyo itokee na watu 28 wamethibitika kufariki kufikia Aprili 18 na watu 268 bado hawajulikani walipo.

eng: Their chances of survival are very slim.
swa: Uwezekano wa kupona ni mdogo mno.

eng: Three images below have been shared publicly by the South Korean Coast Guard's Facebook page .
swa: Picha tatu hapa chini zimetolewa hadharani kupitia ukurasa wa Facebook wa Coast Guard .

eng: The first photo shows the boat's captain amongst the first group to be rescued.
swa: Picha ya kwanza inaonyesha nahodha wa mashua akiwa miongoni mwa kundi la kwanza kuokolewa.

eng: Image shared publicly by South Korean Coast Guard's Facebook page
swa: Picha imetolewa kwa umma na Ukurasa wa Facebook wa Coast Guard wa Korea Kusini

eng: Image of Sewol ferry rescue operation, shared by Korean Coast Guard's Facebook Page
swa: Picha ya Feri ya Sewol katika operesheni ya uokoaji, picha kwa hisani ya Ukurasa wa Facebook wa Coast Guard wa Korea Kusini

eng: Image of Rescue Operation, shared by Korean Coast Guard's Facebook page
swa: Picha ya operesheni ya uokoaji, kwa hisani ya Ukurasa wa Facebook wa Coast Guard wa Korea Kusini

eng: South Korean online venues have been inundated with messages of condolences for the victims and their loved ones and intense anger against the captain and crew members who evacuated early , well before most of the passengers.
swa: Mijadala ya mtandaoni nchini Korea Kusini imefurika salamu za rambirambi kwa waathirika na wapendwa wao pamoja na hasira kali dhidi ya nahodha na wafanyakazi ambao waliokolewa mapema zaidi kabla ya abiria.

eng: In particular, the on board announcement which told the passengers to stay still , even after the ferry started tilting, has further fueled the furor.
swa: Kilichochochea hasira zaidi ni tangazo linalosemekana kutolewa kwenye feri hiyo kuwaambia abiria waendelee kubaki ndani , hata wakati feri ilipoanza kuzama.

eng: During the 2003 Daegu Subway fire disaster, a majority of passengers died as the train conductor ran away after plucking away the master key.
swa: Mwaka 2003 wakati wa maafa ya moto ya reli ya chini ya ardhi ya Daegu, idadi kubwa ya abiria walikufa wakati kondakta wa treni alikimbia baada ya kukwanyua ufunguo.

eng: I hear the stories that the Sewol ferry’s captain and the conductor evacuated early.
swa: Mimi nasikia masimulizi kuwa nahodha wa feri ya Sewol na kondakta waliokolewa mapema.

eng: I wish it is false.
swa: Ningependa iwe ni uongo mtupu.

eng: If that is true, then they can't be forgiven nor escape punishment.
swa: Kama hiyo ni kweli, basi hawawezi kusamehewa wala kuepuka adhabu.

eng: The captain, after ordering a low-ranking female crew member to announce that the passengers should stay where they are, escaped well before anybody else.
swa: Nahodha, baada ya kuagiza mfanyakazi wa kike wa ngazi ya chini kutangaza kwamba abiria wanatakiwa kukaa mahali walipo, alitoroka vizuri kabla ya mtu mwingine yeyote.

eng: It reminds me of the historical event during the Korean War - when President Rhee Seung-man, after broadcasting that "now it is safe", ran away after cutting the Han River bridge.
swa: Inanikumbusha tukio la kihistoria wakati wa Vita vya Korea - wakati Rais Rhee Seung-man, baada ya kutangaza kwamba "sasa hali ni shwari", walikimbia baada ya kukata daraja mto Han.

eng: It's been over 60 years, but the history stays the same.
swa: Imekuwa ni zaidi ya miaka 60, lakini historia inajirudia.

eng: Authorities still can't confirm what caused the incident, and various speculations have sprung up, including that the ferry could have hit a rock.
swa: Mamlaka bado haijaweza kuthibitisha nini kilichosababisha tukio hilo, na uvumi mbalimbali imeibuka, ikiwa ni pamoja na feri inaweza kuwa iligonga mwamba.

eng: Currently, many blame the fact that the ship went through illegal remodeling to host more passengers.
swa: Hivi sasa, wengi wanatoa lawama kwamba meli ilifanyiwa utengenezaji kinyume cha sheria ili kuwabeba abiria zaidi.

eng: Korean net users discussed the unsolved mysteries.
swa: Watumiaji mtandao Korea wakijadili siri ambazo hazijatatuliwa.

eng: There are remaining questions: 1) How was the ferry wrecked in an area with no reef and on a clear weather day 2) There is a big dent on the right side of the hull.
swa: Kuna maswali yaliyobaki: 1) jinsi gani feri ilizama katika eneo hilo na hakuna mwamba na hali ya hewa ilikuwa nzuri siku hiyo 2) Upande wa kulia wa sehemu kuu ya Feri kumebonyea sana.

eng: 3) Announcing "stay put" while the ship started tilting 4) The crew and captain evacuated first 5) The distress call was made at 8:58 by a passenger 6) Local fisherman noticed there is something wrong with Sewol at 7:30.
swa: 3) Tangazo la "kaeni mlipo" wakati meli ilianza kuzama4) wafanyakazi na nahodha kuokolewa kwanza 5) wito wa dhiki ulifanywa saa 8:58 na abiria 6) mvuvi mdogo kuona kuna kitu kisicho sawa na Sewol saa 7:30.

eng: Many blamed sensational and insensitive media coverage.
swa: Wengi walilaumu hisia na kuchukulia urahisi kupitia kwa vyombo vya habari.

eng: If you look at Munhwa newspaper's initial report, you can see how lazy they were in reporting this issue.
swa: Kama ukiangalia ripoti ya awali ya gazeti la Munhwa, unaweza kuona jinsi walikuwa wavivu katika kuripoti suala hili.

eng: MBC talks about money even before the rescue operation has ended.
swa: Mazungumzo MBC kuhusu fedha za hata kabla ya operesheni ya kuwaokoa kumalizika.

eng: KBS focuses more on the president's reaction than the survivors and updates on the rescue mission (by blogger with the online handle of "I am Peter")
swa: KBS inalenga zaidi juu ya majibu ya rais kuliko waathirika na taarifa juu ya ujumbe wa kuwaokoa (kupitia mwanabloglu kwenye mtandao kupitia alama ashiria "Mimi ni Peter")

eng: The rescue mission is under way.
swa: Ujumbe wa kuwaokoa unaendelea.

eng: However, the victims' relatives and families have released a statement lashing out that information is still lacking and the scale of the rescue team has been greatly exaggerated.
swa: Hata hivyo, jamaa na familia ya waathirika walitoa taarifa kukemea kwamba bado hakuna taarifa zinazoeleweka pamoja na habari za kutiwa chumvi kuhusu ukubwa wa timu ya waokoaji.

eng: When we arrived at 5:30 at the Jindo gymnasium emergency center, there was not a single staff member who was responsible for telling people what's going on.
swa: Tulipofika saa 5:30 katika ukumbi wa michezo wa Jindo ambapo ni kituo cha dharura, hakukuwa na mfanyakazi ambaye alikuwa na wajibu wa kuwaambia watu nini kinaendelea.

eng: There was not even a control center We visited the accident scene yesterday.
swa: Hakukuwa hata na kituo cha udhibiti Sisi tulitembelea eneo la ajali jana.

eng: The rescue team was less than 200. There were only two helicopters, two marine boats, two coast guard boats, six special forces boats.
swa: Timu ya kuwaokoa ilikuwa chini ya watu 200 Kulikuwa na helikopta mbili tu, mashua mbili baharini, mashua mbili za walinzi wa pwani, mashua sita ya vikosi maalum..

eng: And eight civil rescue team members have carried out the rescue mission.
swa: Na watu wanane wa timu ya uokoaji wamefanya zoezi la kuokoa.

eng: However, the Disaster Headquarters have lied to us that they have dispatched 555 rescue team members, 121 helicopters and 169 boats.
swa: Hata hivyo, Makao Makuu ya maafa yamesema uongo kwetu sisi kwamba wao waliwapeleka wanachama 555 wa uokoaji, helikopta 121 na mashua 169.

eng: **Further update is to come about the disaster.
swa: **Ripoti zaidi itafuatilia kuhusu maafa.

eng: Former Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad wanted Boeing to take responsibility for the mysterious disappearance of Malaysian Airline flight MH370.
swa: Waziri Mkuu wa zamani wa Malaysia Mahathir Mohamad ameitaka Boeing kuwajibika kufuatia tukio la kupotea kwa ndege ya Shirika la ndege la Malaysia yenye namba MH370.

eng: He wrote in his blog:
swa: Hivi ndivyo alivyoandika kwenye blogu yake:

eng: Boeing built this aircraft.
swa: Boeing ndiyo imetengeneza ndege hii.

eng: Boeing must explain how all these means of tracking the plane can be disabled, can fail.
swa: Boeing lazima waeleze inakuwaje njia zote za kuifuatilia mwenendo wa ndege hiyo ziweze kuzimwa.

eng: Either Boeing technology is poor or it is not fail-safe.
swa: Ni ama teknolojia ya Boeing ni duni au haina uhakika.

eng: I would not like to fly in Boeing aircraft unless Boeing can explain how all its system can fail or be disabled.
swa: Sitapenda tena kupanda ndege ya Boeing mpaka waeleze kwa nini mifumo yake yote inaweza kuzima kienyeji au kushindwa kufanya kazi.

eng: Boeing must accept responsibility for building an aircraft that can disappear in mid-air so completely.
swa: Boeing lazima wakubali kuwajibika kwa kutengeneza ndege ambayo ingeweza kupotea tu hewani na isionekane tena.

eng: Win Tin, legendary Burmese journalist and activist, died last April 21.
swa: Win Tin, mwandishi wa habari na mwanaharakati maarufu wa Burmese, alifariki Aprili 21.

eng: Photo from @hrw (Human Rights WatchVeteran Burmese journalist and pro-democracy activist U Win Tin died of renal failure on April 21, 2014 at the age of 85.
swa: Picha kutoka kwa @ HRW (Haki dhibiti za Binadamu.Mwandishi wa habari na mwanaharakati wa kidemokrasia mkongwe U Win Tin alifariki kwa matatizo ya figo mnamo Aprili 21, 2014 akiwa na umri wa miaka 85.

eng: Before the rise of the military junta in the 1960s, Win Tin was editor of Myanmar’s most popular newspaper.
swa: Kabla ya kuingia madarakani kwa serikali ya kijeshi ya Junta katika miaka ya 1960, Win Tin alikuwa mhariri wa gazeti maarufu la Myanmar.

eng: In 1988, he helped form the opposition National League for Democracy (NLD) and supported the candidacy of Aung San Suu Kyi.
swa: Mwaka wa 1988, alisaidia kuunda chama cha upinzani cha National League for Democracy (NLD) na kumwuunga mkono mgombea Aung San Suu Kyi.

eng: He was accused of being a communist and got arrested in 1989.
swa: Alishtakiwa kwa kuwa mkomunisti na kukamatwa mwaka wa 1989.

eng: After three years, his prison term was extended after he was charged with sedition.
swa: Baada ya miaka mitatu, muda wake gerezani uliongezwa baada ya kushtakiwa tena kwa uchochezi.

eng: In 1996, he was convicted again to another seven years in jail after he sent an 83-page report to the United Nations about the poor prison conditions in Myanmar.
swa: Mwaka wa 1996, alikutwa na hatia tena na kuhukumiwa tena miaka mingine saba katika jela baada ya yeye kutuma ripoti yenye kurasa 83 kwa Umoja wa Mataifa kuelezea hali ilivyo mbaya katika magereza ya Myanmar.

eng: He was finally released in 2008 after being incarcerated for 19 years.
swa: Hatimaye aliachiliwa mwaka wa 2008 baada ya kufungwa kwa miaka 19.

eng: But despite regaining his freedom, he continued to wear a blue prison shirt in solidarity with other political prisoners.
swa: Lakini hata baada ya kurejeshewa uhuru wake, aliendelea kuvaa shati la rangi ya bluu la wafungwa akiwakumbuka na kuwaunga mkono wafungwa wengine wa kisiasa.

eng: He remained a loyal and good friend of Aung San Suu Kyi although he was critical of some of her political decisions including the participation of the NLD in the elections.
swa: Aliendela kuwa rafiki mwaminifu na mzuri wa Aung San Suu Kyi ingawa alikosoa baadhi ya maamuzi yake ya kisiasa ikiwa ni pamoja na ushiriki wa NLD katika uchaguzi.

eng: Win Tin was Myanmar’s longest-held political prisoner.
swa: Win Tin alikuwa mfungwa wa kisiasa aliyefungwa kwa muda mrefu.

eng: Unlike Aung San Suu Kyi who was placed under house arrest, Win Tin was detained in a cell designed for military dogs.
swa: Tofauti na Aung San Suu Kyi ambaye aliwekwa chini ya kifungo cha nyumbani, Win Tin alikuwa kizuizini katika seli iliyojengwa maalumu kwa ajili ya kuwaweka mbwa wa kijeshi.

eng: Zin Linn, a former political prisoner, described Win Tin’s prison cell:
swa: Zin Linn, mfungwa wa zamani wa kisiasa, alielezea kuhusu gereza la Win Tin:

eng: They put him alone in his cell.
swa: Walimweka peke yake katika seli yake.

eng: The cell was 8.5 x 11.5 feet.
swa: Seli ilikuwa ya ukubwa wa futi 8.5 x 11.5.

eng: There was only a bamboo mat on the concrete floor.
swa: Kulikuwa na mkeka wa mianzi pekee juu ya sakafu.

eng: Sleeping, eating, walking and cleaning the bowels were done in the very same place.
swa: Kulala, kula, kutembea na kujisaidia haja vyote hivyo vilifanyika katika sehemu moja.

eng: He could not see the sun, the moon or the stars.
swa: Hakuweza kuona jua, mwezi au nyota.

eng: He was intentionally barred from breathing fresh air, tasting nourishing food and drinking a drop of fresh water.
swa: Alizuiliwa makusudi kupumua hewa safi, kuonja chakula bora na kunywa tone la maji safi.

eng: The worst thing was to stay lonely in such a cage for years.
swa: Jambo baya zaidi ni kukaa pekee katika kizimba hicho kwa miaka.

eng: He called Win Tin ‘the most valiant journalist in Burma’:
swa: Alimtaja Win Tin kama 'mwandishi wa habari hodari katika Burma':

eng: For the junta, U Win Tin is really a rocky mountain.
swa: Kwa Junta, U Win Tin kwa hakika ni mlima wenye miamba.

eng: Although they wish to crush that mountain, they could never do it.
swa: Ingawa wanataka kuponda mlima huo, kamwe hawawatoweza kufanya hivyo.

eng: But as tough as was with his oppressors, his tenderness towards his comrades and his people was boundless.
swa: Lakini kama alivyokuwa jasiri dhidi ya watesi wake, huruma yake kwa wandugu wake na watu wake ilikuwa kubwa kupita kiasi.

eng: He truly deserves great honor for his sacrifices.
swa: Kwa kweli anastahili heshima kubwa kwa ajili ya sadaka yake.

eng: Kyaw Zwa Moe, editor of the Irrawaddy magazine, noted how Win Tin never compromised with the ruling junta despite his failing health:
swa: Kyaw Zwa Moe, mhariri wa jarida la Irrawaddy, alibainisha jinsi ambavyo Win Tin hakupata kamwe kuafikiana na serikali ya Junta licha ya afya yake kudhoofika:

eng: But for any oppressive government, Win Tin was a great enemy.
swa: Lakini kwa serikali yoyote yenye ukandamizaji, Win Tin alikuwa adui mkubwa.

eng: Due to his political activities, the former regime put him in jail for nearly two decades, tortured him, withheld medical treatment and confiscated his home.
swa: Kutokana na harakati zake za kisiasa, serikali ya zamani ilimfunga jela kwa karibu miongo miwili, walimtesa, kumnyima matibabu na kumpokonya nyumbani kwake.

eng: When they eventually released him in 2008, they demanded that he remain on parole.
swa: Hatimaye walipomwachilia huru mwaka wa 2008, aliombA abaki kwenye kifungo cha nje.

eng: Still, despite their pressure, he never backed down from his principles.
swa: Hata hivyo, licha ya shinikizo lao, kamwe hakuacha misimamo yake

eng: Ye Htut, deputy minister of information, released a statement in behalf of the government:
swa: Ye Htut, naibu waziri wa habari, alitoa taaarifa kwa niaba ya serikali:

eng: We have different political views than Win Tin, but we all take our hats off to him for his commitment to his beliefs and for his sacrifices.
swa: Kisiasa hatukubaliani kimsimamo na Win Tin, lakini tunatoa heshima zetu kwa msimamo wake na imani ya kujitolea kwake.

eng: Though we don’t agree with him, we take seriously his good intentions to make the country developed, democratic and prosperous in the ways he believed.
swa: Ingawa hatukubaliani naye, tunathamini nia yake nzuri ya kufanya nchi hii iendelee kidemokrasia katika njia ya mafanikio aliyoiamini.

eng: We believe U Win Tin’s death is a great loss—not only the loss of an open voice of criticism in Burmese politics, but also Burmese media has lost a journalist of experience and wisdom.
swa: Tunaamini kifo cha U Win Tin ni hasara kubwa si tu hasara ya sauti wazi ya upinzani katika siasa za Burmese, lakini pia vyombo vya habari vya Burmese vimepoteza mwandishi wa habari mwenye uzoefu na hekima.

eng: Mya Aye, member of the 88 Generation Students Group, recognized Win Tin as a humble and selfless leader:
swa: Mya Aye, mwanachama wa 88 Generation Students Group, alimtambua Win Tin kama kiongozi mnyenyekevu na wazi :

eng: We must be proud of him and think of him as a role-model politician …He didn’t want to bother anyone.
swa: Ni lazima tujivunie mtu huyu na kumwona kama mfano wa mwanasiasa wa kuigwa ... Hakutaka kumsumbua mtu yeyote.

eng: He even had a wish for an immediate funeral.
swa: Tena aliacha wosia wa kutaka mazishi ya haraka.

eng: He was a selfless man.
swa: Alikuwa mtu muwazi.

eng: He didn’t want any property for himself, he only served the country.
swa: Hakutaka mali yoyote kwa ajili yake mwenyewe, alitumikia nchi kipekee.

eng: He deserved to see that which he sacrificed for.
swa: Alistahili kuona yale ambayo yeye alijitolea kwa ajili yake.

eng: Aung Zaw described Win Tin as a guiding light of the democracy movement:
swa: Aung Zaw alimwelezea Win Tin kama mwanga elekezi wa harakati za demokrasia:

eng: Win Tin was a keen, unrelenting government critic to the very end, intent on taking down all the obstacles on Burma’s long road to democracy.
swa: Win Tin alikuwa mwenye nia, jasiri katika kukosoa serikali hadi mwisho, na dhamira ya kuepuka vikwazo vyote vya Burma kwa safari ndefu ya demokrasia.

eng: Without his guiding light, it’s hard to imagine how the democracy movement will treat the many challenges ahead during this unpredictable democratic transition, where there are still many wolves in sheep’s clothing.
swa: Bila ya mwanga wake kuongoza, ni vigumu kufikiria jinsi harakati ya kidemokrasia itakavyokumbwa na changamoto nyingi zijazo wakati huu wa kidemokrasia mpito usiotabiriki, ambapo bado kuna mbwa mwitu wengi waliovaa mavazi ya kondoo.

eng: For me, the film tells a story of a strong and independent mind – a man who dared to say “no”, when all others said “yes”.
swa: Kwangu mimi, filamu inaelezea hadithi ya akili yenye nguvu na huru - mtu ambaye alijitokeza na kusema "hapana", wakati wengine wote wakisema "ndiyo".

eng: A man who liked to be alone sometimes, but also appreciated the company of the many friends he made during his life.
swa: Mtu ambaye alipenda kuwa peke yake wakati mwingine, lakini pia alipenda kukaa na marafiki wengi aliokuwa nao wakati wa uhai wake.

eng: From time to time, he was a little bit obstinate and rebellious, but it’s this kind of person that makes it all more interesting, I think.
swa: Mara kwa mara, alikuwa mkaidi na mwasi kidogo, lakini ni aina hii ya mtu inayofanya mambo yote kuvutia zaidi, nadhani.

eng: I will miss my uncle from Burma, because I would have liked to show him that many journalists and filmmakers will continue to work for better journalism in his country.
swa: Nitamkumbuka mjomba wangu kutoka Burma, kwa sababu ningelipenda kumfanya aonekane kuwa waandishi wa habari ambaye watengenezaji wa filamu watamuenzi na kufanya kazi ya uandishi wa habari kuwa bora zaidi katika nchi yake.

eng: He would have liked that.
swa: Yeye angependa iwe hivyo.

eng: Kenneth Roth, executive director of the Human Rights Watch, paid tribute to Win Tin:
swa: Kenneth Roth, mkurugenzi mtendaji wa Haki za Binadamu, aliandika tanzia ya Win Tin:

eng: U Win Tin was the exemplar of dignified courage and principle against decades of brutal military rule.
swa: U Win Tin alikuwa Mfano wa ujasiri wenye heshima na kanuni dhidi ya miongo kadhaa ya utawala wa kikatili wa kijeshi.

eng: U Win Tin inspired an entire generation of activists who have taken up his call and struggle to make Burma a rights-respecting democracy.
swa: U Win Tin aliongoza kizazi chote cha wanaharakati ambao walikubali wito wake na mapambano ya kufanya Burma kuwa na haki za kuheshimu demokrasia.

eng: The U.S. Campaign for Burma also honored Win Tin:
swa: Blogu ya US campaign for Burma pia ilikuwa na tanzia kwa Win Tin:

eng: As the movement to establish a free Burma continues, let us pay homage to a man who dedicated his life to the cause.
swa: Kama harakati ya kuanzisha Burma huru zikiendelea, hebu tumuenzi mtu aliyejitolea maisha yake kwa sababu hiyo.

eng: U Win Tin was a journalist, a prisoner, a leader, and an icon.
swa: U Win Tin alikuwa mwandishi wa habari, mfungwa, kiongozi, na mfano wa kuigwa.

eng: Though he is no longer with us, we hope to help create the type of country U Win Tin sought: one represented by the people, all people, unbound by authoritarian control.
swa: Ingawa hayupo tena nasi, tunatumaini kusaidia kujenga aina ya nchi U Win Tin aliyoitaka: moja inayowakilishwa na watu, watu wote, isiyo na utawala wa kimabavu.

eng: The International Federation for Human Rights (FIDH) Secretary-General Debbie Stothard recalled how Win Tin never backed down in criticizing the ‘flawed reform process’ undertaken by the current civilian government:
swa: Katibu mkuu wa shirikisho la Kimataifa la Haki za Binadamu (FIDH) Debbie Stothard alikumbuka jinsi ambavyo Win Tin hakuwahi kuacha kukosoa 'dosari za mchakato wa mageuzi' zilizofanywa na serikali ya sasa ya raia:

eng: When many were applauding the recent progress in Burma, we needed Win Tin to remind us of the sober reality of the country’s flawed reform process.
swa: Wakati wengi walikuwa wanapongeza maendeleo ya hivi karibuni nchini Burma, tulihitaji Win Tin kutukumbusha ukweli wa dosari ya mchakato wa mageuzi ya nchi.

eng: He will be greatly missed but never forgotten.
swa: Atakumbukwa sana na kwa kweli hatasahaulika kamwe.

eng: A small leopard cat.
swa: Chui mdogo.

eng: Photo is taken by the Wildlife First Aid Station and reprinted by leopardcatgo.
swa: Picha kwa hisani ya stesheni ya huduma ya kwanza ya Wanyamapori imechapishwa na leopardcatgo.

eng: Leopard cat is listed as a vulnerable species in Taiwan.
swa: Chui wameorodheshwa kama wanyama wanaoishi kwenye mazingira magumu nchini Taiwan.

eng: Since the big cats live in the forests and jungles in both plains and in hilly areas and their home range is very broad, their habitats in Taiwan are easily disturbed by new construction projects.
swa: Kwa kuwa chui wakubwa huishi misituni na mwituni katika maeneo tambarare na yale yenye milima na makazi yao ni aina tofauti sana. Makazi yao nchini Taiwan yanasumbuliwa kwa sababu ya miradi mipya ya ujenzi.

eng: The Taiwanese environmental evaluation committee had temporally rejected the request from the Miaoli Government to develop an alternative road in Miaoli across the habitat of leopard cats on April 16 2014 after a round of protests and petition.
swa: Kamati ya tathmini ya mazingira ya Taiwan ilikuwa imekataa kwa muda ombi kutoka Serikali ya Miaoli kuendeleza barabara mbadala katika Miaoli inayopita katikati ya makazi ya chui mnamo Aprili 16 2014 baada ya kusambaa maandamano na malalamiko ya kusitishwa mradi huo.

eng: However, this development project was not dropped, and more development projects in this area are coming up.
swa: Hata hivyo, mradi huu wa maendeleo haukusimamishwa, na miradi ya maendeleo zaidi katika eneo hili inaendelea kubuniwa.

eng: A facebook page was set up so people who want to protect the leopard cats in Taiwan can be well informed and mobilized.
swa: Ukurasa wa facebook ulianzishwa ili watu ambao wanaotaka kuwalinda chui nchini Taiwan waweza kupata taarifa vizuri na kuhamasishwa.

eng: Typhoon Haiyan caused a ship to ran aground in Leyte, destroying houses in a crowded coastal village.
swa: Kimbunga Haiyan kilichosababisha meli kukwama katika eneo la Leyte na kuharibu nyumba katika kijiji cha pwani.

eng: Photo by Alessandro Pavone/ Save the ChildrenAlso see Haiyan Devastates the Philippines, our special coverage page.
swa: Picha kwa hisani ya Alessandro Pavone / Tuwaokoe WatotoPia tazama Haiyan yaikumba Ufilipino.

eng: Six months ago, thousands died in Eastern Visayas in the Philippines after it was hit by super typhoon Haiyan (local name: Yolanda).
swa: Miezi sita iliyopita, maelfu walifariki katika eneo la Mashariki mwa Visayas nchini Philippines baada ya kukumbwa na kimbunga kikubwa cha Haiyan (ama kwa jina lingine Yolanda).

eng: Today, thousands continue to suffer due to the lack of a comprehensive government master plan to rehabilitate the devastated region.
swa: Leo, maelfu bado wanaendelea kuteseka kutokana na ukosefu wa mpango wa kina wa serikali wa kukarabati eneo lililoharibiwa.

eng: After learning about this report, Senator Chiz Escudero berated local officials for failing to understand the gravity of the situation:
swa: Baada ya kufahamu kuhusu ripoti hii, Seneta Chiz Escudero alikosoa maafisa wa serikali kwa kushindwa kuelewa uzito wa hali:

eng: This is very sad.
swa: Inahuzunisha sana.

eng: Six months after Yolanda, more than a year after the previous disasters we don't even know what exactly the affected communities need?
swa: Miezi sita baada ya kimbunga cha Yolanda, zaidi ya mwaka baada ya maafa yaliyopita hatujui hata ni nini hasa wanajamii walioathirika wanachohitaji?

eng: It is not about what we can give or what we will to give.
swa: Sio juu ya nini tunaweza kutoa au tunachotaka kuwapatia?

eng: This lackadaisical attitude is prolonging the anguish of victims.
swa: Tabia hii ya kutojali ni ya kuwaongezea machungu waathirika.

eng: It is bordering on criminal already.
swa: Tunachokifanya ni sawa na jinai.

eng: Exacerbating the problem is the lack of coordination among government agencies:
swa: Kuongezeka kwa matatizo ni ukosefu wa uratibu miongoni mwa mashirika ya serikali:

eng: Haiyan caused a storm surge last November which destroyed thousands of villages.
swa: Haiyan ilisababisha kuongezeka kwa dhoruba mwezi Novemba mwaka jana hali iliyoharibu maelfu ya vijiji.

eng: More than 16 million people were affected by the disaster.
swa: Zaidi ya watu milioni 16 waliathirika na maafa.

eng: Several organizations have observed that the typhoon victims are slowly recovering but many problems persist.
swa: Mashirika kadhaa yalibainisha kwamba waathirika wa kimbunga wanapata nafuu pole pole lakini matatizo mengi yanaendelea.

eng: The Red Cross lamented that basic services have not been restored in some areas:
swa: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu lilielezea kuwa huduma za msingi bado hazijarejeshwa katika baadhi ya maeneo:

eng: Affected communities have shown remarkable strength and many are on the road to recovery.
swa: Jamii zilizoathirika zimeonyesha nguvu ya ajabu na wengi wanaelekea kupona.

eng: However, high levels of pre-existing poverty are holding people back and in some areas basic services have not been re-established.
swa: Hata hivyo, viwango vya juu vya umaskini vya awali vililivyokuwa vyafanya watu kubaki nyuma na katika baadhi ya maeneo huduma za msingi hazijatengemaa

eng: Only half of health clinics in the typhoon-damaged provinces have resumed operations which undermined the health of mothers and newborns.
swa: Ni nusu tu ya vituo vya afya katika mikoa iliyoathirika na kimbunga zimerudisha tena shughuli za kawaida hali ambayo imedhoofisha afya ya akina mama na watoto wanaozaliwa.

eng: This report from Save the Children:
swa: Hii ni ripoti kutoka Hifadhi ya Watoto

eng: At a medical center in Eastern Visayas, several babies died from conditions that are normally treatable, such as hypothermia and hypoglycemia, often because nurses were unable to examine newborns properly at night because there was no power for lights.
swa: Katika kituo cha afya katika eneo la Mashariki mwa Visayas, watoto kadhaa walikufa kutokana na hali ambayo kwa kawaida hutibika, kama vile hypothermia na hypoglycemia, kwa sababu wauguzi hawakuweza kuchunguza watoto wachanga vizuri usiku kwa sababu hapakuwa na umeme kuwezesha kuwasha taa.

eng: Four months after the typhoon, only half of affected communities had seen their health centers reopen.
swa: Miezi minne baada ya kimbunga, nusu tu ya jamii zilioathirika ndio wameshuhudia vituo vyao vya afya vikifunguliwa tena upya.

eng: Challenges in delivering critical childbirth and newborn care services were specially great in Tacloban and Leyte.
swa: Changamoto katika huduma muhimu za kujifungua na kutunza watoto wachanga huduma zilikuwa sawa katika Tacloban na Leyte.

eng: Meanwhile, Oxfam warned that 200,000 survivors in coastal areas are at risk of worsening poverty because the government plans to relocate them to safe settlements without adequate consideration as to how they will later earn a living.
swa: Wakati huo huo, Oxfam ilionya kuwa waathirika 200,000 katika maeneo ya pwani wako katika hatari ya kuathirika zaidi na umasikini kwa sababu mipango ya serikali ya kuwahamishia kwenye makazi salama bila kuzingatia jinsi wataendesha maisha yao baadae.

eng: Professor Carl Ramota visited the Palo campus of the country’s premier state university and reported the deplorable conditions in the school:
swa: Profesa Carl Ramota alitembelea chuo kikuu cha Palo na kutoa taarifa ya hali ya kusikitisha katika shule:

eng: Six months after typhoon Yolanda decimated its campus in Palo, Leyte, there is still no clear plan for the rehabilitation or relocation of the UP School of Health Sciences.
swa: Miezi sita baada ya kimbunga Yolanda kuathiri chuo chake cha Palo, Leyte, bado hakuna mpango wa wazi kwa ajili ya ukarabati au kuhamishwa kwa Shule Kuu ya Sayansi ya Afya.

eng: While nearby structures are already being reconstructed, the Palo campus remains in ruins.
swa: Wakati vyombo vya jirani tayari vinajengwa upya, chuo kikuu cha Palo bado kiko katika hali mbaya.

eng: Worse, the asbestos roofing in the old SHS building has not yet been removed, posing a threat to the maternity clinic beside it and other residents.
swa: Mbaya zaidi, paa la jengo kuu la kitivo hicho bado halijaondolewa, na ni tishio kwa kliniki ya uzazi inaendelea na shughuli zake pembeni mwake pamoja na wakazi wengine jirani.

eng: Photo from Facebook page of Carl Ramota
swa: Picha kutoka ukurasa wa Facebook wa Carl Ramota

eng: Youth leader Divs Mosquera also visited Tacloban, the ‘ground zero’ of the disaster, and was moved by the stories of the typhoon survivors.
swa: Kiongozi wa vijana Divs Mosquera pia alitembelea Tacloban, eneo lililoathirika zaidi na maafa, na kuhuzunishwa na habari za waathirika wa kimbunga.

eng: Months after Yolanda, Leyte is still a tent city.
swa: Miezi kadhaa baada ya Yolanda, Leyte bado ni mji uliotawaliwa na mahema.

eng: I've cried buckets since I arrived, hearing the survivors' stories just breaks my heart.
swa: Nimelia sana tangu nilipofika, kusikiliza habari za waathirika. Inavunja tu moyo wangu.

eng: Government statistics placed the number of dead at about 6,300.
swa: Takwimu za serikali zilitaja kuwa idadi ya waliopotezha maisha imefikia 6300.

eng: But the figures could be higher because dead bodies are still being retrieved in the region.
swa: Lakini takwimu zinaweza kuwa za juu kwa sababu maiti bado zinaendelea kuondolewa katika eneo hilo.

eng: Al Octaviano, a resident of Leyte province, said that many dead bodies are not being reported to authorities:
swa: Al Octaviano, mkazi wa mkoa wa Leyte, alisema kuwa mingi ya miili ya waliokufa hairipotiwi kwa mamlaka:

eng: I tied them together so they would not be washed away by the sea, but you know when bodies are immersed in sea water, they fall apart.
swa: Niliwafunga wote pamoja ili wasibebwe na maji ya bahari, lakini unajua wakati miili imezama katika maji ya bahari, humomonyoka.

eng: There are also many bones buried in the mud of the shallows, but people don’t report these anymore.
swa: Pia kuna mifupa mingi iliyozikwa katika matope ya kina, lakini watu hawatoi taarifa tena.

eng: For its part, the government acknowledged the criticisms of its relief work but warned against politicians who are exploiting the situation to advance their political agenda:
swa: Kwa upande wake, serikali ilikubali kukosolewa kwa kazi yake ya kutoa misaada lakini ilionya dhidi ya wanasiasa ambao wanaitumia hali hiyo kuendeleza ajenda zao za kisiasa:

eng: ...we are likewise cynical of those whose agenda includes misleading our people to believe that government is not sensitive enough to alleviate the suffering of the survivors.
swa: ...Vivyo hivyo Kudanganywa na wale ambao agenda yao ni pamoja na kupotosha watu wetu kuamini kwamba serikali haikuwa makini vya kutosha kupunguza mateso ya waathirika.

eng: We detest politicians and political groups who strive to put blinders in exploiting the vulnerability of victims of Yolanda.
swa: Sisi tunachukizwa na wanasiasa na makundi ya kisiasa ambayo hujitahidi kuweka vizingiti katika kutumia mazingira magumu ya waathirika wa Yolanda.

eng: Nigerian bloggers have added their voice to the #BringBackOurGirls campaign:
swa: Wanablogu wa Nigeria wameongezea sauti zao kwa kampeni ya #BringBackOurGirls:

eng: We, the under signed Nigerian bloggers, view with grave concern the continued detention of the innocent school girls who were abducted from Chibok on April 15, 2014.
swa: Sisi, wanablogu wa Nigeria tuliotia saini zetu hapa chini, kwa mtazamo na wasiwasi kwa kuendelea kukamatwa kwa wasichana wa shule wasio na hatia ambao walitekwa kutoka Chibok Aprili 15, 2014.

eng: We are of the strong view that no amount of social grievance either against the government and or the people of Nigeria can justify such an act of violence against school children.
swa: Ni maoni yetu kwamba hakuna kiasi cha kero za kijamii ama dhidi ya serikali na au watu wa Nigeria unaweza kuhalalisha tendo hili la unyanyasaji dhidi ya watoto wa shule.

eng: We therefore condemn the abduction in very strong terms.
swa: Kwa hiyo tunalaani vikali utekaji nyara huo.

eng: The also called on their government to expedient action in getting back the abducted high school students from the Boko haram terrorists:
swa: Pia walitoa wito kwa serikali yao kuchukua hatua kuhakikisha kuwa wanafunzi hao wa sekondari waliotekwa nyara na magaidi wa Boko haram wanapatikana:

eng: We also call on the government of Nigeria to do everything in its power, even if it includes involving an international security agency, to bring the girls back from the hands of those who currently hold them, and restore a sense of security to the country as soon as possible.
swa: Sisi, pia twatoa wito kwa serikali ya Nigeria kufanya kila kilichokwenye uwezo wake, hata kama hiyo itamaanisha kushirikiana na shirika la kimataifa la usalama, kuwaokoa wasichana kutoka mikono ya wanaowashikilia kwa sasa, na kurejesha hali ya usalama katika nchi kwa haraka iwezekanavyo.

eng: Elections are coming up next year.
swa: Uchaguzi unafanyika mwaka ujao.

eng: Citizens want to be able to feel safe wherever they are.
swa: Wananchi wanataka kuwa na uwezo wa kujisikia wako salama popote pale walipo.

eng: Democracy thrives best when citizens feel empowered to pursue their daily chores without fear or threat to their lives and property.
swa: Demokrasia hunawiri vyema wakati raia wanahisi kuwezeshwa kufanya shughuli zao za kila siku bila hofu au tishio kwa maisha wala mali zao.

eng: If our own children were to go missing we would want the world to come to a standstill and help us find them.
swa: Kama watoto wetu wangetoweka tungelipenda dunia yote kusimama na kuja kutusaidia kuwatafuta wao.

eng: We...ask that...you consider why so often women’s bodies become the battlefields upon which wars are fought.
swa: Sisi ... tunauliza kwamba ... kwa nini mara nyingi miili ya wanawake huwa uwanja wa vita ambapo vita hupiganiwa.

eng: This is not a problem that involves a small town in Nigeria, this involves all girls everywhere.
swa: Hili si tatizo ambalo linahusisha mji mdogo nchini Nigeria, ni tatizo la wasichana wote kila mahali.

eng: China has detained prominent rights lawyer Pu Zhiqiang on the charge of “causing a disturbance,” what is seen as an attempt to deter activists from marking the upcoming 25th anniversary of the crackdown on pro-democracy protests in Tiananmen Square.
swa: China imemweka kizuizini mwanasheria maarufu mtetezi wa haki za binadamu Pu Zhiqiang ikimtuhumu 'kusababisha usumbufu,' kwa kile kinachoonekana kuwa jaribio la kuhamisha mawazo ya wanaharakati ili wasilipe uzito tukio la maandamano ya 25 ya kudai demokrasia ilivyominywa kwa muda mrefu kwenye Viwanja vya Tiananmen.

eng: According to newspaper South China Morning Post, Pu had been criminally detained by Beijing police after attending a meeting to commemorate the 1989 crackdown on democracy as well as "explore its implications and consequences and call for an investigation into the truth of June 4.’’
swa: Kwa mujibu wa gazeti la South China Morning Post, Pu amekamatwa kama mhalifu na plisi wa Beijing baada ya kuwa amehudhuria mkutano wa kuadhimisha kuminywa kwa demokrasia pamoja na "kurudusu maana na matokeo yake na kutoa wito wa uchunguzi wa kina kuhusu ukweli wa yaliyotokea siku ya Juni 4.’’

eng: At least 15 people – scholars, activists and relatives of the victims killed in the Tiananmen crackdown – attended the gathering at a private home in Beijing on May 3, 2014.
swa: Watu wasiopungua 15 -wakiwemo wanazuoni, wanaharakati na jamaa wa wahanga waliouawa kwenye ghasia za Tiananmen – walihudhuria mkutano huo kwenye nyumba ya mtu binafsi jijini Beijing mnamo Mei 3, 2014.

eng: At least five other people taken away for questioning after the meeting.
swa: Watu wengine wasiopungua watano wamechukuliwa kwa mahojiano baada ya mkutano huo.

eng: Photos of Pu in the 1989 Tiananmen protest.
swa: Picha ya Pu katika maandamano ya 1989 katika viwanja vya Tiananmen.

eng: Photo circulated on Twitter.
swa: Picha hiyo inasambazwa kwenye mtandao wa twita.

eng: Pu is a prominent figure in the Weiquan movement, having advocated for writers and journalists in a number of high-profile cases, including artist Ai Weiwei.
swa: Pu ni mtu maarufu anayejulikana kwenye harakati za Weiquan, akiwa amewahi kuwatetea waandishi na wanahabari katika kesi kadhaa maarufu, ikiwa ni pamoja na msanii Ai Weiwei.

eng: He was featured in magazines for leading campaign against labour camps.
swa: Aliandikwa sana kwenye magazeti kwa kuongoza kampeni dhidi ya makambi ya kufanyishwa kazi.

eng: Due to his outspoken criticisms of official policies, Pu is monitored by security forces, and has been detained and questioned on several occasions.
swa: Kufuatia tabia yake ya kukosoa sera rasmi za serikali, Pu amejikuta mara kadhaa akifuatiliwa sana na vyombo vya usalama, na amekamatwa na kuhojiwa mara nyingi.

eng: Pu was banned from all microblogging platforms in China in 2013 after he used them to publicly criticize retired senior leader of the Communist Party Zhou Yongkang.
swa: Pu alipigwa marufuku kufanya chochote kwenye majukwaa ya mitandao ya kijamii nchini China mwaka 2013 baada ya kuwa ameyatumia majukwaa hayo kumkosoa hadharani kiongozi mkuu wa Chama cha Kikomunisti Zhou Yongkang.

eng: Pu also participated in the 1989 pro-democracy movement as a student.
swa: Pu vile vile alishiriki kwenye harakati za kudai demokrasi mwaka 1989 wakati huo akiwa mwanafunzi.

eng: Any information related to the Tiananmen movement is still censored in China.
swa: Habari zozote zinazohusiana na harakati za Tiananmen bado zinazuiwa nchini China.

eng: A search of “Tiananmen” on popular microblogging Sina Weibo reveals a message telling users that results cannot be found according to related laws and regulations.
swa: Kutafuta chochote kinachohusiana na neno “Tiananmen” kwenye mtandao maarufu wa kijamii nchini China Sina Weibo kutakutana na ujumbe unaomfahamisha mtafutaji kuwa majibu hayawezi kupatikana kwa mujibu wa sheria na kanuni zinazohusika.

eng: However, most messages supporting Pu were deleted.

eng: Global Voices and CONNECTAS , Colombia-based Latin American journalistic organization, have partnered to share content produced by CONNECTAS on multilingual Global Voices network.
swa: Global Voices na CONNECTAS , shirika lenye mwelekeo wa kiuandishi wa habari la Amerika Kusini lenye makazi yake nchini Colombia, wamefikia makubaliano ya kushirikiana maudhui yanayoandikwa na CONNECTAS kwenye mtandao wa lugha nyingi wa Global Voices.

eng: CONNECTAS is a "non-profit journalistic initiative with the aim of promoting production, sharing, training and disseminating information related to topics that are fundamental for development in the Americas":
swa: CONNECTAS ni mradi usio wa kibiashara wenye mwelekeo wa kiuandishi wa habari wenye lengo la kuhamasisha uzalishaji, ushirikishwaji, mafunzo na usambazaji wa taarifa zinazohusiana na mada ambazo ni muhimu kwa maendeleo ya bara hilo":

eng: CONNECTAS appears in a moment where many opportunities converge in the region, and a need of information of their reality with a transnational prospect.
swa: CONNECTAS inajitokeza kwenye mkutaniko wa fursa nyingi katika eneo hilo, na hitaji la taarifa zenye ukweli wenye manufaa ya mataifa ya bara hilo.

eng: In the Americas, in spite of being a region with similar cultural, historic and linguistic features, of having an active civil society and a growing number of intergovernmental businesses and organizations, there is not enough information with a transnational perspective in the region.
swa: Katika nchi za Amerika Kusini, pamoja na kuwa kwenye eneo lenye utamaduni unaofanana, historia na hata lugha, lenye taasisi za kiraia zilizo hai na pia kuongezeka kwa biashara za baina ya serikali moja na nyingine, hakuna taarifa za kutosha na zenye kunufaisha mataifa hayo kwenye eneo hilo.

eng: Besides journalistic production, CONNECTAS facilitates journalist training in specialized techniques and topics and organizes meetings, forums and talks with opinion leaders and policymakers.
swa: Ukiacha maudhui ya kiuandishi wa habari, CONNECTAS inawezeshesha waandishi wa habari kupata mafunzo hususani kwenye mbinu mahsusi na mada pamoja na kuandaa mikutano, majadiliano na mazungumzo na viongozi maarufu pamoja na watunga sera.

eng: They also promote laws on access to public information in the region and data exchange for investigation, analysis, mapping and visualization.
swa: Pia wanatangaza sheria zinazohusu upatikanaji wa habari kwenye eneo hilo ikiwa ni pamoja na kubadilishana kwa takwimu kwa ajili ya uchunguzi, uchambuzi, utafiti na uelekezaji.

eng: We believe that the articles and reports produced by CONNECTAS will be a quality complement to our coverage of Latin America.
swa: Tunaamini kwamba makala na taarifa zinazozalishwa na CONNECTAS zinasaidia pia kwenye habari zetu za Amerika ya Kusini.

eng: Read the first article published in English by CONNECTAS on Global Voices, "How Gangs Have Become a Trojan Horse in El Salvador's Security Forces" The second part will be posted shortly.
swa: Soma makala ya kwanza iliyochapishwa kwa kiingereza na CONNECTAS kwenye mtandao wetu wa Global Voices, "Namna Magenge ya Wahuni Yalivyogeuka Kirusi kwenye Vyombo vya Kiusalama nchini El Salvador" Sehemu ya pili itachapishwa muda mfupi ujao.

eng: The Vietnam Human Rights Network released its 2013 report about the 'worsening' human rights situation in Vietnam:
swa: Mtandao wa haki za Binadamu illitoa ripoti yake ya 2013 kuhusu 'hali mbaya' ya haki za binadamu nchini Vietnam:

eng: ...the human rights situation in Vietnam took a turn for the worse in 2013.
swa: .... Hali ya haki za binadamu nchini Vietnam iligeuka na kuwa mbaya mwaka 2013.

eng: The number of people detained for political views contrary to those of the ruling party increased, unabated police violence was reflected in the still high number of deaths and injuries caused by such violence, and the number of farmers whose land was expropriated without adequate compensation was on the rise.
swa: Idadi ya watu waliotiwa kizuizini kwa kutoa maoni ya kisiasa yaliyo kinyume na wale wa chama tawala iliongezeka sambamba na kuongezeka kwa ukatili wa polisi uliodhihirishwa na idadi kubwa ya vifo na majeruhi unaosababishwa na vurugu, na idadi ya wakulima ambao walinyang'anywa ardhi yao bila fidia ya kutosha nayo iliongezeka.

eng: The report noted that Vietnam's poor record contradicted its commitment to promote human rights after it became a member of the UN Human Rights Council and after it included human rights concepts on its Constitution.
swa: Ripoti ilibainisha kwamba rekodi mbaya nchini Vietnam ni kinyume na ahadi ya kukuza haki za binadamu baada ya kuwa mwanachama wa Baraza la Haki za Binadamu la Umoja wa Mataifa na baada ya kuongezea dhana ya haki za binadamu katika Katiba yake.

eng: The top 3 causes of adolescent deaths globally are road traffic injuries, HIV/AIDS, and suicide.
swa: Sababu kubwa za vifo vya vijana duniani ni ajali za barabarani, VVU?UKIMWI, na kujiua.

eng: Worldwide, an estimated 1.3 million adolescents died in 2012.

eng: The report also adds that :

swa: Kiwango cha vifo kimeongezeka miongoni mwa vijana wa umri wa miaka 15 na 19 na pia wale wa umri kati ya miaka 10 na 14.

eng: Some policies are suggested to better respond to the mental and overall health needs of adolescents.

eng: However, when Sata appeared at a May 1 Labour Day parade to receive a traditional salute from workers in the land, the appearance was very brief and only accompanied by a one minute address before getting into his motorcade for a three kilometre drive back to the presidential palace, a lot of people were convinced the President was not well.

eng: Angie Ramos guest blogs at Tintero Político about the crisis in Ukraine and after analyzing different key factors involved concludes with the reaction of the internacional community:
swa: guest blogs ya Angie Ramos katika Tintero kuhusu mgogoro wa kisiasa nchini Ukraine na baada ya kuchambua mambo mbalimbali muhimu husika anahitimisha kwa majibu ya Jumuiya ya Kimataifa:

eng: The thing is, the international community, facing cases like this one, acts subjectively as it depends on the magnitude of the interests involved to support or express rejection to some interventionism in various countries.
swa: Jambo ni, jumuiya ya kimataifa, inayokabiliwa na kesi kama hii, hufanya vitendo watakavyo kwa kuwa inategemea ukubwa wa maslahi yanayoshiriki kusaidia au kuelezea kukataliwa kwa baadhi ya uingiliaji kati katika nchi mbalimbali.

eng: Is it that some countries have privileges for the international community?
swa: Ni kwamba baadhi ya nchi wana mapendeleo kwa jumuiya ya kimataifa?

eng: For instance, in the case of the conflict between Great Britain and Argentina regarding Falkland Islands, a referendum carried out on the population, where 98% of the population voted for staying under Great Britain's administration, received support, while in Crimea, there is no will for acknowleding the legality of the process.
swa: Kwa mfano, katika kesi ya vita kati ya Uingereza na Argentina kuhusu Visiwa vya Falkland, kura ya maoni iliofanywa kuhusu idadi ya watu, ambapo 98% ya idadi walipiga kura kwa ajili ya kuwa chini ya utawala wa Uingereza, waliungwa mkono, wakati katika Crimea, hakuna wasia wa kukubali uhalali wa mchakato.

eng: Omg Ghana reports about Joshua Beckford's outstanding academic achievement:

swa: Katika umri wa miaka 8, wewe pengine ulikuwa unafanya mazoezi ya michezo au ulikuwa ukifanya maandalizi ya kujiunga na daraja la tatu.

eng: Well, meet an 8 year old with a twist, Joshua Beckford.
swa: Naam, kutana na Joshua Beckford mwenye umri wa miaka 8.

eng: This particular young boy is by far not your average 8 year old.
swa: Huyu yuko juu ya wastani wa mtu mwenye umri wa miaka 8.

eng: He studied at Oxford University at the age of 6, and he is the face of the National Autistic Society’s Black and Minority (BME) campaign.
swa: Alisoma katika Chuo Kikuu cha Oxford akiwa na umri wa miaka 6, na ni mfano wa kampeni ya wagonjwa wa akili katika jamii ya watu weusi na wachache (BME).

eng: It’s put in to place to highlight the obstacles that people with black minority background often encounter when trying to obtain the access to support and services they need.
swa: Kampeni hiyo ilianzishwa ili kuonyesha vikwazo watu wenye asili ya weusi ambao mara nyingi hukutana nayo wanapojaribu kupata huduma ya kusaidia na huduma wanazohitaji.

eng: Beckford is one of a kind, he is too advanced for his required school grade so that lead him into being homeschooled.
swa: Beckford ni wa pekee, yuko juu zaidi kwa Kiwango cha daraja la shule alilohitajika na ilimlazimu kusomea nyumbani.

eng: He excels in Math, Foreign Languages, History, Philosophy, IT and Science.
swa: Yeye hufanya vizuri katika Hesabu, Lugha za Kigeni, historia, falsafa, teknolojia na Sayansi.

eng: Beza Tesfaye explains why blogging is a threat to the Ethiopian government following the arrests of nine Ethiopian bloggers:
swa: Beza Tesfaye anaelezea kwa nini kublogu ni tishio kwa serikali ya Ethiopia kufuatia kukamatwa kwa wanablogu tisa Ethiopia:

eng: As I write this, I am eerily reminded that in Ethiopia, expressing your views can get you a first class ticket to prison.
swa: Ninapoandika haya, Kwa uwoga nakumbushwa kwamba nchini Ethiopia, kutoa maoni yako kunaweza kukufanya uakapewa tiketi ya daraja la kwanza gerezani.

eng: From April 25 to 26, 2014, nine Ethiopian bloggers and journalists were arrested.
swa: Kutoka Aprili 25 hadi 26, 2014, wanablogu tisa wa Ethiopia na waandishi wa habari walikamatwa.

eng: As we celebrated World Press Freedom Day on Saturday, they were being detained in Addis Ababa’s notorious central investigation office.
swa: Tulipokuwa tunasheherekea Siku ya Uhuru wa Vyombo vya Habari Duniani siku ya Jumamosi, walikuwa kizuizini kwenye mahabusi mbaya zaidi jijini Addis Ababa.

eng: Though charges have not officially been filed, the group is accused of “working with foreign human rights activists” and “using social media to destabilize the country”.
swa: Ingawa madai hayajawasilishwa rasmi, kundi hilo limeshitakiwa kwa " kufanya kazi na kutetea haki za binadamu wa kigeni" na "kutumia vyombo vya habari vya kijamii kufanya nchi isitulie".

eng: If prosecuted under Ethiopia’s controversial Anti-Terrorism Law, they could face the death penalty.
swa: Kama watashitakiwa chini ya sheria ya Ethiopia ya kukabiliana na ugaidi, wanaweza kukabiliwa na adhabu ya kifo.

eng: The arrests are part of a disturbing trend in Ethiopia, which has frequently ranked as one of the most repressive places for press freedom in recent years.
swa: Kukamatwa kwao ni sehemu ya mwenendo wa kuhofia nchini Ethiopia, ambayo mara nyingi imewekwa katika nafasi ya kama moja ya maeneo yenye kandamizi kwa uhuru wa vyombo vya habari katika miaka ya hivi karibuni.

eng: More and more people are demanding transparency from their governments and leaderships.
swa: Watu wanazidi kudai uwazi kwa uongozi wa serikali zao.

eng: By demanding transparency, what people want is to confirm the presence of ethics in government acts.
swa: Kwa kudai uwazi, watu wanachotaka ni kuthibitisha kuwepo kwa maadili katika shughuli za serikali.

eng: But, what about private companies?
swa: Lakini, je vipi kuhusu makampuni binafsi?

eng: Ingrid Kost thinks ethics is indipensable if we want corporate sustainability:
swa: Ingrid Kost anadhani maadili ni muhimu kama tunataka ushirika endelevu:

eng: The demand for more transparency and accountability increases the companies responsibility for improving the dissemination of information regarding their activities.
swa: Mahitaji ya uwazi zaidi na kuongeza uwajibikaji kwa makampuni ya kuboresha usambazaji wa habari kuhusu shughuli zao.

eng: Sustainability reports appear as a tool that favors the convergence of the company with a society that increasingly supports its environment ethic behavior.
swa: Taarifa endelevu huonekana kama chombo ambacho hufadhili muunganiko wa kampuni na jamii ambayo inazidi kusaidia tabia yake kwenye maadili ya mazingira.

eng: The website People's Congress publicly denounces human rights situation during the ongoing agrarian strike in Colombia.
swa: Tovuti ya 'kongamano la watu' imeshutumu hadharani uvunjifu wa haki za binadamu unayoendelea katika mgomo wa kilimo nchini Colombia.

eng: They report alleged human rights violations in different regions: Catatumbo and Cúcuta, San Pablo–Bolívar, Sogamoso - Boyacá, Northern Santander- Hacarí, Yopal- Casanare, Boyacá, Berlín - Santander, Pinchote - Santander y Arauca.
swa: Wanaripoti madai ya ukiukaji wa haki za binadamu katika mikoa mbalimbali: Catatumbo na Cucuta, San Pablo-Bolívar, Sogamoso - Boyaca, Kaskazini Santander-Hacarí, Yopal-Casanare, Boyaca, Berlin - Santander, Pinchote - Santander y Arauca.

eng: They also made a call:
swa: Pia walitoa wito:

eng: To international human rights advocate entities, to intervene and demand a quick and real solution to the situation the country is facing.
swa: Kwa vyombo vya kimataifa vyakutetea haki za binadamu, kuingilia kati na kudai ufumbuzi wa haraka na halisi ya hali inyayoikabili nchi.

eng: To the national and international community and to human rights advocate entities, to speak out regarding the facts mentioned in this claim.
swa: Kwa jamii ya kitaifa na jumuiya ya kimataifa na vyombo vya kutetea haki za binadamu, kuongea kuhusu ukweli uliotajwa katika dai hili.

eng: To the national and international community and to human rights advocate entities to demand for the safety of people taking part and every spokesperson of the national strike.
swa: Kwa jamii ya kitaifa na jumuiya ya kimataifa na vyombo vya kutetea haki za binadamu kudai usalama wa watu wanaohusika na kila msemaji wa mgomo wa kitaifa..

eng: The blog from Parque Biblioteca Tomás Carrasquilla - La Quintana, in Medellin, Colombia, expresses its support for free culture.
swa: Blogu kutoka Parque Biblioteca Tomás Carrasquilla - La Quintana, huko Medellin, Colombia, inaelezea msaada wake kwa utamaduni huru.

eng: After explaining the liberties free culture brings, the blog describes how can this fit together with a librarian's work:
swa: Baada ya kueleze namna ya kuleta utamaduni wa uhuru , blogu hiyo inaelezea jinsi inavyoweza kufanya kazi inayofanana na maktaba:

eng: Public libraries can learn from these liberties to share the creative processes carried out within the communities they serve, and this can empower local information service, co-created, shared, noticed and available to everybody so other libraries, organizations, study groups and individuals may be able to replicate them, improve them and adapt them to their own needs and necessities, so in tiime they can give back those experiences to the original node and diversify what they have learned.
swa: Maktaba za umma zaweza kujifunza katika uhuru huu wa kubadilishana taratibu za ubunifu zilizofanywa ndani ya jamii wanazozihudumia, na hii inaweza kuwawezesha kwenye huduma za habari za mitaa, zilizoundwa kwa ushirikiano, zilizo shirikishwa, zilizoonekana na kupatikana kwa kila mtu ili maktaba nyingine, mashirika, vikundi vya utafiti na watu binafsi waweze kuwa na uwezo wa kuiga hayo, kuziboresha na kukabiliana nazo kwa mahitaji yao wenyewe na vifaa muhimu, hivyo kwa wakati wanaweza kutoa ule uzoefu wa awali na kutoa vyanzo mbalimbali kwa yale wamejifunza.

eng: AFKInsider bloggers contest seeks to discover creative African Business bloggers who write and are interested in technology, agriculture, entrepreneurship, real estate, entertainment, politics, mining and other general news that cover the continent.
swa: Mashindano ya wanablogu ya AFKInsider inanuia kugundua ubunifu wa wanablogu wa Biashara Afrika ambao huandika na wana nia ya teknolojia, kilimo, ujasiriamali, mali isiyohamishika, burudani, siasa, madini na habari nyingine za jumla ambazo hujumuisha bara la Afrika.

swa: Ni aina gani ya wanablogu AFKInsider inatafuta na jinsi gani mtu anaweza kuchaguliwa?

eng: AFKInsider is looking for authentic original content that is well reported and entertaining for the African audience.
swa: AFKInsider inatafuta maudhui halisi ya kiasili ambayo imeripotiwa vizuri na yenye burudani kwa watazamaji wa Afrika.

eng: We are looking for someone that can fill a gap in the African media space by writing unique stories that other media sources don’t usually cover.
swa: Sisi twatafuta mtu ambaye anaweza kujaza pengo katika nafasi ya vyombo vya habari Afrika kwa kuandika habari za kipekee ambazo vyanzo vingine vya vyombo vya habari havijaripoti.

eng: To be considered as a guest blogger at AFKInsider one has to simply submit your blog or stories from your blog for review by our panel editors through info@afkinsider.com.
swa: Kuchukuliwa kama mwanablogu mgeni katika AFKInsider unahitajika tu kuwasilisha blogu yako au hadithi kutoka blogu yako kwa mapitio na jopo letu la wahariri kupitia anwani ya barua pepe info@afkinsider.com.

swa: Kimya cha srikali kimesabbaisha watu kujitafutia namna ya kujisaidia wenyewe, lakini kwa bahati mipango inayoanzishwa na watu wenyewe imesaidia kuwapatia misaada na jitihada za kusaidia kuuhabarisha umma zinaongezeka.

swa: Wakati huo huo, mitandao ya kijamii, vyombo vya habari, na hata watu maarufu wanajikuta wanatishwa na mamlaka kwa "kusababisha tahayaruki" wakati ambao upatikanaji wa habari sahihi ndio unaohitajika.

eng: Popular Tibetan singer Gepe was arrested after singing in a music concert.
swa: Mwimbaji maarufu wa Kitibeti amekamatwa baad aya kuimba kwenye tamasha la muziki.

eng: Tibetan singer Gepe was arrested on 24 May 2014 in Sichuan province after his performance in a concert attended by thousands.
swa: Mwimbaji wa Kitibeti Gepe amekamatwa na kuwekwa kizuizini Mei 24, 2014 kwenye jimbo la Sichuan baada ya onyesho lake kwenye tamasha lililohudhuriwa na maelfu ya mashabiki.

eng: The concert, organized by a group of Tibetan youth, had received permission from local authorities, and according to a report from Voice of America, the concert was to address the importance of Tibetan language and culture.
swa: Tamasha hilo, lililoandaliwa na kikundi cha vijana wa Kitibeti, liliruhusiwa rasmi na serikali za mitaa za sehemu hiyo, na kwa mujibu wa taarifa ya Shirika la Utangazaji la Marekani, tamasha hilo lilikuwa lina maudhui ya kuonyesha umuhimu wa lugha na utamaduni wa Kitebeti.

eng: Gepe is a popular singer from Ngaba in Amdo.
swa: Gepe ni mwimbaji maarufu kutoka eneo la Ngaba, Amdo.

eng: Back in 2012, after he released an album that expresses the pain of separation from his spiritual leader and a strong desire for Tibetan unity, he disappeared for quite a lengthy period of time.
swa: Mwaka 2012, baada ya kuzindua albamu yake iliyokuwa inaonyesha maumivu ya kutengenana na kiongozi wake wa kiroho na shauku yake kubw aya umoja wa Watibeti, alibaki kimya kwa muda mrefu.

swa: Gepe si mwimbaji wa kwanza wa Kitibeti kushitakiwa nchini China.

eng: Since the unrest of March 2008 in Lhasa, Tibetan artists have been one of the targets of political suppression.
swa: Tangu maandamano ya Lhasa mwezi Machi 2008, wasanii wa Kitibeti wamekuwa walengwa wa ukandamizaji wa kisiasa.

eng: Tibetan author and poet Tsering Woeser described the series of crackdowns as "the same policies of the Cultural Revolution but of a different name".
swa: Mwandishi wa Kitibeti na mshahiri Tsering Woeser alieleza mfululizo wa matukio hayo kama "sera zilezile za Mapinduzi ya Kiutamaduni lakini kwa jina tofauti".

eng: Both sing about Tibetan identity, culture and language.
swa: Wawili hao wanaimba kuhusu utambulisho wa Kitibeti, utamaduni na lugha.

swa: Thinley alihukumiwa miaka tisa gerezani kwa "kuhamasisha hisia za kuipinga serikali miongoni mwa wasikilizaji wa muziki wake".
