swa: Blogu hii ina habari zaidi za hivi karibuni kuhusu jitihada za utetezi, ripoti za vyombo vya habari, na hadhi ya kisheria ya wanablogu wa Zone9 nchini Ethiopia.

eng: It is dedicated to report on the trial of innocent bloggers and journalists.
swa: Imejitolea kutoa taarifa juu ya kesi ya wanablogu na waandishi wa habari wasio na hatia.

eng: We believe in the power of accurate and factual reporting of the bloggers situation from the ground.
swa: Tunaamini katika nguvu sahihi na taarifa sahihi ya hali ya wanablogu kutoka eneo kamili.

eng: Maite Oronoz during the confirmation process in the Puerto Rico Senate.
swa: Maite Oronoz wakati wa zoezi la kuthibitishwa kwenye baraza la seneti la Puerto Rico.

eng: Screenshot from video posted by the Senate.
swa: Picha imepigwa kwenye video iliyowekwa na Baraza la Seneti.

eng: On Monday, June 23, 2014, the Puerto Rico Senate confirmed attorney Maite Oronoz Rodríguez as a Supreme Court judge.
swa: Mnamo Jumatatu, Juni 23, 2014, Baraza la Seneti la Puerto Rico lilimthibitisha mwanasheria Maite Oronoz Rodríguez kuwa Jaji wa Mahakama Kuu nchini humo.

eng: The historic nomination marks the first time that an openly gay individual has been appointed to the country's highest court.
swa: Uteuzi huo wa kihistoria unakuwa wa kwanza kwa mtu aliyejitangaza kuwa msagaji kuteuliwa kuitumikia mahakama kuu kabisa nchini humo.

eng: Oronoz Rodríguez, who is the fifth woman to serve on the Supreme Court, expressed her gratitude and pride in a written statement :
swa: Oronoz Rodríguez, ambaye anakuwa mwanamke wa tano kuitumikia Mahakama Kuu, alitoa shukrani zake kupitia tamko la maandishi :

eng: I am pleased that the democratic process has resulted in my nomination.
swa: Ninayo furaha kwamba mchakato wa kidemokrasia umesababisha niteuliwe.

eng: I am proud to continue to serve this country, this time from the Supreme Court.
swa: Ninajivunia kuendelea kuitumikia nchi yangu, wakati huu kwenye Mahakama Kuu.

eng: My commitment to the country and to the constitution of Puerto Rico is unwavering.
swa: Kujitolea kwangu kwa nchi yangu na kwa katiba ya Puerto Rico kutaendelea kuwa imara.

eng: Through me, the people of Puerto Rico will have an honest and fair judge, loyal to the letter of the Constitution.
swa: Kupitia kwangu, watu wa Puerto Rico watapata jaji mwaminifu wa mtenda haki, mtiifu kwa katiba ya nchi.

eng: I thank the Governor and the Senate for the opportunity to reaffirm this commitment.
swa: Ninamshukuru Gavana na Baraza la Seneta kwa fursa ya kuthibitisha kujitolea kwangu.

eng: The Senate's vote to confirm Oronoz Rodríguez fell mostly along partisan lines, with 16 votes in her favor and 10 against .
swa: Kura ya kumthibitisha Oronoz Rodríguez ilikabiliwa na upinzani mkali, kura 16 zikimkubali na 10 zikimkataa .

eng: Among those voting against Oronoz Rodríguez was the only female senator, of the Puerto Rican Independence Party, María de Lourdes Santiago.
swa: Katika kura zilizomkataa Oronoz Rodríguez ilikuwemo ya Seneta pekee wa kike, wa chama cha Puerto Rican Independence Party, María de Lourdes Santiago.

eng: Santiago explained that her decision was based on Oronoz Rodríguez' involvement in a controversial case, when as the director of San Juan's Municipal Legal Division she defended the Mayor's decision to impose searches on every individual who would attend this year's San Sebastian Street Festival.
swa: Santiago alieleza kuwa uamuzi wake ulizingatia uhusika wa Oronoz Rodríguez katika kashfa za siku za nyuma, ambapo inadaiwa akiwa mkurugenzi wa Idara ya Sheria ya Manispaa ya San Juan alitetea uamuzi wa Meya wa kuruhusu kukaguliwa kwa kila mtu ambaye angehudhuria Sherehe za Mtaa wa San Sebastian.

eng: The searches were deemed unconstitutional in court.
swa: Kukaguliwa kulithibitishwa na mahakama ya sheria kuwa kinyume na katiba.

eng: The confirmation process was not without hitches.
swa: Mchakato wa kuthibitishwa haukupia hivi hivi.

eng: After the vote that confirmed Oronoz Rodríguez as a Supreme Court judge, some senators requested a recount of the vote.
swa: Baada ya kura iliyomthibitisha Oronoz Rodríguez kuwa Jaji wa Mahakama Kuu, baadhi ya maseneta waliomba kuhesabiwa upya kwa kura.

eng: Amárilis Pagán (@AmarilisPagan), feminist lawyer and LGBT advocate, expressed her frustration with the process:
swa: Amárilis Pagán (@AmarilisPagan), mwanasheria wa kutetea haki za Mashoga (LGBT), alionyesha kusikitishwa kwake na mchakato huo:

eng: If it weren't for the rampant lesbophobia in the Capital, we wouldn't be in this mess over Oronoz' confirmation.
swa: Kama pasingekuwa na hofu na chuki dhidi ya mashoga mjini humu, tusingekuwa na zengwe hili la kuthibitishwa kwa Oronoz.

eng: National embarrassment.
swa: Ni mchosho wa taifa.

eng: LGBT activist Pedro Julio Serrano praised Oronoz Rodríguez' conduct during the confirmation process:
swa: Mwanaharakati wa Haki za Mashoga Pedro Julio Serrano alikisifu kitendo cha Oronoz Rodríguez wakati wa mchakato wa kuthibitishwa:

eng: Maite presented herself fearlessly - with all her identities in full view of the country.
swa: Maite alijieleza bila hofu - akijitambulisha kikamilifu kama mpenda nchi.

eng: Her appointment merits this same bravery.
swa: Uteuzi wake unathibitisha hili.

eng: It happened, at the end of the day, but in a tumultuous way.
swa: Ilitokea, mwisho wa siku, lakini kwa namna ya kushangaza.

eng: We must proceed straightforwardly, without fear, faces to the sun, with respect and dignity.
swa: Lazima tuendelee mbele, bila woga, tukilitazama jua, kwa heshima na hadhi inayostahili.

eng: As we LGBT individuals deserve.
swa: Kama watu wapendao mapenzi ya jinsia moja wanavyostahili.

eng: As all humans deserve.
swa: Kama binadamu wote wanavyostahili.

eng: The new judge was congratulated by Puerto Rican Congress members Luis Gutiérrez and Nydia Velázquez via Twitter:
swa: Jaji mpya alipongezwa na wabunge wa nchi hiyo, Luis Gutiérrez na Nydia Velázquez kupitia mtandao wa twita:

eng: It's a great day for #LGBT equality & advancing civil rights in PR.
swa: Ni siku kubwa kwa usawa wa kimapenzi na haki kwa mashoga.

eng: I applaud the Governor for nominating Maite Oronoz Rodríguez. — Luis V. Gutierrez (@RepGutierrez) June 23, 2014
swa: Ninampongeza gavana kwa kumteua Maite Oronoz Rodriguez kuwa jaji

eng: Not only will Maite Oronoz make a superb judge but her appointment to PR's Supreme Court is an important step forward for civil rights. — Rep. Nydia Velazquez (@NydiaVelazquez) June 16, 2014
swa: Si tu kuwa Maite Oronoz atakuwa jaji bora lakini uteuzi wake kuwa jaji wa Mahakama Kuu ni hatua moja mbele kwa haki za kiraia

eng: In a column for digital magazine 80 grados, queer activist Yoryie Irizarry (@CyborgYoryie) astutely observed that this historic moment is the fruit of the LGBT community's long fight for equality:
swa: Katika safu ya jarida la mtandaoni 80 grados, mwanaharakati Yoryie Irizarry (@CyborgYoryie) alilitazama tukio hili la kihistoria kama matunda ya mapambano ya muda mrefu ya kudai usawa yaliyoongozwa na jumuiya ya mashoga na wasagaji:

eng: Contrary to what our allies may think, I've decided to think that this historic moment does not come to us courtesy of Governor Alejandro García Padilla.
swa: Kinyume na kile washirika wetu wanavyodhani, nimeamua kufikiri kwamba tukio hili la kihistoria halijatokea kwa nguvu za Gavana Alejandro García Padilla.

eng: We've earned this historic moment in the streets, in the legislature, in our communities and workplaces, educating, making ourselves visible, testifying, writing, signing letters, fighting, and working.
swa: Tumeshuhudia tukio hili mitaani, bungeni, na kwenye jamii zetu na kwenye shemu zetu za kazi, kuelimisha, kujitangaza, kushuhudia, kuandika, kusaini barua, kupambana na tunaona kazi inaendelea.

eng: The public discussion raised by Oronoz Rodríguez' nomination highlights society's persistent fixation on the sexual orientation of public figures, to the point that fundamental issues, like her performance and knowledge, are taking a backseat.
swa: Mjadala wa umma ulionzishwa na uteuzi wa Oronoz Rodríguez unabainisha mwamko endelevu wa hali ya kimapenzi hata kwa watu maarufu, kufikia mahali masuala ya msingi, kama uwezo na uelewa wake, vitafutika kwa sababu tu ya hali yake ya kimapenzi.

eng: In an article for digital magazine El Post Antillano, Jaime Pieras Castañer describes the problem:
swa: Katika makala yake kwa jarida la mtandaoni la El Post Antillano, Jaime Pieras Castañer alielezea tatizo hilo:

eng: The media coverage of the nomination focused too much on the social orientation of the nominee.
swa: Vyombo vya habari vimeupa uteuzi huu sura ya mwelekeo wa kijinsia wa mtauliwa.

eng: Apparently, it would have been fine if she weren't open about her sexual orientation, but she disclosed it.
swa: Kwa hakika, ingekuwa vyema kama asingekuwa wazi kuhusu hali yake ya kimapenzi, lakini ndio hivyo, alishajitangaza.

eng: Thomas Rivera Schatz, ex-president of the Senate, said in a heated speech in the Senate that herself brought her sexual orientation to public attention.
swa: Thomas Rivera Schatz, rais wa zamani wa Seneti, alisema kwenye hotuba yake kali kwneye Seneta kwamba mwenyewe ndiye aliyelileta suala la usagaji wake hadharani.

eng: As if that has anything to do with her qualifications or with any of the factors that should be part of any discussion of Oronoz' gifts and talent.
swa: Utafikiri hali yake ya kimapenzi ina maana yoyote kwa sifa zake au iwe sababu yoyote ambayo yapaswa kuwa sehemu ya mjadala wa vipaji na uwezo wa Oronoz.

eng: Érika Fontánez Torres, lawyer, Law professor and editor of the digital magazine Derecho al Derecho, offers an interesting opinion in the magazine's podcast (at around minute 11:20):
swa: Érika Fontánez Torres, mwanasheria, Profesa wa Sheria na mhariri wa jarida la mtandaoni Derecho al Derecho, anatoa maoni ya kusisimua kwenye podikasti ya jarida hilo (kwenye dakika ya 11:20):

eng: There are some people who have responded to this discussion by saying, "No, it's not important, it's irrelevant whether or not she's a lesbian," but well, the first thing we should be saying is "Yes, yes, it is important"... yes, subjectivities are important in Court, yes, they do bring something to the table, yes, diversity is important when the judges are deliberating , and if an individual, like Maite Oronoz, has a life experience from that perspective, I would say that's extraordinary.
swa: Kuna baadhi ya watu waliojibu mjadala huu kwa kusema, "Hapana, si tatizo, haina maana awe ni msagaji au sio," lakini sawa, jambo la kwanza tunalopaswa kuwa tunalisema ni "Ndio, ndo, ni muhimu"...ndio, maamuzi binafsi ni muhimu kwenye mahakama, ndio, yanaleta jambo fulani kwenye kazi zake za kila siku, ndio, tofauti ni muhimu majaji wnaapotekeleza kazi zao , na kama mtu binafsi, kama Maite Oronoz, ana uzoefu wa kimaisha kwa mtazamo huo, ningeweza kusema kwamba kuwa hilo ni suala kubwa isivyo kawaida.

eng: Photo by Laura Schneider, used with her permission.
swa: Picha imepigwa na Laura Schneider, imetumiwa kwa ruhusa.

eng: On her blog Viajes y Relatos, Laura Schneider shares her experience visiting Puerto Deseado, in the province of Santa Cruz, Argentina.
swa: Kwenye blogu yake Viajes y Relatos, Laura Schneider anasimulia uzoefu wake alipotembelea Puerto Deseado, mji ulioko kwenye Jimbo la Santa Cruz, Ajentina.

eng: On the six-day photo-safari, she photographed the beautiful city and places nearby:
swa: Katika siku yake ya sita ya safari yake ya kupiga picha, alitembelea na kupiga picha za mji huo mzuri katika maeneo ya karibu:

eng: Taking route 3, after passing Comodoro Rivadavia and Caleta Olivia 300 km back, there is a detour that takes you to Puerto Deseado.
swa: Nikiwa usawa wa kilometa 3, 300 baada ya Comodoro Rivadavia na Caleta Olivia, kuna njia panda inayokupeleka Puerto Deseado.

eng: This is a coastal and port city in the Patagonia with cliffs, a large amount of biodiversity with birds and mammals and a series of coastal tours that takes us to the very well known Ria.
swa: Huu ni mji wa pwani na bandari jimboni Patagonia wenye miamba, ndege wakubwa na utajiri wa viumbe na mfululizo wa safari za pwani unaokufikisha kwenye eneo linalofahamika vizuri zaidi la Ria.

eng: Magellanic penguins, rockhopper penguins, Patagonian sea lions, Peale's dolphins, cormorants, river dolphins, oystercatchers and terns are part the great variety of this place.
swa: Ndege wa Magellanic, rockhopper, simba wa baharini waitwao Patagoni, nyangumi wa Peale, waishio kwenye mto, na aina mbalimbali za wanyama ni sehemu ya utajiri wa wanyama unaopatikana kwenye eneo hili.

eng: But beyond the fauna, Puerto Deseado is a city rich in history due to its train.
swa: Lakini zaidi ya hayo, Puerto Deseado ni historia ya jiji tajiri shauri ya miundo mbinu ya gari moshi.

eng: You can follow Laura on her Twitter account.
swa: Unaweza kumfuatilia Laura kwenye mtandao wa Twita.

eng: Ivory Coast's national team during the 2010 FIFA World Cup in South Africa.
swa: Timu ya Taifa ya Kodivaa wakati wa Mashindano ya Kombe la Dunia la FIFA, mwaka 2010, nchini Afrika Kusini.

eng: Image from Flickr user Merah Chhaya.
swa: Picha ni ya mtumiaji wa mtandao wa Flickr, Merah Chhaya.

eng: CC BY 2.0.
swa: CC BY 2.0.

eng: On the website LaMula.pe, Juan Carlos Urtecho explains his reasons for supporting the Ivory Coast in the World Cup match with Colombia on Thursday, June 19:
swa: Kwenye tovuti ya LaMula.pe, Juan Carlos Urtecho anaeleza sababu zake za kuishangilia Kodivaa kwenye mpambano wa Kombe la Dunia kati ya nchi hiyo na Kolombia siku ya Alhamisi, Juni 19:

eng: From the moment they defeated Japan in their debut, the Ivorians became my favorite team in this World Cup. You choose the spoiled ones via the simplest way.
swa: Tangu wakati waliposhinda Japan katika mechi yao ya awali, hawa jamaa wamekuwa timu yangu pendwa kwenye mashindano haya ya Kombe la Dunia Unachagua mayai viza kwa njia rahisi.

eng: Ivory Coast, located in West Africa, with a GDP of 19 million euros and a per capita of 967 euros is the third poorest country that takes part in the World Cup, after Honduras and Bosnia.
swa: Kodivaa, nchi iliyoko Afrika Magharibi yenye Pato la Nchi la Euro milioni 19 na wastani wa Euro 967 kwa kila Mkodivaa, ni nchi maskini zaidi kati ya nchi zinazoshiriki kwenye mashindano hayo, baada ya Honduras na Bosnia.

eng: Japan's economy (GDP 5 billion euros and 30 million per capita) is the second after the United States.
swa: Uchumi wa Japani (Pato la Taifa la Euro bilioni 5 na wastani wa Euro milioni 30 kwa kila Mjapani) ni wa pili baada ya Marekani.

eng: Ivory Coast is a country struggling to recover after a bloody civil war that resulted in ten of thousands dead and hundreds of thousands displaced between 2002 and 2007.
swa: Kodivaa ni nchi inayojikakamua kupata nafuu baada ya vita vikali vya wenyewe kwa wenyewe vilivyoua makumi ya maelfu ya watu na kuwahamisha malaki ya watu kutoka kwenye makazi yao kati ya mwaka 2002 na mwaka 2007.

eng: Japan, is... well, it's Japan.
swa: Japan, ni...aha, ni Japan.

eng: Image by Willard on Flickr.
swa: Picha imepigwa na Willard kwenye mtandao wa flickr.

eng: CC BY-NC-ND 2.0.
swa: CC BY-NC-ND 2.0.

eng: Colombian United Arab Emirates-based Marcelino Torrecilla describes the particulars of Muslim football fans in the 2014 FIFA World Cup:
swa: Raia wa Colombia aliye na makazi yake katika Umoja wa Falme za Kiarabu, Marcelino Torrecilla anatuhabarisha kuhusiana na upekee wa mashabiki wa kiislamu wa mpira wa miguu kwenye Kombe la Dunia la FIFA, 2014 :

eng: For the World Cup, the arrival of 50,000 Muslims from countries as diverse as Iran, Nigeria, Algeria, United States, United Kingdom, Malaysia and many others from the Gulf is expected. For sure, they all will pack the 80 some mosques throughout the length and breadth of this huge country;
swa: Katika Kombe la dunia, waislamu 50,000 wamesili kutoka katika mataifa mbalimbali kama vile Irani, Naijeria, Aljeria, Marekani, Uingereza, Malaysia na wengine wengi wanaotarajiwa kutoka katika Ghuba hii. kwa hakika, wataweza kuijaza takribani misikiti 80 iliyo katika maeneo mbalimbali ya nchi hii kubwa kabisa;

eng: And he adds:
swa: Aliendelea kusema kuwa:

eng: In six out of the 32 countries in competition, Islam has a significative presence.
swa: Nchi sita kati ya 32 zinazoshiriki shindano hili, hiki ni kiwango kikubwa cha ushiriki wa waislam.

eng: Among those countries we have Bosnia-Herzegovina, Cameroon, Iran, Ivory Coast and Nigeria.
swa: Miongoni mwa nchi hizi, tunazo, Bosnia-Herzegovina, Kameruni, Irani, Code Ivar na Naijeria.

eng: You can follow Marcelino on Twitter.
swa: Unaweza kumfuatilia Marcelino kwenye mtandao wa Twita.

eng: This post was part of the sixth #LunesDeBlogsGV on June 9, 2014.
swa: Posti hii ni sehemu ya sita ya mpango wa #LunesDeBlogsGV siku ya Juni 9, 2014.

eng: Djouma and Amadou Moussa are Ibrahim's parents.
swa: Djouma na Amadou Moussa ni wazazi wa Ibrahim.

eng: Djouma and Ibahim are the two lone survivors of an incredibly violent attack by militiamen that took the lives of 5 of Ibrahim's siblings in the Central African Republic, near the border with Cameroon.
swa: Djouma na Ibahim ni wahanga wa shambulizi la kikatili lililofanywa na wanamgambo waaasi, tukio lililokatisha maisha ya ndugu watano wa damu katika Jamhuri ya Afrika ya Kati, karibu na mpaka wa Kameruni.

eng: The militiamen came while Amadou Moussa was away.
swa: Wanamgambo hao walikuja wakati Amadou Moussa akiwa mbali na nyumbani kwake.

eng: Djouma, 30, recalls the attack :
swa: Djouma, 30, anakumbuka tukio hilo baya :

eng: They found me with my children in the house; they gathered all the small children and slaughtered them with machetes.
swa: Walinikuta nikiwa na wanangu nyumbani kwangu; waliwakusanya watoto wote wadogo na kuwachinja kwa panga.

eng: They killed six people, including five children in my presence Ibrahim was among the six children they took.
swa: Waliua watu sita, ikiwa ni pamoja na watoto mbele yangu Ibrahim alikuwa kati ya watoto sita waliowachukua.

eng: When they hit him with the machetes, they thought he was dead.
swa: Walimkata na panga, wakadhani amefariki.

eng: Outgoing Managing Editor, Solana Larsen (L) will be succeeded by Sahar Habib Ghazi (R)
swa: Mhariri Mtendaji anayemaliza muda wake, Solana Larsen (kushoto) nafasi yake inachukuliwa na Sahar Habib Ghazi (kulia)

eng: At the end of May we said good-bye to our long-standing Managing Editor, Solana Larsen, and welcomed our newest volunteer contributor, also called Solana Larsen.
swa: Mwishoni mwa mwezi Mei tulimuaga rasmi Mhariri wetu Mtendaji wa muda mrefu, Solana Larsen, na kumkaribisha rasmi kubadili majukumu yake kuwa, sasa, mchangiaji wetu mpya kabisa wa kujitolea, akiitwa Solana Larsen.

eng: Solana steps down from the Managing Editor position after seven years at the helm of Global Voices' editorial section.
swa: Solana anaachia ngazi kutoka nafasi ya Mhariri Mtendaji, aliyoishikilia kwa miaka saba kuongoza bodi ya uhariri ya Global Voices.

eng: Personal reasons is often a euphemism for other things, but Solana is genuinely relinquishing the post in order to devote more time to family, notably her two year-old daughter.
swa: Watu wengi wanapong'atuka hutumia "sababu binafsi" kama maelezo rahisi ya kufunika sababu halisi, lakini Solana kwa hakika ameamua kuachia ngazi ili apate nafasi ya kutosha kutunza familia yake, hususani binti yake wa miaka miwili.

eng: It's best both for me and Global Voices, she wrote in an e-mail to the community, "to step down now and allow for brand new things to happen."
swa: Ni jambo jema kwangu binafsi na familia ya Global Voices, aliandika kwenye waraka ulioelekezwa kwa familia ya Global Voices, "kuachia ngazi sasa na kuruhusu mambo mapya yatokee."

eng: Solana's deft handling steered Global Voices' editorial through a rapidly shifting media landscape that saw blogging eclipsed by social networks as the primary platform for citizen expression.
swa: Ujuzi wa Solana umemsaidia kumudu vyema majukumu ya uhariri wa Global Voices katika kipindi ambacho uandishi wa habari ulishuhudia blogu na mitandao ya kijamii vikigeuka kuwa majukwaa muhimu kuwawezesha wananchi wa kawaida kusema mawazo yao.

eng: We're happy she'll continue not only as a volunteer contributor, but also to work on special projects and represent us at conferences.
swa: Tunafurahi kwamba ataendelea si tu kama mchangiaji wa kujitolea, lakini pia atafanya kazi nasi kwenye shughuli maalumu na kutuwakilisha kwenye mikutano.

eng: Solana leaves Global Voices' editorial in the excellent hands of Sahar Habib Ghazi, who joined us as Deputy Editor in June 2012.
swa: Solana anaiacha bodi ya uhariri ya Global Voices kwenye mikono mahiri ya Sahar Habib Ghazi, aliyeungana nasi kama Naibu Mhariri mwezi Juni 2012.

eng: Sahar, a journalist, blogger and activist who divides her time between the US and Pakistan, helped launch DawnNews TV and has reported for the New York Times.
swa: Sahar, ambaye ni mwandishi wa habari, mwanablogu na mwanaharakati anayegawa muda wake kati ya Marekani na Pakistani, alisaidia kuanzisha DawnNews TV na ameandikia jarida maarufu la New York Times.

eng: While a John S. Knight Journalism fellow at Stanford University, she launched Hosh Media, an online youth journalism platform.
swa: Akiwa sehemu ya Shule ya Uandishi wa Habari ya John S. Knight katika chuo kikuu cha Stanford, alianzisha Hosh Media, jukwaa la mtandaoni la uandishi wa habari kwa vijana.

eng: Sahar has been instrumental in developing Global Voices' style guides, codifying many of our editorial processes, and building our sub-editing team.
swa: Sahar amekuwa mhimili katika kutengeneza mwongozo wa kimaudhui wa Global Voices, kuratibu shughuli nyingi za uhariri na kujenga timu imara ya uhariri.

eng: Most importantly, she's a highly skilled and deeply committed member of the community, whom we trust will take our editorial section forward, to the places it needs to go.
swa: Lililo kubwa zaidi, ni mjuzi aliyebobea na mwanachama anayejitolea vya kutosha kwa familia ya Global Voices, ambaye tunaamini ataipeleka mbele timu ya uhariri, kwenda inakotakiwa kwenda.

eng: Erik shares 5 reports on technology trends in Africa:
swa: Erik anatushirikisha taarifa 5 kuhusu mwenendo wa teknolojia barani Afrika:

eng: I keep meaning to write blog posts on each of these reports on tech, most of them on Africa, but can’t seem to get it done.
swa: Nimeendelea kutamani kuandika makala za blogu kuhusu taarifa hizi moja baada ya nyingine, nyingi zikihusu Afrika, lakini inaonekana sitaweza.

eng: Instead, I’ll just post a link to each, a visual, and why I think it’s worth reading.
swa: Badala yake, nitaweka kiungo cha kila moja wapo, inayoonekana, na maneno machache ya kwa nini ni muhimu kuzisoma.

eng: The Akamai “State of the Internet” Q3 2013 report
swa: Taarifa ya Akamai kuhusu “Hali ya Mtandnao wa Intaneti” ya mwaka 2013.

eng: Has good information on overall usage globally, and trends.
swa: Taarifa ya Akamai, PDF] Ina taarifa nzuri kuhusiana matumizi ya intaneti duniani, pamoja na mwenendo wake.

eng: In Africa, even though they have a node in Kenya, all we’re seeing is stats on South Africa, Egypt and Morocco.
swa: Katika bara la Afrika, hata kama kuna maendeleo zaidi nchini Kenya, wote tunaona maendeleo pia yanayoonekana katika nchi za Afrika Kusini, Misri na Moroko.

eng: However, there is a really fascinating chart by Ericsson in it on wireless usage.
swa: Hata hivyo, kuna mchoro wa Ericsson kuhusu matumizi ya mtandao wa si-waya.

eng: Did you know what are the top most visited websites in Kenya?
swa: Je, unajua ni tovuti gani maarufu zinazotembelewa zaidi nchini Kenya?

eng: Read James Wamathai's blog post on the subject:
swa: Soka posti ya James Wamathai kwenye blogu yake kufahamu zaidi:

eng: A lot has changed since February, when I did the last Top 50 most visited Kenyan websites list.
swa: Mengi yamebadilika tangu mwezi Januari, wakati nilipotoa orodha ya tovuti maarufu zaidi nchini Kenya.

eng: Budget airline Jambo Jet was launched, NMG’s county paper Nairobi News was launched and then killed off, entertainment website izvipi was relaunched and Sauti Sol released a controversial, but popular, video for their new song ‘Nishike”.
swa: Tovti ya Budget airline Jambo Jet ilizinduliwa, gazeti linalomilikiwa na kampuni ya NMG liitwalo Nairobi News lilizinduliwa na kufanikiwa, tovuti ya burudani ya izvipi nayo ilianzishwa na Sauti Sol ilitoa video ya wimbo wao mpya iliyoibua mjadala mkali, lakini ilijipatia umaarufu, ‘Nishike”.

eng: On the websites popularity front, there are a few changes as well.
swa: Kwenye orodha ya tovuti maarufu, kuna mabadiliko kadhaa kama unavyoona hapa.

eng: Kenyan Post has overtaken Ghafla as the most popular blog in Kenya
swa: Kenyan Post imeipiku Ghafla kama blogu maarufu zaidi nchini Kenya

eng: Jumia, KRA, Career Point Kenya, Helb and Techweez have gone up the ranking.
swa: Jumia, KRA, Career Point Kenya, Helb na Techweez zimepanda chati.

eng: Niaje, The Star, Orange and Michezo Afrika have gone down in the ranking.
swa: Niaje, The Star, Orange na Michezo Afrika zimeshuka umaarufu.

eng: Ben Kiruthi, KU, Kenya Today and Kopo Kopo have joined the top 50 ranking.
swa: Ben Kiruthi, KU, Kenya Today na Kopo Kopo zimeingia kwenye orodha ya 50 bora.

eng: MISA-Swaziland is live tweeting the the trial of human rights lawyer Thulani Maseko and journalist Bheki Makhubu for contempt of court in Swaziland.
swa: MISA-Swaziland anatwiti moja kwa moja mwenendo wa mashitaka dhidi ya mwanasheria wa haki za binadamuThulani Maseko na mwandishi wa habari Bheki Makhubu bila ruhusa ya mahakama nchini Swaziland.

eng: The two were arrested on 17 March 2014.
swa: Wawili hao walikamatwa mnamo Machi 17, 2014.

eng: Image by laranggio on Flickr.
swa: Picha na laranggio kwenye mtandao wa flickr.

eng: CC BY-NC-SA 2.0.
swa: CC BY-NC-SA 2.0.

eng: JM Casanueva, author of the blog SocialTIC, reviews the new trend in activism in Mexico that uses humor on blogs and social networks to reach a larger audience:
swa: JM Casanueva, mwandishi wa blogu ya SocialTIC, anapitia mwelekeo mpya wa harakati nchini Mexico kwenye blogu na kwenye mitandao ya kijamii ambayo inatumia utani kuwafikia watu wengi zaidi:

eng: Humor has always been a successful tactic to transmit causes in an empathetic way (yes, someone who is not you or your fellow activists understands the problem) and reach larger audiences (yes, beyond the lxs groups of usual suspects that always retweet you).
swa: Utani mara zote umekuwa ni mbinu inayofanikiwa sana kufikisha ujumbe (ndio, kwamba mtu fulani ambaye sio wewe au mwanaharakati mwenzako anaelewa tatizo) na kuifikia hadhira kubwa zaidi (ndiyo, zaidi ya makundi ya mtandaoni ya watu wanaokuhisi na kusambaza ujumbe wako).

eng: Mexican activism in 2014 has had a good dose of humor by comedians that have used their talents, keenness and social engagement to impact society.
swa: Wanaharakati wa Kimexico mwaka 2014 wamekuwa na dozi ya kutosha ya ucheshi kutoka wachekeshaji wanaotumia vipaji vyao, umakini na kujichanganya kwao na jamii kuleta manufaa kwa jamii.

eng: You can follow SocialTIC on Twitter.
swa: Unaweza kufuatilia SocialTIC kwenye Twitter.

eng: From Mexico, Katia D'Artigues, author of the blog Campos Elíseos (Champs Elysées), writes about the children who see themselves forced to emigrate on their own , and calls this a "humanitarian tragedy":
swa: Kutoka Mexico, Katia D'Artigues, ambaye ni mwandishi wa blogu ya Campos Elíseos (Champs Elysées), aandika kuhusiana na watoto kulazimika kuhama wao wenyewe , hali inayompelekea kuiita hali hii kuwa ni "baa la kibinadamu":

eng: They are children who are pulled to cross the border by themselves.
swa: Ni watoto wanaolazimika kusafiri hadi nchi nyingine peke yao.

eng: They don't do it for the sake of adventure, but because most of the times they don't have any more choices, out of poverty; because they are looking to reunite with a relative, maybe their father or mother who is already in the United States.
swa: Hawafanyi hivyo kwa sababu za kitalii, sababu kubwa ni kuwa hawana namna nyingine, ni umasikini, ni kwa sababu wanajaribu kuwatafuta ndugu zao ili waungane nao tena, yawezekana ni baba au mama zao ambao tayari wameshafika Marekani.

eng: Figures grow day by day.
swa: Idadi ya wahamiaji watoto inaongezeka siku hadi siku.

eng: They are already counted by the thousands and at least a hundred are put into custody every day, according to unofficial numbers.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa takwimu zisizo rasmi, maelfu ya watoto husafiri na idadi isiyopungua mia moja hukamatwa kila siku.

eng: She then adds:
swa: Anaongeza kuwa:

eng: How are those children? No matter their status and citizenship, they are children and have rights.
swa: Vipi kuhusu hao watoto? bila kujali hali yao na uraia wao, bado ni watoto na wana haki.

eng: It's established already that they will be provided an attorney for free to assess their process, which obviously is one per child.
swa: Imekwisha fahamika kuwa, watoto hawa, kila mmoja atapewa mwanasheria wake.

eng: For now, there are only 100 attorneys who will start working by December this year or January 2015.
swa: Hadi sasa wameshapatikana wanasheria 100 tu ambao wataanza kazi mwezi Disemba mwaka huu au mwezi Januari, 2015.

eng: They won't be enough.
swa: Hawatatosha.

eng: Carlos Thompson from The Chlewey Blog writes about the importance of teaching Maths in Colombia in relation to the poor performance the country had in international tests of quality of education :
swa: Carlos Thompson wa blogu ya Chlewey anaandika juu ya umuhimu wa kufundisha Hesabu nchini Colombia kutokana na nchi hiyo kufanya vibaya kwenye vipimo ya kimataifa vya ubora wa elimu :

eng: Maths provide much more than the ability of countng the change at the store, or the specific abilities to be admitted into Engineering School.
swa: Hesabu huwezesha zaidi ya uwezo wa kutoa 'chenji' dukani, au uwezo maalum wa kuweza kuajiriwa katika Shule ya Uhandisi.

eng: Maths generate a mental structure that also benefits the physician, the social communicator or the socióogist, not specificlaly to be successful in their profession, but as citizens in a democracy and as individuals that have influence in a society.
swa: Hesabu huzalisha muundo wa akili ambao pia humfaidisha daktari, mwasilianaji wa kijamii au mwanasosholojia, si kumfanya awe na mafanikio katika taaluma yake, lakini kuwa raia katika demokrasia na kama watu binafsi wenye ushawishi katika jamii.

eng: This post was part of the fourth #LunesDeBlogsGV on May 26, 2014.
swa: Posti hii ilikuwa ni sehemu ya nne ya #LunesDeBlogsGV mnamo Mei 26, 2014.

eng: Global Voices co-founder, Rebecca MacKinnon, was awarded a Knight News Challenge award to develop a global ranking of Internet companies.
swa: Mwanzilishi wa Global Voices, Rebecca MacKinnon, alitunukiwa tuzo ya Knight News Challenge kwa ajili ya kutayarisha safu ya kiulimwengu ya makampuni yanayotoa huduma ya intaneti.

eng: Photo by Brooke Bready.
swa: Picha na Brooke Bready.

eng: The Global Voices community congratulates two treasured members of our community who are among the winners of the 2014 Knight News Challenge.
swa: Jumuia ya Global Voices inawapongeza wanajumuia wetu wawili ambao ni miongoni wa washindi wa tuzo ya mwaka 2014 ya Knight News Challenge.

eng: The results of the competition were announced today at the MIT-Knight Civic Media Conference in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
swa: Matokeo ya shindano hili yametangazwa leo katika Ukumbi wa MIT-Knight Civic Media Cambridge, Massachusetts.

eng: This year, the Miami-based Knight Foundation awarded a total of US$3,466,000 to projects responding to the question: "How can we strengthen the Internet for free expression and innovation?"
swa: Mwaka huu, taasisi ya Knight yenye maskani yake huko Miami ilitoa fedha kiasi cha dola za Marekani 3,466,000 katika miradi iliyolenga kujibu swali lililouliza: "Ni kwa jinsi gani tunaweza kuimarisha mtandao wa intaneti kwa ajili ya uhuru wa kujieleza na ubunifu?"

eng: Global Voices' co-founder, Rebecca MacKinnon, received $300,000 to develop Ranking Digital Rights along with colleagues at the New America Foundation.
swa: Mwanzilishi mshiriki wa Globalvoices, Rebecca MacKinnon,alipokea kiasi cha dola za Marekani 300,000 ili kumwezesha yeye pamoja na wenzake wa taasisi ya New America katika kuandaa Safu ya Haki za Digitali.

eng: The grant will enable Rebecca and her team to rate Internet companies on how well they protect the privacy of their users, and publish a global ranking to help encourage companies to improve their practices.
swa: Ufadhili huu utamuwezesha Rebecca na wenzake katika kuandaa safu itakayoonesha ni kwa kiasi gani makampuni yanayotoa huduma ya intaneti yanavyoweza kutunza haki za wateja wao, ikiwa ni pamoja na kuiweka hadharani rafu hiyo ya kidunia kwa lengo la kuyahamasisha makampuni hayo kuboresha huduma zake.

eng: People are using social media platforms, telecommunications services, smartphones from these companies, Rebecca said.
swa: Rebecca alifafanua, "watu wanatumia majukwaa ya mitandao ya kijamii, huduma za mawasiliano pamoja na simu za gharama kutoka katika makampuni haya".

eng: What are their policies and practices?
swa: Sera na utendaji kazi wao ni upi?

eng: Rebecca added that Ranking Digital Rights was inspired by a conversation that took place at the 2012 Global Voices Summit in Nairobi, Kenya.
swa: Rebecca aliongeza kuwa, mradi ya kuandaa Safu ya Haki za Digitali uliungwa mkono katika majadiliano yaliyofanyika katika Kongamano la mwaka 2012 la Global Voices lililofanyika Nairobi, Kenya.

eng: I was brainstorming with a bunch of people about how we hold companies accountable, and Mohamed ElGohary said, I'd like to see a list."
swa: Nilikuwa nikijadiliana na watu mbalimbali kuhusu namna ambavyo tunavyoweza kuyawajibisha makampuni yanayotoa huduma ya intaneti, hapo ndipo Mohamed ElGohary aliposema, ningependa kuona orodha."

eng: And other people continued to tell me the same thing."
swa: Na pia, watu wengine waliendelea kuliunga mkono jambo hili."

eng: Jillian C. York's Knight News Challenge-winning project will collect data about censorship on online platforms such as Facebook and Twitter.
swa: Jillian C. York aliye miongoni mwa washindi wa tuzo ya Knight News Challenge ambaye mradi wake utahusika na kukusanya taarifa za udhibiti wa taarifa katika majukwaa ya mtandaoni kama vile Facebook na Twitter.

eng: The project from the other Global Voices laureate, Jillian C. York, also takes on private companies, though from a different angle.
swa: Mradi wa mwanajumuia mwingine wa Global Voices aliyejipatia tuzo kwa kazi yake nzuri, Jillian C. York, utajikita zaidi kwenye makampuni binafsi, pamoja na kuwa, malengo yake yatakuwa kwa mtazamo tofauti.

eng: Jillian, who joined Global Voices in 2007 and serves on the board as volunteers' representative, was awarded $250,000 for OnlineCensorship.org, a platform she'll develop with colleagues at the Electronic Frontier Foundation, where she's Director for International Freedom of Expression.
swa: Jillian, aliyejiunga na Global Voices mwaka 2007 na kufanya kazi kwenye jukwaa hili kama mwakilishi wa kujitolea, alitunukiwa kiasi cha dola za Marekani 250,000 kwa ajili ya OnlineCensorship.org, jukwaa atakalolianzisha yeye pamoja na wenzake katika taasisi ya Electronic Frontier, ambapo, yeye ni mkurugenzi wa taasisi ya Uhuru wa Kimataifa wa Kujieleza.

eng: Currently in alpha, the platform will collect data about incidents of censorship on online platforms such as Facebook and Twitter, with the aim of helping society better understand and manage censorship and free expression issues.
swa: Katika vipau mbele ilivyojiwekea, jukwaa hili litakusanya taarifa kuhusiana na matukio ya udhibiti wa taarifa katika majukwaa ya mtandaoni kama vile Facebook na Twitter, ikiwa na lengo la kuisaidia jamii kuwa na uelewa mpana na namna ya kukabiliana na mambo yanayohusiana na udhibiti wa taarifa na uhuru wa kujieleza.

eng: Many of us have experienced the phenomenon of social media companies taking down our content or deactivating accounts, Jillian said.
swa: Wengi wetu tumeshashuhudia matukio ya makampuni ya uanahabari wa kijamii yakiondoa baadhi ya yale tuyawekayo katika mitandao na pia kufunga akaunti zetu,Jillian alidokeza.

eng: It's really a global phenomenon. 	Kwa kweli, hali hii ipo kila mahali".
I hope the Global Voices community will contribute to the data, which will enable us to show companies and the world the real impact of private organisations on regulating online speech."
swa: Ni matumaini yangu kuwa jumuia ya Global Voices itachangia katika kutoa taarifa ambazo zitatuwezesha kuyaonesha makampuni pamoja na ulimwengu kuhusiana na madhara halisi yatokanayo na vitendo vya makampuni binafsi kudhibiti uhuru wa kujieleza wa mtandaoni"

eng: 44,000 Malagasy Children Die Every Year for Lack of Care.
swa: Watoto Wachanga 44,000 wa Madagaska Hupoteza Maisha kila Mwaka kwa Kukosa Matunzo.

eng: Madagascan children by Yves Picq - CC-BY-SA-3.0
swa: Watoto wa Madagaska na Yves Picq - CC-BY-SA-3.0

eng: In Madagascar, 44,000 children under the age of five die each year, according to the latest UNICEF figures.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa takwimu za hivi karibuni za Shirika la Watoto Duniani, UNICEF watoto 44,000 walio chini ya umri wa miaka mitano hupoteza maisha kila mwaka nchini Madagaska.

eng: That number is the same as the population of all children five and under in the entire Alpes-de-Haute-Provence region of France.
swa: Idadi hii ni sawa na idadi ya watoto wote wa miaka mitano na chini ya miaka mitano katika eneo lote la jimbo la Alpes-de-Haute la ukanda wa Ufaransa.

eng: It’s also the number of victims in the 9/11 terrorist attacks, 15 times over.
swa: Pia, ni idadi ya wahanga wa mashambulizi ya kigaidi ya Septemba 11, zaidi ya mara 15.

eng: The tragedy behind the number - losing a child - most often affects families of limited means.
swa: Matukio ya watoto kupoteza maisha kwa kiasi kikubwa yanaathiri familia zisizojiweza.

eng: Two groups in Madagascar are particularly vulnerable in terms of public health: children younger than five, and pregnant women.
swa: Katika nchi ya Madagaska, suala la afya ya jamii imeonekana kuathiri zaidi makundi mawili: watoto walio na umri chini ya maika mitano na wanawake wajawazito.

eng: According to the World Bank, half of all children under five experience delayed growth, "a larger proportion than in any other country in Africa."
swa: Kwa mujibu wa Benki ya Dunia, nusu ya watoto wote hudumaa, "uwiano ambao ni mkubwa kabisa miongoni mwa mataifa yote ya Afrika."

eng: The maternal mortality rate is estimated at approximately 498 per 100,000 live births, and the causes of death are many, including limited access to skilled staff during delivery, poor prenatal care, and lack of emergency care.
swa: Kiwango cha vifo vya watoto unakadiriwa kufikia watoto 498 kwa kila wanawake 100,000 wanaojifungulia katika vituo vya afya. Vyanzo vya vifo hivi ni vingi, ikiwa ni pamoja na kukosa wataalamu wa kutosha wa kuwasaidia wanawake wakati wa kujifungua, matunzo hafifu katika kipindi cha kabla ya kujifungua na ukosefu wa huduma za dharura.

eng: The health record is appalling, yet there is no shortage of initiatives to change the situation.
swa: Wakati hali ya utoaji wa huduma za afya inazidi kuzorota, hadi sasa hakuna hatua zozote zilizokwisha kuchukuliwa ili kukabiliana na tatizo hili.

eng: In Toliara in southern Madagascar, a school lunch project is helping to fight the problems of chronic malnutrition.
swa: Huko Toliara, kusini mwa Madagaska, mradi wa chakula cha mchana mashuleni unasaidia katika kukabiliana na matatizo yaliyokithiri ya utapia mlo.

eng: The organization Les Enfants du Soleil (Children of the Sun) houses and educates street children and children from needy families.
swa: Shirika la Les Enfants du Soleil (Watoto wa Jua) linawapa hifadhi na kuwasomesha watoto wa mitaani pamoja na wale wanaotokea katika familia zisizojiweza.

eng: The children also receive a noontime meal in the school cafeteria.
swa: Pia, watoto hupata chakula cha mchana katika mkahawa wa shule.

eng: Take a look at photos of children who benefit in this French-language YouTube video:
swa: Tazama picha za watoto wanaofaidika na mradi huu katika video ya You tube iliyo katika lugha ya kifaransa:

eng: Other programs target specific problems such as sickle-cell anemia or malaria.
swa: Miradi mingine inalenga kushughulika na changamoto zenye kuhitaji ufuatiliaji wa karibu zaidi kama vile ugonjwa wa upungufu wa damu au malaria.

eng: The organization LCDMF (the initials stand for Fight Against Sickle-Cell Anemia in Madagascar) works to make the population more aware of this genetic disease affecting 2 percent of the Madagascan people.
swa: Shirika la LCDMF (vifupisho vikiwa na maana ya Tokomeza Anemia Nchini Madagaska) linafanya kazi ya kutoa elimu kwa watu wa Madagaska kuhusiana na ugonjwa huu wa kurithi unaoathiri asilimia 2 ya watu wa Madagaska.

eng: In the following video, the team leaders of LCDMF describe the past activities of the NGO and its objectives for the next three years.
swa: Video ifuatayo inawaonesha viongozi wa LCDMF wakitoa ufafanuzi wa kazi za asasi hii binafsi zilizokwishafanyika pamoja na malengo yake ya miaka mitatu ijayo.

eng: Two of their objectives for the upcoming years are to give better access to antibiotics for sickle-cell anemia patients and to convince Malagasy political leaders that sickle-cell anemia ought to be included in the nation's public health priorities:
swa: Kurahisisha upatikanaji wa viuavijasumu (antibiotics) vya ugonjwa wa anemia na kuwashauri viongozi wa Madagaska kutoa kipaumbele kwa ugonjwa wa anemia katika vipaumbele vya taifa vya huduma ya afya yajamii, ni miongoni mwa malengo mawili ya asasi hii isiyo ya kiserikali kwa miaka ijayo:

eng: In an open letter to Prime Minister Malgache Kolo Roger, LCDMF stressed the importance of treating this problem, especially in isolated regions without modern health facilities:
swa: Katika barua ya wazi aliyoandikiwa Waziri Mkuu, Malgache Kolo Roger, asasi ya LCDMF ilisisitiza umuhimu wa kukabiliana na tatizo hili na hususani katika maeneo yaliyosahaulika na yasiyo na mifumo ya kisasa ya utoaji wa huduma ya afya:

eng: This is a critical public health problem that has a dramatic impact on the neediest inhabitants in a region with nearly a 20 percent disease rate and where one out of five children with major sickle-cell anemia is not likely to survive past the age of five.
swa: Hili ni tatizo kubwa sana katika afya ya jamii lililo na madhara makubwa kwa watu wanaohitaji msaaada wa haraka katika eneo lililo na kiwango cha ongezeko la ugonjwa huu kwa asilimia 20 na ambapo kwa kila mtoto mmoja kati ya watoto watano walio na anemia huwa katika hatari ya kupoteza maisha baada ya kufikisha miaka mitano.

eng: The problem can no longer be handled with half measures.
swa: Tatizo hili haliwezi tena kumalizwa kwa kulipa msisitizo hafifu.

eng: Because sickle-cell anemia is cross-disciplinary and involves all medical specialties, this disease alone illustrates how essential it is for you to immediately take stock of the healthcare situation in our backyard.
swa: Kwa kuwa, ugonjwa wa anemia unamuhusisha kila mmoja na kuwajumuisha wataalamu wote wa afya, ugonjwa huu unaonesha ni kwa jinsi gani unavyopaswa kupewa msisitizo wa haraka kwa kutoa huduma za afya zinazopaswa.

eng: Much remains to be done
swa: Bado kuna mambo mengi yanayotakiwa kutekelezwa

eng: Another area with a pressing need for action is maternal health, due to rapid population growth in Madagascar.
swa: Sehemu nyingine yenye kuhitaji msisitizo wa haraka na kufanyiwa kazi ni afya ya uzazi, hii inatokana na ongezeko la haraka la idadi ya watu nchini Madagaska.

eng: For example, one out of five married women who wishes to space out or limit pregnancies has no access to family planning services (19 percent), and the abortion rate is estimated at one out of every 10 live births, according to the Madagascar National Institute of Statistics (INSAT) and the United Nations Fund for Population (UNFPA).
swa: Kwa mfano, kwa mujibu wa Taasisi ya Taifa ya Takwimu ya Madagaska (INSAT) pamoja na Mfuko wa Takwimu ya Watu wa Umoja wa Mataifa (UNFPA), mmoja kati ya wanawake watano walioolewa wanaopenda kupangilia uzazi au kuzuia mimba hawana elimu ya uzazi wa mpango (asilimia 19), na kiwango cha utoaji mimba kinakadiriwa kufikia mwanamke mmoja kati ya kila wanawake 10 wanaojifungulia katika vituo vya afya.

eng: Despite these efforts, Madagascar is faced with certain weaknesses that hinder improvement in health indicators.
swa: Pamoja na juhudi zote hizi, Madagaska inakabiliwa na mapungufu kadhaa yanayokwamisha uboreshaji wa mambo muhimu katika utoaji wa huduma ya afya.

eng: The source of poor and uneven health outcomes lies in the disparities in household incomes and physical access to health services.
swa: Huduma hafifu inachangiwa na utofauti wa vipato katika familia pamoja na namna ya kuzipata huduma za afya.

eng: Consequently, nearly one in four people (23 percent) with an illness did not seek care at a health center because they could not pay for it.
swa: Kutokana na changamoto hizi, takribani mtu mmoja kati ya watu wanne (sawa na asilimia 23) wanaosumbuliwa na maradhi hawakuweza kupata huduma ya matibabu kwa kuwa hawakuwa na fedha za kulipia.

eng: Availability of medication is also a real problem because the systematic failures in drug management and inventory tracking as well as distribution logistics hamper proper distribution of medications.
swa: Upatikanaji wa dawa pia ni tatizo kubwa kwa kuwa kuna tatizo la kukosekana kwa usimamizi madhubuti wa dawa na taarifa za upatikanaji wa dawa pamoja na taratibu za usambazaji zinazokwamisha mgawanyo sahihi.

eng: As a result, the wealthy use health services four times more often than the poor: 40.9 percent of total expenses in this sector were attributed to the wealthiest fifth, whereas 10.1 percent were paid by the poorest fifth, according to the World Bank.
swa: Matokeo yake ni kuwa, watu matajiri hufaidi huduma za afya mara nne zaidi ya watu masikini: kwa mujibu wa Benki ya Dunia, asilimia 40.9 ya matumizi yote ya sekta ya afya yalichangiwa na kundi la watu matajiri, wakati asilimia 10.1 ilichangiwa na kundi la watu masikini.

eng: Strengthen nutrition programs targeting the most vulnerable groups, and their access to adequate nutrition; Enhance efficiency of budgetary expenses; Improve management of healthcare human resources; Introduce risk-free delivery kits; Bring doctors back to health centers in rural areas.
swa: Kuboresha miradi ya lishe kwa kuangalia zaidi makundi yanayoathirika zaidi na namna bora ya upatikanaji wa lishe ya kutosha; Kuboresha ufanisi wa matumizi ya bajeti ya afya; Kuboresha usimamizi wa rasilimali watu katika utoaji wa huduma za afya; Uwepo wa vifaa kwa ajili ya kutolea huduma za dharura za afya; Kuwarudisha madaktari katika vituo vya afya vya vijijini.

eng: The situation is dire but not desperate, at least not yet.
swa: Hali ni tete, pamoja na kuwa haijafikia kiwango cha kukatisha tamaa.

eng: The proposed policies can be readily implemented if given the political will.
swa: Sera zilizopendekezwa zinaweza kutekelezwa vizuri kama zitapewa kipau mbele na serikali.

eng: The Malagasy children have waited 50 years for their collective health to be at the top of the national agenda.
swa: Watoto wa Malagasi wamesubiri kwa miaka 50 ili kupata mustakabali wa afya yao katika vipau mbele muhimu vya Taifa.

eng: It is high time authorities are reminded that no respectable country would tolerate the obliteration of its future in such a manner, 44,000 times a year.
swa: Ni muda muafaka wa kuikumbusha serikali kuwa hakuna nchi inayoheshimika ingaliweza kuvumilia kuona vizazi vijavyo vikiteketea katika hali kama hii, vifo 44,000 kwa mwaka.

eng: Even before the national team defeated the Netherlands to advance to the World Cup final, Argentina was celebrating.
swa: Hata kabla ya timu ya taifa hilo kuichapa Uholanzi kusonga mbele kwenye fainali za Kombe la Dunia, Ajentina ilikuwa inasherehekea.

eng: July 9 is the country's Independence Day, and the day before archrival Brazil was knocked out of the tournament after suffering a brutal 7-1 loss to Germany.
swa: Siku ya Julai 9 ni Siku ya Uhuru wa nchi hiyo, na ilikuwa ni siku moja kabla ya wapinzani wake wa asili Brazil hajatolewa nje ya mashindano baada ya kushishiwa kipigo cha fedheha cha mabao 7-1 na Ujerumani.

eng: The delight was especially palpable in Tucumán, a city that played a leading role in the Argentinian independence and was an important witness to the events of 1816.
swa: Furaha ilikuwa kubwa huko Tucumán, jiji lilikuwa msitari wa mbele kwa uhuru wa Ajentina na lilikuwa shahidi wa matukio ya mwaka 1816.

eng: There, the Alto Peru Mounted Fanfare Band played a taunting song called "Brasil, decime qué se siente" (roughly translated as, how about that, Brazil!) that has become popular this World Cup.
swa: Pale, bendi iitwayo Alto Peru Mounted Fanfare Band ilipiga wimbo inaoitwa "Brasil, decime qué se siente" (wenye maana ya, vipi hapo, Brazil!) ambao umekuwa maarufu sana kwenye Mashindano haya ya Kombe la Dunia.

eng: The lyrics, set to the melody of Creedence Clearwater Rival's "Bad Moon Rising," refer to Argentina's win over Brazil in the 1990 World Cup in Italy.
swa: Mashairi, yalikuwa na mahadhi ya 'Bad Moon Rising', unaokumbusha ushindi wa Ajentina dhidi ya Brazil kwenye fainali za Kombe la Dunia mwaka 1990 nchini Italia.

eng: That match remained goalless until the final minutes when Diego Maradona passed the ball to Claudio Caniggia, who managed to score on Brazilian goalkeeper Taffarel.
swa: Mchezo huo uliodumu bila magoli mpaka dakika ya mwisho ambapo Diego Maradona alimpasia mpira Claudio Caniggia, aliyeweza kuupachika wavuni na kumzidi maarifa mlinda mlango wa Brazili Taffarel.

eng: Argentina went on to lose to West Germany in the final:
swa: Ajentina ilifungwa na Ujerumani Magharibi katika fainali:

eng: Brazil, tell me how it feels to have your daddy home / I swear that even though time passes by we won't forget it / that Diego dribbled past you and Cani scored on you / you have been crying since Italy / you'll see Messi bring us the cup / Maradona is greater than Pelé.
swa: Brazili, niambie unavyojisikia kumpokea baba yenu / Ninaapa kwamba hata kama muda utapita sitasahau / kwamba Diego aliwapita walinzi wako na Cani akautia mpira kimiani / mmekuwa mkilia tangu enzi za Italia / mtamwona Messi akituletea kombe / Maradona ni mkali kuliko Pelé.

eng: News and video of the military band's musical jab spread quickly on Twitter.
swa: Habari na video ya bendi ya jeshi kupiga wimbo huo zilisambaa haraka sana kwenye mtandao wa Twita.

eng: The blog Acordes 21 posted the chords for anyone who would like to play the song.
swa: Blogu yaAcordes 21 ilichapisha mpangilio wa sauti za wimbo huo kwa ajili ya kumsaidia yeyote anayependa kuuimba.

eng: The fans behind the song are Ignacio Harraca and Patricio Scordo.
swa: Mashabiki nyuma ya wimbo ni Ignacio Harraca na Patricio Scordo.

eng: Harraca explained to Argentinian newspaper Clarín that after confirming that they had tickets to see Argentina play, him and a group of friends wanted to do something different to celebrate.
swa: Harraca alilieleza Gazeti la Ajentina Clarín kwamba baada ya kuthibitisha kwamba walikuwa wamekata tiketi kwa ajili ya kushuhudia mpambano huo wa Ajentina, yeye na rafiki zake walitaka kufanya jambo tofauti kusherehekea.

eng: Once they finalized the lyrics, they circulated them on social media and distributed them on paper.
swa: Walipomaliza mashairi hayo, waliyasambaza kwenye mitandao ya kijamii na kwa njia ya makaratasi.

eng: They debuted the song in front of the team's hotel the night before the Bosnia match:

eng: We distributed the leaflets, and when there was a bit of silence we began to sing it.
swa: Tulisambaza vipeperushi, na palipokuwa na ukimya kidogo tukaamua kuwanza kuimba.

eng: A while later, everyone had caught on and for like 40 minutes you could hear non-stop.
swa: Baadae kidogo, kila mmoja akawa ameufahamu na kama kwa dakika 40 hivi wimbo uliimbwa kwa mfululizo.

eng: IP addresses inside the Russian government continue to be active on Wikipedia, where a computer at the Russian Secret Service, the FSO, revised the German entry for Malaysia Airlines Flight 17, changing the word "separatists" into "rebels."
swa: Alama kadhaa za utambulisho wa kompyuta (IP address) ndani ya serikali ya Urusi zimeendelea kufanya kazi kazi kwenye kamusi elezo ya Wikipedia, ambapo kompyuta ya Shirika la Upelelezi la Urusi, FSO, ilihariri makala ya Kijerumani kuhusu Ndege ya Shirika la Ndege la Malaysia MH17, ikibadili neno "wanaotaka kujitenga" kuwa "waasi."

eng: The Twitter bot @RuGovEdits, which automatically logs all Wikipedia edits made from Russian government IP addresses, caught five separate attempts by an FSO computer this morning to make the "rebels" language stick.
swa: Teknolojia ya Twita ya @RuGovEdits, ambayo bila kuongozwa kufuatilia uhariri wowote unaofanywa kwenye kurasa za Wikipedia kupitia alama za utambulisho wa kompyuta za serikali ya Urusi, ilibaini majaribio saba tofauti yaliyofanywa na kompyuta za "mashushushu" wa FSO asubuhi hii kuhakikisha kuwa neno "waasi" linabaki kwenye kumbukumbu.

eng: The effort failed.
swa: JItihada hizo zilikwama.

eng: German Wikipedia editors reverted the article's language to the original text, every time.
swa: Wahariri wa Kamusi Elezo ya Wikipedia kwa Kijerumani walirudisha maandishi ya awali yaliyokuwepo kwenye makala hiyo, kila mara.

eng: German Wikipedia's MH17 makeover, brought to you by the Russian government.
swa: Uhariri wa Kamusi elezo ya Wikipedia Kijerumani kuhusu MH17 kama unavyoletwa kwako na serikali ya Urusi.

eng: A group of Ghanaians rallied near the president's office as part of a campaign dubbed #OccupyFlagStaffHouse to protest corruption and the country's poor economic situation and press the government to do something about it.
swa: Kundi la raia wa Ghana walikusanyika karibu na Ikulu ya Rais kama sehemu ya kampeni yao #OccupyFlagStaffHouse yenye lengo la kupinga rushwa pamoja na hali tete ya uchumi ikiwa ni sehemu ya harakati zao za kuishinikiza serikali katika kukabiliana na matatizo haya.

eng: The peaceful march, organized in less than five days, happened on July 1, 2014, a public holiday that marked the 54th year since Ghana became a republic following British colonial rule.
swa: Matembezi haya ya amani yaliyoratibiwa katika muda wa siku zisizozidi tano, yalitokea mnamo tarehe 1 Julai, 2014, siku ya mapumziko inayoadhimishwa tangu Ghana ilipokuwa jamhuri kufuatia utawala wa Kijerumani.

eng: The movement was launched on Facebook as OccupyGhana on June 28, and by July 1 it had over 3,000 followers in support of the protest.
swa: Harakati hizi zilianzishwa katika mtandao wa Facebook kwa jina la OccupyGhana siku ya tarehe 28 Juni, na hadi kufikia Julai 1, ilikuwa na wafuatiliaji zaidi ya 3,000 waliokuwa wakiunga mkono maandamano haya.

eng: It now has more than 6,000.
swa: Kwa sasa ina zaidi ya waungaji mkono 6,000.

eng: This comes in the wake of a series of backlashes against the government for the fast depreciation of the cedi since it tightened the country's foreign currency rules and eased them last month, and the shortage of fuel that led to long queues at petrol stations for about a week.
swa: Harakati hizi zinakuja kufuatia mfululizo wa maandamano dhidi ya serikali kutokana na kupungua kwa haraka kwa thamani ya fedha ya Ghana kwani serikali iliongeza vikwazo katika taratibu za fedha za kigeni na mwezi uliopita ikavilegeza tena, hali iliyopelekea kupungua kwa nishati na hivyo kusababisha misururu mirefu ya watu katika vituo vya mafuta, hali iliyodumu kwa takribani wiki moja.

eng: The tipping point was when the government allegedly delivered 3 million US dollars appearance fee in cash to the Ghana Black Stars ahead of their World Cup match against Portugal, a match that was lost.
swa: Hali ilikuwa mbaya zaidi pale serikali iliposemekana kupeleka kiasi cha dola milioni 3 za Marekani kwa ajili ya kikosi cha taifa cha mpira wa miguu Ghana Black Stars kabla ya mechi yao ya kombe la dunia dhidi ya Ureno, ambapo Ghana ilipoteza mchezo huo.

eng: The players had threatened to strike if they did not receive their money before the match.
swa: Wachezaji walitishia kususia mchezo huo kama wasingepewa kiasi hicho cha fedha kabla ya mchezo huo.

eng: The general sentiment after this incident was that government did not care for the people, escalating to outrage on radio, TV and social media platforms.
swa: Mtazamo wa jumla wa tukio hili ni kuwa, serikali haikuwajali watu wake, udhalilishaji uliokithiri katika kupitia redio, televisheni na majukwaa ya mitandando ya kijamii.

eng: In the days leading up to the protest, the group OccupyGhana posted messages that explained their dissatisfaction with government and the state of things in the country.
swa: Katika siku za kukaribia maandamano, kundi la OccupyGhana liliweka jumbe zilizokuwa zikielezea kutokuridhishwa na serikali pamoja na namna hali ya mambo ilivyo nchini mwao.

eng: On June 29, the group wrote on Facebook:
swa: Tarehe 29 Juni, kundi hili liliandika katika ukurasa wa Facebook:

eng: This evening I saw police pickups even loading and stockpiling fuel.
swa: Jioni hii niliona magari ya polisi yakijazwa mafuta na hata kuchukua na ya ziada.

eng: I saw the faces of taxi drivers who are doing work and pay and need to pay off loans struggling for fuel.
swa: Niliziona nyuso za waendesha magari ya kukodisha wakiwa wanaapaswa kufanya kazi na kupeleka fedha kwa waajiri wao, na pia wanaotakiwa kurudisha mikopo, wanahaha ili kupata mafuta na pia kutoa mikopo kwa ajili ya kununulia nishati

eng: I saw anxious workers who leave for work at 5am and return at 8pm but get paid pittance for their Labour anxiously waiting in queues with gallons.
swa: Niliwaona wafanyakazi waiojawa hofu walioondoka makazini kwao saa 11 asubuhi na kisha kurejea saa 2 usiku, na kupewa ujira mdogo, wakiwa na hofu, wanaonekana wakiwa na galoni zao kwenye misururu

eng: Then I saw the elderly couple with kids abroad who need fuel for daddy to go for the checkup, wondering where it all went wrong,
swa: Na ndipo nilipowaona wapenzi walio na watoto wao ughaibuni waliokuwa wanahitaji mafuta kwa ajili ya kumpeleka baba yao kwenye matibabu, wakiwa na butwaa kuwa tatizo la kukosekana kwa mafuta lilitoka na nini.

eng: The bread sellers, beans sellers, kofi broke man sellers who couldn't get taxis to carry their wares, those who need every present they make to survive, Then I saw people like you and I, the Facebookers, the tooknown young middle classers, who greet our poor neighbors every morning with a wave and a condescending how are you?
swa: Wauza mikate, wauza maharage, wachuuzi wa kahawa ambao hawakuweza kupata magari ya kukodisha kwa ajili ya kubeba mizigo yao. Ndipo nilipowaona watu kama wewe na mimi, watumiaji wa Facebook, tabaka la vijana wa umri wa kati, wanaowasalimu majirani zetu walio masikini kwa kuwapungia mikono huku wakitoa salamu ya majivuno, "hamjambo"? Unajawa hofu ya namna utakavyonunua nishati, au namna ya kurudisha deni, au namna ya kufanyia matengenezo lile gari la mkopo...

eng: Activists in Cuba are "putting the revolution in a kiss" in support of LGBT rights.

eng: The "Second Kissing Sit-In for Diversity and Equality," which was organized by Proyecto Arcoiris (Rainbow Project), an anti-capitalist and independent project, gathered about 60 people for the besada in one of the main plazas in Havana and about 15 people in own of Sagua La Grande in Villa Clara Province on June 28.
swa: Maandamano ya pili ya kukaa na kubusiana kpigania tofauti na usawa, ambayo yaliandaliwa na Proyecto Arcoiris (Mradi wa Rainbow ambao unapingana na ubepari na kupingania uhuru), ulikusanya watu 60 kwa ajili ya besada kwenye moja ya majengo makubwa ya kibiashara jijini Havana na watu wengine wasiopungua 15 wanaotokaSagua La Grande kwenye Jimbo la Villa Clara siku ya tarehe 28 Juni.

eng: At the event, activists read the letter that Arcoiris recently sent to Esteban Lazo, chairman of the country's legislature, the National Assembly of People's Power, in protest of the exclusion of gender identity and HIV status as motives of discrimination in the work environment in the New Cuban Labor Code.
swa: Kwenye tukio hilo, wanaharakati walisoma barua ambayo ilitumwa na Arcoiris kwenda kwa mbunge wa Bunge la Nchi hiyo, Esteban Lazo, kupinga kuondolewa kwa utambulisho wa kijinsia na hali ya afya ya VVU vinavyoonekana kuleta hisia ya ubaguzi katika mazingira ya kazi kwenye Sheria mpya ya kazi nchini humo.

eng: For centuries, the joint family tradition in India meant that several generations from grandparents to grandchildren lived under the same roof.
swa: Kwa miongo kadhaa, utamaduni wa familia kuishi pamoja nchini India ulimaanisha kuwa vizazi kadhaa kuanzia babu mpaka wajukuu viliishi kwenye nyumba moja.

eng: With India's rapid development, however, the country's social fabric is changing.
swa: Lakini shauri ya mageuzi ya haraka ya kimaendeleo nchini India, miingiliano ya kijamii nchini humo inabadilika.

eng: More and more Indians are living in smaller family units, and younger people are migrating in search of better opportunities.
swa: Wahindi wengi zaidi sasa wanaishi kwenye familia ndogo, na vijana wanahama kutafuta fursa bora zaidi za kimaisha.

eng: This has led to an increasing number of senior citizens being forced to live alone.
swa: Hali hii imesababisha kuongezeka kwa wazee wengi wanaolazimika kuishi maisha ya upweke.

eng: Many of them face isolation, neglect and loneliness.
swa: Wengi wao wanakabiliana madhila ya kutengwa, kupuuzwa na upweke.

eng: One heartwarming campaign is trying to help.
swa: Kampeni moja inayosisimua inajaribu kusaidia kubadili hali ya mambo.

eng: HelpAge India's HUG - Help Unite Generations encourages India's youth to befriend an elder and share a hug with the hope of building "inter-generational bonding and to increase the empathy of young adults towards elders".
swa: Kampeni inayoratibiwa na HelpAge India KUKUMBATIA- Kunasaidia kuunganisha vizazi inawahamasisha vijana wa Kihindi kufanya urafiki na wazee na kutuma picha zao zinazoonyesha wakiwakumbatia wazee kwa lengo la kujenga "muunganiko wa vizazi na vizazi na kuongeza uelewa wa vijana kwa hali wanazokabiliana nazo wazee".

eng: HelpAge India, a non-governmental organization that works for the cause and care of the elderly, explains on their advocacy page how young people can make a difference:
swa: HelpAge India, shirika lisilo la kiserikali ambalo hufanya kazi ya kuwasaidia na kuwajali wazee, linaeleza katika ukurasa wao utetezi namna vijana wanavyoweza kuleta tofauti:

eng: Whenever you see an elder person sitting all alone, look again!
swa: Wakati wowote unapomwona mzee amekaa mwenyewe, mtazame kwa mara ya pili!!

eng: He or she may be in your family or neighborhood or someone you’ve seen many times and is always alone.
swa: Anaweza kuwa anatoka kwenye familia yako au jirani yako au mtu uliyewahi kumwona mara nyingi akiwa peke yake.

eng: This person has one need that you can fulfill.
swa: Mzee huyo analo hitaji moja tu ambalo kwa hakika unaweza kulitimiza.

eng: With just one word, one smile, one HUG!
swa: Kwa neno moja, tabasamu moja, KUMBATIO moja!

eng: Just give them a little bit of your time.
swa: Wape wazee wa namna hii muda wako mdogo.

eng: These are the gestures that an elder seeks but often does not receive.
swa: Ishara hizi ndizo wazee wanazozitaka lakini kwa bahati mbaya hawazipati.

eng: The HUG Campaign encourages you to simply give a call, listen to experiences, ask how the day was and share your stories with your elder friend.
swa: Kampeni ya KUKUMBATIA inawahamasisha vijana kuwapigia simu, kusikiliza uzoefu wa wazee na kuwauliza siku yao imeendaje na shiriki masimulizi yako na rafiki yako mzee.

eng: The campaign posted a tear-jerking video showing what sharing a hug might look like:
swa: Kampeni hii imeweka video inayoweza kukutoa machozi kuonyesha kile ambacho kinaweza kusababishwa na kukumbatia mzee:

eng: Indians are living longer, and the number of silver citizens is increasing. According to a 2011 Government of India report , India's "grey population" (defined as 60 years old and up) is likely to increase its share of the total population from 7.4 percent in 2001 to 10 percent by 2026.
swa: Wahindi wanaishi maisha marefu, na idadi ya wazee vikongwe inaongezeka...Kwa mujibu wa taarifa ya mwaka 2011 iliyoandaliwa na Serikali ya India, "idadi ya wazee wa Kihindi wenye mvi" (inayoweza kutafsiriwa kama umri wa miaka 60 na kuendelea) inawezekana kuendelea kuongezeka miongoni mwa raia wa nchi hiyo kutoka asilimia 7.4 mwaka 2001 kufikia asilimia 10 mwaka 2026.

eng: Manjira Khurana (@KhuranaManjira), Country Head, Advocacy & Communications at HelpAge India, believes that efforts like this could help sensitize young people to the needs of the elderly.
swa: Manjira Khurana (@KhuranaManjira), Mkuu wa kitaifa, utetezi na Mawasiliano katika shirika la HelpAge India, anaamini kwamba jitihada kama hizi zinaweza kuwasaidia vijana kuelewa mahitaji ya wazee.

eng: Certainly, the elderly do not deserve to be marooned on the island of loneliness and abandonment in their silver years.
swa: Kwa hakika, wazee hawastahili kutelekezwa kwenye kisiwa cha upweke na ukiwa katika miaka yao ya uzeeni.

eng: Today, 50 percent of India's population is below 25.
swa: Leo, asilimia 50 ya idadi ya watu nchini India wana umri wa chini ya miaka 25.

eng: Is this young population listening?
swa: Je, kundi hili la vijana linasikia kampeni hii?

eng: And more importantly, will they take action now so that the elderly feel cared for, loved and wanted in the sunset years of their lives?
swa: Na lililo muhimu zaidi, je litachukua hatua sasa ili wazee wajisikie kujaliwa, kupendwa na hata kujisikia kuhitajika katika kipindi ambacho kwao ni kama jua linazama?

eng: I, for one, sincerely hope so.
swa: Mimi, mmoja wapo, nadhani kwa dhati itakuwa hivyo.

eng: Never worry about numbers.
swa: Usiwe na wasiwasi na idadi ya miaka.

eng: Help one person at a time, and always start with the person nearest you. pic.twitter.com/zHH2b5oZQ4 — HelpAge India (@HelpAgeIndia_) June 27, 2014
swa: Msaidie mtu mmoja kwa wakati mmoja, na siku zote anzia na mtu aliye karibu zaidi na wewe.

eng: A Singapore Airlines flight on March 29, 2014.
swa: Ndege ya Shirika la Ndege la Singapore Machi 29, 2014.

eng: Photo by Flickr user Aero Icarus.
swa: Picha na mtumiaji wa mtandao wa Flickr Aero Icarus.

eng: CC BY-NC-SA 2.0
swa: CC BY-NC-SA 2.0

eng: After news broke out about the Malaysian Airlines MH17 crash in eastern Ukraine, Singapore Airlines posted this message on Facebook and Twitter:
swa: Baada ya habari kufahamika kwamba ndege ya Shirika la Ndege la Malaysia MH17 imeanguka mashariki mwa Ukraine, Shirika la Ndege la Singapore liliweka ujumbe huu kwenye mtandao wa Facebook na Twita:

eng: Customers may wish to note that Singapore Airlines flights are not using Ukraine airspace. — Singapore Airlines (@SingaporeAir) July 17, 2014
swa: Wateja wanaweza kuendelea kufahamu kuwa ndege za Shirika la Ndege la Singapore hazitumii anga la Ukraine

eng: Many netizens accused the airline of being insensitive.
swa: Watumiaji wengi wa mtandao walililaumu shirika hilo la ndege kwa kutokuwa na uungwana.

eng: Sophie Chang commented on Facebook that "a better way for the airline to do is to express condolences first."
swa: Sophie Chang alitoa maoni kwenye mtandao wa Facebook kwamba "namna nzuri kwa shirika la ndege kufanya ni kutoa pole kwanza."

eng: But Stephen Chapman believes that the statement "was intended to bring calm in a general sense."
swa: Lakini Stephen Chapman anaamini kwamba kauli hiyo "ilikusudia kuleta utulivu kwa maana pana."

eng: Ryan Ik appreciated the clarification but he also felt that "without any words of sympathy, the update feels very cold."
swa: Ryan Ik alikubaliana na ufafanuzi huo lakini alijisikia "kukosa maneno ya kutoa pole, habari hizo hazikuwa za kiungwana."

eng: Insensitive or not, this short update has since then become a viral message in a matter of hours.
swa: Iwe ni kweli ama la kwamba ujumbe huo ulikosa uungwana, lakini tangu uwekwe mtandaoni umekuwa ukisambaa kwa kasi ndani ya masaa machache.

eng: #EmailSelfDefense infographic by Journalism++ for the Free Software Foundation (CC BY 4.0)
swa: Picha ya maelezo ya #UlinziwaBaruaPepe iliyotengenezwa na Mfuko wa Zana za Uandishi wa Habari wa Bure (CC BY 4.0)

eng: Email Self-Defense, a beginner's guide to email encryption by the Free Software Foundation (FSF), was released in six new languages on June 30, 2014.
swa: Ulinzi binafsi wa Barua pepe , ni mwongozo wa anayetaka kujifunza kulinda barua pepe zake kwa kutumia Mfuko wa Zana Huru (FSF), uliotolewa katika lugha sita mpya mnamo Juni 30, 2014.

eng: More languages are underway.
swa: Matoleo katika lugha nyinginezo yako mbioni kutoka.

eng: Even if you have nothing to hide, using encryption helps protect the privacy of people you communicate with, and makes life difficult for bulk surveillance systems.
swa: Hata kama huna cha kuficha, kutumia zana hii kunalinda faragha ya watu unaowasiliana nao, na kufanya iwe vigumu kwa mifumo inayofuatilia mawasiliano ya watu kufanikiwa.

eng: If you do have something important to hide, you're in good company; these are the same tools that Edward Snowden used to share his famous secrets about the NSA.
swa: Kama una kitu mihumu cha kuficha, basi umefika; hizi ni zana ambazo Edward Snowden alizitumia katika siri zake maarufu kuhusu sirika la ujasusi la Marekani NSA.

eng: Edward, a friendly email bot, helps Email Self-Defense users test their new encryption systems.
swa: Edward, kitufe kidogo rahisi, huwasaidia watumiaji wa zana ya Kujilinda Barua pepe zao katika mfumo mpya wa kutunza faragha.

eng: Email Self-Defense is only one important piece of the solution to bulk surveillance, FSF states:
swa: Ulinzi binafsi wa barua pepe ni sehemu muhimu ya utatuzi wa tatizo la kufuatiliwa mawasiliano, FSF linasema:

eng: While we learn email encryption tools, we also need to push politically to reign in surveillance, build a safer Internet, and force governments and companies to reduce the amount of data they collect about us in the first place.
swa: Wakati tunajifunza kutumia zana ya kulinda mawasiliano yetu, tunahitaji pia kufanya shinikizo la kisiasa dhidi ya ufuatiliaji, kujenga mtandao salama zaidi wa intaneti, na kulazimisha serikali na makampuni kupunguza kiasi cha data wanazozitumia kutuhusu sisi kama hatua ya kwanza.

eng: We hope translated versions of Email Self-Defense can be the entry into this multifaceted movement for people all around the world.
swa: Tunatumaini kuwa matoleo yaliyotafsiriwa ya Ulinzi Binafsi wa Barua pepe yanaweza kuwa mwanzo wa harakati zenye surra nyingi kwa watu wote duniani kote.

eng: Leila Dee Dougan shares a music video from the latest album by the South African artist Umlilo:
swa: Leila Dee Dougan anaweka video ya muziki inayotoka kwenye toleo la hivi karibuni la msanii wa Afrika Kusini Umlilo:

eng: Umlilo (previously profiled on Africa is a Country here) continues to push societal boundaries, crushing the norms of sexuality and gender roles with ‘Magic Man’, a track from his latest album, which will be released in July 2014.
swa: Umlilo (ambaye hapo awali aliandikwa kwenye tovuti ya Africa is a Country) anaendelea kupunguza mipaka ya kijamii, akivunja vunja mila zinazohusu masuala ya jinsia na mapenzi kwa kutumia albamu yake ya hivi karibuni iliyotoka mwezi Julai 2014.

eng: Watch the making of the music video and hear his thoughts on circus troops, being an outcast and how his music has become his freedom.
swa: Tazama video yake ya muziki na sikiza mawazo yake kuhusu tamaduni hizo, yeye akiwa mgeni wa nchi hiyo na namna muziki ulivyofanyika kuwa uhuru wake.

eng: Sada Tangara, a photographer and blogger based in Dakar, Senegal posted a photoreport on the rise of vigilante justice on the streets of Dakar, capital city of Senegal.
swa: Sada Tangara, mpiga kura na mwanablogu anayeishi Dakar, nchini Senegali aliweka picha-habari inayohusu kuongezeka kwa matukio ya kujichukulia sheria mkononi kwenye mitaa ya Dakar, mji mkuu wa Senegali.

eng: He explains the genesis of his project and why this type of popular justice is prominent in Dakar :
swa: Anaeleza mwanzo wa mradi wake na kwa nini aina hii maarufu ya haki imeshika kasi jijini Dakar :

eng: In Dakar, when an angry crowd manages to catch a delinquent that has just committed an infraction or a crime, he is systematically beaten, and is often seriously injured and may even die.
swa: Jijini Dakar, wakati kundi la watu wenye hasira linafanikiwa kumkamata kibaka ambaye ametoka kufanya uhalifu, mtu huyo hupingwa kwa mfululizo, na wakati mwingine hujeruhiwa sana na hata kufa.

eng: I wanted to understand this cycle of violence and to show the disproportionate violence that some of these delinquents suffer as a result of their actions For the people of Dakar, this type of popular justice is a way to scare potential perpetrators and to deter them from coming back to their homes.
swa: Nilitaka kuelewa mduara huu wa matumizi ya nguvu na kuonyesha namna matumizi haya ya nguvu kupita kiasi yanavyowaathiri vibaka shauri tu ya matendo yao yasiyokubalika kwa watu wa Dakar, na jinsi ambavyo adhabu za namna hii zinavyochukuliwa kuwa namna ya kuwaogofya waendelezaji wa vitendo hivi na kuwafanya wasirudi majumbani kwao.

eng: Palestinian Al Qassam Brigades, Hamas' military wing, unveiled three models of unmanned drones today, which it said it flew into Israeli skies.
swa: Brigedi ya Palestina ya Al Qassam, tawi la kijeshi la Hamas, lilionyesha miundo mitatu ya madege ya kijeshi leo, ikisema kuwa yalirushwa kwenye anga la Israel.

eng: Image of a Turkmen bride.
swa: Picha ya bibi harusi wa Kituruki.

eng: Screenshot taken from a YouTube video uploaded by Basim Annanow
swa: Picha imepigwa kutoka kwenye video ya YouTube iliyowekwa na Basim Annanow

eng: Young man play the music of love,
swa: Kijana hucheza muziki wa mapenzi,

eng: Bride flirt a little more,
swa: Bibi harusi huchepuka kidogo,

eng: Dance your happy moves because it is wedding day,
swa: Cheza kwa furaha kwa sababu ni siku yako ya harusi,

eng: We will sing our wedding song, Today we are celebrating.
swa: Tutaimba wimbo wa harusi yetu, Leo tunasherehekea.

eng: Weddings are incredibly important to Turkmen.
swa: Harusi ni za muhimu sana kwa kwa Watukimen.

eng: Marrying off sons and daughters symbolizes the continuation of community life and the supremacy of the family in society.
swa: Kuoza watoto wao huonyesha mwendelezo wa maisha ya kijamii na thamani ya familia kwenye jamii.

eng: Traditionally Turkmen have big families and a wedding is a chance to see even the furthest-flung relatives, as well as display your status to the neighbours.
swa: Kiasili Waturukimeni wana familia kubwa na harusi ni fursa ya kuona ndugu wnegi zaidi, dalili ya heshima kwa majirani.

eng: A number of must-do rituals and traditions apply to a Turkmen wedding day.
swa: Kuna mila kadhaa za kufanya katika siku ya harusi ya Waturukimeni.

eng: Here is a short summary of things to observe:
swa: Hapa ni muhtasari mfupi wa mambo ya kutazama:

eng: You have to have a famous singer!
swa: Lazima uwe na mwimbaji maarufu!

eng: You are going to dance in the streets, da!
swa: Utaenda kucheza mitaani!

eng: If you have near-exclusive access to the country's national gas wealth, you can hire J-Lo, but even if you don't your crooner has to get the people up and on their feet.
swa: Kama una utajiri wa kutosha kukaribia kununua utajiri wa gesi asilia ya taifa hilo, unaweza kumkodisha J-Lo, lakini hata kama huna utajiri huo basi angalau mwimbaji utakayempata awe na uwezo wa kuwasisimua waalikwa wako.

eng: Below is an example of some top notch wedding singing from local star Kakysh:
swa: Hapa chini ni mfano wa uimbaji wa kwenye harusi kwa kumtumia mwimbaji maarufu wa nchi hiyo Kakysh:

eng: The wind blows gently flirting,
swa: Upepo unavuma kwa kasi ya kubembeleza,

eng: The flower blooms gently flirting,
swa: Maua yanavuma taratibu,

eng: My beloved you will gently smile, My beloved today is our wedding day
swa: Mpenzi wangu utatabasamu taratibu, Mpenzi wangu leo ni siku ya harusi yetu

eng: On one of Turkmenistan's most popular chat forums, Ertir.com, users discussed the lyrics of the song.
swa: Kwenye jukwaa la soga maarufu nchini Turkmenistan, Ertir.com, watumiaji walijadili mashairi ya wimbo huo.

eng: NitrogeN praises Kakysh, and poses a question about a muse that appears regularly in his songs:
swa: NitrogeN Sifa Kakysh, anauliza swali kuhusu hamasa inayoonekana mara kwa mara kwenye wimbo huo:

eng: Kakysh sings well.
swa: Kakysh anaimba vizuri.

eng: In many of his songs he uses the name Läle.
swa: Kwenye nyimbo zake nyingi anatumia jina Läle.

eng: Maybe she broke his heart.
swa: Hivi Kakysh Amandurdyyew anachepuka?

eng: Meka MerGenius is also curious about the man behind the voice:
swa: Watumiaji wengine wa mtandao wanajadili mitazamo yao kuhusu ndoa:

eng: Right before the marriage they say all kinds of words, but don't talk too much after
swa: Kabla tu ya ndoa watu husema maneno yote ya bashasha, lakini hawafanyi hivyo baada ya kuoana

eng: NitrogeN continues, joking :
swa: NitrogeN anandelea, kutania :

eng: When they get married, they become fat, and the wind can't take them away anymore
swa: Wanapooana, wananenepeana, na upepo hauwezi kuwapepesua tena

eng: A wedding dress should show the bride off because later she will wear a headscarf and close her mouth in front of husband's parents.
swa: Vazi la harusi lazima limwonyeshe bibi harusi kwa sababu baadae atavalishwa mtandop na kuufunga mdomo wake mbele ya wakwe zake.

eng: Wedding dresses in Turkmenistan are highly diverse, coming in different colors and patterns, and at different prices.
swa: Mavazi ya harusi nchini Turkmenistan yanatofautiana sana, yakiwa na rangi na mitindo tofauti yenye bei tofauti.

eng: Turkmen families rarely fit into a single shot.
swa: Ni nadra kwa familia ya Kitukimeni kutosha kwenye picha moja.

eng: Screenshot from a YouTube video uploaded by Turkmen Owazy.
swa: Picha ya video ya YouTube iliyowekwa na Turkmen Owazy.

eng: Also, make sure you take a photo in front of President Gurbanguly Berdymuhamedov's portrait.
swa: Vilevile, hakikisha unapiga picha mbele ya Picha Rasmi ya Rais Gurbanguly Berdymuhamedov.

eng: Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty (RFE/RL) has inquired whether this tradition is an official order or an unofficial practice.
swa: Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty (RFE/RL) imeuliza ikiwa utamaduni huu ni amri rasmi au mazoea tu yasiyo rasmi.

eng: The service quotes witnesses who confirm that the photo is an integral part of any official wedding ceremony.
swa: Radio hiyo inawanukuu mashuhuda wanaothibitisha kuwa picha hiyo ni sehemu ya sherehe rasmi ya harusi.

eng: This does not seem to create any problem for netizens, however.
swa: Hata hivyo, hiyo haionekani kuwa tatizo kwa watumiaji wa mtandao wanaojadili suala hili.

eng: Alex comments :
