eng: It's alright.
swa: Ni sawa.

eng: I would take a photo there too!
swa: Hata mimi nitapiga picha mbele ya picha ya Rais pia!

eng: The most exciting part is always the build up to the ceremony itself.
swa: Sehemu inayosisimua zaidi ni namna sherehe yenyewe inavyoendeshwa.

eng: The groom comes to take the bride from her house.
swa: Bwana harusi huja kumchukua bibi harusi kutoka nyumbani kwao.

eng: She is duty-bound to show her sadness because she is leaving her parents forever.
swa: Analazimika kuonyesha huzuni yake kwa sababu anaondoka nyumbani kwa wazazi wao milele.

eng: This is the most touching part of the wedding as the bride's relatives come to say goodbye to her.
swa: Hii ni sehemu ya harusi yenye mguso kwa sababu ndugu wa bibi harusi huja kumuaga.

eng: A sad and happy moment all in one.
swa: Ni wakati mbaya na mzuri kwa wakati mmoja.

eng: Unfortunately, this is the quote of the day.
swa: Bahati mbaya, hii ni nukuu ya siku.

eng: Does it matter who did it?
swa: Ina maana yoyote kujua nani alifanya kitendo hiki?

eng: Leonid Kalashnikov, deputy representative to the Russian parliamentary committee on international affairs, told TV Rain it didn't really matter who was to blame for the downing of the aircraft:
swa: Leonid Kalashnikov, naibu mwakilishi wa kamati ya Bunge la Urusi ya mambo ya kimataifa, aliiambia TV Rain haikuwa na maana yoyote kujua nani wa kumlaumu kwa kuiangusha ndege hiyo:

eng: What, will it make you feel better if you find out who shot down the plane?
swa: Nini, utajisikia nafuu kaa utamjua aliyeiangusha ndege hiyo?

eng: The sinister fifth column.
swa: Uovu wa hali ya juu

swa: Katika nyakati kama hizi ni wazi kuna watu wanatarajia kitu na wanacho wanachokitaka...wapigania uhuru wetu na wapiga propaganda wa Ukraine wanashindania kile kile...

eng: It's simple: blame nobody.
swa: Ni rahisi: hakuna wa kumlaumu

swa: Mkuu wa shirika la Russia TodayMargarita Simonyan alionyesha namna janga hilo lilivyo na faida kwa wa-Soviet wasio na akili:

swa: Kw amuda mrefu nimekuwa nikifanyia kazi taarifa kadhaa za habari zinazotokea, na nimehitimisha kuwa siamini kabisa namna watu wanavyojaribu kuunganisha matukio kujengea hoja imani zao.

swa: Lkaini ninaamini kuwa Usoviet ina matatizo.

eng: Rebels?
swa: Waasi?

swa: Waasi gani?

eng: Last but not least is the reaction of Vladimir Putin himself, who told ITAR-TASS that Kyiv is accountable for the skies over Ukraine's rebel-controlled east.
swa: Mwisho lakini si kwa uzito ni mwitikio wa Vladimir Putin mwenyewe, aliyeliambia shirika la habari la ITAR-TASS kwamba Kyiv inawajibika kwa anga la Ukraine mashariki inayodhibitiwa na waasi.

eng: Certainly, the state over whose territory this occurred bears responsibility for this terrible tragedy. This tragedy would not have occurred if there were peace in this land, if the fighting had not renewed in the South-East of Ukraine.
swa: Kwa hakika, nchi ambayo mpaka wake ndiko tukio hili limetokea inawajibika kwa janga hili Janga hili lisingetokea kama pangekuwa na amani kwenye nchi hiyo, kama mapigano yasingeibuka tena Kusini Mashariki mwa Ukraine.

eng: Activists and scholars in Hong Kong worked together for two years to organize a citizen-led, technology-driven referendum on voting rights that took place at the end of June.
swa: Wanaharakati na wanazuoni wa Hong Kong wamefanya kazi pamoja kwa miaka miwili kuandaa kura ya maoni inayoongozwa na raia na kuwezeshwa na teknolojia juu ya haki ya kupiga kura iliyofanyika mwishoni mwa mwezi wa Juni.

eng: On this edition of GV Face, GV China editor and Hong Kong media freedom advocate Oiwan Lam discusses the strategy and process behind the referendum and tells us what's next for advocates at the forefront of Hong Kong's voting rights movement. Follow our in-depth coverage: Hong Kong's Umbrella Revolution
swa: Katika toleo hili la Mazungumzo ya GV, mhariri wa GV wa China na mtetezi wa haki za vyombo vya habari Hong Kong Diwan Lam wanajadili mkakati na mchakato ulio nyuma ya kura hiyo na wanatudokeza nini hasa kinafuata kwa watetezi walio msitari wa mbele katika harakati hizo la haki ya kupiga kura jimboni Hong Kong.

eng: @Shahdan_shosh shares this photograph of 11 young men arrested for having Suhoor - a latenight meal to prepare them to fast the next day during the Muslim month of Ramadan (Source: Twitter)
swa: @Shahdan_shosh aliweka picha hii ya vijana 11 waliotiwa mbaroni kwa kosa la kukutanika kupata daku - chakula kinacholiwa usiku kwa ajili ya kuendelea na fungo wa siku inayofuata wakati wa mwezi mtukufu wa Ramadhani kwa Waislamu (Chanzo: Mtandao wa Twita)

eng: A year has passed since the ousting of Egypt's president Mohamed Morsi and the new regime has already received a lot of criticism for the declining human rights condition which arbitrary arrest is a big part of.
swa: Mwaka umepita tangu kung'olewa madarakani kwa rais wa Misri Mohamed Morsi na serikali mpya tayari inakosolewa vikali kwa uvunjifu wa haki za binadamu ikiwa ni pamoja na kukamatwa kiholela kwa raia.

eng: In particular, the new gatherings law of Egypt has raised anger among Egyptians, many of whom have tried to challenge that law only to find themselves arrested, including some prominent activists such as Alaa Abd El Fattah, sentenced to 15 years in prison last month, for organizing a protest without a permit.
swa: Sheria mpya ya Misri ya kudhibiti mikusanyiko ndiyo hasa imewasha hasira kali miongoni mwa Wamisri, wengi wakijaribu kupinga sheria hiyo lakini hatimaye kujikuta wakikamatwa wao wenyewe, ikiwa ni pamoja na baadhi ya wanaharakati maarufu kama vile Alaa Abd El Fattah, aliyehukumiwa kifungo cha miaka 15 jela mwezi uliopita, kwa ajili ya kuandaa maandamano pasipo kibali.

eng: With the early days of the month of Ramadan, the holy month of fasting for Muslims, police forces raided a house where a group of 11 young men were having a sahoor (an end of night meal Muslims take before fasting for the day) party, apparently for violating the laws of gathering as some speculate.
swa: Kwa siku za kwanza za mwezi wa Ramadhani, mwezi mtukufu wa kufunga kwa Waislamu, vikosi vya polisi vilivamia makazi ya watu na kuwakuta vijana 11 wakipata daku (chakula cha usiku kinacholiwa na Waislamu kabla ya kuendelea na mfungo kwa siku inayofuata), shughuli ambayo inapofanywa na kundi la watu, huonekana kukiuka sheria ya mkutano kama baadhi yao walivyobashiri.

eng: Netizens started the hashtag #معتقلي_السحور , which translates to Sahoor detainees.
swa: Raia mtandaoni walianzisha alama ashiria #معتقلي_السحور , ambayo tafsiri yake ni wafungwa wa daku.

swa: Watu kumi na moja walikuwa wakipata daku usiku katika moja ya nyumba zao.

eng: The Ministry of Interior arrested them for illegal gathering... free the sahoor detainees

swa: Sijui kama mimi nilie kwa sababu ya mauaji yaliyofanywa na walinzi wa serikali au shauri ya rafiki zangu 11 walioko kizuizini

eng: He sarcastically tweeted later on:
swa: Kwa kejeli baadaye alitwiti:

eng: Will the Public Prosecutor consider the evidence as cheese and olives or will it make it as Molotov
swa: Je, Wakili wa Serikali atatumia ushahidi wa vyakula vya maharage na mizaituni waliyokutwa nayo?

swa: Na Shahdan-shosh alitwiti picha ya wafungwa hao 11 na kubainisha :

swa: Kosa lao hasa ni hili: Kundi la suhoor.

swa: Walikamatwa na (maharage) machafu, falafel na jibini katika nyumba waliyokutwa.

eng: Activist Wael Abbas tweeted to his 265k followers:
swa: Mwanaharakati Wael Abbas alitwiti kwa wafuasi wake 265000:

eng: I'll probably cancel my yearly Iftar party in respect to the new protests law :)
swa: Itanibidi pengine mimi kuachana Iftar yangu ya kila mwaka kutii sheria mpya ya maandamano)

swa: Hata hivyo, nusu ya wale ambao mimi niliwaalika kwa ajili ya Iftar mwaka jana wako jela, uhamishoni au ni watuhumiwa wa makosa ya jinai)

eng: Last year, Morsi's regime was about to impose a similar law which prohibits gatherings which did not see light after an outcry from international organisations.
swa: Mwaka jana, serikali ya Morsi ilijaribu kulazimisha matumizi ya sheria kama hiyo inayozuia mikusanyiko ambayo hata hivyo, haikufaulu baada ya kilio kutoka mashirika ya kimataifa.

eng: The Egyptian blog WikiThawra , which is run by the Egyptian Center for Economic and Social Rights alleges that at least 80 people have died in custody over the past year and more than 40,000 people were detained or indicted between July 2013 (ousting of Morsi's government) and mid-May 2014.
swa: Blogu ya Misri WikiThawra , ambayo inaendeshwa na Kituo cha Misri cha Uchumi na haki za Kijamii inadai kuwa watu wasiopungua 80 wamefariki wakiwa chini ya ulinzi katika kipindi cha mwaka mmoja na zaidi ya watu 40,000 wamewekwa kizuizini au wako kwenye mashitaka katika kipindi cha mwenzi Julai 2013 (kuiondoa serikali ya Morsi) na katikati ya Mei 2014.

eng: A relative of those on board flight MH17 getting emotional while being interviewed by media.
swa: Ndugu wa baadhi ya watu waliokuwa wakisafiri kwa ndege aina ya MH17 akionesha uso wa huzuni pale alipohojiwa na vyombo vya habari.

eng: Photo by Hon Keong Soo.
swa: Picha na Keong Soo.

eng: Copyright @Demotix (7/18/2014)
swa: Haki miliki na @Demotix (7/18/2014)

eng: In the wake of the tragic crash of Malaysia Airlines flight MH17 in eastern Ukraine, condolences have poured in for the families of the 298 passengers and crew members who were on board.
swa: Kutokana na tukio la kuanguka kwa ndege aina ya MH17 ya shirika la ndege la Malaysia, huko mashariki mwa Ukraine, salamu za rambirambi zimekuwa zikitumwa kwa familia za abiria 298 pamoja na wafanyakazi waliokuwemo kwenye ndege hiyo.

eng: MH17 was en route to Kuala Lumpur from Amsterdam when it was shot down by a BUK missile.
swa: MH17 ilitunguliwa kwa kombora la BUK ikitokea Amsterdam kuelekea Kuala Lumpur.

eng: Many reports have pointed to pro-Russian insurgents mistakenly shooting down the passenger jet, but rebel leaders have denied this.
swa: Taarifa mbalimbali zinawahusisha waasi walio na uhusiano wa karibu na serikali ya Urusi ambao kwa bahati mbaya waliishambulia ndege ya abiria, hata hivyo, kiongozi wa waasi hao amekanusha taarifa hizi.

eng: This is the second tragedy to hit Malaysia Airlines in a matter of months.
swa: Hili ni tukio la pili kuzikumba ndege za Malaysia katika kipindi cha miezi kadhaa.

eng: It lost flight MH370, which was carrying 239 passengers and crew on March 8 when it vanished from radar.
swa: Ndege aina ya MH370 Malaysia iliyokuwa na watu 239 pamoja na wahudumu mnamo Machi 8 ilitoweka na haijulikani ilipo mpaka sasa.

eng: Reeling from the twin tragedies, Malaysian netizens are using the Twitter hashtag #PrayForMH17 to talk about the crash.
swa: Wakishtushwa na matukio hay mawili, raia wa mtandaoni wa Malaysia wanatumia kiungo habari cha Twita #PrayForMH17 kujadili kuhusiana na tukio hili la kuanguka kwa ndege.

eng: A Malaysia Airlines flight attendant highlighted the loss of lives on MH17 as well as MH370, sharing a picture on Twitter and Instagram:
swa: Mhudumu wa ndege ya shirika la ndege la Malaysia alijadili kwa uchache kuhusiana na idadi kubwa ya watu kupoteza maisha kwenye ndege hiyo aina ya MH17 pamoja na ile yaMH370, kwa kuweka picha katika ukurasa wa Twita na Instagram:

eng: Within 4month i lost almost 30 frends ... Sad but true we live in hostile world #mh17 #malaysia… http://t.co/n1aQ7ohPGp — HJB ® (@HJB__) July 18, 2014
swa: Kwa kipindi cha miezi 4 nimepoteza marafiki wanaofikia 30.... inasikitisha lakini ukweli ni kuwa tunaishi katika ulimwengu uligubikwa na uadui #mh17 #malaysia… http://t.co/n1aQ7ohPGp — HJB ® (@HJB__) July 18, 2014

eng: Image shared from a Malaysia Airlines flight attendant's Instagram
swa: Picha iliyowekwa na mhudumu wa shirika la ndege la Malaysia Instagram

eng: Many politicians used Twitter to express their shock and explain what they think are the next steps forward.
swa: Wanasiasa wengi walitumia kurasa zao za Twita wakionesha namna walivyoguswa na tukio hili na pia kutoa maoni yao kuhusiana na kipi kifanyike kufuatia tukio hili.

eng: Prime Minister Najib Razak extended his sympathies to the victims and their families:
swa: Waziri mkuu, Najib Razak alitoa pole kwa familia za wafiwa:

eng: My prayers today went out to the passengers and crew of MH17 as well as their families.
swa: Ninawaombea abiria na wahudumu wote wa MH17, pamoja na familia za wafiwa.

eng: This is an extremely tough time for us all.
swa: Huu ni wakati mgumu sana kwetu sote.

eng: Hishammuddin Hussein, Malaysia's minister of defence, tweeted the Malaysian government's priorities:
swa: Hishammuddin Hussein, ambaye ni waziri wa ulinzi wa Malaysia alitwiti kuhusiana na mikakati ya serikali ya Malasia:

eng: #MH17 @1MinDef : Our immediate priority - 1) Was d plane brought down? If so 2) How ? 3) Who ?
swa: #MH17 @1MinDef : Mikakati yetu ya sasa ni kutaka kujua- 1) Ndege ile ilingushwa? na kama ndivyo, 2) Iliangushwaje? 3) Na nani?

eng: All our intel agensies have been activated . — Hishammuddin Hussein (@HishammuddinH2O) July 18, 2014
swa: Vikosi vyetu vyote vya usalama wa taifa tayari vimeanza kazi. — Hishammuddin Hussein (@HishammuddinH2O) July 18, 2014

eng: Malaysian Minister for Youth and Sports Khairy Jamaluddin stressed that blame should not be put on Malaysia Airlines for flying over a conflict zone:
swa: Waziri wa Malaysia wa wizara ya Vijana na Michezo, Khairy Jamaluddin, alisisitiza kuwa lawama zisielekezwe kwa ndege za Malaysia kupita katika anga la ukanda ulio na mgogoro:

eng: We must oppose narrative blaming route selection.
swa: Tunapaswa kupinga maelezo ya kulalamikia uchaguzi wa uelekeo.

eng: FACT: many other planes were traversing same route.
swa: UHALISIA: Ndege nyingine nyingi zimepita pia katika anga hilo.

eng: FACT: ICAO approved the route. #MH17 — Khairy Jamaluddin (@Khairykj) July 18, 2014
swa: UHALISIA: ICAO ilihakiki uelekeo huo. #MH17 — Khairy Jamaluddin (@Khairykj) July 18, 2014

eng: Several renowned Malaysians also tweeted sympathies and shock.
swa: Tunapaswa kupinga maelezo ya kulalamikia uchaguzi wa uelekeo.

eng: Malaysian badminton player Lee Chong Wei was one of them:
swa: Miongoni mwao ni mchezaji wa mchezo wa mpira wa vinyoya wa Malasia, Lee Chong Wei:

eng: My heart aches to see the family members and loved ones of #MH17 going through such a tragic and devastating loss. pic.twitter.com/2TJyMIB9LL — Dato' Lee Chong Wei (@lee_c_wei) July 18, 2014
swa: Moyo wangu unasononeka sana ninaposhuhudia ndugu na wapendwa wetu waliokuwa wakisafiri na #MH17 waliopoteza maisha katika tukio hili baya na la kusikitisha. pic.twitter.com/2TJyMIB9LL — Dato' Lee Chong Wei (@lee_c_wei) July 18, 2014

eng: Television presenter and radio host Xandria Ooi said that blaming will not help the cause:
swa: Mtangazaji wa Televisheni na Redio, Xandria Ooi alidokeza kuwa lawama hazitasaidia kujua chanzo:

eng: Listening to the PC was painful.
swa: Kusikiliza kupitia kwenye kompyuta ilisikitisha sana.

eng: So much implication that MAS flying the route was a mistake.
swa: Wengi wanafahamu kuwa ndege hii iliruka katika uelekeo ilipopatia ajali kwa makosa.

eng: It's a TRAGEDY.
swa: Hili ni janga.

eng: Blame doesn't help. — Xandria Ooi (@xandriaooi) July 18, 2014
swa: Lawama hazisaidii. — Xandria Ooi (@xandriaooi) July 18, 2014

eng: Pang Khee Teik, organiser for Seksualiti Merdeka (Malaysia's sexuality rights festival), sent his sympathies:
swa: Pang Khee Teik, mratibu wa Seksualiti Merdeka (Tamasha la usawa wa jinsia la Malasia), alituma salamu zake za pole:

eng: In a senseless universe, senseless tragedies make sense.
swa: Katika ulimwengu wa kusadikika, matukio ya kusadikika yanaweza kuwa na maana.

eng: In a senseless universe, senseless loving is my only salvation.
swa: Katika ulimwengu wa kusadikika, upendo wa kusadikika ndio wokovu wangu wa pekee.

eng: Hugs to all. #MH17 — Pang Khee Teik (@PangKheeTeik) July 18, 2014
swa: Ninawapenda nyote. #MH17 — Pang Khee Teik (@PangKheeTeik) July 18, 2014

eng: Conspiracies about the crash are circulating in cyberspace, but for many Malaysians this is the time to grieve the loss of innocent lives and to help their loved ones recover from the tragedy.
swa: Kumekuwa na njama zinazosambaa mitandaoni kuhusiana na kuanguka huku kwa ndege, lakini kwa jamii kubwa ya watu wa Malasia, huu ni wakati wa kuomboleza vifo vya watu wasio na hatia na kuwafariji wale wote waliofiwa.

eng: A copy of the order to more than double the cost of fuel in Egypt.
swa: Nakala ya agiz la kupandisha bei ya mafuta kwa zaidi ya mara mbili nchini Misri.

eng: Photo source: @AhmedKheir on Twitter
swa: Chanzo cha Picha: @AhmedKheir kwenye mtandao wa Twita

eng: Egyptian netizens are fuming over a price hike in fuel prices, which they say will lead to an increase in transportation, food and services costs.
swa: Watumiaji wa mtandao nchini Misri wamepandwa na hasira kufuatia kupanda kwa bei ya mafuta, hatua ambayo wanaamini itasababisha kupanda kwa gharama za usafiri, chakula na hata huduma nyinginezo.

eng: According to Ahmed Kheir, a Twitter user from Cairo, who has 2,200 followers:
swa: Kwa mujibu wa Ahmed Kheir, mtumiaji wa mtandao wa Twita kutoka Cairo, mwenye wafuatiliaji 2,200:

eng: 92 Octane gasoline, up by 40 per cent
swa: Mafuta ya Oktane 92 yamepanda kwa asilimia

eng: 80 Octane gasoline, up by 78pc
swa: Mafuta ya Oktane 80 yamepanda kwa asilimia 78

eng: Diesel, used by microbuses and transportation, up by 63pc
swa: Dizeli, inayotumiwa na mabasi madogo madogo na usafiri mwingineo, imepanda kwa asilimia 63

eng: 95 Octane gasoline, used by the richest segment in society, up by 7pc #social_justice
swa: Oktane 95, inatumiwa na kada ya matajiri wa nchi hiyo, imepanda kwa asilimia 7 #haki_jamii

eng: Those figures are echoed in this Reuters report, which states that the prices have been increased as the Egyptian government "tries to cut energy subsidies to ease the burden on its swelling budget deficit."
swa: Takwimu hizo zimerudiwa tena kwenye taarifa ya shirika la habari la Reuters, inayosema kwamba bei zimeongezwa kwa kile kinachosemekana kuwa serikali ya Misri inajaribu kufuta ruzuku kwa nishati ili kupunguza mzigo kwenye bajeti yake yenye nakisi kubwa."

eng: In another tweet, Kheir notes:
swa: Katika twiti nyingine, Kheir anabainisha:

eng: They have increased the price of fuel by more than half, in the absence of a Parliament.
swa: Wameongoza bei ya mafuta kwa zaidi ya nusu ya bei ya awali, bila Bunge.

eng: They took the decision in secret on a day off.
swa: Walichukua maamuzi kwa siri tena kwenye siku ya mapumziko.

eng: All these actions are that of thieves.
swa: Vitendo hivi vyote hufanywa na wezi tu.

eng: Peter Ramez, who has 500 followers on Twitter, blames Egypt's new president Abdelfattah El Sisi, for the increase, saying:
swa: Peter Ramez, mwenye wafuatiliaji 500 kwenye mtandao wa twita, anamlaumu rais mpya wa Misri Abdelfattah El Sisi, kwa ongezeko hilo, akisema:

eng: A more than 40pc increase in gasoline prices you infidels?
swa: Ongezeko la asilimia 40 kwa bei ya mafuta nyie wadhalimu?

eng: May God's justice be met on you.
swa: Haki ya Mungu ikutane nanyi.

eng: You deserve all the curses you will get
swa: Mnastahili kila aina ya laana mtakazozipata

eng: And Ahmed Fathi El Badry adds:
swa: Na Ahmed Fathi El Badry anaongeza:

eng: Do you think that people's love for you will mean anything after this decision?
swa: Hivi kweli mnadhani upendo wa watu kwenu utamaanisha chochote baada ya uamuzi huu?

eng: This is truly a political and social suicide
swa: Hatua hii ni kifo chenu wenyewe cha kisiasa na kijamii

eng: Others have taken to humour to express their frustration.
swa: Wengine walichagua kutumia utani kueleza kuchanganyikiwa kwao.

eng: Shay Sokar Bara, a pseudonym with around 83,000 followers, says:
swa: Shay Sokar Bara, mwenye wafuasi 83,000 kwenye mtandao wa twita, anasema:

eng: I did not rebel against Morsi for the subsidies to be lifted or for the electricity to be cut or to donate .
swa: Sikuasi dhidi ya Morsi kwa kuengeza ruzuku au kupunguza bei ya umeme au kutoa kwa hisani .

eng: I don't have anything and I don't want to go to jail if I say no
swa: Sina chochote na wala sitaki kwenda jela kwa kugoma

eng: In another tweet, he notes:
swa: Katika twiti nyingine, anabainisha:

eng: Egyptians are lined up at petrol stations and everyone is saying they will fill up their tanks before gasoline prices go up.
swa: Wamisri wamejipanga kwenye vituo vya kuuzia mafuta na kila mmoja anasema wanajaza matanki yao ya akiba kabla bei hiyo haijaanza kupanda.

eng: We are a smart nation.
swa: Sisi ni taifa la werevu.

eng: It is as if the fuel in their tanks will never finish
swa: Ni kama vile mafuta kwenye matanki ya akiba hayatakaa yaishe

eng: And Hesham Mansour jokes:
swa: Na Hesham Mansour anatania:

eng: The increase in gasoline prices is a tactical increase.
swa: Kuongezeka kwa bei ya mafuta ni ongezeko la kimkakati.

eng: After increasing the prices of fuel and electricity, the government wants to guarantee that citizens will not find any money to set themselves on fire
swa: Baada ya kuongeza bei ya mafuta na umeme, serikali inataka raia wake wakose kabisa fedha za kujilipua kwa moto

eng: This tweet brings back to our memories the spark which ignited the Arab revolutions, in December 2010, when Tunisian fruit vendor Mohammed Bouazizi set himself on fire.
swa: Twiti hii inatukumbusha tukio lililosababisha mapinduzi ya Kiarabu, mwezi Desemba 2010, wakati mchuuzi wa matunda wa Kitunisia Mohammed Bouazizi kujilipua kwa moto.

eng: Meanwhile, this video from Mansoura shows long queues of cars at a petrol station, which had run out of gasoline:
swa: Wakati huo huo, video hii kutoka kwa Mansoura inanyesha foleni ndefu za magari kwenye kituo cha kuuzia mafuta, ambavyo vimeanza kukosa mafuta hayo:

eng: What does the future hold for Egyptians?
swa: Nini mustakabali wa Wamisri?

eng: Abidjan and other regions of Côte d'Ivoire have been plagued by heavy downpour and floods for the past weeks .
swa: Abidjan na maeneo mengine ya Côte d'Ivoire yamekumbwa na mafuriko makubwa katika majuma kadhaa yaliyopita .

eng: Local residents got organized on social networks to bring relief to stranded citizens.
swa: Wakazi wa maeneo husika walijipanga kwenye mitandao ya kijamii ili kusaidia namna ya kuwaokoa wananchi waliokuwa wamekwama kwenye janga hilo.

eng: On twitter and facebook, #CIVSOCIAL is the hashtag for emergency humanitarian reliefs.
swa: Kwenye mtandao wa twita na facebook, #CIVSOCIAL ilikuwa ni alama ishara iliyokuwa ikitumika kwa ajili ya shughuli za uokoaji wa dhararua na misaada ya kibinadamu.

eng: It was created in 2011 in the aftermath of the post-electoral crisis. The hashtag was revived again as floods marred Abidjan and the rest of the country.
swa: Ilianzishwa mwaka 2011 wakati wa ghasia za baada ya uchaguzi na ikazinduliwa kwa mara nyingine tena wakati mafuriko yaliyoikumba Abidjan na nchi hiyo yote.

eng: The facebook page CIVSOCIAL has collected images, videos and testimonies as well as calls for donations for each afflicted borough.
swa: Ukurasa wa facebook wa CIVSOCIAL ulitumika kukusanya picha, video na shuhuda pamoja na michango kwa kila eneo lililoathirika.

eng: Here is a video of one of the flooded borough :
swa: Hapa unaweza kuona video ya moja wapo ya maeneo yaliyoathirika na mafuriko :

swa: Picha na Sandra Abd'Allah-Alvarez Ramírez

eng: The communications issue in Cuba is without a doubt one of the most followed and present topics in everyday Cuban life.
swa: Bila shaka yoyote, suala la mawasiliano nchini Cuba ni miongoni mwa mada inayofuatiliwa kwa ukaribu kabisa wakati huu.

eng: The improbability of having fast and affordable access to new global telecommunication services has become a popular theme amongst not only those on the island, but anywhere Cubans reside, because of the impact it has on relationships with family members and friends.
swa: Kutokuwepo kwa namna rahisi na ya haraka ya kupata mawasiliano limekuwa si jambo linalozungumzwa sana katika kisiwa hiki, lakini pia mijadala imeshika kasi popote pale waishipo watu wa Cuba, na hii ni kutokana na umuhimu wa njia hii ya mawasiliano baina ya ndugu na marafiki.

eng: Various articles on Cuba's internet problems are circulating on Cuban networks recently.
swa: Makala mbalimbali kuhusiana na tatizo la mtandao wa intaneti nchini Cuba zinasambaa katika mitandao mbalimbali nchini humo.

eng: Here are three of them:
swa: Zifuatazo ni makala tatu miongoni mwa makala nyingi zinazosambazwa.:

eng: ETECSA provides an explanation
swa: ETECSA yatoa ufafanuzi

eng: Last Thursday, June 16th, officials from the Cuban Telecommunications Company (Empresa de Telecomunicaciones de Cuba, ETECSA), the only one in the country, participated in an online forum which was hosted by Cubasi.cu magazine.
swa: Alhamisi iliyopita, tarehe 16 Juni, maafisa kutoka kampuni ya mawasiliano ya Cuba(Empresa de Telecomunicaciones de Cuba, ETECSA), kampuni pekee nchini humo, iliweza kushiriki katika Jukwaa la mtandaoni lililoandaliwa na jarida la Cubasi.cu.

eng: In the presentation, ETECSA acknowledges:
swa: Wakati wa uwasilishaji mada, ETECSA iliweka bayana kuwa:

eng: The state of our services is frequently compared with the affordability and convenience with communication carriers from other countries, including those from Latin American regions.
swa: Hali ya huduma ya mawasiliano katika nchi yetu mara nyingi imekuwa ikilinganishwa na urahisi wa upatikanaji na utoaji wa huduma hizi kutoka kwa wamiliki wa njia za mawasiliano kutoka nchi nyingine, ikiwa ni pamoja na maeneo ya Amerika ya Kusini.

eng: As the necessary investments unfold, our company will reach more comparable measures in regards to quality and development, and the telecommunication's infrastructure will expand, making it possible to reduce costs and assimilate a stronger rate of growth and diversification of services.
swa: Wakati ambapo uwekezaji muhimu unapoanza kuonekana, kampuni yetu itafikia kiwango cha ushindani kwa kuzingatia ubora na ubunifu, na hivyo miundombinu ya mawasiliano itaongezeka, hali itakayopelekea kupungua kwa gharama na kuwezesha kukua kwa haraka njia za mawasilino na utoaji wa huduma nzuri.

eng: In the forum, netizens' questions focused on national mobile telephonic services, cost and access to the internet, highlighting the impossibility of connecting to the Internet from Cuban homes.
swa: katika mijadala ya mtandaoni maswali yalijikita zaidi kwenye huduma za kitaifa za simu za mikononi, gharama na na upatikanaji wa huduma ya intaneti, wakizungumzia hali ya kutokuwapo kwa uwezekano wa kupata huduma ya intaneti watu wakiwa majumbani mwao.

eng: In this respect, Yosiel, questioned:
swa: Katika mtazamo huu, Yosiel, aliuliza;

eng: Why is it not yet possible to make the internet accessible in the homes of Cuban residents at affordable prices?, and I am not referring to the typical infrastructure of the disastrous Modem into 56 Kb with the investments that it needs, in addition to what we already know is not good quality.
swa: Kwa nini hadi sasa huduma ya intaneti haijawezekana kupatikana kwenye makazi ya watu wa Cuba kwa gharama nafuu? Na hapa sizungumzii modem, kifaa hafifu kilicho na uwezo wa KB 56 na aina ya uwekezaji unaopaswa kuzingatiwa, ikizingatiwa pia na uzoefu tulionao, huduma hii haipo katika kiwango kinachotakiwa.

eng: What I am referring to is why not put one or four good wireless network adapters so anyone can have access from home with a Smartphone, PC, Laptop, etc. to the web with similar speed to those in ETECSA centers.
swa: Ninachokimaanisha hapa ni kuwa, ni kwa nini wasiweke chanzo kimoja au vinne vya mtandao wa intaneti wa si-waya ili kila mmoja aweze kupata huduma ya intaneti akiwa nyumbani kwake kupitia simu yake, ngamizi ya kawaida, ngamizi mpakato n.k ikiwa na kasi ifananayo na ile inayopatikana katika vituo vya ETECSA.

eng: ETECSA responded:
swa: ETECSA responded:

eng: ETECSA's strategy foresees access to these services from homes; however the company's initial priority has been to broaden the collective centers in order to guarantee access to a greater number of people.
swa: Mkakati wa ETECSA ni kuwa, siku zijazo mtandao upatikane hadi majumbani, hata hivyo, mpango wa awali wa kampuni ni kuongeza matawi yake ili watu wengi zaidi waweze kupata huduma.

eng: During these times, given the technical limitations, the immediate mainstream access to the internet is not possible.
swa: Katika kipindi hiki, na kwa kuzingatia vikwazo vya kiufundi, haiwezekani kwa haraka kuwezesha watu kupata huduma ya intaneti wakiwa majumbani mwao.

eng: Nonetheless, ETECSA is working on investments that will facilitate the implementation of these services with the required technical conditions and at lower cost than the current ones.
swa: Hata hivyo, , ETECSA inaangalia namna ya utoaji wa huduma utakaochochea utoaji wa huduma kwa kuzingatia uwezo wa kiufundi na kwa gharama za chini zaidi ikilinganishwa na hali ilivyo sasa.

eng: Restricted sites: Access today, perhaps not tomorrow
swa: Tovuti zilizozuiwa: Zipitie leo, na labda sio kesho

eng: On June 19th, several individuals and the media confirmed that restricted sites were now accessible from the island, amongst them the popular Skype.
swa: Mnamo Juni 19, raia kadhaa pamoja na vyombo vya habari vilithibitisha kuwa, tovuti zilizokuwa zimezuiwa, zilianza tena kutumiwa kisiwani humo, miongoni mwa tovuti hizo maarufu, moja wapo ikiwa ni Skype.

eng: Other digital spaces like 14ymedio.com magazine by blogger Yoani Sánchez, which upon its inauguration was redirected to yoanilandia.com, and therefore impossible to visit from the island (raising considerable criticism) was now accessible from Cuban servers.
swa: Majukwaa mengine ya kidigitali kama vile jarida la 14ymedio.com linalosimamiwa na mwanablogu Yoani Sánchez, ambalo kabla ya kurudishwa tena rasmi, lilielekezwa yoanilandia.com, hali iliyopelekea kushindikana kwa jarida hili kutembelewa na watu wakiwa kisiwani humu (hali iliyopingwa vikali) limekuwa tena likipatikana kupitia mtandao wa intaneti nchini Cuba.

eng: Revolico.com, a Cuban e-commerce portal similar to craigslist, was also accessible from the island.
swa: Revolico.com, jukwaa la biashara ya kupitia elekroniki la Cuba linaloshabihiana na craigslist, pia lilianza kupatika mtandaoni kwa watembeleaji waishio Cuba.

eng: Nevertheless, on June 20th, several individuals alerted on Facebook that these sites had been shut down again.
swa: Hata hivyo, mnamo Juni, 20, baadhi ya watumiaji wa mtandao wa Facebook walipelekewa ujumbe kuwa, tovuti hizi zimeshazuiwa tena.

eng: In Cuba, a popular phrase explains that "joy in the home of the poor doesn't last long."
swa: Nchini Cuba, msemo maarufu unasema kuwa, "Furaha katika nyumba ya mlala hoi haidumu"

eng: Free access to the internet
swa: Uhuru wa upatikanaji wa huduma ya intaneti

eng: Reasonably priced Internet access for the Cuban people is what Telecommunications engineer Norges Rodriguez, manager of the blog Salir a la manigua, is petitioning for on Change.org, addressing Cuban authorities, especially the Minister of Communications, Maimir Mesa Ramos.
swa: Kimantiki,gharama za upatikanaji wa mtandao wa intaneti kwa watu wa Cuba zinaelezewa na Mhandisi wa masuala ya mawasiliano, Norges Rodriguez, ambaye pia ni mmiliki wa blogu ya Salir a la manigua, anatembeza hati ya makubaliano ya mtandaoni katika Change.org, yanayoilenga mamlaka ya Cuba, hususani Waziri wa Mawasiliano, Maimir Mesa Ramos.

eng: Amongst the reasons for the request is:
swa: Miongoni mwa sababu za ombi hili ni:

eng: New social practices brought by the internet are key and can only be compared with those that were offered, at their time, by the emergence of writing, the press, radio, telephonic services, and denying this would equate to the denial of development.
swa: Utendaji Mpya wa kijamii uliowezeshwa na mtandao wa intaneti ni msingi na unaweza kufananishwa na ule unaoletwa, kwa wakati wake, yaweza kuwa uharaka wa uandikaji, uandishi wa habari, redio, huduma za simu, kuzuia mambo haya ni sawa na kuzuia maendeleo.

eng: In this particular case, the novelty resides in the fact a blogger from the island has initiated an online campaign.
swa: Katika suala hili, jambo hili linaonekana kuwa ni geni pale ambapo mwanablogu kutoka katika kisiwa hiki kuanzisha kampeni za mtandaoni.

eng: Previously, a petition with a similar purpose had been promoted In Cuba, we ask for reasonable prices for internet access from our mobile phones, but from Florida, United States, on the website Cubanet.
swa: Siku za nyuma, kampeni ya mtandaoni iliyokuwa na lengo kama hili ilipewa nafasi kubwa Nchini Cuba, tunahitaji gharama muafaka za upatikanaji wa mtandao wa intaneti katika simu za mkononi lakini ni kutoka Florida, Marekani, katika wavutiCubanet.

eng: Gas extraction in Tanzania, as seen by cartoonist by Masoud Kipanya.
swa: Uchimbaji wa mafuta nchini Tanzania, mtazamo wa mchora katuni Masoud Kipanya.

eng: Originally published in Mwananchi.
swa: Katuni hii kwa mara ya kwanza iliwekwa katika gazeti la Mwananchi.

eng: Used with permission.
swa: Imetumiwa kwa ruhusa.

eng: No one knows for sure how much gas there is in Tanzania, though estimates put the amount at around 51 trillion cubic feet (TCF).
swa: Kwa hakika, hakuna yeyote ajuaye kiasi cha gesi iliyopo nchini Tanzania, hata hivyo inakisiwa kuwepo kwa takribani futi za ujazo trilioni 51 za gesi.

eng: But expectations surrounding gas exploration in Tanzania are soaringly high.
swa: Mategemeo katika uvunaji wa gesi nchini Tanzania yanaongezeka kwa kasi kubwa.

eng: Across Tanzania's commercial capital, Dar es Salaam, both traffic and new construction are burgeoning.
swa: Katika maeneo mbalimbali ya jiji la Kibiashara la Tanzania, Dar es Salaam, kumekuwa na ongezeko la haraka la magari pamoja na majengo mapya.

eng: The African Development Bank's (AfDB) designation of Dar es Salaam as the fastest growing city in East Africa is almost literally palpable.
swa: Mji wa Dar es Salaam umepewa hadhi na Benki ya Maendeleo ya Afrika (AfDB) kama jiji linalokuwa kwa kasi zaidi Afrika Mashariki ni jambo lisilohitaji ushahidi hata kidogo.

eng: The AfDB report, "Tracking Africa's Progress", predicts that the city’s population will increase from 4 million to 6.2 million over the next 10 years.
swa: Taarifa ya Benki ya Maendeleo ya Afrika, "Ufuatiliaji wa Maendeleo ya Africa", imeonesha makisio ya ongezeko la watu katika jiji hilo kutoka watu milioni 4 hadi milioni 6.2 katika kipindi cha miaka 10 ijayo.

eng: Predictions regarding the country’s economic growth are based on future income from natural resources, like gas from the region of Mtwara.
swa: Ukuaji wa uchumi wa Tanzania kwa siku za usoni unadhaniwa kuongezeka kutokana na kipato kutokana na rasilimali za asili kama vile gesi katika mkoa wa Mtwara.

eng: AfDB's forecast, for instance, makes reference to the potential jobs this activity will create.
swa: Kwa mfano, Mategemeo ya Benki ya Maendeleo ya Afrika ni kuwa uchimbaji huu wa gesi utaongeza kiasi kikubwa cha upatikanaji wa ajira.

eng: Protests in January and May 2013, however, by residents in the port city of Mtwara, signal a lack of confidence that the future envisioned by the AfDB will also materialise for remote rural areas of Tanzania such as Mtwara Region.
swa: Hata hivyo, maandamano ya Januari na Mei 2013 katika mji wa kibandari wa Mtwara yalitoa ishara ya kukosekana kwa imani kuwa matarajio ya Benki ya Maendeleo ya Afrika kutokuwezekana katika maeneo ya vijijini kama yale ya mkoa wa Mtwara.

eng: The catalyst for the protests was the announcement of a decision by the government to construct a gas pipeline from Mtwara to Dar es Salaam instead of a gas processing plant in Mtwara.
swa: Chanzo cha maandamano hayo kilikuwa ni maamuzi yaliyofikiwa na serikali ya kujenga bomba la gesi kutoka Mtwara kwenda Dar Es Salaam badala ya kujenga kiwanda cha kuchakata gesi mkoani Mtwara.

eng: The latter would have fed into an industrialisation strategy that would boost local development.
swa: Ujenzi wa kiwanda cha kuchakata mafuta mkoani Mtwara ungesaidia katika kukuza maendeleo ya kiviwanda mkoani humo.

eng: An incident in early July 2014 involving a production sharing agreement (PSA) between the Tanzanian Petroleum Development Corporation (TPDC) and the Norwegian multinational Statoil, along with Exxon Mobil, highlights how fraught the question of revenues from Tanzania’s gasfields—and who will benefit from them—has become.
swa: Tukio la mwanzoni mwa mwezi Julai 2014 lililohusu makubaliano ya ushirikiano katika uzalishaji (PSA) kati ya Shirika la Maendeleo ya Petroli la Tanzania (TPDC) na kampuni ya Norway ya kimataifa ya Statoil, sambamba na Exxon Mobil, ilionesha hali ya mashaka kuhusiana na suala la mapato kwenye uvunaji wa gesi nchini Tanzania na suala la nani kunufaika na mkataba huo.

eng: Though not directly linked to the protests in Mtwara, the TPDC-Statoil affair underlines a growing awareness among Tanzanians of the issues surrounding oil and gas, and an increasing dissatisfaction with the way the government handles natural resources contracts and communicates this information to citizens.
swa: Pamoja na kuwa hakuna uhusiano wa moja kwa moja na vurugu zilizotokea Mtwara, uhusiano uliopo kati ya TPDC na Statoil wapelekea wananchi wengi wa Tanzania kuongeza umakini wao kwenye masuala ya mafuta na gesi, na pia kuongezeka miongoni mwao kwa kutoridhishwa na namna serikali inavyosimamia mikataba ya rasilimali za asili na namna inavyowashirikisha wananchi.

eng: At the center of the matter is an addendum to Statoil’s original contract with the Tanzanian government for gas extraction in Mtwara Region that was leaked, then brought to the attention of the Tanzanian press in early July 2014.
swa: Sababu za hali hii ni kuvuja kwa kiambata cha mkataba rasmi uliofikiwa kati ya Statoil na serikali ya Tanzania kuhusu uchimbaji wa mafuta mkoani Mtwara, ulivuja, na kisha kugonga vichwa vya habari katika vyombo vya habari vya Tanzania mapema mwezi Julai, 2014.

eng: According to media reports, under the terms of the agreement as outlined in the leaked document, the government stands to lose US$1 billion annually.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa taarifa za vyombo vya habari, kwa kuzingatia makubaliano yaliyofikiwa kwenye taarifa hiyo iliyovuja, seriakali inaonekana kupoteza kaisi cha dola kimarekani bilioni 1 kwa mwaka.

eng: On social media Tanzanians wondered how the two multinationals had managed to strike such a good deal.
swa: Kwenye mitandao ya kijamii, watanzania wameshangazwa kwa namna ambavyo makampuni hay mawili yafanyavyo kazi katika mataifa mbalimbali yalivyoweza kuingia makataba mnono kwa kiasi hicho.

eng: A cartoon by Masoud Kipanya published in the Tanzanian daily Mwananchi depicts a white man with a tank labelled "GESI" (Swahili for "gas") on his back, extracting gas from the ground while handing out pennies to a Tanzanian.
swa: Katuni iliyoandaliwa na Masoud Kipanya na kuchapishwa kwenye gazeti la Tanzania litolewalo kila siku la Mwananchi, ikimuonesha mzungu akiwa amebeba mgongoni mwake tangi la "GESI" akiendelea kuchimba gesi na wakati huo akimpa mtanzania vijisenti.

eng: Another Kipanya cartoon shows a mouse saying in Swahili: “I wish that we would let our gas remain underground till our country reaches adolescence.”
swa: Katuni nyingine ya Kipanya ikimuonesha panya akisema: “Natamani kama gesi yetu isingechimbwa hadi tutakapopevuka.”

eng: Statoil's gas extraction project in Tanzania is one of the largest investments ever in Sub-Saharan Africa.
swa: Mradi wa Statoil wa uvunaji wa gesi nchini Tanzania ni moja ya miradi mikubwa kabisa kuwahi kutokea Kusini mwa Jangwa la Sahara.

eng: Writing on Africa Arguments, the analyst and blogger Ben Taylor claimed that the potential revenue from natural gas is on a scale that could release Tanzania from its heavy dependence on development aid.
swa: Akiandika kuhusiana na masuala ya Africa, mchambuzi na mwanablogu, Ben Taylor alitanabaisha kuwa, mapato sahihi yatokanayo na gesi asilia yanaweza kuifanya Tanzania kuacha kutegemea misaada ya kimaendeleo kwa kiasi kikubwa.

eng: “Another indication of the scale involved here,” wrote Taylor, “is that since the Norwegian government is Statoil’s majority shareholder, the extra revenue to the Norwegian government from this deal could be worth more than double the total of all Norwegian aid to Tanzania since independence.”
swa: “Ishara nyingine kuhusiana na mgawanyo huu,” aliandika Taylor, “ni kuwa, kwa kuwa serikali ya Norway ndiye mmiliki mkubwa wa Statoil, mapato ya ziada inayopata serikali ya Norway katika mradi huu yanaweza kuwa ni mara mbili zaidi ya misaada yote iliyowahi kutolewa na serikali ya Norway kwa Tanzania tangu Tanzania kupata uhuru.”

eng: Zitto Kabwe, a member of parliament and Chairman of the Public Accounts Committee, highlighted some of the leaked document’s key points in a Q&A on his blog, and critiqued the fact that the PSA was not made publicly available.
swa: Zitto Kabwe, ambaye ni mbunge na pia ni Mwenyekiti wa Kamati ya Hesabu za Serikali, alifafanua baadhi ya mambo ya msingi yaliyomo kwenye waraka uliovuja katika blogu yake, na kuchambua kwa kina kuhusiana na hoja ya kuwa hati ya makubaliano kutokuwekwa bayana.

eng: In a July 6 article in the Daily News the TPDC responded to Kabwe, asserting that claims that the country risked losing US$1 billion per year were unfounded.
swa: Kwenye makala ya Julai 6 katika gazeti la Daily News TPDC ilimjibu Kabwe, kwa kusema kuwa, hoja ya kwamba nchi imejiweka katika hatari ya kupoteza kiasi cha dola za kimarekani bilioni 1 kwa mwaka ni hoja isiyo na msingi wowote.

eng: Kabwe and others countered the TPDC’s comments on Twitter, and Kabwe called on the TPDC to clarify the terms of the deal.
swa: Kabwe na watu wengine walijibu hoja za TPDC katika Twita. Kabwe aliitaka TPDC kutolea ufafanuzi wa makubaliano yaliyofikiwa.

eng: According to a July 19 article in The Citizen, the TPCD confirmed its position in a press conference on July 16: "Outgoing TPDC managing director Yona Killagane strongly refuted the claims that the country would incur a loss of $1 billion annually if the pact is fully implemented as agreed.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa makala ya Julai 19 katika gazeti la The Citizen, TPDC ilitoa msimamo wake katika mkutano na waandishi wa habari mnamo Julai 16: "Mkurugenzi aliyeko madarakani wa TPDC, Yona Killagane alipinga vikali kabisa kuwa nchi itapoteza dola bilioni 1 za kimarekani kila mwaka iwapo mkataba huu utatumika kama makubaliano yalivyofikiwa.

eng: Instead, he insisted that the government was likely to earn more money and that it stood a higher chance to benefit from the contract."
swa: Kinyume chake, alisisitiza kuwa nchi ingaliweza kunufaika zaidi kifedha na hii ineipa nchi nafsi kubwa ya kunufaika katika mkataba huu."

eng: Tanzanians are not particularly pampered with regard to transparency around natural resources contracts, but this latest affair gives rise to even further mistrust.
swa: Watanzania kimsingi hawaridhishwi na suala la uwazi wa mikataba inayohusu rasilimali zao, tukio la kuvuja kwa hati ya makubaliano limechochea zaidi watanzania kutokuiamini serikali yao.

eng: Nor does it help when the likes of Patrick Rutabanzibwa, chairman of PanAfrican Energy, the company that runs the Songo Songo Gas and gas-fueled power plant in Ubungo in Dar es Salaam (also the former Permanent Secretary of the Ministry of Energy and Minerals), minimise the matter.
swa: Vile vile, haikusaidia, hata pale Patrick Rutabanzibwa, mwenyekiti wa PanAfrican Energy, kampuni inayoendesha mradi wa gesi ya Songo Songo pamoja na mtambo wa kuzalisha umeme wa Ubungo uliopo jijini Dar es Salaam (na pia ndiye aliyekuwa katibu wa Wizara ya Nishati na Madini), kulimaliza suala hili kimya kimya.

eng: We are failing to enter into resource contracts as it was in mining and currently in oil and gas because our capacity is very low,” said Rutabanzibwa. 	Tunashindwa kuingia mikataba inayohusu rasilimali kama ilivyokuwa kwenye uchimbaji madini na sasa katika mafuta na gesi kwa kuwa uwezo wetu bado ni mdogo,” alisema Rutabanzibwa.
“But if Tanzanians will be empowered then, contracts will be balanced. . . .
swa: “Lakini kama watanzania watawezeshwa, mikataba itakuwa katika hali ya usawa. . . .

eng: We should let bygones be bygones and start by legally making investment contracts in the natural gas sector public; I am sure there will come a day where all investment contracts are public.”
swa: Tunapaswa kusahau yaliyopita na tuanze kuingia mikataba ya uwekezaji ya gesi asilia kwa uwazi na kwa kufuata taratibu; Ni dhahiri kuwa, itafikia wakati ambao mikataba yote ya uwekezaji itakuwa bayana.”

eng: For stakeholders with particular interests in business and investments in Tanzania, criticism makes a challenging investment area like gas even more difficult, and some will even argue that it will result in less money going to neglected areas.
swa: Kwa washikadau walio na mipango ya kufanya biashara na uwekezaji nchini Tanzania, ukosoaji unaifanya sekta kama ya gesi iliyo na changamoto nyingi kuwa ngumu zaidi, na wengine wanaona kuwa, matokeo yake ni kuwa, maeneo yaliyotelekezwa hayatafaidika ipasavyo.

eng: Others might say that regardless of Tanzania’s share of the revenue, there will still be benefits in the form of jobs and local growth in Mtwara.
swa: Wengine wanaweza kusema kuwa, mbali na mgawanyo wa mapato baina ya Tanzania na makampuni yaliyowekeza, bado kutakuwa na faida ya upatikanaji wa ajira pamoja na ukuaji kiuchumi kwa mkoa wa Mtwara.

eng: Analyst Ben Taylor is less optimistic.
swa: Mchambuzi Ben Taylor hakuwa na imani na maelezo hayo.

eng: “One of the big political risks with oil and gas,” wrote Taylor, “is that it can be seen by politicians and senior officials as ‘easy’ money that doesn’t come with the kind of scrutiny that taxpayers demand when they pay their taxes and donors demand when they provide aid.
swa: “Moja ya hatari kubwa ya kisiasa katika uvunaji wa mafuta na gesi,” aliandika Taylor, “ni kuwa,jambo hili linaweza kuchukuliwa na wanasiasa na viongozi waandamizi kuwa ni fedha za "bure" ambazo huwa hazipatikani kirahisi kwa walipa kodi wanaofuatilia kwa makini kabla ya kulipa kodi zao pamoja na matakwa ya watoa misaada kabla ya kutoa misaada.

eng: Unless somebody – the media, politicians, civil society – steps up to fill the gap, decision makers in government will be left free to make whatever decisions they choose, unencumbered by any need to protect the public interest. 	Bila ya mtu– vyombo vya habari, wanasiasa, watetezi wa haki za raia – wasipoingilia kati na kutatua tatizo, viongozi wa serikali wataendelea kuwa huru kufanya maamuzi wanayoona wao yanafaaa, na yasiyo na tija yoyote kwa jamii.
The Statoil PSA may well have cost Tanzania several billion dollars – yet it appears no-one is trying to hold those responsible to account.”
swa: Makubaliano ya Ushirika katika uzalishaji ya Statoil yanaweza kuigharimu Tanzania mabilioni ya dola, lakini yaonekana bado hakuna yeyote anayejaribu kuwawajibisha wale wanaohusika.”

eng: Palestinians say it is raining fire in Gaza, after Israel started ground operations into the besieged enclave tonight.
swa: Wa-Palestina wanasema mvua ya moto inanyesha Gaza, baada ya Israeli kuanza operesheni ya ardhini ndani ya eneo inalolizunguka, Gaza.

swa: Gaza, inayoelezwa kama gereza la wazi, ndiko wanakoishi wa-Palestina milioni 2, ambao hawana pa kukimbilia.

eng: Both borders are heavily controlled, leaving residents with nowhere to run.
swa: Israeli inapakana na Gaza upande mmoj, na Misri inaifungia kwenye upande mwingine.
