eng: Today is the 11th day of the start of “Operation Defensive Edge,” which has left more than 230 Palestinians dead, including women and children, and more than 1,500 injured.
swa: Leo ni siku ya 11 tangu kuanza kwa "Operesheni ya Kujilinda", ambayo imepoteza maisha ya wa-Palestina 230, wakiwemo wanawake na watoto, na zaidi ya watu 1,500 wakijeruhiwa.

eng: From Gaza, Hamas, which has ruled the strip since 2007, has fired missiles into Israel.
swa: Kutoka Gaza, Hamas, ambayo imeutawala ukanda huo tangu mwaka 2007, ililipua makombora kwenda Israeli.

eng: Most of the rockets coming into Israel have caused no serious damage, due in part to the US-funded Iron Dome aerial defense system, which has intercepted at least 70 projectiles so far, according to the Guardian.
swa: Roketi nyingi zinazoingia Israeli hazijasababisha madhara makubwa, kwa sababu, kwa kiasi fulani, ya mfumo wa anga wa ulinzi unaofadhiliwa na Marekani, ambao umezuia makombora yapatayo 70 mpaka sasa, kwa mujibu wa gazeti la the Guardian.

eng: With the group operations, the casualties are expected to rise.
swa: Kwa operesheni hii ya kimakundi, madhara yanaweza kuongezeka zaidi.

eng: The Bahrain Ministry of Interior announced the arrest of yet another netizen, who reportedly faces accusations of "inciting hatred against the regime."
swa: Wizara ya Mambo ya Ndani ya Bahrain imetangaza kumkamata mtumiaji mwingine tena wa mtandao, anayedaiwa kutakiwa kujibu mashitaka ya "kuchochea chuki dhidi ya utawala."

eng: The satirist mirco-blogger, nicknamed Takrooz, was arrested at the Bahrain International Airport, while on his way back from Thailand, said the ministry in a statement on June 18, 2014, without disclosing his name.
swa: Mwanablogu huyo mwenye mtindo wa kutumia utani katika kuwasilisha ujumbe wake, mwenye jina la utani Takrooz, alikamatwa kwenye uwanja wa ndege wa Kimataifa wa Bahrain, wakati akirtudi kutoka Thailand, ilisema taarifa ya Wizara hiyo iliyotolewa Juni 18, 2014, bila kuanika jina lake halisi.

eng: A day later, many Bahrainis were fuming on Twitter, saying the arrest was futile and served no purpose other than to further demonstrate the government's true colours in stifling opposition voices online.
swa: Siku moja kabla, Wabahrain wengi walikuwa na hasira kwenye mtandao wa twita, wakisema kuwa kukamatwa kwake kumefanyika bila sababu na hapakuwa na kingine isipokuwa kuonyesha rangi halisi za serikali dhidi ya sauti kuu za upinzani katika mtandao wa intaneti.

eng: Scores of netizens have been arrested by the regime since anti-government protests started in Bahrain on February 14, 2011.
swa: Watumiaji kadhaa wa mtandao wameshakamatwa na utawala huo tangu maandamano ya kupinga serikali yaanze nchini Bahrain mnamo Februari 14, 2011.

eng: Among them are Mahmood Al-Yousif, Mohamed Almaskati and Global Voices author Mohamed Hassan.
swa: Miongoni mwao ni Mahmood Al-Yousif, Mohamed Almaskati na mwandishi wa Global Voices Mohamed Hassan.

eng: Bahrain is regarded as an enemy of the Internet according to the Reporters without Borders' 2014 report and is ranked second in the number of detained journalists per capita in 2013 according to the Committee to Protect Journalists.
swa: Bahrain inaonekana kuwa adui wa Mtandao wa Intaneti kwa mujibu wa Taarifa ya 2014 ya shirika la Reporters without Borders na imeshikilia nafasi ya pili kwa idadi ya waandishi wa habari waliokamatwa nchini humo kwa mwaka 2012 kwa mujibu wa Kamati ya Kulinda Waandishi wa Habari.

eng: With nearly 18,000 Twitter followers and 100,000 tweets, Takrooz has been an active voice in charting the government crackdown on activists.
swa: Karibu ya wafuatialiaji wa mtandao wa twita 18,000 na twiti zenye jina la Takrooz zipatazo 100,000 zimekuwa sauti hai zinazoilaani serikali kwa kupambana na wanaharakati.

eng: Bahrain Watch, a research and transparency group, reported that Takrooz' Twitter account was repeatedly targeted for surveillance by the Bahraini government.
swa: Asasi ya Bahrain Watch, inayojihusisha na utafiti na uwazi, ilisema kuwa anuani ya twita ya Takrooz inasemekana kuwa shabaha ya kufuatiliwa na serikali ya Bahraini.

eng: His tweets, in Arabic, cover abuse by law enforcement personnel, anti-corruption content and everyday concerns of the average Bahraini.
swa: Kwenye twiti zake, kwa lugha ya Kiarabu, zinajikita kwenye uvunjifu wa sheria unaofanywa na watu, kupambana na vitendo vya ufisadi na masuala ya kila siku ya raia wa kawaida wa Bahraini.

eng: The next day Twitter user @M_Alshaikh published an image of an Arabic daily's coverage of Takrooz's arrest:
swa: Siku iliyofuata mtumiaji wa twita aitwaye @M_Alshaikh alichapisha picha ya habari za Gazeti moja la kila siku la Kiarabu kuhusu kukamatwa kwa Takrooz:

eng: Government newspaper published an article about of the arrest of Takrooz in the first page #Bahrain @Takrooz
swa: Gazeti la serikali limechapisha makala kuhusu kukamatwa kwa Takrooz kwenye ukarasa wake wa kwanza #Bahrain @Takrooz

eng: Lawyer Hanan Alaradi ‏@hananalaradi tweeted questioning his arrest status:
swa: Mwanasheria Hanan Alaradi ‏@hananalaradi alitwiti akihoji kinachoendelea baada ya kukamatwa na Takrooz:

eng: Will the owner of the account @Takrooz be released on bail like other pro-government tweeters @mnarfezhom
swa: Je, mtumiaji wa anuani hii @Takrooz ataachiwa kwa dhamana lama watumiaji wengine wa twita wanaoishabikia serikali @mnarfezhom

eng: Bahrain had earlier arrested pro-government Twitter user, Mnarfezhom, who was released on bail, pending trial.
swa: Hapo awali, Bahrain ilimkamata mtumiaji wa mtandao wa twita anayeishabikia serikali, Mnarfezhom, ambaye aliachiwa kwa dhamanaon, akisubiri mashitaka.

eng: Mnarfezhom is accused of four separate counts of insulting and slandering people, attacking their honour and reputation and offending Bahraini families using indecent expressions through social media accounts on Twitter and Instagram under the names Al Raqeeb, Ahfad Al Waleed, Ahfad Omar and Mnarfezhom.
swa: Mnarfezhom anatuhumiwa kutumia majina manne tofauti kuwatukana na kuwadhalilisha watu, akiwavunia heshima na hadhi yao na kudhalilisha familia za Wabahraini kwa kutumia maneno ya kuudhi kupitia mitandao ya kijamii ya Twita na Instagram kwa kutumia majina manne tofauti Al Raqeeb, Ahfad Al Waleed, Ahfad Omar na Mnarfezhom.

eng: Many angry Twitter users have be inspired to tweet after Takrooz's arrest saying that such arrests are futile. @Lair_Vulnerable noted:
swa: Watumiaji wengi wa mtandao wa twita waliokuwa na hasira walihamasihwa kutwiti baada ya kukamatwa kwa Takrooz wakisema kuwa vitendo vya ukamataji havina sababu ya msingi. @Lair_Vulnerable alibainisha:

eng: #Bahrain when you arrest .. a rebel, a tweeter, a photographer etc .. you're making a symbol out of him you fools and he will be stronger.
swa: #Bahrain unapokamata...muasi, mtumiaji wa twita, mpiga picha nk...unamtengenezea alama ya ushujaa nyie wajinga na atakuwa imara zaidi.

eng: I'm the next Takrooz
swa: Mimi ni Takrooz anayefuata

eng: Official sources say Takrooz has already confessed to running the account and that he will be put on trial for inciting hatred against the regime.
swa: Vyanzo rasmi vinasema Takrooz amekiri kutumia anuani hiyo na kwamba atafunguliwa mashitaka kwa kuchochea chuki dhidi ya utawala.

eng: Ivory Coast-based Koaci.com has learned that a young Ivorian woman was found dead after having been reportedly pushed off the 6th floor of an apartment following a suspected feud with her sponsor concerning her salary payment.
swa: Koaci.com aliye na maskani yake huko Ivory Coast aligundua kuwa msichana wa Ivory coast alikutwa na mauti kwa kile kinachosadikiwa kuwa alitupwa kutoka ghorofa ya 6 kutokana na ugomvi kati yake na mwajiri wake, ugomvi unaosadikiwa kusababishwa na mwajiri wa msichana huyo kutokumpa mishahara yake.

eng: Carolle Feby reports on Koaci.com that :
swa: Carolle Feby anataarifu katika mtandao wa Koaci.com kuwa :

eng: A young Ivorian woman of around 20 years old was found dead after having been reportedly pushed off the 6th floor of a building for demanding her salary in Beirut, Lebanon.
swa: Msichana wa Ivory Coast mwenye miaka inayokadiriwa kufikia 20 alikutwa amefariki kwa kile kilichoripotiwa kuwa alisukumwa na kuanguka kutoka ghorofa ya 6 pale alipokuwa akidai mshahara wake huko Beirut, Lebanon.

eng: This was reported to Koaci.com by a young Cameroonian woman, after the revelations by her sister, who is a neighbor of the victim.
swa: Taarifa hii ilitolewa katika mtandao wa Koaci.com na msichana mmoja wa Cameroon kutokana na ushuhuda alioutoa dada yake ambaye ni jirani wa msichana aliyefariki.

eng: According to her neighbor, whose name can’t be revealed, the young victim was pushed out of the 6th floor of a building in Asharfir – Note: She might have meant Achrafieh -, a neighborhood in the city of Beirut in Lebanon on Tuesday the 1st of July.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa jirani yake, ambaye jina lake limehifadhiwa, msichana huyo alisukumwa na kuanguka kutoka ghorofa ya 6 ya jengo lililopo huko Asharfir – Agalizo: Bila shaka alikuwa anamaanisha Achrafieh -, jirani na jiji la Beirut huko Lebanon siku ya Jumanne tarehe 1 Julai.

eng: She was asking for her salary and the man, refusing, apparently pushed her out of anger.
swa: Alikuwa akidai mshahara wake, mwanamume huyo alikataa, na ndipo kwa hasira, alimsukuma msichana huyo.

eng: This young expatriate reportedly left the Ivory Coast years ago to work as a domestic worker in Lebanon, a common scenario for many young Ivorian women.
swa: Msichana huyu aliyeishi nje ya nchi yake kwa miaka mingi, habari zinasema kuwa alitoka Ivory Coast miaka kadhaa iliyopita kwa ajili ya kufanya kazi za ndani nchini Lebanon, jambo ambalo limekuwa la kawaida kabisa kwa wasichana wa Ivory Coast.

eng: Stories such as this one are unfortunately very common in Lebanon.
swa: Matukio ya aina hii kwa bahati mbaya yamekuwa ya kawaida sana nchini Lebanon.

eng: A few months ago, after a revelation by Koaci.com that a group of African women were being tortured, they were successfully repatriated from Lebanon.
swa: Miezi michache iliyopita, mara baada ya Koaci.com kuweka bayana kuwa kundi moja la wanawake wa kiafrika kunyanyaswa walifanikiwa kurudishwa nchini mwao salama kutoka Lebanon.

eng: This unfortunately is a common occurrence in Lebanon and other Arab countries that employ the Kafala, or 'Sponsorship' system.
swa: Kwa habati mbaya, matukio haya yamekuwa ya kawaida sana nchini Lebanon pamoja na nchi nyingine za kiarabu wanaotunmia mfumo wa Kafala, au mfumo wa 'Ufadhili'.

eng: As explained by Human Rights Watch in its 2014 report on Lebanon:
swa: Kama inavyofafanuliwa na shirika la kutetea haki za binadamu katika taarifa ya mwaka 2014 ya Lebanon:

eng: Migrant domestic workers are excluded from the labor law and subject to restrictive immigration rules based on employer-specific sponsorship—the kafala system—which put workers at risk of exploitation and abuse.
swa: Sheria ya kazi haiwahusu wahamiaji wanaofanya kazi za ndani na badala yake wanakabiliwa na taratibu kali za uhamiaji chini ya mfumo wa mwajiri-mfadhili mahususi- mfumo wa kafala- mfumo unaowaweka wafanyakazi katika hatari ya kukandamizwa na kudhalilishwa.

eng: While outgoing Labor Minister Charbel Nahhas announced in January 2012 that he would look at abolishing the kafala system, in 2013 Labor Minister Salim Jreissati failed to do so or to put forward legislation that would protect the estimated 200,000 migrant domestic workers in the country.
swa: Wakati waziri wa Kazi aliyemaliza muda wake, Charbel Nahhas Januari 2012 alitangaza kuwa angeangalia uwezekano wa kufutilia mbali mfumo wa kafala,mwaka 2013, waziri wa kazi, Salim Jreissati alishindwa kufanya hivyo au kuweka sheria ambayo ingewalinda zaidi ya wafanyakazi wa ndani wanaokadiriwa kufikia 200,000 nchini humo.

eng: In July, a criminal court sentenced an employer to two months in prison, imposed a fine, and required her to pay damages and compensation to a migrant domestic worker whose wages she had not paid for years.
swa: Mwezi Julai, mahakama ya makosa ya jinai ilimuhukumu mwajiri mmoja kifungo cha miezi sita gerezani, kutozwa fidia, na kutakiwa kulipa fidia ya uharibifu pamoja na kulipa mishahara ya mfanya kazi wake wa ndani ambaye hakuwa amemlipa kwa miaka kadhaa.

eng: Migrant domestic workers suing their employers for abuse continue, however, to face legal obstacles and risk imprisonment and deportation due to the restrictive visa system.
swa: Matukio ya wahamiaji wanaofanya kazi za ndani kuwashitaki waajiri wao kwa kuwadhalilisha yanazidi kushika kasi, hata hivyo, wanakabiliwa na changamoto za kisheria na hatari ya kuwekwa gerezani na kurudishwa makwao kutokan na mfumo kandamizi wa taratibu za uhamiaji.

eng: Image by Lon&Queta on flickr (CC BY-NC-SA 2.0).
swa: Picha ya Lon Queta kwenye mtandao flickr (CC BY-NC-SA 2.0).

eng: Panamanian Joel Silva Díaz elaborates what many people wonder, especially men: how to be a good father.
swa: Raia wa Panama Joel Silva Díaz anafafanua kile ambacho kinawashangaza watu wengi, hususani wanaume: namna ya kuwa baba mwema.

eng: On his personal blog he describes his challenges with his own father and his goals as a father:
swa: Kwenye blogu yake anaeleza changamoto alizokutana nazo na baba yake mwenyewe na kuhusianisha na malengo yake kama baba:

eng: I remember I considered a game to look for something to talk about, due to my lack of interest in sports we never had a conversation longer than five lines (rightfully registered for over ten years), but knowing other cases and stories, I at least had a father.
swa: Nakumbuka mchezo wa kuangalia cha kusema, shauri ya kutokupenda kwangu michezo hatukuwahi kuwa na mazungumzo ya zaidi ya mistari mitano (kwa uhakika kabisa nakumbuka kwa zaidi ya miaka kumi), lakini kwa kufahamu mahusiano yetu katika maeneo mengine, angalau naweza kusema nilikuwa na baba.

eng: And that's what I want to improve,I want to be a father that does things without noticing it, I want to hug, kiss my children, present them the best option to make the best decisions and support them when they don't make the good ones, never hesitate in demonstrating my love and care, let alone when they earn a smack on the head.
swa: Na hicho ndicho ninachotaka kukifanya vizuri zaidi, nataka kuwa baba anayefanya bila hata kutambua, nataka kuwakumbatia, kuwabusu, kuwapa fursa bora za kufanya maamuzi bora na kuwasaidia wanapokuwa hawajafanya chema, sichelewi kuwonyesha upendo na kuwajali, hata kama kuna nyakati naweza kweli kuwafinya.

eng: As for me, I don't want a last name to last, nor a check every two weeks, my part has to be present, decisive and I want my child to have at least on only nice memory in their heart, as Salsa and the scent of recently trimmed off grass on Sundays at home.
swa: Kwangu, nisingependa jina la mwisho liishie, wala kuwachungulia kila baada ya majuma mawili, napaswa kuwepo, kuamua, na ninataka watoto wangu wawe na angalau kumbukumbu moja nzuri akilini mwao, kama mwanangu Salsa anavyokumbuka harufu nzuri ya majani yanapokuwa yamekatwa siku za Jumapili nyumbani.

eng: Are you, or plan to be a good father?
swa: Je, wewe ni, au unapanga kuwa baba mwema?

eng: You can read Silva Diaz following his accounts on G+ or Twitter This post was part of the eleventh #LunesDeBlogsGV, (Monday of blogs on GV) on July 14, 2014.
swa: Unaweza kusoma zaidi anayoyaandika Silva Diaz kwa kumfuatilia kwenye akaunti yake ya G+ au Twita Makala haya ni sehu ya kumi na moja ya #LunesDeBlogsGV, (Jumatatu ya blogu kwenye GV) siku ya Julai 14, 2014.

eng: 2014 elections logo, via the Facebook page of the independent election commission As elections near in Tunisia, netizens are debating whether it is worth casting their votes in the upcoming legislative and presidential polls.
swa: Nembo ya uchaguzi wa 2014, kupitia ukurasa wa Facebok wa tume huru ya uchaguzi Kadri uchaguzi unavyokaribia nchini Tunisia, watumiaji wa mtandao wanajadiliana ikiwa uchaguzi huo una hadhi ya wao kupiga kura katika uchaguzi ujao wa wabunge na rais.

eng: Tunisia' parliamentary elections will be held on October 26 while the first round of presidential poll is scheduled for November 23.
swa: Uchaguzi wa Bunge la nchi hiyo utafanyika Oktoba 26 wakati duru ya kwanza ya uchaguzi wa rais imepangwa kufanyika Novemba 23.

eng: However, not everyone is as excited about heading to the polls later this year.
swa: Hata hivyo, si kila mmoja anasisimka kukaribia uchaguzi huo baadae mwaka huu.

eng: Those unwilling to vote often cite their dissatisfaction with the performance of the political class during the past three years, arguing that the 2011 elections 'did not bring any change'.
swa: Wale wasiopenda kupiga kura mara nyingi huzungumzia kutokuridhishwa kwao na utendaji wa kada ya wanasiasa katika miaka mitatu iliyopita, wakitumia hoja kuwa uchaguzi wa mwaka 2011 'hakuleta tija wala mabadiliko yoyote'.

eng: In October 2011, Tunisians elected a National Constituent Assembly (NCA) tasked with drafting a new constitution after the ousting of dictator Zeine el Abidin Ben Ali.
swa: Mwezi Oktoba 2011, Watunisia walipiga kura kuchagua Bunge la Katiba la Taifa (NCA) ambalo lilipewa jukumu la kutunga katiba mpya baada ya kung'olewa madarakani kwa dikteta Zeine el Abidin Ben Ali.

eng: The Islamist party Ennahdha gained 40 per cent of the votes.
swa: Chama chenye mrengo wa Kiislam, Ennahdha kilipata asilimia 40 ya kura zilizopigwa.

eng: Like many, Nymeria wondered: What am I to do in #TnElec ?
swa: Kama wengine wengi, Nymeria alishangazwa:

eng: On June 24, Twitter user Papillon, who has around 13,000 followers, posted the following question:
swa: Mnamo Juni 24, mtumiaji wa twita Papillon, ambaye ana wafuasi 13,000 alibandika swali lifuatalo:

eng: None those of who are encouraging to vote can answer this, yet very simple question: how was voting on 23 October useful?
swa: Hakuna yeyote kati ya hawa wanaowatia moyo kupiga kura wanaweza kujibu swali hili, ambalo ni rahisi sana: je, uchaguzi wa Oktoba 23 ulileta faida gani?

eng: Blogger Saber Arabasta, who has around 12,000 followers, answered :
swa: Mwanablogu Saber Arabasta, mwenye wafuasi 12,000 alijibu :

eng: Knowing the balance of the political forces in the country, changing the government, changing the president, drafting a constitution
swa: Ni kujua uwiano wa nguvu za kisiasa katika nchi hii, kubadilisha serikali, kubadilisha rais, kutunga katiba basi

eng: He added in another tweet :
swa: Akaongeza kwenye twiti nyingine :

eng: Debating laws, debating a budget, deciding on an electoral process and transitional justice and changing diplomacy.
swa: Kujadili sheria, kujadili bajeti, kuamua kuhusu zoezi la uchaguzi na kutolewa kwa haki ya mpito na kubadilika kwa diplomasia.

eng: User Chikh Magon asked :
swa: Mtumiaji Chikh Magon aliuliza :

eng: I return the question to you: what would boycotting the elections be useful for?
swa: Ninawarudishia swali kwenu: kugomea kupiga kura kutasaidia nini?

eng: On Facebook, Journalist and blogger Haythem El Mekki wrote :
swa: Kwenye mtandao wa Facebook, Mwandishi wa habari na Mwanablogu Haythem El Mekki aliandika :

eng: So, those who are in favor of boycotting and abstaining, I would have loved to follow and support you but you need to tell me what have you concretely and permanently planned...What is the result you wish to see by urging boycott?
swa: Kwenu nyote mnaoshabikia kugomea au kuacha , ningependa sana kuwafuata na kuwaunga mkono lakini hebu mniambie nini hasa mmekipanga kwa maana ya uhalisia na ufanisi...mtarajia kuona matokeo gani kwa kugomea kura?

eng: Apart from depriving us from the votes of those who wish to see a change more than anyone else...I am as unsatisfied by the political class as you, even more.
swa: Ukiacha kuwanyima haki wale wanaotamani kuona mabadiliko kuliko mtu yeyote...mimi binafsi siridhishwi na tabaka la wanasiasa kama ambavyo siridhishwi na ninyi, tena zaidi.

eng: But I only see nihilism in your approach which I find destructive and childish...Could you convince me of the opposite?
swa: Lakini ninachokiona kwenu ni ubeuzi tu kwenye mbinu mnayotumia ambayo kwangu naiona kama isiyo na faida yoyote na ni ya kitoto...mnaweza kunishawishi kinyume chake?

eng: Bechir Bizertino commented :
swa: Bechir Bizertino alitoa maoni :

eng: First of all, you explain to us, how taking part in the elections to choose any of the dirty parties imposed on us will change anything in the country.
swa: Awali ya yote, umetueleza, namna ambavyo kushiriki uchaguzi kuchagua vyama vya hovyo tunavyoletewa kutabadili nchi.

eng: For me, I am boycotting because my vote to any of the existent dirty parties is of no use and value since the entire political class only listens to foreign ambassadors and not the people who elect ...by boycotting, at least I'm not giving them any legitimacy and deputizing them so they cannot pretend
swa: Kwangu, ninagomea uchaguzi kwa sababu kura yangu kwa chama chochote cha hovyo hakuna faida yoyote wala thamani yoyote kwa sababu tabaka lote la wanasiasa linasikiliza mabalozi wa kigeni na wala si watu waliowachagua...kwa kugomea uchaguzi, angalau siwapi uhalali wowote na kuwafanya wajifanyie mambo yao wenyewe bila kuigiliza kuwa

eng: Zenova Gamha Fehmi posted this comment :
swa: Zenova Gamha Fehmi alibandika maoni haya :

eng: In my opinion, it is an obligation to vote for any party.
swa: Kwa maoni yangu, ni jukumu letu kupiga kura kwa chama chochote.

eng: In five years' time, if we are still unsatisfied, we can vote to a different party and so on, this is the game.
swa: Kwa muda wa miaka mitano, kama tutaendelea kutokuridhika, tunaweza kupiga kura kwa chama kingine tofauti na kadhalika, ndivyo mambo yanavyopaswa kwenda.

eng: Voting is an obligation towards those who died to grant us this right.
swa: Kupiga kura ni jukumu letu kwa wale wote walioyatoa maisha yao wakafa kwa ajili ya kutuletea haki.

eng: Do not expect a miracle after the elections, Tunisians tend to want to have everything immediately, which is impossible
swa: Msitarajie miujiza baada ya uchaguzi, Watunisia wana tabia ya kutaka kila kitu kwa haraka bila kungoja, jambo ambalo haliwezekani

eng: In the meantime, the country's independent electoral commission (ISIE) launched a campaign urging Tunisians to register before July 22, if they wish to cast their votes.
swa: Wakati huo huo, tume huru ya uchaguzi ya nchi hiyo (ISIE) ilizindua kampeni ya kuwasihi Watunisia kujiandikisha kabla ya tarehe 22 Julai, kama wanataka kupiga kura kwenye uchaguzi ujao.

eng: Those who do not register will not be able to do so.
swa: Wale wote ambao hawatakuwa wamejiandikisha hawataweza kupiga kura.

eng: The campaign targets some 4 million eligible voters who did not register for the October 2011 constituent assembly election.
swa: Kampeni hiyo inawalenga wapiga kura wenye sifa wapatao milioni 4 ambao hawakujiandikisha kwenye uchaguzi wa Oktoba 2011 wa kuchagua bunge la katiba.

eng: With a high abstention rate estimated at 50pc in 2011, the electoral commission and civil-society groups are concerned that this year's turnout rate will be lower in the face of a growing popular disappointment with political parties.
swa: Kufuatia kujitokeza watu wachache sana waliokadiriwa kuwa asilimia 50 tu mwaka 2011, tume ya uchaguzi na makundi ya asasi za kiraia yana wasiwasi kwamba katika uchaguzi wa mwaka huu watu wachache zaidi watajitokeza hasa baada ya kukatishwa tamaa na yanayofanywa na vyama vya siasa.

eng: Abdoulaye Bah, Global Voices contributor and author of the Konakry Express blog has launched a petition to ask Pope Francis to take action against African dictators.
swa: Abdoulaye Bah, mchangiaji wa Global Voices na mwanablogu wa Konakry Express ameanzisha ombi la mtandaoni kumwomba Papa Francis kuchukua hatua dhidi ya madikteta wa Afrika.

eng: Bah, who previously wrote about his admiration for some of the Pope's political stance, denounces the credit granted by the Papacy to five African leaders by officially receiving them at Vatican City.
swa: Bah, ambaye aliwahi kuandika namna anavyokubaliana na baadhi ya misimamo ya kisiasa ya Papa, anapinga sifa zilizotolewa na Papa kwa viongozi watano wa Afrika kwa kuwakaribisha jijini Vatican.

eng: The petition asked for the same punishment for the dictators as what was recently bestowed on members of the Mafia when Pope Francis visited Calabria.
swa: Ombi hilo linaomba kutokewa kwa adhabu kwa madikteta kama ilivyosemwa na wanachama wa Mafia wakati Papa Francis alipotembelea Calabria.

eng: Your Holiness recently received President Robert Mugabe of Zimbabwe, President Eduardo dos Santos of Angola, President Obiang Nguema of Equatorial Guinea, President Paul Biya of Cameroon, and President Sassou Nguesso of the Republic of Congo.
swa: Papa Mtakatifu hivi karibuni alimpokea Rais Robert Mugabe wa Zimbabwe, Rais Eduardo dos Santos wa Angola, Rais Obiang Nguema wa Guinea ya Ikweta, Rais Paul Biya wa Kameruni, na Rais Sassou Nguesso wa Jamhuri ya Kongo.

eng: These five presidents broke world records for longevity in power.
swa: Marais hawa watano walivunja rekodi ya dunia kwa kubaki madarakani kwa muda mrefu.

eng: To do this, they have built oligarchies which pillage resources, kill innocents, rape women, torture opponents and defenders of human rights.
swa: Kwa kufanya hivi, wamejenga himaya zinazovuna raslimali za nchi, kuua watu wasio na hatia, kubaka wanawake, kutesa wapinzani na watetezi wa haki za binadamu.

eng: These oligarchies also corrupt institutions, pervert their people wishes during rigged elections, and divide populations by sowing hate and provoking uprising..
swa: Himaya hizi zinafisidi taasisi, zinaharibu matumaini ya watu wao kwa kuharibu uchaguzi, na kugawa watu wao kwa kutengeneza chuki na kusababisha harakati za kuwapinga.

eng: From outer space, astronaut Alexander Gerst watches as Gaza erupts in flames.
swa: Kutoka kwenye anga la mbali, mwanaanga Alexander Gerst anatazama namna Gaza inavyowaka moto.

eng: He tweets:
swa: Anatwiti:

eng: My saddest photo yet.
swa: Picha mbaya sana hii.

eng: From #ISS we can actually see explosions and rockets flying over #Gaza & #Israel pic.twitter.com/jNGWxHilSy — Alexander Gerst (@Astro_Alex) July 23, 2014
swa: Kutoka ISS tunaweza kuona milipuko na maroketi yakipaa gaza na Israel

eng: This photograph has been retweeted 33K times so far.
swa: Picha hii imechapishwa kwa mara nyingine kwa zaidi ya mara 33,000 mpaka sasa.

eng: Palestinian Sayel tweets to his 1,800 plus followers on Twitter the following photograph of Gazans planting flowers in Israeli shells.
swa: Mpalestina Sayel anatwiti kwa wafuasi wake 1,800 kwenye mtandao wa Twita picha ifuatayo ya wakazi wa Gaza wakipanda maua kwenye maganda ya silaha za Israeli.

eng: Today is Day 19 of an Israeli offensive on the Palestinian enclave, which has claimed the lives of at least 1,000 Palestinians and injured 6,000 others.
swa: Leo ni siku ya 19 ya mashambulizi ya Israel kwenye makazi ya Wapalestina, ambayo yamepoteza maisha ya watu wasiopungua 1,000 na kujeruhi wengine 6,000.

eng: VERY FIRST images of #AH5017 #AirAlgerie trickling out, via @AirLiveNet http://t.co/4pKox7rgjn pic.twitter.com/rngGTv7Rbs — Jason Morrell (@CNNJason) July 25, 2014
swa: PICHA ZA KWANZA za ndege ya AH5017 ya Shirika la Ndege la Algeria ikianguka, kupitia @AirLiveNet

eng: The first footage of the plane crash are now available thanks to a Burkinabe soldier present on the site of the wreck near Gossi, in Northern Mali.
swa: Kipande cha kwanza cha video cha ajali ya ndege sasa kinapatikana. Tunamshukuru mwanajeshi wa Burkina Faso aliyekuwa eneo la tukio la ajali karibu na Gossi, Mashariki mwa Mali.

eng: There are no survivors among the 118 people on board, including more than 50 French nationals.
swa: Hakuna mtu aliyeokoka katika abiria 118 waliokuwa kwenye ndege hiyo, ikiwa ni pamoja na raia 50 wa Ufaransa.

eng: Algerian website Algérie Focus reports in French that:
swa: Tovuti la Aljeria Algérie Focus imeripoti kwa Kifaransa kwamba:

eng: The video shows scattered and crushed debris.
swa: Video inaonyesha vipande vya ndege hiyo vikiwa vimetawanyika.

eng: The sand at the site was blackened by the crash.
swa: Udongo wa eneo hilo uligeuka kuwa mweusi.

eng: In the video, it is virtually impossible to identify the key components of the aircraft amid the debris.
swa: Katika video hiyo, si rahisi kutambua sehemu yoyote ya ndege hiyo kwenye mabaki hayo.

eng: This post is part of our campaign #FreeAlexSodiqov: GV Author Detained in Tajikistan.
swa: Posti hii ni sehemu ya kampeni yetu ya #FreeAlexSodiqov: Mwandishi wa GV aliyetiwa kizuizini nchini Tajikistan.

eng: Three weeks to the day since Global Voices author Alexander Sodiqov was arrested in Khorog, Tajikistan, his wife, Musharraf, has seen him only once.
swa: Ni muda wa wiki tatu tangu mwandishi wa Global Voices Alexander Sodiqov kukamatwa mjini Khorog, Tajikistan, mke wake, Musharraf, amemwona mara moja tu.

eng: Alex is an academic, not a spy.
swa: Alex ni msomi, sio mpelelezi.

eng: Igor Shoikhedbrod speaks at the event for Alexander Sodiqov.
swa: Igor Shoikhedbrod anazungumza katika tukio kwa ajili ya Alexander Sodiqov.

eng: Photo taken from freesodiqov.org, a website set up by Sodiqov's colleagues at the University of Toronto.
swa: Picha kwa hisani ya freesodiqov.org, tovuti iliyoanzishwa na wenzake Sodiqov katika Chuo Kikuu cha Toronto.

eng: Global Voices has been covering, where possible, the academic meetings held in support of Alex Sodiqov.
swa: Global Voices imekuwa ikiripoti, kila inavyowezekana, mikutano ya kitaaluma inayofanyika kumuunga mkono Alex Sodiqov.

eng: They are here, here, here and here.
swa: Ziko hapa, hapa, hapa na hapa.

eng: Overall there were twelve meetings held for Alex.
swa: Kwa ujumla kulikuwa na mikutano kumi na mbili iliyofanyika kwa niaba ya Alex.

eng: On June 27 there was a meeting held at the University of Toronto in Canada, where Alex is a PhD student and Teaching Assistant.
swa: Juni 27 kulikuwa na mkutano uliofanyika katika Chuo Kikuu cha Toronto nchini Canada, mahali ambapo Alex ni mwanafunzi wa Shahada ya Uzamifu (PhD) na mhadhiri msaidizi.

eng: Alex knows so much about Tajikistan’s history its culture and its institutions.
swa: Alex anajua mengi kuhusu historia ya Tajikistan utamaduni wake na taasisi zake.

eng: And he knows these things not as someone looking from the outside in, but as someone that has experienced those institutions, that history and that culture.
swa: Na anajua mambo haya si kama mtu anayetazama kutoka nje, lakini kama mtu mwenye uzoefu wa taasisi hizo, historia hiyo na utamaduni huo.

eng: Aside from being a rising star in academia Alex is first and foremost a family man.
swa: Mbali na kuwa mashuhuri katika masomo, Alex, kwanza kabisa ni mtu apendaye familia.

eng: I remember one time asking him how he was on a morning when we had to hand in assignments and he said that he hadn’t slept because he had had to take his wife and his baby daughter Erica to the hospital because she was teething.
swa: Nakumbuka wakati mmoja nilimuuliza alivyokuwa anajisikia asubuhi wakati tukiwasilisha kazi na yeye alisema kwamba alikuwa hajalala kwa sababu alikuwa amempeleka mke wake na mtoto wake Erica hospitalini kwa sababu ya homa ya kuota meno.

eng: Alex did not spend that much time in the department because he wanted to spend all the time available with his wife and daughter.
swa: Alex hakukaa kwa muda katika idara kwa sababu alitaka kutumia muda wote aliokuwa nao na mke wake na binti.

eng: One of the reasons Alexander was in Tajikistan aside from his scholarly interest in the region, was because like all TAs his contract ran out in April and he had to provide income for his family over the summer.
swa: Moja ya sababu Alexander alikuwa nchini Tajikistan mbali na maslahi yake kitaalamu katika eneo hilo, ilikuwa kwa sababu mkataba wake ulikwisha mwezi Aprili na alihitaji kufanya kazi kujiongezea kipato kwa ajili ya familia yake wakati wa msimu wa kiangazi.

eng: Last time I spoke with Alex and his family he cooked me authentic Tajik plov and promised to bring me a kazan (cooking pot) as a souvenir from Tajikistan.
swa: Mara ya mwisho nilizungumza na Alex na familia yake na alinipikia chakula halisi cha Tajik kiitwachoplov na aliahidi kuniletea kazan (sufuria) kama zawadi kutoka Tajikistan.

eng: It is my sincere hope that he can be released without delay and that he can be reunited with his family.
swa: Ni matumaini yangu kwamba anaweza kuachiliwa bila kuchelewa na kwamba ataweza kuunganishwa na familia yake.

eng: We need more scholars on Tajikistan like Alex.
swa: Tunahitaji wasomi zaidi nchini Tajikistan kama Alex.

eng: The rest of the meeting can be watched here:
swa: Sehemu nyingine ya mkutano waweza kuitazama hapa:

eng: Zambia's President Tried to Prove That He's Hard at Work With These Facebook Photos.
swa: Rais wa Zambia Ajaribu Kuthibitisha Kuwa Yuko ‘Fiti’ kwa Picha Hizi za Facebook.

eng: President Michael Sata reportedly addressing a cabinet meeting upon his return from Israel where he was admitted to a hospital.
swa: Rais Michael Sata akisemekana kuhutubia kikao cha Baraza la Mawaziri mara aliporudi kutoka Israel alikokuwa amelazwa hospitali.

eng: This is one of the photos that was sent to media houses and also appeared on the president's Facebook page.
swa: Hii ni picha mojawapo iliyotumwa kwa vyombo vya habari na ilionekana pia kwenye ukurasa wa Facebook wa rais.

eng: When Zambia's President Michael Sata's team released photos of a supposed cabinet meeting to local media and published them on Facebook, it was meant to put to bed allegations that the leader isn't well nor working.
swa: Timu ya Rais wa Zambia, Michael Sata ilipotoa picha hizo zinazosemekana kuwa ni za kikao cha baraza la Mawaziri kwa vyombo vya habari vya nchi hiyo na kuzichapisha kwenye ukurasa wa Facebook, lengo lilikuwa kumaliza madai kwamba kiongozi huyo ni mgonjwa na hajawa akifanya kazi.

eng: Instead, the images have further fanned the criticism, and some are doubting the authenticity of the meeting because there is no audio or video footage to back it up.
swa: Badala yake, picha hizo zilikuwa mithili ya mafuta yaliyoongezwa kwenye moto unaowaka, kiasi kwamba baadhi hata wanathubutu kuhoji uhalisi wa mkutano huo kwa sababu hapakuwa na kipande cha rekodi ya sauti na video kuthibitisha madai hayo.

eng: It began when Sata left the country unannounced on June 20, 2014.
swa: Mambo yalianza wakati Sata alipoondoka nchini kimya kimya mnamo Juni 20, 2014.

eng: The website Zambian Watchdog exposed the trip, reporting that the president had arrived in Israel and was admitted to a hospital.
swa: Tovuti ya Zambian Watchdog ilitoboa siri hiyo, ikiripoti kuwa rais alikuwa amewasili nchini Israel na alikuwa amelazwa hospitali.

eng: The chief government spokesman then confirmed the trip, but said Sata was on a working holiday in Israel.
swa: Msemaji mkuu wa serikali alilazimika kuthibitisha safari hiyo, lakini alisema Sata alikuwa mapumzikono nchini Israel.

eng: The secrecy surrounding the trip led to a protocol faux pas which was quickly picked by citizens.
swa: Usiri unaozunguka safari hiyo uligeuka kuwa kosa kubwa lililosababisha maneno yasiyothibitishwa ambayo kwa haraka yalisambaa kwenye vijiwe vya mazungumzo.

eng: A couple of days after Sata’s journey, the ceremonial guard and the presidential standard, an orange flag embossed with the coat of arms, both of which are supposed to be removed in his absence, were still in place at the presidential palace in the central district of the capital.
swa: Siku kadhaa baada ya safari ya Sata, ulinzi na itifaki ya kirais na bendera ya rais yenye nembo ya taifa, vyote ambavyo vilipaswa kuondolewa wakati rais asipokuwepo, viliendelea kuwepo ikulu ya rais kwenye wilaya ya kati ya jiji hilo.

eng: Nearly a month later, Zambians were in the dark if their president, who had in previous months appeared unwell, was back in the country or not.
swa: Takribani mwezi mmoja baadae, wa-Zambia hawakuwa wanajua lolote kuhusu ikiwa rais wao, ambaye kwa miezi iliyopita alionekana kuwa mdhaifu, alikuwa amerudi ama la.

eng: The Zambia Reports wrote about the break in Facebook posts:
swa: Zambia Reports iliandikwa kuhusu kukosekana habari mara kwa mara kwenye ukurasa huo wa rais:

eng: It seems everyone has abandoned their posts and is ducking responsibility.
swa: Inaonekana kila mmoja ametelekeza posti zake na hatimizi wajibu.

eng: Is it not ironic that after hyping up facebook updates coming almost by the hour daily basis on the President’s facebook page there has been no update from June, 6?
swa: Si jambo la kawaida kwamba bada ya ‘kuufurikisha’ ukurasa wa facebook kwa habari za karibu kila saa tena kila siku kwenye ukurasa wa Rais wa Facebook, hapajakuwepo na habari zozote tangu Juni 6

eng: On Sata’s Facebook hiatus, Sikota observed with a touch of sarcasm:
swa: Kuhusu kukosekana kwa mabandiko kwenye ukurasa wa Facebook wa Sata, Sikota anabaini kwa hali ya masihara:

eng: There are certain things in life which are so sweet that you can never ever get enough of them.
swa: Kuna mambo kwenye maisha ambayo ni matamu sana kiasi kwamba huwezi kuyachoka.

eng: I guess we all remember our first taste of honey and other delights.
swa: Nadhani sote tunakumbuka tulivyoonja asali kwa mara ya kwanza na mengineyo mazuri.

eng: One such sweet thing or delight is the regular diet we were fed on and became accustomed to is that of the lovely and affable Mr. president Michael Sata.
swa: Moja ya jambo tamu na zuri ni chakula cha mara kwa mara tulichokuwa tukilishwa na kukizoea ni kile cha mhe rais Michael Sata, mtu wa watu na mpenda watu.

eng: And who can forget those regular warm and very person+able updates on His Excellency's Facebook page? Most sounded like the one, which kept us updated on his movements, posted on the 4th April this year which read, "Good Morning Dear Friends, I have now started off my journey back home after a successful European Union - Africa Summit in Brussels, Belgium.
swa: Nani anaweza kusema kasahau zile habari motomoto na za kibinafsi zilizokuwa kwenye ukurasa wa Facebook wa Mheshimiwa?Nyingi zilikuwa ni kama ile iliyotufahamisha kuhusu kila anakokwenda, iliyowekwa April 4 mwaka huu iliyosomeka, “Habari za asubuhi marafiki, nimeanza safari ya kurudi baada ya mkutano wenye mafanikio wa ushirikiano kati ya Umoja wa Ulaya na Afrika uliofanyika Brussels, Ubeligiji.

eng: I have left Brussels for Lusaka via Amsterdam.
swa: Nimeshaondoka Brussels kuja Lusaka kupitia Amsterdam.

eng: Keep well and enjoy your Weekend.
swa: Kaeni vyema na furahieni mwisho mwema wa wiki.

eng: Two days later, photos of a supposed cabinet meeting held on July 14 were sent to media houses and also posted on Facebook in a publication about ongoing country-wide projects.
swa: Siku mbili baadae, picha zinazosemekana kuwa za kikao cha Baraza la Mawaziri kilichofanyika Julai 14 zilziotumwa kwenye vyombo vya habari na kuchapishwa kwenye mtandao wa Facebook ziligeuka kuwa mradi wa nchi nzima.

eng: A local TV station, Muvi, and the BBC doubted the meeting.
swa: Kituo cha runinga cha, Muvi, na hata BBC walionesha mashaka na kikao hicho.

eng: Blogger Chola Mukanga, on his Zambian Economist, refused to use the photos, saying:
swa: Mwanablogu Chola Mukanga, kwenye blogu yake ya Zambian Economist aligoma kuzitumia picha hizo, akisema:

eng: Unfortunately, the Zambian Economist is not able to verify the authenticity of these three photos, which we understand are available at other websites.
swa: Kwa bahati mbaya, blogu ya Zambian Economist haijaweza kuthibitisha uhalisi wa picha hizo tatu, ambazo tunaelewa ziko kwenye tovuti nyingine.

eng: We simply do not have visual or audio footage to go with the photos.
swa: Ni kwamba hatuna rekodi ya sauti wala video zinazothibitisha picha hizo.

eng: Therefore it would be irresponsible of us to share such photos and label them "official" as it may inadvertently mislead the public.
swa: Kwa hiyo itakuwa ni kutokuwa makini kwetu kuonesha picha hizo na kuzipachika alama ‘rasmi’ kwa sababu hiyo inaweza kuupotosha umma.

eng: On Twitter, citizens weighed in on Sata’s absence:
swa: Kwenye mtandao wa Twita, raia walipima uzito wa kukosekana kwa Sata:

eng: So it seems despite publication of pics of "Pres Sata chairing a cabinet meeting" yesterday #Zambia is still asking #whereisthepresident? — Laura Miti (@LauraMiti) July 15, 2014
swa: Kwa hiyo inaonekana pamoja na kuchapishwa kwa picha za Rais Sata akiongoza kikao jana #Zambia bado inauliza yuko wapi rais?

eng: Another user wondered why no information was forthcoming:
swa: Mtumiaji mwinine alishangaa kwa nini alipokuwa nje ya nchi hapakuwa na habari zilizokuwa zinakuja:

eng: To what extent should the Presidency be shrouded in mystery? #Zambia http://t.co/nvm5yv5ntN — Tchiyiwe T Chihana (@AfriWoman) July 12, 2014
swa: Kwa kiwango gani rais anapaswa kuzungukwa na usiri?

eng: The anger is culpable:
swa: Hasira ni hatia:

eng: @AfriWoman This government is taking voters for granted.
swa: Serikali hii inawachukulia wapiga kura kirahisi.

eng: Sata and his cabal are accountable to the people of Zambia not other way round. — David Mwanambuyu (@mbuyujr) July 12, 2014
swa: Sata na baraza lake wanawajibika kwa watu wa Zambia na si kinyume chake

eng: In Sata’s absence, activist Brebner Changala petitioned the High Court to compel the cabinet to put together a medical board to examine Sata and determine his suitability to continue as head of state.
swa: Kuhusu kutokuwepo kwa Sata, mwanaharakati Brebner Changala aliiomba Mahakama Kuu kulilazimisha Baraza la Mawaziri kuunda jopo la madaktari kuchunguza afya ya Sata na kubaini ikiwa anafaa kuendelea na kazi kama Mkuu wa Nchi.

eng: The matter was thrown out but Changala resubmitted his petition.
swa: Ombi hilo lilitupiliwa mbali lakini Changala alirudisha tena ombi hilo hilo Mahakamani.

eng: A few days before the supposed cabinet meeting, South Africa’s Business Day chronicled some of Sata’s unannounced international travels, which are euphemistically called working holidays by the president's office and other government officials.
swa: Siku chache baadae kabla ya kinachodaiwa kuwa kikao hicho, jarida la Afrika Kusini la Business Day lilionyesha mtiririko wa safari za siri za Sata nje ya nchi, ambazo ziliitwa na ofisi ya Rais na maafisa wengine wa serikali kuwa ni likizo la kikazi.

eng: Taking a quick glance at the criticism on social media, it doesn't seem that the euphemism is working.
swa: Kwa kupitia kwa haraka ukosoaji wa habari hiyo kwenye mitandao ya kijamii, inaonekana kuwa kilichokuwa kikisemwa na maafisa hao wa serikali kilikuwa kinafanya kazi.

eng: Image on Flickr by user larshuj (CC BY 2.0).
swa: Picha ya mtumiaji wa mtandao wa Flickr larshuj (CC BY 2.0).

eng: On her blog Historias de una mujer lobo (Stories of a female werewolf), Natalia Cartolini reflects on the reasons why a trip can be beneficial as, in her opinion, "the fact of visiting new places or meeting new people from another perspective is important at any moment.
swa: Kwenye blogu yake iitwayo Historias de una mujer lobo (Hadithi ya mbwamwitu wa kike), Natalia Cartolini anatafakari kuhusu sababu za kwa nini kusafiri kunaweza kuwa na faida kama, kwa maoni yake, "kutembelea maeneo mapya au kukutana na watu wapya wenye mtazamo mwingine ni muhimu wakati wote.

eng: It doesn't matter if you go out within your own city or its surroundings, just open your eyes to a new point of view.
swa: Haijalishi kama unatoka kutembea ndani ya mji unamoishi au kwenye maeneo yanayouzunguka mji, muhimu ni kufungua macho yako ili uweze kuona mtazamo mpya wa maisha.

eng: Do something different.
swa: Fanya jambo tofauti.

eng: But as the further from what you are familiar with, the more you will be able to find yourself, as you are aware you are the only one needed to survive."
swa: Kadri unavyozidi kwenda mbali na kile ulichozoea, ndivyo unavyozidi kujitambua, kwa sababu unatambua kwamba wewe ndiye uliyehitaji kuendelea kuishi."

eng: She ends up her reflections saying:
swa: Anamalizia tafakuri yake kwa kusema:

eng: So, just imagine you listen to your favorite instrumental music as you walk down the streets.
swa: Kwa hiyo, fikiria unasikiza muziki uupendao wa ala unavyotembelea mtaani.

eng: Everything gets transformed.
swa: Kila kitu kinabadilika.

eng: Now you are the leading character.
swa: Na inatokea sasa unakuwa ndiye mhusika mkuu.

eng: For a while, you are a Gatsby, some other times, a cowboy or a mountaineer.
swa: Kwa muda kidogo, unajifanya Gatsbu, wakati mwingine muuza maziwa na wakati mwingine mpanda mlima.

eng: Who can stop imagination?
swa: Nani anaweza kukufanya uache kufikiri zaidi?

eng: Just you.
swa: Ni wewe.

eng: Get out from your place and take the most out of what you have next to you.
swa: Toka unakoishi na katembelee vile vilivyo pembeni mwako.

eng: Because it's all yours.
swa: Kwa sababu unavimiliki vyote.

eng: Image from Flickr, with CC license.
swa: Picha kutoka kwenye mtandao wa Flickr, yenye leseni ya CC.

eng: Mexican student Álvaro blogs about his sentiments and opinions about 2014 FIFA World Cup Brazil.
swa: Mwanafunzi wa Mexico Álvaro anablogu kuhusu hisia na maoni yake kuhusu Kombe la Dunia la FIFA 2014 nchini Brazil.

eng: He reflects on the poor performance of Mexico and Brazil national teams, but highlights what he considers a strategy failure of Brazilian president Dilma Rouseff.
swa: Anatafakari kuhusu kufanya vibaya kwa timu za mataifa ya Mexico na Brazili, lakini anasaili kile anachokiita kushindwa kwa mkakati wa Rais wa Brazili Dilma Rouseff.

eng: The world approach to Brazil only exposed the serious problems the country faces.
swa: Yaliyotokea Brazili yalianika matatizo makubwa ambayo nchi hiyo inakabiliana nayo.

eng: There were many reports by international press about the bad roads, accommodations, people and even stadiums, that collapsed or weren't even completed before the tournament.
swa: Kulikuwa na taarifa nyingi za vyombo vya habari vya kimataifa kuhusu barabara mbaya, malazi yasiyoridhisha, watu na hata viwanja ambavyo vilianguka au hata havikukaika kabla mashindano hayajaanza.

eng: You can follow Álvaro on his Twitter account.
swa: Unaweza kumfuatlia Álvaro kwenye akaunti yake ya Twita.

eng: The war in Ukraine moves to Wikipedia.
swa: Vita nchini Ukraine imeahamia kwenye kamusi elezo ya Wikipedia.

eng: Images mixed by author.
swa: Picha zimechanganywa na Mwandishi wa makala.

eng: A day after a horrific plane crash in eastern Ukraine claimed the lives of nearly 300 people, speculation about who is to blame for shooting down the aircraft is in full swing.
swa: Siku moja baada ya tukio baya la kutunguliwa kwa ndege mashariki mwa Ukraine iliyopoteza maisha ya watu wapatao 300, maneno ya kutafuta kujua nani wa kumlaumu kwa kuitungua ndege hiyo zimepamba moto.

eng: Leaders of Ukraine, Russia, and even the separatists in Donetsk have all placed responsibility on each other.
swa: Viongozi wa Ukraine, Urusi, na hata waasi wanaotaka kujitenga wa Donetsk wote wamekuwa wakibebeshana lawama.

eng: In Kyiv, President Poroshenko blamed rebels in the east and criticized Russia for destabilizing the border.
swa: Jijini Kyiv, Rais Poroshenko aliwalaumu waasi mashariki mwa nchi hiyo na kuishambulia Urusi kwa kufanya hali ya mpaka iwe tete.

eng: In Moscow, Vladimir Putin claimed that Kyiv is accountable for anything that happens in Ukraine.
swa: Jijini Moscow, Vladimir Putin aliibebesha lawama Kyiv kwa chochote kinachotokea Ukraine.

eng: Donetsk’s putative leader denies any role in the attack on Malaysian Flight MH17, saying it must have been the Ukrainian Air Force.
swa: Kiongozi wa waasi wa Donetsk alikana kuhusika na shambulio la ndege hiyo ya Malaysia MH17, akidai limefanywa na jeshi la anga la Ukraine.

eng: Unsurprisingly, the blame game is now playing out on Wikipedia, where editors battle to record the polemics that best reflect their side of the story.
swa: Katika hali isiyoshangaza, mchezo huo wa kulaumiana sasa umehamia kwenye kamusi elezo ya Wikipedia, ambapo vita ya wahariri kuweka kumbukumbu vinazoelekeana na upande wao.

eng: Earlier this morning, the Russian-language Wikipedia entry for commercial aviation accidents hosted one such skirmish, when someone with an IP address based in Kyiv edited the MH17 record to say that the plane was shot down “by terrorists of the self-proclaimed Donetsk People’s Republic with Buk system missiles, which the terrorists received from the Russian Federation.”
swa: Mapema asubuhi hii, ukurasa wa Kirusi wa Wikipedia ulikuwa na andiko lililohusu kuanguka kwa ndege hiyo, ambapo mtumiaji mmoja mwenye alama ya utambulisho wa kompyuta iliyoko Kyiv alihariri habari za MH17 kusema kwamba ndege hiyo ilitunguliwa 'na magaidi waliojitangazia nchi inayoitwa Jamhuri ya Watu wa Donetsk kwa kutumia makombora ya kisasa, yaliyotoka kwenye shirikisho la Urusi."

eng: Less than an hour later, someone with a Moscow IP address replaced this text with the sentence, “The plane was shot down by Ukrainian soldiers.”
swa: Ndani ya muda mfupi usiozidi saa moja, mtu mwingine mwenye alama ya utambulisho wa kompyuta ya Moscow alibadili maelezo hayo na kuandika, "ndege hiyo ilitunguliwa na wanajeshi wa Ukraine."

eng: Thanks to a Twitter bot that tracks anonymous Wikipedia edits made from IP addresses used by the Russian government, we know that the second edit to the MH17 article came from a computer at VGTRK, the All-Russia State Television and Radio Broadcasting Company.
swa: Shukrani kwa mtandao wa Twita unaonukuu uhariri wowote unaofanywa kwenye kamusi elezo ya Wikipedia unaofanywa na alama za utambulisho wa kompyuta zinazotumiwa na serikali ya Urusi, kwani sasa tunafahamu kuwa uhariri huo wa pili kwa makala hiyo ya MH17 ulitoka kwenye kompyuta iliyoko kwenyeKituo cha Televisheni la Taifa la Urusi.

eng: A Wikipedia article about commercial aviation catastrophes was edited by VGTRK.
swa: Makala ya Wikipedia kuhusu kuanguka kwa ndege ya MH17 ilihaririwa na VGTRK.

eng: VGTRK is the home of Dmitri Kiselyov, who is known informally as the Kremlin’s chief propagandist.
swa: VGTRK ambayo ni makzi ya Dmitri Kiselyov, anayefahamanika kwa jina la utani mkuu wa propaganda wa Kremlin.

eng: Kiselyov is notorious for his strong criticisms of the governments in Kyiv and Washington.
swa: Kiselyov anajulikana zaidi kwa kukosoa vikali serikali za Kyiv na Washington.

eng: During the Crimean crisis, Kiselyov once boasted on television that Russia remains “the only country in the world capable of turning the USA into radioactive dust.”
swa: Wakati wa mgogoro wa Crimea, Kiselyov aliwahi kujitapa kwenye televisheni kwamba "Urusi ndiyo nchi pekee duniani iliyobaki inayoweza kuigeuza Marekani kuwa vumbi kwa mabomu ya nyuklia."

eng: In June, two VGTRK journalists were killed near Luhansk after coming under mortar fire while embedded with local rebels.
swa: Mwezi Juni, waandishi wawili wa VGTRK waliuawa karibu na Luhansk baada ya kuunguzwa kwa moto wakiwa na waasi wa maeneo hayo.

eng: Nadiya Savchenko, the helicopter pilot whom separatists captured in Ukraine and transferred to Voronezh earlier this month, now sits in a Russian detention center, accused of participating in the attack that killed the VGTRK reporters.
swa: Nadiya Savchenko, rubani wa helkopta ambaye waasi walimkamata nchini Ukraine na kumsafirisha kwenye Voronezh mapema mwezi huu, sasa anashikiliwa kwenye mahabusu ya Urusi, akituhumiwa kushiriki mashambulizi yalisababisha kuuawa kwa waandishi wa VGTRK.

eng: The Twitter account that discovered VGTRK’s Internet activity, @RuGovEdits, is modeled on another bot, @CongressEdits, which tracks Wikipedia edits made from IP addresses in the US Congress.
swa: Akaunti ya Twita iliyogundua matumizi ya mtandao wa intaneti yaliyofanywa na VGTRK, @RuGovEdits, imetengenezwa na zana (bot) nyingine, @CongressEdits, ambayo hufuatilia uhariri unaofanywa na Wikipedia kutoka kwenye kompyuta za Bunge la Marekani.

eng: The code for CongressEdits, created by programmer Ed Summers, is open-source software and can be configured easily to watch for anonymous edits from any IP ranges.
swa: Alama maalum ya CongressEdits, ilitengenezwa na mtaalam wa program za kompyuta Ed Summers, na ni zana huria inayoweza kurekebishwa kirahisi ili kuwezesha kufuatilia utambulisho wowote wa kompyuta.

eng: ICT Pulse reviews a recently published report from the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights on the right to privacy in the digital age.
swa: Blogu ya ICT Pulse inapitia taarifa iliyochapishwa hivi karibuni iliyoandaliwa na Tume ya Umoja wa Mataifa ya Haki za Binadamu juu ya haki ya faragha katika enzi hizi za dijitali.

eng: It cited social factors such as “poverty and marginalisation, as well as lack of family support, education, opportunity, and protective factors” for the continuing harm done to children.
swa: Mradi wa Nguzo ya Kuokoa Utoto, uliobuniwa na serikali ya Australia, umezinduautafitiukosefu wa msaada wa kijamii, elimu, furasa na ulinzi" kwa kuendelea kwa vitendo vya kuwadhalilisha watoto.

eng: It also identified how travel and tourism “comprised another risk factor contributing to children’s vulnerability.”
swa: Utafiti huo pia umeonyesha namna kusafiri na utalii "ni hatari nyingine inayochangia shida za kudhalilishwa zinazowakumba watoto."

eng: The study covered Thailand, Cambodia, Laos, and Vietnam.
swa: Utafiti huo ulihusisha nchi za Thailand, Kambodia, Laos na Vietnam.

eng: Sixteen international authors who participated at the Palestine Festival of Literature, held from in several Palestinian cities from May 31 to June 5, released a statement condemning Israel's continued settlement construction and applauding the efforts of the Boycott Divest and Sanction (BDS) campaign.
swa: Waandishi kumi na sita wa kimataifa ambao walishiriki katika Tamasha la Wapalestina la Fasihi, lililofanyika katika miji kadhaa Palestina kuanzia Mei 31 hadi Juni 5, walitoa taarifa kukashifu Israeli kwa kuendelea kwa ujenzi wa makazi na kupongeza juhudi za kususia kampeni ya Boycott Divest and Sanction (BDS).

eng: The statement, shared on Facebook, reads:
swa: Taarifa, kupitia mtandao wa Facebook, inasema:

eng: Having personally witnessed the injustice visited upon the Palestinian people in the territories occupied by Israel, it is with the utmost sadness and dismay that we - the undersigned international authors and artists - note Benjamin Netanyahu's approval this week of yet another 1,500 new illegal settlements units in the West Bank. 	Baada ya kushuhudia kibinafsi ukosefu wa haki kwa watu wa Palestina katika maeneo yaliyonyakuliwa na Israeli, ni kwa huzuni kubwa na kusikitishwa kwamba sisi - waandishi wa kimataifa na wasanii tuliotia saini hapa chini - twakumbuka idhini ya Benjamin Netanyahu ya wiki hii ya vitengo vingine vipya vya makazi haramu 1500 katika Ukanda wa Magharibi.
This is particularly unfortunate at a moment when the Palestinians have formed a unity government that has been recognized by the international community.
swa: Hii ni hasa ya kusikitisha kwa wakati ambao Wapalestina wameunda serikali ya umoja ambayo imetambuliwa na jumuiya ya kimataifa.

eng: Israeli settlements in the Occupied Territories have long since been pronounced illegal by international law.
swa: Makazi ya Israeli katika maeneo ya nchi nyingine kwa muda mrefu yametajwa kuwa kinyume cha sheria za kimataifa.

eng: The Israeli occupation of the Palestinian territories is itself illegal, and declared so by the international community through various UN resolutions.
swa: Na makazi ya Israel kwenye maeneo ya Palestina ni kinyume cha sheria, na imetangazwa hivyo na jumuiya ya kimataifa kupitia maazimio mbalimbali ya Umoja wa Mataifa.

eng: Additional settlements can be seen only as an act of aggression, showing utter disregard not just for the human and civil rights of the Palestinian people, but for international law.
swa: Makazi ya ziada yanaweza kuonekana tu kama kitendo cha uchokozi, kuonyesha kupuuza si tu kwa haki za binadamu na kiraia ya watu wa Palestina, lakini kwa sheria za kimataifa.

eng: We applaud the non-violent efforts of the BDS campaign (www.bdsmovement.net) and express our solidarity with its demand that Israel should comply with the precepts of international law by:
swa: Tunapongeza juhudi isiyo na vurugu ya kampeni ya BDS (www.bdsmovement.net) na kuonyesha mshikamano wetu na mahitaji yake kwamba Israeli inapaswa kuzingatia maagizo ya sheria za kimataifa kwa:

eng: Ending its occupation and colonization of all Arab land and dismantling the Wall
swa: Kukomesha ujenzi wa makazi na ukoloni wa ardhi yote ya Kiarabu na kubomolewa kwa Ukuta

eng: Recognizing the fundamental rights of the Arab-Palestinian citizens of Israel to full equality; and
swa: Kutambua haki za msingi za raia wa Kiarabu na Palestina wa Israeli kwa usawa kamili; na

eng: Respecting, protecting and promoting the rights of Palestinian refugees to return to their homes and properties as stipulated in UN resolution 194.
swa: Kuheshimu, kulinda na kukuza haki za wakimbizi wa Kipalestina kurudi makwao na kwa mali yao kama ilivyoainishwa katika azimio la Umoja wa Mataifa 194

eng: We thus call for the Israeli Government to respect international law and reverse the approval of the thousand plus additional settlements units in the West Bank.
swa: Kwa hivyo twatoa wito kwa serikali ya Israeli kuheshimu sheria za kimataifa na kugeuza idhini ya nyongeza ya makazi elfu moja na katika West Bank.

eng: We furthermore call on the International Community to work to induce Israel to uphold basic principles of international law.
swa: Sisi zaidi twatoa wito kwa jumuiya ya kimataifa kufanya kazi kushawishi Israeli kuzingatia kanuni za msingi za sheria za kimataifa.
