eng: Family members rushed to Kuala Lumpur International Airport when informed about the flight MH17 crash.
swa: Wanafamilia wakikimbilia uwanja wa ndege wa kimataifa Kuala Lumpur baada ya kujulishwa kuwa ndege MH17 imeanguka.

eng: Photo by Danny Chan, Copyright @Demotix.
swa: Picha na Danny Chan, Haki miliki @Demotix.

eng: Malaysia Airlines flight MH17, en route from Amsterdam to Kuala Lumpur, crashed in eastern Ukraine Thursday evening, killing all 298 passengers and crew members aboard.
swa: Ndege ya Malaysia ya MH17, iliyokuwa ikisafiri kutoka Amsterdam kwenda Kuala Lumpur, imeanguka mashariki mwa Ukraine jioni ya Alhamisi, ikiwaua abiria 298 pamoja na wafanyakazi waliokuwepo ndani.

eng: Most reports indicate that the plane was shot down by a missile approximately 50km from the Russia-Ukraine border.
swa: Taarifa nyingi zinaonyesha kwamba ndege hiyo ilitunguliwa na silaha umbali wa kilimeta 50 kutoka kwenye mpaka wa Urusi na Ukraine.

eng: The Ukraine government is accusing pro-Russian insurgents of using a BUK surface-to-air missile system to shoot down the plane but rebel leaders have denied this.
swa: Serikali y Ukraine inawatuhumu wapinzani wanaoungwa mkono na Urusi kutumia silaha kali kuitungua ndege hiyo lakini viongozi wa waasi wanakana madai hayo.

eng: This infographic shows the flight path and crash site of MH17:
swa: Picha ya mchoro inaonesha njia ya ndege hiyo na eneo ilikoangukia ndege ya MH17:

eng: Infographic: Crashsite Map incl. MH17 Flight Path - pic.twitter.com/JkPwUJAv8u — Florian Witulski (@vaitor) July 18, 2014
swa: Picha ya mchoro: Ramani ikionesha eneo ilikoanguka ndege ikiw ni pamoja na njia ya ndege MH17

eng: Malaysian Prime Minister Najib Razak assured his constituents that those who shot down the plane will be brought to justice:
swa: Waziri Mkuu wa Malaysia Najib Razak aliwahakikishia wananchi wake kwamba wale waliohusika kuitungua ndege hiyo watapelekwa kwenye mkono wa sheria:

eng: This is a tragic day, in what has already been a tragic year, for Malaysia.
swa: Leo ni siku mbaya, katika mwaka ambao tayari ni mbaya, kwa Malaysia.

eng: If it transpires that the plane was indeed shot down, we insist that the perpetrators must swiftly be brought to justice.
swa: Kama itajulikana kuwa ndege hiyo ilitunguliwa kwa hakika, tunasisitiza kwamba waliohusika wanakabiliana na mkono wa sheria.

eng: The flight’s passengers and crew came from many different countries.
swa: Abiria wa ndege hiyo na wafanyakazi walitoka katika nchi mbalimbali.

eng: But today, regardless of nationality, we are all united in grief.
swa: Lakini leo, bila kujali uraia, wote tuko pamoja kuomboleza.

eng: He also clarified that the aircraft’s flight route, even if it passed directly above a conflict zone, was declared safe by the International Civil Aviation Organisation.
swa: Alifafanua kwamba njia ya ndege hiyo angani, hata kama ilikuwa inapita juu ya eneo lenye mgogoro, ilitangazwa kuwa salama na Shirika la Kimataifa la Safari za Anga.

eng: Flight MH17 crashed in eastern Ukraine.
swa: Ndege MH17 ilianguka mashariki mwa Ukraine.

eng: Photo by Danny Chan, Copyright @Demotix (7/18/2014)
swa: Picha na Danny Chan, Haki Miliki @Demotix (7/18/2014)

eng: The MH17 crash was the second time that a Malaysian Airlines Boeing 777-200 aircraft went down this year.
swa: Kuanguka kwa ndege MH17 kumekuja katika kipindi kifupi ambacho bado dunia inakumbuka kupotea kwa Ndege ya shirika la Malaysia Boeing 777-200 mwaka huu.

eng: On March 8, a Malaysian Airlines MH370 plane carrying 237 people went missing just an hour after it left Kuala Lumpur during its flight to Beijing.
swa: Mnamo Machi 8, ndege ya Malaysia MH370 iliyokuwa na watu 237 ndani yake ilipotea saa moja tu baada ya kupaa kwenye uwanja wa Kuala Lumpur wakati ikisafiri kuelekea Beijing.

eng: The MH370 plane and its passengers have yet to be found.
swa: Ndege ya MH370 na abiria wake bado hawajulikani walipo.

eng: A daughter of an MH370 flight attendant tweeted her message of support to the families and friends of MH17 passengers:
swa: Binti wa mfanyakazi wa ndege hiyo MH370 alitwiti kuwafariji ndugu na marafiki wa abiria wa ndege ya MH17:

eng: As the family member of the crew MH370, and on behalf of all them, we pray for MH17.
swa: Nikiwa mwanafamilia wa mfanyakazi wa ndege MH370, na kwa niaba ya wote, ninawaombea abiria wa ndege MH17.

eng: Josie Fernandez of Transparency International Malaysia urged a complete probe of the incident:
swa: Josie Fernandez wa shirika la Kimataifa la Uwazi Malaysia alitoa wito wa uchunguzi wa kina wa ajali hiyo:

eng: What has happened is unprecedented – Malaysia is the only country where the same carrier, the same type of planes have been involved in tragedies with loss of many lives within months.
swa: Kilichotokea hakikubaliki - Malaysia ni nchi pekee ambapo shirika hilo hilo, aina hiyo hiyo ya ndege zimehusika kwenye majanga yanayopoteza maisha ya watu wengi ndani miezi michache.

eng: MH370 has not been found.
swa: Ndege MH370 haijapatikana.

eng: Malaysia must demand for international action on this unprecedented tragedy.
swa: Malaysia lazima iombe kuchukuliwa kwa hatua za Kimataifa kwa janga hili lisilokubalika.

eng: This is a passenger plane.
swa: Ndege hii ilikuwa ya abiria.

eng: We are not at war with any nations.
swa: Hatuko vitani na taifa lolote.

eng: Writing for The Ant Daily, Alyaa Alhadjri described the shooting down of MH17 as a ‘mass murder’:
swa: Akiandikia gazeti la The Ant Daily, Alyaa Alhadjri alilieleza tukio hilo la kutunguliwa kwa ndege ya MH17 kama ‘mauaji ya halaiki’:

eng: Why are commercial passenger jets still flying over a conflict area where airplanes have been shot down and warned to steer clear of the airspace.
swa: Kwa nini abiria wa ndege ya kibiashara waruhusiwe kupita kwenye eneo lenye mgogoro ambapo ndege zimekuwa zikitunguliwa na walitahadharishwa kusafisha anga.

eng: Whatever the causes for another MAS Boeing 777 for going down a second time in 133 days, losing 537 people in two air disasters does not help lift passengers' confidence in the national airline.
swa: Kwa sababu yoyote iliyosababisha kuanguka kwa ndege ya Shirika la Ndege la Malaysia Boeing 777 kwa mara ya pili ndani ya siku, na kupoteza watu 537 katika majanga mawili ya anga, haisaidii kuinua imani ya wasafiri kwa shirika hilo la ndege.

eng: As Malaysia grieves over another tragic crash, it seems inevitable that many citizens will again press the government to explain the mysterious disappearance of MH370.
swa: Wakati Malaysia ikiomboleza kufuatia ajali nyingine ya ndege, inaonekana kuwa raia wengi wataendelea kuishinikiza serikali kueleza hali hiyo ya 'sintofahamu' iliyosababisha kupotea kwa kwa ndege MH370.

eng: Zone 9 bloggers Zelalem Kibret, Edom Kasaye, and Befeqadu Hailu.
swa: Wanablogu wa Zone 9 Zelalem Kibret, Edom Kasaye, na Befeqadu Hailu.

eng: Photos used with permission.
swa: Picha zimetumiwa kwa ruhusa.

eng: Nine bloggers and journalists, four of them Global Voices members, were charged with terrorism and related activities before Ethiopia’s Lideta High Court yesterday.
swa: Wanablogu na waandishi tisa, wanne wakiwa wanachama wa Global Voices, wamefunguliwa mashitaka ya ugaidi na shughuli zinazohusiana na ugaidi mbele ya Mahakama Kuu ya Lideta nchini Ethiopia hapo jana.

eng: Arrested and detained in Addis Ababa on April 25 and 26, they since have been behind bars on informal accusations of “working with foreign organizations that claim to be human rights activists and…receiving finance to incite public violence through social media.”
swa: Wakiwa wamekamatwa na kuwekwa ndani jijini Addis Ababa tarehe 25 na 26 Aprili, wamekuwa mahabusu kwa tuhuma zisizo rasmi za "kufanya kazi na mashirika ya kigeni yanayodai kuendesha harakati za haki za binadamu na ...kupokea fedha kwa ajili ya kuchochea ghasia kwa kutumia mitandao ya kijamii.”

eng: The defendants’ attorneys and families were not given prior notice about the hearing, and they thus had no legal representation present when the charges were issued.
swa: Wanasheria na ndugu wa washitakiwa hao hawakupewa taarifa ya kusomewa mashitaka yao, na hivyo hakupata msaada wa kusheria wakati mashitaka yao yanasomwa..

eng: The Zone9 Trial Tracker blog, run by sources close to the defendants, reported that the charges included working with organizations branded as “terrorist” by the Ethiopian government; participating in an email encryption training; and “underground organization.”
swa: Blogu ya Kufuatilia Shauri la Zone9, inayoendeshwa na watu walio karibu na washitakiwa hao, iliripoti kwamba mashitaka yao ni pamoja na kufanya kazi na mashirika yaliyopewa jina la 'magaidi' na serikali ya Ethiopia; kushiriki kwenye mafunzo ya kuandika barua pepe kwa lugha ya siril na "kuwa na mipango ya siri."

eng: The bloggers' attorney told AFP that the charges have no "credible substance."
swa: Mwanasheria wa wanablogu hao aliliambia shirika la habari la AFP kwamba mashitaka hayo "hayana maaana yoyote."

eng: Supporters around the world expressed outrage over the charges on Twitter, under the #FreeZone9Bloggers hashtag.
swa: Watu wanaowaunga mkono duniani kote walionyesha hasira yao dhidi ya mashitaka hayo kwenye mtandao wa Twita, kwa kutumia alama habari ya #FreeZone9Bloggers.

eng: Yoseph Mulugeta, a former Human Rights Watch representative in Ethiopia who has been following the case closely, tweeted:
swa: Yoseph Mulugeta, mwakilishi wa zamani wa shirika la Kutetea Haki za Binadamu nchini Ethiopia ana anayefuatilia kwa karibu kesi hiyo, alitwiti:

eng: 19page fabricated charges but no mention of Zone9 by name.Not even once.The brand surely terrifies enemies of free speech #FreeZone9Bloggers
swa: Mashitaka hayo ya kutunga yaliyoorodheshwa kwenye kurasa 19 hayajataja jina la Zone9 kwa jina. Hata mara moja.

eng: — Yoseph Mulugeta (@YosephMulugeta) July 18, 2014
swa: Jina hilo kwa hakika linawaogofya sana maadui wa uhuru wa habari

eng: Enacted in 2009, Ethiopia’s controversial anti-terrorism law is unfortunately familiar for political journalists in the country.
swa: Ikiwa imetungwa mwaka 2009, sheria tata ya kupinga ugaidi nchini Ethiopia kwa bahati mbaya haifahamiki sana kwa waandishi wa habari za kisiasa nchini humo.

eng: Journalists Eskinder Nega and Reeyot Alemu faced the same charge and have been held in Addis Ababa’s Kalaity prison since 2011.
swa: Waandishi Eskinder Nega na Reeyot Alemu walikabiliwa na mashitaka yanayofanana na hayo na wamekuwa wakishikiliwa kwenye mahabusu ya Kalaity jijini Addis Ababa tangu mwaka 2011.

eng: Prosecutors reportedly issued the charge based on accusations that the bloggers had received training and financial support from two Ethiopian political groups based in Europe and the US.
swa: Waendesha mashitaka wanasemekana kuandaa mashitaka hayo kufuatia tuhuma kwamba wanablogu hayo wamekuwa wakipokea mafunzo na misaada ya kifedha kutoka kwenye vikundi viwili vya kisiasa vyenye asili ya vilivyoko Ulaya na Marekani.

eng: Trial Tracker notes that the two groups are ideologically dissimilar.
swa: Blogu ya kufuatilia shauri hilo inabainisha kwamba vikundi hivyo vinafanana kiitikadi..

eng: According to news reports, the bloggers and journalists were also accused of organizing themselves clandestinely as the Zone9 blogging collective, a puzzling charge, given the public nature of the Zone9 blog and activities undertaken by the group.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa taarifa mpya za habari, wanablogu na waandishi hao wanatuhumiwa kujiunga kinyume na sheria kama muungano wa wanablogu wa Zone9, shitaka la ajabu, kwa kuzingatia mwonekano wa wazi wa blogu ya Zone9 na shughuli zinazoendeshwa na kikundi hicho.

eng: The group has been given a trial date of August 8.
swa: Kesi ya kundi hilo itasikilizwa tena Agosti 8.

eng: Visit the Trial Tracker Blog for updates on the case and to learn how your can support the Zone9ers.
swa: Tembelea Blogu ya Kufuatilia Mwenendo wa Mashitaka hayog kwa taarifa zinazojitokeza kuhusu kesi hiyo na kuona namna unavyoweza kuwaunga mkono wanablogu hao wa Zone9.

eng: Free Zone9 Bloggers campaign image.
swa: Picha ya kampeni ya kuwatetea wanablogu wa Zone9.

eng: Created by Hugh D'Andrade, remixed by Hisham Almiraat.
swa: Imetengenezwa na Hugh D'Andrade, na kuchanganywa na Hisham Almiraat.

eng: 12 women staged an anti-World Cup protest on 7 of July in Shanghai.
swa: Wanawake 12 walifanya maandamano ya kupinga kombe la dunia tarehe 7 Julai jijini Shanghai.

eng: Photo from Weibo via Offbeat China.
swa: Picha na Weibo Offbeat China.

eng: Offbeat China explained why women are so angry and how the World Cup has destroyed relationships in China.
swa: Offbeat China alieleza kwa nini wanawake hao wana hasira na jinsi Kombe la Dunia linavyoharibu mahusiano ya kifamilia nchini China.

eng: They are primarily pissed about two things: 1) their partners neglecting family responsibilities due to late-night game watching; 2) reckless gambling on games.
swa: Wanapinga mambo mawili makubwa: 1) wapenzi wao kupuuza majukumu yao ya kifamilia kwa sababu ya kuangalia mpira usiku wa manane; 2) tabia za kucheza kamari kwa mashindano hayo.

eng: A young woman stages a lone protest against FIFA in front of the Maracana stadium after Belgium played Russia in their group stage match on June 22, 2014, despite a large security cordon designed to block such demonstrations against the 2014 World Cup.
swa: Binti akiandamana kivyake kuipinga FIFA mbele ya Uwanja wa Maracana baada ya Ubelgiji kucheza na urusi katika makundi yao yaliyoandamana tarehe 22 Juni, 2014, pamoja na kuandaliwa kwa vikosi vya usalama kuyazuia maandamano hayo kinyume cha mashindano ya kombe la dunia.

eng: Photo by Marcelo Fonseca.
swa: Picha na Marcelo Fonseca.

eng: This post originally appeared on Pen American Center and is republished with permission.
swa: Posti hii awali ilionekana kwenye tovuti ya Pen American Center na imechapishwa kwa mara nyingine kwa ruhusa.

eng: Like me, you may have pinched yourself to see if you were dreaming after watching Brazil's humiliating 7-1 defeat by Germany in the World Cup semifinals.
swa: Kama ilivyo kwangu, unaweza kuwa unaweza kuwa ulihisi unaota baada ya kutazama kipigo cha kufedhehesha cha Brazili kuchapwa mabao 7-1 na Ujerumani katika mashindano ya nusu fainali ya kombe la Dunia.

eng: But it happened.
swa: Lakini ndivyo ilivyotokea.

eng: Bloggers from the Middle East and North Africa expressed their sympathy, with one Bahraini Twitter user wryly noting that the "tear gas" team was leaving in a "scandalous manner."
swa: Wanablogu kutoka Mashariki ya Kati na Afrika Kaskazini walionyesha masikitiko yao, huku mtumiaji mmoja wa mtandao wa Twita wa Bahraini akibaini kuwa kikundi cha 'wapiga mabomu' kilikuwa kinaondoka kwa namna 'yenye sura ya kashfa'.

eng: He was referring to the government of Bahrain's use of Brazilian tear gas to violently stop protests (warning, link contains graphic content).
swa: Alikuwa anamaanisha hatua ya serikali ya Bahrain kutumia mabomu ya machozi ya ki-Brazili kuwanyamazisha waandamanaji kwa kutumia nguvu (tahadhari, kiungo kina maudhui yenye kutisha).

eng: Brazil will receive a minimum of $20 million for its semifinal run in the World Cup, but the team still has an opportunity to win an extra $2 million if it defeats the Netherlands, who lost to Argentina, in the third-place game.
swa: Brazili itapokea kitita kisichopungua dola milioni 20 kwa kufuzu kwake nusu fainali ya Kombe la Dunia, lakini timu hiyo bado ina fursa ya kushinda dola milioni 2 nyinginezo kama itaishinda Uholanzi, iliyopoteza mchezo wake dhidi ya Ajentina, katika mchezo wa kumtafuta mshindi wa tatu wa mashindano hayo.

eng: This money may be sorely needed to make changes to its soccer association.
swa: Fedha hizo zinawezakutumika kuleta mabadiliko kwenye chama cha mchezo wa mpira wa miguu cha nchi hiyo.

eng: Protests continued in the country, but not at the same scale as the lead-up to the tournament.
swa: Maandamano yaliendelea kwenye nchi hiyo, lakini si kwa kiwango kile kile kilichofanyika kabla ya mashindano hayo.

eng: Some 300 protesters in the city of Sao Paulo turned out to demand the release of previous demonstrators, yet the police responded by arresting six more.
swa: Baadhi ya waandamanaji 300 kwenye jiji la Sao Paulo waligeuka na kuanza kudai kuachiliwa huru kwa waandamanaji waliokamatwa kabla, lakini bado polisi ilijibu madai hayo kwa kuwakamatwa wengine sita zaidi.

eng: Most fans traveling to Brazil will not have heard any baile funk (dance funk) because it has been banned for its popularity in favelas and for its racy sounds, which feature police sirens and gunshots.
swa: Mashabiki wengi wanasafiri kwenye Brazili watakuwa hawajasikia chochote kuhusu muziki wa baile funk (aina ya dansi) kwa sababu ilipigwa marufuku kwa umaarufu wake wa uchezaji na sauti, ambayo 'alamu' za kipolisi na milio ya risasi.

eng: Argentina fans, meanwhile, can rejoice because they will have an opportunity to watch their team play against Germany in the final as Lionel Messi, one of the all time greats, plays with heartthrob Ezekiel Lavezzi beside him in attack.
swa: Mashabiki wa Ajentina, wakati huo huo, wanaweza kusherehekea kwa sababu watakuwana fursa ya kutazama timu yao ikicheza dhidi ya Ujerumani katika fainali kama Lionel Messi, mmoja wapo wa wachezaji maarufu zaidi kuwahi kuwepo, atakavyokuwa akicheza na Ezekiel Lavezzi pembeni mwake kwa kumkabili.

eng: Lavezzi has attracted a few more fans after stripping off his shirt in a victory celebration.
swa: Lavezzi amevutia mashabiki zaidi baada ya kumvuta jezi yake katika kusherehekea ushindi.

eng: With racism, it seems more is less.
swa: Kuhusu ubaguzi wa rangi, inaonekana mambo hayakuwa shwari sana.

eng: The global soccer body FIFA has revealed internal divisions about cracking down on racism at the tournament.
swa: Chombo kikuu cha kandanda duniani FIFA kimeonyesha migawanyiko ya ndani kwa ndani kuhusu kupambana na ubaguzi wa rangi kwenye mashindano haya.

eng: FIFA's task force against racism disagreed with the ruling of its disciplinary panel to decline to punish national federations for racist and homophobic chants by fans because the fans were not targeting one player in particular, but entire teams.
swa: Kikosi kazi cha FIFA dhidi ya ubaguzi wa rangi kilifika mahali pa kutokukubaliana na maamuzi ya kamati ya nidhamu kuachana na adhabu dhidi ya mashirikisho ya mataifa kadhaa kwa maneno ya kushangilia yaliyokuwa na sura ya ubaguzi wa rangi na kimapenzi yaliyotolewa na mashabiki ambayo hayakuwa yakilengwa kwa wachezaji fulani fulani, bali kwa timu nzima.

eng: Preparations for the 2022 World Cup in Qatar have already been marred by reports of as many as 400 Nepalese and 700 Indian construction workers dying in conditions that can approach 122 degrees Fahrenheit (50 degrees Celsius).
swa: Maandalizi kwa ajili ya mashindano ya Kombe la Dunia mwaka 2022 huko Qatar tayari yameingia dosari kufuatia taarifa za kufa kwa wafanyakazi wa ujenzi 400 wa Nepal na 700 wa Kihindi katika hali ya hewa inayokaribia nyuzi 122 za Fahrenheit (nyuzi 50 Celsius).

eng: However, one journalism professor in the country argues that the tournament should still be staged because it will allow for sustained pressure on Qatar to improve its human rights record.
swa: Hata hivyo, profesa mmoja wa uandishi wa habari katika nchi hiyo anasihi kuwa maandamano hayolazima yaendelee kufanyika kwa sababu yataruhusu shinikizo zinaloendelea kuhusu Qatar kuboresha rekodi yake ya haki za binadamu.

eng: He is also the co-author of one of the most comprehensive studies on social attitudes towards media in the Middle East, which you can read here in this fascinating interactive website.
swa: Pia alishiriki kuandika moja ya maandishi muhimu zaidi kuwahi kuandikwa kuhusu mitazamo ya kijamii kwa vyombo vya habari katika eneo la Mashariki ya Kati, ambalo unaweza kulisoma katikatovuti hii bora inayoshirikisha wasomaji wake.

eng: His study was funded by the Qatar Foundation, the same organization that sponsors FC Barcelona, home of Lionel Messi.
swa: Utafiri wake uligharamiwa na Mfuko wa Qatar, shirika lile lile linalofadhili timu ya mpira ya Barcelona, anayoichezea Lionel Messi.

eng: The foundation is itself funded in part by the government of Qatar.
swa: Mfuko huo umefadhiliwa kwa sehemu na serikali ya Qatar.

eng: Still following?
swa: Bado unafuatilia?

eng: You be the referee.
swa: Kuwa refa.

eng: Sports pundits often talk about how they love to watch free-flowing soccer.
swa: Wafuatialiaji wa masuala ya michezo mara nyingi huzungumza kuhusu namna wanavyopenda kutazama kandanda lililo huru.

eng: We're going to cheer for the free flow of ideas in the final.
swa: Tutashangilia kutiririka kwa mawazo kwenye mchezo wa fainali.

eng: May the best team win.
swa: Tunaitakia timu bora kushinda.

eng: With additional reporting by Cassandra da Costa.
swa: Taarifa za nyongeza na Cassandra da Costa.

eng: In view of widespread rumors regarding the health of Zambia's president, Michael Sata, Gershom Ndhlovu argues that the constitution mandates the cabinet to probe his health:
swa: Kwa mtazamo wa tetesi zilizoenea sana kuhusu afya ya rais wa Zambia, Michael Sata, Gershom Ndhlovu ana hoja kwamba katiba inalipa Baraza la Mawaziri mamlaka ya kuchunguza afya yake:

eng: The last time Zambia’s President Michael Sata was seen publicly was on or around June 20 when he hosted a Chinese government delegation led by Vice President Li Yuanchao at the Presidential Palace.
swa: Mara ya mwisho rais wa Zambia Michael Sata kuonekana hadharani ilikuwa takribani Juni 20 ambapo alikuwa mwenyeji wa ujumbe wa serikali ya China ukiongozwa na Makamu wa Rais Li Yuanchao katika ikulu ya nchi hiyo.

eng: At that time, Sata’s appearance was that of an ailing man, a confirmation of his scraggy appearance at the High Court a couple of weeks earlier.
swa: Wakati huo, mwenekano wa Sata ulikuwa ule wa mtu aliyedhoofishwa na ugonjwa, hali inayothibitisha madai ya kuonekana mkondefu mno alipojitokeza kwenye Mahakama Kuu majuma kadhaa yaliyopita.

eng: When pictures of a seemingly sick Sata went viral on social media, one online publication, the Zambian Watchdog, reported that the President had been evacuated to Israel for treatment.
swa: Picha za Sata anayedaiwa kuwa mgonjwa ziliposambaa mtandaoni, tovuti moja ya habari mtandaoni, Zambian Watchdog, iliripoti kwamba Rais amepelekwa Israel kwa ajili ya matibabu.

eng: Obviously, the expose did not go down very well with government whose senior officials at the level of vice president and ministers issued all manner of statements ranging from the president being on a working holiday to wooing investors and meeting that country’s President Shimon Perez.
swa: Ni wazi, habari hizo za siri hazikufunua vyema yanayoendelea kuhusu afya ya rais huku maafisa waandamizi wa serikli kuanzia makamu wa Rais na mawaziri wakitoa matamko ya aina aina kuanzia madai kwamba rais yuko kwenye likizo yake ya malipo hadi madai ya kwamba alikuwa anatafuta fursa za kiuwekezaji na kukutana na Rais wa nchi hiyo Shimon Perez.

eng: Upon his return to Lusaka, the president’s office tried to show him as working normally and even posted pictures of him chairing a Cabinet meeting.
swa: Aliporudi Lusaka, ikulu ilijaribu kumwonyesha akiendelea na majukumu yake ya kazi kama kawaida na hata kuchapisha picha zake akiongoza kikao cha baraza la Mawaziri.

eng: The people were not convinced and called of the bluff, alleging that the pictures were photoshopped.
swa: Watu hawakushawishika hata hivyo, na kuona kuwa hiyo ilikuwa ni hatua ya kuwapumbaza, wengine wakisema picha hizo zilikuwa zimetengenezwa.

eng: However, the most disastrous public relations stunt that spectacularly backfired was the picture of President Sata swearing in then Solicitor General Musa Mwenye who had been ratified by parliament for the position of Attorney-General but had been unsworn for weeks on end.
swa: Hata hivyo, jaribio la hatari zaidi lililofanywa na idara ya mahusiano ya umma ya rais ni picha ya rais Sata akimwapisha mkuu wa masuala ya kisheria wa serikali Musa Mwenye ambaye alithibitishwa na bunge kwa nafasi ya Mwanasheria Mkuu wa serikali lakini hajaapishwa majuma kadhaa.

eng: There had been concerns that Mwenye would not perform in his new role without being sworn in.
swa: Kumekuwepo wasiwasi kuwa Mwenye hataweza kutekeleza majukumu yake asipokula kiapo.

eng: The picture which was published on the Presidential Palace Facebook page, supposedly with the aim of showing that Mwenye had been sworn in as Attorney-General, had in it a deceased individual and another one who had been posted to the diplomatic service two years earlier.
swa: Picha iliyokuwa imechapishwa kwenye ukurasa wa Facebook wa Ikulu ya Rais, ikisemekana kuwa na lengo la kuonesha kwamba Mwenye alikuwa ameapishwa kuwa Mwanasheria Mkuu wa Serikali, ilikuwa na sura ya mtu aliyefariki na mwingine aliyekuwa ameteuliwa kuwa mwanadiplomasia miaka miwili iliyopita.

eng: Blogger Antarik Anwesan recalls an alarming experience at Goregaon train Station in Mumbai, India.
swa: Mwanablogu Antarik Anwesan anaelezea hali halisi ya kile kinachoendelea katika kituo cha magarimoshi cha Goregaon kilichopo Mumbai, India.

eng: A local train started from the platform without notice and the crowd hurried to get on board.
swa: Gari moshi lifanyalo safari za ndani liliondoka kituoni bila ya kutoa taarifa wakati abiria walipokuwa wakiharakisha kuingia.

eng: As the train gathered speed quickly, some people fell from the door and two persons were miraculously saved from death.
swa: Kadri ya garimoshi lilivyoongeza mwendo, watu wawili walianguka kupitia mlangoni, chupuchupu kupoteza maisha.

eng: This was not reported in any media.
swa: Taarifa ya tukio hili haikuripotiwa katika kituo chochote cha habari.

eng: The blogger highlights that although the casualties in the local trains are much higher each year, the government is not making provisions for safety for the ever-increasing demand on the local trains.
swa: Mwanablogu huyu afafanua kuwa, pamoja na kuwa waathirika katika magarimoshi yafanyayo safari za ndani huongezeka kila mwaka, serikali haijaweza kuweka mikakati ya usalama wa usafiri wa magarimoshi unaotumiwa na watu wengi zaidi.

eng: The "Knock Knock" video was shot in one take and uses 14 different screens to tell its story.
swa: Video ya wimbo wa "Knock Knock" uliorekodiwa mara moja na kutumia simu 14 tofauti katika kuionesha.

eng: Image from YouTube.
swa: Picha kutoka You Tube.

eng: A little-known Ukrainian indie rock collective has captured the hearts of YouTube users—and Apple fans—with a cleverly shot music video that now has over half a million views.
swa: Kampuni ndogo ya kujitegemea ya utayarishaji wa muziki wa mahadhi ya dansi nchini Ukraine imekonga nyoyo za watumiaji wa You Tube pamoja na wale wa Apple kupitia kwenye video fupi ya muziki ambayo hadi sasa imeshatazamwa na watu zaidi ya nusu milioni.

eng: The video must have taken a lot of preparation, since the authors say it was shot in real time, in one take, using only one camera, and did not involve any post-editing.
swa: Pasi na shaka video hii itakuwa iliwachukua muda mwingi kuiandaa, kwani watayarishaji walisema kuwa video hii ilirekodiwa katika muda ule ule na kwa wakati mmoja, kwa kutumia kamera moja na haikuhusisha marekebisho mengine mara baada ya kurekodiwa.

eng: The result is an endearing love story set to an equally romantic soundtrack.
swa: Kazi hii imeishia kuwa simulizi ya kimapenzi yenye kuvutia na iliyoandaliwa vyema kwa kuwianishwa barabara na wimbo wa kimahaba ulioambatanishwa na video hii.

eng: What it conceals, most likely, is hours of design and animation work, as well as careful choreographing of the gadgets on the table.
swa: Kisichofahamika, bila shaka, ni muda uliotumiwa kubuni na katika uundaji wa katuni, na pia upangiliaji wa vifaa vilivyokuwa juu ya meza.

eng: And, well, perfect timing.
swa: Na pia, kupangilia muda sahihi.

eng: As users continue to share the Ukrainian band's video masterpiece on the Web, some are jokingly speculating the video might secretly be an Apple promotion, since the devices play such a prominent part.
swa: Wakati watumiaji wa Youtube wakiendelea kusambaza video hii ya bendi kutoka Ukraine iliyoandaliwa kwa ustadi mkubwa, baadhi ya watu wanahisi kuwa, yawezekana video video hii imeandaliwa kwa siri kama namna ya kutangaza bidhaa za Apple kufuatia vifaa hivi vya Apple kutumika katika kazi hii iliyotukuka.

eng: We wonder if Apple might take note: the song—and the video—would make a for great Apple advert.
swa: Tunafikiri kama kampuni ya Apple itaweza kulitazama hili: wimbo na video ingaliweza kutumika kama namna muhimu sana ya kuitangaza kampuni ya Apple.

eng: Photo by Flickr user Taro Yamamoto.
swa: Picha na mtumiaji wa mtandao wa Flickr Taro Yamamoto.

eng: CC BY-NC-SA 2.0
swa: CC BY-NC-SA 2.0

eng: Compared to a decade ago, before Facebook, Twitter and other social media took over, there aren't as many Japan blogs are there used to be.
swa: Ukilinganisha na muongo uliopita, kabla ya Facebook, Twita na mitandao mingine ya kijamii haijatwaa nafasi, hivi sasa hakuna blogu nyingi za ki-Japan kama ilivyokuwa.

eng: A few gems still remain.
swa: Zipo chache zilizobaki.

eng: If you're interested in developing a more in-depth understanding of Japan, these blogs, many written by expert expats, are a great place to start.
swa: Kama unahitaji kukuza uelewa wa kina kuhusu Japan, blogu hizi ambazo nyingi zimeandikwa na watu waliobobea, ni uwanja mzuri wa kuanzia.

eng: SNA - Shingestu News Agency
swa: Blogu ya SNA – Shirika la Habari la Shingestu

eng: More than a blog, Shingetsu is an independent news agency that has frequent updates and analysis about current events in Japan.
swa: Ikiwa zaidi ya blogu, Shingetsu ni shirika huru la habari ambalo huweka habari mpya za mara kwa mara pamoja na uchambuzi kuhusu matukio yanayotokea Japan.

eng: Headed by journalist Michael Penn, a frequent contributor to Al-Jazeera, the SNA Twitter feed is a good way to stay on top of breaking news in Japan.
swa: Ikiongozwa na mwandishi wa habari Michael Penn, mchangiaji wa Al-Jazeerawa mara kwa mara, Anwani ya Twita ya SNA ni namna nzuri ya kubaki kuwa kinara wa kutangaza habari zinazotokea nchini Japani.

eng: Shisaku
swa: Shisaku

eng: If you want to truly get a good understanding of Japanese politics, Shisaku is a good place to start.
swa: Kama unataka kupata uelewa mzuri wa siasa za Japani, Shisaku ni mahali sahihi pa kuanzia.

eng: Written by scholar and commentator Michael Cucek, a resident of the Tokyo Metropolitan District since 1994, the Shisaku blog tries to identify the personalities and factions that power Japanese politics, and often provides an informed, sardonic take on current events.
swa: Ikiandikwa na mwanazuoni na mchambuzi Michael Cucek, mkazi wa Wilaya ya Mjini Tokyo tangu mwaka 1994, Blogu ya Shisaku inajaribu kuwatambua watu maarufu na makundi yanayoongoza mwelekeo wa siasa za Japani, na wakati mwingine hutoa mtazamo wa kiweledi kuhusu matukio yanayotokea.

eng: A great place to start is this blog post describing the absurdities behind Japan's pro-whaling stance.
swa: Mahali pazuri kuanzia ni kwenye post hii ya blogu hiyo inayoeleza kwa kina upuuzi nyuma ya mtazamo wa kiudanganyifu wa Kijapani.

eng: Tokyo Reporter
swa: Blogu ya Tokyo Reporter

eng: Taking up where the late, great (and now-banned) Tokyo Confidential left off, Tokyo Reporter provides a regular round-up of the sleazy, sensational stories of Japan's tawdry weekly tabloids.
swa: Ikianzia ilikoishia blogu ya zamani nzuri (na sasa imefungiwa) Tokyo Confidential, Tokyo Reporter inatoa mhutasari wa habari zinazoandikwa na magazeti ya wiki yanayoandikwa nchini Japani.

eng: Filled with a lot of sex, and a little bit of violence, this sometimes-NSFW blog also has interesting stories otherwise missed by foreign media reporting on Japan, such as the man inside the Godzilla costume.
swa: Ikiwa na habari nyingi za ngono, na kiasi fulani cha habari za matumizi ya nguvu, blogu ya NSFW pia ina habari ambazo mara nyingi hazipatikani kwenye vyombo vya habari vya kigeni kuhusu Japani, kama mwanaume ndani ya vazi la Godzilla .

eng: Japan Subculture Research
swa: Utafiti wa Utamaduni wa Japani

eng: Run by Jake Adelstein, an investigative reporter who covered the Tokyo crime beat for Japanese-language dailies, Japan Subculture Research is where you want to go to get the latest gossip and insider notes on the mafia, vice, corrupt politics and the "dark side of the Rising Sun."
swa: Ikiendeshwa na Jake Adelstein, mwandishi wa habari za kiuchunguzi amnayeandika habari za uhalifu jijini Tokyo inayashinda magazeti ya kila siku yanayoandikwa na Kijapani, Utafiti wa Utamaduni wa Japani ni mahali unapoweza kwenda kupata habari za udaku wa hivi karibuni na habari za kiuhalifu, uovu, siasa za kifisadi na “upande wa giza wa Jua Linalochomoza.”

eng: Adelstein's book Tokyo Vice is well worth-reading, with rumors it will soon be made into a motion picture.
swa: Kitabu cha Adelstein Tokyo Vice inafaa kusomwa, huku kukiwa na tetesi kwamba hivi karibuni itakfanywa kuwa sinema.

eng: Tofugu
swa: Tofugu

eng: A rising star in Japan's English-language blogosphere, Tofugu features beautiful design and compelling commentary about Japanese pop culture.
swa: Nyota inayochomoza kwenye ulimwengu wa blogu za Kiingereza nchini Japani, Tofugu huandika ubunifu mzuri na maoni yanayovutia kuhusu utamaduni maarufu wa Kijapani.

eng: One of the more interesting Tofugu stories recently is a follow-up interview with YouTube and social media sensation Medama-sensei.
swa: Simulizi moja wapo la kuvutia la habari zinazoandikwa na blogu ya Tofugu hivi karibuni ni mahojiano ya pili kwenye YouTube na mitandao ya kijamii yaliyofanywa na Medama-sensei.

eng: If you like data, this blog is for you. Have an addition to this list?
swa: Una suala la ziada kwenye orodha hiyo?

eng: Let us know in the comments!
swa: Tufahamishe kwenye maoni!

eng: Right to Report campaign image by Committee to Protect Journalists.
swa: Nembo ya Kampeni ya Haki ya Kutangaza imeandaliwa na Kamati ya Kuwalinda Waandishi.

eng: Free for reuse.
swa: Inaruhusiwa kutumika.

eng: Global Voices is joining more than 60 other media and press freedom organizations in supporting the Committee to Protect Journalists’ campaign for the Right to Report in the Digital Age, targeting the Obama administration.
swa: Global Voices inaungana na mashirika mengine zaidi ya 60 yanayojihusisha na uhuru wa habari kuiunga mkono kampeni ya Kamati ya Kuwalinda Waandishi kwa Haki ya Kutangaza katika Zama za Kidigitali , ikiulenga utawala wa Obama.

eng: Revelations about surveillance, intimidation, and exploitation of the press have raised unsettling questions about the rights and safety of journalists’ ability to report in the digital age.
swa: Kufahamika kwa vitendo vya ufuatiliaji, kutishiwa na kunyonywa kwa tasnia ya habari kumeibua maswali kuhusu haki na usalama wa waandishi katika kutangaza habari katika zama hizi za kidigitali.

eng: The revelations also give ammunition to governments seeking to tighten restrictions on media and the Internet.
swa: Kufahamika kwa vitendo hivyo kadhalika inazilipua serikali zinazotafuta kubana zaidi vizuizi vya uandishi pamoja na mtandao wa intaneti.

eng: Although the petition is directed at Obama, journalists around the world are affected, both directly and indirectly.
swa: Ingawa ombi hilo limeelekezwa kwa Obama, waandishi kote duniani wanaathirika, iwe moja kwa moja au kwa namna moja au nyingine.

eng: Reports that the NSA and allied spy agencies surveilled journalists-including a report that the NSA hacked Al-Jazeera-create a chilling effect on the press.
swa: Taarifa kwamba shirika la Usalama wa taifa hilo na mashirika rafiki ya upelelezi yaliwafuatilia waandishi-ikiwa ni pamoja na taarifa kwamba Shirika la Usalama la Marekani (NSA) liliingilia mawasiliano ya Al-Jazeera-zinaleta athari mbaya kwenye vyombo vya habari.

eng: Border crossing has long posed a risk for journalists, especially with respect to the search of electronic devices.
swa: Kuvuka mipaka kiasi hicho kumetengeneza hatari kwa waandishi, hasa kwa kuzingatia matumizi ya vifaa vya kielekroniki .

eng: Recent revelations about mass surveillance of online platforms in Egypt and the UK, surveillance of journalists in Ethiopia, and harassment of journalists and whistleblowers around the world (often under the auspices of anti-state charges) underscore the fact that the issues raised in the Right to Report campaign are borderless.
swa: Kufahamika kwa ufuatiliaji mkubwa wa majukwaa ya mtandaoni hivi karibuni nchini Misri naUingereza, kufuatiliwa kwa waandishi wa habari nchini Ethiopia, na kubughudhiwa kwa waandishi na wakosoaji wa serikali duniani kote (mara nyingi kwa mashtaka ya kudaiwa kuihujumu serikali) vyote vinathibitisha ukweli kwamba masuala haya yanayoibuliwa kwenye kampeni ya Haki ya Kutangaza hayana mipaka.

eng: From Azerbaijan to Zambia, governments are targeting journalists with communications surveillance and need little excuse to continue doing so.
swa: Kuanzia Azerbaijan mpaka Zambia, serikali zinawalenga waandishi wa habari kwa kuingilia mawasiliano yao na kwa hakika vitendo hivyo havivumiliki kuachwa kuendelea.

eng: The NSA spying revelations unquestionably undercut the US government’s legitimacy in arguing to the contrary.
swa: Kufahamika kwa vitendo vya Shirika la Usalama wa taifa Marekani, NSA vinaondoa uhalali wa Marekani kujaribu kudai vinginevyo.

eng: “In Pakistan, where freedom of expression is largely perceived as a Western notion, the Snowden revelations have had a damaging effect,” Sana Saleem, director of the Pakistani digital rights group Bolo Bhi and an author for Global Voices, wrote in a recent blog post for CPJ.
swa: “Nchini Pakistan, ambako uhuru wa kujieleza unachukuliwa kwa dhana ya Kimagharibi, kufahamika kwa vitendo vya kipelelezi kulikowezeshwa na Snowden kumeleta athari mbaya,” Sana Saleem, mkurugenzi wa kikundi cha haki za kidigitali nchini Pakistani Bolo Bhi na mwandishi wa Global Voices, aliandika kwenye kwenye makala ya hivi karibuni kwenye blogu aliyoiandika kwa ajili ya CPJ.

eng: “From the policy landscape to the public narrative regarding free speech and privacy, the Snowden revelations have strengthened the state's argument for surveillance.”
swa: “Kuanzia kwenye mwonekano wa sera hadi kwenye maelezo yanayotolewa kwa umma kuhusu uhuru wa habari na faragha, kutobolewa siri kulikofanywa na Snowden kumeimarisha hoja za serikali nyingi kueteta vtendo vya udukuzi.”

eng: The first stage in the campaign is an open petition.
swa: Hatua ya kwanza kwenye kampeni hii ni kufungua ombi hili la mtandaoni.

eng: The campaign seeks three key commitments from the Obama administration: Issue a presidential policy directive prohibiting the hacking and surveillance of journalists and media organizations.
swa: Kampeni hiyo inadai masuala matatu makuu kutoka kwenye utawala wa Obama: Kutoa maelekezo ya kisera kwa mamlaka ya ki-Rais kuzuia udukuzi na kufuatiliwa kwa waandishi na mashirika ya habari.

eng: Limit aggressive prosecutions that ensnare journalists and intimidate whistleblowers.
swa: Kudhibiti mashitaka yanayosukumwa na uonevu na chuki yanayolenga kuwakomesha waandishi na kuwatisha wakosoaji wa serikali.

eng: Prevent the harassment of journalists at the U.S. border.
swa: Kuzuia kubughudhiwa kwa waandishi wa habari kwenye mpaka wa Marekani.

eng: Dozens of leading media outlets from the Associated Press to Huffington Post to Vice News, along with professional journalist associations such as the Arab Reporters for Investigative Journalism and the Society of Professional Journalists, and global and national rights groups like Amnesty, Human Rights Watch, and IFEX are all lending their support to the campaign.
swa: Makumi kadhaa ya vyombo vya habari kutoka ikiwa ni pamoja na Associated Press, Huffington Post na Vice News, pamoja na vyama vya waandishi wa habari kama vile Chama cha Waandishi wa habari za uchunguzi Uarabuni na Chama cha Waandishi Weledi , na makundi ya kutetea haki za kidunia na kitaifa kama vile Amnesty, Human Rights Watch, na IFEX yanaunga mkono kampeni hiyo.

eng: Prominent journalists from around the world including Christiane Amanpour, Arianna Huffington, Xiao Qiang and Ahmed Rashid have also signed on to show their support, as well as hundreds of other journalists, bloggers and citizens who recognize that US surveillance and harassment of journalists has an impact beyond national borders.
swa: Waandishi maarufu duniani kote ikiwa ni pamoja na Christiane Amanpour, Arianna Huffington, Xiao Qiang na Ahmed Rashid nao pia wametia saini kuthibitisha wanavyounga mkono kampeni hiyo, pamoja na mamia ya waandishi wengine, wanablogu na wananchi wanaotambua kwamba vitendo vya ufuatiliaji wa mawasiliano na bughudha kwa waandishi vina madhara yanayovuka mipaka ya nchi moja moja.

eng: How can you support CPJ’s #RightToReport in the Digital Age Campaign?
swa: Unawezaje kuunga mkono Kampeni hiyo ya CPJ ya #RightToReport kwenye enzi za Dijitali?

eng: Sign the Right to Report in the Digital Age petition Encourage your colleagues, members and network to sign the petition and support the #RightToReport.
swa: Tia saini wito maalum Haki ya Kutangaza kwenye enzi za Kidijitali Washawishi marafiki, wanachama na mtandao wako kutia saini wito huo maalum na unga mkono kampeni ya #RightToReport.

eng: Share your support for the petition on your social networks Like The Right to Report Facebook page to stay updated If you represent an organization that wants to support the campaign, send your logo to RightToReport@cpj.org and we will add it to the website
swa: Sambaza ujumbe wa wito huu maalum kwenye mitandao ya kijamii Fuatilia Ukurasa wa Facebook wa Right to Report ili kuendelea kupata taarifa zaidi Kama unawakilisha shirika linalotaka kushiriki kampeni hii, tuma nembo yako kwa RightToReport@cpj.org na tutaiongeza kwenye tovuti yetu

eng: Visit CPJ’s Right to Report campaign page to learn more about the effort and find ways to get involved.
swa: Tembelea ukurasa wa kampeni ya Right to Report inayoendeshwa na CPJ ili kujifunza zaidi kuhusu jitihada hizi na kujua namna unavyoweza kushiriki.

eng: The logo of #EbolaFreeGambia campaign.
swa: Nembo la kampeni ya #EbolaFreeGambia inayolenga kuelimisha watu kukabiliana na maradhi ya Ebola.

eng: Image source: #EbolaFreeGambia Facebook page.
swa: Picha imechukuliwa kwenye ukurasa wa Facebook wa #EbolaFreeGambia.

eng: Efforts in the tiny West African state of the Gambia, which hasn't been affected by the devastating Ebola outbreak, are being intensified to protect the country from the deadly virus.
swa: Jitihada za Gambia, nchi ndogo ya Afrika Magharibi ambayo bado haijakumbwa na mlipuko wa maradhi ya Ebola, zimeongezwa kuilinda nchi hiyo na virusi vinavyoeneza maradhi hayo.

eng: As of 31 August, nearly 1,900 people in Guinea, Liberia, Nigeria and Sierra Leone have died, according to the World Health Organisation.
swa: Kufikia mwezi Agosti 31, takribani watu 1,900 katika nchi za Guinea, Liberia, Naijeria na Sierra Leone wamepoteza maisha yao, kwa mujibu wa Shirika la Afya Duniani.

eng: Following the confirmation of the first Ebola case in Senegal, the Gambia's immediate neighbour, concerns soared over the country's preparedness and public awareness about the disease.
swa: Kufuatia kuthibitishwa kwa mgonjwa wa kwanza wa Ebola nchini Senegali , nchi jirani ya Gambia, ilikumbwa na tahayaruki kufuatia wasiwasi wa namna nchi hiyo ilivyojiandaa kukabiliana na maradhi hayo kadhalika kuhusu uelewa wa jamii kuhusiana na ugonjwa huo.

eng: The confirmation created widespread fear among the Gambians because of the closeness of Senegal to Gambia and porous borders between the two countries.
swa: Kuthibitishwa kwa mlipuko wa maradhi hayo kulisababisha kuenea kwa hofu miongoni mwa raia wa Gambia kwa sababu ya ukaribu uliopo kati ya nchi hiyo na Gambia ikiwa ni pamoja na kuwepo kwa njia za panya katika mpaka wa nchi hizo.

eng: A coalition of civil society in the Gambia have launched Ebola Free Gambia to try and keep the country Ebola free.
swa: Muungano wa asasi za kiraia nchini Gambia umeanzisha kampeni ya Gambia isiyo na Ebola kama jitihada za kujaribu na kuifanya nchi hiyo kujikinga na maradhi hayo.

eng: Its Facebook page, created on the 30 August, has over 2,900 likes.
swa: Its Ukurasa wa Facebook, ulioanzishwa tarehe 30 Agosti, tayari unafuatiliwa na watu 2,900.

eng: A description of the coalition on its website says:
swa: Maelezo ya muungano huo kwenye tovuti yao yanasema:

eng: In light of the proximity of Gambia to the Ebola infected areas, there is a pressing need for immediate action to arrest the possible spread of Ebola into The Gambia by sensitizing the population about the nature of the disease, how it is spread and how to avoid being infected.
swa: Kwa kuelewa ukaribu uliopo kati ya Gambia na maeneo mengine yaliyokumbwa na mlipuko wa maradhi ya Ebola, kuna ulazima wa kuchukua hatua za dharura kudhibiti kuingia kwa maambukizi ya maradhi hayo nchini Gambia kwa kuwaelimisha watu kuhusiana na ugonjwa huo, namna unavyoambukizwa na kadhalika jinsi ya kujilinda na maambukizi.

eng: The Government of the Gambia from the onset of the outbreak in West Africa has taken some steps to protect our country from Ebola.
swa: Serikali ya Gambia tangu wakati wa kulipuka kwa ugonjwa huo katika eneo la Afrika Magharibi imechukua hatua kadhaa za kuilinda nchi yetu na ugonjwa wa Ebola.

eng: The impact of the Ebola outbreak in West Africa already having dire economic consequences to the Gambia not to mention the potential health implications if the disease were to spread into the Gambia.
swa: Madhara ya kulipuka kwa ugonjwa huu katika eneo la Afrika Magharibi tayari yanaonekana kwa kudorora kwa uchumi wa Gambia ukiacha matatizo ya kiafya yanayoweza kujitokeza kama ugonjwa utaenea na kuingia Gambia.

eng: The campaign complements government's efforts by raising awareness about preparedness, prevention and response using their website, YouTube videos, Facebook and sensitization drives around the country.
swa: Kampeni hiyo inaunga mkono jitihada za serikali kwa kukuza uelewa wa watu kuhusu kujiandaa, kujilinda na namna ya kuchukua hatua maambukizi yakitokea kwa kutumia tovuti yao, video za mtandao wa You Tube, Facebook na namna nyinginezo zinazoweza kutumika kuwafikia watu nchini humu.

eng: Watch one of the campaign's YouTube video below:
swa: Tazama moja ya video ya kampeni hiyo iliyowekwa kwenye mtandao wa You Tube hapa chini:

eng: Meanwhile, on 11 September the US Embassy in Banjul in collaboration with Gambian artists launched a song dedicated to the crusade against Ebola.
swa: Wakati huo huo, mnamo Septemba 11 ubalozi wa Marekani mjini Banjul kwa kushirikiana na wasanii wa Gambia ulizindua wimbo maalumu kwa kupambana na Ebola.

eng: The Ebola Song features musicians Tra, Badibunka, Cess Ngum, Killa ACE, & Sandeng, and Amadou Sussocebook.
swa: Wimbo huo wa Ebola  umewashirikisha wasanii Tra, Badibunka, Cess Ngum, Killa ACE, & Sandeng, na Amadou Sussocebook.

eng: Listen to it below:
swa: Unaweza kuusikiliza wimbo huo hapa chini:

eng: The Ministry of Health and Social Welfare in Banjul has already established a 24-hour information hotline from any network within the country. #EbolaFreeGambia campaign is different from the efforts by the Ministry of Health to sensitize Gambians.
swa: Wizara ya Afya na Ustawi wa Jamii jijini Banjul tayari imeanzisha laini ya simu inayopatikana masaa 24 kupitia mitandao yote nchini humo. Kampeni ya #EbolaFreeGambia inatofautiana na jitihada nyingine zinazochukuliwa na Wizara ya Afya zinazolenga kuwaelimisha wa-Gambia.

eng: The news of first Ebola case in Senegal prompted Gambian Facebook user Arfang Jobe to suggest that mobile phone companies partner with the Ministry of Health to send text messages to raise awareness about the disease.
swa: Habari za mgonjwa wa kwanza wa Ebola nchini Senegali zilimfanya mtumiaji wa mtandao wa Facebook nchini Gambia Arfang Jobe kupendekeza kwamba makampuni ya simu yashirikiane na Wizara ya Afya kutuma ujumbe mfupi wa maneno kuwaelimisha watu kuhusiana na ugonjwa huo.

eng: Commenting on the suggestion, Hassan Njie cautioned:
swa: Wakitoa maoni kwenye bandiko hilo, Hassan Njie alionya:

eng: The last thing we want is to send fear into the minds of Gambians.
swa: Jambo la mwisho kabisa tunaloweza kufikiri kulifanya ni kutuma ujumbe utakaowajaza watu hofu nchini humu.

eng: The messages must be tailor made for easy understanding.
swa: Ujumbe unapaswa kutengenezwa kwa namna nyepesi kuelewa.

eng: People interpret and react to information differently.
swa: Watu hutafsiri na kufanyia kazi habari wanazozipokea kwa namna tofauti.

eng: Let us be on our guard!
swa: Tuchukue tahadhari!

eng: Kb Bojang advised:
swa: Kb Bojang alishauri:

eng: I think it will be great too, if they can send voice mails in the different languages we have, to their respective customers with regards to Ebola preventive measures, because I doubt everyone will be able to read the text messages
swa: Ninadhani itafaa pia, kama wanaweza kutuma ujumbe wa sauti kwa wateja wao katika lugha tofauti zilizopo nchini, kuhusiana na hatua za kukabiliana na Ebola, kwa sababu nina wasiwasi watu wengi hawatakuwa na muda wa kusoma ujumbe wanaotumiwa.

eng: Mobile phone companies have started sending Ebola related messages to subscribers.
swa: Makapuni ya simu yameanza kutuma ujumbe wa kuelimisha wateja wao kuhusu Ebola.

eng: However, It is not clear whether this initiative is the direct result of the Ebola free campaign on social media.
swa: Hata hivyo, haijawa wazi kama ni kweli mpango huo ni matokeo ya moja kwa moja ya kampeni ya kukabiliana na Ebola iliyoanzia kwenye mitandao ya kijamii.

eng: In August, researchers at Oxford University announced that they will begin a trial of a potential vaccine on healthy UK volunteers once ethical approval is granted, which will eventually extend to the Gambia and Mali.
swa: Mwezi Agosti, watafiti wa Chuo Kikuu cha Oxford walitangaza kwamba wataanza majaribio ya kinga kwa wa-Ingereza waliojitolea kushiriki zoezi hilo wakishapata ruhusa ya kuzingatia maadili ya tafiti, na kisha zoezi hilo linatarajiwa kufanyika pia kwenye nchi za Gambia na Mali.

eng: This announcement has since been received with mixed feelings in the Gambia with some being skeptical.
swa: Tangazo hili limepokelewa kwa hisia tofauti nchini Gambia huo wengine wakiwa na wasiwasi.

eng: Commenting on the announcement, Mass Bajinka wrote on Facebook:
swa: Akitoa maoni juu ya tanagazo hilo, Mass Bajinka aliandika kwenye mtandao wa Facebook:

eng: Why not Liberia, Nigeria and the countries that's already have the virus....why Gambia?????
swa: Kwa nini isiwe Liberia, Naijeria na nchi nyingine ambazo tayari zina maambukizi hayo…kwa nini iwe Gambia????

eng: We don't have single virus their so why Gambia ?
swa: Hatuna hata kirusi kimoja hapa kwa nini sasa iwe Gambia?

eng: I hope the government say nope.
swa: Ninatumaini serikali haitakubaliana na mpango huo.

eng: Eddie Baldeh advised:
swa: Eddie Baldeh alishauri:

eng: The government should say no to this...why The Gambia? a Country that an Ebola has never been reported or diagnose...Do your trials somewhere n leave Gambia alone...in Peace!!
swa: Serikali lazima ikatae mradi huu…kwa nini iwe Gambia? Nchi ambayo haijawahi kuwa na maambukizi ya Ebola wala tetesi za maradhi hayo….Fanyeni majaribio yenu kwingine na iacheni Gambia kivyake…tena kwa amani!!!

eng: But some are more optimistic and would like the trial to go ahead in the Gambia:
swa: Lakini baadhi ya watu wana mtazamo chanya na zoezi hili na wangependa majaribio yaendelee nchini Gambia:

eng: One reason why everyone is worried about this outbreak is because there is no cure.
swa: Sababu moja kwa nini kila mmoja ana wasiwasi kuhusiana na kulipuka kwa maradhi haya ni kwa saabu wanajua hakuna tiba.

eng: And now that a prospective vaccine is about to go through trials, here we go again with our conspiracy theories.
swa: Na sasa kwa sababu chanjo inaelekea kufanyiwa majaribio, sisi hawa hawa tunakuja na hisia zetu.

eng: Every single drug in the market has a side effect and before they are progressed to clinical trial phase they have to pass safety tests in animals first and the vaccine is deactivated before administering, so it cannot cause disease.
swa: Kila dawa iliyoko kwenye soko ina madhara yake na kabla ya kuifanya itimike kwenye tiba lazima kwanza uthibitike kuwa salama kwa wanyama kwanza na kisha inafanywa isifanye kazi kitaalam kabla ya kuanza kuitumia, ili isije ikasababisha ugonjw ahuo.

eng: And why Gambia? because vaccines have to be tested on healthy individuals to assess their effectiveness and MRC has years of experience in conducting such studies.
swa: Ni kwa sababu chanjo hujaribiwa kwa watu wasio na ugonjwa ili kuchunguza ubora wake na kitengo cha cha MRC hapa Gambia kina uzoefu wa miaka mingi katika kufanya tafiti hizi.

eng: Let's just stop the pessimism people and just be thankful that there is active research being geared towards fighting the deadly disease.
swa: Hebu tuwanyamazishe watu wanaopenda kukosoa kila kitu na tushukuru kwamba kuna utafiti makini unaendelea ili kuweza kupambana na maradhi hayo hatari.

eng: Whatever the case may be, the fact is that many people in the country are worried about the deadly virus entering the country. Follow our in-depth coverage: The Struggle to #StopEbola in West Africa
swa: Vyovyote iwavyo, ukweli ni kwamba watu wengi nchini wana wasiwasi kuhusiana na uwezekano wa virusi hivyo kuingia nchini humo.

eng: Sunset Over Selungo is a 30-minute film documenting how the indigenous Penan tribe is defending the remaining rainforest of Borneo island in Malaysia.
swa: Sunset Over Selungo ni filamu ya dakika 30 inayoonesha namna kabila la wenyeji la Penan linavyopigania kutunzwa kwa misitu ya asili kwenye kisiwa cha Borneo nchini Malaysia.

eng: Borneo is the largest island in Asia.
swa: Borneo ni kisiwa kikubwa zaidi barani Asia.

eng: The film was made by independent British filmmaker Ross Harrison
swa: Filamu hiyo imetengenezwa na mtayarishaji huru wa filamu wa Kiingereza, Ross Harrison

eng: Follow @nthakoana (Nthakoana Ngatane) for updates on the political crisis in Lesotho.
swa: Mfuatilie @nthakoana (Nthakoana Ngatane) kupata habari mpya zinazohusu mgogoro wa kisiasa nchini Lesotho.

eng: Nthakoana Ngatane is a writer, speaker, singer, actor and South Africa Broadcasting Corporation correspondent in Lesotho.
swa: Nthakoana Ngatane ni mwandishi, msemaji, mwimbajii, mwigizaji na mwakilishi wa SHirika la Habari la Utangazaji la Afrika Kusini nchini Lesotho.

eng: On 30th August 2014, Lesotho Prime Minister Tom Thabane claimed there was a coup attempt against him.
swa: Mnamo tarehe 30 Agosti 2014, Waziri Mkuu wa Lesotho Tom Thabane alidai kulikuwa na jaribio la kumpindua kijeshi dhidi yake.

eng: He later flew to South Africa fearing for his life.
swa: Baade ilimbidi kwenda Afrika Kusini akihofia kupoteza maisha yake.

eng: Madagascar bat via Wikipedia Public Domain
swa: Picha: Wikipedia kwa matumizi ya umma

eng: The fight against the Ebola epidemic is increasingly turning into an international emergency.
swa: Vita dhidi ya mlipuko wa Ebola inaendela kugeuka kuwa dharura ya kimataifa.

eng: The number of victims is growing rapidly in the three most severely affected countries in West Africa: Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone.
swa: Idadi ya wahanga wa ugonjwa huo inaongozeka kwenye nchi tatu zilizoathiwa zaidi huko Afrika Magharibi: Guinea, Liberia na Sierra Leone.

eng: Patients have also died in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Nigeria.
swa: Wagonjwa kadhaa wameripotiwa kupoteza maisha kwenye Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Kongo na Najeria.

eng: The World Health Organization reports that the most serious epidemic in the history of this hemorrhagic fever has already killed more than 2,800 people out of 5,833 cases as of 20 September.
swa: Shirika la Afya Duniani linaripoti kwamba maradhi haya hatari zaidi kwenye historia ya homa inayosababishwa na virusi tayari imepoteza maisha ya watu zaidi ya 2,800 kati ya wagonjwa 5,833 kufikia tarehe 20 Septemba.

eng: The United Nations Security Council has adopted Resolution 2177 to deal with the public health crisis.
swa: Baraza la Usalama la Umoja wa Mataifa limefikia azimio 2177 la kupambana na janga hilo linalohatarisha afya ya jamii.

eng: On 18 September, 131 countries co-sponsored the resolution, which recognizes "the unprecedented extent of the Ebola epidemic in Africa" and describes the creation of a special mission, the United Nations Mission for Ebola Emergency Response (UNMEER).
swa: Mnamo Septemba 18, nchi zipatazo 131 zilifadhili azimio hilo, linalotambua "kiwango kisichokubalika cha mlipuko wa Ebola barani Afrika " na kueleza kuundwa kwa mpango maalum uitwao Mpango wa Umoja wa Mataifa wa Kushughulikia masuala ya Ebola (UNMEER).

eng: US President Barack Obama has announced that he is sending 3,000 American troops to West Africa, in view of the worsening crisis, with the virus spreading exponentially.
swa: Rais wa Marekani Barack Obama ametangaza kwamba anatuma vikosi 3,000 kwenda Afrika Magharibi, kwa lengo la kukabiliana na hali hiyo inayozidi kuwa mbaya, kufuatia kuenea kwa kasi kubwa kwa virusi vya ugonjwa huo.

eng: Other countries in Africa are concerned about the possibility that the epidemic will spread to them as well, although their health facilities are not ready to deal with it.
swa: Nchi nyingine Barani Afrika zina wasiwasi na uwezekano wa kuenea kwa maradhi hayo katika nchi zao, ingawa vifaa vya afya havionekani kuwa tayari kupambana na ugonjwa huo.

eng: A study states that 15 African countries are potentially at risk, due to having the same environmental conditions as the affected countries.
swa: Utafiti unaonesha kwamba nchi 15 ziko kwenye hatari sana ya kupata maradhi hayo , kwa sababu ya kuwa na mazingira yanayofanana na mazingira yaliyo kwenye nchi zilizoathirika.

eng: This is the case for Madagascar, where a boat from Liberia suspected of carrying the Ebola virus docked recently in the port of Toamasina.
swa: Hali ni hiyo hiyo nchini Madagaska, ambako mashua kutoka Liberia ikidaiwa kubeba watu wenye virusi vya Ebola hivi karibuni ilitua kwenye bandari ya Toamasina.

eng: An emergency meeting was held in Antananarivo on 5 August to look closely at the precautions that need to be taken.
swa: Mkutano wa dharura ulifanyika jijini Antananarivo tarehe 5 Agosti kutazama kwa karibu tahadhari zinazoweza kuchukuliwa.

eng: Secretary General of the Madagascar Ministry of Health Philémon Tafangy recognized the risk:
swa: Katibu Mkuu wa Wizara ya Afya nchini Madagaska Philémon Tafangy alitambua hatari:

eng: A country such as ours isn't safe from the risks , despite our distance from the affected region
swa: Nchi kama yetu haiko salama na hatari hii , pamoja na umbali wetu na eneo liloathirika

eng: Prime Minister Kolo Roger, however, has stated that the health system is ready to deal with such an eventuality and has a contingency plan in place:
swa: Waziri Mkuu Kolo Roger, hata hivyo, ameeleza kwamba mifumo ya afya iko imara kushughulikia majanga hayo kama yatajitokeza na mpango wa dharura uko tayari

eng: This plan incorporates the scenarios and steps required to tackle epidemics of viral hemorrhagic fevers such as the viral disease Ebola.
swa: Mpango huu unajumuisha maeneo na hatua zinazohitajika kwa ajili ya kupambana na magonjwa yanayoenezwa na virusi kama vile Ebola.

eng: Hospital room in Mandritsara, Madagascar - CC BY 2.0
swa: Chumba cha Hospitali huko Mandritsara, Madagaska - CC BY 2.0

eng: But it appears that the Malagasy health infrastructures will not be able to cope if the disease spreads dramatically.
swa: Lakini inaonekana kwamba miundo mbinu ya afya nchini Madagaska haitaweza kuhimili mlipuko wa maradhi hayo kama utatokea.

eng: The PM is choosing to ignore the warnings of scientists, relying instead on airport controls, noting that Madagascar’s public health environment is protected by the lack of flights from the areas affected by the virus.
swa: Waziri Mkuu ameamua kupuuza tahadharani za wanasayansi, akitegemea zaidi taarifa za sehemu za udhibiti kwenye viwanja vya ndege, akisema kwamba mazingira ya afya ya umma nchini Madagaska yamelindwa kwa sababu ya kutokuwepo kwa ndege zinazoingia nchi humo kutoka kwenye maeneo yanayokabiliwa na mlipuko wa maradhi hayo.

eng: Scientists point out that the virus can spread in a different way.
swa: Wanasayansi wanasema kwamba virusi vya Ebola huenea kwa namna tofauti.

eng: Indeed, a recent publication explains how the disease could be spread from the animal kingdom to humans: fruit bats can carry the disease without displaying any signs of it, and are able to migrate and transfer it to other animals, such as monkeys and rodents.
swa: Kwa hakika, chapisho la hivi karibuni linaeleza namna gani ugonjwa unaweza kuenea kutoka kwa wanyama kwenda kwa binadamu: popo walao matunda wanaweza kubeba virusi hivyo bila wao kuonesha dalili za maradhi hayo, na wanaweza kuhama na kueneza virusi hivyo kwenda kwa wanyama wengine, kama vile nyani na pimbi.

eng: Monkeys are sometimes eaten as bushmeat in Madagascar.
swa: Wakati mwingine nyani huliwa na watu waishio porini nchini Madagaska.

eng: Although consumption of meat may not necessarily cause Ebola, preparation of raw infected meat increases the risk of infection.
swa: Ingawa ulaji wa nyama si lazima uwe ni chanzo cha Ebola, uandaaji wa nyama mbichi ambazo zinaongeza uwezekano wa maambukizi.

eng: Ilaym, an Antananarivo-based blogger for the DailyMg, explains why Malagasy people are specifically vulnerable to an Ebola outbreak.
swa: Ilaym, mwanablogu anayeishi Antananarivo anayeandikia blogu ya DailyMg, anaeleza kwa nini wa-Malagasi wako kwenye hatari ya maambukizi ya virusi vya Ebola.

eng: He lists a few reasons: Some Malagasy people hunt and eat bats and lemurs; and the practice of famadihana, a tradition that consists of exhuming the deceased from their tombs.
swa: Anaorodhesha sababu chache : 1) Baadhi ya Walagasi huwinda na kula popo na wanyama wengine 2) kwa sababu ya famadihana, a mila ya kuwafukua wafu kutoka kwenye makaburi yao.

eng: Léa Ratsiazo in Antananarivo questioned in a column for newspaper the Madagascar Tribune the country’s real ability to counteract the potential arrival of Ebola in Madagascar, in the light of a recent event in a hospital in the capital:
swa: Léa Ratsiazo wa Antananarivo alihoji kwenye safu yake iliyoko kwenye jarida la Madagascar Tribune kuhusu uwezo halisi wa nchi hiyo wa kudhibiti uwezekano wa kuenea kwa Ebola nchini Madagaska, kufuatia matukio ya hivi karibuni kwenye hospitali iliyoko jijini Antananarivo:

eng: That takes some believing, because almost at the same time as he was issuing that press statement, a team of foreign surgeons engaging in humanitarian work inadvertenlty contradicted it.
swa: Hiyo inahitaji kuamini kwa kiasi fulani, kwa sababu karibu wakati ule ule alipokuwa anatoa taarifa yake kwa waandishi wa habari, timu ya wapasuaji ya kigeni inayojihusisha na kazi za kibinadamu walisema jambo lililotofautiana na matamshi yake.

eng: This was a team made up of 11 surgeons, doing humanitarian work across several countries in the world, including Madagascar.
swa: Hii ilikuwa ni timu ya wapasuaji 11, wanaofanya kazi za kibinadamu katika nchi mbalimbali duniani, ikiwemo Madagaska.

eng: They carry out surgical procedures free of charge for patients that need them in the countries they visit, in partnership with local hospitals.
swa: Walifanya upasuaji bure kwa wagonjwa waliokuwa na uhitaji katika nchi walizozuru, kwa ushirikiano na hospitali za wenyeji.

eng: The HJRA hospital of Antananarivo, which is the largest health care centre in Madagascar, was chosen for this partnership, but the HJRA officials forgot to inform the public of this fact.
swa: Hospitali ya HJRA jijini Antananarivo, ambayo ni kituo kikuu cha afya nchini Madagaska, kilichaguliwa kwa ushirikiano huo, lakini maafisa wa HJRA walisahau kuwajulisha watu ukweli huu.

eng: As a result, no patients turned up.
swa: Matokeo yake, hakuna mgonjwa alijitokeza.

eng: They ended up with just two HJRA patients instead of the 25 anticipated daily.
swa: Madaktari hao wakaishia kupata wagonjwa wawili wa hospitali hiyo badala ya wagonjwa 25 kwa siku.

eng: These surgeons were annoyed, stating that they had not come here for a holiday, but to help others, and that the least the hospital should have done was to inform the public and raise awareness.
swa: Wapasuaji hao walifedheheshwa, wakisema kwamba hawakuwa wamekuja kwa likizo, ila kuwasaidia wananchi kupata uelewa.

eng: They were also concerned that patients requiring an operation have to pay for all the drugs and other supplies needed for the procedure.
swa: Vile vile waliokuwa na wasiwasi kwamba wagonjwa waliokuwa wanahitaji kufanyiwa upasuaji walitakiwa kulipia dawa zote na vifaa vyote vilivyohitajika kwa ajili ya upasuaji.

eng: In addition, it was noted that the HJRA had an acute shortage of basic materials for surgical procedures.
swa: Kwa yongeza, ilionekana kwamba hospitali ya HJRA ilikuwa na upungufu mkubwa wa vifaa vya msingi kwa ajili ya shughuli za upasuaji.

eng: Le Mouvement des Citoyens Malagasy de Paris MCM (The Coalition of Malagasy citizens in Paris) also wonders whom to believe regarding the risk of an Ebola outbreak in Madagascar: the Prime Minister Kolo who says the risks are minimal or the research scientists who included Madagascar in the nations at risk?
swa: Le Mouvement des Citoyens Malagasy de Paris MCM (Muungano wa raia wa ki-Malagasi waishio Paris) kadhalika haukuelewa nani wa kumwamini kuhusiana na hatari ya mlipuko wa Ebola nchini Madagaska: Waziri Mkuu Kolo anayedai hakuna hatari yoyote au wanasayansi watafiti wanaoijumuisha Madagaska kwenye mataifa yenye hatari?

eng: So, while a contingency plan exists, it remains to be seen if Madagascar has been able to put in place the resources needed to implement it.
swa: Kwa hiyo, wakati mpango wa dharura upo, bado inahitaji kuangaliwa ikiwa Madagaska imeweza kuandaa raslimali zinazohitajika kuutekeleza mpango huo.

eng: The Islamic State in Iraq and Syria has shared a second gruesome video which allegedly shows the beheading of American journalist Steven Sotloff.
swa: Dola ya kiislam ya nchini Iraq na Syria imeweka tena hadharani video nyingine ya mauaji ya kutisha inayoonesha kukatwa kichwa kwa mtu anayedhaniwa kuwa ni mwandishi wa habari wa Marekani, Steven Sotloff.

eng: Photograaph shared widely on social media
swa: Picha hii ilisambazwa katika mitandao mbalimbali ya kijamii

eng: A second video showing the beheading of an American journalist by the Islamic State in Iraq and Syria (ISIS), a spin-off of Al Qaeda that has come to control one-third of Syria and a quarter of Iraq, has emerged.
swa: Video ya pili ikoneshayo mauaji ya kukatwa kichwa mwandishi wa habari wa Marekani, mauaji yaliyofanywa na dola ya Kiislam ya Raq na Syria(ISIS), dola iliyo na chimbuko lake kutoka kwenye kundi la Al Qaeda, kundi lililofanikiwa kutawala theluthi moja ya nchi ya Syria na robo ya nchi ya Iraq.

eng: The three-minute video allegedly shows the beheading of Steven Sotloff, whose work in hotspots across the Middle East has taken him to Bahrain, Syria, Egypt, Libya and Turkey.
swa: Video hii ya dakika tatu inadaiwa kuonesha kukatwa kichwa kwa Steven Sotloff, ambaye amekuwa akifanya kazi sehemu hatari katika maeneo mbalimbali ya Mashariki ya Kati kama vile Bahrain, Syria, Egypt, Libya na Uturuki.

eng: Sotloff disappeared in August last year while reporting in Syria.

eng: This gruesome video follows the beheading of American photojournalist James Wright Foley, who has been missing in Syria for 636 days, before a video showing his murder was released by the ISIS on August 19.

eng: Sotloff was identified in the Foley video, with a warning that he would be next.
swa: Sotloff alitambulishwa katika video ya Foley, angalizo likitolewa kuwa, yeye ndiye atakayefuatia.

eng: Now another hostage, David Haines, from the UK, is said to appear in this second video.

eng: Melody Sundberg analyses freedom of expression in Ethiopia after detained Ethiopian bloggers spent 100 days in prison:
swa: Melody Sundberg anachambua uhuru wa kujieleza nchini Ethiopia baada ya wanablogu wa Ethiopia waliokamatwa kukaa siku 100 gerezani:

eng: Ethiopia is with its almost 94 million population the second most populated country in Africa.
swa: Ethiopia ina idadi ya watu 94,000,000 na ni nchi ya pili yenye wakazi wengi katika bara la Afrika.

eng: Nevertheless, it does not according to an interview with Endalkhachew Chala by Global Voices, have an independent daily newspaper or independent media.
swa: Hata hivyo, hailingani na mahojiano ya Endalkhachew Chala kupitia Global Voices, kuwa na gazeti huru la kila siku au vyombo vya habari huru.

eng: There was a need of an alternative voice and the Zone 9:ers therefore began blogging and using social media to write on subjects related to human rights.
swa: Kulikuwa na haja ya sauti mbadala na kwa hivyo Zone 9:ers walianza kublogu na kutumia vyombo vya habari vya kijamii kwa kuandika juu ya mada zinazohusiana na haki za binadamu.

eng: The name of the group, Zone 9, refers to the zones of the notorious Ethiopian Kality prison, where political prisoners and journalists are being held.
swa: Jina la kundi, Zone 9, inawashiria maeneo ya sifa mbaya za gereza la Ethiopia Kality, ambapo wafungwa wa kisiasa na waandishi wa habari wamefungiwa.

eng: The prison has eight zones, but the ninth "zone" refers to the rest of Ethiopia.
swa: Gerezani ina maeneo manane, lakini "eneo" la tisa inawashiria Ethiopia.

eng: Even if being outside of the prison walls - you are never truly free; any freethinking individual may be arrested.
swa: Hata kama ni nje ya kuta za gereza - hauko huru kamwe; mtu yeyote mwenye fikira huru anaweza kukamatwa.

eng: The bloggers wanted to be the voice of this ninth zone.
swa: Wanablogu walitaka kuwa sauti ya eneo hili la tisa.

eng: In the interview, Endalkachew says that the group had campaigns about respecting the constitution, stopping censorship and respecting the right to demonstrate.
swa: Katika mahojiano, Endalkachew anasema kwamba kundi lilikuwa na kampeni kuhusu kuheshimu katiba, kuacha udhibiti na kuheshimu haki ya kuandamana.

eng: The group also visited political prisoners, such as journalists Eskinder Nega and Reeyot Alemu.

eng: They wanted to bring the publics' attention to them by using social media.

eng: Both my mother and father know certain passages of the Quran by heart, especially those that aid in searching for lost everyday items, and generally find pride in being a Muslim.

eng: Currently occupying every possible government job in any Muslim country you survey, another name for this breed of Muslim is "Hypocritical Bastards".
swa: Kwa sasa wamejichomeka kwenye kila fursa ya ajira serikalini katika nchi za Kiislamu unazoweza kuzifuatilia, jina jingine kwa aina hii ya Waislamu ni “Wapumbavu wanafiki”.

eng: They are different from the Bad Muslims in that, while they may commit every sin and indulge every prohibition, they present themselves as symbols of Islamic virtue.
swa: Hawa ni tofauti na Waislamu wazembe kwa kuwa, wanaweza kufanya kila aina ya dhambi na kuvunja kila kilicho haramu kwenye dini, lakini bado wanajifanya kuwa ndio alama ya Uislam.

eng: You can usually recognize them by the aggressively overt way they express their love for Islam.
swa: Unaweza kuwatambua kwa hisia za hasira wanazoonesha kwa eti kuipenda dini yao.

eng: The men will have long, pious beards, with which they demonstrate both their commitment and masculinity; they have permanently bruised foreheads, to provide evidence of a lifetime spent prostrating on a prayer mat.
swa: Wanaume wanakuwa na madevu marefu, yanayotumika kuonesha misimamo yao ya kidini pamoja na mfumo dume; siku zote wana sehemu ya kipaji cha uso iliyosagika, kuonesha kwamba siku zote wanaswali sala tano.

eng: Their women will wear the hijab—not wrapped tight, as is custom, but instead floating several inches above an immense hairstyle that defies both the laws of physics and style.
swa: Wanawake huvaa hijab –haibani kama ilivyo kawaida, ila kujifunika gubigubi kinyume cha kanuni za fizikia na hata mitindo.

eng: They will always have in their hands a string of prayer beads on an endless rotation through ceaseless fingers.
swa: Muda wote utawaona wamebeba tasbiri yenye vifundo vya kufanyia maombi na haibanduki vidoleni.

eng: Every prayer is read by both genders and every Hajj attended.
swa: Kila ombi linaloombwa linafanyika kwa jinsia zote na kila Hija iliyofanyika.

eng: Their commitment to the charade may even go so far as to shun alcohol and be completely loving and devoted husbands/wives.
swa: Wanaweza kushika dini kiasi cha kuachana na pombe na wanaweza kuwa waume na wake wema.

eng: But put a rupee in front of them and they will serve up a round of bacon and ham while marrying a Kafir and swearing an oath to Satan.
swa: Lakini wanaweka fedha mbele na wanaweza kuwalisha watu nyama ya nguruwe na mapaja yake yaliyokaushwa wakati wa kufunga ndoa na makafiri na pia wanaweza kula kiapo kwa jina la Sheitwani.

eng: They can also be counted in the club of people who believe that America hates Muslims, that its support of Israel is evidence of this, further proven by the invasions of Afghanistan and Iraq.
swa: Hawa pia wanahesabika kwenye kundi la watu wanaoamini kwamba Marekani inawachukiwa Waislamu, na kwamba kitendo cha nchi hiyo kupenda kuikumbatia Israel ni ushahidi wa hili, kwa kujumlisha pia kitendo chake cha kuivamia Afghanistan na Iraq.

eng: The only difference here is that most of them tend to be quite willing to cozy up to their enemy if the price is right.
swa: Tofauti pekee kwa hawa ni kwamba wengi wao wanaweza kushirikiana na adui kama adui huyo atafika bei yao.

eng: Actually, that's not true.
swa: Ukweli, hiyo si kweli.

eng: It's not if the price is right—it's if there is any price at all.
swa: Si kama adui atafika bei –ni kama kuna bei yoyote imetolewa.

eng: Frightening Muslim:
swa: Waislam Tishio:

eng: Tends to talk about "Jihad" a lot.
swa: Wanapenda kuzungumzia “Jihad” sana.

eng: Your average mosque imam is a good example.
swa: Mfano mzuri ni imam wako wa Msikiti.

eng: In appearances not that different from the "Terrible Muslim", only with a greater commitment to the lifestyle.
swa: Kwa mwonekano hawana tofauti sana na “Waislam wa ajabu”, tofauti yao ni uumini uliovuka mipaka.

eng: The men will not just sport beards, but have shaved upper lips as well.
swa: Wanaume si tu wamefuga madevu pia wamenyoa masharubu pia.

eng: This stylish look is rooted in the belief that the Prophet wore his beard in the same way, although there is no actual evidence to prove this.
swa: Mtindo huu una mizizi yake kwenye imani kwamba Mtume alinyoa ndevu zake namna hiyo, ingawa hakuna ushahidi wa hilo.

eng: Nor is there any to prove that his pyjamas ended several inches above his ankles, but that is also a popular sartorial choice amongst this lot.
swa: Na wala hakuna ushahidi kwamba alivaa suruari fupi mithili ya kaptula ndefu, lakini mitindo hiyo ndiyo maarufu zaidi kwa kundi hili.

eng: Now I should also provide some clarification about my introduction to this class of Muslim.
swa: Sasa ni vyema nitoe ufafanuzi kuhusiana na kundi hili la Waislamu.

eng: The Frightening Muslim may say "jihad" a lot and talk about fighting the West and how the Muslim Ummah needs to rise up in revolt, but chances are you will never find one anywhere near a front line.
swa: Waislamu Tishio wanaweza kusema “Jihad” zaidi na wanazungumzia kupambana na nchi za Magharibi na namna umma wa Waslamu unavyohitaji kuamka na kufanya mapinduzi, lakini uwezekano ni kwamba hutawakuta kokote kwenye mstari wa mbele.

eng: They are classified as Frightening, by the way, only by westerners who see the stuff of terroristic nightmares in their appearance.
swa: Wamewekwa kwenye fungu la Kutisha, kwa kweli, na wazungu wanaona yanayofanywa na magaidi kwa sura yao.

eng: For their fellow Muslims, this kind tends to be annoying at most and ridiculous at best.
swa: Kwa Waislamu wenzao, kundi hili ni linakera zaidi na linaonekana kuwa la kijinga zaidi.

eng: We tolerate them because on average they are useful in teaching your children the Quran (as long as you strictly supervise that the education is limited to Arabic rote memorization and does not include any kind of opinion-forming rhetoric or casual molestation).
swa: Tunawavumilia kwa sababu kwa wastani lina umuhimu katika kuwafundisha watoto wako Quran (almuradi unafuatilia kwa makini kuhakikisha kwamba elimu hiyo inabaki kuwa ya kukariri Kiarabu na haijumuishi maoni itikadi nyinginezo za kidini zilizojaa maoni).

eng: Their opinions range from far-fetched conspiracies—in which Islamic sects other than the one they belong to are plotting their downfall—to the belief that America hates Muslims, that its support of Israel is evidence of this, further proven by the invasions of Afghanistan and Iraq.
swa: Maoni yao huanzia kwenye imani za kuzusha mambo –mfano kuamini kwamba madhehebu mengine nje yao yanapanga kuwaangusha –hadi kwenye imani kwamba Marekani inawachukia Waislamu, na kwamba kitendo cha nchi hiyo kuikumbatia Israel ni ushahidi wa hili, na zaidi uvamizi wa Afghanistan na Iraq.

eng: An example of the Frightening Muslim is the entire country of Saudi Arabia.
swa: Mfano wa Waislamu wa Kutisha ni nchi yote ya Saudi Arabia.

eng: Downright Crazy Muslim:
swa: Waislamu Wajinga Kabisa:

eng: They believe that America hates Muslims, that its support of Israel is evidence of this, further proven by the invasions of Afghanistan and Iraq.
swa: Wanaamini Marekani inawachukia Waislamu, na kwamba kitendo chake cha kuikumbatia Israel ni ushahidi, ukijumlisha na uvamizi wake kwa nchi za Afghanistan na Iraq.

eng: The only difference is, they want to do something about it.
swa: Tofauti pekee ni, wanataka kufanya kitu kurekebisha mambo.

eng: And that something includes killing Westerners, killing active supporters of the West, killing passive supporters of the West, killing anyone who is in the way of getting to the actives, passives and westerners and finally just killing everyone.
swa: Na kitu wanachotaka kukifanya ni pamoja na kuwaua raia wa Nchi za Magharibi, kuwaua wanaounga mkono vitendo vinavyofanywa na nchi za Magharibi, kuwaua wanaounga mkono kichini chini vitendo vya Magharibi, kumwua yeyote aliyekinyume na vitendo vya kuwaua washirika wa wazi na wa siri wa Magharibi, na mwishowe nia ni kumwua yeyote.

eng: Examples of the Downright Crazy Muslim are Osama Bin Laden, Ayman Al Zwahiri, all of Al Qaeda, the Taliban.
swa: Mifano ya Waislamu Wajinga Kabisa ni Osama Bin Laden, Ayman Al Zwahiri, Al Qaeda wote, na wanamgambo wa Taliban.

eng: Sami Shah is a stand up comedian, illustrator, graphic designer and columnist living in Western Australia.
swa: Sami Shah ni mchekeshaji, mchoraji, mbunifu wa picha na mwandishi wa safu anayeishi Magharibi mwa Australia.

eng: His work has been profiled in the New York Times, Comedy Central, NPR’s The World and Laughspin Magazine, and he has performed on the BBC Asian Network and for TEDx Melbourne.
swa: Kazi zake zimewahi kuonekana kwenye majarida kama New York Times, Comedy Central, NPR’s The World na Laughspin Magazine, na amefanya maonesho kwenye Mtandao wa Asia wa BBC na kwa TEDx Melbourne.

eng: Sami is the author of I, MIGRANT: A Comedian's Journey From Karachi to the Outback.
swa: Sami ni mwandishi wa MIE, MHAMIAJI: Safari ya Mchekeshaji Kutoka Karachi kwenda Nyikani.
