swa: Picha mnato ya video iliyowekwa kwenye mtandao wa YouTube.

swa: Kufikia katikati mwa mwezi Julai 2014, ukurasa wa Facebook Hapana kwa utalii wa ngono ulianzishwa, kwa lengo la kukuza uelewa kuhusu utalii wa ngono nchini Kolombia.

swa: Utalii wa ngono ni safari zinazohusisha vitendo vya gono, hususani na kahaba.

eng: The World Tourism Organization, a specialized agency of the United Nations, defines sex tourism as "trips organized from within the tourism sector, or from outside this sector but using its structures and networks, with the primary purpose of effecting a commercial sexual relationship by the tourist with residents at the destination".
swa: Shirika la Utalii Duniani , chombo maalum cha Umoja wa Mataifa, unatafsiri utalii wa ngono kama “safari zinazofanywa ndani ya sekta ya utalii au nje ya sekta hii lakini kwa kutumia muundo na mtandao wake, kwa lengo kuu la kuathiri kwa namna moja au nyingine uhusiano wa ngono za kibiashara kati ya mtalii na mkazi wa eneo analokwenda kulizuru ".

eng: When will Ebola news go 24/7?, asks a US/Canadian professor Crawford Kilian:
swa: Ni lini Habari za Ebola zitatangazwa kwa masaa 24 siku saba za wiki?, anauliza Profesa Crawford Kilian wa Marekani na Kanada:

eng: I have long been used to outbreak news dropping off on weekends.
swa: Nimezoea kusikia habari mpya zikisitishwa kutangazwa nyakati za wikiendi.

eng: The media, government agencies, and NGOs all knock off on Friday afternoon and show up again Monday morning.
swa: Vyombo vya habari, mashirika ya serikali, Asasi za Kiraia vyote vikiishia kutangaza habari siku ya Ijumaa mchana na kuibukia siku ya Jumapili asubuhi kwa mara nyingine.

eng: But after the last few weeks of Ebola, I'm losing patience with the folks who make a living covering the outbreak.
swa: Lakini baada ya majuma kadhaa ya Ebola, ninapoteza uvumilivu na jamaa wanaoishi kwa kutangaza habari za maradhi ya Ebola.

eng: Yes, good for them and the collective agreements that give them eight-hour days, weekends off, extended holidays, and excellent health benefits.
swa: Ndio, ni sawa kwao kwa makubaliano yao ya pamoja yanayowapa masaa manane kwa siku, bila kujumuisha wikiendi, siku za mapumziko na manufaa bora ya kiafya.

eng: But if Ebola is as unprecedented as Dr. Chan says it is, how about finding the money to pay those folks overtime so Ebola news carries on over the weekend (not to mention statutory holidays)?
swa: Lakini kama Ebola haikubaliki kama anavyosema Dk Chan, vipi kuhusu kutafuta fedha za kuwalipa hawa jamaa kutumia muda wa ziada ili habari za ebola ziendelee kutangazwa hata muda wa Wikiendi (bila kutaja siku za mapumziko)?

eng: Can you imagine news about Pearl Harbor waiting until some reporter sauntered in on the morning of Monday, December 8, 1941?
swa: Unaweza kuona mazingira ambayo habari za Pearl Harbor zinasubiri mpaka mwandishi mmoja aje na ahabari zake siku za Jumatatu, Desemba 8, 1941?

eng: Or JFK's death going unreported until the following Monday, November 25, 1963?
swa: Au habari za kifo cha JFK zisitanagzwe mpaka siku ya Jumatatu inayofuata ya Novemba 25, 1963?

eng: But the West African media, with a few exceptions, go into hibernation on Friday afternoons and revive sometime the following Monday.
swa: Lakini vyombo vya habari vya Afrika Magharibi, ukiacha vichache, vimekuwa vikipotea kuanzia siku ya Ijumaa mchana, na kuzinduka muda wowote siku za Jumatatu.

eng: So do WHO and the other major health agencies.
swa: Ndivyo yanavyofanya Mashirika kama WHO na mashirika mengine ya afya.

eng: I know very well that they've suffered budget cuts by governments that still think austerity is the road to recovery from the crash of 2008. Follow our in-depth coverage: The Struggle to #StopEbola in West Africa
swa: Ninajua vizuri sana kwamba wanahangaika na kukosekana kwa mafungu ya fedha kutoka serikalini na hivuo vinafikiri nidhamu ya matumizi ni njia pekee ya kukabiliana na mdodoro wa mwaka 2008.

eng: Highway Africa 2014 took place on 7-8 September, 2014 at Rhodes University, Grahamstown, South Africa.
swa: Mkutano wa Highway Africa 2014 ulifanyika kuanzia tarehe 7-8 Septemba, 2014 kwenye Chuo Kikuu cha Rhodes, Grahamstown, Afrika Kusini.

eng: The theme of the conference was Social Media – from the margins to the mainstream.
swa: Maudhui ya mkutano huo yalikuwa Mitandao ya Kijamii -kutoka pembezoni kwenda kwenda kwenye vyombo vikuu vy habari.

eng: Find images and conversations about the conference here.
swa: Angalia picha na mzungumzo kuhusiana na mkutano huo hapa.

eng: Initiated by several government agencies, the Philippine Traditional Knowledge Digital Library on Health (TKDL-Health) seeks to document and digitize indigenous health practices in the country.
swa: Ikiwa imeanzishwa na mamlaka kadhaa za kiserikali, Maktaba Dijitali ya Elimu ya Tiba za Jadi Ufilipino (TKDL-Health) inalenga kuweka kumbukumbu na kufanya masuala ya tiba za jadi kuwa za kidijitali nchini humo.

eng: The communities, characteristically living in the mountains or their fringes, have depended mostly on plants and other natural products from the forest to prevent or treat sickness.
swa: Jamii, ambazo nyingi ni zile za miliamni au majirani zao, zimekuwa zikitegemea miti na mazao mengine ya asili kutoka porini katika kujikinga au kujitibu magonjwa yao.

eng: But environmental degradation and the onslaught of lowland mainstream cultures now threaten their healing traditions.
swa: Lakini uharibifu wa mazingira na kushambuliwa vikali na tamaduni kuu za jamii zinazoishi mabondeni hivi sasa kunatishia mila hizo za tiba.

eng: Official logo for the papal visit to the Philippines in 2015The official logo and website related to the Philippine visit of Pope Francis in January 2015 have been unveiled already.
swa: Nembo rasmi ya ziara ya Papa mtakatifu nchini Ufilipino mwaka 2015 Nembo na tovuti rasmi inayohusiana na ziara ya Papa Francis nchini Ufilipino mwezi Januari 2015 tayari imezinduliwa.

eng: Pope Francis will visit Manila and Tacloban.
swa: Papa Francis atatembelea jiji la Manila ma Tacloban.

eng: Tacloban is the "ground zero" of the Typhoon Haiyan disaster which claimed the lives of more than 6,000 people in the Eastern Visayas region.
swa: Tacloban ndiko lilikotokea janga la Kimbunga cha Haiyan kilichochukua maisha ya watu 6,000 kwenye mkoa wa Visayas Kusini.

eng: Aside from Timor Leste, the Philippine is the only Catholic-dominated nation in Asia.
swa: Ukiachilia mambo Timor Leste, Ufilipino ni nchi pekee yenye wa-Katoliki wengi barani Asia.

eng: Protesters in Hong Kong are using umbrellas to shield themselves from tear gas.
swa: Waandamanaji jijini Hong Kong wanatumia miamvuli kujilinda na moshi wa mabomu ya machozi.

eng: Photo from Twitter @15MBcn_int
swa: Picha kutoka mtandao wa Twita @15MBcn_int

eng: Protesters demanding genuine democratic elections in Hong Kong were met with batons, tear gas and pepper spray during the second day of demonstrations in the city.
swa: Waandamanaji waonadai uchaguzi wenye demokrasia kamili jijini Hong Kong walikumbana na nguvu za dola, mabomu ya machozi na maji ya kuwasha wakati wa siku ya pili ya mandamano hayo jijii humo.

eng: Following clashes between Hong Kong police and student protesters on September 27, pro-democracy group Occupy Central with Love and Peace kickstarted a massive sit-in at 1:30 a.m. the following day to pressure China's government into withdrawing its requirement that candidates for Hong Kong's top leader get majority support from a largely pro-Beijing nominating committee.
swa: Kufuatia mapambano kati ya Polisi wa Hong Kong na waandamanaji wanfaunzi mnamo Septemba 27, maandamano ya kukaa yaliyofanyika katikati ya jiji kudai demokrasia yalianza saa 7:30 usiku siku iliyofuata kuishinikiza serikali ya China kuondoa dai kwamba mgombea wa uongozi wa juu kabisa Hong King lazima apate uungwaji wa walio wengi kutoka kwenye kamati ya uteuli ambao kimsingi inasimamia maslahi ya Beijing.

eng: Riot police began attempting to disperse protesters wielding batons and deploying tear gas and pepper spray beginning at 6 p.m. on September 28.
swa: Polisi wa kutuliza ghasia walianza kujaribu kuwatuliza waandamanaji waliokuwa wamejikinga na moshi wa mabomu ya machozi na maji ya kuwasha kuanzia saa 12 jioni tarehe 28 Septemba.

eng: Thousands of protesters were still in streets near the city's financial center confronting riot police by the time this article was published.
swa: Maelfu ya waandamanaji walikuwa bado mitaani kwenye eneo kuu la kiuchumi la jiji hilo wakipambana na polisi wa ghasia wakati makala hii ikichapishwa.

eng: Unverified accounts of police using rubber bullets to shoot at protesters have circulated on social media.
swa: Habari zisizothibitishwa za polisi kutumia risasi za mpira kuwatawanya waandamanaji zimeenea kwenye mitandao ya kijamii.

eng: Key protest organizers have urged protesters to retreat at around 10 p.m.
swa: Waandaaji wakuu wa maandamano hayo wamewasihi waandamanaji kurudi tena ifikapo saa 4 usiku.

eng: China has promised special administrative region Hong Kong, which enjoys certain autonomy from the mainland, a direct vote in the 2017 chief executive election, but pro-democracy activists maintain the nominating committee undermines the people's right to choose their leader.
swa: China imeuahidi mkoa maalum wa kiutawala wa Hong Kong, ambao una uhuru wa aina fulani kutoka serikali kuu, uwezo wa moja kw amoja kupiga kura kwenye uchaguzi wa 2017 kmchagua kiongozi mkuu wa jimbo hilo, lakini wanaharakati wa demokrasia wanashikilia msimamo wao kwamba kamati ya uteuzi inapunguza haki za watu kumchagua kiongozi wao.

eng: Hong Kong police called the sit-in illegal and blocked roads and pathways leading to the government headquarters.
swa: Polisi wa Hong Kong waliyatangaza maandamano hayo ya kukaa kuwa batili na walifunga barabara na njia zinazoelekea kwenye makao makuu ya serikali.

eng: More and more people arrived and scattered around Admiralty and Central districts as they attempted to reach the government headquarters by walking pass the Harcourt and Connaught Highway.
swa: Polisi wengi zaidi waliwasili na kutawanywa kwenye wilaya za Admiralty na Kati wakati waandamanaji walipojaribu kwenda zilipo ofisi za kiutawala kwa kutembea kupitia barabara za Harcourt na Connaught.

eng: Eventually the two main roads at the center of the financial district were blocked at around 3 p.m.
swa: Mwisho wake barabara hizo mbili zilizopo kwenye eneo la kiuchumi la jiji hilo zilifungwa mwendo wa saa 9 mchana.

eng: Chief Executive Leung Chun-ying held a press conference at 3:30 p.m. repeating his stand that election reform in Hong Kong has to be restricted by the framework set by Beijing and that the police would take action against illegal protests, in accordance with the law.
swa: Mtawala Mkuu wa Hong Kong Leung Chun-ying alifanya mkutano na waandishi wa habari saa 9:30 alasiri akirudia msimamo wake kwamba mabadiliko ya uchaguzi yatafanyika kwa muundo uliowekwa na Beijing na kwamba Polisi watachukua hatua kwa maandamano yaliyo kinyume cha sheria, kwa mujibu wa sheria.

eng: Thousands of protesters were surrounding the government headquarters at various spots in Admiralty and Central districts, blocking several roads.
swa: Maelfu ya waandamanaji walikuwa wamezunguka ofisi za serikali zilizopo kwenye maeneo mbalimbali ya wilaya za Admiralty na Kati, wakifunga baadhi ya barabara.

eng: Police raised an orange-colored warning sign, stating "disperse or we fire":
swa: Polisi waliinua bango la tahadhari lenye rangi ya machungwa, lililosema, “tawanyikeni, vinginevyo tunawapiga risasi”:

swa: Sijawahi kuona ghasia na tahadhari hii ya polisi hapa Hong Kong kwa waandamanaji “TAWANYIKENI VINGINEVYO TUNAWAPIGA RISASI’

eng: At 6 p.m., the riot police started firing tear gas.
swa: Saa 12 jioni, polisi wa kutuliza ghasia walianza kupiga mabomu ya kutoa machozi.

swa: Hii ni Hong Kong!!!

swa: Polisi wanamkamata mzee mwaandamanaji na kumnyunyuzia maji ya kuwasha usoni: kitendo cha kikatili namna gani

eng: Instead of escaping from the scene, many people dispersed and returned with better equipment, such as raincoats, gas masks and goggles:
swa: Badala ya kutoroka eneo hilo, watu wengi wanatawanyika na kurudi eneo hilo wakiwa na vifaa bora zaidi, kama vile makoti ya mvua, vifaa vya kujikinga na moshi wa mabomu na miwani ya kukinga macho:

swa: Lakini waandamanaji wamefunga lango la kuingilia ili kuwazuia plisi kuingia:

eng: In addition, the police instructed the metro company to shut down the Admiralty station in order to deploy more riot police to back up the crackdown.
swa: Wakijibu ghasia zinazofaywa na polisi, Shirikisho la Vyama wa Wanafunzi wa Chuko Kikuu lilitoa wito wa mgomo wa kuingia madarasani wiki hii.

eng: But protesters set up a barricade at the entrance of the subway to block police:
swa: Shirikisho la Vyama vya Wafanyakazi Hong Kong kimetoa wito wa mgomo wa wafanyakazi, Chama cha Walimu Hong Kong na Chama Kikuu cha Wafanyakazi wa Jamii wa Hong Kong nacho kitazindua mgomo wa walimu.

swa: Picha kwenye mtandao wa Flickr na Tim Pierce (CC BY 2.0).

eng: On September 5, the U.S. Department of Justice issued to the organization and Web hosting provider May First an inquiry about one of its members, Greece-based Center for Independent Media Athens, also known as Indymedia Athens.
swa: Mnamo Septemba 5, Wizara ya Sheria ya Marekani iliitaka shirika linaloshughulika na masuala ya kuhifadhi tovuti iitwayo May First kutoa taarifa za mmoja wa wateja wake, ambaye ni Kituo cha Ugiriki cha cha Uandishi Huru Athens, kinachofahamika kama Indymedia Athens.

eng: Founded in 2005, May First is a non-profit organization dedicated to provide cooperative Internet services, such as Web hosting to individuals and organizations.
swa: Likiwa limeanzishwa mwaka 2005, May First ni shirika lisilo la kibiashara linalojikita katika kutoa huduma za mtandao wa Intaneti, kama vile kuhifadhi tovuti za watu binafsi na mashirika.

eng: The data required by federal agents is specific information from the Indymedia Athens account, stored on May First servers.
swa: Taarifa zinazotakiwa na Idara ya Usalama ni habari maalum kutoka kwenye akaunti ya Indymedia Athens, iliyohifadhiwa kwenye vihifadhi takwimu (servers) za May First.

eng: In a statement, May First noted that the request could be interpreted as an attempt by the American government to help the Greek government.
swa: Katika tamko, May First ilibainisha kwamba dai hilo linaweza kutafsiriwa kama jaribio la serikali ya Marekani kuisaidia serikali ya Ugiriki.

eng: For now, lawyers with Electronic Frontier Foundation, who are representing May First, are in touch with the U.S. Attorney General.
swa: Kwa sasa, wanasheria wa Electronic Frontier Foundation, ambao wanaiwakilisha May First, wanawasiliana na Mwanasheria Mkuu wa Serikali ya Marekani.

eng: Upon publication of this piece, US officials had offered no explanation of their motives in requesting said data.
swa: Wakati wa kuchapishwa kwa habari hii, maafisa wa serikali wa Marekani hawajatoa maelezo yoyote kuhusu malengo hasa ya takwimu zinazodaiwa.

eng: There are millions of them.
swa: Wapo mamilioni ya watu kama hawa.

eng: They live scattered across our continent, Europe.
swa: Wanaishi maeneo mbalimbali katika bara letu la Ulaya.

eng: They are all categorised as immigrants.
swa: Wote hawa, wamewekwa katika kundi la wahamiaji.

eng: Despite this, none of them have the same story. Each one is different from the other.
swa: Pamoja na hali hii, kila mmoja ana simulizi yake iliyo tofuti na ya wengine.

eng: Therefore, if we wanted to tell everyone's life story, it would take thousands of books.
swa: Kwa maana hii, kama tungetaka kuelezea historia ya maisha ya kila mmoja, ingelitulazimu kuandaa maelfu ya vitabu.

eng: However, there is an online project that helps to establish contact with these people who are generically labelled as migrants.
swa: Hata hivyo, kuna mradi wa mtandaoni unaosaidia kupata mawasiliano na watu hawa ambao kiujumla wanatambulika kama wahamiaji.

eng: It helps to overcome prejudices and stereotypes and improve people's knowledge about them.
swa: Unasaidia kukabiliana na na unyanyasaji na udhalilishaji ikiwa ni pamoja na kuwaongezea watu ufahamu zaidi kuhusiana na watu hao.

eng: Surprising Europe belongs to them, an open book, written by many people and supported by pictures and videos.
swa: Surprising Europe ni kwa ajili yao, ni kitabu kilicho huru, kilichoandikwa na watu wengi na kilichohanikizwa kwa picha na video.

eng: Personal stories, successes, failures and hopes are "written" on this platform.
swa: Simulizi binafsi za watu, mafanikio, kukosa mafaninikio na matumaini, vyote "vinaandikwa" katika jukwaa hili.

eng: It is the immigrants who tell their story in first person.
swa: Ni wahamiaji wenyewe ndio wanaoelezea simulizi zao.

eng: It is surprising when you find out how much strength is necessary to overcome language barriers, bureaucracy, and relationships.
swa: Inashangaza pale unapobaini ni ujasiri kiasi unaotakiwa katika kukabiliana na changamoto ya lugha, urasimu pamoja na mahusiano.

eng: It is surprising when you find out how many would like to go home and cannot.
swa: Inashangaza pale unapoabaini kuna wengi wanaotaka kurudi makwao lakini wanashindwa.

eng: Many go back and tell their friends: it is better if we build our future here, in our land.
swa: Wengi wanarudi nyumbani na kuwaambia marafiki zao: ni bora kuujengea mustakabali wa maisha yetu tukiwa nchini mwetu.

eng: It is surprising when this message is sent: better poor but free.
swa: Inashangaza pale ujumbe huu unaposambazwa: ni bora kuwa masikini lakini mtu awe huru.

eng: It is surprising when you find out that even in Europe there are poor people and when someone admits that the old continent is not the paradise they dreamed of.
swa: Inashangaza pale unapogundua kuwa kumbe hata Ulaya kuna watu masikini na hata pale mtu atakaposhuhudia kuwa bara hili la mda mrefu siyo pepo waliyokuwa wakiiwazia.

eng: And it is surprising when, on the contrary, someone sees their dream come true, those who succeed through music, those who build a career in a factory, those who study and set up a freelance profession.
swa: Na pia, inashangaza, kwa upande mwingine, pale mtu anapoona kuwa ndoto zake zimekamilika, And it is surprising when, on the contrary, someone sees their dream come true, wale waliofaninikwa kupia mziki, wale waliojijengea ujuzi viwandani, wale waliosoma na kuweza kujiajiri.

eng: In this open space, the words are not abridged and experiences find a way of becoming a common, shared heritage.
swa: Katika jukwaa hili huru, simulizi hazifupishwi, na uzoefu unabaki kuwa ni urithi wa kila mmoja.

eng: This site highlights lives on the margins of society, but also successes.
swa: Tovuti hii itajumuisha simulizi za changamoto katika jamii na pia mafanikio.

eng: You have to enter without preconceptions, without imagining what you will find, as when meeting friends, where one topic leads to another.
swa: Unapaswa kujiunga na mtandao huu bila ya kuwa na mategemeo fulani, bila ya kukisia kile utakacho kikuta, kama jinsi ukutanavyo na marafiki, pale mada moja inavyopelekea kutokea kwa mada nyingine.

eng: The idea—a non-profit project—aims to document the experiences of legal but also illegal migration.
swa: Wazo hili la mradi usio wa kimaslahi umelenga kuweka kumbukumbu ya uhalisia wa hali kwa wahamiaji haramu na pia wale waishio kihalali.

eng: It was created by Witfilm Amsterdam and Ssuuna Goloob, who arrived in Europe from Uganda to see with his own eyes if what he had heard about our countries and how we live here was true.
swa: Mradi huu umebuniwa na Witfilm Amsterdam na Ssuuna Goloob, waliofika barani Ulaya kutoka Uganda ili kujionea wao wenyewe kama ni kweli kwa kile alichokuwa akikisikia kuhusiana na nchi zetu na jinsi tunavyoishi.

eng: A project that many believe in, judging by the sponsors: from Al Jazeera, to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Netherlands, to the International Organisation for Migration and the European Union Fund for repatriation.
swa: Mradi ambao wengi wanauamini, wakiupima kwa kuzingatia wafadhili wake: Kutoka Al Jazeera, hadi Wizara ya Mambo ya Nje ya Uholanzi, hadi Shirika la Kimataifa la Uhamiaji pamoja na Mfuko wa Umoja wa Ulaya wa Urudishaji wa Wahamiaji Makwao.

eng: It is no coincidence that the idea was born in Amsterdam, the capital of the Netherlands, as it is regarded as one of the cities with the largest number of nationalities present: 176 out of a total of 811,000 inhabitants (the metropolitan area on the other hand has a population of 1.6 million inhabitants).
swa: Haikuwa bahati tu kwa wazo hili kuibuliwa huko Amsterdam, mji mkuu wa Uholanzi, Hii ni kwa sababu jiji hili kwa sasa, linachukuliwa kuwa ni moja ya majiji yaliyo na idadi kubwa ya wakazi walio na utaifa tofauti: wakazi 176 kati ya jumla ya wakazi 811,000 (Kwa upande mwingine, eneo la mji mkuu lina wakazi milioni 1.6).

eng: The website is divided into six categories: Leaving for Europe, Life in Europe, Short on luck, Getting down to work, Going back, Music.
swa: Tovuti hii imegawanywa katika makundi 6: Kwenda kuishi Ulaya, Maisha ya Ulaya, Short on luck, Kufanya Kazi, Kurudi Nyumbani, Mziki.

eng: A project within the project is some television series.
swa: Mradi ndani ya mradi ni aina fulani ya mfululizo wa vipindi vya runinga.

eng: Each one different but related by some themes.
swa: Kila kipindi kikiwa ni tofauti na kingine lakini vikiwa vinafanana kwa kwa maudhui.

eng: Stories of desperation, but also stories that are a source of inspiration, hope and creativity.
swa: Simulizi za kukata tamaa, lakini pia, simulizi amabazo zinaweza kuibua hamasa, tumaini na ubunifu.

eng: The dark side and the triumphant side.
swa: Upande wa taabu na upande wa mafanikio.

eng: The fight, sometimes defeat, often success.
swa: Mapambano, wakati mwingine makabiliano, mafaniniko mara nyingi.

eng: The protagonists themselves worked on the television series, which has already been broadcast on Al Jazeera and on Dutch public television.
swa: Wahusika halisi ndio waliojitokeza katika mfululizo wa makala hizi za runinga ambazo zimeshaoneshwa Al Jazeera na pia katika runinga ya Taifa ya Uholanzi.

eng: In this case as well they try to avoid filters, interpretations and judgments.
swa: Kwa utaratibu huu, wanajaribu pia kuepukana na vikwazo vya mitandaoni, tafsiri pamoja na mitazamo ya watu.

eng: The project also has a hymn, "Surprising Europe".
swa: Mradi huu pia una wimbo maalum, "Surprising Europe".

eng: It is sung by Annie, who was born in Italy, with Liberian origins.
swa: Umeimbwa na Annie, ambaye ni mzaliwa wa nchini Italia, akiwa na asili ya nchini Liberia.

eng: And it is to Liberia that she would like to return.
swa: Mwanadada huyu angependa kurudi nchini Liberia.

eng: To get to know her land and maybe live there.
swa: Anataka arudi huko kwa lengo la kuiona nchi yake au labda kuishi huko.

eng: Annie is now part of a "mixed" Afro band, Pepe Soup.
swa: Kwa sasa, Annie ni miongoni mwa wanakikundi "mchanganyiko" wa Bendi ya Afro, Pepe Soup.

eng: They want to convey a message to the world: UNITE!
swa: Wanataka kuufikishia ulimwengu ujumbe: UNGANENI!

eng: Surprising Europe belongs to them, the immigrants, but it also belongs to anyone who wants to better understand and get to know these immigrants.
swa: Surprising Europe ni ya wahamiaji, lakini pia, inamhusu mwingine yeyote apendaye kupata ufahamu wa kutosha na kuwafahamu hawa wahamiaji.

eng: And to go a little deeper into their lives.
swa: Na ngalao kufahamu kwa undani zaidi kuhusu maisha yao.

eng: Protest March in UK demanding to eradicate the centuries-old caste system that exists on the Indian sub continent and amongst expatriate communities.
swa: Maandamano nchini Uingereza kudai kufutwa kwa mfumo wa kuoana kimatabaka uliodumu karne nzima na unaendelea Uhindini pamoja na kwenye jamii nyingine.

eng: Image by Paul Davey.
swa: Picha na Paul Davey.

eng: Copyright Demotix (19/10/2013)
swa: Haki miliki Demotix (19/10/2013)

eng: Karthik Shashidhar, a freelance management consultant and data scientist, shares interesting statistics from the National Family Health Survey.
swa: Karthik Shashidhar, mshauri huru wa utawala na mwanasayansi wa takwimu, anaonesha takwimu kutoka kwenye utafiti wa kitaifa wa Afya ya Familia.

eng: Shashidhar discusses the percentage of women in India who are married to someone of their own caste. The caste system in India is based on an order of (predominantly) endogamous groups rendering marriage out of caste deplored by the society.
swa: Shashidhar anajadili idadi ya wanawake nchini India ambao wameolewa na watu wenye tabia lao wenyewe.Mfumo wa kimatabaka wa kihindi nchini India unaongozwa na amri ya makundi ya makundi ya kuoana wenyewe kwa wenyewe.

eng: Most of the marriage out of caste is out of love and defying the socio-cultural norms.
swa: Ndoa nje ya asili hiyo huchukuliwa kuwa kuvunja mila na desturi za ki-Hindi.

eng: The survey, which was carried out in all states in India, asked “ever-married” women whether they were married to someone from the same caste, or to someone from a higher caste, or to someone from a lower caste.
swa: Utafiti huo, ambao ulifanywa kwenye majimbo yote nchini India, uliuliza wanawake 'waliowahi kuolewa' ikiwa waliolewa na watu wa familia zao wenyewe au mtu wa tabaka la juu, au mtu wa tabaka la chini.

eng: The result shows that the national average for the percentage of women who are married to someone of their own caste is 89%.
swa: Matokeo yalionesha kwamba wastani wa taifa kwa idadi ya wanawake wanaoolewa na watu wa tabaka lao wenyewe ni 89%.

eng: The first Africa Web Festival will take place in Abidjan, Côte D'Ivoire (November 24-26).
swa: Tamasha la kwanza la Africa Web Festival litafanyika jijini Abidjan, Côte D'Ivoire (Novemba 24-26).

eng: The festival will give the opportunity to any designers in Africa to participate in a contest (registrations are open until October 12)
swa: Tamasha hilo litawapa fursa wabunifu wa Afrika kushiriki kwenye mashindano (zoezi la kujiandikisha liko wazi mpaka Oktoba 12)

eng: Are you a journalist, a web developer, a web tv or podcast producer?
swa: Wewe ni mwandishi wa habari, muundaji wa tovuti, mtayarishaji wa vipindi vya runinga mtandaoni au podikasti?

eng: Are you creative, innovative and have an idea or a project in mind?
swa: Je, wewe ni mbunifu, mgunduzi na una wazo au mradi kichwani mwako?

eng: Join the first Web Africa Festival in one of the six competition categories: documentary, tourism, fiction, entertainment, education, advertising and tourism.
swa: Ungana na tamasha la kwanza la Web Africa Festival kwenye moja wapo ya makundi yafuatayo ya ushindani: dokumentari, utalii, masimulizi, burudani, elimu na matangazo.

eng: The Africa Festival Web is a platform for exchanges between experts, web enthusiasts and novices from around the world, where the current state of the affairs in the field of web development will be discussed.
swa: Africa Festival Web ni jukwaa la kubadilishana uzoefu miongoni mwa wataalam, wapenda mtandao na watu wajifunzao mambo mapya kutoka duniani kote, ambako hali ya sasa ya mambo kwenye ukuzaji wa mtandao itajadiliwa.

eng: It will also be the place to debate on the hopes and challenges of internet in Africa, so that the continent can take its rightful place in the digital world.
swa: Kutakuwa na nafasi ya mjadala kuhusu matumaini na changamoto zinazokabili mtandao wa intaneti barani afrika, ili bara liweze kuchukua nafasi yake kwenye ulimwengu wa kidijitali.

eng: More than 500 dead wild water birds appeared in the lake areas of Inner Mongolia since this summer as a result of water pollution.
swa: Zaidi ya ndege wa majini 500 wameonekana wakiwa wamekufa katika eneo la maziwa nchini Mongolia tangu kuanza kwa majira ya kipindi cha joto kutokana na maji kuchafuliwa.

eng: The poisonous water, as reported by local herdsmen, came from factories from a nearby eco-industrial area.
swa: Maji hayo machafu, kama ilivyotaarifiwa na wafugaji wa maeneo hayo, maji haya yaliyochanganyikana na taka sumu yalitoka katika eneo la viwanda.

eng: Annie Lee from China Hush wrote a photo feature on the situation.
swa: Annie Lee kutoka tovuti ya China Hush aliandika habari picha ya hali halisi ya tukio hili.

eng: The body of a victim of Ebola virus is seen covered with a sheet at the back of a truck in Monrovia, Liberia -Public Domain
swa: Mwili wa mtu aliyefariki kwa ugonjwa wa ebola ukiwa umefunikwa kwa shuka ukiwa umepakizwa katika gari huko Monrovia, Liberia -Public Domain

eng: The Press Union of Liberia is concerned about the threat to freedom of information as a result of the actions taken by the government to limit the expansion of the Ebola virus.
swa: Umoja wa wanahabari wa Liberia wasikitishwa na hali ya kukosekana kwa uhuru wa upashanaji habari kufuatia hatua ya serikali ya kuzuia kuenea kwa virusi vya ebola.

eng: The union wrote a letter to the Minister of Justice to draw his attention to the challenges media workers are currently facing.
swa: Umoja huu ulimwandikia barua Waziri wa sheria kumtaka kutafakari upya madhila wanayokabiliana nayo waandishi wa vyombo vya habari.

eng: Here is an excerpt of the letter:
swa: Ufuatao ni muhtasari wa barua yenyewe:

eng: The Press Union of Liberia’s attention is specifically drawn to several circumstances that do not only restrain journalists in their obligation to seek out and share useful news and information with the public, but significantly threaten even media participation in the global fight against Ebola.
swa: Lengo la Umoja wa Vyombo vya habari wa Liberia umejikita haswa katika mambo ambayo siyo tu yanawakwamisha waandishi wa habari katika jukumu lao la kutafuta na kusambaza habari na taarifa muhimu kwa jamii, lakini pia, bila shaka yoyote, jambo jingine ni hili la kuhatarisha ushiriki wa vyombo vya habari katika vita ya kidunia ya kukabiliana na ugonjwa wa ebola.

eng: By all accounts, the media space in Liberia has been a significant partner in the fight to strengthen awareness in our society about the impact and challenges of the epidemic.
swa: Ni dhahiri kuwa, tasnia ya habari nchini Liberia imekuwa moja ya mshiriki mkuu katika harakati za kutoa elimu kwa jamii kuhusiana na madhara na changamoto zitokanazo na ugonjwa huu wa kuambukiza.

eng: Notwithstanding the loss of revenue due to the emergency nature of the epidemic and the effect on general life, the media has remained committed to this fight.
swa: Licha ya kupoteza mapato kufuatia mlipuko wa kushtukiza wa ugonjwa huu pamoja na athari zinazokabili maisha ya kila siku, vyombo vya habari vimeendelea kuwa mstari wa mbele katika mapambano dhidi ya ugonjwa huu.

eng: Unfortunately, several actions against media by government actors, especially during these times, have simply given room to growing skepticism about the disease, and further exacerbating the denials within the community. We think this is unfair and improper.
swa: Kwa bahati mbaya, vikwazo kadhaa kutoka kwa watendaji wa serikali dhidi ya vyombo vya habari, hususani katika kipindi hiki, umetoa mwanya wa kuongezeka kwa hali ya sintofahamu kuhusiana na ugonjwa huu, na pia kuendelea kuongeza hali ya jamii kutokuamini uwepo wa ugojwa huu.

eng: Follow our in-depth coverage: The Struggle to #StopEbola in West Africa
swa: Tunaamini kuwa hali hii haileti usawa na wala siyo sahihi.

eng: As the UN launchs its peace keeping mission with the arrival of 1,500 troops in the Central African Republic (CAR), a few observers were wondering why it took so long given the extent of the casualties.
swa: Wakati Umoja wa Mataifa ukizindua mpango wake wa kulinda amani kwa kutuma wanajeshi 1,500 nchini Jamhuri ya Afrika ya Kati, wafuatiliaji wachache wanajiuliza ni kwa nini uamuzi huu ulichukua muda mrefu pamoja na kuwepo kwa wahanga wengi wa machafuko.

eng: Les Cercles nationaux de Réflexion sur la Jeunesse (CNRJ) is an NGO in Bangui, CAR that strives to build the foundation for sustainable peace in the country in partnership with the University of Bangui.
swa: Les Cercles nationaux de Réflexion sur la Jeunesse (CNRJ) ni shirika lisilo la kiserikali mjini Bangui , Jamhuri ya Afrika ya Kati, linalojibidisha katika kuimarisha msingi wa amani ya kudumu nchini humo kwa kushirikiana na Chuo Kikuu cha Bangui.

eng: Here is a video that illustrates the work in process :
swa: Ifuatayo ni video inayoonesha kwa kina kile kinachoendelea katika mkakati huu:

eng: On September 19, 1985, the center, South and West regions of Mexico, in particular the Federal District, were struck by a powerful earthquake, considered the most lethal in Mexican written history.
swa: Mnamo Septemba 19, 1985, kwenye maeneo ya kati, Kusini na Magharibi mwa Mexico, hususani kwenye Wilaya ya Shirikisho, yalikumbwa na tetemeko kubwa, linalosemekana kuwa baya zaidi katika historia ya Mexico inayojulikana.

eng: Conmemorating the event 29 year later, the Secretary for Civil Protection of Federal District organized an earthquake drill, for the population to know how to act in these events.
swa: Wakikumbuka miaka 29 tangu tukio hilo litokee, Katibu wa Ulinzi wa raia wa Wilaya ya Shirikisho aliandaa mafunzo ya tetemeko, kwa ajili ya kuwasaidia watu kujua namna ya kuchukua hatua yanapotokea matukio kama haya.

eng: The people participated massively, in the capital and in other cities of the country.
swa: Watu walishiriki kwa kiasi kikubwa, katika jiji kuu la nchi hiyo pamoja na majiji mengine.

eng: We carried out successfully the evacuation due to earthquake, remembering what happened in 1985 in Mexico City.
swa: Tulifanya mazoezi ya uokoaji katika tukio ya tetemeko, tukikumbuka kile kilichotokea mwaka 1985 huko Mexico City.

eng: An estimated of 17,000 buildings were evacuated during the drill.
swa: Majengo yanayokadiriwa kuwa 17,000 yalifanyiwa uokozi wakati wa mafunzo hao.

eng: Rolando Zapata's Yucatán government has carried out historic drill in the Palace.
swa: Serikali ya Yucatán inayoongozwa na Rolando Zapata iliendesha mafunzo hayo kwenye ikulu ya nchi hiyo.

eng: Tlalnepantla joins the megaearthquake driill organized in the State of Mexico.
swa: Tlalnepantla anashiriki mafunzo makubwa ya kupambana na matukio ya tetemeko la ardhi yaliyoongzwa na na serikali ya Mexico.

eng: The drill is not only to honor the victims of the earthquake, it's also about society vs bureaucracy.
swa: Mafunzo hayo yalikuwa si tu kuwakumbuka wahanga wa tetemeko la ardhi, bali kushughulikia jamii na taratibu za kirasimu za uendeshaji wa shughuli za serikali.

eng: A screenshot of a YouTube video by Nour Media Center showing the rescue operation
swa: Picha iliyopigwa kutoka kwenye video ya YouTube na Kituo cha Habari cha Nour inayoonyesha operesheni ya uokoaji

eng: Good news from war-torn Syria is rare these days.
swa: Kwa siku za hivi karibuni, imekuwa nadra sana kusikia habari nzuri kutoka Syria, nchi iliyokumbwa na vita vikali.

eng: Just last week, the United Nations revised its death toll for the bloody conflict between forces loyal to President Bashar Al-Assad and the factions that are opposed to his rule to more than 191,000.
swa: Wiki iliyopita, Umoja wa Mataifa ulitoa taarifa mpya ya idadi ya vifo inayofikia zaidi ya watu 191,000. Vifo hivi vinatokana na ugomvi uliopo baina ya vikosi vya wanajeshi vinavyomtii Rais Bashar Al-Assad na vikundi vinavyopinga uongozi wake.

eng: UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Navi Pillay lamented that there is “no end in sight.”
swa: Mkuu wa Tume Kuu ya Umoja wa Mataifa ya Haki za Binadamu, Navi Pillay, alionesha kutoridhishwa na hali kwa kusema kuwa “hakuna dalili ya kusitisha vita.”

eng: With the situation so grim, let’s revisit one of those rare uplifting moments to come out of Syria in the last year.
swa: Hali ikiwa bado ni tete, hebu turejee mojawapo wa matukio haya nadra sana ya mwaka uliopita iliyowahi kutokea nchini Syria.

eng: To those who don't believe in miracles, here is one.
swa: Kwa wale wasioamini katika miujiza, huu hapa ni mmoja.

eng: Ghina is alive again after she was pulled from under the rubble.
swa: Ghina ni mzima tena mara baada ya kuokolewa kutoka chini ya kifusi.

eng: The warplanes shell the buildings, but human beings and children are the victims.
swa: Ndege za kivita zinalipua majengo, lakini watu na watoto wadogo ndio waathirika wakubwa.

eng: Ghina lost her mother when they were buried under the rubble due to shelling.
swa: Ghina alimpoteza mama yake kwa kufukiwa kwenye kifusi kufuatia nyumba yao kulipuliwa kwa mabomu.

eng: Ghina was lucky, but her mother wasn't.
swa: Ghina alikuwa na bahati, tofauti na mama yake, ambaye bahati haikuwa kwake.

eng: Now Ghina lives with her father and six siblings in their displaced house that lacks the minimum necessities of life.
swa: Kwa sasa Ghina anaishi na baba pamoja na ndugu zake 6 katika nyumba iliyo na upungufu mkubwa wa mahitaji muhimu ya maisha.

eng: Ghina is one of thousands of Syrian children who are paying a heavy price in the civil war, now in its third year.
swa: Ghina ni mmoja wa maelfu ya watoto Wasyria wanaokabiliana na madhara makubwa yatokanayo na vita vya wenyewe kwa wenyewe, ikiwa katika mwaka wake wa tatu sasa.

eng: More than 191,000 people have died in the bloody conflict for control of Syria between forces loyal to President Bashar Al-Assad and the factions that are opposed to his rule, who first rose up during the wave of Arab Spring demonstrations across the region.
swa: Zaidi ya watu 191,000 wameshapoteza maisha yao katika ugomvi unaohusisha umwagaji damu wa kugombania kuiongoza nchi ya Syria, ugomvi uliopo baina ya vikosi vya wanajeshi vinavyomtii Rais Bashar Al-Assad na vikundi vinavyopinga uongozi wake. Ugomvi huu uliibuka kwa mara ya kwanza wakati wa vuguvugu la maandamano ya Waarabu katika eneo hilo.

eng: Ghina was a victim of the crude barrel bombs that the government has dropped on civilian areas despite international condemnation.

eng: One person has been confirmed dead, nearly fifty climbers are severely injured, and ten people are missing after Mount Ontake (御嶽山, Ontake-san), a popular climbing spot in central Japan, erupted for the first time in five years.
swa: Mtu mmoja amethibitika kufariki dunia , na takribani wakwea mlima wengine hamsini wamejeruhiwa, na wengine kumi hawajulikani walipo baada ya Mlima Ontake (御嶽山), eneo maarufu la ukweaji wa milima katikati ya Japan, umelipuka kwa mara ya kwanza baada ya miaka mitano.

eng: News coverage shows billowing clouds of ash, and a large climbing lodge at the top of the mountain covered in grey cinder.
swa: Habari za tukio hilo zinaonesha wingu zito la majivu, na sehemu ya juu kwenye kilele cha mlima huo ikiwa imefunikiwa na tope zito la kijivu.

eng: Search for Ontake on Twitter to keep updated on this developing story.

eng: At 3,067 m, Mount Ontake is the second-tallest volcano in Japan after Mount Fuji.
swa: Mlima Ontake wenye urefu wa meta 3,067 , ni mlima wenye volkano, wa pili kwa urefu nchini Japani baada ya Mlima Fuji.

eng: It's located in Gifu, close to the large city of Nagoya in central Japan, and is a popular hiking destination in summer and early fall.
swa: Unapatikana kwenye eneo la Gifu, karibu na jiji kubwa la Nagoya katikati ya Japani, na ni maarufu kwa upandaji mlima hasa nyakati za majira ya joto na kipupwe.

eng: Due to the many missing and wounded, many people are looking for updates on the status and whereabouts of friends and loved ones caught on the mountain during the eruption.
swa: Kwa sababu ya kukosekana kwa watu wengi na wengineo kujeruhiwa, watu wengi wanatafuta habari kuhusu hali na maendeleo ya marafiki na wapenzi wao waliokwama kwenye mlima huo wakati wa mlipuko.

swa: Wimbo wa Zen na video yake iliyoandaliwa kwa utadi inarejea moja kwa moja hali tete ya uhuru wa kujieleza na kujengeka kwa matabaka ya kijamii nchini Macedonia, huku sauti na picha vikirejea kazi za mchekeshaji wa Kimarekani George Carlin na mwandishi wa vitabu wa Uingereza George Orwell.

eng: The music video received critical acclaim and was selected the best video of 2013 by the jury of popular annual manifestation Zlatna Buba Mara.
swa: Video ya wimbo wake imesifika sana na ilichaguliwa kuwa wimbo bora wa video wa mwaka 2013 na majaji wa maonesho maarufu ya mwaka yanayoitwa Zlatna Buba Mara.

eng: Very few people have been able to see, however, as it has been completely absent from mainstream Macedonian media.
swa: Watu wachache wameweza kuuona, hata hivyo, kwa sababu haujapata nafasi kabisa kwenye vyombo vikuu vya habari vya Macedonia.

eng: The artist's performing career has also come to a near stop and he now rarely appears at public events.
swa: Shughuli za maonesho ya muziki ya msanii huyo zimekuwa zikisua sua na kwa sasa haonekani sana wenye matukio ya hadharani.

swa: Waandamanaji wakitumia miamvuli kujikinga na moshi wa mabomu ya machozi.

eng: Can an umbrella be used as a tool to fight for democracy?
swa: Je, mwamvuli unaweza kutumiwa kama kifaa cha kupigania demokrasia?

eng: Absolutely.
swa: Ndio.

eng: In Hong Kong, peaceful demonstrators demanding genuine democratic elections are using umbrellas to shield themselves from pepper spray and tear gas and to to keep them from getting wet if the police deploys water cannons.
swa: Nchini Hong Kong, waandamanaji wa amani wanaodai uchaguzi huru wa kidemokrasia halisi wanatumia miamvuli kujilinda na mabomu na kujizuia kulowa na maji ya washawasha kutoka kwa polisi.

eng: A striking image taken during the massive sit-in near government headquarters on September 28 showed crowds upon crowds of protesters holding umbrellas in a variety of colors, contrasting sharply with the police's riot gear.
swa: Picha ya kuvutia iliyopigwa wakati wa maandamano ya kukaa karibu na makao makuu ya serikali mnamo Septemba 28 iliwaonesha umati wa watu waliokuwa wakiandamana wakiwa wamebeba miamvuli yenye rangi tofauti, ikitofautiana sana na mavazi ya polisi wa kuzuia fujo.

eng: Carol Chan designed the poster for the "umbrella movement" in Hong Kong.
swa: Carol Chan alibuni bango la “Vugu vugu la Miamvuli” nchini Hong Kong.

eng: It said "Taiwan has sun flower movement, Hong Kong has sunshade movement".
swa: Linasema, “Taiwani ina vugu vugu la alizeti, Hong Kong ina vugu vugu la kivuli”

eng: Foreign media have dubbed the peaceful protest the "umbrella revolution".
swa: Vyombo vya habari vya kigeni vimeyapa maandamano hayo ya amani jina la utani “mapinduzi ya miamvuli”.

eng: The Facebook group "Hong Kong Democracy Now" rectified the title to "Umbrella Movement" and wrote a explanatory note on it:
swa: Kundi la mtandao wa Facebook, “Demokrasia ya Hong Kong Sasa” lilibadili jina la kundi lao kuwa “Vugu Vugu la Miamvuli” na kuandika ujumbe wa maelezo kwenye kundi hilo:

eng: Foreign media has titled this movement the "Umbrella Revolution."
swa: Vyombo vya habari vya kigeni vimeyaita maandamano haya kuwa “Mapinduzi ya Miamvuli”.

eng: This is hardly a revolution.
swa: Haya sio mapinduzi kwa maana halisi.

eng: Umbrella Movement is a more suitable title in this context.
swa: “Vugu vugu la Miamvuli’ ni jina sahihi kwa mukhtadha huu.

eng: The only "weapons" we have, at most, are the umbrellas we always carry in our bags for the unpredictable weather.
swa: “Silaha” pekee tulizonazo, mara nyingi, ni miamvuli tunayoibeba kwenye mabegi yetu kwa ajili ya kukabiliana na hali ya hewa isiyotabirika.

eng: Hongkongers wish for nothing but stability.
swa: Wananchi wa Hong Kong hawahitaji kingine chochote isipokuwa utengamano.

eng: However, as much as we cannot see through the cloudy skies, we do not wish to be stormed upon.
swa: Hata hivyo, kwa namna ile ile tusivyoweza kuona kupitia kwenye wingu zito angani, hatutamani kupatwa dhoruba.

eng: Umbrella Movement represents a mellow but determined campaign: In the face of gale and storm, we will never back down!
swa:
Vugu vugu la Miamvuli’ linawakilisha kampeni nyepesi lakini iliyodhamiriwa sana: Katikati ya dhoruba, hatutarudi nyuma!
The sit-in, called Occupy Central, demands that Beijing withdraw the framework it has imposed on the election of Hong Kong's top leader, called the chief executive, which requires those who want to run for the office to get majority support from a nominating committee stacked with pro-Beijing (and therefore pro-Chinese Communist Party) members. 	Maandamano ya kukaa, yanayoitwa Occupy Central, yanadai kuwa Beijing ijitole kwenye mpango wake wa kuingilia uchaguzi wa mtawala wa juu kabisa wa Hong Kong, anayeitwa kiongozi mkuu, ambao unamtaka yeyote anayegombea madaraka apate uungwaji mkono na walio wengi kutoka kwenye kamati ya uteuzi iliyojaa mashabiki wa Beijing (ambao ni watu wenye mrengo wa chama cha Kikomunisti cha China).
The sit-in protests spread from the financial district in Admiralty to the commercial district in Causeway Bay and Mongkok.	Maandamano ya kukaa yameenea kuanzia wilaya ya kiuchumi ya Admiralty mpaka wilaya ya kibiashara kwenye ghuba ya Causeway Bay na Mongkok.
Traffic in Hong Kong Island has remained paralyzed throughout the day of September 29.	Idadi kubw aya watu kwenye kisiwa cha Hong Kong imeendelea kuwepo mtaani siku nzima ya Septemba 29.
Beijing mouthpiece Global Times ran an opinion piece on Occupy Central, which began on September 28, accusing the movement of ruining Hong Kong's image. 	Gazeti linaloisemea Beijing , Global Times lilikuwa nasehemu ya maoni kuhusu maandamano hayo ya Occupy Central, yaliyoanza Septemba 28, likilituhumu vuguvugu hilo kwa kuchafua sura ya Hong Kong.
Are umbrellas really more damaging to the city's image than armed police holding huge tear gas cannons?	Hivi kweli miamuvuli inaharatibu sura ya jiji kuliko polisi waliobeba silaha na mabomu ya kutoa machozi?
Screen capture from local Television - TVB. Follow our in-depth coverage: Hong Kong's Umbrella Revolution	Picha ya mnato iliyopigwa kwenye runinga ya TVB.
	
Someone sure wanted people to know that he was thankful for Togolese President Faure Gnassingbé generosity.	Mtu mmoja alitaka watu wajue kwamba alikuwa na shukrani kwa ukarimu wa Rais wa Togo Faure Gnassingbé.
This week, a giant billboard was raised in Lomé, Togo that praised the president's action in favor of providing lunch for school children. 	Wiki hii, bango kubwa liliwekwa jijini Lomé, Togo kusifia kitendo cha Rais kutoa chakula cha mchana kwa watoto.
Togolese citizens were taken aback by the message and its exuberance.	Raia wa Togo waliguswa na kuvutiwa na ujumbe huo.
They took to twitter to poke fun at the Billboard and create the hashtag #merciPapaFaure (Thank you Daddy Faure).	Waliingia kwenye mtandao wa Twita kuchekeshana kuhusiana na bango hilo na kutengeneza alama habari #merciPapaFaure (Asante sana Baba Faure).
OK, how about some fun with the hashtag #mercipapaFaure ? 	Sawa, vipi cheka kidogo na alama habari #mercipapaFaure ?
The photo above has been shared widely on twitter.	Picha hiyo juu imesambaa mno kwenye mtandao wa Twita.
Adzima provides some background on the state of the affair for the Togolese children at school.	Adzima anatoa maelezo kidogo kuhusu hali ya mambo ilivyo kwa watoto wa Togoshuleni.
	
Flooding in Niamey in Niger - Public Domain	Mafuriko mjini Niamey, nchini Niger - Miliki ya Umma
Heavy rains and flooding in Niger have killed 12 people and left thousands without homes.	Mvua kubwa na mafuriko nchini Niger yamewaua watu 12 na kuacha maelfu bila makazi.
Rivers in Niamey and the extended regions have risen and destroyed thousands of houses.	Mito katika Niamey na maeneo ya karibu imefurika na kuharibu maelfu ya nyumba.
In the region, land degradation and cultivation of marginal land increase the risk that extreme events can develop into natural disasters. 	Katika kanda, uharibifu wa ardhi na kilimo pembezoni mwa ardhi huzidisha hatari ya kwamba matukio yaliyokithiri yanaweza kubadilika kuwa maafa ya asili.
Some solutions for flood preparedness were being implemented by national authorities :	Baadhi ya masuluhisho ya kujiandaa dhidi ya mafuriko yalikuwa yanatekelezwa na mamlaka za kitaifa:
ANADIA Niger aims to develop methodologies and tools to assess flood risk, to support planning at different decision making levels, to increase the resilience of local communities and to develop a greater capacity for forecasting and response. 	ANADIA Niger ina malengo ya kuendeleza mbinu na zana za kutathmini hatari ya mafuriko, kutegemeza mipango kwenye viwango tofauti vya uamuzi, kuzidisha ujasiri wa jamii, na kuendeleza uwezo mkubwa zaidi wa kutabiri na kuitikia.
In this context, the development of a floods database will contribute to a more effective decision-making. 	Kwenye muktadha huu, uundaji wa hifadhidata ya mafuriko utachangia katika uamuzi wenye ufanisi mkubwa zaidi.
	
Up until a few weeks ago, Maryam Al Khawajah and Alaa Abd El Fattah were on hunger strike and in jail. 	Mpaka majuma machache yaliyopita, Maryam Al Khawajah na Alaa Abd El Fattah walikuwa kwenye mgomo wa njaa gerezani.
Hashtags demanding their release from prison in Bahrain and Egypt were trending on Twitter.	Alama ishara zinazodai kuachiliwa kwao huru kutoka kwenye magereza ya Bahrain na Misri zilitawala mtandao wa Twita.
These prominent activists join us on this episode of GV Face from the freedom of their homes, but their struggle is far from over. 	Wanaharakati hawa maarufu wanaungana nasi kwenye toleo la wiki hii la GV Face wakiwa huru, lakini mapambano yao hayana dalili ya kumalizika.
Maryam is currently in Copenhagen, unable to see her father, a leading Bahrain activist who has been behind bars and on hunger strike twice since 2011. 	Maryam kwa sasa yuko Copenhagen, hana nafasi ya kumwona baba yake, ni mwanaharakati wa Bahrain aliyekuwa kifungoni akiongoza mgomo wa kula mara mbili tangu mwaka 2011.
In Egypt, Alaa was released on bail shortly after he ended his 40 days hunger strike in jail a few weeks ago. 	Nchini Misri, Alaa alitolewa kwa dhamana muda mfupi baada ya kumaliza mgomo wake wa kula uliodumu kwa siku 40 na kumalizika majuma kadhaa yaliyopita.
He is currently awaiting a re-trial and is under a travel ban.	Kwa sasa anasubiri kushitakiwa na haruhusiwi kusafiri.
His 20-year-old younger sister is on her 47th day of hunger strike behind bars. Hundreds of political prisoners are currently on hunger strike in Egypt and Bahrain.	Dada yake mdogo mwenye umri wa miaka 20 bado anaendelea na mgomo wake wa kula unaoingia siku ya 47 akiwa gerezani. nbsp; Mamia wa wafungwa wa kisiasa wanaendelea na mgomo wa kula nchini Misri na Bahrain.
Maryam and Alaa have been tweeting their day-by-day struggles the last three years, ever since the 'Arab Spring' captured the imagination of hundreds of thousands around the world. 	Maryam na Alaa wamekuwa waki-twiti mapambano yao ya kila siku kwa miaka mitatu, tangu ‘Mapinduzi ya Uarabuni’ yatawale fikra za mamia ya maelfu duniani kote.
Alaa has more than 636 K Twitter followers and Maryam has close to 101K followers on the microblogging site.	Alaa ana wafuasi zaidi ya laki 6.36 na Maryam ana wafuasi wanaokaribia laki 1 kwenye mtandao wa twita.
In Egypt, some hunger strikers have been in jail since anti-regime protests broke out on January 25, 2011. 	Nchini Misri, baadhi ya wafungwa wanaofanya mgomo wa kula wamekuwa magereza tangu maandamanaji yanayopinga utawala wa nchi hiyo mnamo Januari 25, 2011.
In Bahrain, which has been witnessing anti-regime protests since February 14, 2011, more than 600 political prisoners have gone on hunger strike to protest torture in jail. 	Bahrain, nchi ambayo imekuwa ikishuhudia maandamano ya kupinga utawala wa nchi hiyo tangu Februari 14, 2011, zaidi ya wafungwa 600 wameingia wenye mgomo kupinga mateso wanayoyapata wakiwa gerezani.
In this episode we talk to Alaa and Maryam about their activism, the struggles they face in Bahrain and Egypt and the hopes that keeps them resilient about their country's future. 	Katika toleo la wiki hii tunazungumza na Allan a Maryam kuhusiana na harakati zao, mapambano wanayokabiliana nchini Bahrain na Misri pamoja na matumaini yao yanayowafanya wawe na moyo imara kuhusiana na mustakabali wa nchi yao.
Alaa has been jailed or investigated under every Egyptian head of state who has served during his lifetime.	Alaa alifungwa au kuchunguzwa kila awamu ya Urais wa nchi hiyo.
In 2006, he was arrested for taking part in a peaceful protest. 	Mwaka 2006, alikamatwa kwa kushiriki mandamano ya amani.
In 2011, he spent two months in prison, missing the birth of his first child. 	Mwaka 2011, aliwekwa ndani kwa miezi miwili, akijikuta akikosa kuzaliwa kwa mwanae wa kwanza.
In 2013, he was arrested and detained for 115 days without trial. 	Mwaka 2013, alikamatwa na kuwekwa ndani kwa siku 115 bila kufunguliwa mashitaka.
And he now he faces 15 years in prison.	Na sasa anakabiliana na hukumu ya miaka 15 jela.
Maryam was arrested at the airport in late August, as she tried to enter Bahrain to meet her father a prominent human rights activist who has been behind bars since April 2011. 	Maryam alikamatwa kwenye uwanja wa ndege mwishoni mwa mwezi Agosti, alipojaribu kuingia nchini Bahrain kukutana na baba wa mwanaharakati wa haki za binadamu alikuwa amefungwa tangu mwezi Aprili 2011.
Her father was on the 27th day of his second hunger strike.	Baba yake alikuwa kwenye siku yake ya 27 ya mgomo wake wa pili wa kula.
More than 600 political prisoners have gone on hunger strike in Bahrain to protest being tortured in prison, since February 14, 2011, when anti-regime protests started. 	Zaidi ya wafungwa wa kisiasa wamekuwa kwenye mgomo wa kula nchini Bhrain kupinga kuteswa magerezani, tangu Februari 14, 2011, maandamano yalipoanza.
Maryam is the co-director of the Gulf Center for Human Rights	Maryam ni mkurugenzi mwenza waKituo cha Ghuba ya Arabuni cha Haki za Binadamu
	
The Al Khawaja family has found itself at the forefront of protests in Bahrain, ever since the so-called Arab Spring made its way to the tiny island- kingdom on February 14, 2011. 	Familia ya Al Khawaja imejikuta ikiwa msitari wa mbele kwenye maandamano ya Bahrain, tangu wakati way ale yaliyoitwa Mapinduzi ya Uarabuni yalipoingia kwenye kisiwa hicho cha Ufalme mnamo Febrari 14, 2011.
Prominent human rights activist Abdul Hadi Al Khawaja is currently in prison, serving a life sentence for his role in the protests. 	Mwanaharakati maarufu wa haki za binadamu Abdul Hadi Al Khawaja kwa sasa anatumikia kifungo cha maisha jela kwa kuhusika na maandamano hayo.
Turning to social media, his daughters Maryam, aged 27, and Zainab Al Khawaja, aged 31, became vocal on Twitter, sharing their story and what was happening in their country to thousands of followers across the world. 	Wakitumia mitandao ya kijamii, mabinti zake Maryam, mwenye umri wa miaka 27, na Zainab Al Khawaja, mwenye miaka 31, wamepiga kelele kwenye mtandao wa Twita, wakisambaza habari za yale yanayoendelea nchini humo kwa maelfu ya wafuasi wao duniani kote.
With 102K and 48.8K followers on Twitter respectively, Maryam and Zainab have been constantly badgered by the authorities for speaking up. 	Maryam akiwa na wafuati elfu 10 na Zainabu akiwa na wafuasi 48.8 kwenye mtandao wa Twita, wamepata vitisho vya serikali kwa kitendo chao cha kusema.
Zainab is currently in prison for tearing up the King's photograph in court.	Zainab kwa sasa yuko gerezani kwa kosa la kuchana picha rasmi ya Mfalme wa nchi hiyo akiwa mahakamani.
Maryam had to leave Bahrain after being detained at the airport when she tried to visit her father.	Maryam kwa upande wake, ilimbidi kuondoka nchini humo baada ya kushikiliwa kwenye uwanja wa ndege alipojaribu kumtembelea baba yake.
After Maryam was arrested at the airport, she was accused of hitting a member of the police force. 	Baada ya Maryam kukamatwa uwanja wa ndege, alituhumiwa kumpiga polisi.
Maryam denies the charges.	Maryam anakana mashitaka hayo.
In detention, she started a hunger strike. 	Wakati amekamatwa, alifanya mgomo wa kula.
She was released from jail on September 19 and has since left the country.	Baadae aliachiliwa huru mnamo Septemba 19 na tangu wakati huo anaishi nje ya nchi.
Her father remains in prison.	Baba yake yuko jela.
Maryam is the co-director of the Gulf Center for Human Rights.	Maryam ni Mkurugenzi mwenza wa Kituo cha Ghuba ya Arabuni cha Haki za Binadamu.
In this episode of GV Face, we speak to Maryam Al Khawaja. 	Katika toleo hili la GV Face, tunazungumza na Maryam Al Khawaja.
Bahrain is now in the third year of its crackdown on a popular uprising.	Bahrain mpaka sasa imeingia mwaka wa tatu wa ghasia zaMapinduzi yaliyojipatia umaarufu.
International media reports the protests in Bahrain as a Shia-led revolution against a Sunni regime.	Taarifa za habari za vyombo vikuu vya kimataifa zinasema maandamano nchini Bahrain ni mapinduzi yanayoongozwa na waumini wa dini ya Shia dhidi ya utawala wa Sunni.
While many may see that there is nothing wrong with this description, it is simplistic and doesn’t capture what is happening on the ground. 	Wakati wengi wanaweza kuona kwamba hakuna lolote la maana kwa maelezo haya, na ni maelezo mepesi yasiyoeleza kile kinachoendelea hasa nchini humo.
It fails to acknowledge that Bahrainis who rose against the regime did not do so because they were Shia and the regime was Sunni.	Hayakubali ukweli kwamba wa-Bahrain wanaoinuka kinyume na utawala huo hawafanyi hivyo kwa sababu tu wao ni Shia na utawala huo ni Sunni.
We talk to Maryam Al Khawaja about the role sectarianism plays in Bahrain and how that affects the movement.	Tunazungumza na Maryam Al Khawaja kuhusu namna imani za kidini zinavyoathiri harakati hizo.
Who is the victim and who is the perpetrator of sectarianism?	Nani ni mwathirika na nani ni mwendelezaji wa hisia za kidini?
How does systematic sectarian oppression work in Bahrain?	Namna gani ukandamizaji wa kimfumo wa kidini unavyofanya kazi nchini Bahrain?
And why is the Bahrain uprising tainted as sectarian?	Na kwa nini Mapinduzi ya Bahrain yanaonekana kuwa ya kidini?

These general elections are the first under Tunisia's new constitution and the second since the 2011 uprisings that overthrew Ben Ali.	Uchaguzi Mkuu huu ni wa kwanza tangu Tunisia ipate katiba mpya na ni wa pili tangu yafanyike maandamano ya 2011 yaliyomng'oa madarakani Rais wa zamani wa nchi hiyo Ben Ali.
Tunisia served as the spark for the Arab Spring that rippled across the MENA region in 2011.	Tunisia ndiko kulianzia cheche za Mapinduzi ya Kiarabu zilizoenea katika eneo lote la Afrika Kaskazini na Mashariki ya Kati mwaka 2011.
Uprisings in other countries have led to political stalemates, military takeovers or continued violence, but things have been different in Tunisia. 	Mapinduzi hayo katika nchi hizo yalisababisha mashindano ya kisiasa, mapinduzi ya kijeshi au ghasia zisizokwisha, lakini mambo yamekuwa tofauti nchini Tunisia.
More than 9000 candidates from over a 100 parties are contesting in this election, and for the first time in the country's modern history, Tunisians cannot predict which parties will win. 	Zaidi ya wagombea 9,000 kutoka vyama zaidi ya 100 wanagombea kwenye uchaguzi huu, na kwa mara ya kwanza katika historia ya nchi hiyo, wa-Tunisia hawawezi kubashiri chama gani kitashinda.
Some Tunisians have made the deliberate choice of not voting, while others have decided to concentrate their votes on a few political forces and alliances that are deemed capable of amassing a majority of ballots.
