swa: Aliandika:

eng: ON ZAMBIA'S GOLDEN JUBILEE : Vernon Mwaanga, one of Zambia's own freedom fighters and political authorities, in his book, The Long Sunset, observes as follows: '...the colonialists left more than 40 years ago and in the case of many African countries we can no longer blame them for our woes.
swa: KUHUSU JUBILEE YA MIAKA 50 YA ZAMBIA : Vernon Mwaanga, mmoja wa wapigania uhuru wa Zambia na mwanasiasa mwandamizi, katika kitabu chake, The Long Sunset anasema kama ifuatavyo: ‘wakoloni walituacha miaka 40 iliyopita na kama ilivyo kawaida ya nchi za ki-Afrika hatuwezi kuendelea kuwalaumu wakoloni kwa matatizo yetu.

eng: Slavery belongs to our painful past.
swa: Utumwa ni historia iliyopita.

eng: Now we must transform our countries and move towards modernity, correcting our past mistakes, but moving forward all the time...' The Republican Vice President Dr Guy Scott, fifty years post-independence, only one week ago, commenting on the 2015 National Budget said this: 'Our priorities as a nation are wrong.
swa: Sasa lazima tugeuze nchi zetu ili zipige hatua za kimaendeleo, huku tukisaisha makosa yetu, twapaswa kusonga mbele…’ Makamu wa Rais wa Jamhuri Dr Guy Scott, miaka hamsini baada ya uhuru, juma moja tu lililopita alipokuwa akizungumzia bajeti ya serikali ya mwaka 2015 alisema: ‘Vipaumbele vyetu vya taifa vimepinda.

eng: Instead of fighting unemployment we are focusing on single-digit inflation; meanwhile citizens in the Lukanga swamps are surviving on scorpions.
swa: Badala ya kupambana na ukosefu wa ajira sisi tunapambana na mfumuko wa bei ubaki kuwa tarakimu moja; wakati huo huo wananchi wanaoishi kwenye mabwawa ya Lukanga wanaishi kwa nge.

eng: This is not right.'
swa: Hili si sahihi.'

eng: Mr Alexander Chikwanda, Minister of Finance, a few weeks ago stated as follows: 'We have failed to progress in this country because of leadership failure.'
swa: Bw Alexander Chikwanda, Waziri wa Fedha, majuma machache yaliyopita alitamka maneno yafuatayo: ‘Tumeshindwa kuendelea nchi hii kwa sababu ya uongozi ulioshindwa.’

eng: Mr Chikwanda is spot on with his diagnosis.
swa: Bw Chikwanda yuko sahihi na ameelewa tatizo letu.

eng: As we start another 50 years, we need a new breed of youthful, patriotic, nationalistic, knowledgeable, wise and God-fearing leaders.
swa: Wakati tunaanza miaka mingine 50, tunahitaji kizazi kipya cha vijana, chenye uzalendo, uelewa, busara na chenye kumcha Mungu.

eng: This is our prayer.
swa: Haya ndiyo maombi yetu.

eng: Lord hear us!
swa: Bwana tusikie!

eng: And we are sure that He will answer our prayer.
swa: Na tuna uhakika kwamba utajibu maombi yetu.

eng: These 'Belinda Times', times of deception must surely end!
swa: Hizi nyakati za undanganyifu na ulangai lazima zifikie mwisho!

eng: Michael Chishala, in a contribution to the online news website Zambian Watchdog, wrote:
swa: Michael Chishala, akichangia kwenye tovuti ya habari mtandaoni iitwayo Zambian Watchdog, aliandika:

eng: After 50 years of self-rule, it is shameful that our economic statistics are equivalent to war-torn countries, some of which are now doing better than us in many areas.
swa: Baada ya miaka 50 ya kujitawala, ni aibu kuwa takwimu za uchumi wetu zinafanana na zile za nchi zenye machafuko vya vita, na nyingine zinafanya vizuri kuliko sisi katika maeneo mengi.

eng: Every Zambian government has blamed something other than themselves for the mess we are in.
swa: Kila serikali mpya ya Zambia huja na lawama kwa jambo fulani badala ya kujikagua yenyewe pale iliposhindwa na kutuingiza kwenye matatizo.

eng: They are elected to bring change but they fail, while we the citizens are not putting enough pressure on them.
swa: Wanachaguliwa kuleta mabadiliko lakini wanashindwa, wakati sisi raia tunawashinikiza.

eng: It is time we the new generation make a change.
swa: Ni wakati wa kizazi kipya kuleta mabadiliko.

eng: Chishala then posed some ways forward for Zambia:
swa: Chishala aliandika kile alichofikiri ni suluhisho la kwenda mbele kwa taifa la Zambia:

eng: I believe there has to be a change of ideas and attitudes.
swa: Ninaamini kwamba kumekuwepo mabadiliko ya mawazo na mtazamo.

eng: Zambians should firstly realize that they should take their vote seriously and not be swept off their feet by smooth talking politicians.
swa: Wazambia lazima kwanza waelewe kwamba ni lazima kuona umuhimu wa kura zao na wasidanganywe na maneno ya ulaghai wa wanasiasa.

eng: They should adopt a skeptical disposition and thoroughly question prospective candidates ... Civil Society, the Church, political parties and all of us must press for a drastic reduction in the powers of the Executive, arguably the greatest single problem.
swa: Lazima wajenge hali ya kutokuwaamini kirahisi wanasiasa na wawaulize maswali mazito wanapogombea nafasi za uongozi….vyama vya kiraia, makanisa, vyama vya kisiasa na sisi sote lazima tushinikize kupunguzwa kwa madaraka ya watalawa, ambalo kwa hakika ndilo tatizo kubwa linalotukabili.

eng: In a joint pastoral letter on Independence Day Eve, Zambia's three "mother" body churches—the Zambia Episcopal Conference, Christian Council of Zambia, and Evangelical Fellowship of Zambia—stressed the need for poverty reduction as a top priority:
swa: Katika barua ya pamoja ya kichungaji kwenye mkesha wa siku ya Uhuru, makanisa makuu matatu ya Zambia—Mkutano Mkuu wa Maaskofu Zambia, Baraza la Wakristo Zambia, na Umoja wa Kiinjili wa Zambia—yalisisitiza juu ya haja ya kuchukuliwa hatua za kupunguza umasikini kama kipaumbele cha taifa:

eng: The challenge though still remains for Zambia to put in place better redistributive policies so that the majority poor and the most vulnerable in our society are not left to be mere spectators in the current economic activities.
swa: Changamoto iliyopo ni Zambia kutekeleza sera bora za usawa ili masikini waliowengi na wale walio kwenye mazingira hatarishi katika jamii yetu wasiachwe nyuma na kubaki kuwa waangaliaji tu wa shughuli za uchumi.

eng: In other words, the country’s economic boom would only be meaningful if it significantly reduces poverty among the people of Zambia and allows the active participation of the majority citizenry.
swa: Kwa maneno mengine, ukuaji wa uchumi utakuwa na maana kama utaweza kupunguza umasikini wa watu wa Zambia na kuruhusu ushiriki wa raia walio wengi.

eng: Unfortunately, what we see being achieved is the ever widening gap between the rich and the poor and marginalization of rural areas in terms of infrastructure development and economic activities.
swa: Bahati mbaya, kile tunaona tunafanikiwa ni kukuza pengo kati ya matajiri na masikini na kutengwa kwa maeneo ya vijijini kwa maana ya maendeleo ya miundombinu na shughuli za uchumi.

eng: Young girl in Conakry, by Sebastián Losada - Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 2.0 Generic
swa: Msichana mmoja akiwa jijini Conakry, na Sebastián Losada - Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 2.0 Generic

eng: The Ebola epidemic is raging, causing hysteria worldwide.
swa: Mlipuko wa Ebola unazidi kuenea kwa kasi, kiasi cha kuibua hofu kuu duniani kote.

eng: The people of West Africa, where the epidemic began, are under surveillance by international health authorities.
swa: Watu wa Afrika ya Magharibi, ukanda ambao gonjwa hili la mlipuko lilianzia, wako chini ya uangalizi mkali wa wataalamu wa afya wa kimataifa.

eng: Guinée, which was already in the throes of severe socioeconomic problems before the virus' outbreak, has suffered the brunt of the epidemic.
swa: Guinea, ambayo tayari ilishakabiliwa na tatizo kubwa la kiuchumi miongoni mwa raia wake kabla ya kulipuka kwa ugonjwa huu, hadi sasa imeshaathiriwa vibaya na gonjwa hili. has suffered the brunt of the epidemic.

eng: Guinée's population, however, is coping valiantly with life's daily challenges, despite the risks, the sorrows, and the suspicion from the rest of the world.
swa: Hata hivyo, raia wa Guinea wanaridhika na hali halisi ya changamoto za kimaisha zinazowakabili, hatari zilizopo, majonzi ikiwa ni pamoja na mataifa mengine duniani kuingalia Guinea kwa tahadhari kubwa.

eng: The two bloggers quoted below illustrate Guinée's determination to survive.
swa: Wanablogu wawili kama walivyonukuliwa wanafafanua namna raia wa Guinea walivyo na utayari wa kukabiliana na maisha.

eng: Alimou Sow, a Guinean blogger, decided to eat some pizza with his wife and some friends at a small restaurant in the upper suburbs of Conakry, Guinée's capital.
swa: Alimou Sow, ni mwanablogu wa Guinea, aliyeamua kula Pizza akiwa na mke wake pamoja na baadhi ya marafiki zake katika mgahawa mdogo ulioko pembezoni mwa Conakry, mji mkuu wa Guinea.

eng: He describes this experience of daily life in the capital with a distinct sense of humor:
swa: Aelezea uhalisia wa maisha ya kila siku katika jiji la Konakry akiwa na hali ya uchangamfu usio na mashaka:

eng: From the inside perspective, it's as if our country has been ostracized.
swa: Kwa mtazamo yakinifu, ni kama vile nchi yetu imeshatengwa na jamii ya kimataifa.

eng: The roar of airplanes passing overhead in Conakry has diminished considerably.
swa: Kelele za eropleni zilizokuwa zikisikika kutoka katika anga la jiji la Conakry zimepungua kwa kiasi kikubwa kabisa.

eng: Foreigners have packed their bags, deserting the mining areas, hotels, and restaurants ... and bandwidth has increased on the Internet!
swa: Wageni wameshakusanya vilivyo vyao, wameyakimbia maeneo ya uchimbaji madini, hoteli na migahawa... na pia kasi ya intaneti imeongezeka.

eng: For some time now, the connection has become amazingly fluid.
swa: Kwa kipindi fulani sasa, mtandao wa intaneti umekuwa unapatikana kwa urahisi na wa kasi nzuri.

eng: Downloads are running smoothly. Meanwhile, seen from the outside world, through the prism of both new and traditional media, it's as if Guinée were nothing but an ocean of Ebola virus.
swa: Upakuaji kutoka mtandaoni umekuwa unaridhisha sana. wakati huo huo, jamii ya kimataifa, kupitia upashanaji habari za kisasa na wa zamani, inaitazama Guinea kama vile haikuwa chochote bali ni chanzo kikuu cha ugonjwa wa Ebola.

eng: Many have barricaded themselves indoors, out of fear of being contaminated.
swa: Wengi wamejifungia majumbani kwao wakihofia kuambukizwa ugonjwa huu.

eng: Friendship, solidarity, and conviviality have given way to suspicion and stigma.
swa: Hali ya urafiki, umoja na mshikamano imegeuka na kuwa hali za kutiliana mashaka na kukwepana.

eng: Ebola will certainly find a place in training courses on international relations.
swa: Kwa hakika, ugojwa wa Ebola utalazimisha kuwepo kwa masomo ya muda mfupi kuhusiana na masuala ya uhusiano wa Kimataifa.

eng: In fact, the epidemic has written a new chapter for the textbooks of that discipline.
swa: Ni dhahiri kuwa, gojwa hili la kuambukiza limeshafungua ukurasa mpya kuhusiana na masuala haya ya uhusiano wa kimataifa.

eng: Yet, we live on.
swa: Bado tunaishi.

eng: The heart of Conakry is still beating.
swa: Maisha ya raia wa Conakry bado yanaendelea.

eng: Always the same chaos on the two main roads: the same unscrupulous yellow taxis, the same human bodies packed like sardines into magbana taxi-buses, the same familiar noise that animates the life of my capital.
swa: Kero ni ileile katika barabara kuu mbili: ukatili ni uleule kutoka kwa wamiliki wa teksi za njano , hali ni ile ile ya miili ya binadamu kukusanywa kama samaki kwenye magbana mabasi kama teksi, sauti zilezile ziongezazo furaha ya maisha katika jiji langu.

eng: With horns that keep growing louder, the shouting of curses, and the barking of the coxeur touts, who are finishing up their day of petty larceny committed on passengers.
swa: Sauti ya baragumu inayoongezeka kwa kasi, matamko ya kulaani pamoja na kelele za vibaraka wanaonadi, ambao humaliza siku yao kwa wizi wa wazi wanaofanyiwa abiria.

eng: Markets are crowded, cafés are bustling.
swa: Watu wamejazana masokoni, Pilikapilika katika migahawa imepamba moto.

eng: The rumors and gossip, which are the very essence of Conakry, keep going strong.
swa: Fununu na majungu, ambayo ni mambo muhimu jijini Conakry, yanazidi kumea kwa kasi.

eng: Cireass, another blogger who writes about Guinée, chose a more direct approach to explaining both the epidemic and the challenges of informing the public:
swa: Cireass, mwanablogu mwingine anayeandika kuihusu Guinea, alichagua njia isiyo ya mkato katika kulielezea gojwa la Ebola pamoja na changamoto za kuielimisha jamii:

eng: Although it's not only Guineans who have done so, one big mistake made by our countrymen in the fight against Ebola Fever was to have politicized a situation which has nothing to do with politics.
swa: Pamoja na kuwa siyo raia wa Guinea tu ndio waliokwisha fanya hivi, kosa moja kubwa wanalolifanya viongozi wetu katika vita dhidi ya homa ya dengue ilikuwa ni kuingiza siasa katika jambo ambalo halikuhitaji siasa.

eng: Ever since the announcement of that epidemic, people denied its existence, without even trying to understand what it was.
swa: Tangu kutangazwa kwa ugonjwa huu, watu hawakuamini kuwepo kwake na bila hata ya kutaka kujua undani wa ugonjwa huu.

eng: The result: the Doctors Without Borders centers in the city of Macenta were vandalized by people who claimed that the disease was a lie (ed's note: the facility has resumed its activity). , even though no one could possibly benefit from having invented it as a myth.
swa: Matokeo yake: Madaktari Wasio na Mipaka katika jiji la Macenta walipotoshwa na watu walionadi kuwa, ugonjwa huu ulizushiwa tu kuwepo, pamoja na kuwa hakuna mtu ambaye angaliweza kufaidika kwa kutunga na kuzusha kupepo kwa ugonjwa wa ebola.

eng: Neither the Guinean authorities nor the international non-governmental organizations could profit by inventing a terrifying epidemic like that.
swa: Siyo tu kwa serikali ya Guinea wala mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali ya kimataifa yangeweza kufaidika kwa kutengeneza aina hii ya gonjwa linalotisha.

eng: We shouldn't be looking for a hidden political motive behind everything.
swa: Hatupaswi kuhusisha kila kitu na ushawishi unaochochewa na siasa.

eng: And now, in the case of Ebola, Guinée has become completely isolated on the international stage.
swa: Na sasa, kwa suala la ebola, Guinea imebaguliwa kabisa katika jukwaa la kimataifa.

eng: The only way out of this unfortunate situation will be to work together, to combat Ebola, which is our true enemy.
swa: Namna pekee ya kukabiliana na bahati mbaya hii ni kufanya kazi kwa pamoja, kukabiliana na ebola, ambao ndio adui yetu wa kweli.

eng: It is also important to note that, in the race to cure Ebola, certain metropolitan areas such as the city of Télimélé, have been more resistant to the virus than others—a hopeful sign that could prove crucial to the medical research now underway. Follow our in-depth coverage: The Struggle to #StopEbola in West Africa
swa: Ni muhimu pia kuwa na angalizo kuwa, katika harakati za kukabiliana na ebola, baadhi ya maeneo ya metropolitani kama vile ya jiji la Télimélé, yamekuwa na kinga kubwa ya kukabiliana na kirusi cha ebola kuliko maeneo mengine, ishara ya matumaini inayoweza kudhibitisha umuhimu wa tafiti za kitabibu zinazoendelea.

eng: In an image resonant of a Hollywood movie, attendees at the cremation of former deputy House speaker Apiwan Wiriyachai held up the three-finger salute to the former Prime Minister of the country Yingluck Shinawatra, in what could be seen as a silent message of hope for Thailand.
swa: Katika picha inayofanana na filamu za Hollywood, watu waliohudhuria zoezi la uchomaji wa mwili wa aliyekuwa naibu spika wa Thailand Apiwan Wiriyachai walionesha ishara ya vidole vitatu kumsalimia Waziri Mkuu wa nchi hiyo Yingluck Shinawatra, katika kile kinachoonekana kuwa ni ujumbe mpya wa matumaini kwa nchi ya Thailand.

eng: Please know : there are still many anti-coup Thais who refuse to be oppressed by the military
swa: Tafadhali fahamu: bado wapo wananchi wengi wanaopinga mapinduzi ya kijeshi wanaokataa kunyanyaswa na jeshi

eng: The image, which was originally posted on the BBC Thailand Facebook page has been shared on that platform over 650 times and shared on Twitter over 70 times, including re-tweets from Thais with large followings such as @toyubomm.
swa: Picha hiyo, iliyochapishwa awali kwenye ukurasa wa facebook wa BBC Thailand imesambazwa kwenye mtandao huo mara 650 na kwenye mtandao wa Twita mara 70, ikiwa ni pamoja na kuchapiswa kwa mara nyingine (re-tweet) na wananchi wa Thailand wenye wafuasi wengi kwenye mtandao wa Twita @toyubomm.

eng: The BBC set up this Facebook page in an effort to avoid the systematic attack on the rule of law and liberties which followed May’s coup, including the banning of political gatherings and arresting and detaining hundreds of politicians and anti-coup activists.
swa: BBC iliweka ukurasa huu wa Facebook kama jitihada zake za kukwepa mashambulizi kuhusu masuala ya utawala wa sheria na dhana ya uhuru kufuatia mapinduzi ya mwezi Mei, ikiwa ni pamoja na kuzuiliwa kwa mikusanyiko ya kisiasa na kukamatwa kwa mamia ya wanasiasa na wanaharakati wanaopinga mapinduzi ya kijeshi.

eng: The raised armed salute, inspired by the fantasy blockbuster "The Hunger Games," has been appropriated as the unofficial symbol of anti-coup activists and supporters of the pro-democracy movement.
swa: Ishara hiyo ya heshima kwa kunyanyua mikono, iliyohamasishwa na tangazo la biashara la "The Hunger Games," imekuwa ikichukuliwa kama alama isiyorasmi ya waaharakati wasiokubaliana na mapinduzi ya kijeshi pamoja na watu wanaounga mkono harakati za kidemokrasia.

eng: This activity on Facebook and Twitter occurs at a time of increasing tension in the country, as the military junta continues its massive crackdown of online speech and personal expression in the country.
swa: Hayo yanatokea kwenye mtandao wa Facebook na Twita katika wakati ambao kuna tahayaruki kubwa nchini humo, kufuatia kitendo cha jeshi kuendelea kugandamiza uhuru wa maoni mtandaoni katika nchi hiyo.

eng: Having taken measures to censor citizens on social media and block hundreds of offensive websites, including the UK’s Daily Mail website, in the past week one of the major political blogs in Thailand on the Asian Correspondent website, Bangkok Pundit, announced that it is going on hiatus as a result of "the constrained environment of commenting publicly about Thai politics in the immediate aftermath of the coup."
swa: Baada ya kuwa wamechukua hatua za kuwafuatilia wananchi kwenye mitandao ya kijamii na kufungia mamia ya tovuti zinazodhalilisha wengine, ikiwa ni pamoja na tovuti ya Daily Mail , wiki iliyopita blogu maarufu za kisiasa nchini Thailand kwenye tovuti ya Asian Correspondent, Bangkok Pundit, ilitangaza kwamba itasitisha kazi zake ikiwa ni matokeo ya “kubanwa kwa mazinira ya kutoa maoni waziwazi kuhusiana na siasa za Thailand tangu mapinduzi yafanyike."

eng: Whilst the closure of the anonymous blog is another set-back for the freedom of expression of the Thai people, images such as the three-fingered salute being shared on social media provide a small glimmer of hope for the future of this once open and democratic country.
swa: Wakati kufungwa kwa blogu hiyo isiyofahamika mmiliki wake ni kurudishwa nyuma kwa uhuru wa kujieleza kw watu wa Thailand, kusambaa kwa picha za heshima ya vidole vitatu mtandaoni kunaleta matumaini mapya ya mstakabali wa nchi hii iliwahi kuwa wazi na ya kidemokrasia.

eng: Looking out across the bay from Chowpatty Beach, Mumbai at some of the most expensive land in the world.
swa: Kutoka ng’ambo ya ufukwe wa Chowpatty, Mumbai kutazama eneo moja wapo ghali zaidi duniani.

eng: Image by Flickr user Shreyans Bhansali on 9 January 2007.
swa: Picha na mtumiaji wa mtandao wa Flickr Shreyans Bhansali mnamo Januari 9, 2007.

eng: (CC BY-NC-SA 2.0)
swa: (CC BY-NC-SA 2.0)

eng: Tell the world what inequality means to you.
swa: Tumia fursa ya kuiambia dunia mtazamo wako kuhusu dhana ya kutokuwepo usawa.

eng: Tell your story, share your view, debate and argue.
swa: Andika simulizi lako, sambaza kwa watu mtazamo huo, jadili na jenga hoja.

eng: Do it this Thursday, October 16 on Blog Action Day together with thousands of other bloggers.
swa: Fanya hivyo Alhamisi hii, Oktoba 16 kwenye Siku ya Wajibu wa Blogu Duniani kwa kushirikiana na maelfu ya wanablogu wengine.

eng: Bloggers, unite!
swa: Wanablogu, tuungane!

eng: Since 2007, Blog Action Day have been gathering bloggers from around the world to put global important topics to the table.
swa: Tangu 2007, Siku ya Wajibu wa Blogu imekuwa ikitumika kuwaweka pamoja wanablogu kutoka duniani kote ili kujadili mada muhimu zinazokuwa zimewekwa mezani.

eng: Together, we have massively hit the blogosphere with thousands of posts on water, climate change, poverty, food and the power of we.
swa: Kwa pamoja, huwa utaratibu wa kuvamia anga la blogu kwa kuchapisha maelfu ya posti kuhusu masuala ya maji, mabadiliko ya tabia nchi, umasikini, chakula na nguvu ya pamoja.

eng: It is a brilliant initiative that creates a worldwide action, a global community, and a great dialogue.
swa: Ni mradi mzuri unaojenga mazoea ya wajibu wa pamoja duniani, familia kidunia, na kuibua mjadala mkubwa.

eng: Again this year, Global Voices Online is proud to be an official partner.
swa: Kwa hiyo kwa mara nyingine mwaka huu, Global Voices Online inayo fahari kuwa mshirika rasmi wa siku hiyo.

eng: If I say inequality, you say…?
swa: Nikisema kutokuwepo usawa, wewe unasema…?

eng: The word inequality may bring many associations.
swa: Neno kutokuwepo usawa linaweza kufananishwa na mengi.

eng: Too many maybe; which is exactly why it is a crucial topic to bring to the headlines.
swa: Mengi sana; jambo ambalo ndilo hasa sababu ya kuifanya mada hii kugonga vichwa vya habari kwenye maeneo mengi.

eng: Inequality could refer to healthcare inequality, economic inequality, global inequality, educational inequality, racial inequality, gender inequality, social inequality, and many more unequal constellations.
swa: Kutokuwepo kwa usawa kunaweza kumaanisha kutokuwepo kwa usawa kwenye huduma za afya, ubaguzi wa rangi, jinsia, masuala ya kijamii, na dhana nyinginezo.

eng: Express your view and experiences in your blog, and let’s stand together in discussing inequality in all its forms.
swa: Toa maoni yako na uzoefu wako kwenye blogu yako, na tusimame pamoja kujadili kila aina ya hali za kutokuwepo kwa usawa.

eng: Join #Blogaction14
swa: Ungana na #WajibuwaBlogu14

eng: To participate in Blog Action Day, you can register your own blog on Blog Action Day's website - and note that you can write your entry in any language, from any country.
swa: Kushiriki kwenye Siku ya Wajibu wa Blogu, unaweza kuandikisha blogu yako kwenye Tovuti maalum ya Siku ya Wajibu wa Blogu - na bainisha kwamba unaweza kuandika makala yako katika lugha yoyote, kutoka nchi yoyote.

eng: At the time of writing 1032 participants from 108 countries have registered to take part.
swa: Wakati wa kuandikwa kwa makala haya, washiriki 1032 kutoka nchi 108 wamejiandikisha kushiriki.

eng: On Twitter, keep an eye on the hashtags #Blogaction14, #Inequality, #Oct16.
swa: Kwenye mtandao wa Twita, fuatilia alama habari zifuatazo #Blogaction14, #Inequality, #Oct16.

eng: On October 16, we will list the posts from Global Voices contributors around the world – stay tuned!
swa: Mnamo Oktoba 16, tutaorodhesha makala kutoka kwa waandishi wa Global Voices duniani kote – kaa mkao wa kula!

eng: A scene from the first TMSummit in London in 2013.
swa: Sehemu ya mkutano wa kwanza wa Taasisi ya Transformational Media jijini London mwaka 2013.

eng: All this week in Washington, DC, the Transformational Media Institute will convene a summit that brings together “changemakers, storytellers, and media professionals” from all over the world “to collaborate for good.”
swa: Wiki yote hii jijini Washington, DC, Taasisi ya Transformational Media itafanya mkutano unaowaleta pamoja “waleta mabadiliko, waandishi na wataalam wa vyombo vya habari” kutoka duniani kote “kushirikana kwa nia njema”.

eng: This year’s TMSummit is the Institute’s second annual conference, running from October 26 until November 2, 2014.
swa: Mkutano huo wa TM ni mkutano wa mwaka wa mara ya pili, utakaoendelea kuanzia Oktoba 26 mpaka Novemba 2, 2014.

eng: During the week, associated events are taking place throughout the city, leading up to flagship events, including a workshop at the UN Foundation, on October 31, and the main summit day at George Washington University on November 1.
swa: Wiki hiii, matukio yatakayoenda sambamba na mkutano huo yatafanyika jijini humo, na kuhitimishwa na na shamra shamra nyingi ikiwa ni pamoja na Mfuko wa Umoja wa Mataifa, Oktoba 31, na siku ya mkutano wenyewe itafanyika kwenye Chuo Kikuu cha George Washington Novemba 1.

eng: Participants at the TMSummit will discuss storytelling, collaborative creativity, new technology, sustainable business and living, wellbeing and health, photography, film and music, and journalism, among other issues.
swa: Washiriki wa mkutano huo watajadili uandishi, ubunifu, teknolojia mpya, biashara na maisha endelevu, upigaji picha, filamu na muziki, uandishi wa habari pamoja na masuala mengine mengi.

eng: According to its organizers:
swa: Kwa mujibu wa waandaaji wa mkutano huo:

eng: The TMSummit will focus on how stories and media can create positive change by changing attitudes, bringing new technology solutions, awareness raising, inspiring action, or simply spreading happiness.
swa: Mkutano wa TM utajikita kwenye namna habari na uandishi wa habari unavyoweza kuleta mabadiliko chanya kwa kubadili mitazamo, kuleta ufumbuzi wa kiteknolojia, kukuza uelewa, kuhamasisha uwajibikaji, na zaidi kusambaza furaha.

eng: It brings together leading experts in their fields drawing people from a diverse range of organizations such as: the UN Foundation, Discovery Channel, MTV, and the Jane Goodall Institute.
swa: Unaleta pamoja wataalam wakubwa kwenye maeneo yao wanaotoka kwenye mashirika mbalimbali kama vile: UN Foundation, Discovery Channel, MTV, na Taasisi ya Jane Goodall.

eng: Global Voices spoke to Jeremy Wickremer, who heads the TMSummit, to learn a bit more about the conference.
swa: Global Voices ilizungumza na Jeremy Wickremer, anayeongoza Mkutano huo, kujua machache kuhusiana na mkutano huo.

eng: “It’s about creating a better world,” he says.
swa: “Suala kuu ni kujenga dunia iliyo bora zaidi,” anasema.

eng: “It’s all interrelated: equality, property, the environment, health and wellbeing—they’re all connected.
swa: “Ni masuala ambayo kimsingi yanahusiana kwa karibu: usawa, umiliki, mazingira, afya na ustawi—yote yanahusiana.

eng: You can’t tackle something in a silo,” he warns.
swa: Huwezi kushughulikia suala moja likiwa pekee,” anatahadharisha.

eng: The Transformational Media Institute hopes to attract as broad an audience as possible for this year’s summit in Washington.
swa: Taasisi ya Transformational Media inalenga kuvutia hadhira kubwa kadri inavyowezekana katika mkutano wa mwaka huu jijini Washington.

eng: Wickremer expects a diverse group to attend, from high school students to artists to senior managers.
swa: Wickremer anatarajia makundi mbalimbali kushiriki, kuanzia wanafunzi wa sekondari hadi wasanii na mameneja waandamizi.

eng: “It’s about seeing the big picture, so we should see a diverse group.”
swa: “Hatua ya kuyaita makundi mengi zaidi, ni katika kuliona jambo hili kwa mtazamo mpana zaidi.”

eng: The TMSummit's theme for 2014.
swa: Maudhui ya mkutano wa TM 2014.

eng: One of the summit’s main goals is to bring together people who otherwise might never cross paths, to promote new perspectives and build connections that lead to collaborations “for scaling up the social impact of what these people do.”
swa: Lengo kuu mojawapo la mkutano huo ni kuwaleta watu ambao vinginevyo wasingekutana, ili kukuza uelewa mpya na kujenga mitandao inayoleta ushirikiano “ili kukuza matokeo ya kijamii yanayoletwa na watu hawa.”

eng: Readers wishing to know more about the TMSummit and the Transformational Media Institute can visit the summit’s website and the Institute’s website, Facebook page, and Twitter account.
swa: Wasomaji wanaotamani kujua zaidi kuhusu mkutano wa TM na Taasisi ya Transformational Media wanaweza kutembelea tovuti ya mkutano huo na tovuti ya taasisi hiyo, ukurasa wa Facebook, naanuani ya Twita.

eng: We are pleased to announce that a Global Voices meetup is set to take place in Tunis on November 1, 2014 from 9am to 1pm, at 404 Lab an open innovation lab hosted by the Tunisian Internet Agency (ATI).
swa: Tunayofuraha kutangaza kwamba mkutano wa Global Voices umepangwa kufanyika nchini Tunis mnamo Novemba 1, 2014 kuanzia saa 3asubuhi hadi saa 7 mchana, kwenye Maabara ya wazi ya uvumbuzi 404 inayomilikiwa na Wakala wa Mtandao wa Intaneti Tunisia (ATI).

eng: Global Voices Meetups are local and small gatherings designed to help facilitate meaningful connections with our readers, potential authors or translators, and others that have shown an active interest in our work.
swa: Mikutano ya Global Voices ni mikusanyiko midogo ya mahali inayokusudiwa kusaidia kutengeneza mitandao na wasomaji wetu, waandishi au wafasiri watarajiwa, na wengine wanaonesha kuvutiwa na kazi zetu.

eng: During the same period, other Global Voices meetups will also take place in Accra, Beirut, Dar Es Salaam, and Belgrade.
swa: Wakati huo huo, mikutano ya namna hii itakuwa ikifanyika kwenye miji ya Accra, Beirut, Dar Es Salaam, na Belgrade. .

eng: The Tunis gathering is an opportunity for us to introduce the mission and projects of Global Voices to our readers in Tunisia.
swa: Mkutano huu wa Tunis ni fursa yetu kueleza shughuli na miradi yetu ya Global Voices kwa wasomaji wetu nchini Tunisia.

eng: In the meetup agenda also, a panel on the subject of alternative media in Tunisia and a keynote speech on personal data protection by Chawki Gaddas from the Faculty of Judicial, Political and Social Sciences of Tunis.

eng: As the confirmed Ebola death toll nears 5,000, with at least 10,000 reported cases, many in West Africa are utilizing the power of new media in the fight against the disease.
swa: Wakati idadi iliyothibitishwa ya vifo vilivyotokana na Ebola inakaribia 5,000, huku kukiwa na matukio ya wagonjwa wasiopungua 10000, wananchi wengi katika eneo la Afrika Magharibi wanatumia nguvu ya mitandao ya kijamii katika kupambana na virusi vya ugonjwa huo.

eng: One such initiative is Ebola Alert in Nigeria:
swa: Mmoja wapo wa miradi ya namna hiyo ni Ebola Alert nchini Naijeria:

eng: EbolaAlert is an evidence-driven group of volunteer professionals working on Ebola Virus Disease Interventions.
swa: EbolaAlert ni kundi la wataalamu wanaojitolea kufanya kazi kwa kutumia ushahidi katika mapambano dhidi ya virusi vya Ebola.

eng: It was created by Doctors but also involves active participation of other professionals from different walks of life.
swa: Lilianzishwa na madaktari lakini linajumuisha wataalam wengine wenye shughuli mbalimbali.

eng: The initiative uses Twitter to post daily Ebola-related news and to organise Ebola chat sessions between experts and the general public:
swa: Mradi huo unatumia mtandao wa Twita kuposti habari zinazohusiana na Ebola kila siku na kuratibu majadiliano yanayohusu virusi vya Eloba kati ya wataalam na umma wa wananchi.

eng: You can keep abreast of all the necessary information by following our activities on twitter.
swa: Unaweza kupata taarifa muhimu kwa kuwafuatilia tunayoyafanya kwenye mtandao wa Twita

eng: From the daily #EbolaNews that is posted between 7AM and 8AM WAT to special activities like #EbolaScience where confusing Ebola issues are cracked and clarified.
swa: Masuala yanayohusu maabukizi ya virusi hivyo huajadiliwa kwenye alama habari ya #EbolaNews ambayo huchapishwa kati ya saa 1 na 2 asubuhi kwa saa za Afrika Magharibi kadhalika kupitia alama habari ya #EbolaScience ambapo masuala yanayochanganya ya Ebola hushughulikiwa na kujadiliwa kwa kina.

eng: The #EbolaChat Sessions are Twitter Events where Experts from around the world are available to discuss chosen topics with the general public.
swa: Majadiliano yanayofanyika kwenye #EbolaChat huwa ni matukio ya kwenye mtandao wa Twita ambapo wataalamu kutoka duniani kote huwepo kujadili mada zinazokuwa zimechaguliwa na watu wenyewe.

eng: There have been #EbolaChat Sessions on as many issues as you can imagine
swa: Kumekuwa na majadiliano ya #EbolaChat kuhusu masuala mengi kuliko unavyoweza kufikiri

eng: She is leading the campaign "Beauty for Country: I am 100% Sierra Leonean, Not a Virus" with fellow citizens Elvinah Ade Johnson and Haja Mariatu Thomas.
swa: Anaongoza kampeni inayoitwa “Urembo kwa Nchi yangu: Mimi ni m-Sierra Leone kwa asilimia 100, si Kirusi" akishirikiana na wenzake kama Elvinah Ade Johnson ana Haja Mariatu Thomas.

swa: Wafanyakazi wa Jarida la kila siku la Apple Daily wakionesha msimamo wao wa kuendelea kufanya kazi hata baada ya kushambuliwa mnamo Oktoba 13.

eng: Photo from Chan Pui Man's Facebook page.
swa: Picha kutoka kwenye ukurasa wa Facebook wa Chan Pui Man.

eng: Journalists working in Hong Kong have come under tremendous pressure in recent weeks for covering news on the Umbrella Revolution, the pro-democracy protests demanding free and fair elections.
swa: Waandishi wanaofanya kazi nchini Hong Kong wamejikuta kwenye shinikizo kubwa katika majuma mawili yaliyopita kwa uamuzi wao wa kuandika habari zinazohusu Mapinduzi ya Mwamvuli, maandamano yanayodai demokrasia kupitia uchaguzi ulio huru na haki.

eng: Not only have they exposed themselves to violence while covering clashes between police and protesters, when they return to the office from the field, some of them have to endure the push for self-censorship from the newsroom or even harassment from pro-Beijing thugs.
swa: Si tu kwamba wamejihatarisha kwa ghasia wakati wakiandika habari hizo za mapambano kati ya polisi na waandamanaji, lakini pia waliporudi ofisini wakitokea kwenye uwanja wa habari, wengine wao wamejikuta wakifuatiliwa ndani kwa ndani na waandishi wenzao au hata kujikuta wakibughudhiwa na wahuni wanaounga mkono msimamo wa Beijing.

eng: Since police began removing barricades set up by protesters at the sites of the massive sit-in dubbed Occupy Central, confrontations between protesters and police officers have happened almost every day.
swa: Tangu polisi waanze kuondoa vizuizi vilivyowekwa na waandamanaji kwenye maeneo yaliyopewa jina la Maandamano ya Kukaa Katikati ya Mji, mapigano kati ya waandamanaji na maafisa wa polisi yametokea kila siku.

eng: Standing between the police and protesters, photojournalists have become vulnerable to injuries themselves.
swa: Wakisimama kati ya polisi na waandamanaji, wapiga picha wa vyombo vya habari nao wamejikuta katika mazingira ya kujihatarisha.

eng: It is not uncommon to see TV station cameramen being pepper sprayed or pushed away by police officers during the news report.
swa: Si jambo la ajabu sasa kuona wapiga picha wa televisheni wakinyunyuziwa maji ya kuwasha au kusukumwa na maafisa wa polisi wakati wakitekeleza shughuli zao.

eng: In some cases, the police do not differentiate between protesters and reporters and assault them when they take photos of the front-line.
swa: Katika matukio mengine, polisi hawawatofautishi waandamanaji na wanahabari na hivyo kuwabughudhi wakati waandishi hao wakipiga picha za waandamanaji walio msitari wa mbele.

eng: At 3 a.m., when covering the clearing of Tamar Park, a reporter from SocREC was pulled into the side of the riot police's line and beat up for about 30 seconds.
swa: Saa 9 alfajiri, wakati akiandika habari za kutawanywa kwa watu kwa nguvu kwenye Bustani ya Tamar, mwandishi wa SocREC alivutwa kuelekea walikokuwa polisi na alipigwa kwa sekunde 30.

eng: Later, two police officers dragged him along the road for 30 seconds and threw him into a police detention van.
swa: Baadae, maafisa wawili wa polisi walimburuta barabarani kwa sekunde 30 na kumtupia kwenye gari la polisi.

eng: The wounded reporter repeatedly displayed his press badge during the ordinal, but it did not stop them.
swa: Mwandishi huyo aliyepatwa na mkasa huo wakati wote alikuwa akionesha kitambulisho kilichokuwa kikionesha kwamba yeye ni mwandishi, lakini hilo hata halikuwasumbua polisi kuacha vitendo hivyo.

eng: Instead, they abused him verbally.
swa: Badala yake, waliendelea kumtukana.

eng: Only after a police press officer confirmed his identity inside the van was he allowed to leave.
swa: Baade aliruhusiwa kuondoka baada ya polisi anayehusika na habari kukithibitisha kitambulisho chake.

eng: The reporter sought treatment at the Queen Mary Hospital and the clinical report found obvious injures on his face, forehead, nose, mouth, neck and left arm.
swa: Mwandishi huyo alitafuta matibabu kwenye hospitali ya Queen Mary na taarifa ya matibabu yake inathibitisha kuwa amepata majeraha kwenye uso wake, utosi, pua, mdomo, shingoni na kwenye mkono wa kushoto.

eng: Similarly, a reporter from inmediahk.net covering the news inside a tunnel on Lung Wo Road was suddenly threatened by a police officer with pepper spray.
swa: Vivyo hivyo, mwandishi wa mtandao wa inmediahk.net aliyekuwa akiandika habari akiwa kwenye kinjia pembeni mwa Barabara ya Lung Wo Road alitishwa na polisi na bomba la maji ya kuwasha.

eng: He followed the officer's instruction and backed off, but was sprayed in his face without warning; although he showed his press badge many times, he was arrested and handcuffed.
swa: Alifuata masharti ya polisi na akaacha kufanya kazi yake, lakini hata hivyo bado alimwagiwa maji ya kuwasha usoni bila kupewa onyo; ingawa alionesha kitambulisho chake wakati wote, bado alikamatwa na kupigwa pingu.

eng: In the process, the police officer yelled: "Reporter?
swa: Wakati mwandisi huyo akionesha kitambulisho, polisi alikuwa akipiga kelele: “Mwandishi?

eng: So what?" "Even reporters cannot take photos from the front."
swa: Sasa mimi nifanyeje kwa kujua hivyo?“ “Hata waandishi hawaruhusiwi kupiga picha kwenye uwanja wa mapambano.”

eng: He was released after his identity was clarified.
swa: Mwandishi huyo aliachiwa baada ya kitambulisho chake kuthibitishwa.

eng: Another inmediahk.net reporter was hit in the head by a riot police officer with his shield while he was backing off.
swa: Mwandishi mwingine wa mtandao wa inmediahk.net alipigwa kichwani na afisa wa polisi kwa kutumia ngao ya polisi wakati akiondoka eneo hilo.

eng: Even if reporters at the front-line risk physical injuries to cover the news, their stories might not be published because of self-censorship practices in the newsroom.
swa: Ingawa waandishi wanaokuwa uwanja wa mapambano huhatarisha maisha yao kwa minajili ya kuandika habari, bado habari zao wakati mwingine haziandikwi kwa sababu ya kufuatiliwa kunakofanywa ndani ya vyombo vya habari.

eng: Many news organizations in Hong Kong, a special administrative region of China, were already fearful of losing advertising revenue from their business ties in the mainland or angering the Beijing government.
swa: Mashirika mengi ya habari jijini Hong Kong, jimbo maalumu ya kiutawala la China, yamekuwa na hofu ya kupoteza mapato ya matangazo ya ki-Biashara kutoka bara China au kuogopa kuikasirisha serikali ya Beijing.

eng: This trend has only increased with the recent protests calling for an open nomination system of candidates for the city's chief executive, which goes against the mainland's wish for a largely pro-Beijing nominating committee.
swa: Hali hii imeongezeka kadri maandamano hayo yanavyozidi kutoa wito wa mfumo wazi wa uteuzi wa mgombea wa nafasi ya Mtendaji Mkuu wa jiji hilo, dai ambalo linapingana na matakwa ya bara ya kuwa na kamati inayohodhiwa na watu wenye mrengo wa Beijing.

eng: On October 15, the chief news executive of TVB, the city's most popular television station, ordered the news team to edit a voice-over describing a video report on alleged police brutality.
swa: Mnamo Oktoba 15, mkuu wa matangazo wa TVB, kituo kikuu maarufu cha matangazo cha jiji hilo, kiliamuru timu yake ya habari kuhariri sauti iliyokuwa ikielezea taarifa ya video inayodaiwa kuwa ya ukatili wa polisi.

eng: The footage clearly showed a handcuffed protester punched and kicked by several police officers in a dark corner for four minutes.
swa: Kipande hicho kinaonesha bayana mwanandamanaji aliyefungwa pingu akipigwa mateke na mafisa kadhaa wa Polisi kwenye kona iliyokuwa gizani kwa dakika nne.

eng: The next day, 28 staff members from the newsroom issued a joint statement expressing regret over the management's decision.
swa: Siku iliyofuata, watumishi 28 wa chumba cha habari walitoa tamko la pamoja wakionesha kusikitishwa na uamuzi huo wa utawala wa chombo hicho cha habari.

eng: So far more than 100 staffs from the station's news branch have co-signed it.
swa: Hadi sasa zaidi ya wafanyakazi 100 wa kituo hicho wametia saini tamko hilo.

eng: A former TVB reporter Au Ka Lun explained how the TVB newsroom operates after he read the joint statement:
swa: Mwandishi wa zamani wa TVB Au Ka Lun alieleza namna chumba cha habari cha TVB kinavyofanya kazi baada ya kusoma tamko hilo la pamoja:

eng: Every word in this plain statement is written in blood and sweat.
swa: Kila neno tamko hili la wazi limeandikwa na damu na jasho.

eng: I read it and remembered the endless humiliation and struggle our generation of reporters has faced.
swa: Nimelisoma na kukumbuka unyanyasaji usiokoma na mapambano ambayo kizazi chetu cha waandishi wa habari kimekabiliana nayo.

eng: The huge gap between ideal and reality and whether one should stay or leave is always a struggle.
swa: Pengo kubwa kati ya hali halisi na ile iliyotarajiwa na ikiwa mtu anapaswa kuondoka au kubaki ni sula la mapambano.

eng: Most of the time, the reporters on the front-line are only responsible for interviews and recording what happens onsite.
swa: Muda mwingi, waandishi waliokuwa mstari wa mbele ndio wanaowajibika kwa mahojiano na kurekodi kile kinachotokea kwenye eneo la tukio.

eng: They are like the workers in the sweatshop, responsible for a part of the news making.
swa: Wanakuwa kama wafanyakazi wanaofanya kazi kwenye duka la jasho, wanaowajibika katika shughuli ya kuandika habari.

eng: After they have done their work, the footage would be sent back to the newsroom.
swa: Baada ya kufanya kazi yao, video zao hutumwa kwenye vyumba vya habari.

eng: They won't be responsible for the script.
swa: Na huwa hawawajibiki na walichokituma.

eng: The content and the focus cannot be decided by the reporters.
swa: Maudhui na lengo la habari huwa haliwezi kuandaliwa na waandishi.

eng: In the newsroom, there are many news and assignment editors, and above them there is one more person in charge.
swa: Kwenye vyumba vya habari, kuna wahariri wengi wa habari na majukumu na juu yao kuna mtu mwingine mwenye sauti ya mwisho.

eng: Above that person are even greater forces.
swa: Juu ya mtu huyo kuna shinikizo zaidi.

eng: Reporters are not free and autonomous; they are only free when that single person is asleep, but he sleeps very little.
swa: Waandishi hawana uhuru na hawajitegemei; wanakuwa huru wakati tu huyo jamaa mwenye sauti ya juu amelala, lakini hilo huwa ni nadra kutokea.

eng: The "greater forces" referred to by Au are the different forms of political pressure coming from Beijing, such as smears or even violent threats.
swa: ‘Shinikizo kubwa’ linalorejelewa hapa na Au ni mashinikizo ya aina mbalimbali ya kisiasa kutoka Beijing, kama vile vitisho.

eng: Most media outlets in Hong Kong have compromised by incorporating self-censorship into their newsroom management like TVB.
swa: Vyombo vya habari jijini Hong Kong vimelegeza msimamo wao kwa kuwa utaratibu wa kufuatiliana weyewe ndani kwa ndani kamainavyofanyika kwenye kituo cha TVB.

eng: For those who refused to comply, the threats are more explicit.
swa: Kwa wale wanaogoma kulegeza msimamo, wanatishwa.

eng: Since October 12, pro-Beijing mobs were mobilized to surround pro-democracy Apple Daily's headquarters and stop the media outlet from distributing their papers.
swa: Tangu Oktoba 12, wahuni wanaounga mkono msimamo wa Beijing walipangwa kuzunguka makao makuu ya gazeti linaounga mkono demokrasia na kuwazuia wafanyakazi wa gazeti hilo kutawanya magazeti.

eng: They blocked the entrance of Apple Daily on October 13 and obstructed the papers from being loading onto the trucks.
swa: Wahuni hao walifunga lango kuu la kuingilia kwenye jengo la gazeti hilo mnamo tarehe 13 Oktoba na kuzuia magazeti kupandishwa kwenye magari ya kusambaza.

eng: In addition, Apple Daily's website has suffered from cyber attacks that knocked the site offline and the telephone lines of its office were jammed with abusive phone calls. Despite the fact that the media outlet quickly obtained a restraining order from the court, the mobs continued roaming outside the entrance.
swa: Kama vile haitoshi, tovuti ya gazeti hilo imevamiwa na kuipoteza hewani na laini za simu zilifurikwa na simu za matusi.

eng: About 70,000 people attended Taiwan's LGBT pride parade on October 25 to celebrate the diversity of sexual orientation and gender identity and encourage the public to do the same.
swa: Kiasi cha watu 70,000 walihudhuria matembezi ya fahari ya mashoga na wasagaji nchini Taiwani mnamo Oktoba 25 katika kusherehekea tofauti za hisia za kimapenzi na utambulisho wa kijinsia na kuuhamasisha umma kuiga mfano huo.

eng: The number of participants was one of the largest that the parade has seen since the first was held in 2003.
swa: Idadi ya washiriki ilikuwa kubwa kabisa kuwahi kuonekana tangu matembezi ya kwanza yafanyike mwaka 2003.

eng: In recent years, it has become the biggest pride parade in Asia and attracted many overseas attendees.
swa: Katika miaka hii ya karibuni, matembezi haya yamekuwa makubwa kabisa katika bara la Asia na yamevutia hisia za wahudhuriaji wengi kutoka nje ya nchi.

eng: The theme of the 2014 parade was ‘Walk in Queers’ Shoes,’ featuring voices from marginalized LGBT communities such as physically disabled people, HIV-positive people and sex workers.
swa: Maudhui ya matembezi ya mwaka 2014 yalikuwa ‘Tembea kwa Kutumia Viatu ya (Unaowaona) Hawako kawaida,’ yakiakisi sauti za jamii za watu wa mapenzi ya jinsia moja, mashoga, wanaotengwa kama walemavu, watu wanaoishi na virusi vya UKIMWI na makahaba.

eng: Most of the participants in the parade voiced their support for the legalization of same-sex marriage.
swa: Washiriki wengi katika maandamano hayo walipaza sauti zao kuunga mkono hatua kuhalalisha kisheria ndoa za jinsia moja.

eng: A marriage equality bill was presented to the Legislative Yuan by the Taiwan Alliance to Promote Civil Partnership Rights in 2012.
swa: Muswada wa usawa wa haki ya ndoa ulipelekwa bungeni na Taasisi ya Umoja wa Kukuza Haki za Ushiriki wa Kiraia nchini Taiwan mwaka 2012.

eng: The legislature passed the first reading on October 25, 2013, but the legislative process was suspended in reaction to a massive mobilization of opponents of same-sex marriage.
swa: Bunge liliupitia muswada huo baada ya kuusoma kwa mara ya kwanza Oktoba 23, 2013, lakini mchakato wa kisheria ulisimamishwa baada ya wapinzani wa sheria hiyo kupinga vikali ndoa za jinsia moja.

eng: Gay rights activists began pushing legislators to resume their work in early October this year and a public hearing for the bill was held on October 16.
swa: Wanaharakati wa haki za Mashoga walianza kuwashinikiza wabunge waurudie mswada huo mwezi Oktoba mwaka huu na usomaji wa wazi wa muswada huo ulifanyika Oktoba 16.

eng: Many couples in the LGBT communities took the opportunity of this year's pride parade to share their stories and hope with others.
swa: Wapenzi wengi katika jamii ya mashoga walitumia fursa ya maandamano ya mwaka huu kusimuliza hali na matumaini yao kwa wengine.

eng: Left in the dark about their leader's illness, Zambians were angry more than shocked to learn this week that the country's fifth president, Michael Sata, fondly known as King Cobra, died in London on October 28.
swa: Wakiwa gizani wasijue maradhi yanayomsibu kiongozi wao, wa-Zambia walipatwa na hasira na kushangazwa na habari zilizotolewa na serikali juma hili kwamba rais wa tano wa nchi hiyo, Michael Sata, anayefahamika kwa jina la King Cobra, alikuwa ameaga dunia jijini London mnamo Oktoba 28.

eng: The government only recently acknowledged that the president was sick, waiting until October 20, four days before Zambia's 50th Independence Day, when Sata needed to be evacuated to Britain for emergency medical treatment.
swa: Serikali ilikiri hivi majuzi kwamba rais alikuwa mgonjwa, habari zilizotolewa Oktoba 20, siku nne kabla ya sherehe za Miaka 50 ya Uhuru wa Zambia, ambapo Sata alikuwa amesafirishwa kwenda Uingereza kwa ajili ya matibabu ya dharura.

eng: At the time, the presidential palace stated simply:
swa: Wakati huo, ikulu ya rais ilieleza kirahisi:

eng: His Excellency, Mr. Michael Chilufya Sata, President of the Republic of Zambia, last night left for a medical check- up abroad First Lady Dr Christine Kaseba, some family members and his press aide have accompanied the Head of State.
swa: Mheshimiwa Michael Chilufya Sata, Rais wa Jamhuri ya Zambia, usiku wa jana aliondoka nchini kwa ajili ya kuchunguza afya yake ng'ambo mke wa rais Dk Christine Kaseba, baadhi ya wanafamilia na msaidizi wake wa hotuba wameongozana na Mkuu wa Nchi.

eng: This wasn't the president's first trip abroad to meet with foreign doctors, but it was the first time state officials admitted to Sata's medical needs.
swa: Hii haikuwa ziara ya kwanza ya Rais nje ya nchi kukutana na madaktari wa kigeni. lakini ilikuwa ni mara ya kwanza kwa maafisa wa serikali kukiri kwamba Rais alikuwa anapata matibabu.

eng: In the past, his administration has denied rumors by cabinet members about his declining health, maintaining that Sata was fine and busy at work.
swa: Awali, serikali ilikanusha tetesi zilizokuwa zikienezwa na baadhi ya mawaziri kuhusiana na kuzorota kwa afya yake, ikisema kwamba Sata alikuwa imara na akiendelea na kazi.

eng: Earlier this year, the government told journalists that Sata spent a working holiday in Israel, though the Israeli media later reported that he was there to receive medical treatment.
swa: Mapema mwaka hu, serikali iliwaambia waandishi wa habari kwamba Sata alikuwa kwenye mapumziko ya kikazi nchini Israel, ingawa vyombo vya habari vya Israeli baadae viliandika kwamba alikuwa kule kupata matibabu.

eng: The Zambian government's curious public relations hasn't gone unnoticed on social media.
swa: Kazi iliyokuwa ikifanywa na Idara ya Mahusiano ya umma ya serikali ya Zambia haikupita hivi hivi.

eng: On Facebook, B.M. Jermaine Sikombe reproduced the presidential palace's vague statement announcing Sata's passing.
swa: Kwenye mtandao wa Facebook, B.M. Jermaine Sikombe alinukuu tamko lisiloeleweka lililotolewa na ikulu ya rais kutangaza kifo cha rais.

eng: Sikombe scoffed at the wording, calling on officials to take responsibility for leaving the public woefully misinformed.
swa: Sikombe aligeuza geuza maneno, na kutoa wito kwa maafisa wa serikali kuwajibika kwa kuudanganya umma.

eng: AS YOU ARE AWARE, HIS EXCELLENCY MR. MICHAEL CHILUFYA SATA, PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC OF ZAMBIA HAS BEEN RECEIVING MEDICAL ATTENTION IN LONDON, IN THE UNITED KINGDOM
swa: KAMA MNAVYOFAHAMU, MHESHIMIWA MICHAEL CHILUFYA SATA, RAIS WA JAMHURI YA ZAMBIA AMEKUWA AKIPATA MATIBABU JIJINI LONDON, UINGEREZA

eng: HE LEFT ZAMBIA WITH THE FIRST LADY AND OTHER CLOSE MEMBERS OF THE FAMILY ON OCTOBER 20, 2014.
swa: AMEONDOKA ZAMBIA AKIWA NA MKE WA RAIS NA WANAFAMILIA WENGINE MNAMO OKTOBA 20, 2014.

eng: HOWEVER, IT IS WITH A VERY HEAVY HEART THAT I ADDRESSYOU TODAY, TO INFORM THE NATION THAT OUR BELOVED PRESIDENT AND LEADER, HIS EXCELLENCY, MR MICHAEL CHILUFYA SATA HAS PASSED ON.
swa: HATA HIVYO, NINA HUZUNI KUBWA KWA KUZUNGUMZA NANYI LEO, KULITAARIFU TAIFA KWAMBA RAIS WETU KIPENZI, MHESHIMIWA MICHAEL CHILUFYA SATA AMETUTOKA.

swa: Sikombe anaandika:

eng: On his Facebook page, Emmanuel Mwamba, the former spokesman of Zambia’s second president, the late Frederick Chiluba, wrote:
swa: Kwenye ukurasa wake wa Facebook, Emmanuel Mwamba, msemaji wa zamani wa rais wa pili wa Zambia marehemu Frederick Chiluba, aliandika:

eng: When Zambians were confronted with sad pictures of a frail and clearly unwell President in April 2014, which immediately evoked feelings of concern and anxiety, government officials played down the concerns.
swa: Wa-Zambia waliposumbuliwa na picha mbaya za Rais aliyeonekana wazi ni mdhoofu mwezi Aprili 2014, zilizoibua hisia za wasiwasi na mashaka, maafisa wa serikali hawakuonesha kujali.

eng: Minister of Foreign Affairs Harry Kalaba regularly issued ridiculous statements to Radio Phoenix such as “the Opposition leaders questioning the health of President Sata are malicious”.
swa: Waziri wa Mambo ya Nje Harry Kalaba mara kwa mara alitoa matamko ya kijinga kwenye kituo cha Radio Phoenix kama vile “Viongozi wa upinzani wanaohoji afya ya rais Sata wanaongozwa na chuki".

eng: “Sata will outlive his enemies that wish him dead”, President Sata is enjoying the best of his health”.
swa: Sata atawashinda maadui zake wanaotamani apoteza maisha, "Rais Sata anafurahia afya yake imara”.

eng: Of concern was the manner President Sata was carted around to; South Africa, India, United Kingdom and Israel in a secretive and hushed manner.
swa: Kilicholeta wasiwazi ni namna Rais Sata alivyozungushwa nchi mbali mbali, Afrika Kusini, India, Uingereza na Israeli kwa usiri mkubwa na hali ya dharura.

eng: Recently the nation held with bated breath when President Sata opened the fourth session of Parliament on September 19th 2014. He looked seriously unwell.
swa: Hivi karibuni lilizizima pale rais sata alipofungua mkutano wa nne wa Bunge mnamo Septemba 19, 2014.Alionekana kuudhoofu sana.

eng: Sata disappeared from the public eye last June, after he met a delegation of senior Chinese officials.
swa: Sata alitoweka hadharani mwezi Juni, baada ya kukutana na ujumbe wa maafisa wa China.

eng: He briefly reappeared at the official opening of the 2014-2015 parliamentary session, where he failed to read his prepared speech.
swa: Alionekana tena kidogo wakati wa kufungua mkutano wa bunge wa 2014-2015, ambapo alishindwa kusoma hotuba iliyoandaliwa.

eng: He later traveled to New York to appear before the United Nations General Assembly, but he missed his allotted time slot to deliver his speech.
swa: Baadae alisafiri kwenda New York kuhudhuria Mkutano Mkuu wa Umoja wa Mataifa, lakini alishindwa kuonekana wakati aliopangiwa kuhutubia ulipofika.

eng: Zambian officials's public statements were equally misleading about the health of Levy Mwanawasa, the country's third president, who died in-office from a stroke in 2008.
swa: Matamko ya maafisa wa Zambia yalipotosha ukweli kuhusu afya ya Levy Mwanawasa, rais wa tatu wa nchi hiyo, alipoteza maisha akiwa madarakani kwa kiharusi mwaka 2008.

eng: While Mwanawasa was in a hospital bed, his vice president, Lupando Mwape, famously told the media that the president was jogging in London.
swa: Wakati Mwanawasa akiwa amelazwa hospitali, makamu wake Lupando Mwape, aliwaambia waandishi wa habari kwamba rais walikuwa anafanya mazoezi ya viungo jijini London.

eng: In June 2008, President Mwanawasa collapsed at a meeting of the African Union in Egypt.
swa: Mwez Juni 2008, Rais Mwanawasa alianguka akiwa kwenye mkutano wa Umoja wa Afrika nchini Misri.

eng: He was rushed to France, where he died several weeks later.
swa: Aliwahishwa Ufaransa, ambako alifariki dunia majuma kadhaa baadae.

eng: Aécio Neves has filed suit against Twitter demanding it discloses information on 66 users; now bloggers claim he's using fake accounts to deal with negative YouTube videos.
swa: Aécio Neves amefungua mashtaka dhidi ya mtandao wa Twita kudai taarifa za watumiaji 66 ziwekwe wazi; hivi sasa wanablogu wanadai anatumia anuani bandia kujaribu kupambana na wapinzani wake kwenye mtandao wa YouTube.

swa: Picha na anuani rasmi ya Flickr ya Aécio Neves .

eng: Ten days ago, web documentary “Helicoca – The 60 Million Reais Helicopter” was removed from YouTube thanks to a copyright claim by a person named "Jorge Scalvini".
swa: Siku kumi zilizopita, filamu ya maisha halisi mtandaoni inayoitwa “Helicoca – The 60 Million Reais Helicopter” iliondolewa kwenye mtandao wa YouTube kufutia hatua ya mtu anayeitwa “Jorge Scalvini” aliyedai kuibiwa haki miliki.

eng: Local netizens have begun to suspect that the video's removal was set in motion by presidential candidate Aécio Neves.
swa: Watumiaji wa mitandao walishuku kuwa kuondolewa kwa video hiyo kulipangwa na kutekelezwa na mgombea urais Aécio Neves.

eng: The documentary investigates one of the largest drug seizures by police in Brazil’s history, in which half a ton of cocaine was found in a helicopter belonging to the powerful Perrella family.
swa: Filamu hiyo inachunguza tukio la kukamatwa kwa madawa ya kulevya na Polisi, ambalo ni tukio kubwa kuwahi kutokea katika historia ya Brazili, ambapo kiasi cha nusu tani za dawa za kulevya kiligundulika kwenye helkopta inayomilikiwa na familia tajiri na yenye nguvu ya Perrella.

eng: The Perellas are key political allies of Aécio Neves, the Brazilian Social-Democratic Party (PSDB) presidential candidate and former governor of Minas Gerais, which borders both São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro.
swa: Wanafamilia wa Perella ndio washirika wakuu wa kisiasa wa Aécio Neves, ambaye ndiye mgombea wa urais kupitia chama cha Demokrasia ya Kijamii Brazili (PSDB) na gavana wa zamani wa jimbo la Minas Gerais, linalopakana na São Paulo na Rio de Janeiro.

eng: The pilot and staff who helped maintain the helicopter were charged with the crime, while police rapidly dismissed the possibility of any involvement by the Perrella family.
swa: Rubani na wafanyakazi waliohusika na mpango huo walishtakiwa kwa makosa ya jinai, na polisi kufanya jitihada za kuiepusha familia ya Perrella na sakata hilo.

eng: The strange absence of information about the Perrellas' role in the incident motivated local journalists to further investigate the story.
swa: Kukosekana kwa taarifa za kuhusika kwa familia ya Perella kwenye tukio hilo kulishangaza wengi na kuwafanya waandishi wa habari kuamua kulifuatilia suala hilo kwa kina.

eng: Developed and commissioned via crowdfunding by Diário do Centro do Mundo, an independent, left-leaning news site, the documentary was directed by Joaquim de Carvalho, a seasoned journalist who has worked for major Brazilian news outlets such as O Estado de S. Paulo and TV Globo.
swa: Diário do Centro do Mundo ni filamu iliyoandaliwa na kufadhiliwa kwa michango ya watu wengi imeratibiwa na tovuti huru ya habari yenye mrengo wa kushoto na kuongozwa na mwongozaji wa filamu Joaquim de Carvalho, mwandishi wa habari aliyewahi kufanya kazi na mashirika makubwa ya habari nchini Brazil kama vile O Estado de S. Paulo na TV Globo.

eng: Diário do Centro do Mundo representatives say that the Scalvini account, which requested that YouTube remove Helicoca, is a fake:
swa: Wanaohusika na filamu ya Diário do Centro do Mundo wanasema kwamba anuani ya Scalvini, ambayo iliyoomba uongozi wa YouTUbe kuifuta Helicoca, ilikuwa bandia:

eng: We tried to find out who Scalvini is.
swa: Tulijaribu kuchunguza kujua Scalvini ni nani.

eng: His email is zerobeta000@gmail.com.
swa: Barua pepe yake ni zerobeta000@gmail.com.

eng: We sent him a message to this address and received no reply.
swa: Tulituma ujumbe kwa anuani yake hiyo na hatukupata majibu.

eng: It seems to be a fake profile after all.
swa: Inaonekana ni anuani bandia.

eng: Scalvini has a Twitter account, opened in 2012, with no tweets.
swa: Scalvini ana anuani ya Twita , aliyoifungua mwaka 2012, na haina twiti yoyote.

eng: His profile on Facebook is empty, with a few likes on pages like "TV Revolta", "Mensaleiros na TV" e "Chega de Corrupção".
swa: Wasifu wake kwenye Facebook hauna kitu, ukiwa na mashabiki wachache kwenye kurasa kama "TV Revolta", "Mensaleiros na TV" e "Chega de Corrupção".

eng: He has also an account on YouTube with his name.
swa: Na pia ana anuani kwenye mtandao wa YouTube kwa jina lake.

eng: He last logged in three months ago.
swa: Aliingia mara ya mwisho miezi mitatu iliyopita.

eng: In order to avoid copyright infringement suits, the general practice at Google (owner of YouTube) is to remove such videos.
swa: Ili kuepuka mashitaka ya kuingilia haki miliko, ni kawaida kwa Google (mmiliki wa YouTube) kuondoa video zinazodaiwa kuingilia haki miliki.

eng: It is incumbent on the video's creator, and not the complainant, to prove that he or she has the right to present the video.
swa: Ni lazima mtengenezaji wa video, na sio mlalamikaji, kuthibitisha kwamba ana haki ya kuweka video hiyo.

eng: Diário do Centro do Mundo has appealed the case with Google and has been told to expect an official reply within 10 days' time.
swa: Diário do Centro do Mundo imekata rufaa kwa Google na imejulishwa kwamba itegemee kupata majibu rasmi ndani ya kipindi cha siku 10.

eng: Freitas wrote:
swa: Freitas aliandika:

eng: The video, as you can see, was taken down.
swa: Video, kama unavyoona, iliondolewa.

eng: Some George Scalvini guy claimed intellectual ownership of the video.
swa: Jamaa anayejiita George Scalvini alidai kuwa na haki miliki ya video hiyo.

eng: It's needless to comment on the similarity between the two names.
swa: Haina haja ya kutoa maoni juu ya kufanana kwa majina hayo mawili.

eng: Apparently, Aécio's campaign has a team specialized on not only taking down videos with accusations that could harm his candidacy, but also little jokes like this, that among all the examples of activist humor is one the most good-natured and inoffensive.
swa: Ni wazi, kampeni ya Aécio ina timu ambayo si tu imebobea kwenye kuondoa video zenye tuhuma zinazoweza kuathiri harakati zake, lakini pia kudhibiti vichekesho vidogo kama hivi, ambavyo katika harakati huwa havina athari kubwa.

eng: Although the documentary contains some footage of Neves taken by TV news stations, and thus potentially vulnerable to copyright violation claims, the spoof video includes no content of this sort.
swa: Ingawa filamu hiyo ina vipande vya habari za Neves zilizochukuliwa kutoka kwenye vituo vya runinga vya habari, vinavyoweza kuyapa nguvu madai ya kukiukwa kwa haki miliki, filamu hizo hazina maudhui ya namna hiyo.

eng: What concerns netizens following the story is that both videos had their property rights challenged by the same person — who may not be a real person at all.
swa: Kinachowapa wasiwasi watumiaji wa mtandao wanaofuatilia habari hiyo ni kwamba video hizo zililalamikiwa haki miliki na mtu mmoja— ambaye anaweza kuwa si mtu halisi hata hivyo.

eng: The only discernible connection between the two videos is the mentioning of Aécio Neves..
swa: Kilichowazi kinachoweza kuunganisha video hizo mbili ni kutajwa kwa jina la Aécio Neves.

eng: Suspicions have also been fueled by Neves' various past attempts to quiet criticism of his leadership on social media.
swa: Hofu hiyo imekuwa kubwa kufuatia majaribio ya zamani aliyoyafanya Neves kuwanyamazisha wapinzani wa utawala wake kwenye mitandao ya kijamii.

eng: In late August, Neves filed a lawsuit against Twitter after the company refused to disclose information and IP addresses for 66 Twitter users.
swa: Mwishoni mwa Agosti, Neves alifungua mashitaka dhidi ya Twita baada ya kampuni hiyo kukataa kutoa taarifa za anuani za utambulisho (IP) za watumiaji wapatao 66.

eng: The former governor claimed the accounts were all fake profiles orchestrated by a specific group to disseminate lies and criticism about him and his campaign.
swa: Gavana huyo wa zamani alidai anuani hizo za twita ni bandia zinazoendeshwa na kundi la watu wenye lengo la kusambaza uongo na upinzani dhidi yake na kampeni zake.

eng: Official documentation of the suit can be seen here.
swa: Tamko rasmi la shitaka hilo linaweza kuonekana hapa.

eng: Magazine Revista Fórum interviewed owners of a few of the accounts among the 66 named in the suit.
swa: Jarida la Magazine Revista Fórum liliwahoji wamiliki wa anuani kadhaa kati ya zile 66 zilizotajwa kwenye shitaka hilo.

eng: Among them is famous film critic Pablo Villaça, founder of Cinema em Cena, the oldest movie website in Brazil.
swa: Mmoja wao ni mchambuzi maarufu wa filamu Pablo Villaça, mwanzilishi wa Cinema em Cena, tovuti ya filamu ya muda mrefu nchini Brazil.

eng: Villaça has publicly voiced his support for Neves' rival, current president Dilma Rousseff.
swa: Villaça ametangaza hadharani kumwuunga mkono mpinzani wa Neves, ambaye ni rais wa sasa Dilma Rousseff.

eng: He told Revista Fórum about the accusations:
swa: Akihojiwa na jarida la Revista Fórum kuhusu madai hayo alisema:

eng: I think this is great, now he must prove actually exists.
swa: Nadhani ni suala zuri, sasa athibitishe kwamba upo .

eng: I have been a political activist since I was 18 years old.
swa: Nimekuwa mwanaharakati wa siasa tangu nikiwa na umri wa miaka 18.

eng: My mother fought against the dictatorship, my aunt went to jail and was tortured.
swa: Mama yangu alipambana na udikteta, shangazi yangu alikwenda jela na kuteswa.

eng: And he insinuates I am paid to be an activist.
swa: Sasa huyu bwana anajaribu kufanya nionekane nalipwa ili kuwa mwanaharakati.

eng: In the previous week, senior executives in the US received letters with harsh considerations and serious criticism of the movie.
swa: Katika majuma yaliyopita, mkuu nchini Marekani alipata barua zenye maneno makali ya kukosoa filamu hiyo.

eng: Letters were sent by PSDB of Minas Gerais. PSDB said my film was of a "political-partisan" nature and didn't represent the reality in the state, besides questioning the ethics of my conduct during the production of the film.
swa: Barua hizo zilitumwa na chama cha PSDB jimboni Minas Gerais wakisema kwamba filamu hiyo ilikuwa na chembechembe za “ushabiki wa kisiasa” na haikuwa ikieleza uhalisi wa mambo, pamoja na kuhoji maadili ya kazi yangu wakati wa kutayarisha filamu hiyo.

eng: According to Florêncio, during an internal investigation at Current TV he had to prove to his journalism director Andrew Fitzgerald every statement he used in the movie and that the accusations made by PSDB were false.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa Florêncio, wakati wa uchuguzi wa ndani kwenye kituo hicho cha runinga cha Current TV ilimbidi kuthibitisha kwa mkurugenzi wa uandishi wa habari Andrew Fitzgerald kila kauli iliyotumika kwenye filamu hiyo na kwamba madai yaliyofanywa na chama hicho jimboni Minas Gerais hayakuwa kweli.

eng: A month later, Fitzgerald agreed to put the documentary back on the air.
swa: Mwezi mmoja baadae, Fitzgerald alikubali kuirudisha filamu hiyo hewani..

eng: In sum, these incidents have left bloggers concerned that the recent video removals are more than just coincidence.
swa: Kwa ujumla, matukio haya yamewaacha wanablogu katika hali ya wasiwasi kwamba kuondolewa kwa video hizi si tukio la bahati mbaya.

eng: And Neves' past behaviors suggest there may be more to come.
swa: Na tabia ya zamani ya Neves inaonesha yapo mengi yanayoweza kutarajiwa katika siku za usoni.

eng: 350.org's Pacific climate warriors paddled out into the Port of Newcastle, followed by hundreds of Australians and came head to head with gigantic coal ships on 17 October.
swa: Mashujaa wa 350.org wa tabianchi ya Pasifiki wamevamia bandari ya Newcastle, wakifuatwa na mamia wa wa-Australia na kupambana na meli kubwa za makaa yam awe mnamo ktoba 17.

eng: It truly was David versus Goliath.
swa: Tukio hilo linaweza kufananishwa na hadithi ya Daudi na Goliati.

eng: The courage of the warriors was on full display as they faced off with the fossil fuel industry, which is threatening their homes.
swa: Ujasiri wa mashujaa hao ulionekana pale walipokikabili kiwanda cha mabaki ya viumbe wa kale, ambacho kinaathiri makazi yao.

eng: Using hand carved canoes, they, along with dozens of Australians in kayaks, were able to prevent 10 scheduled ships from passing through the Newcastle coal port.
swa: Kwa kutumia ngalawa zilizotengenezwa kwa mkono, na kwa ushirikiano wa makumi ya wenyeji wa Australia, waliweza kuzuia meli kumi zilizokuwa zimepangwa kupita kwenye bandari ya Newcastle.

eng: But most importantly, the warriors stood tall and their message was heard loud and clear: they are not drowning, they are fighting.
swa: Lakini lililo muhimu zaidi, mashujaa hao walisimama na ujumbe wao ulisikika vyema na kwa ufanisi: hawakuwa wakileta vurugu wala kupambana.

eng: They will continue to fight, but they can not do it alone.
swa: Wataendelea kupambana, lakini hawawezi kushinda wakiwa peke yao.

swa: Wafanyakazi wa tiba nchini Guinea wana hofu kufuatia vifo 28 na kulazwa kwa wafanyakazi 50 tangu Septemba 17.

eng: Compounding this situation, the lack of protective equipment is so serious that medical gloves are being sold on the black market.
swa: Kuthibiti hali hii, ukosefu wa vifaa vya kinga ni mbaya kiasi kwamba glovu za matibabu zinauzwa kwa bei juu.

eng: According to data backed up by Amenisty International, 41 million girls can't even access elementary education.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa takwimu za shirika la kutetea haki za binadamu duniani Amenisty International, wasichana milioni 41 hawana fursa ya kupata elimu ya msingi.

eng: Illiteracy, child marriage, teen pregnancy are part of a vicious cycle that especially affects our girls.
swa: Ujinga, ndoa za umri mdogo, mimba za utotoni ni sehemu ya mduara usiokwisha unaoathiri maisha ya wasichana.

eng: Thus, Latina America isn't exempted from this global issue, mainly about teen pregnancy:
swa: Kwa hali hiyo, Amerika ya Kusini haikwepi suala hilo la kidunia, kuhusu mimba za utotoni:

eng: Venezuela is top of the list in South America and third place in Latin America with the highest rate of early pregnancy.
swa: Venezuela inaongoza orodha ya nchi za Amerika Kusini na ni ya tatu kwenye eneo la Amerika ya Kati ikiwa na kiwango kikubwa kabisa cha mimba za utotoni.

eng: Out of 100 Venezuelan women that get pregnant each year, 25 are teenagers, according to Telemedicine program at the Central University of Venezuela.
swa: Katika wanawake 100 wa Venezuela wanaopata ujauzito kila mwaka, 25 ni watoto wanaopevuka, kwa mujibu wa mpango wa Telemedicine unaoendeshwa na Chuo Kkuu cha Central Venezuela.

eng: Among the causes of teen pregnancy, it's worth mentioning that one-third of unwanted pregnancies are a result of not using protection, and half of the girls affected didn't receive proper sexual and reproductive education before getting pregnant.
swa: Kati ya sababu za mimba za utotoni, theluthi moja ya mimba zisizotarajiwa ni matokeo ya utokutumia kinga, na nuu ya wasichana wanaoathirika ni wale ambao hawakupata elimu ya afya ya uzazi kabla ya kupata mimba.

eng: So, education is the only way.
swa: Kwa hiyo, elimu ni njia moja pekee.

eng: By educating our girls today, we are empowering women of tomorrow, and therefore, their families and communities.
swa: Kwa kuwaelimisha wasichana wetu leo, tunawawezesha wanawake wa kesho, na hivo, familia na jamii zao.

swa: Unaweza kumfuatilia Marita Seara kwenye Mtandao wa Twita.

eng: A comment about whether the population values the researches carried out from the universities, triggers member of academic community César Viloria to shed a light about this on his blog.
swa: Mawazo ikiwa umma wa wananchi unathamini tafiti zinazofanywa na vyuo vikuu, yamewachokoza mwanazuoni César Viloria kutoa mwangaza kidogo kuhusu suala hili kwenye blogu yake.

eng: About research, we have to know it's divided in two branches: basic research and applied research.
swa: Kuhusu utafiti, lazima tufahamu kwamba kuna aina mbili kuu: utafiti msingi na utafiti tumizi.

eng: The former increases or creates knowledge as well as develops and modificies what already exists.
swa: Utafiti msingi hufanywa kwa minajili ya kuongeza au kuja na maarifa mapya ikiwa ni pamoja na kukuza na kuboresha kile kinachofahamika tayari.

eng: On the other hand, applied research focuses in the application and usefulness of these knowledges on the population.
swa: Kwa upande mwingine, utafiti tumizi hujikita katika matumizi na uhitajikaji wa maarifa kwa jamii.

eng: We can also find differences about times, the former has long term results and the latter shows medium term results.
swa: Tunaweza kuona tofauti hii kwa kuangalia muda pia. Utafiti msingi matokeo yake ni ya muda mrefu wakati utafiti tumizi matokeo yake huonekana baada ya muda mfupi.

eng: You might be thinking now, what about all those formulas with impossible numbers?
swa: Unaweza kuwa unafikiri sasa, vipi kuhusu zile kanuni zenye tarakimu zisizowezekanika?

eng: The blog has also an answer to this question:
swa: Blogu hiyo imejibu vizuri swali hilo:

eng: We find several elements in these items that can make difficult its reading, if we want to know “what is it about”, but they will be very useful if we are researches involved with the topic and what we want to know is “how they did it”.
swa: Tunakutana na mambo kadhaa katika kanuni hizi ambazo wakati mwingine ni vigumu kusomeka, kama tungependa kujua "maana yake hasa", lakini kanuni hizi huwa muhimu sana kama sisi watafiti wenyewe tunaelewa mada husika na tunataka kujua "naona ilivyotokea".

eng: Usually, however, on the introduction and conclusions of these texts, it's possible to understand a general idea of “what is this for".
swa: Mara nyingi, hata hivyo, kwenye utangulizi na hitimisho la maandiko haya, inawezekana kuelewa wazo la jumla la "hiki kina maana gani".

eng: For further information, Uninorte has launched a program called Science within reach, to make us feel part of the scientific community.
swa: Kwa taarifa zaidi, Uninorte amezindua mpango unaoitwa Sayansi inayofikika, kutufanya tujisikie sehemu ya jamii ya kisayansi.
