eng: It is republished on Global Voices under a content-sharing agreement.
swa: Imechapishwa kwa mara nyingine Global Voices kwa makubaliano ya kushirikiana maudhui.

eng: Life was put on hold for many residents, students, patients and commuters of Quetta city, when the Prime Minister of Pakistan and his entourage arrived in Balochistan province's capital last week.
swa: Maisha na shughuli za kawaida zilisimamishwa kwa raia wengi, wanafunzi, wagonjwa na wasafiri wa jiji la Quetta city, pale Waziri Mkuu wa Pakistani na ujumbe wake walipozuru kwenye makao makuu ya jimbo la Balochistan juma lililopita.

eng: According to some estimates, hundreds of thousands are directly and indirectly affected every time road blocks are put up for the security of very important people or VIPs in Quetta, a city home to about 1 million.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa makadirio, mamia ya maelefu ya raia wanaathirika moja kwa moja au kwa namna moja au nyingine kila barabara zinapofungwa kwa sababu za usalama wa watu maarufu wanapozuru Quetta, jiji lenye wakazi milioni 1.

eng: This is fifth time VIP security restricted traffic into the city this year.
swa: Hii ni mara ya tano maafisa wa usalama wanafunga njia kwa ajili ya kuwapisha watu maalumu kwenye jiji hilo ndani ya mwaka huu.

eng: Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif reached Quetta in the morning to participate in the cross-party political meeting "All Parties Conference".
swa: Waziri Mkuu Nawaz Sharif aliwasili Quetta asubuhi kushiriki mkutano wa vyama vya siasa uitwao "Mkutano wa Vyama Vyote vya Siasa ".

eng: The meeting was called in the aftermath of the Mastung bus carnage in Balochistan, where militants killed 22 Pashtun passengers in an ethnically motivated attack.
swa: Mkutano huu uliitishwa baada ya tukio la mauaji ya kwenye basi la Mastung jijini Balochistan, ambapo wanamgambo waliwaua abiria 22 wa Pashtun kwenye shambulio linalosemekana kusukumwa na chuki za kikabila.

eng: All major roads of Quetta located in the vicinity of Governor House, where the meeting was taking place, were shut down on the pretext of security.The last few years, whenever a important politician or powerful person visits Quetta, all major roads are blocked and closed to normal traffic.
swa: Barabara zote za Quetta zilizo karibu na Makazi ya Gavana, mahali ambapo mkutano huo ulifanyika, zilzifungwa kwa sababu za kiusalama. Katika kipindi cha miaka michache iliyopita, imekuwa kawaida kila mwanasiasa au mtu maarufu alipotembelea Quetta, barabara zote kufungwa na usafiri wa kawaida kuzuiliwa.

eng: Commuters travelling from the outskirts of the city to the main downtown had to walk two-three kilometres to reach their destination due to the closed roads.
swa: Wasafiri kutoka nje ya jiji waliokuwa wanaingia mjini walilazimika kutembea umbali wa kilometa mbili hadi tatu ili kufika walikokuwa wakienda kwa sababu barabara zote zilikuwa zimefungwa.

eng: Public transport was not allowed to enter the center of the city and passengers were dropped outside the road blocks.
swa: Usafiri wa umma haukuruhusiwa kuingia katikati ya jiji na wasafiri walishushwa karibu na vizuizi.

eng: Patients and people heading to one of the city's main hospitals Sandmen Provincial had to go through long agonizing hours of waiting before entering the facility, which is near the Governor House.
swa: Wagonjwa na watu waliokuwa wakielekea kwenye hospitali kubwa ya jiji hilo iitwayo Sandmen iliwabidi kuvumilia mateso ya kusubiri masaa kadhaa kabla ya kuingia hospitalini, iliyopo karibu kabisa na Makazi ya Gavana.

eng: “I travelled from my village in Kalat district to Quetta for an urgent errand but due to the closure of roads I will not be able to reach my destination on time,” Murtaza Baloch, told The Balochistan Point.
swa: “Nilisafiri kutoka kijijini kwangu wilayani Kalat kuja Quetta nikimleta mtu kwa dharura lakini kwa sababu ya kufungwa kwa barabara sitaweza kufika ninakokwenda kwa wakati,” Murtaza Baloch, aliuambia mtandao wa The Balochistan Point.

eng: He added, “Now I have to come back to Quetta some other day and this is huge mental stress for me.”
swa: Aliongeza, “sasa itanibidi kurudi Quetta siku nyingine na huu ni usumbufu mkubwa kwangu.”

eng: Three major schools in the city St. Francis Grammar School, St. Joseph Convent School and Sacred Heart School were forced to declare a holiday by the city administration.
swa: Shule tatu kubwa jijini hapo Mt. Francis, Mt. Joseph na Sacred Heart zote zilitangazwa kufungwa na mamlaka za jiji.

eng: The schools are located along the route used for the prime minister.
swa: Shule hizo ziko kwenye barabara inayotumiwa na waziri mkuu.

eng: “Whenever our Prime Minister visits this city, a school day of my daughters is wasted because their school is closed down for that day,” said Saleem Haider, a Quetta resident.
swa: “Kila Waziri Mkuu akitembea mji huu, binti yangu hupoteza siku moja ya shule kwa sababu shule yao hufungwa kwa siku hiyo,” alisema Saleem Haider, mkazi wa Quetta.

eng: On the day of the prime minister's visit, Muhammad Siddique, a car owner stuck in a traffic jam said important meetings and VIP movements should be restricted to the high security military cantonment of the city.
swa: Siku hiyo ya ziara ya waziri mkuu, Muhammad Siddique, mmliki wa gari lililokuwa kwenye foleni alisema mikutano muhimu na safari za watu maarufu zibaki kuwa kwenye maeneo ya kijeshi la jiji hilo.

eng: “If the prime minister and Balochistan government have any concern for Quetta's residents," Siddique said, "then they should conduct all their meetings in Quetta Cantonment and spare us from unnecessary mental stress.”
swa: “Kama waziri mkuu na serikali ya Balochistan wanawajali kidogo tu wakazi wa Quetta," Siddique alisema, "basi wafanye mikutano yao kwenye maeneo ya kijeshi ya Quetta na kutuepusha na matatizo yasiyo ya lazima.”

eng: Is going topless an effective strategy for reviving the Kenyan tourism industry following attacks from militant group Al Shabaab?:
swa: Je, kutembea uchi yanaweza kuwa mbinu bora ya kufufua sekta ya utalii nchini Kenya kufuatia mashambulizi ya wanamgambo wa Al Shabaab?:

eng: Nominated Senator, Mbura allegedly asked women in the coastal region to go topless so that more tourists can visit the region.
swa: Seneta mteule, Mbura anasemekana kuwaomba wanawake katika mkoa wa pwani kutembea nusu uchi ili kuwavutia watalii zaidi kuzuru eneo hilo.

eng: This has raised questions as to what the value of the coastal woman is.
swa: Wito huo umeibua maswali kuhusiana na thamani ya mwanamke wa pwani.

eng: Is that all she is worth- An object of trade?
swa: Je, ndicho anachostahili kuwa - chombo cha biashara?

eng: Edom Kassaye on a research trip in Harar, Ethiopia, July 2013.
swa: Edom Kassaye akiwa kwenye safari ya kitafiti huko Harar, Ethiopia, Julai 2013.

eng: Photo by Endalk Chala.
swa: Picha na Endalk Chala.

eng: In April 2014, nine bloggers and journalists were arrested in Ethiopia.
swa: Mnamo mwezi wa Aprili, wanablogu tisa pamoja na waandishi wa habari walikamatwa nchini Ethiopia.

eng: Several of these men and women had worked with Zone9, a collective blog that covered social and political issues in Ethiopia and promoted human rights and government accountability.
swa: Baadhi ya wanaume na wanawake hawa walikuwa wakifanya kazi na Zone9, blogu ya ushirika iliyokuwa inazungumzia masuala ya kijamii na ya kisiasa nchini Ethiopia ikiwa ni pamoja na kuhamasisha uzingatiaji wa haki za binadamu na uwajibikaji wa serikali.

eng: And four of them were Global Voices authors.
swa: Miongoni mwao, wanablogu wanne walikuwa ni waandishi wa Global Voices.

eng: In July 2014, they were charged under the country’s Anti-Terrorism Proclamation.
swa: Mapema mwezi Julai, walishitakiwa chini ya tamko la wazi la nchi dhidi ya ugaidi.

eng: They have been behind bars ever since and their trial has only recently begun.
swa: Wamekuwa gerezani tangu wakati huo na kesi yao hivi karibuni ndio imeanza kusikilizwa.

eng: This post is part of our series – “They Have Names” – that seeks to highlight the individual bloggers who are currently in jail.
swa: Makala hii ni mfululizo wa makala zetu za – “Wanayo Majina” – iliyo na madhumuni ya kuwazungumzia wanablogu ambao hadi sasa wapo gerezani.

eng: We wish to humanize them, to tell their particular and peculiar stories.
swa: Tunataka kutambua utu wao, tunataka kuelezea habari zao za kipekee na mahususi kabisa.

eng: This story comes from Endalk Chala, a founding member of the Zone9 collective who was spared arrest on account of being in the United States, where he is pursuing a PhD in Media Studies.
swa: Simulizi hii inatoka kwa Endalk Chala, mmoja wa waanzilisji wa muungano wa wanablogu wa Zone9 ambaye aliponea chupuchupu kukamatwa kwa sababu zilizotajwa kuwa alikuwa nchini Marekani, anasomea shahada ya Uzamivu ya masuala ya habari.

eng: I first came to know Edom Kassaye through Befeqadu, the great convener of the Zone9 blogging collective.
swa: Nilitokea kumfahamu Edom Kassaye kupitia kwa Befeqadu mwenyekiti shupavu wa jumuia ya wanablogu wa Zone9.

eng: We met in 2012, when she had just returned from a year-long reporting trip in Kenya. She furnished me with many wonderful stories that she covered during her trip.
swa: Kwa mara ya kwanza tulikutana mwaka 2012, mara tu baada ya yeye kurejea baada ya shughuli yake ya mwaka mmoja ya kuripoti akiwa nchini Kenya.

eng: The stories she told me and the relative journalistic freedom she experienced in Kenya generated deep conversations about the unfortunate situation of Ethiopia’s freedom of expression.
swa: Simulizi alizonipa pamoja na uhuru wa habari alioushuhudia nchini Kenya uliibua majadiliano ya kina kuhusu hali tete ya uhuru wa kujieleza nchini Ethiopia.

eng: From then on, until I left the country in 2013, Edom and I met frequently for coffee.
swa: Tokea hapo, hadi nilipoondoka nchini Kenya mwaka 2013, mimi na Edom tulikuwa tukikutana mara kwa mara kwa ajili ya kupata kahawa.

eng: We grew to become good friends.
swa: Tulitokea kuwa marafiki wazuri.

eng: When I think about my time with Edom, I realize it is no wonder that she got arrested along with six members of the Zone9 collective.
swa: Ninapotafakari muda niliokuwa pamoja na Edom, ninatambua kuwa haishangazi kuona alikamatwa pamoja na wanablogu sita wa jumuia ya Zone9.

eng: People ask why Edom was arrested and charged with terrorism when she was not a member of the group.
swa: Watu wanajiuliza ni kwa nini Edom alikamatwa na kushitakiwa kwa kosa la ugaidi ilhali hakuwa mmoja wa wanaounda kundi la Zone9.

eng: I believe it was Edom’s willingness to bring about a gentle change in Ethiopia’s polarized political environment that suggested an affinity between her and the Zone9 blogging collective.
swa: Ninaamini kuwa ilikuwa nidhamira chanya ya Edom ya kuleta mageuzi sahihi ya siasa hafifu ya Ethiopia ambayo pia ilipelekea yeye kuwa karibu zaidi na wanajumuia wa kublogu wa Zone9.

eng: We shared common principles.
swa: Taratibu zetu ziliwiana.

eng: Edom participated in every single online campaign the Zone9 blogging collective held.
swa: Edom alishiriki kwenye kila kampeni ya mtandaoni ambayo jumuia ya kublogu ya Zone9 ilishiriki.

eng: It seems that her participation in the online campaigns got her noticed by state authorities monitoring social networks.
swa: Inaonekana kuwa, ushiriki wake kwenye kampeni za mtandaoni ndio uliomfanya kufahamika kwake na mamlaka ya nchi ya kufuatilia mitandao ya kijamii.

eng: In the days and weeks leading up to her arrest, Edom resisted pressure to serve as an informant about her friends from the collective.
swa: Katika siku na majuma machache kabla ya kukamatwa kwake, Edom alikataa maombi ya kutumiwa kama mtoa taarifa zilizowahusu marafiki zake wa jumuia ya wanablogu wa Zone9.

eng: Instead, she opted to be jailed with her friends.
swa: Badala yake, alichagua kufungwa gerezani pamoja na marafiki zake.

eng: Her integrity and convictions demonstrate something special about her character — her intense commitment to active citizenship within an increasingly brainwashed and fragmented populous.
swa: Uadilifu wake na msimamo wake unaonesha kitu fulani cha pekee alichonacho- utayari wake thabiti katika uraia imara wa jamii ya watu waliorubuniwa na kuparaganyika..

eng: Jomanex, an exiled blogger, a colleague and friend often calls Edom ‘Miss Integrity’.
swa: Jomanex, mwanablogu aliye uhamishoni, mwenzake na rafiki yake, mara nyingi hupenda kumwita Edom ‘ Mrembo Mwadilifu’.

eng: Edom (left) and Mahlet being escorted to the courtroom inside the compound of High Court in Addis Ababa.
swa: Edom (kushoto) akiwa na Mahlet akisindikizwa kwenye chumba cha mahakama ndani ya viunga vya Mahakama kuu jijini Addis Ababa.

eng: Photo courtesy of the trial tracker blog.
swa: Picha kwa hisani ya Blogu ya ufuatiliaji wa kesi.

eng: Edom is one of the few female journalists I know in the country who practiced journalism on multiple platforms.
swa: Edom ni mmoja wa waandishi wanawake wachache sana ninaowafahamu nchini Ethiopia waliokuwa wanajihusisha na uandishi wa habari katika majukwaa anuai.

eng: Her CV reads as a fast-growing multimedia journalist with keen interest in environment, public health, and social justice.
swa: Wasifu wake unatanabaisha kuwa yeye ni mwandishi anayekua kwa kasi akilenga zaidi kwenye masuala ya mazingira, afya ya jamii na usawa katika jamii.

eng: For outsiders, Edom looked like any young aspiring journalist whose works appeared everywhere from state-owned daily newspaper to independent Addis Ababa radio stations.
swa: Kwa wasiomjua, Edom alichorwa kama mwandishi chipukizi aliyekuwa na hamasa kubwa na ambaye kazi zake zilionekana takribani kila mahali kuanzia kwenye gazeti la kila siku linalomilikiwa na serikali hadi kwenye vituo vya redio vinavyojitegemea vya Addis ababa.

eng: But a few details set her apart.
swa: Lakini, maelezo machache tu yanamfanya kuwa tofauti.

eng: Edom began her journalism career at the state-owned daily newspaper.
swa: Edom alianza kazi yake ya uandishi wa habari akiwa na gazeti la kila siku linalomilikiwa na serikali.

eng: Working as a senior reporter, she tried to inspire optimism about hihg-quality journalism that the Ethiopian state media has rarely exhibited.
swa: Akifanya kazi kama mwandishi wa habari mwandamizi, alijaribu kuonesha msimamo wake kwenye uandishi habari ulio na ubora ambao vyombo vya habari vinavyomilikiwa na taifa la Ethiopia havikuwahi kuuonesha.

eng: But her tendency to ask critical questions was incompatible with the sycophantic culture of state journalism and she decided to take a different career path.
swa: Hata hivyo, utaratibu wake wa kuuliza maswali ya kiudadisi haukuendana na utamaduni wa uandishi wa kuilinda serikali na ndipo alipoamua kuangalia jambo jingine la kufanya.

eng: In 2011, she won her reporting fellowship in Kenya, where she focused on environmental reporting.
swa: Mwaka 2011, alifanikiwa kupata nafasi ya kusoma nchini Kenya, ambapo alielekeza nguvu zake kwenye uandishi wa habari za mazingira.

eng: Upon her return, she decided not to work for state media, opting instead to freelance for various media organizations.
swa: Aliporejea, aliamua kutokufanya kazi na vyombo vya habari vya serikali, badala yake, aliamua kufanya kazi na mashirika mbalimbali ya habari kama mwandishi huru.

eng: When we began Global Voices' Amharic language site in 2012 she served as a volunteer translator for the site.
swa: Tulipoanzisha jukwaa la Global Voices' katika lugha ya Kihabeshi mwaka 2012, yeye alifanya kazi ya kujitolea kama mtafsiri wa tovuti ile.

eng: In 2013, Edom, Befeqadu, Zelalem and I worked together to produce a report on the state of freedom of expression in Ethiopia which later was submitted to United Nations Commission on Human Rights for their Universal Periodic Review.
swa: Mwaka 2013, Edom, Befeqadu, Zelalem pamoja na mimi tulifanya kazi ya pamoja ya kuandaa Taarifa ya hali ya Uhuru wa Kujieleza nchini Ethiopia ambayo baadae iliwasilishwa kwenye Tume ya Umoja wa Mataifa ya Haki za Bidamu kwa ajili ya Mapitio yao ya Jumla ya Mara kwa Mara.

eng: Edom Kassaye.
swa: Edom Kassaye.

eng: Drawing by Melody Sundberg.
swa: Mchoro na Melody Sundberg.

eng: In 2011, the government arrested and prosecuted more than 12 journalists on sham terrorism charges, an act that has become routine since 2005.
swa: Mwaka 2011, serikali iliwatia kizuizini na kuwashitaki waandishi wa habari zaidi ya 12 kwa makosa ya kigaidi ya kutengenezwa, matukio yaliyokuwa yanaendelea tangu mwaka 2005.

eng: Edom took pride in showing solidarity with these journalists.
swa: Edom aliona ni heri kujitoa na kuungana na wanahabari hawa.

eng: She routinely traveled back and forth to the prisons to visit award-winning journalists such as Reeyot Alemu and Eskinder Nega, who are still serving their long prison terms.
swa: Mara kwa mara alikuwa akienda gerezani kwa ajili ya kuwasabahi waandishi na washindi wa tuzo kama vile Reeyot Alemu na Eskinder Nega, ambao hadi sasa wanatumikia kifungo chao kirefu gerezani.

eng: This gave Edom a glimpse of what these journalists’ lives looked like in prison.
swa: Utaratibu huu ulimpa Edom taswira ya hali halisi ya maisha wanayoishi wanahabari hawa wakiwa gerezani.

eng: As a gesture of her solidarity toward the journalists, she regularly tweeted the counts of the days the journalists were made to spend in the prison.
swa: Kama ishara ya kuwaunga mkono wanahabari hawa, mra kwa mara alikuwa akitwiti idadi ya siku ambazo wanahabari hawa walipaswa kuzitumikia gerezani.

eng: I wonder if she ever imagined that she would share a similar fate with them.
swa: Nawaza kama kuna siku aliwaza kuwa kuna siku naye angekuwa gerezani kama ilivyo kwa marafiki wake.

eng: Once I asked her where she drew the inspiration for using her Twitter handle as timer to document the dire situation of the journalists.
swa: Nilimuuliza alipata wapi ujasiri wa kutumia ukurasa wake wa twita kama namna ya kufuatilia muda wanaopaswa kutumikia wanahabari hao wakiwa katika hali mbaya ya maisha ya gerezani.

eng: She told me that in Kality Prison, where Eskinder Nega is held, the guards count prisoners every morning using morning whistles.
swa: Aliniambia kuwa, katika gereza la Kality, mahali ambapo Eskinder Nega anaposhikiliwa, walinzi huwa wana utaratibu wa kuwahesabu wafungwa kwa kutumia filimbi za asubuhi.

eng: They shout loudly – ‘Kotera፣ Kotera፣ Kotera’ which means make yourselves available for the tally, for the tally, for the tally.
swa: Huwa wanapaza sauti sana– ‘Kotera፣ Kotera፣ Kotera’ Ikiwa na maana kuwa, jitokezeni wenyewe kwa ajili ya kuhesabiwa, kwa ajili ya kuhesabiwa, kwa ajili ya kuhesabiwa.

eng: This ritual is common throughout the prison system in Ethiopia.
swa: Utaratibu huu unatumika kwa magereza yote nchini Ethiopia.

eng: It has two purposes: the first is to make the prisoners arise early; the second is to make the prisoners available for morning count.
swa: Mfumo huu una malengo mawili: kwanza ni kuwafanya wafungwa waamke mapema; na sababu ya pili ni kuwaona wafungwa kwa ajili ya kuhesabiwa.

eng: Edom poignantly took this counting ritual and used it in her tweets, to document the days the journalists were forced to spend behind bars.
swa: Kwa uchungu, Edom alijijengea utaratibu wake wa kuhesabu katika twits zake kama namna ya kuhesabu siku walizofungwa wanahari wenzake.

eng: Edom did this until the day she herself become one of them.
swa: Edom aliendelea kufanya hivi hadi pale naye alipoungana na wenzake gerezani.

eng: Since April 25, 2014, Edom has been denied her tweeting rights for showing solidarity with these jailed journalists.
swa: Tangu tarehe 25 Aprili, 2014, Edom alipokonywa haki zake za kutwiti kwa ajili ya kuonesha mshikamano wake kwa wanahabari wenzake waliokuwa wamefungwa gerezani.

eng: In her prison journal, where she narrated how she was arrested, she wrote:
swa: Kwenye jarida lake la gerezani, ambapo alielezea mazingira ya kukamatwa kwake, aliandika:

eng: As I walked across the street a vehicle approached me and closed my walkway.
swa: Nilipokuwa ninavuka barabara, gari lilikuja na kunizibia njia.

eng: Then a couple of hooligan looking men jumped off the car and swarmed at me and they started to ask me to get on to the vehicle.
swa: Wanaume walioonekana wakatili walinivamia na kisha kunilazimisha kuingia kwenye gari.

eng: When I resisted getting on to the vehicle one of the men twisted my wrist; at that moment I just recognized my fight not to be arrested is a futile one but I get on to the car defiantly then squeezed into the back seat in the middle of two men.
swa: Nilipokataa kuingia garini, mmoja wa watu wale alinikunja kiganja cha mkono; na ndipo nilipogundua kuwa kujaribu kukwepa kukamatwa kusingekuwa na manufaa, hata hivyo walitumia nguvu kunifanya niingie kwenye gari na kisha katika siti ya nyuma, wanaume wawili walikaa kulia na kushoto kwangu.

eng: Seating in the car with reflexive silence I asked them to let me make a telephone call to my family.
swa: Nikiwa nimekaa huku nikitafakari kimya kimya, niliwaomba waniruhusu niongee na familia yangu.

eng: They denied me and seized my mobile phone violently ….
swa: Walinikatalia na kuharibu kikatili simu yangu….

eng: Near sundown we arrived at notorious Maekelawi, Federal Police Investigation Centre.
swa: Karibu jua kuzama, tulikaribia Maekelewi, Ushirika wa Kituo cha Upelelezi wa Polisi kinachojulikana kwa ukatili uliopitiliza.

eng: I passed through a dehumanizing search before they led me to a dark cell to be with other inmates….
swa: Nilipitia kwenye ukaguzi ambao haukuwa wa kibinadamu kabisa kabla ya kupelekwa kwenye sero iliyokuwa na giza ili kuungana na waliokuwemo humo….

eng: After a while I heard footsteps we all swarmed to have a look through a peephole to see what is going on then I have seen Mahlet being escorted to other cell….At that moment I felt a reflexive horror for my family since they would extremely be worried about my whereabouts and I felt my tears wetting my cheek.
swa: Baada ya muda kidogo, tulisikia mtu akitembea na ndipo sote tulikusanyika na kuchungulia kupitia kwenye kauwazi kadogo ili kujua kilichokuwa kikiendelea, nilipomuona Mahlet akipelekwa kwenye sero nyingine…. Katika hali ile, nilipata hisia kali ya kuogopesha kuhusu familia yangu kwani lazima walikuwa kwenye dibwi la hofu ya wapi nilikuwa, hapa nilijikuta nikitokwa na machozi.

eng: Edom has done journalism along with her understated activism with a remarkable elegance.
swa: Edom amejihusisha na uandishi wa habari ambao pamoja na kuwa uliambatana na kupuuzwa kwa uanaharakati wake, uanahabari wake umekuwa wa kukumbukwa na wa aina yake ya kipekee.

eng: She has her own unique and polite way of making sure she gets her point across without being intimidating or manipulative.
swa: Alikuwa akitumia upole wake wa kipekee wa kuwasilisha kile alichokiamini bila ya vitisho wala kuficha ukweli.

eng: Two months ahead of my departure to the US for my graduate studies, Edom traveled to Tunisia and on her return, brought me a palm-shaped key holder which is popularly believed to provide protection from evil.
swa: Miezi miwili kabla ya safari yangu ya kwenda Marekani kwa ajili ya masomo ya uzamivu, Edom alikuwa na safari ya Tunisia, na aliporudi, aliniletea zawadi ya kishikio cha funguo kilichokuwa na mfano wa mchikichi ambao huaminiwa kutoa ulinzi dhidi ya mabaya.

eng: It pains me that I could not give Edom protection from the wickedness of our government.
swa: Inaniuma sana kwani sikuweza kumpatia Edom ulinzi dhidi ya serikali yetu dhalimu.

eng: I cherish every minute I spent with Edom, a woman who bravely stands for her convictions.
swa: Ninathamini sana kila dakika niliyoitumia nikiwa na Edom, mwanamke ambaye kwa weledi mkubwa amekuwa akitetea kile alichokiamini.

eng: Graffiti artist Rei Blinky at work in San Pedro Sula, Honduras.
swa: Msanii wa uchoraji kuta, Rei Blinky akiwa kazini huko San Pedro Sula, Honduras.

eng: Credit: Nathaniel Janowitz.
swa: Shukrani kwa: Nathaniel Janowitz.

eng: Used with PRI's permission.
swa: Imetumiwa kwa ruhusa ya PRI.

eng: This article and radio report by Susannah Roberson for The World originally appeared on PRI.org on June 26, 2015, and is republished here as part of a content-sharing agreement.
swa: Makala hii pamoja na ripoti ya radio vimeandaliwa na Susannah Roberson kwa ajili ya The World na kwa mara ya kwanza iliwekwa PRI.org mnamo tarehe 26 Juni, 2015, na inachapishwa tena hapa kwa makubalino ya ubia wa kubadilishana maudhui.

eng: Barbed wire fences, deserted streets, security guards bearing shotguns.
swa: Uzio wa seng'enge, mitaa mitupu, na walinda usalama wakiwa na bunduki.

eng: It sounds like the scene of a dystopian movie, but it's no movie.
swa: Ni kama vile kipande cha filamu ya dystopia, lakini siyo filamu.

eng: This is San Pedro Sula, Honduras, the city that has been named the world's deadliest for four years running.
swa: Hii ni San Pedro Sula, Honduras, jiji ambalo limetajwa kuwa na machafuko kuliko jiji lingine lolote duniani kwa miaka minne mfululizo.

eng: Recently, San Pedro Sula has tried to make a much more optimistic name for itself: home to a booming art scene.
swa: Hivi karibuni, jiji la San Pedro Sula limejaribu kujijengea jina lenye matumaini mema. tried to make a much more optimistic name for itself: mahali palipo shamiri kwa sanaa.

eng: This is largely thanks to its graffiti artists, whose brightly colored murals are popping up all around the city.
swa: Shukrani ziwaendee wasanii wa uchoraji kuta ambao picha zao za ukutani za kupendeza zinaonekana maeneo mbalimbali ya jiji.

eng: Graffiti artist Rei Blinky is what journalist Nathaniel Janowitz calls a "pioneer" for the artistic movement sweeping through the city.
swa: Msanii wa uchoraji kuta, Rei Blinky ndiye haswa mwandishi wa habari Nathaniel Janowitz anamhesabu kuwa ndiye "mwanzilishi" wa harakati hizi kupitia sanaa iliyoenea maeneo mbalimbali ya Jiji.

eng: Blinky was the first artist who ventured out into the practically deserted streets.
swa: Blinky ndiye msanii wa kwanza kuvinjari kwenye mitaa ambayo kwa kiasi kikubwa ilikuwa imekimbiwa na watu.

eng: That ghost town feel has a lot to do with the city's gangs.
swa: Hisia mbaya dhidi ya jiji hili zinahusishwa na magenge ya kihalifu.

eng: You never know when a shootout is going to break out between the gangs. 	Huwezi kufahamu ni wakati gani kurushiana risasi kunaweza kutokea kati ya genge moja na jingine.
So you could be walking down the street and catch a bullet," says Janowitz.
swa: Kwa hiyo, unaweza kujikuta umepigwa risasi wakati unatembea mtaani," anasema Janowitz.

eng: Not only did gangs dominate the streets, but the graffiti scene as well.
swa: Siyo tu magenge haya yanatawala mitaa, hata na uchoraji wa kuta pia umechukua nafasi katika mitaani.

eng: Blinky changed all that with his unique style that Janowitz calls "pop-art indigenous."
swa: Blinky alifanya mageuzi makubwa kwa kuja na namna yake mpya ambayo Janowitz anaiita "pop-art indigenous."

eng: His work is bold, colorful and unmistakable.
swa: Kazi yake inaonekana vizuri, yenye rangi za kuvutia na isiyo na makosa.

eng: He's one of those artists that when you go past one of his paintings, you instantly know it's a Rei Blinky. There's no one else like him, Janowitz says.
swa: Huyu ni mmoja wa wale wasanii ambao ukipitia kazi zake utajua tu kuwa ni yuleyule Rei Blinky.Hakuna mwingine kama yeye anasema Janowitz.

eng: Blinky has paved the road for many more artists to join him.
swa: Blinky amefungua njia ya wasanii wengine wengi kujiunga naye.

eng: The movement has grown a lot, and there's really a blossoming art scene in the city, Janowitz says.
swa: Harakati hizi zimeshaenea kwa kiasi kikubwa, kuna michoro mingi ya kuvutia sana jijini, anasema Janowitz.

eng: Many other artists are becoming known on the streets: Baruc, who pays homage to the women of Honduras in his murals, and Carlos Badia, who creates mixed-media work.
swa: Wasanii wengi wengine wamejizolea umaarufu kwenye mitaa mbalimbali: Baruc, katika kazi zake, anawapa wanawake wa honduras nafasi kubwa, wakati Carlos Badia rbrbs anaandaa kazi zake katika maudhui tofauti tofauti.

eng: It seems like people in San Pedro Sula, while they recognize that the problem is very real with the gangs in the city, they also recognize that they can't spend their lives in fear. 	Inaonekana kuwa watu wa San Pedro Sula, wanatambua kuwa uwepo wa magenge ya wahalifu ni tatizo lililo dhahiri, wanatambua pia hawawezi kuishi maisha ya hofu vile vile.
And they have to be willing to go out into the streets and reclaim it in a peaceful fashion," Janowitz says.
swa: Hivyo, wanalazimika kwenda mitaani na kuitafuta amani kwa njia ya utulivu," anasema Janowitz.

eng: If they don't have the will or the tools to go out there with guns, they'll go out with a paintbrush.
swa: Kama hawapo tayari au hawana vitendea kazi ili waende kudai amani kwa bunduki, wataenda na vishungi vya kupaka rangi.

eng: The graffiti artists hope to connect with the young people of San Pedro Sula, many of whom choose to flee rather than stay in the turbulent city.
swa: Wasanii wa uchoraji kuta wana mategemeo ya kuwafikia vijana wadogo wa San Pedro Sula,wengi wao wakifanya juhudi za kulikimbia jiji kuliko kuendelea kuishi kwenye jiji lenye ghasia.

eng: Right now it seems to a lot of the children in the city, you either join the gangs or you run, Janowitz says.
swa: Kwa sasa, inaonekana idadi kubwa ya watoto jijini, kama siyo kujiunga na magenge basi wanachagua kukimbia, anasema Janowitz.

eng: Blinky and his fellow artists strive to give young people another option — to stay, in peace.
swa: Blinky pamoja na wasanii wenzake wanafanya kila juhudi kuwapa vijana njia mbadala ya kujieleza kwa amani.

eng: Janowitz says one of the artists' main goals is to work with children, take them off the streets and teach them about art.
swa: Janowitz anasema kuwa, moja ya malengo yao makubwa ni kufanya kazi na watoto, kuwatoa mitaani na kuwafundisha sanaa.

eng: Blinky is starting to spread his art beyond Honduras.
swa: Blinky ameanza kusambaza sanaa yake nje ya Honduras.

eng: Thanks to him and his fellow artists, Janowitz says, something positive may come out of San Pedro Sula.
swa: Shukrani zimwendee yeye pamoja na wasanii wenzake, Janowitz anasema kuwa, kuna mengi mazuri yataanza kuonekana San Pedro Sula.

eng: Janowitz is confident that Blinky will be successful.
swa: Janowitz ana imani kuwa, Blinky atafanikiwa.

eng: Blinky's work is special, he says, because, "You could see it on a wall or you could see it in the Louvre.
swa: Kazi ya Blinky ni ya kipekee, anasema hivi kwa kuwa, "kazi yake inaweza kuonekana ukutani au kwenye luva.

eng: He's that great of an artist."
swa: Yeye ni aina ya wasanii wazuri kabisa."

eng: If you believe that nothing good can come from a rifle, then you have to get to know the "escopetarra"—a hybrid that transforms two "lethal" weapons (an AK-47 and a guitar) into an instrument of peace.
swa: Kama unaamini kuwa hakuna jambo zuri linaloweza kutokana na bunduki aina ya gobore, basi unapaswa kukifahamu kifaa kiitwacho "escopetarra"— mchanganyiko uliotokana na kubadilisha silaha mbili "hatari" (an AK-47 na gitaa) na kuwa kifaaa cha amani.

eng: Escopetarra is a Spanish blend that combines the words "escopeta" (shotgun) and "guitarra" (guitar).
swa: Escopetarra ni neno lililotokana na muunganiko wa maneno ya Kispaniola, "escopeta" (bunduki) na "guitarra" (gitaa).

eng: In his Spanish-language podcast, Colombian musician César López talks about how he created the instrument, tracing it from the moment of its conception to all of the technical issues he faced creating it, as well as its characteristic sound.
swa: Kwenye podikasti yake katika lugha ya Kispaniola, mwanamuziki wa Colombia, César López anazungumzia namna alivyokibuni chombo hiki tokea alipopata wazo hadi kwenye mambo yote ya kiufundi aliyokabiliana nayo, pamoja na sauti ya chombo hiki.

eng: There are more AK-47s in the world than any other gun, thanks to how unusually cheap the weapon is to make.
swa: Duniani kuna silaha nyingi sana aina ya AK-47s kuliko aina nyingine yoyote, na inashangaza kwa namna silaha hii ilivyo nafuu kuitengeneza.

eng: It is estimated that there are 35-to-50 million AK-47s in existence, not counting those that are manufactured illegally each year.
swa: Inakadiriwa kuwa kuna idadi ya AK-47 zinazokadiriwa kufika milioni 35-hadi-50, na bila kuhesabu zile zinazotengenezwa kinyemela kila mwaka.

eng: First of all, the AK-47 has caused the most deaths by any weapon on the planet. 	Awali ya yote, AK-47 ndiyo silaha iliyosababisha idadi kubwa zaidi ya vifo kuliko silaha nyingine yoyote duniani.
It's been used in South Africa, the Middle East, Central America, and also in Colombia", stated López in an interview with the American television network, Univision.
swa: Inatumika Afrika ya Kusini, Mashariki ya Kati, Amerika ya Kusini, na pia Colombia.", alisema López katika mahojiano na Mtandao wa Televisheni ya Marekani,Univision.

eng: The first "escopetarra" was made in 2003 using a Winchester rifle and a Stratocaster electric guitar.
swa: Escopetarra ya kwanza ilitengenezwa mwaka 2003 kwa kutumia bunduki aina ya Winchesta pamoja na gitaa la umeme aina ya Stratokasta .

eng: The rifle is taken apart in a way that it is no longer considered a weapon and cannot be used as such.
swa: Kinachofanyika ni kuwa, bunduki hufumuliwa kwa namna ambayo haiwezi kuchukuliwa tena kama silaha na wala kutumiwa kwa matumizi ya namna hiyo.

eng: Currently, about 20 "escopetarras" have been presented to prominent musicians and international leaders who stand for peace, including the Colombian band, Aterciopelados, Argentinean musician Fito Páez, and UNESCO.
swa: Hadi sasa, kuna takribani "escopetarra" 20 ambazo zimeshakabidhiwa kwa wanamuziki mashuhuri pamoja na viongozi wa kimataifa wanaotetea amani ikiwa ni pamoja na bendi ya Colombia inayofahamika kama, Aterciopelados, mwanamuziki wa Argentina, Fito Páez, pamoja na UNESCO.

eng: Two alleged gunmen have been captured after an explosion and gunfire rang out at Istanbul’s Dolmabahçe Palace today, a popular tourist attraction and seat of Turkish prime minister Ahmet Davutoglu.
swa: Washukiwa wawili waliokuwa na bunduki wameshakamatwa mara baada ya kutokea kwa mlipuko ulioambatana na kurushiana risasi kwenye Kasri la Dolmabahçe,jijini Instanbul ambalo ni kivutio kikuu cha watalii na palipo na makazi ya Waziri Mkuu wa Uturuki, Ahmet Davutoglu.

eng: Crowds panicked and people fled over gates and into the streets after two assailants unleashed a stun grenade and several rounds of automatic gunfire, allegedly targeting police officers standing guard at the Ottoman-era site.
swa: Watu walipatwa na taharuki huku wakikimbia na kuruka mageti na kisha kuingia mitaani pale wavamizi wawili walipotupa bomu la mkono pamoja na kuvurumisha mizunguko kadhaa ya risasi, shambulizi linalodhaniwa kuwa liliwalenga maafisa wa polisi waliokuwa wameweka doria katika eneo la Ottoman-era.

eng: Police immediately blockaded the scene.
swa: Hata hivyo, polisi walifanikiwa kukabiliana mapema na wavamizi hao.

eng: The Associated Press reported one police officer was slightly injured.
swa: Associated Press lilitaarifu kuwa, polisi mmoja alijeruhiwa kidogo katika tukio hilo.

eng: Though no group has claimed responsibility for the attack, according to the Associated Press the state-run Anadolu news agency reported that the assailants were members of the Revolutionary People’s Liberation Army-Front, or DHKP-C.
swa: Pamoja na kuwa hakuna kundi lolote lililotangaza kuhusika katika tukio hilo, kwa mujibu wa Associated Press Anadolu, moja ya vyombo vya habari vinavyomilikiwa na serikali lilitaarifu kuwa, washambuliaji hao walikuwa ni wanachama wa chama cha Kijeshi cha Wanaharakati wa Ukombozi wa Kimapinduzi, au DHKP-C.

eng: The Guardian also reported that Turkish news agencies were quoting police sources as saying DHKP-C was behind the attack.
swa: The Guardian pia lilitaarifu kuwa vyombo vya habari vya Uturuki viliwakariri maofisa wa polisi walioelezea kuwa DHKP-C ndio waliohusika kwenye shambulio hilo.

eng: Dolmabahçe Palace stands as one the last great remnants of the Ottoman Empire in Istanbul.
swa: Dolmabahçe linabaki kuwa moja ya Makasri muhimu sana yaliyosalia ya Ngome ya Ottoman jijini Istanbul.

eng: The founder of modern Turkey, Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, died there in 1938.
swa: Mbunifu wa Uturuki ya kisasa, Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, alifariki akiwa kwenye Kasri hili mwaka 1938.

eng: The palace features exhibitions for tourists, though other areas house government agencies, including the seat of the Turkish prime minister.
swa: Kasri hili ni eneo muhimu kwa ajili ya watalii, pamoja na kuwa maeneo mengine yanatumiwa na taasisi za serikali ikiwa ni pamoja na makazi ya Waziri Mkuu wa Uturuki.

eng: The incident comes in the midst of heightened tensions in Turkey, as sitting President Reccip Tayyip Erdogan and the Justice Development Party (AKP) issue new offensives against Kurdish militants in northern Iraq and the Islamic State in Syria.
swa: Tukio hili linakuja kipindi ambacho kumekuwa na mvutano mkali nchini Uturuki, kwani Rais aliyepo madarakani, Reccip Tayyip Erdogani pamoja na Chama cha Utafutaji Haki (AKP) wakiwa wameonesha kwa mara nyingine chuki dhidi ya wanamgambo wa Kikurdi waliopo huko kaskazini mwa Iraki pamoja na wanamgambo wa Dola ya Kiislam nchini Syria.

eng: Image: Google maps
swa: Image: Google maps

eng: Also on Wednesday, eight soldiers were killed in a roadside bombing in Siirt, a southeastern Turkish region bordering Syria and Iraq.
swa: Pia, siku ya Jumatano, wanajeshi watano waliuawa kufuatia mlipuko wa bomu lililokuwa limetegwa pembezoni mwa barabara huko Siirt, eneo la Kusini mwa Uturuki linalopakana na nchi za Siria na Iraki.

eng: According to the BBC, that attack was blamed on PKK militants.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa BBC, shambulio hilo linadhaniwa kuwa lilitekelezwa na wanamgambo wa PKK.

eng: “Turkey is on high alert,” said Eyup Kabogan, 27, a bartender at the Pierre Loti Hotel in Sultanahmet, in central Istanbul about five kilometers south of the palace.
swa: “Uturuki ipo katika hali kuu ya tahadhari,” alisema, Eyup Kabogan, aliye na umri wa miaka 27, mfanyakazi katika hoteli ya Pierre Loti iliyopo Sultanahmet, katikati mwa Jiji la Istanbul takribani kilometa 5 Kusini mwa Kasri hili.

eng: “Even I have to watch where I am going when I walk down the street now.”
swa: “Kwa sasa, ninapaswa kuchukua tahadhari kila mtaa ninaopita.”

eng: “I am Kurdish, by the way,” Kabogan said, adding, “but I know that there are other means to change things (politically).”
swa: “Hata hivyo, mimi ni Mkurdi,” anasema Kabogan, anaongeza, “lakini ninajua kuna namna nyingine ya kubadili hali ya mambo (kisiasa).”

eng: Tourists should stay away from crowded areas and police stations, Kabogan warned, though he said that terror groups are “not targeting tourists, but security officers.”
swa: Kabogan alionya kuwa, watalii wanapaswa kuwa mbali na mikusanyiko mikubwa ya watu pamoja na kutokuwepo karibu na vituo vya polisi, pamoja na kuwa alitanabaisha kuwa, makundi ya waasi “hayawalengi watalii, bali maafisa wa usalama.”

eng: Turkey’s political landscape is in flux after Davutoglu’s attempts to create a power-sharing coalition failed last week.
swa: Hali ya siasa za Uturuki ipo katika misukosuko kufuatia kushindikana kwa jaribio la Davutoglu la wiki jana la kuunda serikali ya mseto.

eng: On Tuesday, he gave Erdogan a mandate to form a new government ahead of elections expected in November.
swa: Siku ya Jumanne, alitoa mamlaka kwa Rais Erdogan ya kuunda serikali mpya kabla ya chaguzi zinazotarajiwa kufanyika mwezi November.

eng: “I don’t really know what to say (about today’s attack),” said Berk Çoker, 21, who is Turkish and a rising junior at Stanford University.
swa: “Sijui hata niseme nini (kufuatia shambulizi la leo),” alisema Berk Çoker, aliye na umri wa miaka 21, ambaye ni mturuki na kinda aliyepo Chuo Kikuu cha Stanford.

eng: A computer science major, Coker had plans to return to his home country after a software engineering internship in the San Francisco Bay Area this summer.
swa: Coker, ambaye ni mtaalamu wa Sayansi ya Kompyuta, alikuwa na mipango ya kurejea nchini mwake mara baada ya kumaliza mafunzo yake ya ujasiriamali wa uhandisi wa vitumizi vya kompyuta, uliokuwa unafanyikia eneo la San Francisco Bay katika kipindi cha majira haya ya joto.

eng: “As evidenced by the attacks and the unformed coalition, the political climate is pretty tense, making it an unsafe country for travel,” Coker said.
swa: “Kama inavyodhihirishwa kwa mashambulizi pamoja na kutofikia makubaliano ya serikali ya mseto, hali ya kisiasa bado ni tete sana, kiasi cha kuifanya nchi hii isiwe salama kuizuru,” Coker alisema.

eng: In response to growing violence, according to The Telegraph, the Erdogan government has detained more than 2,500 suspected members of IS, PKK and DHKP-C.
swa: Kufuatia machafuko yanazozidi kushamiri, kwa mujibu wa gazeti la The Telegraph, serikali ya Erdogan imeshawatia nguvuni zaidi ya washukiwa 2,500 wa makundi ya IS, PKK na DHKP-C.

eng: In the middle of intense vegetation in southeastern Veracruz, a state along the Mexican Gulf, the town of Yanga is evidence to the presence and settlement of Africans in Mexico.
swa: Katikati ya uoto uliofungamana huko Kaskazini mwa Veracruz, jimbo linalopakana na Ghuba ya Mexico, mji wa Yanga ni kiashiria cha uwepo wa makazi ya Waafrika huko Mexico.

eng: On our way to the Port of Veracruz, we stopped at Yanga and saw the agricultural fields full of caña and corn surrounding the area, also rich in coffee plantations; the tropical weather invites you to be outside, under the sun's open arms.
swa: Tukiwa tunaelekea kwenye bandari ya Veracruz, tulisimama mjini Yanga ambapo tuliona mashamba ya kilimo yaliyosheheni caña pamoja na mahindi kila mahali, pia yalionekana mashamba makubwa ya kahawa; hali ya hewa ya kitropiki inakufanya uendelee kukaa nje ili kuliota jua.

eng: Yanga claims to have been the first free African town in the Americas, proclaimed on October 3, 1631.
swa: Yanga inaaminika kuwa ndio mji huru wa kwanza wa Waafrika huko Amerika ulioanzihwa rasmi Oktoba 3, 1631.

eng: Afro-Mexicans proudly share the story of “El Yanga,” apparently an enslaved prince from the Yang-Bara tribe from Gabon, who helped slaves to be free from the Spanish around 1570.
swa: Waafrika-Wa-Kimexico wanajivunia kuwa sehemu ya simulizi ya “El Yanga,” aliyejulikana dhahiri kama Mfalme aliyekuwa mateka kutoka katika kabila la Yang-Bara la Gabon, ambaye aliwasaidia watumwa kuwa huru kutoka kwa Waspaniola kwenye miaka ya 1570.

eng: One of the town’s plazas shows his statue, presenting El Yanga as a defiant, proud man.
swa: Moja ya eneo la soko imewekwa sanamu yake, inamtambulisha El Yanga kama mmoja wa watu wajasiri na wa kujivunia.

eng: The main plaza, the portales, and the main church are as typical as in many other Mexican towns inviting serene strolls.
swa: Masoko makuu, malango pamoja na kanisa kuu hufafana kabisa na yale yaliyopo kwenye miji mingine ya Mexico na ambayo huleta hamasa ya utulivu na matembezi ya raha yasiyo na bugudha.

eng: Yanga is peaceful and emanates longevity.
swa: Mji wa Yanga ni wa amani na unatoa imani kwa ustawi mkubwa wa wakazi.

eng: Many centuries and people have lived and died there, perhaps oblivious to history, yet making history themselves.
swa: Karne nyingi na watu wengi wameishi na wameshakufa wakiwa hapo, Many centuries and people have lived and died there, pengine hii ikiwa ni dhahiri katika historia, lakini bado wao wenyewe wanaendelea kuweka historia.

eng: Former Tanzanian Prime Minister and main opposition presidential candidate Edward Lowassa.
swa: Waziri Mkuu Mstaafu wa Tanzania na Mgombea urais kwa tiketi ya Muungano wa vyama upinzani, Edward Lowassa.

eng: Photo by TZA One and released under Creative Commons.
swa: Picha na TZA One na imetolewa kwa masharti ya Creative Commons.

eng: Tanzania's October 25 General Election will be the most tightly contested election in the country's history after hugely popular former Prime Minister, Edward Lowassa, defected from the ruling party to join the main opposition bloc.
swa: Uchaguzi mkuu wa Octoba 25 nchini Tanzania utakuwa na ushindani mkali kuliko uchaguzi mwingine wowote uliowahi kufanyika katika historia ya nchi hiyo baada ya Waziri Mkuu mstaafu na mwenye umaarufu mkubwa, Edward Lowassa kuachana na chama tawala na kujiunga na umoja wa vyama vya upinzani.

eng: Lowassa defected in late July after he was eliminated from the list of presidential aspirants for the ruling party Chama Cha Mapinduzi (CCM).
swa: Lowassa alikihama chama tawala mapema mwisho wa mwezi Julai mara baada ya kuenguliwa kwenye orodha ya wawania kiti cha urais kupitia chama tawala Chama Cha Mapinduzi (CCM).

eng: He announced his intention to run for the opposition bloc Chama Cha Demokrasia and Maendeleo (Chadema) shortly after.
swa: Muda mfupi baadae, alieleza nia yake ya kujiunga na chama cha upinzani, Chama Cha Demokrasia and Maendeleo (Chadema).

eng: Lowassa claims that he unfairly lost his bid to become the ruling party's candidate.
swa: Lowassa anadai kuwa hakutendewa haki na hivyo kukoseshwa nafasi ya kuwa mgombea urais kwa tiketi ya chama tawala.

eng: He now represents a union of four political parties fighting for the adoption of a new constitution.
swa: Kwa sasa, amekuwa mgombea pekee wa urais atakayeuwakilisha umoja wa vyama vinavyotetea kupatikana kwa Katiba ya Wananchi (UKAWA).

eng: Given that Lowassa commands huge support, especially from young people, this is the first time during the history of multiparty politics that the country's opposition has a genuine chance of winning.
swa: Ikizingatiwa kuwa Lowassa anaungwa mkono na watu wengi, hususani vijana, hii ni mara ya kwanza katika historia ya siasa ya mfumo wa vyama vingi kwa upinzani nchini Tanzania kuwa na nafasi kubwa ya kushinda nafasi ya kiti cha Urais.

eng: After Lowassa’s defection, a number of key members of the ruling party including Members of Parliament, councilors and regional officials followed him to Chadema.
swa: Baada ya kutoka chama tawala, wanachama wengine kadhaa wa kutoka chama tawala wakiwemo wabunge, madiwani na viongozi wengine wa mikoani nao walihamia kwenye chama kikuu cha upinzani, Chadema.

eng: His switchover has ruffled feathers, however.
swa: Hata hivyo, kuhama kwake kumeleta mtikitisiko.

eng: Until recently, Chadema considered Lowassa corrupt and unprincipled.
swa: Hadi kipindi cha hivi karibuni, Chadema ilikuwa ikimuona Lowassa kama fisadi na mtu alisiyeoongozwa na misingi inayoeleweka.

eng: Chadema led calls for him to go when he was implicated in a corruption scandal that culminated in his resignation in 2009.
swa: Chadema waliongoza mapambano ya kumtaka kuachia madaraka wakati alipotuhumiwa kuhusika kwenye kashfa ya ufisadi iliyomlazimisha achukue uamuzi wa kujiuzulu 2008.

eng: He has constantly denied that his office was involved in accepting kickbacks for a major energy contract from American company Richmond Development.
swa: Mara zote amekuwa akikanusha kuwa ofisi yake ilihusika kupokea rushwa ili kuwezesha kupitishwa mkataba mkubwa wa uzalishaji umeme kutoka kwa kampuni ya Kimarekani ya Richmond Development.

eng: Some members of Chadema have left the party in protest.
swa: Baadhi ya wanachama wa Chadema wameshangazwa na hatua ya chama hicho kumpokea na wamepinga kwa kukihama chama.

eng: But Chadema's chances may be boosted by the appearance of Juma Duni Haji as Lowassa's running mate.
swa: Hata hivyo, umaarufu wa Chadema unaonekana kuongozeka mara baada ya kupitishwa kwa Juma Duni Haji kama mgombea mwenza wa Lowassa.

eng: Haji, who has run on opposition tickets in Tanzanian presidential elections in the past, was Minister of Infrastructure and Communications until Lowassa defected.
swa: Haji, ambaye katika chaguzi za miaka kadhaa iliyopita amekuwa akigombea kwenye nafasi za kitaifa kwa tiketi ya vyama vya upinzani, alikuwa waziri wa Uchukuzi na Mawasiliano hadi kipindi Lowassa anaihama CCM.

eng: As Moscow appears to be expanding its military presence in Syria, many around the world have been busy debating Russia’s agenda in that country, asking if the Kremlin’s support for President Bashar al-Assad is compatible with the West’s campaign against ISIS, which includes efforts to remove Assad from power.
swa: Kadiri Moscow inavyojaribu kuimarisha ushiriki wake kwenye vita vya nchini Syria, jamii kubwa ya kimataifa imekuwa ikifuatilia na kujadili kwa ukaribu kuhusiana na azma ya Urusi nchini Syria, wakihoji ikiwa msaada wa Kremlin kwa Rais Bashar al-Assad ni msaada muafaka kwa kampeni ya Magharibi ya kulitokomeza kundi la ISIS, ambayo pia inahusisha na harakati za kumuondoa madarakani Assad.

eng: While some question Moscow’s commitment to defeating ISIS in Syria, Russia’s campaign against the extremist group at home is undeniable.
swa: Wakati watu wengine wakihoji kuhusu utayari wa Moscow wa kukabiliana na ISIS nchini Syria, harakati za Urusi dhidi ya kikundi katili cha ISIS nchini humo ni dhahiri kabisa.

eng: Earlier this week, Ramzan Kadyrov, the ruler of the Russian Republic of Chechnya, reminded everyone what this war looks like.
swa: Mapema wiki hii, iongozi wa Jamhuri ya Kirusi ya Chechnia, Ramzan Kadyrov aliwatahadharisha watu kuhusiana na mazingira halisi ya vita hivi.

eng: In a post on Vkontakte (Russia’s most popular online social network), Kadyrov shared a short video featuring roughly half a dozen men standing in a row with their heads bowed in shame.
swa: Kwenye makala ya Vkontakte (Mtandao wa Kijamii maarufu wa Kirusi), Kadyrov alipakia vido fupi iliyokuwa ikionesha watu takribani nusu dazeni waliokuwa wamesimama kwenye mstari huku wakiwa wameinamisha vichwa vyao kwa aibu.

eng: Speaking Chechen, Kadyrov gestures to the men disapprovingly.
swa: Akiongea kwa lugha ya Kichechnia, Kadyrov anawatambulisha watu hao huku akiwa na taswara mbaya dhidi yao.

eng: Next an old man and then an old woman speaks to the men with anger and tears.
swa: Na kilichofuata, mwanaume mkongwe na pia mwanamke mkongwe wanaongea na watu hao kwa hasira na huzuni tele.

eng: They point.
swa: Wanawasema.

eng: They shout.
swa: Wanapaza sauti zao.

eng: They bury their faces in their hands.
swa: Wanazificha nyuso zao kwa mikono yao.

eng: The video features Chechen men caught recruiting for ISIS on social networks, and the elderly people shouting at them are their relatives and local community leaders.
swa: Video hii inawaonesha wanaume wa Chechen waliokamatwa kama mawakala wanaotumiwa kusajili wanachachama wapya wa ISIS kupitia mitandao ya kijamii na watu waliokwenda umri wanaowafokea ni ndugu zao pamoja na viongozi wa jamii ya hapo.

eng: Kadyrov also implies that these individuals were reported to the police by their own families.
swa: Pia, Kadyrov anatanabaisha kuwa, taarifa za watu hawa zilifikishwa kwa polisi na ndugu wa familia zao wenyewe.

eng: I met with the relatives of the young men who promoted ISIS on social networks.
swa: Nilikutana na ndugu wa vijana waliokuwa wakilitangaza kundi la ISIS kwenye mitandao ya kijamii.

eng: I also invited several imams and community leaders.
swa: Niliwaalika pia maimamu kadhaa na viongozi wa kijamii.

eng: All these misguided men have parents who are honest, deeply religious people who sincerely condemn their sons’ actions.
swa: Watu hawa waliopotoshwa wana wazazi ambao ni waaminifu, waumini wa kweli wa dini wanaowalaumu watoto wao kwa vitendo vyao.

eng: These parents repeatedly told them that they raised their sons to become the backbone of their families, to be true Muslims, and good citizens.
swa: Mara kadhaa, wazazi hawa walitanabaisha kuwa waliwakuza watoto wao waje kuwa tegemeo kubwa kwa familia zao, wawe waislam wa kweli na raia wazuri.

eng: They also said they had no need of sons who betrayed their family, their relatives, their loved ones, Islam, and their people.
swa: Walisema pia kuwa hawakuwa na sababu ya kuwa na watoto waliosaliti familia zao, ndugu zao, wapendwa wao, uislam pamoja na watu wao.

eng: One of these young men sought out weak-minded peers and tried to convince them to go to Syria.
swa: Mmoja wa vijana hawa wadogo alikuwa akitafuta wenzake ambao hawakuwa na uwezo mzuri wa kung'amua mambo na kujaribu kuwashawishi waende nchini Syria.

eng: He circulated messages containing threats against the authorities and their families.
swa: Alisambaza jumbe zilizokuwa zikitoa vitisho kwa mamlaka za serikali pamoja na wanafamilia.

eng: I told them again: there’s no place in Chechnya for anyone who even glances in the direction of ISIS.
swa: Niliwaambia tena kwa mara nyingine: Chechen hakuna nafasi kwa yeyote awaye anayejaribu kujihusisha kwa namna yoyote na ISIS.

eng: The most important thing is that parents are working closely with the clergy and the police.
swa: Jambo la muhimu zaidi ni kuwa wazazi wanashirikiana kwa ukaribu kabisa na viongozi wa dini pamoja na polisi.

eng: At the first sign of suspicious behavior, they immediately notify the police and local officials.
swa: Mara tu wanapoona kuna dalili zisizoridhisha, kw haraka sana huwajulisha polisi pamoja na maafisa wengine wa eneo husika.

eng: This helps prevent even worse consequences.
swa: Utaratibu huu husaidia pia kuzuia kutokea kwa madhara mengine makubwa yasiyotarajiwa.

eng: For two days, local authorities failed to respond to requests for help.
swa: Kwa siku mbili, mamlaka husika hazikuweza kujitokeza kwa ajili ya kutoa msaada.

eng: Finally, on Thursday, September 24, several tenants decided to take matters into their own hands, pulling up the bricks and digging out the trapped animal, which turned out to be pregnant.
swa: Hatimaye, siku ya Alhamisi, Septemba 24, wapangaji kadhaa waliamua kuchukua hatua kwa kuyaondoa matofali na kisha kumtoa mbwa huyo na ambaye aligundulika kuwa alikuwa na mimba.

eng: Footage of the rescue soon made its way online, where it has attracted more than 77,000 views in less than 48 hours.
swa: Picha za uokozi kwa haraka zilipata umaarufu katika mitandao ya kijamii, ambapo kwa chini ya masaa 48, zilikwisha kutazamwa na watu zaidi ya 77,000.

eng: A local animal rights community called "Right to Life" has taken temporary custody of the dog, launching a campaign to find her a new home.
swa: Jumuia ya wazawa ya kutetea haki za wanyama inayofahamika kama "Right to Life (Haki ya Maisha")" imechukua jukumu la kumhifadhi mbwa huyo kwa muda, na pia kuanzisha kampeni ya kumpatia mbwa huyo makazi yake mapya.

eng: Sadly, the animal (named Belka, or "Squirrel") lost her puppies due to the stress and dehydration of being trapped underground.
swa: Kwa bahati mbaya watoto wa mbwa huyo(aliyepewa jina la Belka, au "Kichakoro/Kuchakoro") walipoteza maisha kutokana na msongo pamoja na kupoteza maji mengi baada ya kunaswa ardhini.

eng: She is currently rehabilitating in a clinic, where veterinarians performed an ultrasound and sterilized her.
swa: Kwa sasa, mbwa huyo yupo kwenye kliniki kwa ajili ya ungalizi wa karibu, ambapo wataalamu wa mifugo walifanya utabibu wa mionzi na kumhasi.

eng: Some were released after four months of interrogation.
swa: Baadhi yao waliachiwa baada ya miezi minne ya kuhojiwa.

eng: However, ten were charged on October 31, 2014 under Ethiopia's Anti-Terrorism Proclamation with having links to diaspora-based Ethiopian opposition groups such as Ginbot 7, applying to attend an online security training, and engaging in online activism.
swa: Hata hivyo, kumi kati yao walisomewa mashtaka yao mnamo Oktoba 31, 2014 chini ya sheria ya Ethiopia ya Kupambana na Ugaidi kwa madai kuwa wana mitandao ya makundi ya upinzani ya wa-Ethiopia wanaoishi nje ya nchi hiyo kama vile Ginbot 7, kutuma maombi ya kuhudhuria mafunzo ya usalama wa kimtandao, pamoja nna kujihusisha na uanaharakati wa mtandaoni.

eng: Three of the 10 defendants are not members of any political party but ordinary citizens who were arrested for applying to attend a course.
swa: Watatu kati ya washtakiwa 10 hawakuwa wanachama wa chama chochote cha siasa zaidi ya kuwa raia wa kawaida waliokamatwa kwa kuomba kupata mafunzo ya usalama wa mtandaoni.

eng: These are Zelalem Workagegnehu, Yonatan Wolde and Bahiru Degu.
swa: Hawa ni Zelalem Workagenegu, Yonatan Wolde and Bahiru Degu.

eng: The controversial Anti-Terrorism Proclamation was adopted in July 2009.
swa: Sheria hiyo tata ya Kupambana na Ugaidi ilianza kufanya kazi mwezi Julai 2009.

eng: Ethiopian officials tend to defend the law by arguing that its controversial provisions were copied from the existing laws of countries such as the United Kingdom.
swa: Maafisa wa Ethiopia wanaitetea sheria hiyo kwa kudai kwamba vipengele vyake vyenye utata vilinukuliwa kutoka kwenye sheria zinazofanya kazi katika nchi nyingine kama vile Uingereza.

eng: Article 6 of the Proclamation, which has been used to curtail freedom of expression, provides that:
swa: Ibara ya 6 ya sheria hiyo, ambayo ndiyo imetumika kufinya uhuru wa kujieleza, inatamka kwamba:

eng: hosoever publishes or causes the publication of a statement that is likely to be understood by some or all of the members of the public to whom it is published as a direct or indirect encouragement or other inducement to them to the commission or preparation or instigation of an act of terrorism .
swa: Mtu yeyote atakayechapicha au kuwezesha kuchapishwa kwa tamko linaloweza kutafsiriwa na baadhi au watu wengine wote kama kuhamasisha moja kwa moja au kwa namna moja au nyingine ama kuwafanya watu kufanya au kujiandaa au kuchochea kitendo cha ugaidi

eng: Zelalem, the first defendant, is an academic and a human rights activist who blogs at DeBirhan.
swa: Zelalem, mshitakiwa wa kwanza, ni mhadhiri na mwanaharakati wa haki za binadamu anayeblogu kwenye blogu ya DeBirhan.

eng: Yonatan and Bahiru, who are best described as concerned citizens, had applied along with Zelalem for a social media and Internet security training that was brought to their knowledge by a US-based Ethiopian journalist.
swa: Yonatan na Bahiru, wanaoweza kuelezewa vizuri kama wananchi wenye kuguswa na hali ya mambo nchini mwao, walituma maombi sambamba na Zelalem kushiriki mafunzo ya usalama wa intaneti na mitandao ya kijamii baada ya kuarifiwa uwapo wa mafunzo hayo na mwandishi mmoja wa ki-Ethiopia anayeishi Marekani.

eng: After an email from the Ethiopian journalist in the US was found in their possession, these young men were also arrested and later charged with applying for "a terror" when in fact the training was about Internet safety and security.
swa: Kukutwa na barua pepe kutoka kwa mwandishi huyo aliyekuwa Marekani lilikuwa kosa kubwa na vijana hawa walikamatwa na kushitakiwa kwa kosa la kutuma maombi ya "kushiriki mafunzo ya ugaidi" wakati ukweli ni kuwa mafunzo hayo yalihusiana na usalama wa mtandao wa intaneti kwa watumiaji.

eng: Ethiopian court last month acquitted Abraham Solomon, detained for having connections with the first defendant Zelalem, along with four other opposition politicians namely Abraha Desta, an official of the opposition Arena Tigray Party and social media activist, Yeshiwas Assefa, council member of the Blue (Semayawi) Party, Daniel Shibeshi, official of the now defunct Unity for Democracy and Justice (UDJ) party and Habtamu Ayalew, former Public Relations Head of the defunct UDJ.
swa: Mwezi uliopita, mahakama ya Ethiopia haikuwakuta na hatia Abraham Solomon, aliyekuwa amekamatwa kwa kosa la kuwa na uhusiano na mshitakiwa wa kwanza Zelalem, sambamba na wanasiasa wengine wanne wa upinzani ambao ni Abraha Desta, afisa wa chama cha upinzani cha Arena Tigray Party na mwanaharakati wa mitandao ya kijamii, Yeshiwas Assefa, mwanachama wa baraza la chama cha siasa cha Semayawi, Daniel Shibeshi, afisa wa chama kisichosikika sana cha Unity for Democracy and Justice (UDJ) na Habtamu Ayalew, Mkuu wa Mawasiliano ya Umma wa chama hicho.

eng: However, until today they have not been released because the Prosecutor has reportedly appealed the decision.
swa: Hata hivyo, mpaka leo hawajaachiliwa huru kwa sababu Mwendesha mashtaka anasekana kukata rufaa dhidi ya uamuzi huo.

eng: An article by the Electronic Frontier Foundation shows the increasing attempts of silencing online activists and netizens in Ethiopia.
swa: Makala iliyoandikwa na asasi ya Electronic Frontier Foundation inaonesha kuongezeka kwa juhudi za kuwanyamazisha wanaharakati wa mtandaoni pamoja na watumiaji wa jumla wa mitandao hiyo wanaoishi Ethiopia.

eng: The organisation called Ethiopia to:
swa: Asasi hiyo ilitoa mwito kwa Ethiopia:

eng: Immediately free all journalists in prison, including the remaining Zone 9 bloggers, and relieve them of all charges for the “crime” of reporting the news.
swa: Tunadai kuachiwa huru waandishi wote walioko gerezani, ikiwa ni pamoja na wanablogu wa Zone 9 waliobaki, na kufutiwa mashtaka yote ya kutenda 'jinai' kwa sababu tu ya kuandika habari.

eng: End the prosecution of individuals for pursuing security training and using encryption technologies, and free Zelalem Workagegnehu, Yonatan Wolde, Abraham Solomon, and Bahiru Degu.
swa: Acheni kutesa watu kwa kutafuta mafunzo ya usalama mtandaoni ama kutumia teknolojia za kuficha taarifa zao. Mwachieni huru Zelalem Workagegnehu, Yonatan Wolde, Abraham Solomon, na Bahiru Degu.

eng: Cease and desist from using invasive surveillance technologies like FinFisher and Hacking Team’s Remote Control System to spy" on Ethiopian journalists, Diaspora, and opposition groups.
swa: Komesheni na acheni kutumia teknolojia za kudukua mawasiliano ya watu kama vile FinFisher na mfumo wa kudhibiti mawasiliano ya wengine unaitwa Hacking Team kuwapeleleza waandishi wa habari wa Ethiopia, nje ya nchi, na makundi ya upinzani.

eng: While Zone9 remains among Ethiopia's best-known case of its kind, stories like that of Zelalem demonstrate that the issues these bloggers face extend far beyond a few individuals.
swa: Wakati kesi ya Zone9 inabaki kuwa ya aina yake nchini Ethiopia, habari kama za Zelalem zinaleta picha kwamba masuala yanayowakabili wanablogu hawa yanavuka mipaka ya makosa binafsi ya watu wachache.

eng: The next court appearance of Zelalem, Yonatan and Bahiru is Monday, 23 November 2015.
swa: Zelalem, Yonathan na Bahiru wanatarajiwa kusomewa mashtaka yao kati ya Novemba 7-9, 2015.

eng: Tizita Hagere (right) plays the role of 14-year-old Hirut Assefa in 'Difret.'
swa: Tizita Hagere (kulia) akicheza nafasi ya Hirut Assefa mwenye umri wa miaka 14 kwenye filamu ya 'Difret.'

eng: Credit: Truth Aid Media.
swa: Haki Miliki: Truth Aid Media.

eng: This article and radio report by Joyce Hackel and Julia Barton for The World originally appeared on PRI.org on October 22, 2015, and is republished here as part of a content-sharing agreement.
swa: Makala haya pamoja na taarifa ya redioni yameandaliwa na Joyce Hackel akishirikiana na Julia Barton kwa ajili ya kipindi cha The World kilichosikika awali kwenye tovuti ya PRI.org mnamo Oktoba 22, 2015, na imechapishwa tena hapa kama sehemu ya makubaliano ya kushirikiana maudhui.

eng: The word "Difret" has many shades of meaning in Ethiopia's language Amharic: it can mean both "to dare" and "to have courage," but also "to be violated."
swa: Neno "Difret" lina maana nyingi katika lugha ya ki-Amariki inazungumzwa nchini Ethiopia: linaweza kumaanisha 'kuthubutu' na 'kuwa na ujasiri,' lakini vile vile laweza kuwa na maana ya 'kufanyiwa ukatili.'

eng: Like its title, the film "Difret" represents many things: it's a work of fiction based on a true story of courage and change; it's one of the only films from Ethiopia shot on 35mm film; and it's got big name recognition in the form of executive producer Angelina Jolie Pitt.
swa: Kama lilivyo jina lake, filamu ya "Difret" inawakilisha masuala mengi: ni kazi ya sanaa inayosimulia mkasa wa kweli unaohusu ujasiri na mabadiliko yanayoongozwa na msichana; ni filamu pekee iliyoandaliwa nchini Ethiopia kwa picha ya milimeta 35l na tayari imepata heshima kubwa kwa kuandaliwa na mtayarishaji maarufu wa filamu, Angelina Jolie Pitt.

eng: But above all, the film tells the story about a traditional practice through the experience of one frightened girl caught in a whirlwind beyond her control.
swa: Lakini zaidi ya yote, filamu hiyo inasimulia mila za ndoa za asili nchini Ethiopia kwa kutumia mkasa wa kweli uliompata msichana mmoja nchini humo.

eng: Difret is based on the story of Aberash Bekele — called Hirut in the film — a girl who was abducted by men on horseback outside her rural Ethiopian village.
swa: Filamu ya "Difret" inajenga masimulizi yake kwenye tukio la Aberash Bekele — anayetumia jina la Hirut kwenye filamu — msichana aliyekamatwa na wanaume na kutoroshwa kijijini kwa kutumia farasi ili akaolewe.

eng: It's the day she's promoted to 5th grade in school.
swa: Wakati anatekwa na wanaume hao, msichana huyo alikuwa ndio kwanza ameingia darasa la tano shuleni kwake.

eng: Her captor — who failed to get her father's permission to marry her — insists he now has the right to marry her according to a tradition known as telefa.
swa: Mwanaume aliyemteka -aliyeshindwa kupata ruhusa ya baba wa binti huyo ili aweze kumwoa -anatumia utekaji kama njia ya kulazimisha ndoa na msichana huyo kwa mujibu wa mila inayofahamika kama telefa nchini Ethiopia.

eng: But she fights back, accidentally killing him.
swa: Hata hivyo, msichana huyo anapambana, na kwa bahati mbaya anafanikiwa kumwua mwanaume huyo.

eng: She faces a death sentence until attorney Meaza Ashenafi steps in to fight for her.
swa: Matokeo yake, msichana huyo anajikuta akikabiliwa na hukumu ya kifo mpaka pale mwanasheria Meaza Ashenafi anapoingilia kati kumsaidia.

eng: The resulting courtroom drama riveted the nation in 1996, when it took place.
swa: Kurindima kwa kesi hiyo mahakamani kulivuta hisia za watu wengi nchini humo mwaka 1996, wakati mkasa huo ulipotokea.

eng: People started to talk about abduction all over again, Meaza Ashenafi recalls now. "It was a given, especially in the south of the country, women have been abducted for years.
swa: Kwa mara nyingine, watu walianza kuzungumzia mila hiyo ya kumteka mwanamke, Meaza Ashenafi anakumbuka. "kumteka mwanamke lilikuwa suala lnalokubalika, hususani kusini mwa nchi hiyo, wanawake walikuwa wakitekwa kwa miaka mingi.

eng: There was no question about it.
swa: Hapakuwa na yeyote aliyethubutu kuhoji mila hiyo.

eng: But this case opened up a discussion and dialogue around this traditional practice."
swa: Lakini kesi hii ilifungua mjadala mkali dhidi ya mila hii potofu."

eng: Ashenafi had just established the Women Lawyer's Association two years earlier to fight for the rights of women according to Ethiopia's then-new constitution.
swa: Ashenafi alikuwa ndio kwanza ameanzisha Umoja wa Wanasheria Wanawake miaka miwili iliyopita kwa lengo la kupigania haki za wanawake kwa mujibu wa katiba mpya ya Ethiopia.

eng: A scene from "Difret" depicts the horseback kidnapping of the main character.
swa: Sehemu ya filamu hiyo ikionesha tukio la kutekwa kwa mwanamke kwa njia ya farasi.

eng: Credit: Truth Aid Media
swa: Haki Miliki: Truth Aid Media

eng: Difret played to sold-out audiences in Addis Ababa for six weeks.
swa: Filamu ya "Difret" imeoneshwa kwenye kumbi za filamu mjini Addis Ababa kwa majuma sita.

eng: When the filmmakers looked to take it abroad, they sent it to Jolie, a well-known advocate for women's rights in Africa.
swa: Watengeneza filamu walipotaka kuipeleka nje ya nchi, walimtumia Jolie, wakili maarufu wa haki za wanawake barani Afrika.

eng: A foreign-language film from Africa has a tough road ahead for it in terms getting to an audience, filmmaker Mehret Mandefro admits.
swa: Filamu hiyo ya kigeni kutoka barani Afrika ina kazi ngumu mbeleni kwa maana ya kupata watazamaji, mtayarishaji wa filamu Mehret Mandefro anakiri.

eng: So having her support really helped us ... reach people I don't think we could ever reach.
swa: Kwa hiyo kupata ushirikiano wake kumetusaidia sana...kukutana na watu ambao hatukudhani kama tungeweza kuwapata.

eng: Despite the big-name support and the success of "Difret," Ashenafi and Mandrefo say their work is not done: they estimate that at least 20 percent of marriages in the south of Ethiopia are coerced through some form of telefa.
swa: Pamoja na kupata msaada wa watu maarufu na mafanikio ya filamu ya "Difret," Ashenafi na Mandrefo wanasema kazi yao bado haijakamilika: wanakadiria kwamba si chini ya asilimia 20 ya ndoa kusini mwa Athiopia zinatokana na mila inayofanana na telefa.

eng: This has to stop, Ashenafi says.
swa: Mila hii lazima itokomezwe, Ashenafi anasema.

eng: This should not be tolerated at all.
swa: Mila hii haivumiliki kwa vyovyote.

eng: As for the subject of the film itself, Mandrefo says she had a hard life — after the case, she wasn't allowed to return to her village or family.
swa: Kuhusu malengo makuu ya filamu yenyewe, Madrefo anasema amekuwa na maisha magumu baada ya kesi yake, hakuruhusiwa kurudi kijijini kwake wala kuungana na familia.

eng: She attended boarding schoool, and later decided to change her name and leave Ethiopia.
swa: Alijiunga na shule ya bweni, na baadae akaamua kubadili jina lake na kuhama nchi.

eng: But she's recently returned and working on the issue of telefa, hoping to keep girls from facing an ordeal like she did.
swa: Hata hivyo, hivi karibuni alirudi nyumbani na kuendeleza harakati za kupambana na mila hiyo ya telefa, alitumaini kuwakinga wasichana na mikasa kama aliyokumbana nayo.

eng: Friends and supporters changed their avatars on social media to this Free Alaa poster today to protest the first anniversary of his unfair imprisonment
swa: Katika kuadhimisha mwaka mmoja baada ya kufungwa kiuonevu kwa Alaa, marafiki na watetezi wake walibadili picha zao za wasifu kwenye mitandao ya kijamii na kuweka mabango ya 'Alaa aachiwe huru'

eng: It's been a year since the imprisonment of Egyptian blogger Alaa Abdel Fattah, an icon of the Egyptian revolution, for his activism.
swa: Mwaka mmoja umepita tangu mwanablogu wa ki-Misri Alaa Abdel Fattah, mtu muhimu katika mapinduzi yaliyoendelea nchini Misri, ahukumiwe kifungo kwa sababu tu ya uanaharakati wake.

eng: Alaa was slapped a five year prison sentence for allegedly taking part in a protest and “assaulting a policeman and stealing his walkie talkie.”
swa: Alaa alihukumiwa kifungo cha miaka mitano kwa kudaiwa kushiriki maandamano na "kumtukana polisi na kumwibia redio ya upepo".

eng: He was also fined 100,000 Egyptian pounds (13,000 US dollars).
swa: Alitozwa faini ya paundi za Misri 100,000 (sawa na dola 13,000 za Marekani).

eng: To mark the anniversary, netizens from around the world changed their avatars to Abd El Fattah's infamous picture on social media platforms to draw attention to his plight and that of thousands of other political prisoners in Egypt.
swa: Katika kuadhimisha mwaka mmoja tangu kufungwa kwake, katika majukwaa ya kijamii, watumiaji wa mtandao duniani kote walibadili picha zao za wasifu na kutumia picha ya Abd El Fattah ili kuongeza uelewa wa watu kuhusu masaibu ya Alaa pamoja na wafungwa wengine wa kisiasa nchini Misri.

eng: Abd El Fattah is one of 25 defendants in what has become known as the Shura Council case.
swa: Abd El Fattah ni mmoja wapo wa washitakiwa 25 katika kile kilichokuja kujulikana kama kesi ya Baraza la Shura.

eng: He was first arrested for this case on November 28, 2013.
swa: Alikuwa wa kwanza kukamatwa mnamo Novemba 28, 2013.

eng: Last June, he was sentenced to 15 years in absentia and given a 100,000 Egyptian pound fine after being convicted of attacking a police officer and violating a 2013 protest law that prohibits unauthorized demonstrations.
swa: Mwezi Juni mwaka jana, alihukumiwa miaka 15 jela bila kuwepo mahakamani na aliamuriwa kulipa faini ya paundi 100,000 za Misri baada ya kushitakiwa kwa kosa la kumshambulia ofisa wa polisi na kukiuka sheria ya kuandamana ya 2013 inayozuia maandamano yasiyoruhusiwa.

eng: According to Mada Masr, which quoted the state-owned Ahram Gate website, they are accused of: “organizing an unauthorized protest outside the Shura Council in Cairo, attacking a police officer, stealing a walkie-talkie, hooliganism, aggression against police officers, blocking the road, crowding a public place and destruction of public property.”
swa: Kwa mujibu wa tovuti ya Mada Masr, iliyonukuu kutoka kwenye tovuti inayomilikiwa na Ahram Gate, watuhumiwa hao wanadaiwa: “kuandaa maandamano haramu nje ya jengo la Baraza la Shura jijini Cairo, kumshambulia afisa wa polisi, kuiba radio ya upepo, uhuni, ghadhabu dhidi ya maafisa wa polisi, kufunga barabara, kujaza watu kwenye maeneo ya umma na kuharibu mali ya umma."

eng: After an appeal by his lawyers, Abd El Fattah was issued a retrial in August 2014.
swa: Baada ya rufaa iliyokatwa na wanasheria wake, kesi ya Abd El Fattah ilisikilizwa upya mnamo Agosti 2014.

eng: On September 15, 2014, the presiding judge recused himself from the case after an incident a week earlier, in which the prosecution presented a video depicting Manal Hassan, Abd El Fattah’s wife, dancing.
swa: Ilipofika Septemba 15, 2014, jaji aliyekuwa akisikiliza kesi hiyo alimhukumu tena baada ya tukio la juma lililotangulia kesi hiyo, ambako mwendesha mashitaka alionesha video ikimwonesha Manal Hassan, mke wa Abd El Fattah, akicheza dansi.

eng: Taken from Hassan’s laptop, which confiscated by police when Abd El Fattah was arrested and taken from his family’s home in November of 2013, the video bears no discernible relationship with his political activities.
swa: Video hiyo iliyokuwa imechukuliwa kutoka kwenye kompyuta ya Hassan, iliyokuwa imechukuliwa na polisi mara baada ya Abd El Fattah kuwekwa chini ya ulinzi na kuondolewa kwenye familia yake mwezi Novemba 2013, video hiyo haioneshi uhusiano na shughuli zozote za kisiasa.

eng: The saga came to a complete circle on February 23, 2015, with the new judge issuing a five year jail sentence against Abd El Fattah and another defendant Ahmed Abdel Rahman, who was passing by the protest, and was arrested along with Abdel Fattah, as he was helping some girls who were being harassed by the police.
swa: Sekeseke hilo lilimalizika Februari 23, 2015, ambako jaji mpya alimhukumu kifungo cha miaka mitano Abd El Fattah na mwenzake aitwaye Ahmed Abdel Rahman, aliyekuwa anapita wakati wa maandamano, na aliwekwa chini ya ulinzi sambamba na Abdel Fattah, na alikuwa anawasaidia wasichana kadhaa waliokuwa wakibughudhiwa na polisi.

eng: Abdel Rahman was also slapped a similar fine.
swa: Abdel Rahman aliamriwa kulipa kiwango kile kile cha faini.

eng: Eighteen other defendants were sentenced to three years in prison and three years on probation, in addition to a similar fine.
swa: Washitakiwa wengine kumi na nane walihukumiwa miaka mitatu jela na miaka mitatu mingine ya uangalizi, mbali na kiwango kile kile cha faini.

eng: In addition to changing their avatars for the day, supporters shared some of Abd El Fattah's quotes and tweets.
swa: Zaidi ya kubadili picha zao mtandaoni kwa ajili ya siku hiyo, watumiaji wa mtandao wanaomwunga mkono walitumiana nukuu na twiti za Abd El Fattah.

eng: His aunt, renowned novelist Ahdaf Soueif translates some of them here:
swa: Shangazai yake, mwandishi maarufu wa riwaya Ahdaf Soueif alitafsiri baadhi ya nukuu na twiti hizo hapa:

swa: Mimi ni Alaa.

Tomorrow we'll invent solutions without locking each other up. 	Kesho tutatengeneza suluhisho bila kufungana jela.
