eng: Students in Bong County, Liberia, study by candlelight.
swa: Wanafunzi kwenye Kaunti ya Bong, Liberia, wakisoma kwa kutumia mshumaa.

eng: These students missed school during Liberia's civil war.
swa: Wanafunzi hawa walikosa masomo wakati wa vita vya wenyewe kwa wenyewe nchini Liberia.

eng: Public Domain photo by United States Agency for International Development (USAID)4.
swa: Picha ya Shirika la Marekani la Maendeleo ya Kimataifa (USAID)4.

eng: Liberia is poised to set another first for Africa.
swa: Liberia inaelekea kuvunja rekodi ya kuwa nchi ya kwanza kufanya jambo jipya barani Afrika.

eng: The country was the first in Africa to have a female president when Ellen Johnson-Sirleaf was elected in 2006.
swa: Nchi hiyo ilikuwa ya kwanza barani Afrika kuongozwa na rais mwanamke baada ya Ellen Johnson-Sirleaf kuchaguliwa kuwa rais mwaka 2006.

eng: Now, the country is embarking on what some are calling another first in Africa: outsourcing its entire pre-primary and primary education system to a private American company.
swa: Hivi sasa, nchi hiyo iko mbioni kutekeleza kile ambacho baadhi ya watu wanakiita jambo jingine la kwanza kuwahi kutokea barani Afrika: kukabidhi mfumo wake wote wa elimu ya awali na msingi kwa mwekezaji binafsi wa Kimarekani.

eng: Education in Liberia was severely affected by the First Liberian Civil War and Second Liberian Civil War between 1989 and 2003.
swa: Kwa kiwango kikubwa elimu nchini Liberia iliathiriwa na Vita vya Kwanza vya Wenyewe kwa Wenyewe na Vita vya Pili vya Wenyewe kwa Wenyewe kati ya 1989 na 2003.

eng: It is estimated that 50% of young women and 68% of young men have completed primary school or, if not, are able to read a whole sentence.
swa: Inakadiriwa kwamba asilimia 50 ya wasichana na asilimia 68 ya wavulana wamehitimu elimu ya msingi au, kama sivyo, wanaweza kusoma sentensi kamili.

eng: The situation was exacerbated during the recent Ebola crisis.
swa: Hali ilikuwa mbaya zaidi wakati wa mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Ebola.

eng: Liberian Education Minister George Werner announced in January 2016 that pre-primary and primary public education would be outsourced to Bridge International Academies, a private US-based company, for a five-year period.
swa: Waziri wa Elimu wa Liberia George Werner alitangaza mwezi Januari 2016 kwamba elimu ya awali na msingi itakabidhiwa kwa kampuni binafsi ya Kimarekani iitwayo Bridge International Academies, kwa kipindi cha miaka mitano.

eng: The government of Liberia will pay over $65 million.
swa: Serikali ya Liberia italipa zaidi ya dola za Kimarekani milioni 65.

eng: Bridge International Academies describes itself as the world’s largest education innovation company, currently operational in Kenya and Uganda.
swa: Kampuni hiyo ya Bridge International Academies inajieleza kama kampuni kubwa zaidi duniani katika uboreshaji wa elimu, hivi sasa inaendesha shuguli zake nchini Kenya na Uganda.

eng: Class sizes can be as large as 60 students.
swa: Ukubwa wa darasa unaweza kufikia wanafunzi 60 kwa darasa.

eng: Unlike the company's schools in Kenya and Uganda, where families pay tuition of about $6 per term, parents in Libera would not pay for the schools out of pocket.
swa: Tofauti na uendeshaji wa shule za kampuni hiyo zilizoko Kenya na Uganda, ambapo wazazi wa wanafunzi hulipa ada inayofikia dola 6 kwa muhula mmoja wa masomo, wazazi nchini Liberia hawatalipa chochote kinachohitajika shuleni kutoka mifukoni mwao.

eng: The move has drawn international and local criticism.
swa: Hatua hiyo imeibua ukosoaji mkali kutoka sehemu mbalimbali duniani na hata ndani ya nchi hiyo.

eng: Education experts plan to exert pressure on the Liberia government not to go ahead with the plan.
swa: Wataalam wa elimu wanapanga kuishinikiza serikali ya Liberia kusitisha mpango wake huo.

eng: Opposing the plan, Kishore Sing, the UN’s Special Rapporteur on the right to education, said in press release in March:
swa: Akipinga mpango huo, Kishore Sing, Mwandishi Maalum wa Shirika la Umoja wa Mataifa kuhusu haki ya kupata elimu, alisema kwenye taarifa yake kwa vyombo vya habari mwezi Machi:

eng: It is ironic that Liberia does not have resources to meet its core obligations to provide a free primary education to every child, but it can find huge sums of money to subcontract a private company to do so on its behalf.
swa: Ni dhahiri kwamba Liberia haina raslimali za kutekeleza majukumu yake ya msingi ya kutoa elimu ya msingi bure kwa kila mtoto, lakini inaweza kutafuta kiasi kikubwa cha fedha kuingia mkataba na kampuni binafsi ili kutoa elimu kwa niaba yake.

eng: She also took issue with the company’s claim that its students do better than their comparable peers at government schools, pointing out the data comes from a study commissioned by the company itself.
swa: Kadhalika aligusia madai ya kampuni hiyo kuwa wanafunzi wake wanafanya vizuri zaidi kuliko wenzao walio kwenye shule za serikali, akionesha kwamba matokeo hayo ya utafiti yalifadhiliwa na kampuni hiyo.

eng: However, privatised public education might be a good bet for Liberia, whose system is currently "in shambles," she concedes:
swa: Hata hivyo, kubinafsishwa kwa elimu ya msingi kwaweza kuwa fursa nzuri kwa Liberia, ambayo hivi sasa mfumo wake 'una matatizo mengi," anakiri:

eng: In that case, an education system, which is modelled on accountability, standardisation, analytical rigour, and policy changes that can be backed with rich data sets – albeit private – is far better than what Liberia has at the moment.
swa: Kwa hivyo, mfumo wa elimu, unaotengenezwa kwa misingi ya uwajibikaji, uhakiki wa ubora wake, uchambuzi makini, na mabadiliko ya kisera yanayofanywa kwa kutumia matokeo ya utafiti -hata kama ni za watu binafsi - ni bora zaidi kuliko aina ya elimu iliyopo Liberia hivi sasa.

eng: Reacting to the news, Jan Resseger, an American public education expert and blogger, questioned the motives of the company's investors, which include the International Finance Corporation, part of the World Bank Group:
swa: Akijibu habari hizo, Jan Resseger, mtaalam wa elimu ya umma nchini Marekani na mwanablogu, alihoji nia ya wawekezaji wa kampuni hiyo, ambao ni pamoja na Shirika la Fedha la Kimataifa, ambalo ni sehemu ya Makampuni ya Benki ya Dunia:

eng: One must also examine the motivation of some of the so-called investors described as backing the work of Bridge International Academies, for example Bill Gates and Mark Zuckerberg.
swa: Lazima mtu asaili nia hasa ya wale wanaoitwa wawekezaji wanaosemekana kuwa nyuma ya shughuli za kampuni ya Bridge International Academies, kwa mfano Bill Gates na Mark Zuckerberg.

eng: Are these tech-philanthropists supporting such an international education venture as part of their philanthropic aid work or is the purpose to expand the worldwide market for the kind of education technology that has created their personal fortunes?
swa: Je, makampuni haya ya kiteknolojia ya hisani yanasaidia kweli ukuaji wa elimu ya duniani kama sehemu ya misaada yake ya kibinadamu kwa watu au lengo ni kupanua soko la dunia kwa tekenolojia ya elimu iliyotengenezwa kwa ajili ya kujitengenezea faida binafsi?

eng: Global Education Monitoring Report, which is published by UNESCO, expressed concern over the issue:
swa: Ripoti ya Ufuatiliaji wa Elimu ya Dunia, inayochapishwa na UNESCO, ilionesha wasiwasi kwa suala hili:

eng: Thinking of schools only as places to learn how to read may appear a reasonable idea in a country where most children cannot achieve even that.
swa: Kuzifikiria shule kama sehemu tu ya kujifunza kusoma inaweza kuonekana kuwa wazo jema kwa nchi ambayo watoto wake wengi hawawezi kufikia angalau hatua hiyo.

eng: However, it risks reducing appreciably the purpose of education.
swa: Hata hivyo, hatari yake ni kupoteza lengo halisi la elimu.

eng: Policy-makers need to be aware that good teaching cannot be delivered by just anybody out of a script.
swa: Watunga sera wanahitaji kutambua kwamba ufundishaji mzuri hauwezi kufanywa na yeyote kwa kutumia mwongozo wa somo lililoandaliwa tayari na mtu mwingine

eng: The National Teachers' Association of Liberia, among other civil society organizations, have sent a letter to Liberian Education Minister George K. Werner explaining their concerns that the privatisation plan poses a "serious threat" and represents the "commercialisation of education services in Liberia."
swa: Chama cha Walimu nchini Liberia, miongoni mwa mashirika mengine ya kiraia, limetuma barua kwa Waziri wa Elimu wa Liberia George K. Werner kikielezea masikitiko yake kwamba mpango huo wa kubinafsisha elimu unaleta 'hatari kubwa' na ni 'kufanya elimu iwe huduma ya kibiashara nchini Liberia.'

eng: Others, meanwhile, have expressed their opinion on social media:
swa: Wengine, wakati huo huo, wametoa maoni yao kwenye mitandao ya kijamii:

eng: Mind-blowing.
swa: Upuuzi.

eng: Might be last post but I'm determined to gain my freedom bec I'm innocent.
swa: Inaweza kuwa posti ya mwisho lakini ninamatarajio ya kupata uhuru wangu tena kwa sababu sina hatia.

eng: Jailed anti-censorship activist and blogger Hossein Ronaghi Maleki is struggling for his health and freedom.
swa: Afya ya mwanaharakati na mwanablogu wa kupinga kuminywa kwa uhuru wa kujieleza Hossein Ronaghi Maleki yazorota akipambana kudai uhuru.

eng: He began a hunger strike March 26, to protest prison authorities' refusal to give him proper medical care and demand his release.
swa: Alianza mgomo wa kula mnamo Machi 26, kupinga kitendo cha uongozi wa gereza alimofungwa kumnyima huduma stahiki za afya na kudai kuachiliwa huru.

eng: His health now is deteriorating rapidly.
swa: Afya yake kwa sasa imezorota kwa kasi na inaendelea kuwa mbaya.

eng: According to a correspondence between Maleki's father and the International Campaign for Human Rights in Iran (ICHRI), authorities “have threatened him that if his family makes noise about his case he will be transferred to Rajaee Shahr Prison,” located in the northern city of Karaj.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa mawasiliano kati ya baba yake Maleki na Kampeni ya Kimataifa ya Haki za Binadamu nchini Irani (ICHRI), mamlaka "zimemtisha kwamba ikiwa familia yake itapiga kelele kuhusu suala lake basi atahamishiwa kwenye gereza la Rajaee Shahr,” lililoko kwenye mji wa kaskazini uitwao Karaj.

eng: Rajaee Shahr is known for its poor conditions, particularly for political prisoners.
swa: Gereza la Rajaee Shahr linafahamika kwa mazingira machafu, hususani kwa wafungwa wa kisiasa.

eng: Previous reports suggest that in-person visits would be limited there, if not impossible.
swa: Taarifa zilizopita zinadai kwamba safari za binafsi za watu wanaotaka kumtembelea gerezani zitadhibitiwa, kama sio kuzuiwa.

eng: This Thursday, April 14 will mark Maleki's 20th day on a hunger strike.
swa: Alhamisi hii, Aprili 14 itakuwa ni siku ya 20 tangu Maleki aanze mgomo wa kutokula.

eng: Supporters are calling on the global community of activists and technologists who stand up for freedom of expression and access to information to raise their voices on Maleki's behalf using the hashtag #NoJail4Hossein.
swa: Wanaomwunga mkono wanaomba jumuiya ya kimataifa ya wanaharakati na wanateknolojia wanaopigania uhuru na upatikanaji wa habari kupaza sauti zao kwa niaba ya Maleki kwa kutumia alama ishara ya #NoJail4Hossein.

eng: Maleki blogged under the nickname Babak Khorramdin, the name of an ancient Persian freedom fighter from Azerbaijan (Maleki is an ethnic Iranian Azeri).
swa: Maleki alikuwa akiblogu kwa kutumia jina la uandishi la Babak Khorramdin, jina la mpigania uhuru wa kale wa Persia aliyetoka Azerbaijan (Maleki ni mu- Irani mwenye asili ya Azeri).

eng: He is also a computer programmer who worked actively in setting up websites aimed at circumventing online censorship.
swa: Ni mtaalamu wa program za kompyuta aliyefanya kazi ya kutengeneza tovuti zinazokwepa udukuzi wa kimtandao.

eng: The networks of international actors working on Internet freedom and building innovative ways for Iranians to access the Internet is vast.
swa: Ipo mitandao mingi ya wadau wa kimataifa wanaoshughulika na uhuru wa mtandao wa Intaneti na kubuni mbinu za kuwawezesha wa-Irani kupata mtandao wa intaneti.

eng: Maleki is very much a part of this community, but unlike many of his fellow activists, his work landed him directly in the line of fire.
swa: Maleki ni sehemu muhimu wa jamii hii, lakini tofauti na wanaharakati wenzake, kazi yake imemfanya aingie kwenye matatizo.

eng: Maleki was arrested in December 2009, six months after Iran's disputed presidential elections.
swa: Maleki alikamatwa Desemba 2009, miezi sita baada ya uchaguzi wa rais wa Irani ulioshutumiwa kwa vitendo vya udanganyifu.

eng: He was immediately incarcerated at the notorious Evin prison, serving 376 days in solitary confinement before seeing trial in 2010.
swa: Mara baada ya kukamatwa alipelekwa kwenye gereza la Evin, akiishi chini ya ulinzi mkali kwa siku 376 kabla ya kushtakiwa mwaka 2010.

eng: This led to a 15-year sentence on charges of “spreading propaganda against the regime”, “membership of the Internet group Iran Proxy” and “insulting the Iranian supreme leader and the president.”
swa: Mashitaka hayo yalifanya akahukumiwa kifungo cha miaka 15 kwa mashitaka ya "kueneza propaganda kinyume cha utawala", "kuwa mwanachama wa kikundi cha inteneti kiitwacho Iran Proxy” na “kumdhihaki kiongozi mkuu wa Iran na rais wa nchi.”

eng: Maleki was released in 2015 on a temporary six-month furlough to receive medical treatment for kidney failure, but returned to prison on January 19, 2016.
swa: Maleki aliachiliwa huru 2015 kwa muda mfupi wa miezi sita ili kumwezesha kupata matibabu ya matatizo ya figo, lakini alirudi gerezani mnamo Januari 19, 2016.

eng: His return to prison came despite recommendations by the Medical Examiner that his health is unfit for the Iranian prison system.
swa: Alirudishwa gerezani pamoja na ushauri wa Daktari kwamba afya yake hairuhusu kukaa kwenye magereza ya Iran.

eng: The denial of medical care is a routine practice for political prisoners and prisoners of conscience.
swa: Ni kawaida kwa wafungwa wa kisiasa na wafungwa wa makosa ya kihalifu kunyimwa huduma za afya.

eng: Global Voices' Advox and Iran teams are encouraging supporters to give as much exposure as possible to Maleki by sharing his case on social media, and using the hashtags #NoJail4Hossein.
swa: Kitengo cha utetezi cha Global Voices na washirika wa Iran wanawahamasisha watu wanaoguswa na suala hili kulitangaza kadri inavyowezekana kwa kusambaza habari hii kwenye mitandao ya kijamii, na kwa kutumia alama ishara za #NoJail4Hossein.

eng: Appeals can also be sent tagging the President Hassan Rouhani or the Supreme Leader.
swa: Miito ya kuachiliwa kwake inaweza kutumwa pamoja na nakala kwa Rais Hassan Rouhani au Kiongozi Mkuu.

eng: Tweets in English should be sent to @HassanRouhani and @Khamenei_ir.
swa: Twiti za Kiinegerza zitumwe kwa @HassanRouhani na @Khamenei_ir.

eng: Tweets in Persian should be sent to @Rouhani_ir and @Khamenei_fa.
swa: Twiti za ki-Persia zitumwe kwa @Rouhani_ir na @Khamenei_fa.

eng: Ibrahim Esmael Ibrahim at the train station in Idomeni, Greece.
swa: Ibrahim Esmael Ibrahim akiwa kwenye kituo cha treni mjini Idomeni, Ugiriki.

eng: As a teenager, he worked as a translator with the US military in Iraq.
swa: Akiwa kijana, alifanya kazi kama mfasiri wa wanajeshi wa Marekani nchini Iraq.

eng: Credit: Filip Warwick.
swa: Picha: Filip Warwick.

eng: Used with PRI's permission
swa: Imetumiwa kwa idhini ya PRI

eng: This article by Jacob Resneck originally appeared on PRI.org on March 24, 2016, and is republished here as part of a content-sharing agreement.
swa: Makala haya yaliyoandikwa naJacob Resneck awali yalionekana kwenye mtandao wa PRI.org mnamo Machi 24, 2016, na yamechapishwa tena hapa kama sehemu ya makubaliano ya kubadilishana maudhui.

eng: Ibrahim Esmael Ibrahim is a 26-year-old nattily dressed guy from Baghdad.
swa: Ibrahim Esmael Ibrahim ana umri wa miaka 26, mtanashati anayetoka Baghdad.

eng: When I met him, he was standing on the platform at the train station in Idomeni, Greece — though there are no trains running now.
swa: Nilipokutana naye, alikuwa amesimama kwenye kibaraza cha kituo cha treni mjini Idomeni, Ugiriki — ingawa hapakuwa na treni inayopita wakati huo.

eng: Ibrahim speaks good English; as a teenager he landed a job with GLS (Global Linguist Solutions), a Virginia-based contractor that provided interpreters to the US military during the Iraq war.
swa: Ibrahim anaongea Kiingereza kizuri; kabla hajafikisha miaka 20 alipata kazi kwenye kampuni iliyoko Viginia iitwayo GLS (Global Linguist Solutions), iliyotoa wafasiri kwa ajili ya jeshi la Marekani wakati wa vita vya Iraq.

eng: He says the pay was good — $1,500 a month plus bonuses.
swa: Anasema malipo yalikuwa mazuri — Dola za Marekani 1,500 kwa mwezi pamoja marupurupu.

eng: The soldiers liked him and nicknamed him AP.
swa: Wanajeshi walimpenda na wakampachika jina la utani AP.

eng: But after six months on the job, Ibrahim says his life was threatened by insurgents.
swa: Lakini baada ya miezi sita ya kufanya kazi, Ibrahim anasema maisha yake yalihatarishwa na wanajeshi hao.

eng: They told me I will cut your head from your body if I see you again here, he recalls.
swa: Waliniambia nitakata kichwa chako na kukitenga na kiwiliwili kama nitakuona hapa tena, anakumbuka.

eng: Ibrahim’s family urged him to leave the country.
swa: Familia ya Ibrahim ilimsihi ahame nchi.

eng: But before he got out, he emailed his favorite American sergeants to tell them what was going on.
swa: Lakini kabla hajafanya hivyo, aliwandikia wanajeshi wa ki-Marekani waliokuwa rafiki zake kuwaambia kile kilichokuwa kinaendelea.

eng: I told them what happened with me and they told me to give my badge number to GLS in the Green Zone in Baghdad, he says, recalling the incident 10 years later.
swa: Niliwaambia kilichonitokea na wakaniambia niwape GLS kitambulisho changu kwenye eneo ambalo halikuwa na mapigano mjini Baghdad, anasema, akikumbuka tukio hilo miaka kumi baadae.

eng: So I went there and gave to them and the next day I took a bus to Syria.
swa: Kwa hiyo nilienda pale na kuwapa na kesho yake nikachukua basi kwenda Syria.

eng: In Damascus, he found a white-collar job at a telecom company.
swa: Akiwa Damascus, alipata kazi ya ofisini kwenye kampuni ya simu.

eng: But he dreamed of some day going to the US where his sister lives.
swa: Lakini alikuwa na ndoto ya kwenda Marekani anakoishi dada yake.

eng: His brother-in-law pointed out that because of his service to the US military in Iraq, he could apply for a US Special Immigrant Visa.
swa: Shemeji yake alimwambia kwa kufanya kazi na Jeshi la Marekani nchini Iraq, angeweza kuomba Visa Maalum kwa Wahamiaji nchini Marekani.

eng: But for that, he’d need proof of his employment.
swa: Lakini ili kufanya hivyo, alihitaji ushahidi kuwa aliwahi kufanya kazi ya Ufasiri.

eng: So he wrote to GLS, the company with the big Pentagon contract.
swa: Kwa hiyo akawaandikia GLS, kampuni iliyokuwa na mkataba mnono na Wizara ya Ulinzi ya Marekani.

eng: They don’t answer, they don’t answer me, he tells me.
swa: Hawanijibu, hawanipi majibu yoyote, ananiambia.

eng: They say the contract is closed with the US Army and you can’t get your documents. 	Wanasema mkataba wako ulisitishwa na Jeshi la Marekani na huwezi kupata nyaraka zako.
It’s very difficult."
swa: Ni vigumu."

eng: PRI's The World contacted GLS in Virginia last week and left several messages, but we've yet to get a response.
swa: Kipindi cha The World cha PRI kiliwasiliana na kampuni ya GLS huko Virginia juma lililopita na kuacha jumbe kadhaa, lakini hakuna ujumbe uliojibiwa.

eng: Ibrahim say he stayed in Syria for a few years, then moved to the Kurdish region of northern Iraq where he worked odd jobs under the table.
swa: Ibrahim anasema aliishi Syria kwa miaka michache, kisha akahamia mkoa wa Kurdi kaskazini mwa Iraq mahali alipofanya kazi kwa maficho.

eng: But he says being an ethnic Arab there was a problem; Kurdish authorities told him to go back to Baghdad, but he was too afraid to go.
swa: Lakini anasema kuwa mwarabu mgeni kule lilikuwa tatizo; Mamlaka za ki-Kurdi zilimwambia arudi Baghdad, lakini aliogopa kwenda.

eng: Instead, he crossed the border into Turkey, where he met an Afghan woman in 2014.
swa: Badala yake, alivuka mpaka kwenda Uturuki, alipokutana na mwanamke wa ki-Afghan mwaka 2014.

eng: They got married in a religious service.
swa: Walifunga ndoa ya kidini.

eng: Ibrahim says she was able to get to Canada, but she can’t bring him over because they don’t have a legal marriage license.
swa: Ibrahim anasema mke wake aliweza kwenda Canada, lakini hawezi kwenda naye kwa sababu hawana cheti cha ndoa.

eng: I’m alone. 	Niko peke yangu.
My wife is in Canada and my sister is in America," Ibrahim says.
swa: Mke wangu yuko Canada na dada yangu yuko Marekani," Ibrahim anasema.

eng: His parents are in Turkey and he says his sister is able to bring them to the United States in a few months, but it might take years for him to get permission.
swa: Wazazi wake wake Uturuki na anasema dada yake anaweza kumpeleka Marekani ndani ya miezi michache, lakini inaweza kuchukua miaka kwake kupata ruhusa.

eng: So Europe is his preferred destination for now.
swa: Kwa hiyo Ulaya ndio mahali anapodhani panamfaa sasa.

eng: But under the European Union’s new deal with Turkey, it’s unlikely he’ll be allowed to stay.
swa: Lakini kufuatia Makubaliano mapya ya Umoja wa Ulaya na Uturuki , haielekei kwamba ataruhusiwa kubaki.

eng: The EU plans to send back asylum seekers like Ibrahim who make the crossing from Turkey to Greece.
swa: Umoja wa Ulaya una mipango ya kuwarudisha wakimbizi wote kama Ibrahim walioingia nchini humo kutokea Uturuki waende Ugiriki.

eng: Turkey has agreed to take them back in exchange for about $6 billion in aid and other incentives.
swa: Uturuki imekubali kuwachukua na kubadilishana nao kwa msaada na bakhshishi nyingine zinazifikia dola za Marekani bilioni 6.

eng: The EU says the arrangement would discourage people from paying smuggler’s fees and risking their lives to make the perilous Aegean crossing from Turkey to Greece.
swa: Umoja wa Ulaya unasema makubaliano hayo yanaweza kuwakatisha tamaa watu kuwapa hongo watu wanafanya biashara ya kuwasaidia wahamiaji na hivyo kupunguza vitendo hivyo vinavyohatarisha maisha yao kwa kujaribu kuvuka mpaka isivyo halali kwenda Ugiriki kutokea Uturuki.

eng: But critics say when one route closes, another just opens up.
swa: Lakini wakosoaji wa mpango huo wanasema njia moja inapofungwa, nyingine inafunguliwa.

eng: Most of the asylum seekers who have gotten stopped in Greece are Syrians escaping the war at home.
swa: Wakimbilizi wengi walioshikiliwa Ugiriki ni wa-Syria wanaotoroka vita nchini kwao.

eng: Credit: Filip Warwick.
swa: Picha: Filip Warwick.

eng: Used with PRI's permission
swa: Imetumiwa kwa idhini ya PRI

eng: And human rights officials say the prospect of mass deportation is inhumane and potentially, a violation of international law.
swa: Na maafisa wa haki za binadamu wanasema matokeo ya kurudisha watu wengi kwa pamoja ni kinyume cha ubinadamu na inaweza kusababisha uvunjaji wa sheria za kimataifa.

eng: Every person seeking protection has the right to have his case examined on a case-by-case basis on the individual merits, Council of Europe’s Human Rights Commissioner Nils Muiznieks told The World.
swa: Kila mtu anayetafuta hifadhi ana haki ya kufanyiwa uchunguzi hatua kwa hatua kwa kuzungatia maslahi ya mtu huyo, Kamishna wa Baraza la Ulaya la Haki za Binadamu Nils Muiznieks alikiambia kipindi cha The World.

eng: He says the EU’s agreement with Turkey threatens to throw that principle out the window.
swa: Anasema makubaliano ya Umoja wa Ulaya na Uturuki yanatishia kukiukika kanuni hiyo.

eng: Tanzanian netizen Isaac Habakuk Emily, who hails from the Arusha region in the north of the African nation, appeared in court on April 15, 2016 on charges of "insulting" the country's president, John Magufuli.
swa: Mtanzania anayetumia mtandao wa intaneti Isaac Habakuk Emily, anayeishi mkoani Arusha kaskazini mwa nchi hiyo ya Afrika, alisimamishwa kizimbani mnamo Aprili 15, 2016 kwa makosa ya "kumtukana" rais wa nchi hiyo, John Magufuli.

eng: Emily's statements are allegedly contrary to Section 16 of Tanzania's Cybercrime Act No. 14 of 2015, which says:
swa: Maneno ya Emily yanadaiwa kukiuka kifungu cha 16 cha Sheria ya Makosa ya Mtandao ya Tanzania Na. 14 ya 2015, kinachosema:

eng: Any person who publishes information, data or facts presented in a picture, text, symbol or any other form in a computer system where such information, data or fact is false, desceptive, misleading or inaccurate commits an offence, and shall on conviction be liable to a fine not less than three million shillings or to imprisonment for a term not less than six months or to both.
swa: Mtu yeyote anayechapisha taarifa, takwimu au habari katika picha, maandishi, alama au kwa namna nyingine yoyote katika mfumo wa kompyuta ambapo taarifa hizo, takwimu au habari hizo ni za uongo, zenye udanganyifu, zenye kupotosha ukweli au zisizo sahihi atakuwa anatenda kosa, na akitiwa hatiani atatakiwa kulipa fidia ya si chini ya shilingi milioni tatu kifungo jela kisichopungua miezi sita jela au vyote viwili kwa pamoja

eng: Emily is accused of posting a controversial Facebook message (in Swahili) on March 17, 2015, even while knowing that counterfactual criticism of the country's president is against the law.
swa: Emily anadaiwa kuchapisha ujumbe wenye utata kwenye mtandao wa Facebook kwa lugha ya Kiswahili mnamo Machi 17, 2015, hali akijua kwamba kumkosoa rais wa nchi ni kinyume cha sheria.

eng: His comment was in reference to President Magufuli's surprise live call to Clouds TV's current affairs program, 360, during which the president thanked the presenters and expressed his admiration for the show.
swa: Maoni yake hayo kwenye mtandao wa facebook yalihusu kitendo cha Rais Magufuli kupiga simu isiyotarajiwa kwenye kipindi kinachooneshwa na kituo cha televisheni cha Clouds TV kinachohusu habari zinazojiri kiitwacho 360.

eng: Theatrics in politics , how come you compare this imbecile to Nyerere ?
swa: Hizi siasa za maigizo, halafu mnamfananisha huyu bwege and Nyerere wapi buana.

eng: His offence has taken place against the backdrop of Tanzania's parliament passing a cybercrime bill on April 1, 2015, to address cybercrime issues such as child pornography, cyberbullying, online impersonation, electronic production of racist and xenophobic content, spam, illegal interception of communications, and the publication of false information.
swa: Kosa lake hilo limetokea wakati bunge la Tanzania limepitisha muswada wa makosa ya mtandao mnamo Aprili 1, 2015, kukabiliana na masuala yanayohusu makosa ya mtandao kama vile picha za ngono kwa watoto, kashfa za mtandaoni, matusi dhidi ya watu binafsi, utengenezaji wa maudhui yanayoleta hisia za ubaguzi wa rangi au kikabila, utumaji wa ujumbe bila ruhusa ya mpokeaji, kuingilia mawasiliano kinyume cha sheria na kutengeneza taarifa za uongo.

eng: Despite widespread opposition from politicians, social media practitioners, donors and human rights activists, the bill was pushed through parliament with relatively little discussion or debate.
swa: Pamoja upinzani mkubwa dhidi ya hatua hiyo kutoka kwa makundi mbalimbali ya wanasiasa, wadau wa mitandao ya kijamii, wafadhili na wanaharakati wa haki za raia, muswada huo ulipitishwa bungeni baada ya mjadala mfupi.

eng: They have also cautioned that police or the state could use their power to harass online activists or social media users.
swa: Wanaonya kwamba polisi au dola inaweza kutumia mamlaka hayo kuwabughudhi wanaharakati wa mtandnaoni au watumiaji wa mitandao ya kijamii.

eng: That same month, another netizen, Sospiter Jonas, was arraigned in a primary court in Dodoma Region and charged with “misuse of the Internet” after he posted a message on Facebook saying that Tanzanian Prime Minister Mizengo Pinda “will only become a gospel preacher.”
swa: Mwezi huo huo, mtumiaji mwingine wa mtandao, Sospiter Jonas, alisimamishwa kizimbani kwenye mahakama ya mwanzo mkoani Dodoma kwa kosa la 'kutumia vibaya mtandao' baada ya kubandika ujumbe kwenye mtandao wa Facebook akisema Waziri Mkuu wa Tanzania Mizengo Pinda “atakuwa mhubiri wa dini.”

eng: The four appeared before a Magistrate's court in Dar Es Salaam on November 6, 2015.
swa: Wanne haoa walisimamishwa mbele ya Hakimu Mkazi jijini Dar Es Salaam mnamo Novemba 6, 2015.

eng: Public prosecutors alleged that the accused published audio information on a WhatsApp group called the "Soka Group", that was intended to mislead the public during the October 2015 Tanzanian general elections, which were plagued by accusations of vote-rigging.
swa: Mwendesha mashtaka wa serikali alidai kwamba watuhumiwa hao walichapisha taarifa ya sauti kwenye kundi la WhatsApp linaloitwa "Soka Group", ambayo ilikusudia kupotosha umma wakati wa uchaguzi mkuu wa Oktoba 2015 nchini Tanzania , ambao uligubikwa na madai ya wizi wa kura.

eng: As far as this latest incident goes, Emily is scheduled to appear in court again on April 18, 2016 for judgement on his bail application.
swa: Kwa tukio la hivi karibuni, Emily anatarajiwa kusimamishwa kizimbani tena mnamo Aprili 18, 2016 kwa ajili ya maamuzi ya ombi lake la dhamana.

eng: Beachside area in Grand-Bassam, Côte d'Ivoire, site of the March 13 terrorist attack.
swa: Eneo la fukwe huko Grand-Bassam, Côte d'Ivoire, eneo lililoshambuliwa na magaidi Machi 13.

eng: PHOTO: Oluniyi Ajao (CC BY-SA 2.0)
swa: Picha: Oluniyi Ajao (CC BY-SA 2.0)

eng: By Jemila Abdulai.
swa: Na Jemila Abdulai.

eng: A version of this article was originally published on Circumspecte.com.
swa: Toleo la makala hii lilichapishwa kwa mara ya kwanza kwenye Circumspecte.com.

eng: Let's talk for a second about the March 13 terrorist attack in Côte d'Ivoire.
swa: Tujadadili kidogo kuhusu shambulio la kigaidi la Machi 13 nchini Ivory Coast.

eng: Specifically, about what Ghana and other African countries should learn or do.
swa: Hususani kile ambacho nchi ya Ghana pamoja na nchi nyingine za Kiafrika zinaweza kujifunza au kufanya.

eng: For those who don't know, an estimated 16 people died on March 13 in Grand-Bassam, Côte d'Ivoire.
swa: Kwa wale wasiofahamu, takribani watu 16 walipoteza maisha tarehe 13 Machi katika eneo la Grand-Bassam, nchini Ivory Coast.

eng: The former Ivorian capital and a UNESCO World Heritage site, Grand-Bassam is a popular resort and beach town a few hours from Abidjan, the country's capital city. I visited it numerous times when I lived in Côte d'Ivoire.
swa: Mji mkuu wa zamani wa Ivory Coast na eneo linalotambulika na UNESCO kama la kihistoria, Grand-Bassam ni moja ya maeneo yanayotembelewa sana na fukwe iliyo umbali wa masaa machache kutoka Abidjan, mji mkuu wa Ivory Coast.

eng: From a Ghanaian perspective, Grand Bassam could easily be Ada Foah or Labadi Beach.
swa: Kwa nchi ya Ghana, Grand Bassam ingaliweza kufananishwa na Ada Foah au Ufukwe wa Labadi.

eng: In Senegal, it could be Gorée Island or any of Dakar’s many popular beaches.
swa: Nchini Senegali, Grand Bassam yao ingeweza kuwa ni Kisiwa cha Gorée au moja ya fukwe nyingi zilizopo Dakar.

eng: But none of this is new.
swa: Lakini hakuna hata moja ya haya ni jipya.

eng: Same script, different cast.
swa: Muswada wa filamu ni uleule, mwigizaji tofauti.

eng: In terms of strategy, the attackers (Al-Qaeda, in this case) have remained consistent.
swa: Kuhusu mkakati, washambuliaji (Al-Qaeda, kwa muktadha huu) wameendelea kuwa na mikakati ile ile.

eng: From a Ghanaian perspective, Grand Bassam could easily be Ada Foah or Labadi Beach. 	Kwa nchi ya Ghana, Grand Bassam inaweza kufananishwa na Ada Foah au ufukwe wa Labadi .
In Senegal, it could be Gorée Island or any of Dakar’s many popular beaches."
swa: Nchini Senegali, Grand Bassam yao inaweza kuwa ni Kisiwa cha Gorée au moja ya fukwe nyingi maarufu zilizopo Dakar."

eng: What exactly is this strategy?
swa: Mkakati huu upoje haswa?

eng: To attack sites frequented by expatriates and tourists—hotels, resorts, shopping malls, places of entertainment.
swa: Ni kushambulia maeneo ambayo mara kwa mara yanatembelewa na wageni wa nchi za kigeni na hoteli za kitalii, maeneo yanayotembelewa sana, maduka makubwa na maeneo ya burudani.

eng: They've done so in Burkina Faso and Mali, in Tunisia and Kenya, and now Côte d'Ivoire.
swa: Wameshafanya hivi huko Burkina Faso na Mali, huko Tunisia na Kenya, na sasa nchini Ivory Coast.

eng: The strategy might be slightly different in each country (location, for instance), but the motive is largely the same: to draw attention and press coverage to their perceived political grievances.
swa: Mkakati huu unaweza kuwa na malengo tofauti kidogo kwa kila nchi (kwa mfano kulingana na mahali nchi ilipo), lakini lazima kwa kiasi kikubwa lengo linakuwa ni moja: kuvuta hisia za watu na vyombo vya habari ili kusaidia kusikilizwa kwa matakwa yao ya kisiasa.

eng: Why expat or tourist sites?
swa: Ni kwanini maeneo yanayolengwa ni yale ya wageni na watalii?

eng: They want international—not local—press coverage.
swa: Wanachohitaji ni kuona vyombo vya habari vya kimataifa na si vya ndani vikitangaza matukio hayo.

eng: Hitting such sites means more countries are involved.
swa: Kushambulia maeneo kama haya inamaana kuwa nchi nyingi zaidi zinahusihwa.

eng: For example, among the Côte d'Ivoire attack victims were nationals of Germany, France, Cameroon, Mali, and Burkina Faso.
swa: Kwa mfano, miongoni mwa wahanga wa shambulizi la Ivory Coast walikuwemo raia wa Ujerumani, Ufaransa, Cameroon, Mali na Burkina Faso.

eng: One attack, six countries affected (not counting the injured).
swa: Shambulio moja, nchi sita ziliathirika (na bila ya kuhesabu majeruhi).

eng: The January 2016 attack in Burkina Faso resulted in the deaths of people of 18 different nationalities.
swa: Shambulio la Januari 2016 lililotokea nchini Burkina Faso lilisababisha vifo vya watu 18 wa mataifa tofauti.

eng: And this is not counting the numerous local citizens who are also affected.
swa: Hii ni mbali na kuhesabu idadi kubwa ya raia wazawa ambao pia waliathirika.

eng: Another factor is that these groups appear to ride off existing press coverage.
swa: Jambo jingine ni kuwa, makundi haya yanaonekana kufuatilia habari zinazotangazwa zaidi kwenye vyombo vya habari.

eng: Burkina Faso had a civilian uprising prior to the attack there.
swa: Burkina Faso ilikuwa na machafuko ya wenyewe kwa wenyewe kabla ya kushambuliwa .

eng: Mali has been in the news since Gaddafi demise, with a lot of coverage about its United Nations heritage sites.
swa: Mali imekuwa ikitajwa sana kwenye vyombo vya habari tangu kutokea kwa kifo cha Gaddafi, na kuripotiwa kwa kiasi kikubwa kwa maeneo yake ya kihistoria yaliyotambuliwa na umoja wa Mataifa.

eng: And Côte d'Ivoire has been getting lots of positive press lately, especially since the October 2015 presidential election.
swa: Na baadae, Ivory Coast ilipata kujadiliwa kwa uzuri sana kwenye vyombo vya habari, hususani tangu wakati wa uchaguzi mkuu wa Oktoba 2015.

eng: The country recently overtook Nigeria as the preferred investment destination in the sub-region.
swa: Siku za hivi karibuni, Ivory Coast imeizidi Nigeria kwa kuwa nchi inayopendelewa zaidi kwa masuala ya uwekezaji katika eneo la ukanda wa chini.

eng: So, if the trends are clear and the motives generally consistent, the next question is what are African governments doing to prevent, combat or prepare for attacks?
swa: Kwa hiyo, kama mfuliozo wa matukio haya upo wazi kabisa na azma yao ni ileile, swali linalofuata ni kuwa serikali za Kiafrika zinafanya nini ili kukomesha hali hii, kukabiliana au kujiandaa kwa mashambulizi?

eng: The attackers are being strategic—and to a degree coordinated—how are we doing the same?
swa: Washambuliaji wapo kimkakati-kwa kiwasngo cha kuwasiliana vyema-ni kwa kiasi gani nasi tunajipanga hivi?

eng: When the November 2015 Paris attacks took place, the whole of Europe—and the US—went on high alert and ramped up security, as they've certainly had to do once again after this week's attacks in Brussels.
swa: Shambulizi la Novemba 2015 la Paris lilipotokea, maeneo yote ya Ulaya na Marekani waliingia kwenye tahadhari kubwa na kuimarisha ulinzi, kama ambavyo walivyopaswa kufanya kwa mara nyingine mara baada ya kutokea kwa shambulizi la wiki hii huko Brussels.

eng: After the Paris attacks, the United Kingdom police also disseminated a video and information, targeted at civilians, on what to do during a terror attack.
swa: Baada ya kutokea kwa shambulizi la Paris, polisi wa Uingereza walisambaza video na taarifa kwa raia kuhusu kile walichopaswa kukifanya wakati wa shambulizi la kigaidi.

eng: West Africa has experienced three terrorist attacks in recent times (not counting Nigeria).
swa: Afrika ya Magharibi imeshakabiliwa na mashambulizi matatu ya kigaidi kwa siku za hivi karibuni (bila kuijumuisha Nigeria).

eng: In Ghana, at least, beyond news headlines and short-lived discussions about security, I've seen no concrete follow-up information on the attacks, much more about what to do in the event of one.
swa: Nchini Ghana, angalao, mbali na dondoo za kwenye vyombo vya habari na majadiliano mafupi ya moja kwa moja kuhusu ulinzi, sijaona taarifa yoyote ya kina ya ufuatiliaji kuhusu mashambulizi ya aina hii, au kipi kifanyike endapo kutatokea mashambulizi kama haya.

eng: West Africa has experienced three terrorist attacks in recent times (not counting Nigeria). 	Afrika ya Magharibi imeshakabiliwa na mashambulizi matatu ya kigaidi kwa siku za hivi karibuni (bila kuijumuisha Nigeria).
In Ghana, at least, beyond news headlines and short-lived discussions about security, I've seen no concrete follow-up information on the attacks, much more about what to do in the event of one."
swa: Nchini Ghana, angalao, mbali na dondoo za kwenye vyombo vya habari na majadiliano mafupi ya moja kwa moja kuhusu ulinzi, sijaona taarifa yoyote ya kina ya ufuatiliaji kuhusu mashambulizi ya aina hii, au kipi kifanyike endapo kutatokea mashambulizi kama haya."

eng: How, for instance, do we evacuate buildings—hotels or places of work—in the event of an attack?
swa: Kwa mfano, ni kwa namna gani tunaweza kutoka kwenye majengo kama vile hoteli au maeneo ya kazi pindi yanapotokea mashambulizi kama haya?

eng: Have we mapped exit routes out of the capitals and other major cities?
swa: Tumeshaainisha maeneo ya kutokea ya miji na majiji mengine makubwa?

eng: Is there a national or regional early warning system or strategy for attack-prone sites like hotels and resorts?
swa: Kuna mfumo wa Kitaifa au wa kikanda wa ishara za mapema au mkakati wa maeneo yanayoleangwa zaidi kama vile hoteli na maeneo ya vivutio?

eng: Have we undertaken training for first responders like police and ambulances?
swa: Tumeshatoa mafunzo kwa wawajibikaji wa kwanza kabisa kama vile polisi na waokoaji?

eng: Really, where and what is our plan?
swa: Hivi, mkakati wetu ni upi na uko wapi?

eng: I've been asking these questions since the 2013 Al-Shabab attack on Kenya’s Westgate Mall in Nairobi.
swa: Nimekuwa nikiuliza maswali haya tangu shambulio la 2013 kwenye maduka ya Westgate ya jijini Nairobi nchini Kenya.

eng: Where is Africa's regional strategy on security and terrorism?
swa: Upo wapi mkakati wa kikanda wa Afrika kuhusu ulinzi na ugaidi?

eng: If it exists, how are regional bodies like the ECOWAS and the African Union making sure citizens in their member countries are aware of measures being taken?
swa: Kama upo, mamlaka za kikanda kama vile ECOWAS na Umoja wa Afrika zinafanya nini kuhakikisha raia wa nchi wanachama wanaufahamu wa mikakati inayochukuliwa?

eng: Where is our equivalent of the cross-border coordination that has taken place after the European attacks?
swa: Upo wapi makakati wetu unaofanana na ule wa ushirikiano uliofanywa na mataifa ya Ulaya mara baada ya nchi za Ulaya kushambuliwa?

eng: The United States probably has the most comprehensive security intelligence in West Africa—are there any intelligence-sharing deals with African governments?
swa: Bila shaka Marekani inaweza kuwa na ulinzi imara zaidi huko Afrika ya Magharibi, lakini kuna kandarasi zozote za ushirikiano na serikali za kiafrika?

eng: At the end of the day, information, vigilance and preparedness are what will save lives.
swa: Mwisho wa siku, taarifa, kuchukua tahadhari na kufanya maandalizi ndio mambo yatakayosaidia kuokoa maisha ya watu.

eng: Ghana shares borders with Burkina Faso and Côte d'Ivoire, in case you hadn't noticed—too close for comfort.
swa: Nchi ya Ghana inapakana na nchi za Burkina Faso na Ivory Coast, kama ulikuwa hujui-zipo karibu sana kwa ajili ya kusaidiana.

eng: Senegal is another country which should be on high alert.
swa: Senegali ni miongoni mwa nchi ambazo zinapaswa kuwa na tahadhari ya hali ya juu.

eng: Ghana has many sites that are frequented by expats and tourists, and a diverse international community.
swa: Ghana ni miongoni mwa nchi zilizo na maeneo mengi yanayotembelewa sana na wageni na watalii pamoja na watu kutoka katika jamii mbalimbali za kimataifa.

eng: It also has marginalized communities ripe for exploitation by terrorist seeking to recruit members.
swa: Pia, ina jamii za watu wasiotambulika na waliotayari kutumiwa na magaidi wanaotafuta wanachama wapya.

eng: Regardless of our much heralded "peace", these are the facts.
swa: Bila kujali ishara matarajio makubwa ya "amani" yetu, huu utabaki kuwa ukweli.

eng: Life in Ghana not rosy for everyone.
swa: Maisha nchini Ghana siyo rafiki kwa kila mmoja.

eng: We are as vulnerable as any of the countries that has already experienced attacks.
swa: Tupo hatarini kama ilivyo kwa mataifa ambayo tayari yameshashuhudia mashambulizi.

eng: What can be done?
swa: Kipi kinaweza kufanyika?

eng: I don't even need to dig deep: What is the word for "terrorist" in local Ghanian languages such as Twi? Ewe?
swa: Sihitaji hata kulitazama sana hili kwa undani wake: Katika lugha za makabila ya watu wa Ghana, kama vile Twi, Ewe, Dagbani, Fante, na Ga, neno "gaidi" linaweza kuitwaje?

eng: Ga? Does the average Ghanaian know that "Al-Kayida", is not just a popular Ashanti dance, but also evokes and represents something terrifying and dangerous?
swa: Raia wa kawaida wa Ghana anafahamu kuwa "Al-Kayida", siyo tu ngoma ya Ashanti iliyozoeleka, lakini pia inaibua hisia na kuwakilisha kitu cha kuogopesha na kilicho cha hatari?

eng: If someone were to shout "Al-Qaeda", would some people break out their best dance moves, or would they make a break for it and run?
swa: Ikitokea mtu akapiga kelele za "Al-Qaeda", je watu ndio wataendelea kunogesha ngoma, au wataacha kuendelea kucheza na kukimbia?

eng: Have Ghanaians followed the other attacks in the region closely?
swa: Raia wa Ghana wamefuatilia kwa ukaribu matukio ya mashambulizi kwenye nchi za jirani?

eng: Have we been informed or educated enough to understand key elements like the fact that shouting or praying "in Jesus' name" might not be the best bet when confronted, as the terrorists have often targeted Christians?
swa: Tumeshaelimishwa au kupata taarifa za kutosha kuelewa mambo ya msingi kama vile kupayuka au kusali "katika jina la Yesu" kunaweza kusiwe ndio namna suluhisho pekee pale watu wanapovamiwa, kwani magaidi mara nyingi wamekuwa wakiwalenga Wakristo?

eng: Will people, children especially, know to run away from the sound of gunfire, or will they think it's the sound of leftover firecrackers from Christmas?
swa: Watu, hususani watoto, watafahamu kuwa wanalazimika kukaa mbali na sauti za risasi, au watafikiri kuwa ni sauti tu za masalia ya wafyatua fataki wakati wa sikukuu ya Krismasi?

eng: The danger is not as far away as we may think.
swa: Hatari haipo mbali sana kama tunavyoweza kufikiri.

eng: We are nowhere as prepared as we should be.
swa: Bado hatujakuwa na maandalizi yoyote kama tunavyopaswa kufanya.

eng: And, as a 2012 Ghanaian presidential candidate once pointed out, attacks have little to do with internal peace or relations between religious groups.
swa: Na kama alivyotangulia kusema mgombea Urais wa mwaka 2012 nchini Ghana, kuwa mahsambulizi yana nafasi ndogo sana ya kwenye amani ya ndani au uhusiano ulipo kati ya makundi ya kidini.

eng: There are things we can begin doing right away.
swa: Kuna mambo tunayopaswa kuyafanya kwa haraka.

eng: Like sensitizing people, coming up with ways to describe terror events in local languages, warn people, and so on.
swa: Kama vile watu kuelimishwa, kuwepo na namna za kuelezea matukio ya kigaidi kwa lugha za makabila, kuwatahadharisha watu na kadhalika.

eng: We can also take regional incidents like those in Côte d'Ivoire, Mali and Burkina Faso seriously, instead of simply launching "pray for X country" campaigns.
swa: Tunaweza pia kuyachukulia kwa uzito wake matukio ya nchi nyingine kama vile Ivory Coast, Mali na Burkina Faso, badala ya kuzindua kampeni za "kuombea nchi X".

eng: We also need to separate protocol from convenience.
swa: Tunahitaji pia kutofautisha taratibu na alimradi.

eng: Why are there so many motorcades, both civilian and military, in Accra these days?
swa: Kwa nini kwa sasa kuna misururu mingi ya magari ya raia na ya kijeshi?

eng: When a real emergency happens, how will we know the difference?
swa: Pale dharura ya kwlei itakapokuwa imejitokeza, tutawezaje kutofautisha?

eng: Terror spreads quickly when there is lack of information and order.
swa: Ugaidi unaenea haraka sana pale kunapokosekana upashanaji wa taarifa na kukosekana kwa maelewano.

eng: Attacks that happen elsewhere shouldn't just be an occasion to "thank God it's not us".
swa: Mashambulizi yanapotokea mahali, isiwe ni tukio la kusema "asante Mungu, siyo sisi".

eng: Rather, they should also be an incitement to think of "what we would do, if...".
swa: Kinyume chake, matukio haya yanapaswa kuwa ni namna ya kutufanya tuwaze kuwa "sisi tungefanya nini, endapo...."

eng: The YouTube video below was produced by this author in memory of the departed.
swa: Video ya YouTube ifuatayo iliandaliwa na mwandishi huyu kwa kumbukumbu ya wote waliotangulia mbele ya haki.

eng: It's also an appeal for Africa to come together as one and combat terrorism:
swa: Pia ni kwa ajili ya kuzihamasisha nchi za Afrika kuungana pamoja kwa ajili ya kukabiliana na ugaidi:

eng: Jemila Abdulai is the founder and editor of Circumspecte.com, a digital platform dedicated to analysis and perspectives related to Africa and Africans.
swa: Jemila Abdulai ni mwanzilishi na mhariri wa Circumspecte.com, jukwaa la kidigitali linashughulika na uchambuzi na mambo yanayohusiana na Afrika na Waafrika.

eng: An international development and media professional, she has worked across Africa and has a MA in International Economics & International Affairs from Johns Hopkins University SAIS.
swa: Kama mtaalam wa masuala ya habari na Maendeleo ya Kimataifaa, amefanya kazi katika maeneo mbalimbali ya Afrika na ana shahada ya uzamili ya Sanaa ya Uchumi wa Kimataifa & Masuala ya Kimataifai kutoka chuo kikuu cha Johns Hopkins University SAIS.

eng: This week, we take you to Azerbaijan, Chile, Philippines, Poland and China.
swa: Wiki hili, tunakupeleka Azerbaijan, Chile, Ufilipino, Poland na China.

eng: First, we head to Poland where the period got political, after the country's female prime minister supported a bill proposing a complete ban on abortion.
swa: Kwanza, tunaelekea Poland ambako hedhi zimechukua sura ya kisiasa, kufuatia waziri mkuu mwanamke nchini humo kuunga mkono muswada unaopendekea kupigwa marufuku utoaji mimba.

eng: Soon, a Facebook event called “A Heavy Period for the Government” went up encouraging women to post detailed descriptions of their periods on the prime minister's official Facebook page.
swa: Muda mfupi baadae, a Tukio la Facebook liitwalo “Hedhi Nzito kwa Serikali” lilipata umaarufu kuwahamasisha wanawake kusimulia vipindi vyao vya hedhi kwenye ukurasa rasmi wa waziri mkuu.

eng: Our contributor Anna Gotowska brought us the story.
swa: Mwandishi wetu Anna Gotowska alituandalia habari hiyo.

eng: As El Niño hits the most extreme of its 12- to 18-month cycle, large swaths of Myanmar have been beleaguered by high temperatures and water shortages.

eng: Meteorologists have predicted that water shortages in many parts of Myanmar could be ratcheted up by as much as three-fold in the coming months.

eng: In Yangon, the country’s main urban hub, temperatures have already soared to 35 degrees Celsius in recent days, forcing people to take shelter under any shade they can find.

eng: Former South Africa's president Thabo Mbeki says a virus cannot cause a syndrome.
swa: Rais mstaafu wa Afrika Kusini Thabo Mbeki anasema kirusi hawezi kusababisha UKIMWI.

eng: Image released under Creative Commons by Antônio Milena/ABr.
swa: Picha imetolewa kwa leseni ya Creative Commons na Antônio Milena/ABr.

eng: Former South African president Thabo Mbeki has reignited AIDS denialism controversy after writing an article titled "A Brief Commentary on The Question of HIV and AIDS."
swa: Rais wa zamani wa Afrika Kusini Thabo Mbeki imewasha upya mjadala wenye utata unaolenga kuukana UKIMWI baada ya kuandika makala yenye kichwa cha habari "Maoni Mafupi kwenye Swali la VVU/UKIMWI."

eng: While in office, Mbeki and his former Health Minister Manto Tshabalala-Msimang, nicknamed "Dr. Beetroot," were accused of denying that the HIV virus causes acquired immune deficiency syndrome (AIDS), despite conclusive scientific evidence on the matter.
swa: Akiwa madarakani, Mbeki na waziri wake wa zamani wa Afya Manto Tshabalala-Msimang, aliyepachikwa jina la utani "Dk. Magimbi," walituhumiwa kwa kupinga kwamba Virusi Vya UKIMWI (VVU) vinasababisha UKIMWI, pamoja na kuwepo ushahidi wa kisayansi unaothibitisha suala hilo.

eng: Manto Tshabalala-Msimang promoted the use of lemon, beetroot, garlic and olive oil to treat AIDS.
swa: Manto Tshabalala-Msimang alitangaza matumizi ya malimao, magimbi, vitunguu saumu na mafuta ya mzeituni kuwa ndiyo tiba sahihi ya UKIMWI.

eng: During his presidency from 1999 to 2008, Mbeki accused scientists who linked HIV to AIDS of racism.
swa: Wakati wa urais wake kati ya mwaka 1999 na 2008, Mbeki aliwatuhumu wanasayansi wanaohusisha VVU na UKIMWI kwa ubaguzi wa rangi.

eng: He argued that accepting Western conventional wisdom on AIDS would be absurd and illogical.
swa: Alidai kwamba kukubaliana na porojo za Kimagharibi kuhusu UKIMWI ni upuuzi na ni dalili za uelewa finyu.

eng: He opposed the use of antiretroviral drugs (ARVs), saying that they were "poisons" and products of greed by Western pharmaceutical companies.
swa: Alipinga matumizi ya dawa za kupunguza makali ya virusi vya UKIMWI (ARV), akisema zilikuwa 'sumu' na ni bidhaa zilizokubaliwa na makampuni ya madawa kwenye nchi za Magharibi.

eng: He organized a Presidential Advisory Panel regarding HIV/AIDS in 2000, which attracted scientists such as Peter Duesberg and Harvey Bialy, who deny that HIV causes AIDS.
swa: Aliunda Jopo la Kumshauri Rais kuhusu VVU/UKIMWI mwaka 2000, lililokuwa na wanasayansi kama Peter Duesberg na Harvey Bialy, ambao nao wanadai kwamba VVU havisababishi UKIMWI.

eng: In his March 7, 2016 article, Mbeli refutes claims that he ever said that HIV does not cause AIDS.
swa: Kwenye makala yake ya Machi 7, 2016, Mbeki alipinga madai kwamba aliwahi kusema VVU havisababishi UKIMWI.

eng: What he believes, he says, is that a virus cannot cause a syndrome:
swa: Anachoamini, anasema, ni kwamba virusi hivyo haviwezi kusababisha dalili za upungufu wa kinga:

eng: I must also mention that I never said “HIV does not cause AIDS”.
swa: Ni lazima niseme kwamba sijawahi kusema "VVU havisababishi UKIMWI".

eng: This false accusation was made by people who benefitted from trumpeting the slogan “HIV causes AIDS” as though this was a religious edict.
swa: Hizi ni shutma zilizotolewa na watu wanaonufaika na kampeni ya vibwagizo vya "VVU vinasababisha UKIMWI" utafikiri ni mafundisho ya kidini.

eng: What I said is that “a virus cannot cause a syndrome”.
swa: Nilichosema ni kwamba "virusi haviwezi kusababisha upungufu wa kinga".

eng: As you know, AIDS is an acronym for “Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome” – therefore AIDS is a syndrome, i.e. a collection of well-known diseases, with well-known causes.
swa: Kama unavyofahamu, UKIMWI ni kifupisho cha maneno "Upungufu wa Kinga Mwilini" - na hivyo UKIMWI ni upungufu wa kinga, yaani, mkusanyiko wa magonjwa yanayofahamika, yenye visababishi vinavyofahamika.

eng: They are not, together, caused and cannot be caused by one virus!
swa: Magonjwa hayo, kwa pamoja, hayasabishwi na kirusi kimoja!

eng: I said that HIV might be a contributory cause of immune deficiency – the ID in AIDS!
swa: Nilisema kwamba UKIMWI unaweza kuwa sababu moja wapo ya upungufu wa kinga -yaani UKI kwenye neno UKIMWI!

eng: Red Ribbon' symbol of solidarity of people living with HIV/AIDS.
swa:
Utepe Mwekendu' alama ya mshikamano wa watu wanaishi na VVU/UKIMWI.
Image by Flickr user Andy McCarthy UK (CC BY-NC 2.0).	Picha na mtumiaji wa Flickr Andy McCarthy UK (CC BY-NC 2.0).
It is estimated that Mbeki's views and his opposition to the use of ARVs during his presidency lead to up to 365,000 deaths from AIDS. 	Inakadiriwa kwamba maoni ya Mbeki na upinzani wake dhidi ya matumizi ya dawa za kupunguza makali ya virusi (ARV) wakati wa urais wake vimesababisha takribani vifo 365,000 vya wagonjwa wa UKIMWI.
Responding to criticisms that his denial contributed to the number of deaths in his country, he shared data from Statistics South Africa (Statssa) showing ten leading underlying natural causes of death in 2006 in which HIV was number 9 and directed a number of questions to his critics: 	Akijibu wakosoaji wake kuwa kauli zake tata kuhusu VVU na UKIMWI zimesababisha vifo vingi nchini mwake, Mbeki alitoa takwimu kutoka Shirika la Takwimu la Nchi hiyo (Statssa) zinazonesha vyanzo vikuu kumi vya vifo nchini humo kwa mwaka 2006 ambapo UKIMWI ulikuwa nambari tisa na akaelekeza maswali kadhaa kwa wakosoaji wake:
As you will have seen from the above , what Statssa recorded as deaths from “HIV disease” came 9th in terms of the leading causes of death in South Africa in 2006, as indeed it did also in the preceding years. 	Kama unavyoona hapo juu , Shirika la Takwimu lilionesha kwamba vifo vinavyotokana na Ugonjwa wa UKIMWI" vinashika nafasi ya tisa kwenye orodha ya sababu za vifo nchini Afrika Kusini mwaka 2006, kama ilivyokuwa kwa miaka iliyopita.

eng: I am convinced that it would be perfectly understandable that the normal, thinking African would ask the questions:
swa: Ninashawishika kuwa ili suala hili lieeleweke vizuri Mwafrika wa kawaida anayefikiri vizuri angeuliza maswali yafuatayo:

eng: Why did it come about that so much noise was made internationally about the 9th leading cause of death in our country, with not even so much as a whimper about the 1st leading cause of death, tuberculosis?
swa: Ilikuwaje tukasikia kelele nyingi kutoka kwenye nchi za Kimagharibi kuhusu sababu ya tisa ya vifo nchini mwetu, wakati hatusikii chochote dhidi ya kifua kikuu kinachoongoza kwa kusababisha vifo?

eng: Why would the South African Government, knowing the health condition of its own population very well, have been expected so to focus on the 9th leading cause of death as virtually to treat as less urgent and important the first eight (8) leading causes of death, even taken together?
swa: Kwa nini Serikali ya Afrika Kusini, inayofahamu hali ya afya ya watu wake vizuri, itarajiwe kuhangaika na ugonjwa ambao ni sababu ya tisa ya vifo na isiweke nguvu yoyote ya dharura kwa sababu nane (8) nyingine za vifo?

eng: Did this have to do with the fact that South Africa could be a lucrative market for the sale of ARVs, as it now is?
swa: Je, hii inahusiana na ukweli kuwa Afrika Kusini inaweza kuwa soko muhimu la mauzo ya dawa za kupunguza makali ya vurisi (ARV), kama ilivyo sasa?

eng: An attempt to reframe his presidency'
swa: Jaribio la Kujenga Upya Sura ya Urais Wake'

eng: Responding to Mbeki's article, Katherine Furman, a PhD candidate in philosophy at the London School of Economics and Political Science, theorized what influenced Mbeki to take the actions that he did while president:
swa: Akijibu makala ya Mbeki, Katherine Furman, mwanafunzi wa Shahada ya Uzamivu (PHD) katika filosofia kwenye Shule Kuu ya London ya Uchumi na Sayansi ya Siasa, alifikiri kile kinachomfanya Mbeki achukue hatua alizochukua akiwa rais:

eng: The international scientific community made its disagreement with him explicit in the form of the Durban Declaration, a petition signed by more than 5000 scientists that endorsed the mainstream scientific view on HIV and AIDS.
swa: Jumuiya ya kimataifa ya sayansi imekuwa wazi kwa kutokukubaliana naye kupitia Azimio la Durban , tamko lililotiliwa saini na zaidi ya wanasayansi 5000 waliounga mkono maoni ya kisayansi kuhusu VVU na UKIMWI.

eng: It is clear that Mbeki should have taken the objections from scientists seriously, given that they are the experts.
swa: Ni wazi kuwa Mbeki lazima aupe uzito upinzani anaoupata kutoka kwa wanasayansi, kwa kuzingatia kwamba wao ni wataalam.

eng: But part of what went wrong in the Mbeki case was that he was confused about who exactly the real scientific experts were.
swa: Lakini sehemu ya kile kilichokosewa kwenye suala la Mbeki ni kwamba haonekani kuelewa wataalam hasa ni akina nani.

eng: He believed that the denialist scientists he supported were an oppressed minority group who had been unfairly treated by the scientific community – a feeling that was all too familiar to him emerging from the struggle against apartheid.
swa: Anaamini kwamba wanasayansi wapinzani anaowaunga mkono walikuwa kundi la wachache waliotengwa ambao hawajawa wakitendewa ilivyo haki na jumuiya ya wanasayansi wenzao - akiamini kwamba alikuwa anafahamu vilivyo kuwa hayo yote ni sehemu ya mapambano dhidi ya ukaburu.

eng: We could concede, albeit grudgingly, that maybe Mbeki’s confusion was understandable under the circumstances.
swa: Tunaweza kukubaliana, hata hivyo, kwamba labda kuchanganyikiwa kwa Mbeki kunaweza kueleweka katika mazingira hayo.

eng: But even when presented with the Durban Declaration, Mbeki didn’t step back and re-examine his views.
swa: Lakini hata alipoletewa Azimio la Durban, Mbeki hakurudi nyuma na kutafakari upya msimamo wake.

eng: This is an astonishing response.
swa: Hali hii inashangaza.

eng: Following the publication of Mbeki's article, Kerry Cullinan, managing editor for health news site Health-e.org, said Mbeki made it clear he has no remorse for his policies:
swa: Kufuatia kuchapishwa kwa makala ya Mbeki, Kerry Cullinan, mhariri mtendaji wa tovuti ya habari za afya Health-e.org, alisema Mbeki ameonesha kwamba hajisikii kusutwa na dhamira kwa sera zake:

eng: I have often wondered whether former president Thabo Mbeki has regretted his stance on HIV and AIDS, given the remarkable increase in our life expectancy since he was bundled out of power.
swa: Mara nyingine nimefikiri huenda rais mstaafu Thabo Mbeki amejutia msimamo wake kuhusu VVU na UKIMWI, kufuatia kuongezeka kwa umri wa kuishi tangu ang'olewe madarakani.

eng: But today, I wondered no more as Mbeki reiterated many of his bizarre beliefs on AIDS on his website as part of a series of letters he has been writing in an attempt to reframe his presidency.
swa: Lakini leo, sifikiri tena hayo kwa sababu Mbeki ameendelea kusimamia imani zake hizo za kushangaza kuhusu UKIMWI kwenye tovuti yake na kwenye mfululizo wa barua anazoziandika kujaribu kujenga upya kipindi cha urais wake.

eng: While every year under Mbeki saw a decrease in our life expectancy by a year, once he was ousted and the new government adopted an aggressive approach to combatting HIV including widespread access to antiretroviral (ARV) medicine, life expectancy has grown each year by a year.
swa: Wakati kila mwaka katika kipindi cha urais wa Mbeki wastani wa umri wa kuishi ulikuwa ukipungua kila mwaka, baada ya kung'olewa na serikali mpya kuweka mikakati imara ya kupambana na VVU/UKIMWI ikiwa ni pamoja na kusambaza madawa ya kupunguza makali ya virusi (ARV), wastani wa umri wa kuishi umeongezeka mwaka hadi mwaka.

eng: Sanele Sano Ngcobo, a University of Pretoria junior lecturer, challenged Mbeki on the ARVs question:
swa: Sanele Sano Ngcobo, mhadhiri wa Chuo Kikuu cha Pretoria, alimpa changamoto Mbeki kuhusiana na suala la ARV:

eng: Your article is indirectly denying the proven facts that antiretrovirals (ARVs) have saved lives of many South Africans.
swa: Makala yako inapinga kwa namna isiyo ya moja kwa moja ukweli uliothibitika kisayansi kwamba madawa ya kupunguza makali ya VVU (ARV) yameokoa maisha ya raia wengi wa Afrika Kusini.

eng: I would like to share few ARV success stories with you.
swa: Ningependa nikushirikishe habari chache za mafanikio ya matumizi ya ARV:

eng: In 2005, life expectancy in South Africa was 51 years and today it is 61 years.
swa: Mwaka 2005, wastani wa umri wa kuishi nchini Afrika Kusini ulikuwa miaka 51 na leo hii ni miaka 61.

eng: Zimbabwe’s life expectancy in 2000 was 44 years and today it is 60 years.
swa: Nchini Zimbabwe wastani wa umri wa kuishi ulikuwa miaka 44 mwaka 2000 na leo ni miaka 60.

eng: Both South Africa and Zimbabwe introduced massive ARV programmes.
swa: Nchi hizi mbili ziliamua kutekeleza kwa nguvu mipango ya kusambaza dawa za ARV.

eng: Due to ARVs, HIV-related deaths went down by:
swa: Kwa sababu ya matumizi ya ARV, vifo vinavyotokana na VVU vimepungua kwa:

eng: 58 percent in South Africa 71 percent in Ethiopia 64 percent in Thailand, and 87 percent in Senegal.
swa: asimilia 58 nchini Afrika Kusini asilimia 71 nchini Ethiopia asilimia 64 nchini Thailand, na asilimia 87 nchini Senegal.

eng: All these countries started massive ARV programmes.
swa: Nchi zote hizi zilianza kutekeleza kwa bidii mipango ya matumizi ya ARV.

eng: What more proof do we need that ARVs are saving lives of our people?
swa: Tunahitaji ushahidi upi zaidi kwamba ARV zinaokoa maisha ya watu wetu?

eng: You have argued that the US pharmaceutical companies wanted to benefits from provision of ARVs, however on 19 April 2001 your government successfully protected a law allowing the domestic production of cheaper, generic medicines – including ARVs – against a lawsuit filed by transnational pharmaceutical companies.
swa: Umejenga hoja kwamba makampuni ya madawa nchini Marekani yanataka kunufaika na usambazaji wa ARV, hata hivyo mnamo Aprili 19 2001 serikali yako iliamua kutunga sheria inayoruhusu kuzalishwa kwa madawa ya bei nafuu -ikiwa ni pamoja na ARV -kinyume na kesi iliyokuwa imefunguliwa na makampuni makubwa ya kimataifa ya madawa.

eng: Why didn’t you invest in domestic companies to produce ARVs?
swa: Kwa nini hamkuwekeza kwenye makampuni ya ndani ili kuzalisha madawa ya ARV?

eng: A simple apology...would have sufficed'
swa: Tamko Jepesi la Kuomba Radhi...Lingetosha '

eng: Commenting on the issue on Twitter, Africa is a Country simply said:
swa: Akitoa maoni yake kuhusu suala hilo kwenye mtandao wa Twita, Africa is a Country alisema:

eng: We're going to pretend we did not see former South African President Thabo Mbeki recycle his HIV/AIDS denialism again. — AFRICA IS A COUNTRY (@AfricasaCountry) March 7, 2016
swa: Tutajifanya hatukumwona rais mstaafu wa Afrika Kusuni Thabo Mbeki akieneza imani zake za ajabu dhidi ya VVU/UKIMWI

eng: While Muzi Maseko advised the former president to apologise:
swa: Wakati huo huo Muzi Maseko alimshauri rais mstaafu kuomba radhi:

eng: A simple apology from former President Mbeki, on his denialism about HIV causing AIDS which to 300 000 deaths, would have sufficed. — Muzi_Maseko (@liNgcamane) March 9, 2016
swa: Tamko jepesi la kuomba radhi kutoka kwa Rais mstaafu Mbeki, kuhusu imani zake za kudai VVU haisababishi UKIMWI na kusababisha vifo 300,000 lingetosha.

eng: However, Mbeki has got supporters as well.
swa: Hata hivyo, Mbeki ana watu wanaomwuunga mkono pia.

eng: Nande N tried to explain Mbeki's position to his critics:
swa: Nande N alijaribu kueleza msimamo wa Mbeki kwa wakosoaji wake:

eng: Mbeki's dissidents wasn't centered on the denial of AIDS existence but rather what were the causative stages & linkages between HIV & AIDS. — Nande N (@nandnz) March 3, 2016
swa: Msimamo wa Mbeki wala haukusudii kukanusha uwepo wa UKIMWI isipokuwa kuunganisha kwa kisababishi kati ya VVU na UKIMWI

eng: Msizi James wanted discussions about the former president to be about his other good leadership qualities:
swa: Msizi James alitaka majadiliano kuhusu rais huyo wa zamani yawe kwenye siha njema za uongozi wake:

eng: Let's talk about how good Mbeki was.
swa: Tuzungumzie namna alivyokuwa imara.

eng: Apart from not believing AIDS was a real problem #SONA2016 — I'm Msizi James (@msizijames) February 11, 2016
swa: Ukiacha imani zake kwamba UKIMWI haukuwa tatizo kuu

eng: Another user seemed to suggest that it is difficult for AIDS experts to challenge Mbeki's claim:
swa: Mtumiaji mwingine wa mtandao anaonekana kupendekeza kwamba ni vigumu kwa wataalam wa UKIMWI kupingana na madai ya Mbeki:

eng: All these pedestrian HIV/Aids ‘experts’ who scream “Aids denialist” will find it difficult to refute what Mbeki is saying on the matter. — #ConceptSixty5 (@Sentletse) March 7, 2016
swa: Hawa 'wataalam' wote wa VVU/UKIMWI anaopiga kelele za "Mbeki anajifanya hauoni UKIMWI" watakuwa na wakati mgumu kukanusha kile anachokidai Mbeki

eng: Two independent AIDS researchers, Anthony Brink and Chris Rawiins, who also dispute the scientific consensus on the link between HIV and AIDS, have come out in support of Mbeki's article.
swa: Watafiti wawili huru wa UKIMWI, Anthony Brink na Chris Rawiins, wanaokataa kile kinachosemwa na sayansi kuhusu uhusiano kati ya VVU na UKIMWI, wameunga mkono kile alichokiandika Mbeki.

eng: African music legend Papa Wemba passed away on April 24, 2016, in Abidjan, after collapsing on stage during one of his performances.
swa: Mwananamuziki nguli wa ki-Afrika Papa Wemba alifariki dunia mnamo Aprili 24, 2016, jijini Abidjan, baada ya kuanguka akiwa jukwaani wakati wa moja wapo ya maonesho yake ya kimuziki.

eng: He played an active role in popularising Congolese rumba on the international music scene, and he was also known for mentoring other African music stars, including Koffi Olomidé and King Kester Emeneya.
swa: Alifanya kazi kubwa ya kuutangaza muziki wa ki-Kongo kwenye majukwaa ya muziki ya kimataifa, na alifahamika kwa kuwaibua na kuwakuza nyota wengine wa muziki wa ki-Mataifa, akiwamo Koffi Olomidé na mfalme Kester Emeneya.

eng: Three days of national mourning were declared following his death, and a national funeral was held on May 4, 2016, at Our Lady of the Congo Cathedral in Kinshasa.
swa: Siku tatu za maombolezo ya kitaifa zimetangazwa kufuatia kifo chake, na mazishi ya kitaifa yalifanyika mnamo Mei 4, 2016, kwenye Kanisa moja jijini Kinshasa.

eng: If you have just discovered this African legend, here are four highlights in his career full of achievements.
swa: Kama ndio kwanza umemsikia nguli huyu wa ki-Afrika, hapa kuna dondoo nne za mafanikio yake ya kimuziki.

swa: Mtu Mbunifu wa Muziki

eng: Papa Wemba was dubbed the King of Congolese Rumba, a continuously evolving genre that has given rise to other styles such as Soukous and Ndombolo.
swa: Papa Wemba alipewa jina la utani la Mfalme wa Rumba lenye mahadhi ya ki-Kongo, muziki unaendelea kubadilika na kutengeneza miondoko mipya kama vile Soukous na Ndombolo.

eng: As its name indicates, Congolese rumba has roots in Cuban rumba, which arrived in Congo in the 1930s.
swa: Kama jina lake linavyoonesha, rumba lhili la ki-Kongo lina asili ya rumba la ki-Kuba, ambalo lilianza Kongo kwenye miaka ya 1930.

eng: Below is a video from the show “Africanités”, broadcast on TV5 Monde, illustrating the music's history with a selection of hits:
swa: Hapa chini ni video ya kipindi cha “Africanités”, kinachotangazwa na kituo cha televisheni cha TV5 Monde, kuonesha historia ya muziki kwa kutumia vibao vinavyokuwa vimechaguliwa:

eng: Papa Wemba's and his colleagues' contribution to the evolution of Congolese rumba in the 1970s was manifold, when the genre came to favor percussion instruments over wind instruments, as well as a quicker tempo, blending more strongly local trends with rumba's Cuban origins.
swa: Mchango wa Papa Wemba na wenzake kwenye mageuzi ya rumba lenye mahadhi ya ki-Kongo kwenye miaka ya 1970 ulikuwa mkubwa, wakati ambao mahadhi ya muziki huo yalianza kutumia vyombo vya kisasa badala ya vile vya asili, pamoja na kuongezwa mapigo ya haraka, yanayochanganywa na miondoko ya wenyeji wa Kongo ikienda sambamba na rumba asili ya Kuba.

eng: The American and European Tour with Peter Gabriel
swa: Ziara ya Marekani na Ulaya akiwa na Peter Gabriel

eng: In 1993, Papa Wemba toured North America and Europe on the “Secret World Live Tour” alongside Peter Gabriel, who was at the time one of the music industry's biggest stars.
swa: Mwaka 1993, Papa Wemba alizuru Marekani ya Kaskazini na Ulaya kwa ziara iliyopewa jina la "Ziara 'LIve' ya Siri ya Dunia" akiongozana na Peter Gabriel, ambaye wakati huo alikuwa moja wapo wa nyota wa muziki huo.

eng: The international recognition was huge for Papa Wemba.
swa: Papa Wemba alipata utambulisho mkubwa wa Kimataifa.

eng: Here the two artists can be seen performing “In Your Eyes” at a concert.
swa: Kwenye video ifuatayo wasanii hao wawili wanaonekana kwenye onesho la "In Your Eyes".

swa: (Papa Wemba anaanza kuimba kwa ki-Lingala kwenye dakikaya 7:40.)

eng: Peter Gabriel is as well known for his musical career as for his human rights activism, notably through the organisation he founded, called WITNESS.
swa: Peter Gabriel anafahamika kimuziki kwa harakati zake za haki za binadamu kwa kupitia taasisi aliyoianzisha, inayoitwa WITNESS.

eng: Peter Gabriel attended Papa Wemba's funeral in almost complete anonymity.
swa: Peter Gabriel alihudhuria mazishi ya Papa Wemba kwa mazingira yanayokaribia usiri.

eng: In the 1970s, Papa Wemba created a movement called “SAPE”, which is an acronym for the Société des Ambianceurs et des Personnes Elégantes (or Society of Ambiance-ists and People of Elegance).
swa: Katika miaka ya 1970, Papa Wemba alitengeneza vuguvugu aliloliita “SAPE”, ambacho ni kifupi cha maneno Société des Ambianceurs et des Personnes Elégantes (au 'Wazee' wa Mitoko na Watanashati).

eng: (This is the origin of the expression "sapé" in French, which is slang for a loudly but still well-dressed individual.)
swa: (Neno hili ndio chanzo cha neno "sapé" la ki-Faransa, ambalo lina maana ya mtu mwenye maneno mengi lakini mtanashati.)

eng: Papa Wemba liked to dress extravagantly and, by the middle of his career, he was also called the King of Sape.
swa: Papa Wemba alipenda kuvaa kitanashati na, kuwa wakati alifahamika kama Mfalme wa Sape.

eng: Congo is now known as the world's leading “sape” country, thanks in large part to Papa Wemba.
swa: Kongo kwa sasa ni inafahamika kama nchi inayoongoza duniani kwa utanashati, shukrani kwa sehemu zinamrudia Papa Wemba.

swa: Na hivyo tumempoteza Papa Wemba, mwanzilishi wa rumba la ki-Kongo na 'Mfamle wa Sape".

swa: Kwa heri na asante sana kwa msanii huyu, tunasema sisi wa Global Voices.

swa: Makala hii ni ya The Irrawaddy, mtandado huru wa Habari wa nchini Myanmar, na inachapishwa tena Global Voices kama sehemu ya makubaliano ya kushirikiana maudhui.

eng: Shan State’s upland areas are typically cooler than the arid regions of central and lower Myanmar, although this year, much like the rest of the country, it has suffered from an unusually powerful El Niño weather pattern.
swa: Kwa kawaida, maeneo ya ukanda wa juu ya Shan huwa yanakuwa ya hewa nzuri kuliko maeneo makame ya ukanda wa kati na ya ukanda wa chini nchini Myanmar pamoja na kuwa, kwa mwaka huu, kama ilivyo tu kwa maeneo mengi ya nchi, kumekuwepo na hali mbaya ya hewa na ambayo haikutarajiwa ya El Niño.

eng: In southern Shan State, springs and lakes used by local communities to store rainwater for domestic as well as farming purposes have been dry since February, leaving many villagers facing water shortages that are even worse than those in previous years.
swa: Kwa upande wa Kusini mwa jimbo la Shan, chemichemi na maziwa yaliyokuwa yanatumiwa na wanajamii wazawa kwa ajili ya kuhifadhia maji ya mvua kwa matumizi ya nyumbani pamoja na shughuli za umwagiliaji, yamekauka tangu mwezi Februari, hali iliyowaacha wanavijiji wengi bila maji, hali inayosemekana kuwa mbaya zaidi kulinganisha na miaka iliyopita.

eng: Tun Kyi, the head of Kalaw Township’s Le Gaung Village, explains the situation in their area:
swa: Tun Kyi, mkuu wa Kijiji cha Kalaw Township’s Le Gaung, anaelezea hali ya mambo katika maeneo yake:

eng: The lake near our village dried up two months ago.
swa: Ziwa lililopo karibu na kijiji chetu lilikauka miezi miwili iliyopita.

eng: Last year, we were able to use water from there until March.
swa: Mwaka uliopita tuliweza kutumia maji ya Ziwa hili hadi mwezi Machi.

eng: To tackle water scarcity, some local charities, such as the Brighter Future Myanmar Foundation, have started to distribute drinking water to villages.
swa: Katika kukabiliana na tatizo la kukosekana kwa maji, taasisi binafsi za nchini Myanmar kama vile Asasi ya Brighter Future Myanmar ilianza kusambaza maji ya kunywa vijijini.

eng: The foundation, the only in Shan State digging wells in hard-hit areas, has been collaborating with Myanmar’s government since 2014, receiving machines to drill into the mainly limestone Shan plateau.
swa: Asasi hii ya kipekee katika jimbo la Shan inachimba visima kwenye maeneo yaliyo na mwamba mgumu, imekuwa ikishirikiana na serikali ya Mynamar tangu mwaka 2004 kwa kupokea mashine za kuchimbia maji katika maeneo tambarare ya uwanda wa juu yaliyo na asili ya madini ya chokaa.

eng: The foundation says that it has recently spent US$1.5 million to buy their own new drilling equipment and that they have dug over 100 wells in Shan State to date.
swa: Asasi hii inasema kwamba, katika siku za hivi karibuni imetumia kiasi cha dola za marekani milioni 1.5 kwa ajili ya kununulia mitambo yao wenyewe mipya ya kuchimbia maji na kuwa, hadi sasa katika Jimbo la Shan wameshachimba visima 100.

swa: Bwawa lililokauka katika mji mdogo wa Pindaya huko Kusini mwa Jimbo la Shan, Aprili, 28.

swa: Picha na Jpaing /Irrawaddy

eng: In this edition, Global Voices News Editor Lauren Finch and I — Managing Editor at Global Voices– take you to China, Mexico, Jamaica, Macedonia and Uganda.
swa: Katika toleo hili, mhariri wa Habari wa global Voices, Lauren Finch pamoja na mimi — mhariri Mtendaji wa Global Voices– tunakupeleka hadi China, Mexico, Jamaica, Macedonia na Uganda.

eng: In China, we tell you about Chinese dissidents being horrified after Twitter hired a former Chinese military officer to develop their business strategy in the greater China region.
swa: Nchini China, tunakupasha habari kuhusu wakosoaji nchini china waliojawa na hofu kufuatia mtandao wa Twita kumuajiri mwanajeshi mstaafu wa China ili awasaidie kuandaa mpango wa biashara nchini China.

eng: Oiwan Lam brought our attention to this story.
swa: Habari hii ilisimuliwa kwa kina na Oiwan Lam.

eng: Then we head to Mexico to a story brought to us by our partner Sin Embargo, where the Mexican government's favorite contractor is displacing an indigenous community to build a highway.
swa: Pia, tunaelekea nchini Mexico ambapo tutapata habari iliyotayarishwa na mshirika wetu, Sin Embargo, ambapo Mkandarasi wa kutumainiwa wa serikali ya Mexico anaihamisha jamii ya raia wazawa kwa ajili ya kupisha ujenzi wa barabara kuu.

eng: Next, we set our sights on Jamaica, where our author Emma Lewis wrote a story about students at Deaf Can! Coffee who learn how to make coffee and also learn how to run all aspects of the business.
swa: Baadae, tutaangaza huko Jamaica, ambapo mwandishi wetu, Emma Lewis aliandika habari kuhusu wanafunzi katika mgahawa wa Kahawa, Deaf Can! wanaojifunza namna ya kuandaa kahawa na pia kujifunza mambo anuai kuhusu biashara hii.

eng: On to Macedonia, where the streets are full of protesters demanding justice. Our contributor Goran Rizaof reported the story.
swa: Huko Macedonia, ambapo mitaa yake imefunikwa na waandamanaji wanaodai haki, mshirika wetu Goran Rizaof alitupasha kuhusu habari hii.

eng: Finally, we’re off to Uganda, where people are peeved at their government's perceived priorities. The country's only radiotherapy machine for cancer treatment recently broke down.
swa: Mwisho tunakupeleka nchini Uganda, ambapo raia wakasirishwa na vipaombele vya serikali yao. mshine pekee ya kutibu kansa kwa kutumia mionzi ya nchini humo iliharibika hivi karibuni.

eng: It used to serve over 27 thousand patients every year, but it’s now beyond repair. Our contributor Prudence Nyamishana joins the podcast to tell us more about why Ugandans are upset and what a porn detector machine has to do with it.
swa: Ilikuwa ikihudumia zaidi ya watu elfu 27 kwa mwaka, lakini kwa sasa, imeshindikana hata kuifanyia matengenezo. mshirika wetu Prudence Nyamishana aungana nasi kutupasha zaidi ni kwa nini Raia wa Uganda wamekasirishwa na kwa nini kifaa cha kiasherati kinavyohusika.

eng: HiviSasa, Swahili for "right now", is a Kenyan digital media project publishing news and photos from citizen reporters who are paid via M-Pesa, a mobile payment system, for every article published.
swa: HiviSasa, ni mradi wa kidigitali wa kukusanya na kuchapisha habari na picha kutoka kwa waandishi/watoa habari wa kiraia na kwa kila makala inayochapishwa katika tovuti ya mradi huo, mwandishi hulipwa hadi dola $85 kwa wiki.

eng: Some citizen reporters, according to the site, earn up to about US $85 per week.
swa: Malipo hayo hulipwa kupitia huduma ya M-Pesa, ambayo ni mfumo wa malipo malipo kupitia simu za kiganjani.

eng: The project also awards writers whose articles attract the highest number of pageviews with cash prize every week.
swa: Kwa kila wiki, mradi huu huwatunukia waandishi zawadi za fedha taslimu ikiwa makala zao zimeweza kuvutia idadi kubwa ya wasomaji au kutembelewa zaidi na wasomaji wa kurasa zao.

eng: The website currently covers 10 counties in the country: Nakuru, Kiambu, Machakos, Kisii, Nyamira, Kisumu, Uasin Gishu, Garissa, Mombasa and Kibera.
swa: Tovuti hii kwa sasa imeweza kufikia kaunti (Wilaya kwa Tanzania) zipatayo kumi nchini ambazo ni: Nakuru, Kiambu, Machakos, Kisii, Nyamira, Kisumu, Uasin Gishu, Garissa, Mombasa na Kibera.

eng: Accessible, diverse, transparent information empowers both governments and citizens.
swa: Inapatikana kirahisi, inavutia watu wa makundi tofauti, ina uwazi na kumwezesha mwananchi na serikali ujumla.

eng: Better informed citizens make better decisions about their lives and their government.
swa: Wananchi wenye taarifa sahihi hufanya maamuzi bora na sahihi kwa ajili ya maisha yao na kwa serikali yao.

eng: Registration to be a contributor for the site takes less than a minute and one does not need to be a trained journalist to write for HiviSasa:
swa: Usajili wa kujiunga ili uweze kuchangia katika tovuti hii hauchukui zaidi ya dakika moja na haiihitaji mtu kuwa mwandishi aliyesomea ili aweze kuiandikia HiviSasa:

eng: You can be a professional, an organisation, a student, a government officer, a politician, a concerned citizen, a cartoonist, a businessman, a bystander… etc.
swa: Unaweza kuwa Mtaalam, Shirika binafsi, Mwanafunzi, Afisa wa Serikali, Mwanasiasa, mwananchi anayejali mwenendo wa mambo, Mchoraji wa vibonzo, Mfanyabiashara, mtazamaji...... n.k.
