eng: 49 year-old Slimane Bouhafs blogs in support of religious minorities in Algeria.
swa: 49 year-old Slimane Bouhafs mwenye umri wa miaka 49 anablogu kwa ajili ya kuunga mkono jamii za watu wachache walionyimwa fursa ya kuabudu nchini Algeria.

eng: On 6 September, an appeal court in the eastern Algerian city of Setif confirmed the conviction of activist Slimane Bouhafs for insulting Islam and prophet Muhammad on Facebook, while decreasing his jail sentence from five to three years.
swa: Mnamo tarehe 6 Septemba, mahakama ya rufaa ya jiji la Setif lililo Mashariki mwa Algeria ilithibitisha mashtaka ya mwanaharakati Slimane Bouhafs ya kuukashifu Uislam na Mtume Muhammad kupitia mtandao wa Facebook sambamba na kupunguza adhabu ya jela kutoka miaka mitano hadi mitatu.

eng: On 7 August, a primary court sentenced him to five years in jail and a fine of 100,000 Algerian dinars (approximately US $900) for “offending the Prophet” and “denigrating the creed and precepts of Islam” under article 144 bis 2 of Algeria’s Penal Code.
swa: Mnamo Agosti 7, mahakama ya mwanzo ilimhukumu kwenda jela kwa miaka mitano na faini ya dinari za Algeria 100, 000 (takribani dola la Kimarekani 900) kwa kosa la “kumkosea Mtume” na “kudhalilisha taratibu na maadili ya Uislam" chini ya kifungu cha 144 namba 2 cha kanuni ya adhabu ya nchini Algeria.

eng: On appeal, the court of Appeals of Setif maintained his conviction, reduced his jail sentence to three years and dropped the fine.
swa: Kwenye rufaa, mahakama ya rufaa ya Setif iliridhia mashitaka yake, hata hivyo, ilipunguza hadhabu ya kifungo hadi miaka mitatu pamoja na kupunguza fidia aliyopaswa kuitoa.

eng: Bouhafs, a Christian convert, and activist with the St. Augustine Coordination of Christians in Algeria which supports the rights of religious minorities in the country, regularly posts about the situation of Algeria's Christian minority on Facebook, his Google+ profile and personal blog.
swa: Bouhafs,aliyebadili dini na kuwa Mkristo na mwanaharakati akishirikiana na Muungano wa kundi la Mtakatifu Agustino la nchini Algeria kw pamoja wanapigania haki ya makundi madogo ya kidini nchini Algeria, kwa mara kadhaa amekuwa akichapisha makala kuhusiana na hali ya jamii ndogo ya kikristo nchini Algeria kupitia mtandao wa Facebook, his Google+ na kwenye blogu yake .

eng: According to Amnesty International, he is also a supporter of the Movement for Self-Determination of Kabylia (MAK), an autonomous political group seeking autonomy for the region of Kabylia.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa shirika la Amnesty International, yeye pia ni mfuasi wa Harakati za Kujipambanua za Kabylia (MAK), kundi la kisiasa linalojitegemea limalojaribu kutafuta hali ya kujitawala katika eneo la Kabylia.

eng: He was arrested on 31 July, over Facebook posts he published between May and June 2016.
swa: Alikamatwa Julai 31, kufuatia makala alizochapisha kati ya Mei na Juni 2016 kwenye ukurasa wake wa Facebook.

eng: One of the posts reportedly cited as evidence against him was published on 21 June.
swa: Moja ya makala inayodhaniwa kuwa ndio iliyotumika kama ushahidi dhidi yake ilichapishwa Juni 21.

eng: In the post, Bouhafs shared a cartoon by the French satirical magazine Charlie Hebdo showing Prophet Muhammad crying with the following comment:
swa: Katika chapisho hilo, Bouhafs alisambaza kibonzo kilichoandaliwa na jarida la mizaha la Charlie Hebdo iliyomuonesha Mtume Muhammad akilia pamoja na kuweka maoni haya:

eng: Muhammad cries because he lost in advance in Kabylia, but also in all of Algeria.
swa: Muhammad analia kwa kuwa ameshajua kuwa hana nafasi tena Kabylia, hata na Algeria yote.

eng: His lie will disappear because the light of Christ is here, because he is peace, truth and the true path
swa: Uongo wake utapotea kwa kuwa mwanga wa Kristo umewasili, kwani yeye ni amani, ukweli na njia ya kweli.

eng: The link to the Facebook post for which Bouhfsa reportedly went to jail currently shows no Charlie Hebdo cartoon.
swa: Kiungo cha makala yake kwenye mtandao wa Facebook na inayosadikiwa kuwa ndio iliyomsababishia kufungwa gerezani kwa sasa haina tena kibonzo cha Charlie Hebdo.

eng: However, the same post along with the cartoon still appears on his blog.
swa: Hata hivyo, makala hii ikiwa na kibonzo hicho badoHowever, inaonekana kwenye blogu yake.

eng: Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch both slammed Bouhafs' arrest and conviction.
swa: Shirika la Amnesty International na Human Rights Watch kwa pamoja yamekosoa kukamatwa kwa Bouhaf pamoja na mashtaka yanayomkabili.

eng: The Algerian League for Human Rights (which appointed its lawyers to defend Bouhafs' appeal) condemned the sentence for violating the Algerian constitution and international human rights standards, and called on the authorities to amend article 144 of the Penal Code which criminalizes insults to religion and state symbols.
swa: Shirikisho la Watetea haki za Binadamu la nchini Algeria (ambalo liliteua mawakili wa kumuwakilisha Bouhaf kwenye kesi yake ya rufaa) ililaani hukumu iliyotolewa kwani ilikiuka katiba ya Algeria na makubaliano ya Kimataifa ya haki za binadamu na kuzitaka mamlaka husika kubadili kifungu cha sheria namba 144 cha kanuni ya adhabu kinachofanya kuwa ni jinai kukashifu dini pamoja na alama za Taifa.

eng: Algerian authorities repeatedly use this article to silence those who criticize the state or religion.
swa: Serikali ya Algeria, mara kw mara imekuwa ikitumia kifungu hiki cha sheria kuwanyamazisha wale wanaokosoa Taifa au dini.

eng: Journalist Mohamed Tamalt is currently serving two years in jail for criticizing the country's president Abdelaziz Bouteflika in a poem he published on Facebook.
swa: Mwandishi wa habari Mohamed Tamalt kwa sasa anatumikia kifungo cha miaka miwili gerezani kwa kumkosoa Rais Abdelaziz Bouteflika kupitia shairi alilolichapisha kwenye mtandao wa Facebook.

eng: Iwacu front page (n°385, 29/07/2016) asking "Where is Jean?"
swa: Ukurasa wa mbele wa Iwacu (n°385, 29/07/2016) unauliza "Jean Yupo Wapi?"

eng: Burundian journalist Jean Bigirimana has been missing since 22 July 2016.
swa: Mwandishi wa habari wa Burundi Jean Bigirimana hajaonekana tangu Julai 22 2016.

eng: Multiple sources have told his employer, independent newspaper Iwacu, that he is in government custody.
swa: Vyanzo mbalimbali vimemdokezea mwajiri wake, gazeti lisilo la kiserikali la Iwacu, kwamba anashikiliwa na serikali.

eng: Authorities are denying these claims.
swa: Hata hivyo, mamlaka za serikali zimekanusha madai haya.

eng: Iwacu, which represents a small beacon in Burundi's notoriously difficult media environment, last week changed their website design to one that is entirely black and white, in homage to their missing colleague.
swa: Iwacu, linalowakilisha mhimili mdogo wa hali ngumu inayopitiwa na vyombo vya habari nchini Burundi, wiki iliyopita lilibadilisha muonekano wa tovuti yake na kuwa ya nyeusi na nyeupe kama ishara ya kumuenzi mfanyakazi wao asiyejulikana alipo.

eng: #Burundi yet another Black Monday.
swa: #Ni Jamatatu nyingine mbaya kwa Burundi.

eng: Dark days, gloomy weeks, a sombre month for the family of the journalist Jean Bigirimana.
swa: Siku mbaya, wiki zisizo na matumaini, mwezi usio na mategemeo kwa familia ya mwandishi wa habari Jean Bigirimana.

eng: The country's once lively media landscape has suffered from the militarized response to third-term opposition, especially outside the capital Bujumbura.
swa: Ni dhahiri kuwa tasnia ya vyombo vya habari nchini Burundi imeyaonja machungu ya upinzani wa awamu ya tatu wa kukabiliana nguvu ya jeshi, hususani maeneno ya nje ya jiji la Bujumbura.

eng: Burundian and international journalists have faced accusations of anti-government bias or encouraging insurrection and been targeted with violence.
swa: Waandishi wa habari wa Burundi na wale wa kimataifa wamekuwa wakikabiliwa na mashitaka ya kuikosoa serikali au kuhamasisha chuki dhidi ya serikali zinazoambatana na machafuko.

eng: Iwacu director Antoine Kaburahe himself currently lives in exile in Belgium.
swa: Mkurugenzi wa Iwacu Antoine Kaburahe kwa sasa naye anaishi uhamishoni nchini Ubelgiji.

eng: Before coming to Iwacu, Jean worked with Rema FM radio station.
swa: Kabla ya kujiunga na Iwacu, Jean alikuwa akifanya kazi na kituo cha redio cha Rema FM.

eng: Iwacu reports that in his travels to Rwanda, the 37-year-old reporter had written about the lives of exiled Burundian journalists living in the neighboring country.
swa: Iwacu anataarifu kuwa alipowasili Rwanda mwanahabari mwenye Umri wa miaka 37 alishaandika kuhusu maisha ya raia wa Burundi wanaoishi uhamishoni nchi ya jirani.

eng: Rwanda and Burundi have a long history of political and diplomatic tensions.
swa: Rwanda na Burundi zina historia ndefu ya migogoro ya kisiasa na kidiplomasia.

eng: #Burundi moving images from the homage to the journalist Jean @iwacuinfo
swa: #Burundi Picha kutoka kwenye kumbukumbu ya heshima ya mwandishi wa habari Jean @iwacuinfo

eng: Iwacu has vowed to continue searching for Jean.
swa: Iwacu imeapa kuendelea kumtafuta Jean.

eng: Iwacu journalists undertook their own investigations which they published online, and hope to take the case to court, though this may prove difficult given the crisis and the many other uninvestigated deaths and disappearances.
swa: Waandishi wa habari wa Iwacu walifanyauchunguzi wao binafsi na kisha kuuchapisha kwenye mtandao wa intaneti na kutazamia kufungua mashitaka mahakamani, pamoja na kuwa hatua hii inaweza kushindwa kwa kuchukulia mifano ya matukio ambayo hayakufanyiwa uchunguzi ya vifo na watu kupotea.

eng: Burundian rights organization APRODH recently reported that police and military sources, unhappy with the current situation, have identified 14 mass graves, likely containing some of the disappeared.
swa: Shirika linalotetea haki za raia la nchini Burundi,APRODH hivi karibuni lilitaarifu kuwa polisi na vyanzo vya jeshi ambavyo haviungi mkono hali inayoendelea hivi sasa, vimetaarifu kuwa yamepatika makaburi 14 ya mamluki, huku yakidhaniwa kuhusisha miongoni mwa watu wanaosadikiwa kupotea.

eng: During their enquiries, two tortured bodies were found and eventually collected by police.
swa: Wakati wa upekuzi wao, miili ya raia wawili waliokuwa walioonekana kuteswa ilikutwa na polisi.

eng: When Jean’s wife was brought to identify the bodies she said neither was him, although they were then reportedly buried without being identified.
swa: Mke wa Jean alipoitwa ili kubaini kama mume wake alikuwa ni miongoni, alisema kuwa miongoni mwao, hakuwamo mume wake, hata hivyo, iliripotiwa kuwa miili hiyo ilizikwa bila kuwambuliwa na ndugu zao.

eng: Police spokesperson Pierre Nkurikiye confirmed that neither of the two was Jean:
swa: Msemaji wa polisi,Pierre Nkurikiye alithibitisha kuwa miongoni mwa miili miwili iliyokutwa, Jean hakuwamo:

eng: #Burundi Investigation/ Case Jean BIGIRIMANA (journalist/IWACU): The 2 bodies identified : Not Jean.
swa: #Taarifa ya Burundi/ Tukiio la Jean BIGIRIMANA (mwandishi wa habari/IWACU): Miili miwili ilitambuliwa: Jean hakuwa miongoni mwao.

eng: Muramvya Prosecutor to follow up
swa: Mwendesha mashtaka Muramvya ataendelea na ufuatiliaji

eng: The news raised concerns among citizens not only about Jean, but about other possibly undiscovered bodies.
swa: Vyanzo vya habari vilionesha kuguswa kuhusu raia siyo tu kuhusu Jean, lakini pia kuhusu miili mingine ambayo kwa namna moja ama nyingine ambayo haijapatikana.

eng: Twitter user Thierry Uwamahoro asked:
swa: Mtumiaji wa Twitter, Thierry Uwamahoro aliuliza:

eng: Had #FindingJean team not embarked on that trek, we wld have never known about the 2 bodies.
swa: Kama hakukuwa na #FindingJean jopo la watu waliolivalia njuga suala hilo, kamwe tusingefahamu kuhusu miili hiyo ya watu wawili.

eng: So, how many more bodies r out there? #Burundi — Thierry Uwamahoro (@ThierryU) 10 août 2016
swa: Kwa hali hii, kuna miili mingapi zaidi? #Burundi — Thierry Uwamahoro (@ThierryU) 10 août 2016

eng: Eleven days after Jean's disappearance, Iwacu criticized the police for their “deafening silence” and for the apparent lack of an investigation.
swa: siku 11 baada ya kupotea kwa Jean, Iwacu ililishutumu jeshi la polisi kwa “ukimya wao wa kishindo” na kuonekana dhahiri kutokuwepo na ufuatiliaji.

eng: Iwacu attempted to follow a lead of Abel Ahishakiye, someone Jean contacted by phone before disappearing, but he too then apparently disappeared.
swa: Iwacu ilijaribu kumfuatilia Jean kupitia kwa Abel Ahishakiye, mtu ambaye Jean aliwasiliana naye kupitia simu kabla ya kupotea kwake, hata hivyo, naye ghafla alipotea.

eng: In early August, colleagues of Jean's received a tip indicating that he had been secretly detained in Muramvya province.
swa: Mapema mwezi Agosti, wafanyakazi wenzake na Jean walipokea ujumbe ulioonesha kuwa Jean alishikiliwa kwa siri katika jimbo la Muramvya.

eng: Police spokesperson Pierre Nkurikiye denied that the journalist had been arrested, and on 5 August Burundi's independent human rights commission (Commission Nationale Indépendante des Droits de l'Homme) stated it found no evidence that Jean was in the custody of the SNR.
swa: Msemaji wa polisi, Pierre Nkurikiye alikanusha kuwa Jean alikamatwa, na mapema agusti 5, tume huru ya haki za binadamu ya nchini Burundi(Commission Nationale Indépendante des Droits de l'Homme) ilieleza kuwa haikupata ushahidi wowote kuwa Jean alikuwa kwenye jela ya SNR.

eng: Other reporters have recently been similarly targeted. Oximity journalist Julien Barinzigo was arrested on 17 June and released on 05 August with restrictions.
swa: Waandishi wengine wa habari pia wamelengwa kwenye matukio kama haya. mwandishi wa habari wa Oximity Julien Barinzigo alikamatwa tarehe 17 Juni na kuachiwa tarehe 5 Agosti sambamba na makatazo kadhaa.

eng: Gisa Steve Irakoze of Radio Buja FM was arrested by SNR in early August, before being released on 25 August.
swa: Gisa Steve Irakoze wa kituo cha redio cha Buja FM alikamatwa na SNR mapema mwezi agusti na kabla ya kuachiliwa tarehe 25 Agusti.

eng: Some have not returned.
swa: Baadhi hawajarejea.

eng: Rights activist Marie-Claudette Kwizera, with rights organization Ligue Iteka, has not been seen since December 2015 after reportedly being arrested by security agents.
swa: Mwanaharakati wa haki za binadamuMarie-Claudette Kwizera, pamoja na wa shirika la kutetea haki, Ligue Iteka, hawajaonekana tangu mwezi Disemba 2015 mara baada ya kutaarifiwa kuwa walikamatwa na maafisa wa usalama.

eng: APRODH’s president Pierre-Claver Mbonimpa is in exile after surviving an assassination attempt last year, and family members were then murdered.
swa: Rais wa APRODH, Pierre-Claver Mbonimpa yupo uhamishoni mara baada ya kunusurika kwenye tukio la mauaji la mwaka jana, ambapo katika tukio hilo, ndugu zake waliuawa.

eng: The risks of attack even follow reporters into exile.
swa: Hatari ya kushambuliwa inawakuta hata wanahabari wanaoishi uhamishoni.

eng: Boaz Ntaconayigize, a journalist with Bonesha, in exile in Kampala, was stabbed on 31 July.
swa: Boaz Ntaconayigize, mwanahabari nayefanya kazi na Bonesha, aliye uhamishoni jijini Kampala, alichomwa na kisu manamo tarehe 31 Julai.

eng: He said that security agents had come from Bujumbura to infiltrate the refugee community and track journalists and activists.
swa: Alisema kuwa maafisa wa usalama waliwasili kwa siri kwenye kambi za wakimbizi kutoka Bujumbura kwa lengo la kuwasaka waandishi wa habari na wanaharakati.

eng: Boaz was also later questioned by Ugandan police.
swa: Baadae, Boaz alihojiwa pia na polisi wa nchini Uganda.

eng: As many have disappeared or been found dead after being detained, officials' denial of Jean's detention has left his friends and colleagues fearful that authorities may be concealing information on his whereabouts or death.
swa: Ikichukuliwa kuwa watu wengi wameshapotea katika mazingira ya kutatanisha au hata kukutwa wakiwa wamefarikiafter being detained, hali ya maafisa wa serikali kukanusha kushikiliwa kwa Jean kumewaweka marafiki na wafanyakazi wenzake na Jean katika hali hofu kuwa serikali inaweza kuwa inaficha taarifa za alipo au kuhusu kifo chake.

eng: On 25 August Iwacu’s editors published a “Letter to Jean” expressing their hopes of finding him and their fears of the worst.
swa: Mnamo tarehe 25 Agusti, wahariri wa Iwacu walichapisha “ Barua kwa Jean” wakionesha matumaini yao ya kumpata Jean na pia hofu yao ya kupatwa na mabaya.

eng: Dear Jean we are so powerless against those who have made death their speciality.
swa: Dear Jean we are so powerless against those who have made death their speciality.

eng: Today we have only words.
swa: Leo tuna maneno tu.

eng: But words are stronger than death.
swa: Hata hivyo, maneno yana nguvu kuliko kifo.

eng: Jean, they will not win!
swa: Jean, tunakuhakikishia hawataweza!

eng: Image: St. Petersburg Archdiocese
swa: Picha: Dayosisi ya St. Petersburg

eng: The Russian Orthodox Church has another scandal on its hands, or rather on the wrist of one of its top clergyman in St. Petersburg, where the archdiocese recently published photographs taken on Metropolit Varsonofiya’s travels to Greece.
swa: Kanisa la Orthodox la nchini Urusi limekumbwa na kashfa kwa mara nyingine, kashfa inayohusishwa na saa ya mkononi ya mmoja wa Makasisi waandamizi wa St. Petersburg, ambapo hivi karibuni Dayoyisisi hiyo ilichapisha picha zilizochukuliwa katika moja ya safari za Kiaskofu za Varsonofiya alipokuwa akielekea Ugiriki.

eng: In one of the happy images, journalists spotted what appears to be a Rolex Daytona 116509 — a wristwatch that retails for roughly 2.5 million rubles ($40,000).
swa: Katika moja ya picha katika matukio yake ya furaha, waandishi wa habari, waligundua kile kilichoonekana kuwa ni saa ya mkononi aina ya Rolex Daytona 116509 — yenye thamani inayokadiriwa kuwa fedha za Kirusi milioni 2.5 sawa na $40,000.

eng: Varsonofiya went to Mt. Athos on Oct.
swa: Varsonofiya alisafiri hadi Mt.

eng: 23, where he met with the new abbot at a monastery operating within the jurisdiction of the Russian Orthodox Church.
swa: Athos mnamo Oktoba 23, ambapo alikutana na Mkuu mpya wa Watawa katika nyumba ya watawa iliyopo karibu na Kanisa la Kirusi la Orthodox.

eng: According to Varsonofiya’s own account, he congratulated the abbot on being selected to his new position, and gifted him a holy cross.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa maelezo ya Varsonofiya, alimpongeza mkuu huyo wa Watawa kwa kuchaguliwa katika nafasi hiyo kwa kumzawadia msalaba mtakatifu.

eng: To mark the occasion, the church released several photographs of the meeting, including one picture revealing part of what appears to be Varsonofiya’s very expensive wristwatch.
swa: Ili kuweka kumbumbukumbu nzuri ya haafla hiyo, kanisa lilitoa picha kadhaa za mkutano huo, ikiwa ni pamoja na picha moja iliyoonesha kile kinachosadikiwa kuwa ni saa ya mkononi ya Varsonofiya inayoaminika kuwa ni ghali sana.

eng: Rolex introduced its Cosmograph Daytona series in 1963, designed specially to “meet the demands of professional racers.”
swa: Rolex ilitambulisha toleo lake aina ya Cosmograph Daytona la mwaka 1963, iliyobuniwa mahususi kwa ajili ya “kukidhi mahistaji ya wakimbiaji wa kulipwa.”

eng: A watchmaker in St. Petersburg reportedly told the Fontanka news agency that a Rolex Daytona 116509 could likely be purchased on Russia’s black market for about 25,000 euros.
swa: Mtengenezaji wa simu wa huko St. Petersburg anasemekana kuliambia shirika la habari la Fontanka kuwa saa ya mkononi aina Rolex Daytona 116509 inaweza kununuliwa katika maduka bubu ya Urusi kwa takribani Euro 25,000.

eng: The press office for St. Petersburg’s archdiocese says Varsonofiya is still in Greece, telling reporters that clarification about his wristwatch will have to wait until he’s back in Russia.
swa: Mamlaka ya Habari ya Dayosisi ya St. Petersburg inasema kuwa Varsonofiya bado yupo Ugiriki na kwamba maelezo ya kina kuhusu saa yake yatatolewa kwa waandishi wa habari mara baaada ya Varsonofiya kurejea nchini Urusi.

eng: There was a similar controversy four years ago, when Internet users noticed that the Russian Orthodox Church edited photos of Patriarch Kirill to conceal his $30,000 Breguet wristwatch.
swa: Kumekuwepo na sintofahamu kama hii miaka minne iliyopita, pale watumiaji wa mtandao wa intaneti walipogundua kuwa Kanisa la Orthodox la Urusi lilihariri picha za Askofu Kirill kwa lengo la kuficha saa ya mkononi aina ya Brequet yenye thamani ya dola za kimarekani 30,000 to conceal his $30,000.

eng: Sadly for the church, its photo editors forgot to remove the watch’s reflection on a tabletop.
swa: Bahati mbaya kwa kanisa, wahariri wao wa picha walisahau kuondoa taswira ya saa hiyo iliyotokana na sehemu ya juu ya meza.

eng: The church first denied the story, but later blamed an “inexperienced staff member.”
swa: Katika wakati fulani, kanisa lilikanusha habari hiyo, hata hivyo, baaadae lilikuja kamlaumu “mfanyakazi wao ambaye hakuwa na uzoefu.”

eng: Image: Patriarchia.ru
swa: Picha: Patriarchia.ru

eng: Outside Russia's clergy, Vladimir Putin's longtime official spokesman, Dmitry Peskov, landed in the center of a political scandal in August 2015, when anti-corruption activists spotted a $620,000 Richard Mille RM 52-01 wristwatch in his wedding day photos.
swa: Tofauti na Makasisi wa Urusi, msemaji mkuu wa zamani wa Vladimir Putin, Outside Russia's clergy, ndugu Dmitry Peskov, alijikuta katikati ya tuhuma ya kisiasa mNmo Agosti 25 pale wanaharakati dhidi ya rushwa walipogundua kupitia picha za siku aliyofunga ndoa kuwa alikuwa amevaa saa ya mkononi aina ya Richard Mille RM 52-01 yenye thamani ya dola za Kimarekani 620,000.

eng: Peskov claimed the watch was a gift from his bride, and insisted that it was worth just $3,500, but this wasn't the first time he was pictured wearing the timepiece.
swa: Peskov alidai kuwa saa ile alipewa kama zawadi kutoka kwenye mahari na kusisitiza kuwa ilikuwa na thamani ya dola za Kimarekani 3,500 tu, hata hivyo, hii si mara ya kwanza kwa yeye kuonekana katika picha akiwa amevaa saahiyo.

eng: The story was one of the first and biggest revelations made by activist Alexey Navalny about the vast personal wealth of individuals in Vladimir Putin's inner circle.
swa: Habari imekuwa miongoni mwa mojawapo na habari kubwa ya kuweka mambo hadharani iliyoandaliwa na mwanaharakati Alexey Navalny kuhusu utajiri mkubwa wa watu wa karibu kabisa wa Vladimir Putin.

eng: Navalny has continued to publish similar investigations for the past year.
swa: Navalny ameendelea kuchapisha habari za kiuchunguzi kama hizo kwa takribani mwaka mmoja sasa.

eng: Pixabay
swa: Pixabay

eng: Hours ago, the third and final U.S. presidential debate ended, capping off a heated exchange between Hillary Clinton and Donald Trump that again mentioned Russia and its president, Vladimir Putin, many times.
swa: Masaa yaliyopita, mdahalo wa tatu na wa mwisho wa urais nchini Marekani ulimalizika, na kumaliza majibizano makali kati ya Hillary Clinton na Donald Trump ambayo kwa mara nyingine uliitaja Urusi na rais wake, Vladimir Putin, mara nyingi sana.

eng: RuNet Echo recaps the debate-night tweets by one of Russia's biggest national news agencies to get an idea of what resonated in Moscow.
swa: Mradi wa RuNet unaoangazia habari za Urusi unapitia twiti zilizoandikwa usiku wa mdahalo huo na shirika kubwa la habari la Urusi ili kupata picha ya kile kilichoendelea jijini Moscow.

eng: With nearly 3 million followers on Twitter, RIA Novosti was Russia's most active major news organization that offered live blogging during the third debate.
swa: Likiwa na zaidi ya wafuatiliaji milioni tatu kwenye mtandao wa Twita, RIA Novosti lilikuwa shirika kubwa zaidi la habari lililokuwa likitoa habari mubashara wakati wa mdahalo huo.

eng: The following tweets appeared in chronological order.
swa: Twiti zifuatazo zilizoonekana kwa mpangilio wa muda wa kuonekana kwake.

eng: The first tweet appeared about 30 minutes in, when Hillary Clinton first mentioned the U.S. government's spying allegations against the Russian state:
swa: Twiti ya kwanza ilionekana kama dakika ya 30, wakati Hillary Clinton alipotaja madai ya serikali ya Marekani kuwa Urusi inaipeleleza nchi hiyo:

eng: Clinton declares that Russia “spies” on Americans.
swa: Clinton anatangaza kwamba Urusi "inawapeleleza" Wamerekani.

eng: RIA's wording was likely meant to amuse Russian readers, whom the Kremlin has repeatedly reminded are at risk of being spied upon by the U.S. government, in keeping with revelations made by Edward Snowden and others.
swa: Matumizi ya maneno ya shirika hilo la RIA yalionekana kulenga kuwafurahisha wasomaji wa Urusi, ambao Kremlin amekuwa akidai wako hatarini kupelelezwa na serikali ya Marekani, akitumia taarifa zilizotolewa na watu kama Edward Snowden na wengineo.

eng: Trump says why Clinton “doesn't like Putin.”
swa: Trump anatoa sababu kwa nini Clinton "hampendi Putin"

eng: Putin wants to use Trump like a puppet in the U.S. presidency, Clinton believes.
swa: Putin anataka kumtumia Trump kama kikaragosi kwenye serikali ya Marekani, ndivyo anavyoamini Clinton.

eng: Trump declares that the Clinton Foundation charity is a “criminal enterprise.”
swa: Trump anatangaza kwamba Taasisi ya misaada ya Clinton ni "Shirika la Kihalifu."

eng: Trump declares that Assad is much smarter than Clinton and Obama.
swa: Trump anatangaza kuwa Assad ana akili zaidi kuliko hata Clinton na Obama.

eng: Trump promises to cancel Obama's healthcare reforms.
swa: Trump anaahidi kufutilia mbali mpango wa mabadiliko ya huduma za afya nchini humo.

eng: Overall, RIA chose to focus on Donald Trump's comments, whose alarmist tone is likely better for generating traffic on social media.
swa: Kwa ujumla, shirika la habari la RIA lilichagua kuweka mkazo ziaid kwenye matamshi ya Trump, kwa lengo la kupata ufuatiliwaji zaidi kwenye mitandao ya kijamii.

eng: Naturally, the news agency also focused on moments when Russia came up in the debate, though nothing was tweeted regarding the extended conversation about the Russian-Syrian bombing of the Syrian city of Aleppo, which U.S. State Department officials have said should be investigated for war crimes.
swa: Kwa asili, shirika hili la habari lilijikita zaidi kwenye maeneo ambayo Urusi ilitajwa kwenye mdahalo huo, ingawa hakuna kilichoandikwa wakati mazungumzo marefu yakifanyika kuhusu Urusi na Syria kupiga mabomu yhuko Aleppo, hali ambayo kwa mujibu wa maafisa wa Wizara ya Mambo ya Ndani ya Marekani, lazima uchunguzi wa uhalifu wa kivita ufanyike.

eng: In terms of retweets and "likes," the most popular of the tweets above was the one recalling Trump's declaration that Syrian President Bashar al-Assad is “just much tougher and much smarter than and Obama.”
swa: Kuhusu kusambazwa na 'kupendwa' kwa twiti hizo na wafuatiliaji wake, twiti iliongozwa ni ile ambayo Trump alidai kuwa Rais wa Syria Bashar al-Assad ana "msimamo na akili zaidi kuliko na Obama.”

eng: Into the Deep is a new Global Voices podcast that digs deep into one issue that isn’t getting the media coverage it deserves.
swa: Matangazo ya 'Kwa Kina' ni matangazo mapya ya Global Voices yanayochimba kwa kina masuala ambayo hayapewi uzito kwenye vyombo vya habari.

eng: In this week's episode, we hear from Global Voices contributors Robert Valencia and Andrés Lombana-Bermudez as well as peace advocate Diego Osorio about why Colombians voted "No" in a referendum to confirm a peace agreement between Colombia's government and the militant group FARC that would have finally put an end to more than 50 years of war.
swa: Katika kipindi cha wiki hii, tunawasikiliza waandishi wetu wa Global Voices Robert Valencia na Andrés Lombana-Bermudez pamoja na mtetezi wa amani Diego Osorio kuhusu sababu za kupigwa kwa kura ya hapana katika kura ya maoni iliyokusudia kuidhinisha makubaliano ya amani kati ya serikali ya Columbia na kikundi cha waasi kiitwacho FARC, matokeo ambayo yangehitimisha zaidi ya miaka hamsini ya vita.

eng: In this episode, we featured Creative Commons-licensed music from the Free Music Archive, including songs by Blue Dot Sessions called Ray Gun - FasterFasterBrighter and Denzel Sprak, and We Are; by A Ninja Slob Drew Me.
swa: Katika kipindi hiki, tunasindikizwa na muziki wenye haki miliki ya Creative Commons kutoka maktaba ya Free Music na Blue Dot Sessions, ikiwa ni pamoja na Ray Gun - FasterFasterBrighter na Denzel Sprak, na We Are; wa A Ninja Slob Drew Me.

eng: The feature photo in this story is by Manuel Chacón/Agencia Prensa Rural and is published under a CC BY-NC-ND 2.0 license.
swa: Picha inayopambia habari hii imepigwa na Manuel Chacón/Agencia Prensa Rural na imechapishwa kwa idhini ya leseni ya CC BY-NC-ND 2.0.

eng: The graffiti reads, "People.
swa: Maandishi yanasomeka, "Watu.

eng: How many more deaths?"
swa: Vifo vingapi zaidi?"

eng: Trump, Hillary or Stein?
swa: Trump, Hillary au Stein?

eng: Even though many Global Voices contributors cannot vote in the US, we feel invested in this American presidential race like few elections before.
swa: Hata kama waandishi wetu wengi wa Global Voices hawataweza kupiga kura nchini Marekani, tunajisikia kuguswa kwenye uchaguzi huu wa Urais kama ilivyokuwa kwenye chaguzi nyinginezo.

eng: Will the US become a harder place for immigrants and minority groups to live?
swa: Je, Marekani itakuwa mahali magumu zaidi kwa wahamiaji au makundi ya wachache kuishi?

eng: The first episode of this three-part series is a fun, fast-paced conversation between our Beirut-based social media editor Zuhour Mahmoud, our Middle East and North Africa editor Joey Ayoub, Amsterdam-based US voter and Iran contributor Tori Egherman, and Sahar Ghazi, San Francisco-based US voter and Global Voices managing editor.
swa: Kipindi chetu cha kwanza kati mfululizo wa vipindi vitatu kitakuwa na mazungumzo makali na mazuri kati ya mhariri wetu wa mitandao ya jamii anayeishi Beirut Zuhour Mahmoud, mhariri wetu wa Mashariki ya Kati na Afrika Kaskazini Joey Ayoub, mpiga kura wa Marekani anayeishi Amsterdam na mwandishi wa Iran Tori Egherman, na Sahar Ghazi, mpiga kura wa Marekani anayeishi San Francisco na mhariri mtendaji wa Global Voices.

eng: Jihad Diyab will need crutches for the rest of his life—a regular reminder of the torture he endured for 12 years, 8 months, and 7 days as an inmate in Guantanamo Bay, where the U.S. military operates a prison to detain suspected war criminals indefinitely and without trial.
swa: Jihad Diyab atahitaji magongo ya kutembelea kwa maisha yake yote yakiwa ni kitu cha kumkumbusha mateso aliyoyavumilia kwa miaka 12, miezi 8 na siku 7 kama mfungwa katika gereza la Guantanamo Bay, mahali ambapo jeshi la Marekani lilikuwa likiendesha gereza likiweka washukiwa wa makosa ya kivita kwa muda usiofahamika na bila kufunguliwa mashtaka.

eng: Forty-three years old today, Diyab suffered permanent damage to his back while in the care of the U.S. government.
swa: Akiwa na miaka arobaini na tatu leo, Diyab amepatwa na madhara ya kudumu katika mgongo wake akiwa chini ya uangalizi wa serikali ya Marekani.

eng: In an interview conducted earlier this year in Uruguay, he told an an Argentinian journalist that Guantanamo even haunts the prisoners who are lucky enough to leave.
swa: Katika mahojiano yaliyafanyika mapema mwaka huu huko Uruguai, alimwambia an mwandishi wa Ki-Agentina kuwa jinamizi la Guantanamo bado linawawinda hata wafungwa waliokuwa na bahati ya kuondoka mahali hapo.

eng: The ones who make it out, he says, “are still U.S. prisoners inside.”
swa: Anasema kuwa "wote waliofanikiwa kutoka humo bado ni wafungwa wa Marekani kwa ndani"

eng: Diyab is one of the six Guantanamo prisoners (four Syrians, one Palestinian, and one Tunisian) who were freed and welcomed to Uruguay in December 2014, thanks to an agreement between U.S. President Barack Obama and Uruguayan President José “Pepe” Mujica.
swa: Diyab ni kati ya wafungwa sita kutoka Guantanamo ( Wasyria wanne, Mpalestina mmoja na Mtunisia mmoja) ambao waliachiliwa huru na kukaribishwa nchini Uruguai hapo Disemba 2014,shukrani kwa serikali iliyofanya makubaliano kati ya Rais wa Marekani Barack Obama na Rais wa Uruguai José “Pepe” Mujica.

eng: Following a failed campaign to be reunited with his family, who fled from Syria to Turkey, Diyab declared a hunger strike in mid-August.
swa: Kufuatia kushindwa kwa jitihada za kuungana na familia yake, iliyokimbia kutoka Syria kwenda Uturuki, Diyab alitangaza mgomo wa kula katikati mwa mwezi Agosti.

eng: On September 15, he told the BBC that he blamed the governments of Uruguay and the United States for his situation.
swa: Mwezi wa tisa tarehe 15, aliliambia told shirika la habari la BBC kuwa anailaumu serikali ya Uruguai na serikali ya Marekani kwa hali aliyo nayo kwa sasa.

eng: My health is very precarious.
swa: Hali ya afya yangu kwa sasa ni mbaya sana.

eng: I’m sick, my energy is very low, and I personally hold accountable the U.S. and also the Uruguayan government, if I die.
swa: Ninaumwa,nguvu zangu ni kidogo sana na kama nitakufa basi mimi binafsi nitazilaumu serikali za Marekani na Uruguai.

eng: In late September, after receiving a guarantee that his family was safe in Turkey, he resumed a liquid diet.
swa: Mwishoni mwa Septemba, baada ya kupokea uhakika wa kuwa familia yake iko salama huko Uturuki, alianza tena kula vyakula vya majimaji .

eng: Diyab made headlines this June, when he fled Uruguay over the border into Brazil.
swa: Diyab alitengeneza vichwa vya habari mwezi Juni, alipokimbia Uruguai kupitia mpaka wa Brazili.

eng: The Uruguayan media called him an “ungrateful” “rebel” for leaving the country that welcomed him out of U.S. captivity.
swa: Vyombo vya habari vya Uruguai vilimuita "muasi asiye na shukrani" kwa kuikimbia nchi iliyompokea kutoka utumwa wa Marekani.

eng: After a month of uncertainty about his whereabouts, Diyab turned up in Caracas, Venezuela, where he was detained for 17 days and then deported back to Montevideo. The circumstances of Diyab's deportation remain unclear.
swa: Baada ya mwezi usio na matumaini kuhusu mwenendo wake, Diyab aliibukia katika mji wa Caracas nchini Venezuela, ambapo alikamatwa na kuswekwa ndani na hatimaye kusafirishwa tena kwenda Montevideo.

eng: Though officials have maintained that the former Guantanamo prisoners are now “free men,” the reality has been something different.
swa: Suala la kusafirishwa kwa Diyab limebaki kuwa kitendawili.Ingawa maofisa wameendelea kusema kuwa waliokuwa wafungwa wa Guantanamo ni "watu huru" ila katika uhalisia hicho kimekuwa ni kitu tofauti kabisa.

eng: According to the newspaper Brecha, Uruguay apparently agreed to require that the freed prisoners remain in the country for two years before setting foot abroad, though top Uruguayan state officials initially denied that they accepted this condition.
swa: Kulingana na gazeti la Brecha,Uruguai inaonekana kukubali kuwachukua wafungwa walioachiliwa huru na kuwaweka nchini kwa miaka miwili kabla ya kutoa mguu nje ya nchi hiyo, ingawa maafisa wa serikali ya Uruguai wanakataa kuwa waliafikiana na taratibu hizo.

eng: Whatever deal Uruguay made with Washington, the fact remains that the prisoners released from Guantanamo have only been issued Uruguayan citizenship cards, which are not valid for foreign travel.
swa: Mpango wowote ambao Uruguai imefanya na Washington, ukweli unabakia kuwa wafungwa walioachiliwa kutoka Guantanamo wametengenezewa kadi za uraia wa Uruguai pekee ambazo hazitafaa kusafiria katika nchi za kigeni.

eng: Today, public opinion on the former Guantanamo inmates has shifted, and even the former Uruguayan president who negotiated the prisoner release now says receiving the men was simply the price his country needed to pay in order to keep “selling oranges to the United States” and maintain good ties.
swa: Leo, mtazamo wa jamii kuhusu wafungwa wa zamani wa Guantanamo umebadilika na hata raisi wa zamani wa Uruguai aliyejadili kuhusu uhuru wa wafungwa hao kwa sasa anasema kuwa, kuwapokea hao watu ilikuwa ndio gharama nchi yake ilipaswa kulipa ili iweze kuendelea "kuuza machungwa nchini Marekani" na kuimarisha mahusiano mema.

eng: The Prisoners’ Protest
swa: Maandamano ya Wafungwa

eng: Five months after arriving in Uruguay, four of the "Six of Guantanamo" staged a protest in front of the U.S. Embassy in Montevideo.
swa: Miezi mitano baada ya kuwasili nchini Uruguai wafungwa wanne kati ya "sita kutoka Guantanamo" walifanya maandamano mbele ya ubalozi wa Marekani mjini Montevideo.

eng: Diyab was absent.
swa: Diyab hakuwepo.

eng: The men had gathered after learning that Washington refused to provide them with financial assistance.
swa: Wanaume hao walijikusanya mahali hapo baada ya kugundua kuwa Marekani imekataa kuwapa msaada wa fedha.

eng: Writing in a blog, the men say they were dumped in a foreign country without employment, their families, or local language fluency.
swa: Wakiandika katika blogu,wanaume hao wanasema kuwa wametelekezwa katika nchi ya kigeni bila ajira, bila familia zao au uelewa wa lugha ya asili ya mahali hapo.

eng: For this, and for the 13 years they spent locked up without charges, they deserve help from the government responsible, they argued in April:
swa: Kwa hili, na kwa miaka 13 waliyotumikia wakiwa wamefungwa bila mashtaka, wanastahili msaada kutoka kwa serikali inayowajibika, waliyasema hayo hapo April:

eng: They should provide us with the means to live as normal human beings.
swa: They Wanatakiwa watupe namna ya kuishi kama binadamu wengine.

eng: They can’t just throw the mistakes on others, they should help us with houses and financial support.
swa: Hawawezi kurusha makosa kwa watu wengine, wangetusaidia nyumba na misaada ya kifedha.

eng: We are not asking the impossible from them they detained us for 13 years and they should help form some years to come.
swa: Hatuombi yasiyowezekana kutoka kwao, walitufunga kwa miaka 13 hivyo wangepaswa kutusaidia kwa miaka kadhaa ijayo.

eng: We think that this is the least they could do or we can ask for.
swa: Tunafikiri kuwa hiki ni kitu kidogo tu wanachoweza kufanya au tunachowaomba.

eng: In a documentary about Jihad Diyab’s life in Uruguay, Anfibia magazine says the deal that secured his release was actually just an “informal” agreement with the United States.
swa: Katika makala kuhusu maisha ya Jihad Diyab huko Uruguai, jarida la Anfibia linasema kuwa mpango uliosababisha kufunguliwa kwake ulikuwa ni makubaliano "yasiyo rasmi" na Marekani.

eng: In other words, there are no official documents establishing the former prisoners' rights.
swa: Kwa maneno mengine ni kuwa hakuna nyaraka rasmi zinazothibitisha haki za wafungwa hao wa zamani.

eng: The only formal sheet of paper applying to the prisoners is a letter signed by U.S. State Secretary John Kerry that lists the six prisoners' names and says “there is no information that were involved or conducted terrorist activities against the U.S. or its allies.”
swa: Nyaraka pekee ambazo ni rasmi ni barua iliyosainiwa na Katibu wa Ikulu ya Marekani John Kerry inayoorodhesha majina ya wafungwa hao sita ikisema “hakuna taarifa zinazoonesha kuwa walijihusisha au kutekeleza vitendo vya kigaidi kwa Marekani au washirika wake.”

eng: Anfibia's documentary also examines the lives of other former Guantanamo prisoners who have settled in Europe and Africa, where many are facing similar problems.
swa: Jarida hilo la Anfibia pia lilichunguza maisha ya waliokuwa wafungwa wa Guantanamo ambao wengine wanaishi Ulaya na Afrika na kugundua kuwa wengi wanakutana na changamoto zinazofanana.

eng: One of these men, now living in Slovakia, told the magazine, “This is not freedom.
swa: Mmoja kati ya wanaume hao, kwa sasa anaishi nchini Slovakia aliliambia jarida kuwa “Huu sio uhuru.

eng: We are still detained.
swa: Bado tumefungwa.

eng: I’ve left Guantanamo, but it's still in me—all the time.”
swa: Nimeondoka Guantanamo lakini bado iko ndani yangu wakati wote.”

eng: Another prisoner in the film called his life after prison “a second Guantanamo.”
swa: Mfungwa mwingine ndani ya sinema aliyaita maisha yake baada ya kutoka gerezani "Guantanamo ya pili”

eng: Since April, all the former prisoners in Uruguay except Diyab signed a deal with the Ecumenical Service for Human Dignity (SEDHU in Spanish) to receive financial support.
swa: Tangu Aprili, wafungwa hao wote wa zamani walioko Uruguai isipokuwa Diyab walisaini mpango wa Huduma ya Kiekumeni kwa Utu (SEDHU huko Hispania)wa kuwapa msaada wa kifedha.

eng: Diyab refused to sign, saying he disagrees with the terms, which include housing and money for two years.
swa: Diyab alikataa kusaini, akisema kuwa hakubaliani na masharti ambayo yanajumuisha nyumba naxa fedha kwa kipindi cha miaka miwili.

eng: Diyab says his back injury prevents him from working, and argues that the financial aid offered isn't enough to sustain himself, let alone his family.
swa: Diyab anasema kuwa majeraha ya mgongo wake yanamzuia kufanya kazi na akaongeza kusema kuwa msaada huo wa fedha hautoshelezi kuendesha maisha yake achilia mbali familia.

eng: Diyab was the only of the six prisoners who entered Guantanamo with a wife and children.
swa: Diyab ndie mfungwa pekee kati ya sita walioingia Guantanamo akiwa na mke na watoto wake.

eng: Of the group, he alone says that he wants to leave Uruguay for an Arab country, where he hopes to settle with his family.
swa: Katika kundi lake, ndiye pekee anayesema anataka kuondoka nchini Uruguay kwenda katika nchi ya Kiarabu anakotegemea kuishi na familia yake.

eng: So, Where Now?
swa: Kwa hiyo, Ni wapi sasa?

eng: The next challenge Diyab faces is finding a new home.
swa: Changamoto inayomkabili Diyab kwa sasa ni kupata makazi mapya.

eng: In an interview with the independent journal La Diaria, Senator Lucía Topolansky—who imprisoned during Uruguay's dictatorship—promised that the government is searching for a solution:
swa: Ndani ya mahojiano aliyoyafanya na jarida huru liitwalo La Diaria, Senator Lucía Topolansky aliyefungwa enzi za serikali ya kidikteta ya Uruguai aliahidi kuwa serikali inaendelea kutafuta suluhu:

eng: What we have to do is search for a country that accepts him.
swa: Tunachotakiwa kufanya ni kutafuta nchi itakayo mkubali.

eng: And this is not just Uruguay's problem or his problem—it's the world's problem.
swa: Na hili sio tatizo la Uruguai au la kwake pekee, ni tatizo la dunia nzima.

eng: In September, Uruguay’s government released a note confirming that it is looking for a country willing to receive Diyab and his family.
swa: Mwezi Septemba serikali ya Uruguai ilitoa tamko kuthibitisha kuwa inatafuta nchi ambayo iko tayari kumpokea Diyab na familia yake.

eng: Officials say they are doing everything they can and ask Diyab to call off his hunger strike “to respect the principle of life.”
swa: Maofisa wa serikali walisema kuwa wanafanya kila wawezalo kumuomba Diyab kusitisha mgomo wa kula ili "kuheshimu kanuni ya uhai."

eng: The negotiations, however, have made little progress.
swa: Hata hivyo majadiliano hayo yameonesha mafanikio kidogo.

eng: According to WikiLeaks' Gitmo Files, Diyab—the son of a Syrian father and an Argentinian mother—earned his living as a truck driver for many years in Syria.
swa: Kulingana na faili la Gitmo katika mtandao wa WikiLeaks, Diyab ni mwana wa baba wa ki-Syria na mama wa ki-Agentina aliyekuwa akijipatia kipato chake kwa kazi ya udereva wa malori kwa miaka mingi huko Syria.

eng: When he was arrested in Lahore by the Pakistani police in 2002, he was living in an apartment maintained by the Taliban and was selling honey to support his family.
swa: Alipokamatwa huko mjini Lahore na polisi wa Pakistani mwaka 2002, alikuwa akiishi katika nyumba iliyofanyiwa marekebisho na Taliban na alikuwa akiuza asali ili kujikimu yeye na familia yake.

eng: The files link Diyab to al-Qaida members, identifying him as “high risk,” “high intelligence,” and “a threat to the United States.”
swa: Jalada lililomuhusisha Diyab na wafuasi wa al-Qaida, lilimtambulisha kama " mtu hatari" "intelijensia ya hali ya juu" na "tishio kwa Marekani.”

eng: He was allegedly responsible for forging documents and passports for the terrorist organization.
swa: Alidaiwa kuhusika na kughushi nyaraka na hati za kusafiria kwa ajili ya jumuiya za kigaidi.

eng: Held in U.S. detention for well over a decade, he was never formally charged with any crimes.
swa: Akiwa kizuizini mwa Marekani kwa zaidi ya muongo mmoja, hakuwahi kufunguliwa mashtaka rasmi kwa kosa lolote.

eng: Diyab denies all the accusations.
swa: Diyab alikana mashtaka yote.

eng: In the meantime, repeating what he did for 13 years in prison, Diyab waits.
swa: Ni wakati wa kurudia kufanya kile alichokifanya miaka 13 akiwa gerezani, Diyab anasubiri.

eng: In an interview with CNN, he declared:
swa: Ndani ya mahojiano na shirika la habari la CNN,alisema kuwa:

eng: I didn't want to go on hunger strike, but they have closed the doors on me and left me without any solution and this is the only path that I've found.
swa: Sikutaka kuingia katika mgomo wa kula, ila walinifungia milango yote na hawakuniachia ufumbuzi mwingine na hii ndio njia pekee niliyoipata.

eng: This week, after 54 days of hunger striking, Diyab was was diagnosed with a "superficial coma."
swa: Juma hili, baada ya siku 54 za kukataa kula, Diyab aligundulika kuwa na tatizo la "kupoteza fahamu juu juu."

eng: According to the newspaper La Diaria, he previously signed a document refusing medical intervention, "even if his life is in danger," but he later accepted intravenous feeding.
swa: Kulingana na gazeti la La Diaria, hapo nyuma alisaini nyaraka akikataa kuingiliwa kati na huduma za kitabibu "hata kama maisha yake yatakuwa hatarini" lakini baadaye alikubali kulishwa kwa njia ya mishipa.

eng: The doctor who is assisting Diyab says his current health is "critical" with a “high risk of sudden death.”
swa: Daktari anayemuhudumia Diyab anasema kuwa hali yake ya sasa ni "mbaya" inayoweza kusababisha "kifo cha ghafla".

eng: In addition to his deteriorating condition, his mediator with the Uruguayan government just left his case.
swa: Pamoja na hali yake inayotetereka, msulihishi baina yake na serikali ya Uruguai ameiacha kesi yake.

eng: Nevertheless, the hunger strike continues as Diyab waits for a reply to his request.
swa: Hata hivyo, mgomo wa kula utaendelea wakati Diyab anasubiria majibu ya ombi lake.

eng: A sign for an Internet cafe in Tanzania.
swa: Maandishi ya Mgahawa wa kutoa huduma za Intaneti nchini Tanzania.

eng: Tanzania is one of the top 10 countries with most Internet users in Africa.
swa: Tanzania ni moja ya nchi kumi zenye watumiaji wengi wa mtandao wa Intaneti barani Afrika.

eng: Creative Commons photo by Flickr user Aslak Raanes.
swa: Picha ya Creative Commons iliyopigwa na mtumiaji wa Flickr Aslak Raanes.

eng: Five Tanzanian citizens, Dennis Temu, Suleiman Nassoro, Shakira Makame, Juma Mtatuu, Dennis Mtegwa, appeared before a Tanzanian court September 14 charged with insulting President John Magufuli on social media.
swa: Raia watano wa ki-Tanzania, Dennis Temu, Suleiman Nassoro, Shakira Makame, Juma Mtatuu, Dennis Mtegwa, walisimamishwa kizimbani nchini humo mnamo Septemba 14 wakishitakiwa kwa kosa la kumtukana Rais John Magufuli kupitia kwenye mitandao ya kijamii.

eng: The five denied the charges.
swa: Wote watano walikana mashitaka.

eng: It is alleged that the five shared offensive content targeting the president and the police between August 24 and 30 this year, in violation of Section 118 (a) of the Electronic and Postal Communications Act No. 3 of 2010.
swa: Inadaiwa kwamba watano hao walitumiana ujumbe wa matusi ukimlenga rais na jeshi la polisi kati ya tarehe 24 na 30 mwaka huu, kinyume na Kifungu cha 118 (a) cha Sheria ya Mawasiliano ya Kieletroniki na Posta Namba 3 ya 2010.

eng: The section imposes a criminal penalty on any person who:
swa: kifungu hicho kinamtia hatiani mtu yeyote ambaye:

eng: knowingly makes, creates, or solicits or initiates the transmission of any comment, request, suggestion or other communication which is obscene, indecent, false, menacing or offensive in character with intent to annoy, abuse, threaten or harass another person...
swa: kwa kujua atatengeneza, kuunda au kukubaliana au kuanzisha usambazaji wa maoni, maombi, mapendekezo au aina nyingi za mawasiliano ambayo hayana ukweli, yasiyo ya kimaadili, ya uongo, yenye kutishia au kudhalilisha kwa namna yenye lengo la kuudhi, kutukana, kutishia au kumbughudhi mtu mwingine...

eng: Of the five accused, state prosecutors allege that Mr. Mtegwa posted an abusive and offensive comment on a WhatsApp group called DSM 114U Movement in Kiswahili.
swa: Kati ya hao watano wanaoshitakiwa, waendesha mashitaka wa serikali wanadai kwamba Bw. Mtengwa alichapisha maoni yenye udhalilishaji na matusi kwenye kundi la WhatsApp liitwalo DSM 114U Movement kwa lugha ya Kiswahili.

eng: Roughly translated, the comment in question reads:
swa: Maoni hayo yanasomeka kama ifuatavyo:

eng: I don’t know what is going on in JPM’s head… He doesn’t even know how to say sorry.
swa: Sijui kitu gani kinaendelea kwenye kichwa cha JPM … Hajui hata kusema samahani.

eng: We are at this stage because of one person who believes that what he thinks is always right…he needs to understand that politics isn’t about resentment and the Opposition isn’t an enemy…he should learn to compete with the Opposition on the basis of debate, not force.
swa: Tumefikishwa hapa kwa sababu ya mtu mmoja anayeamini siku zote yuko sahihi...anahitaji kuelewa kuwa siasa haihitaji hasira na Upinzani sio adui...ajifunze kushindana na upinzani kwa mjadala, sio nguvu .

eng: In another recent case, Dr. Oscar Magava, a lecturer at the Mkwawa University College of Education in Iringa region, was arrested for allegedly insulting the president.
swa: Kwenye tukio jingine la hivi karibuni, Dk. Oscar Magava, mhadhiri wa Chuo Kikuu Kishiriki cha Elimu cha Mkwawa mkoani Iringa Iringa, alikamatwa kwa kudaiwa kumtukana rais.

eng: Regional Police Commander Dr. Julius Jengi Gava said on September 15 they received reports that the lecturer used social networks to the abuse the president.
swa: Kamanda wa Polisi wa Mkoa Dk. Julius Jengi Gava alisema mnamo Septemba 15 walipokea taarifa kuwa mhadhiri huyo alitumia mitandao ya kijamii kumtukana rais.

eng: He did not specify which social network he used and what exactly Magava said about the president.
swa: Habainisha ni mtandao upi hasa wa kijamii ulitumika na kile hasa ambacho Magava alikisema dhidi ya rais.

eng: Since President John Magufuli won the presidential election in October 2015, 14 people have already being arrested and charged for insulting the president on social media.
swa: Tangu Rais John Magufuli ashinde uchaguzi wa rais uliofanyika Oktoba 2015, watu 14 wameshakamatwa na kupandishwa kizimbani kwa kumtukana rais kupitia mitandao ya kijamii.

eng: Thus far only one citizen, Isaac Abakuki Emily, has been found guilty of these charges.
swa: Mpaka sasa raia mmoja tu, Isaac Abakuki Emily, ndiye aliyepatikana na hatia kwa mashitaka yake.

eng: He was convicted in June 2016 of insulting Tanzanian President John Magufuli on his Facebook page by the Arusha Resident Magistrate’s Court.
swa: Alitiwa hatiani na Mahakama ya Hakimu Mkazi Arusha mwezi Juni 2016 kwa kumtukana Rais wa Tanzania John Magufuli kwa kutumia ukurasa wake wa Facebook.

eng: Tanzanian citizen Leonard Mulokozi was charged on June 22 under Tanzania's Electronic and Postal Communications Act over a WhatsApp message that authorities say is “abusive” to Tanzanias president, John Magufuli.
swa: Mwananchi wa Tanzania Leonard Mulokozi alishitakiwa mnamo Juni 22 kwa kutumia Sheria ya Tanzania ya Mawasiliano ya Kieletroniki na Posta kwa ujumbe wake wa mtandao wa Whatsapp ambao serikali inasema ni 'matusi' kwa Rais wa Tanzania, John Magufuli.

eng: In October 2015, two Tanzanians became the first victims of the new law.
swa: Mwezi Oktoba 2015, wa-Tanzania wawili walijikuta wakiwa wahanga wa kwanza wa sheria hiyo mpya.

eng: Benedict Angelo Ngonyani, a 24-year-old student at Dar es Salaam Institute of Technology, was charged for publishing materials which are “false or not verified by relevant authorities.”
swa: Benedict Angelo Ngonyani, mwanafunzi mwenye miaka 24 wa Taasisi ya Teknolojia ya Dar es Salaam (DIT), alishitakiwa kwa kuchapisha maudhui yaliyokuwa "ya uongo na yasiyothibitika na mamlaka zinazohusika."

eng: It is alleged that he posted a Facebook post claiming that Tanzania's Chief of Defence Forces, General Davis Mwamunyange, had been hospitalized after eating poisoned food.
swa: Inadaiwa alichapisha maandishi kwenye mtandao wa Facebook akidai kwamba Mkuu wa Majeshi wa Tanzania, Jenerali Davis Mwamunyange, alikuwa amelazwa hospitali baada ya kuwa amekula chakula chenye sumu.

eng: In November 2015, four Tanzanians — Leila Sinare, Godfrey Soka, Deo Soka and Monica Gaspary Soka — were charged under Section 16 of Cybercrime Act for publishing false, election-related information on WhatsApp.
swa: Mwezi Novemba 2015, wa-Tanzania wanne — Leila Sinare, Godfrey Soka, Deo Soka na Monica Gaspary Soka — walishtakiwa chini ya Kifungu cha 16 cha Sheria ya Makosa ya Mitandao kwa kuchapisha taarifa za uongo, zilizohusiana na uchaguzi kupitia mtandao wa Whatsapp.

eng: Public prosecutors alleged that the accused published audio information on a WhatsApp group called the “Soka Group”, that was intended to mislead the public during the October 2015 Tanzanian general elections, which were plagued by accusations of vote-rigging.
swa: Waendesha mashitaka wa serikali walidai kwamba mshitakiwa huyo alichapisha taarifa iliyokuwa kwenye mfumo wa sauti kwenye mtandao wa Whatsapp wenye jina la “Soka Group”, ulikusudiwa kuupotosha uma wakati wa uchaguzi wa mkuu wa Tanzania uliofanyika Oktoba 2015, uliokuwa na ujumbe wenye madai ya wizi wa kura.

eng: Most of these citizens have been charged under the controversial relatively new Cybercrime Act.

eng: Authorities frame the Cybercrime Act as an important tool for fighting child pornography, cyberbullying, online impersonation, racist and xenophobic content online, unsolicited messages (i.e. spam), illegal interception of communications, and publication of false information.
swa: Mamlaka za serikali zinadai Sheria ya Makosa ya Mtandao ni zana muhimu ya kupambana na picha za ngono zinazohusisha watoto, udhalilishaji wa mtandaoni, kutumia wasifu wa watu wengine isivyo halali mitandaoni, habari zenye maudhui ya ubaguzi wa rangi na chuki dhidi ya wageni, kusambazwa kwa ujumbe bila idhini ya wapokeaji, kuingilia mawasiliano ya watu wengine kinyume na sheria, na kuchapisha habari za uongo.

eng: The controversial law was signed into law by the former President Jakaya Kikwete in May 2015, despite criticism from opposition politicians, social media practitioners, and human rights activists.

eng: Residents of Khabarovsk in Russia’s Far East have been staying indoors or wearing masks when they go outside since a thick smog blanketed the city on Tuesday.

eng: Russian officials are monitoring carbon monoxide levels, which have increased 1.5 times since the smog rolled in.
swa: Maarifa wa Urusi wanachunguza kiwango cha hewa ya ukaa (carbon monoxide), ambacho kimeongezekan mara 1.5 zaidi tangu ukungu huo utande.

eng: Smoke began to descend on Khabarovsk about two weeks ago and seemed to originate from the Chinese border province of Heilongjiang and the Jewish Autonomous Republic, a Russian region next to Khabarovsk.
swa: Moshi ulianza kutanda kwenye mji wa Khabarovsk takribani majuma mawili yaliyopita na unaonekana kuanzia kwenye mpaka wa nchi hiyo na China kwenye jimbo la Heilongjiang na Jamhuri huru ya Kiyahudi, ambao ni sehemu ya Urusi karibu na Khabarovsk.

eng: Khabarovsk officials said that straw fires in Heilongjiang were responsible for the smoke, and sent a letter to the Heilongjiang Department of Environmental Protection asking that provincial authorities get the situation under control and take new measures to prevent future fires.
swa: Maafisa wa Khabarovsk walisema kuwa moto katika eneo la Heilongjiang ndio sababu ya moshi huo, na walituma barua kwendakwa Idara ya Ulinzi wa Mazingira ya Heilongjiang kuziomba mamlaka za eneo hilo kudhibiti hali hiyo na kuchukua hatua za kuzuia matukio ya moto kwa siku zijazo.

eng: Authorities in Heilongjiang denied the Russian officials' claims, telling the Global Times today that farmers in the province had not yet begun to harvest crops or burn straw—and won't begin do so until early November because of recent precipitation.
swa: Mamalaka za Heilongjiang zilikanusha madai ya maafisa wa Urusi, na kuimbia Global Times leo kuwa wakulima wa jimbo hilo walikuwa hawajaanza kuvuna mazao au kuchoma mabua -na hawataanza kufanya shughuli hizo mpaka mapema mwezi Novemba kwa sababu ya hali mbaya ya hewa katika siku za hivi karibuni.

eng: “The president does not know 45 out of 50 of the people he appointed and I don't know them either, despite being his wife of 27 years," she said.

I will never do it again.”	Sitafanya hivyo tena.”

eng: All mobile internet services have been shut down in Ethiopia for the last seven days, amid increasingly violent protest scenes and a recently declared a "state of emergency".
swa: Huduma zote za intaneti kwenye simu za mkononi zimezimwa nchini Ethiopia kwa siku saba sasa, wakati matukio ya ghasia za maandamano yakiendelea sambamba na "hali ya hatari" iliyotangazwa hivi karibuni.

eng: Demonstrations have taken place with regular frequency in Ethiopia's Oromia region since November 2015, with protesters demanding greater self-rule, freedom and respect for the ethnic identity of the Oromo people, who have experienced systematic marginalization and persecution over the last quarter century.
swa: Maandamano yamekuwa yakifanyika mara kwa mara kwenye majimbo ya Oromia tangu Novemba 2015, kufuatia madai ya kutaka kujitawala, kupata uhuru na kuheshimiwa kwa watu wa kabila la Oromo, ambao wamekuwa wakidaiwa kubaguliwa na kuteswa na mfumo wa serikali kwa zaidi ya robo karne iliyopita.

eng: Authorities have used deadly force against the protesters on more than one occasion.
swa: Vyombo vya dola vimetumia nguvu kupita kiasi katika kujaribu kupambana na waandamanaji kwa zaidi ya tukio moja.

eng: On October 2 alone, 52 people were killed.
swa: Mnamo Oktoba 2 pekee, watu 52 waliuawa.

eng: The Oromo Federalist Congress (OFC), an opposition party, has reported a death toll of nearly 600 people.
swa: Chama cha upinzani cha Oromo Federalist Congress (OFC), kimeripoti idadi ya vifo vinavyofikia watu 600.

eng: While select social media and messaging platforms such as WhatsApp have been shut down sporadically as protests have grown more intense, in Addis Ababa, the capital, this is the longest sustained mobile Internet service shutdown that has taken place since they began.
swa: Wakati baadhi ya mitandao ya kijamii ikifungwa kama vile WhatsApp kadri maandamano yanavyoendelea kushika kasi, jijini Addis Ababa, ambao ni mji mkuu, hili ndilo tukio refu zaidi ya kuzimwa kwa huduma za mtandao wa Intaneti kuwahi kutokea nchini humo.

eng: The sudden silence of the protests on social media has left those tracking the movement over Facebook and Twitter worried.
swa: Kunyamazishwa ghafla kwa waandamanaji kwenye mitandao ya kijamii kumewafanywa wale wanaofuatilia habari za maandamano hayo kwenye mtandao wa Facebook na Twitter kupatwa na wasiwasi.

eng: Mobile internet, social media cut for +7 days in the "African capital" #AddisAbaba.
swa: Inteneti ya simu, mitandao ya kijamii imekatwa kwenye zaidi ya siku saba kwenye jiji hili la ki-Afrika

eng: The mobile Internet blackout is also likely resulting in a decrease in online news about the protests.
swa: Kuzimwa kwa intenti ya simu za mkononi kunaweza kusababisha kupungua kwa habari zinazohusu maandamano hayo kwenye mitandaoani.

eng: Activists fear that the protest movement, which has relied on social media both for coordination and for circulating their message to international audiences, will be severed from their primary means of communication.
swa: Wanaharakati wanawasi kuwa maandamano hayo, ambayo kwa kiasi kikubwa yamekuwa yakitegemea mitandao ya kijamii katika uratibu wake na kusambaza ujumbe kwenda kwa wafuatiliaji wa kimataifa, yataathirika sana kwa kukosekana kwa njia kuu ya mawasiliano.

eng: Despite low Internet penetration in Ethiopia, social media are becoming essential —especially for the protest movements in Oromia and Amhara regional states.
swa: Ingawa si maeneo mengi yameunganishwa na mtandao wa intaneti, mitandao ya kijamii imekuwa muhimu sana -hasa kwa ajili ya maandamano yanayofanyika kwenye majimbo ya Oromia na Amhara.

eng: Newsfeeds from Facebook pages and Twitter feeds from Ethiopia are not showing the same abundance of posts as they were a week ago.
swa: Habari zinazopatikana kwenye kurasa za Facebook na Twita hazioneshi kuwepo kwa machapisho mengi kama ilivyokuwa juma lililopita.

eng: How #Ethiopia censors Facebook.
swa: Namna #Ethiopia inavyofuatilia Facebook.

swa: Huku kukiwa na hali ya hatari iliyotangazwa hivi karibuni, tegemea vitendo zaidi vya #kuzimwa kwa intaneti na #ufuatiliwaji wa matumizi yake. #KeepItOn pic.twitter.com/pD2laTPzpF — Moses Karanja (@Mose_Karanja) October 9, 2016

eng: The government has been cutting off connectivity and blocking social media in Oromia and Amhara regions over the past 12 months.
swa: Serikali imekuwa ikikata mtandao wa intaneti na kuzuia mitandao ya kijamii kwenye maeneo ya Oromia na Amhara kwa zaidi ya miezi 12.

eng: In June they blocked social media in the name of preventing exams leaks, but now it is not clear whether te government is switching off all mobile internet services as a precursor to the ongoing protest, or if the measure is intended as a reaction to protests.
swa: Mwezi Juni serikali ilizima mitandao ya kijamii kwa madai ya kuzuia vitendo vya wizi wa mitihani, lakini hivi sasa haieleweki ikiwa serikali itazima huduma zote za simu za mikononi kuzuia maandamano yanayoendelea, au kama hatua hiyo inalenga kudhibiti maandamano hayo.

eng: Those close to the situation fear this may be the beginning of a dangerous new phase after 12 months of protests.
swa: Wale wanaoufuatilia mwenendo wa mambo wanahofia kuwa hatua hii inaweza kuwa dalili ya mwanzo mbaya kwa maandamano hayo yaliyoendelea kwa miezi 12.

eng: This post originally appeared on Groundviews, an award-winning citizen journalism website in Sri Lanka.
swa: Makala haya yalionekana mara ya kwanza kwenye Groundviews, tovuti iliyoshinda tuzo ya uandishi wa habari za kiraia nchini Sri Lanka.

eng: An edited version is published below as part of a content-sharing agreement.
swa: Habari hii iliyohaririwa imechapishwa hapa chini kama sehemu ya makubaliano ya kushirikiana kwa maudhui.

eng: Sri Lanka recently announced that it will pay as much as USD 170 million (Rs. 25 billion) to the aircraft-leasing company AerCap Holdings, in order to cancel the purchase of four Airbus A350 aircraft, which the country's Rajapaksa government had previously purchased in 2013.
swa: Hivi karibuni Sri Lanka ilitangaza kuwa italipa deni linalofikia Dola za Marekani Milioni 170 kwa kampuni inayotengeneza na kukodisha ndege AerCap Holdings, kama gharama za kuvunja mkataba wa kununua ndege nne aina ya Airbus A350, ambazo ziliagizwa na serikali ya Rais Rajapaksa wa nchi hiyo mwaka 2013.

eng: As part of what officials are calling a restructuring plan, Sri Lanka simultaneously decided to discontinue the budget airline Mihin Lanka.
swa: Hatua hiyo ambayo maafisa wa serikali wanasema ni sehemu ya mpango wa marekebisho, Sri Lanka iliamua kusitisha bajeti ya ndege ya Mihin Lanka.

eng: SriLankan Airlines has languished in debt for years.
swa: SriLankan Airlines imekuwa na madeni mengi kwa miaka hivi karibuni.

eng: The last time the company earned a profit was reportedly in 2009, one year after Emirates sold its stake in the national carrier.
swa: Mara ya mwisho kampuni hiyo kuripotiwa kupata faida ni mwaka 2009, mwaka mmoja baada ya Emirates kuuza hisa zake za shirika hilo.

eng: Most recently, it reported a net loss of Rs.
swa: Siku za hivi karibuni, shirika hilo liliripoti hasara ya Rupia.

eng: 16.33 billion rupees (USD 112 million) for the year.
swa: 16.33 bilioni (Dola za Kimarekani milioni 112) kwa mwaka huo.

eng: Groundviews has created an infographic to show what the government could have funded with the money spent on canceling the purchase of the four aircraft.
swa: Groundviews imetengeneza habari ya picha kuonesha namna gani serikali ingeweza kutumia fedha zilizotumika kufuta mpango wa kununua ndege nne.

eng: The figures are drawn from the Finance Ministry's 2015 annual report.
swa: Takwimu zilizopatikana kupitia ripoti ya mwaka 2015 ya Wizara ya Fedha.

eng: Infographic by Groundviews.
swa: Habari picha na Groundviews.

eng: Rs. 25 billion is a significant sum of money, and the announcement was met with a similar level of anger on social media:
swa: Rupia bilioni 25 ni kiasi kikubwa cha fedha, na tangazo hilo lilipokelewa kwa hasira zinazolingana na kiasi hicho kwenye mitandao ya kijamii:

eng: #lka #FlyingFolly @flysrilankan cancels four A350 aircraft, incurs USD98m (LKR 14b) penalty.
swa: Shirika letu la Ndege limefuta mpango wake wa kununua ndege aina ya A350, mpango unaogharimu faini ya Dola Milioni 98.

eng: As the infographic shows, the money used to cancel the order for the Airbuses could have been used to pay for pensions, Samurdhi payments (social welfare), medicine, or school supplies.
swa: Kama inavyoonekana kwenye habari picha hiyo, pesa hizo zimetumika kufuta mkataba wa kutengenezewa ndege hizo na kampuni ya Airbuses abazo zingetumiwa kulipia mafao ya uzeeni, malipo ya Samurdhi (ustawi wa jamii), madawa, au vifaa vya shule.

eng: SriLankan Airlines has struggled with debt for years (auditors flagged its viability as far back as 2009), and yet the government continued to purchase aircraft, compounding the losses incurred.
swa: Shirika la ndege la SriLankan limehangaika na deni hilo kwa miaka mingi (wakaguzi wa mahesabu walitahadharisha kuwa lingeongezeka tangu mwaka 2009), lakini serikali iliendelea na mpango wake wa kununua ndege hizo, hatua iliyokuza hasara ambayo tayari ilishapatikana.

eng: Now, Sri Lanka will have to pay the price — to the tune of millions of dollars.
swa: Sasa, Sri Lanka italazimika kulipa gharama hiyo - kwa mamilioni ya dola za kimarekani.

eng: The end of LinkedIn in Russia?
swa: Mwisho wa mtandao wa LinkedIn nchini Urusi?

eng: LinkedIn, the world’s largest online professional network, is at risk of being blocked in Russia, where federal censors have convinced a Moscow court to outlaw the network.
swa: LinkedIn, mtandao mkubwa zaidi unaowaunganisha wataalam, uko hatarini kufungiwa nchini Urusi, ambapo maafisa wa serikali wanaopeleleza taarifa za watu wamefanikiwa kuishawishi mahakama kuufutilia mbali mtandao huo nchini humo.

eng: A judge found that LinkedIn illegally shares non-users’ personal data without their permission.
swa: Jaji wa mahakama nchini humo amejiridhisha kuwa LinkedIn hutumia taarifa binafsi za watu wasioutumia mtandao huo bila ridhaa yao.

eng: In what could have even more far-reaching consequences, the Moscow court also ruled that LinkedIn collects personal information from users in Russia without storing the data on servers located in Russia — a legal requirement introduced last year that few foreign Internet companies respect.
swa: Katika kile kinachoonekana kuwa matokeo mabaya, mahakama moja mjini Moscow ilijiridhisha kuwa LinkedIn hukusanya taarifa za watumiaji wake wa Urusi bila kuzihifadhi nchini Urusi - kinyume na takwa la kisheria lililoanza mwaka jana kuyabana makampuni yote ya kigeni yanayotoa huduma za intaneti.

eng: According to the newspaper Kommersant, federal censors decided to move against LinkedIn following repeated leaks of user data.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa gazeti la Kommersant, wapelelezi wa taarifa za watu kutoka serikalini wameamua kupambanana na LinkedIn kufuatia kuvuja kwa taarifa za watuamiaji wake.

eng: Earlier this year, it was revealed that the company lost 167 million account credentials in a data breach in 2012 — far more than the 6.5 million accounts originally thought.
swa: Mapema mwaka huu, ilifahamika kuwa kampuni hiyo ilipoteza watumiaji wapatao milioni 167 kwa sababu ya kuvuja kwa taarifa zao - kiasi kinachozidi watumiaji milioni 6.5 waliokuwa wamekadiriwa hapo awali.

eng: Federal censors say they turned to the courts because LinkedIn has no official representation in Russia.
swa: Wafuatiliaji wa serikali wanasema waliamua kwenda mahakamani kwa sababu LinkedIn haina wawakilishaji wake nchini Urusi.

eng: The network has roughly 5 million registered users in Russia (about half of them are believed to be active) and 400 million users worldwide.
swa: Mtandao huo unakadiriwa kuwa na watumiaji walioandikishwa wapatao milioni 5 nchini Urusi (nusu yao wanaaminiwa kuutumia mtandao huo mara kwa mara) na watumiaji milioni 400 duniani kote.

eng: In their lawsuit, Russian censors reportedly argued that LinkedIn collects and transfers data belonging to Russian citizens, including Russians who are not members of the website, violating multiple privacy laws.
swa: Katika kesi hiyo, wafuatiaji wa Urusi wanadaiwa kujenga hoja kuwa LinkedIn inakusanya na kutuma taarifa za raia wa Urusi, wakiwemo wa-Rusi wasio wanachama wa mtandao huo, na hivyo kuvunja sheria hadhaa za haki ya faragha.

eng: The court ruled in favor of the government on August 4, ordering police to take steps to restrict access to LinkedIn across the country.
swa: Mahakama hiyo imetoa hukumu hiyo na kuipa serikali ushindi mnamo Agosti 4, na kuiamuru polisi kuchukua hatua za kuzuia upatikanaji wa LinkedIn nchini humo.

eng: At the time of this writing, LinkedIn remains accessible to most Internet users in Russia.
swa: Wakati makala haya yanapoandikwa, LinkedIn bado inapatikana kwa watumiaji wengi nchini Urusi.

eng: Based in Arusha, Tanzania, the African Court on Human and Peoples' Rights is a continental court established by African countries to ensure the protection of rights in Africa.
swa: Ikiwa jijini Arusha, Tanzania, Mahakama ya Afrika ya Haki za Binadamu na Raia ni mahakama ya bara zima iliyoanzishwa na nchi za Afrika kwa lengo la kulinda haki barani humo.

eng: The Court complements the African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights.
swa: Mahakama hiyo inafanya kazi bega kwa bega na Tume ya Afrika inayoshughulikia Haki za Binadamu na Raia.

eng: While the African Commission only gives recommendations, the Court's decisions are binding.
swa: Wakati Tume ya Afrika ikiishia kutoa mapendekezo, Mahakama hiyo hufanya maamuzi.

eng: The Court was established under the Protocol to the African Charter on Human and Peoples' Rights on the Establishment of an African Court on Human and Peoples’ Rights.
swa: Mahakama hiyo ilianzishwa chini ya Itifaki ya Makubaliano ya Afrika kwa Haki za Binadamu na Raia kuanzisha Mahakama ya Afrika kwa Haki za Binadamu na Raia.

eng: According to the video, as of September 2016, only 30 countries have ratified the protocol.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa video hiyo, mpaka Septemba 2016, nchi 30 tu zimekubaliana na Makubaliano hayo.

eng: The video points out that the Court has already made two major decisions relating to freedom of expression in Africa.
swa: Video hiyo inaonesha kuwa Mahakama hiyo tayari imefanya maamuzi makubwa mawili yanayohusiana na uhuru wa kujieleza barani Afrika.

eng: In 2014, the Court ruled that imprisonment for defamation violates the right to freedom of expression.
swa: Mwaka 2014, Mahakama iliamua kuwa kufungwa kwa kosa la kumchafua mtu mwingine ni kinyume cha haki ya uhuru wa maoni.

eng: In the same year, the Court ordered a reopening of the investigation into the killing of Burkinabe investigative journalist and publisher Norbert Zongo.
swa: Mwaka huo huo, Mahakama iliagiza kufunguliwa upya kwa uchunguzi wa mauaji ya mwandishi wa habari za uchunguzi na mchapishaji raia wa Burkina Faso Norbert Zongo.

eng: The artist who worked on the animation is a Venezuelan named Juan Carlos Hernández Ramirez.
swa: Msanii alitengeneza katuni hii ni m-Venezuela anayeitwa Juan Carlos Hernández Ramirez.

eng: A screenshot of the documentary "Valley of a Thousand Hills."
swa: Picha iliyopigwa kwenye dokumentari iitwayo, "Bonde la Vilima Elfu."

eng: Valley of a Thousand Hills is a recent mini documentary about Indigo Skate Camp, an effort to create the first generation of Zulu skaters in the village of Isithumba, in the Kwazulu-Natal region of South Africa.
swa: Valley of a Thousand Hills ni filamu ya maisha halisi ya hivi karibuni inayohusu Kambi ya Indigo ya Kuteleza, mradi unaojaribu kutengeneza kizazi cha kwanza cha watelezaji wa ki-Zulu kwenye kijiji cha Isithumba, jimbo la Kwazulu-Natal nchini Afrika Kusini.

eng: The village is surrounded by 1,000 hills, hence the title of the film.
swa: Kijiji hicho kinazungukwa na vilima 1,000 ambavyo ndio sababu ya jina la filamu hiyo.

eng: The camp is the brainchild of South African professional skater Dallas Oberholzer.
swa: Kambi hiyo imeanzishwa na mtaalamu wa mchezo wa kuteleza nchini wa Afrika Kusini aitwaye Dallas Oberholzer.

eng: Skateboarding is not a common sport in South Africa, especially among blacks.
swa: Mchezo wa kuteleza hauna umaarufu sana nchini Afrika Kusini, hasa miongoni mwa raia weusi.

eng: In addition to skateboarding, the 30 to 40 kids taking part in the programme are taught self-respect, health and safety, art and music.
swa: Pamoja na mchezo huo wa kuteleza, watoto wapatao 30 mpaka 40 wanaoshiriki mpango huo wanafundishwa nidhamu, afya na usalama, sanaa na muziki.

eng: The film is by Jess Colquhoun, a documentary filmmaker and photographer, and Huck Magazine.
swa: Filamu hiyo iliyotengenezwa na Jess Colquhoun, mtayarishaji wa filamu na mpiga picha na Huck Magazine.

swa: Matangazo ya yaliyojiri wiki hii hapa Global Voices yanaangazia baadhi ya habari kubwa zilizojitokeza kwenye habari zetu za Global Voices.

eng: This week, we introduce you to women seeking or achieving justice in Poland, Uruguay, Russia and Syria.
