eng: Fear of Justice?
swa: Hofu ya Mkono wa Sheria?

eng: Decolonisation?
swa: Kujitafutia Uhuru?

eng: Gambian President Yahya Jammeh who has been in power since 1994 is widely accused of human rights violations.
swa: Rais wa Gambia Yahya Jammeh ambaye yopo madarakani tangu mwaka 1994 anatuhumiwa kwa ukiukwaji mkubwa wa haki za binadamu.

eng: Public domain photo by the White House uploaded online by Wikipedia user Alifazal.
swa: Pich akwa hisani ya Ikulu iliyopakiwa na mtumiaji wa Wikipedia Alifazal.

eng: Following an announcement to withdraw from the International Criminal Court (ICC), Gambians have dismissed the government's reasoning.
swa: Kufuatia tangazo la kusitisha uanachama katika Mahakama ya Kimataifa ya Makosa ya Jinai(ICC), Raia wa Gambia waonesha kutokukubaliana na sababau za serikali yao za kujiondoa.

eng: Activists and ordinary people both at home and abroad are discussing what they perceive as the "real" reasons the government decision to withdraw the country from the ICC.
swa: Wanaharakati na raia wa kawaida waishio ndani na nje ya nchi wanajadili yale wanayodhani ndio sababu “kuu” zilizopelekea serikali yao kuamua kusitisha uanachama wa ICC.

eng: The government has accused the world body of unfairly targeting African leaders while ignoring leaders of the Western world.
swa: Serikali imeishututumu ICC kwa kuonesha upendeleo kwa kuwalenga zaidi viongozi wa Afrika kuliko wale wa mataifa ya Magharibi.

eng: While announcing the withdrawal, Gambia's Minister of Information Sheriff Bojang said that the ICC is "an International Caucasian Court for the persecution and humiliation of people of colour, especially Africans."
swa: Alipokuwa akitoa taarifa ya kuachana na mahakama hii, Waziri wa Mawasilianmo wa nchini Gambia Sheriff Bojang alisema kwamba ICC ni "Mahakama ya wazungu iliyo na lengo la kuonea na kudhalilisha watu wa rangi nyingine na hususani Waafrika."

eng: The announcement follows moves by South Africa and Burundi to quit the court.
swa: Uamuzi huu umekuja mara baada ya nchi za Afrika Kusini na Burundi kusitisha uanachama wa ICC.

eng: Since its establishment in 2002, the ICC has opened inquiries involving nine nations - all except one involve African nations.
swa: Tangu kuanzishwa kwake mwaka 2002, ICC imeshafungua mashitaka yanayohusisha nchi nane - ambazo zote ni za mataifa ya Afrika isipokuwa nchi moja tu.

eng: Early this year, members of the African Union backed a Kenyan proposal to push for withdrawal from the court.
swa: Mapema mwaka huu, wanachama wa Umoja wa Afrika waliunga mkono pendekezo la Kenya la kutaka kusitisha uanachama wa ICC.

eng: Independent presidential candidate Dr. Isatou Touray in a press release condemned the Gambian government's wish to withdraw and said it reflected current President Yahya Jammeh's rule:
swa: Mgombea binafsi wa kiti cha Urais Dr. Isatou Touray katika mkutano na waandishi wa habari alishutumu kitendo cha serikali ya Gambia kusikitisha uanachama wa ICC na kusema kuwa uamuzi huo uliwakilisha aina ya uongozi wa Rais wa sasa Yahya Jammeh:

eng: Fellow Gambians the removal of the Gambia from the ICC, just like the withdrawal from the Commonwealth in 2013 is an unconstitutional act that reflects once more President Jammeh’s disregard for the constitution and the laws of the Gambia.
swa: Ndugu zangu raia wa Gambia kushitishwa kwa uanachama wa Gambia kwenye ICC, kama ilivyokuwa kusitisha uanachama wa Jumuia ya Madola mwaka 2013, ni jambo lisilo la kikatiba linalo na kwa mara nyingine linaonesha ni kwa kiasi gani uongozi wa Rais Jammeh umeshindwa kuheshimu katiba na sharia za nchini Gambia.

eng: Dr. Touray, a human rights activist, is the first Gambian woman to launch a bid for the presidency.
swa: Dr. Touray, mwanaharakati wa haki za binadamu ndiye mwanamke wa kwanza nchini Gambia kuonesha nia ya kugombea kiti cha Urais.

eng: Presidential elections will be held in the Gambia on 1 December 2016.
swa: Uchaguzi wa Rais utafanyika nchini Gambia tarehe 1 Disemba, 2016.

eng: In October 2013, the country left the Commonwealth, calling it an "extension of colonialism".
swa: Mwezi Oktoba 2013, nchi ya Gambia ilijiondoaleft kwenye Jumuiya ya Madola, kwa kile ilichokiita “kuendelea kusujudu ukoloni".

eng: But for Mama Linguere Sarr, a Gambian journalist and activist based based in Sweden, the government is withdrawing from the ICC for fear of justice.
swa: Hata hivyo, kwa Mama Linguere Sarr, mwandishi wa habari na mwanaharakati aishiye huko Swedenyeye anaona kuwa Gambia imejiondoa ICC kwa kuogopa mkono wa sharia.

eng: In September 2016, President Jammeh removed his interior minister and longtime friend Ousman Sonko.
swa: Mwezi Septemba 2016, Rais Jammeh alimuachisha kazi waziri wake wa mambo ya ndani na rafiki yake kipenzi wa muda mrefu Ousman Sonko.

eng: Shortly after his dismissal, Ousman Sonko, who has been named in extrajudicial killings and forced disappearances, sought asylum in Sweden.
swa: Muda mchache mara baada ya kuachishwa kazi, Ousman Sonko, anayesemekana kutaka kuuawa na maafisa usalama wa serikali na hivyo kulazimika kutokomea na kutafuta hifadhi nchini Sweden.

eng: Breaking!! #Gambia withdraws from ICC.
swa: Kikwazo!! #Gambia yajiondoa ICC.

eng: This follows the dictator's fear that his ex Interior Minister will incriminate him to gain asylum
swa: Hii ni kutokana na hofu ya dikteta kwamba waziri wake wa ndani wa zamani atamponza katika kupata hifadhi.

eng: — MamaLinguere Sarr (@mamasarr) October 25, 2016
swa: — MamaLinguere Sarr (@mamasarr) October 25, 2016

eng: However, some people agree with the government's desire to withdraw from the ICC, hailing it as part of a decolonisation project.
swa: Hata hivyo, baadhi ya watu wanakubaliana na uamuzi wa serikali wa kujiondoa ICC wakisema kuwa huu ni mpango wa kujitafua uhuru kamili.

eng: Benjamin Mpofu wrote on Facebook:
swa: Katika ukurasa wake wa Facebook Benjamin Mpofu aliandika:

eng: The act of continental defiance against a court system created to perpetuate a racist justice system is critical and the timing of it all reminds me of the 50s and 60s when former colonies raged against the machine thanks to the weakening of the colonisers due to the world war.
swa: Huu ni mfumo mahakama wa kizungu ulioandaliwa kwa lengo la kuendeleza mfumo dhalimu wa mahakama na wa kibaguzi na kwamba hali hii inanikumbusha miaka ya 50 na 60 pale makoloni ya enzi hizo yalipokabiliana vikali na wakoloni, angalao ilikuwa fadhali kwa wakoloni kufifishwa nguvu kulikosababishwa na vita vya duania.

eng: The current redesigning of the worlds geopolitics presents the perfect time for Africa to advocate for its own interests.
swa: Hali ya sasa ya kutizama upya uhusiano wa kisiasa kati ya mataifa mbalimbali ni wakati muafaka kwa Afrika kuzingatia vipaumbele vyake.

eng: The project of decolonisation in its totality must begin and leaving the ICC creates that very precedent.
swa: Mpango wa kutafuta uhuru kwa ujumla wake hauna budi kuanza na kwa kuanziaICC iwe mfano

eng: But for lawyer Malick Jallow, the decisions of African countries to quit the ICC is based on the wrong premise.
swa: Lakini kwa mwanasheria Malick Jallow, maamuzi ya nchi za Kiafrika kujiondoa ICC hayana sababu za msingi.

eng: He wrote:
swa: Aliandika:

eng: I have followed the debate on the recent declarations regarding withdrawal by a few African Countries from the ICC, including The Gambia.
swa: Nimefuatilia mijadala ya hivi karibuni kuhusu matamko ya kujiondoa ICC kwa baadhi ya nchi za Kiafrika, ikiwa ni pamoja na Gambia.

eng: A lot of it confirms my long held notion that the ICC and International criminal justice is perhaps the most misunderstood concept in Africa.
swa: Matamko mengi yanathibitisha mtazamo wa muda mrefu sana kuwa ICC pamoja na Haki za Kimataifa za Makosa ya Jinai pengine ni mambo yasiyofahamika kabisa barani Afrika.

eng: The ICC chief prosecutor, Fatou Bensouda, who is Gambian, has since responded to the departure of African states to leave the ICC.
swa: Mwendesha mashitaka wa ICC, Fatou Bensouda, ambaye ni raia wa Gambia, aliwahi kuzungumzia suala la nchi za Afrika kujiondoa ICC.

eng: We must remain strong, Bensouda told reporters in the Hague last week.
swa: Hatuna budi kuwa imara, Bensouda aliwaambia waandishi wa habari wiki iliyopita akiwa Hague.

eng: Bensouda previously served in President Jammeh's government, appointed as minister of justice in 1998, serving as the chief advisor of government on legal matters.
swa: Kabla ya kupata wadhifa kama mwendesha mashtaka wa ICC, Bensouda aliwahi kufanya kazi kwenye serikali ya Rais Jammeh kama waziri wa sharia mwaka 1998, alitumikia pia serikali akiwa kama mshauri mkuu wa serikali kwenye masuala ya sharia.

eng: But she was sacked two years later.
swa: Hata hivyo, aliondolewa miaka miwili baadae.

eng: The Gambia is yet to submit divorce papers to formally begin the withdrawal, but analysts are optimistic that there is no turning point for the tiny West African state.
swa: Nnchi ya Gambia bado haiwasilisha nyaraka kwa ajili ya kuanza mchakato rasmi wa kujiondoa ICC, hata hivyo, wachambuzi wa mambo wanaamini kuwa msimo huu utaendelea kuwa hivi kwa taifa change hili la Afrika Magharibi.

eng: Over the years, the country has increasingly shifted its focus from the West to the East.
swa: Kwa miaka kadhaa, Gambia imeendelea kuhamisha mtazamo wake kutoka ule wa kimagharibi kwenda mrengo wa kimashariki.

eng: In 2016, it opened an embassy in Russia and resumed diplomatic ties with mainland China (both countries are not members of the ICC).
swa: Mwaka 2016, nchi hii ilifungua ubalozi wake huko Urusi pamoja na kurejesha tena uhusiano wake na nchi ya China (nchi zote hizi si wanachama wa ICC)

eng: Who will win on November 8: Trump, Hillary or Stein?
swa: Ni nani ataibuka mshindi siku ya Novemba 8: Trump, Hillary au Stein?

eng: Even though many Global Voices contributors cannot vote in the US, we all feel invested in this American presidential race like few elections ever before.
swa: Hata kama waandishi wetu wengi wa Global Voices hawataweza kupiga kura nchini Marekani, tunajisikia kuguswa kwenye uchaguzi huu wa Urais kama ilivyokuwa kwenye chaguzi nyinginezo.

eng: The questions that come to our mind: Will the US become more interventionist or isolationist?
swa: Maswali tunayojiuliza: Je, Marekani itakuwa na ushirikiano zaidi na mataifa mengine au itajitenga?

eng: Could a woman president in the US change things for women around the world?
swa: Rais mwanamke nchini Marekani ataweza kuleta auheni kwa mambo yanayowahusu wanawake kote duniani?

eng: Will it be harder for immigrants and minority groups to live in the United States?
swa: Itawawia vigumu kwa makundi ya wahamiaji na watu wa chini kuishi nchini Marekani?

eng: To express our angst and get our thoughts out, every Wednesday, from October 26 to November 9, four Global Voices contributors will get together and talk about the latest news coming out of the US elections, what people outside the US think, and how our American contributors—who travel around the world and are familiar with political processes in other countries— feel about this election.
swa: Katika kuelezea hisia na mawazo yetu, kila Jumatano, kuanzia Okotba 26 hadi Novemba 9, watu wanne wa Global Voices watakutana pamoja na kujadili habari motomoto zinazohusu uchaguzi wa nchini Marekani, watu nje ya Marekani wana mitazamo gani, na namna wana Global Voices wenzetu wa Marekani-wanaosafiri katika maeneo mbalimbali ya dunia, walio na uzoefu wa mambo ya siasa katika nchi nyingine-wana maoni gani kuhusu uchaguzi wa Marekani.

eng: Conversation #2: Tuesday, November 2
swa: Maongezi #2: Jumanne Novemba 2

eng: With just six days to go until this roller coaster of an election campaign is over, everyone's nerves are thoroughly frayed.
swa: Tukiwa tumebakiza siku sita kabla ya uchaguzi na kabla ya kumalizika kwa minyukano ya kampeni, kila mmoja anaisubiria siku ya uchaguzi kwa bashasha.

eng: To discussed our frazzled reactions to the campaign, this second episode of this three-part series is a fun, fast-paced conversation between: Marianna Breytman, New York-based US voter and Lingua Community Coordinator Georgia Popplewell, Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago-based Global Voices Managing Director Sana Saleem, San Francisco-based Global Voices Pakistan Editor
swa: Katika kujadili mihemko yetu kutokana na kampeni, makala haya ya pili ya toleo hili lililo katika sehemu tatu ni la kufurahisha, majadiliano ya papo ka hapo kati ya: Marianna Breytman, ambaye anaishi New York, atapiga kura na pia ni Mratibu wa Wanalingua Georgia Popplewell, anayeishi katika mji Mkuu wa Trinidad na Tobago, Port of Spain, na ambay pia ni Mkurugenzi Mwendeshaji wa Global Voices Sana Saleem, ambaye yupo San Francisco na pia anafanya kazi na Global Voices kama Mhariri wa Pakistan

eng: This conversation was moderated by Nevin Thompson, Global Voices social media editor and Japan editor.
swa: Majadiliano haya yalisimamiwa na Nevin Thompson, Mhariri wa mitandao ya Kijamii wa Global Voices na pia ni mhariri wa Japan.

eng: Last week, our Beirut-based social media editor Zuhour Mahmoud moderated a discussion that included our Middle East and North Africa editor Joey Ayoub, Amsterdam-based US voter and Iran contributor Tori Egherman, and Sahar Ghazi, San Francisco-based US voter and Global Voices managing editor.
swa: Wiki iliyopita, mhariri wetu wa mitandao ya kijamii kutoka Beirut-Zuhour Mahmoud alisimamia mjadala uliowahusisha mhariri wetu wa Mashariki ya kati na Afrika Kaskazini-Joey Ayoub, Tori Egherman aliyeko Amsterdam, mpiga kura wa Marekani na pia ni mchangiaji wa Global Voices kutoka Iran, pamoja na Sahar Ghazi, aliyeko San Francisco, mpiga kura katika uchaguzi wa Marekani na pia ni Mhariri Mtendaji wa Global Voices.

eng: You can watch that episode here.
swa: Unaweza Kuitazama makala hiyo hapa.

eng: Zone9 members rejoice at the release of Befeqadu Hailu (second from left, in scarf) in October 2015.
swa: Wanakikundi wa Zone9 wakisherehekea kuachiwa kwa Befeqadu Hailu (wa pili kutoka kushoto, aliye na skafu) manamo Oktoba 2015.

eng: Photo shared on Twitter by Zelalem Kibret.
swa: Picha iliwekwa kwenye mtandao wa Twita na Zelalem Kibret.

eng: Befeqadu Hailu, one of the best-known voices in Ethiopia’s stifled media environment, was arrested on November 10, 2016.
swa: Befeqadu Hailu, mmoja wa watu wanaofahamika sana katika tasnia ya habari nchinin Ethiopia iliyonyimwa uhuru alikamatwa mnamo Novemba 10, 2016.

eng: In the morning hours, authorities took Befeqadu from his home to a jail cell in a nearby police station.
swa: Majira ya asubuhi, serikali ilimakamata Befeqadu akiwa nyumbani kwake na kumuweka katika sero iliyo katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu na nyumbani kwake.

eng: He spent the day in there and was then transferred to a police station located in a neighborhood called Kotebe.
swa: Alishikiliwa hapo kwa siku nzima na baadae alihamishiwa katika kituo cha jirani kiitwacho Kotebe.

eng: A member of the high-profile Zone9 blogger collective and a Global Voices contributor, Befeqadu is an active voice in the blogosphere and on Twitter.
swa: Akiwa mmoja wa wanakikundi mzoefu wa kundi la Zone9 na pia mwandishi wa Global Voices, Befeqadu ni anatumia vyema sana karama yake ya uandishi kupitia Blogu na kwenye Twitter.

eng: When the Ethiopian government declared a state of emergency, he wrote:
swa: Mara tu baada ya serikali ya Ehtiopia kutangaza hali ya hatari, aliandika:

eng: Now, the government in Ethiopia has declared a ‘state of emergency’ that lasts in six months.
swa: Serikali ya Ethiopia "imetangaza hali ya hatari" inayodumu kwa miezi sita.

eng: As ‘the usual suspects’ because of our dissents , my friends and I are scared more than before.
swa: Kama "ilivyo kawaida ya washukiwa", kwa sababu ya ukosoaji wetu, mimi pamoja na marafiki zangu tuna hofu kuu isivyo kawaida.

eng: It has always been a risky thing to criticize the government here.
swa: Kama kawaida, imekuwa ni jambo la hatari sana kuikosa serikali hapa (Ethiopia).

eng: Furthermore, this declaration has given the government the right to arrest us even without an excuse.
swa: Tamko hili limeipa serikali mamlaka ya kutukamata bila hata huruma.

eng: I’m publishing this personal note as a blog because I am afraid I may be arrested sometime soon.
swa: Ninachapisha maneno haya kupitia blogu kwani nina hofu kuwa ninaweza kukamatwa mda wowote.

eng: If so I want people read me and understand me.
swa: Kama itakuwa hivi, ninataka watu wanisome na wanielewe.

eng: I want people to also understand my likes to understand the desperate protests in Ethiopia.
swa: Ninapenda pia watu waelewe namna ninavyokubali maandamano yenye changamoto tele nchini Ethiopia.

eng: It’s an attempt to survive as human with dignity.
swa: Ni jaribio la kutaka kuishi kama mwanadamu mwenye utu.

eng: Authorities did not officially disclose the reason for Befeqadu's arrest, but they told him that he was wanted by the highest-ranking military officer (also known as command post) that is instituted by the state of emergency. Later he was told that the interview he gave for Voice of America's Amharic Service about Ethiopia's state of emergency was the reason for his arrest, and that he either will be charged or given "educational" training.
swa: Serikali haikuweka bayana lengo la kukamatwa kwa Befeqadu, hata hivyo walimwambia kuwa alikuwa anatakiwa kuonana na kiongozi wa ngazi ya juu wa jeshi (anayefahamika pia kama mwenye amri) kama sehemu ya utekelezaji wa hali ya hatari. baadae aliambiwa kuwa mahojianao aliyoyafanya na Idhaa ya Sauti ya Amerika katika lugha ya Kiamhari kuhusu hali ya hatari iliyotangazwa nchini Ethiopia ndio sababu ya kukamatwa kwake, na kwamba anaweza kukutwa na hatia au kupatiwa mafunzo "kabilishi".

eng: His friend and co-author Zelalem Kibret shared on Twitter the five-minute sound bite from Voice of America that supposedly justified Befeqadu's arrest. The clip is in Amharic.
swa: Rafiki na mwandishi menzake Zelalem Kibret alipakia katika ukurasa wa Twitter taarifa ya sauti ya dakika tano kutoka idhaa ya Kiswahili inayodhaniwa kuwa ndiyo iliyopekea Befeqadu kukamatwa.

eng: In October, the Oromo Federalist Congress (OFC), an opposition party, reported a death toll of nearly 600 people.
swa: Kipande hiki cha sauti kipo katika lugha ya Kiamhari.

eng: Along with his Zone9 blogging collective colleagues, the 35-year-old has been arrested and stood trial several times.
swa: Mahakama kuu inategemewa kutoa maamuzi yanayosubiriwa kwa muda mrefu kuhusu kesi ya wanablogu wa @Zone9ners kesho.

eng: From April 2014 until October 2015, they were jailed and then charged under Ethiopia's Anti-Terrorism Act. In April of 2016, the prosecution appealed the decision against five of the Zone9 bloggers, including Befeqadu.
swa: Kwa bahati mbaya, Befeqadu ana marafiki wazuri kutokana na uandishi wake uliotukuka nchini Ethiopia.

eng: Befeqadu unfortunately is in good company as a writer under fire in Ethiopia. Natnael Feleke, also a member of the collective, spent three days in October in a local police station after he was arrested for conversing loudly with his colleagues in a hotel about the causes of stampede that resulted in deaths of hundreds of people in late September.
swa: Natnael Feleke, ambaye pia ni mmoja wa wanakikundi wa Zone9, mwezi Oktoba alijikuta akishikiliwa katika kituo cha polisi mara baada ya kukamatwa kwa kosa la kuzungumza kwa sauti akiwa na rafiki zake wakiwa katika hoteli moja kuhusu kundi kubwa la watu kukanyagana na kupelekea vifo vya watu takribani mia moja mwishoni mwa mwezi Septemba.

eng: Seyoum Teshome, a prominent blogger who was arrested last September is not yet known.
swa: Seyoum Teshome, mwanablogu mashuhuri ambaye alikamatwa mwishoni mwa mwezi Septemba hatma yake bado haijajulikana.

eng: Almost two months after his arrest, authorities have not disclosed the causes of his arrest or any charges against him.
swa: Miezi miwili tangu kukamatwa kwake, serikali bado haijaeleza sababu za kukamatwa kwake wala kusomewa mashtaka yoyote.

eng: The Global Voices community stands in solidarity with Befeqadu.
swa: Jumuia ya Global Voices ipo pamoja na Befeqadu.

eng: We urge his immediate release by Ethiopian authorities.
swa: Tunaitaka serikali ya Ethiopia kumwachia huru mapema iwezekanavyo.

eng: Learn more about Befeqadu and the Zone9 bloggers.
swa: Jifunze zaidi kuhusu Befeqadu na Wanablogu wa Zone9 .

eng: Screen shot from SiliconCaribe.com website.
swa: Picha iliyopigwa kwenye tovuti ya SiliconCaribe.com.

eng: Jamaican tech entrepreneur Ingrid Riley believes it's high time the Caribbean's bloggers emerged into the sunlight and made their voices heard in the online world.
swa: Mjasiriamali wa teknolojia wa ki-Jamaika Ingrid Riley anaamini ni wakati muafaka kwa wanablogu wa eneo la Caribiani kuzama kwenye eneo hilo na kupaza sauti zao kwenye ulimwengu wa mtandaoni.

eng: She and her award-winning Caribbean tech media and events brand SiliconCaribe are launching Caribbean Bloggers Week 2016 (#CBW2016) from December 5-10, 2016.
swa: Yeye na kampuni yake maarufu iliyowahi kupata tuzo inayojishughulisha na teknolojia ya habari na kuratibu matukio kwenye eneo la Caribiani SiliconCaribe wanaanzisha Wiki ya Wanablogu wa Caribiani 2016 (#CBW2016) kuanzia Desemba 5-10, 2016.

eng: The theme of the first CBW is "The Power of Digital Influence," and the main goal is to provide an outlet for Caribbean bloggers and bloggers of Caribbean descent to be recognized.
swa: Mada katika tukio hilo la kwanza ni "Nguvu ya Ushawishi wa Mtandaoni ," na lengo kuu ni kutengeneza jukwaa kwa ajili ya kuwatambua wanablogu wa Caribiani na wanablogu wenye asili ya eneo hilo.

eng: They are out there, and they do have voices.
swa: Wafahamike kuwa nao wapo, na wana zo sauti.

eng: SiliconCaribe Editor-in-Chief and founder of Caribbean Bloggers Week Ingrid Riley.
swa: Mhariri Mtendaji wa SiliconCaribe na wanzilishi wa Wiki ya Wanablogu wa Caribiani Ingrid Riley.

eng: (Screenshot from SiliconCaribe.com)
swa: (Picha kutoka tovuti ya SiliconCaribe.com)

eng: Ninety per cent of the action will be online, where emerging and professional digital influencers will be profiled and interviewed.
swa: Asilimia sitini ya harakati hizo zitafanyika mtandaoni, ambako wanablogu chipukizi, wataalam wa kidijitali na wenye nguvu ya ushawishi watatangazwa wasifu wao na kufanyiwa mahojiano.

eng: The week-long event will also organize blogger meetups hosted by bloggers of Caribbean descent.
swa: Tukio hilo la wiki nzima zitaratibu mikutano ya wanablogu itakayoandaliwa na wanablogu wenye asili ya Caribiani.

eng: Odessa Chambers, owner of the lifestyle and entertainment blog oaccessjamaica.com will host the meetup in Kingston, Jamaica.
swa: Odessa Chambers, mmiliki wa blogu ya mitindo ya maisha na burudani accessjamaica.com ataandaa mkutano jijini Kingston, Jamaica.

eng: Port of Spain's Mel Gabriel, who is a writer, editor and owner of CaribbeanLookBook.com, will be the Trinidadian host.
swa: Mel Gabriel, anayetoka Visiwa vya Port of Spain ambaye ni mwandishi, mhariri na mmiliki wa blogu ya CaribbeanLookBook.com, atakuwa ni mwenyeji mwenye asili ya Trinidadi.

eng: The New York meetup will be hosted by Mikelah Rose, founder of StyleandVibes.com.
swa: Mkutano wa New York meetup utaandaliwa na Mikelah Rose, mwanzilishi wa StyleandVibes.com.

eng: In London, the meetup host will be Ursula Barzey, founder of the Caribbean travel and luxury blog CaribbeanandCo.com.
swa: Jijini London, mkutano utaandaliwa na Ursula Barzey, mwanzilishi wa blogu ya safari za Caribiani na starehe CaribbeanandCo.com.

eng: The CBW might just be the ideal opportunity for Caribbean writers and commentators to step out of the shadows of their Facebook threads, hashtags and retweets, and start making a greater impact in the global online dialogue.
swa: Tukio hilo la Wiki ya Wanablogu wa Caribiani ni fursa nzuri kwa waandishi na wachambuzi wa ki-Caribia kutengeneza habari za Facebook, alama ishara za Twita na hata kusambazwa kwa twiti zao, na hivyo kuanza kuleta tofauti kwenye mijadala ya kimataifa mtandaoni.

eng: ‘Why Can’t I Kiss My Girlfriend in Public?’
swa: ‘Kwa nini Siwezi Kumbusu Mpenzi wangu wa Kike Hadharani?’

eng: Photo: Anna Nikoghosyan for OC Media.
swa: Picha: Anna Nikoghosyan kwa ajili ya OC Media.

eng: All photos used with permission.
swa: Picha zote zimetumiwa kwa ruhusa.

eng: The following is a version of a partner post written by Anna Nikoghosyan that first appeared on the website OC Media.
swa: Lifuatalo ni toleo la makala ya ubia iliyoandikwa na Anna Nikoghosyan na kuchapishwa kwa mara ya kwanza kwenye tovuti ya OC Media.

eng: I was 19-years-old when I met a lesbian girl who liked me.
swa: Nilikuwa na umri wa miaka 19 ndipo nilipokutana na msichana msagaji aliyetokea kunipenda.

eng: I told her I was not one of “them”, but suddenly, for no reason, I kissed her.
swa: Nilimueleza kuwa sikuwa miongoni "mwao" lakini, bila kutarajia, nilimbusu.

eng: It was with her that I first realised what love is.
swa: Nilikuwa naye na hapo ndipo kwa mara ya kwanza nikafahamu nini maana ya upendo.

eng: Eva (not her real name), 24, is a queer woman living in Yerevan.
swa: Eva (ambalo si jina lake halisi), mwenye miaka 24, ni mwanamke msagaji anayeishi Yerevan.

eng: She went through many stages while discovering her sexuality.
swa: Alipitia hatua nyingi katika kutambua jinsia yake.

eng: At first, it was classical self-identification as a heterosexual woman, which then transformed into a bisexual identity.
swa: Kwanza, ilikuwa ni jambo la kawaida sana kujitambulisha kama mwanamke wa kupenda kufanya ngono na mtu wa jinsia tofauti na yake, ambapo, hata hivyonayo baadae alijiweka kwenye kundi la mwanamke wa kupenda ngono ya jinsia zote mbili.

eng: Having realised her affection towards transgender individuals, she then thought that she was pansexual.
swa: Alipogundua mahaba yake kuwa yalikuwa kwa watu wasioweza kuitambulisha jinsia zao, hapo alijiona kuwa kumbe alikuwa mwanamke asiyekuwa na jinsia mahususi.

eng: Now she does not want to associate herself with a distinct sexual category or search for a label for her sexuality.
swa: Kwa sasa, hapendelei tena kujihusisha na aina yoyote ya jinsia au kutafuta namna yoyote ya kuelezea jinsia yake.

eng: I am just a person who loves another person; I am queer, she says.
swa: Mimi ni mtu ninayempenda mtu mwingine; Mimi ni basha, anasema.

eng: Parandzem and Taguhi.
swa: Parandzem na Taguhi.

eng: Photo: Anna Nikoghosyan for OC Media
swa: Pich: Anna Nikoghosyan kwa ajili ya OC Media

eng: On the façade of an old building in downtown Yerevan, there is some graffiti that reads, ‘Parandzem and Taguhi were having sex the whole night’.
swa: Kwenye uso wa jengo kuu lililopo katikati ya jiji la Yerevan, kuna mchoro unaosomeka, ‘Parandzem na Taguhi wamekuwa wakifanya mapenzi usiku kucha’.

eng: This spot of graffiti feminising the male-centric public space of the city is actually a defiant take on well-known advertising slogan from bygone times: 'Parandzem and Taguhi were cooking pasta the whole night'.
swa: Michoro huu unaohamasisha nafasi ya mwanamke katika eneo la jiji linalotawaliwa zaidi na wanaume, kimsingi ni utaratibu wa kinguvu unaojulikana sana wa kueneza msemo toka enzi za kale toka enzi za kale: 'Parandzem na Taguhi wamekuwa wakipika tambi usiku kucha'.

eng: This really influences people, Eva says, without specifying who daubed the graffiti.
swa: Kwa hakika, hii inawahamasisha watu, Eva anasema,lakini bila ya kuweka bayana ni nani aliyeandika maneno haya.

eng: Queer people are one of the most marginalised and discriminated groups in Armenia.
swa: Mabasha ni miongoni mwa makundi ya watu wanaotengwa sana na kunyanyaswa nchini Armenia.

eng: A 2016 research paper entitled ‘Hate Crimes and other Hate-Motivated Incidents against LGBT People in Armenia’ found that of 200 queer people interviewed for the study, 198 had been the victim of or witness to hate crimes or other hate motivated incidents.
swa: Utafiti wa mwaka 2016 uliokuwa na kichwa cha habari ‘ Jinai za Chuki na Matukio mengine yanayoshadiwa na chuki thidi ya watu wa LGBT nchini Armenia’ uligundua kuwa kati ya watu 200 mabasha waliohojiwa kwenye utafiti huo, 198 walikuwa wahanga au walishuhudia makosa ya jinai yaliyosababishwa na chuki au matukio ya makosa mengine yaliyochochewa na chuki.

eng: Recognising the need to stop violence and prejudice against queer people, more and more activists and human rights defenders in Armenia have started to push for the protection of queer rights, for equality, and to end discrimination.
swa: Kwea kutambua umuhimu wa kusitisha machafuko na chuki dhidi ya mabasha, wanaharakati lukuki na waangalizi wa haki za binadamu nchini Armenia wameanzish harakati za kulinda haki za mabasha, usawa pamoja na kukomesha unyanyasaji.

eng: However, within the queer rights discourse, the voices of lesbian, bisexual, and trans women remain marginal.
swa: Hata hivyo, wakati harakati za kutafuta haki za mabasha zikiendelea, sauti za wasagaji, watu wanaovutiwa na jinsia zote na wanawake na wanawake walio na tabia za kiume bado hazijasikiwa vya kutosha.

eng: As in generally all women’s experiences, LBT women’s stories remain invisible, Eva says.
swa: Kwa ujumla, kwa namna hali wanayoishuhudia wanawake walio wengi, simulizi za wanawake wa LBT bado hazijawekwa bayana, Eva anasema.

eng: According to her, in a society where all women face barriers speaking about their issues, it is even more difficult for women with a non-heteronormative sexuality to speak out.
swa: Kwa maoni yake, katika jamii ambayo karibu wanawake wote wanakabiliana na vikwazo katika kusemea mambo yao, ni vigumu hata wa wanawake walio na mtazamo wa kuvutiwa na watu wa jinsia tofauti na wao kujadili hali zao.

eng: We do everything in secret
swa: Kila kitu tunakifanya kwa usiri

eng: Queer women in Armenia thus face a multi-layered oppression that targets their gender and sexual self-expression simultaneously.
swa: Wanawake mabasha nchini Armenia, kwa wakati mmoja wanakabiliana na ukandamizaji wa kila namna unaolenga jinsia na utambulisho wao wa kijinsia.

eng: Since there are a lack of opportunities to freely expose their problems, queer women are psychologically vulnerable and are often unable to share their emotions with the outside world.
swa: Kwa kuwa hakuna bahati ya kupata fursa ya kuelezea changamoto zao, wanawake mabasha wana hatari kubwa ya kuathirika kisaikolojia na pia pia kushindwa kuweka bayana hisia zao kwa jamii.

eng: These pressures sometimes manifests themselves in depression or panic attacks.
swa: Mashinikizo kama haya wakati mwingine hupelekea hali ya kufadhaika na kuingiwa na kukumbwa na hofu kubwa.

eng: We do everything in secret. 	Tunafanya kila kitu kwa usiri.
There are small communities where I can feel safe, but at home, among other friends and relatives, I can’t be who I am," says Eva.
swa: Kuna sehemu ndogo sana ya jamii ambazo ninaweza kujisikia mwenye amani, lakini niwapo nyumbani, na miongoni mwa marafiki na ndugu zangu, siwezi kuonesha uhalisia wangu" anasema Eva.

eng: Isolation and emotional problems are only one example of the challenges faced by queer women in Armenia.
swa: Kutengwa pamoja na matatizo ya kihisia ni moja ya changamoto wanazokabiliana nazo wanawake mabasha nchini Armenia.

eng: Eva says that if a queer person's sexuality is revealed, that person can sometimes be subjected to “corrective rape” as heterosexual men look to assert their definition of what is 'normal' on the victim.
swa: Eva anasema kuwa ikiwa haiba ya ujinsia wa basha itawekwa bayana, mtu wa namna hiyo anaweza kukabiliana na "jaribio la kuhitajika kimapenzi na mtu wa jinsia tofauti" pale wanaume wa mapenzi ya jinsia tofauti wanapojaribu kuonesha "uhalisia" wao kwa mhanga.

eng: The police won’t help
swa: Polisi hawezi kuwa na msaada

eng: The security risks faced by queer women are still very real in the country.
swa: Hatari za kiusalama dhidi ya wanawake mabasha ni jambo la kawaida sana nchini Armenia.

eng: Eva tells of how often, after leaving a pub or a café, or simply while walking down the street with her girlfriend, that she is followed by men.
swa: Eva anaelezea ni kwa kiasi gani, mara baada ya kutoka kumbi za starehe au mgahawani, au pale anapotembea mtaani akiwa na mpenzi wake wa kike, amekuwa akifuatwa na wanaume mara kwa mara.

eng: I get really scared because I don’t know what could happen to me. 	Huwa ninaogopa sana kwani sifahamu ni jambo ganni linaweza kunikuta.
The guy is in a car, physically stronger than I am.
swa: Mwanaume yupo ndani ya gari, na akiwa na nguvu kuliko mimi.

eng: He can do whatever he wants and nobody will care."
swa: Anaweza kufanya lolote atakalo bila hata ya mtu yeyote kujali."

eng: Eva does not believe that the police would help her because even if she goes to them to seek protection, the police will laugh at her sexuality and ask questions that make her feel uncomfortable.
swa: Eva haamini kama polisi wanaweza kumsaidia kwani hata akienda kwao kwa ajili ya kuhitaji ulinzi, polisi watamdhihaki kwa sababu ya utambulisho wake wa kijinsia na pia kuumuliza maswali ambayo yatamfanya asijisikie vizuri.

eng: That has happened to her lesbian friends many times, she says.
swa: Hili limetokea mara nyingi sana kwa marafiki zake wasagaji, anasema Eva.

eng: Once, Eva and her transgender friend were attacked in a park by men, who started to beat and curse them.
swa: Kuna wakati Eva na rafiki yake wa kike walishambuliwa na wanaume wakiwa sehemu ya mapumziko, ambapo watu hao waliwapiga na kuwatukana.

eng: Other men in the area, instead of trying to stop the perpetrators, approached and demanded they stop cursing as there were other women in the park.
swa: Wanaume wengine waliokuwepo eneo la tukio, badala ya kusaidia kuwazuia wahalifu hao, wao walishinikiza akina Eva kuacha kufanya laana kwani katika eneo lile walikuwepo pia wanawake kama wao.

eng: So it was totally fine that they were beating us, but they had to do it in silence, exactly the way they beat women in their homes, says Eva.
swa: Kwa hiyo, ilikuwa sawa kabisa kwa wao kutupiga, hata ivyo, walipaswa kufanya hivyo kimya kimya, sawasawa kabisa na namna wanavyowapiga wanawake wao majumbani anasema Eva.

eng: ‘You need to try it with a man to know what real sex is’
swa: ‘Unapaswa kujaribu na mwanaume ili ufahamu mapenzi ya kweli ni yapi’

eng: While there is widespread violence and aggression against queer women, lesbian relationships are also not considered to be serious.
swa: Wakati bado kukiwa na mwendelezo wa vitisho na ukatili dhidi ya wanawake mabasha, uhusiano wa wanawake wasagaji bado pia haujatiliwa maanani.

eng: Statements such as, ‘she is a lesbian because she hasn’t met a real guy yet’ and ‘you need to try it with a man to know what 'real sex' is’ are commonplace.
swa: Matamko kama vile "yeye ni msagaji kwa kuwa bado hajampata mwanaume wa kweli" na "unapaswa kujaribu mapenzi na mwanaume ili ufahamu 'mapenzi ya kweli' ni yapi' yamekuwa mambo ya kawaida kabisa.

eng: Lesbian women are often objectified by men.
swa: Wanawake wasagaji wanaonekana kama vitu kwa wanaume.

eng: For many, a lesbian is a sexy woman from a porn movie who is there to serve as an object for men’s gazes, and to fulfil a heterosexual man’s craving.
swa: Kwa walio wengi, msagaji ni mwanamke wa mapenzi kutoka kwenye video za mapenzi aliyepo kwa ajili ya wanaume kujichagulia na kutmiza matakwa yao ya kimapenzi.

eng: There were many times when they approached me and my girlfriend to suggest that we have sex with them. 	Mara nyingi wanaumee walikuwa wakinijia mimi na rafiki yangu wa kike na kutuomba tufanye nao mapenzi.
When we would refuse, they would ask if we could at least have sex in front of them," Eva says.
swa: Pale tulipowakatalia, waliomba ikiwa angalao tungeweza kufanya mapenzi mbele yao," anasema Eva.

eng: Family pressures
swa: Mashinikizo kutoka kwenye Familia

eng: The pressure felt by queer women in Armenia does not come only from the outside world.
swa: Changamoto wanazokabiliana nazo wanawake mabasha nchini Armenia hazitokani tu na jamii inayowazunguka.

eng: According to research carried out by Pink Armenia and Socioscope, queer people are very often subjected to different types of violence by their family members, in an attempt to change their ‘incorrect’ sexual orientation or gender identity.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa utafiti uliofanywa na Pink Armenia na Socioscope, mabasha mara kwa mara wamekuwa wakikabiliwa unyanyaswaji wa aina tofauti tofauti kutoka kwenye familia zao kama namna ya kuwaanya waachane na utambulisho "usio sahihi" wa jinsia zao.

eng: Eva’s parents do not know about her sexuality.
swa: Wazazi wa Eva hawafahamu kuhusu hali ya jinsia ya mtoto wao.

eng: However, according to her, she feels lucky, because there is no hatred in her family against any group.
swa: Hata hivyo, kwa mujibu wake, anajisikia mwenye bahati, kwani hakuna chuki yoyote katika familia yake dhidi ya kundi lolote.

eng: Many of my LGBT friends come to our apartment. 	Wengi wa marafiki wangu wa LGBT wanakuja katika nyumba yetu.
Even my trans friends come.
swa: Hata wapenzi wangu wa kike wanakuja.

eng: We all drink coffee with my mum.
swa: Sote tunakunywa kahawa na mama yangu.

eng: She’s really chill with them."
swa: Kwa kweli anawafurahia sana."

eng: Once, Eva’s mother asked her if she was a lesbian.
swa: Kuna wakati mama yake Eva alimuuliza ikiwa Eva alikuwa msagaji.

eng: Eva was not ready to come out to her mother, so she lied to her.
swa: Hata hivyo, Eva hakuwa tayari kumwambia ukweli mama yake na kwa hivyo, alimdanganya.

eng: She regretted this afterwards, since coming out became much harder.
swa: Baadae alijuta sana kwa uamuzi wake, kwani kutoka kwake ilimuwia vigumu sana.

eng: Notwithstanding the relative tolerance of her family, Eva still experiences some psychological pressure from her relatives.
swa: Pamoja na uvumilivu kutoka kwa ndugu wa familia yake, Eva bado anakabiliana na changamoto ya kisaikolojia kutoka kw ndugu zake.

eng: To her grandmother, Eva is already an ‘old maid’.
swa: Bibi yake Eva anamuona Eva kuwa ni mwanamke aliyekosa mume.

eng: Once, when Eva’s mother asked her why she does not get married, Eva asked her in return why she does not do the same.
swa: Kuna wakati mama yake Eva alimuuliza ni kwa nini haolewi, Eva naye alimuuliza mama yake swali kama hilo.

eng: I said, 'I don’t ask you to have a baby so that I have a sister, do I? Then why do you tell me you want a grandchild and a son-in-law?' 	Nilisema, 'sikuombi uwe na mtoto ili nimpate mdogo wangu, ninafanya hivyo? kwa nini basi nawe unanilazimisha nikuzalie mjukuu na niwe na mume?
After this, they never had any conversations like that again."
swa: Baada ya majibzano haya, hawakuwahi tena kuwa na maongezi ya namna hii na mimi."

eng: What is wrong with kissing a beloved in public?
swa: Kuna kosa gani kumbusu hadharani umpendaye?

eng: On other occasions, Eva is not afraid to talk freely about her sexual orientation, however.
swa: Kwa upande mwingine, Eva haogopi kuweka bayana kuhusu uhalisia wa jinsia yake.

eng: Once, some of her old friends were talking about queer people with hate speech, saying that they needed to be burned or killed.
swa: Hata pale ma rafiki zake wa zamani wanapowazungumzia mabasha kama namna ya chuki kwa kusema kuwa wanapaswa kuchomwa moto na kuuawa.

eng: Eva said her remarks made her friends rethink their abusive behaviour and ignorance.
swa: Eva alisema kuwa kauli yake iliwafanya marafiki zake watafakari upya kuhusu tabia yao ya kuddhalilisha na ujinga walio nao.

eng: For Eva’s partner, who comes from abroad, the way people look at her and her girlfriend when they walk together is very strange.
swa: Kwa upande wa rafiki yake na Eva, ambaye anatokea nchi nyingine, namna watu wanavyomtazama yeye na mpenzi wake wa kike pale wanapotoka pamoja, ni jambo linalomshangaza.

eng: Every time they’re at a bus station, Eva’s girlfriend comes closer to kiss her before entering the bus.
swa: Kila mara wanapokuwa kwenye kituo cha basi, mpenz wa Eva humsogelea na kumbusu kabla hawajaingia kwenye basi.

eng: But Eva feels compelled to resist, at the same time wondering what is wrong about kissing her beloved in public.
swa: Hata hivyo, Eva hujisikia kukataa, lakini kwa upande mwingine anajiuliza kuna kosa gani kumbusu hadharani mpenzi wake.

eng: Eva believes that she would never face such challenges were she in a heterosexual relationship.
swa: Eva anaamini kwamba hasingekabiliana na changamoto kama hivi kama angekuwa kwenye uhusiano wa jinsia tofauti.

eng: She recalls her earlier years of adulthood, when she was with a young man.
swa: Anakumbushia enzi za miaka ya mwanzo ya ujana wake, pale alipokuwa kwenye mahusiano na mvulana mdogo.

eng: We could walk freely, hold hands, nobody would pay attention.
swa:
Tuliweza kutembea kwa uhuru, tukiwa tueshikana mikono, na hakuna hata mmoja aliyetufuatilia.
However, in a same-sex relationship, she says, life becomes full of fear and lies; a double life where everything requires overthinking. 	Kinyeme chake, kwenye mahusiano ya jinsia moja, anasema Eva, maisha yamekuwa ya hofu na kudanganya kwingi; maisha yasiyoeleweka ambayo kila mara yanahitaji kufikiri kupita kiasi.
‘I am in love, and I want to be able to talk about this’ 	‘Nipo kwenye mahusiano ya kimapenzi, na ninahitaji kuwa na uwezo wa kulisemea hili’
I don’t know why I need to lie to my mother. I have a person whom I love, I have tender feelings towards her, what could be better than this?
column3:
Sijui ni kwa nini ninalazimika kumdanganya mama yangu.Nina mtu ninayempenda, nina mapenzi ya dhati kabisa kwake, kua jambo gani litakalozidi hili?
I am in love, and I want to be able to talk about this with others. 	Nipo kwenye mahusiano ya kimapenzi na ninahitaji kuweza kuongea na watu wengine kuhusu hili.
We live a happy life together, we walk, we go to cafés, we dance, we smoke. 	Tunaishi maisha ya upendo baina yetu, tunatoka pamoja, tunakwenda mighawani, tunacheza, na tunavuta sigara pamoja.
Isn’t this beautiful?	Hivi kwani haya siyo mambo mazuri?
People should be happy for us, shouldn’t they? 	Watu wanapaswa kutuheshimu, au siyo?
But no, nobody’s happy; people just want to kill us, Eva says, her voice beginning to tremble.
column4: Lakini hapana, hakuna aliye na furaha; watu wanachotaka kufanya ni kutaka kutuua tu" Anasema Eva huku sauti yake ikianza kuwa iliyojawa na hofu.

eng: Eva often thinks about moving.
swa: Kila mara Eva anafikiria kuihama nchi yake.

eng: Locally conducted research shows that in 2011–2013 alone, almost 6,000 Armenian citizens left the country due to some form of discrimination.
swa: Utafiti uliofanywa nchini humo unaonesha kuwa kwa mwaka 2011–2013 pekee, takribani raia 6,000 wa Armenia walisafiri nje ya nchi yao kutokana na aina fulani ya unyanyaswaji.

eng: A non-accepting society can take a tremendous toll on a person's mental health .
swa: Jamii ya watu wasioweza kuwachukulia wengine inaweza kuwwa sababu kuu ya kumuathiri mtu mwingine isaikolojia.

eng: Even seeking consultations from a psychologist is an issue, as psychologists who are queer-friendly and are aware of queer people’s specific challenges are the exception.
swa: Hata kupata msaada kutoka kwa wataalamu wa saikolojia ni jambo gumu, kwani wanasaikolojia wanaowatazama mabasha kwa hali ya uchanya na walio uelelewa wa changamoto za mabasha wenye mahitaji tofauti ni wa nadra sana.

eng: I now have a real struggle inside myself. 	Nnatambua kuwa ninazo harakati halisi sana ndani mwangu.
Should I stay here and try to change our society, or, as I only have one life, should I go to a safer place and have a happier future?"
swa: Pengine ninapaswa niendelee kuwepo hapana kujaribu kuibadilisha jamii yangu au kwa kuwa nina nafasi moja tu ya kuishi, niende mahali salama ili niwe na maisha ya kesho yaliyo ya furaha?"

eng: Homophobia: a political tool in a country at war
swa: Homofobia: Kifaa cha kisiasa kilicho vitani

eng: Photo: Anna Nikoghosyan for OC Media
swa: Pich: Anna Nikoghosyan kwa ajili ya OC Media

eng: Eva believes that homophobia has recently become trendy in Armenia, a heavily militarised country that lives in constant fear of full blown war with neighbouring Azerbaijan.
swa: Eva anaamini kwamba unyanyasaji dhidi ya watu wa mapenzi ya jinsia hvi karibuni imekuwa ni jambo lilishika kasi sana nchini Armenia, nchi iliyo ya kijeshi inayoongozwa na hofu ya wakati wote ya kuingia vitani na jirani yake Azerbaijan.

eng: Even those who do not necessarily have a problem with queer people express hateful, homophobic attitudes just because it is popular to do so.
swa: Hata wale ambao katika hali ya kawaida hawakupaswa kuwa na tatizo na mabasha wanaonesha chuki, mtazamo ya ubaguzi dhidi ya watu wajinsia moja kwa kuwa tu ni jambo la kawaida kufanya hivyo.

eng: Moreover, queer people quite often become a target in political games.
swa: Zaidi, mabasha mara kwa mara wamejikuta wakiwa wahanga kwenye michezo ya kisiasa.

eng: Whenever domestic politics in the economically depressed country threatens to boil over, articles on queer topics suddenly become widespread, and people shift their attention from the controversies of government to the ‘preservation of Armenian values and traditions’.
swa: Pale siasa za ndani zinapokuwa kwenye mnyukano mkali, katika nchi inayozidi kudidimia kiuchumi, katika hali isiyotarajiwa makala kuhusu mabasha zinaanza kujitokeza kwa wingi na kisha watu wanahamisha mjadala kutoka kwenye mikwamo ya serikali hadi kwenye 'kulinda tunu na tamaduni za raia wa Armenia’.

eng: Among possible examples of this are the arson attack on a queer friendly pub two days after the disputed parliamentary elections in 2012, and the ‘anti-gender’ movement in 2013, that emerged as Armenia was choosing between an Association Agreement with the EU and joining the Russian led Eurasian Economic Union.
swa: Miongoni mwa mifano iliypo ya hili ni shambulio la arson kwenye ukumbi rafiki kwa mabasha siku mbili mara baada ya kumalizika kwa uchaguzi mkuu wa mwaka 2012 na harakati dhidi ya 'utambulisho wa jinsia" mwaka 2013, mambo yaliyoibuka pale Armenia ilipokuwa na mcchakato wa kuchagua kati ya kuingia makubaliano ya ushirika na Umoja wa Ulaya na kujinga na Umoja wa Kiuchumi wa Eurasia unaoongozwa na Urusi.

eng: Queer people in Armenia are thus politically constructed by the media as ‘enemies’.
swa: Kwa maana hii, mabasha nchini Armenia wanachorwa kama 'maadaui' na vyombo vvya habari vya nchini humo.

eng: Queer women are particularly targeted.
swa: Katika mazingira haya, wanawake mabasha ndio haswa wanaolengwa.

eng: Eva thinks that in small states on a war footing, like Armenia, where people's lives are absorbed by the struggle for survival, women’s rights and queer rights are not a priority.
swa: Eva anafikiri kuwa kwa nchi changa iliyo katika janga la vita, kama ilivyo kwa Armenia, ambapo maisha ya watu yanagubikwa na harakati zao za kutafuta kuishi, haki za wanawake na haki za mabasha siyo kipaumbele.

eng: If nobody has died today, everything is good, Eva says.
swa: Kama kwa leo hakuna mtu aliyepoteza maisha, kila kitu ni chema anasema Eva.

eng: Therefore, as long as Armenia is in a military conflict and is one of the most militarised countries in the world, there is little hope that anything will change for us, she surmises, lighting the last cigarette in her pack.
swa: Kwa hiyo, kwa kuwa Armenia ipo kwenye wimbi zito la vita na ni moja ya nchi iliyo na misingi ya kijeshi ulimwenguni, kuna uwezekano mdogo sana wa kupata mabadiliko tunayoyahitaji anahitimisha na kuwasha sigara yake ya mwisho iliyokuwa imesalia.

eng: Following intense campaigning from candidates Guillermo Lasso and Lenin Moreno, it was the latter who was declared the winner of the presidential run-off election in Ecuador on April 2.
swa: Kufuatia kampeni za nguvu za wagombea Guillermo Lasso na Lenin Moreno, ndiye aliyetangazwa mshindi wa kinyang'anyiro hicho cha urais nchini Ecuador hapo Aprili 2 mwaka huu.

eng: However, the opposition and Lasso's supporters are alleging fraud and calling for protests to demand a new count.
swa: Hata hivyo, upinzani na wafuasi wa Lasso wanalalamikia udanganyifu katika matokeo na wanaitisha maandamano ya kutaka kura kuhesabiwa tena.

eng: The official numbers given by the National Election Council was 51.16% for Moreno and 48.84% for Lasso.
swa: Hesabu iliyotolewa kiofisi na Tume ya Taifa ya Uchaguzi ilikuwa ni 51.16% kwa Moreno na 48.84% kwa Lasso.

eng: The days following the vote have seen a massive wave of demonstrations, documented under the hashtags #Megafraude (Mega-fraud) and #LicenciadoMoreno ("Graduate" Moreno, a common name used for someone who has a degree) to underline the fact that some people refuse to call him "president-elect":
swa: Siku zilizofuata baada ya uchaguzi limeonekana wimbi kubwa la maandamano, yakiwa na hashtagi za #Megafraude (Udanganyifu-mkuu) na #LicenciadoMoreno ("Muhitimu" Moreno, jina la kawaida analoitwa mtu mwenye shahada au digrii) kuchorea mstari ukweli kwamba watu hawataki kumuita "Rais Mteule":

eng: Some Ecuadorians citizens have gone to the streets to make their voices and their protests heard
swa: Baadhi ya wananchi wa Ecuador wameingia mitaani kuandamana ili sauti zao zisikike

eng: The campaigns exposed a strong division amongst voters, between those who essentially view ruling party candidate Lenin Moreno as continuing the socialist-inspired agenda that until recently was lead by President Rafael Correa, and those who view CREO party candidate Guillermo Lasso as representing strategic change more in line with conservative economic ideals.
swa: Kampeni hizi zimeibua mgawanyiko mkubwa baina ya wapiga kura, kati ya wale wanaomuona mgombea wa chama Tawala Lenin Moreno kama muendelezo wa ajenda ya siasa za ujamaa ambazo hadi karibuni zilikuwa zinaongozwa na Rais Rafael Correa, na hao wanaoona mgombea wa chama cha CREO Guillermo Lasso kama muwakilishi wa mikakati bora ya mabadiliko yakiambatana na uchumi wa kihafidhina.

eng: Lisette Arévalo Gross and Sol Borja, analysts from Ecuadorean media outlet GkillCity, described how the candidates fit into the context of Ecuador's confrontational political landscape, and also the fear that many Ecuadorians have regarding freedom of expression and preserving democracy.
swa: Lisette Arévalo Gross na Sol Borja, mchambuzi kutoka katika vyombo vya habari vya Ecuador; GkillCity, ameelezea jinsi kila mgombea anavyotoshea katika muktadha wa majibizano ya kisiasa na pia hofu waliyonayo wa-Ecuador wengi kuhusu uhuru wa kujieleza na kudumisha demokrasia.

eng: Regarding those who voted for Lasso, Arévalo Gross said:
swa: Kuhusu hao waliompigia kura Lasso, Arévalo Gross alisema:

eng: Many people agree with Guillermo Lasso in that Ecuador needs to be saved.
swa: Watu wengi wanakubaliana na Lasso kuwa Ecuador inahitaji kuokolewa.

eng: That's why they're going to vote for him, they support and follow him.
swa: Ndiyo maana wanaenda kumpigia kura, kumfuata na kumuunga mkono.

eng: Including those who don't support him, or follow him, but they voted for him in the first ballot for the plain and simple reason that Guillermo Lasso was the most likely to reach — indeed as he already has — a second ballot with Lenin Moreno, who's running for the government party, Alianza País.
swa: Pamoja na hao wasio muunga mkono au kumfuata, lakini walimpigia kura katika mzunguko wa kwanza kwa mtazamo wa kuwa Guillermo Lasso ni rahisi kumfikia - hakika kama ilivyokuwa katika mzunguko wa pili na Lenin Moreno anayegombea kupitia chama cha serikali, Alianza País.

eng: And with regard to Lenin Moreno, Borja highlighted:
swa: Na kuhusu Lenin Moreno, Borja alidokeza:

eng: Has been portrayed as the friendly face of a political phenomenon lead by a volatile, intolerant and impulsive character The notion that Moreno is a patriot is reiterated by his supporters and refined by his campaign team.
swa: Amekuwa akioneshwa kwa uso wa kisiasa wenye urafiki unaoongozwa kwa utata, kutokuvumiliana na tabia zisizovumilika. Kauli kwamba Moreno ni mzalendo zinaelezwa na wafuasi wake na kupendezeshwa na timu yake ya kampeni.

eng: There's an impenetrable wall that makes it difficult to get to him and see him outside of this heroic image that his advisers portray.
swa: Kuna ukuta usiopenyeka unaofanya iwe vigumu kumtoa nje ya picha ya kishujaa inayotengenezwa na washauri wake.

eng: Others consider Lasso to be too conservative to appeal to the political centre's vote, which could have changed the outcome.
swa: Wengine wanamuona Lasso kama Muhafidhina sana kiasi cha kutokuweza kupenya hadi kwenye kitovu cha siasa na kupata kura, ambazo zingebadilisha matokeo.

eng: Lasso didn't want to please anybody...
swa: Lasso hakutaka kumfurahisha yeyote...

eng: As a society we should be unyielding against the most corrupt government in history...
swa: Kama jamii tusingekuwa wazito dhidi ya serikali ya wala rushwa katika historia...

eng: Voting day was full of setbacks.
swa: Siku ya kupiga kura kulikuwa na vikwazo vingi.

eng: Complaints about polling stations circulated on social media, and organisations such as Usuarios Digitales (Digital Users), which follows citizen trends across online media, were accused of foul play for sharing information that could be inconvenient for candidates close to the government.
swa: Malalamiko juu ya vituo vya kupigia kura yalizunguka katika mitandao ya kijamii na mashirika kama vile Usuarios Digitales (Watumiaji wa kidigitali), ambayo yalifuata mwenendo wa wananchi mtandaoni, walilaumiwa kwa kucheza mchezo mchafu kwa kutoa taarifa ambazo hazikuwa nzuri kwa wagombea ambao walikuwa karibu na serikali.

eng: #DigitalAlertEC: Web page for election monitoring from CREO political party is currently offline.
swa: #KiashiriochaKidigitaliEC: Tovuti kwa ajili ya kufuatilia uchaguzi kutoka chama cha siasa cha CREO kwa sasa imezimwa.

swa: Huenda kuna shambulio la DDoS

eng: There were comparisons made to other political situations in the Latin American region.
swa: Kuna mlinganisho uliofanywa kwa hali za kisiasa za maeneo mengine ya ukanda wa Ulatini ya Amerika.

eng: For many, the rise of Moreno to power is a continuation of agendas similar to the political and economic strategies seen in Venezuela, which has been at the centre of intense debate due to its political and economic crisis.
swa: Kwa wengi, kuibuka kwa Moreno ni muendelezo wa ajenda sawa na mikakati ya kisiasa na uchumi ilivyoonekana huko Venezuela, ambayo imekuwa katikati ya malumbano makali kutokana na mgogoro wake wa kisiasa na kiuchumi.

eng: I hope what happened in Vzla is an example for Ecuador, that the vote will be a resounding NO to socialist dictatorship in the 21st century #EcuadorChooses2017
swa: Ninatumaini kuwa kilichotokea Venezuela ni mfano kwa Ecuador, kwamba kura itakuwa ni mrudio wa HAPANA kwa Ujamaa wa Kidikteta katika karne ya 21 #EcuadorImechagua2017

eng: Similarly, allegations of fraud evoked accusations made during Venezuela's 2013 elections between Nicolás Maduro, the current president of Venezuela, and Henrique Capriles, his most important opponent:
swa: Vilevile, madai haya ya udanganyifu yalirudisha mashitaka yaliyofanywa wakati wa Venezuela's 2013 uchaguzi baina ya Nicolás Maduro, Rais wa sasa wa Venezuela na Henrique Capriles, mpinzani wake muhimu:

eng: The same thing that happened in Venezuela in April 2013 is happening now in Ecuador.
swa: Kitu kile kile kilichotokea Venezuela Aprili 2013 ndicho kinachotokea Ecuador kwa sasa.

eng: Capriles won and then National Election Council proclaimed Maduro with 1% lead.
swa: Capriles alishinda lakini Tume ya Taifa ya Uchaguzi ikatangaza kuwa Maduro aliongoza kwa asilimia 1 %.

eng: Fraud
swa: Udanganyifu

eng: They're doing the same to #GuillermoLasso in Ecuador as they did to Capriles in #Venezuela.
swa: Hapa Ecuador wanachofanya kwa #GuillermoLasso ni kama alivyofanyiwa Capriles huko #Venezuela.

eng: No to FRAUD! #LassoPresident
swa: Hapana kwa UDANGINYIFU! #LassoRais

swa: Lasso alitangaza kuwa ataitisha kura zihesabiwe upya na atakubaliana na matokeo hata kama atakuwa ameshindwa "kwa kura moja".

eng: In light of the country's unmistakable division, some concluded:
swa: Katika kuangalia mgawanyiko wa nchi pasi na makosa, wengine walihitimisha hivi:

eng: Dividing the country into two irreconciliable parts with a 50% split : Rafael Correa Delgado's greatest achievement.
swa: Kugawanya nchi katika pande mbili zisizopatana kwa 50% : Hayo ndiyo mafanikio makubwa ya Rafael Correa Delgado.

eng: Just what we needed in a political and economic crisis, a president whose electoral legitimacy is called into question.
swa: Hiki ndicho tulichokuwa tunahitaji katika mgogoro wa kisiasa na kiuchumi, Rais ambaye uhalali wa kuchaguliwa kwake una walakini.

eng: Keep it up!
swa: Shikilieni hapo hapo!

eng: Beyond allegations of fraud or the notion of a political party increasing in power, the concerns and tensions over corruption and limitations to freedom of expression continue.
swa: Zaidi ya malalamiko ya udanganyifu au msemo wa kuongezeka kwa mamlaka ya chama cha siasa, wasiwasi na mvutano juu ya rushwa vikwazo dhidi ya uhuru wa kujieleza vinaendelea.

swa: Wahamiaji wenye Ufahamu ni kampeni katika vyombo vya habari iliyo na lengo la kuwahabarisha wahamiaji kutoka nchi 15 za Kiafrika kuhusu hatari za kuhama kupitia jangwa la Sahara, Libya na bahari ya Mediterrania .

eng: For years, thousands of migrants and refugees from Africa and Middle East have been trying to cross the Mediterranean into Europe to escape poverty and political persecution.
swa: Kwa miaka kadhaa, maelfu ya wahamiaji na wakimbizi kutoka barani Afrika na Mashariki ya Kati wamekuwa wakijaribu kuvuka bahari ya Mediterrania kwenda Ulaya kuepuka umasikini na mashitaka ya kisiasa.

eng: The project is organised by the International Organization for Migration (IOM), with the technical and creative support of Horace communication agency, and financed by the Italian Ministry of Interior, Department of Civil Liberties and Immigration.
swa: Huu mradi uliandaliwa na Shirika la Kimataifa la Uhamiaji (IOM), kwa msaada wa ubunifu na ufundi kutoka kwa Horace kampuni ya mawasiliano, na kufadhiliwa na Wizara ya Mambo ya Ndani ya Italia, Idara ya Uhuru wa Wananchi na Uhamiaji.

eng: IOM reported last March 10, 2017 that 19,567 migrants arrived by sea to Italy but 521 have died at sea, which is 50 more compared to the same period in 2016.
swa: Machi 10, 2017 iliripoti kuwa wahamiaji wapatao 19,567 waliwasili Italia kwa njia ya bahari lakini 521 walikufa baharini ambapo ni 50 zaidi ukilinganisha na kipindi kama hicho kwa mwaka 2016.

eng: Majority of the migrants were from Ivory Coast, Nigeria, Guinea, Senegal and Gambia.
swa: Wengi wa wahamiaji walikuwa wanatokea Ivory Coast, Naijeria, Guinea, Senegal na Gambia.

eng: Many are unaware of the dangers and risks of migrating with the assistance of smugglers, not only at sea or in the desert, but also in transit countries like Libya.
swa: Wengi hawakuwa na ufahamu juu ya hatari za kuhama kwa msaada wa wasafirishaji haramu, sio kwa baharini au jangwani pekee, lakini pia katika nchi walizopita kama vile Libya.

eng: Recalling the life-threatening risks along their journey is often very distressing and in many instances, most migrants wish to forget and move forward with their lives and therefore tend not to share their experience with peers who are still back home.
swa: Wakikumbuka hatari dhidi ya maisha katika safari yao huwa inawasononesha sana na mara nyingi hutamani kusahau na kusonga mbele na maisha yao na hivyo wengi huwa hawapendi kushirikisha uzoefu na wenzao walio bado nyumbani.

eng: It's April Fool's Day—"Day of Laughter" in the Russian-speaking world—and the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) has seized the opportunity to indulge in some geopolitical satire, delighting in the attention Russia has drawn for interfering in the 2016 American presidential election.
swa: Tarehe 1 Aprili, siku ya wajinga duniani —"ni siku ya kucheka" kwa utamaduni wa jamii ya watu wa Urusi— Wizara ya Mambo ya nje ya Urusi(MFA) imetumia vyema siku hii kwa kutayarisha kichekesho cha namna Urusi inavyohusiana kisiasa na mataifa ya nje, na kwa sasa ikitumia tukio lililoifanya Urusi kufuatiliwa sana mwaka 2016 baadaa ya kuingilia mchakato wa uchaguzi Mkuu wa Marekani.

eng: The MFA posted a video of a joke Russian Embassy voicemail recording on its Facebook page this morning with the caption, "The Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs has worked out a full voicemail recording for all Russian diplomatic missions abroad."
swa: Asubuhi ya leo katika ukurasa wa Facebook wa Ubalozi wa Urusi, Wizara ya mambo ya Nje ilipakia video ya mzaha katika mfumo wa sauti yenye kichwa cha habari, "Wizara ya mambo ya Nje ya Urusi imeandaa maelezo ya sauti yanayoweka bayana mipango yote ya mahusiano ya Kimataifa."

eng: Good day! 	Uwe na siku nzuri!
You have reached the Russian Embassy.
swa: Huu ni Ubalozi wa Urusi.

eng: Your call is very important to us.
swa: Simu yako ni ya muhimu sana kwetu.

eng: To arrange a call from a Russian diplomat to your political opponent, press 1.
swa: Ili kuwasiliana na mpinzani wako wa kisiasa kutokea Ubalozi wa Urusi, bonyeza 1.

eng: To use the services of Russian hackers, press 2.
swa: Kuwatumia wataalam wa udukuzi wa Kirusi, bonyeza 2.

eng: To request election interference, press 3 and wait until the next election campaign.
swa: Ili kuvamia chaguzi, bonyeza 3 na kisha subiri hadi wakati wa kampeni.

eng: Please note that all calls are monitored for quality control and training purposes."
swa: Tafadhali, ni vizuri ukafahamu kuwa simu zote zinakaguliwa kwa ajili ya ubora wa uendeshaji na utoaji mafunzo."

eng: Marta Sam sings with a classroom of four-year-olds.
swa: Marta Sam akiimba kwenye darasa lenye watoto wenye umri wa miaka minne.

eng: Credit: Erika Beras
swa: Picha: Erika Beras

eng: Marta Sam is surrounded by really energetic 4-year-olds.
swa: Marta Sam amezungukwa na watoto wachangamfu wenye umri wa miaka minne.

eng: She’s at St. Martin’s Day Care in Erie, Pennsylvania, guiding the kids as they sing and dance.
swa: Anafanya kazi kwenye kituo cha kulea watoto kinachojulikana kama St. Martin kilicho kwenye mji wa Erie, Pennsylvania, anawasaidia watoto namna ya kuimba na kucheza.

eng: Sam sings in Arabic, then English.
swa: Sam anaweza kuimba kwa Kiarabu, na Kiingereza.

eng: She takes the students through a Congolese song, followed by "Five Little Monkeys Jumping On The Bed."
swa: Akiwaelekeza watoto kuimba wimbo wa Kikongo, kisha anawaongoza kuimba wimbo wa "Five Little Monkey Jumping on The Bed" .

eng: The kids follow her cues, dancing and calling out their favorite songs.
swa: Watoto huiga anayoyafanya huku wakicheza na kutaja majina ya baadhi ya nyimbo wazozipendelea.

eng: Sam is used to this.
swa: Ni hali ambayo Sam ameizoea .

eng: “When they see me in the classroom they say, 'Miss Marta can we do this?
swa: “Wanaponiona darasani huwa wanasema, 'Dada Marta Je, tunaweza kufanya hivi?

eng: Miss Marta can we sing this?
swa: Dada Marta Je,tunaweza kuimba wimbo huu?

eng: Miss Marta can we jump?'" she says.
swa: Dada MartaJe,tunaweza kuruka?'" na huwa nawajibu.

eng: Yeah, I will jump with them and get silly like them — working with the kids you just get down in their level and just ... mess with them.
swa: Ndiyo, Halafu nitaruka pamoja nao na kuwa kama mtoto mwenzao — ukifanya kazi na watoto huna budi kujishusha na kuwa kama wao ... fanya nao fujo.

eng: Sam, 59, is a roving educator at St. Martin's Day Care.
swa: Sam,mwenye miaka 59, ni muelimishaji anayezungukia kituo hichi maarufu cha kulelea watoto cha St. Martin.

eng: She goes from room to room and sings lullabies from all over the world with the kids.
swa: Hupitia chumba kimoja baada ya kingine akiimba nyimbo tulivu za sansuri kuwafanya watoto walale.

eng: Originally from South Sudan, she came to Erie 13 years ago as part of the first wave of thousands of refugees who have resettled in this small Rust Belt city.
swa: Asili yake ni Sudani ya Kusini, alikuja mjini Erie miaka 13 iliyopita ikiwa ni kundi la kwanza la wakimbizi waliopewa ardhi katika mji huu mdogo uitwao Rust Belt .

eng: She worked at a plastics factory and started learning English.
swa: Alifanya kazi katika kiwanda cha plastiki na akaanza kujifunza lugha ya kiingereza.

eng: Then she heard she could get job training to work in day cares.
swa: Ndipo aliposikia nafasi ya kazi katika kituo cha kulea watoto.

eng: In return she’d share the traditional songs she had sung to her children when they were young.
swa: Kwa upande mwingine angeweza kushiriki nao nyimbo za asili alizowahi kuwaimbia watoto wake wakati wakiwa bado wadogo.

eng: It was just what she needed.
swa: Hilo ndilo lilikuwa tamanio lake.

eng: “Oh, it changed my life very much. ... I’m somebody now,” she says.
swa: “Oh, kwa kweli ilibadilisha maisha yangu sana. ... na mimi sasa najisikia kuwa mtu,” anasema.

eng: Sam works at St. Martin’s because of Old Songs, New Opportunities, a program dreamed up by Kelly Armor, a folklorist and educator at the Erie Art Museum.
swa: Sam anafanya kazi katika kituo hiki cha St. Martin kwenye kipindi kiitwacho Old Songs, New Opportunities programu iliyokuwa ni ndoto ya Kelly Armor, msimuliaji na muelimishaji katika sehemu ya makumbusho ya sanaa ya Erie.

eng: Armor is from Erie, but spent time in the 1980s studying traditional song in Kenya and Tanzania.
swa: Armor amtokea mjini Erie, lakini muda mwingi kwenye miaka ya 1980 alisomea nyimbo za asili nchini Kenya na Tanzania.

eng: When she noticed refugees settling in Erie in recent years, she had an idea.
swa: Alipotambua uwepo wa wakimbizi katika sehemu hii ya Erie miaka ya karibuni, akapata wazo.

eng: “Could it be that ... there are refugee women that are, would love to work with small children?
swa: “Ya kwamba inawezekana ... wanawake hawa wakimbizi wangependa kufanya kazi na watoto wadogo?

eng: And could it be that they know lots of songs and they know how to use songs with kids?” she wondered.
swa: Na hivi Je, kuna uwezekano wanawake hawa wakawa wanajua nyimbo nyingi za asili na pia namna ya kuzitumia nyimbo hizo hasa wakiwa na watoto?” akafikiri.

eng: It turned out they did, and in some cases the songs were all they bought to the US.
swa: Ikatokea kweli wakafanya hivyo na katika mazingira fulani nyimbo zilikuwa ni kitu pekee walichoweza kuizawadia Marekani.

eng: That was the case for Victoria Angelo, who is also from South Sudan.
swa: Hiyo ilitokea kwa Victoria Angelo, ambaye pia asili yake ni Sudani ya Kusini.

eng: “I was not able to bring anything.
swa: “Sikuwa na uwezo wa kuleta chochote.

eng: No dishes, nothing, no ,” she says.
swa: Sio sahani, hakuna kitu, wala ,” anasema.

eng: “What I actually brought with me was the songs.”
swa: “Kitu pekee nilichowaletea ni nyimbo.”

eng: But in some ways the songs represented everything that was missing.
swa: Lakini pia kwa upande wa pili nyimbo ziliwakilisha kila kitu ambacho hatukuleta.

eng: “It's just expressing our feelings, our happiness, our sadness, the war going on, expressing the season, when there is heavy rain, when there is drought,” she says.
swa: “Ni katika hali ya kuonyesha hisia zetu, furaha yetu, huzuni yetu, vita inayoendelea huko tulikokimbia, kuelezea misimu, wakati wa mvua za masika , wakati wa kiangazi,” anasema.

eng: Victoria Angelo and some of the toddlers she works with.
swa: Victoria Angelo akiwa na baadhi ya watoto wanaojifunza kutembea katika sehemu yake ya kazi.

eng: Credit: Erika Beras
swa: Picha: Erika Beras

eng: Armor, the folklorist, got funding to train women like Angelo and Sam so they could get jobs in child care.
swa: Muelimishaji kupitia simulizi za mdomo, Armor, aliwekeza kuwapa ujuzi wanawake kama Angelo na Sam ili waweze kuajiriwa katika kituo hichi cha kulea watoto.

eng: Then, just as she had done in Africa, she collected and translated their songs.
swa: Kisha, kama alivyofanya huko Afrika, akazikusanya nyimbo zao na kuzitafsiri.

eng: Combining job training and musical tradition has been so successful, the museum released a CD.
swa: Kuunganisha ujuzi wa kikazi na and tamaduni za kimuziki imekuwa kazi yenye mafanikio kwa kiwango kikubwa, kakika sehemu ya makumbusho walitoa CD.

eng: Angelo sings some of the songs, like the one from the Acholi people that is sung when a child begins to toddle.
swa: Angelo akiimba baadhi ya nyimbo, moja ya nyimbo hizo ni kama ule waaacholi wanaouimbaga watto wanapofikia umri wa kujifunza kutembea.

eng: “It is a way to call the child to toddle to you and then you sing to that child to turn around and then somebody else sings to that child,” explains Armor.
swa: “Ni njia ya kumuita mtoto atembee kukufuata mahali na pia unamwimbia mtoto ageuke upande wa mtu mwingine ambaye nae atamwimbia amfate,” Armor akilezea.

eng: In the United States, some of the most popular children’s songs already come from overseas — think "London Bridge Is Falling Down" or "Ring Around The Rosie."
swa: Nchini Marekani, baadhi ya nyimbo nyingi maarufu za watoto asili ya ni nchi za nje — fikiria "Daraja la London likivunjika " au "Ring Around The Rosie."

eng: But every country and culture has these types of songs, and with migration and assimilation, they can be lost — or gained.
swa: Lakini kila nchi na utamaduni zina nyimbo za aina hii, na uhamiaji wa watu pamoja na mazoea, ni baadhi ya vitu ambavyo tunaweza kuvipoteza — au kuvipata.

eng: Armor has archived nearly a hundred songs from almost as many countries and cultures.
swa: Armor amefanikiwa kupata takribani nyimbo mia moja kutoka nchi nyingi na tamaduni mbalimbali.

eng: They're about everything — animals, emotions, experiences.
swa: Zinagusa vitu vyote — wanyama, hisia, uzoefu.

eng: One Nepalese song is about climbing mango trees at recess to pick ripe fruit.
swa: Wimbo mmoja wakinepali maudhui yake ni kupanda wakati wa mapumziko kutungua embe liliyoiva.

eng: “But at the end of the song the bell rings and you don’t get the mango," she says. "I think of that as kind of, well there you go, there’s an eternal truth.
swa: “Lakini mwisho wa wimbo huu kengele inagongwa bila kufanikiw kupata embe," she anasema"Naifikiria hali hiyo kama ya, pale unapokwenda kuna ukweli wenyewe.

eng: Recess will never be long enough.
swa: Mapumziko hayawezi kuwa kipindi kirefu cha kutosha.

eng: And sometimes you don’t get time to eat that mango."
swa: Na wakati mwingine unaweza hata usipate muda wa kilila embe hilo."

swa: Hii hapa ni orodha ya nyimbo kwenye CD iitwayo "Simba La La: World Music for Children," jina la CD hiyo kwa hisani ya Makumbusho ya Sanaa ya Erie.

eng: Environmentalists in Krasnoyarsk appeal to Dr. DiCaprio.
swa: Wana mazingira wa Krasnoyarsk wakata rufaa kwa Dr. DiCaprio.

eng: Image: Vkontakte
swa: Picha: Vkontakte

eng: According to a popular legend many Russians learn in school, the Russian people 11 centuries ago invited “managers” from Scandinavia to come and help rule over their lands.
swa: Kulingana na hadithi maarufu wanazojifunza Warusi shuleni, katika karne ya 11 watu wa Urusi walialika "mameneja" kutoka Skandinavia kuja na kutawala ardhi yao.

eng: The so-called "Varangian" tribe leaders (coming from the territories of modern Sweden and Norway) had a knack for good governance, and they were enormously helpful in Old Rus, the story goes.
swa: Waliitwa "Wa-Varangia" wakuu wa kabila (wakitokea katika mamlaka za Sweden na Norway iliyostaarabika) wakiwa na ujuzi katika uongozi bora na walisaidia sana katika Urusi ya zamani,hadithi inaendelea.

eng: The age of the Varangians came and went, but some Russians today are still looking abroad for another savior.
swa: Enzi ya Wavarangia ilikuja na kuondoka, lakini baadhi ya Warusi leo bado wanatafuta mkombozi kutoka nje.

eng: In Krasnoyarsk, the third largest city in Siberia, local environmentalists have found their man: Hollywood star Leonardo DiCaprio.
swa: Katika mji wa Krasnoyarsk, ambao ni mji wa tatu kwa ukubwa, huko Siberia, wanamazingira wa humo walimpata mwanaume wao: Nyota wa Hollywood, Leonardo DiCaprio.

eng: In order to draw attention to air pollution that's choking their home, local activists recently displayed several large banners throughout the city bearing DiCaprio's handsome face, with a desperate appeal reading, “Leon, save Krasnoyarsk from coal!”
swa: Ili kuvuta umakini juu ya uchafuzi wa hali ya hewa unaokabili nyumba zao, wanaharakati hao hivi karibuni waliweka bango kubwa likionesha uso mzuri wa Leonardo DiCaprio na maneno yenye wakha yanayosomeka "Leon, iokoe Krasnoyarsk kutoka kwenye mkaa!”

eng: This was just the latest stunt in a campaign against local power plants that's lasted years.
swa: Hiki kilikuwa kitendo kipya kabisa katika kampeni dhidi ya vinu vya kufulia nishati zilizodumu kwa miaka kadhaa sasa.

eng: Last month, for example, citizens held a public protest to demand that the powerhouses switch from coal to natural gas, which environmentalists hope would lower air pollution.
swa: Kwa mfano mwezi uliopita, wananchi waliitisha maandamano wakitaka vinu vya makaa ya mawe vizimwe na itumike gesi asilia, ambapo wanamazingira wanaamini kuwa itapunguza uchafuzi wa hali ya hewa.

eng: A founder of a wildlife conservation foundation in 1998 and a UN climate change ambassador, Leonardo DiCaprio is renown for his environmentalist work.
swa: Muanzilishi wa shirika la Uhifadhi wa Wanyamapori mwaka 1998 na balozi wa Mabadiliko ya Tabia Nchi katika Umoja wa Mataifa, Leonardo DiCaprio anasifika kwa kazi zake za Uanamazingira.

eng: When accepting his Oscar award last year, he devoted a good deal of his acceptance speech to climate issues.
swa: Wakati akipokea tuzo yake ya Oscar mwaka jana, alitoa hotuba yake akilenga katika masuala ya tabia nchi.

eng: Krasnoyarsk environmentalists' appeal to DiCaprio represents a worldwide trend, when activists spend years hounding unresponsive local authorities, before appealing to the global viral community, in this case using a world-famous celebrity to draw attention to their cause.
swa: Wanamazingira wa Krasnoyarsk kuelekeza kilio chao kwa DiCaprio inawakilisha mwenendo wa ulimwengu mzima, ambapo wanaharakati hutumia miaka kadhaa wakiziwinda mamlaka ambazo hazina mwitikio, kabla hazijakata rufaa kwa jumuiya za kimataifa, na kwa wakati huu wakimtumia mtu maarufu duniani kuvuta umakini katika suala lao.

eng: Scholar Ethan Zuckerman (who co-founded Global Voices) coined the “cute cat theory of digital activism,” which suggests that somewhere between the images of adorable cats and brunch selfies, new forms of social activism can thrive.
swa: Mwanazuoni Ethan Zuckerman (mshirika-mwanzilishi wa Global Voices) aliunda “kanuni ya paka mzuri ya uanaharakati wa dijitali,” ambayo inapendekeza kwamba kati ya picha nzuri za paka na picha (selfie) za wakati wa chai ya saa nne, ndipo muundo mpya wa wanaharakati wa kijamii wanaweza kustawi.

eng: By hanging banners appealing to Leonardo DiCaprio, environmentalists in Krasnoyarsk aren't putting direct pressure on the city's officials, but the publicity could bring the matter to their attention indirectly, perhaps more effectively than a traditional protest outside city hall.
swa: Kwa kuning'iniza mabango yakukata rufaa kwa Leonardo DiCaprio, wanamazingira wa Krasnoyarsk hawaweki msisitizo wa moja kwa moja kwa maafisa wa mamlaka za miji lakini tangazo hilo linaweza kulileta jambo hilo katika ufahamu wao kwa njia isiyo ya moja kwa moja, na labla yaweza kuwa njia bora zaidi kuliko utamaduni wa migomo ya nje ya ukumbi wa mji.

eng: A typical problem with viral campaigning is that struggles to transition from computer screens to the streets.
swa: Tatizo la kawaida kwa kampeni kama hizi huwa ni kupambana kuondoa mapambano haya wenye skrini ya kompyuta kwenda mitaani.

eng: As unlikely as it probably is, what could really help the campaign in Krasnoyarsk would be for DiCaprio himself to publicize the situation in the city.
swa: Kuna uwezekano pengine kile kilichokuwa msaada kwa kampeni za Krasnoyarsk kikaweza kuwa na kwa Dicaprio kutangaza suala la mji huo.

eng: In the meantime, Russian Internet users are already finding the humor in Krasnoyarsk's strange public appeal.
swa: Na wakati huo huo, watumiaji wa mitandao nchini Urusi wanafanya mzaha juu ya wito huo wa umma wa Krasnoyarsk.

eng: “You're better off asking Chuck Norris for help.
swa: “Ingekuwa bora zaidi kama wangetafuta msaada kwa Chuck Norris.

eng: Leo can only deal with the potholes,” some people have joked.
swa: Leo anaweza kushughulika na masuala ya kwenye maji pekee,” baadhi ya watu walitania.

eng: Showing an impressive grasp of DiCaprio's filmography, others have written in online comments: “They'll call in Tarantino for help with the street violence.”
swa: Wakionesha ufahamu na kuvutiwa na uigizaji wa DiCaprio, wengine waliandika katika maoni yao mitandaoni: “Wangemwita Tarantino aje kusaidia uhalifu mitaani.”

swa: Wataalam wa program za kompyuta nchini India wanatengeneza tovuti maalum inayosaidia kubaini ujumbe bandia unasambazwa kwenye mtandao wa Whatsapp na Facebook.

eng: Known as check4spam.com, the site relies on both the research and investigation by the check4spam team along with volunteer users.
swa: Ukifahamika kama check4spam.com, mtandao huo unategemea kwa kiasi kikubwa utafiti na uchunguzi unaofanywa na timu ya check4spam sambamba na watumiaji wake wa kujitolea.

eng: The group hopes to expand the portal's capabilities to provide certain services through technical tools.
swa: Kikundi hicho kinalenga kukuza uwezo wa tovuti hiyo kutoa huduma za kuaminika kupitia zana za kiteknolojia.
