swa: Daily News 15/6/17: "Wizi wa madini"

eng: The Citizen, 15/6/17: “We want our money back”.
swa: The Citizen, 15/6/17: “Tunataka hela zetu zirudi”.

eng: The varying interpretations of the outcome of the meeting between Magufuli and Thornton by the Tanzanian media raises the question of whether these journalists and editors are aware they were potentially misleading the public; and if they did know, why were they doing so?
swa: Tafsiri tofauti za matokeo ya mkutano huo kati ya Magufuli na Thornton zilizochorwa na vyombo vya habari vya Tanzania zinaibua swali ikiwa waandishi na wahariri wao wanaelewa kwamba walikuwa wakiupotosha umma; na kama walijua, kwa nini walikuwa wanafanya hivyo?

eng: Could it have anything to do with the law that allows the government to suspend Mawio so easily?
swa: Je, inawezekana haya yote yametokana na sheria inayoiruhusu serikali kufungia gazeti la Mawio kirahisi?

eng: Could they be worried that what happened to Mawio could happen to others as well?
swa: Je, inawezekana walikuwa na wasiwasi kwamba kilichotokea kwa gazeti la Mawio kingewatokea na wao pia?

eng: Those who spread fake news through the social media are also liable under the proposed bill.
swa: Wale wanaosambaza habari potofu kwenye mitandao ya kijamii wanaguswa na muswada unaopendekezwa.

eng: Flickr photo by Stanley Cabigas (CC BY 2.0)
swa: Picha ya mtandao wa Flickr na Stanley Cabigas (CC BY 2.0)

eng: Philippine Senator Joel Villanueva filed a bill in late June that would criminalize the “malicious distribution of false news.”
swa: Seneta wa Ufilipino Senator Joel Villanueva amewasilisha muswada mwishoni mwa Juni utakaofanya "Usambamzaji wa habari potofu" kuwa kosa la jinai.

eng: Media groups are warning it could lead to censorship.
swa: Muswada wa Villanueva kwa Seneti Na.

eng: Villanueva’s Senate Bill No. 1492 or “An Act Penalizing the Malicious Distribution of False News and Other Related Violations” defines fake news as “those which either intend to cause panic, division, chaos, violence, and hate, or those which exhibit a propaganda to blacken or discredit one's reputation.”
swa: 1492 au “Sheria Inayoadhibu Usambazaji Wenye Nia Ovu wa Habari Potofu na Makosa Mengine kama Hayo" inafafanua maana ya habari potofu kuwa ni "habari ambazo ama zinakusudia kusababisha hali ya tahayaruki, mgawanyiko, ghasia, na chuki au zile zenye ujumbe wa kipropaganda kwa lengo la kuchafua au kuharibu hadhi ya mtu mwingine.”

eng: The bill assigns penalties to those who publish "fake news" and even to those who share it, potentially criminalizing social media users who may not fully understand the implications of simply sharing an article with friends.
swa: Nuswada huo unapendekeza adhabu kwa wale watakaochapisha "habari potofu" na hata wale watakaosambaza habari hizo, na kuweka uwezekano wa kuwaadhibu watumiaji wa mitandao ya kijamii ambao wanaweza wasioelewe kikamilifu matokeo ya kusambaza makala kwa marafiki.

eng: Prison sentencing under the proposed law depends on the status of the entity who publishes or spreads the so-called "fake news".
swa: Hukumu ya mahakama chini ya sheria hiyo inayopendekezwa inategemea na shirika linalochapisha au kusambaza hicho kinachoitwa "habari potofu".

eng: A private individual found guilty of publishing or spreading fake news can face a prison term of up to five years.
swa: Mtu binafsi atakayekutwa na hatia ya kuchapisha au kusambaza habari potofu anaweza kuhukumiwa kifungo cha mpaka miaka mitano jela.

eng: A government official's sentence would be double that of a private individual.
swa: Hukumu kwa maafisa wa serikali itakuwa mara mbili ya ile ya watu binafsi.

eng: And a media entity or social media platform spreading fake news could be detained for up to 20 years.
swa: Na chombo cha habari au jukwaa la mtandao wa kijamii utakaohusika na kusambaza habari potofu wanaweza kufungwa hadi miaka 20.

eng: Villanueva explained the rationale behind these penalties:
swa: Villanueva alieleza nia ya adhabu hizo:

eng: The effect of fake news should not be taken lightly.
swa: Madhara ya habari potofu yasichukuliwe kirahisi.

eng: Fake news creates impression and beliefs based on false premises leading to division, misunderstanding and further exacerbating otherwise strenuous relations.
swa: Habari potofu zinajenga mitazamo na imani zinazotokana na dhana zinazoweza kusababisha mgawanyiko, kutokuelewana na kuharibu mahusiano ambayo tayari ni mabaya.

eng: He added that the passage of the bill “will encourage our citizens, especially public officers, to be more responsible and circumspect in creating, distributing and/or sharing news.”
swa: Aliongeza kwamba kupitishwa kwa muswada huo "kutawahamasisha wananchi hasa maafisa wa serikali, kuwajibika zaidi katika kutengeneza, kusambaza na/au kueneza habari.”

eng: Journalism Professor Danilo Arao reviewed the four-page bill and summarized his objections:
swa: Profesa wa Uandishi wa Habari Danilo Arao alichambua muswada huo wa kurasa nne na kuandika muhtasari wa kuukata muswada huo:

eng: Definition of "false news or information" under Sec. 2 is so broad that it includes practically anything perceived to cause, among others, panic and hate (obviously hard to define)… Media organizations could be subjected to censorship under Sec. 3 of the proposed law because even fair commentary or investigative reports that are perceived to tarnish the reputation of a public official could be flagged as "false news".
swa: Tafsiri ya "habari au taarifa potofu" kwenye kifungu cha 2 ni pana kiasi kwamba inahusisha chochote kinachoaminika kusababisha, pamoja na mambo mengine, tahayaruki na chuki (jambo ambalo ni gumu kulitafsiri)… Mashirika ya habari yanaweza kujikuta kwenye mazingira ya kudhibitiwa chini ya kifungu cha 3 cha sheria inayopendekezwa kwa sababu hata maoni ya haki au taarifa za kiuchunguzi zinaweza kuchukuliwa kama kuharibu sifa ya maafisa wa serikali na kupachikwa jina la "habari potofu".

eng: Arao further disputed the need for a special law mentioning public officials, reasoning that they are already assumed to be following a code of conduct.
swa: Arao anapinga hitaji la sheria maalum inayowataja maafisa wa serikali, akidai kwamba tayari watu hao wanafuata sheria za maadili ya kazi.

eng: In a TV interview, a spokesperson from the Center for Media Freedom and Responsibility said the proposed legislation is unnecessary because Philippine libel law already addresses the issues raised by the senator.
swa: Kwenye mahojiano ya televisheni, msemaji kutoka Kituo cha Uhuru na Wajibu wa Vyombo vya Habari alisema sheria hiyo haina ulazima kwa sabbau sheria ya uhuru Ufilipino tayari inashughulikia masuala yanayoibuliwa na seneta.

eng: A member of the House of Representatives proposed that instead of criminalizing fake news, the congress should work to approve a pending Freedom of Information bill that he says would help counter the irresponsible sharing of false information on media and the Internet.
swa: Mbunge wa Bunge la nchi hiyo alipendekeza kwamba badala ya kufanya habari potofu ziwe jinai, Baraza la Seneti lifanyie kazi Muswada wa Uhuru wa Habari ambao bado haujafanyiwa kazi akidai kwamba ungesaidia kupambana na usambazaji holela wa taarifa zisizo sahihi kupitia vyombo vya habari na mtandao wa intaneti.

eng: AlterMidya, a network of independent media groups, denounced Villanueva’s bill as “irresponsible, unnecessary and dangerous attempt to impose a form of censorship on free expression and press freedom.”
swa: AlterMidya, mtandao wa makampuni huru ya habari, ulilaani muswada wa Villanueva na kusema “ni wa hovyo, usiohitajika na ni hatua za hatari kutengeneza mazingira ya kudhibiti uhuru wa kujieleza na uhuru wa vyombo vya habari.”

eng: How does one distinguish between a false report based on an honest mistake and one maliciously spread through print, broadcasting and online?
swa: Unatofautishaje kati ya taarifa ya uongo iliyotokana na kosa la kibinadamu na ile inayosambazwa kwa nia mbaya kupitia magazeti, matangazo au mtandaoni?

eng: It would endow the bureaucracy with the arbitrary power to declare any media issuance contrary to government interests as fake news, while approving, loudly or otherwise, even the most fraudulent report from either private or State media so long as it favors whatever regime is in power.
swa: Inaweza kutengeneza urasimu wa kimadaraka unampa mtu mamlaka ya kutangaza chombo cha habari kilichoandika habari zilizo kinyume cha maslahi ya serikali kuwa ni habari potofu, wakati huo huo kuunga mkono kwa sauti au vinginevyo, uandikaji wa habari mbaya zinazoandikwa na vyombo vya habari vya serikali au binafsi almuradi ziwe zinalinda maslahi ya utawala ulioko madarakani.

eng: Veteran journalist Luis Teodoro reminded the senator that there are better ways to fight fake news:
swa: Mwandishi nguli Luis Teodoro alimkumbusha seneta kwamba kuna namna bora zaidi za kupambana na habari potofu:

eng: Accountability in the exercise of the right to communicate is best enforced, not by the State, but by the media community itself as well as by a public media-literate and responsible enough to detect and not to spread fake news.
swa: Uwajibikaji kwenye zoezi la haki ya kuwasiliana ufanyiwe kazi, sio na Serikali, lakini na jamii ya waandishi wa habari wenyewe ikiwa ni pamoja na wasomi wa vyombo vya habari vya umma wenye uwezo wa kugundua na kuacha kusambaza habari potofu.

eng: Philippine Star newspaper columnist Jarius Bondoc warned that if the bill becomes law, it could be abused by authorities who want to silence critics:
swa: Mwandishi wa makala kwenye gazeti la Philippine Star Jarius Bondoc alionya kwamba kama muswada huo utakuwa sheria, unaweza kutumiwa vibaya na mamlaka za serikali zinazotaka kuwanyamazisha wakosoaji wake:

eng: The bill is prone to abuse.
swa: Muswada huu unatengeneza uwezekano mkubwa wa kutumiwa vibaya.

eng: A bigot administration can apply it to suppress the opposition.
swa: Utawala wa kifisadi unaweza kuutumia kuunyamazisha upinzani.

eng: By prosecuting critics as news fakers, the government can stifle legitimate dissent.
swa: Kwa kuwafungulia mashtaka wakosoaji wake kwa madai ya kutengeneza habari potofu, serikali inaweza kunyamazisha habari za kweli isizokubaliana nazo.

eng: Whistleblowers, not the grafters, would be imprisoned and fined for daring to talk.
swa: Wafuatiliaji wa utendaji wa serikali, sio wapenzi wa serikali, watafungwa na kupigwa faini kwa kuthibutu kusema.

eng: Investigative journalists would cram the jails.
swa: Waandishi wa habari za kiuchunguzi wataozea jela.

eng: This is not the first time that a Philippine legislator has filed a bill that seeks to address the negative impact of fake news.
swa: Hii si mara ya kwanza kwa mtunga sheria wa Ufilipino kuonesha nia ya kupelekea muswada unaojaribu kushughulikia madhara ya habari potofu.

eng: Early this year, the Speaker of the House of Representatives proposed regulating social media to prevent the spread of fake accounts and fake information.
swa: Mapema mwaka huu, Spika wa Baraza la Wawakilishi alipendekeza kudhibiti mitandao ya kijamii ili kuzuia kusambaa kwa akaunti bandia na taarifa bandia.

eng: “I understand how hard it is to take care of little kids,” says 19-year-old Luis Duarte, second from right, who is now caring for his three younger siblings after his parents, originally from Mexico, were detained by US immigration agents in late May.
swa: “ Ninaelewa ni jinsi gani ilivyo vigumu kuwatunza watoto wadogo,” ndivyo anavyosema kijana wa miaka 19 Luis Duarte, wapili kulia, ambaye anawalea wadogo zake watatu baada ya wazazi wao ambao kwa asili wanatokea Mexico, kuswekwa ndani na mamlaka za uhamiaji za Marekani mwezi Mei mwishoni.

eng: Credit: Deepa Ferndandes
swa: Shukrani kwa: Deepa Ferndandes

eng: This story by Deepa Fernandes originally appeared on PRI.org on June 11, 2017.
swa: Habari hii iliyoandikwa na Deepa Fernandes mwanzo ilichapishwa kwenye PRI.org Juni 11, 2017.

eng: As 19-year-old Francisco Duarte watched his parents handcuffed and driven away by immigration officials in late May outside their San Diego, California, home, all he could do was console his hysterical 12-year-old twin sisters.
swa: Kwa jinsi Francisco Duarte 19 alivyoshuhudia wazazi wake wakivalishwa pingu na kuchukuliwa na maafisa wa uhamiaji mwishoni mwa mwezi Mei nje ya nyumba yao huko San Diego, California, kitu pekee alichoweza kufanya ni kuwabembeleza kwa lengo la kuwatuliza wadogo zake mapacha wa kike wenye miaka 12 waliokuwa wamefadhaika.

eng: Then he took off to find help for his parents.
swa: Kisha aliondoka kwenda kutafuta msaada kwa ajili ya wazazi wake.

eng: They would need an immigration attorney, and Francisco would need to gather their paperwork.
swa: Katika hali hiyo ni dhahiri wangehitaji mwanasheria wa masuala ya uhamiaji na Fransisco angehitajika kukusanya nyaraka zao.

eng: His younger brother Luis, 17, stepped up to look after the younger sisters — he cooked them eggs and ham when they came home from school that day.
swa: Mdogo wake wa kiume Luis, 17, alijitolea kuwaangalia wadogo zao, na aliwapikia mayai waliporudi kutoka shuleni siku hiyo.

eng: The brothers were busy figuring out all the household chores, making sure they had their little sisters taken care of.
swa: Kaka hao walitingwa na kupangilia shughuli zote za nyumbani huku wakihakikisha wanawatunza wadogo zao wa kike.

eng: And then it hit the brothers.
swa: Kisha pigo likawakuta kaka hao.

eng: Rent was due in less than a week.
swa: Kodi ya nyumba inaisha ndani ya muda usiozidi juma moja.

eng: They were now going to have to pay all the family’s bills.
swa: Pia walikuwa wanatakiwa kulipa bili zote ndani ya familia.

eng: Duarte said he and his brother gathered all the money his parents had.
swa: Duarte anasema yeye na kaka yake walikusanya fedha yote waliyokuwa nayo wazazi wao.

eng: It came to $2,500.
swa: Walipata kiasi cha dola 2,500.

eng: They would need to supplement their father's income somehow.
swa: Walihitajika kuongezea kipato cha baba yao kwa namna yoyote.

eng: He was the breadwinner, running the family ice-cream business.
swa: Ndiye aliyekuwa anatafuta mkate wa familia kwa kuendesha biashara ya kuuza barafu.

eng: “My mom and my dad met selling ice cream from pushcarts 20 years ago when they came to this country,” Duarte said.
swa: Mama yangu na baba walikutana wakiuza barafu kwenye vitoroli miaka 20 iliyopita walipokuja nchi hii alisema Duarte.

eng: While Francisco and Luis push their own ice cream carts to help out, neither could bring in the money that their farther did, Duarte said.
swa: Wakati Francisco na Luis walikuwa wakiendesha vitoroli vyao binafsi vya barafu kusaidia familia, hawakuweza kuingiza kipato alichokuwa anaingiza baba yao, alisema Duarte.

eng: Francisco Duarte Sr. and his wife, Rosenda Perez, were arrested by immigration agents on May 23.
swa: Francisco Duarte Sr. na mkewe Rosenda Perez, walikamatwa na maafisa wa uhamiaji Mei 23.

eng: Duarte had left his National City, California, home to buy a newspaper across the street.
swa: Duarte alikuwa ameondoka nyumbani kwake National City, California, kwenda kununua gazeti mtaani.

eng: His wife came out to see what was going on and she was arrested too.
swa: Mke wake alitoka kuja kuangalia ni kitu gani kinaendelea ndipo naye alikamatwa pia.

eng: Officials say they have been charged with “immigration violations” in the US.
swa: Maafisa wanasema wanatuhumiwa kwa "kukiuka taratibu za uhamiaji" ndani ya Marekani.

eng: There are no criminal charges against them, and neither has a criminal record.
swa: Hakuna tuhuma za jinai wala rekodi za uhalifu dhidi yao.

eng: The San Diego couple are among a growing number of non-citizens arrested on civil immigration charges during the first months of the Donald Trump administration.
swa: Wanandoa hawa wa San Diego ni kati ya idadi kubwa ya watu wasio raia wanaokamatwa kwa makosa ya uhamiaji katika miezi ya mwanzo ya utawala wa Donald Trump.

eng: From January 22 to April 29, more than 41,000 people suspected of living in the US without proper authorization have been arrested by federal agents — nearly a 40 percent increase from the same period in 2016, according to US officials.
swa: Kuanzia Januari 22 mpaka Aprili 29, zaidi ya watu 41,000 wanashukiwa kuishi nchini Marekani bila vibali halali vya uhamiaji wamekamatwa na maafisa usalama, hili ni ongezeko la karibu asilimia 40 ulikilinganisha na kipindi hicho hicho kwa 2016, na hii ni kulingana na maafisa wa Marekani.

eng: A quarter of those arrested are charged with being in the US without legal status, but have no prior criminal records.
swa: Robo ya waliokamatwa wanashitakiwa kwa makosa ya kutokuwa nchini Marekani kihalali, lakini hawana rekodi za makosa ya jinai ya hapo kabla.

eng: It’s a group that was not targeted as heavily by the Barack Obama administration.
swa: Ni kundi ambalo halikulengwa sana na utawala wa Barack Obama.

eng: The latest numbers show Trump is making good on his campaign promise to change that, as detailed recently by reporter Maria Sacchetti at The Washington Post.
swa: Idadi ya hivi karibuni inaonesha Trump anafanya vyema katika ahadi yake ya wakati wa kampeni ya kubadilisha hilo, kama ilivyoelezwa hivi karibuni na mwanahabari Sacchetti kwenye The Washington Post.

eng: Before his arrest, Duarte was able to pass custody of his three younger children to Luis, his oldest son.
swa: Kabla ya kukamatwa kwake, Duarte alikuwa amekamilisha kuwaweka wanae wadogo chini ya uangalizi wa kijana wake mkubwa Luis.

eng: For the kids, it's been a whirlwind.
swa: Kwa watoto, hiki kimekuwa kimbunga kwao.

eng: On a recent Tuesday, Francisco sought commmunity members to write letters of support for his parents.
swa: Jumanne ya hivi karibuni, Fransisco aliomba msaada wa jamii kuandika barua za kuwaunga mkono wazazi wao.

eng: He arrived back home hungry.
swa: Alirudi nyumbani mwenye njaa. "

eng: “I’ve been out all morning," said Luis.
swa: Nilikuwa nimetoka tangu asubuhi", alisema Luis.

eng: We've just been hectic, doing as much as we can for our parents, so yeah, breakfast at 2:37 p.m.” 	Tumechoka, tumejitahidi kufanya tulichoweza kwa wazazi wetu, hivyo ndiyo, napata kiamsha kinywa saa 8.37 mchana.
Mark Lane, a legal assistant at an LA-based immigration law firm, sat with Francisco, and they discussed what else needed to be collected for his parent’s case.
swa: Mark Lane, msaidizi wa kisheria katika ofisi za wanasheria wa masuala ya Uhamiaji LA aliketi na Fransisco, na walijadili ni kitu gani zaidi wanapaswa kukusanya kwa ajili ya kesi ya wazazi wake.

eng: Lane was one of the people Francisco called for help the day his parents were arrested.
swa: Lane ni mmoja wa watu walioitwa na Fransisco kutoa msaada siku wazazi wake walipokamatwa.

eng: “Pre-Trump administration, maybe I got two to three calls a week, now I get 10 to 15 calls a day,” Lane said.
swa: “Kabla ya utawala wa Trump labda nilikuwa napokea simu mbili au tatu kwa juma, sasa napokea mpaka simu 10 au 15 kwa siku, alisema Lane. "

eng: “People are very scared, families are being split up.”
swa: Watu wanahofu sana, familia zimetawanyika."

eng: Lane, whose firm has taken the case of Francisco’s parents, talked to the kids about the expenses they would need to pay.
swa: Lane, ambaye ofisi yake imechukua kesi ya wazazi wa Fransisco, aliongea na watoto kuhusu gharama wanazopaswa kulipa.

eng: All four children are in school, leaving little time to work and bring in income.
swa: Watoto wote wanne wako shuleni, wakipata muda kidogo wa kufanya kazi ili kuleta kipato kwa familia.

eng: So they decided to turn to a terrain they know well: social media.
swa: Hivyo waliamua kugeukia uwanja wanaoufahamu vyema: mitandao ya kijamii.

eng: They created a short video about their situation, posted it to YouTube, and linked it to a GoFundMe fundraising page.
swa: Walitengeneza video fupi kuhusu suala lao na kuiweka YouTube, na kuiunganisha na tovuti ya GoFundMe inayochangisha fedha.

eng: They set their fundraising goal at $70,000 and, just days later, they had surpassed it.
swa: Waliweka lengo la kukusanya fedha kiasi cha dola 70,000 na, siku chache baadae walishangaa kuvuka lengo.

eng: More than $72,000 in donations have come in so far.
swa: Michango zaidi ya dola 72,000 ilipatikana.

eng: They’re stunned and grateful.
swa: Wameshangazwa na wanashukuru.

eng: But it wasn’t just money rolling in — people were also reaching out to say we support you.
swa: Lakini sio pesa pekee ziliingia kwao, pia watu walituma jumbe wakiwaambia wako pamoja nao.

eng: “It’s just very uplifting that every day I get messages from people and they’re just letting me know that they’re there for me and if there’s anything that I need they’re just a phone call, a text away,” Francisco said.
swa: “Inatia moyo sana kuona kila siku napokea jumbe toka kwa watu wakiniambia wako pamoja nasi na kama kuna lolote tunalohitaji tupige simu au kutuma ujumbe mfupi wa maneno, "alisema Fransisco"

eng: The older Francisco found it hard to comprehend the social media campaign his kids are pursuing on his behalf, his son said.
swa: Fransisco mkubwa aliona vigumu sana kukubaliana na kampeni ya mitandaoni watoto wake wanayoifanya kwa niaba yake, kijana wake alisena.

eng: During a recent phone call, the younger Francisco explained to his father how money and support was coming in.
swa: Katika mazungumzo ya hivi karibu kwa njia ya simu Fransisco mdogo alimuelewesha baba yake jinsi fedha na misaada inavyomiminika kwao.

eng: His dad asked who was donating. “Many people,” his son told him.
swa: Baba yake aliuliza ni nani hasa anayesaidia, "watu wengi" alijibu kijana wake.

eng: “Teachers, neighbors, friends, people from around the city,” he told his father during their telephone conversation.
swa: Waalimu, majirani, marafiki, watu wa sehemu mbalimbali hapa mjini," alimwambia baba yake wakati wa mazungumzo yao kwenye simu.

eng: As word spread on social media, friends began coming by the house to help.
swa: Taarifa zilivyoenea mitandaoni, marafiki walianza kufika nyumbani kutoa msaada.

eng: A group of Luis’s friends from school are helping out.
swa: Kundi la marafiki wa Luis kutoka shuleni wanasaidia.

eng: Luz Maria Castañon said they don’t want Luis to suffer at school.
swa: Luz Maria Castañon alisema hawataki Luis apate tabu akiwa shuleni.

eng: “He’s going to be valedictorian, honestly. nothing compared to his GPA.”
swa: “Anaenda kuwa mwanafunzi mwenye ufaulu wa juu kwa kweli. cha kufananishwa na GPA yake.”

eng: In the kitchen, another friend, Maria de Jesus, cooks up some tacos.
swa: Huko jikoni, rafiki mwingine, Maria de Jesus, anapika tacos.

eng: She said should would cook for the children until their parents come back home.
swa: Alisema ataendelea kuwapikia watoto mpaka wazazi warudi nyumbani.

eng: The twin sisters, Aracely and Yarely, watched their parents get handcuffed and be taken away by immigration officials.
swa: Wadada mapacha, Aracely and Yarely, waliangalia wazazi wao wakivalishwa pingu na kuchukuliwa na maafisa wa uhamiaji.

eng: It was confusing, Aracely said, and they miss them a lot.
swa: Ilinichanganya, alisema Aracely, na wanawakumbuka sana wazazi wao.

eng: Especially when they come home from school.
swa: Hasa wanapotoka shuleni.

eng: “Usually my mom would be here and she would sometimes have a little snack prepared,” Yarely said.
swa: “Kwa kawaida mama angekuwa hapa na angetuandalia vitafunwa kidogo wakati mwingine,” alisema Yarely.

eng: The girls are not identical twins, but they both have the same sweet, kind of sad smile.
swa: Wasichana hao sio mapacha wanaofanana, ila wote wana tabasamu tamu, linalohuzunisha namna fulani.

eng: They busy themselves putting things away in their room.
swa: Hujishughulisha na kupanga vitu chumbani mwao.

eng: “Sometimes it is a bit overwhelming but, um, …” Yarely trails off.
swa: “Wakati mwingine hii ni balaa lakini , um, …” Yarely aliondoka

eng: Luis checks in on his sisters, makes sure they are OK, and then has to leave.
swa: Luis huwaangalia dada zake kuhakikisha wako sawa, na kisha huondoka. "

eng: “I’m going to go and do laundry right now because our sheets are really nasty," he said.
swa: Ninaenda kufua nguo kwa sababu shuka zetu ni chafu sana," alisema.

eng: Is this his job normally?
swa: Je ni kazi yake ya kawaida?

eng: “Nah, not really."
swa: “Hapana, kwa kweli."

eng: After the laundry, he has to be home for his sisters.
swa: Baada ya kufua, anatakiwa awepo nyumbani kwa ajili ya dada zake.

eng: His brother will continue gathering letters of support for their parents.
swa: Kaka yake ataendelea kukusanya barua kwa ajili ya kuwaunga mkono wazazi wao.

eng: “I understand how hard it is to take care of little kids now,” Luis said.
swa: “Sasa ninaelewa ni kiasi gani ilivyo vigumu kuwalea watoto wadogo,” alisema Luis.

eng: Six of the human rights defenders who were detained on July 5, 2017.
swa: Sita kati ya wapigania Haki za Binadamu waliowekwa kizuizini Julai 5, 2017.

eng: Images shared widely on Twitter under the hashtag #İnsanHaklarıSavunucularınaDokunma.
swa: Picha zimetumiwa kwa mapana katika mtandao wa Twita chini ya alama ishara ya #İnsanHaklarıSavunucularınaDokunma.

eng: Eight of Turkey's best-known human rights defenders were arrested during a digital security and information management workshop on one of Istanbul's islands, Buyukada, on July 5.
swa: Wapigania Haki za Binadamu nane wa nchini Uturuki Eight of Turkey's best-known human rights defenders were walikamatwa wakati wakiwa kwenye semina na usalama na usimamizi wa taarifa za kidigitali katika moja ya visiwa vya Istanbul, Buyukada, hapo Julai 5.

eng: Two trainers were also arrested along with the rights defenders.
swa: Wawezeshaji wawili pia walikamatwa pamoja na wapigania Haki hai.

eng: Police also briefly detained the owner of the hotel where the event was held.
swa: Polisi walimuweka kizuizini kwa muda mmiliki wa hoteli ambapo warsha hiyo ilikuwa inafanyika.

eng: Among those arrested is the director of Amnesty International Turkey, Idil Eser.
swa: Kati ya hao waliokamatwa ni Mkurugenzi wa Shirika la Haki za Binadamu Uturuki, Idil Eser.

eng: Independent media outlet Bianet reported that police in plainclothes raided the workshop, detained the participants, and confiscated electronic equipment including computers and mobile phones.
swa: Chanzo huru cha habari cha Bianet kiliripoti kuwa polisi waliovalia kiraia walivamia warsha hiyo, kuwaweka kizuizini washiriki na kuchukua vifaa vya kielektroniki zikiwemo kompyuta na simu za mkononi.

eng: The eight Turkish citizens will be held for seven days pre-trial.
swa: Raia hao tisa wa Uturuki watawekwa kizuizini kwa siku saba kabla ya kufunguliwa mashitaka.

eng: Less than a month ago Amnesty International's Turkey chair, Taner Kilic was also remanded in prison.
swa: Chini ya mwezi mmoja uliopita Mwenyekiti wa Shirika la Haki za Binadamu la Uturuki, Taner Kilic aliwekwa aliwekwa rumande gerezani.

eng: Amnesty International released a statement on July 6:
swa: Shirika la Haki za Binadamu limeachia waraka hapo Julai 6:

eng: (Idil Eser's) incommunicado detention and that of the other human rights defenders attending a routine training event, is a grotesque abuse of power and highlights the precarious situation facing human rights activists in the country.
swa: kizuizi pasipo mawasiliano kwa (Idil Eser) na wapigania Haki za Binadamu wengine waliokuwa wanahudhuria mafunzo ya kawaida, ni utumizi mbaya uliopitiliza wa sheria na inaonesha ni hali ya namna gani inayowakumba wanaharakati wa Haki za Binadamu nchini.

eng: Idil Eser and those detained with her, must be immediately and unconditionally released.
swa: Idil Eser na wote waliowekwa kizuizini naye, lazima waachiwe huru haraka na bila masharti.

eng: The reaction at home and abroad has been immediate, with Twitter supporters clamoring for the release of the eight advocates, all of whom are experts in their field, using the hashtags #İnsanHaklarıSavunucularınaDokunma and #freehumanrightsdefenders.
swa: Muitikio wa nyumbani na ule wa nje umekuwa wa haraka, na wanaowaunga mkono kupitia Twitter wanashinikiza kuachiliwa kwa wanaharakati hao nane, ambao ni wataalam katika sekta zao wakitumia hashatag za #İnsanHaklarıSavunucularınaDokunma na #freehumanrightsdefenders.

eng: 8 Turkey human rights defenders detained on eve of @JHahnEU Ankara visit.
swa: 8 Wapigania Haki za Binadam wa Uturuki waliwekwa kizuizini katika usiku wa @JHahnEU kutembelea Ankara.

eng: Release them now, drop investigation @omerrcelik @bybekirbozdag pic.twitter.com/QzKXLSolqp — Emma Sinclair-Webb (@esinclairwebb) July 5, 2017
swa: Waachiwe sasa, acha upelelezi @omerrcelik @bybekirbozdag pic.twitter.com/QzKXLSolqp — Emma Sinclair-Webb (@esinclairwebb) July 5, 2017

eng: Locations of all 10 detainees now known - they are in 5 different places.
swa: Imefahamika walipo watu wote 10- wako katika maeneo 5 tofauti.

eng: Now release them all. #insanHaklarıSavunucularınaDokunma — Andrew Gardner (@andrewegardner) July 6, 2017
swa: Sasa waachieni wote. #insanHaklarıSavunucularınaDokunma — Andrew Gardner (@andrewegardner) July 6, 2017

eng: No information is given to lawyers, journalists, and attorneys.
swa: Hakuna taarifa zimetolewa kwa mawakili, wanahabari na wanasheria.

eng: They act as if they just cracked down on some very serious, and very dangerous organization.
swa: Wanajifanya kuwa walivamia shirika fulani hivi muhimu na la hatari sana.

eng: The pro-government news agency Ahaber was quick to denounce the rights defenders as "agents", calling to mind a similar incident that took place before the 15 July 2016 coup attempt in Turkey:
swa: Shirika la habari linaloiunga serikali mkono Ahaber kwa haraka lilianza kukemea wanaharakati hao kama " washirika" wa tukio kama hilo lilitokea 15 Julai 2016 kabla ya jaribio la mapinduzi nchini Uturuki:

eng: ON THE HUNT FOR AGENTS A group of 17 people, consisting mostly of foreigners, checked in at a hotel in Buyukada on July 15.
swa: KWENYE MAWINDO YA WASHIRIKA Kundi la watu wapatao 17, likiwa na raia wa kigeni, walipanga kwenye hoteli ya Buyakada mnamo 15 Julai.

eng: They held meetings for two days.
swa: Walifanya mkutano kwa siku mbili.

eng: One of the participants who attracted the most attention was a CIA employee, American professor Henry Barkey.
swa: Mmoja wa washiriki aliyevuta hisia za wengi ni mtumishi wa CIA, Profesa wa ki-Marekani Henry Barkey.

eng: Ahaber referred to the training event as "reminiscent of a meeting ahead of July 15," but did not offer any details about the who attended the supposed meeting last year.
swa: Ahaber ilisema tukio la uwezeshaji ni kama "ukumbusho wa kikao kilichofanyika Julai 15," lakini hawakutoa dondoo zaid kuhusu nani aliyehudhuria mkutano huo wa mwaka jana.

eng: Turkey's AKP (Justice and Development Party) leadership is routinely accused of using last year's coup attempt as a justification for purging the government of non-loyalists and dissolving what remains of civil society and independent media in the country.
swa: Uongozi wa Chama cha AKP (Justice and Development Party) nchini Uturuki wameendelea kutuhumiwa kutumia jaribio la mapinduzi la mwaka jana kama haki ya kuisafisha serikali ya watu wasio waaminifu na kuvunja masalia ya jumuiya za kiraia na vyombo huru vya habari nchini.

eng: The country remains in a condition of "emergency rule" that grants broad powers to security services.
swa: Nchi imebaki katika "hali ya hatari" inayotoa wigo mpana kwa mamlaka za ulinzi.

eng: Responding to the story in Abaher, one of Turkey's best-known lawyers tweeted:
swa: Akijibu habari ikiyotolewa na Abaher, mmoja wa wanasheria mashuhuri nchini Uturuki aliandika hivi huko Twitter:

eng: In this country, anyone can be announced being a terrorist at any time.
swa: Ndani ya nchi hii, mtu yeyote anaweza kutajwa kama gaidi saa yoyote.

eng: Even those who have those have only protected the right to life and living.
swa: Hata wale ambao wamekuwa wakiilinda haki ya kuishi.

eng: The people mentioned in this news story are people who have dedicated their lives to human rights.
swa: Watu waliotajwa katika habari hii ni watu ambao wameyatoa maisha yao katika Haki za Binadamu.

eng: A day will come when they will stand for the rights of those behind these vile news stories.
swa: Siku itakuja pale watakaposimama kwa ajili ya haki za hao walio nyuma ya habari hii ovu.

eng: Turkish pro govt media smears detained human rights defenders as "agents" - a lie we have seen so many times before https://t.co/120mEQaJ5j — Emma Sinclair-Webb (@esinclairwebb) July 6, 2017
swa: Chombo cha habari kinachoiunga mkono serikali ya Uturuki kimewachafua wapigania haki za binadamu kwa kuwaita "washirika" -uongo ambao tumeuona mara nyingi sana kabla https://t.co/120mEQaJ5j — Emma Sinclair-Webb (@esinclairwebb) July 6, 2017

eng: The detentions occurred on the eve of EU Commissioner Johannes Hahn's July 6 visit to Ankara to discuss Turkey's troubled accession bid, after the European parliament called for a suspension of negotiations.
swa: Kizuizi hiki kilifanywa usiku wa Julai 6 pale Kamishina wa Umoja wa Ulaya Johannes Hahn alipotembela Ankara kujadili kuhusu jitihada zilizokwama za kukabidhi madaraka, baada ya Bunge la Ulaya kutaka kusimamishwa kwa majadiliano hayo.

eng: At a time when almost all the news about Puerto Rico in mainstream media is firmly focussed on the island's fiscal and economic woes, the deluge of negative headlines making the rounds on social media can feel overwhelming.
swa: Katika wakati ambao karibu kila habari kuhusu Puerto Rico kwenye vyombo vikuu vya habari inahusiana zaidi na kudorora kwa uchumi na ukosefu wa fedha kisiwani humo, wingi vya vichwa hasi vya habari vinavyosambazwa kwenye mitandao ya kijamii inaweza kumchosha mtu.

eng: The Juice Media, a Facebook page which specializes in satire, created a video about what it believes to be the root cause of many of Puerto Rico's troubles and disadvantages: US colonialism.
swa: The Juice Media, ukurasa wa Facebook ambao hujikita kwenye habari za mizaha, ulitengeneza video inayohusiana na kile wanachoamini ni mzizi wa matatizo na changamoto nyingi za Puerto Rico: Ukoloni wa Marekani.

eng: Widely shared on Facebook, its creators were encouraged to produce the clip after the success of a similar video about Hawai'i in their "Honest Government Advert" series.
swa: Ikiwa imesambazwa mno kwenye mtandao wa Facebook, watengenezaji wake walitiwa moyo kutengeneza kipande baada ya mafanikio ya video kama hiyo kuhusu Hawai'i katika mfululizo wao wa "Matangazo ya Uaminifu Yatolewayo na Serikali".

eng: The video summarizes some of the ways the US government has historically exploited Puerto Rico, from using it as a bombing practice site for decades, to sterilizing over a third of Puerto Rican women without their knowledge or consent in the mid-twentieth century.
swa: Video hiyo inatoa muhtasari wa baadhi ya njia ambazo serikali ya Marekani imekuwa ikizitumia kihistoria kuinyonya Puerto Rico, kuanzia kwenye kuituia nchi hiyo kama eneo la kujaribishia mabomu kwa miongo kadhaa, mpaka kuwafunga kizazi zaidi ya theluthi ya wanawake wa Puerto Rican bila wao kujua au kuwaomba ridhaa katikati ya karne ya kumi na mbili.

eng: The cheery presenter in the clip begins:
swa: Mtangazaji wa kipande hicho mwenye bashasha anaanza kwa kusema:

eng: Fortunately, however, few know about the real Puerto Rico, a Territory of the United States since 1898 when we seized it from the Spanish who in turn stole it from the Taino Which makes Puerto Ricans US citizens—well second-class citizens… despite fighting in every one of our wars they still can’t vote for President and have no representation in Congress.
swa: Kwa bahati nzuri, hata hivyo, wachache wanafahamu Puerto Rico ya kwenye, koloni la Marekani tangu 1898 baada ya kuwanyang'anya wa-Hispania ambao nao waliliiba kutoka Taino na kuwafanya raia wa Puerto Rico kuwa raia wa Marekani —raia daraja la pili hata hivyo… pamoja na kupigana kila vita yetu bado hawawezi kuchagua Rais na hawana uwakilishi kwenye Baraza la Kongresi.

eng: In other words, US citizens who have f*-all say in the laws the US Government makes for them...
swa: Kwa maneno mengine, raia wa Marekani ambao wametufanyia kila ujinga wana kauli kuptia sheria ambazo Serikali ya Marekani inawatungia...

eng: The video can be watched in full below:
swa: Video hii inaweza kutazamwa kikamilifu hapa chini:

eng: Residents of Warsaw gathered in front of the Presidential Palace.
swa: Wakazi wa Warsaw wakiwa wamekusanyika mbele ya Ikulu.

eng: Photo by Anna Gotowska, CC-BY.
swa: Picha na Anna Gotowska, CC-BY.

eng: 2017 marks a century since the establishment of the Polish Supreme Court, but instead of celebrating, Poles are taking to the streets in defense of the country's independent judiciary.
swa: Mwaka 2017 ni karne moja tangu kuundwa kwa mahakama kuu ya Poland, lakini badala ya kusherehekea wa-Poland wanaandamana barabarani kwa ajili ya kutetea Uhuru wa mahakama.

eng: And now the ruling party has its eyes on the Supreme Court.
swa: Na sasa chama tawala kimeyaelekeza macho yake kwa Mahakama Kuu.

eng: A set of legislative changes, introduced last week and voted to a parliamentary committee on July 18, provides for an on-the-spot purge of the entire cadre of Poland’s highest appellate panel, which consists of 83 top judges.
swa: Mabadiliko kadhaa ya kisheria yalifanyika wiki iliyopita na kupigiwa kura na kamati ya bunge Julai 18, ambayo yaliwaondoa papo hapo watumishi wa kada ya juu ya jopo la rufaa nchini Poland, ambapo lina majaji wa juu 83.

eng: The dismissals would take place one day after the law’s promulgation.
swa: Watu hao wataondolewa siku moja baada ya sheria hiyo kupitishwa.

eng: The only exceptions are to be made by the minister of justice, also a member of Law and Justice.
swa: Upendeleo pekee utafanywa na Waziri wa Sheria, pia mwanachama wa Sheria na Haki.

eng: The aforementioned National Council of Judiciary, under the influence of the party, will then fill the empty seats.
swa: Baraza la Sheria la Taifa lililotajwa hapo kabla, chini ya mamlaka ya chama litajaza nafasi itakazoachwa wazi.

eng: The revamped Supreme Court would have final appeal powers over all civil and criminal cases.
swa: Mahakama Kuu iliyofanyiwa marekebisho itakuwa na mamlaka ya mwisho juu ya rufaa zote za madai ya kiraia na kesi za jinai.

eng: The bill also provides for the establishment of the new Disciplinary Chamber within the Supreme Court, which will make final determinations on disciplinary actions against all judges in the country.
swa: Muswada huo pia unatoa mwanya wa kuundwa kwa kitengo cha nidhamu ndani ya mahakama Kuu, ambacho kitakuwa kikisimamia na kuchukua hatua dhidi ya makosa yote yatakayofanywa na majaji wa nchi nzima.

eng: In a surprise move on July 18, as the bill was being debated, President Andrzej Duda, a former member of Law and Justice party, announced he will not sign the bill regulating the Supreme Court until his new amendments to the National Council of Judiciary bill passed the week before were incorporated.
swa: Kwa namna ya kushangaza, wakati muswada ukiendelea kujadiliwa hapo Julai 18, Rais Andrzej Duda, mwanachama wa zamani wa Chama cha Sheria na Haki, alitangaza kuwa hatatia saini muswada unaodhibiti Mahakama Kuu mpaka pale marekebisho ya muswada wake mpya dhidi ya Baraza la Sheria la Taifa uliopitishwa wiki moja kabla utakapokubaliwa.

eng: These amendments provide that the members of the council are to be elected by a three-fifths parliamentary majority, instead of the ordinary majority suggested by the original bill, making it much harder for Law and Justice representatives to elect their candidates.
swa: Marekebisho haya yanatoa muongozo kuwa wanachama wa baraza lazima wachaguliwe na tatu ya tano ya wabunge wote, badala ya mapendekezo ya awali ya muswada huo, na hii inafanya iwe vigumu zaidi kwa wawakilishi wa Haki na Sheria kuchagua wagombea wao.

eng: However, many consider the new law to be unconstitutional and argue that the president's proposal, if adopted, wouldn't change that fact.
swa: Hata hivyo, wengine wanadhani kuwa sheria mpya haipo kikatiba na kusema pendekezo la Rais likipokelewa hakuna kitakachobadilika.

eng: In response, the residents of Warsaw and other major Polish cities took to the streets urging the president to veto the bill entirely.
swa: Kwa kuyajibu hayo, wakazi wa Warsaw na miji mingine mikuu ya Poland waliingia mitaani wakimtaka Rais apeleke muswada huo kwenye kura ya veto.

eng: The gatherings were a continuation of demonstrations that began over the weekend and grew more massive on the day the parliament was debating the controversial bill.
swa: Makusanyiko hayo yalikuwa muendelezo wa maandamano yaliyoanza mwishoni mwa juma na kuongezeka zaidi siku bunge lilipokuwa linajadili kuhusu muswada huo wenye utata.

eng: Warsaw rally for #democracy and #ruleoflaw in #Poland continues...
swa: Mbio za Warsaw kwa ajili ya #demokrasia na #utawalawasheria ndani ya #Poland inaendelea...

eng: Candles symbolise hope for freedom and a better future. pic.twitter.com/QizU5OCZdp — Bartosz T. Wieliński (@Bart_Wielinski) July 18, 2017
swa: Mishumaa ni ishara ya tumaini la Uhuru na maisha bora yajayo. pic.twitter.com/QizU5OCZdp — Bartosz T. Wieliński (@Bart_Wielinski) Julai 18, 2017

eng: A heated discussion in the Parliament lasted almost until midnight, with the opposing minority trying to stop the Supreme Court bill from being passed.
swa: Mjadala motomoto ndani ya Bunge ulidumu mpaka usiku wa manane, kukiwa na kundi dogo linalopinga kupitishwa kwa muswada wa Mahakama Kuu.

eng: The final vote is expected to take place on July 19.
swa: Kura za mwisho inatarajiwa zitapigwa hapo Julai 19.

eng: Bobi Wine at one of his rallies.
swa: Bobi Wine akiwa kwenye moja wapo ya mikutano yake.

eng: Photo courtesy of Bobi Wine's official Facebook page.
swa: Picha ya ukurasa rasmi wa Facebook wa Bobi Wine.

eng: Used with permission. Wine is not new to activism.
swa: Wine si mgeni kwenye shughuli za harakati.

eng: His music has for a while been focused on social justice issues.
swa: Muziki wake umekuwa ukijikita kwenye masuala ya haki za raia.

eng: But singing about policy issues is not enough.
swa: Lakini kuimba masuala ya kisera tu haitoshi.

eng: On 29 June, he finally crossed the line to become a policy maker after securing a parliamentary seat in Kyadondo, winning 75% of the votes in a by-election.
swa: Mnamo Juni 29, hatimaye alifanikiwa kuvuka kihunzi na kuwa mtunga sera baada ya kushinda kiti cha ubunge kwa jimbo la Kyadondo, kwa ushindi wa asilimia 75 ya kura zote za uchaguzi huo mdogo.

eng: He began singing about social justice in 2005.
swa: Alianza kuimba masuala ya haki za raia mwaka 2005.

eng: Many top musicians took part in the song that Wine refused to take part in.
swa: Wanamuziki wengi maarufu walishiriki wimbo ambao Wine alikataa kushiriki.

eng: One of his more popular songs, "Ghetto", talks about police brutality against people residing in the slums of Kampala and the inadequate services that delivered to them.
swa: Moja wapo ya nyimbo zake maarufu zaidi, "Ghetto", unazungumzia ukatili wa polisi dhidi ya watu wanaoishi kwenye maeneo ya makazi duni jijini Kampala na kutokuwepo kwa huduma zinazokidhi mahitaji yao.

eng: Wine refers to himself as “The Ghetto President” and “Omubanda Wakabaka,” loosely translated as “The King’s Gang Star”.
swa: Wine anajiita “Rais wa Ghetto” na “Omubanda Wakabaka,” kumaanisha “Mfalme Nyota wa Kijiweni".

eng: He is the fifth person from the country's art fraternity to go into politics, following in the footsteps of Ali Ndawula Wowoto, Sulaiman Madada, Judith Babirye and Kato Lubwama, who now serve as members of parliament.
swa: Amekuwa mtu wa tano kutoka kwenye tasnia ya sanaa kuingia kwenye siasa, akifuata nyayo za Ali Ndawula Wowoto, Sulaiman Madada, Judith Babirye na Kato Lubwama, ambao wote hivi sasa ni wabunge.

eng: His campaign was characterized by music, with large numbers of musicians, radio personalities and TV presenters turning up and using their social media accounts to push his message to the electorate, employing the hashtag #BikwaseKyagulanyi, which means "hand over everything to Kyagulanyi".
swa: Kampeni yake ilipambwa na muziki, akiambatana na idadi kubwa ya wanamuziki, watangazaji wa radio na televisheni ambao kwa pamoja walitumia mitandao ya kijamii kusambaza ujumbe wake kwa wapiga kura, wakitumia alama ishara za #BikwaseKyagulanyi, yenye maana ya "mkabidhini kila kitu Kyagulanyi".

eng: At his final rally, he was arrested by the police, who alleged that Wine was holding the gathering in a wrong venue close to where President Museveni was campaigning for his candidate.
swa: Kwenye mkutano wake wa mwisho, alikamatwa na polisi, waliodai kwamba Wine alikuwa anafanya mkutano kwenye eneo lisilo sahihi karibu na mahali ambapo Rais Museveni alikuwa akimnadi mgombea wake.

eng: The video below by NTV Uganda, a local broadcaster, shows him being detained.
swa: Video hapa chini ya NTV Uganda, kituo cha televisheni nchini humo, inamwonesha akikamatwa.

eng: He pleads with the police, saying he is fighting for people's rights.
swa: Aliwasihi polisi, akisema anachokisema yeye ni kupigania haki za watu.

eng: Nevertheless, he won the by-election handily.
swa: Hata hivyo, alishinda uchaguzi huo mdogo kwa kura nyingi.

eng: He secured 25,659 votes, defeating Sitenda Sebalu, the ruling NRM party candidate, who only received 4,556 votes.
swa: Alipata kura 25,659, alimshinda Sitenda Sebalu, mgombea wa chama tawala cha NRM, aliyeambulia kura 4,556.

eng: Wine's platform focusing on unemployment and other issues that affect youth, who he believes are misrepresented, captured huge amounts of support.
swa: Ilani ya Wine iliyohusu masuala ya ukosefu wa ajira na masuala mengine yanayowagusa vijana, ambao anaamini hawapati uwakilishi wanaoustahili, ilipata uungwaji mkono mkubwa.

eng: After he was announced as the winner of the election, he tweeted to his 28,000 followers that something profound has happened in Uganda's electoral politics.
swa: Bada ya kutangazwa kuwa mshindi, alitwiti kwa wafuasi wake 28,000 kwenye mtandao wa Twitakwamba jambo lisilo la kawaida limetokea kwenye siasa za uchanguzi nchini Uganda.

eng: THE PEOPLE HAVE SPOKEN
swa: WATU WAMESEMA.

eng: This 29th day of June marks a turning point in the politics of our country!
swa: Tarehe ya leo 29 inageuza historia kwenye siasa za nchi yetu!

eng: Ugandans took to social media to congratulate the 35 year-old celebrated artist on his election into Parliament.
swa: Wa-Ganda waliingia kwenye mitandao ya kijamii kumpongeza msanii huyo maarufu mwenye miaka 35 kuchaguliwa kuingia bungeni.

eng: The list of supporters included politicians, musicians and ordinary people on the media platforms.
swa: Orodha ya wanaomwunga mkono ilijumuisha wanasiasa, wanamuziki na watu wa kawaida kwenye majukwaa mbalimbali ya habari.

eng: A few hours before the electoral commission announced the results, NRM Secretary General Justine Lumumba tweeted his message of congratulations:
swa: Masaa machache kabla ya tume ya uchaguzi kutangaza matokeo, Katibu Mkuu wa NRM Justine Lumumba alitwiti ujumbe wake wa kumpongeza:

eng: Congratulations to the people of Kyadondo East, congratulations to @BobiWineOmuband Kyagulanyi Robert Sentamu. — JustineKasuleLumumba (@JustineLumumba) June 29, 2017
swa: Pongezi nyingi kwa watu wa Kyadondo Mashariki, hongera kwa Kyagulanyi Robert Sentamu

eng: And Kizza Besigye, the first runner up in the 2016 presidential campaign, also came out to applauded Bobi Wine's victory; Besigye never campaigned for him as his party had fronted another candidate in the election:
swa: Na Kizza Besigye, mshindani mkubwa kwenye kampeni ya uchaguzi wa Rais wa 2016, alijitokea kufurahia ushindia wa Bobi Wine; Besigye hakuwahi kumfanyia kampeni kwa sababu chama chake kilikuwa kikimwuunga mkono mgombea mwingine kwenye uchaguzi huo:

eng: Landslide victory for the HE Bobi Wine.
swa: Ushindi wa kishindo kwa Mhe Bobi Wine.

eng: Congratulations-PEOPLE POWER!!
swa: Hongera sana-NGUVU YA UMMA!!

eng: That's why Wakiso people weren't allowed to vote 2016. @FDCOfficial1 pic.twitter.com/8wV7HwuQbY — Kifefe Kizza-Besigye (@kizzabesigye1) June 29, 2017
swa: Ndio maana basi watu wa jamii ya Wakiso hawakuruhusiwa kupiga kura kwenye uchaguzi wa mwaka 2016

eng: Fellow artist Jose Chameleone congratulated Bobi Wine on his win:
swa: Msanii mwenzake Jose Chameleone alimpongeza Bobi Wine kwa ushindi wake:

eng: When we believe, We Achieve.
swa: Tunapoamini, Tunapata.

eng: Congrats to Hon. Robert Kyagulanyi,Family,Friends and Kyadondo East for the remarkable victory .
swa: Hongera kwa Mhe Robert Kyagulanyi, Familia, Marafiki na Jimbo la Kyadondo Mashariki kwa ushindi huu muhimu.

eng: Leaders are chosen by God.So, May he guide you as you deliver Kyadondo East to the promised Land.
swa: Viongozi wanachaguliwa na Mungu. Kwa hiyo, Mungu na akulinde unapotekeleza ahadi zako kuiongoza Kyadondo Mshariki kwenda kwenye Nchi ya Ahadi.

eng: Fellow musicians Radio and Weasel also thanked Bobi Wine for his efforts towards giving the poor a voice through his music and now in politics as well: You Have Brought The Ghetto UpTown.
swa: Wanamuziki wenzake Radio na Weasel pia walimpongeza Bobi Wine kwa jitihada zake za kuhakikisha anawapa watu masikini sauti kupitia muziki wake na sasa akiwa ameingia pia kwenye siasa:

eng: A famous pop band in Thailand has released a music video parodying the junta that grabbed power in 2014 and continues to govern the country despite its pledge to restore civilian rule.
swa: Bendi maarufu ya Pop nchini Thailand imeachia video ya muziki ikiigiza mtindo wa Junta ambaye alitwaa madaraka mwaka 2014 na anaendelea kutawala nchi hiyo kinyume na ahadi yake ya kurejesha utawala wa kiraia.

eng: The Tattoo Colour band’s new song ‘Dictator Girl’ (Phadet Girl) is about a young man narrating the rules set for him by his girl.
swa: Wimbo mpya wa Bendi hiyo iitwayo Tattoo Colour ‘Dictator Girl’ unahusiana na kijana anayeelezea sheria zake kwa msichana wake.

eng: While not explicitly about politics, the music video made indirect reference to the continuing military rule.
swa: Ingawa hauhusiani moja kwa moja na siasa, wimbo huo unazungumzia unazungumzia kwa kificho utawala wa kijeshi unaoendelea.

eng: The band was praised by fans and other Internet users for its bravery in depicting the country’s situation.
swa: Bendi hiyo inasifika na mashabiki na watumiaji wengine wa intaneti kwa ujanja wake wa kuielezea hali ya mambo nchini humo.

eng: The song’s video immediately went viral.
swa: Video ya wimbo huo ilitawanyika haraka sana mtandaoni.

eng: As of this writing, the video uploaded on Facebook has already garnered 1,254 shares and 8,800 likes.
swa: Wakati makala hii ikiandaliwa, video hiyo iliyowekwa kwenye mtandao wa Facebook tayari imetumwa mara 1,254 na kuvutia watumiaji 8,800.

eng: Last month, even a Charlie Chaplin video clip, ‘The Dictator’ was blocked in Thailand after an activist group encouraged the public to watch it.
swa: Mwezi uliopita, hata kipande cha video ya Charlie Chaplin, kiitwacho ‘The Dictator’ kilifungiwa nchini Thailand baada ya wanaharakati kuuhamasisha umma kuitazama.

eng: The video can be interpreted as a creative and fun introduction to Thai politics, especially the country’s situation under Junta rule.
swa: Video hiyo inaweza kutafsiriwa kama namna ya kuelezea siasa za Thailand kwa ubunifu na vicheesho, hususani kuhusu mwenendo wa mmabo chini ya utawala wa Junta.

eng: Consider these images in the video that alluded to some of the political issues that have dogged Thailand over the past three years.
swa: Tazama pihca hizi zilizopo kwenye video hiyo zinavyohusiana na masuala ya kisiasa yaliyotokea nchini humo kwa zaidi ya miaka mitatu.

eng: The ‘44 rules by girl’ can be referring to the draconian Section 44 of the Interim Constitution which gave the army chief absolute powers to decide on important national issues.
swa: Sheria 44 za msichana' zinaweza kuwa na maana ya Kifungu cha 44 kwenye Katiba ya Muda kinachompa mamlaka makubwa mkuu wa majeshi kuamua masuala muhimu ya kitaifa.

eng: The 11th rule: ‘Adjust your Attitude’, is about the infamous ‘attitude-adjustment’ sessions given by the army to journalists, students, scholars, activists, politicians, and others perceived to be critical of the junta.
swa: Sheria namba 11: ‘Rekebisha Mtazamo Wako’, inahusiana na is about the infamous ‘attitude-adjustment’ maelekezo ya 'kubadili mtazamo' yaliyotolewa kwa waandishi wa habari, wanafunzi, wanazuoni, wanasiasa, na wengine wanaoonekana kuwa wakosoaji wakubwa wa Junta.

eng: The image above reflects the implementation of the Computer Crimes Act whose vague and overbroad provisions are often used by authorities to detain activists and other critics of the state.
swa: Picha hiyo juu inaashiria utekelezaji wa Sheria ya Makosa ya Mtandao yenye vipengele vyenye tafsiri zisizowazi na pana vinavyotumiwa na serikali kuwakamata wanaharakati na wakosajia wengine wa serikali.

eng: An army unit was set up to monitor online content and prosecute individuals accused of defaming the monarchy.
swa: Kikosi cha jeshi kinafuatilia maudhui ya mtandaonina kuwashitaki watu wanaotuhumiwa kuutukana utawala huo.

eng: Thailand enforces a strict Lese Majeste (anti-Royal Insult) law.
swa: Thailand inatumia sheria ngumu ya Lese Majeste (Matusi dhidi ya Ufalme).

eng: On May 20, 2014, martial law was declared in Thailand.
swa: Mnamo Mei 20, 2014, sheria ya kijeshi ilitangazwa nchini Thailand.

eng: Two days later, the army staged a coup.
swa: Siku mbili baadae, jeshi lilifanya mapinduzi.

eng: One of the issues hounding the junta is its decision to buy expensive submarines despite security analysts warning the purchase was unnecessary and a waste of taxpayers’ money.
swa: Moja wapo ya masuala yanayokwamisha utawala wa Junta ni uamuzi wake wa kununua nyambizi ghali bila kujali wachambuzi wa usalama walioonya kwamba ununuzi huo haukuwa wa lazima na ulikuwa ni upotevu wa bure wa fedha za walipa kodi.

eng: Even the case of individuals kidnapped and thrown inside a black van before being sent to detention camps was depicted in the video.
swa: Hata suala la watu waliotekwa na kutupwa ndani ya gari jeusi kabla ya kupelekwa kwenye makambi ya utesaji lilionekana kwenye video hiyo.

eng: Media continues to face serious restrictions; some journalists have been jailed for allegedly causing "confusion" in society, and Internet users face long prison terms if they insult the monarchy.
swa: Vyombo vya habari vinaendelea kukabiliana na sheria kali; baadhi ya waandishi wa habari wamewekwa ndani kwa kudaiwa kusababisha "mtafaruku" kwenye jamii, na watuaji wa Intaneti wanakabiliwa na vifungo virefu gerezani kama watautukana utawala wa nchi hiyo.

eng: Meanwhile, the promotional teaser of the song featured members of the band doing the 'Hunger Games' salute which was used by anti-coup activists during protest actions in 2014.
swa: Wakati huo huo, tangazo la kuutambuliza wimbo huo unaonesha waimbaji wa bendi hiyo wakitoa ishara ya heshima kwa wimbo wa 'Hunger Games' iliyotumiwa na wanaharakati wanaopinga mapinduzi wakati wa maandamano ya mwaka 2014.

swa: Colombo, Sri Lanka.

eng: The 2017 Global Voices Summit is open for registration!
swa: Mkutano Mkuu wa Global Voices 2017 uko wazi kwa ajili ya kujiandikisha!

eng: We'll be gathering this year in Colombo, Sri Lanka on December 2-3 to discuss the evolving state of the open Internet, online civic movements and human rights in the digital age.
swa: Tutakuwa tukikutana mwaka huu jijini Colombo, Sri Lanka mnamo Desemba 2-3 kujadili mabadiliko ya hali ya mtandao huru, harakati huru za kiraia mtandao na haki za binadamu katika zama za kidijitali.

eng: In interactive sessions, panels, and debates, we will explore issues ranging from misinformation/disinformation, to corporate control of the internet, to legal threats against bloggers and activists—all challenges that could make or break the future of the internet.
swa: Katika vipindi, majopo, na midahalo, tutaangazia masuala kama upotoshwaji wa taarifa, kudhibitiwa kwa mtandao, matishio ya kisheria dhidi ya wanablogu na wanaharakati -changamoto hizi zinazochangia kuharibu au kujenga mustakabali wa mtandao wa intaneti.

eng: Joining us will be communities and organizations central to the history and future of the open internet, both globally and regionally, including Creative Commons, Mozilla, Wikipedia, the Web Foundation, the Association of Progressive Communications, IFEX, the MIT Media Lab, the Digital Asia Hub, in addition to the leading lights of Sri Lanka’s internet culture, and many others.
swa: Watakaoungana nasi watakuwa ni wanajamii na mashirika yanayohusika kwa karibu na historia na mustakabali wa mtandao huru wa intaneti, duniani kote au kwa maeneo husika, ikiwa ni pamoja na Creative Commons, Mozilla, Wikipedia, Web Foundation, Association of Progressive Communications, IFEX, MIT Media Lab, Digital Asia Hub, yote hayo yakitanguliwa na utamaduni wa intaneti nchini Sri Lanka, pamoja na wengi wengineo.

eng: The Summit will take place at TRACE Expert City, a technology hub and incubator in Colombo's Maradana district.
swa: Mkutano utafanyikia TRACE Expert City, kituo cha teknolojia kilichopo kwenye wilaya ya Maradana jijini Colombo.

eng: Visit our registration page to reserve your spot at the Global Voices Summit 2017, and keep checking in on the Summit web site over the coming weeks as we develop the Summit programme and post stories, audio and interviews.
swa: Tembelea ukurasa wetu wa kujiandikisha ili kujiwekea nafasi kwenye ratiba ya Mkutano Mkuu wa Global Voices 2017, na endelea kuchungulia tovuti ya Mkutano kwa majuma machache yajayo kadri tunavyoendelea kuweka ratiba kamili ya Mkutano na habari, sauti na mahojiano.

eng: We’ll see you in December!
swa: Tutaonana nawe Desemba!
