eng: Tanzanian President John Magufuli has called for teen mothers who get pregnant while they are still in school to be banned from returning once they have given birth.
swa: Rais wa Tanzania Mheshimiwa John Magufuli amepiga marufuku wanafunzi wa kike kuendelea na masomo mara baada ya kujifungua.

eng: Speaking at a rally in Chalinze, a small town in the eastern region of Pwani, President Magufuli chastised NGOs in Tanzania for encouraging teenage mothers to go back to school, stating that they were "finishing the country" and leading to a state of "moral decay" in Tanzania:
swa: Akiongea katika mkutano wa hadhara huko Chalinze, mji mdogo Mashariki ya Pwani, Rais Magufuli aliyakemea mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali Tanzania kwa harakati zao za kutaka wasichana wanaopata mimba katika umri mdogo kuendelea na masomo baada ya uzazi: Akikiri kwamba kitendo hiki kinaliangamiza taifa na kuchangia mmomonyoko wa maadili

eng: If a girl gets pregnant, if it is deliberate or by accident, gives birth and then returns to school, she will teach these others who haven’t given birth that this is okay.
swa: Kama msichana akipata mimba, iwe ni makusudi au kwa bahati mbaya, akazaa na akarui tena shuleni, atawafundisha na wengine.

eng: The same girl can then go again and get pregnant, give birth and go back to school. And again for a third time.
swa: Halafu akipata mimba ya pili, azae na arudi tena shuleni. na tena kwa awamu ya tatu.

eng: Are we educating parents?
swa: Je, tunasomesha wazazi?

eng: The president added that teen moms attending either primary or secondary school would be banned from going back once they have given birth:
swa: Sambamba na hilo, Mheshimiwa Raisi alipiga marufuku wanafunzi watakaozaa kabla hawajamaliza elimu ya sekondari kuendelea na masomo:

eng: I want to tell them, and those NGOs as well, that during my administration, no girl who has given birth will be allowed to go back to school .
swa: Nataka niwaambie, na hayo mashirika yasio ya kiserikali wasikie kwamba, katika kipindi hichi cha utawala wangu, hakuna msichana atakaezaa na kupewa nafasi ya kurudi shuleni kwa awamu ya pili.

eng: The president went on to say that teen mothers could go elsewhere if they want to get an education, such as the Vocational Educational and Training Authority, or even taking up farming.
swa: Akishauri kwamba yapo mambo mengi ya kufanya ukiacha shule, kama vyuo vya ufundi na stadi za maisha, au hata kilimo.

eng: The announcement sparked outrage on social media, with Tanzanians using the #ArudiShule (return to school) hashtag to criticize the move, especially considering that over 8,000 Tanzanian girls drop out of school every year due to pregnancy according to a Human Rights Watch report.
swa: Tamko hili la Rais lilienea katika mitandao ya kijamii, na idadi kubwa ya Watanzania wakitumia alama habari ya #ArudiShule kupinga wazo hilo, ukizingatia idadi kubwa ya wasichana wa Kitanzania wapatao 8,000 wanaositisha masomo yao kwa sababu ya ujauzito kulingana n ripoti ya haki za binadamu.

eng: So, the question is, do student-mothers influence other students' reproductive behaviour?
swa: Je, ni kweli wanafunzi waliozaa wanaweza kuathiri tabia za wengine pindi wanaporejea mshuleni?

eng: PesaCheck has researched the issue, with input from citizen-centered initiative Twaweza, and finds that President Magufuli’s statement is MISLEADING for the following reasons:
swa: PesaCheck imefanya utafiti juu ya swala hili, kwa kuanzisha chombo cha kujitegemea kwa wananchi kiitwacho Twaweza, na kugundua kwamba tamko la Mheshimiwa Raisi linakiuka yafuatayo:

eng: Causes of adolescent pregnancies
swa: Sababu za mimba za utotoni

eng: According to the Tanzania Health and Demographic Survey (THDS) 2015–16 the rate of adolescent pregnancies in mainland Tanzania is considerably high at 27%.
swa: Kufuatana na tafiti za Shirika la Afya na Makazi mwaka (THDS) 2015–16 idadi ya mimba za utotoni Tanzania bara imeongezeka kwa asilimia 27.

eng: What factors contribute to this figure?
swa: Je, ni sababu zipi zimechangia ongezeko hili?

eng: A publication by HakiElimu found citizens opinion on the key contributors to teen pregnancies includes low household income.
swa: Makala ya HakiElimu baada ya kupitia mawazo ya wananchi juu ya hili iligundua kwamba miongoni mwa sababu ya ongezeko hilo ni kipato duni cha mwananchi.

eng: The publication states that nearly 31% of the respondents (including parents and teenage girls) thought that poverty was a key factor, with difficult economic situations driving parents to marry off their children as they are not able to meet the basic needs of the female children.
swa: Makala hiyo inasema kwamba asilimia 31 ya wahusika (wakiwemo wazazi na mabinti wenye ummri wa kubalehe) wamefikiri kwamba sabu ni umaskini, hali ngumu ya uchumi imepelekea wazazi kuwaozesha mabinti zao kwa sababu wameshindwa kuwatimizia mahitaji yao muhimu.

eng: The THDS report also shows that fertility varies with economic levels, decreasing with increasing household wealth.
swa: Ripoti ya THDS inaonyesha kwamba idadi ya watoto wanaozaliwa hubadilika kutegemeana na ngazi za kiuchumi, hupungua pale uchumi wa watu unapoongezeka.

eng: Wealthier households also have a higher age at first birth, meaning that poorer households are more likely to have younger mothers, most likely of schoolgoing age.
swa: Wenye uchumi wa juu huwa na umri mkubwa pale wanapopata wazawa wao kwa kwanza, ni dhahiri kwamba mama masikini huwa na umri mdogo pengine umri ambao wangetakiwa wawe wanajiendeleza kimasomo.

eng: Corroborating this fact, a UNICEF report shows that one in six young women aged 15–19 is married in Tanzania.
swa: Sambamba na hilo, ripoti ya UNICEF inaonesha kwamba moja kati ya wasichana sita wa Kitanzania wenye umri kati ya miaka 15 hadi 19 ameolewa.

eng: These girls get affected psychologically, meaning that many of them are unable to return to school once they drop out.
swa: Wasichana hawa wanaathirika kisaikolojia , yaani wengi wao huwa hawpti nafasi za kujiendeleza kimasomo bada ya haya.

eng: Another factor in the HakiElimu publication was “poor upbringing and teenage girls own personal desires”.
swa: Sababu nyingine iliyotolewa na makala ya HakiElimu ni "malezi mabaya ya hawa wasichana kitendo kinachosababisha wasichana kushindwa kujizuia katika hali ya matamanio yao.”

eng: They found that some parents don’t spend time on their children’s morals and upbringing.
swa: Wakigundua kwamba wazazi wengi hawana muda wa kuzungumza na kufuatilia maadili ya watoto wao pale wanapofikia umri wa kupevuka.

eng: Another finding was the lack of reproductive education which helps teens to fully understand puberty.
swa: Kuna pia suala la kukosekana kwa elimu ya uzazi.

eng: “A lot of parents in villages don’t speak to their female children who are going through puberty.”
swa: “Wazazi wengi huwa hawazungumzi na mabinti zao wanapovunja ungo.”

eng: TDHS 2015 data shows that over half of women already experience sex before the age of 16.
swa: Takwimu za TDHS 2015 zinaonyesha kwamba nusu ya wasichana hushiriki ngono chini ya umri wa miaka 16.

eng: The HakiElimu report also found another contributing factor to be the societal view of a girls child’s value is in being married and being a mother.
swa: Ripoti hiyo ya HakiElimu ilisema kwamba mtazamo wa jamii pia juu ya thamani ya mtoto wa kike kuwa yeye ni mtu wa kuolewa tu, kuzaa na kuwa mama ilichangia kwa namna moja au nyingine katika hili.

eng: The TDHS 2015–16 report shows that fertility rates are strongly related to the level of education. It states that women with no education have 3.3 times more children than women with secondary education.
swa: Ripoti ya TDHS 2015–16 imeonyesha kwamba ongezeko la watoto wanaozaliwa linategemeana sana na kiwango cha elimu ikimaanisha kwamba wanawake ambao hawajaenda shule wana uwezekano wa kuwa na watoto mara 3.3 ikilinganishwa na wale walioko shule.

eng: Adolescent women with no education are 5 times more likely to have begun childbearing compared to those with secondary or higher education.
swa: Wanawake ambao hawana elimu wana uwezekano wa kuzaa mara tano zaaidi ya wale waliohitimi masomo ya sekondari au elimu ya juu.

eng: TDHS 2010 as stated in the UNICEF report (p.12) found that for a majority of the girls who give birth while they are “still children themselves” are in fact not in school.
swa: TDHS mwaka 2010 sambamba na ripoti ya UNICEF (p.12) iligundua kwamba kundi kubwa la wasichana huzaa wakiwa bado na umri mdogo huwa hawapo mashuleni.

eng: Are student-mothers key influencers of adolescent pregnancies?
swa: Je, wasichana hawa ndio kichocheo cha mimba mashuleni?

eng: According to the THDS, Zanzibar has a significantly low rate of adolescent pregnancies at 8% compared to mainland Tanzania.
swa: Kulingana na THDS, Zanzibar inaongoza kwa kuwa na asilimia ndogo ya mimba za utotoni ukilinganisha na asilimia 8 bara.

eng: Zanzibar introduced a return to school policy in 2010 as a measure to reduce dropouts.
swa: Zanzibar ilianzisha kauli mbiu ya arejee shuleni mwaka 2010 kama hili.

eng: Kenya is just in between Tanzania mainland and Zanzibar with 18% adolescent pregnancies.
swa: Kenya iko kati ya Tanzania bara na Zanzibar kwa asilimia 18% ya mimba za utotoni.

eng: In both these places student mothers are going to school and the adolescent fertility is much lower.
swa: Na katika maeneo yote husika wanafunzi wnaojifungua hurejea mashuleni na bado hawajtufiki katika hili l kuongoza kutoa wasichn wengi wenye mimba za utotoni.

eng: Therefore the statement that student mothers returning to school will influence other students and lead to a rise in teenage pregnancies is MISLEADING.
swa: Kwa hivyo kusema kwamba kitendo cha kuwarejesha mashuleni ni kuchochea mimba za utotoni ni upotoshaji.

eng: Most research around adolescent pregnancies attribute teen pregnancies to economic factors and the community attitude and upbringing of female children.
swa: Tafiti zimefanyika na sababu kuu za mimba za utotoni ni uchumi mbovu na kukosekana kwa malezi bora na uwajibikaji wa wazazi kwa mabinti zetu.

eng: Do you want us to fact-check something a politician or other public figure has said about public finances?
swa: Je unahitaji kuthibitisha habari zilizosemwa na mwanasiasa au kiongozi yeyote wa uma kuhusu masuala ya fedha?

eng: Fill this form, or reach out to us on any of the contacts below, and we’ll help ensure you’re not getting bamboozled.
swa: Jaza fomu hii, au wasiliana nasi kwa kutumia mawasiliano haya hapa chini, na tutahakikisha hukatishwi tamaa.

eng: This report was written by PesaCheck Fellow Mwegelo Kapinga, a development consultant, researcher and writer.
swa: Ripoti hii iliandikwa na Mshirika wa PesaCheck Mwegelo Kapinga, mshauri mwelekezi wa maendeleo, mtafiti na mwandishi.

eng: Mwegelo has previously worked for Twaweza East Africa as a research analyst.
swa: Mwegelo amefanya kazi na Twaweza Afrika Mashariki kama mchambuzi wa tafiti.

eng: The infographics are by PesaCheck Fellow Brian Wachanga, who is a Kenyan civic technologist interested in data visualisation.
swa: Picha ya takwimu imetengenezwa na Mshirika kwa PesaCheckBrian Wachanga, ambaye ni mwanateknolojia ya kiraia wa Kenya anayependa kutengeneza takwimu zionekane vyema kwa macho.

eng: This report was edited by PesaCheck Managing Editor Eric Mugendi.
swa: Ripoti hii ilihaririwa na Mhariri Mtendaji wa PesaCheck Eric Mugendi.

eng: PesaCheck, co-founded by Catherine Gicheru, is East Africa’s first fact-checking initiative.
swa: PesaCheck, iliyoanzishwa na Catherine Gicheru, ni mradi kwanza Afrika Mashariki unaothibitisha taarifa.

eng: It seeks to help the public separate fact from fiction in public pronouncements about the numbers that shape our world, with a special emphasis on pronouncements about public finances that shape government’s delivery of so-called ‘Sustainable Development Goals’ or SDG public services, such as healthcare, rural development and access to water / sanitation.
swa: Lengo lake ni kuwasaidia wananchi kupambanua ukweli na hisia kutokana kutangazwa kwa takwimu zinazoathiri dunia yetu, uzito ukiwa kwenye matangazo yanayohusu fedha za umma zinazoathiri utekelezajiwa kile kinachoitwa "Malengo Endelevu ya Milenia" au huduma za umma za SDG, kama vile afya, maendeleo vijijini na upatikanaji wa maji.

eng: PesaCheck also tests the accuracy of media reportage.
swa: Pesachecki pia inatafiti umakini wa habari zinazotangazwa na vyombo vya habari.

eng: To find out more about the project, visit pesacheck.org.
swa: Kufahamu zaidi kuhusu mradi huu, tembelea pesacheck.org.

eng: Peace TV network is suspended for one month.
swa: Peace TV imefungiwa kwa mwezi mmoja.

eng: Image from the Southeast Asian Press Alliance, used with permission.
swa: Picha kutoka Shirikisho la Muungano wa Vyombo vya Habari la Kusini Mashariki ya Asia, imetumika kwa ruhusa.

eng: Thailand’s National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) has suspended for one month the license of a TV network which has been criticizing the policies of the military-led government.
swa: Tume ya Taifa ya Habari Thailand (NBTC) imekinyang'anya leseni kwa mwezi mmoja kituo kimoja cha televisheni ambacho kimekuwa kikikosoa sera za serikali inayoongozwa kijeshi.

eng: Signed on August 9, 2017, the NBTC order will take effect once the letter is delivered to the Peace TV network.
swa: Ikiwa imesainiwa hapo Agosti 9, 2017, amri ya NBTC itaanza kufanyiwa kazi pale barua itakapofikiswa kwa Mtandao wa Peace TV.

eng: Peace TV is affiliated to the United Front Against Dictatorship for Democracy, a group also known as "red shirts" whose prominent leaders are supporters of former Prime Minister Thaksin Shinawatra.
swa: Peace TV ina uhusiano na Muungano wa Kidemokrasia Dhidi ya Udikteta (UFDD) kundi linalojulikana pia kama "Shati Jekundu" ambalo viongozi wake wakuu ni wanaomuunga mkono Waziri Mkuu wa zamani Thaksin Shinawatra.

eng: Some “red shirts” are also known critics of the Lese Majeste (anti-Royal Insult) law, which the government has been using to prosecute activists and anti-junta politicians.
swa: Baadhi ya "shati jekundu" wanafahamika kama wakosoaji wa sheria ya Lese Majeste (kinyume na watukanaji wa Mfalme), ambayo serikali imekuwa ikiitumia kuwahukumu wanaharakati na wanasiasa walio kinyume na Junta.

eng: Thailand’s army grabbed power in 2014 and has remained in power through a constitution it drafted.
swa: Jeshi la Thailand lilinyakua mamlaka mwaka 2014 na limebakia madarakani kupitia katiba iliyoitengeneza.

eng: It vowed to restore civilian rule once political and electoral reforms have been implemented.
swa: Liliapa kurudisha mamlaka ya kiraia pale marekebisho ya kisiasa na uchaguzi yatakapo tekelezwa.

eng: Since 2014, the junta has strictly regulated the media and arrested Internet users accused of defaming authorities.
swa: Tangu 2014, junta wamekuwa wakividhibiti vyombo vya habari na kuwakamata watumiaji wa mitandao ya intaneti wakituhumiwa kwa kutukana mamlaka.

eng: NBTC said Peace TV violated the law when it aired two programs in July that undermined the constitutional monarchy, national security and "good morality."
swa: NBTC ilisema kuwa Peace TV ilivunja sheria pale iliporushwa vipindi vilivyoidharau Mamlaka ya Kifalme ya Kikatiba, usalama wa Taifa na "Maadili mema" hapo Julai.

eng: However, it didn’t specify which parts of the programs have incited the public to oppose the government.
swa: Hata hivyo, haikubainisha ni sehemu zipi za vipindi hivyo zilizochochea umma kuipinga serikali.

eng: This is the third time that Peace TV has been suspended by the NBTC.
swa: Hii ni mara ya tatu kwa Peace TV kufungiwa kurusha matangazo na NBTC.

eng: It was previously suspended in April 2015 and July 2016 for allegedly threatening national security.
swa: Kipindi kilichopita ilikuwa ni Aprili 2015 na Julai 2016 kwa madai ya kutishia usalama wa nchi.

eng: Some believe Peace TV was suspended because it dared to call former army chief and now Prime Minister Prayut Chan-o-cha a dictator:
swa: Baadhi wanaamini kuwa Peace TV ilifungiwa kwa sababu ilidhubutu kumuita Waziri Mkuu wa zamani Prayut Chan-o-cha dikteta:

eng: #Thailand authorities slap @peacetvnews with 30-day ban for calling #junta leader Gen Prayut "dictator". #censorship pic.twitter.com/32RaKf8wDy — Sunai (@sunaibkk) August 10, 2017
swa: Mamlaka za #Thailand zimeipiga kofi @peacetvnews kwa kuwafungia kwa siku 30 kwa kumuita kiongozi wa #junta Gen Prayut "dikteta". #censorship pic.twitter.com/32RaKf8wDy — Sunai (@sunaibkk) August 10, 2017

eng: The Southeast Asian Press Alliance questioned the harsh ruling of the NBTC since it will affect all programs and employees of the TV network:
swa: Shirikisho la Muungano wa Vyombo vya Habari la Kusini Mashariki ya Asia lilihoji kuhusu uongozi mkali wa NBTC kwa sababu itaathiri vipindi vyote na watumishi wa Kituo hicho cha televishenil:

eng: We see the suspension order as too severe, given that the NBTC has identified specific programming on specific dates that it deemed violating Thailand broadcasting laws.
swa: Tunaona amri ya kufungiwa ilikuwa kali mno, hasa kwa kuwa NBTC ilivitambua vipindi maalum na tarehe maalum viliporushwa hewani na kuvunja sheria za habari za Thailand.

eng: The order punishes the entire station including all programs regardless of content, and all personnel regardless of role.
swa: Amri inawaadhibu kituo kizima vikiwamo vipindi vyote bila kujali mahudhui, na watumishi wote bila kujali majukumu yao.

eng: The group also warned that the NBTC order will lead to the further curtailment of press freedom in Thailand:
swa: Kundi hili lilionya pia kuwa amri ya NBTC itaenda mpaka katika udhibiti wa Uhuru wa Vyombo vya Habari Thailand:

eng: Such broad and sweeping powers, especially under a regular law must be used with restraint and proportionality, considering that it can set precedents to be used to potentially infringe on freedom of the press and the public’s right to know and hear all sides of the political discourse in Thai society.
swa: Mamlaka pana na yenye kufagia kama hii hasa chini ya sheria za mara kwa mara lazima itumike kwa kujizuia na kwa uwiano, ikizingatiwa kuwa inaweza kutengeneza utangulizi wa kuzuia uhuru wa habari na Haki za umma kusikia na kufahamu habari kutoka pande zote za mijadala ya kisiasa katika jamii ya Wa-Thai.

eng: Peace TV officials insisted that the program episodes cited by NBTC didn’t incite the public to rise up against the junta.
swa: Maafisa wa Peace TV walisisitiza kuwa sehemu za vipindi vilivyoelezewa na NBTC havikuueleza umma kupingana na junta.

eng: They added that during the month-long suspension, Peace TV programs will still be aired through Facebook Live.
swa: Waliongeza kuwa kwa kipindi cha mwezi mmoja wa kufungiwa, vipindi vya Peace TV vitakuwa vikirushwa mubashara kupitia Facebook.

eng: They also questioned the timing of the suspension order, which coincided with the August 25 corruption hearing of ousted Prime Minister Yingluck Shinawatra.
swa: Pia wamehusianisha amri ya kufungiwa kwao na kusikilizwa kwa shauri la rushwa dhidi ya Waziri Mkuu Yingluck Shinawatra hapo Agosti 25.

eng: But Prime Minister Prayut denied that the TV network was suspended in order to silence supportive "red shirt" media during Yingluck’s trial.
swa: Lakini Waziri Mkuu Prayut alikana kuwa Televisheni hiyo ilifungiwa ili kuwanyamazisha vyombo vya habari vinavyowaunga mkono "Shati Nyekundu" wakati wa shauri la Yingluck.

eng: He said that it this were the intention of the government, then all media networks should be suspended by NBTC.
swa: Alisema kuwa ingekuwa hili ndilo kusudio la serikali, basi vyombo vyote vya habari vingefungiwa na NBTC.

eng: Zunar is demanding the police to return 1,187 books and 103 t-shirts which were seized during his arrest last December 17, 2016.
swa: Zunar anaitaka polisi irudishe vitabu 1,187 na tisheti 103 walivyochukua wakati walipomkamata hapo Desemba 17, 2016.

eng: Photo from the Facebook page of Zunar Cartoonist Fan Club
swa: Picha kutoka Ukurasa wa Mashabiki wa Vibonzo wa Zunar.

eng: Malaysian cartoonist Zulkiflee S.M. Anwarul Haque, more popularly known as Zunar, has filed a case against the police for arresting him and seizing his cartoon books and t-shirts on December 17, 2016.
swa: Mchora vibonzo wa Malaysia Zulkiflee S.M. Anwarul Haque, maarufu zaidi kama Zunar, amefungua kesi dhidi ya polisi kwa kumkamata na kuchukua vitabu vyake vya vibonzo na tisheti hapo Disemba 17, 2016.

eng: Zunar accused the police of making an unlawful arrest and confiscating a total of 1,187 books and 103 t-shirts during an event which he organized to meet his fans and raise funds.
swa: Zunar anawatuhumu polisi kwa kumkamata bila kufuata sheria na kutaifisha jumla ya vitabu 1,187 na tisheti 103 wakati wa tamasha aliloliandaa ili kukutana na mashabiki wake na kukusanya fedha za kutunisha mfuko.

eng: He explains his reason for taking legal action:
swa: Anaelezea sababu za yeye kuchukua hatua za kisheria:

eng: My books are not banned and I was only selling them to my fans during the fundraising event.
swa: Vitabu vyangu havijafungiwa na nilikuwa naviuza tu kwa mashabiki wangu wakati wa tukio la kukusanya fedha za kutunisha mfuko.

eng: What is wrong with that?
swa: Kuna tatizo gani hapo?

eng: Zunar has been arrested several times in the past few years and charged with sedition for his cartoons that criticize government policies, abuse of power by the ruling coalition that has dominated Malaysia’s politics since the 1950s, and curtailment of civil liberties.
swa: Zunar ameshakamatwa mara kadhaa miaka michache iliyopita na akashtakiwa kwa uchochezi wa vibonzo vyake vilivyokuwa vikizikosoa sera za serikali, matumizi mabaya madaraka kwa serikali ya mseto ambayo imeshikilia siasa za Malaysia tangu 1950 na kukatiza haki na uhuru wa raia.

eng: Many of Zunar’s cartoon books have also been confiscated by authorities for allegedly threatening national security.
swa: Vitabu vingi vya vibonzo vya Zunar vimeshashikiliwa na mamlaka kwa madai ya kutishia usalama wa nchi.

eng: Zunar has won recognition in and outside Malaysia as a press freedom fighter.
swa: Zunar amefahamika ndani na nje ya Malaysia kama mpigania uhuru wa habari.

eng: He has won accolades from Human Rights Watch, the Committee to Protect Journalists and Cartoonist Rights Network International.
swa: Amepata tuzo ya utambulisho toka Shirika la Haki za Binadamu, Kamati ya Mtandao wa Kimataifa wa Kulinda Haki za Wanahabari na Wachora Vibonzo.

eng: His December arrest was tied to a police investigation of him under Section 124C of the Penal Code for “activities detrimental to parliamentary democracy.”
swa: Kukamatwa kwake hapo Disemba kulifungamanishwa na upelelezi wa polisi dhidi yake kwa Kifungu 124C cha adhabu kwa " shughuli mbaya kwa demokrasia ya bunge.”

eng: He was interrogated for six hours and released after the police told him that “they will apply a law to ban all my books.”
swa: Alihojiwa kwa masaa sita na aliachiwa baada ya polisi kumuambia kuwa "watatumia sheria kuvifungia vitabu vyake vyote.”

eng: He issued this statement shortly after his release:
swa: Alitoa kauli hii muda mfupi baada ya kuachiliwa kwake:

eng: I would like to point out my stand: talent is not a gift, but a responsibility.
swa: Ninapenda kutoa msimamo wangu: kipaji sio zawadi ila ni wajibu.

eng: It is my responsibility as a cartoonist to expose corruption and injustices.
swa: Ni wajibu wangu kama mchora vibonzo kufunua rushwa na matendo yasiyo haki.

eng: Do I fear jail?
swa: Je naogopa gereza?

eng: Yes, but responsibility is bigger that fear.
swa: Ndio, lakini wajibu ni mkubwa kuliko hofu hiyo.

eng: You can ban my books, you can ban my cartoons, but you cannot ban my mind.
swa: Mnaweza kufungia vitabu vyangu, mnaweza kufungia vibonzo vyangu lakini hamuwezi kuifungia akili yangu.

eng: I will keep drawing until the last drop of my ink.
swa: Nitaendelea kuchora mpaka tone la mwisho la wino wangu.

eng: Zunar could be referring to the corruption scandal involving the prime minister and 1MDB, a state-owned investment firm.
swa: Zunar anahusishwa na kashfa ya rushwa iliyomuhusisha waziri Mkuu na 1MDB, kampuni inayomilikiwa kwa ubia kati ya serikali na mtu binafsi.

eng: The prime minister is accused of pocketing 680 million US dollars through alleged anomalous transactions made by 1MDB.
swa: Waziri mkuu anatuhumiwa kuweka mfukoni dola milioni 680 kupitia malipo ya ajabu yaliyofanywa na 1MDB.

eng: Zunar’s lawyer, N. Surendran, said the filing of the case against the police is intended to warn authorities about making another illegal arrest:
swa: Mwanasheria wa Zunar, N. Surendran, anasema kufungua kesi dhidi ya polisi inakusudia kuionya mamlaka kuhusu kukamata kwingine kusipo kwa kisheria:

eng: There will be no more tolerance for this kind of unlawful behaviour against a person whose only crime is to criticise the authorities.
swa: Hakutakuwa na uvumilivu kwa aina ya tabia hii isiyo ya kisheria dhidi ya mtu ambaye kosa lake pekee ni kuikosoa serikali.

eng: That is the democratic right of every Malaysian.
swa: Hiyo ni haki ya kidemokrasia ya kila m-Malaysia.

eng: Zunar is demanding the police to return his books and t-shirts.
swa: Zunar anaishinikiza polisi warudishe vitabu vyake na tisheti

eng: On the left, one refugee asks, “Are you sure we can really eat as much as we want?”
swa: Kushoto, mkimbizi mmoja akiuliza, “Una uhakika kuwa tutakula kwa kadri tunavyotaka?”

eng: On the right, the other female defector says, “All the food in this restaurant is rotten."
swa: Kulia, mkimbizi mwanamke mmoja anasema, “Vyakula vyote vya mgahawa huu vimeoza".

eng: South Koreans use the English word “buffet," which sounds like the Korean word for “rotten."
swa: Wakorea Kusini hutumia neno la Kiingereza "makofi" na linaposikika hushabihiana na neno la Kikorea "kuoza."

eng: A challenge for many North Korean defectors is to learn all of these borrowed foreign words that have become part of the southern vernacular.
swa: Changamoto kubwa kwa wakimbizi wa Korea Kaskazini ni kujifunza maneno haya ya kigeni ambayo yamekuwa sehemu ya lugha ya asili ya Wakorea Kusini.

eng: Credit: Choi Seong-guk
swa: Credit: Choi Seong-guk

eng: This story by Jason Strother originally appeared on PRI.org on July 6, 2017.
swa: Habari hii ya Jason Strother ilichapishwa awali kwenye mtandao wa PRI.org mnamo Julai 6, 2017.

eng: It is republished here as part of a partnership between PRI and Global Voices.
swa: Imechapishwa tena kama sehemu ya makubaliano kati ya PRI na Global Voices.

eng: The escape of around 30,000 North Korean defectors to South Korea might not seem like a storyline rife with laughter.
swa: Kutoroka kwa wakimbizi wapatao 30,000 kutoka Korea Kaskazini kwenda Korea Kusini haiwezi kuonekana kuwa habari kubwa ya kuchekesha.

eng: But an online comic strip series created by a North Korean refugee, who now lives in Seoul, attempts to bring some humor to what is an often-harrowing journey and difficult resettlement.
swa: Lakini mtandao wa mfululizo wa vibonzo uliotengenezwa na mkimbizi wa Korea Kaskazini, ambaye sasa anaishi Seoul amejaribu kuleta ucheshi kidogo katika safari ambayo mara nyingi ni ya taabu na makazi mapya magumu.

eng: After his own defection to South Korea in 2010, Choi Seong-guk, 37, realized that the two Koreas were no longer the same country — many cultural and linguistic differences have arisen during more than 70 years of division.
swa: Baada ya yeye mwenyewe kukimbilia Korea Kusini mwaka 2010, Choi Seong-guk, 37, aligundua kuwa Korea mbili hazikuwa tena nchi moja- tofauti nyingi za utamaduni na lugha zilikuwa zimeibuka katika kipindi cha zaidi ya miaka 70 ya mgawanyiko.

eng: For Choi, who had once worked for Pyongyang’s premier animation studio, SEK, one of the first differences that stood out was that cartoons in the south weren’t anything like the ones in the north.
swa: Kwa Choi, ambaye alishawahi kufanya kazi katika studio kubwa ya vibonzo huko Pyongyang, SEK, tofauti ya kwanza iliyojitokeza ni kuwa vibonzo kwa upande wa Kusini havikuwa chochote kwa vile vya upande wa Kaskazini.

eng: “When I first saw South Korean cartoons, I just didn’t get them,” he says.
swa:
Kwa mara ya kwanza nilipoviona vibonzo vya Kusini, sikuvielewa,” alisema.
“There were no stories about patriotism or catching spies or war.	“Hakuna hadithi kuhusu uzalendo, kukamata majasusi au vita.
They just seemed useless to me.”	Vilionekana havina maana kwangu.”
Choi has had a knack for drawing since he was a kid, when teachers praised him for his sketches of evil American soldiers that he says he made look “as ugly and violent as possible.” 	Choi amekuwa na ujuzi wa kuchora tangu akiwa mdogo, wakati waalimu walipomsifia kwa michoro yake ya Askari Wabaya wa Marekani ambapo alisema aliwafanya  wawe wabaya na wakatili kwa kadri alivyoweza.”

eng: This is a re-creation of a drawing Choi made as a young student.
swa: Haya ni marudio ya mchoro wa Choi aliouchora akiwa mwanafunzi.

eng: It depicts an American soldier kicking a South Korean soldier as they prepare to cross the border into North Korea.
swa: Inamuonesha askari wa Marekani akimpiga mateke askari wa Korea Kusini wakati wakijiandaa kuvuka mpaka kwenda Korea Kaskazini.

eng: The caption reads, "Invasion from the South." Credit: Choi Seong-guk
swa: Maelezo yanasomeka, "Uvamizi kutoka Korea Kusini" Shukrani: Choi Seong-guk

eng: In 2016, Choi returned to drawing and began an online comic strip series called "Rodong Shimmun," which means "labor interrogation" — it’s a play on the name of North Korea’s "Rodong Shinmun," the labor newspaper.
swa: Mwaka 2016, Choi alirudi katika uchoraji na alianzisha mtandao wa mfululizo wa vibonzo ulioitwa "Rodong Shimmun," ikiwa na maana ya "kuhojiwa kazi" — ni akilichezesha jina la "Rodong Shinmun," ambalo ni gazeti la kazi la Korea Kaskazini.

eng: The satirical series follows a group of newly arrived refugees as they spend their first months in South Korea at a government–run integration center.
swa: Mfululizo wa mizaha ulifuatiwa na kundi la wakimbizi wapya waliofika karibuni ambao walitumia miezi yao ya mwanzo katika kituo cha mahojiano kinachoendeshwa na serikali ya Korea Kusini.

eng: Choi pokes fun at their 'newbie-ness,' like their shock about all the food at a buffet restaurant.
swa: Choi alichochea utani katika 'upya wao' kama vile mshangao wao katika aina za vyakula katika mgahawa.

eng: He also tells the story of one lovelorn defector, which he says is based on his own embarrassing cultural misunderstanding.
swa: Pia alihadithia kuhusu mkimbizi mmoja asiye na mapenzi, ambaye husema hiyo imetokana na aibu yake mwenyewe ya kutokuelewa utamaduni.

eng: The defector meets a South Korean woman, who says, “Interesting.
swa: Mkimbizi anakutana na mwanamke mmoja wa Korea Kusini, ambaye anasema "amevutiwa".

eng: I’ve never met a North Korean person before.
swa: Sijawahi kuonana na mtu wa Korea Kaskazini kabla.

eng: Can I have your phone number?”
swa: Je naweza kupata namba yako ya simu?”

eng: Credit: Choi Seong-guk
swa: Credit: Choi Seong-guk

eng: “One time I met a South Korean woman who asked for my phone number and said she wanted to become my friend,” he recalls.
swa: “Mara moja nilikutana na mwanamke wa Korea Kusini aliyetaka namba yangu ya simu na alisema angependa kuwa rafiki yangu" alikumbuka.

eng: “I somehow misinterpreted that as she wanted to marry me.”
swa:
Nami nilitafsiri ndivyo sivyo kuwa anataka tuoane.”
The woman goes on to use a term of endearment that’s casually spoken in South Korea.	Mwanamke aliendelea kutumia neno hilo la mapenzi ambalo hutumika kikawaida Korea kusini.
In a subsequent text bubble, Choi explains to his readers how this caused mixed signals. 	Baadaye katika kisanduku cha maneno, Choi aliwaeleza wasomaji wake jinsi lilivyomsababishia mkanganyiko wa hisia au ishara.
“In North Korea only romantic partners would say that to each other. Amongst friends, we just call each other 'comrade.'” 	“Katika Korea Kaskazini, ni watu walio katika mahusiano ya kimapenzi pekee wanaweza kuambiana hivyo Baina ya marafiki huwa tunaitana 'komredi.'”

eng: Not all of Choi’s drawings are funny, though.
swa: Hata hivyo, Sio michoro yote ya Choi ni ya kuchekesha.

eng: Some depict scenes in North Korea of people starving in the streets.
swa: Mingine huonesha watu wakifa njaa mitaani huko Korea Kaskazini.

eng: Throughout Choi’s comic series are glimpses of life in North Korea.
swa: Katika mifululizo yote ya vibonzo vya Choi inaoneshwa mitazamo ya maisha ya Korea Kaskazini.

eng: In this drawing, the person says, "Hey, you could die.
swa: Katika mchoro huu mtu anasema " Wewe, unaweza kufa.

eng: We should eat this grass.”
swa: Tunaweza kula hizi nyasi.”

eng: Credit: Choi Seong-guk
swa: Credit: Choi Seong-guk

eng: Others portray how some defectors made their escape under fire from border guards.
swa: Nyingine zinaonesha jinsi wakimbizi wanavyotoroka chini ya mtutu wa moto wa askari wa mpakani.

eng: Choi says he hopes his comic series will help change the mindset of South Koreans, who are generally apathetic toward North Korean refugees.
swa: Choi anasema anatumaini kuwa mfululizo wa vibonzo vyake utasaidia kubadili mitazamo ya wa-Korea Kusini ambao hawahisi huruma dhidi ya wakimbizi kutoka Korea Kaskazini.

eng: The caption above the drawing reads: “Escaping North Korea is all about survival.
swa: Maelezo juu ya mchoro yanasomeka: “Kutoroka Korea Kaskazini inahusu kuishi.

eng: Even if one of your family members get shot and falls down, you just have to keep running."
swa: Hata kama mmoja wa wanafamilia wako atapigwa risasi na kuanguka, utaendelea tu kukimbia" Credit: Choi Seong-guk

eng: Credit: Choi Seong-guk And it might be working.
swa: Na inaweza kuwa inafanya kazi.

eng: Rodong Shimmun now receives tens of thousands of views and some readers leave comments saying it’s helped them better understand the cultural differences between North and South Korea.
swa: Rodong Shimmun sasa inapokea makumi elfu ya watazamaji na baadhi ya wasomaji huacha maoni wakisema imewasaidia kuwa na uelewa mzuri juu ya utofauti wa utamaduni kati ya Korea Kusini na Korea Kaskazini.

eng: Others write that they feel more empathetic toward defectors.
swa: Wengine wanaandika kuwa sasa wanahisi huruma juu ya wakimbizi.

eng: From left to right: Pravit Rojanaphruk, Watana Muangsook, and Pichai Naripthaphan.
swa: Kutoka kushoto kwenda kulia: Pravit Rojanaphruk, Watana Muangsook, na Pichai Naripthaphan.

eng: In the past week, three Facebook users in Thailand were charged with sedition over posts criticizing the military-led government.
swa: Wiki iliyopita, watumiaji watatu wa Facebook nchini Thailand walishitakiwa kwa makosa ya uchochezi kufuatia kuikosoa serikali inayoongozwa kijeshi.

eng: Veteran journalist Pravit Rojanaphruk, Watana Muangsook of the Pheu Thai political party, and former energy minister Pichai Naripthaphan were informed by the police about the sedition charges.
swa: Mwanahabari nguli Pravit Rojanaphruk, Watana Muangsook wa Pheu Thai chama cha siasa, na waziri wa zamani wa nishati Pichai Naripthaphan walitaarifiwa na polisi kuhusiana na makosa hayo ya uchochezi.

eng: The military grabbed power in 2014 and continues to rule the country through a Constitution it passed in 2016. Aside from strictly regulating the media, it has been aggressively prosecuting individuals accused of either insulting the monarchy or criticizing the junta.
swa: Jeshi lilijitwalia madaraka mwaka 2014 na kuendelea kuliongoza taifa chini ya katiba iliyopitishwa mwaka 2016. mbali na kuvibana vyombo vya habari, serikali hii imekuwa ikiwashitaki watu kwa tuhuma za ama kumkahifu mtukufu Rais au serikali.

eng: Thailand implements a Lese Majeste (anti-Royal Insult) law, which critics believe is being abused by the army to silence dissident voices.
swa: Thailand inatumia sheria ya Lese Majeste (kutokumdhalilisha Kiongozianti-Royal Insult), ambayo wakosoaji wanaamini kuwa shetria hii inatumika vibaya na jeshi kwa lengo la kuwanyamzisha wakosoaji wa serikali.

eng: Pravit, a senior reporter for the news website Khaosod English, wrote on August 1, 2017 about how he learned of his sedition case:
swa: Pravit, ripota mwandamizi wa tovuti ya habari Khaosod kwa Kiingereza, aliandika mnamo Agosti 1, 2017 kile alichojifunza kufuatia kesi yake ya uchochezi:

eng: I received a call from the Deputy Superintendent of the Technology Crime Suppression Division informing me at about 6.40pm that a police of the rank of Police Lieutenant Colonel is charging me of violating sedition law through an estimate 5 Facebook postings.
swa: NIlipokea simu kutoka kwa msaidizi wa wa kitengo cha Kukabiliana na Makosa ya Mstumizi mabaya Teknolojia akinitaarifu kuwa afisa wa polisi mwenye cheo cha Luteni Kanali ananishtaki kwa kosa la kukiuka sheria ya uchochezi kufuatia kuchapisha makala zinakadiriwa kufikia tano kwenye mtandao wa Facebook.

eng: I insist that I criticize the military regime in good faith I will continue to criticize the illegitimate military regime until they take away my smartphone.
swa: Hata hivyo, nilisisitiza tena kuwa, nilikuwa ninaikosa serikali kwa lengo jema kabisa Nitaendelea kuikosa serikali batili hadi pale watakaponinyang'anya simu janja yangu.

eng: The police didn’t inform him which of the Facebook posts he wrote have been deemed seditious by the government.
swa: Polisi hawakuweza kumfafanulia kuhusu makala ya Facebook aliyoiandika na ambayo ilipelekea serikali kuiona kuwa ni ya uchochezi.

eng: Pravit was previously ‘invited’ by the army to undergo an ‘attitude-adjustment’ session.
swa: Pravit hapo awali ‘alialikwa’ na jeshi kwa ajili ya kupatiwa huduma ya namna ya ‘namna ya kurekebisha mwenendo’.

eng: This unusual detention is the army’s way of dealing with perceived critics in the media and academe.
swa: Ushikiliwaji huu usio wa kawaida ni mbinu ya jeshi ya kukabiliana na wakosoaji wa serikali kupitia vyombo ya habari na majukwaa ya kitaaluma.

eng: If found guilty, Pravit can be detained for up to 20 years.
swa: Akikutwa na hatia, Pravit anaweza kufungwa gerezani kwa kipindi cha hadi miaka 20.

eng: Correction: Aft consulting @TLHR2014 again, possible maximum imprisonment term is 20 not 60 yrs.
swa: Masahihisho: Baada ya kuwasiliana na @TLHR2014 tena, muda unatarajiwa wa kifungo cha gerezani ni miaka 20 na si 60.

eng: Pichai, meanwhile, served under the former prime minister, Yingluck Shinawatra, who is currently facing a corruption case.
swa: Pichai, kwa sasa, nafanya kazi na waziri mkuu wa zamani, Yingluck Shinawatra, ambaye kwa sasa anakabiliwa na kesi ya rushwa.

eng: According to Khaosod English, Pichai posted the following status update on Facebook, which he claimed he wrote with ‘sincere intentions’:
swa: Kwa mujibu wa Khaosod katika lugha ya English, Pichai alichapisha ujumbe ufuatao kwenye facebook, ujumbe anadai kuwa aliundika kwa ‘malengo mazuri’:

eng: If the government does not solve it in time, the economic situation will keep deteriorating, like a frog in a pot that gradually boils.
swa: Ikiwa serikali haitafanyia kazi kwa wakati, hali ya uchumi itazidi kuzorota, kama ilivyo kwa chura ndani ya chungu ambacho taratibu kinaendelea kuchemka.

eng: I hope the Thai government and Thai people will realize this in time, and be the frog that leaps out before the water boils.
swa: Ninaimani kuwa serikali ya Thai na raia wake watalitambua hili bila kuchelewa, na hivyo kuwa kama chura aliyeruka kabla chungu hakijaanza kuchemka.

eng: Watana is another member of the Yingluck admnistration who is accused by the police of misleading the public about the justice system and the military-led government through a post he uploaded on Facebook.
swa: Watana ni mwanachama mwingine wa milki ya Yingluck ambaye anatuhumiwa na polisi kwa kuipotosha jamii kuhusu mfumo wa mahakama na serikali ya kijeshi kupitia makala yake aliyoichapisha kwenye ukurasa wake Facebook.

eng: Both Pichai and Watana were members of the ruling party before the military staged a coup in 2014.
swa: Pichai na Watana walikuwa wanachama wa chama tawala kabla ya jeshi kuchukua madaraka mwaka 2014.

eng: The two politicians were charged in the same week that Yingluck faced the court on corruption charges related to a rice subsidy scheme, prompting some to wonder whether the charges are meant to silence Yingluck's supporters.
swa: Wanasiasa hawa wawili walifunguliwa mashtaka wiki moja wakati Yingluck alipofika mahakamani kujibu tuhuma za rushwa zinazohusishwa na mpango wa mchele wa bei nafuu, jambo linalowafanya watu kujiuliza ikiwa tuhuma hizo zinalenga kuwanyamazisha wafuasi wa Yingluck.

eng: News about the filing of sedition cases against junta critics prompted some Twitter users to comment about the restriction of free speech in the country:
swa: Taarifa kuhusu kufunguliwa kwa kesi za uchochezi dhidi ya wakosoaji wa serikali ya kijeshi iliwafanya watumiaji wa twitter kutoa maoni yao kuhusu uminywaji wa uhuru wa kujieleza nchini humo:

eng: One tweet mentioned Prayut, the former army chief who led the 2014 coup and is now the country's prime minister:
swa: Makala moja ya Twitter inamtaja Prayut, kingozi wa jeshi aliyeongoza mapinduzi ya mwaka 2014 na sasa ni Waziri Mkuu wa nchi:

eng: Orange Democratic Movement supporters holding a portrait of their party's candidate Raila Odinga in 2007.
swa: Mashabiki wa chama cha ODM wakiwa wamebeba picha ya mgombea wa chama chao Raila Odinga mwaka 2007.

eng: Odinga is contesting the presidency for the third time in 2017.
swa: Odinga anagombea Urais kwa mara ya tatu mwaka huu.

eng: Photo by Demosh (CC BY 2.0)
swa: Picha na Demosh (CC BY 2.0)

eng: On August 8, millions of Kenyans will cast their vote in what is expected to be the most competitive general elections to date.
swa: Endapo majaliwa tarehe 8 Agosti, mamilioni ya Wakenya wanatarajiwa kupiga kura zao katika moja ya chaguzi kuu zinazotarajiwa kuwa na ushindani wa kipekee kufikia leo hii.

eng: Ballots will be cast for 290 members of parliament, 47 female county representatives, 47 senators and governors, as well as the president.
swa: Kura hizo zitawaendea wagombea 290 nafasi ya ubunge, wawakilishi 47 wanawake kupitia nafasi za viti maalum, maseneta na magavana 47, sambamba na Raisi wao.

eng: The presidential vote will be a rematch of the 2013 poll that pit incumbent Uhuru Kenyatta against his ex-rival, former prime minister Raila Odinga.
swa: Kura za urais zitapigwa baina ya mgombea wa mwaka 2013 aliyeko madarakani kwa sasa Rais, Uhuru Kenyatta na mpinzani wake wa awali, waziri mkuu mstaafu mheshimiwa Raila Odinga.

eng: By any measure, this election is expected to be the closest contest to date between Kenyatta and Odinga, raising the political and economic stakes for the country.
swa: Katika hali ya kawaida, uchaguzi huu unatarajiwa kuleta ushindani mkubwa baina ya wagombea hao wawili ,Kenyatta and Odinga, ukichochea mabadiliko ya siasa na uchumi nchini hapo.

eng: As Kenya is the undisputed economic anchor of the region, the smooth execution of the August 8 elections will be critical for wider East Africa.
swa: Nchi hiyo ya Kenya ikiwa kama muhimili wa uchumi, utekelezaji mororo wa uchaguzi huo tarehe 8 Agosti ni muhimu kwa mustakabali wa Afrika Mashariki yote.

eng: Kenya remains one of the largest and most vibrant economies on the continent and any sign of political and/or economic volatility will be felt well beyond its own borders.
swa: Kenya inabaki kuwa moja kati ya nchi zenye uchumi mahiri barani Afrika na alama yoyote tete kiuchumi au kisiasa itapelekea athari hadi nje ya mipaka.

eng: There is evidence from the past to suggest that fears of post-election instability have impacted the country's economy.
swa: Upo ushahidi wa hapo awali kwamba kwamba hofu za nchi kuyumba baada ya uchaguzi zimeathiri uchumi wa nchi.

eng: No matter who wins, it is likely that the candidates will challenge the results of what analysts are already calling the most expensive election in Africa.
swa: Haijalishi nani atashinda, ni dhahiri kwamba wagombea watahoji kuhusu matokeo hatua ambayo watafiti huita chaguzi zenye gharama sana Afrika.

eng: Any such challenge will have the worrying effect of eroding public confidence in the Independent Election and Boundaries Commission (IEBC) and the judiciary, the two institutions responsible for safeguarding electoral integrity.
swa: Madhara ya changamoto yoyote aina hii huleta hofu inayovuruga kujiamini kwa tume huru ya uchaguzi (IEBC) na mahakama mbele ya umma, taasisi hizi zinawajibu a kushuhulikia usalama na uadilifu wakati wa uchaguzi.

eng: Public trust in these institutions last hit a low in 2007, and the bloody aftermath of that year’s elections stands as a stark reminder of what could transpire when people lose faith in the integrity of these institutions.
swa: Imani ya umma juu ya taasisi hizi kwa mara ya mwisho ilikuwa kiwango cha chini sana mwaka 2007, na umwagikaji wa damu unaendelea kusimama ikiwa ni ishara kamili kwamba umma hawana imani juu ya taasisi hizo .

eng: In the 2013 election, when Kenya avoided a repeat of 2007-08 and held relatively peaceful elections, East Africa heaved a collective sigh of relief that reverberated throughout the continent and many other parts of the world.
swa: Katika uchaguzi wa 2013, ambapo Kenya haikurudia yaliotokea 2007-08 na kufanya uchaguzi wa amani kabisa, Affika ya Mashariki ilijiinua kwa pamoja ikiwa na kofia za shangwe kwa ahueni ambazo zilisikika barani nzima mwa Afrika na kufikia sehemu nyingi duniani.

eng: This was due in part to the electoral cycle: political tension tends to rise when incumbents are defending their seats, and in 2013 incumbent president Mwai Kibaki had already served two terms and wasn’t eligible for re-election.
swa: Haya yalitokea kama sehemu katika mzunguko wa uchaguzi: mvutano wa kisiasa huinuka pale viongozi waliopo madarkani wnapojaribu kutetea nafasi zao, mnamo mwaka 2013 kiongozi liyekuwa madarakani Rias Mwai Kibaki alikuwa tayari mekwisha tumikia taifa kwa vipindi viwili mfululizo na hakuwa na vigezo kama mgombea tena katika uchaguzia.

eng: By then public confidence in the IEBC and the judiciary had also improved compared to the previous election.
swa: Lakini pia taasisi za kusimamia uchaguzi IEBC na mahakama zilijiaminisha kwa umma ukilinganisha na uchaguzi uliopita.

eng: This time around, however, the odds appear once again stacked against the smooth running of the polls.
swa: Katika majira haya , tabia zisizofaa zimekua zikijitokeza kuzuia uchaguzi wa amani.

eng: Firstly, Kenyatta wants to get re-elected, so he will be seeking to use all the resources at his disposal to retain power.
swa: Awali ya yote, Bwana Kenyatta amesadikika kuwa na anashauku ya kuchaguliwa kwa awamu nyingine ,hali itakayopelekea matumizi mabovu ya rasilimali ili kurejesha madaraka.

eng: More critically, public confidence in the electoral commission and the judiciary is once again falling, to levels reminiscent of those in 2007.
swa: Kwa kina zaidi, imani ya umma juu ya taasisi ya kusimamia uchaguzi na mahakama imeshuka kwa kiasi fulani ukilinganisha na mwaka 2007, .

eng: Both institutions have come under attack from both the opposition, which has been critical of the IEBC, and the government, which has directed its criticism at the courts.
swa: Taasisi zote hizi zimejikuta chini ya mashambulizi kutoka pande zote za upinzani, hali imekua tete kwa IEBC, na serikali, ambao wetua kukosolewa kwao kwa mahakama.

eng: Some of the latter has come directly from President Kenyatta towards the judiciary.
swa: Baadhi ya barua zimetumwa na mheshimiwa Rias Kenyatta ziifikie mahakama .

eng: These developments have the stage for potential challenges to the election results.
swa: Hali kama hizi zinajenga changamoto wakati wa matokeo kutangazwa kwa hapo baadae.

eng: Key factors to watch
swa: Mambo muhimu yakuzingatiwa

eng: The Electoral commission: The IEBC has been since the beginning of the year, with allegations levelled against it that include legal breaches, logistical inefficiencies, and transparency issues surrounding its procurement process.
swa: Tume ya Uchaguzi: inayofahamika kama IEBC imekuwepo tangu mwanzoni mwa mwaka, na madai yaliyooanishwa na ukiukwaji wa sheria, uhaba wa vifaa, na uwazi katika swala zima la manunuzi.

eng: There are also concerns over the IEBC’s preparedness to conduct and execute on election day without any major glitches.
swa: Pia imehusishwa na shutuma kuhusiana na viashiria vya IEBC kusimamia na kutekeleza wajibu wao bila kufuata taratibu zilizowekwa.

eng: Managing elections for president, governors, senators and county representatives is a logistical challenge under normal circumstances, but given the delays in staffing senior leadership positions and procurement issues that plague the organization, the credibility and reputational stakes for the Commission have undoubtedly increased.
swa: Kusimamia uchaguzi wa Rais,magavana,maseneta na wawakilishi wanawake viti maalum ni changamoto kubwa katika hali ya kawaida, lakini ucheleweshwaji wa kuwapumzisha viongozi walioko madarakani na tuhuma za kifedha zinazokipiga chombo hicho, kuaminika na sifa za vigingi kwa tume hiyo ni dhahiri bila pingamizi vimeongezeka.

eng: The high probability of close elections both at the county and presidential levels makes matters are even more complex.
swa: Uwezkano mkubwa wa ukaribu wa uchaguzi katika ngazi zote ya kata na urais inapelekea hali kuwa tata zaidi.

eng: There is a risk that neither Odinga nor Kenyatta will secure the necessary 50% +1 of votes cast, thus triggering a second-round vote.
swa: Ikikadiriwa kwamba wagombea wote sio Odinga wala Kenyatta wakakosa asilimia 50% +1 oya kura zitkazopigwa, hali itakyopelekea kurudiwa kwa uchaguzi kwa awamu ya pili.

eng: This would be unprecedented and would be arriving at a time when political and social pressures are high, further exerting undue pressure on the IEBC.
swa: Hii haijawahi kutokea na itafikia wakati ambapo migandamizo ya kisiasa na kijamii iko juu sana na kuihemea IEBC.

eng: Leaving the presidential election aside, it is also possible that certain gubernatorial and other local elections might not result in a definitive winner.
swa: Ukiacha uchaguzi wa Rais pembeni, inawezekana pia uongozi flani na chaguzi nyingine kwenye ngazi za chini isitangaze washindi stahiki.

eng: Will the IEBC be able to hold it all together?
swa: Je, IEBC itaweza kuyashikilia haya yote kwa pamoja?

eng: The Economy: Although ethnic divisions are typically the focal point of Kenyan elections, this year concerns about the economy are taking centre stage.
swa: Uchumi: Ingawa tofauti za kikabila zimekuwa zikiangaliwa sana katika chaguzi za Kenya, mwaka huu kigezo cha uchumi kilipewa kipaumbele.

eng: Inflation is on the rise, led by food prices, reaching a peak of 21% year-on-year in April.
swa: Mfumuko wa bei umeongezeka, ukiongozwa na gharama za chakula, kufikia asilimia 21% mwaka hadi mwaka mnamo Aprili.

eng: This pushed headline inflation to a five-year high of 11.5% in April 2017, up from 10.3% in March.
swa: Hali iliyosababisha kujengwa kusikika kwa mfumuko wa bei kwa mfululizo kwa muda wa miaka mitano kufikia 11.5% Aprili 2017, juu kutoka 10.3% Machi.

eng: The rise in food prices is primarily the result of drought in some parts of the country, which drove up the prices of staple commodities such as maize, sugar and vegetables, and in some cases has led to shortages.
swa: Ongezeko la gharama za chakula lilmesababishwa na ukame kwa baadhi ya maeneo ya nchi,ambapo imepelekea kupanda kwa bei kwa bidhaa muhimu kama mahindi, sukari na mbogamboga, huku baadhi ya maeneo malighafi hizo zikikosekana kabisa.

eng: Criticism of the government’s handling of the situation may, in fact, translate into a protest vote against the government at the polls.
swa: Kukosolewa kwa serkali kushindwa kuhimili hali kama hii, kiuhalisia, kutaleta tafsiri ya maandamano wakati wa uchaguzi.

eng: Security: One important similarity between the 2017 and 2013 election environments is the absence of either terrorism and the militant group al-Shabaab or the fact that Kenya remains at war in Somalia as a campaign issue.
swa: Ulinzi: ni moja kati ya mfanano baina ya uchauzi wa 2017 na 2013 mazingira ya uendeshwaji wa tukio zima la uchaguzi ni kutokuwepo kwa ugaidi au wapiganaji wa kikundi cha al-Shabaab ukweli ni kwamba Kenya inabaki kuwa katika hali ya vita kama kampeni.

eng: It only took a few months after the elections in 2013 for al-Shabaab to make its presence known with the horrific events at the Westgate Shopping Centre that left 67 people dead. But terrorism and insecurity remain a constant threat in Kenya, and groups like al-Shabaab and others may look to undermine and influence the election outcome in the weeks leading up to August 8, or even in the days after.
swa: Ilichukua takribani miezi miwili tu baada ya kumalizika kwa uchaguzi mwaka 2013 ambapo al-Shabaab walifanya tukio lililofahamika kama horrific events at the Westgate Shopping Centre lililoua watu 67.Lakini ugaidi na na usalama duni nchini Kenya bado ni tatizo makundo kama al-Shabaab na mengine yanaweza kutumia upepo wa uchaguzi kuivamia Kenya Agosti 8, au hata siku za usoni baada ya uchaguzi.

eng: Post-election environment remains uncertain
swa: Mazingira yasiyoeleweka baada ya Uchaguzi

eng: Assuming all goes well after the polls, whether the presidency is occupied by Kenyatta or Odinga, more problems are looming – particularly on the economic front: Kenya has mounting debts. Starting the end of this calendar year to 2019, fiscal resources are expected to come under pressure due to external debt servicing.
swa: Pata picha kila kitu kiekwenda sawa wakati wa uchaguzi, nafasi ya uchaguzi ikikihimiwa na yoyote kati ya Kenyatta au Odinga, matatizo yakaendelea kufurukuta – zaidi kiuchumi: Kenya ina malimbikizi ya madeni.Tulianzia mwishoni mwa kalenda ya mwaka huu hadi hapo 2019, fedha zinatarajiwa kutokana na mdandamizo uliosababishwa na madeni ya nje.

eng: For example, in December, a $750 million commercial loan, secured in October 2015, will be due.
swa: Kwa mfano, mwezi Disemba, mkopo wa dola milioni za Marekani $ , kuulinda Octoba 2015, will be.

eng: This will be followed by the expected repayment in June 2018 of a $600 million loan from the African Export-Import Bank, earlier secured to support cash-strapped Kenya Airways.
swa: Sambamba na malipo yanayotarajiwa Jun750e 2018 ya zipatazo milioni $600 dola za kimarekani kutoka African Export-Import Bank, zilizokopwa hapo awali ktutoa msaada kufungua Kenya Airways.

eng: Furthermore, in 2019, the five-year $750 million Eurobond, issued in 2014, will fall due in December, as well as a portion of another $800 million syndicated loan granted by commercial banks, including Citigroup, Standard Bank, Standard Chartered and Rand Merchant Bank.
swa: Vilevile, itakapofikia mwaka 2019, dola za kimarekani milioni $750 zilizotolewa na Eurobond, mwaka 2014, zitatakiwa kurejeshwa Disemba pale ambapo muda wake utafikia tamati, ikiwa sawia na sehemu ya pesa taslmiu milioni $800 fedha za Marekani iliyoandikwa na commercial Bank, ikijumuisha Citigroup, Standard Bank, Standard Chartered and Rand Merchant Bank.

eng: These payments are expected to result in external debt servicing rising by a whopping 242%, from $424 million to $1.4 billion in the 2017-18 budget. These repayments are all expected to happen against the backdrop of a weaker Kenyan shilling and a stronger US dollar, which majority of Kenya’s external debts are denominated in.
swa: Malipo haya yatapelekea kuongezea kwa uduma za malipo kwa nchi za nje kwa nguvu 242%, kutoka dola milioni $424 hadi $1.4 dola bilioni kwenye bajeti ya 2017-18. hii imesababishwa na kushuka kwa thamani ya shilingi ya Kenya ukishindwa nguvu na dola la Marekaniambapo wakenya wengi wamellia huko.

eng: Needless to say, the new president may not have much time to bask in the glory of his victory.
swa: Napenda kusema,Rais mpya anaweza akakosa muda wa kutosha kuota katika utukufu wa ushindi aliopata.

eng: Former prime minister of Jamaica, Portia Simpson-Miller, when she attended the ceremony unveiling the winning design for the slavery memorial at the United Nations (in her capacity, as then prime minister).
swa: Waziri Mkuu wa zamani wa Jaimaica, Portia Simpson-Miller, alipohudhuria sheria za kupitisha ubunifu utakayowakilisha kumbukumbu la utumwa huko Umoja wa Mataifa (kwa wadhifa wake kama Waziri Mkuu).

eng: Photo by United Nations Information Centres, CC BY-NC-ND 2.0.
swa: Picha na kituo cha habari za Umoja wa Mataifa, CC BY-NC-ND 2.0.

eng: On June 29, 2017, Jamaica's first female prime minister, Portia Simpson-Miller, made her final speech in parliament.
swa: Mnamo Juni 29, 2017, Waziri Mkuu mwanamke wa kwanza wa Jamaica, Portia Simpson-Miller, alitoa hotuba yake ya mwisho ndani ya bunge.

eng: It marked, at the age of 72, her retirement from representational politics.
swa: Kwa umri wake wa miaka 72 anafika mwisho wa safari yake ya siasa za uwakilishi.

eng: Simpson-Miller had been under some pressure to step down as opposition leader ever since the People's National Party (PNP), under her leadership, lost the general elections in February 2016.
swa: Simpson-Miller amekuwa katika shinikizo la kujiuzulu kama kiongozi wa upinzani tangu pale Chama Cha Wananchi (PNP), chini ya uongozi wake kiliposhindwa katika uchaguzi mkuu hapo Februari 2016.

eng: Former finance minister, Peter Phillips, was returned unopposed as party leader, and sworn in as opposition leader on April 3, 2017.
swa: Waziri wa Zamani wa Fedha, Peter Phillips, alirudishwa bila kupingwa kama kiongozi wa chama, na aliapishwa kama kiongozi wa Upinzani hapo Aprili 3, 2017.

eng: Ms. Simpson Miller was showered with tributes by colleagues on both sides of the house in a joint sitting of parliament on June 27, where she was described as a champion of the poor.
swa: Bi. Simpson Miller alifunikwa na hotuba mbali mbali toka kwa wenzake wa pande zote mbili bungeni katika bunge la pamoja lililokaa hapo June 27, ambapo alielezewa kuwa mshindi kwa maskini.

eng: With rural roots, her political journey as a woman and her personal resilience in the face of stiff challenges were often topics of praise and admiration.
swa: Akiwa na asili ya mtu wa mashambani, safari yake ya kisiasa kama mwanamke mada nyingi zilikuwa za kumpongeza na kumsifia kwa ujasiri aliouonesha katika changamoto mbalimbali alizokutana nazo mara kwa mara.

eng: However, her leadership skills were often called into question during her two stints as prime minister, and as she left the political stage she still had her detractors.
swa: Hata hivyo, uongozi wake ulileta maswali mara kwa mara katika vipindi vyake viwili kama Wazir Mkuu, na hata alivyoondoka katika jukwaa la siasa bado yuko na vizuizi vyake.

eng: Outspoken entertainer Tanya Stephens took to Facebook to deliver a devastating critique of Simpson-Miller's legacy:
swa: Mburudishaji mkubwa Tanya Stephens alitumia mtandao wa Facebook kufikisha ukosoaji mkubwa dhidi ya kumbukumbu ya Simpson-Miller:

swa: Kusikia watu wanalalamikia kuondoka kwa Portia ni kama kuona watu wakimpongeza mbakaji wangu kwa kuwa mwanaume mwema....Portia sio mtu mzuri.

eng: SHE knows that.
swa: Anafahamu hilo.

eng: Besides unqualified AND an embarrassing representation who wasn't even of average intelligence as per her public displays, she was also an awful apathetic human who perfected the art of pandering to the hypocrisy of Jamaicans.
swa: Licha ya uwakilishi usioridhisha na udhalilishaji hana akili ya kiwango kinachooneshwa na umma, alikuwa mtu mbaya na asiye na utu ndani yake aliyeweza kuukuwadia vyema unafiki wa Wa-Jamaica.

eng: I'm happy to see her back.
swa: Nimefurahi kumuona akiondoka.

eng: I'm not alone.
swa: Siko peke yangu.

eng: Good riddance.
swa: Kuondoka kwema.

swa: Stephens aliwajibu Wajamaica wengi waliokerwa na maneno yake kirahisi tu kwa kusema:

eng: That it takes 'audacity' to criticize a PUBLIC SERVANT is a tragedy.
swa: Inahitaji 'ujasiri' kumkosoa MTUMISHI WA UMMA ni hatari.

eng: As a quite unpleasant war of words ensued, community activist Damien Williams shared:
swa: Ikichukuliwa ni vita vya maneno, mwanaharakati wa kijamii Damien Williams alisema:

eng: To compare the fanfare & well wishes towards PSM to that being offered to a rapist is NOT a critique of her capacity, competence or a commentary on her failures but NASTY personal attack, plain and simple.
swa: Kufananisha shamrashamra & mapenzi mema kwa PSM na zile zinazotolewa kwa mbakaji SIO ukosoaji wa kiwango chake, ushindani au maoni juu ya kushindwa kwake ila kwa uwazi na kwa urahisi kabisa hilo ni shambulio CHAFU na binafsi.

eng: However, to offer a defense of PSM by doing same is equally nasty.
swa: Hata hivyo, kumtetea PSM kwa njia ile ile nayo pia ni uhuni vile vile.

eng: Rape is NEVER something you downplay or use to inflict pain/recompense.
swa: Ubakaji HAUWEZI kubezwa au kutumiwa kusababisha maumivu au kufidiwa.

eng: We certainly can express dissent without ad hominem.
swa: Tunaweza kukinzana bila kudhalilishana.

eng: We are always so grotesquely excessive and then use as a crutch, freedom of speech.
swa: Mara zote tumekuwa wa ajabu sana halafu tunatumia kama kisingizio cha uhuru wa kujieleza.

eng: KMT
swa: KMT

eng: Affectionately known as "Mama P," Simpson-Miller presided over the gritty "garrison" constituency of South West St. Andrew for over four decades.
swa: Kwa Upendo anafahamika kama "Mama P," Simpson-Miller alikuwa mwenyekiti katika ngome ya changarawe ya jimbo la Kusini Magharibi St. Andrew kwa zaidi ya miongo minne.

eng: It is an inner city area of the capital, plagued with poor infrastructure, unemployment and poverty.
swa: Ni sehemu ya ndani ya mji lililo na miundo mbinu mibovu, ukosefu wa ajira na umaskini.

eng: Columnist Martin Henry wrote:
swa: Mwandishi wa Makala Martin Henry aliandika:

eng: Portia Simpson came to representational politics at the parliamentary level in 1976 when political tribalism and its ugly pickney, political violence, were on the upswing.
swa: Portia Simpson alikuja katika siasa za uwakilishi kwa ngazi ya bunge mwaka 1976 wakati siasa za ukabila na mabaya yake, vurugu za kisiasa zilikuwa za hali ya juu.

eng: The state of emergency declared by the Government that year, partly in response to escalating violence associated with the election campaign, assisted the young KSAC councillor to capture what up till then was a safe JLP seat, having never been won before by the PNP since its creation in 1959.
swa: Hali ya hatari ilitangazwa na serikali mwaka huo, ikiwa ni matokeo ya vurugu zilizosababishwa na kampeni za uchaguzi, ikisaidia diwani kijana wa KSAC kushikilia nafasi ya JLP mpaka hapo ilipoonekana kuwa ni salama tena, na PNP haijawahi kushinda tangu kuundwa kwake hapo 1959.

eng: Her 76 per cent margin of victory in '76 just kept growing to the point where it equalled the number of voters, even when a few voted for the JLP candidate.
swa: Kiwango cha asilimia 76 za ushindi wake hapo 1976 kimeendelea kukua kufikia kiwango cha idadi sawa na wapiga kura, hata pale wachache walipopiga kura kwa mgombea wa JLP.

eng: Since 1976, criminal violence, indexed by murder, has progressively increased, with South West Andrew making its above-average contribution.
swa: Tangu 1976, vurugu za kihalifu, mauaji yakiongoza, imeendelea kuongezeka na Kusini Magharibi St Andrew ikichangia kwa asilimia nyingi.

eng: Within a week or two of Simpson-Miller's resignation as a member of parliament, the party became gradually embroiled in a political tussle over her possible successor in the constituency.
swa: Ndani ya wiki moja au mbili za kujiuzulu kwa Simpson-Miller kama mbunge, chama chake kimeanza kugubikwa kidogo kidogo na mkanganyiko na mpambano wa kisiasa juu ya mrithi wa jimbo lake.

eng: This was reported and commented on in detail by both traditional and social media.
swa: Hili liliripotiwa na kutolewa maoni na vyombo vya habari pamoja na mitamdao ya kijamii.

eng: Jamaicans have a taste for political intrigue, and many (especially those with party affiliations) are following every twist and turn with interest.
swa: Wa-Jamaica wanapenda fitna za kisiasa na wengi (hasa wale wenye maslahi na chama) hufuatilia kila jambo kwa hamasa.

eng: Blake, who has recovered, is reportedly no longer interested in contesting the seat.
swa: Blake, ambaye amepata nafuu, ameripotiwa kutokutaka kugombea nafasi hiyo tena.

eng: While Councillor Audrey Smith-Facey, who is campaigning under the hashtag #OurAudrey, was expected to be the main contender, the waters were muddied considerably when a video was posted of Simpson Miller endorsing former Kingston mayor, Councillor Angela Brown-Burke, to succeed her.
swa: Wakati Diwani Audrey Smith-Facey, ambaye anafanya kampeni kwa hashtagi #AudreyWetu, alitarajiwa kuwa ndiye mpinzani mkuu, maji yalivurugwa mno pale video ya Simpson Miller akimuidhinisha Meya wa zamani wa Kingston, Diwani Angela Brown-Burke, kuwa mrithi wake.

eng: This was a surprise to many, with some questioning whether it was genuine, having come after the nomination period had ended; this threw the party into further confusion.
swa: Hii ilikuwa mshtuko kwa wengi kukiwa na maswali kama ilikuwa ni vizuri, kutolewa wakati kipindi cha uteuzi kikiwa kimepita, hili limekifanya chama kiingie katika mkanganyiko zaidi.

eng: According to one news report, however, party delegates are firmly rejecting Brown-Burke.
swa: Kulingana na moja ya taarifa za habari, hata hivyo, wajumbe wa chama wamemkataa Brown-Burke.

eng: Many would like to see the young maverick, Damion Crawford, in the seat.
swa: Wengi wangependa kumuona kijana machachari Damion Crawford, akichukua nafasi hiyo.

swa: Inaonekana Crawford hana mpango na nafasi hiyo ila hilo halimzuii kufurahia mzaha katika jambo hilo (akiwa amefungamanisha pembe zake na Brown Burke katika mitandao ya jamii mwaka 2015):

eng: Noting in fake exasperation: In moments like these i wish my name wasn't damion crawford it's too easy to call.
