eng: Residents of Boracay in the central Philippine province of Aklan are mobilizing against a plan by the government to shut down and environmentally "rehabilitate" the world-famous resort island for six months, at the same time that two casinos are in the works.
swa: Wakazi wa kisiwa cha Boracay kikichopo katikati mwa mji wa Alkan uliomaeneo ya kati ya Ufilipino, wanashirikiana kupinga mpango wa serikali wa kukifunga kwa miezi sita kisiwa maarufu duniani kwa utalii kwa kile kinachoelezwa kuwa ni kwa sababu ya "uboreshaji" wa mazingira, huku ujenzi wa makasino mawili makubwa ukiendelea.

eng: Fearing loss of employment for thousands of workers and the destruction of an economy based on resort operations in Boracay, residents formed the #NoToBoracayClosure Coalition to defend people’s livelihoods and oppose moves to transform the island into a mega-casino complex:
swa: Wakihofia kupoteza ajira kwa maelfu ya wafanyakazi na kuharibiwa kwa uchumi unaotokana na shughuli za kitalii kwenye kisiwa cha Boracay, wakazi wake wameunda UmojaWaKuteteaKutokufungwaKwaBoracay kwa lengo la kulinda mustakabali wa maisha yao pamoja na kupinga hatua ya kubadilisha kisiwa hicho kuwa cha mkusanyiko wa makasino makubwa:

eng: We are calling on President Rodrigo Duterte to rescind his blanket closure order of the country’s premier tourist destination.
swa: Tunamtaka Rais Rodrigo Duterte atengue kauli yake ya kufunga kisiwa muhimu kabisa nchini humu kwa kuwavutia watalii.

eng: We also call on the national government to come up with a scientific and comprehensive rehabilitation plan for Boracay that will not result to massive economic dislocation after due consultation with all its stakeholders.
swa: Tunaitaka pia serikali kuu ije na mkakati madhubuti na wa kisayansi wa kuendeleza Boracay na ambao hautapelekea kuharibu hali ya uchumi kwa kuwashirikisha ipasavyo wadau wake wote.

eng: Boracay has long received flak from environmentalists, but these issues suddenly came into the spotlight in February 2018.
swa: Kwa kipindi kirefu Boracay imekuwa ikipokea hati zisizoridhisha kutoka kwa wanamazingira, lakini, suala hili lilikuja kutiliwa mkazo zaidi mapema mwezi Februari 2018.

eng: Calling the resort island a “cesspool,” Duterte declared he would close down the island after six months if these environmental problems were not solved immediately.
swa: Kisiwa hiki cha watalii ambacho kimekuwa kikifahamika kwa jina la “shimo la maji taka,” Duterte aliweka wazi kuwa angekifunga baada ya miezi sita kama changamoto hizi za uhifadhi wa mazingira zisingalitafutiwa ufumbuzi mapema iwzekanavyo.

eng: Boats and tourists in Boracay.
swa: Boti na watali huko Boracay.

eng: Photo credit: Wikimedia Commons.
swa: Picha na: Wikimedia Commons.

eng: Duterte's outburst came after an inspection of the island by the government’s tourism and environment agencies in January.
swa: Tamko la Duterte linakuja kufuatia uchunguzi uliofanyika visiwani humo na wakala wa serikali wa masuala ya utalii na mazingira mapema January.

eng: Duterte then ordered Cabinet to prepare for the closure of the island by April 26, without consultation with local stakeholders and in the absence of any master plan for the development and rehabilitation of the island, or contingency plans for the livelihoods and relocation of those affected.
swa: Na ndipo Duterte alipolitaka baraza la Mawaziri kufanya maandalizi ya kukifunga kisiwa hiki hadi kufika Aprili 26, bila hata ya kushauriana na wadau wakaazi na bila ya uwepo wa mpango kazi wowote wa kuendeleza na kuboresha kisiwa wala kuwepo kwa mpango wa muda mrefu wa maisha ya watu na utoaji wa makazi mapya kwa wale walioathirika.

eng: Several sectors became suspicious of Duterte’s intentions after reports came out that the government has granted the Macau-based Galaxy Entertainment Group (GEG) permission to construct a US$500 million casino complex in the prime tourist destination.
swa: Sekta mbalimbali ziliingiwa na mashaka kuhusu maamuzi ya Duterete mara baada ya taarifa kuvuja kuwa serikali imetoa kibali kwa Kampuni ya Burudani ya Galaxy (GEG) yenye maskani yake huko Macau cha kujenga kasino lenye thamani ya dola milioni 500 za Kimarekani kwenye kisiwa hiki muhimu mno kwa kuvutia watalii.

eng: The Presidential Palace announced it was cancelling the deal, yet the Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation (PAGCOR) has in fact granted a permit to GEG and its local partner, Leisure and Resorts World Corporation (LRWC).
swa: Ikulu ilitangaza kusitisha mkataba huu, lakini Shirika la Burudani na Michezo la nchini Ufilipino (PAGCOR) lilikuwa tayari limeshatoa kibali kwa GEG na mshirika wake mkaazi, Kampuni ya Sherehe na Burudani (LRWC).

eng: The company dismissed claims by officials that they are looking for another venue for the casino.
swa: Kampuni hii ilikanusha madai yaliyotolewa na serikali kuwa wanatafuta sehemu nyingine ya kujenga kasino.

eng: Duterte denied knowledge of a plan to construct a casino on Boracay, but official photos show the president meeting with GEG representatives, led by its chairman Lui Che-Woo and vice chairman Francis Lui Yiu Tiung, at the Presidential Palace on December 6, 2017.
swa: Duterte alikanusha kufahamu mpango wa kujenga kasino kwenye kisiwa cha Baracoy, pamoja na uwepo wa picha rasmi za serikali zinazoonesha mkutano wa Rais na wawakilishi wa kampuni ya GEG , ulioongozwa na Mwenyekiti wake Lui Che-Woo na Naibu Mwenyekiti Francis Lui Yiu Tiung, wakiwa katika makazi ya Raid mapema tarehe 6 Disemba, 2017.

eng: Duterte meets with officials of Macau-based casino magnates Galaxy Entertainment Group at the Presidential Palace last December 6, 2017.
swa: Duterte akutana na wawakilishi wa kampuni ya masuala ya Burudani inayofahamika kama Galaxy yenye maskani yake huko Macau mapema tarehe 6 Disemba, 2017.

eng: Philippine government photo
swa: Picha kutoka Serikali ya Ufilipino

eng: PAGCOR officials also said that a second mega-casino complex is in the works in Boracay, following its approval of gaming operations by a joint venture between tycoon Andrew Tan and Malaysia’s Genting Group at the Savoy Hotel, located at Megaworld Corporation’s Boracay New Coast development.
swa: Wawakilishi wa PAGCOR pia walisema kuwa kasino kubwa la pili linaendelea kujengwa huko Boracay, mara baada ya kupatiwa kibali cha kufanya burudani kufuatia muungano wa pamoja kati ya mfanyabiashara mkubwa Andrew Tan na Kampuni ya Malaysia ya Genting kwenye hoteli ya Savoy, inayopatikana kwenye eneo la mpango wa maendeleo ya fukwe wa Boracay wa kampuni ya inayojihusisha na mali zisizo hamishika inayofahamika kama Megaworld.

eng: To allay public outrage over the contradiction between the avowed aim of environmental rehabilitation and the building of mega-casinos on the island, Duterte then claimed that Boracay would in fact be subjected to land reform.
swa: Kama namna ya kuwanyamazisha wananchi waliochukizwa kufuatia makanganyiko wa kati ya lengo lililokubaliwa la kufanyia maboresho ya mazingira na ujenzi wa kasino kubwa kisiwani humo, Duterte alitamka kuwa kisiwa cha Boracay kitawekewa mpango mpya wa matumzi ya ardhi .

eng: But many find this statement outlandish, given that there is not much farmland left on the resort island, most of whose area is already occupied by residential and commercial structures.
swa: Hata hivyo, watu wengi wamegundua kuwa kauli hii inakosa mashiko, kutokana na ukweli kuwa hakuna tena ardhi ya kutosha kwenye kisiwa hiki cha mapumziko, maeneo mengi yameshajengwa kwa ajili ya makazi pamoja na majengo ya biashara.

eng: The laments of Boracay residents over Duterte’s closure order are captured in a short documentary by Jason Magbanua posted on Facebook, which was contextualized with the following text: FACT
swa: Malalamiko ya wakazi wa Boracay kuhusu hatua ya Duterte ya kukifungia kisiwa hiki yanafafanuliwa kwenye filamu fupi iliyoandaliwa na Jason Magbanua iliyopakiwa kwenye ukurasa wa Facebook, na kisha kufafanuliwa kwa undani kupitia maelezo yafuatayo:

eng: Thousands upon thousands of real people will be affected by a complete closure of the island.
swa: Malefu kwa maelfu ya watu wataathirika ikiwa kisiwa hiki kitafungwa moja kwa moja.

eng: Real, breathing humans, not statistics.
swa: Watu halisi, wanaopumua, siyo takwimu.

eng: We are talking about kids, mothers, fathers, entire families – not an "insignificant GDP drop.
swa: Tunawaongelea watoto, akina mama, akina baba, familia yote kwa ujumla – siyo "kushuka kiduchu kwa kiwango cha ukuaji uchumi (GDP).

eng: FACT
swa: UKWELI

eng: There are more realistic solutions in solving the problems of Boracay.
swa: Kuna namna nzuri zaidi za kutatua changamoto za Boracay.

eng: Solutions that won't completely disenfranchise the people inhabiting the island, the greatest, most important stakeholders of them all.
swa: Suluhisho ambalo halitawadharau kabisa wakazi wa kisiwa hicho, jamii ya watu ambao ndio wa muhimu kabisa kuliko kitu kingine chochote.

eng: For Ilonggo blogger Samot Tallana, the handling of the Boracay issue only exposes the bankruptcy of President Duterte's environmentalist and populist pretensions.
swa: Mwanablogu wa Blogu ya Ilonggo Samot Tallana, anasema kuwa namna suala la Boracay linavyoshughulikiwa linaanika namna Rais Duterte alivyokosa hoja kwa kujidai hadharani kuwa yeye ni mwanamazingira.

eng: Mass layoffs of tourism workers in the island have already begun as business establishments scramble to cope with the shutdown.
swa: Idadi kubwa ya wafanyakazi wa sekta ya utalii wameanza kuachishwa kazi kisiwani humo kama namna ya wafanyabiashara kukabiliana na madhara ya kufungwa kwa kisiwa hicho.

eng: Electricity prices across Aklan are likewise expected to shoot up as the province’s lone power supplier seeks to recover the P99 million (US$1.9 million) loss from the island’s closure.
swa: Bili za umeme katika maeneo yote ya Aklan inategemewa pia kuongezeka kwani msambaza umeme jimboni hapo anatarajia kuokoa kiasi cha Pesosi milioni 99 (sawa na dola za kimarekani milioni 1.9), kiasi kitakachopotezwa kwa kufungwa kisiwa hicho.

eng: Many also question the draconian security measures imposed by the government, such as the deployment of riot police, restricting access to many parts of Boracay, and preventing the media from monitoring the planned rehabilitation of the island.
swa: Watu wengi pia wanahoji taratibu za kikatili za ulinzi zilizowekwa na serikali, kama vile kuwatumia polisi wa machafuko, kuweka vizuizi vinavyozuia watu kufika maeneo mengi ya Boracay, na kuzuia vyombo vya habari kufuatilia mwenendo wa mpango wa uboreshaji wa kisiwa hiki.

eng: Concerned citizens put up Friends of Boracay network to help campaign against the island's closure.
swa: Raia walioguswa wameanzisha matandao wa Marafiki wa Boracay kama namna ya kusaidia kuendesha kampeni ya kuzuia kufungwa kwa kisiwa hiki.

eng: Photo used with permission.
swa: Picha imetumiwa kwa ruhusa.

eng: While many agree on the need to address Boracay’s environmental woes, the economic destruction to be wrought by the arbitrary and sudden closure of the island has compelled different sectors to close ranks behind the affected residents and workers.
swa: Wakati watu wengi wakikubaliana na uhitaji wa kukabiliana na changamoto ya hali mbaya ya mazingira ya Boracay, anguko la kiuchumi linalosababishwa na sintofahamu na uharaka wa kufunga kisiwa cha Boracay kumepelekea makundi mbalimbali ya watu kuungana pamoja na wakazi na wafanyakazi waliothiriwa.

eng: A Friends of Boracay Facebook page has been set up to gather statements of support for the island, its workers, and its small and medium enterprises.
swa: Marafiki wa Boracay ukurasa wa Facebook umeanzishwa kwa lengo la kukusanya matamko yenye lengo la kuunga mkono kampeni ya kisiwa hiki ya kuwasaidia wafanyakazi na vikundi vidogo na vya kati vya wafanyabiashara.

eng: As the date of the island’s closure nears, they are calling on the public to take a stand for Boracay and the people who will be displaced by its closure.
swa: Kadiri ya siku za kufunga kisiwa hiki zinavyokaribia, wanawaomba wananchi kuwa na msimamo thabiti kwa ajili ya Boracay na kuwaunga mkono watu ambao watahamishwa ikiwa kisiwa hiki kitafungwa.

eng: As Ugandan president Museveni plans a social media tax to curb gossip, netizens are concerned over freedom of expression.
swa: Wakati Rais Mseveni wa Uganda akipanga kutoza kodi mitandao ya kijamii kama njia ya kuzuia umbea, raia wa mtandaoni wanahoji kuhusu uhuru wa kujieleza.

eng: Image by Pixabay via CC0 Creative Commons, used with permission.
swa: Picha na Pixabay kupitia CC0 Creative Commons, na imetumiwa kwa ruhusa.

eng: In early April 2018, Museveni directed the Ministry of Finance to introduce taxes on "over the top" communication platforms (OTTs) such as Facebook, Twitter, and WhatsApp.
swa: Mapema mwezi Aprili 2018, Rais Mseveni alielekeza Wizara ya Fedha kuanzisha kodi kwa ajili ya mitandao “maarufu” ya kijamii kama vile facebook, Twitter na WhatsApp.

eng: In Museveni's view, social media users use these platforms for what he called 'lugambo' (meaning gossip in Lugwere).
swa: Rais Mseveni anawaona watumiaji wa mitandao ya kijamii hutumia majukwaa hayo ya habari mtandaoni kwa kile anachokiita ‘lugambo’ (maana yake umbea katika lugha ya lugwere).

eng: In a statement quoted by The Daily Monitor, Musveni explained his position:
swa: Kwa kauli yake iliyokaririwa na gazeti la Daily Monitor, Rais Museveni anaeleza msimamo wake:

eng: However, lugambo on social media (opinions, prejudices, insults, friendly chats) and advertisements by Google and I do not know who else must pay tax because we need resources to cope with the consequences of their lugambo...
swa: Hata hivyo, lugambo katika mitandao ya kijamii (maoni, chuki, matusi, maongezi ya kirafiki) na matangazo kupitia Google na hata kupitia mtandao mwingine wowote lazima yatozwe kodi kwa sababu tunahitaji rasilimali ili kukabili athari za lugambo...

eng: The president accused the Finance Ministry and Uganda Revenue Authority of not working hard enough to identify new sources of taxes, lamenting that the government currently lacks tax income.
swa: Rais alilalamika kuwa kwa sasa serikali inakosa kodi ya mapato na kuishtumu Wizara ya Fedha na Mamlaka ya Mapato ya Uganda kwa kuzembea kuainisha vyanzo vipya vya kodi.

eng: The government's attention to "over-the-top" applications raises a long-standing issue that many governments have taken with IP-based (Internet Protocol) communication applications, such as WhatsApp, which are free of charge for any person with internet access.
swa: Mkazo wa serikali juu ya matumizi ya mitandao mikubwa ya kijamii inaibua suala lililokuwepo muda mrefu ambalo serikali nyingi zimechukua itifaki ya matumizi ya mawasiliano ya kimtandao kama WhatsApp, ambazo zipo huru bila tozo kwa mtu yeyote anayetumia mtandao.

eng: Government actors (in Uganda and many other countries) have long voiced concern about losses in revenue for national telecom operators that were once the primary providers (and cost beneficiaries) of these services.
swa: Watendaji wa serikali (katika Uganda na nchi nyingine) kwa muda mrefu wanapata hasara ya maduhuli ya uendeshaji wa mawasiliano ya taifa ambayo wao walikuwa wa kwanza kutoa (na wapanga gharama) huduma hizi.

eng: Museveni assures citizens that this tax will not affect those who use the internet for educational purposes, arguing that it will only affect those who spend time online engaging in idle gossip.
swa: Rais Mseveni anawahakikishia wananchi kuwa kodi hii haitawathiri wale ambao watatumia mtandao kwa madhumuni ya kielimu, itaathiri wale wote ambao watatumia intaneti kwa ajili ya udaku.

eng: In an opinion piece for The Daily Monitor, Daniel Bill Opio called the social media tax "regressive":
swa: Maoni ya gazeti la Daily Monitor, Daniel Bill Opio aliita kuwa kodi inayotozwa kwenye mitandao ya kijamii ni "kirudisha maendeleo nyuma":

eng: Social media being a widely used platform for communication, and most importantly as means to access of information, imposing of taxes thereon will be an impediment to the enjoyment of various rights.
swa: Mitandao ya kijamii inatumiwa sana kwa mawasiliano na pia kama njia ya kupata habari, kuiwekea kodi ni kuzuia haki mbalimbali zilizopo katika kutumia mitandao.

eng: Indeed, officials have offered no information about how (or by whom) social media content will be judged for its quality.
swa: Kiukweli, viongozi hawajaeleza namna (au nani) ya kutathmini ubora wa maudhui ya habari ya mitandao ya kijamii.

eng: If gossip or rumors take a political tone, could this lead to taxation or even indirect censorship of political criticism?
swa: Kama tetesi zikichukua mrengo wa kisiasa, je zinaonesha kuelekea kwenye kodi au ni sensa isiyo rasmi ya kujua ukosoaji wa kisiasa?

eng: Netizens have also expressed doubts about the economic rationale behind the proposal.
swa: Pia,Wananchi wameeleza wasiwasi juu ya mantiki ya kiuchumi ulioko nyuma ya pendekezo hili.

eng: Democratic Party President Norbert Mao wrote on his Facebook page:
swa: Raisi wa chama cha demokrasia Norbert Mao aliandika kupitia ukurasa wake wa facebook:

eng: At a time when other countries are cutting the costs of internet, President Museveni wants to increase its cost.
swa: Wakati nchi nyingine zikipunguza gharama za kutumia intaneti, Rais Museveni yeye anataka kuongeza gharama kwenye mitandao ya kijamii.

eng: We actually need to aspire to making internet free.
swa: Hakika tunahitaji kufanya gharama za intaneti kuwa bure.

eng: Some are questioning whether these taxes will truly benefit Ugandans or if they will be used for Museveni's personal gains, as has been alleged in the past:
swa: Wananchi wengine wanahoji kama kweli kodi zitakazotolewa zitanufaisha waganda au zitamnufaisha Mseveni mwenyewe, kamailivyo kuwa ikidaiwa siku za nyuma:

eng: Uganda wants to profit where it did not invest.
swa: Serikali ya Uganda inataka kufaidika mahali ambapo haijawekeza.

eng: Social media owners gave it out for free and you wanna tax it?
swa: Wamiliki wa mitandao ya kijamii hutoa bila kutoza kodi, wewe unataka walipe kodi?

eng: Is it an opportunity to increase revenue, avoiding transparency or just GREED?!! — Trish (@trish886) April 9, 2018
swa: Je ni fursa ya kuongeza maduhuli, au kukwepa kukosolewa au ni tamaa?!! — Trish (@trish886) Tarehe 9,Aprili 2018

eng: The fact that social media was blocked twice on election day in Uganda on February 18, 2016, and during the swearing in of the president in May 2016 discourages poet and human rights lawyer Kizza Ebron:
swa: Ukweli ni kwamba tarehe 18 Februari, 2016 siku ya uchaguzi katika nchi ya Uganda, mitandao ya kijamii ilizimwa mara mbili, na mwezi Mei siku rais anaapishwa mwanasheria wa haki za binadamu na muimbaji wa mashairi Kizza Ebron alizuiwa.

eng: The proposal to tax social has a bothersome background.
swa: Pendekezo la kutoza kodi mitandao ya kijamii lina usuli unaokera.

eng: Eron goes on to compare social media to a public highway:
swa: Eron analinganisha mitandao ya kijamii na vyombo vya habari vikubwa:

swa: Mitandao ya kijamii ni barabara kuu.

eng: The proposed tax on social media use is a military road block.
swa: Kodi inayopendekezwa kutozwa watumiaji wa mitandao ya kijamii ni kama kizuizi cha kijeshi barabarani.

eng: Kyambadde Ronald, a health and social justice advocate, tweets:
swa: Kyambadde Ronald, wakili wa haki za kijamii na afya aliaandika kwenye ukurasa wa tweeter:

eng: The government of Uganda should at some point understand that the citizens are not gold mines, which they'll exploit vehemently, how on earth can you justify, the ongoing saga of new taxes- social media tax, banking tax etc?
swa: Kuna wakati serikali ya Uganda inapaswa kufahamu kuwa raia siyo migodi ya dhahabu, kiasi cha kuwatumia hadi tone la mwisho la damu yao, unawezaje kukubali, matukio yanayoendelea ya kodi mpya- kodi za mitandao ya kijamii, kodi za huduma za benki n.k?

eng: Internet World Stats reports that Uganda currently has about 19 million internet subscribers, with 43 percent of the population online.
swa: Tovuti ya Internet World Stats inaripoti kuwa Uganda ina takribani watu milioni 19 waliojisajili kwenye huduma ya intaneti, ambapo asilimia 43 ya idadi ya watu wake wanapatikana mtandaoni.

eng: The move to tax social media users could increase the digital gap if cost barriers rise.
swa: Azma ya kutoza kodi watumiaji wa mitandao ya kijamii itaongeza pengo katika kutumia mtandao.

eng: This is only one way in which spaces for civic engagement are shrinking in Uganda.
swa: Hii ni mojawapo ya namna inayolenga kuminya nafasi ya mahusiano ya kiraia nchini Uganda.

eng: A January 2018 report from Unwanted Witness, a Ugandan NGO, painted a dim picture for free expression online in Uganda:
swa: Ripoti ya Januari 2018 ya shirika lisilo la kiserikali la UNwanted Witness la nchini Uganda, liliandaa picha iliyofifia kwa ajili ya kudai uhuru wa kutoa maoni mtandaoni nchini Uganda:

eng: 2017 registered the highest number of Ugandans ever arrested for their online expression and these arrests are clearly targeted crackdown on free flow of information and speech on the Internet.
swa: Mwaka 2017 ni mwaka ambao kulikuwa na orodha kubwa ya waganda walitiwa nguvuni kutokana na maoni yao ya mtandaoni, kamatakamata inayolenga kukwamisha utoaji huru wa habari na uhuru wa kujieleza kupitia mtandao wa intaneti.

eng: In March 2018, the Uganda Communications Commission put out a directive to all online content creators to register their websites, creating yet another barrier to free expression online.
swa: Mwezi Machi 2018, Tume ya mawasiliano nchini Uganda ilitoa maelekezo kwa waandaaji wa maudhui ya habari za mtandaoni kuandikisha tovuti zao, hali inayoongeza kikwazo kingine katika uhuru wa kutoa maoni kupitia mtandao wa intaneti.

eng: The directive read:
swa: Mwongozo huo unasomeka:

eng: All online data communication service providers, including online publishers, online news platforms, online radio and television operators are therefore, advised to apply and obtain authorisation from the Commission with immediate effect.
swa: Watoa huduma za taarifa za mawasiliano mtandaoni, ukijumuisha wachapishaji, majukwaa ya habari za mtandaoni, waendeshaji wa redio na runinga za mtandaoni, wanashauriwa kutuma maombi na kupata kibali kutoka Tume mapema iwezekanavyo.

eng: As of now, it is still not clear how the "gossip tax" will be implemented or monitored, or when it will take effect.
swa: Mpaka sasa, haijajulikana wazi tetesi za kutoza kodi zitatekelezwa au kuratibiwa kwa namna gani au ni lini zitaanza kutekelezwa.

eng: At 4:14 p.m.
Eastern Daylight Time (EDT) on May 11, 2018, Bangabandhu-1, Bangladesh’s first geostationary communications satellite, was launched into space from Cape Canaveral, Florida in the United States.
swa: Mchana Saa za Mashariki (EDT) Mei 11, 2018, Bangabandhu-1, satelaiti ya kwanza ya mawasiliano nchini Bangladeshi ilirushwa angani kutokea Cape Canaveral, Florida nchini Marekani.

eng: It marked a key milestone for the country and was celebrated throughout Bangladesh.
swa: Haya ni mafanikio makubwa kwa nchi na yalisherehekewa Bangladeshi nzima.

eng: Bangabandhu-1, named after the nickname of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, founding father of Bangladesh, was launched into its orbital slot on 119.1 degrees east longitude.
swa: Bangabandhu-1, ilipewa jina hili ambalo ni jina la Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, ambaye ni baba wa Taifa la Bangladeshi, na ilirushwa katika mhimili wake wa nyuzi 119.1 longitudo ya Mashariki.

eng: The satellite's mission is expected to last at least 15 years.
swa: Mpango huu wa setilaiti unategemewa kudumu angalau kwa miaka 15.

eng: The launch was originally planned for May 10 and postponed to take place the following day after an error was found just a minute before launch.
swa: Ilipangwa chombo hicho kurushwa tangu Mei 10 lakini iliahirishwa na kufanyika siku iliyofuata baada ya kuonekana hitilafu dakika chache kabla ya kurushwa.

eng: A delegation of Bangladeshi officials, led by State Minister for Telecommunications and Post, Tarana Halim, arrived in Florida on Tuesday to witness the successful launch.
swa: Ujumbe wa maafisa wa Bangladesh uliongozwa na Waziri wa Mawasiliano ya Simu na Posta, Tarana Halim, waliwasili Florida siku ya Jumanne kushuhudia chombo hicho kikirushwa kwa mafanikio.

swa: Kurushwa kwa chombo hicho ni mafanikio kwa kampuni SpaceX, iliyokuwa imechukuwa mkataba wa kukirusha chombo yenyewe.

eng: It was the debut of a new upgrade to their launch vehicle, known as Falcon 9 Block 5, which is a more reusable, higher-thrust model.
swa: Ulikuwa mwanzo wa kupanda viwango kwa gari lao la kurushia linalojulikana kama Falcon 9 Block 5, ambalo ni la muundo ambao linaweza kutumika tena, na lenye msukumo mkubwa.

eng: SpaceX is an American company founded in 2002 by entrepreneur Elon Musk.

eng: Bangabandhu-1 will provide satellite television, internet access, and emergency communication services, as well as broadband to rural areas in Bangladesh, and will be operated by the newly-formed state-owned company the Bangladesh Communication Satellite Company Ltd, after having been led by the Bangladesh Telecommunication Regulatory Committee (the BTRC) up until this point.
swa: Bangabandhu-1 itatoa huduma za runinga za setilaiti, mtandao wa intaneti, na huduma ya mawasiliano ya dharura kwa maeneo ya vijijini ya Bangladeshi na itaendeshwa na kampuni mpya iliyoundwa na inayomilikiwa na serikali inayoitwa Kampuni ya Mawasiliano ya Setilaiti Bangladeshi Ltd, baada ya kuwa imeongozwa mpaka sasa na Kamati ya Uratibu wa Mawasikiano ya Simu Bangladeshi mpaka sasa (Bangladesh Telecommunication Regulatory Committee - BTRC.)

eng: According to the Dhaka Tribune, Bangladesh’s annual expenditure for satellite connectivity is currently 14 million USD spent on renting bandwidth from foreign operators.
swa: Kulingana na the Dhaka Tribune, Bangladesh kwa mwaka hutumia kiasi cha dola milioni 14 kwa ajili ya kukodi mawasiliano ya setilaiti kutoka kwa makampuni ya kigeni.

eng: As Brazil creates new mechanisms to prevent the spread of fake news, internet freedom activists are worried this will restrict free speech.
swa: Wakati Brazil wakitengeneza mbinu mpya ya kupambana na ueneaji wa habari zisizo za kweli, wanaharakati wa mtandaoni wanahofia kuwa hili litazuia uhuru wa kujieleza.

eng: Imaged shared by Digital Spy on Flickr, with permission: CC BY-NC-SA 2.0
swa: Picha na Digital Spy on Flickr, imetumiwa kwa ruhusa: CC BY-NC-SA 2.0

eng: In early December 2017, Brazil's government established a committee to monitor and possibly order the blocking of false news reports on social media ahead of the 2018 presidential elections.
swa: Mwanzoni mwa Disemba 2017, serikali ya Brazili iliunda kamati ya kuratibu na ikibidi kufungia taarifa zisizo za kweli katika mitandao ya kijamii kuelekea uchaguzi wa Rais utakaofanyika mwaka 2018.

eng: The news has raised concerns about censorship among the public.
swa: Habari hiyo imeamsha hisia kuhusu udhibiti huo miongoni mwa jamii.

eng: The "Consultative Council on Internet and Elections" will operate under the auspices of the Superior Electoral Court and includes representatives from the Court, the Ministry of Justice, the Ministry of Science and Technology, the army, the national intelligence agency, the federal police, SaferNet (a Brazilian non-governmental organization (NGO) that combats online crime in partnership with the Federal Public Ministry) and researchers from the Getúlio Vargas Foundation (a private university).
swa: Baraza la Ushauri kuhusu Mtandao wa Intaneti na Uchaguzi litafanya kazi chini ya mwamvuli wa Mahakama Kuu ya Masuala ya Uchaguzi likihusisha wawakilishi kutoka katika Mahakama, Wizara ya Sheria, Wizara ya Sayansi na Teknolojia, Jeshi, Shirika la Ujausi la Taifa, Jeshi la Polisi, SaferNet (shirika lisilo la Kiserikali nchini Brazili (NGO) ambalo hupambana na uhalifu wa.mitandaoni ikishirikiana na Wizara ya Mambo ya Jamii) na Chuo binafsi cha Getúlio Vargas Foundation.

eng: In its first meeting, the Council proposed to create a tool through which users could file reports to the Council itself of news that appeared suspicious.
swa: Katika kikao chake cha kwanza, Baraza lilipendekeza kutengenezwa kwa zana ambayo watumiaji wa mtandao watakuwa wakitumia kutoa taarifa dhidi ya habari wanazozitilia shaka.

eng: This would work as an extension of existing hotlines and website forms where voters can submit complaints to report irregularities in traditional media.
swa: Hii itapanua wigo ukijumlisha na uwepo wa simu ya moja kwa moja na fomu katika tovuti ambazo wapiga kura watakuwa wakitumia kufikisha malalamiko yao dhidi ya vyombo vya habari.

eng: The Council has not yet further explained how the tool would operate in terms of asking social media companies to remove news deemed false or targeting people and groups that post false news.
swa: Baraza halikueleza zaidi jinsi zana au kifaa hicho kitavyokuwa kikifanya kazi katika kuyataka makampuni ya mitandao ya kijamii kuondoa habari zisizo za kweli au jinsi itakavyowalenga watu na vikundi vitakavyokuwa vimetoa habari za uongo.

eng: Members say they are negotiating support from social media companies, but it remains unclear where this will lead.
swa: Wajumbe walisema kuwa walikuwa wanajadili kuungwa mkono na makampuni ya mitandao ya kijamii lakini haifahamiki uelekeo wa suala hili utakuwa upi.

eng: When Facebook introduced a "report fake news" feature in December 2016, it showed that many users reported fake content as part of an effort to discredit information or ideas with which they disagreed, even when those ideas were based on verified facts.
swa: Kipindi Facebook walipotambulisha kipengele cha "ripoti taarifa isiyo kweli" hapo Disemba 2016, ilionesha kuwa watumiaji wengi waliripoti mahudhui yasiyo ya kweli kama jitihada za kukataa taarifa au mawazo ambayo wao hawaafikiani nayo hata kama mawazo hayo ni hakika na yamethibitishwa.

eng: This move comes amid deep political uncertainty in Brazil approaching the 2018 elections, which will be the first ballot following the controversial impeachment of president Dilma Rousseff of the Workers' Party in 2016.
swa: Mpango huu umekuja wakati kukiwa na mkanganyiko mkubwa wa kisiasa kuelekea uchaguzi mkuu nchini Brazili, ambapo utakuwa uchaguzi wa kwanza ukifuatia tuhuma tata dhidi ya Dilma Rousseff, Raisi wa Chama cha Wafanyakazi hapo 2016.

eng: The party's de-facto candidate for 2018 is former president Luiz Inácio "Lula" da Silva, who leads the presidential polls at 34% and has spent the past few months touring the country rallying crowds despite having been sentenced in July to nearly 10 years in prison for accepting bribes from construction companies during his term.
swa: Mgombea halisi wa chama kwa mwaka 2018 ni Raisi wa zamani Luiz Inácio "Lula" da Silva, ambaye anaongoza kwa kura za maoni kwa 34% na amekuwa akizuru nchi na kukusanya umati wa watu ingawa amehukumiwa hapo Julai kifungo cha miaka karibu kumi kwa kosa la kupokea rushwa kutoka kwa makampuni ya ujenzi katika kipindi cha Uongozi wake.

eng: A court is expected to rule on his appeal on January 24.
swa: Mahakama inatarajiwa kusikiliza rufaa yake hapo Januari 24.

eng: Large-scale corruption investigations have convicted dozens of politicians in the past three years, opening the grounds for outsiders and far-right candidates like Jair Bolsonaro, the federal deputy and former military officer, notorious for homophobic diatribes as well as tough-talking on criminals and drug-dealers.
swa: Upelelezi dhidi ya rushwa kubwa umewafunga makumi ya wanasiasa kwa kipindi cha miaka mitatu iliyopita na kufungua milango kwa watu wa nje na wale wa mrengo wa kulia kama vile Jair Bolsonaro, Msaidizi wa Kamanda na Afisa wa Jeshi Mstaafu, anayejulikana kwa kunanga mapenzi ya jinsia moja pamoja na kuwa na mijadala mikali dhidi ya uhalifu na wauza dawa za kulevya.

eng: Should Lula's conviction be upheld, a fragmented, polarized and heavily disputed electoral landscape is expected.
swa: Lazima hukumu ya Lula ikizingatiwa, tutegemee mgawanyiko, ubaguzi na mgogoro mkubwa katika uchaguzi

eng: More rules aimed at minimizing 'fake news'
swa: Sheria zaidi zakusudiwa katika kupunguza 'habari zisizo za kweli'

eng: The committee is only one of the immediate outcomes of the Superior Electoral Court's current preoccupation with 'fake news.'
swa: Kamati hii ni moja kati ya matokeo ya haraka ya Mahakama ya Masuala ya Uchaguzi iliyojazwa na 'habari za uongo'.

eng: The judges have openly defended the creation of additional legal mechanisms to suppress reports deemed as false.
swa: Majaji wametetea wazi kuundwa kwa mfumo wa ziada wa kisheria kuwajibisha habari zitakazodhaniwa kuwa ni za uongo.

eng: In hearings on the rules for 2018 elections, Justice Luis Fux, who will preside over the court starting in February, spoke of creating preventive measures to curb the spread of false information.
swa: Katika kuwasilisha sheria za uchaguzi wa mwaka 2018, Jaji Luis Fux, ambaye atakuwa Mwenyekiti wa mahakama kuanzia Februari alizungumza kuhusu kuunda hatua za tahadhari za kuzuia kuenea kwa bahari za uongo.

eng: This could include the freezing of assets and even prison time for those who could be "preparing themselves to perpetuate this kind of deleterious strategy which, so to say, in informal language, have melted some nominations."
swa: Hili litahusisha kutaifisha mali na hata kifungo kwa wale watakaokuwa " wamejiandaa kuendelea na mpango huu mbovu, hivyo ni kusema kuwa kwa lugha isiyo rasmi, kuyeyusha baadhi ya nafasi za uteuzi"

eng: Additionally, the Brazilian Congress is analysing a bill that would render sharing false reports on social media a crime punishable by two to eight months in prison or a fine of 1,500 to 4,000 BRL (500-1200 USD) per day.
swa: Kwa kuongezea, Bunge la Brazili linachambua muswada ambapo kutoa taarifa zisizo kweli katika mitandao ya kijamii litakuwa kosa la kuadhibiwa kwa kifungo cha miezi miwili hadi nane gerezani au faini ya fedha za Kibrazili 1,500 hadi 4,000 ambazo ni (dola za Marekani500-1200) kwa siku.

eng: The bill makes a criminal offense "to publish or share, through any means, on the internet, false or unfairly incomplete information to the detriment of a private individual or legal persons."
swa: Muswada unafanya "kuchapisha au kushirikisha kwa njia yoyote kwenye intaneti habari za uongo au habari ambayo haijakamilika na uongo huo kusababisha madhara kwa makusudi kwa mtu binafsi au kiongozi, kuwa kosa la jinai."

eng: Internet freedom activists speak out
swa: Wanaharakati wa Uhuru katika waongea

eng: Internet freedom activists have expressed concern over the bill and the creation of the Consultative Council.
swa: Wanaharakati wa uhuru wa mitandaoni wameelezea wasi wasi wao kuhusu mswada na kuundwa kwa Baraza la Ushauri.

eng: An open letter published by Coalizão Direitos na Rede (Internet Rights Coalition) during this year's Brazil Internet Forum (a regional meeting prior to the global Internet Governance Forum) criticised the military's poor record when it comes to respecting civil liberties in Brazil (Brazil was governed by a United States-supported military dictatorship from 1964 to 1985):
swa: Barua ya wazi iliyochapishwa na Direitos na Rede (Muungano wa Kugombea Haki za Mitandao) wakati wa Jukwaa la Intanet Brazili (mkutano wa kanda ulioutangulia mkutano wa ulimwengu kuhusu uendeshaji wa Intaneti) ilikosoa rekodi mbaya ya jeshi katika kuheshimu uhuru wa raia katika mwaka huu (Brazil ilitawaliwa na Marekani-ikisaidiwa na utawala wa kiimla wa jeshi kuanzia 1964 mpaka 1985):

eng: The Armed Forces must not monopolize control over the veracity of facts because 1) they do not possess that constitutional authority; 2) they do not have the technical capacity for this 3) they do not possess the necessary knowledge to distinguish fake news; and 4) they are not neutral in politics.
swa: Majeshi yenye silaha hayatahodhi ukweli wa mambo kwa sababu 1) hawamiliki mamlaka ya kikatiba; 2) hawana uwezo wa kitaalamu kuhusu hiki 3) hawana utaalamu wa kutofautisha habari ya uongo; na 4) hawako sawia katika siasa.

eng: To make it worse, these institutions have left violent and deep scars in the country's recent history by promoting the curtailment of freedom of expression and public demonstration of Brazilians during the civil-military dictatorship.
swa: Kuifanya kuwa mbaya zaidi, taasisi hizi zimeacha vurugu na makovu makubwa katika historia ya nchi ya hivi karibuni kwa kuhamasisha kukatishwa kwa uhuru wa kujieleza na maandamano ya waBrazili wakati wa utawala wa kiimla wa kiraia-jeshi.

eng: The creation of the committee by the Superior Electoral Court was also mentioned in a collective statement signed by 38 organizations from Latin America and the Caribbean as an example of how the discourse on fake news can be used to restrict free speech.
swa: Kuundwa kwa kamati na Mahakama ya Masuala ya Uchaguzi pia ilitajwa katika taarifa ya pamoja iliyosainiwa na mashirika 38 kutoka Amerika ya Ulatini na Karibiani kama mfano wa jinsi mjadala wa habari zisizo kweli unavyoweza kuzuia uhuru wa kujieleza.

eng: The letter expresses concerns over how hysteria over fake news eclipses the long-standing efforts for better regulation of media monopolies which dominate the mainstream media landscape in the region and has historically engaged in campaigns of misinformation during elections or otherwise:
swa: Barua ilielezea mashaka jinsi hofu juu ya habari zisizo za kweli ilivyogubika jitihada za muda mrefu za kuwa na sheria bora za kuhodhi vyombo vya habari ambapo imeshikilia vyombo vikuu vya habari katika ukanda na vimekuwa na historia ya kushiriki katika kampeni kuhusu kutoa taarifa zisizo sahihi wakati wa uchaguzi au vinginevyo:

eng: We cannot discount years of work and debate from the movement for democratization of communications and adopt the “fake news” terminology as a completely new phenomenon in Latin America.
swa: Hatuwezi tukapoteza miaka ya kazi na majadiliano kwenye harakati za kidemokrasia ya mawasiliano na kuchukua kauli ya "habari zisizo za kweli" kama kitu kipya kabisa katika Amerika ya Ulatini.

eng: (Left to right) Inés María Chapman Waugh, Beatriz Jhonson Urrutia Image and Salvador Valdés Mesa.
swa: (kutoka kushoto kuelekea kulia) Inés María Chapman Waugh, Beatriz Jhonson Urrutia na Salvador Valdés Mesa.

eng: Image made by the author with images from EcuRed.
swa: Picha na mwandishi kutoka EcuRed.

eng: On April 19, 2018, the Republic of Cuba swore in former university professor Miguel Díaz-Canel Bermúdez as its new president and the 9th Congress of the National Assembly of People’s Power—the country’s supreme body of government power—elected a new Council of State.
swa: Tarehe 19 Aprili, 2018, Jamhuri ya Cuba ilimuapisha Profesa wa zamani wa Chuo kikuu Miguel Díaz-Canel Bermúdez kama Rais wake mpya na bunge la 9 la taifa ambalo —ndiyo chombo cha juu chenye nguvu serikalini —lilichagua Halmashauri mpya ya taifa.

eng: But the euphoria and uncertainty surrounding a supposed “Cuba without Castros” and related matters have eclipsed another major development: the presence of four Black leaders who will be part of the new government through 2023.
swa: Lakini furaha na wasiwasi vipo ukizingatia “Cuba kutokuwa na Castro” na masuala mengine yanayohusiana yamezuia maendeleo makubwa: Kuwepo kwa viongozi wanne weusi ambao ni sehemu ya serikali mpya hadi mwaka 2023.

eng: Black Cubans make 10% of the population but their representation in circles of power has been very limited, in spite of ideals of equality after the revolution.
swa: Wacuba weusi ni asilimia 10 ya idadi ya watu wa Cuba lakini uwakilishi katika awamu za serikali umekuwa mdogo mno ingawa baada ya mapinduzi ya Cuba kumekuwa na dhana ya usawa.

eng: Before Bermúdez, the previous Congress had two Black men in senior positions: First Vice President Juan Esteban Lazo Hernández and Salvador Valdés Mesa, President of the National Assembly.
swa: Kabla ya Bermúdez , bunge lililopita lilikuwa na wacuba weusi wawili wa kiume katika nafasi za juu: Makamu wa kwanza wa Rais Juan Esteban Lazo Hernández and Salvador Valdés Mesa, ambaye alikuwa rais wa bunge la taifa.

eng: With the selection of Inés María Chapman Waugh and Beatriz Jhonson Urrutia as vice presidents, Cuba has, so to speak, “added more color” to the government.
swa: Kuteuliwa kwa Inés María Chapman Waugh na Beatriz Jhonson Urrutia kama makamu wa Rais, nchi ya Cuba imeongeza “rangi zaidi” katika serikali.

eng: Before I discuss the two women, I want to spend a minute on Valdés Mesa and Lazo Hernández.
swa: Kabla ya kuwajawadili wanawake wawili, nitumie dakika chache kuelezea Valdés Mesa na Lazo Hernández.

eng: Valdés, who previously held the positions of secretary of the Workers’ Central Union of Cuba, Minister of Labor and Social Security, and Secretary of Agricultural Workers, among others, is not from the generation of “los históricos” meaning those who led the 1959 Cuban Revolution, and who have usually ceded power only when they’re ousted or have died.
swa: Valdés, ambaye alishika nafasi ya katibu wa muungano mkuu wa wafanyakazi nchini Cuba, waziri wa kazi na hifadhi ya jamii, na pia Katibu wa umoja wafanyakazi wa kilimo si miongoni mwa kizazi cha “los históricos” yenye maana wale waliongoza mapinduzi nchini Cuba mwaka 1959, na ambao wamekuwa wakiachiwa madaraka pindi wenzao wanapoondolewa au kufa.

eng: He is from the generation that followed, as is Lazo, who was elected President of the National Assembly in 2013 and will keep the position until 2023, when he will be 79.
swa: Kama ilivyo kwa Lazo ambaye alichanguliwa kuwa Rais wa Bunge la taifa mwaka 2013, anatokea katika kizazi kilichofuata na atakuwa katika nafasi hiyo hadi mwaka 2023, atakapokuwa na miaka 79.

eng: Lazo has a long and varied trajectory in Cuban politics. He has been secretary of the Cuba Communist Party for the Matanzas, Santiago de Cuba, and Havana provinces, a member of the Cuban parliament since 1981, and Vice President of the Council of State since 1992.
swa: Lazo ana historia ndefu katika siasa za Cuba; amekuwa ni katibu wa chama cha kikomunisti cha Matanzas huko Santiago Cuba na mikoa ya Havana, mbunge wa bunge la Cuba tangu mwaka 1981, na makamu wa rais wa Halmashauri ya taifa tangu 1992.

eng: Lazo has also represented Cuba’s foreign affairs with countries in the Caribbean, Africa, and Asia.
swa: Pia, Lazo ameiwakilisha Cuba katika masuala ya mambo ya nje katika Karibi, Afrika na Asia.

eng: He was elected President of the National Assembly of People’s Power on February 25, 2013.
swa: Alichaguliwa kuwa rais wa bunge la taifa la nguvu ya umma tarehe 25 Feburuari 2013.

eng: A new crucible of scrutiny
swa: Makali mapya ya uchunguzi

eng: The two new women vice presidents are, by parliamentary standards, relatively young if we consider age in the Legislature—only about 13% of members are under 35.
swa: Wanawake wawili wapya ambao ni makamu wa rais kwa vigezo vya bunge ni vijana kama tukiangalia umri wao bungeni—ni karibu asilimia 13 ya wabunge wana umri chini ya miaka 35.

eng: Ines María Chapman Waugh, from Holguín, is an engineer.
swa: Ines María Chapman Waugh, ni mhandisi kutoka Holguín.

eng: Currently president of the National Hydraulic Resources Institute, for Cubans she’s a household name.
swa: Kwa sasa ni rais wa taasisi ya taifa ya rasilimali ya maji. Kwa watu wa Cuba ana jina litumikalo na wengi.

eng: For some time now she’s been the face of the agency she heads, offering the public important information during hurricane season.
swa: Kwa muda sasa, amekuwa ni nembo ya shirika analoliongoza,kwa kuwa huhabarisha umma habari muhimu kipindi cha majira ya kimbunga.

eng: She was a member of the National Assembly for the preceding Congress and has been a member of the Council of State since 2008.
swa: Alikuwa mjumbe wa mkutano mkuu wa taifa uliotangulia bunge la taifa na ni mjumbe wa halmashauri ya taifa tangu 2008.

eng: In 2011 she was elected to the Central Committee of the Cuban Communist Party.
swa: Mwaka 2011 alichaguliwa kuwa mjumbe wa kamati kuu ya chama cha Kikomunisti cha Cuba.

eng: Beatriz Jhonson Urrutia is also an engineer.
swa: Pia, Beatriz Jhonson Urrutia ni mhandisi.

eng: In 2011 she was elected vice president of the Provincial Assembly of People’s Power in her native province of Santiago de Cuba.
swa: Mwaka 2011 alichaguliwa kuwa makamu wa raisi wa baraza kuu la mkoa la nguvu ya umma katika mkoa wake alikozaliwa wa Santiago, Cuba.

eng: She became President of this body in 2016.
swa: Hatimaye akawa rais wa chama hicho mwaka 2016.

eng: In the 7th Congress round a decade ago she was elected to the Central Committee. She became a member of parliament in 2013.
swa: Muongo ulioyopita katika bunge la saba alichaguliwa kuwa mjumbe wa kamati kuu na akawa mbunge mwaka 2013.

eng: Both Chapman Waugh and Jhonson Urrutia come from the grassroots and developed professional careers prior to or alongside their political ones.
swa: Kwa pamoja Chapman Waugh and Jhonson Urrutia wanatoka vijijini na tangu mapema walijiendeleza katika kazi za kitaaluma au katika vyama vyao.

eng: As Black women, they’ve had to work hard at getting their degrees and building their careers to this point. And these latest appointments don’t mean they have arrived.
swa: Kama wanawake weusi , hadi hatua hii, wamefanya kazi kwa bidii katika kupata shahada na kujenga taaluma za kazi zao na teuzi za hivi karibuni hazimaanishi kuwa wamefika.

eng: Now they enter another crucible, where they’ll be “tested” due to their blackness and subjected to racist scrutiny and the expectation that sooner or later they will undoubtedly mess up.
swa: Sasa wameingia katika sehemu ngumu si muda mrefu sana ambapo “watajaribiwa” kutokana na weusi wao na kulazimika kuchunguzwa na inategemewa wanaweza kuharibu majukumu.

eng: Silence is also racism
swa: ukimya pia ni ubaguzi wa rangi.

eng: Why haven’t the Cuban and international press, and people in general, embraced and hailed these developments with enthusiasm?
swa: Kwa nini watu wa Cuba na vyombo vya habari vya kimataifa na umma kwa ujumla hawajakumbatia na kusifia maendeleo haya kwa shauku?

eng: I find it suspicious, considering that in the current political scenario this is a bigger surprise than Díaz-Canel, whose appointment was expected.
swa: Naona kuwa ina tia shaka, nikifikilia, huu ni mshangao mkubwa zaidi kwa mazingira ya sasa ya kisiasa, kwa Diaz-Canel, yeye uteuzi wake ulitegemewa.

eng: The media has now turned its attention to the first lady and other superficialities while continuing to ignore this key piece of news.
swa: Hivi sasa vyombo vya habari vimeelekeza macho yao kwa mke wa Rais na viongozi wengine huku vikiendelea kutojali habari hii muhimu.

eng: Making things invisible is one of the ways racism operates.
swa: Kufanya vitu visijulikane ni njia mojawapo ya ubaguzi wa rangi kutenda kazi.

eng: At times silence says more than words ever could.
swa: Muda mwingine ukimya unazungumza zaidi ya maneno ambavyo yangeweza.

eng: What I think is at work here is a combination of fear of Blackness with the casual neo-racism of everyday life.
swa: Kitu kilichopo hapa kazini ninachofikiria ni maisha ya kila siku ambapo kuna mchanganyiko wa uoga wa weusi na ubaguzi wa kawaida wa rangi wa kisasa.

eng: This includes the official notion, in Cuba, that speaking of Blackness, racism, and racial discrimination divides the nation.
swa: Hii hujumuisha dhana rasmi iliyopo Cuba kuwa ukiongelea weusi na ubaguzi wa rangi unaingawa nchi.

eng: About this last point, I want to add that even among the most committed social and political activists and laypeople, the idea persists that considering racial issues in any way dilutes a vaguely defined “supreme goal”.
swa: Kwa kuongezea wazo hilo la mwisho, ni kwamba hata miongoni mwa wanaharakati wa kisiasa na kijamii wenye msimamo na watu wa kawaida kwa namna fulani masuala ya ubaguzi wa rangi hufikiriwa kuwa yanafifilisha “lengo kuu”.

eng: It’s from this position that notions ranging from the term “Afro-Cuban” to whether there is structural racism in the country are challenged.
swa: Ni kutokana na msimamo huu mawazo yanayotokana na isitilahi ya “mcuba mweusi" hata kama ni ubaguzi wa rangi wa matabaka uliyopo nchini yanapingwa.

eng: While it is fair to assume there’ll be no change to race-related policies, it’s worth pointing out that the arrival of these three Black legislators, especially the two women, speaks favorably of the drive towards inclusion.
swa: Ni vizuri kufikiria kwamba hakutakuwa na badiliko katika sera zinazuhusu ubaguzi wa rangi, ni muhimu kusema kuwa kuingia kwa hawa wabunge weusi, hasa wanawake wawili kutapelekea msukumo kuelekea ushirikishwaji.

eng: Or, at the very least, it hints that it has been taken into account in the highest spheres of power on the island.
swa: Au inaonesha kuwa katika kisiwa hiki angalau ushirikishwaji umezingatiwa katika nafasi za juu za serikali.

eng: We can assume that no one holding a seat in the National Assembly has an explicit anti-racism political agenda.
swa: Tunaweza kuamini kuwa hakuna mwenye nafasi katika Baraza kuu la taifa ambaye ana ajenda bayana ya kisiasa inayopinga ubaguzi wa rangi.

eng: As members of the Cuban Parliament, how could they?
swa: Kama wabunge wa bunge la Cuba wangewezaje?

eng: And I see this as evidence of racism, along with the particularities of the Cuban electoral system and the intricacies of how one becomes “political” in Cuba.
swa: Na ninaona hii kama ushahidi wa ubaguzi wa rangi, pamoja na ukamilifu wa mfumo wa uchaguzi wa Cuba, vikwazo na namna ya kuwa “mwanasiasa” katika Cuba.

eng: This is a country where independent activism falls outside of legitimatized spaces of power—which creates the anomalous situation where people completely lacking in political interests or public recognition can sit, for five years, in the supreme branch of government.
swa: Hii ni nchi ambayo wanaharakati waliopigania uhuru huwekwa pembeni ya nafasi halali serikalini—ambayo hujenga hali ya ajabu kwa watu hukosa kabisa hamu ya kisiasa au uelewa wa umma unaweza kukaa kwa miaka mitano katika mhimili mkuu wa serikali.

eng: Changing that would require convincing those in the corridors of power that racism is currently Cuba’s most urgent problem.
swa: Kubadilisha hilo kunahitaji kushawishi walioko madarakani wajue kuwa ubaguzi wa rangi kwa sasa ni tatizo kubwa sana Cuba.

eng: It’s connected to many others, such as poverty. It limits the enjoyment of basic and universal rights such as access to university education.
swa: Tatizo hilo limeunganika na mambo mengine kama umaskini na linazuia kufurahia haki za msingi na za binadamu wote kama upatikanaji wa elimu ya chuo kikuu.

eng: The fear of tackling the issue is evident in the minimal impact that so many race-related publications, research and theses have had on Cuba’s decision-makers.
swa: Woga wa kushughulikia jambo hilo unaonekana hata kwa wenye mamlaka wa Cuba wanavyoshughulikia kwa namna ya chini matokeo ya machapisho, utafiti na tasnifu zinazohusu ubaguzi wa rangi.

eng: I wonder what else is needed to prompt an open acknowledgement of this matter and everything it entails—and the ensuing public policy proposals to address racism.
swa: Mimi ninashangaa, ni kitu gani zaidi kinatakiwa ili kulikiri na kila kinachususiana na tatizo hilo — na yafuatie mapendekezo ya sera ya umma kushughulikia ubaguzi wa rangi.

eng: Racial issues are not listed as topic/objective in any of the ten permanent working groups of the National Assembly of People’s Power.
swa: Masuala ya ubaguzi wa rangi hayajaorodheshwa kama mada /malengo na makundi kumi ya kudumu yanayofanya kazi katika Baraza kuu la taifa la nguvu ya umma.

eng: I can think of at least three that are relevant to the issue of race: the Commission for the Attention of Childhood, Youth, and Equal Rights for Women; the Commission on Economic Issues; and the Commission of Education, Culture, Science, Technology, and the Environment.
swa: Angalau naweza kufiria makundi matatu yanayohusika na suala la ubaguzi wa rangi: Tume ya uangalizi wa watoto, vijana na haki sawa kwa wanawake; Tume ya Masuala ya Uchumi; Tume ya elimu, utamaduni, sayannsi, teknologia na mazingira.

eng: There's no racism in Cuba, ¿de verdad?
swa: hakuna ubaguzi wa rangi nchini

eng: If there’s a subject on which Cubans at opposite ends of the political spectrum agree, it's racial discrimination.
swa: Kama kuna mada ambayo wananchi katika vyama vyao wanaikubali ni ubaguzi wa rangi.

eng: Both supporters and opponents of the Cuban government assert wholeheartedly that “in Cuba blacks and whites are the same.”
swa: Kwa pamoja wapinzani na wafuasi wa serikali ya Cuba wanasema kutoka moyoni kwamba katika “Cuba wazungu na watu weusi ni sawa.”

eng: For government supporters on and off the island, the situation looks good enough, including on this issue.
swa: Kwa wafuasi wa serikali waliopo ndani na nje ya kisiwa hali ya unyanyasaji pamoja na jambo hili ni nzuri.

eng: For opponents everywhere, things in Cuba are so terrible and everyone is so equally oppressed that racial discrimination is unworthy of special attention.
swa: Kwa wapinzani kokote kule, mambo katika Cuba ni ya kutisha na kila mwananchi ananyanyaswa sana kiasi kwamba ubaguzi wa rangi unahitaji tahadhali maalumu.

eng: These dynamics hijack the discussion and keep us from moving forward.
swa: Tofauti hizi zinateka mjadala na zinatuzuia kusonga mbele.

eng: Among some in the exile community, Cuban-flavored racism has even superseded anti-government animosity.
swa: Miongoni mwa jamii zinazoishi uhamishoni kwao radha ya ubaguzi wa rangi nchini Cuba ni zaidi ya uadui na serikali.

eng: A screenshot from Facebook: “Diaz Canel is not the worst of it all.
swa: Picha ya haraka kutoka katika mtandao wa Facebook: “Diaz Canel sio mbaya.

eng: It’s the “N*****-load” left by Raúl Castro within inches of Power.
swa: Ni “N*****-mzigo” ulioachwa Raúl Castro karibu na serikali.

eng: The next Cuban government, and formed from exile, has to exclude Black candidates…no ties to the regime, witchcraft, laziness, theft, and mediocrities” By now, we should have been implementing solutions, for example, to the problem of the overrepresentation of Black and mixed-race Cubans in the prison population.
swa: Serikali ijayo ya Cuba, na uliundwa uhamishoni, inatakiwa kwaondoa wagombea weusi… hakuna ushirika na utawala, uchawi, uzembe, wizi na dhaifu” Kwa sasa, tungekuwa tunatekeleza ufumbuzi, kwa mfano tatizo la uwingi wa wacuba weusi na wenye rangi mchanganyiko gerezani.

eng: There should already be progress towards affirmative action on self-employment community projects.
swa: Tayari ungekuwa na mwafaka juu ya miradi ya kujiajiri katika jamii.

eng: Nevertheless, the fact that there are now more senior politicians representing Black Cubans, even if imperfectly, fills me with optimism.
swa: Hata hivyo inanipa matumaini kwamba kuna wanasiasa wazoefu wanaowakilisha wacuba weusi japo si kwa ukamilifu.

eng: I do not ask anything of our three Black VicePresidents that I wouldn’t ask of other legislators, but tackling racism and discrimination in Cuba requires the participation of all members of the society, within the spaces of power and privilege each of them occupies.
swa: Makamu wetu wa rais watatu siwaombi chochote ambacho sikiombi kwa wabunge wengine, lakini kukabiliana na ubaguzi wa rangi katika Cuba kunahitaji ushirikiano wa wajumbe wote kutokana na heshima na nafasi zao walizonazo.

eng: This article appeared originally on the blog Negra cubana tenía que ser.
swa: taarifa hii ilionekana awali kwenye blogu Negra cubana tenía que ser.

eng: Protesters in the streets of Managua, Nicaragua's capital, in April 2018.
swa: Waandamanaji wakiwa katika viunga vya Managua, mji mkuu wa Nicaragua, mapema Aprili 2018.

eng: Photo by Voice of America, released to public domain via Wikimedia Commons.
swa: Picha kwa hisani ya Sauti ya Amerika, imetolewa kwenye jamii kupitia Wikimedia Commons.

eng: According to the Nicaraguan Center for Human Rights, at least 34 people, including one journalist, have been killed during demonstrations in Nicaragua over the past several days.
swa: Kwa mujibu wa kituo cha Haki za Binadamu cha Nicaragua, watu zaidi ya 34, akiwemo mwanahabari mmoja wameshapoteza maisha hadi sasa wakiwa kwenye maandamano nchini Nicaragua kwa kipindi cha siku kadhaa zilizopita.

eng: What began as a protest against social security reforms has expanded into a broad-based public outcry against the administration of President Daniel Ortega, who has been in office for 11 years but has held political power in the country in various roles since the 1979 Sandinista Revolution.
swa: Maandamano yaliyoanza kwa ajili ya kupinga mabadiliko ya bima za jamii yalichukua sura mpya hadi kuwa kilio kikuu cha wananchidhidi ya uongozi wa Rais Daniel Ortega, ambaye amekuwa madarakani kwa miaka 11 lakini akiwa ameshashika nyadhifa mbalimbali za kisiasa tangu mageuzi ya Sandinista ya mwaka 1979.

eng: Some are now calling for his resignation.
swa: Kwa sasa baadhi ya raia wanamtaka kuondoka mdarakani.

eng: Multiple TV networks have been taken off air or banned from broadcasting the demonstrations and one radio station was set on fire.
swa: Vituo kadhaa vya runinga vimekuwa havipatikani hewani au vimezuiwa kurusha matangazo ya maandamano ikiwa ni pamoja na kituo kimoja cha Redio .

eng: Independent local news sites La Prensa and Confidencial suffered what appeared to be distributed denial of service (DDoS) attacks.
swa: Tovuti huru za habari za wazawa La Prensana Confidencialzilikabiliwa na kile kinachodhaniwa kuwa ni kuzuiwa kutoa huduma kufuatia Shambulizi la Kuzuia Tovuti Kutoa Huduma (DDoS).

eng: Both had been reporting the most up-to-date accounts from the ground.
swa: Tovuti zote zilikuwa zikiripoti kwa wakati halisi matukio yote yaliyokuwa yanatokea wakati wa maandamano.

eng: Confidencial was knocked offline for seven hours on April 23.
swa: Touti ya Confidencial ilishambuliwa na kutopatikana kwa masaa saba mnamo Aprii 23.

eng: In a tweet confirming the attacks, Editor Carlos Chamorro wrote:
swa: Kupitia ujumbe wa Twiter, mhariri Carlos Chamorro alithibitisha shambulio hili kwa kuandika:

eng: TO OUR READERS For the past three hours, the Confidencial website has been out of service.
swa: KWA WASOMAJI WETU. Kwa kipindi cha masaa matatu yaliyopita, tovuti ya Confidential haikuwa inapatikana.

eng: We have determined that the cause is a targeted attack by the enemies of press freedom.
swa: Tumegundua kuwa kilichosababisha ni shambulio la makusudi kutoka kwa maadui wasiopenda uhuru wa vyombo vya habari.

eng: Our technical staff are working to reestablish the site connection.
swa: Mafundi wetu wanashughulikia tatizo hili ili kurejesha mawasiliano.

eng: We will continue posting updates on our social media channels.
swa: Tutaendelea kuwapa yanayojiri kupitia mitandao ya kijamii.

eng: The Inter-American Press Association the website condemned the attacks.
swa: Tovuti ya Inter-American Press Association ililaani mashambulizi haya.

eng: In the city of Bluefields, on Nicaragua’s southern Caribbean coast, video journalist Angel Gahona was shot and killed while filming and broadcasting a confrontation between protesters and police on Facebook Live.
swa: Katika jiji la Bluefields, kwenye pwani ya Caribean ya Kusini mwa Nicaragua, mwanahabari aliyebobea kwenye video Angel Gahona aliuwawa kwa kupigwa risasi akiwa anachukua picha za video na kutangaza moja kwa moja kupitia Facebook makabiliano kati ya waandamanaji na polisi.

eng: Gahona lived with his family and ran a small media outlet called El Meridiano.
swa: Gahona alikuwa akiishi na familia yake na pia akisimamia kituo chake kidogo cha habari kinachojulikana kama El Meridiano.

eng: Multiple witnesses said the police were the only people in the area with weapons powerful enough to shoot and kill a person.
swa: Mashududa kadhaa wanasema kuwa polisi ndio waliokuwa na silaha nzito ambazo zingeweza kumpiga mtu na kumuua.

eng: Police have yet to release a statement regarding Gahona’s death.
swa: Hadi sasa polisi bado hawajatoa taarifa kufuatia kifo cha Gahona.

eng: Gahona did not die immediately on impact, and thus managed to capture the moments after he was shot, which have now been seen worldwide via YouTube and news media outlets.
swa: Gahona hakupoteza maisha hapohapo, hali iliyomruhusu angalau kuchukua video za baadhi ya matukio mara baada ya kupigwa risasi, ambayo hadi sasa yamekuwa yakitazamwa ulimwenguni kote kupitia You Tube na vyombo mbalimbali vya habari.

eng: In an interview with Univisión, his sister said: “I never imagined that he would film his own death.”
swa: Kwenye mahojiano na Univisión,dada yake alisema: “Sikuweza kuamini ikiwa alichukua video ya kifo chake mwenyewe.”

eng: The Organization of American States and the Inter-American Commission on Human Rights have condemned the media bans and the killing of Angel Gahona.
swa: Taasisi ya Mataifa ya Amerika na Tume ya Mataifa ya Amerika ya Hali za Binadamu kwa pamoja zimelaani vitendo vya kufungia vyombo vya habari na mauaji ya Angel Gahona.

eng: His family members are soliciting support for funeral costs and their future on GoFundMe.
swa: Watu wa familia yake wanaomba msaada wa mazishi ya ndugu yao pamoja na fedha za kuendeshea maisha yao kupitia anwani ya GoFundMe.

eng: Spanish activist arrested for insulting monarchy on Facebook
swa: Mwanaharakati wa Kihispaniola alikamatwa kwa kosa la kukashifu serikali ya Kifalme kupitia ukurasa wa Facebook

eng: Roberto Mesa, a digital activist in the Spanish island of Tenerife, was arrested by police at his home on April 18 after he posted a message on Facebook suggesting that the Bourbons (the royal family) should go “to the sharks”.
swa: Roberto Mesa, mwanaharakati wa mtandaoni katika kisiwa cha Kihispaniola cha Tenerife alikamatwa na polisi akiwa nyumbani kwake mapema Aprili 18 mara baada ya kuchapisha ujumbe kwenye Facebook akisema kuwa familia ya Kifalme yapaswa kwenda kwa "mshauri nasaha”.

eng: In Spanish, the message rhymes: "Los Borbones, a los tiburones."
swa: Kwa Kihispaniola, ujumbe huu unasomeka: "Los Borbones, a los tiburones."

eng: Supporters anticipate that he will be charged under Spain’s public security law, commonly referred to as the gag law (“Ley Mordaza”), which places multiple prohibitions on public and online protest.
swa: Wanaomuunga mkono wanaona kuwa mwanaharakati huyu atahukumiwa kwasheria ya nchi ya usalama ya Hispania, ambayo mara nyingi hufahamika kama sharia kabaji (“Ley Mordaza”), inayoweka makataa mbalimbali ya maandamano ya wazi na ya mtandaoni.

eng: Tanzanian news and discussion website suffers DDoS attack
swa: Tovuti ya Habari na Mijadala ya Nchini Tanzania Yapata Shambulizi la Kuzuiwa Kutoa Huduma (DDoS)

eng: Tanzanian news sharing and discussion platform Jamii Forums was briefly kicked offline this week due to a DDoS attack.
swa: Jukwaa la habari na mijadala la nchini Tanzania Jamii Forums kwa kiasi fulani halikuwa linapatikana wiki hii kutokana na shambulizi la matandaoni la kuzuiwa kutoa huduma (DDoS).

eng: Known for intense political discussions and revelations of corruption that take place on its comment and discussion threads, in a style similar to that of Reddit, Jamii is one of the most popular local sites in East Africa.
swa: Likifahamika kwa mijadala mizito ya kisiasa na uwekaji bayana wa matendo ya rushwa kupitia maoni na mijadala kwenye nyuzi mbalimbali, kama ilivyo kwa Reddit, Jamii Forums ni moja ya tovuti maarufu sana kwa ukanda wa Afrika Mashariki.

eng: The site’s co-founder and owner Maxence Melo is currently fighting charges under Tanzania’s Cybercrimes Law for refusing police requests for forum members’ personal data.
swa: Mwanzilishi mwenza na mmiliki wa Jukwaa la Jamii Forums, Maxence Melo kwa sasa anakabiliwa na kesi chini ya sheria ya Tanzania ya makosa ya mtandaoni kwa kukataa ombi la polisi la kumataka kutoa taarifa za watumiaji wa jukwaa lake.

eng: LGBT content gets uncensored in China, thanks to citizen pressure
swa: Maudhui ya Haki za Wasagaji, Mashoga, na Mabasha (LGBT) Yasitishwa Kukaguliwa Nchini China, Shukrani kwa Shinikizo kutoka kwa Wananchi

eng: The social media campaign #IamLGBT pressured China’s information control apparatus to scale back its censorship of LGBT content on social media.
swa: Kampeni ya kupitia mitandao ya kijamii ya #IamLGBT ilikilazimisha Chombo cha Usimamizi wa Mawasiliano cha China kupunguza ufuatiliaji wa maudhui ya LGBT kwenye mitandao ya kijamii.

eng: But after Weibo announced a three-month crackdown on games, multimedia and LGBT content, the hashtag #IamLGBT was used 500,000 times and had roughly 500 million views.
swa: Hata hivyo, mara baada ya Weibo kutangaza kuwa michezo ya mtandaoni, habari mbalimbali na maudhui ya LGBT yatakuwa chini ya uangalizi kwa muda wa miezi mitatu, kiungoishara cha #IamLGBT kilitumiwa mara 500,000 na kilikuwa na watazamaji milioni 500.

eng: Within days, the Chinese Communist Party publication the People’s Daily published a memorandum announcing LGBT content should not be confused with vulgar, violent or pornographic content, and Weibo announced its three-month crackdown would no longer target LGBT content.
swa: Ndani ya siku chache, gazeti la Chama cha Kijamaa (Chinese Communist Party)-People’s Daily lilichapisha hati inayosema kuwa maudhui ya LGBT hayapaswi kufananishwa na maudhui ya hovyo, kidhalimu au ya kingono, na pia Weibo ilitangaza kuwa uhamasishaji wake wa miezi mitatu hautahusisha tena maudhui ya LGBT.

eng: Is a Russian troll farm really launching a news agency?
swa: Je,Ni kweli kuwa Kundi la Urusi la Propaganda za Mtandaoni Linaanzisha Chombo cha habari?

eng: A Russian troll farm with connections to Saint Petersburg’s Internet Research Agency announced its plans to launch a new venture entitled “USA Really” next month.
swa: Kundi la Urusi la propaganda za mtandaoni lililo na uhusiano wa karibu na Taasisi ya Utafiti wa Intaneti ya Saint Petersburg ilitangaza azma yake ya kuzindua mradi mpya wenye jina “USA Really” mapema mwezi ujao.

eng: The project, initially reported by EU vs Disinfo, takes a stance consistent with the anti-Western, anti-liberal narrative of previous Internet Research Agency efforts, which grabbed international headlines in 2016, before and after the presidential elections in the United States.
swa: Mradi huu, ambao hapo awali uliripotiwa na tovuti ya EU vs Disinfo, unasimamia kidete kupambana na Magharibi, kuchukizwa na kisa cha kiliberali cha juhududi zilizopita za Wakala wa Utafiti wa Mtandao wa Intaneti, ambayo iliteka vichwa vya habari vya kimataifa mnamo mwaka 2016, kabla na baada ya chaguzi za Urais nchini Marekani.

eng: The self-described “news organization” RIA FAN announced:
swa: “Asasi ya Habari” inayojipambanua yenyewe ya RIA FAN ilitangaza:

eng: The information flow coming from the US and its allies, which is aimed at discrediting the Russian Federation, should not remain unanswered by the Russian media…The Federal News Agency (FAN) is not going to put up with the hegemony of the US authorities in the information field.
swa: Taarifa zinazosambaa kutoka Marekani na kwa washirika wake, na ambazo zinalenga kushushia hadhi Shirikisho la Kirusi, halipaswi kunyamaziwa na vyombo vya habari vya Urusi.… Federal News Agency (FAN) haitafumbia macho ubabe wa mamlaka za Marekani katika tasnia ya uhabarishaji.

eng: YouTube takes down millions of videos, mostly for images of abuse and violence
swa: YouTube Yaondoa Mamilioni ya Video, Nyingi Zikiwa za Taswira za Machafuko na Udhalilishaji

eng: YouTube removed more than 8.2 million videos between October and December 2017, 6.68 million of which had been flagged automatically by systems that are built to identify sexual abuse and violent extremism imagery.
swa: YouTube iliondoa zaidi ya video milioni 8.2 kati ya Oktoba na Disemba 2017, ambapo video milioni 6.68 zilitambuliwa moja kwa moja kwa kutumia mifumo iliyobuniwa mahususi kwa ajili ya kutambua video za udhalilishaji wa kijinsia pamoja na picha za ukatili uliokithiri.

eng: The company published this information in its most recent transparency report, marking the first time that a major Silicon Valley company has included this level of detail about content removed from its platform.
swa: Youtube ilitoa taarifa hii katika Ripoti ya uwazi ya hivi karibuni, ikiwa ni kwa mara ya kwanza kwa kampuni mama ya Silicon Valley kuweka taarifa ya kina ya namna hii kuhusu maudhui yaliyoondolewa kwenye tovuti yao.

eng: Who will be next in line?
swa: Ni nani atakayefuata?

eng: Facebook releases internal guidelines for content moderation
swa: Facebook Yatoa Miongozo Ya Ofisi Kuhusu Udhibiti wa Maudhui

eng: Facebook took steps toward making its content moderation processes more transparent by publishing most of the internal guidelines its moderators use to enforce its community standards.
swa: Facebook ilifanya uamuzi wa kufanya mchakato wa kudhibiti maudhui kuwa wa wazi zaidi kwa kuweka hadharani taratibu karibu zote za kiofisi ambazo hutumiwa na wadhibiti wake kama namna ya kuimarisha uaminifu wake kwenye jamii.

eng: The company excluded information about issues like terrorism to prevent users from taking advantage of the publication of the guidelines.
swa: Kampuni haikuweka wazi taarifa kuhusu mambo kama vile ya ugaidi ili kutoruhusu watumiaji kutumia taratibu hizo kujinufaisha.

eng: The company also announced plans to allow users to appeal the removal of a photo, video or post in addition to the removal of an account or page for certain categories of content.
swa: Pia, Kampuni hii ilitangaza mipango ya kuruhusu watumiaji kukata rufaa kuondolewa kwa picha, video au andiko sambamba na kuondolewa kwa akaunti au ukurasa kwa kundi fulani la maudhui.

eng: In the future, Facebook says it will give people the opportunity to provide additional context and to allow users to appeal content that is reported and left up.
swa: Katika siku za mbeleni, Facebook yaweka wazi kuwa itawapa watu nafasi ya kuongeza maudhui pamoja na kuruhusu watumiaji kukata rufaa ya maudhui yaliyotolewa taarifa na kutozingatiwa.

eng: Malaysian group Bersih during one of its rallies calling for a clean and honest electoral process.
swa: Kundi la waMalaysia la Bersih wakati wa moja ya kampeni zake za kutaka shughuli za Uchaguzi ziwe huru na za Haki.

eng: Source: Facebook
swa: Chanzo: Facebook

eng: After sixty years of as the ruling party in Malaysia, Barisan Nasional (BN) was defeated at the 14th General Elections (GE14) on May 9, 2018.
swa: Baada ya miaka sita ya chama tawala cha Malaysia, Barisan Nasional (BN) kimeshindwa katika uchaguzi Mkuu wa kumi na nne (GE14) hapo Mei 9, 2018.

eng: The BN-led government was headed by Najib Razak who was linked to several corruption scandals.
swa: Serikali ya BN iliongozwa na Najib Razak aliyehusishwa na kashfa za rushwa.

eng: Razak also became more unpopular as he tried to suppress the demand for accountability and transparency with regard to these corruption allegations.
swa: Umaarufu wa Razak ulizidi kupungua pale alipojaribu kukandamiza madai ya uwazi na ukweli kuhusu tuhuma na kashfa za rushwa zilizomkabili.

eng: Malaysia will now be led by 92-year-old Dr. Mahathir Mohamad who served as prime minister for 22 years until his retirement in 2003.
swa: Sasa Malaysia itaongozwa na mzee wa miaka 92, Dr. Mahathir Mohamad aliyewahi kuhudumu kama waziri Mkuu kwa muda wa miaka 22 mpaka alipostaafu mwaka 2003.

eng: He became active again in politics to lead the Pakatan Harapan (PH) opposition party in challenging Razak and the ruling coalition he once led.
swa: Alianza tena masuala ya siasa ili kukiongoza Pakatan Harapan (PH) Chama cha Upinzani katika kumkabili Razak na Muungano wa utawala ambao alishawahi kuuongoza.

eng: The final tally of the GE14 reflected the dissatisfaction of most Malaysians to the performance of Razak's government.
swa: Matokeo ya mwisho ya Uchaguzi Mkuu yanaonesha Wamalysia wengi kutokuridhishwa na utendaji wa serikali ya Razak.

eng: Many Malaysian netizens celebrated the news about the historic voting result:
swa: Wanamitandao wengi wa Malaysia walisherehekea habari za matokeo ya kihistoria ya kura:

eng: Can you believe it?
swa: Unaweza kuamini hili?

eng: We won.
swa: Tumeshinda.

eng: At 3.30 A.M on the 10th of May 2018, Barisan Nasional is no longer our ruler.
swa: Mei 19, 2018, Saa 9.30 Alifajiri, Barisan Nasional sio mtawala wetu tena.

eng: A few hours from now, the sun will begin to rise over the horizon.
swa: Masaa machache kuanzia sasa, jua litaanza kuchomoza kupita upeo wa macho.

eng: How poignant.. we'll see a new Malaysia greeting us.
swa: Kwa msisitizo.....tutaiona Malaysia mpya ikitusabahi.

eng: The future awaits us, let's go to sleep.#GE14 — K.A C-137 (@terimame) May 9, 2018
swa: Kesho yetu inatusubiri, twende tukalale#GE14 — K.A C-137 (@terimame) May 9, 2018

eng: Today, history has been made 🇲🇾
swa: Leo historia imeandikwa, 🇲🇾

eng: • new government after 61 years
swa: • serikali mpya baada ya miaka 61

eng: • Malaysia first female deputy minister
swa: • Naibu Waziri Mwanamke wa kwanza Malaysia

eng: • the oldest (93y/o) candidate won
swa: • Mgombea mzee kabisa wa miaka 93 ameshinda

eng: • the youngest (22y/o) candidate won
swa: • Mgombea kijana zaidi wa miaka 22 ameshinda

eng: A proud first time voter here! #GE14 — Ana (@nmalyanah) May 9, 2018
swa: Najisikia vizuri hapa mpiga kura wa mara ya kwanza ! #GE14 — Ana (@nmalyanah) May 9, 2018

eng: On his first day in office, the new president tweeted:
swa: Katika siku yake ya kwanza ofisini, Rais mpya aliandika:

eng: First day on the job... once again. pic.twitter.com/Oxe3E8OEuU — Dr Mahathir Mohamad (@chedetofficial) May 11, 2018
swa: Siku ya kwanza kazini.....kwa mara nyingine tena. pic.twitter.com/Oxe3E8OEuU — Dr Mahathir Mohamad (@chedetofficial) May 11, 2018

eng: He vowed to investigate agencies involved in corruption.
swa: Alihapa kuchunguza vitengo vilivyohusika katika rushwa.

eng: He also reaffirmed the pledge of the opposition to abolish repressive laws, taxes, and programs.
swa: Pia alilikubali ombi la wapinzani kuondoa sheria, kodi na mipango kandamizi.

eng: We also want to abolish laws that are oppressive and unfair. 	Pia tunataka kufuta sheria ambazo zinakandamiza na zisizo za haki.
We will abolish the fake news act..." - Dr Mahathir. #GE14 — Sumisha Naidu (@SumishaCNA) May 10, 2018
swa: Tutaifuta na sheria ya habari za uongo..." - Dr Mahathir. #GE14 — Sumisha Naidu (@SumishaCNA) May 10, 2018

eng: Malaysiakini, an independent news website, highlighted the importance of the opposition victory:
swa: Malaysiakini, tovuti huru ya habari, ilionesha umuhimu wa ushindi wa upinzani:

eng: This is the day Malaysians experienced the power of the ballot.
swa: Hii ndio siku waMalaysia wanaona nguvu ya sanduku la kura.

eng: Anger towards the current administration had brought them out in large numbers to cast their votes in the historic 14th general election.
swa: Hasira dhidi ya uongozi wa sasa imewafanya watoke kwa wingi kupiga kura katika uchaguzi wa 14 na wa kihistoria.

eng: This is the first time the country has witnessed a change of government since independence from the British in 1957.
swa: Hii ni mara ya kwanza nchi inashuhudia kubadilika kwa serikali tangu kupata uhuru toka kwa Waingereza hapo 1957.

eng: The paper made a point to remind the new government of urgent reforms necessary to ‘heal’ the nation:
swa: Gazeti limechukua hatua ya kuikumbusha serikali mpya kuhusu mabadiliko ya msingi na ya haraka ili 'kuiponya' nchi:

eng: Now the hard work begins.
swa: Sasa uchapakazi umeanza.

eng: No one should be under the illusion that a new government would be able to reverse the rot that had taken root for decades.
swa: Hakuna anayepaswa kuwa chini ya udanganyifu kuwa serikali mpya itaweza kufuta uozo ambao umeota mizizi kwa miongo mingi.

eng: For a country that is so divided, it would take time to heal the wounds, and for Malaysians to rebuild the trust for one another and for the many institutions that have failed them.
swa: Kwa nchi ambayo imegawanyika hivi, itachukua muda kupona majeraha na kwa waMalaysia kujenga imani baina yao na kwa taasisi zilizowakwaza.

eng: Aliran, a civil society group, also celebrated the outcome of the GE14 while enumerating some of the challenges faced by the new government:
swa: Aliran, kikundi cha kijamii, pia ilisherehekea matokeo ya uchaguzi mkuu GE14 wakati ikiorodhesha baadhi ya changamoto ambazo serikali mpya itakumbana nazo:

eng: Aliran salutes the people of Malaysia who rose up, braved the odds stacked against them and used their vote to make this happen.
swa: Aliran inawashukuru watu wa Malaysia walioinuka, wakashinda magumu yaliyokuwa mbele yao na kutumia kura na kufanya hili litokee.

eng: We salute too the many women and men who worked (many of them for decades) in bringing about the awareness necessary for this change to take place.
swa: Tunawapongeza pia wanawake na wanaume ambao wamefanya kazi (wengi wao kwa miongo mingi) ili kuleta muamko ambao ulihitajika sana kwa mabadiliko haya.

eng: The outcome of the general election is a testament to the power of the people to bring about change.
swa: Matokeo ya uchaguzi mkuu ni agano la nguvu ya watu katika kuleta mabadiliko.

eng: Around the world, Malaysia has set a good example – that of People Power and that of a peaceful transition of government.
swa: Ulimwenguni kote, Malaysia imeweka mfano bora- kwa Nguvu ya Umma na serikali kubadilishana madaraka kwa amani.

eng: PH must work towards dismantling the many structures which have kept the corrupt in power for so long.
swa: Serikali ya PH lazima ifanye kazi ya kubomoa taasisi nyingi ambazo ziliwaweka wala rushwa madarakani.

eng: This also entails, among other things, curbing the power of the executive and the restoration of other institutions badly tainted by political interference.
swa: Hili pamoja na mengine, pia linahusisha kudhibiti nguvu ya serikali kuu na kuhuisha mamlaka nyingine ambazo ziliharibiwa kwa kuingiliwa vibaya na siasa.

eng: This tweet summarizes the sentiment of many a day after the historic GE14:
swa: Bandiko hiki la twita linajumuhisha hisia za wengi siku moja baada ya uchaguzi wa kihistoria GE14:

eng: Even with PH winning, changes will not happen immediately.
swa: Pamoja na ushindi wa PH, mabadiliko hayatatokea mara moja.

eng: There's still so many things to be fixed so we gotta be patient enough for when that happens.
swa: Bado kuna mambo mengi ya kurekebisha hivyo tunapaswa kuwa wavumilivu mpaka hapo yatakapotokea.

eng: Let's focus on maintaining peace and keep things in view for a better tomorrow, for a better Malaysia. #GE14 — Lum Bao Yi (@CHANIEL96) May 9, 2018
swa: Tuelekeze nguvu zetu katika kuitunza amani na kuyaweka mambo kwa ajili ya kesho iliyo bora na kwa Malaysia bora . #GE14 — Lum Bao Yi (@CHANIEL96) May 9, 2018

eng: A photo of her destructed house.
swa: Picha ya nyumba yake iliyoharibiwa vibaya.

eng: Taken by Lens of a Damascene Young Man.
swa: Picha kwa hisani ya Kijana Madogo wa Lens of a Damascene.

eng: This is the testimony of Um Mohammed; a kind, 61-year-old woman from Zamalka.
swa: Huu ni ushuhuda wa Um Mohammed; mwanamke mwema wa miaka 61 kutoka Zamalka.

eng: Um Mohammed's kindness reflects of her face with its childish features.
swa: Ukarimu wa Um Mohammed unawakilishwa na sura yake iliyojawa na mwonekano wa wakati wa utoto wake.

eng: Her cheeks still turn red when she is agitated.
swa: Mashavu yake bado yanaweza kuwa myekundu pale anapoghadhibishwa.

eng: Um Mohammed loves old songs and memorizes quite a few. As a loving grandmother, she adores little children and could play with them for hours.
