swa: Um Mohammed anazioendanyimbo za zamani na amekariri baadhi yake.Kama bibi mwenye upendo, anawasujudu sana watoto na angaliweza naokwa masaa.

eng: Um Mohammed used to live in Zamalka, a town of Eastern Ghouta.
swa: Um Mohammed alikuwa akiishi Zamalka, mji uliopo Ghouta Mashariki.

eng: Its population was estimated at 150,000 in the last census.
swa: Katika sensa ilipita, mji huu ulikadiriwa kuwa na watu laki moja na nusu.

eng: Zamalka fell out of the regime's control in 2012.
swa: Zamalka uliacha kuwa chini ya uangalizi wa serikaki mwaka 2012.

eng: Since then it has been subjected to a stifling siege, along with all the towns of Eastern Ghouta.
swa: Tangu hapo, umekuwa ukikabiliwa na majanga mabaya, sambamba na miji yote ya Ghouta Mashariki.

eng: Zamlaka endured continuous heavy shelling daily.
swa: Zamlaka ilikabiliana na mabomu ya kutupwa mfululizo karibu kila siku.

eng: In this testimony, the forcibly displaced Um Mohammed talks about her home and family in Zamalka and about her connection to that house and its furniture:
swa: Katika ushuhuda huu, Um Mohammed aliehamiahwa kwa lzima anaelezea kuhusu nyumbana familia yake huko Zamlka na pia kuhusu uhusino wake na nyumba hiyo pamoja na samani zake:

eng: I have three daughters and a son.
swa: Ninao watoto watatu wa kike na wa kiume mmoja.

eng: My three daughters remained with me in Ghouta, while my son fled seven years ago.
swa: Watoto wangu wa kike walibaki nami Ghouta, huku mtoto wangu wa kiume aliondoka miaka saba iliyopita.

eng: The siege deprived me the opportunity to attend his wedding, or to be with him when his son was born.
swa: Mgogoro huu ulinaizuia kushiriki sherehe ya ndoa ya mtoto wangu, au hata kuwa naye pale alipojaaliwa mtoto wake wa kiume.

eng: I lived in the family house.
swa: Niliishi kwenye nyumba ya familia.

eng: A very old house that my husband inherited from his father who inherited it from his father and so on.
swa: Nyumba ya zamani sana ambayo mume wangu aliirithi kutoka kwa baba yake ambaye naye aliirithi kutoka kwa baba yake.

eng: Generation after generation grew up in that house.
swa: Kizazi baada ya kizazi kilikulia katika nyumba hiyo.

eng: Those of them who are still alive hold so many fond memories of it.
swa: Wale ambao bado wapo hai wana kumbukumbu nzuri sana kuihusu nyumba hiyo.

eng: Over time, as the house needed renovation, we carried the work while being very diligent so as to maintain its original features.
swa: Hata pale nyumba hii ilipohitaji matengenezo, tuliifanya kazi hii kwa unyenyekevu sana ili kuendelea kutunza mwonekano wake wa mwanzo.

eng: We wanted to preserve its soul.
swa: Tulinuia kulinda uasili wake.

eng: During the siege all means of fuel became very scarce, or unbelievably expensive.
swa: Wakati wa mgogoro vyanzo vyote vya nishati vilikuwa vya kubahatisha sana au kupatikana kwa bei ya juu sana kuliko kawaida.

eng: So we had to rely on wood for heating, cooking, bathing and sometimes even for lighting.
swa: Kwa hiyo ilitubidi tutumie kuni zaidi kwenye upashaji joto, kupikia, kupashia maji ya kuoga na wakati mwingingine hata kutumika kama chanzo cha mwanga.

eng: As shelling intensified during the last stretch since February, it became impossible to leave the basements and go out to buy wood.
swa: Jinsi mabomu ya kutupwa yalivyokuwa yakiongezeka katikakipindi cha mwezi Februari, haikuwa rahisi kutoka kwenye basement na kwenda kununua kuni.

eng: The lack of proper ventilation in the basements and the dampness exacerbated the feeling of cold.
swa: Kukosekana kwa mfumo mzuri wa hewa safi kwenye basemwnt na hali ya ukungu ilfanya hali ya baridi kuwa mbaya zaidi.

eng: One day in that basement, as the shelling was burning the city, we had to use the furniture for heating.
swa: Siku moja katika basement hiyo, wakati mji ukiungua kwa moto wa mabomu, ilitulazimu kutumia samani kama kuni.

eng: I will never forget that mad shelling that burned our memories and the memories of all those around us.
swa: Sitakaa kusahau bomu hilo lililoharibu kumbukumbu zetu na kumbukumbu za wote waliokuwa karibu yetu.

eng: It wiped any trace of us in Zamalka, our homeland, before we were completely uprooted.
swa: Lilifuta kabisa uwepo wetu mjini Zamalka, eneo letu la asili, kabla ya kuondolewa.

eng: The first pieces of furniture we burnt were the couches, and this was due to hunger.
swa: Samani zamkwanza kabisa kuzichoma ilikuwa ni makochi, na hii ilitokaa na njaa.

eng: My grandchildren were hungry, and the extensive shelling prevented us from going outside to get wood.
swa: Wajuu wangu walikuwa na njaa, na bahati mbaya mfululizo wa mabomu ulituzuia kwenda kununua kuni.

eng: Even if someone would risk their life outside, there was no one selling anything in that hell.
swa: Hata kama mtu angejitokeza kwenda kununua kuni, hakukuwa na yeyote aliyekuwa akiuza kutoka na hali ilivyokuwa mbaya.

eng: My son in law asked for my permission to break the couch to use its wood for cooking fire.
swa: Mkwe wangu aliniomba alivunje kochi ili tutumie mbao hizo kwa ajili ya kupikia.

eng: I approved, but something inside me was shattered.
swa: Nilimkubalia lakini kuna kitu ndani mwangu nilihisi hakikuwa sawa.

eng: That couch carried a beautiful story.
swa: Kochi hilo lina kumbukumbu ya kuvutia sana.

eng: My husband bought it ten years after our marriage.
swa: Mume wangu alilinunua miaka kumi baada ya ndoa yetu.

eng: He was so happy that we could afford it.
swa: Alikuwa na furaha sana kwa kuweza kulinunua.

eng: We picked it together.
swa: Tulienda pamoja kulichukua.

eng: It was one of the very few times we were able to go out together without the kids.
swa: Ilikuwa ni mara chache sana kutoka pamoja hivi na kuwaacha watoto.

eng: Yes, I might be able to restore material belongings, but the memories attached to them, how could they ever be recuperated?
swa: Ndio, ninaweza tens kuvipata vitu hivyo, lakini kwa kumbukumbu zinazohusishwa na vitu hivyo, lakini ni kwa namna gani kumbukumbu hizi zitarudishwa tena kwenye vitu hivyo?

eng: The pain was greater when we had to set my bedroom furniture on fire.
swa: Maumivu yalikuwa makubwa zaidi pale tulipotakiwa kuchoma samani za chumba changu cha kulala.

eng: That bedroom accompanied me for 35 years, ever since I got married.
swa: Chumba kile kilikitumia kwa miaka 35, tangu nilipoolewa.

eng: It witnessed the best, and the worst days of my life.
swa: Kilinipitisha kwenye nyakati nzur na mbaya sana za maisha yangu.

eng: The scent of my beloved late husband lingered there.
swa: Manukato ya marehemu mume wangu yangalipo hadi sasa kwenye chumba hiki.

eng: I used to sense his spirit floating around it, that's why I felt he was beside me whenever I fell asleep.
swa: Nilikuwa nikihisi roho yake ikielea chumbani hapo, ndio maana siku zote nilihisi alikuwa pembeni yangu nilipokuwa ninalala.

eng: I burnt most of my clothes.
swa: Nilichoma nguo zangu karibu zote.

eng: For instance that gown I wore for my eldest daughter's wedding.
swa: Mojawapo likiwa gauni nililovaa wakati wa sherehe ya kuolewa kwa mtoto wangu wa kwanza.

eng: I remember going with her to the tailor and having it tailor made for the occasion, along with her own wedding dress.
swa: Ninakumbuka nilivyoenda nae kwa fundi cherehani ili atushonee gauni kwa ajili ya sherehe hiyo, sambamba na gauni lake la harusi.

eng: My own mantles, which became my attire ever since I grew older and became a grandmother.
swa: Mavazi yangu mwenyewe, niliyoyatumia tangu nilipokuwa mtu mzima hadi nilipokuwa mzee.

eng: I managed to salvage only one of them to take with me when we are eventually forcibly displaced.
swa: Niliweza kutunza moja tu ambalo ningelivaa oale ambapo tungelazimishwa kuhama.

eng: Out of my kitchen utensils that survived the shelling, I burnt all the plastics because they were highly flammable and provided extra warmth.
swa: Miongoni mwa vyombo vyangu vya nyumbani vilivyosalimika baada ya mabomu, nilichoma vyombo vyote vya plastiki kwa kuwa viliwaka vizuri sana na kutoa joto la ziada.

eng: What was important was for my children and grandchildren to eat and feel some warmth.
swa: Kilichokuwa cha muhimu zaidi ilikuwa ni watoto wangu na wajukuu wangu kula na kuota moto.

eng: In our traditions, the bride's family would send with her to her husband's house a glass cabinet where lavish plates and cutlery would be displayed.
swa: Kwa utamaduni wetu, familia ya bibi harusi humuoza mtoto wao na kumpeleka kwa mume wake sambamba kabati la glasi ambapo sahani za kifahari na vitu kama vijiko, uma na visu vya kulia viliwekwa.

eng: Usually this cabinet is passed on through the generations.
swa: Kwa kawaida, kabati hili hurithishwa kutoka kizazi kimoja hadi kingine.

eng: But after all the glassware in my cabinet was shattered due to the shelling, we broke it to pieces and used its wood to warm water for bathing.
swa: Hata hivyo mara baada ya vyombo vya kioo kuvunjika kutokana na shambulio la bomu, kabati lile tulilivunjavunja na kutumia mbao zake kama kuni za kupashia maji ya kuoga.

eng: Yet the hardest situation I had to overcome was taking the decision to burn my son's wardrobe.
swa: Kama haikutosha, moja ya hali ngumu sana nliyoipitia ni kufanya uamuzi wa kuchoma kabati la nguo la mtoto wangu wa kiume.

eng: My son, whom I haven't seen for seven years.
swa: Mtoto wangu ambaye sikuwahi kuonana naye kwa miaka saba.

eng: That wardrobe held all the beautiful memorabilia of his childhood.
swa: Kabati hilo lilikuwa na kumbukumbu nyingi na nzuri za tangu utoto wake.

eng: His toys, his baby clothes, even his favorite cup.
swa: Midoli yake, nguo zake za utotoni na hata kikombe chake alichokipenda sana.

eng: I can't carry all that with me on that bus of forcible displacement.
swa: Siwezi kubeba vyote hivi katika basi hilo la kuhamishwa kwa lazima.

eng: But I also can't destroy those memories with my own hands; nor can I leave them behind for strangers to fiddle around with after we were gone, or see them in videos being sold on the streets.
swa: Lakini pia siwezi kuharibu kumbukumbu hizi kwa mikono yangu mwenyewe, wala kuziacha halafu watu wabaya waje kuziiba mara baada ya sisi kuondoka, au kuziona kupitia video zikiwa zinauzwa mitaani.

eng: Eventually I had to make the decision to break and burn them.
swa: Hatimaye nilifikia uamuzi wa kulivunja kabati na kuchoma nguo zilizokuwemo.

eng: I only kept very small items that I could carry with me.
swa: Nilibakiza vitu vichache sana ambavyo ningeweza kusafiri navyo.

eng: That was the hardest situation of all.
swa: Hiyo ilikuwa ndio hali ngumu kabisa kuliko yoyote ile.

eng: For I always dreamed of giving my son his memorabilia back, and of seeing his son wearing his own clothes when he was his age, and of telling that grandson stories about the photos of his father.
swa: Kwani muda wote nilikuwa na ndoto ya kuja kumpatia mwanangu vifaa vyake vya utotoni, na kumwona mototo wake akivaa nguo za baba yake alipokuwa na umri wake, na pia kumsimulia mjukuu kuhusu picha za baba yake.

eng: I wanted my grandchildren to grow up in that house where I would tell them stories about their parents' mischievousness.
swa: Nilipenda wajuu wangu wakulie kwenye nyumba ile ili niwahadithie changamoto walizozipitia wazazi wao.

eng: A home that i would pass on to them so they would in turn pass it on to their grandchildren; so that they would add to it a new life every time, just like every generation of our ancestors did.
swa: Makazi ambayo ningewarithisha ili nao waje kuwarithisha wajukuu wao; ili wawe wanaiongezea nyumba maisha mapya kila wakati, kama ilivyo kwa kila kizazi cha mababu zetu walivyofanya.

eng: Towards the end we even had to burn the doors of the house.
swa: Hatimaye tulilazimika pia kuchoma milango ya nyumba.

eng: My house, the family house, my children's house, was left widely open, exposed and violated.
swa: Nyumba yangu, nyumba ya familia, nyumba ya watoto wangu, iliachwa wazi kabisa, isiyositiriwa na kutelekezwa.

eng: Following the horrible shelling offensive during which the Syrian regime and Russian forces showed us hell, we were forcibly removed from Zamalka as broken refugees.
swa: Kufuatia shambulio la mabomu wakati ambapo serikali ya Syria na vikosi vya Urusi vilivyotupeleka kuzimu, tuliondolewa kwa nguvu kutoka Zamalka kama wakimbizi.

eng: It was impossible for us to live under the regime again.
swa: Hakuwa tena rahisi kwa sisi kuishi chini ya uongozi wa serikali.

eng: That regime that can detain my sons in law or drag them to military service.
swa: Serikali ambayo inaweza kumshikilia mkwe wangu au kuwalazimisha kujiunga na vyombo vya ulinzi.

eng: It was impossible especially knowing that my son would never go back to Zamlaka.
swa: Halikuwa jambo rahisi na hususani pale nilifahamu kuwa mototo wangu asingeweza tena kurudi Zamlka.

eng: I left behind the family house and all the memories it nurtured.
swa: Niliiacha nyumba ya familia pamoja na kumbukumbu zote ilizozitengeneza.

eng: I left to Idlib with my daughters and their families, broken hearted.
swa: Nilielekea Idlib pamoja na watoto wangu wa kike na familia zao, nikiwa nimekata tamaa kabisa.

eng: The one thing that offered me some consolation was that I was finally reunited with my son whom I didn't see for seven years and I held his son in my arms.
swa: Jambo moja ambalo lilinipa faraja kwa kiasi fulani ni hatimaye kuungana tena na mototo wangu ambaye sikukaa kuonana naye kwa takribani miaka saba na pia kumbeba mototo wake kwa mikono yangu mwenyewe.

eng: The one thing that gives me hope is that I know I will tell my grandson all about his grandfather, his father and the family house with all the memories it nurtured.
swa: Jambo moja linalonipa matumaini ni kuwa nijua kuwa nitamsimulia mjukuu wangu kila kitu kuhusu babu yake, baba yake na nyumba ya familia na kumbukumbu zake zote tangu kuwepo kwa nyumba hiyo.

eng: Upon our reunion I gave me son the small memorabilia that I managed to salvage from his wardrobe.
swa: Mara baada ya kukutana tena na mototo wangu, nilimpatia vitu vichache nilivyoweza kuviokoa kutoka kwenye kabati lake la nguo.

eng: At the beginning he couldn't believe his eyes.
swa: Hapo awali, hakuweza kuamini kabisa kuhusu kile alichokiona.

eng: He couldn't believe that I managed to bring with me a piece of his memory.
swa: Hakumini kabisa kuwa ningeweza kubeba kitu ambacho kingeweza kumkumbusha mbali.

eng: At that moment I prayed for my son to go back to the family house, to rebuild it and raise his children in it.
swa: Kwa wakati huo, nilitamani sana kuona mwanangu anarudi tena kwenye nyumba ile kuijenga tena upya na kuwakuzia pale watoto wake.

eng: Today I live with my son and his family, hopping from one house to the other until we manage to find a temporary settlement post, which I am confident will never, ever, replace my home.
swa: Kwa sasa ninaishi na mtoto wangu na familia yake, huku tukihamahama kutoka nyumba moja kwenda nyingine hadi tutakapoweza kupata sehemu ya kamazi ya muda, ambayo nina hakika kuwa, kamwe haitaweza kuwa mbadala wa nyumba yangu.

eng: A funeral was held for Sabika Sheikh in her hometown of Karachi on May 23, 2018, five days after the 17-year-old Pakistani exchange student in the US was killed by a teenage gunman who opened fire at a school in the state of Texas.
swa: Mazishi ya Sabika Sheikh yalifanyika katika mji wa nyumbani kwake karachi tarehe 23 Mei, 2018, siku tano baada ya mwanafunzi aliyepelekwa Marekani kwenye mpango wa elimu nje ya nchi kutoka Pakistani mwenye miaka 17 kuuawa na vijana wenye silaha ambao walipiga risasi shuleni katika jimbo la Texas.

eng: In total, 10 people were killed including Sheikh and 13 wounded in the violence.
swa: Kwa ujumla watu 10 waliuawa akiwemo Sheikh na 13 kuumia katika vurugu hizo.

eng: Sheikh was an exchange student at Santa Fe High School under the US State Department-sponsored KL-YES program and was set to return home on June 10, 2018 after completing the program.
swa: Sheikh alikuwa ni mwanafunzi aliyekuwa Marekani kwenye mpango wa elimu nje ya nchi katika sekondari ya juu ya Santa Fe iliyopo chini ya Idara ya udhamini wa Ikulu ya Marekani programu ya KL-YES na alikuwa amepanga kurudi nyumbani tarehe 10, Juni 2018.

eng: The news of her death took over social media in Pakistan, and messages of condolences poured in.
swa: Habari za kifo chake zilitawala vyombo vya habari katika Pakistan, na salamu za rambirambi zilimiminika sana.

eng: Before her body was sent to Pakistan, a funeral was also held in Texas on May 20, 2018.
swa: Kabla ya mwili wake kupelekwa Pakistan, mazishi yalikuwa pia yafanyike Texas tarehe 20, Mei 2018.

eng: Michael Mathes, a US politics correspondent for news agency AFP, tweeted:
swa: Michael Mathes, mwandishi wa siasa za Marekani ofisi ya habari ya AFP alitwiiti:

eng: Just devastating.
swa: Ni mauaji tu.

eng: Funeral service attendees in Stafford, TX pray over the coffin of Sabika Sheikh, the young Pakistani exchange student killed in the mass shooting at her high school in nearby Santa Fe. pic.twitter.com/GWYVk6FANm — Michael Mathes (@MichaelMathes) May 20, 2018
swa: Wahudhuriaji wa huduma za mazishi katika Stafford, TX pray over the coffin of Sabika Sheikh, mwanafunzi kijana wa Pakistani wa programu ya nchi za nje aliuawa katika mauaji ya umma kwa kupigwa risasi katika shule yake ya sekondari ya juu karibu na Santa Fe. pic.twitter.com/GWYVk6FANm — Michael Mathes (@MichaelMathes) Mei 20, 2018

eng: At her funeral in Texas, Sheikh's host parents spoke about how she had impacted their lives:
swa: Kwenye mazishi yake wazazi walezi wa Sheikh walisema ambavyo alikuwa ameyabadili maisha yao:

eng: The host father is speaking about how Sabika Sheikh came into their lives.
swa: Baba yake mlezi anazungumzia jinsi Sheih alivyokuwa katika maisha yao.

eng: Calls her the most precious gift that came into her life.
swa: Alimtaja kama zawadi nzuri ambayo ilitolewa kwa ajili ya maisha yake.

eng: He says the root of everything is love.
swa: Anasema mzizi wa kila kitu ni upendo.

eng: He wants to carry the tradition of love she brought from Pakistan. #KAKEnews #SantaFe #SanteFeStrong pic.twitter.com/wThTbPVU6h — KAKE Monica Castro (@KAKEmonica) May 20, 2018
swa: Anataka kuchukua mila na desturi za upendo aliotoka nao Pakistan. #KAKEnews #SantaFe #SanteFeStrong pic.twitter.com/wThTbPVU6h — KAKE Monica Castro (@KAKEmonica) Mei 20, 2018

eng: Her host mother Joleen Cogburn tearfully described what had motivated Sheikh to study in the US:
swa: Mama yake mlezi Joleen Cogburn kwa majonzi alieleza kitu kilichokuwa kimemumotisha Sheikh kusoma Marekani:

eng: I asked how she got involved with wanting to become a foreign exchange student and why.
swa: Nilimuuliza jinsi alivyojihusisha na kutaka kuwa mwanafunzi katika programu ya elimu katika nchi ya Marekani na kwa nini.

eng: And she said because I want to learn the American culture and I want America to learn the Pakistan culture and I want us to come together and unite.
swa: Na alijibu ni kwa sababu nataka kujifunza utamaduni wa Marekani na ninataka Marekani kujifunza utamaduni wa Pakistan na ninataka tuwe wamoja na kuungana.

eng: She said I don't know if they know us the way they should.
swa: Alisema sijui kama wanajua wanavyopaswa kutujua.

eng: Of her own feelings about being selected to study in the US, Sheikh had said in a video message:
swa: Kwa hisia zake juu ya kuchaguliwa kusoma Marekani, Sheikh alisema kupitia ujumbe wa video:

eng: People around me got sad a little bit that I'll be leaving them, but this was the bestest thing that happened.
swa: Watu walioko karibu yangu wameumia kidogo kwa kuwa nitakuwa nawaacha, lakini hii ni jambo zuri sana kutokea.

eng: I was so very excited, I still am very excited.
swa: Nilifurahai sana na bado nina.

eng: US media often covers Pakistan, if it does so at all, through the lens of conflict.
swa: Mara nying vyombo vya habari vya marekani huandika habari za Pakistan labda iwe vinafanya hivyo , kwa jicho la ugomvi.

eng: A Pakistani-born, US-based Twitter user named Zareen Nayyar was one of many pointing out that Pakistan is often portrayed as the unsafe country:
swa: Mzaliwa wa Pakistan ambaye ni mtumiaji wa tweeter Marekani ni mmojawapo ya waliosema kuwa Pakistan mara nyingi huoneshwa kuwa nchi isiyo na usalama:

eng: Just a thought ... this girl born and raised in #Pakistan didn't die in her home country, which according to the west is doing nothing to fight #terrorism. Yet she comes to #America and dies in a #SchoolShooting. #irony#texasschoolshooting#SabikaSheikhhttps://t.co/FGlrC9wju9 — Zareen Nayyar (@zareennayyar) May 23, 2018
swa: Wazo tu ... binti huyu aliyezaliwa na kukulia #Pakistan hakufia katika nchi yake, haina maana kupambana na #ugaidi . amekuja #Marekani na kufa kwa kupigwa na #risasi shuleni . # ni kejeli#kupiga risasi shuleni Texas #SabikaSheikhhttps://t.co/FGlrC9wju9 — Zareen Nayyar (@zareennayyar) Mei 23, 2018

eng: Mass shootings, including in schools, are a serious problem in the US.
swa: Umma kupigwa risasi pamoja na shuleni ni tatizo kubwa katika Marekani.

eng: According to data from Gun Violence Archive (via Vox), since 2012 at least 1,941 people have been killed and 7,104 wounded in at least 1,686 mass shootings, defined as an event in which four or more people (not counting the shooter) are shot at the same general time and location.
swa: Kutokana na taarifa kutoka hifadhi ya vifo vinavyosabishwa na kupigwa na risasi (kupitia Vox), tangu mwaka 2012 karibu watu 1941 wameuawa na 7104 kujeruhiwa katika matukio 1686 ya umma kupigwa risasi, hii ina maana kwamba kila tukio watu wanne au zaidi (bila kuhesabu wafyatuaji wa risasi) wanakufa kwa kupigwa risasi muda na mahali palepale.

eng: The US also has a high gun homicide rate.
swa: Pia marekani ina kiwango kubwa cha mauaji ya binadamu kwa kupigwa risasi.

eng: Part of the problem, analysts say, is the ease of access to firearms in the US: the country has the world's highest rate of gun ownership.
swa: Wachambuzi wanasema sehemu ya tatizo ni urahisi wa kuingiza bunduki katika Marekani: nchi ina kiwango kikubwa cha kumiliki bunduki duniani .

eng: Speaking to the media, Sheikh's father and uncle pleaded with the US government to make schools safer for their students.
swa: Akiongea na vyombo vya habari, baba na mjomba wake waliomba seriakli ya Marekani kufanya shule kuwa sehemu salama kwa wanafunzi wao.

eng: With her death, the US mass shooting crisis has become an international concern.
swa: Kwa kifo chake, mgogoro wa mauaji ya umma kwa risasi katiak nchi ya Marekani umekuwa ni jambo linalogusa mataifa.

eng: Protesters in the Gambia following the election of Adama Barrow in 2017.
swa: Waandamanaji katika nchi ya Gambia kufuatia uchaguzi wa Adam Barrow mwaka 2017.

eng: Screenshot from YouTube video, widely circulated.
swa: Picha ya haraka kutoka kwenye video vya You Tube iliyozunguka sana mitandaoni.

eng: The Supreme Court in the Gambia struck down the 2013 Information and Communication Amendment (ICA) Act, declaring it unconstitutional.
swa: Mahakam kuu ya Gambia imezuia marekebisho yaliyofanywa ya sheria ya habari na mawasiliano ya mwaka 2013, na kutamka kuwa yanapingana na Katiba.

eng: The court nevertheless upheld key sections of the country’s sedition law.
swa: Pia, mahakama imetetea vifungu muhimu vya sheria ya uhaini wa nchi.

eng: Both have been used as tools for media repression.
swa: Vifungu hivyo vilikuwa vikitumika kama zana za kukandamiza vyombo vya habari.

eng: The ruling is the result of a 2015 court filing by the Gambia Press Union challenging the constitutionality of sedition, libel, criminal defamation, and false news laws.
swa: Hukumu hiyo ni matokeo ya shauri lililosajiliwa mahakamani mwaka 2015 na umoja wa waandishi wa habari wa Gambia ukihoji kikatiba kuhusu uhaini, kuasi, uhalifu wa kukashfu.

eng: The regional court of the Economic Community of West African States recently ruled on the same laws, in a case brought by four exiled Gambian journalists, and found them all unconstitutional.
swa: Hivi karibuni mahakama ya jumuia ya uchumi ya nchi za Africa Magharibi ilitoa hukumu juu ya sheria kama hiyo , kwa waandishi wa habari wanne wa Kigambia walioko uhamishoni ambao walikutwa na hatia ya kikatiba.

eng: But the Gambian Supreme Court thought differently.
swa: Lakini Mahama kuu ya Gambia ilifikiri tofauti.

eng: The ruling upheld sedition laws that can be used to punish critical speech or journalistic investigations related to the president, while it struck down the a 2013 amendment to the ICA, which criminalized online defamation and the spread of “false news” on the internet.
swa: Wakati hukumu iliyotolewa inakumbatia sheria ya uhaini ambayo inaweza kutumika kuadhibu taarifa muhimu au uchunguzi wa wanahabari unaomuhusu Rais,inaondoa marekebisho ya sheria ya habari na mawasiliano ya mwaka 2013 ambayo yalifanya kashfa mtandaoni na kusambazwa kwa “habari za uongo” mtandaoni kuwa jinai.

eng: Violators were subject to heavy fines and prison terms of up to 15 years in prison.
swa: Wakiukaji wa sheria hiyo walilazimika kulipa faini kubwa na kufungwa mihula ya vifungo hadi miaka 15 gerezani.

eng: On Twitter, Gambian journalist Sanna Camara described the ICT Act as one of the “toughest internet laws in Africa.”
swa: Kupitia mtandao wa Tweeter, Sanna Camara, mwandishi wa habari wa gambia anaeleza sheria ya habari na mawasiliano ni moja ya “sheria mbaya” ya mtandao katika Afrika.

eng: Camara himself faced legal threats in the Gambia for his coverage of human trafficking, published by The Standard.
swa: Camara alikabiliwa na vitisho vya kisheria kwa kuchapisha habari katika gazeti la Standard kuhusu utoroshaji wa binadamu nchini Gambia .

eng: In 2014, Camara was accused of publishing “false news” and fled the country shortly thereafter.
swa: Mwaka 2014 Camara alishtakiwa kwa kuchapisha “habari za uongo” na muda mfupi baada ya kushtakiwa alikimbia nchi.

eng: The Committee to Protect Journalists’ Angela Quintal described the decision as “one step forward, two steps backwards.”
swa: Kamati ya kulinda wanandishi wa habari ya Angela Quintal ilieleza uamuzi huo ni “hatua moja mbele na mbili nyuma.”

eng: “ sends a message that journalists are still not free to work without the threat of criminal prosecution,” she said.
swa: “ inatuma ujumbe kuwa waandishi wa habari bado hawako huru kufanya kazi bila ya vitisho vya kushitakiwa kwa makosa ya jinai,” alisema.

eng: The ruling marks the court’s first major decision affecting free speech since the 2017 transition of power from long-time ruler Yahya Jammeh to current president Adama Barrow.
swa: Hukumu hiyo ni maamuzi makubwa ya kwanza ya mahakama ambayo yanaathiri uhuru wa kutoa maoni tangu mwaka 2017 ambacho kilikuwa kipindi cha mpito wa madaraka kutoka kwa mtawala wa muda mrefu Yahya Jammeh kwenda kwa Rais wa sasa Adam Barrow.

eng: Shortly after assuming office, Barrow freed hundreds of prisoners and launched a series of investigations into alleged human rights violations under the Jammeh regime.
swa: Punde tu baada ya kuingia ofisini, Rais Barrow aliwaachia mamia ya wafungwa na kuanzisha uchunguzi mfululizo juu ya ukiukwaji wa haki za binadmu kipindi cha utawala wa Jammeh.

eng: But activists and citizens who speak their minds in public spaces online and off have continued to do so under pressure.
swa: Lakini wanaharakati na watumiaji wa mtandao wanaotoa mawazo yao katika mitandao ya umma na isiyo ya umma wameendelea kufanya hivyo kwa shinikizo.

eng: In February 2018, a university lecturer was detained over comments he made to a local media outlet.
swa: Mwezi Februari 2018,mhadhiri wa Chuo Kikuu aliwekwa kizuizini kwa sababu ya maoni aliyoyatoa kupitia vyombo vya habari nchini.

eng: Just this past week, youth activists were arrested after calling attention to the threat of environmental degradation caused by Golden Lead, a Chinese-owned fish processing factory in the coastal settlement of Gunjur.
swa: Wiki hii iliyopita, wanaharakati vijana walikamatwa baada ya kutoa wito wa tahadhari ya kitisho cha uharibifu wa mazingira ambacho kilisababishwa na Golden Lead kiwanda cha kusindika samaki kinachomilikiwa na Wachina kilichopo makazi ya pwani ya Gunjur.

eng: Tanzanian court puts ‘blogger tax’ on hold, for now
swa: Kwa sasa, mahakama ya Tanzania imezuia kodi ya kublogu

eng: A Tanzanian High Court has halted the implementation of the US $900 “blogger tax” imposed by the government as part of the Electronic and Postal Communications (Online Content) Regulations which demanded that bloggers paid a fine or cease blogging.
swa: Mahakamu kuu ya Tanzania imezuia utekelezaji wa ”kodi ya kublogu” dola za kimarekani 900 iliyoamuriwa na Serikali kama sehemu ya kanuni za Mawasiliano ya Kielektroniki na Posta (Maudhui Mtandaoni) ambayo inataka wanaoblogu kulipa faini au kuacha kublogu.

eng: Six human right groups in the country had asked the court to review the regulations, arguing that the Minister of Information acted outside his authority and in violation of the right to freedom of expression.
swa: Makundi sita ya haki za binadamu nchini yaliomba mahakama kurudia na kurekebisha sheria kwa hoja kwamba waziri wa mawasiliano alitumia madaraka yake vibaya na kulikuwa na ukiukwaji wa haki ya kutoa maoni.

eng: Though temporary, the high court ruling is a win for free speech in Tanzania.
swa: Hata hivyo, hukumu ya mahakama kuu ni ushindi juu ya uhuru wa kuongea Tanzania kwa muda.

eng: Honduran journalist followed after receiving death threats on Facebook
swa: Mwandishi wa habari wa Hundrus alifuatiliwa baada ya kupokea vitisho vya kifo kupitia mtandao wa Facebook

eng: Honduran broadcast journalist Mauricio Ortega received a death threat over Facebook messenger, not long after conducting a series of reports on incidents of passengers being physically assaulted on public transport.
swa: Mauricio Ortega mwandishi wa habai wa Hindrus alipokea kitisho cha kifo kupitia ujumbe wa Facebook baada tu ya kuripoti mfululizo matukio ya wasafiri kuvamiwa kwa nguvu katika usafiri wa umma.

eng: Later that day, he was followed by a car with no license plates.
swa: Baadaye siku hiyo, alifuatwa na gari iliyokuwa haina namba rasmi za gari.

eng: In an interview with the Honduran Committee for Free Expression, he said:
swa: Katika mahojiano na kamati ya uhuru wa kutoa maoni, alisema:

eng: ...threats against us have unfortunately become normal, we’re accustomed to being insulted, threatened and discredited by those who take offense at our work.
swa: ...kwa bahati mbaya vitisho juu yetu vimekuwa ni kawaida, tumezoea kutukanwa, kutishwa na kuaibishwa na wanaovunja sheria kazini kwetu.

eng: And sadly, there is little trust or efficiency in those who are supposed to ensure justice, which leaves us that much more vulnerable.
swa: Na mbaya zaidi, kuna uaminifu au ufanisi mdogo sana kwa wanaotakiwa kusimamia haki, ambao hutuacha katika hali ya kudhurika.

eng: Mobile networks falter as Russians protest Putin’s inauguration
swa: Mitandao ya simu ni dhaifu wakati waandamanaji wa Urusi wakipinga kuapishwa kwa Rais Plutin

eng: As protests broke out across Russia, approaching Vladimir Putin's official inauguration into his fourth term as president, several activists reported that their mobile phone signals became weak or non-existent.
swa: Kadri siku zinavyokaribia uzinduzi rasmi wa muhula wa nne wa Vladimir Putin kama Rais, waandamanaji wameongezeka nchi nzima ya Urusi , baadhi ya wanaharakati wameripoti kwamba ishara za mawasiliano katika simu zao zinakuwa dhaifu au hazipo kabisa.

eng: Some said Russian telecom operators were intentionally degrading the quality of service or even delisting their numbers at the orders of the authorities.
swa: Baadhi wameeleza kuwa waendesha mitambo ya mawasiliano ya simu walipunguza makusudi kabisa ubora wa huduma au hata kufuta namba za simu zao kutokana na amri ya mamlaka.

eng: Activist Denis Styazhkin reported that his telco operator, Beeline, told him that his number had been de-listed on police orders.
swa: Mwanaharakati Denis Styazhkin alilipoti kwamba mwendesha mitambo ya mawasiliano ya simu anayeitwa Beeline alimwambia kuwa namba yake ya simu ilifutwa kutokana na amri ya polisi.

eng: China’s censors have their eyes on Peppa Pig
swa: Wakaguzi wa China macho yao yapo kwenye Peppa Pig

eng: A Chinese internet subculture connecting the TV cartoon character “Peppa Pig” with “Shehuiren”, a term that refers to organized crime syndicates, has resulted in a muddy puddle for the popular porker.
swa: “Peppa Pig” na “Shehuiren”, ni isitilahi yenye maana ya umoja wa wachapishaji wa uharifu wa katuni, imetumbukia katika matope mazito kwa sababu ya nyama maarufu ya nguruwe.

eng: After leading state media outlets criticized the inkage, the popular Chinese video platform Douyan removed more than 30,000 videos of the cheerful pink character and made the term “Peppa Pig” unsearchable on its website, likely anticipating an all-out ban on Peppa.
swa: Baada ya kuongoza vyombo vya habari vya taifa watoa maoni walikosoa uandishi, jukwaa la video maarufu za kichina la Douyan kwa kuondoa video zaidi ya 30,000 ambazo zilikuwa na rangi nzuri ya pinki na ilifanya isitilahi ya “Peppa Pig” isipatikane kwenye tovuti yake na kudhani kuwa Peppa imepigwa marufuku.

eng: Egyptian legislators move to monitor Uber rides
swa: Wabunge Misri walenga kufatilia wanaoendesha huduma usafiri wa haraka

eng: On May 7, Egypt’s parliament passed a law that will require ride-hailing services like Uber and the UAE-based Careem to establish servers in Egypt for the processing of all data pertaining to Egypt-based users.
swa: Tarehe 7 Mei, Bunge la Misri ilipitisha sheria ambayo inawataka watoa huduma za usafiri wa haraka unaotumia mtandao kama Uber na UAE kuanzisha kituo cha kutunza taarifa kwa ajili ya kuchakata taarifa zote zinazohusiana na watumiaji wa Misri.

eng: The law, which is still awaiting executive approval, obligates these companies to provide user data (including information about the location of both riders and drivers) to security authorities at their request.
swa: Sheria ambao inasubiri idhini ya utendaji, inawajibisha makampuni haya kutoa taarifa za mtumiaji (zikijumuisha taarifa kuhusu eneo walipo madereva na wasafiri) kwenye mamlaka za usalama zinapohitajika.

eng: Both companies were temporarily suspended in March 2018 after a group of local taxi operators sued the companies on licensing grounds.
swa: Makampuni hayo yalisimamishwa kwa muda mwezi Machi, 2018 baada ya kundi moja la wazawa wanaondesha teksi kuyashtaki kwa sababu ya leseni.

eng: Will biometric ID cards become mandatory in Europe?
swa: Kadi za kibayometriki zitakuwa ni lazima Ulaya?

eng: The European Commission proposed new counterterrorism measures including the mandatory inclusion of biometric data in ID cards and residence documents for EU residents and their family members.
swa: Tume ya Ulaya imependekeza mikakati mipya ya kupambana na ugaidi ni kujumuisha kwa lazima taarifa za kibayometriki katika kadi za vitambulisho na nyaraka za makazi kwa wakazi wa Ulaya na familia zao.

eng: This measure would require the majority of EU residents to be fingerprinted so that biometric identifiers can be checked at border points.
swa: Mkakati huu unawahitaji wakazi wengi wa Ulaya kuchukuliwa alama za vidole ili vitambulisho vya kibayometriki viweze kukaguliwa kwenye vituo vya mpakani.

eng: One voter got Cambridge Analytica to hand over his data.
swa: Mpiga kura mmoja alitumia Cambridge Analytica kukabidhi taarifa zake.

eng: What about the rest of us?
swa: Je vipi kuhusu tuliosalia?

eng: The UK Information Commissioner’s Office has given Cambridge Analytica 30 days to hand over all the data and personal information it has on one American voter, or face a criminal prosecution.
swa: Ofisi ya kamishina wa habari wa Uingereza imeipa Cambridge Analytica siku 30 kukabidhi taarifa zote na taarifa binafi walizonazo za mpiga kura wa Marekani, au kukabili mashitaka ya uhalifu.

eng: The voter, David Carroll, found that because Cambridge Analytica had processed US voter data in the UK, he could assert his rights under British laws.
swa: Mpiga kura, David Carroll, aligundua kuwa adai haki yake kupitia sheria za Uingereza kwa sababu Cambridge Analytica imefanya mchakato wa taarifa za wapiga kura wa Marekani katika Uingereza.

eng: Cambridge Analytica announced this week that it has gone into liquidation.
swa: Wiki hii, Cambridge Analytica ilitangaza kuwa imefilisika.

eng: Declaration from World Press Freedom Day
swa: Azimio la siku ya uhuru wa habari ulimwenguni

eng: Participants at the UNESCO World Press Freedom Day International Conference released the Accra Declaration calling on UNESCO member states to create and strengthen legal and policy frameworks to ensure respect for free expression and privacy and to protect safety of journalists and media workers.
swa: Washiriki katika Mkutano wa kimataifa wa siku ya uhuru wa habari duniani iliyoandaliwa na UNESCO walitangaza Azimio la Accra wakiomba nchi wanachama wa UNESCO kuunda na kuimarisha mifumo ya sheria na sera ili kuhakikisha kuheshimiwa kwa uhuru wa kutoa maoni na faragha na kulinda usalama wa wanahabari na wafanyakazi wa vyombo vya habari.

eng: Hate Speech Laws in India - Centre for Communication Governance, National Law University, Delhi So this is democracy?
swa: Chukia sheria za habari katika India - Kituo cha Utawala wa Mawasiliano, Chuo Kikuu cha Taifa cha Sheria cha Delhi Kwa hiyo hii ni demokrasia?

eng: State of media freedom in Southern Africa 2017 - Media Institute of Southern Africa Subscribe to the Netizen Report
swa: Hali ya Uhuru wa Vyombo vya Habari Kusini mwa Afrika 2017 - Taasisi ya Vyombo vya Habari Kusini mwa Afrika Jiunge na taarifa ya raia mtandaoni

eng: Afef Abrougui, Ellery Roberts Biddle, Nwachukwu Egbunike, Mohamed ElGohary, Rohith Jyothish, Demba Kandeh, Leila Nachawati, and Sarah Myers West contributed to this report.
swa: Afef Abrougui, Ellery Roberts Biddle, Nwachukwu Egbunike, Mohamed ElGohary, Rohith Jyothish, Demba Kandeh, Leila Nachawati, na Sarah Myers West walichangia taarfa hii.

eng: LGBT Flag of Cuba.
swa: Bendera ya mashoga nchini Cuba.

eng: Licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 4.0 International license.
swa: Imepewa leseni ya Creative Commons- Unaweza kusambaza kwa leseni ya 4.0 kimataifa.

eng: On May 11, 2018, a score of Cuban intellectuals and activists launched an exhaustive agenda for the rights of lesbians, gays, bisexuals, intersexuals, trans, queer and intersex people in Cuba.
swa: Hapo Mei 11, 2018, kundi la wasomi na wanaharakati wa Cuba walizindua ajenda nzito kuhusu haki za wasagaji, mashoga, watu wenye jinsia mbili, waliobadili jinsia na watu wote wenye hisia mchanganyiko dhidi ya mapenzi nchini Cuba.

eng: According to the submission:
swa: Kulingana na kilichowasilishwa:

eng: Based on the Yogyakarta principles on the application of international human rights law in relation to sexual orientation and gender identity, in the Declaration of Sexual Rights of the World Association for Sexual Health (WAS) and due to the upcoming constitutional and legal reforms in Cuba, members of the Cuban LGBTIQ community have met to promote this agenda.
swa: Kulingana na kanuni za Yogyakarta katika maombi ya sheria ya kimataifa kuhusu mahusiano na utambulisho wa jinsia, katika Azimio la Haki za Kujamiiana la Jumuiya ya Afya ya Kujamiiana (Declaration of Sexual Rights of the World Association for Sexual Health (WAS)) na kwa sababu ya marekebisho ya katiba na sheria yanayokuja nchini Cuba, wanachama wa jumuiya ya mashoga Cuba wamekutana kuhamasisha ajenda hiyo.

eng: The document begins by considering that sexual orientation and gender identity are inherent to human dignity.
swa: Andiko hilo linaanza kwa kutambua mirengo ya kujamiiana na utambuzi wa jinsia kuwa ni vitu vya asili katika utu wa binadamu.

eng: The goal is not only for the text to work as a collective statement but also as a proposal that contributors can continue to feed with ideas and suggestions.
swa: Lengo sio tu andiko hilo litumike kama tamko la pamoja lakini pia litumike kama pendekezo ambalo wachangiaji wataendelea kujazia mawazo na mapendekezo yao.

eng: The text also proposes specific lines of action that can be used as a starting point for research and for developing public policies, as Isbel Díaz Torres explains in Havana Times.
swa: Andiko hili pia lilipendekeza baadhi ya vipengele ambavyo vinaweza kuanza kutumika kwa ajili ya utafiti na kuanzisha sera za umma kama Isbel Díaz Torres anavyoelezea katika Havana Times.

eng: The agenda is the first of its kind in Cuba, compiled entirely by members of the public and focuses on the rights of LGTBIQ people.
swa: Mkakati huu ni wa kwanza na wa aina yake nchini Cuba, umeandaliwa moja kwa moja na wanajamii na umelenga katika haki za wanachama wa umoja wa mashoga.

eng: In addition, it includes 63 specific demands and is divided into two large sections: legislative measures and policies, plans and strategies.
swa: Kwa kuongezea, limehusisha mahitaji 63 na limegawanyika katika sehemu kuu mbili: mitazamo ya kisheria, kisera, mipango na mikakati.

eng: Cuban film director Yaíma Pardo set an important precedent with the demands collected in her documentary Causas y Azares (Causes and Chances, subtitles in English available).
swa: Muongoza sinema wa Cuba Yaíma Pardo aliweka utangulizi muhimu kwa mahitaji yaliyotolewa katika makala yake ya Causas y Azares (Sababu na Nafasi), tafsiri kwa kiingereza inapatikana.

eng: Another precedent was the text written by activist and blogger Alberto Roque.
swa: Utangulizi mwingine ulikuwa wa chapisho lilioandikwa na mwanaharakati na mwanablogu Alberto Roque.

eng: The documentary highlights numerous analyses regarding the current state of the LGBTQI community's rights in Cuba and the ideological and institutional changes necessary to ensure their full exercise.
swa: Makala ilionesha chambuzi kadhaa kuhusu hali ya sasa ya haki za wanaLGBTQI nchini Cuba na mitazamo na mabadiliko muhimu ya kitaasisi kuhakikisha inafanya kazi ipasavyo.

eng: Mercedes García and Yasmin Silvia Portales Machado, two activists who participated in the documentary, clarify important points to understand the context for recognizing and protecting Cuba's LGBTIQ community.
swa: Mercedes García na Yasmin Silvia Portales Machado ni wanaharakati wawili ambao walishiriki katika makala hiyo, walifafanua mambo muhimu ya kutambua na kuzingatia katika kutambua na kuzilinda haki za mashoga Cuba.

eng: In principle, they explain how the Cuban government does not acknowledge the complexity of gender compositions or the diversity of human sexuality.
swa: Katika kanuni wameelezea jinsi serikali ya Cuba isivyotambua ugumu wa muundo wa kijinsia au utofauti wa kujamiiana baina ya binadamu.

eng: García assesses Cuba's shortcomings in this regard:
swa: García alichambua mapungufu ya Cuba katika hili:

eng: Regrettably, the Socialist social project inherited that discrimination, those false concepts, that ignorance regarding human sexuality; and in Cuba's case, it has taken too long, to my liking, to face that reality and transform it.
swa: Jambo la kusikitisha, mradi wa jamii ya Ujamaa umerithi unyanyapaa, mitazamo hasi, umbumbumbu kuhusu kujamiiana kwa binadamu na katika shauri la Cuba imechukua muda mrefu sana kwa mtazamo wangu, kuukabili ukweli huu na kuubadilisha.

eng: Machado expands this point and highlights how the historical and cultural background of Cuba's political ideology prevents distinguishing citizens' diverse lives: Marxism appeared in the West and was a philosophical a white man.
swa: Machado aliipanua mada hii na kuonesha jinsi misingi ya historia na utamaduni wa mitazamo ya siasa za Cuba zinavyozuia upekee wa maisha ya raia wake:

eng: Socialism has failed so far. The Agenda for LGBTIQ rights in Cuba promotes a broad and inclusive debate on human rights and requests that their demands be considered by the National Assembly of People's Power, the Council of Ministers and those who make policies, plans and strategies in Cuba.
swa: Ajenda ya Haki za LGBTIQ nchini Cuba inahamasisha mjadala mkubwa na mpana kuhusu haki za binadamu na kutaka mahitaji yao yafikiriwe na Bunge laTaifa la Nguvu ya Umma, Baraza la Mawaziri na wale wote wanaotengeneza sera, mipango na mikakati nchini Cuba.

eng: A raised relief map of Pirin Mountain area on the wall of Mountain Rescue Service in Borovets, Bulgaria.
swa: Ramani ya eneo la Mlima wa Pirin kwenye ukuta wa Borovets, Bulgaria.

eng: Photo by Global Voices, CC-BY.
swa: Picha ya Global Voices, CC-BY.

eng: Environmental activists cheered when on April 26 the Bulgarian Supreme Administrative Court ruled that the government must stop its plans to allow new construction at Pirin National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, without conducting a Strategic Environmental Assessment first.
swa: Wanaharakati wa mazingira walifurahia pale mapema Aprili 26 mahakama kuu ya Nchini Bulgaria ilipofikia uamuzi kuwa Serikali haina budi kusitisha mpango wake wa kiruhusu ujenzi mpya karika hifadhi ya Taifa ya Purinmu, ambayo ni eneo la urithi wa Dunia la UNESCO, bila ya kufanya tathimini ya makakati wa mazingira.

eng: A coalition called For the Nature had brought the lawsuit and hailed the court's decision as an important step in their fight to protect the treasured piece of nature.
swa: Muungano ulioitishwa kwa ajili ya Mazingira ulianzisha sheria na na kuunga mkono uamuzi wa mahakama ikiwa ni moja ya hatua zao muhimu kwenye kupigania kulinda sehemu ya eneo lenye thamani kubwa.

eng: According to WWF-Bulgaria, a coalition member:
swa: Kwa mujibu wa WWF-Bulgaria, mmoja wa watu wa muungano huu:

eng: The plan permits construction on an area that is 12.5-times larger than currently permitted area and could lead to commercial logging affecting nearly 60 per cent of the park (currently no commercial logging is permitted in the park).
swa: Serikali imepanga kutoa kibali cha ujenzi kwenye eneo la ukubwa wa mara 12.5 zaidi ya eneo lililoruhususiwa kwa sasa, hali inayoweza kupelekea kudorora kwa uchumi, hali inayotarajiwa kuathiri karibu asilimia 60 ya hifadhi (kwa sasa hakuna shughuli yoyote ya kiuchumi inauoruhisiwa kwenye eneo la hifadhi).

eng: Development of the plan has been financed by the EU.
swa: Utekelezaji wa mpango huu umefadhiliwa na Umoja wa Ulaya.

eng: The threat to Pirin National Park has incited a five-month-long wave of protests across Bulgaria and abroad.
swa: Hali ya hatari dhidi ya hifadhi ya Pirin ilipelekea maandamano ya miezi mitano mfululizo katika maeneo mbalimbali ya Bulgaria na nje ya nchi.

eng: The latest round took place in Sofia, Blagoevgrad, Plovdiv, Sliven and London on April 26, in which participants also demanded protection of natural heritage in the Black Sea area.
swa: Maandamano ya hivi karibuni yalifanyika huko Sofia, Blagoevgrad, Plovdiv, Sliven na London mapema Aprili 26, ambapo waandamanaji walitoa pia wito wa kulindwa kwa urithi.wa asili wa eneo la Bahari Nyeusi.

eng: The court ruling overturned the decision by the Bulgarian Ministry of Environment and Waters to accept a draft management plan for Pirin National Park for the period 2014-2020 without a prior Strategic Environmental Assessment, allowing construction of new ski facilities near the town of Bansko.
swa: Maamuzi ya mahakama yalioindua maamuzi ya Wizara ya Mazingira na Maji ya nchini Bulgaria ya kukubali mpango wa usimamizi wa Hifadhi ya Purin kwa kipindi cha mwaka 2014-2020 bila ya kufanyika kwa tathmini ya kimkakati ya mazingira, ili kuruhusu ujenzi wa miundombinu mipya ya mchezo wa kuteleza kwenye theluji karibu na mji wa Bansko.

eng: The activists who initiated the lawsuit say such development will jeopardize the whole park and is in direct violation of EU Directive 2001/42/EO, which requires that an environmental assessment must be made in cases of decisions affecting tourism, forest industry and biodiversity.
swa: Wanaharakati waliofungua kesi mahakamani wanasema ujenzi kama huu utahatarisha hifadhi nzima na ni ukiukwaji wa agizo la Umoja wa Ulaya la 2001/42/EO, linalobainisha kuwa tathmini ya mazingira lazima ifanyike kwenye mambo yanayohusu utalii, sekta ya misitu na bayoanuai.

eng: The court argued that without conducting the required environmental assessment, "the Ministry had no basis to make a proper estimate whether the actions from the plan would have an impact on the environment or not." The three-judge panel noted that such assessment must be based on the criteria of the Environmental Assessment Regulation, which had not been the case so far.
swa: Mahakamailijenga hoja kuwa bila ya kufanya upembuzi yakinifu wa mazingira, "Wizara haikuwa na ushahidi wowote wa awali wa kufanya makadirio yoyote ikiwa utekelezaji wa maazimio kwenye mpango ulioandaliwa ungeweza kuwa na manufaa kwenye mazingira au la."Jopo la majaji watatu liliweka bayana kuwa tathmini ya aina hii inapaswa kuzingatia vigezo vya Kanuni ya Upembuzi Yakinifu wa Mazingira, ambayo haijazingatiwa hadi sasa.

eng: Even though they briefly celebrated the Supreme Administrative Court ruling, Bulgarian environmental activists are cautious to consider it an end to their struggle to #SavePirin, as they are aware that powerful financial interests would like to claim the land for their tourism projects.
swa: Pamoja na kuwa kwa kiasi fulani walisherehekea maamuzi ya Mahakama Kuu ya nchini Bulgaria, wanaharakati wa mazingira wa nchini humo wanachukua tahadhari na kuona kuwa huu sio mwisho wa jitihada zao za #kuokoaPirin, kwani wanatambua kuwa hila za matajiri wakubwa zinaweza bado kulitwaa eneo hill kwa ajili ya miradi ya kitalii.

eng: For one, legally the ministry has two weeks to submit an appeal, which would be submitted to a five-judge panel.
swa: Kisheria, wizara inazo wiki mbili za kukata rufaa, ambayo itawasilishwa kwenye jopo la mawakili watano.

eng: Great news for @zazemiata + thousands of people protesting against plans to damage #Pirin national park in Bulgaria! #SavePirin https://t.co/fBM7QtCGGM — Friends of the Earth (@foeeurope) April 30, 2018
swa: Habari njema kwa @zazemiata + maelfu ya watu wanaandamana dhidi ya mpango wa uharibifu wa #Pirin hifadhi ya taifa ya nchini Bulgaria! #OkoaPirin https://t.co/fBM7QtCGGM — Marafiki wa Ulimwengu (@foeeurope) Aprili 30, 2018

eng: Mainstream media in Bulgaria are mostly run by oligarchs and haven't exactly championed the cause, either, presenting protests as insignificant and sparsely attended.
swa: Vyombo vikuu vya habari nchini Bulgaria kwa kiasi kikubwa vinaendeshwa kwa mfumo kandamizi na hivyo kutokutangaza inavyotakiwa matukio haya, kolichofanyika ni ama kuonesha kuwa maandamano hayakuwa na madhara yoyoye na kwa uchache sana yalitiliwa maanani.

eng: For instance, one recent article calls the activists "the green bribers" (Bul. зелени рушветчии).
swa: Kwa mfano makala moja ya hivi karibuni inawaita wanaharakati hawa "wapokea hongo wa kijani" (Bul. зелени рушветчии).

eng: Bulgaria is last on media freedom in EU and in the Balkanshttps://t.co/TdCRdOaPf7#EU2018BG #SavePirin — Aleksandra Terzieva (@Sasha_Terzieva) April 25, 2018
swa: Bulgaria ni ya mwisho kwenye Uhuru wa vyombo vya habari miongoni mwa nchi za Umoja wa Ulaya na eneo la peninsula ya Kaskazini Mashariki mwa Ulaya https://t.co/TdCRdOaPf7#EU2018BG #SavePirin — Aleksandra Terzieva (@Sasha_Terzieva) April 25, 2018

eng: Green handkerchief mob at the Congress.
swa: Kikundi cha kitambaa cha kijani kikiwa kwenye jengo la Bunge.

eng: Image from the Facebook page of the National Campaign for the Right to "Safe, Legal and Free Abortion", widely shared online.
swa: Picha kutoka ukurasa wa Facebook wa Kampeni ya Kitaifa kwa Haki ya "Utoaji Mimba Salama, wa Kisheria na Huru", imesambazwa sana mtandaoni.

eng: On June 13, the members of Argentina's lower house of Congress, the Chamber of Deputies, will decide if they will give preliminary approval to a bill that would legalize abortion.
swa: Mnamo June 13, mkutano wa baraza la wawakilishi nchini Argentina, wakiwemo wasaidizi wao, litafikia tamati ya kupitisha muswada wa kuhalalisha utoaji mimba nchini humo.

eng: The debate started officially in March this year, a historic milestone in the long struggle for reproductive rights in the country.
swa: Mjadala huo ulianza rasmi mwanzoni mwa mwezi Machi mwaka huu, kama hatua moja wapo katika harakati za kutatea haki za uzazi kwenye nchi hiyo.

eng: For two months, the Chamber of Deputies listened to the different arguments for and against.
swa: Kwa kipindi cha miezi miwili, baraza la wasaidizi limesikiliza maoni mbalimbali ya waungaji mkno na wapinzani wa suala hilo.

eng: The debate period gave way to certain modifications to the bill to gain votes from undecided deputies.
swa: Muda wa majailiano ulitoa fursa ya maboresho fulani kwa muswada huo ili kupata kura kutoka kwa wasaidizi ambao bado walikua kimya.

eng: The most significant ones are the possibility for doctors to invoke conscientious objection, although hospitals are obliged to have professionals on staff who would accept to go forward with the procedure.
swa: Ingawa watu wenye sauti kubwa katika hili ni madaktari ambao ndio washika silaha mkononi ambao wametoa mtazamo hasi, ingawa baadhi yao wameliafiki suala hili.

eng: Also, consent from parents or legal guardians will be required for women under 16.
swa: Wakishauri kwamba uangalizi wa walezi uwepo kwa wanawake wenye umri chini ya miaka 16.

eng: Meanwhile, another debate has taken place on and offline: every Tuesday since April, several human rights organizations and civil society groups, convened by the National Campaign for the Right to Safe, Legal and Free Abortion, have met in front of Congress with a green handkerchief as a symbol of the struggle.
swa: Wakati huo huo, mjadala mwingine ulikua ukiendelea katika mitandao ya kijamii kila siku ya Jumanne tangu ilipotimu mwezi Aprili, ambapo mashirika mbalimbali yasiyo ya kiserikali ya kutetea haki za binadamu na vikundi vya kujitolea vya kiraia, vilivyoitishwa na Kampeni ya Kitaifa kwa Haki ya "Utoaji Mimba Salama, wa Kisheria na Huru", vikikutana mbele ya jengo la makutano ya baraza la wawakilishi wakishikilia juu vitambaa vya kijani kama ishara ya kupambana kilizuia swala hilo.

eng: Their slogan reads: "Sexual education to have a choice, contraception to avoid abortions, legal abortion to avoid death".
swa: Wakiwa na kauli mbiu: "Elimu ya uzazi ni maamuzi, uzazi wa mpango kuzuia utoaji mimba, utoaji mimba halali kuepuka kifo".

eng: There have also been demonstrations against the bill lead by different religious organizations and anti-abortion groups with the motto "Let's save both lives".
swa: Pia kumekua na udadavuaji wa muswada huu ukiongozwa na mashirika ya kidini na vikundi vinavyolipingana na muswada huu. Wote wakiwa na kauli mbiu "Tuokoe maisha ya wote."

eng: On June 13, a vigil is scheduled to take place in front of Congress as the Chamber of Deputies deliberates.
swa: Juni 13, mkesha unatarajiwa kufanyika mbele ya mkutano wa baraza la wasaidizi.

eng: Several polls have pointed to general support for the bill among the population.
swa: Mawazo ya wengi wameafikiana na muswada huu.

eng: Even renowned journalist Eduardo Feinmann, a passionate anti-abortion advocate, made a quick poll on Twitter and wasn't too happy with the results:
swa: Kuthibitisha hilo hata mwandishi wa habari maarufu aliyekuwa akilipinga swala zima la upitishwaji wa muswada huu aliandika ujumbe mfupi kupitia ukurasa wake wa Twitter kuwa hakufurahishwa na matokeo hayo.:

eng: Poll. 	Piga kura.
Are you for or against legal, safe and free abortions?" .
swa: Unaunga mkono au unapinga utoaji mimba kwa mujibu wa sheria, salama na huru?" .

eng: However, so far an analysis of deputies' voting intention shows a small inclination against legalization.
swa: Hata hivyo, mchanganuo wa kura za matakwa ya baraza la wawakilishi waliopiga kura unaonesha muelekeo wa kupinga uhalalishwaji.

eng: There are still a lot of undefined votes, though, either because deputies are undecided or are keeping their position private to avoid pressure or threats.
swa: Bado zipo kura nyingi ambazo bado hazieleweki, ingawa hali hii inaweza kuwa inapelekewa na kutotolewa tamko rasmi kutoka baraza la wawakilishi hivyo basi si rahisi kwao kuonyesha msimamo wao uko wapi ili tu kuepuka ushindani na vitisho vinavyoweza kujitokekeza kwa wakati huu.

eng: The last day of formal debate featured a strong presentation by Minister of Health Adolfo Rubinstein in support of decriminalization:
swa: Siku ya mwisho ulipofanyika muhadhara halali ilitolewa hotuba nzito na waziri wa Afya Adolfo Rubinstei iliyounga mkono hoja ya kuondoa sheriai:

eng: We've had 35 years of democracy.
swa: Tumekuwa na demokrasia kwa miaka 35.

eng: Abortion is a issue that has been swept under the rug. The evidence is solid: decriminalization reduces maternal deaths and the number of abortions.
swa: Utoaji mimba limekua ni jambo lililofunikiwa sakafuni Bila ushahidi: kuondoa sheria kutapunguza vifo vya kinamama na idadi ya utoaji mimba.

eng: One way or another, we need to act.
swa: Kwa njia moja, au nyingine, tuchukue hatua.

eng: If preliminary approval is granted, the bill will move to the Senate, where for the moment there are many more votes against legalization-for the moment, quite bigger.
swa: Ikiwa hapo awali itapitishwa, muswada utafikishwa kwa Bunge la Seneti, ambapo kwa sasa kura nyingi zinapinga uhalalishwaji.

eng: This tendency could change, however, according to the result of the debate taking place in the Chamber of Deputies, where those who are undecided play a crucial role.
swa: Hata hivyo, hali hii inaweza kutokana na matokeo ya mhadhara uliofanywa na baraza la wawakilishi, ambao maamuzi yao ndio muhimu.

eng: I'm just another green handkerchief looking at Congress
swa: Mimi mtu tu nimeshikilia kitambaa cha kijani hapa mbele ya mjengo

eng: It's impossible to ignore the influence of public opinion, not only in the polls, but also through different personal stories that are being shared online.
swa: Sio rahisi kupinga maamuzi ya umma, sio tu kwa kura lakini pia kwa kupitia similizi mbalimbali binafsi za watu katika mitandao.

eng: In one such testimony, a women talks in detail about the legal and bureaucratic obstacles she had to face when she needed a therapeutic abortion. Without making the names of the doctors public, she describes how some of them refused to help her, and how one of them asked for an unconscionable amount of money in exchange:
swa: Kwenye ushuhuda mmoja, mwanamke huyu bila kutaja majina ya madaktari alieleza adha alizozipata pale alipohijaji kutoa mimba ili kuokoa maisha yake, akieleza namna ambavyo wengne waalikataa kumsaidia wakkitaka kiwango kikubwa cha pesa kwanza:

eng: My head and my body had not been yet able to restart.
swa: Nikiwa nimeinamisha kichwa bila kujua nianzie wapi.

eng: I still had the anxiety of that moment in which, instead of getting the help and the unbiased position I needed from the medical institution and the doctor, I found myself jumping into a void without a net.
swa: Bado nikiwa mwenye wasiwasi kwa wakati huo, ambapo badala ya kupata msaada ila kunyanyapaliwa kutoka kwa madaktari nilijikuta nikirukia kitandani pasipo na chandarua.

eng: Whenever I slept, I had nightmares with Dr. N and Dr. B I can't stop thinking about Dr. B. Especially after seeing him in Congress, arguing in favor of life.
swa: B bila kumsahau Dk. B. tena baada ya kumwona pele mjengoni akihoji kuokoa maisha.

eng: And she concludes:
swa: Akitoa hitimisho:

eng: I feel we've been risking a lot these last days.
swa: Nafikiri tumekuwa tukihatarisha vingi nyakati hizi.

eng: Some girlfriends give me strength. they were holding my hand, like on that day I'm just another green handkerchief looking at Congress and asking it to vote in favor of legalizing abortions.
swa: Baadhi ya marafiki wa kike hunipa nguvu . wameishikilia mikono yangu , ni kama siku ile Mimi ni mtu tu nilieshikilia kitambaacha kijani nimesimama mbele ya mjemgo nikitazama na kuomba wapitishe utoaji mimba.

eng: On Twitter, others have also expressed strong opinions and different views in favor of the bill:
swa: Huko Twitter, watu wamejitokeza wakiwa na yao mazito kuelezea maoni yao juu ya muswada huu:

eng: The UN defined the criminalization of abortion as a method of torture.
swa: Umaja wa Mataifa umefanya kitendo cha utoaji mimba kuwa kosa la jinai kama njia moja wapo ya kuumiza watu.

eng: If the law is not approved, those responsable for that torture and the eventual deaths will be the deputies who voted against it.
swa: Kama sheria haitapitishwa, wale wanaowajibika na utesaji na hatimaye vifo watakuwa wasaidizi wa wale wanaowaunga mkono.

eng: They will have to carry each and every woman who bleeds to death in their conscience.
swa: Watalazimika kumbeba kila mwanamke anayepoteza damu mpaka kufa kwa ajili ya dhamira zao.

eng: Abortion exists, legal or illegal.
swa: Utoaji mimba upo, iwe kwa mujibu wa sheria au kinyume.

eng: I only support legal abortion in case of rape, if not, let them be screwed for opening their legs, then you don't really care about "both lives" ; what you want is to punish women, don't you think? Legal or illegal abortion, that is the question.
swa: naunga mkono utoaji halai wa mimba kwa waliobakwa , kama sio, wacha wawekwe ndani kwa kuachia miguu yao, kupitia hili hamjali kuhusu kuokoa maisha "maisha ya wote" [waliokuwa kinyume na mmuswada huu walisema; mnachotaka ni kuwaadhibu wanawake au sio? utoaji mimba ni hali au usio halali?, hilo ndio swali.

eng: If the law is passed, Argentina would be the second country in Latin America to follow the global trend towards either legalizing or decriminalizing abortion.
swa: Kama sheria hii itapitishwa , Argentina itakuwa ni nchi ya pili merika ya Kusini kufuata msafara huu wa kupitisha sheria ya uhalalishwaji wa kutoa mimba.

eng: The first country in the region to do it was Uruguay in 2012.
swa: Nchi ya kwanza ilikuwa Uruguay mwaka 2012.

eng: As a result, the maternal death rate dropped and has become the second lowest in Latin America.
swa: Ikirekodiwa kuwa na idadi ndogo ya uzazi ya pili kutoka mwisho ikilinganishwa nanchi nyingine huko Amerika ya Kusini.

eng: Let's be like the countries we want to be like.
swa: Hebu tuwe kama nchi tunazotaka ziwe.

eng: Without corruption, integrated in the world, with a responsable macro-economy, social protection, political dialogue... and legal abortion.
swa: Bila rushwa, tumejumuishwa duniani, tukiwa nauchumi mkubwa wenye kuwajibika kwa wahusika wa uchumi mkubwa, uhifadhi ya jamii, majadiliano ya kisiasa...na utoaji mimba kwa mujibu wa sheria.

eng: Bracelets distributed by Beirut Pride.
swa: Bangili ziligawanywa na Fahari ya Beirut.

eng: Source: Facebook page.
swa: Chanzo: Ukurasa wa Facebook.

eng: For the second year in a row, Beirut Pride, in collaboration with other groups supporting and advocating for LGBTQ+ rights, has organized talks and events against hate and discrimination based on gender and sexual diversity.
swa: Kwa mwaka wa pili mfululizo, Fahari ya Beirut kwa ushirikiano na makundi mengine yanayounga mkono na kutetea haki za mashoga wameandaa mijadala na matamasha yanayopinga chuki na unyanyapaa wa kijinsia dhidi ya tofauti katika kujamiiana.

eng: Beirut Pride 2018 was launched on May 12, with a brunch celebrating "parents who preserved their families, who did not reject their children when they came out as homosexuals, or at least, who sought for family to stay composed."
swa: Fahari ya Beirut 2018 ilizinduliwa hapo Mei 12 wakati wa mlo wa mchana wakisherehekea "wazazi ambao wamezitunza familia zao, ambao hawakuwatenga watoto wao walipogundulika kuwa wanajihusisha na ngono za jinsia moja au angalau wazazi waliotaka kuziweka familia zao pamoja."

eng: But this year, Lebanon's General Security barred one schedule Pride event—a play reading—from taking place, alleging that it was being held illegally.
swa: Lakini mwaka huu, mamlaka ya Ulinzi ya Lebanoni ilizuia kufanyika kwa tamasha moja lililokuwa limepangwa la kusoma tamthilia wakisema kuwa tamasha hilo liliandaliwa kinyume na sheria.

eng: General Security had said it didn't.
swa: Mkuu wa ulinzi akasema haihitaji.

eng: The cancelled event was set to take place in Beirut's Zoukak Theater.
swa: Tamasha hili lililokatazwa ilikuwa lifanyike katika ukumbi wa Zoukak Beirut.

eng: Members of General Security and the investigative branch of the police arrived at the theater and stopped a scheduled, free-of-charge reading of and Arabic translation of a French play, Yann Verburgh's "Ogres".
swa: Wajumbe wa kamati ya ulinzi na tawi la polisi la upelelezi waliwasili katika ukumbi huo na kusimamisha utaratibu, uliokuwa umewekwa wa kusoma na kutafsiri bure tamthilia ya Kifaransa " Zimwi" Yann Verburgh kwa lugha ya Kiarabu.

eng: One Beirut Pride organizer, Hadi Damien, was detained for the night, and after pressure from General Security, Beirut Pride decided to suspend its events "for the time being".
swa: Muandaaji mmoja wa Fahari ya Beirut Hadi Damien, alikuwa ameshikiliwa kwa usiku mmoja na baada ya shuruti kutoka kwa mkuu wa ulinzi, Fahari ya Beirut waliamua kuahirisha matamasha yao " kwa muda".

eng: Damien spent the night of May 14-15 in Beirut's notorious Hobeiche police station, known for instances of torture such as the one reported by the Lebanese francophone daily L'Orient Le Jour (OLJ), in which a gay couple was arrested, maltreated and tortured in Hobeiche and other detention centers in Lebanon.
swa: Damien alishikiliwa usiku wa Mei 14-15 katika kituo cha polisi cha Hobeiche ambacho kinafahamika kwa matukio ya utesaji kama moja ya matukio yaliyoripotiwa huko Lebanoni na gazeti la kila siku la lugha ya Kifaransa L'Orient Le Jour (OLJ), ambapo wapenzi wawili ambao ni mashoga walikamatwa na walitendwa vibaya kwa kuteswa huko Hobeiche na katika vizuizi vingine huko Lebanon.

eng: According to police sources who spoke to OLJ, Hadi Damien was detained because of an order from Lebanon's public prosecution.
swa: Kulingana na vyanzo vya polisi vilivyoongea na OLJ, Hadi Damien alishikiliwa kwa amri ya mwendesha mashtaka wa umma wa Lebanoni.

eng: He was given the choice of either signing a contract committing to stop the events of Beirut Pride or of having his case referred to a judge who would interrogate him on the basis of articles "pertaining to the incitement to immorality and to the breach of public morality for coordinating the activities".
swa: Aliamriwa kuchagua kati ya kusaini mkataba kuwa hatajihusisha na matamasha ya Fahari ya Beirut au shauri lake kupelekwa kwa jaji ambae atahojiana naye kwa misingi ya kifungu cha "kujihusisha na kuchochea; na kukiuka maadali ya jamii kwa kuandaa matamasha hayo".

eng: On advice from his lawyer, Damien decided that the best option was to sign the pledge, and the Beirut Pride coordinator was then allowed to leave the police station.
swa: Kwa ushauri wa mwanasheria wake, Damien aliamua kusaini mkataba huo na muandaaji huyo wa Fahari ya Beirut aliruhusiwa kuondoka katika kituo hicho cha polisi.

eng: On May 15, Beirut Pride released the following statement:
swa: Hapo Mei 15, Fahari ya Beirut ilitoa waraka ufuatao:

eng: Nobody is now detained, and Beirut Pride is safe.
swa: Hakuna mtu yeyote aliye kizuizini kwa sasa, na Fahari ya Beirut ni salama.

eng: The events scheduled under the banner of Beirut Pride until May 20, 2018 are suspended for the time being.
swa: Matamasha yalikuwa yametangazwa katika mabango ya Fahari ya Beirut hadi Mei 20, 2018, yamefutwa kwa sasa.

eng: We thank you for your concern and empathy, and kindly ask you to refrain from speculating.
swa: Tunawashukuru kwa kujali kwenu na ninawaomba mjiepushe na uvumi.

eng: We will issue a detailed statement by 9 pm to explain the happening.
swa: Tutatoa taarifa kamili hapo saa tatu usiku kuwaelezea kinachojiri.

eng: The pressuring by the authorities was condemned by civil society organisations.
swa: Shinikizo kutoka kwenye mamlaka lililaaniwa na mashirika ya kijamii.

eng: Proud Lebanon, which works "to achieve protection, empowerment & equality to marginalized groups through community service activities", condemned the silencing peaceful activities, adding that:
swa: Fahari ya Lebanon, ambayo hufanya kazi ili "kuwezesha ulinzi, uwezeshwaji, na usawa katika makundi ya pembezoni kupitia kazi za huduma za kijamii", walilaani kunyamazishwa kwa shughuli zinazofanywa kwa amani, wakiongeza kuwa:

eng: Lebanon has always been known for respecting diversity and claims to be an inclusive country for ALL its citizens, despite their differences.
swa: Mara zote Lebanoni inajulikana kwa kuheshimu utofauti na husemwa kuwa ni nchi yenye umoja kwa wananchi wake wote, pamoja na tofauti zao.

eng: Yet in the past couple of years we are witnessing a total boycott of the LGBTIQ+ movement from expressing loudly and publicly its need of co-existence in a society that should be protective, inclusive and welcoming each and every individual.
swa: Lakini kwa miaka kadhaa sasa tumeshuhudia ususiaji wa harakati za mashoga katika kupaza sauti na kuelezea hitaji la uwepo wao katika jamii kulindwa na kupokelewa na kila mmoja.

eng: The ongoing struggle against homophobia in Lebanon
swa: Mpambano dhidi ya hofu ya ushoga unaoendelea nchini Lebanon

eng: In Lebanon, homosexual relationships are prohibited on the basis of being "unnatural": Article 534 of the Lebanese Penal code prohibits "any sexual intercourse contrary to the order of nature".
swa: Nchini Lebanon, mahusiano ya jinsia moja yamekatazwa kwa misingi ya "kutokuwa ya kawaida": kifungu 534 cha adhabu cha Lebanoni kinazuia ushoga "kujamiiana kuwe kulingana na utaratibu wa asili".

eng: Between 2007 and 2017, however, four judges have found that the law should not apply to consensual sex between adults of the same sex.
swa: Hata hivyo, kati ya 2007 na 2017, majaji wanne waliona kuwa sheria isitumike dhidi ya ngono ya jinsia moja kwa watu wenye umri sawa waliokubaliana.

eng: But this hasn't stopped widespread abuses by the Lebanese government.
swa: Lakini hili halijakomesha kuenea kwa unyanyasaji wa serikali ya Lebanoni.

eng: Human Rights Watch (HRW) recently reported that gay men and transgender women in Lebanon have been beaten with electric cables and raped with iron rods.
swa: Hivi karibuni Shirika la Haki za Binadamu (HRW) liliripoti kuwa wanaume mashoga na wanawake waliobadilisha jinsia nchini Lebanoni wamekuwa wakipigwa kwa nyaya za umeme na kubwakwa kwa kutumia fimbo za vyuma.

eng: HRW found that while Lebanese activist groups have had some success in "shaming" the police service's Internal Security Forces by "documenting abuses and publicizing the accounts of victims", General Security was "less susceptible to public pressure, which has made abuses against LGBT people by General Security more difficult to counter."
swa: Shirika la Haki za Binadamu liligundua kuwa wakati makundi ya wanaharakati nchini Lebanoni wakifanikiwa " kuziaibisha" huduma za polisi Usalama wa Ndani kwa "kuandika kuhusu ukatili na kuweka wazi taarifa za wahanga", Mkuu wa Ulinzi "amehusishwa kidogo hivyo shinikizo la umma linapata ugumu katika kukabiliana na unyanyasaji wa mashoga unaofanywa na Mkuu huyo wa Ulinzi."

eng: One 2017's Beirut Pride event was also cancelled because of threats from the League of Muslim Scholars (Ulemas) in Lebanon (هيئة علماء المسلمين في لبنان).
swa: Moja ya matamasha ya Fahari ya Beirut ya 2017 yalifutwa pia kwa sababu ya vitisho kutoka kwa Kikundi cha Wanazuoni wa Kiislamu (Ulamaa) wa Lebanon (هيئة علماء المسلمين في لبنان).

eng: Members of a Christian Orthodox group were also asked to “pray against the threat of homosexuality”
swa: Wanachama wa Kikundi cha Wakristo Waorthodox pia waliombwa “kuomba dhidi ya tishio la ushoga”

eng: On its website, Beirut Pride calls itself "a collaborative platform that takes a positive stance against hate and discrimination based on gender and sexual diversity.
swa: Katika tovuti, yake Fahari ya Beirut hujiita "jukwaa shirikishi ambalo huchukua misimamo chanya dhidi ya chuki na unyanyapaa unaolenga utofauti wa jinsia na kujamiiana.

eng: Beirut Pride is articulated around May 17, the International Day Against Homophobia and Transphobia."
swa: Baina ya Mei 17, Fahari ya Beirut ilitajwa katika Siku ya Kimataifa Dhidi ya Hofu ya Ushoga na Ubadilishaji Jinsia."

eng: Illustration by the author.
swa: Mchoro umeandaliwa na mwandishi.

eng: As a kid reading Arabic-language versions of DC and Marvel comics in Sudan, I believed in superheroes.
swa: Nikiwa kama mtoto aliyesoma miandiko migumu katika lugha ya Kiarabu nchini Sudani, niliamini kuna watu wanaweza kuwa mashujaa.

eng: But I didn’t understand why none of the superheroes looked like me or had stories to which people like me could relate.
swa: Lakini sikuelewa kwa nini hakuna mashujaa walioonekana kama mimi au hata kuwa na masimulizi ambayo watu kama mimi wangejitambulisha nayo.

eng: Maybe that’s why I decided to become a cartoonist?
swa: Labda hiyo ndiyo sababu niliamua kuwa mchora katuni?

eng: All my childhood feelings came to the surface yesterday on Twitter when I stumbled on the viral video of a man selflessly scaling a four-storey building in less than 20 seconds to save a child, hashtagged #ParisSpiderman.
swa: Hisia zangu zote za utotoni zilinirudia jana kwenye mtandao wa Twita nilipokutana na video iliyokuwa inasambaa kwa kasi mtandaoni ikimwonesha mwanaume mmoja akikwea jengo lenye ghorofa nne kwa sekunde chini ya 20 ili amwokee mtoto, habari iliyopewa alama ishara ya #ParisSpiderman.

eng: Refreshing my Twitter feed gave me bits and pieces of the secret identity of the mysterious #ParisSpiderman, then they flooded my Twitter feed.
swa: Wakati nikipitia habari mpya kwenye mtandao wa Twita, nikapata taarifa zaidi kuhusu utambulisho wa siri wa huyu jamaa wa #ParisSpiderman, ndipo maruriko ya habari yalipoanza.

eng: His name is Mamoudou Gassama and, an undocumented immigrant from Mali.
swa: Jina lake ni Mamoudou Gassama na, alikuwa mhamiaji asiyeandikishwa kutoka Mali.

eng: “This is a much better—and more realistic—plot than Black Panther,” I thought to myself.
swa: Huu ni mkakati mzuri zaidi -na wenye uhalisia zaidi kuliko Black Panther, nilinong'oneza.

eng: While refreshing the hashtag to try to get at this new hero’s origin story, it struck me that his religion was not mentioned, as this is usually the first adjective featured in clickbait headlines and hashtags when an immigrant does something negative.
swa: Nilipokuwa naendelea kutafuta taarifa zaidi kupata masimulizi ya shujaa huyu mpya, nilishangaa dini yake haikutajwa, kwa sababu hii ndiyo huwa sifa ya kwanza kutajwa kwenye vichwa vya habari wakati mhamiaji anapofanya kitu hasi.

eng: Within hours, the headlines were reporting that #ParisSpiderman had been invited to meet the French president and that he would be granted citizenship.
swa: Ndani ya saa kadhaa, vichwa vya habari viliripoti kuwa #ParisSpiderman amekaribishwa na rais wa Ufaransa na kwamba angepewa uraia.

eng: A typical zero to hero intro to a superhero story.
swa: Utangulizi wa simulizi za kutoka mavumbini mpaka kuwa shujaa.

eng: With very little light shed on the details of the backstory, it highlighted the stereotypes (black, struggling, poor, ghetto-dwelling), with a quick fast-forward to the climactic scene where the unknown underdog hero saves the child in a public spectacle— and POW!—the introduction of a new “minority” hero, a new addition to the mostly-white superhero line up.
swa: Habari hazikuwa na undani wa kile hasa kilichotokea, isipokuwa maelezo ya kibaguzi (mweusi, masikini, anayehangaika na maisha, akiishi kwenye mageto), zikikimbilia kueleza kwa ufupi tukio la mtu huyu asiyefahamika akiokoa maisha ya mtoto -na PUU! -utangulizi wa shujaa mpya anayetoka kwenye jamii ya wachache, kipengele ambacho huongezwa kwenye masimulizi ya habari za mshujaa weupe.

eng: Here’s the missing backstory: Gassama left Mali as a teenager and traveled via , Libya—where he was arrested and beaten—to the coast, where he undertook a perilous boat journey to Italy.
swa: Hapa ninakupa simulizi ambalo hatukusikia likizungumzwa: Gassama aliondoka Mali kama kijana kinda na alisafiri kupitia Burkina Faso, Libya -ambapo alikamatwa na kupigwa- hatimaye akaelekea ufukweni, alikopata usafiri wa maji kwenda Italia.

eng: He spent four years in Italy before arriving in France in September 2017 to join his brother.
swa: Aliishi Italia kwa miaka minne kabla hajaelekea Ufaransa mwezi Septemba 2017 kuungana na kaka yake.

eng: Without the proper documentation to be in France, he had been sleeping on the floor of a residence for immigrants in Montreuil, outside Paris, rolling out a thin mattress each night and packing it up in the morning.
swa: Akiwa hana nyaraka za maana kumruhusu kukaa Ufaransa, alikuwa akilala sakafuni kwenye jengo la wahamiaji eneo la Montreuil, nje ya Paris, akiwa na kawaida ya kukunjua kigodoro chake kila usiku na kukufunga alfajiri.

eng: He shared a cramped room with six others and was, of course, unable to work legally.
swa: Alishirikiana chumba na wenzake sita na, kwa hakika, hakuweza kufanya kazi kwa mujibu wa sheria.

eng: So scaling that building was probably one of the easiest things Mamoudou had done in years.
swa: Kwa hiyo kupanda lile jengo ilikuwa ni moja wapo ya vitu rahisi zaidi Mamoudou kuwahi kuvifanya kwa miaka mingi.

eng: What readers should realize and what the storytellers need to do differently this time is to shed more light on the details of our hero’s life and the real hardships he’d had to endure before he scaled that building to save the child.
swa: Kile ambacho wasomaji wanahitaji kukielewa na kile ambacho wasimuliaji wanahitaji kukifanya wakati huu ni kuangazia kidogo zaidi undani wa maisha ya shujaa huyu na ugumu aliopambana nao kabla hajapanda ghorofa lile kumwokoa mtoto.

eng: Superman, the greatest of superheroes, was an immigrant but he was the “good kind”, the kind that looks “normal” and fits it, and doesn’t get randomly checked or surveilled.
swa: Shujaa huyu, shujaa mkuu wa mashujaa, alikuwa mhamiaji lakini pia alikuwa na "moyo mwema", moyo ambao unaonekana 'wa kawaida" na hakuwahi kusumbuliwa mara kwa mara wala kufuatiliwa.

eng: Let the introduction of this new and different superhero make France, and the rest of the world, realize how many superheroes have come in on those boats that are still waiting for their intro scene.
swa: Hebu utambulisho wa shujaa huyu mpya na wa tofauti uifanye Ufaransa, na dunia yote, kutambua mashujaa wangapi wameingia kwenye nchi hiyo kwa kutumia boti na bado wanangoja kutambulisha ushujaa wao.

eng: Next issue: Is our hero going to cope with his five minutes of fame?
swa: Suala jingine: Je, shujaa wetu huyu atamudu dakika tano za umaarufu?

eng: How is he going manage now that his powers have been discovered?
swa: Atawezaje kuishi sasa ambapo nguvu zake zimegundulika?

eng: Man wearing the Kofeyeh (traditional Palestinian head accessory) talking to a man wearing Shmagh (traditional Jordanian head accessory).
swa: Mwanaume aliyevaa kilemba (kwa mila za wapalestina) akiongea na mwanaume akiwa amevaa kilemba (cha mila ya Kijordan).

eng: Photo released to public domain, Source: Garaa News.
swa: Picha imetolewa kwa umma na: gazeti la Garaa .

eng: About 70 percent of Jordan’s population is of Palestinian origin, and they are generally well-integrated into Jordanian society.
swa: Karibu asilimia 70 ya idadi ya watu wa Jordani ni wa asili ya Palestina na kwa ujumla wapalestina hao wameingiliana na jamii za Jordan.

eng: Jordanians and Palestinians have been living alongside each other since the 1948 Arab-Israeli war and Palestinian Nakba, and even long before that.
