swa: Wajordani na Wapalestina wamekuwa wakiishi pamoja tangu vita ya waarabu-waisraeli na palestina Nakba mwaka 1948 , na hata kabla ya hapo.

eng: However, speak with everyday Palestinians and Jordanians and you might turn up stories that speak to underlying tensions between both groups.
swa: Hata hivyo, ukiongea na wapalestina na Wajordani kila siku, unaweza kupata simulizi za ndani zinazoelezea mgogoro kati ya makundi haya.

eng: Sara Suod, who is from Madaba, Central Jordan, told Global Voices that her parents would not allow her to visit Palestinian friends:
swa: Sara Suod anayetokea Madaba, katikati ya Jodan, aliambia Global Voices kwamba wazazi wake walikuwa hawamruhusu kwenda kutembea kwa rafiki zake wakipalestina:

eng: “I come from Madaba, and my family is extremely proud of that .
swa: “Ninatokea Madaba, na familia yangu inafurahia sana kuwa .

eng: So proud that they refused to let my sisters and I visit our Palestinian friends at their houses as children.”
swa: Wanajivuna sana kiasi kwamba walinikataza mimi na dada zangu kutembelea watoto wakipalestina rafiki zetu nyumbani kwao .”

eng: While the time living together has created a sense of peace among the two peoples, complete harmony is still not present.
swa: Wakati kuishi pamoja kumejenga amani mingoni mwa makundi haya, lakini amani kamili bado haipo.

eng: Marriage and sports are two of the domains where we can still see these tensions more clearly.
swa: Ndoa na michezo ni nyanja mbili ambapo bado tunaweza kuona migogoro yao vizuri zaidi.

eng: Are Jordanian-Palestinian Marriages Still Taboo?
swa: Je, ndoa kati ya wajordani na wapalestina bado ni mwiko?

eng: Out of the 82,000 Jordanian women married to foreigners, almost 53,000 are married to Palestinians.
swa: Kati ya wanawake 82,000 wa Jordani wameolewa na wageni, na karibu wanawake 53,000 wameolewa na palestina .

eng: A relatively high figure that could be taken to indicate the normality of Jordanian-Palestinian marriage in Jordan, but that figure can also be misleading.
swa: Idadi kubwa hii ingeonesha ulinganifu wa ndoa za watu wajordani na palestina lakini idadi hiyo nayo inapotosha.

eng: Stories from Jordanian citizens (whether of Jordanian or Palestinian descent) paint a different picture of Jordanian society regarding these marriages.
swa: Kutokana na taarifa kutoka kwa raia wa Jordani (awe wa asili ya Jordani au wapalestina) ndoa hizi zinaonesha picha tofauti ya uhusiano wa jamii ya Jordani.

eng: Even though the marriage is not exactly taboo, it can range –depending on the area and family—from being normal, to frowned upon, to being utterly forbidden.
swa: Hata kama ndoa sio mwiko kabisa, zinaweza kutofautiana kutegemea eneo na familia — kuna familia zinaona ndoa kama kawaida, nyingine zinichukia na nyingine zinaiona kama haramu. .

eng: Starting with stories of families who are at peace with the issue comes the story of Ahmad Khalil, a Palestinian man, and his Jordanian wife. Regarding their marriage as a successful one, he told Global Voices that:
swa: Ukianzia na hadithi ya familia ambazo zina amani katika suala la ndoa, taarifa ya Ahmad Khalil ambaye ni mpalestina na mke wake mjordani inaonesha kuwa ndoa yao ilikuwa yenye mafanikio, aliiambia Global Voices kwamba:

eng: We met at college, and got engaged after we both finished.
swa: Tulikutana chuoni na tukachumbiana baada ya kumaliza masomo yetu.

eng: Her family knew from the beginning, and so did mine.
swa: Tangia mwanzo, familia yake na ya kwangu pia zilijua.

eng: No one objected to anything, and things went quite smoothly throughout the engagement.
swa: Hakuna mtu aliyekataa kitu chochote, na mambo yote yalikwenda vizuri katika uchumba.

eng: Aside from normal, pedantic clashes between the in-laws, no major problems arose. Also, the clashes were never race-related.
swa: Hakukua na matatizo makubwa yaliyotoke mbali na mgongano wa baaadhi tu ya sheria za kijadi kati ya wakwe na wala haukuhusu tofauti za makabila yetu.

eng: I guess it is because my mom is Jordanian, and her uncles are all married to Palestinians, so you can say our families are both equally used to the situation.
swa: Nafikiri ni kwa sababu mama yangu ni mjodani na wajomba zake wameoa wapalestina, kwa hiyo familia yetu yote wamekumbana na hali hiyo.

eng: Ahmad and his spouse are lucky, and so are the ones who are born into families that are mixed, as the problem of prejudice or racism is minimised by the fact that each individual claims both identities.
swa: Ahmad na mke wake wana bahati kuzaliwa katika familia ambayo inamchanganyiko kwa hiyo tatizo la chuki au ubaguzi wa rangi ni dogo kwa kuwa kila mwanafamilia ana asili ya kutoka pande zote mbili.

eng: However, not everyone has had the same experience as Ahmad.
swa: Hata hivyo sio kila mmoja amekumbwa na hali kama ya Ahmad.

eng: Speaking of her spouse’s and her own family’s opinion of her marriage to a Palestinian, Sara Majali, a 26-year-old woman from Al-Salt, west central Jordan, tells Global Voices:
swa: Sara Majali ni mwanamke mwenye miaka 26 ambaye anatoka Al-salt katikati mwa magharibi ya Jordan alielezea Global Voices maoni yaliyotolewa na mme wake ambaye ni mpalestina na familia yake kuhusu ndoa yake:

eng: Growing up, my family was never particularly strict about my siblings and I marrying a Palestinian, although when I told them that I was, they were not exactly thrilled about it.
swa: Katika kukua kwangu, familia yangu hawakuwa wakali juu ya ndugu zangu na kuolewa na mpalestina hata nilipowambia nataka kuolewa naye wala hawakujali pia.

eng: They would have rather I married my cousin who also comes from Al-Salt, or at least someone else from it.
swa: Waliniambia ni bora nikaolewa na binamu yangu ambaye pia anatokea Al-Salt au angalau yeyote anayetokea hapo.

eng: My mom opposed the marriage at first, telling me I could find someone ‘closer to us’, but my dad was not as opinionated.
swa: Mwanzoni kabisa mama yangu alikataa nisifunge ndoa hiyo kwa kuniambia nitafute kijana ambaye ni wa ‘ukoo wetu’ lakini baba hakuwa na maoni yoyote.

eng: Her mother eventually agreed to the marriage.
swa: Mwishoni mama yake alikubaliana na ndoa hiyo.

eng: My mom eventually agreed to the marriage after months of convincing, but she still does not wholeheartedly bless the marriage.
swa: Mwoshowe mama yangu alikubali niolewe baada ya miezi kadhaa ya kumshawishi, lakini alikuwa bado hajaridhika moyoni kubariki ndoa hiyo.

eng: When my partner and I fight, the first words out of her mouth are always “wouldn’t it have been better if you married…?” and then she mentions the name of any Salt-born man.
swa: Mimi na mchumba tulipofuatilia zaidi, mara kwa mara maneno yaliyokuwa yanatoka kinywani mwa mama yangu yalikuwa “ingekuwa vizuri kama ungeolewa na….?” na kisha alitamka jina la kijana yeyote aliyezaliwa Salt.

eng: She continues:
swa: Aliendelea:

eng: My partner’s family, although not as aggressively against the marriage as my mom, still gave him a hard time.
swa: Wazazi wa mchumba wangu, ingawa hawakuwa wakali juu ya ndoa hiyo kama alivyokuwa kwa mama yangu lakini walimsumbua.

eng: Afraid of the fact that I come from a large family, a trait that they think I would use against my husband, they also ironically advised him to find someone ‘closer’ to them.
swa: Haliogopa ukweli kuwa ninatoka katika familia kubwa kitu ambacho walifikiri ningetumia kwa mme wangu, kwa kejeli walimshauri atafute yeyote kutoka katika ukoo wao.

eng: After 3 years of marriage, they have gotten to know me better, but I still feel that they put borders around my interactions with them—unlike their relationship with my brother in law’s Palestinian wives, who were immediately accepted and treated as a part of the family.
swa: Tofauti na wake wa shemeji zangu waliokuwa wapalestina ambao walipokelewa haraka na kuwa kama sehemu ya familia— baada ya miaka mitatu ya ndoa, walinielewa vizuri, ingawa nilijihisi kama waliniwekea mipaka katika kuchanyikana nao.

eng: No spine is a derogatory way of saying that Palestinian families are not as large and/or as well-connected as the Jordanian ones, implying that a Jordanian man or woman would be more in control of the marriage because they have the family and power to show for it.
swa: Kusema kuwa “hazina msingi” ni namna ya dharau ya kuziambia familia za wapalestina kuwa ni ndogo au hazikuungana vizuri kama zile za wajordan. Hii inamaanisha kuwa mwanaume au mwanamke mjordan anakuwa na nguvu katika udhibiti wa ndoa kwa sababu wana familia na nguvu ya kufanya hivyo.

eng: That is why many Palestinian families are reluctant about marrying into a Jordanian family, and vice versa.
swa: Ndio maana familia nyingi za kipalestina wanasita kuoana na familia ya Kijordan na familia ya kijordan vivyo hivyo.

eng: Rivalries Between Football Fans
swa: Uadui kati ya mashabiki wa mpira wa miguu

eng: Al-Faisaly is one of the Jordanian Football League’s most famous teams and has been taken as a symbol for Jordanian citizens of Jordanian heritage.
swa: Al-Faisaly in moja ya timu mashuhuri sana katika ligi ya mpira wa miguu Jordan na imekuwa ndiyo ishara au nembo ya raia wa Jordan kwa urithi wa Jordan.

eng: Al-Wehdat, named after the 2nd largest Palestinian refugee camp in southeast Amman, is just as famous and is instead a symbol for Jordanian citizens of Palestinian heritage.
swa: Al-wehdat iliyoundwa katika kambi ya pili kwa ukubwa ya wapalestina nayo ni mashuhuri na ni ishara au nembo ya raia wa Jordan kwa urithi wa wapalestina.

eng: While fans usually have a go at each other no matter the team, Jordanians of both heritage usually brace themselves when a game between the aforementioned teams is scheduled.
swa: Mara nyingi mashabiki huwa na kawaida ya kushaingilia timu hizi zinapokuwa zinacheza na timu nyingine lakini zinapokutana timu hizi kunakuwa na ushabiki wa kutambiana kati ya mashabiki wake..

eng: Cases of assault are common, and have once gotten to the point where 250 fans were injured.
swa: Kushambuliana ni kawaida na ilifika hatua ambapo mashabiki 250 walijeruhiwa .

eng: Shops and cars owned by bystanders are often burned for no obvious reason other than to flare the riots.
swa: Maduka na magari yanayomilikiwa na watazamaji mara nyingi huchomwa bila sababu ya msingi isipokuwa ni kuibuka kwa vurugu za uhasama.

eng: The police are usually involved, and the two clubs’ managements usually try to discipline their fans by banning anyone who is trying to start a fight between the two—something that does not happen when either of the two teams plays against any other team.
swa: Mara nyingi askari polisi na uongozi wa timu hizo mbili huhusishwa ili kujaribu kuwafundisha masahabiki wao adabu kwa kuwafungia kujihusiha na michezo wale wanaoanzisha vurugu —kitu ambacho hakijaonekana wakati timu hizo zikicheza zenyewe na timu nyingine.

eng: In 2009, a leaked US diplomatic cable said that:
swa: Mwaka 2009 leaked US diplomatic cable ilisema kwamba :

eng: Anti-Palestinian hooliganism and slogans denigrating the Palestinian origins of both the Queen and the Crown Prince led to the cancellation of a July 17 soccer game between the rival Faisali and Wahdat clubs , who traditionally represent the East Banker and Palestinian communities, respectively.
swa: Wito wa uzuiaji wa uhuni wa kipalestina na kuwavunjia heshima wapalestina wenye asili ya Malkia na Mfalme ilipelekea kuahirishwa kwa mechi ya mpira wa miguu kati ya klabu zenye upinzani mkali za Faisal and Wahdat ambapo timu ya Faisal huwakilisha East Banker na Wahdat huwakilisha jamii za kipalestina.

eng: The conclusion can be drawn that the riots, arson, and misconduct is about more than just soccer, it is about what the teams represent: race.
swa: Hitimisho linaweza kufikiwa kuwa ghasia, uchomaji mali za watu kwa makusudi na tabia mbaya ni zaidi ya soka, ni kile ambacho timu hizo zinawakilisha ambacho ni ubaguzi wa rangi.

eng: This point is highlighted by Al Wehdat’s own Palestinian President, who has said in one of his interviews with World Soccer:
swa: Hoja hii ilitolewa na Raisi wa kipalestina wa timu ya Wehdat katika mahojiano na Ulimwengu wa soka :

eng: For Wehdat, 99 per cent of the fans are Palestinian, you won’t find any Jordanian fans of Wehdat.
swa: Asilimia 99 ya mashabiki wa Wehdat ni wapalestina , huwezi kuona shabiki yeyote wa kijordan wa timu ya Wehdat. .

eng: Shujaat Bukhari, Srinagar based Journalist/Writer and Editor-in-Chief of Rising Kashmir.
swa: Shujaat Bukhari, mwandishi wa habari/mtunzi na mhariri mkuu wa Rising Kashmir anayeishi Srinagar.

eng: Image via Twitter account of Shujaat Bukhari
swa: Picha kutoka ukurasa wa Tweeter wa Shujaat Bukhari

eng: Shujaat Bukhari, the editor of prominent Kashmiri English daily Rising Kashmir, was shot dead in Srinagar, the summer capital of Jammu and Kashmir, sending shock waves throughout the region.
swa: Shujaat Bukhari, mhariri wa gazeti maarufu la kila siku huko Kashmiri la Rising Kashmir, alipigwa risasi na kufa huko Srinagar, mji wa majira ya joto wa Jammu na Kashmiri na kutuma mawimbi ya mshituko katika ukanda wote.

eng: His vehicle was surrounded by a group of suspected militants who opened fire on him and his security personnel.
swa: Gari lake lilizingirwa na watu waliohisiwa kuwa wanamgambo waliompiga risasi yeye na walinzi wake.

eng: Two security personnel later died as a result of their injuries at a hospital.
swa: Walinzi wake wawili walifariki baadaye wakiwa hospitalini kwa sababu ya majeraha.

eng: Bukhari's colleague said that he had just stepped outside his office after finishing his daily work and was heading to break his fast when the attack took place.
swa: Wenzake na Bukhari walisema kuwa ndi alikuwa ametka tu nje ya ofisi yake baada ya kumaliza shughuli zake za kila siki na alikiwa anaelekea kufuturu shambulio hilo lilipotokea.

eng: (Warning: Graphic image in the tweet below.)
swa: (Onyo: Picha hapo chini kutoka tweeter.)

eng: Journalist Shujaat Bukhari Attacked near Press Colony in Sringar.
swa: Mwanahabari Shujaat Bukhari alishambuliwa katibu na Koloni la Vyomho vya habari huko Srinagar.

eng: His PSO is also critically injured pic.twitter.com/g6AsFuudyr — Jyoti NS Pachnanda (@PachnandaJyoti) June 14, 2018
swa: Mlinzi wake pia amejeruhiwa vibaya. pic.twitter.com/g6AsFuudyr — Jyoti NS Pachnanda (@PachnandaJyoti) June 14, 2018

eng: After the attack on Shujaat Bukhari It's clear indication that nobody is safe in kashmir.
swa: Baada ya shambulio dhidi ya Shujaat Bukhari ni ishara iliyowazi kuwa hakuna mtu ambaye yu salama ndani ya Kashmir.

eng: The incident took place in the heart of city Lal Chowk.
swa: Tukio limetukia ndani ya moyo wa mji Lal Chowk.

eng: Shujaat Bukhari was probably leaving from his office when he was shot dead by Terrorists.
swa: Shujaat Bukhari alikuwa akitoka ofisini kwake aliposhambuliwa na magaidi.

eng: Whosoever did this must be his close aide. — Ibne Sina (@Ibne_Sena) June 14, 2018
swa: Yeyote aliyefanya hivi lazima atakuwa mtu wake wa karibu. — Ibne Sina (@Ibne_Sena) June 14, 2018

eng: Not a single day passes without blood being spilled in #Kashmir.
swa: Hakuna siku moja inayopita bila damu kumwagika ndani ya #Kashmir.

eng: Go through Shujaat Bukhari’s work to know who must have been after his life.
swa: Napitia kazi za Shujaat Bukhari ili kutambua ni nani anayeweza kuwa aliyataka maisha yake.

eng: Everything is uncertain.
swa: Kila kitu hakiko sawa.

eng: One can be killed anywhere and anytime . — Burhan Gilani (@Katar_Koshur) June 14, 2018
swa: Mtu yeyote anaweza kuuawa saa yoyote na mahali popote. — Burhan Gilani (@Katar_Koshur) June 14, 2018

eng: Bukhari was one of the few moderate and bold voices in Kashmir who stood for dialogue between India and Pakistan to resolve the Kashmir dispute.
swa: Bukhari alikuwa kati ya watu wachache wenye ujasiri ndani ya Kashmiri ambao walisimama kati ya India na Pakistani kusuluhisha mgogoro wa Kashmiri.

eng: Read more: The Kashmiri People Versus the Indian State
swa: Soma zaidi: Watu wa Kashmiri dhidi ya watu wa taifa la India

eng: Protests for independence (called "azadi") and self-rule in the Kashmir Valley have been active since 1989 and ever since, Jammu and Kashmir has been under Indian military presence with statutes such as the Armed Forces Special Powers Act and the Public Safety Act giving them wide-ranging powers.
swa: Maandamano ya kudai uhuru (yaliyoitwa "azadi") na utawala binafsi ndani ya Bonde la Kasmiri yamekuwa hai tangu mwaka 1989, na tangu hapo Jammu na Kashmiri imekuwa chini ya Jeshi la India kwa kifungu cha amri ya Jeshi maalumu lenye silaha na Kifungu cha sheria cha Usalama wa Raia ukiwapa uwanja mpana wa mamlaka.

eng: The Indian government has officially stated that it believes all of Jammu and Kashmir to be an integral part of India.
swa: Serikali ya India imetamka rasmi kwamba inaamini kuwa Jammu na Kashmiri sehemu muhimu ya India.

eng: An Indian policeman stands near an alley in the uptown of Srinagar, the summer capital of Indian administered Kashmir.
swa: Polisi wa India akiwa amesimama karibu na chochoro mmoja katika mji wa Srinagar, mji mkuu wa majira ya joto wa Kashmiri unaosimamiwa na India.

eng: Image by the author via Instagram.
swa: Picha na mmiliki kupitia Instagram.

eng: Bukhari had worked for several top national and international publications and written hard-hitting articles, never shying away from taking an unpopular stand.
swa: Bukhari alifanya kazi na kampuni kubwa za uchapishaji za kitaifa na zile za kimataifa na aliandika makala nyingi zilizogonga vichwa, hakuwai kuona aibu kuchukua msimamo ambao hakuungwa mkono na wengi.

eng: He was special correspondent with The Hindu newspaper from 1997 to 2012 and continued to write for Frontline magazine.
swa: Alikuwa mwandishi maalum wa gazeti la Hindu kuanzia mwaka 1997 hadi 2002 na aliendelea kuandikia jarida la Mstari wa Mbele.

eng: The Press Club of India has expressed its shock and dismay over the incident in the Kashmir valley.
swa: Klabu ya Wanahabari ya India imeelezea mshtuko wake na kusikitishwa na tukio hilo lililotokea ndani ya Bonde la Kashmiri.

eng: The Editors Guild of India tweeted a statement:
swa: Chama cha Wahariri wa India kilitoa taatifa yake huko twita:

eng: The Editors Guild of India unequivocally condemns the assassination of Rising Kashmir Editor Shujaat Bukhari.
swa: Chama cha Wahariri cha India kwa pamoja tunalaani mauaji ya Mhariri wa Rising Kashmiri ndugu Shujaat Bukhari.

eng: This is a grave attack on press freedom and democratic voices.
swa: Hili ni shambulio la kikatili dhidi ya uhuru wa habari na sauti ya demokrasia.

eng: We will be issuing a more detailed statement soon — Editors Guild of India (@IndEditorsGuild) June 14, 2018
swa: Tutatoa taarifa nyingine ya kina hivi karibuni — Editors Guild of India (@IndEditorsGuild) June 14, 2018

eng: Condolences are pouring in via social media.
swa: Salamu za rambirambi zinamiminika kupitia mitandao ya kijamii.

eng: Siddharth Varadarajan, the Editor of the Wire news portal, tweeted:
swa: Siddharth Varadarajan, mhariri wa Wire news portal, alitwiti:

eng: Shujaat Bukhari and I were colleagues at The Hindu.
swa: Mimi na Shujaat Bukhari tulifanya kazi pomoja kwenye gazeti la Hindu.

eng: He was a formidable reporter, and, as editor of Rising Kashmir, a powerful voice for the embattled media fraternity, a true voice of sanity and reason.
swa: Alikuwa mwandishi asiye na hofu na kama mhariri wa Rising Kashmiri alikuwa sauti yenye nguvu iliyopigania umoja wa vyombo vya habari, sauti ya kweli katika umakini na fikra.

eng: No words of condemnation are enough for the scum who have assassinated him. — Siddharth (@svaradarajan) June 14, 2018
swa: Hakuna maneno ya kutosha kuwalaani washenzi waliomuua. — Siddharth (@svaradarajan) June 14, 2018

eng: Marvi Sirmed, a member of the executive council of the Human Rights Commission of Pakistan (HRCP) and special correspondent for the Daily Times Pakistan, tweeted:
swa: Marvi Sirmed, mjumbe wa baraza kuu la Kamisheni na Haki za Binadamu la Pakistani (HRCP) na mwandishi maalum wa Daily Times wa Pakistan, alitwiti:

eng: Shujaat Bukhari was a voice of reason in Kashmir.
swa: Shujaat Bukhari alikuwa sauti yenye fikra ndani ya Kashmir.

eng: Brilliant journalist who pandered to no extremes.
swa: Mwandishi bora ambaye hakuukuwadia uovu.

eng: He did his job honorably till his last breath & paid the price of being upright.
swa: Aliifanya kazi yake kwa haki mpaka mwisho wa pumzi yake na amelipa gharama za kuwa muungwana.

eng: Objectively reported human rights violations at the hands of Indian forces & extremists in Kashmir. — Marvi Sirmed मार्वि ماروی (@marvisirmed) June 14, 2018
swa: Kwa lengo la kutoa taarifa za uvunjwaji wa haki za binadamu unaofanywa na majeshi katili ya India huko Kashmir. — Marvi Sirmed मार्वि ماروی (@marvisirmed) June 14, 2018

eng: This wasn't the first time that Bukhari was targeted.
swa: Hii haikuwa mara ya kwanza Bukhari kulengwa.

eng: On July 8, 1996, a militant group abducted 19 local journalists in the Anantnag district and held them as hostages for at least seven hours.
swa: Hapo Julai 8, 1996, kikundi cha wanamgambo waliwateka waandishi wa habari 19 katika wilaya ya Anantnag na kuwashikilia kwa masaa saba.

eng: Bukhari was among those abducted.
swa: Bukhari alikuwa mmoja wao.

eng: He was also given police protection after an attack against him in 2000.
swa: Pia alipewa ulinzi na polisi baada ya shambulio dhidi yake hapo mwaka 2000..

eng: Student politician Shehla Rashid tweeted:
swa: Mwanafunzi mwanasiasa Shehla Rashid alitwiti:

eng: Even in a senseless place like Kashmir, the assassination of Mr. Shujaat Bukhari doesn't make sense.
swa: Hata katika eneo lisilo na maana kama Kashmiri mauaji ya Shujaat Bukhari hayaleti maana.

eng: Everyone in the state is asking one question: "Why would anyone want him dead?"
swa: Kila mtu hapa anauliza swali moja tu kuwa: "Kwanini mtu yeyote angetaka afe?"

eng: Except the govt which seems to have reached a conclusion
swa: Isipokuwa serikali ambayo ingekuwa imefikia suluhisho.

eng: Appeal to @MehboobaMufti to ensure probe — Shehla Rashid (@Shehla_Rashid) June 14, 2018
swa: Ninatoa wito wa @MehboobaMufti kuhakikisha uchunguzi wa kina unafanyika. — Shehla Rashid (@Shehla_Rashid) June 14, 2018

eng: Former chief minister of Indian Administered Jammu and Kashmir, Omar Abdullah, tweeted:
swa: Waziri wa zamani wa Jammu na Kashmiri iliyosimamiwa na India, Omar Abdullah, alitwiti:

eng: The show must go on.
swa: Lazima mambo yaendelee.

eng: As Shujaat would have wanted it to.
swa: Kama ambavyo Shujaat angependa yawe.

eng: This is today’s @RisingKashmir issue.
swa: Hili ni jambo @RisingKashmir la leo.

eng: That Shujaat’s colleagues were able to bring out the paper in the face of insurmountable grief is a testament to their professionalism & the most fitting tribute to their late boss. pic.twitter.com/ADP70D4F1q — Omar Abdullah (@OmarAbdullah) June 14, 2018
swa: Kitendo cha Wafanyakazi wenza wa Shujaat kuweza kuchapisha na kulitoa gazeti hilo wakati huu wa maombolezo haya makubwa ni ushuhuda wa ukomavu wa taaluma yao na salamu za rambi rambi za kumfaa bosi wao aliyefariki. pic.twitter.com/ADP70D4F1q — Omar Abdullah (@OmarAbdullah) June 14, 2018

eng: According to Reporters Without Borders, Shujaat Bukhari escaped a murder attempt by armed men in June 2006.
swa: Kulingana na waandishi wa habari wasio na mipaka, Shujaat Bukhari alisalimika jaribio la kumuua lililofanywa na watu wenye silaha hapo Juni 2006.

eng: Shujaat Bukhari told Reporters Without Borders, "It is virtually impossible to know who are our enemies and who are our friends."
swa: Shujaat Bukhari aliwaambia Waandishi wa Habari wasio na mipaka kuwa, " Ni vigumu kutambua ni nani ni maadui zetu na ni nani ni marafiki zetu."

eng: Despite this, the guns couldn't silence his pen.
swa: Pamoja na hili, bunduki haziwezi kuinyamazisha kalamu yake.

eng: Telco ad on a van in Kampala, Uganda.
swa: Telco ad akiwa kwenye gari dogo Kampala, Uganda.

eng: Photo by futureatlas.com via Flickr (CC BY 2.0)
swa: Picha na futureatlas.com kupitia Flickr (CC BY 2.0)

eng: The Ugandan government approved a new tax law that will apply levies to a range of goods and services, including mobile money accounts and social media services such as Facebook and WhatsApp.
swa: Serikali ya Uganda ilithibitisha kuwa sheria mpya ya kodi itahusu kiwango cha kodi ya huduma na bidhaa ikijumuisha akaunti ya fedha za simu na and huduma za mitandao ya jamii kama vile Facebook na WhatsApp.

eng: It was also popular among local telecom providers, who do not directly benefit from the use of foreign-based “over-the-top” services such as WhatsApp.
swa: Na lilipokelewa vizuri miongoni mwa watoa mawasiliano ya simu ambao hawafaidiki moja kwa moja na kutumia mitandao hiyo ya kigeni “mikuu” kama huduma za WhatsApp.

eng: In an interview, Ugandan blogger and Global Voices author Pru Nyamishana told BuzzFeed:
swa: Katika mahojiano na mganda Pru Nyamishana ambaye mwanabloga na mwandishi wa Global Voices aliambia BuzzFeed kwamba :

eng: one of the two biggest challenges that we face in internet governance is access.
swa: Moja ya changamoto kubwa tunazokabiliana nazo ni upatikanaji wa mtandao.

eng: This tax is locking people out....we also believe it is a deliberate move to censor Ugandans and cut down on dissenting voices.
swa: Kodi hii inafunga watu kuwa nje ya mtandao....tunaamini kuwa huu ni mpango wa makusudi kutaka kujua idadi ya waganda ambao ni watumiaji wa mtandao ili kunyamanzisha sauti za wapinzani.

eng: Citing a recent rise in murders and kidnappings, the Ugandan government has also ended a two-month freeze on SIM card sales and ordered telecom companies to register all new mobile SIM cards with the National Biometrics Data Center.
swa: Serikali ya Uganda ikitaja kutekwa na mauaji ya watu ya hivi karibuni imehitimisha kifungo cha miezi miwili cha ununuaji wa kadi za simu na kuamuru makambuni ya simu kuorodhesha watu wote wenye kadi mpya za simu kwenye kituo cha taarifa za kibayometriki cha taifa .

eng: It has banned the sale of scratchable recharge cards as well.
swa: Serikali pia imefunga mauzo ya kadi zinazokwanguliwa kwa ajili ya kuongeza salio kwenye simu.

eng: Authorities say violent criminals communicate using unregistered SIM cards in order to plan the attacks without being traced.
swa: Mamlaka zinasema kuwa wahalifu huwasiliana kwa kutumia kadi za simu ambazo hazijasajiliwa ili kupanga mikakati ya mashambulio bila kufatiliwa.

eng: While the ban on SIM card sales has been lifted, new regulations will now require Ugandans to provide vendors with their national identification cards so that their personal data can be verified on electronic card readers at the time of purchase.
swa: Wakati katazo juu ya kadi za simu limeondolewa, sasa sheria mpya inawataka waganda wakati wananuna kadi hizo kutoa kadi za utambulisho wa taifa kwa wachuuzi ili zithibitishwe kwenye kadi ya umeme inayosoma taarifa ya mnunuzi wa kadi za simu.

eng: Under the new law, which goes into effect July 1, customers will also be made to use mobile money accounts in order to recharge their SIM cards.
swa: Kwa sheria hii mpya inayotarajia kuanza Julai mosi, wateja watatakiwa pia kutumia akaunti za fedha za simu zao kuongeza muda wa maongezi kwenye kadi za simu zao.

eng: In a press statement, the Uganda Consumer Protection Association said SIM card regulatory measures would not reduce the crime rate.
swa: Taarifa kwa vyombo vya habari iliyotolewa na chama cha kulinda walaji cha Uganda kilisema kuwa hatua za kudhibiti kadi za simu zisingepunguza kiwango cha uhalifu.

eng: Writing about the new tax law, Juliet Nanfuka of the Collaboration on International ICT Policy in East and Southern Africa (CIPESA) called it “the latest in a series of government actions that threaten citizens’ access to the internet.”
swa: Akiandika kuhusu sheria ya kodi mpya, Juliet Nanfuka wa ushirikiano wa sera ya kimataifa ya TEHAMA kusini mwa Afrika(CIPESA) aliiita sheria hiyo kuwa “ni kitendo kipya katika mfululizo wa matendo ya serikali ambayo yanatishia upatikanaji wa mtandao kwa wananchi.”

eng: Internet shutdown in India’s Tamil Nadu state following massacre of protesters
swa: Mtandao katika jimbo la tamil Nadu India wafungwa kufuatia mauaji ya waandamanaji

eng: After police shot and killed 13 civilians at a public demonstration in the southern Indian state of Tamil Nadu, fixed and mobile internet networks were shut down in three districts at the order of local government authorities.
swa: Baada ya askari polisi kufyatua risasi na kuua raia 13 katika maandamano ya umma kusini mwa jimbo la Tamil Nadu India vifaa vya mawasiliano na simu za mononi zilizounganishwa kwenye mtandao vilifungwa katika wilaya tatu kwa amri ya mamlaka ya serikali za mtaa.

eng: The demonstrators were protesting the expansion of a copper plant that they say is polluting the air and water in their district and putting their health at risk.
swa: Waandamanaji walikuwa wanapinga upanuzi wa machimbo ya shaba ambao walisema unahalibu hewa na maji katika wilaya yao na kufanya afya zao kuwa katika hatari.

eng: Videos of police acting violently or cruelly toward protesters have been circulating on social media, leaving many skeptical of the government’s motivations for cutting off internet access.
swa: Picha za video za askari wakiwatendea ukatili waandamanaji zimekuwa zikisambazwa katika mitandao ya kijamii ambazo ziliwaacha wengi na wasiwasi juu ya nia ya serikali ya kuondoa upatikanaji wa mtandao.

eng: According to the Software Freedom Law Center of New Delhi, there have been 55 regional internet shutdowns in India so far in 2018.
swa: Kutokana na kituo huru cha sheria cha habari nyororo za mtandao cha New Delhi, kumekuwa na kuzimwa kwa mtandao katika kanda 55 nchini India hadi mwaka 2018.

eng: Papua New Guinea puts a one-month ban on Facebook, citing ‘fake users’
swa: Papua New Guinea yatoa katazo la mwezi mmoja kutotumia Facebook likitaja kuwepo kwa ‘watumiaji bandia’

eng: Officials in the southern Pacific island state of Papua New Guinea will impose a one-month-long ban on Facebook, in what they say is an effort to better understand the platform as a catalyst for the spread of false information.
swa: Maafisa kusini mwa jimbo la kisiwa cha Pacific cha Papua New Guinea wataweka katazo la mwezi mmoja kutotumia facebook , kwa kile wanachosema ni jitihada za kuelewa jukwaa hilo vizuri zaidi ambalo limechochea kusambaa kwa taarifa za uongo mtandaoni.

eng: In an interview with The Guardian, digital media scholar and Global Voices author Aim Sinpeng expressed concern about the ban, but also noted that it would have less impact there than in other parts of the world, given the country’s low proportion of internet users.
swa: Katika mahojiano na gazeti la Gardian , msomi wa vyombo vya habari vya kidigitali na mwandishi wa Global Voices, Aim Sinpeng alieleza kuhusu katazo hilo, lakini pia alibainisha kwamba kule kuna athari kidogo kuliko sehemu nyingine yoyote ulimwenguni kutokana na uwiano mdogo wa watumiaji wa mtandao.

eng: Papua New Guinea has a population of just over eight million and an internet penetration rate of only 12 percent.
swa: Papua New Guinea ina idadi ya watu ambao wanazidi kidogo milioni nane na kiasi kinachoingia kwenye mtandao ni asilimia 12 tu.

eng: UAE human rights advocate faces 10 years in prison for social media activism
swa: Wakili wa haki za binadamu wa UAE akabiliwa na kifungo cha miaka 10 jela kwa sababu ya harakati katika mitandao ya kijamii

eng: Emirati human rights advocate Ahmed Mansoor was sentenced to ten years in prison by an Abu Dhabi appeals court for allegedly spreading “hatred and sectarianism” and publishing “false information” on social media.
swa: Wakili wa haki za binadamu wa Emirati Ahmed Mansoor alihukumiwa miaka kumi jela na mahakama ya rufaa kwa kusambaza habari za “chuki na kubagua” na kuchapisha “habari za uongo” kwenye mitandao ya kijamii.

eng: He was also issued a one million dirham fine (roughly USD $272,000) for “insulting the status and prestige of the UAE.”
swa: Pia alipigwa faini ya kulipa milioni moja ya Abu Dhabi (ni sawa na dola za Kimarekani 272,000) kwa “kutukana hadhi na heshima ya UAE.”

eng: Mansoor, who has been held in detention since March 2017, is among a handful of vocal human rights advocates in the Gulf country and received the 2015 Martin Ennals Award for Human Rights Defenders.
swa: Mansoor aliwekwa kizuini tangu Machi 2017, ni miongoni mwa mawakili wachache wanaotetea haki za binadamu katika nchi ya Guba ambaye alipewa tuzo ya watetezi wa haki za binadamu ya Martin Ennals mwaka 2015 .

eng: He was also jailed in 2011, after he campaigned for democratic reforms in UAE and signed a pro-democracy petition.
swa: Pia, aliwahi kufungwa mwaka 2011 baada ya kufanya kampeni ya mabadiliko ya kidemokrasia katika UAE na alisaini ombi la waraka wa demokrasia nchini humo.

eng: From this time until his most recent arrest, he faced harassment and surveillance both online and off.
swa: Kuanzia muda huo hadi anakamatwa hivi karibuni, amekumbwa na unyanyasaji na ufuatiliaji wa karibu mno mtandaoni na nje ya mtandao.

eng: With new software, Amazon.com is helping governments surveil US residents
swa: Com inatumia habari nyororo kusaidia serikali kufuatilia wakazi wa Marekani.

eng: Amazon.com has developed its own facial recognition software, Rekognition, a product the company says can perform “real-time face recognition across tens of millions of faces, and detection of up to 100 faces in challenging crowded photos.”
swa: Amazon. com wameanzisha kitambuzi cha kielektroniki chakutambua uso kinachojulikana kama Rekognition, ambacho kampuni inasema ni zao ambalo linaweza “kutambua sura katika sura milioni kumi na kuchunguza sura hadi 100 katika picha nyngi.”

eng: Through a Freedom of Information Act request, attorneys at the American Civil Liberties Union obtained and released emails proving that Amazon has been selling the software to local governments in the US states of Arizona, California and Oregon and that the company had trained and consulted with government officials under a non-disclosure agreement initiated by Amazon.
swa: Sheria ya uhuru wa habari inamtaka mwanasheria mkuu wa Umoja wa uhuru wa raia Marekani kupata na kutoa barua pepe kuthibitisha kuwa amazon imekuwa ikiuza kitambuzi hicho serikali za mtaa katika majimbo ya Arizona, California na Oregon na kampuni hiyo imewapa mafunzo na ushauri wa kitaalam maafisa wa serikali katika mkataba wa siri.

eng: The organization also co-wrote a coalition letter to Amazon CEO Jeff Bezos, demanding that Amazon “stop powering a government surveillance infrastructure that poses a grave threat to customers and communities across the country.”
swa: Pia Umoja huo ulimwandikia barua ya pamoja Mtendajii mkuu Jeff Bezos wa Amozon, iliyodai kwamba Amazon “iache kuimarisha miundombinu ya serikalini ya ufuatiliaji ambayo inatishia sana wateja na jamii nchini kote.”

eng: The Council on American-Islamic Relations, the Electronic Frontier Foundation and Human Rights Watch were among signatories.
swa: Baraza la mahusianao ya kiislamu Marekani, Umoja wa kujitolea wa kielektronik na waangalizi wa haki za binadamu walikuwa ni miongoni mwa watia saini barua hiyo.

eng: Report of the Special Rapporteur on the promotion and protection of the right to freedom of opinion and expression - United Nations The Oxygen of Amplification: Better Practices for Reporting on Extremists, Antagonists, and Manipulators Online - Whitney Phillips, Data and Society Subscribe to the Netizen Report
swa: Taarifa ya Mwandishi Maalumu wa Kuimarisha na Kulinda Haki ya Uhuru wa Kujieleza na Kutoa Maoni inaeleza -Umoja wa Mataifa Kuongezeka kwa oksijeni: Mazoezi Mazuri ya Kutoa Taarifa za Wenye Msimamo Mkali, Wapinzani na Wenye Hila Mtandaoni - Whitney Phillips, Taarifa na Jamii Jiunge na taarifa za raia mtandaoni

eng: Afef Abrougui, Ellery Roberts Biddle, Nwachukwu Egbunike, Mohamed ElGohary, Rohith Jyothish, Rezwan Islam, Inji Pennu, James Propa and Sarah Myers West contributed to this report.
swa: Afef Abrougui, Ellery Roberts Biddle, Nwachukwu Egbunike, Mohamed ElGohary, Rohith Jyothish, Rezwan Islam, Inji Pennu, James Propa na Sarah Myers West wamechangia taarifa hii.

eng: A digital illustrated novel tells the stories of Indonesian Chinese who were attacked during the riots that toppled the Indonesian government in 1998.
swa: Kitabu cha digitali cha riwaya kinachoelezea hadithi za Wachina wenye asili ya Indonesia ambao walishambuliwa wakati wa maandamano yaliyoiangusha serikali ya Indonesia hapo mwaka 1998

eng: In May 1998, violent riots erupted across Indonesia demanding the resignation of then President Suharto who had ruled the country for over three decades.
swa: Mnamo Mei 1998, maandamano yenye vurugu yaliibuka nchini Indonesia kumtaka Rais Suharto aliyeitawala nchi hiyo kwa miongo mitatu ajiuzulu.

eng: Many Orang Tionghoa (how Indonesians with full or partial Chinese ancestry are called) fled the country because of the escalating violence that targeted them.
swa: Waorang Tionghoa wengi (ndivyo WaIndonesia wenye asili ya China wanavyoitwa) waliikimbia nchi kwa sababu vurugu zilizoenea ziliwalenga wao.

eng: A government report released in October 1998 revealed that, while some violent incidents against Indonesian Chinese were spontaneous, most cases appeared to be systematically planned by local thugs supported by powerful political and military forces.
swa: Taarifa ya serikali iliyatolewa Oktoba 1998 ilionesha kuwa wakati baadhi ya vurugu dhidi ya Waindonesia wenye asili China zilikuwa za hiyari, lakini mikasa mingi ilionekana kupangwa kiufundi na wahuni wa mjini wakiungwa mkono na mamlaka zenye nguvu kisiasa na kijeshi.

eng: The report also documented cases of rape that victimized many Indonesian Chinese women.
swa: Taarifa hiyo pia iliandika kuhusu visa vya ubakaji ambapo waathirika walikuwa ni wanawake Waindonesia wenye asili ya China.

eng: After two decades, victims of the attacks in 1998 and their families continue to seek justice.
swa: Baada ya miongo miwili, wahanga wa mashambulio hayo na familia zao wameendelea kutafuta haki.

eng: Written by Melbourne-based artist Rani Pramesti, the ‘Chinese Whispers’ illustrated novel narrates the tragedy that forced her to flee her beloved country in 1998.
swa: Ikiwa imeandikwa na msanii anayeishi Melbourne Rani Pramesti, riwaya ya ‘Minong'ono ya Wachina’ inasimulia jinsi janga hilo lilivyomlazimisha kuikimbia nchi yake aliyoipenda hapo mwaka 1998.

eng: It also features the stories of women who witnessed the 1998 riots.
swa: Pia kitabu hicho kimebeba simulizi za wanawake walioshuhudia maandamano hayo ya mwaka 1998.

eng: Global Voices interviewed her about the novel and her motivation for initiating this project:
swa: Global Voices ilimuhoji kuhusu riwaya hiyo na kichocheo cha kuanzisha mradi huu:

eng: The Chinese Whispers was inspired by my personal experiences of how the May 1998 racial violence impacted my sense of identity as well as by the historical context of May 1998.
swa: Minong'ono ya Wachina ilichochewa na uzoefu wangu binafsi wa jinsi vurugu za kibaguzi za Mei 1998 zilivyoathiri maana ya utambulisho wangu pamoja na mazingira ya tukio hilo la kihistoria la Mei 1998.

eng: I noticed how 1998 became an important unspoken issue (among) Chinese Indonesian diaspora in Australia.
swa: Nilitambua jinsi suala la 1998 lilivyokuwa muhimu lakini lisilozumgumziwa miongoni mwa Waindonesia wenye asili ya China wanaoishi Australia.

eng: I can’t speak for other people’s experiences.
swa: Siwezi kuzungumzia uzoefu wa watu wengine lakini naweza kuzungumzia uzoefu wangu.

eng: But I can speak about mine. My family and I were spared from (the) 1998 looting, rape, and violence but we lived the era where we were subjected to politically motivated racism.
swa: Mimi na familia yangu tulisalimika katika ubakaji, uporaji na vurugu za 1998 lakini tumeishi katika kipindi ambacho tulikabiliwa na ubaguzi uliochochewa na siasa.

eng: Being raised unequivocally Indonesian, a proud one that is, the 1998 riot questioned my identity.
swa: Nikiwa nimelelewa kama Muindonesia kamili mwenye kujivunia nchi yake, vurugu za 1998 zilileta maswali juu ya utambulisho wangu.

eng: Through the Chinese Whispers, I want to reveal what politically motivated racism (PMR) could do to people, (and it) doesn’t matter how many years after it happened.
swa: Kupitia Minong'ono ya Wachina, nataka kuweka wazi jinsi ubaguzi unaochochewa na siasa unavyoweza kuwafanya watu (na) haijalishi imepita miaka mingapi tangu itokee.

eng: PMR has real human costs, not just in Indonesia but the entire world today.
swa: Ubaguzi unaochochewa na siasa unagharama kubwa kwa binadamu na sio tu kwa Indonesia bali kwa dunia yote leo.

eng: She explained why she chose the title ‘Chinese Whispers’ for her novel:
swa: Alifafanua ni kwa nini alichagua jina la riwaya yake kuwa 'Minong'ono ya Wachina':

eng: During the creative process with the community, we talked about many things and everything.
swa: Wakati wa shughuli za usanifu na jamii, tulizungumza kuhusu mambo mengi na kila kitu.

eng: Yet, when I brought up the events that took place in 1998, of our whereabouts and what not, the voices in the room were reduced to whispers.
swa: Lakini bado nilipoibua tukio lililotokea 1998 na kuhusu wapi na nini sicho, sauti ndani ya chumba zilififia na kuwa minong'ono.

eng: As a student of dramatic arts, I learned to observe tones, body languages, expressions.
swa: Kama mwanafunzi wa sanaa za maonesho, nimejifunza kuchunguza sauti, lugha na ishara za mwili.

eng: What I came across during the meetings and dramatic workshops, 1998 held a certain significance to the community. Many said that the 1998 riot is something taboo to talk about.
swa: Nilichokumbana nacho wakati wa mikutano na semina za sanaa za maonesho ni kwamba mwaka 1998 umeshika nafasi muhimu katika jamii Wengi walisema kuwa vurugu za 1998 ni kitu ambacho ni mwiko kukizungumzia.

eng: It remains sensitive, it’s hard to talk about the events, but taboo’s not the word to describe it.
swa: Limebaki kuwa jambo nyeti, ambalo ni vigumu kulizungumzia lakini mwiko halitoshi kuwa neno la kulielezea jambo hilo.

eng: And this is what she hopes her work will accomplish:
swa: Na hiki ndicho anachoamini kazi yake itafanya:

eng: One day I attended a poetry reading by Mark Gonzales, one of his poems reads “We cannot heal what we will not face.”
swa: Siku moja nilihudhuria usomaji wa mashairi wa Mark Gonzales na moja ya shairi lake lilisema "Hatuwezi kupona kile tusichokabiliana nacho".

eng: That rang true to me.
swa: Na hiki kilikuwa ukweli kwangu.

eng: 20 years on, 1998 is barely acknowledged.
swa: Ni miaka 20 sasa na mwaka 1998 ni vigumu kuukubali.

eng: There a lot of things to be done in terms of healing, to obtain some forms of justice.
swa: Kuna mambo mengi sana ya kufaywa kwa ajili ya uponyaji na kupata aina fulani ya haki.

eng: I’m not only talking about healing at the personal level, but also as a nation.
swa: Sizungumzii kuhusu kupona katika ngazi ya mtu binafsi pekee bali kwa Taifa pia.

eng: I want my readers to remember what 1998 entails and to be moved by the experiences of individuals who went through it.
swa: Nataka wasomaji wangu wakumbuke mwaka 1998 unahusu nini na pia kuguswa na uzoefu wa waliyoyapitia watu wengine.

eng: In my work, my 12-year-old persona experienced having her identity torn apart by politically motivated racism.
swa: Katika kazi yangu, muhusika wangu mmoja mwenye miaka 12 alikumbana na mkasa wa utambulisho wake kuchanwa chanwa na siasa za kibaguzi.

eng: I love how dramatic arts contributed in telling my personal stories.
swa: Napenda jinsi sanaa za maonyesho zilivyochangia kusimulia habari zangu binafsi.

eng: One of the pages of the Chinese Whispers.
swa: Ukurasa mmojawapo wa riwaya ya Minong'ono ya Wachina.

eng: Currently, the Chinese Whispers is available in Indonesian.
swa: Kwa sasa Minong'ono ya Wachina inapatikana Indonesia.

eng: Its English version is due out by the end of 2018.
swa: Tolea kwa lugha ya Kiingereza itapatikana mwishoni mwa mwaka 2018.

eng: Rani's work can be found on her website and she can be reached through her Facebook page and Instagram.
swa: Kazi ya Rani inapatikana katika tovuti yake na unaweza kumpata kupitia ukurasa wake wa Facebook na Instagram.

eng: Sorry, I don't speak English.
swa: Samahani, Siongei Kiingereza.

eng: Percussionist on the streets of Detroit, Michigan, United States of America.
swa: Mpiga ngoma akiwa katika mtaa wa Detroit, Michigan, Marekani.

eng: (Photograph by the author, published with permission).
swa: (Picha na mwandishi na imechapishwa kwa ruhusa).

eng: Talking about what it means to migrate can be difficult, but perhaps time or distance enables some to see the migration process more clearly as a whole comprised of a myriad of parts.
swa: Kuongelea maana ya kuhama kunaweza kuwa kugumu, labda muda au umbali huwasaidia kuona vizuri zaidi mchakato mzima wa kuhama kuwa una mambo mengi.

eng: Every migration story is unique, but these stories are also connected to things that transcend them and make them equal to other life stories.
swa: Kila hadithi ya kuhama ni pekee, lakini hujumuisha mambo ambayo hupitiwa wakati wa kuhama ambayo ni sawa na hadithi nyingine katika maisha..

eng: Could this advice be of any use to people who find themselves in the process of leaving their homes, or who have already left?
swa: Je, ushauri huu unaweza kuwa wa faida yoyote kwa watu wanaojikuta katika mchakato wa kuhama nyumbani kwao, au ambao tayari wameshahama?

eng: For these people there are no words strong enough to be of any comfort or counsel.
swa: Kwa watu hawa hakuna maneno yenye nguvu kiasi cha kuwa faraja yoyote au kuwa ushauri.

eng: No one is ever fully prepared to leave.
swa: Hakuna hata mmoja ambaye anakuwa amejindaa vizuri kuondoka.

eng: In the Venezuela that I left, I was part of a story shared by a whole group of people who required no explanation from me.
swa: Katika Venezuela ambapo niliondoka , nilikuwa sehemu ya hadithi iliyoongelewa na kundi zima la watu ambao hawakuhitaji maelezo kutoka kwangu.

eng: Everything was easy to read: the gestures, the routines, the dangers, the past and the prospects of a future—even if it was clouded by the fog of political instability.
swa: Kila kitu kilikuwa rahisi kukisoma: ishara, utaratibu, hatari, yaliyopita na yajao—hata kama yalikuwa yamefunikwa na ukungu wa hali mbaya ya kisiasa.

eng: Because personal and group identity were implicit in all our everyday activities, the questions of who am I or who are they did not exist for me.
swa: Kwa sababu utambulisho wa mtu binafsi na kundi ilikuwa wazi sana katika shughuli zetu za kila siku, maswali yamimi ni nani au wao ni akina nani hayakuwepo kwangu.

eng: At that time the rate of emigration from Venezuela had not yet reached the shocking figures that we are seeing today, and leaving still had romantic overtones: going away meant automatically doing well in that new land.
swa: Kipindi kilekiwango cha uhamaji kutoka Venezuela kilikuwa hakijafikia idadi ya kutisha kama tunayoiona leo, na kuhama kulikuwa bado ni mapenzi ya mtu: kwenda nje ilikuwa na maana ya moja kwa moja kuwa na maisha mazuri katika nchi hiyo mpya.

eng: The Venezuela that started to build itself in exile back in 1999 was very much misunderstood by the Venezuela that was left behind.
swa: Venezuela ambayo ilianza kujijenga uhamishoni tangu mwaka 1999 ilikuwa haikueleweka kwa wanavenezuela ambao walikuwa wameachwa nyuma.

eng: Grievances on the part of the emigrants in the face of their new living situation were not accepted by their fellow compatriots who, at the same time, were beginning to suffer what is recognized today as the worst political, economic and humanitarian crisis in the contemporary history of Venezuela.
swa: Manung’uniko ya wahamiaji juu ya hali ya maisha yao yalikuwa hayakubaliki na ndugu zao ambao muda huo walikuwa wanateseka na kile kinachojulikana leo kama hali mbaya ya kisiasa, kiuchumi na haki za binadamu katika historia ya sasa ya Venezuela.

eng: Because of this, emigrants were losing a say in matters: their political opinions of their country were minimized due to the distance and because the difficulties that stemmed from their change of life were not accepted as such.
swa: Kwa sababu hiyo, wahamiaji hawakuwa na la kusema juu ya tatizo lolote: maoni ya kisiasa ya nchi zao yalipuuzwa kutokana na umbali na ugumu uliotokana na mabadiliko ya maisha yao.

eng: The belief that a new country offered a life devoid of real difficulties, at least in comparison with the difficulties faced by those back in Venezuela, filled the imaginations of those watching them from home.
swa: Imani kuwa nchi mpya ingewapa maisha bila ya matatizo ukilinganisha na matatizo waliyokuwa wanayapata waliobaki Venezuela yalijaa kwenye mawazo ya wale waliokuwa wanawaangalia wakiwa nyumbani.

eng: And at the same time, the country receiving these immigrants did not consider the newcomers' criticism valid, far less accept them as true political actors.
swa: Wakati huo, nchi iliyowapokea wahamiaji haikujali ukosoaji na maoni yao kuwa ni haki, na zaidi haikuwaruhusu kufanya shughuli za kisiasa.

eng: The others, foreign realities and impenetrable worlds
swa: Hali nyingine halisi ya nje na nchi zisizoingilika

eng: I did not know any of the things I'm reflecting upon now when I first arrived in the United States in the summer of 2011.
swa: Mwaka 2011 kipindi cha kiangazi wakati ninawasili Marekani nilikuwa sijui chochote juu ya mambo ambayo ninayazungumzia sasa.

eng: At that time there was very little that I could say apart from some greetings and the necessary apology for not speaking English.
swa: Wakati ule kwa kushindwa kuongea lugha ya kiingereza, nilikuwa natamka maneno machache katika kusalimia na kuomba msamaha.

eng: (The option of calling friends who were still in Venezuela to get things off my chest was not an option). In order to establish any new communication, I needed my husband's help to write, read and translate what I was saying to to other people and then, in turn, translate what they were saying to me.
swa: (Chaguo la kuwaeleza rafiki zangu waliokuwa bado Venezuela haikuwa chaguo tena).Ili kuanzisha mazungumzo yoyote mapya, nilihitaji msaada wa mume wangu kuniandikia, kusoma na kutafsiri kile ambacho nilikuwa nawambia watu na halafu yeye akitafsiri kile walichosema.

eng: Photograph taken during the Detroit Jazz Festival.
swa: Picha iliyopigwa wakati wa tamasha la bendi ya Detroit.

eng: Behind this young woman, who looks directly at the camera without a trace of shyness, there is a religious protester speaking of forgiveness and repentance.
swa: Nyuma ya huyu mama kijana ambaye anaangalia kamera bila ya aibu, kuna mpingaji wa kidini anayezungumzia kusamehewa na kutubu.

eng: This is a stark contrast with the young woman who stopped in front of my camera and posed without me even having to ask her to do so.
swa: Hii ni kinyume kabisa kusimama mbele ya kamera yangu bila mimi kumuomba kufanya hivyo.

eng: (Photograph by the author, shared with permission).
swa: (Picha na mwandishi na imechapishwa kwa ruhusa.).

eng: This fear resulted in self-confinement at home, coupled with endless hours of total isolation.
swa: Uoga huu ulifanya kujifungia nyumbani, ukiambatana na upweke wa muda mrefu.

eng: When someone leaves his or her home country, even the most insignificant incident that occurs in contact with this other outside world can have an immense demoralizing power that can plunge anyone into the deepest of insecurities.
swa: Kadhia kubwa wakati mtu anapoondoka kutoka nchini mwake na ambayo inakatisha tamaa sana katika nchi ya ugenini inaweza kuwa kutumbukia katika hatari ya kukosekana kwa usalama kabisa.

eng: Hiding away is, therefore, one of the possible paths one can take, and this was precisely the one that I chose for quite some time.
swa: Kwa hiyo, kujificha mbali , kwa hiyo ni moja ya njia mtu anaweza kuchukua na hii ndiyo hakika niliyoitumia kwa muda mrefu.

eng: During this time of confinement, the windows of my home became my favorite camera.
swa: Kipindi hiki cha kufungiwa, madirisha ya nyumba yangu yalikuwa ndiyo kamera yangu niliyoipenda.

eng: These wide openings in the walls gave me the chance to get closer to the social dynamics that I considered impenetrable.
swa: Uwazi huu mkubwa wa madirisha ulinipa nafasi kuwa karibu na mambo mbalimbali ya kijamii ambayo niliyaona.

eng: Part of the fascination with observing others lies in the questions that arise from this encounter with a foreign reality.
swa: Sehemu ya kivutio katika kuwaangalia ipo kwenye maswali kuhusu ukweli wa ugenini.

eng: Likewise, the nature of the answers that emerge from such questions has the power to raise more unanswered questions.
swa: Pia, asili ya majibu yatolewayo kwa maswali hayo, huibua zaidi maswali yasiyojibika.

eng: By observing, wondering and reacting, I learned that the people I was observing were all very different from one another.
swa: kwa kuangalia, kushangaa na kufurahia, niligundua kwamba watu niliokuwa nawaangalia walikuwa wanatofautiana kutoka mtu mmoja hadi mwingine.

eng: While this world rich in differences was flourishing and expanding, my personal identity was diminishing.
swa: Wakati dunia hii yenye utajiri wa kutofautiana ulikuwa ukishamiri na kupanuka, kujulikana kwangu kulikuwa kunapungua.

eng: I was no longer seen as me, a person from the city of Barquisimeto, but instead as a person from Venezuela.
swa: Nilikuwa sijione tena kama natoka jiji la Barquismeto, badala yake kama mtu wa Venezuela.

eng: I even fell into a category that was as new as it was incomprehensible: I was a latina, the label that is supposed to define someone from Tierra del Fuego as being no different from someone from the city of Juárez in Mexico.
swa: Nilijikuta katika aina ya jamii ya watu wasioeleweka.I even fell into a category that was as new as it was incomprehensible: nilikuwa I was a latina, kitambulisho kinachopaswa kumuelezea mtu fulani kutoka Tierra del Fuego kutokuwa tofauti na mtu atokaye katika jiji la Juarez katika nchi ya Mexico.

eng: But I did gain something from all it: I realized that, almost without fail, neither the Venezuelans from here or from there, nor the Americans from anywhere in the country, reject the stories or products that come from encountering a photo or a photographer.
swa: Lakini kutokana na hayo yote nilifaidika kitu fulani.: nimetambua kuwa bila kushindwa, si wavenezuela kutoka hapa au kule, wala si wamarekani kutoka sehemu yoyote nchini anayeweza kukataa habari au matokeo yatokayo na picha au mpiga picha.

eng: This was something I learned when I decided to stop watching through my window and went out for the first time with my camera for company.
swa: Hili ndilo nililojifunza pindi nilipoamua kutoangalia kupitia dirisha langu na kwenda nje kwa mara ya kwanza na kamera yangu ya kampuni.

eng: And now the camera comes with me every time.
swa: Kila wakati sasa ninakuwa na kamera .

eng: Snippets of the world
swa: Dondoo za habari za dunia

eng: There is something transgressive in the simple act of taking a photograph.
swa: Kuna jambo limevuka mipaka katika kupiga picha.

eng: The image captured is the small trophy of a shrewd petty thief who becomes the owner of a snippet of the world that has been frozen.
swa: Picha iliyopigwa ni nyara ndogo ya mwizi mjanja aliyekuwa mhusika wa dondoo za habari dunia.

eng: The space of the streets contracts and all gestures become important, but for the purpose of recognizing the ones that would make me want to hide, but instead to try and gather them, to collect and understand them all in the still of the night, when reviewing the remaining photographs from the day.
swa: Nafasi ya mitaa ilikuwa finyu na ishara zilikuwa muhimu, lakini kwa nia ya kumjua aliyenifanya nijifiche, badala yake nilijaribu kuzikusanya na kuzielewa zote usiku, nilipokuwa narudia picha zilizobaki siku ile.

eng: I, who had remained cooped up for a number of years, all of a sudden found the courage to go out and face people with my camera.
swa: Mimi , niliyekuwa kizuizini kwa miaka mingi, ghafla nilipata ujasiri wa kutoka nje na kuwakabili watu kwa kamera yangu.

eng: When I was able to start reading, the short texts that appeared along the way were included in the scenes of some of the people on the street, something that served as a base and support to enhance these images.
swa: Nilipoanza kusoma vifungu vifupi vya maneno vilijumuishwa kwenye matukio ya maadhi ya watu, jambo ambalo lilikuwa msingi na lilisaidia kuongeza ubora wa picha.

eng: Ann Arbor, Michigan.
swa: Ann Arbor, Michigan.

eng: (Photograph by the author, shared with permission).
swa: (Picha na mwandishi na imechapishwa kwa ruhusa.).

eng: Even when my ability to communicate was still very limited, people would come and ask me to take their photographs.
swa: Hata wakati uwezo wangu wa kuwasiliana ulikuwa mdogo. Watu walikuwa wanakuja kuniomba niwapige picha.

eng: Having this kind of control in a situation like this, in which an individual belonging to this indifferent world, someone that in another time would have passed before my window without seeing me, is looking me directly in the eye, was a new way of experiencing being an immigrant.
swa: Ukiwa na aina hii ya uwezo katika hali hii ambayo upo katika nchi nyingine wakati muda mwingine mtu huyo angepita mbele ya dirisha langu bila kuniona na sasa ananiangalia moja kwa moja hii ilikuwa njia nyingene ya kupata uzoefu kama mhamiaji.

eng: It was also a small victory in the face of the insecurities with which all immigrants have to live.
swa: Pia ilikuwa kama ushindi mdogo wa kukabili ukosefu wa usalama ambao wahamiaji wote wanapaswa kuuishi.

eng: As a Venezuelan, and through my camera, I have built an image of the United States for myself—and for my own survival as well.
swa: Kama mvezuela na kupitia kamera yangu, nimejitengenezea picha ya Mareakani— na kwa maisha yangu pia.

eng: Sharing my images made it possible for me to get back to communicating by using a language that depended more on gestures than it did on voice.
swa: Kupiga na kugawa picha zangu kulifanya iwezekane kwangu kuwasiliana kwa kutumia lugha iliyotegemea ishara zaidi kuliko sauti.

eng: By using a camera I learned how to read this, my new world.
swa: Kwa kutumia kamera, nilijifunza namna ya kusoma dunia yangu mpya.

eng: I learned to speak, only not English or Spanish, but Photography.
swa: Nilijifunza kuzungumza sio kiingereza wala kispanishi, bali picha .

eng: And most importantly, I learned how to be looked in the eye once again.
swa: Na muhimu zaidi, mara nyingine nilijifunza namna ya kutazamwa kwa jicho .

eng: Photography was the bridge by which I discovered that I am the "other" in this country, but also that difference is good; so much so that there is nothing that can't be photographed, nothing that does not warrant the telling of a new story.
swa: Picha ilikuwa ni daraja ambalo kwalo niligundua kwamba mimi ni mtu mwingine katika nchi hii lakini pia kuwa tofauti ni vizuri; zaidi sana kwamba hakuna kisichoweza kupigwa picha na hakuna kisichoweza kutoa habari mpya.

eng: See more of Natali's photographs on Instagram.
swa: Zaidi angalia picha za Natali kwenye Instagram.

eng: Netizen Report: Who will be next?
swa: Taarifa ya raia mtandaoni: Nani Atafuata?

eng: Photo by Jamez42 via Wikimedia Commons (CC0)
swa: Picha na Jamez 42 kupitia Wikimedia Commons (CC0)

eng: Online censorship and repression of social media users are reaching new heights in Venezuela, where citizens continue to protest dire economic and public health conditions wrought by the country’s ongoing political crisis.
swa: Udhibiti mtandaoni na ukandamizaji wa watumiaji wa mitandao ya kijamii unafikia kilele kipya katika Venezuela ambapo wananchi wanaendelea na kupinga vikali uchumi na hali ya afya ya wananchi vilivyosabishwa na mgogoro wa kisiasa unaoendelea .

eng: It has become extraordinarily difficult for journalists to report the news, as they face regular accusations of “disturbing public order” or “threatening the revolution”.
swa: Imekuwa ni vigumu sana kwa waandishi wa habari kuchapisha habari kwa kuwa wanakabiliwa na kukamatwa mara kwa mara kwa “kuvuruga amani ya umma” au “kutishia mapinduzi”.

eng: Social media users who actively engage with a broad public on various civic issues are also being targeted.
swa: Watumiaji wa mitandao ya kijamii ambao wanajishughulisha na mambo mapana ya kiraia ya wananchi nao wamelengwa.

eng: In mid-May, popular Twitter user Pedro Jaimes, who offered climate, meteorological and air traffic reports to nearly 80,000 followers, went missing.
swa: Katikati ya mwezi Mei, Pedro Jaimes ambaye ni mtumiaji maarufu wa Twitter ambaye huchapisha habari juu ya utabiri wa hali ya hewa kwa wafuasi wapatao 80,000, alipotea .

eng: Shortly before his disappearance, Jaimes had tweeted about the pathway of an airplane carrying Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro, information that is available to the public through online news outlet Efecto Cocuyo.
swa: Muda mfupi kabla ya kupotea kwake Jaimes alituma ujumbe kupitia Tweetter kuhusu njia ya ndege iliyokuwa imembeba Rais Nicolas Maduro wa Venezuela, habari ambayo inapatikana kwa umma kupitia kituo cha habari mtandaoni cha Efecto Cocuyo.

eng: On June 15, more than a month after he went missing, Jaimes called family members to inform them that he had been detained inside El Helicoide, the military facility turned prison belonging to the Bolivarian National Intelligence Service (SEBIN).
swa: Tarehe 15 Juni, zaidi ya mwezi mmoja baada ya kutoonekna, Jaimes aliwapigia wanafamilia kuwataarifu kwamba alikuwa amewekwa kizuizini ndani ya El Helicoide ambacho ni kituo cha jeshi kiligeuzwa gereza na mali ya huduma ya taifa ya kiintelejensia ya Bolivaria. (SEBIN).

eng: Meanwhile, accessing basic information and communication platforms online is becoming ever-more difficult.
swa: Upatikanaji wa jukwaa la mawasiliano mtandaoni kwa sasa ni mgumu sana.

eng: With electrical grids faltering for lack of maintenance and periodically deactivated in an effort to ration energy, internet access is never a guarantee.
swa: Kususua kwa umeme wa gridi kutokana na ukosefu wa ukarabati na kutowashwa kwa muda katika harakati za mgao wa umeme umefanya upatikanaji wa mtandao kutokuaminika.

eng: Yet web-based news and communication systems are increasingly the only way that Venezuelans can exchange and obtain information independent of the state.
swa: Lakini bado habari za mtandaoni na mifumo ya mawasiliano vinahitajika sana kama njia pekee ya wanavenezuela kubadilishana na kupata habari ambazo sio za serikali.

eng: In early June, the websites of two major news outlets, La Patilla and El Nacional, were blocked, along with access points for the Tor Network, which enables internet users to circumvent online censorship.
swa: Mapema mwezi Juni tovuti ya vituo vikubwa vya habari ambavyo ni La Pitilla na El Nacional, vilifungwa , pamoja na mtandao wa Tor ambao huwezesha watumiaji wa mtandao kukwepa udhibiti wa mtandaoni.

eng: Major pornography websites have been blocked as well, in what may be an attempt to test the country’s online censorship capacity.
swa: Tovuti kubwa za picha za ngono zimefungwa nazo pia katika kile kinachoweza kuwa ni harakati za kujaribu uwezo wa kudhibiti mtandao wa taifa.

eng: In some countries, these types of measures have been a precursor to efforts to increase online censorship.
swa: Katika baadhi ya nchi hatua hizi zimekuwa zikitangulia katika harakati za kuongeza udhibiti mtandaoni.

eng: Palestinian journalists targeted with assault, mobile phone seizure
swa: Waandishi wapalestina wamelengwa kuvamiwa na kunyang’anywa simu za mkononi

eng: Journalists covering a labor rights protest in Gaza on June 19 reported to MADA (the Palestinian Center for Development and Media Freedom) that they were assaulted and had their mobile phones and cameras either confiscated or destroyed by uniformed people associated with the Hamas movement, which rules the Gaza Strip.
swa: Waandishi wa habri wanaochapisha habari za maandamano ya haki za kazi katika Gaza tarehe 19 Juni waliitaarifu MADA (kituo kwa maendeleo na uhuru wa vyombo vya habari Palestina) kwamba walivamiwa na simu za mkononi na kamera zao aidha kunyang’anywa au kuharibiwa na watu waliokuwa wamevaa sare wanahusiana na kikundi cha Hamas ambacho kinatawala ukanda wa Gaza.

eng: At a June 15 protest in the West Bank city of Ramallah, journalists reported that Palestinian Authority security forces used similar tactics in an effort to stop them from filming and reporting on the protest.
swa: Kwenye maandamano ya tarehe 15 katika mji wa West Bank, Ramallah, waandishi wa habari walitaarifu kuwa vikosi vya mamlaka ya usalama vya Palestina vilitumia mbinu zilezile katka jitihada za kuwakataza kupiga picha na kutochapisha habari juu ya maandamano hayo.

eng: Nigerian student suspended for lamenting school’s poor infrastructure
swa: Mwanafunzi wa Nigeria asimamishwa masomo kwa kulalamia miundo mbinu ya shule

eng: Kunle Adebajo, a law student at Nigeria’s University of Ibadan, was suspended for two semesters for writing an article that was deemed critical of the university administration.
swa: Kunle Adebajo, mwanafunzi anayesomea sheria katika Chuo kikuu cha Ibadan Nigeria alisimamishwa mihula mbili ya masomo kwa kuandika habari ambayo iliyoonekana ni kali kwa uongozi wa chuo.

eng: On April 20, Kunle Adebajo wrote an opinion article, “UI: The irony of fashionable rooftops and awful interiors”, which described the deplorable state of infrastructure in student residences in his university.
swa: Tarehe 20 mwezi Aprili, Kunle Adebajo aliandika waraka wenye maoni, “juu ya hali ya kutisha ya paa na vyumba ”, ambapo ilieleza hali ya kusikitisha ya miundo mbinu ya mahali wanapoishi wanafunzi katika chuo kikuu hicho chake.

eng: University administrators then summoned Adebajo to a disciplinary panel, which described Adebayo's article as “rude, defamatory and insubordinate” and issued his suspension.
swa: Uongozi wa chuo ulimuita Adebajo kwenye kamati ya nidhamu ambayo ilieleza waraka wa debajo kuwa “ni wakukejeri, kashfa na kudharau uongozi” na kamati ilimsimamisha masomo.

eng: In an article for Sahara Reporters, Fisayo Soyombo, an award-winning investigative journalist and an alumnus of University of Ibadan, described the disciplinary action against Adebajo as “a clear uppercut on press freedom.”
swa: Katika taarifa ya waandishi wa habari wa Sahara, Fisayo Soyombo ambaye ni mshindi wa tuzo ya mwandishi wa habari za uchunguzi na mmoja wa wanafunzi waliomaliza chuo kikuu cha Ibadan, alieleza hatua ya kinidhamu iliyochukuliwa dhidi ya Adebajo kama ni “kunyamanzisha waziwazi uhuru wa kutoa maoni.”

eng: Cuban authorities revoke press credentials from renowned blogger
swa: Mamlaka za Cuba zafuta sifa za vyombo vya habari na bloga mashuhuri

eng: Veteran blogger and former BBC correspondent Fernando Ravsberg, an Uruguayan journalist who has made his home in Cuba since the late 1990s, was denied press credentials by Cuban media regulators for the first time.
swa: Mwanabloga wa zamani na mwanahabari wa zamani wa BBC Fernando Ravsberg ambaye ni mwandishi murugwai wa habari na ambaye amehamishia makao yake hapa Cuba tangu mwishoni mwa mwaka 1990 kwa mara ya kwanza alinyimwa sifa na masharti ya kuanzisha chombo cha habari na mamlaka za kudhibiti vyombo vya habari Cuba.

eng: Ravsberg had long used earnings from his work as an accredited foreign journalist to support his popular blog “Cartas desde Cuba” (Letters from Cuba), where he writes critical commentary about public life and politics in Cuba, and where a single post regularly garners hundreds of comments from readers.
swa: Ravsberg kwa muda mrefu alitumia mapato aliyoyapata kutoka katika kazi yake kama mwandishi wa habari kutoka nje kuimarisha blogu yake mashuhuri inayojulikana kama “barua kutoka Cuba” (Cartas desde Cuba), ambapo huandika habari za kisiasa na maisha ya wananchi wa Cuba alizozifafanua vizuri, na mara nyingi akituma habari mara moja hupata maoni miamoja hivi kutoka kwa wasomaji.

eng: Ravsberg reflected on the move in his own words:
swa: Hatua hiyo, Ravsberg aliiakisi katika maneno yake mwenyewe :

eng: Over these past 10 years, they have tried to tame me with kind words of advice, hidden threats, with breaking my teeth, demanding that I be expelled from the country, and ‘warnings’ directed at my children.
swa: kwa miaka kumi iliyopita, wamenifunga kwa maneno mazuri ya ushauri, vitisho vilivyofichika na kuchekesha meno yangu , wakidai wanifukuze nchi na ‘maonyo’ yaliyoelekezwa kwa watoto wangu.

eng: None of this has worked until now, but removing my foreign media credentials has allowed them to give Cartas a coup de grace.
swa: Hakuna hata moja katika haya ambalo mpaka sasa limetekelezwa, lakini kuondoa sifa zangu za vyombo vya habari zimewaruhusu kuiua Cartas.

eng: In Nicaragua, pro-government forces seem to be changing peoples’ WiFi network names
swa: Katika Nicaragua vyombo vya serikali vinaonekana kubadili majina ya mitandao wa WIFI

eng: With anti-government protests still raging in Nicaragua, hundreds of people reported in mid-June that their SSID (their Wi-Fi network names) had spontaneously changed in the middle of the night.
swa: Kutokana na maandamano dhidi ya serikali bado kuwa makali katika Nicaragua, mamia ya watu wametaarifu kuwa katikati ya mwezi Juni majina yao ya mtandao wa WIFI yalibadilishwa bila ya hiari yao usiku wa manane.

eng: All of those reporting the change were subscribers to Claro, a subsidiary of the Mexican telecommunications giant América Móvil.
swa: Hao wote wanaotaarifu mabadiliko ni wale waliojiunga na Claro ambayo ni kampuni tanzu ya Kampuni kubwa ya mawasiliano ya Mexico ya America Movil.

eng: This message has been used consistently, and as a social media hashtag, by government actors and supporters online.
swa: Ujumbe huu umetumika na maafisa wa serikali na waunga mkono mtandao mara kwa mara kama alama ya mitandao ya kijamii.

eng: Barricades have been popping around the country in an effort to pressure President Daniel Ortega to leave power and protect communities from state violence.
swa: Ukandamizaji umekuwa unaendelea karibu nchi nzima katika juhudi za kushinikiza Rais Daniel Ortega awalinde wananchi na nguvu kubwa unayotumiwa na serikali.

eng: A mobile phone access initiative is offering free mobile phones to female heads of household living below the poverty line in the northeast Indian state of Chhattisgarh.
swa: Kuna mpango wa upatikanaji wa simu za mkononi ambao unatoa simu za mkononi bure kwa wanawake wenye familia wanaoishi chini ya kiwango cha umaskini kaskazini mwa India katika jimbo la Chhattisgarh.

eng: An investigation by independent news site Scroll.in showed that participants have not been told how the government might use their Aadhaar numbers.
swa: Uchunguzi uliofanywa na chombo cha habari cha kujitegemea cha Scroll.in unaonesha kuwa washiriki hawajaambiwa jinsi serikali inavyoweza ikatumia namba zao za Aadhaar.

eng: 2018 thematic report to the UN Human Rights Council on content regulation - David Kaye, UN Special Rapporteur on the promotion and protection of the right to freedom of opinion and expression Digital News Report 2018 - Reuters Institute
swa: Taarifa ya mwaka 2018 kwa Halmashauri ya Haki za Binadamu ya Umoja wa Mataifa juu ya sheria ya Maudhui - David Kaye, mwanahabari maalumu wa Umoja wa Matiafa juu ya kulinda na kuimarisha haki ya uhuru wa kutoa maoni na kujieleza taarifa ya habari za Kidijitali ya mwaka 2018 - Taasisi ya Reuters

eng: Ellery Roberts Biddle, Marianne Diaz, L. Finch, Oiwan Lam, Laura Vidal and Sarah Myers West contributed to this report.
swa: Ellery Roberts Biddle, Marianne Diaz, L. Finch, Oiwan Lam, Laura Vidal na Sarah Myers West wamechangia taarifa hii.

eng: A newsstand advertising The Citizen, an independent newspaper in Dar Es Salaam, Tanzania.
swa: Kibanda cha kuuzia Gazeti la Citizen, gazeti la kujitegemea Dar Es Salaam, Tanzania.

eng: Photo by Adam Jones via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0)
swa: Picha na Adam Jones kupitia Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0)

eng: The Advox Netizen Report offers an international snapshot of challenges, victories, and emerging trends in Internet rights around the world.
swa: Taarifa ya raia mtandaoni ya Advox inaangazia taswira ya kimataifa juu ya changamoto, ushindi na mienendo inayoibuka katika haki za kimtandao duniani.

eng: With elections approaching in July, Cambodia’s National Election Committee has published a set of plans intended to monitor and control online news.
swa: Wakati uchaguzi ukikaribia mwezi ujao wa Julai kamati ya uchaguzi ya taifa Cambodia imetangaza mipango kadhaa inayotarajiwa kudhibiti habari mtandaoni .

eng: A new inter-ministry working group, formed to investigate media outlets deemed to be spreading “fake news”, has put forth a new regulation that bans journalists from including “personal opinion or prejudice” in their reporting, publishing news that “affects political and social stability”, conducting interviews at polling stations or broadcasting news that could sow “confusion and loss of confidence” in the election.
swa: Kikundi kipya cha kazi baina ya wizara kiliundwa kuchunguza vyombo vya habari vinavyosambaza “habari za uongo”, kimetoa sheria mpya ambayo inawafungia waandishi wa habari kama watatoa “habari za chuki au maoni yao” katika kuhabarisha, kuchapisha habari ambazo zinaathiri, “utulivu wa kisiasa na kijamii”, kuendesha mahojiano kwenye vituo vya kupigia kura au kutangaza habari “ambayo inachochea vurugu au kupoteza kujiamini” katika uchaguzi.

eng: Violations are punishable by fines of up to USD $7,355.
swa: Uvunjaji wa sheria adhabu yake ni faini ya dola za kimarekeni 7,355.

eng: The Ministry of Information will be empowered to censor websites and social media pages found in violation of the regulation.
swa: Wizara ya habari itawezeshwa kufanya sensa ya tovuti na mitandao ya kijamii zitakazokuwa zinavunja sheria.

eng: Internet service providers will be required to install software that enables the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications to “easily filter or block any websites, accounts or social media pages that are deemed illegal”.
swa: Watoa huduma za mtandaoni watatakiwa kufunga programu ambayo itaiwezesha wizara ya posta na mawasiliano “kuchuja kirahisi au kuzuia tovuti yoyote, akaunti au kurasa za mitandao ya kijamii ambazo ni haramu”.

eng: After receiving crippling tax bills, the Daily ceased its operations in September 2017, while the Post's owner sold the newspaper.
swa: Baada ya kupokea bili ya kodi kubwa, gazeti la Daily lilisimamisha shughuli zake mwezi Septemba 2017, wakati mmilki alipoliuza.

eng: The publication now belongs to Sivakumar S Ganapathy, who is the managing director of a Malaysia-based ASIA PR company that has worked on behalf of Cambodia’s ruling party and Prime Minister Hun Sen.
swa: Sasa machapisho yanamilikiwa na Sivakumar s Ganapathy ambaye ni Mkurugenzi Mtendaji wa Kampuni ya ASIA PR ya Malaysia ambayo inafanya kazi kwa niaba ya chama tawala na waziri mkuu Hun Sen wa Cambodia.

eng: Meanwhile in Tanzania, a much-maligned “blogger tax” goes into effect on June 15, and will require bloggers and independent website owners to register and pay roughly $900 USD per year to publish online.
swa: Wakati huo, “kodi mbaya ya wanablogu” Tanzania itaanza kutumika tarehe 15 mwezi Juni na wanablogu na wamilki wa tovuti watahitajika kujiandikisha na kulipa kiasi kipatacho dola za kimarekani 900 hivi kwa mwaka ili kuweza kuchapisha habari mtandaoni.

eng: The extremely popular Jamii Forums — which has been dubbed both the “Tanzanian Reddit” and “Swahili Wikileaks” — has shut itself down last week on grounds that the law creates insurmountable regulatory barriers for sites like Jamii.
swa: Jamii Forums ambayo ni mashuhuri sana — ambayo imepewa majina ya “Reddit ya Tanzania” na “Wikileaks ya kiswahili” — limefunga shughuli zake wiki iliyopita kwa sababu ya sheria ina vikwazo kwa vituo kama cha Jamii Forums.

eng: Reporters Without Borders has called on the government to scrap the new regulation.
swa: Umoja wa waandishi wasiokuwa na mipaka umeomba serikali kurekebisha sheria hiyo mpya.

eng: Bangladeshi secular writer and activist assassinated in public
swa: Mwanaharakati na mwandishi wa kujitegemea Bangladeshi auawa mbele ya umma

eng: Bangladeshi secular writer Shahzahan Bachchu was shot and killed near his home town of Munshiganj.
swa: Mwandishi wa kujitegemea Bangladeshi, Shahzahan Bachchu alipigwa risasi na kuuawa karibu na mji wa Munshiganj anamoishi.

eng: Bachchu was known as an outspoken activist for secularism, and printed poetry and books on humanism and free thought.
swa: Bachchu alijulikana sana kama mwanaharakati anayetetea dini isiwe msingi wa utawala, na alichapisha shairi na vitabu juu ya ubinadamu na mawazo huru.

eng: He was reportedly dragged out of a pharmacy and gunned down by men on motorcycles.
swa: Alilipotiwa kuwa ameburuzwa nje kidogo ya duka la dawa na kupigwa risasi na waendesha pikipiki.

eng: Bachchu’s death follows a series of attacks on humanists and freethinkers in Bangladesh, including the murders of writers and digital advocates Avijit Roy, Washiqur Rahman, Ananto Bijoy Das and Niloy Neel, among others. In the past, government officials including the prime minister Sheikh Hasina have blamed the attacks on atheists for criticizing religion.
swa: Kifo cha Bachchu kinafuatia mfululizo wa kuvamiwa wanaharakati wa haki za binadamu na wenye mawazo huru katika Bangladesh pamoja na kuuawa waandishi na mwakili wa digitali kama Avijit Roy, Washiqur Rahman, Ananto Bijoy Das, Niloy Neel na wengine. siku za nyuma, maafisa wa serikali akiwemo waziri mkuu Sheikh Hasina walilaumu kuvamiwa kwa wanaokufuru Mungu kwa kukosoa dini.

eng: Algerian blogger gets 10 years in prison for video interview
swa: Mwanabloga Mualjeria afungwa miaka 10 kwa sababu ya mahojiano ya video

eng: Algerian blogger Merzoug Touati was sentenced to ten years in prison in late May for reporting online about austerity strikes, job protests, and human rights violations.
swa: Mwanabloga ambaye ni mualjeria Merzoug Touati alifungwa miaka kumi jela mwishoni mwa mwezi Mei kwa kutoa habari mtandaoni juu ya mgomo mkali, kugoma kazini na uvunjaji wa haki za binadamu.

eng: Touati, who has been in jail since January 2017, was convicted of providing “intelligence to agents of a foreign power likely to harm Algeria’s military or diplomatic position or essential economic interests” after posting an interview with an Israeli official online.
swa: Touati ambaye amekuwa jela tangu Januari 2017 anashtakiwa kwa kutoa taarifa za “kiintelejensia kwa wakala wa nchi moja ya nje ili idhuru jeshi la Algeria au uwezo wa kidiplomasia au faida ya kiuchumi” baada ya kutuma mtandaoni mahojiano na afisa wa Israel.

eng: Touati is expected to appeal the sentence.
swa: Touati anatarajia kukata rufaa kwa hukumu hiyo.

eng: Facebook user in India arrested for complaining about poor infrastructure
swa: Mtumiaji wa facebook alikamatwa kwa kulaumu miundombinu mibovu

eng: A man from Kerala, India was arrested by police after writing a Facebook post about a damaged road, calling on a local politician to repair it.
swa: Mtu mmoja kutoka Kerala India, alikamatwa na polisi baada ya kuandika kwenye Facebook kuhusu barabara iliyoharibika na kuomba mwanasiasa aikarabati.

eng: The politician alleged that the post was “defamatory” and that insulted her gender and religion.
swa: Mwanasiasa alidai kuwa taarifa ile ni “kashifa” na kwamba ametukana jinsia na dini yake.
